tīrthayātrāprasaṅgena svāgataṃ sūtamabruvan //
meaning:
/
नैमिषे हरिमीजाना ऋषयः शौनकादयः /
/
तीर्थयात्राप्रसङ्गेन स्वागतं सूतमब्रुवन् //
text_mt:
In the Naimiṣa forest, sages headed by Śaunaka, worshiping Hari,
spoke to the Sūta who had arrived in the course of his pilgrimage to sacred fords:

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ
sūta tvaṃ pūjito 'smābhiḥ sārātsāraṃ vadasva naḥ /
yena vijñānamātreṇa(2) sarvajñatvaṃ prajāyate //
meaning:
ऋषय ऊचुः
सूत त्वं पूजितो ऽस्माभिः सारात्सारं वदस्व नः /
येन विज्ञानमात्रेण(2) सर्वज्ञत्वं प्रजायते //
text_mt:
The sages said:
O Sūta, you have been honored by us; declare to us the quintessential essence,
by the mere realization of which omniscience arises.

sanskrit_iast:
sūta uvāca
sārātsāro hi bhagavān viṣṇuḥ sargādikṛdvibhuḥ /
brahmāhamasmi taṃ jñātvā sarvajñatvaṃ prajāyate //
meaning:
सूत उवाच
सारात्सारो हि भगवान् विष्णुः सर्गादिकृद्विभुः /
ब्रह्माहमस्मि तं ज्ञात्वा सर्वज्ञत्वं प्रजायते //
text_mt:
The Sūta said:
The quintessential essence is the blessed Lord Viṣṇu, the all-pervading creator of creation and the rest.
Having known him—'I am Brahman'—omniscience arises.

sanskrit_iast:
dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma paraṃ ca yat(3) /
dve vidye veditavye hi iti cātharvaṇī śrutiḥ //
meaning:
द्वे ब्रह्मणी वेदितव्ये शब्दब्रह्म परं च यत्(3) /
द्वे विद्ये वेदितव्ये हि इति चाथर्वणी श्रुतिः //
text_mt:
'Two Brahmans are to be known: the Brahman as sound and that which is supreme;
two sciences are indeed to be known'—so states the revelation of the Atharvaveda.

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ śukaś ca pailādyā gatvā vadarikāśramam /
vyāsaṃ natvā pṛṣṭavantaḥ so 'smān sāramathābravīt //
meaning:
अहं शुकश् च पैलाद्या गत्वा वदरिकाश्रमम् /
व्यासं नत्वा पृष्टवन्तः सो ऽस्मान् सारमथाब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Having gone to Badarikāśrama, I, Śuka, Paila, and the others,
bowed to Vyāsa and questioned him; he then spoke the essence to us.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāsa uvāca
śukādyaiḥ śṛṇu sūta tvaṃ vaśiṣṭho māṃ yathābravīt(5) /
brahmasāraṃ hi pṛcchantaṃ munibhiś ca parātparam //
:n
1 lakṣmīmiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 yadabravīditi kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 1
meaning:
व्यास उवाच
शुकाद्यैः शृणु सूत त्वं वशिष्ठो मां यथाब्रवीत्(5) /
ब्रह्मसारं हि पृच्छन्तं मुनिभिश् च परात्परम् //
:न्
1 लक्ष्मीमिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 यदब्रवीदिति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 1
text_mt:
Vyāsa said:
O Sūta, listen, together with Śuka and the rest, to how Vasiṣṭha spoke to me,
as I and the sages questioned him about the essence of Brahman, the highest of the high.
[Notes]
1. "lakṣmīm" is the variant reading in manuscript 'gha'.
4 The reading in the two manuscripts kha and gha is 'yadabravīt'.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
dvaividhyaṃ brahma(1) vakṣyāmi śṛṇu vyāsākhilānugam(2) /
yathāgnirmāṃ purā prāha munibhirdaivataiḥ saha //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
द्वैविध्यं ब्रह्म(1) वक्ष्यामि शृणु व्यासाखिलानुगम्(2) /
यथाग्निर्मां पुरा प्राह मुनिभिर्दैवतैः सह //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
I shall explain the two kinds of brahman; listen, Vyāsa, to that which pervades all,
just as Agni told me formerly along with the sages and the gods:

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇaṃ paramāgneyaṃ brahmavidyākṣaraṃ param /
ṛgvedādyaparaṃ brahma sarvadevasukhāvaham(3) //
meaning:
पुराणं परमाग्नेयं ब्रह्मविद्याक्षरं परम् /
ऋग्वेदाद्यपरं ब्रह्म सर्वदेवसुखावहम्(3) //
text_mt:
the supreme Āgneya Purāṇa, the supreme imperishable knowledge of brahman,
and the lower brahman consisting of the Ṛgveda and the rest, which brings happiness to all the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
agninoktaṃ purāṇam yad āgneyaṃ brahmasammitam(4) /
bhuktimuktipradaṃ divyaṃ(5) paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ nṛṇām //
meaning:
अग्निनोक्तं पुराणम् यद् आग्नेयं ब्रह्मसम्मितम्(4) /
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं दिव्यं(5) पठतां शृण्वतां नृणाम् //
text_mt:
The Purāṇa spoken by Agni, which is the Āgneya, commensurate with brahman,
bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation, divine, upon men who read and listen [to it].

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgnirūpiṇam viṣṇuṃ jyotirbrahma parātparam /
munibhiḥ pṛṣṭavān devaṃ pūjitaṃ jñānakarmabhiḥ //
meaning:
कालाग्निरूपिणम् विष्णुं ज्योतिर्ब्रह्म परात्परम् /
मुनिभिः पृष्टवान् देवं पूजितं ज्ञानकर्मभिः //
text_mt:
Together with the sages, [Vasiṣṭha] questioned the god, Viṣṇu in the form of the fire of destruction,
the radiant brahman, higher than the highest, worshipped through knowledge and ritual works.

sanskrit_iast:
vasiṣṭha uvāca
saṃsārasāgarottāra- nāvaṃ brahmeśvaraṃ vada /
vidyāsāraṃ yadviditvā(6) sarvajño jāyate naraḥ //
meaning:
वसिष्ठ उवाच
संसारसागरोत्तार- नावं ब्रह्मेश्वरं वद /
विद्यासारं यद्विदित्वा(6) सर्वज्ञो जायते नरः //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Speak of the boat to cross the ocean of saṃsāra, the lord of brahman,
the essence of knowledge, having known which a man becomes omniscient.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
viṣṇuḥ kālāgnirudro 'haṃ(7) vidyāsāraṃ vadāmi te /
vidyāsāraṃ purāṇaṃ(8) yat sarvaṃ sarvasya kāraṇaṃ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
विष्णुः कालाग्निरुद्रो ऽहं(7) विद्यासारं वदामि ते /
विद्यासारं पुराणं(8) यत् सर्वं सर्वस्य कारणं //
text_mt:
Agni said:
I am Viṣṇu, Kālāgnirudra; I will tell you the essence of knowledge,
the Purāṇa which is the essence of knowledge, the all, the cause of everything,

sanskrit_iast:
sargasya pratisargasya vaṃśamanvantarasya ca /
vaṃśānucaritādeś ca, matsyakūrmādirūpadhṛk //
meaning:
सर्गस्य प्रतिसर्गस्य वंशमन्वन्तरस्य च /
वंशानुचरितादेश् च, मत्स्यकूर्मादिरूपधृक् //
text_mt:
of creation, secondary creation, lineage, cosmic era of a Manu,
and the dynastic chronicles, bearing the forms of the Fish, the Tortoise, and others.

sanskrit_iast:
dve vidye bhagavān viṣṇuḥ parā caivāparā ca ha /
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvākhyā vedāṅgāni ca ṣaḍ dvija(9) //
:n
1 dve vidye brahma iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 akhilātmagamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 sarvavedamukham paramiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
9 yad dvija iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 2
meaning:
द्वे विद्ये भगवान् विष्णुः परा चैवापरा च ह /
ऋग्यजुःसामाथर्वाख्या वेदाङ्गानि च षड् द्विज(9) //
:न्
1 द्वे विद्ये ब्रह्म इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अखिलात्मगमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 सर्ववेदमुखम् परमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
9 यद् द्विज इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 2
text_mt:
There are two knowledges, Lord Viṣṇu: the higher and indeed the lower;
the Ṛg, Yajur, Sāma, and Atharva, and the six ancillary limbs of the Veda, O twice-born:
[Footnote]
1 The reading in manuscript gha is 'dve vidye brahma'.
2 The reading in manuscript kha is 'akhilātmagam'.
3 The reading in manuscript kha is 'sarvavedamukham param'.
9 The reading in manuscript kha is 'yad dvija'.

sanskrit_iast:
śikṣā kalpo vyākaraṇaṃ niruktaṃ jyotiṣāṅgatiḥ /
chando 'bhidhānaṃ mīmāṃsā dharmaśāstraṃ purāṇakam //
meaning:
शिक्षा कल्पो व्याकरणं निरुक्तं ज्योतिषाङ्गतिः /
छन्दो ऽभिधानं मीमांसा धर्मशास्त्रं पुराणकम् //
text_mt:
phonetics, ritual theory, grammar, etymology, the movements of astronomy,
metrics, lexicography, hermeneutics, legal treatises, and the Purāṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
nyāyavaidyakagāndharvaṃ dhanurvedo 'rthaśāstrakam /
apareyaṃ parā vidyā yayā brahmābhigamyate(1) //
meaning:
न्यायवैद्यकगान्धर्वं धनुर्वेदो ऽर्थशास्त्रकम् /
अपरेयं परा विद्या यया ब्रह्माभिगम्यते(1) //
text_mt:
logic, medicine, music, archery, and statecraft—
this is the lower; the higher knowledge is that by which brahman is attained:

sanskrit_iast:
yattadadṛśyamagrāhyam agotracaraṇam dhruvam(2) /
viṣṇunoktaṃ yathā mahyaṃ devebhyo brahmaṇā purā /
tathā te kathayiṣyāmi hetuṃ matsyādirūpiṇam //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye praśno nāma prathamodhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
matsyāvatāravarṇanaṃ
meaning:
यत्तददृश्यमग्राह्यम् अगोत्रचरणम् ध्रुवम्(2) /
विष्णुनोक्तं यथा मह्यं देवेभ्यो ब्रह्मणा पुरा /
तथा ते कथयिष्यामि हेतुं मत्स्यादिरूपिणम् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये प्रश्नो नाम प्रथमोध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्वितीयो ऽध्यायः
मत्स्यावतारवर्णनं
text_mt:
that which is invisible, ungraspable, without lineage or limbs, constant.
As it was spoken by Viṣṇu to me, [and] formerly by Brahmā to the gods,
so I shall relate to you the cause, having the form of the Fish and other [incarnations].
Thus ends the first chapter, named 'The Inquiry', in the Ādi-Mahāpurāṇa Āgneya.
Now the second chapter.
Description of the Fish Incarnation.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśiṣṭha uvāca
matsyādirūpiṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ brūhi sargādikāraṇam /
purāṇaṃ brahma cāgneyaṃ yathā viṣṇoḥ purā śrutam //
meaning:
वशिष्ठ उवाच
मत्स्यादिरूपिणं विष्णुं ब्रूहि सर्गादिकारणम् /
पुराणं ब्रह्म चाग्नेयं यथा विष्णोः पुरा श्रुतम् //
text_mt:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Tell of Viṣṇu in the form of the Fish and others, the cause of creation and the rest,
and the Āgneya Purāṇa, which is brahman, just as was heard formerly from Viṣṇu.
title: vijñātamātreṇa iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
matsyāvatāraṃ vakṣye 'haṃ vasiṣṭha śṛṇu vai hareḥ /
avatārakriyā duṣṭa- naṣṭyai satpālanāya hi //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
मत्स्यावतारं वक्ष्ये ऽहं वसिष्ठ शृणु वै हरेः /
अवतारक्रिया दुष्ट- नष्ट्यै सत्पालनाय हि //
text_mt:
Agni said:
I shall speak of the Fish incarnation of Hari; listen, Vasiṣṭha!
For the act of incarnation is for the destruction of the wicked and the protection of the good.

sanskrit_iast:
āsīdatītakalpānte brāhmo naimittiko layaḥ /
samudropaplutāstatra lokā bhūrādikā mune //
meaning:
आसीदतीतकल्पान्ते ब्राह्मो नैमित्तिको लयः /
समुद्रोपप्लुतास्तत्र लोका भूरादिका मुने //
text_mt:
At the end of the past kalpa, there was the occasional dissolution pertaining to Brahmā;
there, O sage, the worlds beginning with the earth were submerged by the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
manurvaivasvatastepe tapo vai bhuktimuktaye /
ekadā kṛtamālāyāṃ kurvato jalatarpaṇaṃ //
meaning:
मनुर्वैवस्वतस्तेपे तपो वै भुक्तिमुक्तये /
एकदा कृतमालायां कुर्वतो जलतर्पणं //
text_mt:
Manu Vaivasvata performed ascetic austerity indeed for worldly enjoyment and liberation.
Once, as he was making a water oblation in the Kṛtamālā river,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāñjalyudake matsyaḥ svalpa eko 'bhyapadyata /
kṣeptukāmaṃ jale prāha na māṃ kṣipa narottama(3) //
:n
2 agotracaraṇaṃ paramiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 na māṃ kṣipa nṛpottama iti kha, ga, gha,
cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
:p 3
meaning:
तस्याञ्जल्युदके मत्स्यः स्वल्प एको ऽभ्यपद्यत /
क्षेप्तुकामं जले प्राह न मां क्षिप नरोत्तम(3) //
:न्
2 अगोत्रचरणं परमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 न मां क्षिप नृपोत्तम इति ख, ग, घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
:प् 3
text_mt:
into the water in his hollowed palms a small fish came.
To him who wished to throw it into the water, it said: 'Do not throw me, O best of men!
[Footnote]
2 The reading in manuscript ga is 'agotracaraṇaṃ param'.
3 The reading in the three manuscripts kha, ga, and gha is 'na māṃ kṣipa nṛpottama'.

sanskrit_iast:
p>grāhādibhyo bhayaṃ me 'dya(1) tac chrutvā kalaśe 'kṣipat /
sa tu vṛddhaḥ punarmatsyaḥ prāha taṃ dehi me vṛhat //
meaning:
प्>ग्राहादिभ्यो भयं मे ऽद्य(1) तच् छ्रुत्वा कलशे ऽक्षिपत् /
स तु वृद्धः पुनर्मत्स्यः प्राह तं देहि मे वृहत् //
text_mt:
Today I fear crocodiles and the like.' Hearing that, he placed it in a jar.
That fish, however, having grown, said to him again: 'Give me a large

sanskrit_iast:
sthānametadvacaḥ śrutvā rājāthodañcane 'kṣipat /
tatra vṛddho 'bravīdbhūpaṃ pṛthu dehi padaṃ mano //
meaning:
स्थानमेतद्वचः श्रुत्वा राजाथोदञ्चने ऽक्षिपत् /
तत्र वृद्धो ऽब्रवीद्भूपं पृथु देहि पदं मनो //
text_mt:
place.' Hearing these words, the king then cast it into a water vessel.
There, having grown, it said to the king: 'Give me a wide place, O Manu!'

sanskrit_iast:
sarovare punaḥ kṣipto vavṛdhe tatpramāṇavān /
ūce dehi vṛhat sthānaṃ(2) prākṣipaccāmbudhau tataḥ(3) //
meaning:
सरोवरे पुनः क्षिप्तो ववृधे तत्प्रमाणवान् /
ऊचे देहि वृहत् स्थानं(2) प्राक्षिपच्चाम्बुधौ ततः(3) //
text_mt:
Cast then into a lake, it grew to the measure of that [lake].
It said: 'Give me a large place.' Then he threw it into the ocean.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣayojanavistīrṇaḥ kṣaṇamātreṇa so 'bhavat /
matsyaṃ tamadbhutaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitaḥ prābravīn manuḥ //
meaning:
लक्षयोजनविस्तीर्णः क्षणमात्रेण सो ऽभवत् /
मत्स्यं तमद्भुतं दृष्ट्वा विस्मितः प्राब्रवीन् मनुः //
text_mt:
In merely an instant, it became one hundred thousand yojanas wide.
Seeing that wondrous fish, Manu, astonished, spoke:

sanskrit_iast:
ko bhavān nanu vai viṣṇur(4) nārāyaṇa namostute /
māyayā mohayasi māṃ kimarthaṃ tvaṃ janārdana //
meaning:
को भवान् ननु वै विष्णुर्(4) नारायण नमोस्तुते /
मायया मोहयसि मां किमर्थं त्वं जनार्दन //
text_mt:
'Who are you? Surely you are Viṣṇu! O Nārāyaṇa, praise be to you!
Why do you delude me with your māyā, O Janārdana?'

sanskrit_iast:
manunokto 'bravīnmatsyo manuṃ vai pālane ratam /
avatīrṇo bhavāyāsya jagato duṣṭanaṣṭaye //
meaning:
मनुनोक्तो ऽब्रवीन्मत्स्यो मनुं वै पालने रतम् /
अवतीर्णो भवायास्य जगतो दुष्टनष्टये //
text_mt:
Addressed by Manu, the Fish spoke to Manu, who was devoted to protection:
'I have descended for the welfare of this world, and for the destruction of the wicked.

sanskrit_iast:
saptame divase tvabdhiḥ plāvayiṣyati vai jagat /
upasthitāyāṃ nāvi tvaṃ vījādīni vidhāya ca //
meaning:
सप्तमे दिवसे त्वब्धिः प्लावयिष्यति वै जगत् /
उपस्थितायां नावि त्वं वीजादीनि विधाय च //
text_mt:
On the seventh day, the ocean will indeed inundate the world.
When a boat has arrived, having placed seeds and other things in it,

sanskrit_iast:
saptarṣibhiḥ parivṛto niśāṃ brāhmīṃ cariṣyasi /
upasthitasya me śṛṅge nibadhnīhi mahāhinā //
meaning:
सप्तर्षिभिः परिवृतो निशां ब्राह्मीं चरिष्यसि /
उपस्थितस्य मे शृङ्गे निबध्नीहि महाहिना //
text_mt:
surrounded by the Seven Sages, you will traverse the night of Brahmā.
Bind [the boat] to the horn of me who have arrived, with a great serpent.'

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvāntardadhe matsyo(5) manuḥ kālapratīkṣakaḥ(6) /
sthitaḥ samudra udvele nāvamāruruhe tadā //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वान्तर्दधे मत्स्यो(5) मनुः कालप्रतीक्षकः(6) /
स्थितः समुद्र उद्वेले नावमारुरुहे तदा //
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the Fish vanished. Manu, awaiting the time,
stayed [there]. Then, when the ocean overflowed, he boarded the boat.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaśṛṅgadharo matsyo haimo niyutayojanaḥ /
:n
1 me 'tra iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 punaḥ sthānamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 ambudhau manuriti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
4 nanu viṣṇustvamiti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
5 ity uktāntarhito matsya iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 ity uktvā devamatsyātmā bṛhatkāraṇasaṅgata iti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 4
nāvambabandha tacchṛṅge(1) matsyākhyaṃ ca purāṇakam //
meaning:
एकशृङ्गधरो मत्स्यो हैमो नियुतयोजनः /
:न्
1 मे ऽत्र इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 पुनः स्थानमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 अम्बुधौ मनुरिति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
4 ननु विष्णुस्त्वमिति ख, ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
5 इत्य् उक्तान्तर्हितो मत्स्य इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 इत्य् उक्त्वा देवमत्स्यात्मा बृहत्कारणसङ्गत इति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 4
नावम्बबन्ध तच्छृङ्गे(1) मत्स्याख्यं च पुराणकम् //
text_mt:
The Fish, bearing a single horn, golden, one million yojanas [in length],
[Footnote]
1 The reading in manuscript kha is 'me 'tra'.
2 The reading in manuscript kha is 'punaḥ sthānam'.
3 The reading in the two manuscripts kha and gha is 'ambudhau manuḥ'.
4 The reading in the three manuscripts kha, ga, and gha is 'nanu viṣṇustvam'.
5 The reading in manuscript gha is 'ity uktāntarhito matsyaḥ'.
6 The reading in manuscript ga is 'ity uktvā devamatsyātmā bṛhatkāraṇasaṅgataḥ'.
he bound the boat to its horn, and the Purāṇa called the Matsya

sanskrit_iast:
śuśrāva matsyātpāpaghnaṃ saṃstuvan stutibhiś ca taṃ(2) /
brahmavedaprahartāraṃ hayagrīvañca dānavaṃ //
meaning:
शुश्राव मत्स्यात्पापघ्नं संस्तुवन् स्तुतिभिश् च तं(2) /
ब्रह्मवेदप्रहर्तारं हयग्रीवञ्च दानवं //
text_mt:
he heard from the Fish, which destroys sin, praising him with hymns of praise.
And the Dānava Hayagrīva, who had stolen the Vedas of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
avadhīt, vedamatsyādyān pālayāmāsa keśavaḥ /
prāpte kalpe 'tha vārāhe kūrmarūpo 'bhavaddhariḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye matsyāvatāro nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
||
:ś atha tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ
kūrmāvatāravarṇanaṃ
meaning:
अवधीत्, वेदमत्स्याद्यान् पालयामास केशवः /
प्राप्ते कल्पे ऽथ वाराहे कूर्मरूपो ऽभवद्धरिः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये मत्स्यावतारो नाम द्वितीयो ऽध्यायः
||
:श् अथ तृतीयो ऽध्यायः
कूर्मावतारवर्णनं
text_mt:
Keśava slew; he protected the Vedas, the Fish, and the others.
Then, when the Vārāha kalpa arrived, Hari assumed the form of the Tortoise.
Thus ends the second chapter, named 'The Fish Incarnation', in the Ādi-Mahāpurāṇa Āgneya.
Now the third chapter.
Description of the Tortoise Incarnation.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
vakṣye kūrmāvatārañca śrutvā pāpapraṇāśanam(3) /
purā devāsure yuddhe daityair devāḥ parājitāḥ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
वक्ष्ये कूर्मावतारञ्च श्रुत्वा पापप्रणाशनम्(3) /
पुरा देवासुरे युद्धे दैत्यैर् देवाः पराजिताः //
text_mt:
Agni said:
I shall narrate the Tortoise Incarnation, hearing which destroys sins.
Formerly, in the war between gods and demons, the gods were defeated by the Daityas.
title: aparañca parañca yaditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
durvāsasaś ca śāpena niśrīkāścābhavaṃstadā /
stutvā kṣīrābdhigaṃ(4) viṣṇum ūcuḥ pālaya cāsurāt //
meaning:
दुर्वाससश् च शापेन निश्रीकाश्चाभवंस्तदा /
स्तुत्वा क्षीराब्धिगं(4) विष्णुम् ऊचुः पालय चासुरात् //
text_mt:
And by the curse of Durvāsas they became destitute of fortune.
Praising Viṣṇu who resides in the Milk Ocean, they said, "Protect [us] from the asura!"

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādikān hariḥ prāha sandhiṃ kurvantu cāsuraiḥ(5) /
kṣīrābdhimathanārthaṃ hi amṛtārthaṃ śriye 'surāḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादिकान् हरिः प्राह सन्धिं कुर्वन्तु चासुरैः(5) /
क्षीराब्धिमथनार्थं हि अमृतार्थं श्रिये ऽसुराः //
text_mt:
Hari said to Brahmā and the others, "Make peace with the asuras
for the churning of the Milk Ocean, indeed for the sake of the nectar, for fortune's sake, O asuras [and gods]!

sanskrit_iast:
arayo 'pi hi sandheyāḥ sati kāryārthagaurave /
yuṣmānamṛtabhājo hi kārayāmi(6) na dānavān //
:n
1 nāvaṃ badhvā tasya śṛṅge iti kha, gha,
cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 stutibhirmanuriti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 saṃśrutaṃ pāpanāśanamiti kha, ga, gha
cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
4 surā kṣīrābdhigamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustkadvayapāṭhaḥ
5 sandhiṃ kuruta cāsurariti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 bhājo hi kariṣyāmi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 5
meaning:
अरयो ऽपि हि सन्धेयाः सति कार्यार्थगौरवे /
युष्मानमृतभाजो हि कारयामि(6) न दानवान् //
:न्
1 नावं बध्वा तस्य शृङ्गे इति ख, घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 स्तुतिभिर्मनुरिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 संश्रुतं पापनाशनमिति ख, ग, घ
चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
4 सुरा क्षीराब्धिगमिति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्त्कद्वयपाठः
5 सन्धिं कुरुत चासुररिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 भाजो हि करिष्यामि इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 5
text_mt:
Even enemies are to be allied with when the gravity of the purpose demands.
I shall cause you, not the Dānavas, to partake of the nectar."
[Notes]
"1 having tied the boat to its horn, thus the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and gha"
"2 Manu with praises, thus the reading in the manuscript marked ga"
"3 heard, destroying sin, thus the reading in the three manuscripts marked kha, ga, and gha"
"4 the gods to the one residing in the Milk Ocean, thus the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha"
"5 make peace with the asuras, thus the reading in the manuscript marked ga"
"6 I shall make you partake, thus the reading in the manuscript marked kha / p. 5"

sanskrit_iast:
manthānaṃ mandaraṃ kṛtvā netraṃ kṛtvā tu (1) vāsukim /
kṣīrābdhiṃ matsahāyena nirmathadhvamatandritāḥ //
meaning:
मन्थानं मन्दरं कृत्वा नेत्रं कृत्वा तु (1) वासुकिम् /
क्षीराब्धिं मत्सहायेन निर्मथध्वमतन्द्रिताः //
text_mt:
Making Mount Mandara the churning rod and Vāsuki the churning rope,
churn the Milk Ocean unflaggingly with my assistance.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇūktāṃ saṃvidaṃ kṛtvā daityaiḥ kṣīrābdhimāgatāḥ /
tato mathitumārabdhāḥ yataḥ pucchantataḥ surāḥ //
meaning:
विष्णूक्तां संविदं कृत्वा दैत्यैः क्षीराब्धिमागताः /
ततो मथितुमारब्धाः यतः पुच्छन्ततः सुराः //
text_mt:
Having made the agreement spoken by Viṣṇu, they came to the Milk Ocean with the Daityas.
Then they began to churn, the gods being at the tail.

sanskrit_iast:
phaṇiniḥśvāsasantaptā(2) hariṇāpyāyitāḥ surāḥ /
mathyamāne 'rṇave so 'drir anādhāro hy apo 'viśat //
meaning:
फणिनिःश्वाससन्तप्ता(2) हरिणाप्यायिताः सुराः /
मथ्यमाने ऽर्णवे सो ऽद्रिर् अनाधारो ह्य् अपो ऽविशत् //
text_mt:
Scorched by the breaths of the hooded serpent, the gods were refreshed by Hari.
As the ocean was being churned, that mountain, having no support, sank into the waters.

sanskrit_iast:
kūrmarūpaṃ samāsthāya dadhre viṣṇuś ca mandaram /
kṣīrābdhermathyamānācca viṣaṃ hālāhalaṃ hy abhūt //
meaning:
कूर्मरूपं समास्थाय दध्रे विष्णुश् च मन्दरम् /
क्षीराब्धेर्मथ्यमानाच्च विषं हालाहलं ह्य् अभूत् //
text_mt:
Assuming the form of a tortoise, Viṣṇu supported Mandara.
And as the Milk Ocean was being churned, the hālāhala poison arose.

sanskrit_iast:
hareṇa dhāritaṃ kaṇṭhe nīlakaṇṭhastato 'bhavat(3) /
tato 'bhūdvāruṇī devī pārijātastu kaustubhaḥ //
meaning:
हरेण धारितं कण्ठे नीलकण्ठस्ततो ऽभवत्(3) /
ततो ऽभूद्वारुणी देवी पारिजातस्तु कौस्तुभः //
text_mt:
It was held in the throat by Hara, who thereby became the blue-throated Nīlakaṇṭha.
Then arose the goddess Vāruṇī, the Pārijāta tree, and the Kaustubha gem.

sanskrit_iast:
gāvaścāpsaraso divyā lakṣmīrdevī hariṅgatā /
paśyantaḥ sarvadevāstāṃ stuvantaḥ saśriyo 'bhavan //
meaning:
गावश्चाप्सरसो दिव्या लक्ष्मीर्देवी हरिङ्गता /
पश्यन्तः सर्वदेवास्तां स्तुवन्तः सश्रियो ऽभवन् //
text_mt:
And the wish-granting cows, the celestial apsarases, and the goddess Lakṣmī went to Hari.
All the gods, beholding her and praising [her], became endowed with fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dhanvantarirviṣṇur āyurvedapravartakaḥ(4) /
bibhrat kamaṇḍalumpūrṇam amṛtena samutthitaḥ //
meaning:
ततो धन्वन्तरिर्विष्णुर् आयुर्वेदप्रवर्तकः(4) /
बिभ्रत् कमण्डलुम्पूर्णम् अमृतेन समुत्थितः //
text_mt:
Then Dhanvantari arose, a manifestation of Viṣṇu who inaugurated the science of medicine,
bearing a water pot filled with nectar.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtaṃ tatkarāddaityā surebhyo 'rdhaṃ pradāya ca /
gṛhītvā jagmurjanmādyā viṣṇuḥ strīrūpadhṛk tataḥ //
meaning:
अमृतं तत्कराद्दैत्या सुरेभ्यो ऽर्धं प्रदाय च /
गृहीत्वा जग्मुर्जन्माद्या विष्णुः स्त्रीरूपधृक् ततः //
text_mt:
Taking the nectar from his hand, after giving half to the gods,
the Daityas, led by Janman, departed; then Viṣṇu assumed the form of a woman.

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpasampannāṃ daityāḥ procurvimohitāḥ /
bhava bhāryāmṛtaṃ gṛhya pāyayāsmān varānane //
meaning:
तां दृष्ट्वा रूपसम्पन्नां दैत्याः प्रोचुर्विमोहिताः /
भव भार्यामृतं गृह्य पाययास्मान् वरानने //
text_mt:
Seeing her endowed with beauty, the Daityas, infatuated, said:
"Be [our] wife! Take the nectar and make us drink it, O fair-faced woman!"

sanskrit_iast:
tathetyuktvā haristebhyo gṛhītvāpāyayatsurān /
candrarūpadharo rāhuḥ pibaṃścārkendunārpitaḥ (5) //
:n
1 rajjaṃ kṛtvā tu iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 niḥśvāsasaṃglānā iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 tato hara iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
4 pradarśaka iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
5 akandusūcita iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 6
meaning:
तथेत्युक्त्वा हरिस्तेभ्यो गृहीत्वापाययत्सुरान् /
चन्द्ररूपधरो राहुः पिबंश्चार्केन्दुनार्पितः (5) //
:न्
1 रज्जं कृत्वा तु इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 निःश्वाससंग्लाना इति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 ततो हर इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
4 प्रदर्शक इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
5 अकन्दुसूचित इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 6
text_mt:
Saying "So be it," Hari took [it] from them and made the gods drink.
Rāhu, having assumed the form of the moon, was drinking when pointed out by the sun and moon.
[Notes]
"1 having made a rope, thus the reading in the manuscript marked kha"
"2 exhausted by the breaths, thus the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and gha"
"3 then Hara, thus the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha"
"4 the exhibitor, thus the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga"
"5 pointed out by the sun and moon, thus the reading in the manuscript marked kha / p. 6"

sanskrit_iast:
hariṇāpyariṇā cchinnaṃ(1) sa rāhustacchiraḥ pṛthak /
kṛpayāmaratānnītaṃ varadaṃ harimabravīt //
meaning:
हरिणाप्यरिणा च्छिन्नं(1) स राहुस्तच्छिरः पृथक् /
कृपयामरतान्नीतं वरदं हरिमब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
Severed by Hari with his discus, that Rāhu's head became separated;
brought to immortality out of compassion, he spoke to boon-granting Hari:

sanskrit_iast:
rāhurmattastu candrārkau prāpsyete grahaṇaṃ grahaḥ /
tasmin kale ca yaddānaṃ dāsyante syāt tadakṣayaṃ(2) //
meaning:
राहुर्मत्तस्तु चन्द्रार्कौ प्राप्स्येते ग्रहणं ग्रहः /
तस्मिन् कले च यद्दानं दास्यन्ते स्यात् तदक्षयं(2) //
text_mt:
"May the sun and moon suffer eclipse through me, the planet Rāhu!
And whatever gift people give at that time shall be imperishable."

sanskrit_iast:
tathetyāhātha taṃ viṣṇus tataḥ sarvaiḥ sahāmaraiḥ /
strīrūpaṃ samparityajya hareṇoktaḥ pradarśaya //
meaning:
तथेत्याहाथ तं विष्णुस् ततः सर्वैः सहामरैः /
स्त्रीरूपं सम्परित्यज्य हरेणोक्तः प्रदर्शय //
text_mt:
Then Viṣṇu said to him, "So be it." Then, together with all the immortals,
having renounced the female form, he was addressed by Hara: "Show it [to me]!"

sanskrit_iast:
darśayāmāsa rudrāya strīrūpaṃ bhagavān hariḥ /
māyayā mohitaḥ śambhuḥ gaurīṃ tyaktvā striyaṃ gataḥ //
meaning:
दर्शयामास रुद्राय स्त्रीरूपं भगवान् हरिः /
मायया मोहितः शम्भुः गौरीं त्यक्त्वा स्त्रियं गतः //
text_mt:
The blessed Lord Hari displayed the female form to Rudra.
Bewitched by the illusion, Śambhu abandoned Gaurī and pursued the woman.

sanskrit_iast:
nagna unmattarūpo 'bhūt striyaḥ keśānadhārayat(3) /
agādvimucya keśān strī anvadhāvacca tāṅgatām //
meaning:
नग्न उन्मत्तरूपो ऽभूत् स्त्रियः केशानधारयत्(3) /
अगाद्विमुच्य केशान् स्त्री अन्वधावच्च ताङ्गताम् //
text_mt:
Naked, he assumed a maddened appearance and seized the woman's hair.
Releasing her hair, the woman escaped, and he pursued her as she ran.

sanskrit_iast:
skhalitaṃ tasya vīryaṃ kau yatra yatra harasya hi /
tatra tatrābhavat kṣetraṃ liṅgānāṃ kanakasya ca (4) //
meaning:
स्खलितं तस्य वीर्यं कौ यत्र यत्र हरस्य हि /
तत्र तत्राभवत् क्षेत्रं लिङ्गानां कनकस्य च (4) //
text_mt:
Wherever Hara's semen was spilled on the earth,
there arose a sacred site of liṅgas and of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
māyeyamiti tāṃ jñātvā svarūpastho 'bhavaddharaḥ /
śivamāha harī rudra jitā māyā tvayā hi me //
meaning:
मायेयमिति तां ज्ञात्वा स्वरूपस्थो ऽभवद्धरः /
शिवमाह हरी रुद्र जिता माया त्वया हि मे //
text_mt:
Realizing "This is an illusion," Hara returned to his true nature.
Hari spoke to Śiva: "O Rudra, my illusion has indeed been conquered by you.

sanskrit_iast:
na jetumenāṃ śakto me tvadṛte 'nyaḥ pumān bhuvi /
aprāpyāthāmṛtaṃ daityā devair yuddhe nipātitāḥ /
tridivasthāḥ surāścāsan yaḥ paṭhet tridivaṃ vrajet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye kūrmāvatāro nāma tṛtīyo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 hariṇā cāsinā cchinnamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

text_mt:
No other man on earth, except you, is able to conquer this [illusion] of mine."
Then, failing to obtain the nectar, the Daityas were struck down by the gods in battle.
And the gods dwelt in heaven. Whoever recites [this] shall attain heaven.
Thus ends the third chapter, named "The Tortoise Incarnation," in the first Mahāpurāṇa, the Āgneya.
[Notes]
"1 severed by Hari with a sword, thus the reading in the manuscript marked ga"
"2 may I be; whatever gift they give at that time shall be imperishable, thus the reading in the manuscript marked kha"
"3 deluded by illusion, Rudra swiftly went to her; having reached Mohinī, the wise one seized the woman's hair, thus the reading in the manuscript marked ga"
"4 there arose a great sacred ford, highest of sacred sites, thus the reading in the manuscript marked ga / p. 7"
Now the fourth chapter:
Description of the Boar and other Incarnations.

sanskrit_iast:

avatāraṃ varāhasya vakṣye 'haṃ pāpanāśanam /

अवतारं वराहस्य वक्ष्ये ऽहं पापनाशनम् /

text_mt:
Agni said:
I shall narrate the Boar Incarnation, which destroys sin.
Hiraṇyākṣa was lord of the asuras; having conquered the gods, he dwelt in heaven.

having slain that Dānava, a thorn together with the Daityas,

हिरण्याक्षस्य वै भ्राता हिरण्यकशिपुस् तथा(4) //
text_mt:
and having protected dharma, the gods, and others, Hari then vanished.
Likewise, Hiraṇyākṣa's brother Hiraṇyakaśipu,

having conquered the sacrificial shares of the gods, usurped the authority of all the gods.
Assuming the form of Nṛsiṃha, he slew him along with the gods [assisting].

sanskrit_iast:

Formerly, in the war between the gods and asuras, the gods were conquered by Bali and others.

सुराणामभयं दत्वा अदित्या कश्यपेन च //
text_mt:
Deposed from heaven, they went to Hari for refuge.
Giving fearlessness to the gods, and praised by Aditi and Kaśyapa,

of the illustrious patron Bali; at the royal gate he recited the Veda.

though restrained by Śukra: "Speak what you desire!

Now begins the fifth chapter.
The description of the incarnation of glorious Rāma.

yajñavighnavināśāya viśvāmitrārthito nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
प्राशिताद्यज्ञसंसिद्धाद् रामाद्याश् च समाः पितुः /
यज्ञविघ्नविनाशाय विश्वामित्रार्थितो नृपः //
text_mt: which was consumed upon the completion of the sacrifice; and Rāma and his brothers were like their father. / To remove obstacles to his sacrifice, the king was solicited by Viśvāmitra;

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaṃ sampreṣayāmāsa lakṣmaṇaṃ muninā saha /
:p 10
rāmo gato 'straśastrāṇi śikṣitastāḍakāntakṛt(1) //
meaning:
रामं सम्प्रेषयामास लक्ष्मणं मुनिना सह /
:प् 10
रामो गतो ऽस्त्रशस्त्राणि शिक्षितस्ताडकान्तकृत्(1) //
text_mt:
he sent forth Rāma along with Lakṣmaṇa in company with the sage.
[Page 10]
Rāma went, was instructed in missiles and weapons, and brought about Tāḍakā's end.

sanskrit_iast:
mārīcaṃ mānavāstreṇa mohitaṃ dūrato 'nayat /
subāhuṃ yajñahantāraṃ sabalañcāvadhīt balī //
meaning:
मारीचं मानवास्त्रेण मोहितं दूरतो ऽनयत् /
सुबाहुं यज्ञहन्तारं सबलञ्चावधीत् बली //
text_mt: With the human missile, he sent Mārīca far away in a swoon; / and the mighty one slew Subāhu, the destroyer of the sacrifice, along with his force.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhāśramanivāsī ca viśvāmitrādibhiḥ saha /
gataḥ kratuṃ maithilasya draṣṭuñcāpaṃ sahānujaḥ //
meaning:
सिद्धाश्रमनिवासी च विश्वामित्रादिभिः सह /
गतः क्रतुं मैथिलस्य द्रष्टुञ्चापं सहानुजः //
text_mt: Dwelling in Siddhāśrama, he went together with Viśvāmitra and others, / along with his younger brother, to the sacrifice of the king of Mithilā, in order to see the bow.

sanskrit_iast:
śatānandanimittena viśvāmitraprabhāvitaḥ /
rāmāya kathito rājñā samuniḥ pūjitaḥ kratau //
meaning:
शतानन्दनिमित्तेन विश्वामित्रप्रभावितः /
रामाय कथितो राज्ञा समुनिः पूजितः क्रतौ //
text_mt: By means of Śatānanda, Viśvāmitra's greatness / was related to Rāma, and that sage was honored by the king at the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanurāpūrayāmāsa līlayā sa babhañja tat(2) /
vīryaśuklāñca janakaḥ sītāṃ kanyāntvayonijām //
meaning:
धनुरापूरयामास लीलया स बभञ्ज तत्(2) /
वीर्यशुक्लाञ्च जनकः सीतां कन्यान्त्वयोनिजाम् //
text_mt: He drew the bow and broke it with ease; / and Janaka gave his daughter Sītā, not born of a womb,

sanskrit_iast:
dadau rāmāya rāmo 'pi pitrādau hi samāgate /
upayeme jānakīntām urmilāṃ lakṣmaṇas tathā(3) //
meaning:
ददौ रामाय रामो ऽपि पित्रादौ हि समागते /
उपयेमे जानकीन्ताम् उर्मिलां लक्ष्मणस् तथा(3) //
text_mt: whose bride-price was valor, to Rāma; and Rāma too, when his father and others had arrived, / married that daughter of Janaka, and Lakṣmaṇa [married] Urmilā.

sanskrit_iast:
śrutakīrtiṃ māṇḍavīñca kuśadhvajasute tathā /
janakasyānujasyaite śatrughnabharatāvubhau //
meaning:
श्रुतकीर्तिं माण्डवीञ्च कुशध्वजसुते तथा /
जनकस्यानुजस्यैते शत्रुघ्नभरतावुभौ //
text_mt: Śrutakīrti and Māṇḍavī, the daughters of Kuśadhvaja, / the younger brother of Janaka—both these girls

sanskrit_iast:
kanye dve upayemāte janakena supūjitaḥ /
rāmo 'gātsavaśiṣṭhādyair jāmadagnyaṃ vijitya ca /
ayodhyāṃ bharatobhyāgāt(4) saśatrughno yudhājitaḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe bālakāṇḍavarṇanaṃ
nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:n
1 tāḍakāpahṛditi kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
2 babhañja taddṛḍhaṃ dhanuriti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 tadā iti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
4 bharatothāgāt iti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
:p 11
:ś atha ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ
śrīrāmāvatāravarṇanaṃ
meaning:
कन्ये द्वे उपयेमाते जनकेन सुपूजितः /
रामो ऽगात्सवशिष्ठाद्यैर् जामदग्न्यं विजित्य च /
अयोध्यां भरतोभ्यागात्(4) सशत्रुघ्नो युधाजितः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये रामायणे बालकाण्डवर्णनं
नाम पञ्चमो ऽध्यायः
:न्
1 ताडकापहृदिति ख, ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
2 बभञ्ज तद्दृढं धनुरिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 तदा इति ख, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
4 भरतोथागात् इति ख, ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
:प् 11
:श् अथ षष्ठो ऽध्यायः
श्रीरामावतारवर्णनं
text_mt:
Śatrughna and Bharata married. Highly honored by Janaka, / Rāma went, having conquered Jamadagni's son, with Vasiṣṭha and the others; / and Bharata, together with Śatrughna, returned to Ayodhyā from Yudhājit's house.
Thus ends the fifth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Bālakāṇḍa in the Rāmāyaṇa', in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
[Notes]
1. 'tāḍakāpahṛt' is the reading in the three manuscripts marked kha, ga, and ṅa.
2. 'babhañja taddṛḍhaṃ dhanuḥ' is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
3. 'tadā' is the reading in the three manuscripts marked kha, gha, and ṅa.
4. 'bharatothāgāt' is the reading in the three manuscripts marked kha, gha, and ṅa.
Now begins the sixth chapter.
The description of the incarnation of glorious Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
bharate 'tha gate rāmaḥ pitrādīnabhyapūjayat /
rājā daśaratho rāmam uvāca śṛṇu rāghava //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
भरते ऽथ गते रामः पित्रादीनभ्यपूजयत् /
राजा दशरथो रामम् उवाच शृणु राघव //
text_mt: Nārada said: / When Bharata had departed, Rāma honored his father and others. / King Daśaratha spoke to Rāma: 'Listen, O descendant of Raghu:
title: yad gaditvā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
guṇānurāgādrājye tvaṃ prajābhirabhiṣecitaḥ /
manasāhaṃ prabhāte te yauvarājyaṃ dadāmi ha //
meaning:
गुणानुरागाद्राज्ये त्वं प्रजाभिरभिषेचितः /
मनसाहं प्रभाते ते यौवराज्यं ददामि ह //
text_mt: out of love for your virtues, you have been consecrated for the kingdom by the subjects; / in my mind, I bestow the heir-apparency upon you at dawn.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau tvaṃ sītayā sārdhaṃ saṃyataḥ suvrato bhava /
rājñaś ca mantriṇaścāṣṭau savasiṣṭhās tathābruvan //
meaning:
रात्रौ त्वं सीतया सार्धं संयतः सुव्रतो भव /
राज्ञश् च मन्त्रिणश्चाष्टौ सवसिष्ठास् तथाब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Spend the night with Sītā in self-restraint and with good votive observances.' / And the king's eight ministers, along with Vasiṣṭha, spoke thus:

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭirjayanto vijayaḥ siddhārtho rāṣṭravardhanaḥ(1) /
aśoko dharmapālaś ca sumantraḥ savasiṣṭhakaḥ(2) //
meaning:
सृष्टिर्जयन्तो विजयः सिद्धार्थो राष्ट्रवर्धनः(1) /
अशोको धर्मपालश् च सुमन्त्रः सवसिष्ठकः(2) //
text_mt: Sṛṣṭi, Jayanta, Vijaya, Siddhārtha, Rāṣṭravardhana, / Aśoka, Dharmapāla, and Sumantra, together with Vasiṣṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
pitrādivacanaṃ śrutvā tathetyuktvā sa rāghavaḥ /
sthito devārcanaṃ kṛtvā kauśalyāyai nivedya tat //
meaning:
पित्रादिवचनं श्रुत्वा तथेत्युक्त्वा स राघवः /
स्थितो देवार्चनं कृत्वा कौशल्यायै निवेद्य तत् //
text_mt: Having heard the words of his father and others, the descendant of Raghu said, 'So be it'; / he remained there having performed worship of the gods, and informed Kauśalyā of it.

sanskrit_iast:
rājovāca vasiṣṭhādīn rāmarājyābhiṣecane /
sambhārān sambhavantu sma ity uktvā kaikeyīṅgataḥ //
meaning:
राजोवाच वसिष्ठादीन् रामराज्याभिषेचने /
सम्भारान् सम्भवन्तु स्म इत्य् उक्त्वा कैकेयीङ्गतः //
text_mt: The king said to Vasiṣṭha and the others: 'Let the provisions / for Rāma's royal consecration be gathered'; having said this, he went to Kaikeyī.

sanskrit_iast:
ayodhyālaṅkṛtiṃ dṛṣṭvā jñātvā rāmābhiṣecanaṃ /
bhaviṣyatītyācacakṣe kaikeyīṃ mantharā sakhī(3) //
meaning:
अयोध्यालङ्कृतिं दृष्ट्वा ज्ञात्वा रामाभिषेचनं /
भविष्यतीत्याचचक्षे कैकेयीं मन्थरा सखी(3) //
text_mt: Seeing the decorations of Ayodhyā and knowing that Rāma's consecration / was about to take place, the female companion Mantharā reported it to Kaikeyī.

sanskrit_iast:
pādau gṛhītvā rāmeṇa karṣitā sāparādhataḥ /
tena vaireṇa sā rāma- vanavāsañca kāṅkṣati //
meaning:
पादौ गृहीत्वा रामेण कर्षिता सापराधतः /
तेन वैरेण सा राम- वनवासञ्च काङ्क्षति //
text_mt: She had once been dragged by the feet by Rāma for a fault; / out of that enmity, she desired forest-exile for Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
kaikeyi tvaṃ samuttiṣṭha rāmarājyābhiṣecanaṃ /
maraṇaṃ tava putrasya mama te nātra saṃśayaḥ //
:n
1 rājyavardhana iti kha, ga, gha cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
2 sumantraś ca vaśiṣṭhaka iti kha, ga, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ
3 mantharāsatī iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ mantharā
satīmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 12
meaning:
कैकेयि त्वं समुत्तिष्ठ रामराज्याभिषेचनं /
मरणं तव पुत्रस्य मम ते नात्र संशयः //
:न्
1 राज्यवर्धन इति ख, ग, घ चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
2 सुमन्त्रश् च वशिष्ठक इति ख, ग, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकचतुष्टयपाठः
3 मन्थरासती इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः मन्थरा
सतीमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 12
text_mt:
'Kaikeyī, arise! Rāma's consecration to the kingdom / means the death of your son, and of me; there is no doubt about this.'
[Notes]
1. 'rājyavardhanaḥ' is the reading in the three manuscripts marked kha, ga, and gha.
2. 'sumantraś ca vasiṣṭhakaḥ' is the reading in the four manuscripts marked kha, ga, gha, and ṅa.
3. 'mantharāsatī' is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa; 'mantharā satīm' in the manuscript marked ga.

sanskrit_iast:
kabjayoktañca tac chrutvā ekamābharaṇaṃ dadau /
uvāca me yathā rāmas tathā me bharataḥ sutaḥ //
meaning:
कब्जयोक्तञ्च तच् छ्रुत्वा एकमाभरणं ददौ /
उवाच मे यथा रामस् तथा मे भरतः सुतः //
text_mt: Hearing what was spoken by the hunchbacked woman, she gave her an ornament / and said: 'As Rāma is to me, so is my son Bharata;

sanskrit_iast:
upāyantu na paśyāmi bharato yena rājyabhāk /
kaikeyīmabravīt kruddhā hāraṃ tyaktvātha mantharā //
meaning:
उपायन्तु न पश्यामि भरतो येन राज्यभाक् /
कैकेयीमब्रवीत् क्रुद्धा हारं त्यक्त्वाथ मन्थरा //
text_mt: yet I see no means by which Bharata may obtain the kingdom.' / Thereupon Mantharā, enraged, cast aside the necklace and said to Kaikeyī:

sanskrit_iast:
bāliśe rakṣa bharatam ātmānaṃ māñca rāghavāt /
bhavitā rāghavo rājā rāghavasya tataḥ sutaḥ //
meaning:
बालिशे रक्ष भरतम् आत्मानं माञ्च राघवात् /
भविता राघवो राजा राघवस्य ततः सुतः //
text_mt: "Foolish woman, protect Bharata, yourself, and me from Rāghava! / Rāghava will become king, and after Rāghava, his son.

sanskrit_iast:
rājavaṃśastu kaikeyi bharatāt parihāsyate /
devāsure purā yuddhe śambareṇa hatāḥ surāḥ //
meaning:
राजवंशस्तु कैकेयि भरतात् परिहास्यते /
देवासुरे पुरा युद्धे शम्बरेण हताः सुराः //
text_mt: The royal lineage, O Kaikeyī, will be lost to Bharata. / Formerly, in the war between gods and asuras, the gods were slain by Śambara.

sanskrit_iast:
rātrau bhartā gatastatra rakṣito vidyayā tvayā /
varadvayantadā prādād yācedānīṃ nṛpañca tat //
meaning:
रात्रौ भर्ता गतस्तत्र रक्षितो विद्यया त्वया /
वरद्वयन्तदा प्रादाद् याचेदानीं नृपञ्च तत् //
text_mt: Your husband went there at night, and he was protected by you with [your] mystic knowledge. / He then gave you two boons; now ask the king for those:

sanskrit_iast:
rāmasya ca vanevāsaṃ nava varṣāṇi pañca ca /
yauvarājyañca bharate tadidānīṃ pradāsyati //
meaning:
रामस्य च वनेवासं नव वर्षाणि पञ्च च /
यौवराज्यञ्च भरते तदिदानीं प्रदास्यति //
text_mt: forest-dwelling for Rāma for nine years and five, / and the status of crown prince for Bharata—that he will grant now."

sanskrit_iast:
protsāhitā kubjayā sā anarthe cārthadarśinī /
uvāca sadupāyaṃ me kaccittaṃ(1) kārayiṣyati //
meaning:
प्रोत्साहिता कुब्जया सा अनर्थे चार्थदर्शिनी /
उवाच सदुपायं मे कच्चित्तं(1) कारयिष्यति //
text_mt: Instigated by the hunchback woman, seeing benefit in disaster, / she said: "Will [the king] carry out that good stratagem of mine?"

sanskrit_iast:
krodhāgāraṃ praviṣṭātha patitā bhuvi mūrchitā /
dvijādīnarcayitvātha rājā daśarathastadā //
meaning:
क्रोधागारं प्रविष्टाथ पतिता भुवि मूर्छिता /
द्विजादीनर्चयित्वाथ राजा दशरथस्तदा //
text_mt: Then, having entered the chamber of anger, she fell unconscious to the ground. / Then, after honoring the twice-born and others, King Daśaratha

sanskrit_iast:
dadarśa kekayīṃ ruṣṭām uvāca kathamīdṛśī /
rogārtā kiṃ bhayodvignā kimicchasi karomi tat //
meaning:
ददर्श केकयीं रुष्टाम् उवाच कथमीदृशी /
रोगार्ता किं भयोद्विग्ना किमिच्छसि करोमि तत् //
text_mt: saw Kaikeyī enraged and said: "How are you like this? / Are you afflicted by illness? Are you agitated by fear? What do you wish? I shall do it.

sanskrit_iast:
yena rāmeṇa hi vinā na jīvāmi muhūrtakam /
śapāmi tena kuryāṃ vai vāñchitaṃ tava sundari //
meaning:
येन रामेण हि विना न जीवामि मुहूर्तकम् /
शपामि तेन कुर्यां वै वाञ्छितं तव सुन्दरि //
text_mt: For without Rāma I do not live even for a moment; / by him I swear: I will indeed do what you desire, O lovely woman!"

sanskrit_iast:
satyaṃ brūhīti sovāca nṛpaṃ mahyaṃ dadāsi cet /
varadvayaṃ pūrvadattaṃ satyāt tvaṃ dehi me nṛpa //
meaning:
सत्यं ब्रूहीति सोवाच नृपं मह्यं ददासि चेत् /
वरद्वयं पूर्वदत्तं सत्यात् त्वं देहि मे नृप //
text_mt: She said to the king: "Speak the truth; if you give them to me, / then out of truthfulness, O king, grant me the two boons previously given:

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśasamā rāmo vane vasatu saṃyataḥ /
:n
1 kathitamiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 13
sambhārair ebhiradyaiva bharatotrābhiṣecyatām //
meaning:
चतुर्दशसमा रामो वने वसतु संयतः /
:न्
1 कथितमिति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 13
सम्भारैर् एभिरद्यैव भरतोत्राभिषेच्यताम् //
text_mt:
Let Rāma dwell self-restrained in the forest for fourteen years;
[Footnote]
1. "kathitam" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
[Page 13]
with these very preparations, let Bharata be consecrated here this very day.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣaṃ pītvā mariṣyāmi dāsyasi tvaṃ na cennṛpa /
tac chrutvā mūrchito bhūmau vajrāhata ivāpatat //
meaning:
विषं पीत्वा मरिष्यामि दास्यसि त्वं न चेन्नृप /
तच् छ्रुत्वा मूर्छितो भूमौ वज्राहत इवापतत् //
text_mt: I will drink poison and die if you do not grant them, O king!" / Hearing that, he fainted and fell to the ground as if struck by a thunderbolt.

sanskrit_iast:
muhūrtāccetanāṃ prāpya kaikeyīmidamabravīt /
kiṃ kṛtaṃ tava rāmeṇa mayā vā pāpaniś caye //
meaning:
मुहूर्ताच्चेतनां प्राप्य कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत् /
किं कृतं तव रामेण मया वा पापनिश् चये //
text_mt: Regaining consciousness after a moment, he said this to Kaikeyī: / "What has been done to you by Rāma or by me, you of evil resolve,

sanskrit_iast:
yanmāmevaṃ bravīṣi tvaṃ sarvalokāpriyaṅkari /
kevalaṃ tvatpriyaṃ kṛtvā bhaviṣyāmi suninditaḥ //
meaning:
यन्मामेवं ब्रवीषि त्वं सर्वलोकाप्रियङ्करि /
केवलं त्वत्प्रियं कृत्वा भविष्यामि सुनिन्दितः //
text_mt: that you speak to me thus, you bringer of displeasure to the whole world? / Merely doing your bidding, I shall become deeply reviled.

sanskrit_iast:
yā tvaṃ bhāryā(1) kālarātrī bharato nedṛśaḥ sutaḥ /
praśādhi vidhavā rājyaṃ mṛte mayi gate sute //
meaning:
या त्वं भार्या(1) कालरात्री भरतो नेदृशः सुतः /
प्रशाधि विधवा राज्यं मृते मयि गते सुते //
text_mt: You who are my wife are the Night of Doom, [and] Bharata is not such a son. / Rule the kingdom as a widow when I am dead and my son is gone!"

sanskrit_iast:
satyapāśanibaddhastu rāmamāhūya cābravīt /
kaikeyyā vañcito rāma rājyaṃ kuru nigṛhya mām //
meaning:
सत्यपाशनिबद्धस्तु राममाहूय चाब्रवीत् /
कैकेय्या वञ्चितो राम राज्यं कुरु निगृह्य माम् //
text_mt: Bound by the snare of truth, however, he summoned Rāma and said: / "I have been deceived by Kaikeyī, O Rāma; restrain me and take the kingdom!

sanskrit_iast:
tvayā vane tu vastavyaṃ kaikeyībharato nṛpaḥ /
pitarañcaiva kaikeyīṃ namaskṛtya pradakṣiṇaṃ //
meaning:
त्वया वने तु वस्तव्यं कैकेयीभरतो नृपः /
पितरञ्चैव कैकेयीं नमस्कृत्य प्रदक्षिणं //
text_mt: You must live in the forest, [and] Kaikeyī's Bharata is the king." / Having bowed to his father and Kaikeyī, and circumambulating them,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā natvā ca kauśalyāṃ samāśvasya salakṣmaṇaḥ /
sītayā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ sarathaḥ sasumantrakaḥ //
meaning:
कृत्वा नत्वा च कौशल्यां समाश्वस्य सलक्ष्मणः /
सीतया भार्यया सार्धं सरथः ससुमन्त्रकः //
text_mt: having bowed to Kauśalyā and comforted her, accompanied by Lakṣmaṇa, / with Sītā his wife, with his chariot, and with Sumantra,

sanskrit_iast:
datvā dānāni viprebhyo dīnānāthebhya eva saḥ /
mātṛbhiś caiva viprādyaiḥ śokārtair nirgataḥ purāt //
meaning:
दत्वा दानानि विप्रेभ्यो दीनानाथेभ्य एव सः /
मातृभिश् चैव विप्राद्यैः शोकार्तैर् निर्गतः पुरात् //
text_mt: having given gifts to the brahmins, and to the poor and helpless, / he departed from the city [accompanied] by his mothers and by the brahmins and others stricken with grief.

sanskrit_iast:
uṣitvā tamasātīre rātrau paurān vihāya ca /
prabhāte tamapaśyanto 'yodhyāṃ te punarāgatāḥ //
meaning:
उषित्वा तमसातीरे रात्रौ पौरान् विहाय च /
प्रभाते तमपश्यन्तो ऽयोध्यां ते पुनरागताः //
text_mt: Having stayed the night on the bank of the Tamasā, he left the citizens behind; / at daybreak, not seeing him, they returned to Ayodhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
rudan rājāpi kauśalyā- gṛhamāgāt suduḥkhitaḥ /
paurā janā striyaḥ sarvā rurudū rājayoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
रुदन् राजापि कौशल्या- गृहमागात् सुदुःखितः /
पौरा जना स्त्रियः सर्वा रुरुदू राजयोषितः //
text_mt: The weeping king also went to Kauśalyā's house, exceedingly sorrowful; / the townsfolk, all the women, and the royal wives wept.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo rathasthaścīrāḍhyaḥ śṛṅgaverapuraṃ yayau /
guhena pūjitastatra iṅgudīmūlamāśritaḥ(2) //
:n
1 na tvaṃ bhāryā iti ga, gha, cha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
2 saṃśrita iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 14
meaning:
रामो रथस्थश्चीराढ्यः शृङ्गवेरपुरं ययौ /
गुहेन पूजितस्तत्र इङ्गुदीमूलमाश्रितः(2) //
:न्
1 न त्वं भार्या इति ग, घ, छ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
2 संश्रित इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 14
text_mt:
Rāma, mounted on his chariot and dressed in bark garments, went to Śṛṅgaverapura; / honored there by Guha, he rested at the foot of an iṅgudī tree.
[Footnote]
1. "na tvaṃ bhāryā" is the reading in the three manuscripts marked ga, gha, and cha.
2. "saṃśritaḥ" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha.
[Page 14]

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmaṇaḥ sa guho rātrau cakraturjāgaraṃ hi tau /
sumantraṃ sarathaṃ tyaktvā prātar nāvātha jāhnavīṃ //
meaning:
लक्ष्मणः स गुहो रात्रौ चक्रतुर्जागरं हि तौ /
सुमन्त्रं सरथं त्यक्त्वा प्रातर् नावाथ जाह्नवीं //
text_mt: Lakṣmaṇa and Guha kept vigil that night; / leaving Sumantra with the chariot, in the morning [Rāma crossed] the Jāhnavī by boat.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmalakṣmaṇasītāś ca tīrṇā āpuḥ prayāgakam /
bharadvājaṃ namaskṛtya citrakūṭaṃ giriṃ yayuḥ //
meaning:
रामलक्ष्मणसीताश् च तीर्णा आपुः प्रयागकम् /
भरद्वाजं नमस्कृत्य चित्रकूटं गिरिं ययुः //
text_mt: Having crossed, Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, and Sītā reached Prayāga; / having bowed to Bharadvāja, they went to Mount Citrakūṭa.

sanskrit_iast:
vāstupūjāntataḥ kṛtvā sthitā mandākinītaṭe /
sītāyai darśayāmāsa citrakūṭañca rāghavaḥ //
meaning:
वास्तुपूजान्ततः कृत्वा स्थिता मन्दाकिनीतटे /
सीतायै दर्शयामास चित्रकूटञ्च राघवः //
text_mt: Then, having performed the site architecture worship, they stayed on the bank of the Mandākinī; / and Rāghava showed Citrakūṭa to Sītā.

sanskrit_iast:
nakhair vidārayantantāṃ kākantaccakṣurākṣipat /
aiṣikāstreṇa śaraṇaṃ prāpto devān vihāyasaḥ //
meaning:
नखैर् विदारयन्तन्तां काकन्तच्चक्षुराक्षिपत् /
ऐषिकास्त्रेण शरणं प्राप्तो देवान् विहायसः //
text_mt: To a crow that tore her with its claws, he struck out its eye; / by the reed-missile, [though] it took refuge in heaven with the gods, [it was pursued].

sanskrit_iast:
rāme vanaṃ gate rājā ṣaṣṭhe 'hni niśi cābravīt /
kauśalyāṃ sa kathāṃ paurvāṃ(1) yadajñānaddhataḥ purā //
meaning:
रामे वनं गते राजा षष्ठे ऽह्नि निशि चाब्रवीत् /
कौशल्यां स कथां पौर्वां(1) यदज्ञानद्धतः पुरा //
text_mt: When Rāma had gone to the forest, the king on the sixth night told Kauśalyā / an old story of how, out of ignorance, he had killed [an ascetic boy] long ago:

sanskrit_iast:
kaumāre śarayūtīre yajñadattakumārakaḥ /
śabdabhedācca kumbhena śabdaṃ kurvaṃś ca tatpitā //
meaning:
कौमारे शरयूतीरे यज्ञदत्तकुमारकः /
शब्दभेदाच्च कुम्भेन शब्दं कुर्वंश् च तत्पिता //
text_mt: in his youth, on the bank of the Sarayū, the youth Yajñadatta / was making a sound with a pitcher, and by sound-aiming [Daśaratha shot him]; and his father,

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāpa vilapanmātrā śokaṃ kṛtvā rudanmuhuḥ /
putraṃ vinā mariṣyāvas tvaṃ ca śokānmariṣyasi //
meaning:
शशाप विलपन्मात्रा शोकं कृत्वा रुदन्मुहुः /
पुत्रं विना मरिष्यावस् त्वं च शोकान्मरिष्यसि //
text_mt: lamenting, grieving with the mother and weeping repeatedly, cursed [him]: / "Bereft of our son, we two will die; and you also shall die of grief!

sanskrit_iast:
putraṃ vinā smaran śokāt kauśalye maraṇaṃ mama /
kathāmuktvātha hā rāmam uktvā rājā divaṅgataḥ //
meaning:
पुत्रं विना स्मरन् शोकात् कौशल्ये मरणं मम /
कथामुक्त्वाथ हा रामम् उक्त्वा राजा दिवङ्गतः //
text_mt: O Kauśalyā, remembering [him] without my son, my death [comes] from grief." / Having spoken this tale and cried out: "Ah, Rāma!", the king departed to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
suptaṃ mattvātha kauśalyā suptā śokārtameva sā /
suprabhāte gāyanāś ca sūtamāgadhavandinaḥ //
meaning:
सुप्तं मत्त्वाथ कौशल्या सुप्ता शोकार्तमेव सा /
सुप्रभाते गायनाश् च सूतमागधवन्दिनः //
text_mt: Kauśalyā, thinking he was merely sleeping, fell asleep, stricken with grief; / at dawn, the singers, bards, chroniclers, and eulogists,

sanskrit_iast:
prabodhakā bodhayanti na ca budhyatyasau mṛtaḥ(2) /
kauśalyā taṃ mṛtaṃ jñātvā hā hatāsmīti cābravīt(3) //
meaning:
प्रबोधका बोधयन्ति न च बुध्यत्यसौ मृतः(2) /
कौशल्या तं मृतं ज्ञात्वा हा हतास्मीति चाब्रवीत्(3) //
text_mt: the wakers, awakened him, but he, being dead, did not awaken; / Kauśalyā, realizing that he was dead, said: "Alas, I am ruined!"

sanskrit_iast:
narā nāryo 'tha rurudur ānīto bharatastadā /
vaśiṣṭhādyaiḥ saśatrughnaḥ śīghraṃ rājagṛhātpurīm //
:n
1 pūrvāmiti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 nṛpa iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 cāpataditi ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 15
meaning:
नरा नार्यो ऽथ रुरुदुर् आनीतो भरतस्तदा /
वशिष्ठाद्यैः सशत्रुघ्नः शीघ्रं राजगृहात्पुरीम् //
:न्
1 पूर्वामिति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 नृप इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 चापतदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 15
text_mt:
Then men and women wept; Bharata, accompanied by Śatrughna, / was then brought quickly to the city from Rājagṛha by Vasiṣṭha and others.
[Footnote]
1. "pūrvām" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and ṅa.
2. "nṛpa" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "cāpatat" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
[Page 15]

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā saśokāṃ kaikeyīṃ nindayāmāsa duḥkhitaḥ /
akīrtiḥ pātitā mūrdhni kauśalyāṃ sa praśasya ca //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा सशोकां कैकेयीं निन्दयामास दुःखितः /
अकीर्तिः पातिता मूर्ध्नि कौशल्यां स प्रशस्य च //
text_mt: Seeing Kaikeyī full of sorrow, he censured her in his grief: / "Infamy has been brought upon my head!"; and having praised Kauśalyā,

sanskrit_iast:
pitarantailadroṇisthaṃ saṃskṛtya sarayūtaṭe /
vaśiṣṭhādyair janair ukto rājyaṃ kurviti so 'bravīt //
meaning:
पितरन्तैलद्रोणिस्थं संस्कृत्य सरयूतटे /
वशिष्ठाद्यैर् जनैर् उक्तो राज्यं कुर्विति सो ऽब्रवीत् //
text_mt: having cremated his father, who had been placed in an oil vat, on the bank of the Sarayū, / when told by Vasiṣṭha and the others: "Rule the kingdom!", he said:

sanskrit_iast:
vrajāmi rāmamānetuṃ rāmo rājā mato balī(1) /
śṛṅgaveraṃ prayāgañca bharadvājena bhojitaḥ //
meaning:
व्रजामि राममानेतुं रामो राजा मतो बली(1) /
शृङ्गवेरं प्रयागञ्च भरद्वाजेन भोजितः //
text_mt: "I go to bring back Rāma; mighty Rāma is regarded as the king." / [Passing through] Śṛṅgavera and Prayāga, he was fed by Bharadvāja.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskṛtya bharadvājaṃ rāmaṃ lakṣmaṇamāgataḥ /
pitā svargaṃ gato rāma ayodhyāyāṃ nṛpo bhava //
meaning:
नमस्कृत्य भरद्वाजं रामं लक्ष्मणमागतः /
पिता स्वर्गं गतो राम अयोध्यायां नृपो भव //
text_mt: Bowing to Bharadvāja, he came to Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa: / "Our father has gone to heaven, O Rāma; become the king in Ayodhyā!

sanskrit_iast:
ahaṃ vanaṃ prayāsyāmi tvadādeśapratīkṣakaḥ /
rāmaḥ śrutvā jalaṃ datvā gṛhītvā pāduke vraja //
meaning:
अहं वनं प्रयास्यामि त्वदादेशप्रतीक्षकः /
रामः श्रुत्वा जलं दत्वा गृहीत्वा पादुके व्रज //
text_mt: I shall go to the forest, awaiting your command." / Rāma, having heard, offered water [libations] and [said]: "Go, taking the sandals.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyāyāhannayāsyāmi(2) satyāccīrajaṭādharaḥ /
rāmokto bharataścāyān nandigrāme sthito balī //
tyaktvāyodhyāṃ pāduke te pūjya rājyamapālayat //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe
'yodhyākāṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ
rāmāyaṇavarṇanaṃ
meaning:
राज्यायाहन्नयास्यामि(2) सत्याच्चीरजटाधरः /
रामोक्तो भरतश्चायान् नन्दिग्रामे स्थितो बली //
त्यक्त्वायोध्यां पादुके ते पूज्य राज्यमपालयत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये रामायणे
ऽयोध्याकाण्डवर्णनं नाम षष्ठो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ सप्तमो ऽध्यायः
रामायणवर्णनं
text_mt:
Because of truthfulness, wearing bark and matted hair, I will not go to the kingdom." / Addressed by Rāma, mighty Bharata returned and stayed at Nandigrāma; / leaving Ayodhyā, he protected the kingdom, venerating those sandals.
Thus ends the sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Ayodhyākāṇḍa', in the Rāmāyaṇa in the Great Agni Purāṇa.
Now the seventh chapter:
Description of the Rāmāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
rāmo vaśiṣṭhaṃ mātṝñca natvātiñca praṇamya saḥ /
anasūyāñca tatpatnīṃ śarabhaṅgaṃ sutīkṣṇakam //
:n
1 yato balī iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ gato balī iti kha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 nāhaṃ rājyaṃ prayāsyāmi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ rājyaṃ
nāhaṃ prayāsyāmi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 16
meaning:
नारद उवाच
रामो वशिष्ठं मातॄञ्च नत्वातिञ्च प्रणम्य सः /
अनसूयाञ्च तत्पत्नीं शरभङ्गं सुतीक्ष्णकम् //
:न्
1 यतो बली इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः गतो बली इति ख, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 नाहं राज्यं प्रयास्यामि इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः राज्यं
नाहं प्रयास्यामि इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 16
text_mt:
Nārada said: / Rāma, having bowed to Vasiṣṭha and his mothers, and having prostrated to Atri, / and to Anasūyā his wife, to Śarabhaṅga, and to Sutīkṣṇa,
[Footnote]
1. "yato balī" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga; "gato balī" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
2. "nāhaṃ rājyaṃ prayāsyāmi" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "rājyaṃ nāhaṃ prayāsyāmi" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
[Page 16]
title: jñānasandīpanādeva iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
agastyabhrātaraṃ natvā agastyantatprasādataḥ /
dhanuḥkhaḍgañca samprāpya daṇḍakāraṇyamāgataḥ //
meaning:
अगस्त्यभ्रातरं नत्वा अगस्त्यन्तत्प्रसादतः /
धनुःखड्गञ्च सम्प्राप्य दण्डकारण्यमागतः //
text_mt: having bowed to Agastya's brother and to Agastya, through his grace / obtained a bow and a sword and came to the Daṇḍaka forest.

sanskrit_iast:
janasthāne pañcavaṭyāṃ sthito godāvarītaṭe /
tatra sūrpaṇakhāyātā bhakṣituṃ tān bhayaṅkarī //
meaning:
जनस्थाने पञ्चवट्यां स्थितो गोदावरीतटे /
तत्र सूर्पणखायाता भक्षितुं तान् भयङ्करी //
text_mt:
Dwelling at Pañcavaṭī in Janasthāna on the bank of the Godāvarī,
there the terrifying Śūrpaṇakhā arrived to devour them.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaṃ surūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā kāminī vākyamabravīt /
kastvaṃ kasmātsamāyāto bhartā me bhava cārthitaḥ //
meaning:
रामं सुरूपं दृष्ट्वा सा कामिनी वाक्यमब्रवीत् /
कस्त्वं कस्मात्समायातो भर्ता मे भव चार्थितः //
text_mt:
Seeing Rama's handsome form, she, filled with lust, spoke these words:
“Who are you? Whence have you come? Be my husband, as I desire!”

sanskrit_iast:
etau ca bhakṣayiṣyāmi ity uktvā taṃ samudyatā /
tasyā nāsāñca karṇau ca rāmokto lakṣmaṇo 'cchinat //
meaning:
एतौ च भक्षयिष्यामि इत्य् उक्त्वा तं समुद्यता /
तस्या नासाञ्च कर्णौ च रामोक्तो लक्ष्मणो ऽच्छिनत् //
text_mt:
Saying, “And I shall devour these two,” she rushed forward;
instructed by Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa cut off her nose and ears.

sanskrit_iast:
raktaṃ kṣarantī prayayau kharaṃ bhrātaramabravīt /
mariṣyāmi vināsāhaṃ khara jīvāmi vai tadā //
meaning:
रक्तं क्षरन्ती प्रययौ खरं भ्रातरमब्रवीत् /
मरिष्यामि विनासाहं खर जीवामि वै तदा //
text_mt:
Dripping blood, she went and spoke to her brother Khara:
“Nose-less, I shall die, Khara; only then shall I live,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmasya bhāryā sītāsau tasyāsīllakṣmaṇo 'nujaḥ /
teṣām yadrudhiraṃ(1) soṣṇaṃ pāyayiṣyasi māṃ yadi //
meaning:
रामस्य भार्या सीतासौ तस्यासील्लक्ष्मणो ऽनुजः /
तेषाम् यद्रुधिरं(1) सोष्णं पाययिष्यसि मां यदि //
text_mt:
if Rāma’s wife is this Sītā, his younger brother was Lakṣmaṇa—
if you make me drink their warm blood.”

sanskrit_iast:
kharastatheti tāmuktvā caturdaśasahasrakaiḥ /
rakṣasāṃ dūṣaṇenāgād yoddhuṃ(2) triśirasā saha //
meaning:
खरस्तथेति तामुक्त्वा चतुर्दशसहस्रकैः /
रक्षसां दूषणेनागाद् योद्धुं(2) त्रिशिरसा सह //
text_mt:
Khara said to her, “So be it,” and with fourteen thousand
rākṣasas, together with Dūṣaṇa and Triśiras, went to fight

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaṃ rāmo 'pi yuyudhe śarair vivyādha rākṣasān /
hastyaśvarathapādātaṃ balaṃ ninye yamakṣayaṃ //
meaning:
रामं रामो ऽपि युयुधे शरैर् विव्याध राक्षसान् /
हस्त्यश्वरथपादातं बलं निन्ये यमक्षयं //
text_mt:
Rāma. Rāma also fought, and pierced the rākṣasas with arrows;
he sent their army of elephants, horses, chariots, and foot-soldiers to the abode of Yama.

sanskrit_iast:
triśīrṣāṇaṃ kharaṃ raudraṃ yudhyantañcaiva dūṣaṇam /
yayau sūrpaṇakhā laṅkāṃ rāvaṇāgre 'patad bhuvi //
meaning:
त्रिशीर्षाणं खरं रौद्रं युध्यन्तञ्चैव दूषणम् /
ययौ सूर्पणखा लङ्कां रावणाग्रे ऽपतद् भुवि //
text_mt:
[Having slain] Triśiras, the fierce Khara, and Dūṣaṇa who was fighting,
Śūrpaṇakhā went to Laṅkā and fell upon the ground before Rāvaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
abravīdrāvaṇaṃ kruddhā na tvaṃ rājā na rakṣakaḥ /
kharādihantū rāmasya sītāṃ bhāryāṃ harasva ca //
meaning:
अब्रवीद्रावणं क्रुद्धा न त्वं राजा न रक्षकः /
खरादिहन्तू रामस्य सीतां भार्यां हरस्व च //
text_mt:
Enraged, she spoke to Rāvaṇa: “You are no king, nor a protector!
Carry off the wife Sītā of Rāma, the slayer of Khara and the rest!

sanskrit_iast:
rāmalakṣmaṇaraktasya pānājjīvāmi nānyathā /
tathetyāha ca tac chrutvā mārīcaṃ prāha vai vraja //
meaning:
रामलक्ष्मणरक्तस्य पानाज्जीवामि नान्यथा /
तथेत्याह च तच् छ्रुत्वा मारीचं प्राह वै व्रज //
text_mt:
Only by drinking the blood of Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa shall I live, not otherwise!”
Hearing that, he said, “So be it,” and indeed told Mārīca: “Go!

sanskrit_iast:
svarṇacitramṛgo bhūtvā rāmalakṣmaṇakarṣakaḥ /
:n
1 hṛdrudhiramiti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
2 rakṣasāṃ sahasā prāyādyoddhumiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 17
sītāgre tāṃ hariṣyāmi anyathā maraṇaṃ tava //
meaning:
स्वर्णचित्रमृगो भूत्वा रामलक्ष्मणकर्षकः /
:न्
1 हृद्रुधिरमिति ख, ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
2 रक्षसां सहसा प्रायाद्योद्धुमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 17
सीताग्रे तां हरिष्यामि अन्यथा मरणं तव //
text_mt:
Becoming a variegated golden deer, luring Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa away,
[Footnote]
[Variant reading: 'the heart's blood' in manuscripts Kha, Ga, and Ṅa.]
[Variant reading: 'He went swiftly with the rākṣasas to fight' in manuscript Ga.]
I shall abduct her from before Sītā['s eyes]; otherwise, your death [is certain].”

sanskrit_iast:
mārīco rāvaṇaṃ prāha rāmo mṛtyurdhanurdharaḥ(1) /
rāvaṇādapi martavyaṃ martavyaṃ rāghavādapi //
meaning:
मारीचो रावणं प्राह रामो मृत्युर्धनुर्धरः(1) /
रावणादपि मर्तव्यं मर्तव्यं राघवादपि //
text_mt:
Mārīca said to Rāvaṇa: “Rāma, wielding the bow, is death itself.
One must die by Rāvaṇa's hand, or die by Rāghava's.

sanskrit_iast:
avaśyaṃ yadi martavyaṃ varaṃ rāmo na rāvaṇaḥ /
iti matvā mṛgo bhūtvā sītāgre vyacaranmuhuḥ //
meaning:
अवश्यं यदि मर्तव्यं वरं रामो न रावणः /
इति मत्वा मृगो भूत्वा सीताग्रे व्यचरन्मुहुः //
text_mt:
If one must inevitably die, better Rāma than Rāvaṇa.”
Thinking thus, having become a deer, he roamed repeatedly before Sītā.

sanskrit_iast:
sītayā prerito(2) rāmaḥ śareṇāthāvadhīcca taṃ /
mriyamāṇo mṛgaḥ prāha hā sīte lakṣmaṇeti ca //
meaning:
सीतया प्रेरितो(2) रामः शरेणाथावधीच्च तं /
म्रियमाणो मृगः प्राह हा सीते लक्ष्मणेति च //
text_mt:
Urged by Sītā, Rāma then killed it with an arrow;
dying, the deer cried out: “Alas, Sītā! Lakṣmaṇa!”

sanskrit_iast:
saumitriḥ sītayokto 'tha viruddhaṃ rāmamāgataḥ /
rāvaṇopyaharat sītāṃ hatvā gṛdhraṃ jaṭāyuṣaṃ //
meaning:
सौमित्रिः सीतयोक्तो ऽथ विरुद्धं राममागतः /
रावणोप्यहरत् सीतां हत्वा गृध्रं जटायुषं //
text_mt:
Then the son of Sumitrā, addressed by Sītā, came to Rāma against his will;
and Rāvaṇa abducted Sītā, having slain the vulture Jaṭāyus.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭāyuṣā sa bhinnāṅgo(3) aṅkenādāya jānakīm /
gato laṅkāmaśokākhye dhārayāmāsa cābravīt //
meaning:
जटायुषा स भिन्नाङ्गो(3) अङ्केनादाय जानकीम् /
गतो लङ्कामशोकाख्ये धारयामास चाब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
With his body torn by Jaṭāyus, he took the daughter of Janaka on his lap,
went to Laṅkā, detained her in the grove named Aśoka, and said:

sanskrit_iast:
bhava bhāryā mamāgryā tvaṃ rākṣasyo rakṣyatāmiyam /
rāmo hatvā tu mārīcaṃ dṛṣṭvā lakṣmaṇamabravīt //
meaning:
भव भार्या ममाग्र्या त्वं राक्षस्यो रक्ष्यतामियम् /
रामो हत्वा तु मारीचं दृष्ट्वा लक्ष्मणमब्रवीत् //
text_mt:
“Become my foremost wife! O rākṣasa women, let her be guarded!”
Having slain Mārīca and seeing Lakṣmaṇa, Rāma said:

sanskrit_iast:
māyāmṛgo 'sau saumitre yathā tvamiha cāgataḥ /
tathā sītā hṛtā nūnaṃ nāpaśyat sa gato 'tha tām //
meaning:
मायामृगो ऽसौ सौमित्रे यथा त्वमिह चागतः /
तथा सीता हृता नूनं नापश्यत् स गतो ऽथ ताम् //
text_mt:
“This was an illusion-deer, O son of Sumitrā! Just as you have come here,
so surely Sītā has been abducted.” Then, going there, he did not see her.

sanskrit_iast:
śuśoca vilalāpārto māntyaktvā kva gatāsi vai /
lakṣmaṇāśvāsito rāmo mārgayāmāsa(4) jānakīm //
meaning:
शुशोच विललापार्तो मान्त्यक्त्वा क्व गतासि वै /
लक्ष्मणाश्वासितो रामो मार्गयामास(4) जानकीम् //
text_mt:
He grieved, lamenting in distress: “Having abandoned me, where indeed have you gone?”
Comforted by Lakṣmaṇa, Rāma searched for the daughter of Janaka.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvā jaṭāyustaṃ prāha rāvaṇo hṛtavāṃś ca tāṃ /
mṛto 'tha saṃskṛtastena kabandhañcāvadhīttataḥ //
śāpamukto 'bravīdrāmaṃ sa tvaṃ sugrīvamāvraja //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyaṇe
āraṇyakakāṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:n
1 mṛtyurna tadvaramiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 preṣita iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 viratha iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
4 āhvayāmāsa iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 18
:ś atha aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śrīrāmāvatārakathanaṃ
meaning:
दृष्ट्वा जटायुस्तं प्राह रावणो हृतवांश् च तां /
मृतो ऽथ संस्कृतस्तेन कबन्धञ्चावधीत्ततः //
शापमुक्तो ऽब्रवीद्रामं स त्वं सुग्रीवमाव्रज //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये रामायणे
आरण्यककाण्डवर्णनं नाम सप्तमो ऽध्यायः
:न्
1 मृत्युर्न तद्वरमिति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 प्रेषित इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 विरथ इति ख, ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
4 आह्वयामास इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 18
:श् अथ अष्टमो ऽध्यायः
श्रीरामावतारकथनं
text_mt:
Seeing him, Jaṭāyus said to him, “Rāvaṇa has carried her off.”
Having died, he was then cremated by him; then [Rāma] killed Kabandha.
Freed from a curse, he said to Rāma: “Go to Sugrīva!”
Thus ends the seventh chapter, titled “Description of the Āraṇyakāṇḍa” in the Rāmāyaṇa, in the primeval Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
[Footnote]
[Variant reading: 'death is not better than that' in manuscripts Kha and Ga.]
[Variant reading: 'sent' in manuscript Kha.]
[Variant reading: 'chariotless' in manuscripts Kha, Ga, and Ṅa.]
[Variant reading: 'called out to' in manuscript Ṅa.]
Now the eighth chapter.
Narration of the divine incarnation of Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
rāmaḥ pampāsaro gatvā śocan sa śarvarīṃ tataḥ(1) /
hanūmatā sa sugrīvaṃ(2) nīto mitrañcakāra ha //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
रामः पम्पासरो गत्वा शोचन् स शर्वरीं ततः(1) /
हनूमता स सुग्रीवं(2) नीतो मित्रञ्चकार ह //
title: brahmāgneyaṃ purāṇamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ

sanskrit_iast:
sapta tālān vinirbhidya śareṇaikena paśyataḥ /
pādena dundubheḥ kāyañ cikṣepa daśayojanaṃ //
meaning:
सप्त तालान् विनिर्भिद्य शरेणैकेन पश्यतः /
पादेन दुन्दुभेः कायञ् चिक्षेप दशयोजनं //
text_mt:
Having pierced seven palmyra trees with a single arrow before their eyes,
with his foot he kicked the corpse of Dundubhi ten leagues away.

sanskrit_iast:
tadripuṃ bālinaṃ hatvā bhrātaraṃ vairakāriṇam /
kiṣkindhāṃ kapirājyañca rumāntārāṃ samarpayat //
meaning:
तद्रिपुं बालिनं हत्वा भ्रातरं वैरकारिणम् /
किष्किन्धां कपिराज्यञ्च रुमान्तारां समर्पयत् //
text_mt:
Having slain his enemy Bālin, the brother who caused hostility,
he bestowed Kiṣkindhā and the monkey kingdom, along with Rumā and Tārā.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣyamūke harīśāya kiṣkindheśo 'bravītsa ca(3) /
sītāṃ tvaṃ prāśyase yadvat(4) tathā rāma karomi te //
meaning:
ऋष्यमूके हरीशाय किष्किन्धेशो ऽब्रवीत्स च(3) /
सीतां त्वं प्राश्यसे यद्वत्(4) तथा राम करोमि ते //
text_mt:
On Ṛṣyamūka, that lord of Kiṣkindhā said to the lord of monkeys:
“Rāma, I shall act for you in such a way that you will regain Sītā.”

sanskrit_iast:
tac chrutvā mālyavatpṛṣṭhe cāturmāsyaṃ cakāra saḥ /
kiṣkindhāyāñca sugrīvo yadā nāyāti darśanaṃ //
meaning:
तच् छ्रुत्वा माल्यवत्पृष्ठे चातुर्मास्यं चकार सः /
किष्किन्धायाञ्च सुग्रीवो यदा नायाति दर्शनं //
text_mt:
Hearing that, he spent the four months of the rainy season on the ridge of Mālyavat;
and when Sugrīva did not come into sight at Kiṣkindhā,

sanskrit_iast:
tadābravīttaṃ rāmoktaṃ lakṣmaṇo vraja rāghavam /
na sa saṅkucitaḥ panthā yena bālī hato gataḥ //
meaning:
तदाब्रवीत्तं रामोक्तं लक्ष्मणो व्रज राघवम् /
न स सङ्कुचितः पन्था येन बाली हतो गतः //
text_mt:
then Lakṣmaṇa spoke to him at Rāma’s bidding: “Go to Rāghava!
The path by which Bālin went, slain, is not closed.

sanskrit_iast:
samaye tiṣṭha sugrīva mā bālipathamanvagāḥ /
sugrīva āha saṃsakto(5) gataṃ kālaṃ na buddhavān //
meaning:
समये तिष्ठ सुग्रीव मा बालिपथमन्वगाः /
सुग्रीव आह संसक्तो(5) गतं कालं न बुद्धवान् //
text_mt:
Abide by your agreement, Sugrīva; do not follow the path of Bālin!”
Sugrīva said: “Indulging [in pleasures], I did not realize the time had passed.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā sa gato rāmaṃ natvovāca harīśvaraḥ /
ānītā vānarāḥ sarve sītāyāś ca gaveṣaṇe //
:n
1 gauravācchavarīnataḥ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / śavarīṃ
tata iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 hanūmatā vānarendramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 abravīttat iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 prāpsyasi yathā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 sugrīvamāha saṅkruddha iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ /
sugrīva ṛddhisaṃsakta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 19
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा स गतो रामं नत्वोवाच हरीश्वरः /
आनीता वानराः सर्वे सीतायाश् च गवेषणे //
:न्
1 गौरवाच्छवरीनतः इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / शवरीं
तत इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 हनूमता वानरेन्द्रमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 अब्रवीत्तत् इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 प्राप्स्यसि यथा इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 सुग्रीवमाह सङ्क्रुद्ध इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः /
सुग्रीव ऋद्धिसंसक्त इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 19
text_mt:
Having spoken thus, the lord of monkeys went, bowed to Rāma, and said:
“All the monkeys have been gathered for the search for Sītā.
[Footnote]
[Variant reading: 'bowed to by Śabarī out of respect' in manuscript Ṅa; 'then to Śabarī' in manuscripts Kha and Ga.]
[Variant reading: 'by Hanūmat to the lord of monkeys' in manuscript Ṅa.]
[Variant reading: 'said that' in manuscript Ga.]
[Variant reading: 'as you shall obtain' in manuscript Kha.]
[Variant reading: 'enraged, he said to Sugrīva' in manuscripts Kha and Ga; 'Sugrīva, attached to prosperity' in manuscript Ṅa.]

sanskrit_iast:
tvanmatāt preṣayiṣyāmi vicinvantu ca jānakīm /
pūrvādau māsamāyāntu māsādūrdhvaṃ nihanmi tān //
meaning:
त्वन्मतात् प्रेषयिष्यामि विचिन्वन्तु च जानकीम् /
पूर्वादौ मासमायान्तु मासादूर्ध्वं निहन्मि तान् //
text_mt:
With your approval, I shall dispatch them; let them search for the daughter of Janaka.
Let them return within a month from the east and other quarters; after a month, I shall kill them.”

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktā vānarāḥ pūrva- paścimottaramārgagāḥ /
jagmū rāmaṃ sasugrīvam apaśyantas tu jānakīm //
meaning:
इत्युक्ता वानराः पूर्व- पश्चिमोत्तरमार्गगाः /
जग्मू रामं ससुग्रीवम् अपश्यन्तस् तु जानकीम् //
text_mt:
Thus instructed, the monkeys traveling the eastern, western, and northern paths
returned to Rāma and Sugrīva, not having seen the daughter of Janaka.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmāṅgulīyaṃ saṅgṛhya hanūmān vānaraiḥ saha /
dakṣiṇe mārgayāmāsa suprabhāyā guhāntike //
meaning:
रामाङ्गुलीयं सङ्गृह्य हनूमान् वानरैः सह /
दक्षिणे मार्गयामास सुप्रभाया गुहान्तिके //
text_mt:
Taking Rāma’s signet ring, Hanūmat, along with the monkeys,
searched in the south near the cave of Suprabhā.

sanskrit_iast:
māsādūrdhvañca vinyastā apaśyantastu jānakīm /
ūcurvṛthā mariṣyāmo jaṭāyurdhanya evasaḥ //
meaning:
मासादूर्ध्वञ्च विन्यस्ता अपश्यन्तस्तु जानकीम् /
ऊचुर्वृथा मरिष्यामो जटायुर्धन्य एवसः //
text_mt:
Delaying beyond a month, and not seeing the daughter of Janaka,
they said, “We shall die in vain! Blessed indeed is that Jaṭāyus,

sanskrit_iast:
sītārthe yo 'tyajat prāṇān rāvaṇena hato raṇe /
tac chrutvā prāha sampātir vihāya kapibhakṣaṇaṃ //
meaning:
सीतार्थे यो ऽत्यजत् प्राणान् रावणेन हतो रणे /
तच् छ्रुत्वा प्राह सम्पातिर् विहाय कपिभक्षणं //
text_mt:
who gave up his life for Sītā’s sake, slain in battle by Rāvaṇa.”
Hearing that, Sampāti, refraining from eating the monkeys, said:

sanskrit_iast:
bhrātāsau me jaṭāyurvai mayoḍḍīno 'rkamaṇḍalam /
arkatāpādrakṣito 'gāt dagdhapakṣo 'hamabbhragaḥ //
meaning:
भ्रातासौ मे जटायुर्वै मयोड्डीनो ऽर्कमण्डलम् /
अर्कतापाद्रक्षितो ऽगात् दग्धपक्षो ऽहमब्भ्रगः //
text_mt:
“That Jaṭāyus is my brother; he flew with me toward the orb of the sun.
Protected by me from the sun’s heat, he went [unharmed]; with my wings burned, falling through the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmavārtāśravāt pakṣau jātau bhūyo 'tha jānakīm /
paśyāmyaśokavanikā- gatāṃ laṅkāgatāṃ kila //
meaning:
रामवार्ताश्रवात् पक्षौ जातौ भूयो ऽथ जानकीम् /
पश्याम्यशोकवनिका- गतां लङ्कागतां किल //
text_mt:
by hearing news of Rāma, my two wings have grown again! Now
I see the daughter of Janaka, indeed gone to the Aśoka grove, gone to Laṅkā,

sanskrit_iast:
śatayojanavistīrṇe lavaṇābdhau trikūṭake /
jñātvā rāmaṃ sasugrīvaṃ vānarāḥ kathayantu vai //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye rāmāyāṇe
kiṣkindhākāṇḍavarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha navamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śrīrāmāvatārakathanaṃ
meaning:
शतयोजनविस्तीर्णे लवणाब्धौ त्रिकूटके /
ज्ञात्वा रामं ससुग्रीवं वानराः कथयन्तु वै //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये रामायाणे
किष्किन्धाकाण्डवर्णनं नाम अष्टमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ नवमो ऽध्यायः
श्रीरामावतारकथनं
text_mt:
on mount Trikūṭa in the salt ocean, a hundred leagues wide!
Having learned this, let the monkeys report it to Rāma and Sugrīva!”
Thus ends the eighth chapter, titled “Description of the Kiṣkindhākāṇḍa” in the Rāmāyaṇa, in the primeval Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now the ninth chapter.
Narration of the divine incarnation of Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
sampātivacanaṃ śrutvā hanumānaṅgadādayaḥ /
abdhiṃ dṛṣṭvābruvaṃste 'bdhiṃ laṅghayet ko nu jīvayet //
:p 20
meaning:
नारद उवाच
सम्पातिवचनं श्रुत्वा हनुमानङ्गदादयः /
अब्धिं दृष्ट्वाब्रुवंस्ते ऽब्धिं लङ्घयेत् को नु जीवयेत् //
:प् 20
text_mt:
Nārada said:
Having heard the words of Sampāti, Hanumān, Aṅgada and the others, / seeing the ocean, said: "Who indeed could cross the ocean? Who could save [our] lives?"
[Page 20]
title: rekhāṃ prakurvīteti kha.. ,ga.. ca

sanskrit_iast:
kapīnāṃ jīvanārthāya rāmakāryaprasiddhaye /
śatayojanavistīrṇaṃ pupluve 'bdhiṃ sa mārutiḥ //
meaning:
कपीनां जीवनार्थाय रामकार्यप्रसिद्धये /
शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं पुप्लुवे ऽब्धिं स मारुतिः //
text_mt: For the preservation of the monkeys' lives and for the accomplishment of Rāma's mission, / that son of Marut leaped across the ocean, one hundred yojanas wide.

sanskrit_iast:
dṛṣṭvotthitañca mainākaṃ siṃhikāṃ vinipātya ca /
laṅkāṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣasānāṃ gṛhāṇi vanitāgṛhe //
meaning:
दृष्ट्वोत्थितञ्च मैनाकं सिंहिकां विनिपात्य च /
लङ्कां दृष्ट्वा राक्षसानां गृहाणि वनितागृहे //
text_mt: Having seen Maināka risen, and having struck down Siṃhikā, / and having seen Laṅkā, the dwellings of the rākṣasas, and in the women's quarters,

sanskrit_iast:
daśagrīvasya kumbhasya kumbhakarṇasya rakṣasaḥ /
vibhīṣaṇasyendrajito gṛhe 'nyeṣāṃ ca rakṣaso //
meaning:
दशग्रीवस्य कुम्भस्य कुम्भकर्णस्य रक्षसः /
विभीषणस्येन्द्रजितो गृहे ऽन्येषां च रक्षसो //
text_mt: in the house of the Ten-necked one (Daśagrīva), of Kumbha, of Kumbhakarṇa the rākṣasa, / of Vibhīṣaṇa, of Indrajit, and in the houses of other rākṣasas,

sanskrit_iast:
nāpaśyat pānabhūmyādau sītāṃ cintāparāyaṇaḥ /
aśokavanikāṃ gatvā dṛṣṭavāñchiṃśapātale //
meaning:
नापश्यत् पानभूम्यादौ सीतां चिन्तापरायणः /
अशोकवनिकां गत्वा दृष्टवाञ्छिंशपातले //
text_mt: he did not see Sītā in the drinking halls and elsewhere. Filled with anxiety, / having gone to the Aśoka grove, he saw beneath a śiṃśapā tree

sanskrit_iast:
rākṣasīrakṣitāṃ sītāṃ bhava bhāryeti vādinaṃ /
rāvaṇaṃ śiṃśapāstho 'tha neti sītāntu vādinīṃ //
meaning:
राक्षसीरक्षितां सीतां भव भार्येति वादिनं /
रावणं शिंशपास्थो ऽथ नेति सीतान्तु वादिनीं //
text_mt: Sītā guarded by rākṣasīs, and Rāvaṇa saying: "Become my wife!", / while he stood in the śiṃśapā tree, and Sītā saying: "No!"

sanskrit_iast:
bhava bhāryā rāvaṇasya rākṣasīrvādinīḥ kapiḥ /
gate tu rāvaṇe prāha rājā daśaratho 'bhavat //
meaning:
भव भार्या रावणस्य राक्षसीर्वादिनीः कपिः /
गते तु रावणे प्राह राजा दशरथो ऽभवत् //
text_mt:
And the rākṣasīs saying: "Become the wife of Rāvaṇa!"
When Rāvaṇa had departed, the monkey said: "There was a king Daśaratha.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmo 'sya(1) lakṣmaṇaḥ putrau vanavāsaṅgatau varau /
rāmapatnī jānakī tvaṃ rāvaṇena hṛtā balāt //
meaning:
रामो ऽस्य(1) लक्ष्मणः पुत्रौ वनवासङ्गतौ वरौ /
रामपत्नी जानकी त्वं रावणेन हृता बलात् //
text_mt: His excellent sons are Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa, who went to live in the forest. / You are Rāma's wife, Jānakī, carried off by Rāvaṇa by force.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaḥ sugrīvamitras tvāṃ mārgayan preṣayacca mām(2) /
sābhijñānañcāgulīyaṃ rāmadattaṃ gṛhāṇa vai //
meaning:
रामः सुग्रीवमित्रस् त्वां मार्गयन् प्रेषयच्च माम्(2) /
साभिज्ञानञ्चागुलीयं रामदत्तं गृहाण वै //
text_mt: Rāma, allied with Sugrīva, searching for you, dispatched me. / Take indeed this token ring given by Rāma."

sanskrit_iast:
sītāṅgulīyaṃ jagrāha sāpaśyanmārūtintarau /
bhūyo 'gre copaviṣṭaṃ tam uvāca yadi jīvati //
meaning:
सीताङ्गुलीयं जग्राह सापश्यन्मारूतिन्तरौ /
भूयो ऽग्रे चोपविष्टं तम् उवाच यदि जीवति //
text_mt: Sītā took the ring. She saw the son of Marut in the tree. / Sitting once again before her, he said to her: "If he lives,

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaḥ kathaṃ na nayati śṛṅkitāmabravīt kapiḥ /
rāmaḥ sīte na jānīte jñātvā tvāṃ sa nayiṣyati //
meaning:
रामः कथं न नयति शृङ्कितामब्रवीत् कपिः /
रामः सीते न जानीते ज्ञात्वा त्वां स नयिष्यति //
text_mt: why does Rāma not lead [you] away?" To her who was doubtful, the monkey said: / "O Sītā, Rāma does not know; once he knows, he will take you away,

sanskrit_iast:
rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasaṃ hatvā sabalaṃ devi mā śuca /
sābhijñānaṃ dehi me tvaṃ maṇiṃ sītādadatkapau //
meaning:
रावणं राक्षसं हत्वा सबलं देवि मा शुच /
साभिज्ञानं देहि मे त्वं मणिं सीताददत्कपौ //
text_mt: having slain the rākṣasa Rāvaṇa along with his army. O lady, do not grieve! / Give me a token [for him]." Sītā gave a crest-jewel to the monkey

sanskrit_iast:
uvāca māṃ yathā rāmo nayecchīghraṃ tathā kuru /

kākākṣipātanakathām pratiyāhi hi śokaha //

उवाच मां यथा रामो नयेच्छीघ्रं तथा कुरु /

:प् 21
काकाक्षिपातनकथाम् प्रतियाहि हि शोकह //

and said: "Act in such a way that Rāma may take me away quickly.

2. "tvāṃ mārgayet preṣayecca mām" is the reading of the manuscript marked gha. / [Page 21]
Go back [with] the story of the piercing of the crow's eye, O dispeller of grief!"

maṇiṃ kathāṃ gṛhītvāha hanūmānneṣyate patiḥ /
athavā te tvarā kācit pṛṣṭhamāruha me śubhe //
