कश्यपवंशवर्णनम्
text_mt:
Vṛṣākapi, Śambhu, Kapardin, Raivata, / Mṛgavyādha, Sarpa, and Kapālin—these are the eleven Rudras; / and there are a hundred and a hundred thousand Rudras by whom all moving and unmoving things are pervaded.
Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, named "The Description of the Creation of the Universe", in the Agni Mahāpurāṇa.
Now the nineteenth chapter:
Description of the Lineage of Kaśyapa

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
kaśyapasya vede sargamadityādiṣu he mune /
cākṣuṣe tuṣitā devāste 'dityāṃ kaśyapātpunaḥ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
कश्यपस्य वेदे सर्गमदित्यादिषु हे मुने /
चाक्षुषे तुषिता देवास्ते ऽदित्यां कश्यपात्पुनः //
text_mt: Agni said: / Hear of the creation of Kaśyapa through Aditi and the others, O sage. / The gods who were the Tuṣitas in the Cākṣuṣa [manvantara] were again born to Kaśyapa in Aditi:

sanskrit_iast:
āsan viṣṇuś ca śakraś ca tvaṣṭā dhātā tathāryamā /
pūṣā vivasvān savitā mitrotha varuṇo bhagaḥ //
meaning:
आसन् विष्णुश् च शक्रश् च त्वष्टा धाता तथार्यमा /
पूषा विवस्वान् सविता मित्रोथ वरुणो भगः //
text_mt: They were Viṣṇu, Śakra, Tvaṣṭṛ, Dhātṛ, and Aryaman, / Pūṣan, Vivasvan, Savitṛ, Mitra, Varuṇa, Bhaga,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśuś ca dvādaśādityā āsan vaivasvatentare /
ariṣṭanemipatrīnāmapatyānīha ṣoḍaśa //
meaning:
अंशुश् च द्वादशादित्या आसन् वैवस्वतेन्तरे /
अरिष्टनेमिपत्रीनामपत्यानीह षोडश //
text_mt: and Aṃśa—these were the twelve Ādityas in the Vaivasvata interval. / The offspring of the wives of Ariṣṭanemi here were sixteen;

sanskrit_iast:
bahuputrastha viduṣaś catasro vidyutaḥ sutāḥ(2) /
pratyaṅgirajāḥ śreṣṭhāḥ kṛśāśvasya surāyudhāḥ //
meaning:
बहुपुत्रस्थ विदुषश् चतस्रो विद्युतः सुताः(2) /
प्रत्यङ्गिरजाः श्रेष्ठाः कृशाश्वस्य सुरायुधाः //
text_mt: the four lightning-daughters were of the wise Bahuputra; / the divine weapons of Kṛśāśva were born from Pratyaṅgiras, the most excellent ones.

sanskrit_iast:
udayāstamane sūrye tadvadete yuge yuge /
hiraṇyakaśipurdityāṃ hiraṇyākṣaś ca kaśyapāt //
:n
1 saptama iti kha ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 smṛtā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 47
meaning:
उदयास्तमने सूर्ये तद्वदेते युगे युगे /
हिरण्यकशिपुर्दित्यां हिरण्याक्षश् च कश्यपात् //
:न्
1 सप्तम इति ख ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्मृता इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 47
text_mt:
They appear in every yuga at sunrise and sunset in the same way. / Hiraṇyakaśipu and Hiraṇyākṣa were born to Kaśyapa from Diti.
[Footnote]
1. "saptamaḥ" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
2. "smṛtāḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhikā cābhavat kanyā vipracitteḥ parigrahaḥ /
rāhuprabhṛtayastasyāṃ saiṃhikeyā iti śrutāḥ //
meaning:
सिंहिका चाभवत् कन्या विप्रचित्तेः परिग्रहः /
राहुप्रभृतयस्तस्यां सैंहिकेया इति श्रुताः //
text_mt: And Siṃhikā was a daughter who became the wife of Vipracitti; / from her were born Rāhu and others, celebrated as the Saiṃhikeyas.

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāś catvāraḥ prathitaujasaḥ /
anuhrādaś ca hrādaś ca prahrādaścātivaiṣṇavaḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्यकशिपोः पुत्राश् चत्वारः प्रथितौजसः /
अनुह्रादश् च ह्रादश् च प्रह्रादश्चातिवैष्णवः //
text_mt: Hiraṇyakaśipu had four sons of renowned might: / Anuhrāda, Hrāda, and Prahrāda, devoted to Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhrādaś ca caturthobhūt hrādaputro hradas tathā /
hradasya putra āyuṣmān(1) śibirvāskala eva ca //
meaning:
संह्रादश् च चतुर्थोभूत् ह्रादपुत्रो ह्रदस् तथा /
ह्रदस्य पुत्र आयुष्मान्(1) शिबिर्वास्कल एव च //
text_mt: and Saṃhrāda was the fourth. Hrāda's son was Hrada, / and Hrada's long-lived son was Śibi, as well as Vāskala.

sanskrit_iast:
virovanastu prāhrādirbalirjajñe virocanāt /
baleḥ putraśataṃ tvāsīdvāṇaśreṣṭhaṃ(2) mahāmune //
meaning:
विरोवनस्तु प्राह्रादिर्बलिर्जज्ञे विरोचनात् /
बलेः पुत्रशतं त्वासीद्वाणश्रेष्ठं(2) महामुने //
text_mt: Virocana was the son of Prahrāda; from Virocana, Bali was born. / Bali had a hundred sons, of whom Bāṇa was the eldest, O great sage.

sanskrit_iast:
purākalpe hi bāṇena prasādyomāpatiṃ varaḥ(3) /
pārśvato vihariṣyāmītyevam prāptaś ca īśvarāt(4) //
meaning:
पुराकल्पे हि बाणेन प्रसाद्योमापतिं वरः(3) /
पार्श्वतो विहरिष्यामीत्येवम् प्राप्तश् च ईश्वरात्(4) //
text_mt: For in a previous cosmic cycle, Bāṇa, having propitiated the husband of Umā, obtained a boon / from the Lord: 'I shall sport at your side.'

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyākṣasutāḥ pañca śambaraḥ śakunistviti(5) /
dvimūrdhā śaṅkurāryaś ca(6) śatamāsan danoḥ sutāḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्याक्षसुताः पञ्च शम्बरः शकुनिस्त्विति(5) /
द्विमूर्धा शङ्कुरार्यश् च(6) शतमासन् दनोः सुताः //
text_mt: Hiraṇyākṣa had five sons: Śambara, Śakuni, / Dvimūrdhan, Śaṅku, and Ārya. Danu had a hundred sons.

sanskrit_iast:
svarbhānostu prabhā kanyā pulomnastu śacī smṛtā /
upadānavī hayaśirā śarmiṣṭhā vārṣaparvaṇī //
meaning:
स्वर्भानोस्तु प्रभा कन्या पुलोम्नस्तु शची स्मृता /
उपदानवी हयशिरा शर्मिष्ठा वार्षपर्वणी //
text_mt: Svarbhānu's daughter was Prabhā, and Puloman's is known as Śacī; / Upadānavī, Hayaśiras, and Śarmiṣṭhā the daughter of Vṛṣaparvan.

sanskrit_iast:
pulomā kālakā caiva vaiśvānarasute ubhe /
kaśyapasya tu bhārye dve tayoḥ putrāś ca koṭayaḥ //
meaning:
पुलोमा कालका चैव वैश्वानरसुते उभे /
कश्यपस्य तु भार्ये द्वे तयोः पुत्राश् च कोटयः //
text_mt: Pulomā and Kālakā were both daughters of Vaiśvānara; / they were two wives of Kaśyapa, and their sons numbered in the tens of millions.

sanskrit_iast:
prahrādasya catuṣkoṭyo nivātakavacāḥ kule /
tāmrāyāḥ ṣaṭ sutāḥ syuś ca kākī śvenī ca bhāsyapi //
meaning:
प्रह्रादस्य चतुष्कोट्यो निवातकवचाः कुले /
ताम्रायाः षट् सुताः स्युश् च काकी श्वेनी च भास्यपि //
text_mt: In the lineage of Prahrāda were forty million Nivātakavacas. / Tāmrā had six daughters: Kākī, Śvenī, and Bhāsī,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛdhrikā śuci sugrīvā(7) tābhyaḥ kākādayo 'bhavan /
:n
1 saṃhrādaputra āyuṣmāniti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 vāṇajyeṣṭhamiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 prabhumiti kha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
4 ity evaṃ prāptamīśvarāditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 jharjharaḥ śakunistvatīti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / śaknistvatheti
ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 dvimūrdhā śambarādyāś ca iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
7 gṛdhrikā ca śucigrīvo iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
gṛdhrikāśucisugrīvo iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 48
aśvāścoṣṭrāś ca tāmrāyā aruṇo garuḍas tathā //
meaning:
गृध्रिका शुचि सुग्रीवा(7) ताभ्यः काकादयो ऽभवन् /
:न्
1 संह्रादपुत्र आयुष्मानिति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 वाणज्येष्ठमिति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 प्रभुमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
4 इत्य् एवं प्राप्तमीश्वरादिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 झर्झरः शकुनिस्त्वतीति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / शक्निस्त्वथेति
ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 द्विमूर्धा शम्बराद्याश् च इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
7 गृध्रिका च शुचिग्रीवो इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
गृध्रिकाशुचिसुग्रीवो इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 48
अश्वाश्चोष्ट्राश् च ताम्राया अरुणो गरुडस् तथा //
text_mt:
Gṛdhrikā, Śuci, and Sugrīvā; from them crows and other birds were born.
[Footnote]
1. "saṃhrādaputra āyuṣmān" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga.
2. "vāṇajyeṣṭham" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga.
3. "prabhum" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha.
4. "ity evaṃ prāptamīśvarāt" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
5. "jharjharaḥ śakunistvatī" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "śaknistvathe" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
6. "dvimūrdhā śambarādyāś ca" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
7. "gṛdhrikā ca śucigrīvo" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "gṛdhrikāśucisugrīvo" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
Horses and camels also came from Tāmrā, as well as Aruṇa and Garuḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
vinatāyāḥ sahasrantu sarpāś ca surasābhavāḥ /
kādraveyāḥ sahasrantu śeṣavāsukitakṣakāḥ //
meaning:
विनतायाः सहस्रन्तु सर्पाश् च सुरसाभवाः /
काद्रवेयाः सहस्रन्तु शेषवासुकितक्षकाः //
text_mt: Vinatā had a thousand [offspring], and serpents were born from Surasā; / Kadrū's progeny were a thousand, including Śeṣa, Vāsuki, and Takṣaka.

sanskrit_iast:
daṃṣṭriṇaḥ krodhavaśajā dharotthāḥ(1) pakṣiṇo jale /
surabhyāṃ gomahiṣyādi irotpannāstṛṇādayaḥ //
meaning:
दंष्ट्रिणः क्रोधवशजा धरोत्थाः(1) पक्षिणो जले /
सुरभ्यां गोमहिष्यादि इरोत्पन्नास्तृणादयः //
text_mt: Fanged beasts were born of Krodhavaśā; from Dharā arose the birds upon the water; / from Surabhi arose cows, buffaloes, and the like; and from Irā were born grasses and other plants.

sanskrit_iast:
svasāyāṃ yakṣarakṣāṃsi muneraśvarasobhavan /
ariṣṭāyāntu gandharvāḥ kaśyapāddhi sthirañcaraṃ(2) //
meaning:
स्वसायां यक्षरक्षांसि मुनेरश्वरसोभवन् /
अरिष्टायान्तु गन्धर्वाः कश्यपाद्धि स्थिरञ्चरं(2) //
text_mt: From Svasā were born the Yakṣas and Rākṣasas; from the sage [Kaśyapa] arose the horses and Apsarases; / from Ariṣṭā the Gandharvas; thus from Kaśyapa came the stationary and the moving [creation].

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ putrādayo 'saṅkhyā devair vai dānavā jitāḥ(3) /
ditirvinaṣṭaputrā vai toṣayāmāsa kaśyapaṃ //
meaning:
एषां पुत्रादयो ऽसङ्ख्या देवैर् वै दानवा जिताः(3) /
दितिर्विनष्टपुत्रा वै तोषयामास कश्यपं //
text_mt: Their sons and descendants were innumerable; the Dānavas were defeated by the gods. / Diti, whose sons had perished, propitiated Kaśyapa.

sanskrit_iast:
putramindraprahartāramicchatī prāpa kaśyapāt /
pādāprakṣālanāt suptā tasyā garbhaṃ jaghāna ha //
meaning:
पुत्रमिन्द्रप्रहर्तारमिच्छती प्राप कश्यपात् /
पादाप्रक्षालनात् सुप्ता तस्या गर्भं जघान ह //
text_mt: Desiring a son who would strike down Indra, she obtained [one] from Kaśyapa. / When she fell asleep without washing her feet, he struck the embryo [in] her [womb].

sanskrit_iast:
chidramanviṣya cendrastu te devā maruto 'bhavan /
śakrasyaikonapañcāśatsahāyā dīptatejasaḥ //
meaning:
छिद्रमन्विष्य चेन्द्रस्तु ते देवा मरुतो ऽभवन् /
शक्रस्यैकोनपञ्चाशत्सहाया दीप्ततेजसः //
text_mt: Seeking an opening, Indra [did this]; they became the gods, the Maruts, / forty-nine companions of Śakra, radiant with splendour.

sanskrit_iast:
etatsarvaṃ harirbrahmā abhiṣicya pṛthuṃ nṛpaṃ /
dadau krameṇa rājyāni anyeṣāmadhipo hariḥ //
meaning:
एतत्सर्वं हरिर्ब्रह्मा अभिषिच्य पृथुं नृपं /
ददौ क्रमेण राज्यानि अन्येषामधिपो हरिः //
text_mt: Having consecrated King Pṛthu over all this, Hari, Brahmā, / and Hari the overlord bestowed kingdoms upon the others in turn:

sanskrit_iast:
dvijauṣadhīnāṃ candraś ca apāntu varuṇo nṛpaḥ /
rājñāṃ vaiśravaṇo rājā sūryāṇāṃ viṣṇorīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
द्विजौषधीनां चन्द्रश् च अपान्तु वरुणो नृपः /
राज्ञां वैश्रवणो राजा सूर्याणां विष्णोरीश्वरः //
text_mt: Candra was made king of the twice-born and medicinal herbs; Varuṇa of waters; / Vaiśravaṇa of kings; and Viṣṇu the lord of the solar deities.

sanskrit_iast:
vasūnāṃ pāvako rājā marutāṃ vāsavaḥ prabhuḥ /
prajāpatīnāṃ dakṣo 'tha prahlādo dānavādhipaḥ //
meaning:
वसूनां पावको राजा मरुतां वासवः प्रभुः /
प्रजापतीनां दक्षो ऽथ प्रह्लादो दानवाधिपः //
text_mt: Pāvaka was made king of the Vasus; Vāsava lord of the Maruts; / Dakṣa of the Prajāpatis; and Prahlāda sovereign of the Dānavas.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṝṇāṃ ca yamo rājā bhūtādīnāṃ haraḥ(4) prabhuḥ /
himavāṃś caiva śailānāṃ nadīnāṃ sāgaraḥ prabhuḥ //
:n
1 dharaṇyā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 kaśyapādi parasparamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 devair dāityāḥ parājitā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 bhūtānāñca hara iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 49
meaning:
पितॄणां च यमो राजा भूतादीनां हरः(4) प्रभुः /
हिमवांश् चैव शैलानां नदीनां सागरः प्रभुः //
:न्
1 धरण्या इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 कश्यपादि परस्परमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 देवैर् दाइत्याः पराजिता इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 भूतानाञ्च हर इति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 49
text_mt:
Yama was made king of the ancestors; Hara lord of the spirits and other beings; / Himavat lord of the mountains; and the ocean lord of the rivers.
[Footnote]
1. "dharaṇyāḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "kaśyapādi parasparam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "devair daityāḥ parājitāḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "bhūtānāñ ca haraḥ" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and ṅa.

sanskrit_iast:
gāndharvāṇāṃ citraratho nāgānāmatha vāsukiḥ /
sarpāṇāṃ takṣako rājā garuḍaḥ pakṣiṇāmatha //
meaning:
गान्धर्वाणां चित्ररथो नागानामथ वासुकिः /
सर्पाणां तक्षको राजा गरुडः पक्षिणामथ //
text_mt: Citraratha was made king of the Gandharvas; Vāsuki of the Nāgas; / Takṣaka of the serpents; and Garuḍa of the birds.

sanskrit_iast:
airāvato gajendrāṇāṃ govṛṣotha gavāmapi /
mṛgaṇāmatha śārdūlaḥ plakṣo vanaspatīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ऐरावतो गजेन्द्राणां गोवृषोथ गवामपि /
मृगणामथ शार्दूलः प्लक्षो वनस्पतीश्वरः //
text_mt: Airāvata of noble elephants; the bull of cattle; / the tiger of beasts of prey; and the plakṣa tree the lord of trees.

sanskrit_iast:
uccaiḥśravās tathāśvānāṃ sudhanvā pūrvapālakaḥ /
dakṣiṇasyāṃ śaṅkhapadaḥ ketumān pālako jale /
hiraṇyaromakaḥ saumye pratisargoyamīritaḥ //
:e ity ādimāhāpurāṇe āgneye pratisargavarṇanaṃ nāma
ūnaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha viṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
sargaviṣayakavarṇanaṃ
meaning:
उच्चैःश्रवास् तथाश्वानां सुधन्वा पूर्वपालकः /
दक्षिणस्यां शङ्खपदः केतुमान् पालको जले /
हिरण्यरोमकः सौम्ये प्रतिसर्गोयमीरितः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमाहापुराणे आग्नेये प्रतिसर्गवर्णनं नाम
ऊनविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ विंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
सर्गविषयकवर्णनं
text_mt:
Uccaiḥśravas of horses; Sudhanvan protector of the east; / Śaṅkhapada in the south; Ketumat protector in the water [of the west]; / and Hiraṇyaromaka in the north. Thus secondary creation has been declared.
Thus ends the nineteenth chapter, entitled "The Description of Secondary Creation," in the great and ancient Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the twentieth chapter.
The description regarding primary creation.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
prathamo mahataḥ sargo vijñeyo brahmaṇastu saḥ /
tanmātrāṇāṃ dvitīyastu bhūtasargo hi sa smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
प्रथमो महतः सर्गो विज्ञेयो ब्रह्मणस्तु सः /
तन्मात्राणां द्वितीयस्तु भूतसर्गो हि स स्मृतः //
text_mt: Agni said: / The first creation should be known as that of Mahat, which belongs to Brahmā. / The second is that of the subtle elements, known as the elemental creation.

sanskrit_iast:
vaikārikastṛtīyastu sarga aindriyakaḥ smṛtaḥ /
ityeṣa prākṛtaḥ sargaḥ sambhūto buddhipūrvakaḥ //
meaning:
वैकारिकस्तृतीयस्तु सर्ग ऐन्द्रियकः स्मृतः /
इत्येष प्राकृतः सर्गः सम्भूतो बुद्धिपूर्वकः //
text_mt: The third creation, originating from modification, is known as that of the sense organs. / Thus this is the primary creation, which arose preceded by intelligence.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhyaḥ sargaś caturthastu mukhyā vai sthāvarāḥ smṛtāḥ /
tiryaksrotāstu yaḥ proktaḥ stairyagyonyastataḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
मुख्यः सर्गश् चतुर्थस्तु मुख्या वै स्थावराः स्मृताः /
तिर्यक्स्रोतास्तु यः प्रोक्तः स्तैर्यग्योन्यस्ततः स्मृतः //
text_mt: The fourth creation is the primary; the immobile beings are known as the primary. / That which is proclaimed as having an oblique flow of life is remembered as that of the animals.

sanskrit_iast:
tathordhvasrotasāṃ ṣaṣṭho devasargastu sa smṛtaḥ /
tatorvāksrotasāṃ sargaḥ saptamaḥ sa tu mānuṣaḥ //
meaning:
तथोर्ध्वस्रोतसां षष्ठो देवसर्गस्तु स स्मृतः /
ततोर्वाक्स्रोतसां सर्गः सप्तमः स तु मानुषः //
text_mt: Likewise, the sixth, that of beings with an upward flow of life, is known as the creation of the gods; / then the seventh creation, of beings with a downward flow of life, is that of humans.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamonugrahaḥ sargaiḥ sātvikastāmasaś ca yaḥ /
pañcaite vaikṛtāḥ sargāḥ prākṛtāś ca trayaḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अष्टमोनुग्रहः सर्गैः सात्विकस्तामसश् च यः /
पञ्चैते वैकृताः सर्गाः प्राकृताश् च त्रयः स्मृताः //
text_mt: The eighth is the benevolent creation, which is characterised by goodness and darkness. / These five are secondary creations, and three are known as primary.

sanskrit_iast:
prākṛto vaikṛtaś caiva kaumāro navamas tathā /
:p 50
brahmato nava sargāstu jagato mūlahetavaḥ //
meaning:
प्राकृतो वैकृतश् चैव कौमारो नवमस् तथा /
:प् 50
ब्रह्मतो नव सर्गास्तु जगतो मूलहेतवः //
text_mt:
The ninth is the Kaumāra creation, both primary and secondary.
[Page 50]
These are the nine creations from Brahmā, the root causes of the universe.

sanskrit_iast:
khyātyādyā dakṣakanyāstu bhṛgvādyā upayemire /
nityo naimittakaḥ sargastridhā prakathito janaiḥ //
meaning:
ख्यात्याद्या दक्षकन्यास्तु भृग्वाद्या उपयेमिरे /
नित्यो नैमित्तकः सर्गस्त्रिधा प्रकथितो जनैः //
text_mt: Khyāti and other daughters of Dakṣa were married by Bhṛgu and others. / Creation is described by people as threefold: perpetual, occasional, [and causal].

sanskrit_iast:
prākṛtā dainandinī syādantarapralayādanu /
jāyate yatrānudinaṃ mityasargo hi sammataḥ //
meaning:
प्राकृता दैनन्दिनी स्यादन्तरप्रलयादनु /
जायते यत्रानुदिनं मित्यसर्गो हि सम्मतः //
text_mt: The elemental [dissolution] and the daily [dissolution] occur after an intermediate dissolution; / that creation which takes place daily is considered the perpetual creation.

sanskrit_iast:
devau dhātāvidhātārau bhṛgoḥ khyātirasūyata /
śriyañca patnī viṣṇoryā stutā śakreṇa vṛddhaye //
meaning:
देवौ धाताविधातारौ भृगोः ख्यातिरसूयत /
श्रियञ्च पत्नी विष्णोर्या स्तुता शक्रेण वृद्धये //
text_mt: Khyāti bore to Bhṛgu two gods, Dhātṛ and Vidhātṛ, / and Śrī, who is the consort of Viṣṇu, praised by Śakra for prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
dhāturvidhārturdvau putrau kramāt prāṇo mṛkaṇḍukaḥ /
mārkaṇḍeyo mṛkaṇḍoś ca jajñe vedaśirāstataḥ //
meaning:
धातुर्विधार्तुर्द्वौ पुत्रौ क्रमात् प्राणो मृकण्डुकः /
मार्कण्डेयो मृकण्डोश् च जज्ञे वेदशिरास्ततः //
text_mt: To Dhātṛ and Vidhātṛ were born two sons respectively, Prāṇa and Mṛkaṇḍu; / from Mṛkaṇḍu was born Mārkaṇḍeya, and from him Vedaśiras.

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsaś ca sambhūtyāṃ marīcerabhavat sutaḥ /
smṛtyāmaṅgirasaḥ putrāḥ sinīvālī kuhūs tathā //
meaning:
पौर्णमासश् च सम्भूत्यां मरीचेरभवत् सुतः /
स्मृत्यामङ्गिरसः पुत्राः सिनीवाली कुहूस् तथा //
text_mt: And Paurṇamāsa was the son of Marīci through Sambhūti. / Through Smṛti, Aṅgiras had sons, and Sinīvālī and Kuhū,

sanskrit_iast:
rākāścānumatiścātreranasūyāpyajījanat /
somaṃ durvāsasaṃ putraṃ dattātreyañca yoginam //
meaning:
राकाश्चानुमतिश्चात्रेरनसूयाप्यजीजनत् /
सोमं दुर्वाससं पुत्रं दत्तात्रेयञ्च योगिनम् //
text_mt: as well as Rākā and Anumati. Through Anasūyā, Atri also fathered / Soma, the son Durvāsas, and the yogin Dattātreya.

sanskrit_iast:
prītyāṃ pulastyabhāryāyāṃ dattolistatsutobhavat /
kṣamāyāṃ(1) pulahājjātāḥ sahiṣṇuḥ karmapādikāḥ //
meaning:
प्रीत्यां पुलस्त्यभार्यायां दत्तोलिस्तत्सुतोभवत् /
क्षमायां(1) पुलहाज्जाताः सहिष्णुः कर्मपादिकाः //
text_mt: Through Prīti, wife of Pulastya, Dattoli was his son. / Through Kṣamā, from Pulaha were born Sahiṣṇu, Karmapāda, and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
sannatyāñca kratorāsan bālikhilyā mahaujasaḥ /
aṅguṣṭhaparvamātrāste ye hi ṣaṣṭisahasviṇaḥ //
meaning:
सन्नत्याञ्च क्रतोरासन् बालिखिल्या महौजसः /
अङ्गुष्ठपर्वमात्रास्ते ये हि षष्टिसहस्विणः //
text_mt: And through Sannati, Kratu had the Vālikhilyas of great splendor; / they are merely the size of a thumb-joint, sixty thousand in number.

sanskrit_iast:
urjāyāñca vaśiṣṭhācca rājā gātrordhvabāhukaḥ(2) /
savanaścālaghuḥ śukraḥ(3) sutapāḥ sapta carṣayaḥ //
meaning:
उर्जायाञ्च वशिष्ठाच्च राजा गात्रोर्ध्वबाहुकः(2) /
सवनश्चालघुः शुक्रः(3) सुतपाः सप्त चर्षयः //
text_mt: And through Ūrjā, from Vasiṣṭha came Rāja, Gātra, Ūrdhvabāhu, / Savana, Anagha, Śukra, and Sutapas—the seven ṛṣis.

sanskrit_iast:
pāvakaḥ pavamānobhūcchuciḥ svāhāgnijobhavat /
:n
1 kumāryāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 rajogotrordhvāhuka iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ rājā
śātrordhvabālaka iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, rajogotrordhvavāhaka iti
ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 sabalaścānaghaḥ śukra iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 51
agnisvāttā varhiṣado 'nagnayaḥ sāgnayo hy ajāt(1) //
meaning:
पावकः पवमानोभूच्छुचिः स्वाहाग्निजोभवत् /
:न्
1 कुमार्यामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 रजोगोत्रोर्ध्वाहुक इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः राजा
शात्रोर्ध्वबालक इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः, रजोगोत्रोर्ध्ववाहक इति
ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 सबलश्चानघः शुक्र इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 51
अग्निस्वात्ता वर्हिषदो ऽनग्नयः साग्नयो ह्य् अजात्(1) //
text_mt:
Pāvaka, Pavamāna, and Śuci were born of Agni and Svāhā.
[Footnote]
1. "kumāryām" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "rajogotrordhvāhukaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "rājā śātrordhvabālakaḥ" in ga; "rajogotrordhvavāhakaḥ" in ṅa.
3. "sabalaścānaghaḥ śukraḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha. / [p. 51]
The Agniṣvāttas and Barhiṣads, without sacred fires and with sacred fires, were born [of Brahmā].

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbhyaś ca svadhāyāñca menā vaidhāriṇī sute(2) /
hiṃsābhāryā tvadharmasya tayorjajñe tathānṛtam //
meaning:
पितृभ्यश् च स्वधायाञ्च मेना वैधारिणी सुते(2) /
हिंसाभार्या त्वधर्मस्य तयोर्जज्ञे तथानृतम् //
text_mt: And from the Pitṛs through Svadhā were born two daughters, Menā and Vaidhāriṇī. / But Hiṃsā was the wife of Adharma; to the two of them was born Anṛta,

sanskrit_iast:
kanyā ca nikṛtistābhyāṃ bhayannarakemeva ca /
māyā ca vedanā caiva mithunantvidametayoḥ //
meaning:
कन्या च निकृतिस्ताभ्यां भयन्नरकेमेव च /
माया च वेदना चैव मिथुनन्त्विदमेतयोः //
text_mt: and the maiden Nikṛti; from those two came Bhaya and Naraka, / and Māyā and Vedanā; this indeed is the pair born of these two.

sanskrit_iast:
tayorjajñetha vai māyāṃ mṛtyuṃ bhūtāpahāriṇam /
vedanā ca sutaṃ cāpi duḥkhaṃ jajñetha rauravāt //
meaning:
तयोर्जज्ञेथ वै मायां मृत्युं भूतापहारिणम् /
वेदना च सुतं चापि दुःखं जज्ञेथ रौरवात् //
text_mt: Then to those two was born Māyā; [and] Mṛtyu, who carries off living beings; / and Vedanā bore a son, Duḥkha, from Raurava.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtyorvyādhijarāśokatṛṣṇākrodhāś ca jajñire /
brahmaṇaś ca rudan jāto rodanādrudranāmakaḥ //
meaning:
मृत्योर्व्याधिजराशोकतृष्णाक्रोधाश् च जज्ञिरे /
ब्रह्मणश् च रुदन् जातो रोदनाद्रुद्रनामकः //
text_mt: From Mṛtyu were born Vyādhi, Jarā, Śoka, Tṛṣṇā, and Krodha. / And from Brahmā, weeping, was born [a son] who was called Rudra because of his crying.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavaṃ śarvamatheśānaṃ tathā paśupatiṃ dvija /
bhīmamugraṃ mahādevamuvāca sa pitāmahaḥ //
meaning:
भवं शर्वमथेशानं तथा पशुपतिं द्विज /
भीममुग्रं महादेवमुवाच स पितामहः //
text_mt: The Grandfather spoke to him as Bhava, Śarva, then Īśāna, / and Paśupati, O twice-born, and Bhīma, Ugra, and Mahādeva.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣakopācca tadbhāryā dehantatyāja sā satī /
himavadduhitā bhūtvā patnī śambhorabhūt punaḥ //
meaning:
दक्षकोपाच्च तद्भार्या देहन्तत्याज सा सती /
हिमवद्दुहिता भूत्वा पत्नी शम्भोरभूत् पुनः //
text_mt: And out of wrath at Dakṣa, his wife Satī abandoned her body; / becoming the daughter of Himavat, she again became the wife of Śambhu.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛṣibhyo nāradādyuktāḥ pūjāḥ snānādipūrvikāḥ /
svāyambhuvādyāstāḥ kṛtvā viṣṇvāderbhuktimuktidāḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye jagatsargavarṇanaṃ nāma viṃśatitamo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha ekaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
sāmānyapūjākathanaṃ
meaning:
ऋषिभ्यो नारदाद्युक्ताः पूजाः स्नानादिपूर्विकाः /
स्वायम्भुवाद्यास्ताः कृत्वा विष्ण्वादेर्भुक्तिमुक्तिदाः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये जगत्सर्गवर्णनं नाम विंशतितमो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ एकविंशो ऽध्यायः
सामान्यपूजाकथनं
text_mt:
The rites of worship preceded by bathing and the like, spoken of by Nārada and others to the ṛṣis, / having been performed by Svāyambhuva and others, bestow worldly enjoyment and liberation with respect to Viṣṇu and others.
Thus ends the twentieth chapter, named "Description of the Creation of the Universe," in the venerable Agni Mahāpurāṇa.
Now, the twenty-first chapter.
Instruction on General Worship

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
sāmānyapūjāṃ viṣṇvādervakṣye mantrāṃś ca sarvadān /
samastaparivārāya acyutāya namo yajet //
:n
1 sāgnayo hy agāditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, agnipālā varhiṣado hy
ājyapāḥ sāgnayo hy ajāditi gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vaisāraṇī sute iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 52
meaning:
नारद उवाच
सामान्यपूजां विष्ण्वादेर्वक्ष्ये मन्त्रांश् च सर्वदान् /
समस्तपरिवाराय अच्युताय नमो यजेत् //
:न्
1 साग्नयो ह्य् अगादिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः, अग्निपाला वर्हिषदो ह्य्
आज्यपाः साग्नयो ह्य् अजादिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 वैसारणी सुते इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 52
text_mt:
Nārada said: / I shall declare the general worship of Viṣṇu and others, and the mantras that grant all things. / One should worship saying: "Homage to Acyuta along with his entire retinue."
[Footnote]
1. "sāgnayo hy agāt" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "agnipālā varhiṣado hy ājyapāḥ sāgnayo hy ajāt" in gha.
2. "vaisāraṇī sute" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [p. 52]

sanskrit_iast:
dhātre vidhātre gaṅgāyai yamunāyai nidhī tathā /
dvāraśriyaṃ vastunavaṃ śaktiṃ kūrmamanantakam //
meaning:
धात्रे विधात्रे गङ्गायै यमुनायै निधी तथा /
द्वारश्रियं वस्तुनवं शक्तिं कूर्ममनन्तकम् //
text_mt: To Dhātṛ, Vidhātṛ, Gaṅgā, Yamunā, and the two treasures, / the fortune of the door, the nine substances, Śakti, Kūrma, and Ananta;

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthivīṃ dharmakaṃ jñānaṃ vairāgyaiśvaryameva ca /
adharmādīn kandanālapadmakeśarakarṇikāḥ //
meaning:
पृथिवीं धर्मकं ज्ञानं वैराग्यैश्वर्यमेव च /
अधर्मादीन् कन्दनालपद्मकेशरकर्णिकाः //
text_mt: Earth, Dharma, knowledge, dispassion, and sovereignty, / Adharma and the rest, the bulb, stalk, lotus petals, filaments, and pericarp;

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgvedādyaṃ kṛtādyañca satvādyarkādimaṇḍalam /
vimalotkarṣiṇī jñānā kriyā yogā ca tā yajet //
meaning:
ऋग्वेदाद्यं कृताद्यञ्च सत्वाद्यर्कादिमण्डलम् /
विमलोत्कर्षिणी ज्ञाना क्रिया योगा च ता यजेत् //
text_mt: the Ṛgveda and the rest, the Kṛta age and the rest, the sattva quality and the rest, the disc of the sun and the rest. / One should worship them: Vimalā, Utkarṣiṇī, Jñānā, Kriyā, and Yogā;

sanskrit_iast:
prahvīṃ satyāṃ tatheśānānugrahāsanamūrtikām(1) /
durgāṃ giraṅgaṇaṃ(2) kṣetraṃ vāsudevādikaṃ yajet //
meaning:
प्रह्वीं सत्यां तथेशानानुग्रहासनमूर्तिकाम्(1) /
दुर्गां गिरङ्गणं(2) क्षेत्रं वासुदेवादिकं यजेत् //
text_mt: Prahvī, Satyā, and likewise the icon on the seat of grace of Īśāna; / one should worship Durgā, Gir, Gaṇa, the field, and Vāsudeva and the others;

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayañca śiraḥ śūlaṃ varmanetramathāstrakam /
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ gadāṃ padmaṃ śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ yajet //
meaning:
हृदयञ्च शिरः शूलं वर्मनेत्रमथास्त्रकम् /
शङ्खं चक्रं गदां पद्मं श्रीवत्सं कौस्तुभं यजेत् //
text_mt: and the heart, the head, the trident, the armor, the eye, and the weapon; / one should worship the conch, discus, mace, lotus, Śrīvatsa, and Kaustubha;

sanskrit_iast:
vanamālāṃ śriyaṃ puṣṭiṃ garuḍaṃ gurumarcayet /
indramagniṃ yamaṃ rakṣo jalaṃ vāyuṃ dhaneśvaram //
meaning:
वनमालां श्रियं पुष्टिं गरुडं गुरुमर्चयेत् /
इन्द्रमग्निं यमं रक्षो जलं वायुं धनेश्वरम् //
text_mt: one should revere the forest garland, Śrī, Puṣṭi, Garuḍa, the guru, / Indra, Agni, Yama, the Rakṣas, the waters, Vāyu, the lord of wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
īśānantamajaṃ cāstraṃ vāhanaṃ kumudādikam /
viṣvaksenaṃ maṇḍalādau siddhiḥ pūjādinā bhavet //
meaning:
ईशानन्तमजं चास्त्रं वाहनं कुमुदादिकम् /
विष्वक्सेनं मण्डलादौ सिद्धिः पूजादिना भवेत् //
text_mt: Īśāna, Ananta, Aja, the weapon, the mount, Kumuda and the rest, / and Viṣvaksena in the maṇḍala and elsewhere; accomplishment comes through worship and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
śivapūjātha sāmānyā pūrvaṃ nandinamarcayet /
mahākālaṃ yajedgaṅgāṃ(3) yamunāñca gaṇādikam //
meaning:
शिवपूजाथ सामान्या पूर्वं नन्दिनमर्चयेत् /
महाकालं यजेद्गङ्गां(3) यमुनाञ्च गणादिकम् //
text_mt: Now the general worship of Śiva: first one should revere Nandin; / one should worship Mahākāla, Gaṅgā, Yamunā, the Gaṇas, and the rest;

sanskrit_iast:
giraṃ śriyaṃ(4) guruṃ vāstuṃ śakyādīn dharmakādikam (5) /
vāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī kālī kalavikāriṇī //
meaning:
गिरं श्रियं(4) गुरुं वास्तुं शक्यादीन् धर्मकादिकम् (5) /
वामा ज्येष्ठा तथा रौद्री काली कलविकारिणी //
text_mt: Gir, Śrī, the guru, the site, the powers and the rest, Dharma and the rest; / Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, Kālī, Kalavikāriṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
balavikariṇī cāpi balapramathinī kramāt /
:n
1 prahvī sandhyā tatheśānānugrahāsanamūrtikā iti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 durgāṃ giriṃ gaṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ durgāṃ
śivaṃ gaṇamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 yajet durgāṃ iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 giriṃ śriyamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ śivaṃ śriyatamiti gha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 gaurīṃ śriyaṃ guruṃ cāstraṃ śaktyādiṃ dharmakādikamiti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 53
sarvabhūtadamanī ca madanonmādinī śivāsanaṃ //
meaning:
बलविकरिणी चापि बलप्रमथिनी क्रमात् /
:न्
1 प्रह्वी सन्ध्या तथेशानानुग्रहासनमूर्तिका इति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 दुर्गां गिरिं गणमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः दुर्गां
शिवं गणमिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 यजेत् दुर्गां इति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 गिरिं श्रियमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः शिवं श्रियतमिति घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 गौरीं श्रियं गुरुं चास्त्रं शक्त्यादिं धर्मकादिकमिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 53
सर्वभूतदमनी च मदनोन्मादिनी शिवासनं //
text_mt:
and Balavikariṇī, Balapramathinī in order,
[Footnote]
1. "prahvī sandhyā tatheśānānugrahāsanamūrtikā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2. "durgāṃ giriṃ gaṇam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "durgāṃ śivaṃ gaṇam" in gha.
3. "yajet durgām" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and gha.
4. "giriṃ śriyam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "śivaṃ śriyatam" in gha.
5. "gaurīṃ śriyaṃ guruṃ cāstraṃ śaktyādiṃ dharmakādikam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [p. 53]
Sarvabhūtadamanī, and Madanonmādinī, on the seat of Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
hāṃ huṃ hāṃ śivamūrtaye sāṅgavaktraṃ śivaṃ yajet /
hauṃ śivāya hāmityādi hāmīśānādivaktrakaṃ //
meaning:
हां हुं हां शिवमूर्तये साङ्गवक्त्रं शिवं यजेत् /
हौं शिवाय हामित्यादि हामीशानादिवक्त्रकं //
text_mt: "Hāṃ huṃ hāṃ to the icon of Śiva"—one should worship Śiva with his limbs and faces; / "Hauṃ to Śiva, hām" and so forth; "hām" to the faces beginning with Īśāna;

sanskrit_iast:
hrīṃ gaurīṃ gaṃ gaṇaḥ śakramukhāś caṇḍīhṛtādikāḥ /
kramātsūryārcane mantrā daṇḍī pūjyaś ca piṅgalaḥ //
meaning:
ह्रीं गौरीं गं गणः शक्रमुखाश् चण्डीहृतादिकाः /
क्रमात्सूर्यार्चने मन्त्रा दण्डी पूज्यश् च पिङ्गलः //
text_mt: "hrīṃ" to Gaurī, "gaṃ" to Gaṇa, and those headed by Indra, the heart of Caṇḍī, and the rest. / In order, the mantras in the worship of Sūrya: Daṇḍin and Piṅgala are to be worshipped,

sanskrit_iast:
uccaiḥśravāścāruṇaś ca prabhūtaṃ vimalaṃ yajet /
sārādhyoparamasukhaṃ(1) skandādyaṃ madhyato yajet //
meaning:
उच्चैःश्रवाश्चारुणश् च प्रभूतं विमलं यजेत् /
साराध्योपरमसुखं(1) स्कन्दाद्यं मध्यतो यजेत् //
text_mt: Uccaiḥśravas and Aruṇa; one should worship Prabhūta and Vimala; / one should worship the supreme bliss easily attained, Skanda and the others, in the center;

sanskrit_iast:
dīptā sūkṣmā jayā bhadrā vibhūtirvimalā tathā /
amoghā vidyutā caiva pūjyātha sarvatomukhī //
meaning:
दीप्ता सूक्ष्मा जया भद्रा विभूतिर्विमला तथा /
अमोघा विद्युता चैव पूज्याथ सर्वतोमुखी //
text_mt: Dīptā, Sūkṣmā, Jayā, Bhadrā, Vibhūti, Vimalā, / Amoghā, and Vidyutā; and then Sarvatomukhī is to be worshipped;

sanskrit_iast:
arkāsanaṃ hi haṃ khaṃ kha solkāyeti ca mūrtikām /
hrāṃ hrīṃ sa sūryāya nama āṃ namo hṛdāya ca //
meaning:
अर्कासनं हि हं खं ख सोल्कायेति च मूर्तिकाम् /
ह्रां ह्रीं स सूर्याय नम आं नमो हृदाय च //
text_mt: the seat of Sūrya with "haṃ khaṃ kha solkāya" and the icon; / "Hrāṃ hrīṃ saḥ to Sūrya, namaḥ," and "āṃ namaḥ to the heart,"

sanskrit_iast:
arkāya śirase tadvadagnīśāsuravāyugān(2) /
bhūrbhuvaḥ svare jvālini śikhā huṃ kavacaṃ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
अर्काय शिरसे तद्वदग्नीशासुरवायुगान्(2) /
भूर्भुवः स्वरे ज्वालिनि शिखा हुं कवचं स्मृतं //
text_mt: likewise "to the Sun, to the head"; those residing in the directions of Agni, Īśa, Asura, and Vāyu; / "bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ, O radiant one," the crest; "huṃ" is stated to be the armor;

sanskrit_iast:
bhāṃ netraṃ vas tathārkāstraṃ rājñī śaktiś ca niṣkubhā(3) /
somo 'ṅgārakotha budho jīvaḥ śukraḥ śaniḥ kramāt //
meaning:
भां नेत्रं वस् तथार्कास्त्रं राज्ञी शक्तिश् च निष्कुभा(3) /
सोमो ऽङ्गारकोथ बुधो जीवः शुक्रः शनिः क्रमात् //
text_mt: "bhāṃ" the eye, "vaḥ" likewise the weapon of the Sun; Rājñī, Śakti, and Niṣkubhā; / Soma, Aṅgāraka, then Budha, Jīva, Śukra, Śani in order,

sanskrit_iast:
rāhuḥ ketustejaś caṇḍaḥ saṅkṣepādatha pūjanaṃ /
āsanaṃ mūrtaye mūlaṃ hṛdādyaṃ paricārakaḥ //
meaning:
राहुः केतुस्तेजश् चण्डः सङ्क्षेपादथ पूजनं /
आसनं मूर्तये मूलं हृदाद्यं परिचारकः //
text_mt: Rāhu, Ketu, and the fierce splendor; now the worship in brief: / the seat, for the icon, the root [mantra], beginning with the heart, the attendant;

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇvāsanaṃ viṣṇurmūrteroṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ śrīdharohariḥ /
hrīṃ sarvamūrtimantroyamiti trailokyamohanaḥ //
meaning:
विष्ण्वासनं विष्णुर्मूर्तेरों श्रीं श्रीं श्रीधरोहरिः /
ह्रीं सर्वमूर्तिमन्त्रोयमिति त्रैलोक्यमोहनः //
text_mt: the seat of Viṣṇu, Viṣṇu for the icon: "oṃ śrīṃ śrīṃ Śrīdhara Hari, / hrīṃ"—this is the mantra for all icons, enchanting the three worlds;

sanskrit_iast:
hrīṃ hṛṣīkeśaḥ klīṃ viṣṇuḥ svarair dīrghairhṛdādikaṃ /
samastaiḥ pañcamī pūjā saṅgrāmādau jayādidā //
:n
1 sāvārādhyoparaṃ duḥkhamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 agnisāśrayavāyugāniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / arkāya śirase
tadvadagnijāyāyutañca taditi ṅa,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 śaktiś ca nirgatā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 54
meaning:
ह्रीं हृषीकेशः क्लीं विष्णुः स्वरैर् दीर्घैर्हृदादिकं /
समस्तैः पञ्चमी पूजा सङ्ग्रामादौ जयादिदा //
:न्
1 सावाराध्योपरं दुःखमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अग्निसाश्रयवायुगानिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / अर्काय शिरसे
तद्वदग्निजायायुतञ्च तदिति ङ,चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 शक्तिश् च निर्गता इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 54
text_mt:
"hrīṃ Hṛṣīkeśa, klīṃ Viṣṇu," with the long vowels for the heart and other limbs; / the fifth worship with all of them grants victory and the like in battle and elsewhere.
[Footnote]
1. "sāvārādhyoparaṃ duḥkham" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "agnisāśrayavāyugān" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "arkāya śirase tadvadagnijāyāyutañca tat" in ṅa.
3. "śaktiś ca nirgatā" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [p. 54]

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ gadāṃ kramācchaṅkhaṃ muṣalaṃ khaḍgaśārṅgakam /
pāśāṅkuśau ca śrīvatsaṃ kaustubhaṃ vanamālayā //
meaning:
चक्रं गदां क्रमाच्छङ्खं मुषलं खड्गशार्ङ्गकम् /
पाशाङ्कुशौ च श्रीवत्सं कौस्तुभं वनमालया //
text_mt: The discus, club, in order the conch, pestle, sword, and bow Śārṅga, / and the noose and goad, the Śrīvatsa mark, the Kaustubha jewel, together with the forest garland;

sanskrit_iast:
śrīṃ śrīrmahālakṣmītārkṣyo gururindrādayo 'rcanam /
sarasvatyāsanaṃ mūrtirauṃ hrīṃ dadhī sarasvatī //
meaning:
श्रीं श्रीर्महालक्ष्मीतार्क्ष्यो गुरुरिन्द्रादयो ऽर्चनम् /
सरस्वत्यासनं मूर्तिरौं ह्रीं दधी सरस्वती //
text_mt: Śrīṃ, Śrī, Mahālakṣmī, Garuḍa, the guru, Indra and the other [guardians], are worshiped. / Sarasvatī's seat and icon: auṃ hrīṃ dadhī Sarasvatī;

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdādyā lakṣmīrmedhā ca kalātuṣṭiś ca puṣṭikā /
gaurī prabhāmatī durgā gaṇo guruś ca kṣetrapaḥ //
meaning:
हृदाद्या लक्ष्मीर्मेधा च कलातुष्टिश् च पुष्टिका /
गौरी प्रभामती दुर्गा गणो गुरुश् च क्षेत्रपः //
text_mt: The deities of the heart and other limbs, Lakṣmī, Medhā, Kalā, Tuṣṭi, and Puṣṭi, / Gaurī, Prabhāvatī, Durgā, Gaṇapati, the guru, and Kṣetrapāla;

sanskrit_iast:
tathā gaṃ gaṇapataye ca hrīṃ gauryai ca śrīṃ śriyai /
hrīṃ tvaritāyai hrīṃ sau tripurā(1) caturthyantanamontakāḥ //
meaning:
तथा गं गणपतये च ह्रीं गौर्यै च श्रीं श्रियै /
ह्रीं त्वरितायै ह्रीं सौ त्रिपुरा(1) चतुर्थ्यन्तनमोन्तकाः //
text_mt: Likewise, gaṃ to Gaṇapati, hrīṃ to Gaurī, and śrīṃ to Śrī, / hrīṃ to Tvaritā, hrīṃ sauḥ to Tripurā, ending with the dative and namas;

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavādyāś ca nāmādyamakṣaraṃ vindusaṃyutaṃ /
oṃ yutaṃ vā sarvamantrapūjanājjapataḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
प्रणवाद्याश् च नामाद्यमक्षरं विन्दुसंयुतं /
ओं युतं वा सर्वमन्त्रपूजनाज्जपतः स्मृताः //
text_mt: Beginning with praṇava and the first letter of the name, joined with the bindu, / or combined with oṃ, [these] are handed down from the worship and recitation of all mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
homāttilaghṛtādyaiś ca dharmakāmārthamokṣadāḥ /
pūjāmantrān paṭhedyastu bhuktabhogo divaṃ vrajet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye vāsudevādipūjākathanaṃ nāma
ekaviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha dvāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
snānavidhikathanaṃ
meaning:
होमात्तिलघृताद्यैश् च धर्मकामार्थमोक्षदाः /
पूजामन्त्रान् पठेद्यस्तु भुक्तभोगो दिवं व्रजेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये वासुदेवादिपूजाकथनं नाम
एकविंशतितमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ द्वाविंशो ऽध्यायः
स्नानविधिकथनं
text_mt:
Through fire oblations of sesame seeds, clarified butter, and the like, they grant duty, pleasure, wealth, and liberation. / Whoever recites these mantras of worship, having enjoyed worldly pleasures, goes to heaven.
Thus ends the twenty-first chapter in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa, the Āgneya, entitled ‘The Account of the Worship of Vāsudeva and Others’.
Now, the twenty-second chapter.
The account of the rules for bathing.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
vakṣye snānaṃ kriyādyarthaṃ nṛsiṃhena tu mṛttikāṃ /
gṛhītvā tāṃ dvidhā kṛtvā manaḥsnānamathaikayā //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
वक्ष्ये स्नानं क्रियाद्यर्थं नृसिंहेन तु मृत्तिकां /
गृहीत्वा तां द्विधा कृत्वा मनःस्नानमथैकया //
text_mt: Nārada said: / I shall explain the bath for rites and other duties. Having taken clay with the Nṛsiṃha [mantra], / and dividing it into two portions, one first performs the mental bath with one portion.

sanskrit_iast:
nimajyācamya vinyasya siṃhena kṛtarakṣakaḥ(2) /
:n
1 hrīṃ tvaritāyai, hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sau tripurā iti kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 kṛtarakṣaṇa iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 55
vidhisnānaṃ tataḥ kuryāt prāṇāyāmapuraḥsaraṃ //
meaning:
निमज्याचम्य विन्यस्य सिंहेन कृतरक्षकः(2) /
:न्
1 ह्रीं त्वरितायै, ह्रीं ऐं क्लीं सौ त्रिपुरा इति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 कृतरक्षण इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 55
विधिस्नानं ततः कुर्यात् प्राणायामपुरःसरं //
text_mt:
Having submerged oneself, sipped water, performed ritual deposition, and protected oneself with the Narasiṃha [mantra],
[Footnote]
1. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is ‘hrīṃ tvaritāyai hrīṃ aiṃ klīṃ sau tripurā’.
2. In the manuscript marked gha, the reading is ‘kṛtarakṣaṇaḥ’.
One should then perform the prescribed ritual bath, preceded by breath control.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdi dhyāyan harijñānaṃ(1) mantreṇāṣṭākṣareṇa hi /
tridhā pāṇitale mṛtsnāṃ digbandhaṃ siṃhajaptataḥ //
meaning:
हृदि ध्यायन् हरिज्ञानं(1) मन्त्रेणाष्टाक्षरेण हि /
त्रिधा पाणितले मृत्स्नां दिग्बन्धं सिंहजप्ततः //
text_mt: Meditating in one's heart on Hari with knowledge, indeed using the eight-syllable mantra, / [placing] the clay in threefold division on the palm, one secures the directions with [the clay] consecrated by the Narasiṃha [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
vāsadevaprajaptena tīrthaṃ saṅkalpya cālabhet /
gātraṃ vedādinā mantraiḥ sammārjyārādhya mūrtinā //
meaning:
वासदेवप्रजप्तेन तीर्थं सङ्कल्प्य चालभेत् /
गात्रं वेदादिना मन्त्रैः सम्मार्ज्याराध्य मूर्तिना //
text_mt: With the sacred ford invoked through [water] consecrated by the Vāsudeva [mantra], one touches [the water]. / One should wipe the body with the mantras starting with the Vedas, and worship with the mūrti-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvāghamarṣaṇaṃ vastraṃ paridhāya samācaret /
vinyasya mantrair dvirmārjya pāṇisthaṃ jalameva ca //
meaning:
कृत्वाघमर्षणं वस्त्रं परिधाय समाचरेत् /
विन्यस्य मन्त्रैर् द्विर्मार्ज्य पाणिस्थं जलमेव च //
text_mt: Having performed the sin-eradicating rite (aghamarṣaṇa) and put on dry garments, one should act: / performing ritual deposition with mantras, wiping oneself twice, and then taking water in the hand,

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇena saṃyamya vāyumāghrāya cotsṛjet /
jalaṃ dhyāyan hariṃ paścāddatvārghyaṃ dvādaśākṣaraṃ //
meaning:
नारायणेन संयम्य वायुमाघ्राय चोत्सृजेत् /
जलं ध्यायन् हरिं पश्चाद्दत्वार्घ्यं द्वादशाक्षरं //
text_mt: Restraining one's breath with the Nārāyaṇa [mantra], smelling the water, one should release it. / Meditating on Hari in the water and then offering arghya water, one should recite the twelve-syllable [mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
japtvānyāñchataśastasya yogapīṭhāditaḥ kramāt /
mantrān dikpālaparyantānṛṣīn pitṛgaṇānapi //
meaning:
जप्त्वान्याञ्छतशस्तस्य योगपीठादितः क्रमात् /
मन्त्रान् दिक्पालपर्यन्तानृषीन् पितृगणानपि //
text_mt: Hundreds of times, and other mantras in sequence, beginning with his yogapīṭha / down to the guardians of the directions, the sages, and the ancestral spirits (pitṛs),

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyān sarvabhūtāni sthāvarāntānyathāvaset /
nyasya cāṅgāni saṃhṛtya mantrānyāgagṛhaṃ vrajet //
evamanyāsu pūjāsu mūlādyaiḥ snānamācaret //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye snānavidhikathanaṃ nāma
dvāviṃśodhyāyaḥ
:ś atha trayoviṃśodhyāyaḥ
pūjāvidhikathanaṃ
meaning:
मनुष्यान् सर्वभूतानि स्थावरान्तान्यथावसेत् /
न्यस्य चाङ्गानि संहृत्य मन्त्रान्यागगृहं व्रजेत् //
एवमन्यासु पूजासु मूलाद्यैः स्नानमाचरेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये स्नानविधिकथनं नाम
द्वाविंशोध्यायः
:श् अथ त्रयोविंशोध्यायः
पूजाविधिकथनं
text_mt:
Men, and all living beings down to the immovable. / Having deposited and withdrawn the limb-mantras, one should proceed to the sacrificial chamber. / In this way, during other worship rituals, one should perform the bath using the mūlamantra and other mantras.
Thus ends the twenty-second chapter in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa, the Āgneya, entitled ‘The Account of the Rules for Bathing’.
Now, the twenty-third chapter.
The account of the rules for worship.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
vakṣye pūjāvidhiṃ viprā yat kṛtvā sarvamāpnuyāt /
prakṣālitāṅghrirācamya vāgyataḥ kṛtarakṣakaḥ //
:n
1 dhyāyaṃ hariṃ devamiti gha.cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 56
meaning:
नारद उवाच
वक्ष्ये पूजाविधिं विप्रा यत् कृत्वा सर्वमाप्नुयात् /
प्रक्षालिताङ्घ्रिराचम्य वाग्यतः कृतरक्षकः //
:न्
1 ध्यायं हरिं देवमिति घ.चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 56
text_mt:
Nārada said: / O Brahmins, I shall explain the procedure of worship by performing which one obtains everything. / Having washed the feet, sipped water, restrained speech, and protected oneself,
[Footnote]
1. In the manuscript marked gha, the reading is ‘dhyāyaṃ hariṃ devam’.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṅmukhaḥ svastikaṃ baddhvā padmādyaparameva ca /
yaṃ vījaṃ nābhimadhyasthaṃ dhūmraṃ caṇḍānilātmakaṃ //
meaning:
प्राङ्मुखः स्वस्तिकं बद्ध्वा पद्माद्यपरमेव च /
यं वीजं नाभिमध्यस्थं धूम्रं चण्डानिलात्मकं //
text_mt: Facing east, assuming the svastika posture, or the lotus posture and the like, / [one contemplates] the seed-syllable ‘yaṃ’ situated in the center of the navel, smoky and having the nature of a violent wind;

sanskrit_iast:
viśeṣayedaśeṣantu(1) dhyāyet kāyāttu kalmaṣaṃ /
kṣauṃ hṛtpaṅkajamadhyasthaṃ vījaṃ tejonidhiṃ smaran //
meaning:
विशेषयेदशेषन्तु(1) ध्यायेत् कायात्तु कल्मषं /
क्षौं हृत्पङ्कजमध्यस्थं वीजं तेजोनिधिं स्मरन् //
text_mt: One should dry up completely and contemplate the taint [expelled] from the body. / Remembering the seed-syllable ‘kṣauṃ’ situated in the center of the heart-lotus, an ocean of light,

sanskrit_iast:
adhordhvatiryaggābhistu jvālābhiḥ kalmaṣaṃ dahet /
śaśāṅkākṛtivaddhyāyedambarasthaṃ sudhāmbubhiḥ //
meaning:
अधोर्ध्वतिर्यग्गाभिस्तु ज्वालाभिः कल्मषं दहेत् /
शशाङ्काकृतिवद्ध्यायेदम्बरस्थं सुधाम्बुभिः //
text_mt: One burns away the taint with flames extending downward, upward, and horizontally. / One should meditate on [the seed-syllable] situated in the sky, resembling the moon, with nectar-waters

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpadmavyāpibhirdehaṃ svakamāplāvayetsudhīḥ(2) /
susumnāyonimārgeṇa sarvanāḍīvisarpibhiḥ //
meaning:
हृत्पद्मव्यापिभिर्देहं स्वकमाप्लावयेत्सुधीः(2) /
सुसुम्नायोनिमार्गेण सर्वनाडीविसर्पिभिः //
text_mt: Pervading the heart-lotus; the wise practitioner should bathe his own body / through the pathway of the suṣumnā origin, flowing through all the channels (nāḍīs).

sanskrit_iast:
śodhayitvā nyasettattvaṃ karaśuddhirathāstrakaṃ /
vyāpakaṃ hastayorādau dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhatoṅgakaṃ //
meaning:
शोधयित्वा न्यसेत्तत्त्वं करशुद्धिरथास्त्रकं /
व्यापकं हस्तयोरादौ दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठतोङ्गकं //
text_mt: Having purified it, one should deposit the cosmic principles. Then comes purification of the hands, and then the astra-mantra; / first the pervasive ritual deposition on the hands, then on the limbs beginning from the right thumb.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlaṃ dehe dvādaśāṅgaṃ nyasenmantrair dviṣaṭkakaiḥ /
hṛdayaṃ ca śiraś caiva śikhā varmāstralocane //
meaning:
मूलं देहे द्वादशाङ्गं न्यसेन्मन्त्रैर् द्विषट्ककैः /
हृदयं च शिरश् चैव शिखा वर्मास्त्रलोचने //
text_mt: One should deposit the twelve-limbed mūlamantra on the body with the twelve mantras: / the heart, the head, the tuft, the armor, the astra-weapon, the eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
udaraṃ ca tathā pṛṣṭhaṃ bāhurujānupādakaṃ /
mudrāṃ dattvā smaret viṣṇuṃ japtvāṣṭaśatamarcayet //
meaning:
उदरं च तथा पृष्ठं बाहुरुजानुपादकं /
मुद्रां दत्त्वा स्मरेत् विष्णुं जप्त्वाष्टशतमर्चयेत् //
text_mt: The belly, the back, the arms, the thighs, the knees, and the feet. / Presenting the ritual gesture, meditating on Viṣṇu, and reciting [the mantra] one hundred and eight times, one should worship.

sanskrit_iast:
vāme tu vardhanīṃ nyasya pūjādravyaṃ tu dakṣiṇe /
prakṣālyāstreṇa cārghyeṇa gandhapuṣpānvite nyaset //
meaning:
वामे तु वर्धनीं न्यस्य पूजाद्रव्यं तु दक्षिणे /
प्रक्षाल्यास्त्रेण चार्घ्येण गन्धपुष्पान्विते न्यसेत् //
text_mt: Placing the vardhanī pitcher on the left and the worship implements on the right, / washing them with the astra-mantra and arghya water, one should deposit them accompanied by fragrant sandal-paste and flowers.

sanskrit_iast:
caitanyaṃ sarvagaṃ jyotiraṣṭajaptena vāriṇā /
phaḍantena tu saṃsicya haste dhyātvā hariṃ pare(3) //
meaning:
चैतन्यं सर्वगं ज्योतिरष्टजप्तेन वारिणा /
फडन्तेन तु संसिच्य हस्ते ध्यात्वा हरिं परे(3) //
text_mt: Sprinkling with water consecrated eight times with the mantra ending in phaṭ, / [which embodies] consciousness, all-pervading light, and meditating on Hari in one's hand, on the supreme [pedestal],

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ vahnidiṅmukhāḥ /
adharmādīni gātrāṇi pūrvādau yogapīṭhake //
meaning:
धर्मं ज्ञानं च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यं वह्निदिङ्मुखाः /
अधर्मादीनि गात्राणि पूर्वादौ योगपीठके //
text_mt: Dharma, knowledge, dispassion, and sovereign power, facing the south-east and other directions; / unrighteousness and the rest as the sides, starting from the east on the yogapīṭha.

sanskrit_iast:
kūrmaṃ pīṭhe hy anantañca yamaṃ(4) sūryādimaṇḍalaṃ /
:n
1 viśoṣayedaśeṣantu iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 svakāmān dāhayet sudhīḥ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
svakamāhlādayet sudhīriti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 sthalaṃ tena tu saṃsicya haste dhyātvā hariṃ paṭhediti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 padmamiti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
:p 57
vimalādyāḥ keśarasthānugrahā karṇikā sthitā //
meaning:
कूर्मं पीठे ह्य् अनन्तञ्च यमं(4) सूर्यादिमण्डलं /
:न्
1 विशोषयेदशेषन्तु इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्वकामान् दाहयेत् सुधीः इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
स्वकमाह्लादयेत् सुधीरिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 स्थलं तेन तु संसिच्य हस्ते ध्यात्वा हरिं पठेदिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 पद्ममिति ख, ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
:प् 57
विमलाद्याः केशरस्थानुग्रहा कर्णिका स्थिता //
text_mt:
On the seat [one worships] Kūrma, Ananta, Yama, and the orb of the sun and other planets;
[Footnote]
1. In the manuscript marked ṅa, the reading is ‘viśoṣayedaśeṣantu’.
2. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is ‘svakāmān dāhayet sudhīḥ’; in the manuscript marked ṅa, ‘svakamāhlādayet sudhīḥ’.
3. In the manuscript marked ṅa, the reading is ‘sthalaṃ tena tu saṃsicya haste dhyātvā hariṃ paṭhet’.
4. In the three manuscripts marked kha, ga, and ṅa, the reading is ‘padmam’.
Vimalā and the other [śaktis] reside on the filaments, and Anugrahā resides on the pericarp.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ svahṛdaye dhyātvā āvāhyārcaiś ca maṇḍale /
arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tathācāmaṃ madhuparkaṃ punaś ca tat //
meaning:
पूर्वं स्वहृदये ध्यात्वा आवाह्यार्चैश् च मण्डले /
अर्घ्यं पाद्यं तथाचामं मधुपर्कं पुनश् च तत् //
text_mt: Having first meditated [on him] in one's own heart, invoking him with worship rites into the maṇḍala, / [one offers] arghya water, water for washing the feet, water for sipping, madhuparka, and again that [water for sipping];

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ vastropavītañca bhūṣaṇaṃ gandhapuṣpakaṃ /
dhūpadīpanair vedyāni puṇḍarīkākṣavidyayā //
meaning:
स्नानं वस्त्रोपवीतञ्च भूषणं गन्धपुष्पकं /
धूपदीपनैर् वेद्यानि पुण्डरीकाक्षविद्यया //
text_mt: Bath, garments, sacred thread, ornaments, fragrant sandal-paste and flowers, / incense, lamps, and food offerings, using the Puṇḍarīkākṣa mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
yajedaṅgāni pūrvādau dvāri pūrve pareṇḍajaṃ /
dakṣe cakraṃ gadāṃ saumye koṇe śaṅkhaṃ dhanurnyaset //
meaning:
यजेदङ्गानि पूर्वादौ द्वारि पूर्वे परेण्डजं /
दक्षे चक्रं गदां सौम्ये कोणे शङ्खं धनुर्न्यसेत् //
text_mt: One should worship the limbs starting in the east; at the eastern gate, the bird Garuḍa; / on the right, the discus; on the north, the club; at the corner, one should deposit the conch and bow;

sanskrit_iast:
devasya vāmato dakṣe ceṣudhī khaḍgameva ca /
vāme carma śriyaṃ(1) dakṣe puṣṭiṃ vāmegrato nyaset //
meaning:
देवस्य वामतो दक्षे चेषुधी खड्गमेव च /
वामे चर्म श्रियं(1) दक्षे पुष्टिं वामेग्रतो न्यसेत् //
text_mt: To the left and right of the deity, quivers and the sword; / on the left, the shield; on the right, Śrī; on the left, Puṣṭi; and in front,

sanskrit_iast:
vanamālāñca śrīvatsakaustubhau dikpatīnvahiḥ /
svamantraiḥ pūjayet sarvān viṣṇurarghovasānataḥ(2) //
meaning:
वनमालाञ्च श्रीवत्सकौस्तुभौ दिक्पतीन्वहिः /
स्वमन्त्रैः पूजयेत् सर्वान् विष्णुरर्घोवसानतः(2) //
text_mt: The forest garland, the Śrīvatsa mark, the Kaustubha jewel, and the regents of the directions outside. / One should worship them all with their own mantras, Viṣṇu [being worshiped] until the conclusion of the arghya offering.

sanskrit_iast:
vyastena ca samastena aṅgair vījena vai yajet /
japtvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya stuttvārdhyañca samarpya ca //
meaning:
व्यस्तेन च समस्तेन अङ्गैर् वीजेन वै यजेत् /
जप्त्वा प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य स्तुत्त्वार्ध्यञ्च समर्प्य च //
text_mt: One should worship with the mantra both divided and whole, with the limbs, and with the seed-syllable. / Having recited [the mantra], circumambulated clockwise, praised him, and offered arghya water,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdaye vinyaseddhyātvā ahaṃ brahma haristviti /
āgacchāvāhane yojyaṃ kṣamasveti visarjane //
meaning:
हृदये विन्यसेद्ध्यात्वा अहं ब्रह्म हरिस्त्विति /
आगच्छावाहने योज्यं क्षमस्वेति विसर्जने //
text_mt: One should deposit him in the heart, contemplating: ‘I am indeed Brahman, Hari.’ / ‘Come’ is to be employed in invocation; ‘Pardon’ in dismissal.

sanskrit_iast:
evamaṣṭākṣarādyaiś ca pūjāṃ kṛtvā vimuktibhāk /
ekamūrtyarcanaṃ proktaṃ navavyūhārcanaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
एवमष्टाक्षराद्यैश् च पूजां कृत्वा विमुक्तिभाक् /
एकमूर्त्यर्चनं प्रोक्तं नवव्यूहार्चनं शृणु //
text_mt: Having thus performed worship with the eight-syllable mantra and others, one attains liberation. / The worship of a single mūrti has been declared; now listen to the worship of the nine vyūhas:

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhakadvaye nyasya vāsudevaṃ balādikān /
tarjanyādau śarīretha śirolalāṭavaktrake //
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठकद्वये न्यस्य वासुदेवं बलादिकान् /
तर्जन्यादौ शरीरेथ शिरोललाटवक्त्रके //
text_mt: Depositing Vāsudeva on the two thumbs, Baladeva and the others / on the index fingers and the rest; then on the body, on the head, forehead, and mouth,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛnnābhiguhyajānvaṅghrau madhye pūrvādikaṃ yajet(3) /
ekapīṭhaṃ navavyūhaṃ navapīṭhañca pūrvavat //
:n
1 vāme varma śriyamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 asmallabdhapustakeṣu viṣṇurarghovasānata iti viṣṇāvarghau ca
mānataḥ iti ca pāṭho vartate / ayansvasamīcīna iva pratibhāti
viṣṇumarghyāsanādibhiriti tu yuktaḥ pāṭhaḥ
3 madhyagulphāditaḥ pisphaca iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 58
meaning:
हृन्नाभिगुह्यजान्वङ्घ्रौ मध्ये पूर्वादिकं यजेत्(3) /
एकपीठं नवव्यूहं नवपीठञ्च पूर्ववत् //
:न्
1 वामे वर्म श्रियमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अस्मल्लब्धपुस्तकेषु विष्णुरर्घोवसानत इति विष्णावर्घौ च
मानतः इति च पाठो वर्तते / अयन्स्वसमीचीन इव प्रतिभाति
विष्णुमर्घ्यासनादिभिरिति तु युक्तः पाठः
3 मध्यगुल्फादितः पिस्फच इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 58
text_mt:
On the heart, navel, private parts, knees, and feet, one should worship in the center and starting from the east; / one may worship the nine vyūhas on a single seat or on nine seats as described before.
[Footnote]
1. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is ‘vāme varma śriyam’.
2 In the manuscripts obtained by us, there is the reading "viṣṇurarghovasānataḥ" and "viṣṇāvarghau ca mānataḥ". This appears rather improper; the reading "viṣṇumarghyāsanādibhiḥ", however, is suitable.
3 The manuscript marked "ṅa" reads "madhyagulphāditaḥ pisphacaḥ".

sanskrit_iast:
navābje navamūrtyā ca navavyūhañca pūrvavat /
iṣṭaṃ madhye tataḥ sthāne vāsudevañca pūjayet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye ādimūrtyādipūjāvidhirnāma
trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
kuṇḍanirmāṇādividhiḥ
meaning:
नवाब्जे नवमूर्त्या च नवव्यूहञ्च पूर्ववत् /
इष्टं मध्ये ततः स्थाने वासुदेवञ्च पूजयेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये आदिमूर्त्यादिपूजाविधिर्नाम
त्रयोविंशो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ चतुर्विंशो ऽध्यायः
कुण्डनिर्माणादिविधिः
text_mt:
In the nine-lotus, [one should worship] with the nine icons and the nine emanations as before. / Then, in the center, in that place, one should worship Vāsudeva.
Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, named 'The Rule for Worshiping the Primeval Icon and Others', in the Ādi-Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now, the twenty-fourth chapter.
The Rule for the Construction of Fire-pits and Related Rites

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
agnikāryaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena syātsarvakāmabhāk /
caturabhyadhikaṃ viṃśamaṅgulaṃ caturasrakaṃ //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
अग्निकार्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि येन स्यात्सर्वकामभाक् /
चतुरभ्यधिकं विंशमङ्गुलं चतुरस्रकं //
text_mt: Nārada said: / I shall explain the fire-rite by which one attains all desires: / a square of twenty-four finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtreṇa sūtrayitvā tu kṣetraṃ tāvat khanetsamaṃ /
khātasya mekhalā kāryā tyaktvā caivāṅguladvayaṃ //
meaning:
सूत्रेण सूत्रयित्वा तु क्षेत्रं तावत् खनेत्समं /
खातस्य मेखला कार्या त्यक्त्वा चैवाङ्गुलद्वयं //
text_mt: Having measured the area with a cord, one should dig it evenly to that extent. / Leaving [a border of] two finger-breadths, the belt of the excavated [pit] is to be made.

sanskrit_iast:
sattvādisañjñā(1) pūrvāśā dvādaśāṅgulamucchritā /
aṣṭāṅgulā dvyaṅulātha caturaṅgulavistṛtā //
meaning:
सत्त्वादिसञ्ज्ञा(1) पूर्वाशा द्वादशाङ्गुलमुच्छ्रिता /
अष्टाङ्गुला द्व्यङुलाथ चतुरङ्गुलविस्तृता //
text_mt: Designated as sattva and the like, [the tiers] in the eastern direction are twelve finger-breadths high, / eight finger-breadths, [and] two finger-breadths; and [each is] four finger-breadths wide.

sanskrit_iast:
yonirdaśāṅgulā ramyā ṣaṭcaturdvyaṅgulāgragā /
kramānnimnā tu kartavyā paścimāśāvyavasthitā //
meaning:
योनिर्दशाङ्गुला रम्या षट्चतुर्द्व्यङ्गुलाग्रगा /
क्रमान्निम्ना तु कर्तव्या पश्चिमाशाव्यवस्थिता //
text_mt: The beautiful yoni is ten finger-breadths [wide], its tip measuring six, four, and two finger-breadths; / it should be made gradually sloping and situated in the western direction.

sanskrit_iast:
aśvatthapatrasadṛśī kiñcit kuṇḍe niveśitā /
turyāṅgulāyatā nālaṃ pañcadaśāṅgulāyataṃ //
meaning:
अश्वत्थपत्रसदृशी किञ्चित् कुण्डे निवेशिता /
तुर्याङ्गुलायता नालं पञ्चदशाङ्गुलायतं //
text_mt: Resembling an aśvattha leaf, it is placed slightly into the fire-pit; / it extends four finger-breadths, and its neck extends fifteen finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlantu tryaṅgulaṃ(2) yonyā agraṃ tasyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ /
lakṣaṇañcaikahastasya dviguṇaṃ dvikarādiṣu //
meaning:
मूलन्तु त्र्यङ्गुलं(2) योन्या अग्रं तस्याः षडङ्गुलं /
लक्षणञ्चैकहस्तस्य द्विगुणं द्विकरादिषु //
text_mt: The base of the yoni is three finger-breadths; its tip is six finger-breadths. / This is the characteristic of [a pit of] one cubit; in those of two cubits and so forth, it is doubled.

sanskrit_iast:
ekatrimekhalaṃ kuṇḍaṃ vartulādi vadāmyahaṃ /
:n
1 sadmādisañjñā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 malantu dvyaṅgulamiti ga,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 59
kuṇḍārdhe tu sthitaṃ sūtraṃ koṇe yadatiricyate //
meaning:
एकत्रिमेखलं कुण्डं वर्तुलादि वदाम्यहं /
:न्
1 सद्मादिसञ्ज्ञा इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 मलन्तु द्व्यङ्गुलमिति ग,चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 59
कुण्डार्धे तु स्थितं सूत्रं कोणे यदतिरिच्यते //
text_mt:
I shall describe the fire-pit with one or three belts, circular and of other shapes.
[Footnotes]
1 The manuscript marked "kha" reads "sadmādisañjñā".
2 The manuscript marked "ga" reads "malantu dvyaṅgulam".
A cord placed across half of the fire-pit, which projects beyond the corner—

sanskrit_iast:
tadardhaṃ diśi saṃsthāpya bhrāmitaṃ vartulaṃ bhavet /
kuṇḍārdhaṃ koṇabhāgārdhaṃ diśiścottarato vahiḥ //
meaning:
तदर्धं दिशि संस्थाप्य भ्रामितं वर्तुलं भवेत् /
कुण्डार्धं कोणभागार्धं दिशिश्चोत्तरतो वहिः //
text_mt: having placed half of that in the [cardinal] direction and rotated it, a circle will be produced. / Placing half the fire-pit plus half the corner segment outside in the northern direction,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvapaścimato yatnāllāñchayitvā tu madhyataḥ /
saṃsthāpya bhrāmitaṃ kuṇḍamardhacandraṃ bhavet śubhaṃ //
meaning:
पूर्वपश्चिमतो यत्नाल्लाञ्छयित्वा तु मध्यतः /
संस्थाप्य भ्रामितं कुण्डमर्धचन्द्रं भवेत् शुभं //
text_mt: carefully marking it from east to west, and having fixed and rotated it from the center, / an auspicious crescent-shaped fire-pit will be produced.

sanskrit_iast:
padmākāre dalāni syurmekhalānāntu vartule /
bāhudaṇḍapramāṇantu homārthaṃ kārayet srucaṃ //
meaning:
पद्माकारे दलानि स्युर्मेखलानान्तु वर्तुले /
बाहुदण्डप्रमाणन्तु होमार्थं कारयेत् स्रुचं //
text_mt: In a lotus-shaped [pit] there should be petals, and in a circular one [there should be] belts. / For the fire oblation, one should make a sruc measuring the length of an arm.

sanskrit_iast:
saptapañcāṅgulaṃ vāpi caturasrantu kārayet /
tribhāgena bhavedgartaṃ madhye vṛttaṃ suśobhanam //
meaning:
सप्तपञ्चाङ्गुलं वापि चतुरस्रन्तु कारयेत् /
त्रिभागेन भवेद्गर्तं मध्ये वृत्तं सुशोभनम् //
text_mt: Or one may make it square, measuring seven or five finger-breadths. / The hollow should occupy one-third, and a very beautiful circle should be in the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
tiryagūrdhvaṃ samaṃ khātādvahirardhantu śodhayet /
aṅgulasya caturthāṃśaṃ śeṣārdhārdhaṃ tathāntataḥ //
meaning:
तिर्यगूर्ध्वं समं खाताद्वहिरर्धन्तु शोधयेत् /
अङ्गुलस्य चतुर्थांशं शेषार्धार्धं तथान्ततः //
text_mt: Level crosswise and upward, outside the excavated [hollow] one should clear half [the surface]; / one-fourth of a finger-breadth, and half of the remaining half at the edge.

sanskrit_iast:
khātasya mekhalāṃ ramyāṃ śeṣārdhena tu kārayet /
kaṇṭhaṃ tribhāgavistāraṃ aṅguṣṭhakasamāyataṃ //
meaning:
खातस्य मेखलां रम्यां शेषार्धेन तु कारयेत् /
कण्ठं त्रिभागविस्तारं अङ्गुष्ठकसमायतं //
text_mt: With the remaining half, one should make a charming belt for the excavated hollow. / The neck is one-third in width and equal in length to a thumb;

sanskrit_iast:
sārdhamaṅguṣṭhakaṃ vā syāttadagre tu mukhaṃ bhavet /
caturaṅgulavistāraṃ pañcāṅgulamathāpi vā //
meaning:
सार्धमङ्गुष्ठकं वा स्यात्तदग्रे तु मुखं भवेत् /
चतुरङ्गुलविस्तारं पञ्चाङ्गुलमथापि वा //
text_mt: or it may be one and a half thumbs; at its tip there should be a mouth, / four finger-breadths in width, or even five finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
trikaṃ dvyaṅgulakaṃ tat syānmadhyantasya suśobhanam /
āyāmastatsamastasya madhyanimnaḥ suśobhanaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिकं द्व्यङ्गुलकं तत् स्यान्मध्यन्तस्य सुशोभनम् /
आयामस्तत्समस्तस्य मध्यनिम्नः सुशोभनः //
text_mt: It should be three or two finger-breadths; its middle is very handsome. / Its entire length should be equal to it, depressed and very handsome in the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
śuṣiraṃ kaṇṭhadeśe syādviśed yāvat kanīyasī /
śeṣakuṇḍantu kartavyaṃ yathāruci vicitritaṃ //
meaning:
शुषिरं कण्ठदेशे स्याद्विशेद् यावत् कनीयसी /
शेषकुण्डन्तु कर्तव्यं यथारुचि विचित्रितं //
text_mt: In the region of the neck there should be a cavity into which the little finger can enter. / The remainder of the fire-pit should be made decorated according to one's taste.

sanskrit_iast:
sruvantu hastamātraṃ syāddaṇḍakena samanvitaṃ (1) /
vaṭukaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ(2) vṛttaṃ kartavyantu suśobhanaṃ //
:n
1 kuṇḍakena samanvitamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 kaṇṭhakaṃ dvyaṅgulamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ candrābhaṃ
dvyaṅgulamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 60
meaning:
स्रुवन्तु हस्तमात्रं स्याद्दण्डकेन समन्वितं (1) /
वटुकं द्व्यङ्गुलं(2) वृत्तं कर्तव्यन्तु सुशोभनं //
:न्
1 कुण्डकेन समन्वितमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 कण्ठकं द्व्यङ्गुलमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः चन्द्राभं
द्व्यङ्गुलमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 60
text_mt:
The sruva should measure one cubit and be provided with a handle. / The cup should be made circular, two finger-breadths [wide], and very handsome,
1 The manuscript marked "kha" reads "kuṇḍakena samanvitam".
2 The manuscript marked "kha" reads "kaṇṭhakaṃ dvyaṅgulam"; the manuscript marked "ṅa" reads "candrābhaṃ dvyaṅgulam".

sanskrit_iast:
gopadantu yathā magnamalpapaṅke tathā bhavet /
upalipya likhedrekhāmaṅgulāṃ vajranāsikāṃ(1) //
meaning:
गोपदन्तु यथा मग्नमल्पपङ्के तथा भवेत् /
उपलिप्य लिखेद्रेखामङ्गुलां वज्रनासिकां(1) //
text_mt: such as a cow's footprint sunk into shallow mud would be. / Having smeared [the ground], one should draw lines a finger-breadth [wide] with the tip of a vajra.

sanskrit_iast:
saumyāgrā prathamā tasyāṃ rekhe pūrvamukhe tayoḥ /
madhye tisras tathā kuryāddakṣiṇādikrameṇa tu //
meaning:
सौम्याग्रा प्रथमा तस्यां रेखे पूर्वमुखे तयोः /
मध्ये तिस्रस् तथा कुर्याद्दक्षिणादिक्रमेण तु //
text_mt: The first of these points north; [there are] two lines facing east. / Between them, one should likewise make three, in sequence beginning with the south.

sanskrit_iast:
evamullikhya cābhyukṣya praṇavena tu mantravit /
viṣṭaraṃ kalpayettena tasmin śaktintu vaiṣṇavīṃ //
meaning:
एवमुल्लिख्य चाभ्युक्ष्य प्रणवेन तु मन्त्रवित् /
विष्टरं कल्पयेत्तेन तस्मिन् शक्तिन्तु वैष्णवीं //
text_mt: Having thus inscribed and sprinkled [the area] with the praṇava, the knower of mantras / should prepare a seat with it, and in that, [visualize] the Vaiṣṇava power.

sanskrit_iast:
alaṃ kṛtvā mūrtimatīṃ kṣipedagniṃ hariṃ smaran /
prādeśamātrāḥ samidho datvā parisamuhya taṃ //
meaning:
अलं कृत्वा मूर्तिमतीं क्षिपेदग्निं हरिं स्मरन् /
प्रादेशमात्राः समिधो दत्वा परिसमुह्य तं //
text_mt: Having adorned her as personified, one should deposit the fire, remembering Hari. / Offering firewood sticks measuring a span, and sweeping around it,

sanskrit_iast:
darbhaistridhā paristīrya pūrvādau tatra pātrakaṃ /
āsādayedidhmavahnī bhūmau ca śrukśruvadvayaṃ //
meaning:
दर्भैस्त्रिधा परिस्तीर्य पूर्वादौ तत्र पात्रकं /
आसादयेदिध्मवह्नी भूमौ च श्रुक्श्रुवद्वयं //
text_mt: and strewing [the area] three times with darbha grass beginning from the east, one should place the vessel there. / One should set down the firewood, the fire, and both the sruc and sruva on the ground;

sanskrit_iast:
ājyasthālī carusthālī kuśājyañca praṇītayā /
prokṣayitvā prokṣaṇīñca gṛhītvāpūrya vāriṇā //
meaning:
आज्यस्थाली चरुस्थाली कुशाज्यञ्च प्रणीतया /
प्रोक्षयित्वा प्रोक्षणीञ्च गृहीत्वापूर्य वारिणा //
text_mt: the ghee-pot, the caru-pot, the kuśa grass, and the ghee. Sprinkling them with the praṇītā [water], / and taking up the prokṣaṇī vessel and filling it with water,

sanskrit_iast:
pavitrāntarhite haste pariśrāvya ca tajjalaṃ /
prāṅnītvā prokṣaṇīpātraṇ jyotiragre nidhāya ca //
meaning:
पवित्रान्तर्हिते हस्ते परिश्राव्य च तज्जलं /
प्राङ्नीत्वा प्रोक्षणीपात्रण् ज्योतिरग्रे निधाय च //
text_mt: straining that water into a hand holding a pavitra, / and bringing the prokṣaṇī vessel eastward and placing it in front of the flame,

sanskrit_iast:
tadadbhistriś ca samprokṣya iddhmaṃ vinyasya cāgrataḥ /
praṇītāyāṃ supuṣpāyāṃ viṣṇuṃ dhyātvottareṇa ca //
meaning:
तदद्भिस्त्रिश् च सम्प्रोक्ष्य इद्ध्मं विन्यस्य चाग्रतः /
प्रणीतायां सुपुष्पायां विष्णुं ध्यात्वोत्तरेण च //
text_mt: and sprinkling three times with that water, one should lay the kindling in front. / Having meditated on Viṣṇu in the flower-adorned praṇītā [vessel] to the north,

sanskrit_iast:
ājyasthālīmathājyena sampūryāgre nidhāya ca /
samplavotpavanābhyāntu kuryādājyasya saṃskṛtiṃ //
meaning:
आज्यस्थालीमथाज्येन सम्पूर्याग्रे निधाय च /
सम्प्लवोत्पवनाभ्यान्तु कुर्यादाज्यस्य संस्कृतिं //
text_mt: and filling the ghee-pot with ghee and placing it in front, / one should perform the consecration of the ghee by flooding and skimming.

sanskrit_iast:
akhaṇḍitāgrau nirgarbhau kuśau prādeśamātrakau /
tābhyāmuttānapāṇibhyāmaṅguṣṭhānāmikena tu //
meaning:
अखण्डिताग्रौ निर्गर्भौ कुशौ प्रादेशमात्रकौ /
ताभ्यामुत्तानपाणिभ्यामङ्गुष्ठानामिकेन तु //
text_mt: With two span-length kuśa blades that are unbroken at the tips and without sprouts inside, / held by both upturned hands with thumb and ring finger,

sanskrit_iast:
ājyaṃ tayostu saṅgṛhya dvirnītvā triravāṅkṣipet(2) /
sruksruvau cāpi saṅgṛhya tābhyāṃ prakṣipya vāriṇa //
:n
1 rudranāsikāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ vaktranāsikāmiti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 ādyaṃ tayostu sampūjya trīn vārānūrdhvamutkṣipediti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 61
meaning:
आज्यं तयोस्तु सङ्गृह्य द्विर्नीत्वा त्रिरवाङ्क्षिपेत्(2) /
स्रुक्स्रुवौ चापि सङ्गृह्य ताभ्यां प्रक्षिप्य वारिण //
:न्
1 रुद्रनासिकामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः वक्त्रनासिकामिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 आद्यं तयोस्तु सम्पूज्य त्रीन् वारानूर्ध्वमुत्क्षिपेदिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 61
text_mt:
grasping the ghee with the two of them, moving it twice, one should cast it downward three times. / Grasping also the sruc and sruva, sprinkling them with water,
[Footnotes]
1 The manuscript marked "kha" reads "rudranāsikām"; the manuscript marked "ṅa" reads "vaktranāsikām".
2 The manuscript marked "ṅa" reads "ādyaṃ tayostu sampūjya trīn vārānūrdhvamutkṣipet".

sanskrit_iast:
pratapya darbhaiḥ sammṛjya punaḥ prakṣyālya caiva hi /
niṣṭapya sthāpayitvā(1) tu praṇavenaiva sādhakaḥ //
meaning:
प्रतप्य दर्भैः सम्मृज्य पुनः प्रक्ष्याल्य चैव हि /
निष्टप्य स्थापयित्वा(1) तु प्रणवेनैव साधकः //
text_mt: heating them, wiping them with darbha blades, and washing them again, / and heating them thoroughly, the practitioner should set them down with the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavādinamontena paścāddhomaṃ samācaret /
garbhādhānādikarmāṇi yāvadaṃśavyavasthayā //
meaning:
प्रणवादिनमोन्तेन पश्चाद्धोमं समाचरेत् /
गर्भाधानादिकर्माणि यावदंशव्यवस्थया //
text_mt: Then, one should perform the fire oblation with [the mantra] beginning with the praṇava and ending with "namaḥ", / through the rites beginning with conception, divided into portions:

sanskrit_iast:
nāmāntaṃ vratabandhāntaṃ samāvartāvasānakam /
adhikārāvasānaṃ vā karyādaṅgānusārataḥ //
meaning:
नामान्तं व्रतबन्धान्तं समावर्तावसानकम् /
अधिकारावसानं वा कर्यादङ्गानुसारतः //
text_mt: ending with the naming, ending with the investiture with the sacred thread, ending with graduation from studentship, / or ending with qualification [for householdership], one should perform them according to their components.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavenopacārantu kuryātsarvatra sādhakaḥ /
aṅgair homastu kartavyo yathāvittānusārataḥ //
meaning:
प्रणवेनोपचारन्तु कुर्यात्सर्वत्र साधकः /
अङ्गैर् होमस्तु कर्तव्यो यथावित्तानुसारतः //
text_mt: The practitioner should perform the attendances everywhere with the praṇava. / The fire oblation with the ancillary mantras should be performed in accordance with one's wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhādānantu prathamaṃ tataḥ puṃsavanaṃ smṛtam /
sīmantonnayanaṃ jātakarma nāmānnaprāśanam //
meaning:
गर्भादानन्तु प्रथमं ततः पुंसवनं स्मृतम् /
सीमन्तोन्नयनं जातकर्म नामान्नप्राशनम् //
text_mt: Conception is taught as the first, then the rite for securing a male child, / the parting of the hair, the birth-rite, the naming, the first feeding of solid food,

sanskrit_iast:
cūḍakṛtiṃ vratabandhaṃ vedavratānyaśeṣataḥ(2) /
samāvartanaṃ patnyā ca yogaścāthādhikārakaḥ(3) //
meaning:
चूडकृतिं व्रतबन्धं वेदव्रतान्यशेषतः(2) /
समावर्तनं पत्न्या च योगश्चाथाधिकारकः(3) //
text_mt: tonsure, investiture with the sacred thread, the Vedic observances in full, / graduation from studentship, union with a wife, and then entitlement [as a householder].

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdādikramato dhyātvā ekaikaṃ karma pūjya ca /
aṣṭāvaṣṭau tu juhuyāt pratikarmāhutīḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
हृदादिक्रमतो ध्यात्वा एकैकं कर्म पूज्य च /
अष्टावष्टौ तु जुहुयात् प्रतिकर्माहुतीः पुनः //
text_mt: Meditating [on each rite] in order from the heart and other bodily parts, and worshiping each rite, / one should offer eight oblations for each rite.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dadyāt śrucā mūlena sādhakaḥ /
vauṣaḍantena mantreṇa plutaṃ susvaramuccaran //
meaning:
पूर्णाहुतिं ततो दद्यात् श्रुचा मूलेन साधकः /
वौषडन्तेन मन्त्रेण प्लुतं सुस्वरमुच्चरन् //
text_mt: Then, the practitioner should offer the full oblation with the sruc and the root mantra, / uttering a prolated, melodious tone with the mantra ending in "vauṣaṭ".

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇorvahnintu saṃskṛtya śrapayedvaiṣṇavañcarum /
ārādhya sthiṇḍile viṣṇuṃ mantrān saṃsmṛtya saṃśrapet (4) //
meaning:
विष्णोर्वह्निन्तु संस्कृत्य श्रपयेद्वैष्णवञ्चरुम् /
आराध्य स्थिण्डिले विष्णुं मन्त्रान् संस्मृत्य संश्रपेत् (4) //
text_mt: Having consecrated the fire of Viṣṇu, one should cook the Vaiṣṇava caru. / Having worshiped Viṣṇu on the altar and remembering the mantras, one should boil it thoroughly.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanādikrameṇaiva sāṅgāvaraṇamuttamam /
gandhapuṣpaiḥ samabhyarcya dhyātā devaṃ surottamam //
meaning:
आसनादिक्रमेणैव साङ्गावरणमुत्तमम् /
गन्धपुष्पैः समभ्यर्च्य ध्याता देवं सुरोत्तमम् //
text_mt: Following the proper sequence beginning with the seat, having worshipped the highest Lord along with his limbs and retinue / with fragrant perfumes and flowers, the meditator, [worshipping] that supreme deity,

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāyedhmamathāghārāvājyāvagnīśasaṃsthitau /
:n
1 niyujya sthāpayitveti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 devavratānyaśeṣata iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 yogaścāthādhikārata iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 mantrān santarpya saṃtrapet iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 62
vāyavyanairṛtāśādipravṛttau tu yathākramam //
meaning:
आधायेध्ममथाघारावाज्यावग्नीशसंस्थितौ /
:न्
1 नियुज्य स्थापयित्वेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 देवव्रतान्यशेषत इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 योगश्चाथाधिकारत इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 मन्त्रान् सन्तर्प्य संत्रपेत् इति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 62
वायव्यनैरृताशादिप्रवृत्तौ तु यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt:
should place the kindling wood, and then the two ghee-stream oblations stationed at the fire and īśa [corners],
[Footnote]
1. "having employed and set up" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "the observances of the gods entirely" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "and yoga according to qualification" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "having gratified the mantras, he should cook" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and gha.
[Page 62]
directed in due order towards the north-west and south-west directions.

sanskrit_iast:
ājyabhāgau tato hutvā cakṣuṣī dakṣiṇottare /
madhyetha juhuyātsarvamantrānarcākrameṇa tu //
meaning:
आज्यभागौ ततो हुत्वा चक्षुषी दक्षिणोत्तरे /
मध्येथ जुहुयात्सर्वमन्त्रानर्चाक्रमेण तु //
text_mt: Then, having offered the two portions of clarified butter, which are the right and left eyes, / in the centre he should then offer [oblations for] all the mantras according to the sequence of worship.

sanskrit_iast:
ājyena tarpayenmūrterdaśāṃśenāṅgahomakam /
śataṃ sahasraṃ vājyādyaiḥ samidbhirvā tilaiḥ saha(1) //
meaning:
आज्येन तर्पयेन्मूर्तेर्दशांशेनाङ्गहोमकम् /
शतं सहस्रं वाज्याद्यैः समिद्भिर्वा तिलैः सह(1) //
text_mt: With clarified butter he should gratify the icon; with a tenth part [thereof], the oblation for the ancillary limbs, / numbering a hundred or a thousand, with ghee and other [substances], or with firewood together with sesame seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
samāpyārcāntu homāntāṃ śucīn śiṣyānupoṣitān /
āhūyāgre niveśyātha hy astreṇa prokṣayet paśūn //
meaning:
समाप्यार्चान्तु होमान्तां शुचीन् शिष्यानुपोषितान् /
आहूयाग्रे निवेश्याथ ह्य् अस्त्रेण प्रोक्षयेत् पशून् //
text_mt: Having concluded the worship ending with the fire oblation, he should summon the pure students who have fasted, / seat them in front, and then sprinkle those bound souls with the weapon-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyānātmani saṃyojya avidyākarmabandhanaiḥ /
liṅgānuvṛttaś caitanyaṃ saha liṅgena pāśitam(2) //
meaning:
शिष्यानात्मनि संयोज्य अविद्याकर्मबन्धनैः /
लिङ्गानुवृत्तश् चैतन्यं सह लिङ्गेन पाशितम्(2) //
text_mt: Having united the students within himself, consciousness, which follows the subtle body, / bound by the bonds of ignorance and karma along with the subtle body,

sanskrit_iast:
dhyānamārgena samprokṣya vāyuvījena śodhayet /
tato dahanavījena sṛṣṭiṃ brahmāṇḍasañjñikām //
meaning:
ध्यानमार्गेन सम्प्रोक्ष्य वायुवीजेन शोधयेत् /
ततो दहनवीजेन सृष्टिं ब्रह्माण्डसञ्ज्ञिकाम् //
text_mt: sprinkling it by the path of meditation, he should purify it with the wind-seed-syllable. / Then, with the fire-seed-syllable, the creation known as the cosmic egg,

sanskrit_iast:
nirdagdhāṃ sakalāṃ dhyāyedbhasmakūṭanibhasthitām /
plāvayedvāriṇā bhasma saṃsāraṃ vārmayaṃsmaret(3)
meaning:
निर्दग्धां सकलां ध्यायेद्भस्मकूटनिभस्थिताम् /
प्लावयेद्वारिणा भस्म संसारं वार्मयंस्मरेत्(3)
text_mt: he should meditate upon as entirely burnt up, standing like a heap of ashes. / He should inundate the ashes with water, and contemplate the cyclic world as composed of water.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra śaktiṃ nyaset paścāt pārthivīṃ bījasañjñikām /
tanmātrābhiḥ samastābhiḥ saṃvṛtaṃ pārthivaṃ śubham //
meaning:
तत्र शक्तिं न्यसेत् पश्चात् पार्थिवीं बीजसञ्ज्ञिकाम् /
तन्मात्राभिः समस्ताभिः संवृतं पार्थिवं शुभम् //
text_mt: There he should then deposit the power of earth called the seed-syllable. / Enveloped by all the subtle elements, auspicious and earthy,

sanskrit_iast:
aṇḍantadudbhavandhyāyettadādhārantadātmakam /
tanmadhye cintayenmūrtiṃ pauruṣīṃ praṇavātmikām //
meaning:
अण्डन्तदुद्भवन्ध्यायेत्तदाधारन्तदात्मकम् /
तन्मध्ये चिन्तयेन्मूर्तिं पौरुषीं प्रणवात्मिकाम् //
text_mt: he should meditate upon the egg arising from that, based on that and consisting of that. / In the middle of it, he should contemplate the person-form consisting of the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgaṃ saṅkrāmayet paścādātmasthaṃ pūrvasaṃskṛtam (4) /
vibhaktendriyasaṃsthānaṃ kramād vṛddhaṃ vicintayet //
meaning:
लिङ्गं सङ्क्रामयेत् पश्चादात्मस्थं पूर्वसंस्कृतम् (4) /
विभक्तेन्द्रियसंस्थानं क्रमाद् वृद्धं विचिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: He should then transfer the subtle body situated within himself, consecrated previously; / he should visualize it growing by degrees, with its bodily organs properly differentiated.

sanskrit_iast:
tatoṇḍamabdamekaṃ tu sthitvā dviśakalīkṛtam /
:n
1 samidbhirvā tilais tathā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 saha liṅgena darśitamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 saṃsārañcākṣayaṃ smarediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 sthaṇḍile pūrvasaṃskṛtamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 63
dyāvāpṛthivyau śakale tayormadhye prajāpatim //
meaning:
ततोण्डमब्दमेकं तु स्थित्वा द्विशकलीकृतम् /
:न्
1 समिद्भिर्वा तिलैस् तथा इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 सह लिङ्गेन दर्शितमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 संसारञ्चाक्षयं स्मरेदिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 स्थण्डिले पूर्वसंस्कृतमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 63
द्यावापृथिव्यौ शकले तयोर्मध्ये प्रजापतिम् //
text_mt:
Then, that egg, having stayed for a single year, splits into two;
[Footnote]
1. "or with firewood and likewise sesame seeds" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
2. "shown along with the subtle body" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "and should contemplate cyclic existence as imperishable" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "consecrated previously on the sacrificial ground" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
[Page 63]
the two halves become heaven and earth; between them, the lord of creatures

sanskrit_iast:
jātaṃ dhyātvā punaḥ prokṣya praṇavena tu saṃśritam /
mantrātmakatanuṃ kṛtvā yathānyāsaṃ puroditam //
meaning:
जातं ध्यात्वा पुनः प्रोक्ष्य प्रणवेन तु संश्रितम् /
मन्त्रात्मकतनुं कृत्वा यथान्यासं पुरोदितम् //
text_mt: is born; having meditated [thus], having sprinkled [them] again, taking refuge in the praṇava, / making their bodies consist of mantras according to the ritual deposition previously explained,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurhastaṃ tato mūrdhni datvā dhyātvā tu vaiṣṇavam /
evamekaṃ bahūn vāpi janitvā dhyānayogataḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुर्हस्तं ततो मूर्ध्नि दत्वा ध्यात्वा तु वैष्णवम् /
एवमेकं बहून् वापि जनित्वा ध्यानयोगतः //
text_mt: the master, placing the hand of Viṣṇu on the head, should meditate upon the Vaiṣṇava state. / Having thus brought about the birth of one or many [students] through the yoga of meditation,

sanskrit_iast:
karau saṅgṛhya mūlena netre baddhvā tu vāsasā /
netramantreṇa mantrī tān sadanenāhatena tu //
meaning:
करौ सङ्गृह्य मूलेन नेत्रे बद्ध्वा तु वाससा /
नेत्रमन्त्रेण मन्त्री तान् सदनेनाहतेन तु //
text_mt: grasping their hands with the root-mantra, and binding their eyes with a cloth / using the eye-mantra, the mantrin [should lead] them, with an unbroken garment,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtapūjo guruḥ samyak devadevasya tattvavān /
śiṣyān puṣpāñjalibhṛtaḥ prāṅmukhānupaveśayet //
meaning:
कृतपूजो गुरुः सम्यक् देवदेवस्य तत्त्ववान् /
शिष्यान् पुष्पाञ्जलिभृतः प्राङ्मुखानुपवेशयेत् //
text_mt: The guru, who knows the reality and has properly performed the worship of the God of gods, / should seat the disciples facing east, holding flowers in their folded hands.

sanskrit_iast:
arcayeyuś ca tepyevamprasūtā guruṇā harim /
kṣiptvā puṣpāñjaliṃ tatra puṣpādibhiranantaram //
meaning:
अर्चयेयुश् च तेप्येवम्प्रसूता गुरुणा हरिम् /
क्षिप्त्वा पुष्पाञ्जलिं तत्र पुष्पादिभिरनन्तरम् //
text_mt: They too, having thus been born through the guru, should worship Hari; / having cast folded hands of flowers there, immediately thereafter with flowers and other offerings,

sanskrit_iast:
amantramarcanaṃ kṛtvā(1) guroḥ pādārcanantataḥ /
vidhāya dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt sarvasvaṃ cārdhameva vā //
meaning:
अमन्त्रमर्चनं कृत्वा(1) गुरोः पादार्चनन्ततः /
विधाय दक्षिणां दद्यात् सर्वस्वं चार्धमेव वा //
text_mt: having performed the worship without mantras, then, having performed the worship of the guru's feet, / he should offer the sacrificial fee, either his entire property or half of it.

sanskrit_iast:
guruḥ saṃśikṣayecchiṣyān taiḥ pūjyo nāmabhirhariḥ /
viśvaksenaṃ yajedīśaṃ śaṅkhacakragadādharam //
meaning:
गुरुः संशिक्षयेच्छिष्यान् तैः पूज्यो नामभिर्हरिः /
विश्वक्सेनं यजेदीशं शङ्खचक्रगदाधरम् //
text_mt: The guru should instruct the disciples; Hari is to be worshipped by them with his names. / He should worship the lord Viṣvaksena, who bears the conch, discus, and mace.

sanskrit_iast: tajjapantañca tarjanyā maṇḍalasthaṃ visarjayet //57//
meaning: तज्जपन्तञ्च तर्जन्या मण्डलस्थं विसर्जयेत् //57//
text_mt: With the forefinger, reciting his mantra, he should dismiss him from the maṇḍala. //57

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇunirmālyamakhilaṃ viṣvaksenāya cārpayet /
praṇītābhis tathātmānamabhiṣicya ca kuṇḍagaṃ //
meaning:
विष्णुनिर्माल्यमखिलं विष्वक्सेनाय चार्पयेत् /
प्रणीताभिस् तथात्मानमभिषिच्य च कुण्डगं //
text_mt: He should offer all the leftover offerings of Viṣṇu to Viṣvaksena. / And having sprinkled himself with the praṇītā waters, and having the fire in the fire-pit

sanskrit_iast:
vahnimātmani saṃyojya viṣvaksenaṃ visarjayet /
bubhukṣuḥ sarvamāpnoti mumukṣur līyate harau //

'dhyāyaḥ

vāsudevādimantranirūpaṇaṃ

वह्निमात्मनि संयोज्य विष्वक्सेनं विसर्जयेत् /
बुभुक्षुः सर्वमाप्नोति मुमुक्षुर् लीयते हरौ //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये अग्निकार्यादिकथनं नाम चतुर्विंशो
ऽध्यायः

united within himself, he should dismiss Viṣvaksena. / One who desires enjoyment attains everything; one who desires liberation dissolves into Hari.
Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Fire Rite and Related Matters", in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.

1. "having performed worship of Vāsudeva" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.

Now, the twenty-fifth chapter.
Determination of the Mantras of Vāsudeva and Others

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
vāsudevādimantrāṇāṃ pūjānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vade /
vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
वासुदेवादिमन्त्राणां पूजानां लक्षणं वदे /
वासुदेवः सङ्कर्षणः प्रद्युम्नश्चानिरुद्धकः //
text_mt: Nārada said: / I shall state the characteristics of the mantras and worship of Vāsudeva and others: / Vāsudeva, Saṅkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha;

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhagavate cādau a ā aṃ aḥ svavījakāḥ(1) /
oṅkārādyā namontāś ca namo nārāyaṇastataḥ //
meaning:
नमो भगवते चादौ अ आ अं अः स्ववीजकाः(1) /
ओङ्काराद्या नमोन्ताश् च नमो नारायणस्ततः //
