text_mt: with "namo bhagavate" at the beginning, a, ā, aṃ, aḥ are their respective seed-syllables; / they begin with the syllable Oṃ and end with namaḥ; and then "namo nārāyaṇāya";

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ tat sat brahmaṇe caiva oṃ namo viṣṇave namaḥ /
oṃ kṣauṃ oṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
ओं तत् सत् ब्रह्मणे चैव ओं नमो विष्णवे नमः /
ओं क्षौं ओं नमो भगवते नरसिंहाय वै नमः //
text_mt: "Oṃ tat sat brahmaṇe", and likewise "Oṃ namo viṣṇave namaḥ"; / "Oṃ kṣauṃ oṃ namo bhagavate narasiṃhāya vai namaḥ";

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ bhūrnamo bhagavate varāhāya narādhipāḥ /
javāruṇaharidrābhā nīlaśyāmalalohitāḥ //
meaning:
ओं भूर्नमो भगवते वराहाय नराधिपाः /
जवारुणहरिद्राभा नीलश्यामललोहिताः //
text_mt: "Oṃ bhūḥ namo bhagavate varāhāya", O kings; / having the luster of the China rose, dawn, and turmeric, dark blue, blackish, and red,

sanskrit_iast:
meghāgnimadhupiṅgābhā vallabhā nava nāyakāḥ /
aṅgāni svaravījānāṃ svanāmāntair yathākramam //
meaning:
मेघाग्निमधुपिङ्गाभा वल्लभा नव नायकाः /
अङ्गानि स्वरवीजानां स्वनामान्तैर् यथाक्रमम् //
text_mt: having the luster of a cloud, fire, and honey-reddish, the nine beloved leaders [are thus]. / The ancillary limbs of the vowel-seed-syllables, ending with their respective names in due order,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayādīni kalpeta vibhaktaistantravedibhiḥ /
vyañjanādīni vījāni teṣāṃ lakṣaṇamanyathā //
meaning:
हृदयादीनि कल्पेत विभक्तैस्तन्त्रवेदिभिः /
व्यञ्जनादीनि वीजानि तेषां लक्षणमन्यथा //
text_mt: the heart and the others, should be arranged by those who know the tantras as distinct. / The consonants and others are seed-syllables; their characteristic is otherwise:

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghasvaraistu bhinnāni namontāntasthitāni tu /
aṅgāni hrasvayuktāni upāṅgānīti varṇyate //
meaning:
दीर्घस्वरैस्तु भिन्नानि नमोन्तान्तस्थितानि तु /
अङ्गानि ह्रस्वयुक्तानि उपाङ्गानीति वर्ण्यते //
text_mt: divided by long vowels, ending with namaḥ, / the limbs joined with short vowels are described as the minor limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhaktanāmavarṇāntasthitāni vījamuttamaṃ(2) /
dīrghair hrasvaiś ca saṃyuktaṃ sāṅgopāṅgaṃsvaraiḥ kramāt(3) //
meaning:
विभक्तनामवर्णान्तस्थितानि वीजमुत्तमं(2) /
दीर्घैर् ह्रस्वैश् च संयुक्तं साङ्गोपाङ्गंस्वरैः क्रमात्(3) //
text_mt: The excellent seed-syllable standing at the end of the divided letters of the name, / joined with long and short vowels, with limbs and minor limbs in sequence,

sanskrit_iast:
vyañjanānāṃ kramo hy eṣa hṛdayādiprakḷptaye /
svavījena svanāmāntair vibhaktānyaṅganāmabhiḥ //
:n
1 dvādaśākṣaravījakā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 sthitavījārthamuttamamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 dīrghasvaraiś ca saṃyuktamaṅgopāṅgaṃ svaraiḥ kramāditi kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 svaravījeṣu nāmāntair vibhaktānyaṅganāmabhiriti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 65
meaning:
व्यञ्जनानां क्रमो ह्य् एष हृदयादिप्रकॢप्तये /
स्ववीजेन स्वनामान्तैर् विभक्तान्यङ्गनामभिः //
:न्
1 द्वादशाक्षरवीजका इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्थितवीजार्थमुत्तममिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 दीर्घस्वरैश् च संयुक्तमङ्गोपाङ्गं स्वरैः क्रमादिति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 स्वरवीजेषु नामान्तैर् विभक्तान्यङ्गनामभिरिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 65
text_mt:
this is indeed the order of the consonants for the formation of the heart and the other limbs, / distinguished by its own seed-syllable, ending with its own name, by the names of the limbs.
[Footnote]
1. "having the twelve-syllable seed-mantras" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "the highest meaning of the established seed-syllable" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "and joined with long vowels, limb and minor limb in sequence by vowels" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "among the vowel-seeds, ending with names, divided by the names of the limbs" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
[Page 65]

sanskrit_iast:
yuktāni hṛdayādīni dvādaśāntāni pañcataḥ(1) /
ārabhya kalpayitvā tu japet siddhyanurūpataḥ //
meaning:
युक्तानि हृदयादीनि द्वादशान्तानि पञ्चतः(1) /
आरभ्य कल्पयित्वा तु जपेत् सिद्ध्यनुरूपतः //
text_mt: Endowed with the heart and others, ending with twelve, beginning from five, / having arranged them, one should recite them in accordance with [the desired] supernatural attainment.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayañca śiraścūḍā kavacaṃ netramastrakaṃ /
ṣaḍaṅgāni tu vījānāṃ mūlasya dvādaśāṅgakaṃ //
meaning:
हृदयञ्च शिरश्चूडा कवचं नेत्रमस्त्रकं /
षडङ्गानि तु वीजानां मूलस्य द्वादशाङ्गकं //
text_mt: Heart, head, tuft of hair, armour, eye, and weapon / are the six limbs of the seed-syllables; the root-mantra has twelve limbs:

sanskrit_iast:
hṛcchiraś ca śikhā varma cāstranetrāntayodaraṃ /
praṣṭabāhūrujānūṃś ca jaṅghā pādau kramānnyaset //
meaning:
हृच्छिरश् च शिखा वर्म चास्त्रनेत्रान्तयोदरं /
प्रष्टबाहूरुजानूंश् च जङ्घा पादौ क्रमान्न्यसेत् //
text_mt: heart, head, tuft, armour, and ending with weapon and eye; the belly, / back, arms, thighs, knees, shanks, and feet—he should deposit them in order:

sanskrit_iast:
kaṃ ṭaṃ paṃ śaṃ vainateyaḥ khaṃ ṭhaṃ phaṃ ghaṃgadāmanuḥ(2) /
gaṃ ḍaṃ baṃ saṃ puṣṭhimanto ghaṃ ḍhaṃ bhaṃ haṃ śriyainamaḥ //
meaning:
कं टं पं शं वैनतेयः खं ठं फं घंगदामनुः(2) /
गं डं बं सं पुष्ठिमन्तो घं ढं भं हं श्रियैनमः //
text_mt: kaṃ, ṭaṃ, paṃ, śaṃ for Garuḍa; khaṃ, ṭhaṃ, phaṃ, ghaṃ is the mace-mantra; / gaṃ, ḍaṃ, baṃ, saṃ for Puṣṭi; ghaṃ, ḍhaṃ, bhaṃ, haṃ, homage to Śrī;

sanskrit_iast:
vaṃ śaṃ maṃ kṣaṃ(3) pāñcajanyaṃ chaṃ taṃ paṃ(4)kaustubhāya ca /
jaṃ khaṃ vaṃ sudarśanāya śrīvatsāya saṃ vaṃ daṃ caṃlaṃ(5) //
meaning:
वं शं मं क्षं(3) पाञ्चजन्यं छं तं पं(4)कौस्तुभाय च /
जं खं वं सुदर्शनाय श्रीवत्साय सं वं दं चंलं(5) //
text_mt: vaṃ, śaṃ, maṃ, kṣaṃ for Pāñcajanya; chaṃ, taṃ, paṃ for the Kaustubha gem; / jaṃ, khaṃ, vaṃ for Sudarśana; saṃ, vaṃ, daṃ, caṃ, laṃ for Śrīvatsa;

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ dhaṃ vaṃ vanamālāyai mahānantāya vai namaḥ(6) /
nirvījapadamantrāṇāṃ padair aṅgāni kalpayet //
meaning:
ओं धं वं वनमालायै महानन्ताय वै नमः(6) /
निर्वीजपदमन्त्राणां पदैर् अङ्गानि कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: Oṃ dhaṃ vaṃ, homage to the garland of forest flowers and to great Ananta. / For word-mantras devoid of seed-syllables, he should construct the limbs by means of words.

sanskrit_iast:
jātyantair nāmasaṃyukterhṛdayādīni pañcadhā /
praṇavaṃ hṛdayādīni tataḥ proktāni pañcadhā //
meaning:
जात्यन्तैर् नामसंयुक्तेर्हृदयादीनि पञ्चधा /
प्रणवं हृदयादीनि ततः प्रोक्तानि पञ्चधा //
text_mt: The [mantras] of the heart and the rest are fivefold, ending with the appropriate grammatical ending and combined with the name. / The Praṇava, the heart, and the rest are thus stated to be fivefold:

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavaṃ hṛdayaṃ pūrvaṃ parāyeti śiraḥ śikhā /
nāmnātmanā tu(7) kavacaṃ astraṃ nāmāntakaṃ bhavet //
:n
1 dvādaśārṇāni yatnata iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 mahāgadā iti ṅa,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 ṭhaṃ ṇaṃ maṃ kṣaṃ iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 daṃ bhaṃ pamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 śrīvatsāya ca pañcamamiti ṅa, cihnitapustkapāṭhaḥ śrīvatso
vaṃ caṃ daṃ ṭhaṃ laṃ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 namonantāya vai nama iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
7 nāmnāmunā tu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustkadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 66
meaning:
प्रणवं हृदयं पूर्वं परायेति शिरः शिखा /
नाम्नात्मना तु(7) कवचं अस्त्रं नामान्तकं भवेत् //
:न्
1 द्वादशार्णानि यत्नत इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 महागदा इति ङ,चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ठं णं मं क्षं इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 दं भं पमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 श्रीवत्साय च पञ्चममिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्त्कपाठः श्रीवत्सो
वं चं दं ठं लं इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 नमोनन्ताय वै नम इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
7 नाम्नामुना तु इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्त्कद्वयपाठः
:प् 66
text_mt:
The Praṇava is first, followed by the heart; with "to the supreme" [parāya], the head [and] the crest; / with the name and "the Self" [ātmane], the armor; the weapon ends with the name.
:n
1. "dvādaśārṇāni yatnataḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "mahāgadā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "ṭhaṃ ṇaṃ maṃ kṣaṃ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "daṃ bhaṃ pam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
5. "śrīvatsāya ca pañcamam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa; "śrīvatso vaṃ caṃ daṃ ṭhaṃ laṃ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
6. "namonantāya vai namaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
7. "nāmnāmunā tu" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa. / :p 66

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ parāstrādisvanāmātmā(1) caturthyanto namontakaḥ /
ekavyūhādiṣaḍviṃśavyūhāttasyātmano manuḥ(2) //
meaning:
ओं परास्त्रादिस्वनामात्मा(1) चतुर्थ्यन्तो नमोन्तकः /
एकव्यूहादिषड्विंशव्यूहात्तस्यात्मनो मनुः(2) //
text_mt: Oṃ, the supreme weapon and so forth, composed of one's own name, ending in the dative case and concluding with "namaḥ"— / this is the mantra of that Self, ranging from the single emanation up to the twenty-six emanations.

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭādikarāgreṣu prakṛtiṃ dehakercayet /
parāya puruṣātmā syāt prakṛtyātmā dvirūpakaḥ //
meaning:
कनिष्टादिकराग्रेषु प्रकृतिं देहकेर्चयेत् /
पराय पुरुषात्मा स्यात् प्रकृत्यात्मा द्विरूपकः //
text_mt: One should worship Prakṛti at the tips of the fingers beginning with the little finger and on the body. / The supreme would be the nature of Puruṣa; the two-formed is of the nature of Prakṛti.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ parayāmnyātmane caiva vāyvarkau ca dvirūpakaḥ /
agniṃ trimūrtau(3) vinyasya vyāpakaṃ karadehayoḥ //
meaning:
ओं परयाम्न्यात्मने चैव वाय्वर्कौ च द्विरूपकः /
अग्निं त्रिमूर्तौ(3) विन्यस्य व्यापकं करदेहयोः //
text_mt: "Oṃ, unto the supreme radiant Self," and also wind and the sun are the two-formed. / Having deposited Agni in the triple form, pervasively upon the hands and body,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyvarkau karaśākhāsu savyetarakaradvaye /
hṛdi mūrto tanāveṣa trivyūhe turyarūpake //
meaning:
वाय्वर्कौ करशाखासु सव्येतरकरद्वये /
हृदि मूर्तो तनावेष त्रिव्यूहे तुर्यरूपके //
text_mt: [one should deposit] wind and the sun on the fingers of both the left and other hand, / this [deity] embodied in the heart in the bodily form, in the triple emanation and in the fourth form.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgvedaṃ vyāpakaṃ haste aṅgulīṣu yajurnyaset /
taladvayetharvarūpaṃ śirohṛccaraṇāntakaḥ //
meaning:
ऋग्वेदं व्यापकं हस्ते अङ्गुलीषु यजुर्न्यसेत् /
तलद्वयेथर्वरूपं शिरोहृच्चरणान्तकः //
text_mt: One should deposit the Ṛgveda pervasively in the hand, the Yajurveda upon the fingers, / the form of the Atharvaveda upon the two palms, ending with the head, heart, and feet.

sanskrit_iast:
ākāśaṃ vyāpakaṃ nyasya kare dehe tu pūrvavat /
aṅgulīṣu ca vāyvādi śirohṛdguhyapādake //
meaning:
आकाशं व्यापकं न्यस्य करे देहे तु पूर्ववत् /
अङ्गुलीषु च वाय्वादि शिरोहृद्गुह्यपादके //
text_mt: Having deposited space pervasively in the hand and on the body as before, / and the wind and the rest upon the fingers, [one deposits them] on the head, heart, genitals, and feet.

sanskrit_iast:
vāyurjyotirjalaṃ pṛthvī pañcavyūhaḥ samīritaḥ /
manaḥ śrotrantvagdṛgjihvā ghrāṇaṃ ṣaḍvyūha īritaḥ //
meaning:
वायुर्ज्योतिर्जलं पृथ्वी पञ्चव्यूहः समीरितः /
मनः श्रोत्रन्त्वग्दृग्जिह्वा घ्राणं षड्व्यूह ईरितः //
text_mt: Wind, fire, water, and earth: this is declared as the fivefold emanation. / The mind, ear, skin, eye, tongue, and nose are declared as the sixfold emanation.

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpakaṃ mānasaṃ nyasya tatoṅguṣṭāditaḥ kramāt /
mūrdhāsyahṛdguhyapatsu kathitaḥ karuṇātmakaḥ //
meaning:
व्यापकं मानसं न्यस्य ततोङ्गुष्टादितः क्रमात् /
मूर्धास्यहृद्गुह्यपत्सु कथितः करुणात्मकः //
text_mt: Having deposited the mind pervasively, then in sequence from the thumbs onward, / [and] on the head, mouth, heart, genitals, and feet, the compassionate [Self] is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
ādimūrtistu sarvatra vyāpako jīvasañjñitaḥ /
bhūrbhuvaḥ svarmaharjanastapaḥ styañca saptadhā //
meaning:
आदिमूर्तिस्तु सर्वत्र व्यापको जीवसञ्ज्ञितः /
भूर्भुवः स्वर्महर्जनस्तपः स्त्यञ्च सप्तधा //
text_mt: The primal form is pervasive everywhere, known as the individual self [jīva]. / Earth, atmosphere, heaven, Maharloka, Janaloka, Tapoloka, and Satyaloka are the sevenfold.

sanskrit_iast:
kare dehe nyasedādyamaṅguṣṭādikrameṇa tu /
talasaṃsthaḥ saptamaś ca(4) lokeśo dehake kramāt //
:n
1 oṃ parāstrādityanāmātmā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 evaṃ vyūhādiṣaḍviṃśaṃ vyūhāttasyātmano manuriti kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 agniṃ dvimūrtau iti kha, cihnitapustkapāṭhaḥ
4 talasthaḥ saptamaś caiva iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 67
meaning:
करे देहे न्यसेदाद्यमङ्गुष्टादिक्रमेण तु /
तलसंस्थः सप्तमश् च(4) लोकेशो देहके क्रमात् //
:न्
1 ओं परास्त्रादित्यनामात्मा इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 एवं व्यूहादिषड्विंशं व्यूहात्तस्यात्मनो मनुरिति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 अग्निं द्विमूर्तौ इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्त्कपाठः
4 तलस्थः सप्तमश् चैव इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 67
text_mt:
One should deposit the primary one in the hand and on the body in the sequence from the thumbs onward; / and situated on the palm is the seventh, the lord of the worlds, in sequence on the body.
:n
1. "oṃ parāstrādityanāmātmā" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
2. "evaṃ vyūhādiṣaḍviṃśaṃ vyūhāttasyātmano manuḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "agniṃ dvimūrtau" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "talasthaḥ saptamaś caiva" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / :p 67

sanskrit_iast:
dehe śirolalāṭāsyahṛdguhyāṅgriṣu saṃsthitaḥ /
agniṣṭhomastathokthastu ṣoḍaśī vājapeyakaḥ //
meaning:
देहे शिरोललाटास्यहृद्गुह्याङ्ग्रिषु संस्थितः /
अग्निष्ठोमस्तथोक्थस्तु षोडशी वाजपेयकः //
text_mt: Stationed on the body at the head, forehead, mouth, heart, genitals, and feet / are the Agniṣṭoma, then the Ukthya, the Ṣoḍaśin, the Vājapeya,

sanskrit_iast:
atirātrāptoryāmañca(1) yajñātmā saptarūpakaḥ /
dhīrahaṃ manaḥ śabdaś ca sparśarūparasāstataḥ(2) //
meaning:
अतिरात्राप्तोर्यामञ्च(1) यज्ञात्मा सप्तरूपकः /
धीरहं मनः शब्दश् च स्पर्शरूपरसास्ततः(2) //
text_mt: the Atirātra, and the Aptoryāma—the sevenfold embodiment of sacrifice. / Intellect, ego, mind, and sound; then touch, form, and taste;

sanskrit_iast:
gandho buddhirvyāpakaṃ tu kare dehe nyaset kramāt /
nyasedantyai ca(3) talayoḥ ke lalāṭe mukhe hṛdi //
meaning:
गन्धो बुद्धिर्व्यापकं तु करे देहे न्यसेत् क्रमात् /
न्यसेदन्त्यै च(3) तलयोः के ललाटे मुखे हृदि //
text_mt: and smell: having deposited intellect pervasively on the hands and body in sequence, / one should deposit the rest on the two palms, on the head, forehead, mouth, and heart,

sanskrit_iast:
nābhau guhye ca pāde ca aṣṭavyūhaḥ pumān smṛtaḥ(4) /
vījo buddhirahaṅkāro manaḥ śabdo guṇonilaḥ //
meaning:
नाभौ गुह्ये च पादे च अष्टव्यूहः पुमान् स्मृतः(4) /
वीजो बुद्धिरहङ्कारो मनः शब्दो गुणोनिलः //
text_mt: at the navel, the genitals, and the feet; the eightfold emanation is known as Puruṣa. / The seed, intellect, ego, mind, sound, the attribute of wind,

sanskrit_iast:
rūpaṃ raso navātmāyaṃ jīva aṅguṣṭhakadvaye /
tarjanyādikramāccheṣaṃ yāvadvāmapradeśinīṃ //
meaning:
रूपं रसो नवात्मायं जीव अङ्गुष्ठकद्वये /
तर्जन्यादिक्रमाच्छेषं यावद्वामप्रदेशिनीं //
text_mt: form, and taste: this is the ninefold Self, the individual self on the two thumbs, / the remainder in sequence from the forefingers up to the left index finger.

sanskrit_iast:
dehe śirolalāṭāsyahṛnnābhiguhyajānuṣu /
pādayoś ca daśātmāyaṃ indro vyāpī samāsthitaḥ //
meaning:
देहे शिरोललाटास्यहृन्नाभिगुह्यजानुषु /
पादयोश् च दशात्मायं इन्द्रो व्यापी समास्थितः //
text_mt: On the body: at the head, forehead, mouth, heart, navel, genitals, knees, / and the two feet, this tenfold Self, the all-pervading Indra, is situated.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhakadvaye vahnistarjanyādau pareṣu ca /
śirolalāṭavaktreṣu hṛnnābhiguhyajānuṣu //
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठकद्वये वह्निस्तर्जन्यादौ परेषु च /
शिरोललाटवक्त्रेषु हृन्नाभिगुह्यजानुषु //
text_mt: Fire is on the two thumbs, and the other [entities] on the forefingers and the rest; / on the head, forehead, mouth, heart, navel, genitals, knees,

sanskrit_iast:
pādayorekadaśātmā manaḥ śrotraṃ tvageva ca /
cakṣurjihvā tathā ghrāṇaṃ vākpāṇyaṅghriś ca pāyukaḥ //
meaning:
पादयोरेकदशात्मा मनः श्रोत्रं त्वगेव च /
चक्षुर्जिह्वा तथा घ्राणं वाक्पाण्यङ्घ्रिश् च पायुकः //
text_mt: and the two feet is the elevenfold Self: mind, ear, and skin, / eye, tongue, and nose, speech, hands, feet, and anus,

sanskrit_iast:
upasthaṃ mānaso vyāpī śrotramaṅguṣṭhakadvaye /
tarjanyādikramādaṣṭau atiriktaṃ taladvaye //
meaning:
उपस्थं मानसो व्यापी श्रोत्रमङ्गुष्ठकद्वये /
तर्जन्यादिक्रमादष्टौ अतिरिक्तं तलद्वये //
text_mt: and genitals; the mental all-pervading [Self] [is pervasive], the ear on the two thumbs, / eight in sequence from the forefinger onward, and the remainder on the two palms.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamāṅgulalalāṭāsyahṛnnābhāvatha guhyake /
uruyugme tathā jaṅghe gulphapādeṣu ca kramāt //
:n
1 atirātrāptayāmaś ca iti kha, cihnitapustkapāṭhaḥ
2 rasās tathā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 nyasedante ca iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / nyasedaṣṭau ca iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 kramāt smṛta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭḥaḥ
:p 68
meaning:
उत्तमाङ्गुलललाटास्यहृन्नाभावथ गुह्यके /
उरुयुग्मे तथा जङ्घे गुल्फपादेषु च क्रमात् //
:न्
1 अतिरात्राप्तयामश् च इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्त्कपाठः
2 रसास् तथा इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 न्यसेदन्ते च इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / न्यसेदष्टौ च इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 क्रमात् स्मृत इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाट्ःअः
:प् 68
text_mt:
On the crown of the head, forehead, mouth, heart, navel, then the genitals, / on the two thighs, as well as the shanks, ankles, and feet in sequence:
:n
1. "atirātrāptayāmaś ca" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "rasās tathā" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "nyasedante ca" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "nyasedaṣṭau ca" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "kramāt smṛtaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / :p 68

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇurmadhuharaś caiva trivikramakavāmanau /
śrīdharotha hṛṣīkeśaḥ padmanābhastathaiva ca //
meaning:
विष्णुर्मधुहरश् चैव त्रिविक्रमकवामनौ /
श्रीधरोथ हृषीकेशः पद्मनाभस्तथैव च //
text_mt: Viṣṇu, Madhuhara, Trivikrama, and Vāmana, / Śrīdhara, then Hṛṣīkeśa, and likewise Padmanābha,

sanskrit_iast:
dāmodaraḥ keśavaś ca nārāyaṇastataḥ paraḥ /
mādhavaścātha govindo viṣṇuṃ vai vyāpakaṃ nyaset //
meaning:
दामोदरः केशवश् च नारायणस्ततः परः /
माधवश्चाथ गोविन्दो विष्णुं वै व्यापकं न्यसेत् //
text_mt: Dāmodara, Keśava, Nārāyaṇa next, / Mādhava, and then Govinda—one should deposit Viṣṇu as pervasive.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhādau tale dvau ca pāde jānuni vai kaṭau /
śiraḥśikharakaṭyāñca jānupādādiṣu nyaset //
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठादौ तले द्वौ च पादे जानुनि वै कटौ /
शिरःशिखरकट्याञ्च जानुपादादिषु न्यसेत् //
text_mt: On the thumbs and the rest, two on the palm, on the feet, knees, hips, / on the crown of the head, waist, and knees, feet, and so on, one should deposit.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśātmā pañcaviṃśaḥ ṣaḍviṃśavyūhakas tathā /
puruṣo dhīrahaṅkāro manaścittañca śabdakaḥ //
meaning:
द्वादशात्मा पञ्चविंशः षड्विंशव्यूहकस् तथा /
पुरुषो धीरहङ्कारो मनश्चित्तञ्च शब्दकः //
text_mt: Thus the twelvefold Self, the twenty-fivefold, and the twenty-sixfold emanation: / Puruṣa, intellect, ego, mind, thought, and sound,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā sparśo raso rūpaṃ gandhaḥ śrotraṃ tvacas tathā /
cakṣurjihvā nāsikā ca vākpāṇyaṅghriś ca pāyavaḥ //
meaning:
तथा स्पर्शो रसो रूपं गन्धः श्रोत्रं त्वचस् तथा /
चक्षुर्जिह्वा नासिका च वाक्पाण्यङ्घ्रिश् च पायवः //
text_mt: likewise touch, taste, form, smell, ear, and skin, / eye, tongue, nose, speech, hands, feet, and anus,

sanskrit_iast:
upastho bhūrjalantejo vāyurākāśameva ca /
puruṣaṃ vyāpakaṃ nyasya aṅguṣṭhādau daśa nyaset //
meaning:
उपस्थो भूर्जलन्तेजो वायुराकाशमेव च /
पुरुषं व्यापकं न्यस्य अङ्गुष्ठादौ दश न्यसेत् //
text_mt: genitals, earth, water, fire, wind, and space: / having deposited Puruṣa as pervasive, one should deposit ten on the thumbs and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣān hastatale nyasya śirasyatha lalāṭake /
mukhahṛnnābhiguhyorujānvaṅghrau karaṇodgatau //
meaning:
शेषान् हस्ततले न्यस्य शिरस्यथ ललाटके /
मुखहृन्नाभिगुह्योरुजान्वङ्घ्रौ करणोद्गतौ //
text_mt: depositing the remainder on the palms of the hands; on the head, then on the forehead, / mouth, heart, navel, genitals, thighs, knees, and feet, arising from the faculties;

sanskrit_iast:
pāde jānvorupasthe ca hṛdaye mūrdhni ca kramāt /
paraś ca puruṣātmādau ṣaḍviṃśe pūrvavatparaṃ //
meaning:
पादे जान्वोरुपस्थे च हृदये मूर्ध्नि च क्रमात् /
परश् च पुरुषात्मादौ षड्विंशे पूर्ववत्परं //
text_mt: on the feet, knees, genitals, heart, and head in sequence. / The supreme Self of Puruṣa is at the beginning; in the twenty-sixth, the Supreme is as before.

sanskrit_iast:
sañcintya maṇḍalaike tu prakṛtiṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ /
pūrvayāmyāpyasaumyeṣu hṛdayādīni pūjayet //
meaning:
सञ्चिन्त्य मण्डलैके तु प्रकृतिं पूजयेद्बुधः /
पूर्वयाम्याप्यसौम्येषु हृदयादीनि पूजयेत् //
text_mt: Having meditated in a single maṇḍala, the wise one should worship Prakṛti; / in the east, south, west, and north, one should worship the heart and other [limbs];

sanskrit_iast:
astramagnyādikoṇeṣu(1) vainateyādi pūrvavat /
dikpālāṃś ca vidhistvanyaḥ(2) trivyūhegniś ca madhyataḥ //
meaning:
अस्त्रमग्न्यादिकोणेषु(1) वैनतेयादि पूर्ववत् /
दिक्पालांश् च विधिस्त्वन्यः(2) त्रिव्यूहेग्निश् च मध्यतः //
text_mt: the weapon in the corners beginning with the south-east, Vainateya and the rest as before, / and the guardians of the directions; but another procedure applies in the triple emanation, with Agni in the middle,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādidigbalāvasorājyādibhiralaṅkṛtaḥ /
karṇikāyāṃ nābhasaś ca mānasaḥ karṇikāsthitaḥ //
:n
1 astramagnyādipatreṣu iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 dikpālāṃś ca vidhistasya iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
dikpālādau vidhistulya iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 69
meaning:
पूर्वादिदिग्बलावसोराज्यादिभिरलङ्कृतः /
कर्णिकायां नाभसश् च मानसः कर्णिकास्थितः //
:न्
1 अस्त्रमग्न्यादिपत्रेषु इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 दिक्पालांश् च विधिस्तस्य इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
दिक्पालादौ विधिस्तुल्य इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 69
text_mt:
adorned with ghee and other offerings to the strength-wealth of the directions beginning with the east; / and the celestial one in the pericarp, while the mental one is stationed in the pericarp.
:n
1. "astramagnyādipatreṣu" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
2. "dikpālāṃś ca vidhistasya" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha; "dikpālādau vidhistulyaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / :p 69

sanskrit_iast:
viśvarūpaṃ sarvasthityai(1) yajedrājyajayāya ca /
sarvavyūhaiḥ samāyuktamaṅgair api ca pañcabhiḥ //
meaning:
विश्वरूपं सर्वस्थित्यै(1) यजेद्राज्यजयाय च /
सर्वव्यूहैः समायुक्तमङ्गैर् अपि च पञ्चभिः //
text_mt: One should worship the Cosmic Form for the maintenance of all and for victory over the kingdom, / endowed with all emanations and with the five limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
garuḍādyaistathendrādyaiḥ sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt /
viśvaksenaṃ yajennāmnā vai vījaṃ vyomasaṃsthitaṃ(2) //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye mantrapradarśanaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
mudrālakṣaṇakathanaṃ
meaning:
गरुडाद्यैस्तथेन्द्राद्यैः सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात् /
विश्वक्सेनं यजेन्नाम्ना वै वीजं व्योमसंस्थितं(2) //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये मन्त्रप्रदर्शनं नाम पञ्चविंशो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ षड्विंशो ऽध्यायः
मुद्रालक्षणकथनं
text_mt:
together with Garuḍa and the others, and Indra and the others; one shall obtain all desires. / One should worship Viṣvaksena by name, with the seed-syllable stationed in the ether.
:e Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, entitled "Exposition of Mantras," in the ancient and great Agni Purāṇa.
:ś Now the twenty-sixth chapter:
Description of the Characteristics of Ritual Gestures

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
mudrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye sānnidhyādiprakārakaṃ /
añjaliḥ prathamā mudrā vandanī hṛdayānugā //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
मुद्राणां लक्षणं वक्ष्ये सान्निध्यादिप्रकारकं /
अञ्जलिः प्रथमा मुद्रा वन्दनी हृदयानुगा //
text_mt: Nārada said: / I shall explain the characteristics of the ritual gestures, which cause [the deity's] presence and so forth. / The first ritual gesture is the folded hands (añjali), used in salutation, held near the heart.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvāṅguṣṭhovāmamuṣṭirdakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhabandhanaṃ /
savyasya tasya cāṅguṣṭho yasya cordhve prakīrtitaḥ(3) //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वाङ्गुष्ठोवाममुष्टिर्दक्षिणाङ्गुष्ठबन्धनं /
सव्यस्य तस्य चाङ्गुष्ठो यस्य चोर्ध्वे प्रकीर्तितः(3) //
text_mt: The left fist has the thumb raised; the right thumb is clasped, / and the thumb of the right hand is stated to be upright.

sanskrit_iast:
tisraḥ sādharaṇā vyūhe athāsādharaṇā imāḥ /
kaniṣṭhādivimokena aṣṭo mudrā yathākramaṃ //
meaning:
तिस्रः साधरणा व्यूहे अथासाधरणा इमाः /
कनिष्ठादिविमोकेन अष्टो मुद्रा यथाक्रमं //
text_mt: Three are common to the divine emanations (vyūha); now these are the specific ones: / by releasing [the fingers] starting from the little finger, the eight ritual gestures are formed in order.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭānāṃ pūrvavījānāṃ kramaśastvavadhārayet /
aṅguṣṭhena kaniṣṭāntaṃ namayitvāṅgulitrayaṃ //
meaning:
अष्टानां पूर्ववीजानां क्रमशस्त्ववधारयेत् /
अङ्गुष्ठेन कनिष्टान्तं नमयित्वाङ्गुलित्रयं //
text_mt: One should understand them in the order of the eight preliminary seed-syllables: / having bent the three fingers ending with the little finger with the thumb,

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ kṛtvā sammukhañca vījāya navamāya vai /
vāmahastamathottānaṃ kṛtvārdhaṃ nāmayecchanaiḥ //
:n
1 sarvasiddhyai iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 vairājaṃ nāgasaṃyutamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭḥaḥ / yau
vījaṃ cāṅgasaṃyutamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 yaḥ savyerdhe prakīrtita iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 70
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं कृत्वा सम्मुखञ्च वीजाय नवमाय वै /
वामहस्तमथोत्तानं कृत्वार्धं नामयेच्छनैः //
:न्
1 सर्वसिद्ध्यै इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 वैराजं नागसंयुतमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाट्ःअः / यौ
वीजं चाङ्गसंयुतमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 यः सव्येर्धे प्रकीर्तित इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 70
text_mt:
and holding them upward and facing forward, [that is] indeed for the ninth seed-syllable. / Then, turning the left hand upward, one should slowly bend half of it.
[Footnote mark]
1. The reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa is 'sarvasiddhyai'.
2. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is 'vairājaṃ nāgasaṃyutam'; the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'yauvījaṃ cāṅgasaṃyutam'.
3. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is 'yaḥ savyerdhe prakīrtitaḥ'. / [Page 70]

sanskrit_iast:
varāhasya smṛtā mudrā aṅganāñca kramādimāḥ /
ekaikāṃ mocayedbaddhvā vāmamuṣṭo tathāgulīṃ //
meaning:
वराहस्य स्मृता मुद्रा अङ्गनाञ्च क्रमादिमाः /
एकैकां मोचयेद्बद्ध्वा वाममुष्टो तथागुलीं //
text_mt: This is remembered as the ritual gesture of Varāha, and these are successively [those] of the ancillary [deities]: / having formed a left fist, one should release each single finger in turn.

sanskrit_iast:
ākuñcayet pūrvamudrāṃ dakṣiṇepyevameva ca /
ūrdhvāṅguṣṭho vāmamuṣṭhirmudrāsiddhistato bhavet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye mudrāpradarśanaṃ nāma
ṣaḍviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha saptaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
dīkṣāvidhikathanaṃ
meaning:
आकुञ्चयेत् पूर्वमुद्रां दक्षिणेप्येवमेव च /
ऊर्ध्वाङ्गुष्ठो वाममुष्ठिर्मुद्रासिद्धिस्ततो भवेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये मुद्राप्रदर्शनं नाम
षड्विंशो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ सप्तविंशो ऽध्यायः
दीक्षाविधिकथनं
text_mt:
One should contract the previous gesture, and similarly with the right [hand] as well: / the left fist with the thumb upright—thence comes success with the ritual gestures.
Thus in the glorious Agni Mahāpurāṇa, the twenty-sixth chapter, entitled 'Explanation of Ritual Gestures'.
Now, the twenty-seventh chapter.
Explanation of the Rules of Initiation

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
vakṣye dīkṣāṃ sarvadāñca maṇḍalebje hariṃ yajet /
daśamyāmupasaṃhṛtya yāgadravyaṃ samastakaṃ //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
वक्ष्ये दीक्षां सर्वदाञ्च मण्डलेब्जे हरिं यजेत् /
दशम्यामुपसंहृत्य यागद्रव्यं समस्तकं //
text_mt: Nārada said: / I shall explain initiation, which bestows everything. One should worship Hari in the lotus of the maṇḍala. / Having collected all the ritual sacrificial materials on the tenth lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
vinyasya nārasiṃhena sammantrya śatavārakaṃ /
sarṣapāṃstu phaḍantena(1) rakṣoghnān sarvataḥ kṣipet //
meaning:
विन्यस्य नारसिंहेन सम्मन्त्र्य शतवारकं /
सर्षपांस्तु फडन्तेन(1) रक्षोघ्नान् सर्वतः क्षिपेत् //
text_mt: depositing [them] and consecrating them a hundred times with the Nārasiṃha mantra, / one should scatter mustard seeds that destroy demons in all directions with the mantra ending in phaṭ.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktiṃ sarvātmakāṃ tatra nyaset prāsādarūpiṇīṃ /
sarvauṣadhiṃ samāhṛtya vikirānabhimantrayet //
meaning:
शक्तिं सर्वात्मकां तत्र न्यसेत् प्रासादरूपिणीं /
सर्वौषधिं समाहृत्य विकिरानभिमन्त्रयेत् //
text_mt: There one should deposit the all-pervading energy embodied as the temple. / Having gathered all medicinal herbs, one should consecrate the scattering grains (vikira)

sanskrit_iast:
śatavāraṃ śubhe pātre vāsudevena sādhakaḥ /
saṃsādhya paṇjagavyantu pañcabhirmūlamūrtibhiḥ //
meaning:
शतवारं शुभे पात्रे वासुदेवेन साधकः /
संसाध्य पण्जगव्यन्तु पञ्चभिर्मूलमूर्तिभिः //
text_mt: a hundred times in an auspicious vessel with [the mantra of] Vāsudeva. The practitioner, / having prepared the five products of the cow with the five primary icons,

sanskrit_iast:
nārāyaṇāntaiḥ samprokṣya kuśāgraistena tāṃbhuvaṃ(3)/
vikirānvāsudevena kṣipeduttānapāṇinā //
meaning:
नारायणान्तैः सम्प्रोक्ष्य कुशाग्रैस्तेन तांभुवं(3)/
विकिरान्वासुदेवेन क्षिपेदुत्तानपाणिना //
text_mt: and having sprinkled that ground with the tips of kuśa grass [using the mantras] ending with Nārāyaṇa, / should scatter the grains with [the mantra of] Vāsudeva with the palm turned upward.

sanskrit_iast:
tridhā pūrvamukhastiṣṭhan dhyāyet viṣṇuṃ tathā hṛdi /
vardhanyā sahite kumbhe sāṅgaṃ viṣṇuṃ prapūjayet //
:n
1 sarṣapāṃstadvadastreṇa iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 kuśāgreṇaiva tāṃ bhuvamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭḥaḥ
:p 71
meaning:
त्रिधा पूर्वमुखस्तिष्ठन् ध्यायेत् विष्णुं तथा हृदि /
वर्धन्या सहिते कुम्भे साङ्गं विष्णुं प्रपूजयेत् //
:न्
1 सर्षपांस्तद्वदस्त्रेण इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 कुशाग्रेणैव तां भुवमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाट्ःअः
:प् 71
text_mt:
Standing facing east, he should meditate three times on Viṣṇu in his heart. / In the pitcher accompanied by the vardhanī vessel, he should worship Viṣṇu together with his limbs.
[Footnote mark]
1. The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'sarṣapāṃstadvadastreṇa'.
2. The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'kuśāgreṇaiva tāṃ bhuvam'. / [Page 71]

sanskrit_iast:
śatavāraṃ mantrayitvā tvastreṇaiva ca vardhanīṃ /
acchinnadhārayā siñcan īśānāntaṃ nayecca taṃ //
meaning:
शतवारं मन्त्रयित्वा त्वस्त्रेणैव च वर्धनीं /
अच्छिन्नधारया सिञ्चन् ईशानान्तं नयेच्च तं //
text_mt: Having consecrated the vardhanī vessel a hundred times with the weapon-mantra (astra), / and sprinkling with an unbroken stream, one should carry it as far as the north-east.

sanskrit_iast:
kalasaṃ pṛṣṭhato nītvā sthāpayedvikiropari /
saṃhṛtya vikirān darbhaiḥ kumbheśaṃ karkarīṃ yajet //
meaning:
कलसं पृष्ठतो नीत्वा स्थापयेद्विकिरोपरि /
संहृत्य विकिरान् दर्भैः कुम्भेशं कर्करीं यजेत् //
text_mt: Bringing the pitcher from behind, one should place it upon the scattered grains; / gathering up the grains with darbha grass, one should worship the Lord of the pitcher and the water-jar (karkarī).

sanskrit_iast:
savastraṃ pañcaratnāḍhyaṃ khaṇḍile pūjayeddhariṃ /
agnāvapi samabhyarcya mantrān sañjapya pūrvavat //
meaning:
सवस्त्रं पञ्चरत्नाढ्यं खण्डिले पूजयेद्धरिं /
अग्नावपि समभ्यर्च्य मन्त्रान् सञ्जप्य पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: One should worship Hari clothed in garments and rich in the five gems on an altar; / having worshipped him in the fire as well, and reciting the mantras as before,

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālya puṇḍarīkena vilipyāntaḥ sugandhinā /
ukhāmājyena(1) saṃpūrya gokṣīreṇa tu sādhakaḥ //
meaning:
प्रक्षाल्य पुण्डरीकेन विलिप्यान्तः सुगन्धिना /
उखामाज्येन(1) संपूर्य गोक्षीरेण तु साधकः //
text_mt: cleansing [the vessel] with a lotus and smearing the interior with fragrant substance, / the practitioner, filling the cooking-pot with clarified butter and cow's milk,

sanskrit_iast:
ālokya vāsudevena(2) tataḥ saṅkarṣaṇena ca /
taṇḍulānājyasaṃsṛṣṭān kṣipet kṣīre susaṃskṛte //
meaning:
आलोक्य वासुदेवेन(2) ततः सङ्कर्षणेन च /
तण्डुलानाज्यसंसृष्टान् क्षिपेत् क्षीरे सुसंस्कृते //
text_mt: inspecting [it] with [the mantra of] Vāsudeva and then with Saṅkarṣaṇa, / should throw rice grains mixed with clarified butter into the well-prepared milk.

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnena smāloḍya darvyā saṅghaṭṭayecchanaiḥ /
pakvamuttārayet paścādaniruddhena deśikaḥ //
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नेन स्मालोड्य दर्व्या सङ्घट्टयेच्छनैः /
पक्वमुत्तारयेत् पश्चादनिरुद्धेन देशिकः //
text_mt: Having stirred it with Pradyumna, he should gently blend it with a ladle; / when cooked, the master (deśika) should afterwards take it off [the fire] with Aniruddha.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālyālipya tat kuryādūrdhvapuṇḍraṃ tu bhasmanā /
nārāyaṇena pārśveṣu carumevaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ //
meaning:
प्रक्षाल्यालिप्य तत् कुर्यादूर्ध्वपुण्ड्रं तु भस्मना /
नारायणेन पार्श्वेषु चरुमेवं सुसंस्कृतं //
text_mt: Having washed and anointed it, he should make an upright mark (ūrdhvapuṇḍra) with ashes / on its sides with [the mantra of] Nārāyaṇa; [such is] the well-prepared sacred porridge (caru).

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgamekaṃ tu devāya kalaśāya dvitīyakaṃ /
tṛtīyena tu bhāgena pradadyādāhutitrayaṃ //
meaning:
भागमेकं तु देवाय कलशाय द्वितीयकं /
तृतीयेन तु भागेन प्रदद्यादाहुतित्रयं //
text_mt: [He should offer] one portion to the deity and a second to the pitcher; / with the third portion, he should make three oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyaiḥ saha caturthaṃ tu gururadyādviśuddhaye(3) /
nārāyaṇena sammantrya saptadhā kṣīravṛkṣajam //
meaning:
शिष्यैः सह चतुर्थं तु गुरुरद्याद्विशुद्धये(3) /
नारायणेन सम्मन्त्र्य सप्तधा क्षीरवृक्षजम् //
text_mt: Together with the disciples, the guru should eat the fourth [portion] for purification. / Having consecrated seven times with Nārāyaṇa a tooth-stick

sanskrit_iast:
dantakāṣṭhaṃ bhakṣayitvā tyaktvā jñātvāsvapātakaṃ /
aindrāgnyuttarakeśānīmukhaṃ patitamuttamaṃ //
meaning:
दन्तकाष्ठं भक्षयित्वा त्यक्त्वा ज्ञात्वास्वपातकं /
ऐन्द्राग्न्युत्तरकेशानीमुखं पतितमुत्तमं //
text_mt: produced from a milky tree, chewing it and discarding it, he may discern good or bad fortune: / if it falls facing the east, south-east, north, or north-east, it is excellent;

sanskrit_iast:
śubhaṃ siṃhaśataṃ hutvā(4) ācamyātha praviśya ca /
:n
1 utthāyājyeneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 āloḍya vāsudevena iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 vivṛddhaye iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 śubhaṃ siddhamiti jñātvā ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 72
pūjāgāraṃ nyasenmantrī prācyāṃ viṣṇuṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ //
meaning:
शुभं सिंहशतं हुत्वा(4) आचम्याथ प्रविश्य च /
:न्
1 उत्थायाज्येनेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 आलोड्य वासुदेवेन इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 विवृद्धये इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 शुभं सिद्धमिति ज्ञात्वा ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 72
पूजागारं न्यसेन्मन्त्री प्राच्यां विष्णुं प्रदक्षिणं //
text_mt:
knowing it to be auspicious, having offered a hundred oblations to the Lion [Nṛsiṃha], sipping water, and then entering,
[Footnote mark]
1. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is 'utthāyājyena'.
2. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is 'āloḍya vāsudevena'.
3. The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'vivṛddhaye'.
4. The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'śubhaṃ siddhamiti jñātvā'. / [Page 72]
the mantra-practitioner should deposit Viṣṇu in the east of the worship-chamber, moving clockwise.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsārārṇavamagnānāṃ paśūnāṃ pāśamuktaye /
tvameva śaraṇaṃ deva sadā tvaṃ bhaktavatsala //
meaning:
संसारार्णवमग्नानां पशूनां पाशमुक्तये /
त्वमेव शरणं देव सदा त्वं भक्तवत्सल //
text_mt: "For the liberation from bonds of the bound souls (paśu) sunk in the ocean of worldly existence, / you alone are the refuge, O Lord! You are always compassionate to devotees!

sanskrit_iast:
devadevānujānīhi prākṛtaiḥ pāśabandhanaiḥ /
pāśitānmocayiṣyāmi tvatprasādāt paśūnimān //
meaning:
देवदेवानुजानीहि प्राकृतैः पाशबन्धनैः /
पाशितान्मोचयिष्यामि त्वत्प्रसादात् पशूनिमान् //
text_mt: O God of gods, permit [me]: by your grace, I shall release / these bound souls who are bound by material bonds!"

sanskrit_iast:
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ sampraviśya paśūṃstataḥ /
dhāraṇābhistu saṃśodhya pūrvajjvalanādinā //
meaning:
इति विज्ञाप्य देवेशं सम्प्रविश्य पशूंस्ततः /
धारणाभिस्तु संशोध्य पूर्वज्ज्वलनादिना //
text_mt: Having thus petitioned the Lord of gods, he enters, and then, / purifying the bound souls through meditative retentions (dhāraṇā) starting with fire as before,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskṛtya mūrtyā saṃyojya(1) netre baddhvā pradarśayet /
puṣpapūrṇāñjalīṃstatra kṣipettannāma yojayet //
meaning:
संस्कृत्य मूर्त्या संयोज्य(1) नेत्रे बद्ध्वा प्रदर्शयेत् /
पुष्पपूर्णाञ्जलींस्तत्र क्षिपेत्तन्नाम योजयेत् //
text_mt: consecrating them, joining them with the icon, and blindfolding their eyes, he should present them; / they should cast folded hands full of flowers there, and he should assign their name.

sanskrit_iast:
amantramarcanaṃ tatra pūrvavat kārayet kramāt /
yasyāṃ mūrtau patet puṣpaṃ tasya tannāma nirdiśet //
meaning:
अमन्त्रमर्चनं तत्र पूर्ववत् कारयेत् क्रमात् /
यस्यां मूर्तौ पतेत् पुष्पं तस्य तन्नाम निर्दिशेत् //
text_mt: He should perform the worship there in order without mantras as before; / on whichever icon a flower falls, he should assign its name to him.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāntasammitaṃ sūtraṃ pādāṅguṣṭhādi ṣaḍguṇaṃ /
kanyāsu kartitaṃ raktaṃ(2) punastattriguṇīkṛtam //
meaning:
शिखान्तसम्मितं सूत्रं पादाङ्गुष्ठादि षड्गुणं /
कन्यासु कर्तितं रक्तं(2) पुनस्तत्त्रिगुणीकृतम् //
text_mt: A cord measured from the big toe of the foot to the crest, six-fold, / spun by unmarried maidens, red, and then tripled again—

sanskrit_iast:
yasyāṃ saṃlīyate viśvaṃ yato viśvaṃ prasūyate /
prakṛtiṃ prakriyābhedaiḥ saṃsthitāṃ tatra cintayet //
meaning:
यस्यां संलीयते विश्वं यतो विश्वं प्रसूयते /
प्रकृतिं प्रक्रियाभेदैः संस्थितां तत्र चिन्तयेत् //
text_mt: in which the universe is dissolved, and from which the universe is brought forth, / in that [cord] one should meditate upon Primordial Nature (prakṛti) abiding through the different cosmic processes.

sanskrit_iast:
tena prākṛtikān pāśān grathitvā tattvasaṅkhyayā(3) /
kṛtvā śarāve tat sūtraṃ kuṇḍapārśve nidhāya tu(4) //
meaning:
तेन प्राकृतिकान् पाशान् ग्रथित्वा तत्त्वसङ्ख्यया(3) /
कृत्वा शरावे तत् सूत्रं कुण्डपार्श्वे निधाय तु(4) //
text_mt: Having tied the material bonds with that [cord] according to the number of cosmic principles (tattva), / placing that cord in a shallow dish, and depositing it beside the fire-pit,

sanskrit_iast:
tatastattvāni sarvāṇi dhyātvā śiṣyatanau nyaset /
sṛṣṭikramāt prakṛtyādipṛthivyantāni deśikaḥ //
meaning:
ततस्तत्त्वानि सर्वाणि ध्यात्वा शिष्यतनौ न्यसेत् /
सृष्टिक्रमात् प्रकृत्यादिपृथिव्यन्तानि देशिकः //
text_mt: the master should then meditate upon all the cosmic principles and deposit them in the disciple's body, / according to the order of creation, from Primordial Nature down to earth.

sanskrit_iast:
tatraikadhā paṇcadhā syāddaśadvādaśadhāpi vā(4) /
:n
1 mūrtyā samprokṣya iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 sūtramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 tatra saṅkhyayā iti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
4 nidhīyate iti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
5 tatrārcā pañcadhā yā syādaṅgair dvādaśadhāpi veti kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / tatrātmā pañcadhā vā syāt
daśadvadaśadhāpiveti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 73
jñātavyaḥ sarvabhedena grathitastattvacintakaiḥ //
meaning:
तत्रैकधा पण्चधा स्याद्दशद्वादशधापि वा(4) /
:न्
1 मूर्त्या सम्प्रोक्ष्य इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 सूत्रमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 तत्र सङ्ख्यया इति ख, ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
4 निधीयते इति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
5 तत्रार्चा पञ्चधा या स्यादङ्गैर् द्वादशधापि वेति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / तत्रात्मा पञ्चधा वा स्यात्
दशद्वदशधापिवेति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 73
ज्ञातव्यः सर्वभेदेन ग्रथितस्तत्त्वचिन्तकैः //
text_mt:
There it may be twofold, fivefold, or even tenfold or twelvefold;
[Footnote mark]
1. The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'mūrtyā samprokṣya'.
2. The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'sūtram'.
3. The reading in the three manuscripts marked kha, ga, and gha is 'tatra saṅkhyayā'.
4. The reading in the two manuscripts marked gha and ṅa is 'nidhīyate'.
5. The reading in the manuscript marked kha is 'tatrārcā pañcadhā yā syādaṅgair dvādaśadhāpi vā'; the reading in the two manuscripts marked gha and ṅa is 'tatrātmā pañcadhā vā syāt daśadvadaśadhāpivā'. / [Page 73]
it should be understood by contemplators of the cosmic principles as tied with all varieties.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgaiḥ pañcabhiradhvānaṃ nikhilaṃ vikṛtikramāt /
tanmātrātmani saṃhṛtya māyāsūtre paśostanau(1) //
meaning:
अङ्गैः पञ्चभिरध्वानं निखिलं विकृतिक्रमात् /
तन्मात्रात्मनि संहृत्य मायासूत्रे पशोस्तनौ(1) //
text_mt: Having dissolved the entire path through the five limbs in the reverse order of cosmic transformation / into the subtle elements within the cord of illusion (māyāsūtra) on the body of the bound soul,

sanskrit_iast:
prakṛtirliṅgaśaktiś ca kartā buddhis tathā manaḥ /
pañcatanmātrabuddhyākhyaṃ karmākhyaṃ bhūtapañcakaṃ //
meaning:
प्रकृतिर्लिङ्गशक्तिश् च कर्ता बुद्धिस् तथा मनः /
पञ्चतन्मात्रबुद्ध्याख्यं कर्माख्यं भूतपञ्चकं //
text_mt: Prakṛti, the subtle-body power (liṅgaśakti), the agent, the intellect (buddhi), as well as the mind (manas), / the five subtle elements (tanmātra), the organs of knowledge, the organs of action, and the five gross elements—

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyecca dvādaśātmānaṃ sūtre dehe tathecchayā /
hutvā sampātavidhinā sṛṣṭeḥ sṛṣṭikrameṇa tu //
meaning:
ध्यायेच्च द्वादशात्मानं सूत्रे देहे तथेच्छया /
हुत्वा सम्पातविधिना सृष्टेः सृष्टिक्रमेण तु //
text_mt: one should meditate upon the twelvefold self in the thread and in the body according to one's will. / Then, offering fire oblations according to the rule of drops (saṃpāta), in the order of creation,

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaṃ śatahomena dattvā pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ /
śarāve sampuṭīkṛtya kumbheśāya nivedayet //
meaning:
एकैकं शतहोमेन दत्त्वा पूर्णाहुतिं ततः /
शरावे सम्पुटीकृत्य कुम्भेशाय निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: having offered a hundred fire oblations for each one, and then offering the final full oblation (pūrṇāhuti), / sealing [the thread] inside an earthen bowl, he should present it to the Lord of the Pitcher (kumbheśa).

sanskrit_iast:
adhivāsya yathā nyāyaṃ bhaktaṃ śiṣyaṃ tu dīkṣayet /
karaṇīṃ kartarīṃ vāpi(2) rajāṃsi khaṭikāmapi //
meaning:
अधिवास्य यथा न्यायं भक्तं शिष्यं तु दीक्षयेत् /
करणीं कर्तरीं वापि(2) रजांसि खटिकामपि //
text_mt: Having performed the preliminary consecration according to rule, he should initiate the devoted disciple. / The trowel or scissors, the powders, and the chalk—

sanskrit_iast:
anyadapyupayogi syāt sarvaṃ tadvāyugocare /
saṃsthāpya mūlamantreṇa parāmṛśyādhivādhivāsayet //
meaning:
अन्यदप्युपयोगि स्यात् सर्वं तद्वायुगोचरे /
संस्थाप्य मूलमन्त्रेण परामृश्याधिवाधिवासयेत् //
text_mt: and whatever else is useful—placing all that in the sphere of the wind [in the northwest], / touching them with the root mantra, he should perform the preliminary consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
namo bhūtebhyaś ca baliḥ kuśe śete smaran hariṃ /
maṇḍapaṃ bhūṣayitvātha vitānaghaṭalaḍḍukaiḥ(3) //
meaning:
नमो भूतेभ्यश् च बलिः कुशे शेते स्मरन् हरिं /
मण्डपं भूषयित्वाथ वितानघटलड्डुकैः(3) //
text_mt: With 'Obeisance to the beings,' a bali offering [is made], and he sleeps upon kuśa grass remembering Hari. / Then, having adorned the pavilion with canopies, pitchers, and sweets,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍaletha yajedviṣṇuṃ tataḥ santarpya pāvakaṃ /
āhūya dīkṣayecchiṣyān baddhapadmāsanasthitān //
meaning:
मण्डलेथ यजेद्विष्णुं ततः सन्तर्प्य पावकं /
आहूय दीक्षयेच्छिष्यान् बद्धपद्मासनस्थितान् //
text_mt: he should worship Viṣṇu in the maṇḍala, and then, having satisfied the fire, / he should summon and initiate the disciples who sit bound in the lotus posture.

sanskrit_iast:
sammokṣya viṣṇuṃ hastena mūrdhānaṃ spṛśya vai kramāt /
prakṛtyādivikṛtyantāṃ sādhibhūtādhidaivatāṃ //
meaning:
सम्मोक्ष्य विष्णुं हस्तेन मूर्धानं स्पृश्य वै क्रमात् /
प्रकृत्यादिविकृत्यन्तां साधिभूताधिदैवतां //
text_mt: Having sprinkled [them] with water for Viṣṇu and touched their heads with his hand in order, / [he contemplates] the creation beginning with prakṛti and ending with its transformations, along with the elements and deities,

sanskrit_iast:
sṛṣṭimādhyātmikīṃ kṛtvā hṛdi tāṃ saṃharet kramāt /
tanmātrabhūtāṃ sakalāṃ jīvena samatāṃ gatāṃ //
meaning:
सृष्टिमाध्यात्मिकीं कृत्वा हृदि तां संहरेत् क्रमात् /
तन्मात्रभूतां सकलां जीवेन समतां गतां //
text_mt: having made it interior (ādhyātmikī), he should dissolve it in order within the heart, / reduced to subtle elements and having attained identity with the individual soul (jīva).

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samprārthya kambheśaṃ sūtraṃ saṃhṛtya deśikaḥ /
:n
1 māyāsūtre suśobhane iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 karālaṃ kartarīñcāpi iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 vitānabhavagandhakair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
vitānapaṭakendriyair iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 74
agneḥ samīpamāgatya pārśve taṃ sanniveśya tu //
meaning:
ततः सम्प्रार्थ्य कम्भेशं सूत्रं संहृत्य देशिकः /
:न्
1 मायासूत्रे सुशोभने इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 करालं कर्तरीञ्चापि इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 वितानभवगन्धकैर् इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
वितानपटकेन्द्रियैर् इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 74
अग्नेः समीपमागत्य पार्श्वे तं सन्निवेश्य तु //
text_mt:
Then, praying to the Lord of the Pitcher, the preceptor gathers up the thread.
[Footnote]
1. 'In the very beautiful māyā-thread' is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. 'The spade and the scissors' is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga.
3. 'With canopies, clothes, and fragrances' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / 'With canopies, banners, and flags' is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha. / [p. 74]
Coming near to the fire and seating him at its side,

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamantreṇa sṛṣṭīśamāhutīnāṃ śatena taṃ /
udāsīnamathāsādya pūrṇāhutyā ca deśikaḥ //
meaning:
मूलमन्त्रेण सृष्टीशमाहुतीनां शतेन तं /
उदासीनमथासाद्य पूर्णाहुत्या च देशिकः //
text_mt: the preceptor, [worshipping] the Lord of Creation with the root mantra through a hundred oblations, / then approaching him who is detached, with the final full oblation,

sanskrit_iast:
śuklaṃ rajaḥ samādāya mūlena śatamantritaṃ /
santāḍya hṛdayantena huṃphaṭkārāntasaṃyutaiḥ //
meaning:
शुक्लं रजः समादाय मूलेन शतमन्त्रितं /
सन्ताड्य हृदयन्तेन हुंफट्कारान्तसंयुतैः //
text_mt: taking white powder consecrated one hundred times with the root mantra, / striking [the disciple] with [the mantra ending in] hṛdaya, joined with huṃ and phaṭ at the end,

sanskrit_iast:
viyogapadasaṃyuktair vījaiḥ padādibhiḥ kramāt /
pṛthivyādīni tattvāni viśliṣya juhuyāttataḥ //
meaning:
वियोगपदसंयुक्तैर् वीजैः पदादिभिः क्रमात् /
पृथिव्यादीनि तत्त्वानि विश्लिष्य जुहुयात्ततः //
text_mt: with seed-syllables joined to words of severance, beginning with the words in order, / having dissociated the cosmic principles beginning with earth, he should then offer fire oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
vahnāvakhilatattvānāmālaye vyāhṛte harau /
nīyamānaṃ kramātsarvaṃ tatrādhvānaṃ smaredbudhaḥ //
meaning:
वह्नावखिलतत्त्वानामालये व्याहृते हरौ /
नीयमानं क्रमात्सर्वं तत्राध्वानं स्मरेद्बुधः //
text_mt: In the fire, the abode of all cosmic principles, when Hari is uttered, / the wise man should contemplate the entire path being led into it in order.

sanskrit_iast:
tāḍanena viyojyaivaṃ(1) ādāyāpādya śāmyatāṃ /
prakṛtyāhṛtya juhuyādyathokte jātavedasi //
meaning:
ताडनेन वियोज्यैवं(1) आदायापाद्य शाम्यतां /
प्रकृत्याहृत्य जुहुयाद्यथोक्ते जातवेदसि //
text_mt: Severing thus by striking, taking it, and bringing it to pacification, / drawing it into prakṛti, he should offer it into the fire as prescribed.

sanskrit_iast: garbhādhānaṃ jātakarma bhogañcaiva layantathā /
meaning: गर्भाधानं जातकर्म भोगञ्चैव लयन्तथा /
text_mt: Conception, the birth-rite, experience, and likewise dissolution:

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhaṃ tattvaṃ samuddhṛtya pūrṇāhutyā tu deśikaḥ /
sannayeddvipare tattve yāvadavyāhṛtaṃ kramāt //
meaning:
शुद्धं तत्त्वं समुद्धृत्य पूर्णाहुत्या तु देशिकः /
सन्नयेद्द्विपरे तत्त्वे यावदव्याहृतं क्रमात् //
text_mt: raising up the purified cosmic principle, the preceptor, by means of the final full oblation, / should lead it into the higher cosmic principle in order, up to the unmanifest.

sanskrit_iast:
tat paraṃ jñānayogena vilāpya paramātmani /
vimuktabandhanaṃ jīvaṃ parasminnavyaye pade //
meaning:
तत् परं ज्ञानयोगेन विलाप्य परमात्मनि /
विमुक्तबन्धनं जीवं परस्मिन्नव्यये पदे //
text_mt: Having dissolved that highest principle into the supreme self through the yoga of knowledge, / the wise man should contemplate the soul, freed from bonds, in the supreme imperishable state,

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttaṃ paramānande śuddhe buddhe smaredbudhaḥ /
dadyāt pūrṇāhutiṃ paścādevaṃ dīkṣā samāpyate //
meaning:
निवृत्तं परमानन्दे शुद्धे बुद्धे स्मरेद्बुधः /
दद्यात् पूर्णाहुतिं पश्चादेवं दीक्षा समाप्यते //
text_mt: withdrawn into supreme bliss, pure, and enlightened. / He should then give the final full oblation; thus the initiation is completed.

sanskrit_iast:
prayogamantrān vakṣyāmi yair dīkṣā homasaṃlayaḥ /
oṃ yaṃ bhūtāni viśuddhaṃ huṃ phaṭ
anena tāḍanaṃ kuryādviyojanamiha dvayaṃ //
meaning:
प्रयोगमन्त्रान् वक्ष्यामि यैर् दीक्षा होमसंलयः /
ओं यं भूतानि विशुद्धं हुं फट्
अनेन ताडनं कुर्याद्वियोजनमिह द्वयं //
text_mt:
I shall state the practical mantras through which initiation and dissolution in the fire [occur]:
Oṃ yaṃ bhūtāni viśuddhaṃ huṃ phaṭ.
With this he should perform both the striking and the severance here.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ yaṃ bhūtānyāpātayehaṃ
ādānaṃ kṛtvā cānena prakṛtyā yojanaṃ śṛṇu /
:n
1 tāḍanena vimokṣyaivamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 75
oṃ yaṃ bhūtāni puṃścāho
homamantraṃ pravakṣyāmi tataḥ pūrṇāhutermanuṃ //
oṃ bhūtāni saṃhara svāhā / oṃ aṃ oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya
vauṣaṭ
meaning:
ओं यं भूतान्यापातयेहं
आदानं कृत्वा चानेन प्रकृत्या योजनं शृणु /
:न्
1 ताडनेन विमोक्ष्यैवमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 75
ओं यं भूतानि पुंश्चाहो
होममन्त्रं प्रवक्ष्यामि ततः पूर्णाहुतेर्मनुं //
ओं भूतानि संहर स्वाहा / ओं अं ओं नमो भगवते वासुदेवाय
वौषट्
text_mt:
'Oṃ yaṃ bhūtāny āpātaye 'ham'— / having performed the taking with this, hear the union with prakṛti:
[Footnote]
1. 'Thus releasing by striking' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [p. 75]
Oṃ yaṃ bhūtāni puṃścāho. / I shall state the mantra of the oblation, and then the mantra of the final full oblation:
Oṃ bhūtāni saṃhara svāhā. / Oṃ aṃ oṃ namo bhagavate vāsudevāya vauṣaṭ.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāhutyanantare tu tadvai śiṣyantu sādhayet(1) /
evaṃ tattvāni sarvāṇi kramātsaṃśodhayed budhaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्णाहुत्यनन्तरे तु तद्वै शिष्यन्तु साधयेत्(1) /
एवं तत्त्वानि सर्वाणि क्रमात्संशोधयेद् बुधः //
text_mt: Immediately after the final full oblation, he should bring the disciple into that [higher principle]. / In this way the wise man should purify all cosmic principles in order,

sanskrit_iast:
namontena svavījena tāḍanādipuraḥsaram /
oṃ vāṃ varmendriyāṇi / oṃ deṃ buddhīndriyāṇi
yaṃ vījena samānantu tāḍanādiprayogakam //
meaning:
नमोन्तेन स्ववीजेन ताडनादिपुरःसरम् /
ओं वां वर्मेन्द्रियाणि / ओं दें बुद्धीन्द्रियाणि
यं वीजेन समानन्तु ताडनादिप्रयोगकम् //
text_mt:
beginning with striking and so forth, with each one's own seed-syllable ending in namaḥ.
Oṃ vāṃ karmendriyāṇi; Oṃ deṃ buddhīndriyāṇi.
The application of striking and so forth is similar, with the seed-syllable yaṃ:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ suṃgandhatanmātre viyuṅkṣva huṃ phaṭ / oṃ sampāhiṃ
hā(2) // oṃ khaṃ khaṃ kṣa prakṛtyā(3) / oṃ suṃ huṃ
gandhatanmātre saṃhara svāhā
tataḥ pūrṇāhutiś caivamuttareṣu prayujyate /
oṃ rāṃ rasatanmātre / oṃ bheṃ rūpatanmātre / oṃ raṃ
sparśatanmātre / oṃ eṃ śabdatanmātre / oṃ bhaṃ namaḥ / oṃ
soṃ ahaṅkāraḥ / oṃ naṃ buddhe / oṃ oṃ prakṛte
ekamūrtāvayaṃ prokto dīkṣāyogaḥ samāsataḥ /
evameva prayogastu navavyūhādike smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ओं सुंगन्धतन्मात्रे वियुङ्क्ष्व हुं फट् / ओं सम्पाहिं
हा(2) // ओं खं खं क्ष प्रकृत्या(3) / ओं सुं हुं
गन्धतन्मात्रे संहर स्वाहा
ततः पूर्णाहुतिश् चैवमुत्तरेषु प्रयुज्यते /
ओं रां रसतन्मात्रे / ओं भें रूपतन्मात्रे / ओं रं
स्पर्शतन्मात्रे / ओं एं शब्दतन्मात्रे / ओं भं नमः / ओं
सों अहङ्कारः / ओं नं बुद्धे / ओं ओं प्रकृते
एकमूर्तावयं प्रोक्तो दीक्षायोगः समासतः /
एवमेव प्रयोगस्तु नवव्यूहादिके स्मृतः //
text_mt:
Oṃ suṃ gandhatanmātre viyuṅkṣva huṃ phaṭ. Oṃ saṃ pāhi hā. Oṃ khaṃ khaṃ kṣa prakṛtyā. Oṃ suṃ huṃ gandhatanmātre saṃhara svāhā. / Then the final full oblation is applied in this manner to the subsequent ones:
Oṃ rāṃ rasatanmātre; Oṃ bheṃ rūpatanmātre; Oṃ raṃ sparśatanmātre; Oṃ eṃ śabdatanmātre; Oṃ bhaṃ namaḥ; Oṃ soṃ ahaṅkāraḥ; Oṃ naṃ buddhe; Oṃ oṃ prakṛte.
This practice of initiation is declared briefly in the case of a single icon;
in this very manner is the practice taught for the ninefold manifestation (navavyūha) and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhāparasmin sandadhyānnirvāṇe prakṛtinnaraḥ /
avikāre samādadhyādīśvare prakṛtinnaraḥ //
meaning:
दग्धापरस्मिन् सन्दध्यान्निर्वाणे प्रकृतिन्नरः /
अविकारे समादध्यादीश्वरे प्रकृतिन्नरः //
text_mt: Having burned it, a man should join prakṛti to the supreme in liberating initiation (nirvāṇa); / a man should establish prakṛti in the changeless Lord (īśvara).

sanskrit_iast:
śodhayitvātha bhutāni karmāṅgāni(4) viśodhayet /
buddhyākhyānyatha tanmātramanojñānamahaṅkṛtiṃ //
meaning:
शोधयित्वाथ भुतानि कर्माङ्गानि(4) विशोधयेत् /
बुद्ध्याख्यान्यथ तन्मात्रमनोज्ञानमहङ्कृतिं //
text_mt: Having purified the gross elements, he should then purify the organs of action, / then the organs of knowledge, the subtle elements, the mind, intellect, ego,

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgātmānaṃ viśodhyānte prakṛtiṃ śodhāyet punaḥ /
:n
1 tadvai śiṣyantusannayediti kha, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ suṃ āyāhi hāmiti kha,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ oṃ saṃ pāhi
svāhā iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 aṃ duṃ stva prakṛtyā iti oṃ khaṃ khaṃ stva prakṛtyā iti ca kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 karmākhyāni ca śodhayediti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 76
puruṣaṃ prākṛtaṃ śuddhamīśvare dhāmni saṃsthitaṃ //
meaning:
लिङ्गात्मानं विशोध्यान्ते प्रकृतिं शोधायेत् पुनः /
:न्
1 तद्वै शिष्यन्तुसन्नयेदिति ख, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
2 ओं सुं आयाहि हामिति ख,चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः ओं सं पाहि
स्वाहा इति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 अं दुं स्त्व प्रकृत्या इति ओं खं खं स्त्व प्रकृत्या इति च ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 कर्माख्यानि च शोधयेदिति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 76
पुरुषं प्राकृतं शुद्धमीश्वरे धाम्नि संस्थितं //
text_mt:
and having purified the nature of the subtle body, he should at the end purify prakṛti again.
[Footnote]
1. 'He should truly lead the disciple into that' is the reading in the three manuscripts marked kha, gha, and ṅa.
2. 'Oṃ suṃ āyāhi hām' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; 'Oṃ saṃ pāhi svāhā' is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and ṅa.
3. 'Aṃ duṃ stva prakṛtyā' and 'Oṃ khaṃ khaṃ stva prakṛtyā' is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. 'And he should purify the organs of action' is the reading in the two manuscripts marked gha and ṅa. / [p. 76]
The spiritual person (puruṣa) freed from nature (prākṛta), purified, established in the abode of the Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
svagocarīkṛtāśeṣabhogamuktau kṛtāspadaṃ /
dhyāyan pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāddīkṣeyaṃ tvadhikāriṇī //
meaning:
स्वगोचरीकृताशेषभोगमुक्तौ कृतास्पदं /
ध्यायन् पूर्णाहुतिं दद्याद्दीक्षेयं त्वधिकारिणी //
text_mt: who has made the entire field of experience his own and established himself in liberation— / contemplating him, he should offer the final full oblation. This is the qualifying initiation (adhikāriṇī dīkṣā).

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgair ārādhya mantrasya nītvā tattvagaṇaṃ samaṃ /
kramādevaṃ viśodhyānte sarvasiddhisamanvitaṃ //
meaning:
अङ्गैर् आराध्य मन्त्रस्य नीत्वा तत्त्वगणं समं /
क्रमादेवं विशोध्यान्ते सर्वसिद्धिसमन्वितं //
text_mt: Having worshipped with the limbs of the mantra, bringing the group of cosmic principles into equilibrium, / purifying them in order thus at the end, endowed with all supernatural attainments (siddhi),

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāyan pūrṇāhitiṃ dadyātdīkṣeyaṃ sādhake smṛtā /
dravyasya vā na sampattiraśaktirvātmano yadi //
meaning:
ध्यायन् पूर्णाहितिं दद्यात्दीक्षेयं साधके स्मृता /
द्रव्यस्य वा न सम्पत्तिरशक्तिर्वात्मनो यदि //
text_mt: contemplating, he should offer the final full oblation. This initiation is taught for the practitioner (sādhaka). / If there is lack of wealth or incapacity of oneself,

sanskrit_iast:
iṣṭvā devaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ sarvopakaraṇānvitaṃ /
sadyodhivāsya dvādaśyāṃ dīkṣayeddeśikottamaḥ //
meaning:
इष्ट्वा देवं यथा पूर्वं सर्वोपकरणान्वितं /
सद्योधिवास्य द्वादश्यां दीक्षयेद्देशिकोत्तमः //
text_mt: having worshipped the deity as before with all the ritual implements, / performing the preliminary consecration immediately, the excellent preceptor should initiate on the twelfth lunar day (dvādaśī).

sanskrit_iast:
bhakto vinītaḥ śārīrair guṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ /
śiṣyo nātidhanī yastu sthaṇḍilebhyarcya dīkṣayet //
meaning:
भक्तो विनीतः शारीरैर् गुणैः सर्वैः समन्वितः /
शिष्यो नातिधनी यस्तु स्थण्डिलेभ्यर्च्य दीक्षयेत् //
text_mt: A disciple who is devoted, humble, endowed with all physical virtues, / but not very wealthy, he should initiate after worshipping upon a bare sacrificial ground (sthaṇḍila).

sanskrit_iast:
adhvānaṃ nikhilaṃ daivaṃ(2) bhautaṃ vādhyātmikī kṛtaṃ /
sṛṣṭikrameṇa śiṣyasya dehe dhyātvā tu deśikaḥ //
meaning:
अध्वानं निखिलं दैवं(2) भौतं वाध्यात्मिकी कृतं /
सृष्टिक्रमेण शिष्यस्य देहे ध्यात्वा तु देशिकः //
text_mt: The entire cosmic path—divine, elemental, or made internal— / meditating upon it in the order of creation within the disciple's body, the preceptor,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāṣṭāhutibhiḥ pūrvaṃ kramāt santarpya sṛṣṭimān /
svamantrair vāsudevādīn jananādīn visarjayet(2) //
meaning:
अष्टाष्टाहुतिभिः पूर्वं क्रमात् सन्तर्प्य सृष्टिमान् /
स्वमन्त्रैर् वासुदेवादीन् जननादीन् विसर्जयेत्(2) //
text_mt: having first propitiated with eight oblations each in order, observing the order of creation, / should dismiss Vāsudeva and the others, birth and the other [rites], with their own mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
homena śodhayet paścātsaṃhārakramayogataḥ /
yonisūtrāṇi baddhāni muktvā karmāṇi deśikaḥ //
meaning:
होमेन शोधयेत् पश्चात्संहारक्रमयोगतः /
योनिसूत्राणि बद्धानि मुक्त्वा कर्माणि देशिकः //
text_mt: He should afterwards purify through fire oblations by applying the order of dissolution; / having released the tied threads of origin and the karmas, the preceptor

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyadehātsamāhṛtya kramāttattvāni śodhayet /
agnau prākṛtike viṣṇau layaṃ nītvādhidaivake //
meaning:
शिष्यदेहात्समाहृत्य क्रमात्तत्त्वानि शोधयेत् /
अग्नौ प्राकृतिके विष्णौ लयं नीत्वाधिदैवके //
text_mt: Withdrawing the principles from the disciple's body, he should purify them in sequence, / having dissolved them into the fire belonging to Prakṛti, [and] into Viṣṇu, the presiding deity.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhaṃ tattvamaśuddhena pūrṇāhutyā tu sādhayet(3) /
śiṣye prakṛtimāpanne dagdhvā prākṛtikān guṇān //
:n
1 likhitaṃ daivamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 pūjāṃ kṛtvā visarjayediti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ vimalādīn
visarjayediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 pūrṇāhutyā tu sannayediti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 77
meaning:
शुद्धं तत्त्वमशुद्धेन पूर्णाहुत्या तु साधयेत्(3) /
शिष्ये प्रकृतिमापन्ने दग्ध्वा प्राकृतिकान् गुणान् //
:न्
1 लिखितं दैवमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 पूजां कृत्वा विसर्जयेदिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः विमलादीन्
विसर्जयेदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 पूर्णाहुत्या तु सन्नयेदिति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 77
text_mt:
With a full offering, he should effect the pure principle by means of the impure, / and once the disciple has attained the state of Prakṛti, having burnt away the qualities belonging to Prakṛti,
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: The manuscript marked kha reads 'likhitaṃ daivam'.]
[Footnote 2: The manuscript marked gha reads 'pūjāṃ kṛtvā visarjayet'; the manuscript marked ṅa reads 'vimalādīn visarjayet'.]
[Footnote 3: The two manuscripts marked kha and gha read 'pūrṇāhutyā tu sannayet'. / p. 77]

sanskrit_iast:
maucayedadhikāre vā niyuñjyāddeśikaḥ śiśūn(1) /
athānyān śaktidīkṣāṃ vā kuryāt bhāve sthito guruḥ //
meaning:
मौचयेदधिकारे वा नियुञ्ज्याद्देशिकः शिशून्(1) /
अथान्यान् शक्तिदीक्षां वा कुर्यात् भावे स्थितो गुरुः //
text_mt: the master should release or assign the youngsters to their qualification; / or, established in devotional contemplation, the guru may perform the initiation of power for others.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā samprātipannānāṃ yatīnāṃ nirdhanasya ca /
sampūjya sthaṇḍile viṣṇuṃ pārśvasthaṃ sthāpya putrakaṃ //
meaning:
भक्त्या सम्प्रातिपन्नानां यतीनां निर्धनस्य च /
सम्पूज्य स्थण्डिले विष्णुं पार्श्वस्थं स्थाप्य पुत्रकं //
text_mt: For those who have surrendered out of devotion, for ascetics, and for a poor man, / having worshipped Viṣṇu on an earthen altar, placing the spiritual son beside him,

sanskrit_iast:
devatābhimukhaḥ śiṣyastiryagāsyaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ /
adhvānaṃ nikhilaṃ dhyātvā parvabhiḥ svair vikalpitaṃ //
meaning:
देवताभिमुखः शिष्यस्तिर्यगास्यः स्वयं स्थितः /
अध्वानं निखिलं ध्यात्वा पर्वभिः स्वैर् विकल्पितं //
text_mt: the disciple facing the deity, while he himself sits turned sideways, / having meditated upon the entire path divided according to its sections,

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyadehe tathā devamādhidaivikayācanaṃ /
dhyānayogena sañcintya pūrvavattāḍanādinā //
meaning:
शिष्यदेहे तथा देवमाधिदैविकयाचनं /
ध्यानयोगेन सञ्चिन्त्य पूर्ववत्ताडनादिना //
text_mt: and contemplating through meditative union the deity in the disciple's body, the petition to the presiding deity, / as before, by means of striking and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
kramāttattvāni sarvāṇi śodhayet sthaṇḍile harau /
tāḍanena viyojyātha gṛhītvātmani tatparaḥ(2) //
meaning:
क्रमात्तत्त्वानि सर्वाणि शोधयेत् स्थण्डिले हरौ /
ताडनेन वियोज्याथ गृहीत्वात्मनि तत्परः(2) //
text_mt: he should purify all the principles in order upon Hari on the earthen altar. / Having detached [a principle] by striking, and having taken it into himself, intent on that,

sanskrit_iast:
deve saṃyojya saṃśodhya gṛhītvā tat svabhāvataḥ /
ānīya śuddhabhāvena sandhayitvā krameṇa tu //
meaning:
देवे संयोज्य संशोध्य गृहीत्वा तत् स्वभावतः /
आनीय शुद्धभावेन सन्धयित्वा क्रमेण तु //
text_mt: uniting it with the deity, purifying it, taking it back naturally, / bringing it in a pure state, and joining it in sequence,

sanskrit_iast:
śodhayeddhyānayogena sarvato jñānamudrayā /
śuddheṣu sarvatattveṣu pradhāne ceśvare sthite //
meaning:
शोधयेद्ध्यानयोगेन सर्वतो ज्ञानमुद्रया /
शुद्धेषु सर्वतत्त्वेषु प्रधाने चेश्वरे स्थिते //
text_mt: he should purify [it] completely through meditative union with the gesture of wisdom. / When all principles are purified, and Pradhāna rests in the Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhvā nirvāpayecchiṣyān pade caiśe niyojayet /
ninayet siddhimārge vā sādhakaṃ deśikottamaḥ //
meaning:
दग्ध्वा निर्वापयेच्छिष्यान् पदे चैशे नियोजयेत् /
निनयेत् सिद्धिमार्गे वा साधकं देशिकोत्तमः //
text_mt: having burnt [the bonds], he should liberate the disciples and establish [them] in the state of the Lord; / or the excellent master should lead the practitioner onto the path of spiritual attainments.

sanskrit_iast:
evamevādhikārastho gṛhī karmaṇyatandritaḥ /
ātmānaṃ śodhayaṃstiṣṭhed yāvadrāgakṣayo bhavet //
meaning:
एवमेवाधिकारस्थो गृही कर्मण्यतन्द्रितः /
आत्मानं शोधयंस्तिष्ठेद् यावद्रागक्षयो भवेत् //
text_mt: Thus established in his qualification, unwearied in rites, a householder / should remain purifying himself until his attachment is destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣīṇarāgamathātmānaṃ jñātvā saṃśuddhikilviṣaḥ /
āropya putre śiṣye vā hy adhikārantu saṃyamī //
meaning:
क्षीणरागमथात्मानं ज्ञात्वा संशुद्धिकिल्विषः /
आरोप्य पुत्रे शिष्ये वा ह्य् अधिकारन्तु संयमी //
text_mt: Knowing himself to be free of attachment, with his sins thoroughly purified, / having transferred his authority onto his son or disciple, the self-controlled man,

sanskrit_iast:
dagdhvā māyāmayaṃ pāśaṃ pravrajya svātmani sthitaḥ /
śarīrapātamākāṅkṣannāsītāvyaktaliṅgavān //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye sarvadīkṣākathanaṃ nāma
saptaviṃśodhyāyaḥ
:n
1 paśūniti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 tat punariti kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakacatuṣṭayapāṭhaḥ
:p 78
:ś atha aṣṭāviṃśodhyāyaḥ
abhiṣekavidhānaṃ
meaning:
दग्ध्वा मायामयं पाशं प्रव्रज्य स्वात्मनि स्थितः /
शरीरपातमाकाङ्क्षन्नासीताव्यक्तलिङ्गवान् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये सर्वदीक्षाकथनं नाम
सप्तविंशोध्यायः
:न्
1 पशूनिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 तत् पुनरिति ख, ग, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकचतुष्टयपाठः
:प् 78
:श् अथ अष्टाविंशोध्यायः
अभिषेकविधानं
text_mt:
having burnt the snare made of Māyā, having renounced, remaining in himself, / awaiting the fall of his body, should abide without outward sectarian marks.
Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, entitled 'The Explanation of All Initiations', in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: The manuscript marked gha reads 'paśūn'.]
[Footnote 2: The four manuscripts marked kha, ga, gha, and ṅa read 'tat punar'. / p. 78]
Now the twenty-eighth chapter.
The Procedure for Consecration by Aspersion

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
abhiṣekaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathācāryastu putrakaḥ /
siddhibhāk sādhako yena rogī rogādvimucyate //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
अभिषेकं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथाचार्यस्तु पुत्रकः /
सिद्धिभाक् साधको येन रोगी रोगाद्विमुच्यते //
text_mt: Nārada said: / I shall explain the consecration by aspersion whereby the spiritual son becomes an ācārya, / the practitioner enjoys spiritual attainment, and the diseased man is freed from illness.

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ rājā sutaṃ strīñca prāpnuyānmalanāśanaṃ /
mūrtikumbhān suratnāḍhyānmadhyapūrvādito nyaset //
meaning:
राज्यं राजा सुतं स्त्रीञ्च प्राप्नुयान्मलनाशनं /
मूर्तिकुम्भान् सुरत्नाढ्यान्मध्यपूर्वादितो न्यसेत् //
text_mt: A king obtains a kingdom, a woman a son; and it destroys impurities. / One should place the pitchers representing the deities, rich in fine jewels, beginning from the center and the east.

sanskrit_iast:
sahasrāvartitān kuryādathavā śatavartitān /
maṇḍape maṇḍale viṣṇuṃ prācyaiśānyāñca pīṭhike //
meaning:
सहस्रावर्तितान् कुर्यादथवा शतवर्तितान् /
मण्डपे मण्डले विष्णुं प्राच्यैशान्याञ्च पीठिके //
text_mt: He should recite over them a thousand times or a hundred times. / In a pavilion, upon a maṇḍala, [having established] Viṣṇu on the pedestal in the east and northeast,

sanskrit_iast:
niveśya śakalīkṛtya putrakaṃ sādhakādikaṃ /
abhiṣekaṃ samabhyarcya kuryādgītādipūrvakaṃ //
meaning:
निवेश्य शकलीकृत्य पुत्रकं साधकादिकं /
अभिषेकं समभ्यर्च्य कुर्याद्गीतादिपूर्वकं //
text_mt: having seated the spiritual son, the practitioner, and others, and having performed the division of the body, / having worshipped, he should perform the consecration by aspersion, preceded by singing and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyācca yogapīṭhādīṃstvanugrāhyāstvayā narāḥ /
guruś ca samayān brūyādguptaḥ śiṣyotha sarvabhāk //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye ācāryābhiṣeko nāma
aṣṭāviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha ūnatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
sarvatobhadramaṇḍalakathanaṃ
meaning:
दद्याच्च योगपीठादींस्त्वनुग्राह्यास्त्वया नराः /
गुरुश् च समयान् ब्रूयाद्गुप्तः शिष्योथ सर्वभाक् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये आचार्याभिषेको नाम
अष्टाविंशो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ ऊनत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
सर्वतोभद्रमण्डलकथनं
text_mt:
And he should give the throne of yoga and other [insignia], saying, 'People must be favored by you.' / And the guru should declare the pledges; then the disciple, protected, attains all.
Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, entitled 'Consecration of the Ācārya by Aspersion', in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now the twenty-ninth chapter.
The Explanation of the Sarvatobhadra Maṇḍala

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
sādhakaḥ sādhayenmantraṃ devatāyatanādike /
śuddhabhūmau gṛhe prārcya maṇḍale harimīśvaraṃ //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
साधकः साधयेन्मन्त्रं देवतायतनादिके /
शुद्धभूमौ गृहे प्रार्च्य मण्डले हरिमीश्वरं //
text_mt: Nārada said: / The practitioner should master the mantra in an abode of the deity or similar place, / on pure ground, or in a house, having first worshipped Hari, the Supreme Lord, in a maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
caturastrīkṛte kṣetre maṇḍalādīni vai likhet /
rasavāṇākṣikoṣṭheṣu sarvatobhadramālikhet //
meaning:
चतुरस्त्रीकृते क्षेत्रे मण्डलादीनि वै लिखेत् /
रसवाणाक्षिकोष्ठेषु सर्वतोभद्रमालिखेत् //
text_mt: In a field made square, he should draw maṇḍalas and the like. / In two hundred and fifty-six compartments, he should draw the Sarvatobhadra [maṇḍala].

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭtriṃśatkoṣṭhakaiḥ padmaṃ pīṭhaṃ paṅktyāvahirbhavet /
dvābhyāntu vīthikā tasmād dvābhyāṃ dvārāṇi dikṣu ca //
:p 79
meaning:
षट्त्रिंशत्कोष्ठकैः पद्मं पीठं पङ्क्त्यावहिर्भवेत् /
द्वाभ्यान्तु वीथिका तस्माद् द्वाभ्यां द्वाराणि दिक्षु च //
:प् 79
text_mt:
The lotus consists of thirty-six compartments; outside it, in a row, is the seat; / next is a pathway of two [rows], and in the cardinal directions are doors measuring two [compartments].
p. 79

sanskrit_iast:
vartulaṃ bhrāmayitvā tu padmakṣetraṃ puroditam /
padmārdhe bhāmayitvā tu bhāgaṃ dvādaśamaṃ vahiḥ //
meaning:
वर्तुलं भ्रामयित्वा तु पद्मक्षेत्रं पुरोदितम् /
पद्मार्धे भामयित्वा तु भागं द्वादशमं वहिः //
text_mt: Having inscribed a circle within the lotus-field previously mentioned, / having rotated it at half of the lotus, [and] leaving the twelfth part outside,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhajya bhrāmayeccheṣaṃ catuḥkṣetrantu vartulaṃ /
prathamaṃ karṇikākṣetraṃ keśarāṇāṃ dvitīyakam //
meaning:
विभज्य भ्रामयेच्छेषं चतुःक्षेत्रन्तु वर्तुलं /
प्रथमं कर्णिकाक्षेत्रं केशराणां द्वितीयकम् //
text_mt: dividing it, he should draw the remaining circular field of four zones. / The first is the field of the pericarp; the second is that of the filaments;

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaṃ dalasandhīnāṃ dalāgrāṇāṃ caturthakam /
prasārya koṇasūtrāṇi koṇadiṅmadhyamantataḥ //
meaning:
तृतीयं दलसन्धीनां दलाग्राणां चतुर्थकम् /
प्रसार्य कोणसूत्राणि कोणदिङ्मध्यमन्ततः //
text_mt: the third is that of the petal joints; the fourth is that of the petal tips. / Stretching the corner cords, and having placed the ends / at the midpoint between the corners and directions on the tips of the filaments, he should mark the petal joints. / Then, having dropped the cords, he should draw the eight petals there.

sanskrit_iast:
nidhāya keśarāgre tu dalasandhīṃstu lāñchayet /
pātayitvātha sūtrāṇi tatra patrāṣṭakaṃ likhet //
meaning:
निधाय केशराग्रे तु दलसन्धींस्तु लाञ्छयेत् /
पातयित्वाथ सूत्राणि तत्र पत्राष्टकं लिखेत् //
text_mt: Then, having dropped the cords, he should draw the eight petals there.

sanskrit_iast:
dalasandhyantarālantu mānaṃ madhye nidhāya tu /
dalāgraṃ bhrāmayettena tadagraṃ tadanantaraṃ //
meaning:
दलसन्ध्यन्तरालन्तु मानं मध्ये निधाय तु /
दलाग्रं भ्रामयेत्तेन तदग्रं तदनन्तरं //
text_mt: Placing the measure of the interval between the petal joints in the center, / he should rotate the tip of the petal with it, and immediately thereafter its apex.

sanskrit_iast:
tadantarālaṃ tatpārśve kṛtvā vāhyakrameṇa ca /
keśare tu likheddvau dvau dalamadhye tataḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
तदन्तरालं तत्पार्श्वे कृत्वा वाह्यक्रमेण च /
केशरे तु लिखेद्द्वौ द्वौ दलमध्ये ततः पुनः //
text_mt: Placing that interval on its sides, and in an outward order, / he should draw two filaments each in the middle of each petal.

sanskrit_iast:
padmalakṣmaitat sāmānyaṃ dviṣaṭkadalamucyate /
karṇikārdhena mānena prāksaṃsthaṃ bhrāmayet kramāt //
meaning:
पद्मलक्ष्मैतत् सामान्यं द्विषट्कदलमुच्यते /
कर्णिकार्धेन मानेन प्राक्संस्थं भ्रामयेत् क्रमात् //
text_mt: This is the general characteristic of the lotus; it is called twelve-petalled. / With a measure equal to half of the pericarp, he should rotate in order from the east.

sanskrit_iast:
tatpārśve bhramayogena kuṇḍalyaḥ ṣaḍ bhavanti hi /
evaṃ dvādaśa matsyāḥ syurdviṣaṭkadalakañca taiḥ //
meaning:
तत्पार्श्वे भ्रमयोगेन कुण्डल्यः षड् भवन्ति हि /
एवं द्वादश मत्स्याः स्युर्द्विषट्कदलकञ्च तैः //
text_mt: On its side, by the motion of the compass, there are indeed six coils; / thus there are twelve fish figures, and through them is the twelve-petalled [lotus].

sanskrit_iast:
pañcapatrābhisiddhyarthaṃ matsyaṃ kṛtvaivamabjakam /
vyomarekhāvahiḥ pīṭhantatra koṣṭāni mārjayet //
meaning:
पञ्चपत्राभिसिद्ध्यर्थं मत्स्यं कृत्वैवमब्जकम् /
व्योमरेखावहिः पीठन्तत्र कोष्टानि मार्जयेत् //
text_mt: For the accomplishment of the five-petalled lotus, having made the fish figure thus for the lotus, / outside the sky-line is the pedestal; there he should clear the compartments:

sanskrit_iast:
trīṇi koṇeṣu pādārthaṃ dvidvikānyaparāṇi tu /
caturdikṣu viliptāni gātrakāṇi bhavantyuta //
meaning:
त्रीणि कोणेषु पादार्थं द्विद्विकान्यपराणि तु /
चतुर्दिक्षु विलिप्तानि गात्रकाणि भवन्त्युत //
text_mt: three in the corners for the feet, and the others in pairs; / coated in the four directions, they become the limbs.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paṅktidvayaṃ dikṣu vīṭhyarthantu vilopayet(1) /
dvārāṇyāśāsu kurvīta catvāri catasṛṣvapi //
meaning:
ततः पङ्क्तिद्वयं दिक्षु वीठ्यर्थन्तु विलोपयेत्(1) /
द्वाराण्याशासु कुर्वीत चत्वारि चतसृष्वपि //
text_mt: Then he should erase two rows in the directions for the sake of the pathway; / he should make four doors in all four directions.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārāṇāṃ pārśvataḥ śobhā aṣṭau kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ /
:n
1 paṅktidvayaṃ dvayaṃ dikṣu vīthyarthaṃ viniyojayediti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 80
tatpārśva upaśobhāstu tāvatyaḥ parikīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
द्वाराणां पार्श्वतः शोभा अष्टौ कुर्याद्विचक्षणः /
:न्
1 पङ्क्तिद्वयं द्वयं दिक्षु वीथ्यर्थं विनियोजयेदिति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 80
तत्पार्श्व उपशोभास्तु तावत्यः परिकीर्तिताः //
text_mt:
On the sides of the doors, the wise man should make eight decorative projections.
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: The manuscript marked ṅa reads 'paṅktidvayaṃ dvayaṃ dikṣu vīthyarthaṃ viniyojayet'. / p. 80]
Beside them, as many subsidiary projections are proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
samīpa upaśobhānāṃ koṇāstu parikīrtitāḥ(1) /
caturdikṣu tato dve dve cintayenmadhyakoṣṭhakaiḥ //
meaning:
समीप उपशोभानां कोणास्तु परिकीर्तिताः(1) /
चतुर्दिक्षु ततो द्वे द्वे चिन्तयेन्मध्यकोष्ठकैः //
text_mt: Near the subsidiary projections, corners are proclaimed; / from there, in the four directions, he should design two [compartments] each from the central compartments.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri vāhyato mṛjyādekaikaṃ pārśvayorapi /
śobhārthaṃ pārśvayostrīṇi trīṇi lumpaddalasya tu //
meaning:
चत्वारि वाह्यतो मृज्यादेकैकं पार्श्वयोरपि /
शोभार्थं पार्श्वयोस्त्रीणि त्रीणि लुम्पद्दलस्य तु //
text_mt: He should wipe out four on the outside, and one on each of the two sides; / for the sake of the decorative projection, he should erase three on each side of the petal.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvadviparyaye kuryādupaśobhāṃ tataḥ param /
koṇasyāntarvahistrīṇi cintayeddvirvibhedataḥ //
meaning:
तद्वद्विपर्यये कुर्यादुपशोभां ततः परम् /
कोणस्यान्तर्वहिस्त्रीणि चिन्तयेद्द्विर्विभेदतः //
text_mt: In the same inverted manner, he should then make the subsidiary projection. / Inside and outside the corner, he should design three by a twofold division.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ ṣoḍaśakoṣṭhaṃ syādevamanyattu maṇḍalam /
dviṣaṭkabhāge ṣaṭtriṃśatpadaṃ padmantu vīthikā //
meaning:
एवं षोडशकोष्ठं स्यादेवमन्यत्तु मण्डलम् /
द्विषट्कभागे षट्त्रिंशत्पदं पद्मन्तु वीथिका //
text_mt: Thus it becomes sixteen compartments; thus is another maṇḍala. / In a division of twelve, the lotus has thirty-six squares, while the pathway

sanskrit_iast:
ekā paṅktiḥ prābhyāṃ tu dvāraśobhādi pūrvavat /
dvādaśāṅgulibhiḥ padmamekahaste tu maṇḍale //
meaning:
एका पङ्क्तिः प्राभ्यां तु द्वारशोभादि पूर्ववत् /
द्वादशाङ्गुलिभिः पद्ममेकहस्ते तु मण्डले //
text_mt: is one row; with two rows are the door, decorative projection, and the rest, as before. / In a maṇḍala of one cubit, the lotus is twelve finger-breadths;

sanskrit_iast:
dvihaste hastamātraṃ syādvṛddhyā dvāreṇa vācaret /
apīṭhañcaturasraṃ syādvikarañcakrapaṅkajam //
meaning:
द्विहस्ते हस्तमात्रं स्याद्वृद्ध्या द्वारेण वाचरेत् /
अपीठञ्चतुरस्रं स्याद्विकरञ्चक्रपङ्कजम् //
text_mt: in one of two cubits, it should measure one cubit, or he should proceed by increase through the door. / The lotus of the disc without a pedestal is square and without rays.

sanskrit_iast:
padmārdhaṃ navabhiḥ proktaṃ nābhistu tisṛbhiḥ smṛtā /
aṣṭābhirdvārakān kuryānnemintu caturaṅgulaiḥ //
meaning:
पद्मार्धं नवभिः प्रोक्तं नाभिस्तु तिसृभिः स्मृता /
अष्टाभिर्द्वारकान् कुर्यान्नेमिन्तु चतुरङ्गुलैः //
text_mt:
Half of the lotus is said to be nine [digits], and the nave is handed down as three;
one should make the door-openings eight [digits], and the rim four digits.

sanskrit_iast:
tridhā(2) vibhajya ca kṣetramantardvābhyāmathāṅkayet /
pañcāntasvarasiddhyarthaṃ(3) teṣvasphālya likhedarān //
meaning:
त्रिधा(2) विभज्य च क्षेत्रमन्तर्द्वाभ्यामथाङ्कयेत् /
पञ्चान्तस्वरसिद्ध्यर्थं(3) तेष्वस्फाल्य लिखेदरान् //
text_mt:
Dividing the field into three and then marking off within by two,
one should snap lines upon them to draw spokes for the sake of attaining the fifth interval.

sanskrit_iast:
indīvaradalākārānathavā mātulāṅgavat /
padmapatrāyatānvāpi likhedicchānurūpataḥ //
meaning:
इन्दीवरदलाकारानथवा मातुलाङ्गवत् /
पद्मपत्रायतान्वापि लिखेदिच्छानुरूपतः //
text_mt:
One should draw them shaped like blue lotus petals, or like the citron fruit,
or elongated like lotus petals, according to one's wish.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāmayitvā vahir nemāvarasandhyantare sthitaḥ /
bhrāmayedaramūlantu sandhimadhye vyavasthitaḥ //
:n
1 parimārjitā iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 dvidhā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 pañcāntarastvasiddhyarthamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ pañcottarastu
siddhyarthamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 81
meaning:
भ्रामयित्वा वहिर् नेमावरसन्ध्यन्तरे स्थितः /
भ्रामयेदरमूलन्तु सन्धिमध्ये व्यवस्थितः //
:न्
1 परिमार्जिता इति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 द्विधा इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 पञ्चान्तरस्त्वसिद्ध्यर्थमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः पञ्चोत्तरस्तु
सिद्ध्यर्थमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 81
text_mt:
Rotating outside on the rim, positioned in the junction-interval of the spokes,
one should rotate the base of the spokes, situated in the midst of the junction.
:n
1 The reading in the manuscript marked gha is 'parimārjitā'.
2 The reading in the manuscript marked kha is 'dvidhā'.
3 The reading in the manuscript marked kha is 'pañcāntarastvasiddhyartham'; the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'pañcottarastu siddhyartham'.
:p 81

sanskrit_iast:
aramadhye sthito madhamaraṇiṃ bhrāmayet samam /
evaṃ siddhyantarāḥ samyak mātulāṅganibhāḥ samāḥ //
meaning:
अरमध्ये स्थितो मधमरणिं भ्रामयेत् समम् /
एवं सिद्ध्यन्तराः सम्यक् मातुलाङ्गनिभाः समाः //
text_mt:
Situated in the middle of a spoke, one should rotate the central turning-pin evenly;
thus the intervals are well produced, even, resembling citron fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhajya saptadhā kṣetraṃ caturdaśakaraṃ samam /
dvidhā kṛte śataṃ hy atra ṣaṇnavatyadhikāni tu //
meaning:
विभज्य सप्तधा क्षेत्रं चतुर्दशकरं समम् /
द्विधा कृते शतं ह्य् अत्र षण्नवत्यधिकानि तु //
text_mt:
Dividing the field of fourteen cubits equally into seven parts,
when it is halved, there are indeed one hundred and ninety-six

sanskrit_iast:
koṣṭakāni caturbhistair madhye bhadraṃ samālikhet /
parito visṛjedvīthyai tathā dikṣu samālikhet //
meaning:
कोष्टकानि चतुर्भिस्तैर् मध्ये भद्रं समालिखेत् /
परितो विसृजेद्वीथ्यै तथा दिक्षु समालिखेत् //
text_mt:
squares; with four of them one should draw an auspicious figure in the centre.
One should leave space around for a pathway, and likewise in the directions one should draw

sanskrit_iast:
kamalāni punarvīthyai paritaḥ parimṛjya tu /
dve dve madhyamakoṣṭhe tu grīvārthaṃ dikṣu lopayet //
meaning:
कमलानि पुनर्वीथ्यै परितः परिमृज्य तु /
द्वे द्वे मध्यमकोष्ठे तु ग्रीवार्थं दिक्षु लोपयेत् //
text_mt:
lotuses; then, clearing around for a pathway,
one should erase two middle squares in each of the directions for the neck.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri vāhyataḥ paścāttrīṇi trīṇi tu lopayet /
grīvāpārśve vahistvekā śobhā sā parikīrtitā //
meaning:
चत्वारि वाह्यतः पश्चात्त्रीणि त्रीणि तु लोपयेत् /
ग्रीवापार्श्वे वहिस्त्वेका शोभा सा परिकीर्तिता //
text_mt:
Then one should erase four on the outside, and three by three;
on the outside, beside the neck, is one [part]: that is proclaimed as the vestibule.

sanskrit_iast:
vimṛjya vāhyakoṇeṣu saptāntastrīṇi mārjayet /
maṇḍalaṃ navabhāgaṃ syānnavavyūhaṃ hariṃ yajet //
meaning:
विमृज्य वाह्यकोणेषु सप्तान्तस्त्रीणि मार्जयेत् /
मण्डलं नवभागं स्यान्नवव्यूहं हरिं यजेत् //
text_mt:
Erasing at the outer corners, one should wipe out three ending at the seventh.
