The maṇḍala should consist of nine divisions; one should worship Hari in nine manifestations.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaviṃśatikavyūhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ viśvarūpagaṃ /
dvātriṃśaddhastakaṃ kṣetraṃ bhaktaṃ dvātriṃśatā samaṃ //
meaning:
पञ्चविंशतिकव्यूहं मण्डलं विश्वरूपगं /
द्वात्रिंशद्धस्तकं क्षेत्रं भक्तं द्वात्रिंशता समं //
text_mt:
The maṇḍala of twenty-five manifestations pertains to the universal form;
a field measuring thirty-two cubits is divided equally into thirty-two.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ kṛte caturviṃśatyadhikantu sahasrakaṃ /
koṣṭhakānāṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ madhye śoḍaśakoṣṭhakaiḥ //
meaning:
एवं कृते चतुर्विंशत्यधिकन्तु सहस्रकं /
कोष्ठकानां समुद्दिष्टं मध्ये शोडशकोष्ठकैः //
text_mt:
When this is done, one thousand and twenty-four
squares are stated; with sixteen squares in the centre,

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrakaṃ parilikhyātha pārśve paṅktiṃ vimṛjya tu /
tataḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ koṣṭair dikṣu bhadrāṣṭakaṃ likhet(1) //
meaning:
भद्रकं परिलिख्याथ पार्श्वे पङ्क्तिं विमृज्य तु /
ततः षोडशभिः कोष्टैर् दिक्षु भद्राष्टकं लिखेत्(1) //
text_mt:
having drawn an auspicious figure and wiped out a row on the side,
one should then draw eight auspicious figures in the directions with sixteen squares [each].

sanskrit_iast:
tatopi paṅktiṃ sammṛjya tadvat ṣoḍaśabhadrakaṃ /
likhitvā paritaḥ paṅktiṃ vimṛjyātha prakalpayet //
meaning:
ततोपि पङ्क्तिं सम्मृज्य तद्वत् षोडशभद्रकं /
लिखित्वा परितः पङ्क्तिं विमृज्याथ प्रकल्पयेत् //
text_mt:
Then, having wiped out a row, one should likewise draw sixteen auspicious figures,
and having cleared a row all around, one should then arrange

sanskrit_iast:
dvāradvādaśakaṃ dikṣu trīṇi trīṇi yathākramaṃ /
ṣaḍbhiḥ parilupyāntarmadhye catvāri pārśvayoḥ //
meaning:
द्वारद्वादशकं दिक्षु त्रीणि त्रीणि यथाक्रमं /
षड्भिः परिलुप्यान्तर्मध्ये चत्वारि पार्श्वयोः //
text_mt:
twelve doorways in the directions, three by three in proper sequence;
erasing six on the inside, four in the middle, [and] on the flanks

sanskrit_iast:
catvāryantarvahirdve tu śobhārthaṃ parimṛjya tu /
upadvārasiddhyarthaṃ trīṇyantaḥ pañca vāhyataḥ //
:n
1 dikṣu tatrāṣṭakaṃ likhediti kha, ga, gha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 82
meaning:
चत्वार्यन्तर्वहिर्द्वे तु शोभार्थं परिमृज्य तु /
उपद्वारसिद्ध्यर्थं त्रीण्यन्तः पञ्च वाह्यतः //
:न्
1 दिक्षु तत्राष्टकं लिखेदिति ख, ग, घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 82

sanskrit_iast:
parimṛjya tathā śobhāṃ pūrvavat parikalpayet /
vahiḥ koṇeṣu saptāntastrīṇi koṣṭhāni mārjayet //
meaning:
परिमृज्य तथा शोभां पूर्ववत् परिकल्पयेत् /
वहिः कोणेषु सप्तान्तस्त्रीणि कोष्ठानि मार्जयेत् //
text_mt:
and having wiped away, one should arrange the vestibule as before.
At the outer corners, one should wipe out three squares ending at the seventh.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaviṃśatikavyūhe paraṃ brahma yajet kaje(1) /
madhye pūrvāditaḥ padme vāsudevādayaḥ kramāt //
meaning:
पञ्चविंशतिकव्यूहे परं ब्रह्म यजेत् कजे(1) /
मध्ये पूर्वादितः पद्मे वासुदेवादयः क्रमात् //
text_mt:
In the [maṇḍala] of twenty-five manifestations, one should worship the supreme Brahman on the lotus;
in the centre, on the lotus beginning from the east, Vāsudeva and the others in order.

sanskrit_iast:
varāhaṃ pūjayitvā ca pūrvapadme tataḥ kramāt /
vyūhān sampūjayettāvat yāvat ṣaḍviṃśamo bhavet //
meaning:
वराहं पूजयित्वा च पूर्वपद्मे ततः क्रमात् /
व्यूहान् सम्पूजयेत्तावत् यावत् षड्विंशमो भवेत् //
text_mt:
Having worshipped the Boar on the eastern lotus, one should then in sequence
worship the manifestations until there are twenty-six.

sanskrit_iast:
yathoktaṃ vyūhamakhilamekasmin paṅkaje kramāt /
yaṣṭavyamiti yatnena(2) pracetā manyate 'dhvaraṃ(3) //
meaning:
यथोक्तं व्यूहमखिलमेकस्मिन् पङ्कजे क्रमात् /
यष्टव्यमिति यत्नेन(2) प्रचेता मन्यते ऽध्वरं(3) //
text_mt:
The entire manifestation as prescribed should be worshipped sequentially on a single lotus;
Pracetas considers the sacrifice thus [performed] with care.

sanskrit_iast:
satpantu mūrtibhedena vibhaktaṃ manyate 'cyutaṃ /
catvāriṃśat karaṃ kṣetraṃ hy uttaraṃ(4) vibhajet kramāt //
meaning:
सत्पन्तु मूर्तिभेदेन विभक्तं मन्यते ऽच्युतं /
चत्वारिंशत् करं क्षेत्रं ह्य् उत्तरं(4) विभजेत् क्रमात् //
text_mt:
He considers Acyuta divided through distinct bodily forms.
A field of forty cubits should be divided progressively beyond:

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaṃ saptadhā bhūyastathaivaikaṃ dvidhā punaḥ /
catuḥṣaṣṭyuttaraṃ saptaśatānyekaṃ sahasrakaṃ //
meaning:
एकैकं सप्तधा भूयस्तथैवैकं द्विधा पुनः /
चतुःषष्ट्युत्तरं सप्तशतान्येकं सहस्रकं //
text_mt:
each into seven again, and likewise each again into two,
[yielding] one thousand seven hundred and sixty-four

sanskrit_iast:
koṣṭhakānāṃ bhadrakañca madhye ṣoḍaśakoṣṭhakaiḥ /
pārśve vīthīṃ tataścāṣṭabhadrāṇyatha ca vīthikā //
meaning:
कोष्ठकानां भद्रकञ्च मध्ये षोडशकोष्ठकैः /
पार्श्वे वीथीं ततश्चाष्टभद्राण्यथ च वीथिका //
text_mt:
squares, and an auspicious figure in the centre with sixteen squares.
At the side a pathway, and then eight auspicious figures, and then a pathway,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśābjānyatho vīthī caturviṃśatipaṅkajaṃ /
vīthīpadmāni dvātriṃśat paṅktivīthikajānyatha //
meaning:
षोडशाब्जान्यथो वीथी चतुर्विंशतिपङ्कजं /
वीथीपद्मानि द्वात्रिंशत् पङ्क्तिवीथिकजान्यथ //
text_mt:
sixteen lotuses, then a pathway, twenty-four lotuses,
a pathway, thirty-two lotuses, then lotuses of the pathway row,

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśattato vīthī śeṣapaṅktitrayeṇa ca /
dvāraśobhopaśobhāḥ syurdikṣu madhye vilopya ca //
meaning:
चत्वारिंशत्ततो वीथी शेषपङ्क्तित्रयेण च /
द्वारशोभोपशोभाः स्युर्दिक्षु मध्ये विलोप्य च //
text_mt:
forty, and then a pathway; and by means of the remaining three rows
there should be doorways, vestibules, and minor vestibules, erasing in the directions and in the middle.

sanskrit_iast:
dvicatuḥṣaḍdvārasiddhyai caturdikṣu vilopayet /
pañca trīṇyekakaṃ vāhye śobhopadvārasiddhaye //
:n
1 śubhe iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 yaṣṭavyamiti yajñena iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
yaṣṭavyamiti mantreṇa iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 pracetā manyate dhruvamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 hyuttamamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 83
meaning:
द्विचतुःषड्द्वारसिद्ध्यै चतुर्दिक्षु विलोपयेत् /
पञ्च त्रीण्येककं वाह्ये शोभोपद्वारसिद्धये //
:न्
1 शुभे इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 यष्टव्यमिति यज्ञेन इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
यष्टव्यमिति मन्त्रेण इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 प्रचेता मन्यते ध्रुवमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 ह्युत्तममिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 83
text_mt:
For the attainment of two, four, and six doors, one should erase in the four directions;
[erasing] five, three, and one on the outside for the attainment of vestibules and secondary doorways.
:n
1 The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'śubhe'.
2 The reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha is 'yaṣṭavyamiti yajñena'; the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'yaṣṭavyamiti mantreṇa'.
3 The reading in the manuscript marked kha is 'pracetā manyate dhruvam'.
4 The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'hyuttamam'.
:p 83

sanskrit_iast:
dvārāṇāṃ pārśvayorantaḥ ṣaḍ vā catvāri madhyataḥ /
dve dve lumpedevameva ṣaḍ bhavantyupaśobhikāḥ //
meaning:
द्वाराणां पार्श्वयोरन्तः षड् वा चत्वारि मध्यतः /
द्वे द्वे लुम्पेदेवमेव षड् भवन्त्युपशोभिकाः //
text_mt:
On the flanks of the doorways, within, six, or four from the middle;
one should erase two by two; thus there are six minor vestibules.

sanskrit_iast: ekasyāṃ diśi saṅkhyāḥ syuḥ catasraḥ prisaṅkhyayā //
meaning: एकस्यां दिशि सङ्ख्याः स्युः चतस्रः प्रिसङ्ख्यया //
text_mt: In one direction the count should be four by enumeration.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasyāṃ diśi trīṇi dvārāṇyapi bhavantyuta /
pañca pañca tu koṇeṣu paṅktau paṅktau kramāt mṛjet /
koṣṭakāni bhavedevaṃ martyeṣṭyaṃ maṇḍalaṃ śubhaṃ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye maṇḍalādilakṣaṇaṃ nāma
ūnatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
maṇḍalavidhiḥ
meaning:
एकैकस्यां दिशि त्रीणि द्वाराण्यपि भवन्त्युत /
पञ्च पञ्च तु कोणेषु पङ्क्तौ पङ्क्तौ क्रमात् मृजेत् /
कोष्टकानि भवेदेवं मर्त्येष्ट्यं मण्डलं शुभं //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये मण्डलादिलक्षणं नाम
ऊनत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
मण्डलविधिः
text_mt:
In each single direction there are also three doorways.
One should erase five by five in the corners in row after row in succession;
thus there will be an auspicious maṇḍala pleasing to mortals.
Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter, entitled "Characteristics of the Maṇḍala and Related Matters," in the venerable Agni Mahāpurāṇa.
Now, the thirtieth chapter.
The Rule of the Maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
nārada uvāca
madhye padme yajedbrahma sāṅgaṃ pūrvebjanābhakaṃ /
āgneyebje ca prakṛtiṃ yāmyebje puruṣaṃ yajet //
meaning:
नारद उवाच
मध्ये पद्मे यजेद्ब्रह्म साङ्गं पूर्वेब्जनाभकं /
आग्नेयेब्जे च प्रकृतिं याम्येब्जे पुरुषं यजेत् //

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣāddakṣiṇe ca vahniṃ nairṛte vāruṇenilaṃ /
ādityamaindave padme ṛgyajuś caiśapadmake //
meaning:
पुरुषाद्दक्षिणे च वह्निं नैरृते वारुणेनिलं /
आदित्यमैन्दवे पद्मे ऋग्यजुश् चैशपद्मके //
text_mt:
And to the south of Puruṣa, Fire; in the south-west, Wind in the western [lotus];
the Sun in the northern lotus; and the Ṛg[veda] and Yajur[veda] in the north-eastern lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādīṃś ca dvitīyāyāṃ padme ṣoḍaśake tathā /
sāmātharvāṇamākāśaṃ vāyuṃ tejas tathā jalaṃ //
meaning:
इन्द्रादींश् च द्वितीयायां पद्मे षोडशके तथा /
सामाथर्वाणमाकाशं वायुं तेजस् तथा जलं //
text_mt:
And Indra and the others in the second [circuit], likewise in the sixteen-petaled lotus:
the Sāma[veda], the Atharva[veda], space, air, fire, and water,

sanskrit_iast:
pṛṭhivīñca manaś caiva śrotraṃ tvak cakṣurarcayet /
rasanāñca tathā ghrāṇaṃ bhūrbhuvaś caiva ṣoḍaśaṃ //
meaning:
पृठिवीञ्च मनश् चैव श्रोत्रं त्वक् चक्षुरर्चयेत् /
रसनाञ्च तथा घ्राणं भूर्भुवश् चैव षोडशं //
text_mt:
earth, mind, hearing, skin, eye;
tongue, smell, and the sixteenth, Bhūḥ and Bhuvaḥ.

sanskrit_iast:
maharjanastapaḥ satyaṃ tathāgniṣṭomameva ca /
atyagniṣṭomakaṃ(1) cokthaṃ ṣoḍaśīṃ vājapeyakaṃ //
meaning:
महर्जनस्तपः सत्यं तथाग्निष्टोममेव च /
अत्यग्निष्टोमकं(1) चोक्थं षोडशीं वाजपेयकं //
text_mt:
Mahaḥ, Janaḥ, Tapaḥ, Satya, and also the Agniṣṭoma,
the Atyagniṣṭoma, the Uktha, the Ṣoḍaśin, the Vājapeya,

sanskrit_iast:
atirātrañca sampūjya tathāptoryāmamarcayet /
mano buddhimahaṅkāraṃ śabdaṃ sparśañca rūpakaṃ //
meaning:
अतिरात्रञ्च सम्पूज्य तथाप्तोर्याममर्चयेत् /
मनो बुद्धिमहङ्कारं शब्दं स्पर्शञ्च रूपकं //
text_mt:
and having worshipped the Atirātra, one should worship the Āptoryāma;
mind, intellect, ego, sound, touch, form,

sanskrit_iast: rasaṃ gandhañca padmeṣu caturviṃśatiṣu kramāt /
meaning: रसं गन्धञ्च पद्मेषु चतुर्विंशतिषु क्रमात् /
text_mt: taste, and smell in the twenty-four lotuses in due order;

sanskrit_iast:
:n
1 pratyagniṣṭomakamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ jyotiṣṭomakamiti
ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 84
jīvaṃ manodhipañcāhaṃ prakṛtiṃ śabdamātrakaṃ //
meaning:
:न्
1 प्रत्यग्निष्टोमकमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः ज्योतिष्टोमकमिति
ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 84
जीवं मनोधिपञ्चाहं प्रकृतिं शब्दमात्रकं //
text_mt:
:n
1 The reading in the manuscript marked kha is 'pratyagniṣṭomakam'; the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'jyotiṣṭomakam'.
:p 84
the soul, the five lords of the mind, Prakṛti, and sound-subtle-element.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevādimūrtīñca tathā caiva daśatmakaṃ /
manaḥ śrotraṃ tvacaṃ prārcya cakṣuś ca rasanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
वासुदेवादिमूर्तीञ्च तथा चैव दशत्मकं /
मनः श्रोत्रं त्वचं प्रार्च्य चक्षुश् च रसनं तथा //
text_mt:
and the forms of Vāsudeva and the rest, likewise consisting of ten principles,
having worshipped the mind, hearing, and touch, and likewise sight and taste,

sanskrit_iast:
ghrāṇaṃ vākpāṇipādañca dvātriṃśadvārijeṣvimān /
caturthāvaraṇe pūjyāḥ sāṅgāḥ saparivārakāḥ //
meaning:
घ्राणं वाक्पाणिपादञ्च द्वात्रिंशद्वारिजेष्विमान् /
चतुर्थावरणे पूज्याः साङ्गाः सपरिवारकाः //
text_mt:
smell, speech, hands, and feet in these thirty-two lotuses.
In the fourth enclosure they are to be worshipped with their limbs and retinue.

sanskrit_iast:
pāyūpasthau ca sampūjya māsānāṃ dvādaśādhipān /
puruṣottamādiṣaḍviṃśān vāhyāvaraṇake yajet //
meaning:
पायूपस्थौ च सम्पूज्य मासानां द्वादशाधिपान् /
पुरुषोत्तमादिषड्विंशान् वाह्यावरणके यजेत् //
text_mt:
Having worshipped the anus and genitals, and the twelve lords of the months,
one should worship the twenty-six beginning with Puruṣottama in the outer enclosure.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrābje teṣu sampūjyā māsānāṃ patayaḥ kramāt /
aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ ṣaḍvā pañcātha caturo 'pare //
meaning:
चक्राब्जे तेषु सम्पूज्या मासानां पतयः क्रमात् /
अष्टौ प्रकृतयः षड्वा पञ्चाथ चतुरो ऽपरे //
text_mt:
In the lotus-wheel, the lords of the months should be worshipped in them in order.
The primary constituents are eight, or six, or five, or others say four.

sanskrit_iast:
rajaḥ pātaṃ tataḥ kuryāllikhite maṇḍale śṛṇu /
karṇikā pītavarṇā syādrekhāḥ sarvāḥ sitāḥ samāḥ //
meaning:
रजः पातं ततः कुर्याल्लिखिते मण्डले शृणु /
कर्णिका पीतवर्णा स्याद्रेखाः सर्वाः सिताः समाः //
text_mt:
Hear then how to sprinkle the powder when the maṇḍala is drawn:
the pericarp should be yellow; all the lines should be white and even;

sanskrit_iast:
dvihaste 'ṅguṣṭamātrāḥ syurhaste cārdhasamāḥ sitāḥ /
padmaṃ śuklena sandhīṃstu kṛṣṇena śyāmatothavā //
meaning:
द्विहस्ते ऽङ्गुष्टमात्राः स्युर्हस्ते चार्धसमाः सिताः /
पद्मं शुक्लेन सन्धींस्तु कृष्णेन श्यामतोथवा //
text_mt:
in a two-cubit [diagram] they should measure a thumb['s breadth]; in a one-cubit [diagram] they should be half that, and white.
[One should fill] the lotus with white, but the joints with black or dark green;

sanskrit_iast:
keśarā raktapītāḥ syuḥ koṇān raktena pūrayet /
bhūṣayedyogapīṭhantu yatheṣṭaṃ sārvavarṇikaiḥ //
meaning:
केशरा रक्तपीताः स्युः कोणान् रक्तेन पूरयेत् /
भूषयेद्योगपीठन्तु यथेष्टं सार्ववर्णिकैः //
text_mt:
the filaments should be red and yellow; one should fill the corners with red.
One should decorate the yoga-seat as one wishes with all colors.

sanskrit_iast:
latāvitānapatrādyair vīthikāmupaśobhayet /
pīṭhadvāre tu śuklena śobhāraktena pītataḥ //
meaning:
लतावितानपत्राद्यैर् वीथिकामुपशोभयेत् /
पीठद्वारे तु शुक्लेन शोभारक्तेन पीततः //
text_mt:
One should adorn the pathway with creepers, canopies, leaves, and the like.
At the doorway of the seat, with white; the decorative border with red [and] yellow;

sanskrit_iast:
upaśobhāñca nīlena koṇaśaṅkhyāṃś ca vai sitān /
bhadrake pūraṇaṃ proktamevamanyeṣu pūraṇaṃ //
meaning:
उपशोभाञ्च नीलेन कोणशङ्ख्यांश् च वै सितान् /
भद्रके पूरणं प्रोक्तमेवमन्येषु पूरणं //
text_mt:
the secondary border with blue; and the corner conches with white.
Filling has been described in the bhadraka [design]; thus is the filling in others.

sanskrit_iast:
trikoṇaṃ sitaraktena kṛṣṇena ca vibhūṣayet /
dvikoṇaṃ raktapītābhyāṃ nābhiṃ kṛṣṇena cakrake //
meaning:
त्रिकोणं सितरक्तेन कृष्णेन च विभूषयेत् /
द्विकोणं रक्तपीताभ्यां नाभिं कृष्णेन चक्रके //
text_mt:
One should decorate a triangle with white, red, and black;
a two-cornered [figure] with red and yellow; the navel with black in a wheel;

sanskrit_iast:
arakān pītaraktābhiḥ śyāmān nemintu raktataḥ /
sitaśyāmāruṇāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ pītā rekhāstu vāhyataḥ //
meaning:
अरकान् पीतरक्ताभिः श्यामान् नेमिन्तु रक्ततः /
सितश्यामारुणाः कृष्णाः पीता रेखास्तु वाह्यतः //
text_mt:
the spokes with yellow and red; the dark-green rim with red.
White, dark green, red, black, and yellow lines are on the outside.

sanskrit_iast:
śālipiṣṭādi śuklaṃ syādraktaṃ kausumbhakādikam /
haridrayā ca hāridraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ syāddagdhadhānyataḥ //
:p 85
meaning:
शालिपिष्टादि शुक्लं स्याद्रक्तं कौसुम्भकादिकम् /
हरिद्रया च हारिद्रं कृष्णं स्याद्दग्धधान्यतः //
:प् 85

sanskrit_iast:
śamīpatrādikaiḥ śyāmaṃ vījānāṃ lakṣajāpyataḥ /
caturlakṣaistu mantrāṇāṃ vidyānāṃ lakṣasādhanam //
meaning:
शमीपत्रादिकैः श्यामं वीजानां लक्षजाप्यतः /
चतुर्लक्षैस्तु मन्त्राणां विद्यानां लक्षसाधनम् //
text_mt:
dark green with śamī leaves and the like. By reciting one hundred thousand seed-syllables,
with four hundred thousand of mantras, [and] with one hundred thousand the attainment of the vidyās [is achieved].

sanskrit_iast:
ayutaṃ buddhividyānāṃ stotrāṇāñca sahasrakam /
pūrvamevātha lakṣeṇa mantraśuddhis tathātmanaḥ //
meaning:
अयुतं बुद्धिविद्यानां स्तोत्राणाञ्च सहस्रकम् /
पूर्वमेवाथ लक्षेण मन्त्रशुद्धिस् तथात्मनः //
text_mt:
Ten thousand of the buddhi-vidyās, and a thousand of the hymns of praise.
First, by a hundred thousand [recitations], purification of the mantra and of oneself [is achieved];

sanskrit_iast:
tathāpareṇa lakṣeṇa mantraḥ kṣetrīkṛto bhavet /
pūrvamevāsamo homo vījānāṃ samprakīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
तथापरेण लक्षेण मन्त्रः क्षेत्रीकृतो भवेत् /
पूर्वमेवासमो होमो वीजानां सम्प्रकीर्तितः //
text_mt:
then, by another hundred thousand, the mantra becomes cultivated.
Preliminary unmatched fire oblation of the seed-syllables has been declared.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasevā daśāṃśena mantrādīnāṃ prakīrtitā /
paraś carye tu mantre tu māsikaṃ vratamācaret //
meaning:
पूर्वसेवा दशांशेन मन्त्रादीनां प्रकीर्तिता /
परश् चर्ये तु मन्त्रे तु मासिकं व्रतमाचरेत् //
text_mt:
Preliminary service of mantras and the rest is declared to be by a tenth part.
When a mantra is to be practiced further, one should perform a month-long votive observance:

sanskrit_iast:
bhuvi nyasedvāmapādaṃ na gṛhṇīyāt pratigraham /
evaṃ dvitriguṇenaiva madhyamottamasiddhayaḥ //
meaning:
भुवि न्यसेद्वामपादं न गृह्णीयात् प्रतिग्रहम् /
एवं द्वित्रिगुणेनैव मध्यमोत्तमसिद्धयः //
text_mt:
one should place the left foot on the earth and not accept a gift.
Thus, by doubling or tripling [the practice], middling and highest attainments [are achieved].

sanskrit_iast:
mantradhyānaṃ pravakṣyāmi yena syānmantrajaṃ phalam /
sthūlaṃ śabdamayaṃ rūpaṃ vigrahaṃ vāhyamiṣyate //
meaning:
मन्त्रध्यानं प्रवक्ष्यामि येन स्यान्मन्त्रजं फलम् /
स्थूलं शब्दमयं रूपं विग्रहं वाह्यमिष्यते //
text_mt:
I shall declare the meditation on mantras by which the fruit born of the mantra arises.
The gross form consists of sound; the external image is prescribed [as such].

sanskrit_iast:
sukṣmāṃ jyotirmayaṃ rūpaṃ hārdaṃ cintāmayaṃ bhavet /
cintayā rahitaṃ yattu tat paraṃ prakīrtitam //
meaning:
सुक्ष्मां ज्योतिर्मयं रूपं हार्दं चिन्तामयं भवेत् /
चिन्तया रहितं यत्तु तत् परं प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt:
The subtle form consists of light; the mental [form] in the heart consists of thought.
That which is devoid of thought is proclaimed as the supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
varāhasiṃhaśaktīnāṃ sthūlarūpaṃ pradhānataḥ /
cintayā rahitaṃ rūpaṃ vāsudevasya kīrtitam //
meaning:
वराहसिंहशक्तीनां स्थूलरूपं प्रधानतः /
चिन्तया रहितं रूपं वासुदेवस्य कीर्तितम् //
text_mt:
The form of the Boar, the Lion, and the Śaktis is primarily gross.
The form devoid of thought is declared to be that of Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
itareṣāṃ smṛtaṃ rūpaṃ hārdaṃ cintāmayaṃ sadā /
sthūlaṃ vairājamākhyātaṃ sūkṣmaṃ vai liṅgitaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
इतरेषां स्मृतं रूपं हार्दं चिन्तामयं सदा /
स्थूलं वैराजमाख्यातं सूक्ष्मं वै लिङ्गितं भवेत् //
text_mt:
The form of the others is traditionally regarded as being in the heart, consisting always of thought.
The gross is called universal; the subtle is indeed characterized [by the linga-śarīra].

sanskrit_iast:
cintayā rahitaṃ rūpamaiśvaraṃ parikīrtitam /
hṛtpuṇḍarīkanilayañcaitanyaṃ jyotiravyayam //
meaning:
चिन्तया रहितं रूपमैश्वरं परिकीर्तितम् /
हृत्पुण्डरीकनिलयञ्चैतन्यं ज्योतिरव्ययम् //
text_mt:
The form devoid of thought is declared to be divine:
abiding in the lotus of the heart, consciousness, imperishable light.

sanskrit_iast:
vījaṃ vījātmakaṃ dhyāyet kadambakusumākṛtiṃ /
kumbhāntaragato dīpo niruddhaprasavo yathā //
meaning:
वीजं वीजात्मकं ध्यायेत् कदम्बकुसुमाकृतिं /
कुम्भान्तरगतो दीपो निरुद्धप्रसवो यथा //
text_mt:
One should meditate on the seed-syllable whose nature is the source, having the form of a kadamba blossom.
Just as a lamp inside a pot, its spread obstructed,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhataḥ kevalastiṣṭhedevaṃ mantreśvaro hṛdi /
anekaśuṣire kumbhe tāvanmātrā gabhastayaḥ //
meaning:
संहतः केवलस्तिष्ठेदेवं मन्त्रेश्वरो हृदि /
अनेकशुषिरे कुम्भे तावन्मात्रा गभस्तयः //
text_mt:
stands concentrated and alone, so does the lord of the mantra stand in the heart.
Just as through a pot with many holes rays radiate out

sanskrit_iast:
prasaranti vahistadvannāḍībhirvījaraśmayaḥ /
:p 86
athāvabhāsato daivīmātmīkṛtya tanuṃ sthitāḥ //
meaning:
प्रसरन्ति वहिस्तद्वन्नाडीभिर्वीजरश्मयः /
:प् 86
अथावभासतो दैवीमात्मीकृत्य तनुं स्थिताः //

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayāt prasthitā nāḍyo darśanendriyagocarāḥ /
agnīṣomātmake tāsāṃ nāḍyau nāsāgrasaṃsthite //
meaning:
हृदयात् प्रस्थिता नाड्यो दर्शनेन्द्रियगोचराः /
अग्नीषोमात्मके तासां नाड्यौ नासाग्रसंस्थिते //
text_mt:
the channels issuing from the heart are the realm of the sensory faculties.
Among them, two channels partaking of Fire and Soma reside at the tip of the nose.

sanskrit_iast:
samyagguhyena yogena jitvā dehasamīraṇam /
japadhyānarato mantrī mantralakṣaṇamaśnute(1) //
meaning:
सम्यग्गुह्येन योगेन जित्वा देहसमीरणम् /
जपध्यानरतो मन्त्री मन्त्रलक्षणमश्नुते(1) //
text_mt:
Having thoroughly conquered the bodily breath through esoteric yoga,
the mantra practitioner, devoted to recitation and meditation, attains the characteristics of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃśuddhabhūtatanmātraḥ sakāmo yogamabhyasan /
aṇimādimavāpnoti viraktaḥ pravilaṅghya ca /
devātmake bhūtamātrānmucyate cendriyagrahāt //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye maṇḍalādivarṇanaṃ nāma triṃśo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha ekatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
mārjanavidhānaṃ
meaning:
संशुद्धभूततन्मात्रः सकामो योगमभ्यसन् /
अणिमादिमवाप्नोति विरक्तः प्रविलङ्घ्य च /
देवात्मके भूतमात्रान्मुच्यते चेन्द्रियग्रहात् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये मण्डलादिवर्णनं नाम त्रिंशो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ एकत्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
मार्जनविधानं
text_mt:
Having purified the gross elements and subtle elements, practicing yoga with desire,
he obtains atom-sized minimization and the other [perfections]; and transcending them, detached,
in the divine nature he is freed from the elements and from the grasp of the senses.
:e Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, titled Description of the Maṇḍala and Others, in the venerable early Mahāpurāṇa, the Āgneya.
:ś Now the thirty-first chapter.
The Rite of Sprinkling.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
rakṣāṃ svasya pareṣāñca vakṣye tāṃ mārjanāhvayāṃ /
yayā vimucyate duḥkhaiḥ sukhañca prāpnuyānnaraḥ(2) //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
रक्षां स्वस्य परेषाञ्च वक्ष्ये तां मार्जनाह्वयां /
यया विमुच्यते दुःखैः सुखञ्च प्राप्नुयान्नरः(2) //
text_mt:
Agni said:
I shall explain the protective rite for oneself and others, known as the ritual cleansing,
by which a man is freed from miseries and attains happiness.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namaḥ paramārthāya puruṣāya mahātmane /
arūpabahurūpāya vyāpine paramātmane //
meaning:
ओं नमः परमार्थाय पुरुषाय महात्मने /
अरूपबहुरूपाय व्यापिने परमात्मने //
text_mt:
Om, reverence to the supreme reality, the Person, the Great Soul,
the formless one who has many forms, the all-pervasive Supreme Self.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkalmaṣāya śuddhāya dhyānayogaratāya ca /
namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi yat tatsidhyatu me vacaḥ //
meaning:
निष्कल्मषाय शुद्धाय ध्यानयोगरताय च /
नमस्कृत्य प्रवक्ष्यामि यत् तत्सिध्यतु मे वचः //
text_mt:
To the stainless, the pure, and the one delighting in the yoga of meditation,
having bowed, I shall speak; may that speech of mine be effective.

sanskrit_iast:
varāhāya nṛsiṃhāya vāmanāya mahāmune /
namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi yattatsidhyatu me vacaḥ //
:n
1 mantrajaṃ phalamaśnute iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 sukhaṃ brahmāpnuyānnaraḥ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 87
meaning:
वराहाय नृसिंहाय वामनाय महामुने /
नमस्कृत्य प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्तत्सिध्यतु मे वचः //
:न्
1 मन्त्रजं फलमश्नुते इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 सुखं ब्रह्माप्नुयान्नरः इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 87
text_mt:
To the Boar, to Nṛsiṃha, to Vāmana, O great sage,
having bowed, I shall speak; may that speech of mine be effective.
[Footnote]
[Variant] “He enjoys the fruit born of the mantra” is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
[Variant] “A man attains the happiness of Brahman” is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.

sanskrit_iast:
trivikramāya rāmāya vaikuṇṭhāya narāya ca /
namaskṛtya pravakṣyāmi yattat sidhyatu me vacaḥ //
meaning:
त्रिविक्रमाय रामाय वैकुण्ठाय नराय च /
नमस्कृत्य प्रवक्ष्यामि यत्तत् सिध्यतु मे वचः //
text_mt:
To Trivikrama, to Rāma, to Vaikuṇṭha, and to Nara,
having bowed, I shall speak; may that speech of mine be effective.

sanskrit_iast:
varāha narasiṃheśa vāmaneśa trivikrama /
haragrīveśa sarveśa hṛṣīkeśa harāśubham //
meaning:
वराह नरसिंहेश वामनेश त्रिविक्रम /
हरग्रीवेश सर्वेश हृषीकेश हराशुभम् //
text_mt:
O Boar, O Lord Narasiṃha, O Lord Vāmana, O Trivikrama,
O Lord Hayagrīva, O Lord of all, O Hṛṣīkeśa, remove misfortune!

sanskrit_iast:
aparājitacakrādyaiś caturbhiḥ paramāyudhaiḥ /
akhaṇḍitānubhāvaistvaṃ(1) sarvaduṣṭaharo bhava //
meaning:
अपराजितचक्राद्यैश् चतुर्भिः परमायुधैः /
अखण्डितानुभावैस्त्वं(1) सर्वदुष्टहरो भव //
text_mt:
With the four supreme weapons, beginning with the invincible discus,
endowed with unbroken power, be the destroyer of all wicked forces!

sanskrit_iast:
harāmukasya duritaṃ sarvañca kuśalaṃ kuru /
mṛtyubandhārtabhayadaṃ duritasya ca yat phalam //
meaning:
हरामुकस्य दुरितं सर्वञ्च कुशलं कुरु /
मृत्युबन्धार्तभयदं दुरितस्य च यत् फलम् //
text_mt:
Remove the wickedness from so-and-so and bring about all auspiciousness,
as well as whatever fruit of wickedness causes death, bondage, distress, and fear.

sanskrit_iast:
parābhidhyānasahitaiḥ prayuktañcābhicārakam /
gadasparśamahārogaprayogaṃ jarayā jara //
meaning:
पराभिध्यानसहितैः प्रयुक्तञ्चाभिचारकम् /
गदस्पर्शमहारोगप्रयोगं जरया जर //
text_mt:
Wear down through decay malevolent sorcery cast together with ill-will from others,
[and] the application of severe illnesses through the contact of diseases!

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namo vāsudevāya namaḥ kṛṣṇāya khaḍgine /
namaḥ puṣkaranetrāya keśavāyādicakriṇe //
meaning:
ओं नमो वासुदेवाय नमः कृष्णाय खड्गिने /
नमः पुष्करनेत्राय केशवायादिचक्रिणे //
text_mt:
Om, reverence to Vāsudeva; reverence to Kṛṣṇa, wielder of the sword;
reverence to the lotus-eyed Keśava, the primeval discus-bearer!

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ kamalakiñjalkapītanirmalavāsase /
mahāhararipuskandhasṛṣṭacakrāya cakriṇe //
meaning:
नमः कमलकिञ्जल्कपीतनिर्मलवाससे /
महाहररिपुस्कन्धसृष्टचक्राय चक्रिणे //
text_mt:
Reverence to the one whose pure garments are yellow like lotus filaments,
the discus-wielder who hurled the discus at the neck of the great enemy of Hara!

sanskrit_iast:
dṃṣṭroddhṛtakṣitibhṛte(2) trayīmūrtimate namaḥ /
mahāyajñavarāhāya śeṣabhogāṅkaśāyine //
meaning:
द्ंष्ट्रोद्धृतक्षितिभृते(2) त्रयीमूर्तिमते नमः /
महायज्ञवराहाय शेषभोगाङ्कशायिने //
text_mt:
Reverence to the bearer of the three Vedas in bodily form, who raised the earth upon his tusk,
to the Boar of the great sacrifice, who reclines on the coils of Śeṣa!

sanskrit_iast:
taptahāṭakakeśāgrajvalatpāvakalocana /
vajrādhikanakhasparśaṃ divyasiṃha namostu te //
meaning:
तप्तहाटककेशाग्रज्वलत्पावकलोचन /
वज्राधिकनखस्पर्शं दिव्यसिंह नमोस्तु ते //
text_mt:
O you whose hair-tips are like molten gold, whose eyes are blazing fires,
whose claw-touch surpasses the thunderbolt, divine Lion, reverence to you!

sanskrit_iast:
kāśyapāyātihrasvāya ṛgyajuḥsāmabhūṣita /
tubhyaṃ vāmanarūpāyākramate gāṃ(3) namo namaḥ //
meaning:
काश्यपायातिह्रस्वाय ऋग्यजुःसामभूषित /
तुभ्यं वामनरूपायाक्रमते गां(3) नमो नमः //
text_mt:
To the son of Kaśyapa, exceedingly diminutive, adorned with Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāma,
to you in the form of Vāmana who stride across the earth, reverence, reverence!

sanskrit_iast:
varāhāśeṣaduṣṭāni sarvapāpaphalāni vai /
marda marda mahādaṃṣṭra marda marda ca tatphalam //
:n
1 akhaṇḍitātmabhāvaistvamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 daṃṣṭroddhṛtabhūmibhartre iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 sṛjate gāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 88
meaning:
वराहाशेषदुष्टानि सर्वपापफलानि वै /
मर्द मर्द महादंष्ट्र मर्द मर्द च तत्फलम् //
:न्
1 अखण्डितात्मभावैस्त्वमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 दंष्ट्रोद्धृतभूमिभर्त्रे इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 सृजते गामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 88
text_mt:
O Boar, crush, crush, O great-tusked one, crush, crush all wicked things,
all fruits of sin, and the consequences thereof!
[Footnote]
[Variant] “with unbroken self-nature, you” is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
[Variant] “to the supporter of the earth raised on the tusk” is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
[Variant] “who emits the earth” is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.

sanskrit_iast:
narasiṃha karālākhya dantaprāntānalojjvala /
bhañja bhañja ninādena duṣṭānyasyārtināśana //
meaning:
नरसिंह करालाख्य दन्तप्रान्तानलोज्ज्वल /
भञ्ज भञ्ज निनादेन दुष्टान्यस्यार्तिनाशन //
text_mt:
O Narasiṃha, named the Terrifying One, radiant with fire at the tips of your teeth,
break, break with your roar the wicked afflictions of this person, O destroyer of distress!

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgyajuḥsāmagarbhābhirvāgbhirvāmanarūpadhṛk /
praśamaṃ sarvaduḥkhāni nayattvasya janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
ऋग्यजुःसामगर्भाभिर्वाग्भिर्वामनरूपधृक् /
प्रशमं सर्वदुःखानि नयत्त्वस्य जनार्दनः //
text_mt:
Assuming the form of Vāmana, with words embodying the Ṛg, Yajus, and Sāman,
may Janārdana bring all the miseries of this person to cessation!

sanskrit_iast:
aikāhikaṃ dvyāhikañca tathā tridivasaṃ jvaram /
cāturthakantathātyugrantathaiva satatajvaram //
meaning:
ऐकाहिकं द्व्याहिकञ्च तथा त्रिदिवसं ज्वरम् /
चातुर्थकन्तथात्युग्रन्तथैव सततज्वरम् //
text_mt:
Fever recurring every day, every second day, or every third day,
as well as the extremely violent quartan fever, and continuous fever,

sanskrit_iast:
doṣotthaṃ sannipātotthaṃ tathaivāgantukaṃ jvaram /
śamaṃ nayāśu govinda cchindhi cchindhyasya vedanām(1) //
meaning:
दोषोत्थं सन्निपातोत्थं तथैवागन्तुकं ज्वरम् /
शमं नयाशु गोविन्द च्छिन्धि च्छिन्ध्यस्य वेदनाम्(1) //
text_mt:
fever born of humoral disturbance, born of combined humours, and also accidental fever—
bring them swiftly to peace, O Govinda; sever, sever his pain!

sanskrit_iast:
netraduḥkhaṃ śiroduḥkhaṃ duḥkhañcodarasambhavam /
antaḥśvāsamatiśvāsaṃ(2) paritāpaṃ savepathum //
meaning:
नेत्रदुःखं शिरोदुःखं दुःखञ्चोदरसम्भवम् /
अन्तःश्वासमतिश्वासं(2) परितापं सवेपथुम् //
text_mt:
Eye affliction, head affliction, affliction originating in the abdomen,
shortness of breath, excessive breathing, burning heat accompanied by trembling,

sanskrit_iast:
gudaghrāṇāṅghrirogāṃś ca kuṣṭharogāṃs tathā kṣayaṃ(3) /
kāmalādīṃs tathā rogān pramehāṃścātidāruṇān //
meaning:
गुदघ्राणाङ्घ्रिरोगांश् च कुष्ठरोगांस् तथा क्षयं(3) /
कामलादींस् तथा रोगान् प्रमेहांश्चातिदारुणान् //
text_mt:
diseases of the anus, nose, and feet, leprosy, consumption,
jaundice and other diseases, and exceedingly dreadful urinary disorders,

sanskrit_iast:
bhagandarātisārāṃś ca mukharogāṃś ca valgulīm /
aśmarīṃ mūtrakṛcchrāṃś ca rogānanyāṃś ca dāruṇān //
meaning:
भगन्दरातिसारांश् च मुखरोगांश् च वल्गुलीम् /
अश्मरीं मूत्रकृच्छ्रांश् च रोगानन्यांश् च दारुणान् //
text_mt:
fistula-in-ano, dysentery, mouth diseases, valgulī-disease,
urinary calculus, strangury, and other terrible diseases—

sanskrit_iast:
ye vātaprabhavā rogā ye ca pittasamudbhavāḥ /
kaphodbhavāś ca ye kecit ye cānye sānnipātikāḥ //
meaning:
ये वातप्रभवा रोगा ये च पित्तसमुद्भवाः /
कफोद्भवाश् च ये केचित् ये चान्ये सान्निपातिकाः //
text_mt:
those diseases that originate from wind, those that arise from bile,
whatever arise from phlegm, and those others born of combined humours,

sanskrit_iast:
āgantukāś ca ye rogā lūtā visphoṭakādayaḥ /
te sarve praśamaṃ yāntu vāsudevāpamārjitāḥ(5) //
meaning:
आगन्तुकाश् च ये रोगा लूता विस्फोटकादयः /
ते सर्वे प्रशमं यान्तु वासुदेवापमार्जिताः(5) //
text_mt:
and exogenous diseases such as spider poison, boils, and the like—
may all of them go to pacification, cleansed away by Vāsudeva!

sanskrit_iast:
vilayaṃ yāntu te sarve viṣṇoruccāraṇena ca /
kṣayaṃ gachhantu cāśeṣāste cakrābhihatā hareḥ //
:n
1 chinda chindāsya vedanāmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 aniśvāsamatiśvāsamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 tathaiva ca iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 ye rogāḥ pittasambhavā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 vāsudevaparājitā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 89
meaning:
विलयं यान्तु ते सर्वे विष्णोरुच्चारणेन च /
क्षयं गछ्हन्तु चाशेषास्ते चक्राभिहता हरेः //
:न्
1 छिन्द छिन्दास्य वेदनामिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अनिश्वासमतिश्वासमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 तथैव च इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 ये रोगाः पित्तसम्भवा इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 वासुदेवपराजिता इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 89
text_mt:
May they all dissolve away through the utterance of Viṣṇu's name;
and may they completely perish, struck by the discus of Hari!
[Footnote]
[Variant] “sever, sever his pain” is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
[Variant] “breathlessness and excessive breathing” is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
[Variant] “and likewise” is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
[Variant] “the diseases that arise from bile” is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
[Variant] “vanquished by Vāsudeva” is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.

sanskrit_iast:
acyutānantagovindanāmoccāraṇabhīṣitāḥ /
naśyanti sakalā rogāḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ vadāmyaham //
meaning:
अच्युतानन्तगोविन्दनामोच्चारणभीषिताः /
नश्यन्ति सकला रोगाः सत्यं सत्यं वदाम्यहम् //
text_mt:
Terrified by the utterance of the names Acyuta, Ananta, and Govinda,
all diseases perish; truly, truly do I say this.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ vāpi kṛtrimaṃ cāpi yadviṣam /
dantodbhavaṃ nakhabhavamākāśaprabhavaṃ viṣam //
meaning:
स्थावरं जङ्गमं वापि कृत्रिमं चापि यद्विषम् /
दन्तोद्भवं नखभवमाकाशप्रभवं विषम् //
text_mt:
Poison that is inanimate or animate, or also that which is artificial,
poison arising from fangs, arising from claws, or arising from the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
lūtādiprabhavaṃ yacca viṣamanyattu duḥkhadaṃ /
śamaṃ nayatu tat sarvaṃ kīrtitosya janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
लूतादिप्रभवं यच्च विषमन्यत्तु दुःखदं /
शमं नयतु तत् सर्वं कीर्तितोस्य जनार्दनः //
text_mt:
and whatever poison originates from spiders and the like, or any other that causes misery—
may Janārdana, being praised, bring all of that to cessation for him!

sanskrit_iast:
grahān pretagrahāṃścāpi tathā vai ḍākinīgrahān(1) /
vetālāṃś ca piśācāṃś ca gandharvān yakṣarākṣasān(2) //
meaning:
ग्रहान् प्रेतग्रहांश्चापि तथा वै डाकिनीग्रहान्(1) /
वेतालांश् च पिशाचांश् च गन्धर्वान् यक्षराक्षसान्(2) //
text_mt:
Seizing spirits, spirits of the dead, and also ḍākinī spirits,
vetālas, piśācas, gandharvas, yakṣas, and rākṣasas,

sanskrit_iast:
śakunīpūtanādyāṃś ca tathā vaināyakān grahān /
mukhamaṇḍīṃ tathā krūrāṃ revatīṃ vṛddharevatīm //
meaning:
शकुनीपूतनाद्यांश् च तथा वैनायकान् ग्रहान् /
मुखमण्डीं तथा क्रूरां रेवतीं वृद्धरेवतीम् //
text_mt:
the seizing spirits beginning with Śakunī and Pūtanā, and the seizing spirits of Vināyaka,
Mukhamaṇḍī, the cruel Revatī, and Vṛddharevatī,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhakākhyān grahāṃścogrāṃs tathā mātṛgrahānapi /
bālasya viṣṇoś caritaṃ hantu bālagrahānimān //
meaning:
वृद्धकाख्यान् ग्रहांश्चोग्रांस् तथा मातृग्रहानपि /
बालस्य विष्णोश् चरितं हन्तु बालग्रहानिमान् //
text_mt:
the fierce seizing spirits called Vṛddhaka, and also the mother spirits—
may the deeds of child Viṣṇu slay these child-afflicting spirits!

sanskrit_iast:
vṛddhāś ca ye grahāḥ kecidye ca bālagrahāḥ kvacit /
narasiṃhasya te dṛṣṭyā dagdhā ye cāpi yauvane //
meaning:
वृद्धाश् च ये ग्रहाः केचिद्ये च बालग्रहाः क्वचित् /
नरसिंहस्य ते दृष्ट्या दग्धा ये चापि यौवने //
text_mt:
And whatever spirits afflict the aged, and whatever spirits afflict children anywhere,
and also those in youth, are burned by the glance of Narasiṃha.

sanskrit_iast:
sadā(3) karālavadano narasiṃho mahābalaḥ /
grahānaśeṣānniḥśeṣān karotu jagato hitaḥ //
meaning:
सदा(3) करालवदनो नरसिंहो महाबलः /
ग्रहानशेषान्निःशेषान् करोतु जगतो हितः //
text_mt:
May the terrifying-faced Narasiṃha of great power, who works the welfare of the world,
wholly eliminate all seizing spirits without remainder!

sanskrit_iast:
narasiṃha mahāsiṃha jvālāmālojjvalānana /
grahānaśeṣān sarveśa khāda khādāgnilocana //
meaning:
नरसिंह महासिंह ज्वालामालोज्ज्वलानन /
ग्रहानशेषान् सर्वेश खाद खादाग्निलोचन //
text_mt:
O Narasiṃha, great Lion, whose face is ablaze with garlands of flames,
O fire-eyed Lord of all, devour, devour all seizing spirits!

sanskrit_iast:
ye rogā ye mahotpātā yadviṣaṃ ye mahāgrahāḥ /
yāni ca krūrabhṛtāni grahapīḍāś ca dāruṇāḥ //
meaning:
ये रोगा ये महोत्पाता यद्विषं ये महाग्रहाः /
यानि च क्रूरभृतानि ग्रहपीडाश् च दारुणाः //
text_mt:
Whatever diseases, whatever great portents, whatever poison, whatever great seizing spirits,
and whatever cruel beings and dreadful afflictions of planets there are,

sanskrit_iast:
śastrakṣateṣu ye doṣā jvālāgardabhakādayaḥ /
tāni sarvāṇi sarvātmā paramātmā janārdanaḥ //
:n
1 tathā vetālikān grahāniti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 gandharvān rāksasānapi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 śaṭā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 90
meaning:
शस्त्रक्षतेषु ये दोषा ज्वालागर्दभकादयः /
तानि सर्वाणि सर्वात्मा परमात्मा जनार्दनः //
:न्
1 तथा वेतालिकान् ग्रहानिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गन्धर्वान् राक्ससानपि इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 शटा इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 90
text_mt:
whatever disorders arise in weapon-wounds, such as erysipelas and the like—
all those, Janārdana, the Self of all, the Supreme Self,
[Footnote]
[Variant] “and likewise the vetālika seizing spirits” is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
[Variant] “gandharvas and rākṣasas as well” is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
[Variant] “with manes” is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.

sanskrit_iast: kiñcidrūpaṃ samāsyāya vāsudevāsya nāśaya //37//
meaning: किञ्चिद्रूपं समास्याय वासुदेवास्य नाशय //37//
text_mt: assuming some form, O Vāsudeva, destroy for him! // 37

sanskrit_iast:
kṣiptvā sudarśanañ cakraṃ jvālāmālātibhīṣaṇam /
sarvaduṣṭopaśamanaṃ kuru devavarācyuta //
meaning:
क्षिप्त्वा सुदर्शनञ् चक्रं ज्वालामालातिभीषणम् /
सर्वदुष्टोपशमनं कुरु देववराच्युत //
text_mt:
Hurling the Sudarśana discus, exceedingly terrifying with garlands of flames,
bring about the pacification of all wicked things, O best of gods, O Acyuta!

sanskrit_iast:
sudarśana mahājvāla cchindhi cchindhi mahārava(1) /
sarvaduṣṭāni rakṣāṃsi kṣayaṃ yāntu vibhīṣaṇa //
meaning:
सुदर्शन महाज्वाल च्छिन्धि च्छिन्धि महारव(1) /
सर्वदुष्टानि रक्षांसि क्षयं यान्तु विभीषण //
text_mt:
O Sudarśana of great blaze, sever, sever, O loud-roaring one!
May all wicked rākṣasas meet destruction, O terrifying one!

sanskrit_iast:
prācyāṃ pratīcyāṃ ca diśi dakṣiṇottaratas tathā /
rakṣāṅkarotu sarvātmā narasiṃhaḥ sugarjitaḥ(2) //
meaning:
प्राच्यां प्रतीच्यां च दिशि दक्षिणोत्तरतस् तथा /
रक्षाङ्करोतु सर्वात्मा नरसिंहः सुगर्जितः(2) //
text_mt: In the east and in the west, likewise in the south and in the north, / may Narasiṃha, who has a noble roar and is the soul of all, grant protection.

sanskrit_iast:
divi bhuvyantarīkṣe ca pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvatogrataḥ /
rakṣāṅkarotu bhagavān bahurūpī janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
दिवि भुव्यन्तरीक्षे च पृष्ठतः पार्श्वतोग्रतः /
रक्षाङ्करोतु भगवान् बहुरूपी जनार्दनः //
text_mt: In heaven, on earth, and in intermediate space, behind, at the sides, and in front, / may the Blessed Janārdana of many forms grant protection.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā viṣṇurjagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣaṃ /
tena satyena duṣṭāni śamamasya vrajantu vai(3) //
meaning:
यथा विष्णुर्जगत्सर्वं सदेवासुरमानुषं /
तेन सत्येन दुष्टानि शममस्य व्रजन्तु वै(3) //
text_mt: Just as Viṣṇu is the entire world with its gods, asuras, and humans, / by that truth, may his misfortunes indeed come to peace.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā viṣṇau smṛte sadyaḥ saṅkṣayaṃ yānti pātakāḥ /
satyena tena sakalaṃ duṣṭamasya praśāmyatu //
meaning:
यथा विष्णौ स्मृते सद्यः सङ्क्षयं यान्ति पातकाः /
सत्येन तेन सकलं दुष्टमस्य प्रशाम्यतु //
text_mt: Just as sins perish immediately when Viṣṇu is remembered, / by that truth, may all evil of his be pacified.

sanskrit_iast:
paramātmā yathā viṣṇurvedānteṣu ca gīyate /
tena satyena sakalaṃ duṣṭamasya praśāmyatu //
meaning:
परमात्मा यथा विष्णुर्वेदान्तेषु च गीयते /
तेन सत्येन सकलं दुष्टमस्य प्रशाम्यतु //
text_mt: Just as Viṣṇu is sung as the supreme Self in the Upaniṣads, / by that truth, may all evil of his be pacified.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā yajñeśvaro viṣṇurdeveṣvapi hi gīyate /
satyena tena sakalaṃ yanmayoktaṃ tathāstu tat //
meaning:
यथा यज्ञेश्वरो विष्णुर्देवेष्वपि हि गीयते /
सत्येन तेन सकलं यन्मयोक्तं तथास्तु तत् //
text_mt: Just as Viṣṇu is celebrated as the lord of sacrifice among the gods, / by that truth, may everything that I have spoken come to pass.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntirastu śivañcāstu duṣṭamasya praśāmyatu /
vāsudevaśarīrotthaiḥ kuśair nirmathitaṃ mayā(4) //
meaning:
शान्तिरस्तु शिवञ्चास्तु दुष्टमस्य प्रशाम्यतु /
वासुदेवशरीरोत्थैः कुशैर् निर्मथितं मया(4) //
text_mt: May there be peace, may there be auspiciousness, may his misfortune be pacified! / It has been stirred away by me with kuśa grass sprung from Vāsudeva's body.

sanskrit_iast:
apamārjatu govindo naro nārāyaṇas tathā /
tathāstu sarvaduḥkhānāṃ praśamo japanāddhareḥ //
:n
1 mahābala iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 svargarjitair iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 prayāntu vai iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 kuśair nirṇāśitamiti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 91
meaning:
अपमार्जतु गोविन्दो नरो नारायणस् तथा /
तथास्तु सर्वदुःखानां प्रशमो जपनाद्धरेः //
:न्
1 महाबल इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्वर्गर्जितैर् इति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 प्रयान्तु वै इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 कुशैर् निर्णाशितमिति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 91
text_mt:
May Govinda, Nara, and likewise Nārāyaṇa wipe [it] away. / May all afflictions thus be pacified by recitation of Hari's name.
[Footnote]
1. "mahābala" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "svargarjitaiḥ" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and ṅa.
3. "prayāntu vai" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
4. "kuśair nirṇāśitam" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga. / [Page 91]

sanskrit_iast:
apamārjanakaṃ śastraṃ sarvarogādivāraṇam /
ayaṃ hariḥ kuśo viṣṇurhatā rogā mayā tava //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye kuśāpamārjanaṃ nāma ekatriṃśo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha dvātiṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
saṃskārakathanaṃ
meaning:
अपमार्जनकं शस्त्रं सर्वरोगादिवारणम् /
अयं हरिः कुशो विष्णुर्हता रोगा मया तव //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये कुशापमार्जनं नाम एकत्रिंशो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ द्वातिंशो ऽध्यायः
संस्कारकथनं
text_mt:
The wiping [rite] is a weapon that wards off all diseases and ailments. / This Hari, the kuśa grass, is Viṣṇu; your diseases have been destroyed by me.
Thus in the primal Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the thirty-first chapter, entitled "Kuśāpamārjana".
Now the thirty-second chapter:
Account of the Saṃskāras

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
nirvāṇādiṣu dīkṣāsu cattvāriṃśattathāṣṭa ca /
saṃskārān kārayeddhīmān śṛṇutānyaiḥ suro bhavet //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
निर्वाणादिषु दीक्षासु चत्त्वारिंशत्तथाष्ट च /
संस्कारान् कारयेद्धीमान् शृणुतान्यैः सुरो भवेत् //
text_mt: Agni said: / In the liberating and other initiations, a wise man should perform forty-eight / saṃskāras. Listen to those by which one becomes a god.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhādhānantu yonyāṃ vai tataḥ puṃsavanañcaret /
sīmantonnayanañcaiva jātakarma ca nāma ca //
meaning:
गर्भाधानन्तु योन्यां वै ततः पुंसवनञ्चरेत् /
सीमन्तोन्नयनञ्चैव जातकर्म च नाम च //
text_mt: One should perform the conception rite in the womb, then the puṃsavana rite, / the parting of the hair, the birth rite, and the naming rite,

sanskrit_iast:
annāśanaṃ tataścūḍā brahmacaryavratāni ca /
catvāri vaiṣṇavī pārthī bhautikī śrotrikī tathā //
meaning:
अन्नाशनं ततश्चूडा ब्रह्मचर्यव्रतानि च /
चत्वारि वैष्णवी पार्थी भौतिकी श्रोत्रिकी तथा //
text_mt: first feeding of food, then tonsure, and the four observances of studentship: / Vaiṣṇavī, Pārthī, Bhautikī, and Śrotrikī,

sanskrit_iast:
godānaṃ sūtakatvañca pākayajñāś ca sapta te(1) /
aṣṭakā pārvaṇaśrāddhaṃ śrāvaṇyagrāyaṇīti ca //
meaning:
गोदानं सूतकत्वञ्च पाकयज्ञाश् च सप्त ते(1) /
अष्टका पार्वणश्राद्धं श्रावण्यग्रायणीति च //
text_mt: the gift of a cow, and the end of birth-impurity; and these are the seven cooked sacrifices: / the aṣṭakā, the pārvaṇaśrāddha, the śrāvaṇī, the āgrayaṇī,

sanskrit_iast:
caitrī cāśvayujī sapta haviryajñāṃś ca tān śṛṇu /
ādhānañcāgnihotrañca darśo vai paurṇamāsakaḥ //
meaning:
चैत्री चाश्वयुजी सप्त हविर्यज्ञांश् च तान् शृणु /
आधानञ्चाग्निहोत्रञ्च दर्शो वै पौर्णमासकः //
text_mt: the caitrī, and the āśvayujī. And listen to those seven oblation sacrifices: / the establishment of the sacred fire, the agnihotra, the new moon sacrifice, the full moon sacrifice,

sanskrit_iast:
cāturmāsyaṃ paśubandhaḥ sautrāmaṇirathāparaḥ /
somasaṃsthāḥ sapta śṛṇu agniṣṭomaḥ kratūttamaḥ //
meaning:
चातुर्मास्यं पशुबन्धः सौत्रामणिरथापरः /
सोमसंस्थाः सप्त शृणु अग्निष्टोमः क्रतूत्तमः //
text_mt: the cāturmāsya, the animal sacrifice, and then another, the sautrāmaṇī. / Hear the seven forms of the soma sacrifice: the agniṣṭoma, the best of sacrifices,

sanskrit_iast:
atyagniṣṭoma ukthaś ca ṣoḍaśo vājapeyakaḥ /
atirātrāptoryāmaś ca sahasreśāḥ savā ime //
meaning:
अत्यग्निष्टोम उक्थश् च षोडशो वाजपेयकः /
अतिरात्राप्तोर्यामश् च सहस्रेशाः सवा इमे //
text_mt: the atyagniṣṭoma, the ukthya, the ṣoḍaśin, the vājapeya, / the atirātra, and the āptoryāma. These are the savas, lords of thousands:

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyāṅghrirhiraṇyākṣo hiraṇyamitra ity ataḥ /
:n
1 sapta ca iti ga, kha, cihnitapustkadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 92
hiraṇyapāṇirhemākṣo hemāṅgo hemasūtrakaḥ //
meaning:
हिरण्याङ्घ्रिर्हिरण्याक्षो हिरण्यमित्र इत्य् अतः /
:न्
1 सप्त च इति ग, ख, चिह्नितपुस्त्कद्वयपाठः
:प् 92
हिरण्यपाणिर्हेमाक्षो हेमाङ्गो हेमसूत्रकः //
text_mt:
the hiraṇyāṅghri, the hiraṇyākṣa, and therefore the hiraṇyamitra,
[Footnote]
1. "sapta ca" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and kha. / [Page 92]
the hiraṇyapāṇi, the hemākṣa, the hemāṅga, the hemasūtraka,

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyāsyo hiraṇyāṅgo hemajihvo hiraṇyavān /
aśvamedho hi sarveśo guṇāścāṣṭātha tān śṛṇu //
meaning:
हिरण्यास्यो हिरण्याङ्गो हेमजिह्वो हिरण्यवान् /
अश्वमेधो हि सर्वेशो गुणाश्चाष्टाथ तान् शृणु //
text_mt: the hiraṇyāsya, the hiraṇyāṅga, the hemajihva, and the hiraṇyavat; / indeed, the horse sacrifice is the lord of all. Now hear those eight virtues:

sanskrit_iast:
dayā ca sarvabhūteṣu kṣāntiś caiva tathārjavam /
śaucaṃ caivamanāyāso maṅgalaṃ cāparo guṇaḥ //
meaning:
दया च सर्वभूतेषु क्षान्तिश् चैव तथार्जवम् /
शौचं चैवमनायासो मङ्गलं चापरो गुणः //
text_mt: compassion toward all beings, patience, uprightness, / purity, freedom from anxiety, and another virtue is auspiciousness,

sanskrit_iast:
akārpaṇyañcāspṛhā ca mūlena juhuyācchatam /
sauraśākteyaviṣṇvīśadīkṣāstvete samāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अकार्पण्यञ्चास्पृहा च मूलेन जुहुयाच्छतम् /
सौरशाक्तेयविष्ण्वीशदीक्षास्त्वेते समाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: absence of stinginess, and desirelessness. One should make one hundred oblations with the root mantra. / These initiations of Sūrya, Śakti, Viṣṇu, and Śiva are considered equal.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃskāraiḥ saṃskṛtaś caitair bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
sarvarogādvinirmukto devavadvartate naraḥ /
japyāddhomātpūjanācca dhyānāddevasya ceṣṭabhāk //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye aṣṭacatvāriṃśatsaṃskārakathanaṃ
nāma dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha trayastriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
pavitrārohaṇavidhānaṃ
meaning:
संस्कारैः संस्कृतश् चैतैर् भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् /
सर्वरोगाद्विनिर्मुक्तो देववद्वर्तते नरः /
जप्याद्धोमात्पूजनाच्च ध्यानाद्देवस्य चेष्टभाक् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये अष्टचत्वारिंशत्संस्कारकथनं
नाम द्वात्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
पवित्रारोहणविधानं
text_mt:
Consecrated by these saṃskāras, one obtains worldly enjoyment and liberation; / freed from all disease, a man lives like a god; / through recitation, fire oblation, worship, and meditation on the deity, he attains his desires.
Thus in the primal Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the thirty-second chapter, entitled "Account of the Forty-Eight Saṃskāras".
Now the thirty-third chapter:
Rule for the Investiture with the Sacred Thread

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
pavitrārohaṇaṃ vakṣye varṣapūjākalaṃ hareḥ /
āṣāḍhādau kārtikānte pratipadvanadā tithiḥ(1) //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
पवित्रारोहणं वक्ष्ये वर्षपूजाकलं हरेः /
आषाढादौ कार्तिकान्ते प्रतिपद्वनदा तिथिः(1) //
text_mt: Agni said: / I will explain the investiture with the sacred thread, yielding the fruit of a year's worship of Hari. / From Āṣāḍha onwards to the end of Kārtika, the lunar days bestow wealth:

sanskrit_iast:
śriyā gauryā gaṇeśasya sarasvatyā guhasya ca /
mārtaṇḍamātṛdurgāṇāṃ nāgarṣiharimanmathaiḥ //
meaning:
श्रिया गौर्या गणेशस्य सरस्वत्या गुहस्य च /
मार्तण्डमातृदुर्गाणां नागर्षिहरिमन्मथैः //
text_mt: for Śrī, Gaurī, Gaṇeśa, Sarasvatī, and Guha, / for the Sun, the Mothers, the Durgās, the serpent deities, the sages, Hari, and Manmatha,

sanskrit_iast:
śivasya brahmaṇastadvaddvitīyādititheḥ kramāt /
yasya devasya yo bhaktaḥ pavitrā tasya sā tithiḥ //
meaning:
शिवस्य ब्रह्मणस्तद्वद्द्वितीयादितिथेः क्रमात् /
यस्य देवस्य यो भक्तः पवित्रा तस्य सा तिथिः //
text_mt: likewise for Śiva and Brahmā, in the order of lunar days beginning with the second lunar day. / The sacred thread belongs to whatever deity one is devoted to, on that lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
ārohaṇe tulyavidhiḥ pṛthak mantrādikaṃ yadi /
:n
1 vardhate tithiriti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 93
sauvarṇe rājataṃ tāmraṃ netrakārpāsikādikaṃ //
meaning:
आरोहणे तुल्यविधिः पृथक् मन्त्रादिकं यदि /
:न्
1 वर्धते तिथिरिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 93
सौवर्णे राजतं ताम्रं नेत्रकार्पासिकादिकं //
text_mt:
The ritual is identical in the investiture, even if mantras and the like are separate.
[Footnote]
1. "vardhate tithiḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [Page 93]
[It may be made] of gold, silver, copper, silk, cotton, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇyā kartitaṃ sūtraṃ tadalābhe tu saṃskṛtaṃ /
triguṇaṃ triguṇīkṛtya tena kuryāt pavitrakaṃ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मण्या कर्तितं सूत्रं तदलाभे तु संस्कृतं /
त्रिगुणं त्रिगुणीकृत्य तेन कुर्यात् पवित्रकं //
text_mt: Thread spun by a Brahmin woman, or consecrated if that is unavailable, / having tripled it and tripled it again, one should make the sacred thread with it.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣtottaraśatādūrdhvaṃ tadardhaṃ cottamādikaṃ /
kriyālopāvighātārthaṃ yattvayābhihitaṃ prabho //
meaning:
अष्तोत्तरशतादूर्ध्वं तदर्धं चोत्तमादिकं /
क्रियालोपाविघातार्थं यत्त्वयाभिहितं प्रभो //
text_mt: Above one hundred and eight [threads], and half that, are the best and middle kinds. / "O Lord, for the purpose of removing impediments from defects in the rite, that which was declared by You,

sanskrit_iast:
mayā tat kriyate deva yathā yatra pāvitrakaṃ /
avighnaṃ tu bhavedatra kuru nātha jayāvyaya //
meaning:
मया तत् क्रियते देव यथा यत्र पावित्रकं /
अविघ्नं तु भवेदत्र कुरु नाथ जयाव्यय //
text_mt: that is being performed by me, O God, as and where the sacred thread [is offered]. / Let there be no obstacle here; make it so, O victorious and imperishable Master!"

sanskrit_iast:
prārthya tanmaṇḍalāyādau gāyatryā bandhayennaraḥ /
oṃ nārāyaṇāya vidmahe vāsudevāya dhīmahi //
meaning:
प्रार्थ्य तन्मण्डलायादौ गायत्र्या बन्धयेन्नरः /
ओं नारायणाय विद्महे वासुदेवाय धीमहि //
text_mt: Having prayed thus to the maṇḍala at first, a man should tie it with the Gāyatrī: / "Om, we know Nārāyaṇa; we meditate on Vāsudeva;

sanskrit_iast:
tanno viṣṇuḥ pracodayāt devadevānurūpataḥ /
jānūrunābhināmāntaṃ pratimāsu pavitrakaṃ //
meaning:
तन्नो विष्णुः प्रचोदयात् देवदेवानुरूपतः /
जानूरुनाभिनामान्तं प्रतिमासु पवित्रकं //
text_mt: may that Viṣṇu impel us." According to the deity of deities, / the sacred thread on images should reach to the knees, thighs, or navel.

sanskrit_iast:
pādāntā vanamālā syādaṣṭottrasahasrataḥ(1) /
mālā tu kalpasādhyaṃ vā dviguṇaṃ ṣoḍaśāṅgulāt //
meaning:
पादान्ता वनमाला स्यादष्टोत्त्रसहस्रतः(1) /
माला तु कल्पसाध्यं वा द्विगुणं षोडशाङ्गुलात् //
text_mt: Reaching to the feet, it is a forest garland, made of a thousand and eight [threads]; / or the garland may be made according to ritual rule, double that of sixteen finger-breadths.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikā keśaraṃ patraṃ mantrādyaṃ(2) maṇḍalāntakaṃ /
maṇḍalāṅgulamātraikacakrābjādyau(3) pavitrakaṃ //
meaning:
कर्णिका केशरं पत्रं मन्त्राद्यं(2) मण्डलान्तकं /
मण्डलाङ्गुलमात्रैकचक्राब्जाद्यौ(3) पवित्रकं //
text_mt: From the pericarp, filaments, petals, beginning with mantras, up to the end of the maṇḍala; / the sacred thread for the discus, lotus, and others is merely the finger-breadths of the maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
sthaṇḍile 'ṅgulamānena ātmanaḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ /
ācāryāṇāṃ ca sūtrāṇi pitṛmātrādipustake //
meaning:
स्थण्डिले ऽङ्गुलमानेन आत्मनः सप्तविंशतिः /
आचार्याणां च सूत्राणि पितृमात्रादिपुस्तके //
text_mt: On an altar, by measure of finger-breadths, twenty-seven for oneself; / and the threads for teachers, on books of parents and others,

sanskrit_iast:
nābhyantaṃ dvādaśagranthiṃ tathā gandhapavitrake /
dvyaṅgulāt kalpanādau dvirmālā cāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ //
meaning:
नाभ्यन्तं द्वादशग्रन्थिं तथा गन्धपवित्रके /
द्व्यङ्गुलात् कल्पनादौ द्विर्माला चाष्टोत्तरं शतं //
text_mt: reaching to the navel, with twelve knots, likewise in the fragrant sacred thread. / In making it two finger-breadths from the beginning, the double garland has one hundred and eight [knots],

sanskrit_iast:
athavārkacaturviṃśaṣaḍtriṃśanmālikā dvijaḥ /
anāmāmadhyamāṅguṣṭhair mandādyaiḥ mālikārthibhiḥ (4) //
:n
1 pādāntareṇa mālā syādaṣṭottarasahasraśaḥ iti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 gadādyamiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 cakrāṅgadau pavitrake iti gha, cihnitaputakapāṭhaḥ
4 mandādau iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ mandrādyair iti gha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 94
meaning:
अथवार्कचतुर्विंशषड्त्रिंशन्मालिका द्विजः /
अनामामध्यमाङ्गुष्ठैर् मन्दाद्यैः मालिकार्थिभिः (4) //
:न्
1 पादान्तरेण माला स्यादष्टोत्तरसहस्रशः इति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गदाद्यमिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 चक्राङ्गदौ पवित्रके इति घ, चिह्नितपुतकपाठः
4 मन्दादौ इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः मन्द्राद्यैर् इति घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 94
text_mt:
or a twice-born person may make a garland of twelve, twenty-four, or thirty-six [knots], / using the ring finger, middle finger, and thumb, by those seeking garlands from slow [recitation] and so on.
[Footnote]
1. "pādāntareṇa mālā syādaṣṭottarasahasraśaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2. "gadādyam" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
3. "cakrāṅgadau pavitrake" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
4. "mandādau" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga; "mandrādyaiḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha. / [Page 94]

sanskrit_iast:
kaniṣṭādau dvādaśa vā granthayaḥ syuḥ pavitrake /
raveḥ kumbhahutāśādeḥ sambhave viṣṇuvanmatam //
meaning:
कनिष्टादौ द्वादश वा ग्रन्थयः स्युः पवित्रके /
रवेः कुम्भहुताशादेः सम्भवे विष्णुवन्मतम् //
text_mt: Or there may be twelve knots in the sacred thread, beginning from the little finger. / In the presence of the Sun, the water-pot, the fire, and so forth, the view is that it is like that of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhasya pīṭhamānaṃ syānmekhalānte ca kuṇḍakaṃ /
yathāśakti sūtragranthiparicāretha vaiṣṇave //
meaning:
पीठस्य पीठमानं स्यान्मेखलान्ते च कुण्डकं /
यथाशक्ति सूत्रग्रन्थिपरिचारेथ वैष्णवे //
text_mt: The size of the pedestal should be the measure of the altar, and a small pit at the end of the belt, / according to capacity, in the attendant service of the cord-knots in the Vaiṣṇava rite.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtrāṇi vā saptadaśa sūtreṇa trivibhaktake(1) /
rocanāgurukarpūraharidrākuṅkumādibhiḥ //
meaning:
सूत्राणि वा सप्तदश सूत्रेण त्रिविभक्तके(1) /
रोचनागुरुकर्पूरहरिद्राकुङ्कुमादिभिः //
text_mt: Or seventeen threads, divided threefold by a thread; / with rocanā, agallochum, camphor, turmeric, saffron, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
rañjayeccandanādyair vā snānasandhyādikṛnnaraḥ /
ekādaśyāṃ yāgagṛhe bhagavantaṃ hariṃ jayet //
meaning:
रञ्जयेच्चन्दनाद्यैर् वा स्नानसन्ध्यादिकृन्नरः /
एकादश्यां यागगृहे भगवन्तं हरिं जयेत् //
text_mt: or with sandal paste and the like, a man, having performed his bath, twilight prayers, and other rites, should dye [them]. / On the eleventh lunar day, in the sacrificial hall, he should worship the Lord Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
samastaparivārāya baliṃ pīṭhe samarcayet /
kṣyauṃ kṣetrapālāya dvārānte dvāropari tathā śriyaṃ //
meaning:
समस्तपरिवाराय बलिं पीठे समर्चयेत् /
क्ष्यौं क्षेत्रपालाय द्वारान्ते द्वारोपरि तथा श्रियं //
text_mt: He should offer bali on the pedestal to the entire retinue: / with "Kṣyauṃ to Kṣetrapāla" at the door, and above the door to Śrī likewise;

sanskrit_iast:
dhātre dakṣe vidhātre ca gaṅgāñca yamunāṃ tathā /
śaṅkhapadmanidhī pūjya madhye vāstvapasāraṇaṃ //
sāraṅgāyeti bhūtānāṃ bhūtaśuddhiṃ sthitaś caret //
oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(2) gandhatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi
namaḥ ||
oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(3) rasatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi
namaḥ
oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(4) rūpatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi
namaḥ ||
oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(5) sparśatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi
namaḥ
:n
1 trisūtrāṇi ca bhadrake iti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hūṃ haḥ phaṭ hūmiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ oṃ hrāṃ
haḥ phaṭ hrūmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hrīṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 oṃ hrāṃ haḥ hrūṃ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ oṃ hrāṃ
haḥ phaṭ hrīmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 oṃ hrāṃ haḥ phaṭ iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 95
oṃ hrūṃ haḥ phaṭ hrūṃ(1) śabdatanmātraṃ saṃharāmi
namaḥ ||
meaning:
धात्रे दक्षे विधात्रे च गङ्गाञ्च यमुनां तथा /
शङ्खपद्मनिधी पूज्य मध्ये वास्त्वपसारणं //
सारङ्गायेति भूतानां भूतशुद्धिं स्थितश् चरेत् //

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ bhīṣaya bhīṣaya hṛt śirastrāsaya vai punaḥ /
mardaya mardaya śikhā agnyādau śastratostrakaṃ //
meaning:
ओं भीषय भीषय हृत् शिरस्त्रासय वै पुनः /
मर्दय मर्दय शिखा अग्न्यादौ शस्त्रतोस्त्रकं //
text_mt: "Oṃ terrify, terrify!" to the heart; "Frighten!" then to the head; / "Crush, crush!" to the tuft of hair; in the directions beginning with fire, the weapon with the weapon [mantra]:

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣa rakṣa pradhvaṃsaya pradhvaṃsaya kavacāya(2) namastataḥ /
oṃ hrūṃ(3) phaṭ astrāya namo mūlavījena cāṅgakaṃ //
meaning:
रक्ष रक्ष प्रध्वंसय प्रध्वंसय कवचाय(2) नमस्ततः /
ओं ह्रूं(3) फट् अस्त्राय नमो मूलवीजेन चाङ्गकं //
text_mt: "Protect, protect, destroy, destroy! Homage to the armor!" then; / "Oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ, homage to the weapon!", and the limb[-nyāsa] with the root seed-syllable.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvadakṣāpyasaumyeṣu mūrtyāvaraṇamarcayet /
vāsudevaḥ saṅkarṣaṇaḥ pradyumnaścāniruddhakaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वदक्षाप्यसौम्येषु मूर्त्यावरणमर्चयेत् /
वासुदेवः सङ्कर्षणः प्रद्युम्नश्चानिरुद्धकः //
text_mt: In the east, south, west, and north, one should worship the enclosure of icons: / Vāsudeva, Saṅkarṣaṇa, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha.

sanskrit_iast:
agnyādau śrīdhṛtiratikāntayo mūrtayo hareḥ /
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmamagnyādau pūrvakādikaṃ //
meaning:
अग्न्यादौ श्रीधृतिरतिकान्तयो मूर्तयो हरेः /
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्ममग्न्यादौ पूर्वकादिकं //
text_mt: Beginning with the south-east [are] Hari's icons Śrī, Dhṛti, Rati, and Kānti. / Beginning with the east [and south-east are] the conch, discus, mace, and lotus;

sanskrit_iast:
śārṅgañca muṣalaṃ khaḍgaṃ vanamālāñca tadvahiḥ /
indrādyāś ca tayānanto nairṛtyāṃ varuṇastataḥ //
meaning:
शार्ङ्गञ्च मुषलं खड्गं वनमालाञ्च तद्वहिः /
इन्द्राद्याश् च तयानन्तो नैरृत्यां वरुणस्ततः //
text_mt: outside of that, the Śārṅga bow, the pestle, the sword, and the forest garland. / Indra and the other [guardians], and along with them Ananta; then Varuṇa in the south-west;

sanskrit_iast:
brahmendreśānayormadhye astrāvaraṇakaṃ vahiḥ /
airāvatastataśchāgo mahiṣo vānaro jhaṣaḥ //
:n
1 gaṇaś ca tāsu pūjyo 'tha iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 rakṣa rakṣa pradhvaṃsaya kavacāyeti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 oṃ hrīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 98
meaning:
ब्रह्मेन्द्रेशानयोर्मध्ये अस्त्रावरणकं वहिः /
ऐरावतस्ततश्छागो महिषो वानरो झषः //
:न्
1 गणश् च तासु पूज्यो ऽथ इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 रक्ष रक्ष प्रध्वंसय कवचायेति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ओं ह्रीमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 98
text_mt:
Brahmā between Indra and Īśāna; outside [is] the enclosure of weapons. / Then Airāvata, a goat, a buffalo, a monkey, a fish,
:n
1. "gaṇaś ca tāsu pūjyo 'tha" is the variant reading in manuscript ṅa.
2. "rakṣa rakṣa pradhvaṃsaya kavacāya" is the variant reading in manuscript ṅa.
3. "oṃ hrīm" is the variant reading in manuscript kha. / :p 98

sanskrit_iast:
mṛgaḥ śaśo 'tha vṛṣabhaḥ kūrmo haṃsastato vahiḥ /
pṛśnigarbhaḥ kumudādyā dvārapālā dvayaṃ dvayaṃ //
meaning:
मृगः शशो ऽथ वृषभः कूर्मो हंसस्ततो वहिः /
पृश्निगर्भः कुमुदाद्या द्वारपाला द्वयं द्वयं //
text_mt: a deer, a hare, then a bull, a tortoise, a swan; then outside / are Pṛśnigarbha, Kumuda, and others—the door-keepers in pairs.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādyuttaradvārāntaṃ hariṃ natvā baliṃ vahiḥ /
viṣṇupārṣadebhyo namo balipīṭhe baliṃ dadet //
meaning:
पूर्वाद्युत्तरद्वारान्तं हरिं नत्वा बलिं वहिः /
विष्णुपार्षदेभ्यो नमो बलिपीठे बलिं ददेत् //
text_mt: From the eastern entrance to the northern entrance, having bowed to Hari, outside / one should offer an oblation on the oblation pedestal, [saying,] 'Homage to the attendants of Viṣṇu.'

sanskrit_iast:
viśvāya viśvaksenātmane īśānake yajet /
devasya dakṣiṇe haste rakṣāsūtrañca bandhayet //
meaning:
विश्वाय विश्वक्सेनात्मने ईशानके यजेत् /
देवस्य दक्षिणे हस्ते रक्षासूत्रञ्च बन्धयेत् //
text_mt: In the north-east one should worship [him] as Viśvaksena, whose self is the universe. / One should bind a protective thread on the right hand of the god:

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsarakṛtācāryāḥ sampūrṇaphaladāyine /
pavitrārohaṇāyedaṃ kautukaṃ dhāraya oṃ namaḥ //
meaning:
संवत्सरकृताचार्याः सम्पूर्णफलदायिने /
पवित्रारोहणायेदं कौतुकं धारय ओं नमः //
text_mt: 'O teacher [of rites] performed through the year, who grants complete fruit, / wear this festive cord for the investiture with sacred thread! Oṃ homage!'

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsādiniyamaṃ kuryādvai devasannidhau /
upavāsādiniyato devaṃ santoṣayāmyaham //
meaning:
उपवासादिनियमं कुर्याद्वै देवसन्निधौ /
उपवासादिनियतो देवं सन्तोषयाम्यहम् //
text_mt: One should undertake the observance of fasting and the like in the presence of the god: / 'Observant of fasting and other [disciplines], I please the god.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmakrodhādayaḥ sarve mā me tiṣṭhantu sarvathā /
adyaprabhṛti deveśa yāvadvaiśeṣikaṃ dinam //
meaning:
कामक्रोधादयः सर्वे मा मे तिष्ठन्तु सर्वथा /
अद्यप्रभृति देवेश यावद्वैशेषिकं दिनम् //
text_mt: May lust, anger, and all others never abide in me / from this day forward, O Lord of gods, until the special day!'

sanskrit_iast:
yajamāno hy aśaktaścet kuryānnaktādikaṃ vratī /
hutvā visarjayet stutvā śrīkarannityapūjanam //
oṃ hrīṃ(1) śrīṃ śrīdharāya trailokyamohanāya namaḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pavitrārohaṇe
śrīdharanityapūjākathanaṃ nāma trayastriṃśodhyāyaḥ
:ś atha catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
homādividhiḥ
meaning:
यजमानो ह्य् अशक्तश्चेत् कुर्यान्नक्तादिकं व्रती /
हुत्वा विसर्जयेत् स्तुत्वा श्रीकरन्नित्यपूजनम् //
ओं ह्रीं(1) श्रीं श्रीधराय त्रैलोक्यमोहनाय नमः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये पवित्रारोहणे
श्रीधरनित्यपूजाकथनं नाम त्रयस्त्रिंशोध्यायः
:श् अथ चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽध्यायः
होमादिविधिः
text_mt:
If the patron is unable, the observer of the votive observance may perform [the observance of eating only] at night and the like. / Having offered fire oblations and praised [him], one should dismiss [him]. The daily worship that brings prosperity [is]: / 'Oṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ homage to Śrīdhara, who enchants the three worlds!'
:e Thus in the first great Purāṇa, the Āgneya, in [the section on] investiture with sacred thread, the thirty-third chapter, called 'Instruction on the Daily Worship of Śrīdhara.'
:ś Now, the thirty-fourth chapter:
The Rules for Fire Oblations and Other Rites.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
viśedanena mantreṇa yāgasthānañca bhūṣayet /
namo brahmaṇyadevāya śrīdharāyāvyayātmane //
:n
1 oṃ krīmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 99
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
विशेदनेन मन्त्रेण यागस्थानञ्च भूषयेत् /
नमो ब्रह्मण्यदेवाय श्रीधरायाव्ययात्मने //
:न्
1 ओं क्रीमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 99
text_mt:
Agni said: / One should enter with this mantra and adorn the sacrificial area: / 'Homage to the god devoted to the Brahman, to Śrīdhara, the imperishable self,
:n
1. "oṃ krīm" is the variant reading in manuscript kha. / :p 99

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgyajuḥsāmarūpāya śabdadehāya /
vilikhya maṇḍalaṃ sāyaṃ yāgadravyādi cāharet //
meaning:
ऋग्यजुःसामरूपाय शब्ददेहाय /
विलिख्य मण्डलं सायं यागद्रव्यादि चाहरेत् //
text_mt: whose form is the Ṛg, Yajur, and Sāma Vedas, whose body is sound!' / Having drawn a maṇḍala in the evening, one should bring the sacrificial substances and other requisites.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālitakarāṅghriḥ san vinyasyārghyakaro naraḥ /
arghyādibhistu śiraḥ prokṣya dvāradeśādikaṃ yathā //
meaning:
प्रक्षालितकराङ्घ्रिः सन् विन्यस्यार्घ्यकरो नरः /
अर्घ्यादिभिस्तु शिरः प्रोक्ष्य द्वारदेशादिकं यथा //
text_mt: Having washed his hands and feet, performing the ritual depositions with a water offering in hand, / and having sprinkled his head, the doorway, and the rest with the water offering and other substances,

sanskrit_iast:
ārabhed dvārayāgañca toraṇeśān prapūjayet /
aśvatthodumbaravaṭaprakṣāḥ pūrvādigā nagāḥ //
meaning:
आरभेद् द्वारयागञ्च तोरणेशान् प्रपूजयेत् /
अश्वत्थोदुम्बरवटप्रक्षाः पूर्वादिगा नगाः //
text_mt: he should begin the sacrifice of the doorways and worship the lords of the archways. / The trees in the east and the other [directions] are the aśvattha, udumbara, vaṭa, and plakṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgindraśobhanaṃ prāsyāṃ yujuryamasubhadrakam /
sāmāpaś ca sudhanvākhyaṃ somātharvasuhotrakam //
meaning:
ऋगिन्द्रशोभनं प्रास्यां युजुर्यमसुभद्रकम् /
सामापश् च सुधन्वाख्यं सोमाथर्वसुहोत्रकम् //
text_mt: In the east [are] the Ṛgveda, Indra, and Śobhana; the Yajurveda, Yama, and Subhadraka; / the Sāmaveda, Varuṇa, and the one named Sudhanvan; Soma, the Atharvaveda, and Suhotraka.

sanskrit_iast:
toraṇāntaḥ patākāś ca kumudādyā ghaṭadvayam /
dvāri dvāri svanāmnārcyāḥ pūrve pūrṇaś ca puṣkaraḥ //
meaning:
तोरणान्तः पताकाश् च कुमुदाद्या घटद्वयम् /
द्वारि द्वारि स्वनाम्नार्च्याः पूर्वे पूर्णश् च पुष्करः //
text_mt: Inside the archways are banners, and Kumuda and others, with a pair of pitchers / to be worshipped by their own names at each door: Pūrṇa and Puṣkara in the east;

sanskrit_iast:
ānandanandanau dakṣe vīrasenaḥ suṣeṇakaḥ /
sambhavaprabhavau saumye dvārapāṃś caiva pūjayet //
meaning:
आनन्दनन्दनौ दक्षे वीरसेनः सुषेणकः /
सम्भवप्रभवौ सौम्ये द्वारपांश् चैव पूजयेत् //
text_mt: Ānanda and Nandana in the south; Vīrasena and Suṣeṇa; / Sambhava and Prabhava in the north; and one should also worship the door-keepers.

sanskrit_iast:
astrajaptapuṣpakṣepādvighnānutsārya saṃviśet /
bhūtaśuddhiṃ vidhāyātha vinyasya kṛtamudravaḥ //
meaning:
अस्त्रजप्तपुष्पक्षेपाद्विघ्नानुत्सार्य संविशेत् /
भूतशुद्धिं विधायाथ विन्यस्य कृतमुद्रवः //
text_mt: Having dispelled obstacles by throwing flowers consecrated with the weapon-mantra, one should enter. / Then, having performed the purification of elements, having made the ritual depositions, and having formed the ritual gestures,

sanskrit_iast:
phaṭkārāntāṃ śikhāṃ japtvā sarṣapān dikṣu nikṣipet /
vāsudevena gomūtraṃ saṅkarṣaṇena gomayam //
meaning:
फट्कारान्तां शिखां जप्त्वा सर्षपान् दिक्षु निक्षिपेत् /
वासुदेवेन गोमूत्रं सङ्कर्षणेन गोमयम् //
text_mt: having recited the crest-mantra ending in phaṭ, one should scatter mustard seeds in all directions. / [One should take] cow's urine with the Vāsudeva [mantra], and cow dung with the Saṅkarṣaṇa [mantra];

sanskrit_iast:
pradyumnena payastajjāt dadhi nārāyaṇād ghṛtam /
ekadvitryādivārāṇi ghṛtādvai bhāgatodhikam //
meaning:
प्रद्युम्नेन पयस्तज्जात् दधि नारायणाद् घृतम् /
एकद्वित्र्यादिवाराणि घृताद्वै भागतोधिकम् //
text_mt: milk with the Pradyumna [mantra], curd produced from it, and ghee with the Nārāyaṇa [mantra]. / One, two, three, or more times, each portion increasing from the ghee,

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtapātre tadekatra pañcagavyamudāhṛtam /
maṇḍapaprokṣaṇāyaikañcāparamprāśanāya ca //
meaning:
घृतपात्रे तदेकत्र पञ्चगव्यमुदाहृतम् /
मण्डपप्रोक्षणायैकञ्चापरम्प्राशनाय च //
text_mt: gathered together in the ghee vessel, that is called the five cow-products: / one [portion] for sprinkling the pavilion and another for drinking.

sanskrit_iast:
ānīya daśakumbheṣu indrādyān lokapān yajet /
pūjyājñāṃ śrāvayettāṃś ca sthātavyaṃ cājñayā hareḥ //
meaning:
आनीय दशकुम्भेषु इन्द्राद्यान् लोकपान् यजेत् /
पूज्याज्ञां श्रावयेत्तांश् च स्थातव्यं चाज्ञया हरेः //
text_mt: Having brought [them] in ten water jars, one should worship Indra and the other world guardians; / and having worshipped them, one should announce the command to them: 'You must remain here by Hari's command!'

sanskrit_iast:
yāgadravyādi saṃrakṣya vikirān vikirettataḥ /
mūlāṣṭaśatasañjaptān kuśakūrcān hareś ca tān //
meaning:
यागद्रव्यादि संरक्ष्य विकिरान् विकिरेत्ततः /
मूलाष्टशतसञ्जप्तान् कुशकूर्चान् हरेश् च तान् //
text_mt: Having protected the sacrificial substances and other requisites, one should then scatter the grain scatterings / and Hari's bundles of kuśa grass consecrated eight hundred times with the root-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ diśi tatrasthaṃ sthāpyaṃ kumbhañca vardhanīṃ /
:p 100
kumbhe sāṅgaṃ hariṃ prārcya vardhanyāmastramarcayet //
meaning:
ऐशान्यां दिशि तत्रस्थं स्थाप्यं कुम्भञ्च वर्धनीं /
:प् 100
कुम्भे साङ्गं हरिं प्रार्च्य वर्धन्यामस्त्रमर्चयेत् //
text_mt:
In the north-eastern direction one should place the water jar and the vardhanī vessel standing there.
:p 100
Having worshipped Hari with his limbs in the jar, one should worship the weapon in the vardhanī vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇaṃ yāgagṛhaṃ vardhanyācchinnadhārayā /
siñcannayettataḥ kumbhaṃ pūjayecca sthirāsane //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणं यागगृहं वर्धन्याच्छिन्नधारया /
सिञ्चन्नयेत्ततः कुम्भं पूजयेच्च स्थिरासने //
text_mt: Circling clockwise around the sacrificial pavilion with the continuous stream from the vardhanī vessel, / sprinkling as he carries it, he should then worship the jar on a steady seat.

sanskrit_iast:
sapañcaratnavastrāḍhyakumbhe gandhādibhirharim /
vardhanyāṃ hemagarbhāyāṃ yajedastrañca vāmataḥ //
meaning:
सपञ्चरत्नवस्त्राढ्यकुम्भे गन्धादिभिर्हरिम् /
वर्धन्यां हेमगर्भायां यजेदस्त्रञ्च वामतः //
text_mt: In the jar supplied with the five gems and a cloth, [one should worship] Hari with perfumes and other offerings, / and in the vardhanī containing gold, one should worship the weapon on the left.

sanskrit_iast:
tatsamīpe vāstulakṣmīṃ bhūvināyakamarcayet /
srapanaṃ kalpayedviṣṇoḥ saṅkrāntyādau tathaiva ca //
meaning:
तत्समीपे वास्तुलक्ष्मीं भूविनायकमर्चयेत् /
स्रपनं कल्पयेद्विष्णोः सङ्क्रान्त्यादौ तथैव च //
text_mt: Near that, one should worship Vāstulakṣmī, the Earth, and Vināyaka. / One should likewise prepare Viṣṇu's ablution at the solar ingress and other [occasions],

sanskrit_iast: pūrṇakumbhān nava sthāpya navakoṇeṣu nirbraṇān //
meaning: पूर्णकुम्भान् नव स्थाप्य नवकोणेषु निर्ब्रणान् //
text_mt: having placed nine unblemished, full jars at the nine corners.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādikalasegnyādau pañcāmṛtajalādikam /
dadhi kṣīraṃ madhūṣṇīdaṃ pādyaṃ syāccaturaṅgakam //
meaning:
पूर्वादिकलसेग्न्यादौ पञ्चामृतजलादिकम् /
दधि क्षीरं मधूष्णीदं पाद्यं स्याच्चतुरङ्गकम् //
text_mt: In the jars starting from the east and south-east are the five nectars, water, and so forth: / curd, milk, honey, and warm water. The foot-washing water should have four constituents:

sanskrit_iast:
padmaśyāmākadūrvāś ca viṣṇupatnī ca pādyakam /
tathāṣṭāṅgārghyamākhyātaṃ yavagandhaphalākṣatam //
meaning:
पद्मश्यामाकदूर्वाश् च विष्णुपत्नी च पाद्यकम् /
तथाष्टाङ्गार्घ्यमाख्यातं यवगन्धफलाक्षतम् //
text_mt: lotus, śyāmāka grain, dūrvā grass, and viṣṇupatnī make up the foot-washing water. / Likewise, the water offering of eight constituents is said to be barley, perfume, fruit, unbroken rice,

sanskrit_iast:
kuśāḥ siddhārthapuṣpāni tilā dravyāṇi cārhaṇam(1) /
lavaṅgakakkolayute dadyādācamanīyakam //
meaning:
कुशाः सिद्धार्थपुष्पानि तिला द्रव्याणि चार्हणम्(1) /
लवङ्गकक्कोलयुते दद्यादाचमनीयकम् //
text_mt: kuśa grass, white mustard seeds, flowers, sesame seeds, and articles of worship. / One should offer the water for sipping containing cloves and cubeb berries.

sanskrit_iast:
snāpayenmūlamantreṇa devaṃ pañcāmṛtair api /
śuddhodaṃ madhyakumbhena devamūrdhni viniḥkṣipet //
meaning:
स्नापयेन्मूलमन्त्रेण देवं पञ्चामृतैर् अपि /
शुद्धोदं मध्यकुम्भेन देवमूर्ध्नि विनिःक्षिपेत् //
text_mt: One should bathe the god with the root-mantra using the five nectars as well; / with the central jar, one should pour pure water over the god's head.

sanskrit_iast:
kalaśānniḥsṛtaṃ toyaṃ kūrcāgraṃ(2) saṃspṛśennaraḥ /
śuddhodakena pādyañca arghyamācamanandadet //
meaning:
कलशान्निःसृतं तोयं कूर्चाग्रं(2) संस्पृशेन्नरः /
शुद्धोदकेन पाद्यञ्च अर्घ्यमाचमनन्ददेत् //
text_mt: A person should touch the water flowing from the jar with the tip of a bundle of grass. / With pure water he should offer foot-washing water, the water offering, and water for sipping.

sanskrit_iast:
parimṛjya paṭenāṅgaṃ savastraṃ maṇḍalaṃ nayet /
tatrābhyarcyācareddhomaṃ kuṇḍādau prāṇasaṃyamī //
meaning:
परिमृज्य पटेनाङ्गं सवस्त्रं मण्डलं नयेत् /
तत्राभ्यर्च्याचरेद्धोमं कुण्डादौ प्राणसंयमी //
text_mt: Having wiped the limbs with a cloth, he should bring [the image] with its garments to the maṇḍala. / Having worshipped it there, one who controls his breath should perform the fire oblation in the fire-pit and other places.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālya hastau rekhāś ca tisraḥ pūrvāgragāminīḥ /
:n
1 cārhaṇā iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 dūrvāgramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 101
dakṣiṇāduttarāś ca tisraś caivaottarāgragāḥ //
meaning:
प्रक्षाल्य हस्तौ रेखाश् च तिस्रः पूर्वाग्रगामिनीः /
:न्
1 चार्हणा इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 दूर्वाग्रमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 101
दक्षिणादुत्तराश् च तिस्रश् चैवओत्तराग्रगाः //
text_mt:
Having washed his hands, [he draws] three lines running towards the east,
:n
1. "cārhaṇā" is the variant reading in both manuscripts kha and ṅa.
2. "dūrvāgram" is the variant reading in manuscript ṅa. / :p 101
and from south to north, three lines running towards the north.

sanskrit_iast:
arghyodakena samprokṣya yonimudrāmpradarśayet /
dhyātvāgnirūpañcāgnintu yonyāṃ kuṇḍe kṣipennaraḥ //
meaning:
अर्घ्योदकेन सम्प्रोक्ष्य योनिमुद्राम्प्रदर्शयेत् /
ध्यात्वाग्निरूपञ्चाग्निन्तु योन्यां कुण्डे क्षिपेन्नरः //
text_mt: Having sprinkled them with water from the water offering, he should display the yoni ritual gesture. / Having meditated on Agni's form, a person should cast the fire into the womb of the fire-pit.

sanskrit_iast:
pātrāṇyāsādayet paścāddarbhaśrukśruvakādibhiḥ /
bāhumātrāḥ paridhaya idhmavraś canameva ca //
meaning:
पात्राण्यासादयेत् पश्चाद्दर्भश्रुक्श्रुवकादिभिः /
बाहुमात्राः परिधय इध्मव्रश् चनमेव च //
text_mt: Then he should set out the vessels with darbha grass, the śruc, the śruva, and other ladles; / the enclosure sticks measuring an arm's length, and the firewood pieces trimmed [to measure];

sanskrit_iast:
praṇītā prokṣaṇīpātramājyasthālī ghṛtādikam /
prasthadvayaṃ taṇḍulānāṃ yugmaṃ yugmamadhomukham //
meaning:
प्रणीता प्रोक्षणीपात्रमाज्यस्थाली घृतादिकम् /
प्रस्थद्वयं तण्डुलानां युग्मं युग्ममधोमुखम् //
text_mt: the praṇītā vessel, the prokṣaṇī vessel, the clarified butter bowl, ghee, and the rest; / two prastha measures of rice grains, placed in pairs face down.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇītāprokṣaṇīpātre nyaset prāgagragaṃ kuśam /
adbhiḥ pūryapraṇītāntu dhyātvā devaṃ prapūjya ca //
meaning:
प्रणीताप्रोक्षणीपात्रे न्यसेत् प्रागग्रगं कुशम् /
अद्भिः पूर्यप्रणीतान्तु ध्यात्वा देवं प्रपूज्य च //
text_mt: In the praṇītā and prokṣaṇī vessels he should place kuśa grass pointing eastward. / Having filled the praṇītā with water, and having meditated upon and worshipped the god,

sanskrit_iast:
praṇītāṃ sthāpayedagre dravyāṇāñcaiva madhyataḥ /
prokṣaṇīmadbhiḥ sampūrya prārcya dakṣe tu vinyaset //
meaning:
प्रणीतां स्थापयेदग्रे द्रव्याणाञ्चैव मध्यतः /
प्रोक्षणीमद्भिः सम्पूर्य प्रार्च्य दक्षे तु विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: he should place the praṇītā in front, right in the middle of the implements. / Having filled the prokṣaṇī with water and worshipped it, he should place it on the right.

sanskrit_iast:
caruñca śrapayedagnau brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset /
kuśānāstīrya pūrvādau paridhīn sthāpayettataḥ //
meaning:
चरुञ्च श्रपयेदग्नौ ब्रह्माणं दक्षिणे न्यसेत् /
कुशानास्तीर्य पूर्वादौ परिधीन् स्थापयेत्ततः //
text_mt: He should cook the sacrificial porridge on the fire and place Brahmā to the south. / Having spread kuśa grass in the east and other directions, he should then lay down the enclosure sticks.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiṣṇavīkaraṇaṃ kuryād garbhādhānādinā naraḥ /
garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanañjaniḥ //
meaning:
वैष्णवीकरणं कुर्याद् गर्भाधानादिना नरः /
गर्भाधानं पुंसवनं सीमन्तोन्नयनञ्जनिः //
text_mt: A man should perform the Vaiṣṇava consecration [of the fire] through the rites of conception and the rest: / conception, the rite for procuring a male child, the parting of the hair, birth,

sanskrit_iast:
nāmādisamāvartanāntaṃ juhuyādaṣṭa cāhutīḥ /
pūrṇāhutīḥ pratikarma śrucā sruvasuyuktayā //
meaning:
नामादिसमावर्तनान्तं जुहुयादष्ट चाहुतीः /
पूर्णाहुतीः प्रतिकर्म श्रुचा स्रुवसुयुक्तया //
text_mt: and the rites ending with the return home from studenthood, offering eight oblations, / and full oblations for each rite with the ladle joined with the dipping ladle.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍamadhye ṛtumatīṃ lakṣmīṃ sañcintya homayet /
kuṇḍalakṣmīḥ samākhyātā prakṛtistriguṇātmakā //
meaning:
कुण्डमध्ये ऋतुमतीं लक्ष्मीं सञ्चिन्त्य होमयेत् /
कुण्डलक्ष्मीः समाख्याता प्रकृतिस्त्रिगुणात्मका //
text_mt: Having meditated upon Lakṣmī in her fertile period within the fire-pit, he should make oblations. / The Lakṣmī of the fire-pit is described as material nature consisting of the three qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
sā yoniḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ vidyāmantragaṇasya ca /
vimukteḥ kāraṇaṃ vahniḥ paramātmā ca muktidaḥ //
meaning:
सा योनिः सर्वभूतानां विद्यामन्त्रगणस्य च /
विमुक्तेः कारणं वह्निः परमात्मा च मुक्तिदः //
text_mt: She is the womb of all beings and of the multitude of sciences and mantras. / Fire is the cause of liberation, and the Supreme Self is the giver of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
prācyāṃ śiraḥ samākhyātaṃ bāhū koṇe vyavasthitau /
īśānāgneyakoṇe tu jaṅghe vāyavyanairṛte //
meaning:
प्राच्यां शिरः समाख्यातं बाहू कोणे व्यवस्थितौ /
ईशानाग्नेयकोणे तु जङ्घे वायव्यनैरृते //
text_mt: Her head is declared to be in the east; her two arms are placed in the corners: / in the northeast and southeast corners, and her two shanks in the northwest and southwest.

sanskrit_iast:
udaraṃ kuṇḍamityuktaṃ yoniryonirvidhīyate /
guṇatrayaṃ mekhalāḥ syurdhyātvaivaṃ samidho daśa //
:p 102
meaning:
उदरं कुण्डमित्युक्तं योनिर्योनिर्विधीयते /
गुणत्रयं मेखलाः स्युर्ध्यात्वैवं समिधो दश //
:प् 102
text_mt:
The fire-pit is called the belly; the pit's vulva is prescribed as her vulva. / The three tiers are the three qualities. Having meditated thus, ten sticks of sacrificial fuel,
[Page 102]

पञ्चाधिकांस्तु जुहुयात् प्रणवान्मुष्टिमुद्रया(1) /
पुनराघारौ जुहुयाद्वाय्वग्न्यन्तं ततः श्रपेत् //

sanskrit_iast:
īśāntaṃ mūlamantreṇa ājyabhāgau tu homayet /
uttare dvādaśāntena dakṣiṇe tena madhyataḥ //
meaning:
ईशान्तं मूलमन्त्रेण आज्यभागौ तु होमयेत् /
उत्तरे द्वादशान्तेन दक्षिणे तेन मध्यतः //
text_mt: He should offer the two portions of clarified butter up to the northeast with the root mantra: / in the north with the twelve-syllable [mantra], in the south with that [same mantra], and in the middle

sanskrit_iast:
vyāhṛtyā padmamadhyasthaṃ dhyāyedvahnintu saṃskṛtam /
vaiṣṇavaṃ saptajihvaṃ ca sūryakoṭisamaprabham //
meaning:
व्याहृत्या पद्ममध्यस्थं ध्यायेद्वह्निन्तु संस्कृतम् /
वैष्णवं सप्तजिह्वं च सूर्यकोटिसमप्रभम् //
text_mt: with the vyāhṛtis. He should meditate on the consecrated fire situated in the center of the lotus, / related to Viṣṇu, seven-tongued, possessing the radiance of ten million suns,

sanskrit_iast:
candravaktrañca(2) sūryākṣaṃ juhuyācchatamaṣṭa ca /
tadardhañcāṣṭa mūlena aṅgānāñca daśāṃśataḥ //

'dhyāyaḥ ||

pavitrādhivāsanādividhiḥ
meaning:
चन्द्रवक्त्रञ्च(2) सूर्याक्षं जुहुयाच्छतमष्ट च /
तदर्धञ्चाष्ट मूलेन अङ्गानाञ्च दशांशतः //

ऽध्यायः ||

text_mt:
with a moon-like face and sun-like eyes; and he should offer one hundred and eight [oblations], / or half of that, and eight with the root mantra, and for the limbs a tenth part.
Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, entitled "The Description of Fire Rites," in the venerable and great Āgneyapurāṇa.
Now, the thirty-fifth chapter:
The Rule for the Preliminary Consecration of the Sacred Cord and Related Rites

agnir uvāca

sanskrit_iast:
vastrasaṃveṣṭitānyeva pātrasthānyabhimantrayet /
vilvādyadbhiḥ prokṣitāni mantreṇa caikadhā dvidhā(4) //

वस्त्रसंवेष्टितान्येव पात्रस्थान्यभिमन्त्रयेत् /
विल्वाद्यद्भिः प्रोक्षितानि मन्त्रेण चैकधा द्विधा(4) //
