kṛte tu kiṃ punastasya prāsāde vidhinaiva tu /
aṣṭeṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ yaḥ kuryāddevatālayaṃ //
meaning:
कृते तु किं पुनस्तस्य प्रासादे विधिनैव तु /
अष्टेष्टकसमायुक्तं यः कुर्याद्देवतालयं //
text_mt: What more need be said when a temple has indeed been built by him in accordance with rule? / He who makes an abode for a deity endowed with eight bricks—

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya phalasampattirvaktuṃ śakyeta kenacit /
anenaivānumeyaṃ hi phalaṃ prāsādavistarāt //
meaning:
न तस्य फलसम्पत्तिर्वक्तुं शक्येत केनचित् /
अनेनैवानुमेयं हि फलं प्रासादविस्तरात् //
text_mt: no one could express the abundant fruit he gains. / From the extent of the temple itself, indeed, such fruit is to be inferred.

sanskrit_iast:
grāmamadhye ca pūrve ca pratyagdvāraṃ prakalpayet /
vidiśāsu ca sarvāsu grāme pratyaṅmukho bhavet /
dakṣiṇe cottare caiva paścime prāṅmukho bhavet //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pātālayogakathanaṃ nāma
ekacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvācatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāsādalakṣaṇakathanaṃ
meaning:
ग्राममध्ये च पूर्वे च प्रत्यग्द्वारं प्रकल्पयेत् /
विदिशासु च सर्वासु ग्रामे प्रत्यङ्मुखो भवेत् /
दक्षिणे चोत्तरे चैव पश्चिमे प्राङ्मुखो भवेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये पातालयोगकथनं नाम
एकचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्वाचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
प्रासादलक्षणकथनं
text_mt:
In the middle of the village and in the east, one should provide a west-facing doorway; / and in all the intermediate directions in the village, it should face west; / in the south, north, and west, it should face east.
Thus in the primary Great Purāṇa, the Āgneya, the forty-first chapter, entitled "The Account of the Conjunction with the Netherdworld."
Now the forty-second chapter.
Description of the Characteristics of a Temple

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīva uvāca
prāsādaṃ sampravakṣyāmi sarvasādhāraṇaṃ śṛṇu /
caturasrīkṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ bhajet ṣoḍaśadhā budhaḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीव उवाच
प्रासादं सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वसाधारणं शृणु /
चतुरस्रीकृतं क्षेत्रं भजेत् षोडशधा बुधः //
text_mt: Hayagrīva said: / I shall explain the temple common to all; listen: / A wise man should divide a squared ground into sixteen parts.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye tasya caturbhistu kuryādāyasamanvitaṃ /
:n
1 samaprāsādamānata iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 122
dvadaśaiva tu bhāgāni bhittyarthaṃ parikalpayet //
meaning:
मध्ये तस्य चतुर्भिस्तु कुर्यादायसमन्वितं /
:न्
1 समप्रासादमानत इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 122
द्वदशैव तु भागानि भित्त्यर्थं परिकल्पयेत् //
text_mt:
In the middle of it, with four [parts], he should make [the sanctum] endowed with breadth.
[Footnote]
1 "samaprāsādamānataḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
[p. 122]
He should assign twelve parts for the wall.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṅghocchrāyantu kartavyaṃ caturbhāgeṇa cāyataṃ(1) /
jaṅghāyāṃ dviguṇocchrāyaṃ mañjaryāḥ kalpayed budhaḥ //
meaning:
जङ्घोच्छ्रायन्तु कर्तव्यं चतुर्भागेण चायतं(1) /
जङ्घायां द्विगुणोच्छ्रायं मञ्जर्याः कल्पयेद् बुधः //
text_mt: The height of the wall-shaft is to be made equal in length to four parts; / a wise man should design the height of the spire to be twice that of the wall-shaft.

sanskrit_iast:
turyabhāgena mañjaryāḥ kāryaḥ samyak pradakṣiṇaḥ(2) /
tanmānanirgamaṃ kāryamubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ samaṃ //
meaning:
तुर्यभागेन मञ्जर्याः कार्यः सम्यक् प्रदक्षिणः(2) /
तन्माननिर्गमं कार्यमुभयोः पार्श्वयोः समं //
text_mt: A circumambulatory passage is to be made properly with a fourth part of the spire; / an projection of that measure is to be made equal on both sides.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhareṇa samaṃ kāryamagre jagati vistaraṃ /
dviguṇenāpi kartavyaṃ yathāśobhānurūpataḥ //
meaning:
शिखरेण समं कार्यमग्रे जगति विस्तरं /
द्विगुणेनापि कर्तव्यं यथाशोभानुरूपतः //
text_mt: The breadth of the basal platform in front is to be made equal to the spire, / or it may also be made twice [that], in accordance with beauty.

sanskrit_iast:
vistārānmaṇḍapasyāgre garbhasūtradvayena tu /
dairghyātpādādhikaṃ kuryānmadhyastambhair vibhūṣitaṃ //
meaning:
विस्तारान्मण्डपस्याग्रे गर्भसूत्रद्वयेन तु /
दैर्घ्यात्पादाधिकं कुर्यान्मध्यस्तम्भैर् विभूषितं //
text_mt: In front of the pavilion, by two measuring lines of the sanctum beyond its width, / he should make [it] longer by one fourth of its length, adorned with central pillars.

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādagarbhamānaṃ vā kurvīta mukhamaṇḍapaṃ /
ekāśītipadair vyāstuṃ paścāt maṇḍapamārabhet //
meaning:
प्रासादगर्भमानं वा कुर्वीत मुखमण्डपं /
एकाशीतिपदैर् व्यास्तुं पश्चात् मण्डपमारभेत् //
text_mt: Or he should make the front pavilion the measure of the temple's sanctum. / Having measured out the site with eighty-one squares, he should subsequently begin the pavilion.

sanskrit_iast:
śukān prāgdvāravinyāse pādāntaḥsthān yajet surān /
tathā prākāravinyāse yajed dvātriṃśadantagān(3) //
meaning:
शुकान् प्राग्द्वारविन्यासे पादान्तःस्थान् यजेत् सुरान् /
तथा प्राकारविन्यासे यजेद् द्वात्रिंशदन्तगान्(3) //
text_mt: In the placement of the east door, he should worship the deities situated within the parts, as well as the parrots; / likewise, in laying out the surrounding wall, he should worship those situated at the thirty-two limits.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasādhāraṇaṃ caitat prāsādasya ca lakṣaṇaṃ /
mānena pratimāyā vā prāsādamaparaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
सर्वसाधारणं चैतत् प्रासादस्य च लक्षणं /
मानेन प्रतिमाया वा प्रासादमपरं शृणु //
text_mt: This is the characteristic of a temple common to all. / Or listen to another [type of] temple [proportioned] by the measurement of the image.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāyāḥ pramāṇana kartavyā piṇḍikā śubhā /
garbhastu piṇḍikārdhena garbhamānāstu bhittayaḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिमायाः प्रमाणन कर्तव्या पिण्डिका शुभा /
गर्भस्तु पिण्डिकार्धेन गर्भमानास्तु भित्तयः //
text_mt: An auspicious pedestal is to be made by the measure of the image. / The sanctum is [measured by] half the pedestal, and the walls are the measure of the sanctum.

sanskrit_iast:
bhitterāyāmamānena utsedhantu prakalpayet /
bhittyucchrāyāttu dviguṇaṃ śikharaṃ kalpayed budhaḥ //
meaning:
भित्तेरायाममानेन उत्सेधन्तु प्रकल्पयेत् /
भित्त्युच्छ्रायात्तु द्विगुणं शिखरं कल्पयेद् बुधः //
text_mt: He should design the height by the measure of the length of the wall; / and from the height of the wall, a wise man should design the spire to be twice [as high].

sanskrit_iast:
śikharasya tu turyeṇa bhramaṇaṃ parikalpayet /
śikharasya caturthena vyagrato mukhamaṇḍapaṃ //
:n
1 catyurbhāgeṇa vā yutamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / caturbhāgeṇa
saṃyutamiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 samyak kuryāt pradakṣiṇamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 dvātriṃśadantare iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 123
meaning:
शिखरस्य तु तुर्येण भ्रमणं परिकल्पयेत् /
शिखरस्य चतुर्थेन व्यग्रतो मुखमण्डपं //
:न्
1 चत्युर्भागेण वा युतमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / चतुर्भागेण
संयुतमिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 सम्यक् कुर्यात् प्रदक्षिणमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 द्वात्रिंशदन्तरे इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 123
text_mt:
He should design the circumambulatory passage with a fourth of the spire, / and the front pavilion facing forward with a fourth of the spire.
[Footnote]
1 "caturbhāgeṇa vā yutam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "caturbhāgeṇa saṃyutam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2 "samyak kuryāt pradakṣiṇam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3 "dvātriṃśadantare" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
[p. 123]

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamāṃsena garbhasya rathakānāntu nirgamaḥ /
paridherguṇabhāgena rathakāṃstatra kalpayet //
meaning:
अष्टमांसेन गर्भस्य रथकानान्तु निर्गमः /
परिधेर्गुणभागेन रथकांस्तत्र कल्पयेत् //
text_mt: The projection of the buttresses is by an eighth part of the sanctum; / he should design the buttresses there by a third part of the perimeter.

sanskrit_iast:
tattṛtīyeṇa(4) vā kuryādrathakānāntu nirgamaṃ /
vāmatrayaṃ sthāpanīyaṃ rathakatritaye sadā //
meaning:
तत्तृतीयेण(4) वा कुर्याद्रथकानान्तु निर्गमं /
वामत्रयं स्थापनीयं रथकत्रितये सदा //
text_mt: Or he should make the projection of the buttresses by one third of that; / three recessed angles must always be placed on the three buttresses.

sanskrit_iast:
śikharārthaṃ hi sūtrāṇi catvāri vinipātayet /
śukanāśordhvataḥ sūtraṃ tiryagbhūtaṃ nipātayet //
meaning:
शिखरार्थं हि सूत्राणि चत्वारि विनिपातयेत् /
शुकनाशोर्ध्वतः सूत्रं तिर्यग्भूतं निपातयेत् //
text_mt: Indeed, for the sake of the spire, he should drop four plumb-lines; / above the antefix, he should drop a cord positioned obliquely.

sanskrit_iast:
śikharasyārdhabhāgasthaṃ siṃhaṃ tatra tu kārayet /
śukanāsāṃ sthirīkṛtya madhyasandhau nidhāpayet //
meaning:
शिखरस्यार्धभागस्थं सिंहं तत्र तु कारयेत् /
शुकनासां स्थिरीकृत्य मध्यसन्धौ निधापयेत् //
text_mt: He should then place a lion standing in the middle part of the spire; / having made the antefix firm, he should set it at the central joint.

sanskrit_iast:
apare ca tathā pārśvaṃ tadvat sūtraṃ nidhāpayet /
tadūrdhvantu bhavedvedī sakaṇṭā manasārakaṃ //
meaning:
अपरे च तथा पार्श्वं तद्वत् सूत्रं निधापयेत् /
तदूर्ध्वन्तु भवेद्वेदी सकण्टा मनसारकं //
text_mt: And on the other side likewise, he should drop the cord in the same way. / Above that there should be an altar platform with a neck and a crowning capstone.

sanskrit_iast:
skandhabhagnaṃ na kartavyaṃ vikarālaṃ tathaiva ca /
ūrdhvaṃ ca vedikāmānāt kalaśaṃ parikalpayet //
meaning:
स्कन्धभग्नं न कर्तव्यं विकरालं तथैव च /
ऊर्ध्वं च वेदिकामानात् कलशं परिकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: It must not be made with a broken shoulder, nor terrifyingly distorted; / and above the measure of the altar platform, he should design the pot-finial.

sanskrit_iast:
vistārāddviguṇaṃ dvāraṃ kartavyaṃ tu suśobhanaṃ /
udumbarau tadūrdhvañca nyasecchākhāṃ sumaṅgalaiḥ //
meaning:
विस्ताराद्द्विगुणं द्वारं कर्तव्यं तु सुशोभनं /
उदुम्बरौ तदूर्ध्वञ्च न्यसेच्छाखां सुमङ्गलैः //
text_mt: The doorway is to be made twice [the measure of] the breadth, very beautiful; / above the two threshold posts, he should place the doorframe with very auspicious [motifs].

sanskrit_iast:
dvārasya tu caturthāṃśe kāryau caṇḍapracaṇdakau /
viśvaksenavatsadaṇḍau śikhordhvoḍumbare śriyaṃ //
meaning:
द्वारस्य तु चतुर्थांशे कार्यौ चण्डप्रचण्दकौ /
विश्वक्सेनवत्सदण्डौ शिखोर्ध्वोडुम्बरे श्रियं //
text_mt: Caṇḍa and Pracaṇḍa are to be made on the fourth part of the doorway, / holding staffs like Viṣvaksena; and above the lintel, [he should place] Śrī,

sanskrit_iast:
diggajaiḥ snāpyamānāntāṃ ghaṭeḥ sābjāṃ surūpikāṃ /
prāsādasya caturthāṃśaiḥ prākārasyocchrayo bhavet //
meaning:
दिग्गजैः स्नाप्यमानान्तां घटेः साब्जां सुरूपिकां /
प्रासादस्य चतुर्थांशैः प्राकारस्योच्छ्रयो भवेत् //
text_mt: being bathed by the elephants of the quarters with pitchers, holding a lotus, of beautiful form. / The height of the surrounding wall should be one fourth of [the height of] the temple.

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādāt pādahīnastu gopurasyocchrayo bhavet /
pañcahastasya devasya ekahastā tu pīṭhikā //
meaning:
प्रासादात् पादहीनस्तु गोपुरस्योच्छ्रयो भवेत् /
पञ्चहस्तस्य देवस्य एकहस्ता तु पीठिका //
text_mt: The height of the gateway-tower should be one quarter less than that of the temple. / For a deity of five cubits, the pedestal is one cubit.

sanskrit_iast:
gāruḍaṃ maṇḍapañcāgre ekaṃ bhaumādidhāma ca /
kuryāddhi pratimāyāntu dikṣu cāṣṭamāsu copari //
meaning:
गारुडं मण्डपञ्चाग्रे एकं भौमादिधाम च /
कुर्याद्धि प्रतिमायान्तु दिक्षु चाष्टमासु चोपरि //
text_mt: In front, there should be a Garuḍa pavilion and a single multi-storeyed abode, / and on the image, he should place [deities] in the eight directions and above:

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve varāhaṃ dakṣe ca nṛsiṃhaṃ śrīdharaṃ jale /
uttare tu hayagrīvanāgneyyāṃ jāmadagnyakaṃ //
:n
1 tatturīyeṇeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 124
meaning:
पूर्वे वराहं दक्षे च नृसिंहं श्रीधरं जले /
उत्तरे तु हयग्रीवनाग्नेय्यां जामदग्न्यकं //
:न्
1 तत्तुरीयेणेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 124
text_mt:
Varāha in the east, Nṛsiṃha in the south, Śrīdhara in the [direction of] water, / Hayagrīva in the north, and Paraśurāma in the south-east,
[Footnote]
1 "tatturīyeṇa" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
[p. 124]

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtyāṃ rāmakaṃ vāyau vāmanaṃ vāsudevakaṃ /
īśe prāsādaracanā deyā vasvarkakādibhiḥ /
dvārasya cāṣṭamādyaṃśaṃ tyatkā bedho na doṣabhāk //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye prāsādalakṣaṇaṃ nāma
dvācattvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāsādadevatāsthāpanaṃ
meaning:
नैरृत्यां रामकं वायौ वामनं वासुदेवकं /
ईशे प्रासादरचना देया वस्वर्ककादिभिः /
द्वारस्य चाष्टमाद्यंशं त्यत्का बेधो न दोषभाक् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये प्रासादलक्षणं नाम
द्वाचत्त्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ त्रिचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
प्रासाददेवतास्थापनं
text_mt:
Rāma in the south-west, Vāmana in the north-west, and Vāsudeva / in the north-east: the layout of the temple should be given by groups of eight, twelve, and so on; / discarding the eighth and first part of the doorway, an obstruction incurs no fault.
Thus in the primary Great Purāṇa, the Āgneya, the forty-second chapter, entitled "Description of the Characteristics of a Temple."
Now the forty-third chapter.
Installation of Deities in a Temple

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
prāsāde devatāḥ sthāpyā vakṣye brahman śṛṇuṣva me /
pañcāyatamadhye tu vāsudevaṃ niveśayet //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
प्रासादे देवताः स्थाप्या वक्ष्ये ब्रह्मन् शृणुष्व मे /
पञ्चायतमध्ये तु वासुदेवं निवेशयेत् //
text_mt: The Blessed One said: / I shall state the deities to be installed in a temple; listen to me, O Brahmā: / In the middle of a five-shrine complex, one should install Vāsudeva,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanaṃ nṛhariñcāśvaśīrṣaṃ tadvañca śūkaraṃ /
āgneye nairṛte caiva vāyavye ceśagocare //
meaning:
वामनं नृहरिञ्चाश्वशीर्षं तद्वञ्च शूकरं /
आग्नेये नैरृते चैव वायव्ये चेशगोचरे //
text_mt: and Vāmana, Nṛhari, the Horse-Headed One, and likewise the Boar / in the south-east, south-west, north-west, and north-east quarters.

sanskrit_iast:
atha nārāyaṇaṃ madhye āgneyyāmambikāṃ nyaset /
nairṛtyāṃ bhāskaraṃ vāyau brahmāṇaṃ liṅgamīśake //
meaning:
अथ नारायणं मध्ये आग्नेय्यामम्बिकां न्यसेत् /
नैरृत्यां भास्करं वायौ ब्रह्माणं लिङ्गमीशके //
text_mt: Or else one should place Nārāyaṇa in the center, Ambikā in the south-east, / the Sun in the south-west, Brahmā in the north-west, and a liṅga in the north-east;

sanskrit_iast:
athavā rudrarūpantu athavā navadhāmasu /
vāsudevaṃ nyasenmadhye pūrvādau vāmavāmakān //
meaning:
अथवा रुद्ररूपन्तु अथवा नवधामसु /
वासुदेवं न्यसेन्मध्ये पूर्वादौ वामवामकान् //
text_mt: or in the form of Rudra; or in nine shrines / one should place Vāsudeva in the center, and on the left of each, beginning with the east,

sanskrit_iast:
indrādīn lokapālāṃś ca athavā navadhāmasu /
pañcāyatanakaṃ kuryāt madhye tu puruṣottamaṃ //
meaning:
इन्द्रादीन् लोकपालांश् च अथवा नवधामसु /
पञ्चायतनकं कुर्यात् मध्ये तु पुरुषोत्तमं //
text_mt: Indra and the other world-protectors. Or in nine abodes / he should make a five-shrine complex with Puruṣottama in the center.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīvaiśravaṇau pūrvaṃ dakṣe mātṛgaṇaṃ nyaset /
skandaṃ gaṇeśamīśānaṃ sūryādīn paścime grahān //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीवैश्रवणौ पूर्वं दक्षे मातृगणं न्यसेत् /
स्कन्दं गणेशमीशानं सूर्यादीन् पश्चिमे ग्रहान् //
text_mt: He should place Lakṣmī and Kubera in the east, the troop of Mothers in the south, / Skanda, Gaṇeśa, and Īśāna [along with] the Sun and other planets in the west,

sanskrit_iast:
uttare daśa matsyādīnāgneyyāṃ caṇḍikāṃ tathā /
nairṛtyāmambikāṃ sthāpya vāyavye tu sarasvatīṃ //
meaning:
उत्तरे दश मत्स्यादीनाग्नेय्यां चण्डिकां तथा /
नैरृत्यामम्बिकां स्थाप्य वायव्ये तु सरस्वतीं //
text_mt: the ten [incarnations] beginning with the Fish in the north; likewise Caṇḍikā in the south-east; / having placed Ambikā in the south-west, and Sarasvatī in the north-west,

sanskrit_iast:
padmāmaiśe vāsudevaṃ madhye nārāyaṇañca vā /
trayodaśālaye madhye viśvarūpaṃ nyaseddhariṃ //
:p 125
meaning:
पद्मामैशे वासुदेवं मध्ये नारायणञ्च वा /
त्रयोदशालये मध्ये विश्वरूपं न्यसेद्धरिं //
:प् 125
text_mt:
[One should deposit] Padmā in the northeast, or Vāsudeva or Nārāyaṇa in the centre; / in a shrine of thirteen [deities] one should deposit Hari in his cosmic form (Viśvarūpa) in the centre.
[Page 125]

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādau keśavādīn vā anyadhāmasvayaṃ hariṃ(1) /
mṛṇmayī dārughaṭitā lohajā ratnajā tathā //
meaning:
पूर्वादौ केशवादीन् वा अन्यधामस्वयं हरिं(1) /
मृण्मयी दारुघटिता लोहजा रत्नजा तथा //
text_mt: Or [one should deposit] Keśava and the others beginning in the east, or Hari himself in another abode. / An image is taught to be of seven kinds: made of clay, fashioned of wood, made of metal, made of jewels,

sanskrit_iast:
śailajā gandhajā caiva kausumī(2) saptadhā smṛtā /
kausumī gandhajā caiva mṛṇmayī pratimā tathā //
meaning:
शैलजा गन्धजा चैव कौसुमी(2) सप्तधा स्मृता /
कौसुमी गन्धजा चैव मृण्मयी प्रतिमा तथा //
text_mt: made of stone, made of fragrant paste, and made of flowers. / An image made of flowers, of fragrant paste, or of clay—

sanskrit_iast:
tatkālapūjitāś caitāḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ /
atha śailamayīṃ vakṣye śilā yatra ca gṛhyate //
meaning:
तत्कालपूजिताश् चैताः सर्वकामफलप्रदाः /
अथ शैलमयीं वक्ष्ये शिला यत्र च गृह्यते //
text_mt: these, worshipped for that particular time, bestow the fruits of all desires. / Now I shall describe [the image] made of stone, and where the stone is to be taken.

sanskrit_iast:
parvatānāmabhāve ca gṛhṇīyādbhūgatāṃ śilāṃ /
pāṇḍarā hy aruṇā pītā kṛṣṇā śastā tu vairṇināṃ //
meaning:
पर्वतानामभावे च गृह्णीयाद्भूगतां शिलां /
पाण्डरा ह्य् अरुणा पीता कृष्णा शस्ता तु वैर्णिनां //
text_mt: In the absence of mountains, one may take a stone found in the earth. / White, red, yellow, and black stones are commended for the four social classes.

sanskrit_iast:
na yadā labhyate samyag varṇināṃ varṇataḥ śilā /
varṇādyāpādānaṃ tatra juhyāt siṃhavidyayā //
meaning:
न यदा लभ्यते सम्यग् वर्णिनां वर्णतः शिला /
वर्णाद्यापादानं तत्र जुह्यात् सिंहविद्यया //
text_mt: When a stone according to the colour of the social classes cannot properly be obtained, / one should perform fire oblation there using the Nṛsiṃha mantra to produce the [desired] colour and other [qualities].

sanskrit_iast:
śilāyāṃ śuklarekhāgryā kṛṣṇāgryā siṃhahomataḥ /
kāṃsyaghaṇṭāninādā syāt puṃliṅgā visphuliṅgikā //
meaning:
शिलायां शुक्लरेखाग्र्या कृष्णाग्र्या सिंहहोमतः /
कांस्यघण्टानिनादा स्यात् पुंलिङ्गा विस्फुलिङ्गिका //
text_mt: A stone with prominent white lines, or prominent black lines through fire oblation to Nṛsiṃha, / producing the sound of a bronze bell, sparking, is masculine.

sanskrit_iast:
tanmandalakṣaṇā(3) strī syādrūpābhāvānnapuṃsakā /
dṛśyate maṇḍalaṃ yasyāṃ sagarbhāṃ tāṃ vivarjayet //
meaning:
तन्मन्दलक्षणा(3) स्त्री स्याद्रूपाभावान्नपुंसका /
दृश्यते मण्डलं यस्यां सगर्भां तां विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: One with milder characteristics is feminine; in the absence of [either set of] characteristics, it is neuter. / One in which a circular mark is seen should be avoided as pregnant.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimārthaṃ vanaṃ gatvā vrajayāgaṃ samācaret /
tatra khātvopalipyātha maṇḍape tu hariṃ yajet //
meaning:
प्रतिमार्थं वनं गत्वा व्रजयागं समाचरेत् /
तत्र खात्वोपलिप्याथ मण्डपे तु हरिं यजेत् //
text_mt: Having gone to the forest for the sake of the image, one should perform the sacrifice for departure. / There, having dug and smeared [the ground], one should worship Hari in a pavilion.

sanskrit_iast:
baliṃ datvā karmaśastraṃ ṭaṅkādikamathārcayet /
hutvātha śālitoyena astreṇa prokṣayecchilāṃ //
meaning:
बलिं दत्वा कर्मशस्त्रं टङ्कादिकमथार्चयेत् /
हुत्वाथ शालितोयेन अस्त्रेण प्रोक्षयेच्छिलां //
text_mt: Having offered an oblation, one should then worship the working tools, such as the chisel. / Having made fire oblation, one should sprinkle the stone with rice water using the weapon-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣāṃ kṛtvā nṛsiṃhena mūlamantreṇa pūjayet(4) /
hutvā pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyāttato bhūtabaliṃ guruḥ //
:n
1 anyadhāmasu yajñaviditi kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
yugmadhāmasvayaṃ harimiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 kaumudī iti kha, gha, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 unmattalakṣaṇā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 mantrayediti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 126
meaning:
रक्षां कृत्वा नृसिंहेन मूलमन्त्रेण पूजयेत्(4) /
हुत्वा पूर्णाहुतिं दद्यात्ततो भूतबलिं गुरुः //
:न्
1 अन्यधामसु यज्ञविदिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
युग्मधामस्वयं हरिमिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 कौमुदी इति ख, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 उन्मत्तलक्षणा इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 मन्त्रयेदिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 126
text_mt:
Having made protection with Nṛsiṃha, one should worship [it] with the root-mantra. / Having made fire oblation, the guru should offer the final oblation and then the oblation to the spirits.
[Footnotes]
1. "anyadhāmasu yajñavit" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
"yugmadhāmasvayaṃ harim" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
2. "kaumudī" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and gha.
3. "unmattalakṣaṇā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "mantrayet" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [Page 126]

sanskrit_iast:
atra ye saṃsthitāḥ sattvā yātudhānāś ca guhyakāḥ /
siddhādayo vā ye cānye tān sampūjya kṣamāpayet //
meaning:
अत्र ये संस्थिताः सत्त्वा यातुधानाश् च गुह्यकाः /
सिद्धादयो वा ये चान्ये तान् सम्पूज्य क्षमापयेत् //
text_mt: Whatever beings, Yātudhānas, Guhyakas, / Siddhas, or others dwell here, having worshipped them, one should ask their pardon:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇubimbārthamasmākaṃ(1) yātraiṣā keśavājñayā /
viṣṇvarthaṃ yadbhavet kāryaṃ yuṣmākamapi tadbhavet //
meaning:
विष्णुबिम्बार्थमस्माकं(1) यात्रैषा केशवाज्ञया /
विष्ण्वर्थं यद्भवेत् कार्यं युष्माकमपि तद्भवेत् //
text_mt: “This journey of ours is for the sake of an image of Viṣṇu, by the command of Keśava. / The work that is for the sake of Viṣṇu shall also be yours.

sanskrit_iast: anena balidānena prītā bhavata sarvathā /
meaning: अनेन बलिदानेन प्रीता भवत सर्वथा /
text_mt: May you be pleased in every way by this offering of oblation!

sanskrit_iast: kṣameṇa gacchatānyatra muktvā sthānamidaṃ tvarāt //
meaning: क्षमेण गच्छतान्यत्र मुक्त्वा स्थानमिदं त्वरात् //
text_mt: Pardon us and go elsewhere, leaving this place quickly.”

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ prabodhitāḥ sattvā yānti tṛptā yathāsukhaṃ /
śilpibhiś ca caruṃ prāśya svapnamantraṃ japenniśi //
meaning:
एवं प्रबोधिताः सत्त्वा यान्ति तृप्ता यथासुखं /
शिल्पिभिश् च चरुं प्राश्य स्वप्नमन्त्रं जपेन्निशि //
text_mt: Thus addressed, the spirits depart, satisfied and at ease. / Having eaten the ritual porridge along with the artisans, one should recite the dream-mantra at night:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namaḥ sakalalokāya viṣṇave prabhaviṣṇave /
viśvāya viśvarūpāya svapnādhipataye(2) namaḥ //
meaning:
ओं नमः सकललोकाय विष्णवे प्रभविष्णवे /
विश्वाय विश्वरूपाय स्वप्नाधिपतये(2) नमः //
text_mt: “Oṃ, obeisance to Viṣṇu, the Lord of all the worlds, / to the All, the Cosmic Form, the Lord of dreams, obeisance!

sanskrit_iast:
ācakṣva devadeveśa prasuptosmi(3) tavāntikaṃ /
svapne sarvāṇi kāryāṇi hṛdisthāni tu yāni me //
oṃ oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ viṣṇave svāhā(4)
meaning:
आचक्ष्व देवदेवेश प्रसुप्तोस्मि(3) तवान्तिकं /
स्वप्ने सर्वाणि कार्याणि हृदिस्थानि तु यानि मे //
ओं ओं ह्रूं फट् विष्णवे स्वाहा(4)
text_mt:
Tell me, O Lord of the gods of gods, as I sleep near you, / in a dream, all the tasks that dwell within my heart!”
“Oṃ oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ to Viṣṇu, svāhā!”

sanskrit_iast:
śubhe svapne śubhaṃ sarvaṃ hy aśubhe siṃhahomataḥ /
prātararghyaṃ śilāyāṃ tu datvāstreṇāstrakaṃ yajet //
meaning:
शुभे स्वप्ने शुभं सर्वं ह्य् अशुभे सिंहहोमतः /
प्रातरर्घ्यं शिलायां तु दत्वास्त्रेणास्त्रकं यजेत् //
text_mt: If the dream is auspicious, everything is auspicious; but if inauspicious, [one cures it] by fire oblation to Nṛsiṃha. / In the morning, having offered water offering to the stone, one should worship the weapon with the weapon-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
kuddālaṭaṅkaśastrādyaṃ madhvānyāktamukhañcaret /
ātmānaṃ cintayedviṣṇuṃ śilpinaṃ viśvakarmakaṃ(5) //
meaning:
कुद्दालटङ्कशस्त्राद्यं मध्वान्याक्तमुखञ्चरेत् /
आत्मानं चिन्तयेद्विष्णुं शिल्पिनं विश्वकर्मकं(5) //
text_mt: One should smear the edges of the hoe, chisel, and other tools with honey and ghee. / One should contemplate oneself as Viṣṇu, and the artisan as Viśvakarman.

sanskrit_iast:
śastraṃ viṣṇvātmakaṃ(6) dadyāt mukhapṛṣṭhādi darśayet /
jitendriyaḥ ṭaṅkahastaḥ śilpī tu caturasrakāṃ //
:n
1 lokasiddhyarthamasmākamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 viśvādhipataye iti kha, cihnitapuatakapāṭhaḥ
3 prapanno 'smi iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 oṃ oṃ hrīṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 viśvakarmaṇimiti kha, ga, cihnitapuatakapāṭhaḥ
6 viśvātmakamiti ga, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
:p 127
meaning:
शस्त्रं विष्ण्वात्मकं(6) दद्यात् मुखपृष्ठादि दर्शयेत् /
जितेन्द्रियः टङ्कहस्तः शिल्पी तु चतुरस्रकां //
:न्
1 लोकसिद्ध्यर्थमस्माकमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 विश्वाधिपतये इति ख, चिह्नितपुअतकपाठः
3 प्रपन्नो ऽस्मि इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 ओं ओं ह्रीं फडिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 विश्वकर्मणिमिति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुअतकपाठः
6 विश्वात्मकमिति ग, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
:प् 127
text_mt:
One should present the tool as being composed of Viṣṇu, and indicate the face, back, and other parts. / Restraining his senses, with chisel in hand, the artisan [should make it] four-sided.
[Footnotes]
1. "lokasiddhyarthamasmākam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "viśvādhipataye" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "prapanno 'smi" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4. "oṃ oṃ hrīṃ phaṭ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
5. "viśvakarmaṇim" is the reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga.
6. "viśvātmakam" is the reading in the three manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa. / [Page 127]

sanskrit_iast:
śilāṃ kṛtvā piṇḍikārthaṃ kiñcinnyūnāntu kalpayet /
rathe sthāpya samānīya savastrāṃ kāruveśmani /
pūjayitvātha ghaṭayet pratimāṃ sa tu karmakṛt //
:e ity ādi mahāpurāṇe āgneye śāntyādivarṇanaṃ nāma
tricatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha catuś catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
vāsudevādipratimālakṣaṇavidhiḥ
meaning:
शिलां कृत्वा पिण्डिकार्थं किञ्चिन्न्यूनान्तु कल्पयेत् /
रथे स्थाप्य समानीय सवस्त्रां कारुवेश्मनि /
पूजयित्वाथ घटयेत् प्रतिमां स तु कर्मकृत् //
:ए इत्य् आदि महापुराणे आग्नेये शान्त्यादिवर्णनं नाम
त्रिचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ चतुश् चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
वासुदेवादिप्रतिमालक्षणविधिः
text_mt:
Having fashioned the stone, he should design [another] slightly smaller for the pedestal. / Placing it on a chariot, bringing it covered with cloth to the artisan's workshop, / and worshipping it, that workman should fashion the image.
Thus ends the forty-third chapter, entitled “Description of Rites for Pacification and Image-stone Selection”, in the great and venerable Agni Purāṇa.
Now, chapter forty-four:
The rules on the characteristics of the images of Vāsudeva and other deities.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
vāsudevādipratimālakṣaṇaṃ pravadāmi te /
prāsādasyottare pūrvamukhīṃ vā cottarānanāṃ //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
वासुदेवादिप्रतिमालक्षणं प्रवदामि ते /
प्रासादस्योत्तरे पूर्वमुखीं वा चोत्तराननां //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / I shall tell you the characteristics of the image of Vāsudeva and others. / To the north of the temple, [having placed the stone] facing east or facing north,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpya pūjya ca baliṃ datvātho madhyasūcakaṃ /
śilāṃ śilpī tu navadhā vibhajya navame 'ṃśake //
meaning:
संस्थाप्य पूज्य च बलिं दत्वाथो मध्यसूचकं /
शिलां शिल्पी तु नवधा विभज्य नवमे ऽंशके //
text_mt: having installed it, worshipped it, and given an oblation indicating the centre, / the artisan, dividing the stone into nine parts, in the ninth part,

sanskrit_iast:
sūrpabhaktaiḥ śilāyāṃ tu bhāgaṃ svāṅgulamucyate /
dvyaṅgulaṃ golakaṃ nāmnā kālanetraṃ taducyate //
meaning:
सूर्पभक्तैः शिलायां तु भागं स्वाङ्गुलमुच्यते /
द्व्यङ्गुलं गोलकं नाम्ना कालनेत्रं तदुच्यते //
text_mt: by measures of a grain of barley upon the stone, a part is called one's own digit (aṅgula); / two digits by name is a golaka; it is [also] called a kālanetra.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāgamekaṃ tridhā bhaktvā pārṣṇibhāgaṃ prakalpayet /
bhāgamekaṃ tathā jānau grīvāyāṃ bhāgameva ca //
meaning:
भागमेकं त्रिधा भक्त्वा पार्ष्णिभागं प्रकल्पयेत् /
भागमेकं तथा जानौ ग्रीवायां भागमेव च //
text_mt: Dividing one part into three, one should design the heel part; / likewise, one part for the knee, and one part for the neck.

sanskrit_iast:
mukuṭaṃ tālamātraṃ syāttālamātraṃ tayā mukhaṃ /
tālenaikena kaṇṭhantu tālena hṛdayaṃ tathā //
meaning:
मुकुटं तालमात्रं स्यात्तालमात्रं तया मुखं /
तालेनैकेन कण्ठन्तु तालेन हृदयं तथा //
text_mt: The crown should be a span (tāla) in measure, and the face a span in measure; / the throat is one span, and the chest is likewise a span;

sanskrit_iast:
nābhimeḍhrāntarantālaṃ dvitālāvūrukau tathā /
tāladvayena jaṅghā syāt sūtrāṇi śṛṇu sāmprataṃ //
meaning:
नाभिमेढ्रान्तरन्तालं द्वितालावूरुकौ तथा /
तालद्वयेन जङ्घा स्यात् सूत्राणि शृणु साम्प्रतं //
text_mt: the distance between the navel and the penis is a span, and the two thighs are two spans; / the lower leg should be two spans. Now listen to the plumb-lines.

sanskrit_iast:
kāryaṃ sūtradvayaṃ pāde jaṅghāmadhye tathāparaṃ /
jānau sūtradvayaṃ kāryamūrūmadhye tathāparaṃ //
meaning:
कार्यं सूत्रद्वयं पादे जङ्घामध्ये तथापरं /
जानौ सूत्रद्वयं कार्यमूरूमध्ये तथापरं //
text_mt: Two lines are to be made on the foot, and another in the middle of the lower leg; / two lines are to be made on the knee, and another in the middle of the thighs;

sanskrit_iast:
meḍhre tathāparaṃ kāryaṃ kaṭyāṃ sūtrantathāparaṃ /
mekhalābandhasiddhyarthaṃ nābhyāṃ caivāparantathā //
:p 128
meaning:
मेढ्रे तथापरं कार्यं कट्यां सूत्रन्तथापरं /
मेखलाबन्धसिद्ध्यर्थं नाभ्यां चैवापरन्तथा //
:प् 128
text_mt:
another is to be made at the penis, and another line at the waist; / and another at the navel to establish the fastening of the girdle;
[Page 128]

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdaye ca tathā kāryaṃ kaṇṭhe sūtradvayaṃ tathā /
lalāte cāparaṃ kāryaṃ mastake ca tathāparaṃ //
meaning:
हृदये च तथा कार्यं कण्ठे सूत्रद्वयं तथा /
ललाते चापरं कार्यं मस्तके च तथापरं //
text_mt: and likewise [a line] is to be made at the heart, and two lines at the neck; / another is to be made at the forehead, and another at the head;

sanskrit_iast:
mukuṭopari kartavyaṃ sūtramekaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥ /
sūtrāṇyūrdhvaṃ pradeyāni saptaiva kamalodbhava(1) //
meaning:
मुकुटोपरि कर्तव्यं सूत्रमेकं विचक्षणैः /
सूत्राण्यूर्ध्वं प्रदेयानि सप्तैव कमलोद्भव(1) //
text_mt: one line should be made above the crown by the discerning. / Only seven vertical lines should be applied, O Lotus-Born One (Brahmā);

sanskrit_iast:
kakṣātrikāntareṇaiva ghaṭ sūtrāṇi pradāpayet /
madhyasūtraṃ tu santyajya sūtrāṇyeva nivedayet //
meaning:
कक्षात्रिकान्तरेणैव घट् सूत्राणि प्रदापयेत् /
मध्यसूत्रं तु सन्त्यज्य सूत्राण्येव निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: six lines should be placed across the armpits and hips. / Discarding the central line, one should lay down the other lines.

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭaṃ nāsikāvaktraṃ kartavyañcaturaṅgulaṃ /
grīvākarṇau tu kartavyau āyāmāccaturaṅgulau //
meaning:
ललाटं नासिकावक्त्रं कर्तव्यञ्चतुरङ्गुलं /
ग्रीवाकर्णौ तु कर्तव्यौ आयामाच्चतुरङ्गुलौ //
text_mt: The forehead, nose, and mouth should be made four digits [each]; / the neck and ears should be made four digits in length;

sanskrit_iast:
dvyaṅgule hanuke kārye vistārāccibukantathā /
aṣṭāṅgulaṃ lalāṭantu vistāreṇa prakīrtitam //
meaning:
द्व्यङ्गुले हनुके कार्ये विस्ताराच्चिबुकन्तथा /
अष्टाङ्गुलं ललाटन्तु विस्तारेण प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: the two jaws should be made two digits, and likewise the chin in width; / the forehead is declared to be eight digits in width;

sanskrit_iast:
pareṇa dvyaṅgulau śaṅkhau kartavyāvalakānvitau /
caturaṅgulamākhyātamantaraṃ karṇanetrayoḥ //
meaning:
परेण द्व्यङ्गुलौ शङ्खौ कर्तव्यावलकान्वितौ /
चतुरङ्गुलमाख्यातमन्तरं कर्णनेत्रयोः //
text_mt: further, the temples should be made two digits, accompanied by locks of hair; / the distance between the ear and the eye is declared to be four digits;

sanskrit_iast:
dvyaṅgulau pṛthukau karṇau karṇāpāṅgārdhapañcame /
bhrūsamena tu sūtreṇa karṇaśrotraṃ prakīrtitam //
meaning:
द्व्यङ्गुलौ पृथुकौ कर्णौ कर्णापाङ्गार्धपञ्चमे /
भ्रूसमेन तु सूत्रेण कर्णश्रोत्रं प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: the two ears should be two digits wide, five and a half digits from the ear to the outer corner of the eye; / the ear-cavity is declared to be along the line level with the eyebrow;

sanskrit_iast:
viddhaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ karṇamaviddhañcaturaṅgulam /
civukena samaṃ viddhamaviddhaṃ vā ṣaḍaṅgulam //
meaning:
विद्धं षडङ्गुलं कर्णमविद्धञ्चतुरङ्गुलम् /
चिवुकेन समं विद्धमविद्धं वा षडङ्गुलम् //
text_mt: a pierced ear is six digits, and an unpierced one four digits; / pierced it may be level with the chin, or unpierced it may be six digits;

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapātraṃ tathāvartaṃ śaṣkulīṃ kalpayettathā /
dvyaṅgulenādharaḥ kāryastasyārdhenottarādharaḥ //
meaning:
गन्धपात्रं तथावर्तं शष्कुलीं कल्पयेत्तथा /
द्व्यङ्गुलेनाधरः कार्यस्तस्यार्धेनोत्तराधरः //
text_mt: one should fashion the concha, the helix, and the lobe of the ear. / The lower lip should be made two digits, and the upper lip half of that.

sanskrit_iast:
ardhāṅgulaṃ tathā netraṃ(2) vaktrantu caturaṅgulam /
āyāmena tu vaipulyāt sārdhamaṅgulamucyate //
meaning:
अर्धाङ्गुलं तथा नेत्रं(2) वक्त्रन्तु चतुरङ्गुलम् /
आयामेन तु वैपुल्यात् सार्धमङ्गुलमुच्यते //
text_mt: The eye is half a digit, and the mouth is four digits [in length]; / in width, however, it is stated to be one and a half digits.

sanskrit_iast:
avyāttamevaṃ syādvaktraṃ vyāttaṃ tryaṅgulamiṣyate /
nāsāvaṃśasamucchrāyaṃ mūle tvekāṅgulaṃ matam //
meaning:
अव्यात्तमेवं स्याद्वक्त्रं व्यात्तं त्र्यङ्गुलमिष्यते /
नासावंशसमुच्छ्रायं मूले त्वेकाङ्गुलं मतम् //
text_mt: Thus the mouth should be when closed; when open, it is prescribed as three digits. / The height of the nasal bridge is considered one digit at the base;

sanskrit_iast:
ucchrāyā dvyaṅgulaṃ cāgre karavīropamāḥ smṛtāḥ /
:n
1 mukuṭopari iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 tathā gojī iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 129
antaraṃ cakṣuṣoḥ kāryaṃ caturaṅgulamānataḥ //
meaning:
उच्छ्राया द्व्यङ्गुलं चाग्रे करवीरोपमाः स्मृताः /
:न्
1 मुकुटोपरि इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 तथा गोजी इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 129
अन्तरं चक्षुषोः कार्यं चतुरङ्गुलमानतः //
text_mt:
its height at the tip is two digits, and [the nostrils] are considered like oleander flowers.
:n
1 'Above the crown' is the reading in manuscript kha.
2 'Likewise the philtrum' is the reading in manuscript kha.
:p 132
The distance between the two eyes should be made four digits in measure.

sanskrit_iast:
dvyaṅgulaṃ cākṣikoṇaṃ ca dvyaṅgulaṃ cāntaraṃ tayoḥ /
tārā netratribhāgeṇa dṛktārā pañcamāṃśikā //
meaning:
द्व्यङ्गुलं चाक्षिकोणं च द्व्यङ्गुलं चान्तरं तयोः /
तारा नेत्रत्रिभागेण दृक्तारा पञ्चमांशिका //
text_mt: The corner of the eye is two digits, and the space between them is two digits. / The iris is one-third of the eye, and the pupil is one-fifth.

sanskrit_iast:
tryaṅgulaṃ netravistāraṃ droṇī cārdhāṅgulā matā /
tatsamāṇā bhruvorlekhā bhruvau caiva same mate //
meaning:
त्र्यङ्गुलं नेत्रविस्तारं द्रोणी चार्धाङ्गुला मता /
तत्समाणा भ्रुवोर्लेखा भ्रुवौ चैव समे मते //
text_mt: The length of the eye is three digits, and the eye-socket is considered half a digit. / The eyebrow line is equal to that [length], and the two eyebrows are considered equal.

sanskrit_iast:
bhrūmadhyaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ bhrūdairghyaṃ caturāṅgulam(1) /
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulāyāmammastakasya tu veṣṭanam //
meaning:
भ्रूमध्यं द्व्यङ्गुलं कार्यं भ्रूदैर्घ्यं चतुराङ्गुलम्(1) /
षट्त्रिंशदङ्गुलायामम्मस्तकस्य तु वेष्टनम् //
text_mt: The space between the eyebrows should be made two digits, and the length of the eyebrow four digits. / The circumference of the head is thirty-six digits in extent.

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtīnāṃ keśavādīnāṃ dvātriṃśadveṣṭanaṃ bhavet /
pañcanetrā tvadhogrīvā vistārādveṣṭanaṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
मूर्तीनां केशवादीनां द्वात्रिंशद्वेष्टनं भवेत् /
पञ्चनेत्रा त्वधोग्रीवा विस्ताराद्वेष्टनं पुनः //
text_mt: For icons of Keśava and others, the circumference should be thirty-two [digits]. / The lower neck is five digits in width, while its circumference

sanskrit_iast:
triguṇantu bhavedūrdhvaṃ vistṛtāṣṭāṅgulaṃ punaḥ /
grīvātriguṇamāyāmaṃ grīvāvakṣontaraṃ bhavet //
meaning:
त्रिगुणन्तु भवेदूर्ध्वं विस्तृताष्टाङ्गुलं पुनः /
ग्रीवात्रिगुणमायामं ग्रीवावक्षोन्तरं भवेत् //
text_mt: should be threefold; the upper [neck] is again eight digits broad. / The length of the neck should be three times [its width], and such should be the distance between the neck and the chest.

sanskrit_iast:
skandhāvaṣṭāṅgulau kāryau trikalāvaṃśakau śubhau /
saptanetrau smṛtau bāhū prabāhū ṣoḍaśāṅgulau //
meaning:
स्कन्धावष्टाङ्गुलौ कार्यौ त्रिकलावंशकौ शुभौ /
सप्तनेत्रौ स्मृतौ बाहू प्रबाहू षोडशाङ्गुलौ //
text_mt: The two shoulders should be made eight digits, and the two collarbones auspicious with three kalās. / The upper arms are taught as seven digits, and the forearms as sixteen digits.

sanskrit_iast:
trikalau vistṛtau bāhū prabāhū cāpi tatsamau /
bāhudaṇḍordhvato jñeyaḥ pariṇāhaḥ kalā nava //
meaning:
त्रिकलौ विस्तृतौ बाहू प्रबाहू चापि तत्समौ /
बाहुदण्डोर्ध्वतो ज्ञेयः परिणाहः कला नव //
text_mt: The two upper arms are three kalās broad, and the forearms are equal to them. / At the top of the shaft of the arm, the circumference is to be known as nine kalās.

sanskrit_iast:
saptadaśāṅgulo madhye kūrpārordhe ca ṣoḍaśa /
kūrpārasya bhavennāhaḥ triguṇaḥ kamalodbhava //
meaning:
सप्तदशाङ्गुलो मध्ये कूर्पारोर्धे च षोडश /
कूर्पारस्य भवेन्नाहः त्रिगुणः कमलोद्भव //
text_mt: It is seventeen digits in the middle, and sixteen digits above the elbow. / The circumference of the elbow is three times that, O Lotus-born [Brahmā]!

sanskrit_iast:
nāhaḥ prabāhumadhye tu ṣoḍaśāṅgula ucyate /
agrahaste parīṇāho dvādaśāṅgula ucyate //
meaning:
नाहः प्रबाहुमध्ये तु षोडशाङ्गुल उच्यते /
अग्रहस्ते परीणाहो द्वादशाङ्गुल उच्यते //
text_mt: The circumference in the middle of the forearm is said to be sixteen digits. / The circumference at the wrist is said to be twelve digits.

sanskrit_iast:
vistareṇa karatalaṃ kīrtitaṃ tu ṣaḍaṅgulam /
dairghyaṃ saptāṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ madhyā pajcāṅgulā matā //
meaning:
विस्तरेण करतलं कीर्तितं तु षडङ्गुलम् /
दैर्घ्यं सप्ताङ्गुलं कार्यं मध्या पज्चाङ्गुला मता //
text_mt: The palm of the hand is declared to be six digits in breadth; / the length should be made seven digits, and the middle finger is considered five digits.

sanskrit_iast:
tarjanyanāmikā caiva tasmādardhāṅgulaṃ vinā /
kaniṣṭhāṅguṣṭhakau kāryau caturaṅgulasammitau //
:n
1 bhrūdairghyāccaturaṅgulā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 130
meaning:
तर्जन्यनामिका चैव तस्मादर्धाङ्गुलं विना /
कनिष्ठाङ्गुष्ठकौ कार्यौ चतुरङ्गुलसम्मितौ //
:न्
1 भ्रूदैर्घ्याच्चतुरङ्गुला इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 130
text_mt:
The forefinger and ring finger are less than that by half a digit. / The little finger and thumb should be made measuring four digits.
:n
1 'Four digits in length of the eyebrow' is the reading in manuscript ṅa.
:p 130

sanskrit_iast:
dviparvoṅguṣṭhakaḥ kāryaḥ śeṣāgulyastriparvikāḥ /
sarvāsāṃ parvaṇordhena nakhamānaṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
द्विपर्वोङ्गुष्ठकः कार्यः शेषागुल्यस्त्रिपर्विकाः /
सर्वासां पर्वणोर्धेन नखमानं विधीयते //
text_mt: The thumb should be made with two phalanges; the remaining fingers have three phalanges. / The measure of the nail for all [fingers] is prescribed as half a phalanx.

sanskrit_iast:
vakṣaso yat pramāṇantu jaṭharaṃ tatpramāṇataḥ /
aṅgulaikaṃ bhavennābhī vedhena ca pramāṇataḥ //
meaning:
वक्षसो यत् प्रमाणन्तु जठरं तत्प्रमाणतः /
अङ्गुलैकं भवेन्नाभी वेधेन च प्रमाणतः //
text_mt: Whatever the measure of the chest is, the abdomen is of that same measure. / The navel should be one digit in depth and measurement.

sanskrit_iast:
tato meḍhrāntaraṃ kāryaṃ tālamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ /
nābhimadhye prīṇāho dvicatvāriṃśadaṅgulaiḥ //
meaning:
ततो मेढ्रान्तरं कार्यं तालमात्रं प्रमाणतः /
नाभिमध्ये प्रीणाहो द्विचत्वारिंशदङ्गुलैः //
text_mt: From there, the distance to the penis should be made one tāla in measure. / The circumference at the middle of the navel is forty-two digits.

sanskrit_iast:
antaraṃ stanayoḥ kāryaṃ tālamātraṃ pramāṇataḥ /
civukau(1) yavamānau tu maṇḍalaṃ dvipadaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
अन्तरं स्तनयोः कार्यं तालमात्रं प्रमाणतः /
चिवुकौ(1) यवमानौ तु मण्डलं द्विपदं भवेत् //
text_mt: The space between the breasts should be made one tāla in measure. / The nipples measure one barley-corn each, and their halo should be two digits.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥṣaṣṭyaṅgulaṃ kāryaṃ veṣṭanaṃ vakṣasaḥsphuṭam /
caturmukhañca tadadhoveṣṭanaṃ parikīrtitam //
meaning:
चतुःषष्ट्यङ्गुलं कार्यं वेष्टनं वक्षसःस्फुटम् /
चतुर्मुखञ्च तदधोवेष्टनं परिकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: The circumference of the chest should clearly be made sixty-four digits. / Below that, the circumference is declared to be four mukhas.

sanskrit_iast:
pariṇāhas tathā kaṭyā catuḥpañcāśadaṅgulaiḥ /
vistāraścorumūle tu procyate dvādaśaṅgulaḥ //
meaning:
परिणाहस् तथा कट्या चतुःपञ्चाशदङ्गुलैः /
विस्तारश्चोरुमूले तु प्रोच्यते द्वादशङ्गुलः //
text_mt: Likewise, the circumference of the waist is fifty-four digits. / And the breadth at the base of the thigh is stated as twelve digits.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādabhyadhikaṃ madhye tato nimnataraṃ kramāt /
vistṛtāṣṭāṅgulaṃ jānutriguṇā pariṇāhataḥ //
meaning:
तस्मादभ्यधिकं मध्ये ततो निम्नतरं क्रमात् /
विस्तृताष्टाङ्गुलं जानुत्रिगुणा परिणाहतः //
text_mt: Greater than that in the middle, and from there gradually tapering. / The knee is eight digits broad and threefold in circumference.

sanskrit_iast:
jaṅghāmadhye tu vistāraḥ saptāṅgula udāhṛtaḥ /
triguṇā paridhiścāsya jaṅghāgraṃ pañcavistarāt //
meaning:
जङ्घामध्ये तु विस्तारः सप्ताङ्गुल उदाहृतः /
त्रिगुणा परिधिश्चास्य जङ्घाग्रं पञ्चविस्तरात् //
text_mt: The width in the middle of the shin is declared to be seven digits, / and its circumference is threefold; the top of the shin is five [digits] in width.

sanskrit_iast:
triguṇā paridhiścāsya pādau tālapramāṇakau /
āyāmādutthitau pādau caturaṅgulameva ca //
meaning:
त्रिगुणा परिधिश्चास्य पादौ तालप्रमाणकौ /
आयामादुत्थितौ पादौ चतुरङ्गुलमेव च //
text_mt: Its circumference is threefold; the two feet measure one tāla. / The feet raised in height are four digits.

sanskrit_iast:
gulphāt pūrvaṃ tu kartavyaṃ pramāṇāccaturaṅgulam /
trikalaṃ vistṛtau pādau tryaṅgulo guhyakaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
गुल्फात् पूर्वं तु कर्तव्यं प्रमाणाच्चतुरङ्गुलम् /
त्रिकलं विस्तृतौ पादौ त्र्यङ्गुलो गुह्यकः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Before the ankle should be made four digits in measure. / The two feet are three kalās broad; the big toe is known to be three digits.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāṅgulastu nāhosya dīrghā tadvat pradeśinī /
aṣṭamāṣṭāṃśatonyūnaḥ śeṣāṅgulyaḥ krameṇa tu //
meaning:
पञ्चाङ्गुलस्तु नाहोस्य दीर्घा तद्वत् प्रदेशिनी /
अष्टमाष्टांशतोन्यूनः शेषाङ्गुल्यः क्रमेण तु //
text_mt: Its circumference is five digits; the second toe is equally long. / Decreasing by one-eighth [of a digit] progressively are the remaining toes.

sanskrit_iast:
sapādāṅgulamutsedhamaṅguṣṭasya prakīrtitaṃ /
yavonamaṅgulaṃ kāryamaṅguṣṭhasya nakhaṃ tathā //
:n
1 cūcukau iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 131
meaning:
सपादाङ्गुलमुत्सेधमङ्गुष्टस्य प्रकीर्तितं /
यवोनमङ्गुलं कार्यमङ्गुष्ठस्य नखं तथा //
:न्
1 चूचुकौ इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 131
text_mt:
The height of the big toe is proclaimed as one and a quarter digits; / the nail of the big toe should be made one digit less a barley-corn.
:n
1 'The two nipples' is the reading in manuscript ṅa.
:p 131

sanskrit_iast:
ardhāṅgulaṃ tathānyāsāṃ(1) kramān nyūnaṃ tu kārayet /
aṅgulau vṛṣaṇau kāryau meḍhraṃ tu caturaṅgulam //
meaning:
अर्धाङ्गुलं तथान्यासां(1) क्रमान् न्यूनं तु कारयेत् /
अङ्गुलौ वृषणौ कार्यौ मेढ्रं तु चतुरङ्गुलम् //
text_mt: For the others, one should make it gradually decrease by half a digit. / The testicles should be made two digits, and the penis four digits.

sanskrit_iast:
pariṇāhotra koṣāgraṃ kartavyañcaturaṅgulam /
ṣaḍaṅgulaparīṇāhau vṛṣaṇau parikīrtitau //
meaning:
परिणाहोत्र कोषाग्रं कर्तव्यञ्चतुरङ्गुलम् /
षडङ्गुलपरीणाहौ वृषणौ परिकीर्तितौ //
text_mt: Here the tip of the scrotum should be made four digits in circumference. / The testicles are declared to have a circumference of six digits.

sanskrit_iast:
pratimā bhūṣaṇāḍhyā syādetaduddeśalakṣaṇam /
anayaiva diśā kāryaṃ loke dṛṣṭvā tu lakṣaṇam //
meaning:
प्रतिमा भूषणाढ्या स्यादेतदुद्देशलक्षणम् /
अनयैव दिशा कार्यं लोके दृष्ट्वा तु लक्षणम् //
text_mt: The image should be richly ornamented; this is the summary of characteristics. / In this very manner, having observed [the figures] in the world, the characteristics should be made.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe tu kare cakramadhastāt padmameva ca /
vāme śaṅkhaṃ gadādhastādvāsudevasya lakṣaṇāt //
meaning:
दक्षिणे तु करे चक्रमधस्तात् पद्ममेव च /
वामे शङ्खं गदाधस्ताद्वासुदेवस्य लक्षणात् //
text_mt: In the right hand [is] the discus, and below it the lotus; / in the left [is] the conch, and below it the mace, according to the characteristics of Vāsudeva.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīpuṣṭau vāpi kartavye padmavīṇākarānvite /
ūrumātrocchitāyāme mālāvidyādharau(2) tathā //
meaning:
श्रीपुष्टौ वापि कर्तव्ये पद्मवीणाकरान्विते /
ऊरुमात्रोच्छितायामे मालाविद्याधरौ(2) तथा //
text_mt: Śrī and Puṣṭi should also be made, holding a lotus and a vīṇā in their hands, / their height and length measuring up to the thighs; likewise two garland-bearing Vidyādharas,

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāmaṇḍalasaṃsthau tau prabhā hastyādibhūṣaṇā /
padmābhaṃ pādapīṭhantu pratimāsvevamācaret //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma catuś
catvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ
piṇḍikālakṣaṇakathanaṃ
meaning:
प्रभामण्डलसंस्थौ तौ प्रभा हस्त्यादिभूषणा /
पद्माभं पादपीठन्तु प्रतिमास्वेवमाचरेत् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये प्रतिमालक्षणं नाम चतुश्
चत्वारिंशोध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चचत्वारिंशोध्यायः
पिण्डिकालक्षणकथनं
text_mt:
both situated on the halo, which is adorned with elephants and the like. / The footstool should resemble a lotus; thus should one make for images.
:e Thus in the Agnipurāṇa, the primeval Mahāpurāṇa, the forty-fourth chapter, named 'The Characteristics of Images' [is concluded].
:ś Now the forty-fifth chapter.
The Statement on the Characteristics of the Pedestal

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
piṇḍikālakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye dairghyeṇa pratimāsamā /
ucchrāyaṃ pratimārdhantu catuḥṣaṣṭipuṭāṃ(2) ca tām //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
पिण्डिकालक्षणं वक्ष्ये दैर्घ्येण प्रतिमासमा /
उच्छ्रायं प्रतिमार्धन्तु चतुःषष्टिपुटां(2) च ताम् //
text_mt: The Blessed Lord said: / I shall state the characteristics of the pedestal: it is equal to the image in length, / and its height is half of the image; it is divided into sixty-four compartments.

sanskrit_iast:
tyaktvā paṅktidvayaṃ cādhastadūrdhvaṃ yattu koṣṭhakam /
:n
1 sārdhāṅgulaṃ tathāyāmamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 maṇividyādharāviti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 catuḥṣaṣṭipadāmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 132
samantādubhayoḥ pārśve antasthaṃ parimārjayet //
meaning:
त्यक्त्वा पङ्क्तिद्वयं चाधस्तदूर्ध्वं यत्तु कोष्ठकम् /
:न्
1 सार्धाङ्गुलं तथायाममिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 मणिविद्याधराविति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 चतुःषष्टिपदामिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 132
समन्तादुभयोः पार्श्वे अन्तस्थं परिमार्जयेत् //
text_mt:
Leaving two rows below, whatever square is above that,
:n
1 'Likewise one and a half digits in length' is the reading in manuscript ṅa.
2 'Jewel-bearing Vidyādharas' is the reading in manuscript gha.
3 'Consisting of sixty-four squares' is the reading in manuscript ṅa.
:p 132
on both sides all around, one should erase the interior [squares].

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ paṅgktidvayaṃ tyaktvā adhastād yattu koṣṭhakam /
antaḥ sammārjayet yatnāt pārśvayorubhayoḥ samam //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं पङ्ग्क्तिद्वयं त्यक्त्वा अधस्ताद् यत्तु कोष्ठकम् /
अन्तः सम्मार्जयेत् यत्नात् पार्श्वयोरुभयोः समम् //
text_mt: Leaving two rows above, whatever square is below, / one should carefully erase inside, equally on both sides.

sanskrit_iast:
tayormadhyagatau tatra catuṣkau mārjayettataḥ /
caturdhā bhājayitvā tu ūrdhvapaṅktidvayaṃ budhaḥ //
meaning:
तयोर्मध्यगतौ तत्र चतुष्कौ मार्जयेत्ततः /
चतुर्धा भाजयित्वा तु ऊर्ध्वपङ्क्तिद्वयं बुधः //
text_mt: Then, one should erase the four-square space situated between the two. / Having divided the upper two rows into four parts, the wise person

sanskrit_iast:
mekhalā bhāgamātrā syāt khātaṃ tasyārdhamānataḥ /
bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ parityajya pārśvayorubhayoḥ samaṃ //
meaning:
मेखला भागमात्रा स्यात् खातं तस्यार्धमानतः /
भागं भागं परित्यज्य पार्श्वयोरुभयोः समं //
text_mt: should make the girdle one part in size, and the cavity half of that in measure. / Having left one part each equally on both sides,

sanskrit_iast:
datvā caikaṃ padaṃ vāhye pramāṇaṃ kārayed budhaḥ /
tribhāgeṇa ca bhāgasyāgre syāttoyavinirgamaḥ //
meaning:
दत्वा चैकं पदं वाह्ये प्रमाणं कारयेद् बुधः /
त्रिभागेण च भागस्याग्रे स्यात्तोयविनिर्गमः //
text_mt: and having given one square on the outside, the wise person should make the measurement. / And at one-third of a part in front should be the water spout.

sanskrit_iast:
nānāprakārabhedena bhadreyaṃ(1) piṇḍikā śubhā /
aṣṭatālā tu kartavyā devī lakṣmīstayā striyaḥ //
meaning:
नानाप्रकारभेदेन भद्रेयं(1) पिण्डिका शुभा /
अष्टताला तु कर्तव्या देवी लक्ष्मीस्तया स्त्रियः //
text_mt: With various types of divisions, this auspicious pedestal is of the Bhadra type. / The goddess Lakṣmī and other female [deities] should be made measuring eight tālas.

sanskrit_iast:
bhruvau yavādhike kārye yavahīnā tu nāsikā /
golakenādhikaṃ vaktramūrdhvaṃ tiryagvivarjitaṃ //
meaning:
भ्रुवौ यवाधिके कार्ये यवहीना तु नासिका /
गोलकेनाधिकं वक्त्रमूर्ध्वं तिर्यग्विवर्जितं //
text_mt: The two eyebrows should be made larger by one barley-corn, but the nose smaller by one barley-corn. / The mouth is greater by the eyeball, devoid of upward or oblique [distortion].

sanskrit_iast:
āyate nayane kārye tribhāgonair yavaistribhiḥ /
tadardhena tu vaipulyaṃ netrayoḥ parikalpayet //
meaning:
आयते नयने कार्ये त्रिभागोनैर् यवैस्त्रिभिः /
तदर्धेन तु वैपुल्यं नेत्रयोः परिकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: The two eyes should be made elongated by three barley-corns minus a third; / and one should fix the width of the two eyes as half of that.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇapāśo .dhikaḥ kāryaḥ sṛkkaṇīsamasūtrataḥ /
namraṃ kalāvihīnantu kuryādaṃśadvayaṃ tathā //
meaning:
कर्णपाशो .धिकः कार्यः सृक्कणीसमसूत्रतः /
नम्रं कलाविहीनन्तु कुर्यादंशद्वयं तथा //
text_mt:
The earlobe should be made larger, on an even line with the corners of the mouth;
and one should make the two parts sloping down, reduced by a digit.

sanskrit_iast:
grīvā sārdhakalā kāryā tadvistāropaśobhitā /
netraṃ vinā tu vistārau ūrū jānū ca piṇḍikā //
meaning:
ग्रीवा सार्धकला कार्या तद्विस्तारोपशोभिता /
नेत्रं विना तु विस्तारौ ऊरू जानू च पिण्डिका //
text_mt: The neck should be made one and a half kalās [in height], adorned with a width [equal to] that. / Leaving aside the eyes, [such are] the widths; and [so are] the thighs, the knees, and the pedestal.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅghripṛṣṭhau sphicau kaṭyāṃ yathābhāgaṃ prakalpayet /
saptāṃśonās tathāṅgulyo dīrghaṃ viṣkambhanāhataṃ //
meaning:
अङ्घ्रिपृष्ठौ स्फिचौ कट्यां यथाभागं प्रकल्पयेत् /
सप्तांशोनास् तथाङ्गुल्यो दीर्घं विष्कम्भनाहतं //
text_mt: One should fashion the tops of the feet and the buttocks on the hip in their proper proportion. / Likewise, the fingers are reduced by a seventh part, long, struck [proportionately] by the diameter.

sanskrit_iast:
netraikavarjitāyāmā jaṅghorū ca tathā kaṭiḥ /
madhyapārśvaṃ ca tadvṛttaṃ ghanaṃ pīnaṃ kucadvayaṃ //
:n
1 tatreyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 133
meaning:
नेत्रैकवर्जितायामा जङ्घोरू च तथा कटिः /
मध्यपार्श्वं च तद्वृत्तं घनं पीनं कुचद्वयं //
:न्
1 तत्रेयमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 133
text_mt:
The shanks, thighs, and likewise the waist have a length minus one eye[-measure]; / and the waist-side is rounded, and the pair of breasts is firm and plump.
[...]
[Alternative reading:] 'tatreyamiti' is the variant reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 133]

sanskrit_iast:
tālamātrau stanau karyau kaṭiḥ sārdhakalādhikā /
lakṣma śeṣaṃ purāvatsyāt dakṣiṇe cāmubujaṃ kare //
meaning:
तालमात्रौ स्तनौ कर्यौ कटिः सार्धकलाधिका /
लक्ष्म शेषं पुरावत्स्यात् दक्षिणे चामुबुजं करे //
text_mt: The breasts should be made one tāla [in size]; the waist is greater by one and a half kalās. / The remaining characteristic should be as before, and in the right hand an aquatic lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
vāme vittvaṃ striyau pārśve śubhe cāmarahastake /
dīrghaghoṇastu garuḍaś cakrāṅgādyānatho vade //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye piṇḍikālakṣmādilakṣaṇaṃ
nāma pañcacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
śālagrāmādimūrtilakṣaṇakathanaṃ
meaning:
वामे वित्त्वं स्त्रियौ पार्श्वे शुभे चामरहस्तके /
दीर्घघोणस्तु गरुडश् चक्राङ्गाद्यानथो वदे //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये पिण्डिकालक्ष्मादिलक्षणं
नाम पञ्चचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ षट्चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
शालग्रामादिमूर्तिलक्षणकथनं
text_mt:
On the left, [the emblem of] wealth; two auspicious women on the sides holding chowries in their hands. / But Garuḍa has a prominent beak. Now I shall declare [the icons] marked with the disc and others.
Thus ends the forty-fifth chapter, titled 'The Characteristics of the Pedestal and other Marks', in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now the forty-sixth chapter.
Declaration of the characteristics of the icons such as the śālagrāma.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
śālagrāmādimūrteś ca vakṣyehaṃ bhuktimuktidāḥ /
vāsudevo 'sito dvāre śālagrāmadvicakrakaḥ //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
शालग्रामादिमूर्तेश् च वक्ष्येहं भुक्तिमुक्तिदाः /
वासुदेवो ऽसितो द्वारे शालग्रामद्विचक्रकः //
text_mt: The Lord said: / I shall declare the icons of the śālagrāma and others, which grant worldly enjoyment and liberation. / Vāsudeva is black, has two discs of the śālagrāma at the entrance.

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyaḥ saṅkarṣaṇo lagnadvicakro rakta uttamaḥ /
sūkṣmacakro bahucchidraḥ pradyumno nīladīghavaḥ //
meaning:
ज्ञेयः सङ्कर्षणो लग्नद्विचक्रो रक्त उत्तमः /
सूक्ष्मचक्रो बहुच्छिद्रः प्रद्युम्नो नीलदीघवः //
text_mt: Saṅkarṣaṇa is to be known as having two joined discs, red, and excellent. / Pradyumna has a minute disc, many apertures, and a long blue body.

sanskrit_iast:
pīto niruddhaḥ padmāṅgo vartulo dvitrirekhavān /
kṛṣṇo nārāyaṇo nābhyunnataḥ śuṣiradīrghavān //
meaning:
पीतो निरुद्धः पद्माङ्गो वर्तुलो द्वित्रिरेखवान् /
कृष्णो नारायणो नाभ्युन्नतः शुषिरदीर्घवान् //
text_mt: Aniruddha is yellow, marked with a lotus, round, and possessing two or three lines. / Nārāyaṇa is black, elevated at the navel, and having a long cavity.

sanskrit_iast:
parameṣṭho sābjacakraḥ pṛṣṭhacchidrakaś ca(1) vindumān /
sthūlacakro 'sito viṣṇurmadhye rekhā gadākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
परमेष्ठो साब्जचक्रः पृष्ठच्छिद्रकश् च(1) विन्दुमान् /
स्थूलचक्रो ऽसितो विष्णुर्मध्ये रेखा गदाकृतिः //
text_mt: Parameṣṭhin is endowed with a lotus and a disc, has an aperture at the back, and is marked with dots. / Viṣṇu has a thick disc, is black, and has a line in the middle shaped like a mace.

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhaḥ kapikaḥ sthūlavakraḥ syāt pañcavindukaḥ /
varāhaḥ śaktiliṅgaḥ syāt taccakrau viṣamau sṛtau //
meaning:
नृसिंहः कपिकः स्थूलवक्रः स्यात् पञ्चविन्दुकः /
वराहः शक्तिलिङ्गः स्यात् तच्चक्रौ विषमौ सृतौ //
text_mt: Nṛsiṃha is tawny, has a thick curved [line], and possesses five dots. / Varāha has the mark of a spear; his two discs are uneven and spread out.

sanskrit_iast:
indranīlanibhaḥ sthūlastrirekhālāñchitaḥ śubhaḥ /
kūrmastathonnataḥ pṛṣṭhe vartulāvartako 'sitaḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रनीलनिभः स्थूलस्त्रिरेखालाञ्छितः शुभः /
कूर्मस्तथोन्नतः पृष्ठे वर्तुलावर्तको ऽसितः //
text_mt: He resembles a sapphire, is thick, marked with three lines, and auspicious. / Kūrma is likewise elevated on the back, has a circular spiral, and is black.

sanskrit_iast:
hayagrīvoṅkuśāvārarekho nīlaḥ savindukaḥ /
:n
1 pṛthuśccchidraśceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 134
vaikuṇṭhaḥ ekacakro 'bjī maṇibhiḥ puccharekhakaḥ //
meaning:
हयग्रीवोङ्कुशावाररेखो नीलः सविन्दुकः /
:न्
1 पृथुश्च्च्छिद्रश्चेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 134
वैकुण्ठः एकचक्रो ऽब्जी मणिभिः पुच्छरेखकः //
text_mt:
Hayagrīva has a line resembling an elephant-goad, is blue, and marked with dots.
[...]
[Alternative reading:] 'pṛthuśccchidraśceti' is the variant reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 134]
Vaikuṇṭha has a single disc, is endowed with a lotus, and has a tail-line with gems.

sanskrit_iast:
matsyo dīrghastrivinduḥ syāt kācavarṇastu pūritaḥ /
śrīdharo vanamālāṅkaḥ pañjarekhastu vartulaḥ //
meaning:
मत्स्यो दीर्घस्त्रिविन्दुः स्यात् काचवर्णस्तु पूरितः /
श्रीधरो वनमालाङ्कः पञ्जरेखस्तु वर्तुलः //
text_mt: Matsya is long, has three dots, has the color of glass, and is plump. / Śrīdhara is marked with a garland of forest flowers, has five lines, and is round.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmano vartulaścātihrasvo nīlaḥ savindukaḥ /
śyāmastrivikramo dakṣarekho vāmena vindukaḥ //
meaning:
वामनो वर्तुलश्चातिह्रस्वो नीलः सविन्दुकः /
श्यामस्त्रिविक्रमो दक्षरेखो वामेन विन्दुकः //
text_mt: Vāmana is round, exceedingly short, blue, and marked with dots. / Trivikrama is dark, has a line on the right, and a dot on the left.

sanskrit_iast:
ananto nāgabhogāṅgo naikābho naikamūrtimān /
sthūlo dāmodaro madhyacakro dvāḥsūkṣmavindukaḥ(1) //
meaning:
अनन्तो नागभोगाङ्गो नैकाभो नैकमूर्तिमान् /
स्थूलो दामोदरो मध्यचक्रो द्वाःसूक्ष्मविन्दुकः(1) //
text_mt: Ananta has the body of a serpent's coils, manifold luster, and manifold forms. / Dāmodara is thick, has a central disc, and small dots at the entrance.

sanskrit_iast:
sudarśanastvekacakro lakṣmīnārāyaṇo dvayāt /
tricakraścācyuto devastricakrako vā trivikramaḥ //
meaning:
सुदर्शनस्त्वेकचक्रो लक्ष्मीनारायणो द्वयात् /
त्रिचक्रश्चाच्युतो देवस्त्रिचक्रको वा त्रिविक्रमः //
text_mt: Sudarśana has a single disc; Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa has two; / the god Acyuta has three discs, or Trivikrama has three discs.

sanskrit_iast:
janārdanaś catuś cakro vāsudevaś ca pañcabhiḥ /
ṣaṭvakraś caiva pradyumnaḥ saṅkarṣaṇañca saptabhiḥ //
meaning:
जनार्दनश् चतुश् चक्रो वासुदेवश् च पञ्चभिः /
षट्वक्रश् चैव प्रद्युम्नः सङ्कर्षणञ्च सप्तभिः //
text_mt: Janārdana has four discs, and Vāsudeva has five; / Pradyumna has six curved [lines], and Saṅkarṣaṇa has seven.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣottamoṣṭacakro navavyūho navāṅkitaḥ /
daśāvatāro daśabhirdaśaikenāniruddhakaḥ /
dvādaśātmā dvādaśabhirata ūrdhvamanantakaḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye śālagrāmādimūrtilakṣaṇaṃ nāma
ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha saptacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
śālagrāmādipūjākathanaṃ
meaning:
पुरुषोत्तमोष्टचक्रो नवव्यूहो नवाङ्कितः /
दशावतारो दशभिर्दशैकेनानिरुद्धकः /
द्वादशात्मा द्वादशभिरत ऊर्ध्वमनन्तकः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये शालग्रामादिमूर्तिलक्षणं नाम
षट्चत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ सप्तचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
शालग्रामादिपूजाकथनं
text_mt:
Puruṣottama has eight discs; Navavyūha is marked with nine; / Daśāvatāra has ten; Aniruddha has eleven; / Dvādaśātman has twelve; beyond this, [the icon] is Ananta.
Thus ends the forty-sixth chapter, titled 'The Characteristics of the Icons such as the Śālagrāma', in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now the forty-seventh chapter.
Declaration of the worship of the śālagrāma and other [stones].

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
śālagrāmādicakrāṅkapūjāḥ siddhyai vadāmi te /
trividhā syāddhareḥ pūjā kāmyākāmyobhayātmikā //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
शालग्रामादिचक्राङ्कपूजाः सिद्ध्यै वदामि ते /
त्रिविधा स्याद्धरेः पूजा काम्याकाम्योभयात्मिका //
text_mt: The Lord said: / I shall declare to you the worship of the [stones] marked with discs such as the śālagrāma, for attainment. / Worship of Hari is of three kinds: with desire, desireless, and consisting of both.

sanskrit_iast:
mīnādīnāntu pañcānāṃ kāmyātho vobhayātmikā(2) /
:n
1 madhyacakrādhaḥ sūkṣmavinduka iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 kāmyārthevobhayātmaketi gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 135
varāhasya nṛsiṃhasya vāmanasya ca muktaye //
meaning:
मीनादीनान्तु पञ्चानां काम्याथो वोभयात्मिका(2) /
:न्
1 मध्यचक्राधः सूक्ष्मविन्दुक इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 काम्यार्थेवोभयात्मकेति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 135
वराहस्य नृसिंहस्य वामनस्य च मुक्तये //
text_mt:
For the five beginning with the Fish, [it is] with desire, or consisting of both;
[...]
[Alternative reading:] 'madhyacakrādhaḥ sūkṣmavinduka iti' is the variant reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
[Alternative reading:] 'kāmyārthevobhayātmaketi' is the variant reading in the manuscript marked gha. / [Page 135]
for Varāha, Nṛsiṃha, and Vāmana, [it is] for liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
cakrādīnāṃ trayāṇāntu śālagrāmārcanaṃ śṛṇu /
uttamā niṣphalā pūjā kaniṣṭhā saphalārcanā //
meaning:
चक्रादीनां त्रयाणान्तु शालग्रामार्चनं शृणु /
उत्तमा निष्फला पूजा कनिष्ठा सफलार्चना //
text_mt: Listen to the worship of the śālagrāma and others of the three, beginning with the disc: / The highest worship is without [desire for] fruit; the lowest worship is [attended] with fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamā mūrtipūjā syāccakrābje caturasrake /
praṇavaṃ hṛdi vinyasya ṣaḍaṅgaṅkaradehayoḥ //
meaning:
मध्यमा मूर्तिपूजा स्याच्चक्राब्जे चतुरस्रके /
प्रणवं हृदि विन्यस्य षडङ्गङ्करदेहयोः //
text_mt: The middling is the worship of the icon on a four-sided [diagram] with a disc and a lotus. / Having deposited the praṇava in the heart, and the six limbs upon the hands and body,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtamudrātrayaś cakrād vahiḥ pūve guruṃ yajet /
āpye gaṇaṃ vāyave ca dhātāraṃ nairṛte yajet //
meaning:
कृतमुद्रात्रयश् चक्राद् वहिः पूवे गुरुं यजेत् /
आप्ये गणं वायवे च धातारं नैरृते यजेत् //
text_mt: having made the three ritual gestures, one should worship the guru outside the disc in the east; / one should worship Gaṇa in the west, Dhātṛ in the north-west, and Nairṛta in the south-west;

sanskrit_iast:
vidhātārañca kartāraṃ hartāraṃ dakṣasaumyayoḥ /
viśvaksenaṃ yajedīśe āgneye kṣetrapālakam //
meaning:
विधातारञ्च कर्तारं हर्तारं दक्षसौम्ययोः /
विश्वक्सेनं यजेदीशे आग्नेये क्षेत्रपालकम् //
text_mt: Vidhātṛ and the Creator and the Destroyer in the south and north; / one should worship Viṣvaksena in the north-east, and the Kṣetrapāla in the south-east;

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgādivedān prāgādau ādhārānantakaṃ bhuvaṃ /
pīṭhaṃ padmaṃ cārkacandravahnyākhyaṃ maṇḍalatrayaṃ //
meaning:
ऋगादिवेदान् प्रागादौ आधारानन्तकं भुवं /
पीठं पद्मं चार्कचन्द्रवह्न्याख्यं मण्डलत्रयं //
text_mt: the Vedas beginning with the Ṛgveda in the east and the other [quarters]; the Support, Ananta, the earth, / the seat, the lotus, and the three maṇḍalas named Sun, Moon, and Fire;

sanskrit_iast:
āsanaṃ dvādaśārṇena tatra sthāpya śilāṃ yajet /
astena ca samastena svavījena yajet kramāt //
meaning:
आसनं द्वादशार्णेन तत्र स्थाप्य शिलां यजेत् /
अस्तेन च समस्तेन स्ववीजेन यजेत् क्रमात् //
text_mt: having placed the stone there on the seat with the twelve-syllable mantra, one should worship it. / One should worship it successively with the weapon[-mantra], with the complete [mantra], and with its own seed-syllable.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādāvatha vedādyair gāyatrībhyāṃ jitādinā /
praṇavenārcayet pañcānmudrāstisraḥ pradarśayet //
meaning:
पूर्वादावथ वेदाद्यैर् गायत्रीभ्यां जितादिना /
प्रणवेनार्चयेत् पञ्चान्मुद्रास्तिस्रः प्रदर्शयेत् //
text_mt: Then in the east and other [directions], with the Vedic [mantras] and others, with the two Gāyatrīs, with [the hymn] beginning with 'Jita', / and with the praṇava, one should worship afterwards; one should show the three ritual gestures.

sanskrit_iast:
viśvaksenasya cakrasya kṣetrapālasya darśayet /
śālagrāmasya prathamā pūjārtho niṣphalocyate //
meaning:
विश्वक्सेनस्य चक्रस्य क्षेत्रपालस्य दर्शयेत् /
शालग्रामस्य प्रथमा पूजार्थो निष्फलोच्यते //
text_mt: One should show [the gestures] of Viṣvaksena, of the disc, and of the Kṣetrapāla. / The first worship of the śālagrāma is said to be without [desire for] fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavat ṣoḍaśārañca sapadmaṃ maṇḍalaṃ likhet /
śaṅkhacakragadākhaḍgair gurvādyaṃ pūrvavadyajet(1) //
meaning:
पूर्ववत् षोडशारञ्च सपद्मं मण्डलं लिखेत् /
शङ्खचक्रगदाखड्गैर् गुर्वाद्यं पूर्ववद्यजेत्(1) //
text_mt: As before, one should draw a sixteen-spoked maṇḍala with a lotus. / With conch, disc, mace, and sword, one should worship the guru and the others as before.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrve saumye dhanurvāṇān vedādyair āsanaṃ dadet /
śilāṃ nyased dvādaśārṇaistṛtīyaṃ pūjanaṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
पूर्वे सौम्ये धनुर्वाणान् वेदाद्यैर् आसनं ददेत् /
शिलां न्यसेद् द्वादशार्णैस्तृतीयं पूजनं शृणु //
text_mt: In the east and the north, [one places] bow and arrows; one should offer a seat with the Vedic [mantras] and others. / One should deposit the stone with the twelve-syllable mantra. Listen to the third worship:

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāramabjaṃ vilikhet gurvādyaṃ(2) pūrvavadyajayet /
:n
1 caturbhiḥ pūrvavadyajediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 gandhādyair iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 136
aṣṭārṇenāsanaṃ datvā tenaiva ca śilāṃ nyaset /
pūjayeddaśadhā tena gāyatrībhyāṃ jitaṃ tathā(1) //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye śālagrāmādipūjākathanaṃ nāma
saptacatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭācatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
caturviṃśatimūrtistotrakathanaṃ
meaning:
अष्टारमब्जं विलिखेत् गुर्वाद्यं(2) पूर्ववद्यजयेत् /
:न्
1 चतुर्भिः पूर्ववद्यजेदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गन्धाद्यैर् इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 136
अष्टार्णेनासनं दत्वा तेनैव च शिलां न्यसेत् /
पूजयेद्दशधा तेन गायत्रीभ्यां जितं तथा(1) //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये शालग्रामादिपूजाकथनं नाम
सप्तचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टाचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः
चतुर्विंशतिमूर्तिस्तोत्रकथनं
text_mt:
One should draw an eight-petalled lotus and worship the guru and the others as before.
[...]
[Alternative reading:] 'caturbhiḥ pūrvavadyajediti' is the variant reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
[Alternative reading:] 'gandhādyair iti' is the variant reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 136]
Having offered the seat with the eight-syllable mantra, one should deposit the stone with that very [mantra].
One should worship tenfold with that, with the two Gāyatrīs, and likewise [with the hymn] 'Jita'.
Thus ends the forty-seventh chapter, titled 'Declaration of the Worship of the Śālagrāma and Others', in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now the forty-eighth chapter.
Declaration of the hymn of praise to the twenty-four icons.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
oṃrūpaḥ keśavaḥ padmaśaṅkhacakragadādharaḥ /
nārāyaṇaḥ śaṅkhapadmagadācakrī pradakṣiṇaṃ //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
ओंरूपः केशवः पद्मशङ्खचक्रगदाधरः /
नारायणः शङ्खपद्मगदाचक्री प्रदक्षिणं //
text_mt: The Lord said: / Keśava, whose form is the syllable Oṃ, bears the lotus, conch, disc, and mace. / Nārāyaṇa holds the conch, lotus, mace, and disc in circumambulatory order.

sanskrit_iast:
tato gado mādhavoriśaṅkhapadmī namāmi taṃ /
cakrakaumodakīpadmaśaṅkhī govinda ūrjitaḥ //
meaning:
ततो गदो माधवोरिशङ्खपद्मी नमामि तं /
चक्रकौमोदकीपद्मशङ्खी गोविन्द ऊर्जितः //
text_mt: Next, Mādhava holds the mace, disc, conch, and lotus; I bow to him. / Govinda, mighty, holds the disc, Kaumodakī, lotus, and conch.

sanskrit_iast:
bhokṣadaḥ śrīgadī padmī śaṅkhī viṣṇuś ca cakradhṛk /
śaṅkhacakrābjagadinaṃ madhusūdanamāname //
meaning:
भोक्षदः श्रीगदी पद्मी शङ्खी विष्णुश् च चक्रधृक् /
शङ्खचक्राब्जगदिनं मधुसूदनमानमे //
text_mt: Viṣṇu, the grantor of liberation, holds Śrī, mace, lotus, conch, and disc. / I bow to Madhusūdana, who holds the conch, disc, lotus, and mace.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktyā trivikramaḥ padmagadī cakrī ca śaṅkhyapi /
śaṅkhacakragadāpadmī vāmanaḥ pātu māṃ sadā //
meaning:
भक्त्या त्रिविक्रमः पद्मगदी चक्री च शङ्ख्यपि /
शङ्खचक्रगदापद्मी वामनः पातु मां सदा //
text_mt:
With devotion, Trivikrama holds a lotus, mace, discus, and conch.
May Vāmana, holding a conch, discus, mace, and lotus, always protect me.

sanskrit_iast:
gaditaḥ śrīdharaḥ padmī cakraśārṅgī ca śaṅkhyapi(2) /
hṛṣīkeśo gadācakrī padmī cakraśaṅkhī ca pātu naḥ //
meaning:
गदितः श्रीधरः पद्मी चक्रशार्ङ्गी च शङ्ख्यपि(2) /
हृषीकेशो गदाचक्री पद्मी चक्रशङ्खी च पातु नः //
text_mt:
Śrīdhara is described as holding a lotus, discus, bow, and conch.
May Hṛṣīkeśa, holding a mace, discus, lotus, and conch, protect us.

sanskrit_iast:
varadaḥ padmanābhastu śaṅkhābjārigadādharaḥ /
dāmodaraḥ padmaśaṅkhagadācakrī namāmi taṃ //
meaning:
वरदः पद्मनाभस्तु शङ्खाब्जारिगदाधरः /
दामोदरः पद्मशङ्खगदाचक्री नमामि तं //
text_mt:
Padmanābha is the boon-giver, holding a conch, lotus, discus, and mace.
I bow to Dāmodara, who holds a lotus, conch, mace, and discus.

sanskrit_iast:
tene gadī śaṅkhacakrī vāsudevobjabhṛjjagat /
saṅkarṣaṇo gadī śaṅkhī padmī cakrī ca pātu vaḥ //
:n
1 jitaṃ tata iti kha, ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
2 cakrī gadyatha śaṅkhyapi iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 137
meaning:
तेने गदी शङ्खचक्री वासुदेवोब्जभृज्जगत् /
सङ्कर्षणो गदी शङ्खी पद्मी चक्री च पातु वः //
:न्
1 जितं तत इति ख, ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
2 चक्री गद्यथ शङ्ख्यपि इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 137
text_mt:
Vāsudeva, holding a mace, conch, discus, and lotus, pervaded the world.
May Saṅkarṣaṇa, holding a mace, conch, lotus, and discus, protect you all.
[...]
[Footnote 1: The reading in the three manuscripts marked kha, ga, and ṅa is 'jitaṃ tataḥ'.]
[Footnote 2: The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'cakrī gadyatha śaṅkhyapi'.] / [Page 137]

sanskrit_iast:
gadī cakrī śaṅkhagadī (1) pradyumnaḥ padmabhṛt prabhuḥ /
aniruddhaś cakragadī śaṅkhī padmī ca pātu naḥ //
meaning:
गदी चक्री शङ्खगदी (1) प्रद्युम्नः पद्मभृत् प्रभुः /
अनिरुद्धश् चक्रगदी शङ्खी पद्मी च पातु नः //
text_mt:
Lord Pradyumna holds a mace, discus, conch, and lotus.
May Aniruddha, holding a discus, mace, conch, and lotus, protect us.

sanskrit_iast:
sureśoryabjaśaṅkhāḍhyaḥ śrīgadī puruṣottamaḥ /
adhokṣajaḥ padmagadī śaṅkhī cakrī ca pātu vaḥ //
meaning:
सुरेशोर्यब्जशङ्खाढ्यः श्रीगदी पुरुषोत्तमः /
अधोक्षजः पद्मगदी शङ्खी चक्री च पातु वः //
text_mt:
Puruṣottama, lord of the gods, is endowed with a discus, lotus, conch, and mace.
May Adhokṣaja, holding a lotus, mace, conch, and discus, protect you all.

sanskrit_iast:
devo nṛsiṃhaś cakrābjagadāśaṅkhī namāmi tam /
acyutaḥ śrīgadī padmī cakrī śaṅkhī ca pātu vaḥ //
meaning:
देवो नृसिंहश् चक्राब्जगदाशङ्खी नमामि तम् /
अच्युतः श्रीगदी पद्मी चक्री शङ्खी च पातु वः //
text_mt:
The god Nṛsiṃha holds a discus, lotus, mace, and conch; I bow to him.
May Acyuta, holding Śrī, a mace, lotus, discus, and conch, protect you all.

sanskrit_iast:
bālarūpī śaṅkhagadī upendraś cakrapadmyapi /
janārdanaḥ padmacakrī śaṅkhadhārī gadādharaḥ //
meaning:
बालरूपी शङ्खगदी उपेन्द्रश् चक्रपद्म्यपि /
जनार्दनः पद्मचक्री शङ्खधारी गदाधरः //
text_mt:
Upendra has the form of a child, holding a conch, mace, discus, and lotus.
Janārdana holds a lotus, discus, conch, and mace.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhī padmī ca cakrī ca hariḥ kaumodakīdharaḥ /
kṛṣṇaḥ śaṅkhī gadī padmī cakrī me bhuktimuktidaḥ //
meaning:
शङ्खी पद्मी च चक्री च हरिः कौमोदकीधरः /
कृष्णः शङ्खी गदी पद्मी चक्री मे भुक्तिमुक्तिदः //
text_mt:
Hari holds a conch, lotus, discus, and the Kaumodakī [mace].
Kṛṣṇa holds a conch, mace, lotus, and discus; he grants me worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ādimūttirvāsudevastasmāt saṅkarṣaṇobhavat /
saṅkarṣaṇācca pradyumnaḥ pradyumnādaniruddhakaḥ //
meaning:
आदिमूत्तिर्वासुदेवस्तस्मात् सङ्कर्षणोभवत् /
सङ्कर्षणाच्च प्रद्युम्नः प्रद्युम्नादनिरुद्धकः //
text_mt:
Vāsudeva is the primary icon; from him arose Saṅkarṣaṇa.
From Saṅkarṣaṇa arose Pradyumna, and from Pradyumna, Aniruddha.

sanskrit_iast:
keśavādiprabhedena aikaikasya tridhā kramāt /
dvādaśākṣarakaṃ stotraṃ caturviṃśatimūrtimat /
yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi nirmalaḥ sarvamāpnuyāt //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye caturviṃśatimūrtistotraṃ nāma
aṣṭācatvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athonapañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ
matsyādilakṣaṇavarṇanaṃ
meaning:
केशवादिप्रभेदेन ऐकैकस्य त्रिधा क्रमात् /
द्वादशाक्षरकं स्तोत्रं चतुर्विंशतिमूर्तिमत् /
यः पठेच्छृणुयाद्वापि निर्मलः सर्वमाप्नुयात् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये चतुर्विंशतिमूर्तिस्तोत्रं नाम
अष्टाचत्वारिंशो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथोनपञ्चाशो ऽध्यायः
मत्स्यादिलक्षणवर्णनं
text_mt:
By division into Keśava and the rest, three-fold in sequence for each one:
whoever recites or listens to this hymn of twelve syllables embodying the twenty-four icons,
becomes stainless and attains everything.
Thus ends the forty-eighth chapter, called 'Hymn of the Twenty-Four Icons', in the venerable Agni Mahāpurāṇa.
Now begins the forty-ninth chapter.
Description of the characteristics of Matsya and other [incarnations].

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
daśāvatāraṃ matsyādilakṣaṇaṃ pravadāmi te /
matsyākārastu matsyaḥ syāt kūrmaḥ kārmākṛlirbhavet //
:n
1 śaṅkhapadmī iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
:p 138
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
दशावतारं मत्स्यादिलक्षणं प्रवदामि ते /
मत्स्याकारस्तु मत्स्यः स्यात् कूर्मः कार्माकृलिर्भवेत् //
:न्
1 शङ्खपद्मी इति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
:प् 138
text_mt:
The Blessed Lord said:
I shall tell you the characteristics of the ten incarnations, beginning with Matsya:
Matsya should have the form of a fish, and Kūrma should have the form of a tortoise.
[...]
[Footnote 1: The reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and ṅa is 'śaṅkhapadmī'.] / [Page 138]

sanskrit_iast:
narāṅgo vātha kartavyo bhūvarāho gadādibhṛt /
dakṣiṇe vāmake śaṅkhaṃ lakṣmīrvā padmameva vā //
meaning:
नराङ्गो वाथ कर्तव्यो भूवराहो गदादिभृत् /
दक्षिणे वामके शङ्खं लक्ष्मीर्वा पद्ममेव वा //
text_mt:
Or Bhūvarāha should be made with a human body, bearing a mace and other attributes:
in the right [hand], and in the left hand a conch, or Lakṣmī, or a lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīvāmakūrparasthā tu kṣmānantau caraṇānugau /
varāhasthāpanādrājyaṃ bhavābdhitaraṇaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
श्रीवामकूर्परस्था तु क्ष्मानन्तौ चरणानुगौ /
वराहस्थापनाद्राज्यं भवाब्धितरणं भवेत् //
text_mt:
Śrī rests on his left elbow, and Earth and Ananta accompany his feet.
From establishing Varāha, one attains kingship and crossing over the ocean of worldly existence.

sanskrit_iast:
narasiṃho vivṛttāsyo vāmorukṣatadānavaḥ(1) /
tadvakṣo dārayanmālī sphuraccakragadādharaḥ //
meaning:
नरसिंहो विवृत्तास्यो वामोरुक्षतदानवः(1) /
तद्वक्षो दारयन्माली स्फुरच्चक्रगदाधरः //
text_mt:
Narasiṃha has a wide-open mouth, tearing apart the demon on his left thigh,
ripping open his chest, wearing a garland, and bearing a radiant discus and mace.

sanskrit_iast:
chatrī daṇḍī vāmanaḥ syādathavā syāccaturbhujaḥ /
rāmaścāpeṣuhastaḥ syāt kaḍgī paraśunānvitaḥ //
meaning:
छत्री दण्डी वामनः स्यादथवा स्याच्चतुर्भुजः /
रामश्चापेषुहस्तः स्यात् कड्गी परशुनान्वितः //
text_mt:
Vāmana should hold an umbrella and staff, or he may have four arms.
Rāma should have bow and arrow in hand, holding a sword and accompanied by an axe.

sanskrit_iast:
rāmaścāpī śarī khaḍgī śaṅkhī vā dvibhujaḥ smṛtaḥ /
gadālāṅgaladhārī ca rāmo vātha caturbhujaḥ //
meaning:
रामश्चापी शरी खड्गी शङ्खी वा द्विभुजः स्मृतः /
गदालाङ्गलधारी च रामो वाथ चतुर्भुजः //
text_mt:
Or Rāma is traditionally known with two arms, holding a bow, arrow, sword, or conch;
or Rāma has four arms, bearing a mace and a plough.

sanskrit_iast:
vāmordhve lāṅgalaṃ dadyādadhaḥ śaṅkhaṃ suśobhanaṃ /
muṣalaṃ dakṣiṇordhve tu cakrañcādhaḥ suśobhanaṃ //
meaning:
वामोर्ध्वे लाङ्गलं दद्यादधः शङ्खं सुशोभनं /
मुषलं दक्षिणोर्ध्वे तु चक्रञ्चाधः सुशोभनं //
text_mt:
One should place a plough in his upper left [hand], and a beautiful conch below;
a pestle in the upper right [hand], and a beautiful discus below.

sanskrit_iast:
śāntātmā lambakarṇaś ca gaurāṅgaścāmbarāvṛtaḥ(2) /
ūrdhvapadmasthito buddho varadābhayadāyakaḥ //
meaning:
शान्तात्मा लम्बकर्णश् च गौराङ्गश्चाम्बरावृतः(2) /
ऊर्ध्वपद्मस्थितो बुद्धो वरदाभयदायकः //
text_mt:
Buddha has a peaceful mind, long ears, fair limbs, and is draped in garments;
seated on an upright lotus, he grants boons and fearlessness.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanustūṇānvitaḥ(3) kalkī mlecchotsādakaro dvijaḥ /
athavāśvasthitaḥ khaḍgī śaṅkhacakraśarānvitaḥ //
meaning:
धनुस्तूणान्वितः(3) कल्की म्लेच्छोत्सादकरो द्विजः /
अथवाश्वस्थितः खड्गी शङ्खचक्रशरान्वितः //
text_mt:
Kalki is a twice-born holding a bow and quiver, destroying the barbarians;
or he is mounted on a horse, bearing a sword, conch, discus, and arrows.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṇaṃ vāsudevādinavakasya vadāmi te /
dakṣiṇordhve gadā vāme vāmordhve cakramuttamaṃ //
meaning:
लक्षणं वासुदेवादिनवकस्य वदामि ते /
दक्षिणोर्ध्वे गदा वामे वामोर्ध्वे चक्रमुत्तमं //
text_mt:
I shall tell you the characteristics of the nine [deities] beginning with Vāsudeva:
In the upper right [hand] is a mace; in the left, in the upper left [hand], an excellent discus.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmeśau pārśvagau nityaṃ vāsudevosti pūrvavat /
śaṅkhī sa varado vātha dvibhujo vā caturbhujaḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मेशौ पार्श्वगौ नित्यं वासुदेवोस्ति पूर्ववत् /
शङ्खी स वरदो वाथ द्विभुजो वा चतुर्भुजः //
text_mt:
Brahmā and Śiva are constantly at his sides; Vāsudeva is as described before,
holding a conch, granting boons, with either two arms or four arms.

sanskrit_iast:
lāṅgalī muṣalī rāmo gadāpadmadharaḥ smṛtaḥ /
:n
1 vāmoruhṛtadānava iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 gaurāṅgaścāyudhāvṛta iti kha, ga,
cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
3 dhanurvāṇānvita iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 139
pradyumno dakṣiṇe vajraṃ(1) śaṅkhaṃ vāme dhanuḥ kare //
meaning:
लाङ्गली मुषली रामो गदापद्मधरः स्मृतः /
:न्
1 वामोरुहृतदानव इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गौराङ्गश्चायुधावृत इति ख, ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
3 धनुर्वाणान्वित इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 139
प्रद्युम्नो दक्षिणे वज्रं(1) शङ्खं वामे धनुः करे //
text_mt:
Rāma is remembered holding a plough, pestle, mace, and lotus.
[...]
[Footnote 1: The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'vāmoruhṛtadānavaḥ'.]
[Footnote 2: The reading in the two manuscripts marked kha and ga is 'gaurāṅgaścāyudhāvṛtaḥ'.]
[Footnote 3: The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'dhanurvāṇānvitaḥ'.] / [Page 139]
Pradyumna holds a thunderbolt in his right hand, and a conch and bow in his left hand.

sanskrit_iast:
gadānābhyāvṛtaḥ(2) pītyā pradyumno vā dhanuḥśarī /
caturbhujo niruddhaḥ syāttathā nārāyaṇo vibhuḥ //
meaning:
गदानाभ्यावृतः(2) पीत्या प्रद्युम्नो वा धनुःशरी /
चतुर्भुजो निरुद्धः स्यात्तथा नारायणो विभुः //
text_mt:
Or Pradyumna holds a mace and lotus, accompanied by Rati, bearing bow and arrow.
Aniruddha should be four-armed, and likewise the all-pervading Nārāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
caturmukhaś caturbāhurvṛhajjaṭharamaṇḍalaḥ /
lambakūrco(3) jaṭāyukto vrahmā haṃsāgravāhanaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्मुखश् चतुर्बाहुर्वृहज्जठरमण्डलः /
लम्बकूर्चो(3) जटायुक्तो व्रह्मा हंसाग्रवाहनः //
text_mt:
Brahmā has four faces, four arms, a large belly,
a long beard, matted hair, and a swan-fronted vehicle.

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe cākṣasūtrañca sruvo vāme tu kuṇḍikā /
ājyasthālī sarasvatī sāvitrī vāmadakṣiṇe //
meaning:
दक्षिणे चाक्षसूत्रञ्च स्रुवो वामे तु कुण्डिका /
आज्यस्थाली सरस्वती सावित्री वामदक्षिणे //
text_mt:
In the right [hands] are a rosary and sacrificial ladle, and in the left a water-pot
and ghee-pot; Sarasvatī and Sāvitrī are on his left and right.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuraṣṭabhujastārkṣe kare khaḍgastu dakṣiṇe /
gadāśaraś ca varado vāme kārmukakheṭake //
meaning:
विष्णुरष्टभुजस्तार्क्षे करे खड्गस्तु दक्षिणे /
गदाशरश् च वरदो वामे कार्मुकखेटके //
text_mt:
Viṣṇu has eight arms, mounted on Garuḍa; in the right hands are a sword,
mace, arrow, and boon-granting gesture; in the left are a bow and shield,

sanskrit_iast:
cakraśaṅkhau caturbāhur narasiṃhaś caturbhujaḥ /
śaṅkhacakradharo vāpi vidāritamahāsuraḥ //
meaning:
चक्रशङ्खौ चतुर्बाहुर् नरसिंहश् चतुर्भुजः /
शङ्खचक्रधरो वापि विदारितमहासुरः //
text_mt:
a discus, and a conch. Narasiṃha is four-armed,
or holding a conch and discus, having torn open the great demon.

sanskrit_iast:
acaturbāhurvarāhastu śeṣaḥ pāṇitale dhṛtaḥ /
dhārayan bāhunā pṛthvīṃ vāmnena kamalādharaḥ(4) //
meaning:
अचतुर्बाहुर्वराहस्तु शेषः पाणितले धृतः /
धारयन् बाहुना पृथ्वीं वाम्नेन कमलाधरः(4) //
text_mt:
Varāha has four arms, with Śeṣa held beneath his feet;
supporting the Earth with one arm, he holds a lotus with his left.

sanskrit_iast:
pādalagnā dharā kāryā padā lakṣmīrvyavasthitā /
trailokyamohanastārkṣye aṣṭabāhustu dakṣiṇe //
meaning:
पादलग्ना धरा कार्या पदा लक्ष्मीर्व्यवस्थिता /
त्रैलोक्यमोहनस्तार्क्ष्ये अष्टबाहुस्तु दक्षिणे //
text_mt:
Earth should be made clinging to his foot, while Lakṣmī is stationed at his foot.
Trailokyamohana is mounted on Garuḍa, with eight arms; in the right:

sanskrit_iast:
cakraṃ khaḍgaṃ ca muṣalaṃ aṅkuśaṃ vāmake kare /
śaṅkhaśārṅgagadāpāśān padmavīṇāsamanvite //
meaning:
चक्रं खड्गं च मुषलं अङ्कुशं वामके करे /
शङ्खशार्ङ्गगदापाशान् पद्मवीणासमन्विते //
text_mt:
a discus, sword, pestle, and goad; in the left hand:
a conch, bow, mace, and noose, accompanied by a lotus and lute.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣmīḥ sarasvatī kārye viśvarūpo 'tha dakṣiṇe /
mudgaraṃ ca tathā pāśaṃ śaktiśūlaṃ śaraṃ kare //
meaning:
लक्ष्मीः सरस्वती कार्ये विश्वरूपो ऽथ दक्षिणे /
मुद्गरं च तथा पाशं शक्तिशूलं शरं करे //
text_mt:
Lakṣmī and Sarasvatī should be depicted. Now Viśvarūpa, on the right:
a club, noose, spear, trident, and arrow in hand;

sanskrit_iast:
