vāme śaṅkhañca śārṅgañca gadāṃ pāśaṃ ca tomaraṃ /
:n
1 dakṣiṇe cakramiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 gadī ratyāvṛta iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 lambabhruva iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭaḥ
4 dhārayannākulāṃ pṛthvīṃ vāmena kamalāmadha iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 140
lāṅgalaṃ paraśuṃ daṇḍaṃ churikāṃ carmakṣepakaṃ(1) //
meaning:
वामे शङ्खञ्च शार्ङ्गञ्च गदां पाशं च तोमरं /
:न्
1 दक्षिणे चक्रमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गदी रत्यावृत इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 लम्बभ्रुव इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाटः
4 धारयन्नाकुलां पृथ्वीं वामेन कमलामध इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 140
लाङ्गलं परशुं दण्डं छुरिकां चर्मक्षेपकं(1) //
text_mt:
on the left, a conch, bow, mace, noose, and javelin;
[...]
[Footnote 1: The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'dakṣiṇe cakram'.]
[Footnote 2: The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'gadī ratyāvṛtaḥ'.]
[Footnote 3: The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'lambabhruvaḥ'.]
[Footnote 4: The reading in the manuscript marked ṅa is 'dhārayannākulāṃ pṛthvīṃ vāmena kamalāmadhaḥ'.] / [Page 140]
a plough, axe, staff, dagger, and a shield-thrower.

sanskrit_iast:
viṃśadbāhuś caturvaktro dakṣiṇasthotha vāmake /
trinetre vāmapārśve na śayito jalaśāyyapi //
meaning:
विंशद्बाहुश् चतुर्वक्त्रो दक्षिणस्थोथ वामके /
त्रिनेत्रे वामपार्श्वे न शयितो जलशाय्यपि //
text_mt:
He has twenty arms and four faces, standing on the right or on the left;
or Jalaśāyin [Viṣṇu], three-eyed, reclining on his left side,

sanskrit_iast:
śriyā dhṛtaikacaraṇo vimalādyābhirīḍitaḥ /
nābhipadmacaturvaktro hariśaṅkarako hariḥ //
meaning:
श्रिया धृतैकचरणो विमलाद्याभिरीडितः /
नाभिपद्मचतुर्वक्त्रो हरिशङ्करको हरिः //
text_mt:
one foot held by Śrī, praised by Vimalā and others,
four-faced Brahmā in his navel-lotus, Hari as Hariśaṅkara.

sanskrit_iast:
śūlarṣṭidhārī dakṣe ca gadācakradharo pade /
rudrakeśavalakṣmāṅgo gaurīlakṣmīsamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
शूलर्ष्टिधारी दक्षे च गदाचक्रधरो पदे /
रुद्रकेशवलक्ष्माङ्गो गौरीलक्ष्मीसमन्वितः //
text_mt: Holding a trident and a spear on the right side, and bearing a mace and discus at his foot, / having the bodily characteristics of Rudra and Keśava, accompanied by Gaurī and Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
śaṅkhacakragadāvedapāṇiścāśvaśirā hariḥ /
vāmapādo dhṛtaḥ śeṣe dakṣiṇaḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhagaḥ //
meaning:
शङ्खचक्रगदावेदपाणिश्चाश्वशिरा हरिः /
वामपादो धृतः शेषे दक्षिणः कूर्मपृष्ठगः //
text_mt: Hari with the head of a horse has a conch, discus, mace, and the Vedas in his hands; / his left foot rests on Śeṣa, and the right rests on the back of a tortoise.

sanskrit_iast:
dattātreyo dvibāhuḥ syādvāmotsaṅge śriyā saha /
viśvaksenaś cakragadī halī śaṅkhī harergaṇaḥ //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye pratimālakṣaṇaṃ nāma
ūnapañcāśo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcāśodhyāyaḥ
devīpratimālakṣaṇakathanaṃ
meaning:
दत्तात्रेयो द्विबाहुः स्याद्वामोत्सङ्गे श्रिया सह /
विश्वक्सेनश् चक्रगदी हली शङ्खी हरेर्गणः //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये प्रतिमालक्षणं नाम
ऊनपञ्चाशो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चाशोध्यायः
देवीप्रतिमालक्षणकथनं
text_mt:
Dattātreya should have two arms, with Śrī on his left lap. / Viśvaksena, an attendant of Hari, holds a discus, mace, ploughshare, and conch.
Thus ends the forty-ninth chapter, entitled “The Characteristics of Images,” in the venerable Agni Mahāpurāṇa.
Now, the fiftieth chapter.
The description of the characteristics of the images of the goddesses.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
caṇḍī viṃśatibāhuḥ syādbibhratī dakṣiṇaiḥ karaḥ /
śūlāsiśakticakrāṇi pāśaṃ kheṭāyudhābhayaṃ //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
चण्डी विंशतिबाहुः स्याद्बिभ्रती दक्षिणैः करः /
शूलासिशक्तिचक्राणि पाशं खेटायुधाभयं //
text_mt: The Lord said: / Caṇḍī should have twenty arms, holding with her right hands / a trident, sword, spear, discus, noose, shield, weapon, gesture of fearlessness,

sanskrit_iast:
ḍamaruṃ śaktikāṃ vāmair nāgapāśañca kheṭakaṃ /
kuṭhāṅkuśacāpāṃś ca ghaṇṭādhvajagadāṃs tathā //
meaning:
डमरुं शक्तिकां वामैर् नागपाशञ्च खेटकं /
कुठाङ्कुशचापांश् च घण्टाध्वजगदांस् तथा //
text_mt: a hand-drum, and a dart; with her left hands, a serpent-noose, a buckler, / an axe, an elephant-goad, a bow, a bell, a banner, a mace,

sanskrit_iast:
ādarśamudgarān hastaiś caṇḍī vā daśabāhukā /
tadadho mahiṣaśchinnamūrdhā patitamastakaḥ //
:n
1 carma cottamamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 141
meaning:
आदर्शमुद्गरान् हस्तैश् चण्डी वा दशबाहुका /
तदधो महिषश्छिन्नमूर्धा पतितमस्तकः //
:न्
1 चर्म चोत्तममिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 141
text_mt:
a mirror, and a mallet; or Caṇḍī may have ten arms. / Beneath her is the buffalo with its head severed and fallen.
[Apparatus note]
1 “and an excellent hide” is the reading in manuscript ṅa. / [page 141]

sanskrit_iast:
śastrodyatakaraḥ kruddhastadgrīvāsambhavaḥ pumān /
śūlahasto vamadrakto raktasraṅmūrdhajekṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
शस्त्रोद्यतकरः क्रुद्धस्तद्ग्रीवासम्भवः पुमान् /
शूलहस्तो वमद्रक्तो रक्तस्रङ्मूर्धजेक्षणः //
text_mt: Emerging from its neck is an enraged man with hand upraised with a weapon, / trident in hand, vomiting blood, with a blood-garland, [blood-red] hair and eyes,

sanskrit_iast:
siṃhenāsvādyamānastu pāśabaddho gale bhṛśaṃ /
yāmyāṅghyrākrāntasiṃhā ca savyāṅghrirnīcagāsure //
meaning:
सिंहेनास्वाद्यमानस्तु पाशबद्धो गले भृशं /
याम्याङ्घ्य्राक्रान्तसिंहा च सव्याङ्घ्रिर्नीचगासुरे //
text_mt: being savaged by the lion, tightly bound by a noose around the neck; / and she has her right foot resting upon the lion, and her left foot upon the fallen demon.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍikeyaṃ trinetrā ca saśastrā ripumardanī /
navapadmātmake sthāne pūjyā durgā svamūrtitaḥ //
meaning:
चण्डिकेयं त्रिनेत्रा च सशस्त्रा रिपुमर्दनी /
नवपद्मात्मके स्थाने पूज्या दुर्गा स्वमूर्तितः //
text_mt: This is Caṇḍikā, three-eyed, armed with weapons, the crusher of foes. / Durgā should be worshipped in a site of nine lotuses according to her icon,

sanskrit_iast:
ādau madhye tathendrādau navātattvātmabhiḥ(1) kramāt /
aṣṭādaśabhujaikā tu dakṣe muṇḍaṃ ca kheṭakaṃ //
meaning:
आदौ मध्ये तथेन्द्रादौ नवातत्त्वात्मभिः(1) क्रमात् /
अष्टादशभुजैका तु दक्षे मुण्डं च खेटकं //
text_mt: first in the center and then beginning with Indra[’s quarter], sequentially with the ninefold realities. / One has eighteen arms: on the right, a severed head, a shield,

sanskrit_iast:
ādarśatarjanīcāpaṃ dhvajaṃ ḍamarukaṃ tathā /
pāśaṃ vāme bibhratī ca śaktimudgaraśūlakaṃ //
meaning:
आदर्शतर्जनीचापं ध्वजं डमरुकं तथा /
पाशं वामे बिभ्रती च शक्तिमुद्गरशूलकं //
text_mt: a mirror, the warning gesture, a bow, a banner, a hand-drum, / and a noose; and holding in the left a dart, a mallet, a trident,

sanskrit_iast:
vajrakhaḍgāṅkuśaśarān cakrandevī śalākayā /
etair evāyudhair yuktā śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśabahukāḥ //
meaning:
वज्रखड्गाङ्कुशशरान् चक्रन्देवी शलाकया /
एतैर् एवायुधैर् युक्ता शेषाः षोडशबहुकाः //
text_mt: a thunderbolt, sword, elephant-goad, arrows, and the discus, the goddess with a dart. / Endowed with these very weapons, the remaining [goddesses] have sixteen arms,

sanskrit_iast:
ḍamaruṃ tarjanīṃ tyaktvā rudracaṇḍādayo nava /
rudracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā caṇḍanāyikā //
meaning:
डमरुं तर्जनीं त्यक्त्वा रुद्रचण्डादयो नव /
रुद्रचण्डा प्रचण्डा च चण्डोग्रा चण्डनायिका //
text_mt: omitting the hand-drum and the warning gesture: the nine beginning with Rudracaṇḍā— / Rudracaṇḍā, Pracaṇḍā, Caṇḍogrā, Caṇḍanāyikā,

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍā caṇdavatī caiva caṇḍarūpāticaṇḍikā /
ugracaṇḍā ca madhyasthā rocanābhāruṇāsitā //
meaning:
चण्डा चण्दवती चैव चण्डरूपातिचण्डिका /
उग्रचण्डा च मध्यस्था रोचनाभारुणासिता //
text_mt: Caṇḍā, Caṇḍavatī, Caṇḍarūpā, Aticaṇḍikā, / and Ugracaṇḍā situated in the center, possessing the radiance of yellow pigment, reddish, dark,

sanskrit_iast:
nīlā śuklā dhūmrikā ca pītā śvetā ca siṃhagāḥ /
mahiṣotha pumān śastrī tatkacagrahamuṣṭikāḥ //
meaning:
नीला शुक्ला धूम्रिका च पीता श्वेता च सिंहगाः /
महिषोथ पुमान् शस्त्री तत्कचग्रहमुष्टिकाः //
text_mt: blue, white, smoky, yellow, and white, mounted on lions; / then the buffalo and the man armed with weapons, with fists grasping their hair.

sanskrit_iast:
ālīḍhā nava(2) durgāḥ syuḥ sthāpyāḥ putrādivṛddhaye /
tathā gaurī ca caṇḍikādyā kuṇḍyakṣararadāgnidhṛk //
meaning:
आलीढा नव(2) दुर्गाः स्युः स्थाप्याः पुत्रादिवृद्धये /
तथा गौरी च चण्डिकाद्या कुण्ड्यक्षररदाग्निधृक् //
text_mt: The nine Durgās should be in the ālīḍha posture, installed for the increase of sons and the rest. / Likewise, Gaurī, beginning with Caṇḍikā, holds a water-pot, rosary, tooth, and fire.

sanskrit_iast:
saiva rambhā vane siddhāgnihīnā lalitā tathā /
skandhamūrdhakarā vāme dvitīye dhṛtadarpaṇā //
:n
1 navatatvādibhirirti ṅa,cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 śālāsu nava iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 142
meaning:
सैव रम्भा वने सिद्धाग्निहीना ललिता तथा /
स्कन्धमूर्धकरा वामे द्वितीये धृतदर्पणा //
:न्
1 नवतत्वादिभिरिर्ति ङ,चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 शालासु नव इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 142
text_mt:
She alone is Rambhā in the grove, having attained perfection without fire; likewise Lalitā / has her hands on her shoulder and head, holding a mirror in the second left [hand],
[Apparatus note]
1 “with the nine realities and the rest” is the reading in manuscript ṅa.
2 “nine in the halls” is the reading in manuscript ṅa. / [page 142]

sanskrit_iast:
yāmye phalāñjalihastā saubhāgyā tatra cordhvikā /
lakṣmīryāmyakarāmbhojā vāme śrīphalasaṃyutā //
meaning:
याम्ये फलाञ्जलिहस्ता सौभाग्या तत्र चोर्ध्विका /
लक्ष्मीर्याम्यकराम्भोजा वामे श्रीफलसंयुता //
text_mt: holding a cupped offering of fruit in the right hand; there, Saubhāgyā holds them raised aloft. / Lakṣmī has a lotus in her right hand and is endowed with a bilva fruit in the left.

sanskrit_iast:
pustākṣamālikāhastā vīṇāhastā sarasvatī /
kumbhābjahastā śvetābhā makaropari jāhnavī (1)//
meaning:
पुस्ताक्षमालिकाहस्ता वीणाहस्ता सरस्वती /
कुम्भाब्जहस्ता श्वेताभा मकरोपरि जाह्नवी (1)//
text_mt: Sarasvatī has a book and rosary in hand, and holds a vīṇā. / Jāhnavī is white-complexioned, with a pot and lotus in hand, upon a makara.

sanskrit_iast:
kūrmagā yamunā kumbhakarā śyāmā ca pūjyate /
savīṇastumburuḥ śuklaḥ śūlī mātragrato vṛṣe //
meaning:
कूर्मगा यमुना कुम्भकरा श्यामा च पूज्यते /
सवीणस्तुम्बुरुः शुक्लः शूली मात्रग्रतो वृषे //
text_mt: Yamunā, mounted on a tortoise, holding a pot, dark, is worshipped. / Tumburu, holding a vīṇā, white, trident-bearing, on a bull, stands before the mothers.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurī caturmukhī brāhmī akṣamālāsurānvitā /
kuṇḍakṣapātriṇī vāme haṃsagā śāṅkarī sitā //
meaning:
गौरी चतुर्मुखी ब्राह्मी अक्षमालासुरान्विता /
कुण्डक्षपात्रिणी वामे हंसगा शाङ्करी सिता //
text_mt: Gaurī is four-faced; Brāhmī is accompanied by a rosary and sacrificial ladle, / having a water-pot and ladle on the left, mounted on a goose; Śāṅkarī is white,

sanskrit_iast:
śaracāpau dakṣiṇe 'syā vāme cakraṃ(2) dhanurvṛṣe /
kaumārī śikhigā raktā śaktihastā dvibāhukā //
meaning:
शरचापौ दक्षिणे ऽस्या वामे चक्रं(2) धनुर्वृषे /
कौमारी शिखिगा रक्ता शक्तिहस्ता द्विबाहुका //
text_mt: having arrow and bow on her right, and on the left discus and bow, upon a bull. / Kaumārī is mounted on a peacock, red, holding a spear, two-armed.

sanskrit_iast:
cakraśaṅkhadharā savye vāme lakṣmīrgadābjadhṛk /
daṇḍaśaṅkhāsi(3) gadayā vārāho mahiṣasthitā //
meaning:
चक्रशङ्खधरा सव्ये वामे लक्ष्मीर्गदाब्जधृक् /
दण्डशङ्खासि(3) गदया वाराहो महिषस्थिता //
text_mt: Lakṣmī holds discus and conch on the right, and mace and lotus on the left. / Vārāhī stands upon a buffalo, with staff, conch, sword, and mace.

sanskrit_iast:
aindrī vāme vajrahastā sahasrākṣī tu siddhaye /
cāmuṇḍā koṭarāghnī syānnirmāṃsā tu trilocanā //
meaning:
ऐन्द्री वामे वज्रहस्ता सहस्राक्षी तु सिद्धये /
चामुण्डा कोटराघ्नी स्यान्निर्मांसा तु त्रिलोचना //
text_mt: Aindrī has a thunderbolt in her left hand, and is thousand-eyed for success. / Cāmuṇḍā should be hollow-eyed, emaciated, and three-eyed,

sanskrit_iast:
nirmāṃsā asthisārā vā ūrdhvakeśī kṛśodarī /
dvīpacarmadharā vāme kapālaṃ paṭṭiśaṅkare //
meaning:
निर्मांसा अस्थिसारा वा ऊर्ध्वकेशी कृशोदरी /
द्वीपचर्मधरा वामे कपालं पट्टिशङ्करे //
text_mt: fleshless or skeletal, hair standing upright, lean-bellied, / wearing a tiger skin, with a skull-bowl in the left hand and a paṭṭiśa weapon,

sanskrit_iast:
śūlaṃ kartrī dakṣaṇe 'syāḥ śavārūḍhāsthitabhūṣaṇā /
vināyako narākāro vṛhatkukṣirgajānanaḥ //
meaning:
शूलं कर्त्री दक्षणे ऽस्याः शवारूढास्थितभूषणा /
विनायको नराकारो वृहत्कुक्षिर्गजाननः //
text_mt: and with a trident and knife in her right, mounted on a corpse, adorned with bones. / Vināyaka has a human form, a large belly, and the face of an elephant,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛhacchuṇḍo hy upavīto mukhaṃ saptakalaṃ bhavet /
vistārāddairghyatacaiva śuṇḍaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ //
meaning:
वृहच्छुण्डो ह्य् उपवीतो मुखं सप्तकलं भवेत् /
विस्ताराद्दैर्घ्यतचैव शुण्डं षट्त्रिंशदङ्गुलं //
text_mt: with a large trunk and wearing a sacred thread; his face should be seven kalās / in breadth and length, and the trunk thirty-six aṅgulas.

sanskrit_iast:
kalā dvādaśa nāḍī tu grīvā sārdhakalocchritā /
ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ guhyamadhyardhamaṅgulaṃ //
:n
1 makareddhari jāhnavīti kha, gha, ṅa, cihnitapustatrayakapāṭhaḥ
2 vāme vajramiti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 śaṅkhāri iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 143
meaning:
कला द्वादश नाडी तु ग्रीवा सार्धकलोच्छ्रिता /
षट्त्रिंशदङ्गुलं कण्ठं गुह्यमध्यर्धमङ्गुलं //
:न्
1 मकरेद्धरि जाह्नवीति ख, घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तत्रयकपाठः
2 वामे वज्रमिति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
2 शङ्खारि इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 143
text_mt:
The nāḍī is twelve kalās; the neck is one and a half kalās high; / the throat is thirty-six aṅgulas; the private parts are one and a half aṅgulas.
[Apparatus note]
1 “Jāhnavī upon a makara” is the reading in the three manuscripts kha, gha, and ṅa.
2 “a thunderbolt on the left” is the reading in the two manuscripts kha and ṅa.
3 “conch and discus” is the reading in manuscript kha. / [page 143]

sanskrit_iast:
nābhirūrū dvādaśañca jaṅghe pāde tu dakṣiṇe /
svadantaṃ paraśuṃ vāme laḍḍukañcotpalaṃ śaye //
meaning:
नाभिरूरू द्वादशञ्च जङ्घे पादे तु दक्षिणे /
स्वदन्तं परशुं वामे लड्डुकञ्चोत्पलं शये //
text_mt: The navel and thighs are twelve [aṅgulas], and the shanks and feet. In the right [hands] / [he holds] his own tusk and axe; in the left, a sweetmeat and blue lotus in the hand.

sanskrit_iast:
sumukhī ca viḍālākṣī pārśve skando mayūragaḥ /
svāmī śākho viśākhaś ca dvibhujo bālarūpadhṛk //
meaning:
सुमुखी च विडालाक्षी पार्श्वे स्कन्दो मयूरगः /
स्वामी शाखो विशाखश् च द्विभुजो बालरूपधृक् //
text_mt: Sumukhī and Viḍālākṣī are at his side. Skanda is mounted on a peacock, / as Svāmin, Śākha, and Viśākha, two-armed, bearing the form of a child,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣe śaktiḥ kukkuṭotha ekavaktrotha ṣaṇmukhaḥ /
ṣaḍbhujo vā dvādaśabhirgrāmeraṇye dvibāhukaḥ //
meaning:
दक्षे शक्तिः कुक्कुटोथ एकवक्त्रोथ षण्मुखः /
षड्भुजो वा द्वादशभिर्ग्रामेरण्ये द्विबाहुकः //
text_mt: with a spear and rooster on the right, single-faced or six-faced, / six-armed, or with twelve [arms] in a village, or two-armed in the forest,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktīṣupāśanistriṃśatotradostarjanīyutaḥ /
śaktyā dākṣiṇahasteṣu ṣaṭsu vāme kare tathā //
meaning:
शक्तीषुपाशनिस्त्रिंशतोत्रदोस्तर्जनीयुतः /
शक्त्या दाक्षिणहस्तेषु षट्सु वामे करे तथा //
text_mt: endowed with a spear, arrow, noose, sword, goad, and the warning gesture, / with a spear among the six right hands; likewise in the left hands,

sanskrit_iast:
śikhipicchandhanuḥ kheṭaṃ patākābhayakukkuṭe /
kapālakartarīśūlapāśabhṛdyāmyasaumyayoḥ //
meaning:
शिखिपिच्छन्धनुः खेटं पताकाभयकुक्कुटे /
कपालकर्तरीशूलपाशभृद्याम्यसौम्ययोः //
text_mt: peacock feathers, a bow, shield, flag, fearlessness gesture, and a rooster. / Bearing a skull-bowl, scissors, trident, and noose in the right and left [hands],

sanskrit_iast:
gajacarmabhṛdūrdhvāsyapādā syāt rudracarcikā /
saiva cāṣṭabhujā devī śiroḍamarukānvitā //
meaning:
गजचर्मभृदूर्ध्वास्यपादा स्यात् रुद्रचर्चिका /
सैव चाष्टभुजा देवी शिरोडमरुकान्विता //
text_mt: wearing an elephant skin, with feet raised upward, Rudracarcikā should be. / That very goddess has eight arms, endowed with a severed head and hand-drum;

sanskrit_iast:
tena sā rudracāmuṇḍā nāṭeśvaryatha nṛtyatī /
iyameva mahālakṣmīrupaviṣṭā caturmukhī //
meaning:
तेन सा रुद्रचामुण्डा नाटेश्वर्यथ नृत्यती /
इयमेव महालक्ष्मीरुपविष्टा चतुर्मुखी //
text_mt: therefore she is Rudracāmuṇḍā; and as Nāṭeśvarī, she dances. / This very Mahālakṣmī is seated and four-faced,

sanskrit_iast:
nṛvājimahiṣebhāṃś ca khādantī ca kare sthitān /
daśabāhustrinetrā ca śastrāsiḍamarutrikaṃ //
meaning:
नृवाजिमहिषेभांश् च खादन्ती च करे स्थितान् /
दशबाहुस्त्रिनेत्रा च शस्त्रासिडमरुत्रिकं //
text_mt: devouring men, horses, buffaloes, and elephants held in her hands, / having ten arms, three eyes, holding a weapon, sword, and three hand-drums

sanskrit_iast:
bibhratī dakṣiṇe haste vāme ghaṇṭāṃ ca kheṭakaṃ /
khaṭvāṅgaṃ ca triśūlañca siddhacāmuṇḍakāhvayā //
meaning:
बिभ्रती दक्षिणे हस्ते वामे घण्टां च खेटकं /
खट्वाङ्गं च त्रिशूलञ्च सिद्धचामुण्डकाह्वया //
text_mt: in her right hands, and in the left a bell, shield, / khaṭvāṅga, and trident, named Siddhacāmuṇḍakā,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhayogeśvarī devī sarvasiddhapradāyikā /
etadrūpā bhavedanyā pāśāṅkuśayutāruṇā //
meaning:
सिद्धयोगेश्वरी देवी सर्वसिद्धप्रदायिका /
एतद्रूपा भवेदन्या पाशाङ्कुशयुतारुणा //
text_mt: the goddess Siddhayogeśvarī, granter of all perfections. / Another may be of this form, endowed with a noose and goad, reddish,

sanskrit_iast:
bhairavī rūpavidyā tu bhujair dvādaśabhiryutā /
etāḥ śmaśānajā raudrā ambāṣṭakamidaṃ(1) smṛtaṃ //
:n
1 ādyāṣṭakamidamiti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
:p 144
meaning:
भैरवी रूपविद्या तु भुजैर् द्वादशभिर्युता /
एताः श्मशानजा रौद्रा अम्बाष्टकमिदं(1) स्मृतं //
:न्
1 आद्याष्टकमिदमिति ख, ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
:प् 144
text_mt:
Bhairavī, having twelve arms, an embodiment of sacred knowledge. / These born in the cremation ground are fierce; this is remembered as the group of eight Mothers.
[Apparatus note]
1 “this original group of eight” is the reading in the three manuscripts kha, ga, and gha. / [page 144]

sanskrit_iast:
kṣamā śivāvṛtā(1) vṛddhā dvibhujā vivṛtānanā /
danturā kṣemakarī syādbhūmau jānukarā sthitā //
meaning:
क्षमा शिवावृता(1) वृद्धा द्विभुजा विवृतानना /
दन्तुरा क्षेमकरी स्याद्भूमौ जानुकरा स्थिता //
text_mt: Kṣamā is surrounded by jackals, aged, two-armed, with an open mouth, / protruding teeth, being Kṣemakarī, standing with hands upon her knees on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
yakṣiṇyastabdhadīrghākṣāḥ śākinyo vakradṛṣṭayaḥ(2) /
piṅgākṣāḥ syurmahāramyā rūpiṇyopsarasaḥ(3) sadā //
meaning:
यक्षिण्यस्तब्धदीर्घाक्षाः शाकिन्यो वक्रदृष्टयः(2) /
पिङ्गाक्षाः स्युर्महारम्या रूपिण्योप्सरसः(3) सदा //
text_mt: The Yakṣiṇīs have fixed, long eyes; the Śākinīs have squinting eyes; / the Apsarases always have reddish-brown eyes, very charming, beautiful.

sanskrit_iast:
sākṣamālī triśūlī ca nandīśo dvārapālakaḥ /
mahākālosimuṇḍī syācchūlakhaṭakavāṃs tathā //
meaning:
साक्षमाली त्रिशूली च नन्दीशो द्वारपालकः /
महाकालोसिमुण्डी स्याच्छूलखटकवांस् तथा //
text_mt: Holding a rosary and a trident, Nandīśa is the door-keeper; / Mahākāla should have a sword and severed head, as well as a trident and club.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛśo bhaṅgī ca nṛtyan vai kuṣmāṇḍasthūlakharvavān /
gajagokarṇavaktrādyā vīrabhadrādayo gaṇāḥ //
meaning:
कृशो भङ्गी च नृत्यन् वै कुष्माण्डस्थूलखर्ववान् /
गजगोकर्णवक्त्राद्या वीरभद्रादयो गणाः //
text_mt: Bhṛṅgin is emaciated, bent, and dancing; the Kuṣmāṇḍa [gaṇas] are fat and dwarfish. / The gaṇas such as Vīrabhadra and others have faces resembling elephants, cows, ears, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṇṭākarṇoṣṭadaśadoḥ pāparogaṃ vidārayan /
vajrāsidaṇḍacakreṣumuṣalāṅkuśamudgarān //
meaning:
घण्टाकर्णोष्टदशदोः पापरोगं विदारयन् /
वज्रासिदण्डचक्रेषुमुषलाङ्कुशमुद्गरान् //
text_mt: Ghaṇṭākarṇa has eighteen arms, tearing apart sins and diseases; / [he holds] a thunderbolt, sword, staff, discus, arrow, pestle, elephant-goad, club,

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe tarjanīṃ kheṭaṃ śaktiṃ muṇḍañca pāśakaṃ /
cāpaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ kuṭhārañca dvābhyāñcaiva triśūlakaṃ /
ghaṇṭāmālākulo devo visphoṭakavimardanaḥ(4) //

They have eight arms or four arms, hold weapons according to desire, and grant all supernatural attainments.

3. The reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha is "vimalā tataḥ".

5 "kālavarṇī" is the reading of the two manuscripts marked ga and gha.

Bhairava should have twelve hands, an elbow-like face, and bear matted locks and the moon.

sanskrit_iast:
gajacarmadharo dvābhyāṃ kṛttivāsohibhūṣataḥ /

text_mt:
Caṇḍikā should have ten hands, bearing a sword, a trident, a discus, and a spear / in the right, and in the left a serpent-noose, a shield, a goad, an axe, / and a bow; and the buffalo [demon] is fiercely struck by the trident on the lion.
Thus ends the fifty-second chapter, titled "Characteristics of Images", in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
1 "danturāsya" is the reading of the two manuscripts marked kha and gha.
2 "maṇḍalāgnidalārūḍham" is the reading of the manuscript marked ṅa.
3 "śūlaṃ galantī kuṇḍī ca" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
4 "skandagaṇā daśa vināyakāḥ" is the reading of the manuscript marked kha.
5 Here, the reading "khaḍgaśūlāriśaktidhṛk" in the ten hands of Caṇḍikā is suitable.
This reading is not found in the five manuscripts obtained by us.
Now the fifty-third chapter.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
liṅgādilakṣaṇaṃ vakṣye kamalodbhava tacchṛṇu /

भगवानुवाच
लिङ्गादिलक्षणं वक्ष्ये कमलोद्भव तच्छृणु /

sanskrit_iast:
viṣkambhaṃ bhūtabhāgaistu caturasrantu kārayet /
āyāmaṃ mūrtibhirbhaktvā ekadvitrikramān nyaset //
meaning:
विष्कम्भं भूतभागैस्तु चतुरस्रन्तु कारयेत् /
आयामं मूर्तिभिर्भक्त्वा एकद्वित्रिक्रमान् न्यसेत् //
text_mt: one should make the square diameter five parts. / Having divided the height into [nine] parts, one should assign [them] in the order of one, two, and three

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaviṣṇuśivāṃśeṣu vardhamānoyamucyate /
caturasresya varṇārdhaṃ guhyakoṇeṣu lāñchayet //

text_mt: to the portions of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Śiva; this is called the Vardhamāna [liṅga]. / On its square, one should mark half a syllable in the hidden corners.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāgraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ bhāgaṃ sidhyatyeva na saṃśayaḥ /
ṣoḍaśāsraṃ tataḥ kuryāddvātriṃśāsraṃ tataḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
अष्टाग्रं वैष्णवं भागं सिध्यत्येव न संशयः /
षोडशास्रं ततः कुर्याद्द्वात्रिंशास्रं ततः पुनः //

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥṣaṣṭyasrakaṃ kṛtvā vartulaṃ sādhayettataḥ /
kartayedatha liṅgasya śiro vai deśikottamaḥ //

चतुःषष्ट्यस्रकं कृत्वा वर्तुलं साधयेत्ततः /
कर्तयेदथ लिङ्गस्य शिरो वै देशिकोत्तमः //
text_mt: having made it sixty-four-sided, one should then make it circular. / The best of masters should then fashion the head of the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
vistāramatha liṅgasya aṣṭadhā saṃvibhājayet /
bhāgārdhārdhantu santyajya cchatrākāraṃ śiro bhavet //

विस्तारमथ लिङ्गस्य अष्टधा संविभाजयेत् /
भागार्धार्धन्तु सन्त्यज्य च्छत्राकारं शिरो भवेत् //
text_mt: Then one should divide the width of the liṅga eightfold; / having discarded a quarter part, the head should take the shape of an umbrella.

sanskrit_iast:
triṣu bhāgeṣu sadṛśamāyāmaṃ yasya cistaraḥ /
tadvibhāgasamaṃ liṅgaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradaṃ //

त्रिषु भागेषु सदृशमायामं यस्य चिस्तरः /
तद्विभागसमं लिङ्गं सर्वकामफलप्रदं //

sanskrit_iast:
dairghyasya tu caturthena viṣkambhaṃ devapūjite /
sarveṣāmeva liṅgānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇu sāmprataṃ //

दैर्घ्यस्य तु चतुर्थेन विष्कम्भं देवपूजिते /
सर्वेषामेव लिङ्गानां लक्षणं शृणु साम्प्रतं //

sanskrit_iast:
madhyasūtraṃ samāsādya brahmarudrāntikaṃ(1) budhaḥ /
ṣoḍaśāṅgulaliṅgasya ṣaḍbhāgair bhājito yathā //

मध्यसूत्रं समासाद्य ब्रह्मरुद्रान्तिकं(1) बुधः /
षोडशाङ्गुललिङ्गस्य षड्भागैर् भाजितो यथा //

sanskrit_iast:
tadvaiyamanasūtrābhyāṃ mānamantaramucyate /
yavāṣṭamuttare kāryaṃ śeṣāṇāṃ yavahānitaḥ //

तद्वैयमनसूत्राभ्यां मानमन्तरमुच्यते /
यवाष्टमुत्तरे कार्यं शेषाणां यवहानितः //

sanskrit_iast:
adhobhāgaṃ tridhā kṛtvā tvardhamekaṃ parityajet /

aṣṭadhā taddvayaṃ kṛtvā ūrdhvabhāgatryaṃ tyajet //

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvañca pañcamādbhāgād bhrāmya rekhāṃ pralambayet /
bhāgamekaṃ parityajya saṅgaṃ kārayettayoḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वञ्च पञ्चमाद्भागाद् भ्राम्य रेखां प्रलम्बयेत् /
भागमेकं परित्यज्य सङ्गं कारयेत्तयोः //

sanskrit_iast:
etat sādhāraṇaṃ proktaṃ liṅgānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ mayā /
sarvasādhāraṇaṃ vakṣye piṇḍikāntānnibodha me //
meaning:
एतत् साधारणं प्रोक्तं लिङ्गानां लक्षणं मया /
सर्वसाधारणं वक्ष्ये पिण्डिकान्तान्निबोध मे //

sanskrit_iast:

nyased brahmaśilāṃ vidvān samyakkarmaśilopari //

ब्रह्मभागप्रवेशञ्च ज्ञात्वा लिङ्गस्य चोच्छ्रयं /
न्यसेद् ब्रह्मशिलां विद्वान् सम्यक्कर्मशिलोपरि //
text_mt: Having understood the entrance of the Brahmā portion and the height of the liṅga, / the wise man should place the stone of Brahmā properly above the stone of ritual.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā sumucchrayaṃ jñātvā piṇḍikāṃ pravibhājayet /
dvibhāgamucchritaṃ pīṭhaṃ vistāraṃ liṅgasammitam //
meaning:
तथा सुमुच्छ्रयं ज्ञात्वा पिण्डिकां प्रविभाजयेत् /
द्विभागमुच्छ्रितं पीठं विस्तारं लिङ्गसम्मितम् //
text_mt: Likewise, having understood its full height, one should divide the pedestal; / the pedestal should be two parts in height and its width equal to the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
tribhāgaṃ madhyataḥ khātaṃ kṛtvā pīṭhaṃ(1) vibhājayet /
svamānārdhatribhāgeṇa bāhulyaṃ parikalpayet //
meaning:
त्रिभागं मध्यतः खातं कृत्वा पीठं(1) विभाजयेत् /
स्वमानार्धत्रिभागेण बाहुल्यं परिकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: Having made an excavation of three parts in the center, one should divide the pedestal; / one should design the thickness as three parts of half its own measurement.

sanskrit_iast:
bāhulyasya tribhāgeṇa mekhalāmatha kalpayet /
khātaṃ syānmekhalātulyaṃ kramānnimnantu kārayet //
meaning:
बाहुल्यस्य त्रिभागेण मेखलामथ कल्पयेत् /
खातं स्यान्मेखलातुल्यं क्रमान्निम्नन्तु कारयेत् //

sanskrit_iast:
mekhalāṣoḍaśāṃśena khātaṃ vā tatpramāṇajñaḥ /
ucchrāyaṃ tasya pīṭhasya vikārāṅgaṃ tu(2) kārayet //
meaning:
मेखलाषोडशांशेन खातं वा तत्प्रमाणज्ञः /
उच्छ्रायं तस्य पीठस्य विकाराङ्गं तु(2) कारयेत् //
text_mt: Or the one knowing its proportions [makes] the cavity one-sixteenth of the molding; / one should make the height of that pedestal into transformed parts:

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmau praviṣṭamekaṃ tu bhāgaikena(3) piṇḍikā /
kaṇṭhaṃ bhāgaistribhiḥ kāryaṃ bhāgenaikena paṭṭikā //
meaning:
भूमौ प्रविष्टमेकं तु भागैकेन(3) पिण्डिका /
कण्ठं भागैस्त्रिभिः कार्यं भागेनैकेन पट्टिका //
text_mt: one [part] entered into the earth, the pedestal [itself] by one part; / the neck is to be made with three parts, and the fillet with one part.

sanskrit_iast:
dyaṃgena cordhvapaṭṭantu(4) ekāṃśāḥ śeṣapaṭṭikā /
bhāgaṃ bhāgaṃ praviṣṭantu yāvat kaṇṭhaṃ tataḥ punaḥ //
meaning:
द्यंगेन चोर्ध्वपट्टन्तु(4) एकांशाः शेषपट्टिका /
भागं भागं प्रविष्टन्तु यावत् कण्ठं ततः पुनः //
text_mt: The upper fillet with two parts, and the remaining fillets are of one part each; / each part entered as far as the neck, and then again

sanskrit_iast:
nirgamaṃ bhāgamekaṃ tu yāvadvai śeṣapaṭṭikā /
praṇālasya tribhāgena nirgamastu tribhāgataḥ //
:n
1 madhyataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pīṭhamiti gha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vikārāṃśāṃśceti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 bhāgenaikeneti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 cārdhapaṭṭantu iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 151
meaning:
निर्गमं भागमेकं तु यावद्वै शेषपट्टिका /
प्रणालस्य त्रिभागेन निर्गमस्तु त्रिभागतः //
:न्
1 मध्यतः कृत्वा ततः पीठमिति घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 विकारांशांश्चेति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 भागेनैकेनेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 चार्धपट्टन्तु इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 151
text_mt:
a projection of one part as far as the remaining fillet; / the drain's projection is by three parts from the three parts.
[Notes]
1 "madhyataḥ kṛtvā tataḥ pīṭham" is the reading of the manuscript marked gha.
2 "vikārāṃśāṃś ca" is the reading of the manuscript marked gha.
3 "bhāgenaikena" is the reading of the manuscript marked ga.
4 "cārdhapaṭṭantu" is the reading of the manuscripts marked kha and ga.

sanskrit_iast:
mūleṅgulyagravistāramagre tryaṃśena cārdhataḥ /
īṣannimnantu kurvīta khātaṃ taccottareṇa vai /
piṇḍikāsahitaṃ liṅgametat sādhāraṇaṃ smṛtam //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye liṅgalakṣaṇaṃ nāma
tripañcāśattamodhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha catuḥpañcāśattamodhyāyaḥ
liṅgamānādikathanaṃ
meaning:
मूलेङ्गुल्यग्रविस्तारमग्रे त्र्यंशेन चार्धतः /
ईषन्निम्नन्तु कुर्वीत खातं तच्चोत्तरेण वै /
पिण्डिकासहितं लिङ्गमेतत् साधारणं स्मृतम् //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये लिङ्गलक्षणं नाम
त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमोध्यायः ||
:श् अथ चतुःपञ्चाशत्तमोध्यायः
लिङ्गमानादिकथनं
text_mt:
The width at the base is an finger-tip, and at the top it is half of three parts; / one should make it slightly low, with that cavity indeed towards the north; / this is remembered as the universal [rule] for a liṅga endowed with a pedestal.
Thus ends the fifty-third chapter, titled "Characteristics of the Liṅga", in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now the fifty-fourth chapter.
Statement of the Measurements and Other Properties of the Liṅga

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
vakṣyāmyanyaprakāreṇa(1) liṅgamānādikaṃ śṛṇu /
vakṣye lavaṇajaṃ liṅgaṃ ghṛtajaṃ buddhivardhanam //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
वक्ष्याम्यन्यप्रकारेण(1) लिङ्गमानादिकं शृणु /
वक्ष्ये लवणजं लिङ्गं घृतजं बुद्धिवर्धनम् //
text_mt: The Lord said: / I shall state the measurements and other properties of the liṅga in another manner; listen: / I shall speak of the liṅga made of salt, and that made of ghee which increases intellect;

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtaye vastraliṅgantu liṅgantātkālikaṃ viduḥ /
pakvāpakvaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ syādapakvāt pakvajaṃ varaṃ //
meaning:
भूतये वस्त्रलिङ्गन्तु लिङ्गन्तात्कालिकं विदुः /
पक्वापक्वं मृण्मयं स्यादपक्वात् पक्वजं वरं //
text_mt: a cloth liṅga is for prosperity; they consider [these] liṅgas temporary. / An earthen one may be baked or unbaked; the baked one is better than the unbaked.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dārumayaṃ puṇyaṃ dārujāt śailajaṃ varaṃ /
śailādvaraṃ tu muktājaṃ tato lauhaṃ suvarṇajaṃ //
meaning:
ततो दारुमयं पुण्यं दारुजात् शैलजं वरं /
शैलाद्वरं तु मुक्ताजं ततो लौहं सुवर्णजं //
text_mt: Better than that is one made of wood, meritorious; better than one made of wood is one of stone; / better than stone is one made of pearl; then one made of iron, and one made of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
rājataṃ kīrtitaṃ tāmraṃ paittalaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ /
raṅgajaṃ (2) rasaliṅgañca bhuktimuktipradaṃ varaṃ //
meaning:
राजतं कीर्तितं ताम्रं पैत्तलं भुक्तिमुक्तिदं /
रङ्गजं (2) रसलिङ्गञ्च भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं वरं //
text_mt: One of silver is celebrated, [and] copper, [and] brass, granting worldly enjoyment and liberation; / a tin liṅga and a mercury liṅga are superior, granting worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
rasajaṃ rasalohādiratnagarbhantu vardhayet /
mānādi neṣṭaṃ siddhādi sthāpitetha svayambhuvi //
meaning:
रसजं रसलोहादिरत्नगर्भन्तु वर्धयेत् /
मानादि नेष्टं सिद्धादि स्थापितेथ स्वयम्भुवि //
text_mt: One should augment the mercury-born [liṅga] containing mercury, iron and other metals, and gems; / measurement and other rules are not required for one established by perfected beings or one that is self-manifest.

sanskrit_iast:
vāme ca svecchayā teṣāṃ pīṭhaprāsādakalpanā /
pūjayet sūryavimbasthaṃ darpaṇe prativimbitaṃ //
meaning:
वामे च स्वेच्छया तेषां पीठप्रासादकल्पना /
पूजयेत् सूर्यविम्बस्थं दर्पणे प्रतिविम्बितं //
text_mt: And on their left, the arrangement of pedestal and temple is according to one's wish. / One should worship [the deity] situated in the disc of the sun, reflected in a mirror.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjye harastu sarvatra liṅge pūrṇārcanaṃ bhavet /
hastottaravidhaṃ śailaṃ(3) dārujaṃ tadvadeva hi //
:n
1 pravakṣye 'haṃ prakāreṇeti ga. cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 ratnajamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 haste tu vividhaṃ śailamiti ga. cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 152
meaning:
पूज्ये हरस्तु सर्वत्र लिङ्गे पूर्णार्चनं भवेत् /
हस्तोत्तरविधं शैलं(3) दारुजं तद्वदेव हि //
:न्
1 प्रवक्ष्ये ऽहं प्रकारेणेति ग. चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 रत्नजमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 हस्ते तु विविधं शैलमिति ग. चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 152
text_mt:
When Hara is worshipped, there is full worship in every liṅga. / Stone [liṅgas] are of the variety exceeding a cubit, and wooden ones are indeed just like that.
[...]
1 "I shall explain in due manner" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2 "Made of gems" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3 "In a cubit indeed there are diverse stones" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / [Page 152]

sanskrit_iast:
calamaṅgulamānena dvāragarbhakaraiḥ sthitam(1) /
aṅgulād gṛhaliṅgaṃ syādyāvat pañcaśāṅgulaṃ //
meaning:
चलमङ्गुलमानेन द्वारगर्भकरैः स्थितम्(1) /
अङ्गुलाद् गृहलिङ्गं स्याद्यावत् पञ्चशाङ्गुलं //
text_mt: A movable [liṅga] is measured by digits, while a stationary one is measured by cubits of the door and the sanctum. / A household liṅga should be from one digit up to fifteen digits.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāramānāt trisaṅkhyākaṃ navadhā garbhamānataḥ /
navadhā garbhamānena liṅgandhāmni ca pūjayet //
meaning:
द्वारमानात् त्रिसङ्ख्याकं नवधा गर्भमानतः /
नवधा गर्भमानेन लिङ्गन्धाम्नि च पूजयेत् //
text_mt: From the measure of the door, it is threefold; from the measure of the sanctum, it is ninefold. / One should worship the liṅga in the shrine according to the ninefold measure of the sanctum.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ liṅgāni ṣaṭtriṃśat jñeyāni jyeṣṭhamānataḥ /
madhyamānena ṣaṭtriṃśat ṣaṭtriṃśadadhamena ca //
meaning:
एवं लिङ्गानि षट्त्रिंशत् ज्ञेयानि ज्येष्ठमानतः /
मध्यमानेन षट्त्रिंशत् षट्त्रिंशदधमेन च //
text_mt: Thus thirty-six liṅgas are to be known by the superior measure, / thirty-six by the middling measure, and thirty-six by the inferior.

sanskrit_iast:
itthamaikyena liṅgānāṃ śatamaṣṭottaraṃ bhavet /
ekāṅgulādipañcāntaṃ kanyasañcalamucyate //
meaning:
इत्थमैक्येन लिङ्गानां शतमष्टोत्तरं भवेत् /
एकाङ्गुलादिपञ्चान्तं कन्यसञ्चलमुच्यते //
text_mt: Thus by combination there are one hundred and eight liṅgas. / The smallest movable [liṅga] is said to range from one digit up to five.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣadvādidaśaparyantañcalaṃ liṅgañca madhyamaṃ /
ekādaśāṅgulādi syāt jyeṣṭhaṃ pañcadaśāntakam //
meaning:
षद्वादिदशपर्यन्तञ्चलं लिङ्गञ्च मध्यमं /
एकादशाङ्गुलादि स्यात् ज्येष्ठं पञ्चदशान्तकम् //
text_mt: The middling movable liṅga ranges from six digits up to ten; / the superior should range from eleven digits up to fifteen.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṅgulaṃ mahāratnai ratnair anyair navāṅgulam /
ravibhirhemabhārotthaṃ liṅgaṃ śeṣaistripañcabhiḥ //
meaning:
षडङ्गुलं महारत्नै रत्नैर् अन्यैर् नवाङ्गुलम् /
रविभिर्हेमभारोत्थं लिङ्गं शेषैस्त्रिपञ्चभिः //
text_mt: With great precious stones it is six digits; with other gems, nine digits; / made of a bhāra of gold, [it is measured] by twelve; with the remaining materials, by fifteen.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣoḍaśāṃśe ca vedāṃśe yugaṃ luptvordhvadeśataḥ /
dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśāṃśāṃś ca(2) koṇayostu vilopayet //
meaning:
षोडशांशे च वेदांशे युगं लुप्त्वोर्ध्वदेशतः /
द्वात्रिंशत्षोडशांशांश् च(2) कोणयोस्तु विलोपयेत् //
text_mt: Having removed four parts from the upper region in sixteenths and fourths, / one should pare away thirty-seconds and sixteenths at the corners.

sanskrit_iast:
caturniveśanāt kaṇṭho viṃśatistriyugais tathā(3) /
pārśvābhyāṃ tu viluptābhyāṃ calaliṅgaṃ bhavedvaraṃ(4) //
meaning:
चतुर्निवेशनात् कण्ठो विंशतिस्त्रियुगैस् तथा(3) /
पार्श्वाभ्यां तु विलुप्ताभ्यां चललिङ्गं भवेद्वरं(4) //
text_mt: From setting four parts, the neck is formed, and likewise twenty by six parts; / with both flanks pared away, an excellent movable liṅga is produced.

sanskrit_iast:
dhāmno yugartunāgāṃśair dvāraṃ hīnāditaḥ kramāt /
liṅgadvārocchrayādarvāg bhavet pādonataḥ kramāt //
meaning:
धाम्नो युगर्तुनागांशैर् द्वारं हीनादितः क्रमात् /
लिङ्गद्वारोच्छ्रयादर्वाग् भवेत् पादोनतः क्रमात् //
text_mt: The door is in parts of four, six, or eight of the shrine, successively from the inferior [to the superior]; / the liṅga should be less than the height of the door, successively reduced by one fourth.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhārdhenādhamaṃ liṅgaṃ bhūtāṃśaiḥ syāt tribhirvaraṃ /
tayormadhye ca sūtrāṇi sapta sampātayet samaṃ //
:n
1 vanamaṅgulamānena dvāragarbhakare sthitamiti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 dvātriṃśatṣoḍaśārdhañceti ga, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakatrayapāṭhaḥ
3 viṃśatistriguṇaistatheti gha, cihnitapusutakapāṭhaḥ
4 vanaliṅgaṃ bhavedvaramiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / calaliṅgaṃ
bhaved dhruvamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 153
meaning:
गर्भार्धेनाधमं लिङ्गं भूतांशैः स्यात् त्रिभिर्वरं /
तयोर्मध्ये च सूत्राणि सप्त सम्पातयेत् समं //
:न्
1 वनमङ्गुलमानेन द्वारगर्भकरे स्थितमिति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 द्वात्रिंशत्षोडशार्धञ्चेति ग, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकत्रयपाठः
3 विंशतिस्त्रिगुणैस्तथेति घ, चिह्नितपुसुतकपाठः
4 वनलिङ्गं भवेद्वरमिति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / चललिङ्गं
भवेद् ध्रुवमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 153
text_mt:
An inferior liṅga is half the sanctum; the best is three-fifths. / Between those two, one should drop seven equal cords.
[...]
1 "The forest [liṅga] is measured by digits, while it is situated in cubits of the door and sanctum" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2 "Thirty-two and a half sixteenths" is the reading in the three manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa.
3 "Twenty by three times the attributes" is the reading in the manuscript marked gha.
4 "An excellent forest liṅga is produced" is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and gha. "A movable liṅga is certainly produced" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [Page 153]

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ syurnava sūtrāṇi bhūtasūtraiś ca madhyamaṃ /
dvyantaro vāmavāmañca(1) liṅgānāṃ dīrghatā nava //
meaning:
एवं स्युर्नव सूत्राणि भूतसूत्रैश् च मध्यमं /
द्व्यन्तरो वामवामञ्च(1) लिङ्गानां दीर्घता नव //
text_mt: Thus there should be nine cords, and the middling [measure] is with five cords; / with intervals of two, progressively to the left, the length of the liṅgas is ninefold.

sanskrit_iast:
hastādvivardhate hasto yāvatsyur nava pāṇayaḥ /
hīnamadhyottamaṃ liṅgaṃ trividhaṃ trividhātmakam //
meaning:
हस्ताद्विवर्धते हस्तो यावत्स्युर् नव पाणयः /
हीनमध्योत्तमं लिङ्गं त्रिविधं त्रिविधात्मकम् //
text_mt: It increases from a cubit by a cubit until there are nine cubits. / The liṅga is threefold—inferior, middling, and superior—each being threefold.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaliṅgamadhyeṣu trīṇi trīṇi ca pādaśaḥ /
liṅgāni ghaṭayeddhīmān ṣaṭsu cāṣṭottareṣu ca //
meaning:
एकैकलिङ्गमध्येषु त्रीणि त्रीणि च पादशः /
लिङ्गानि घटयेद्धीमान् षट्सु चाष्टोत्तरेषु च //
text_mt: Within each single liṅga, a wise man should fashion three liṅgas / quarter by quarter, among the one hundred and eight.

sanskrit_iast:
sthiradīrghaprameyāttu dvāragarbhakarātmikā /
bhāgeśañcāpyamīśañca devejyantulyasaṃjñitaṃ //
meaning:
स्थिरदीर्घप्रमेयात्तु द्वारगर्भकरात्मिका /
भागेशञ्चाप्यमीशञ्च देवेज्यन्तुल्यसंज्ञितं //
text_mt: Derived from the stationary and long measurement, consisting of cubits of the door and sanctum, / [they are] named Āḍhya, Anāḍhya, Surejya, and Samāna.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri liṅgarūpāṇi viṣkambheṇa tu lakṣayet /
dīrghamāyānvitaṃ kṛtvā liṅgaṃ kuryāt trirūpakaṃ //
meaning:
चत्वारि लिङ्गरूपाणि विष्कम्भेण तु लक्षयेत् /
दीर्घमायान्वितं कृत्वा लिङ्गं कुर्यात् त्रिरूपकं //
text_mt: One should characterize the four forms of liṅgas by their diameter. / Having made the liṅga long and endowed with length, one should make it threefold in form.

sanskrit_iast:
caturaṣṭāṣṭavṛttañca tattvatrayaguṇātmakaṃ /
liṅgānāmīpsitaṃ dairghyaṃ tena kṛtvāṅgulāni vai //
meaning:
चतुरष्टाष्टवृत्तञ्च तत्त्वत्रयगुणात्मकं /
लिङ्गानामीप्सितं दैर्घ्यं तेन कृत्वाङ्गुलानि वै //
text_mt: Four-sided, eight-sided, and circular, possessing the quality of the three principles: / having determined the desired length of the liṅgas into digits thereby,

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajādyāyaiḥ surair bhūtaiḥ śikhibhirvā haret kṛtiṃ /
tānyaṅgulāni yaccheṣaṃ lakṣayecca śubhāśubhaṃ //
meaning:
ध्वजाद्यायैः सुरैर् भूतैः शिखिभिर्वा हरेत् कृतिं /
तान्यङ्गुलानि यच्छेषं लक्षयेच्च शुभाशुभं //
text_mt: one should divide the product by the deities of the banner and the rest, or by the elements, or by the fires; / whatever remains of those digits, one should discern the auspicious and inauspicious [result].

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajādyā dhvajasiṃhebhavṛṣāḥ jyeṣṭhāḥ pare śubhāḥ /
svareṣu ṣaḍjagāndhārapañcamāḥ śubhadāyakāḥ //
meaning:
ध्वजाद्या ध्वजसिंहेभवृषाः ज्येष्ठाः परे शुभाः /
स्वरेषु षड्जगान्धारपञ्चमाः शुभदायकाः //
text_mt: Banner and the rest are banner, lion, elephant, and bull; the former are best, the others are auspicious. / Among notes, the ṣaḍja, gāndhāra, and pañcama bestow auspiciousness.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūteṣu ca śubhā bhūḥ syādagniṣvāhavanīyakaḥ /
uktāyāmasya cārdhāṃśe nāgāṃśair bhājite kramāt //
meaning:
भूतेषु च शुभा भूः स्यादग्निष्वाहवनीयकः /
उक्तायामस्य चार्धांशे नागांशैर् भाजिते क्रमात् //
text_mt: Among elements, the auspicious one is earth; among fires, the āhavanīya. / In half the part of its stated length, divided successively into eight parts,

sanskrit_iast:
rasabhūtāṃśaṣaṣṭhāṃśatryaṃśādhikaśarair bhavet /
āḍhyānāḍhyasurejyārkatulyānāñcaturasratā //
meaning:
रसभूतांशषष्ठांशत्र्यंशाधिकशरैर् भवेत् /
आढ्यानाढ्यसुरेज्यार्कतुल्यानाञ्चतुरस्रता //
text_mt: with an excess of six, five, a sixth, and a third part of five, / the four-sidedness belongs to the Āḍhya, Anāḍhya, Surejya, and Arka-equal [liṅgas].

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamaṃ vardhamānākhyaṃ vyāsānnāhapravṛddhitaḥ /
dvidhā bhedā bahūnyatra vakṣyante viśvakarmataḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चमं वर्धमानाख्यं व्यासान्नाहप्रवृद्धितः /
द्विधा भेदा बहून्यत्र वक्ष्यन्ते विश्वकर्मतः //
text_mt: The fifth is named Vardhamāna, due to an increase in diameter and circumference. / Many twofold distinctions here will be spoken of according to Viśvakarman.

sanskrit_iast:
āḍhyādīnāṃ tridhā sthaulyādyavadhūtaṃ tadaṣṭadhā(2) /
:n
1 antare vāmavāme ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 sthaulyād yavavṛddhyā tadaṣṭadhā iti kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 154
tridhā hastājjinākhyañca yuktaṃ sarvasamena ca(1) //
meaning:
आढ्यादीनां त्रिधा स्थौल्याद्यवधूतं तदष्टधा(2) /
:न्
1 अन्तरे वामवामे चेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 स्थौल्याद् यववृद्ध्या तदष्टधा इति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 154
त्रिधा हस्ताज्जिनाख्यञ्च युक्तं सर्वसमेन च(1) //
text_mt:
From the threefold thickness of the Āḍhya and the others, that is discarded as eightfold,
[...]
1 "In the interval, on the left and left" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "From thickness by an increase of a barley-corn, that is eightfold" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / [Page 154]
threefold from the cubit, called Jina, and endowed with equal dimensions in all.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaviṃśatiliṅgāni nādye(2) devārcite tathā /
pañcasaptabhirekatvājjinair bhaktair bhavanti hi //
meaning:
पञ्चविंशतिलिङ्गानि नाद्ये(2) देवार्चिते तथा /
पञ्चसप्तभिरेकत्वाज्जिनैर् भक्तैर् भवन्ति हि //
text_mt: There are twenty-five liṅgas in the Āḍhya, and likewise in that worshipped by the gods; / united by five and seven, they indeed become [varieties] divided by Jina.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśasahasrāṇi caturdaśaśatāni ca /
evamaṣṭāṅgulavistāro(3) navaikakaragarbhataḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्दशसहस्राणि चतुर्दशशतानि च /
एवमष्टाङ्गुलविस्तारो(3) नवैककरगर्भतः //
text_mt: Fourteen thousand and fourteen hundred; / thus the width is eight digits from a sanctum of nine to one cubit.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāṃ koṇārdhakoṇasthaiścintyāt koṇāni(4) sūtrakaiḥ /
vistāraṃ madhyamaḥ kṛtvā sthāpyaṃ vā madhyatastrayaṃ //
meaning:
तेषां कोणार्धकोणस्थैश्चिन्त्यात् कोणानि(4) सूत्रकैः /
विस्तारं मध्यमः कृत्वा स्थाप्यं वा मध्यतस्त्रयं //
text_mt: By means of cords situated at their corners and half-corners, one should consider the corners. / Having made the middling width, one should establish the triad from the middle,

sanskrit_iast:
vibhāgādūrdhvamaṣṭāsro(5) dvyaṣṭāsraḥsyācchivāṃśakaḥ /
pādājjānvantako brahmā nābhyanto viṣṇurityataḥ //
meaning:
विभागादूर्ध्वमष्टास्रो(5) द्व्यष्टास्रःस्याच्छिवांशकः /
पादाज्जान्वन्तको ब्रह्मा नाभ्यन्तो विष्णुरित्यतः //
text_mt: above the division it should be eight-sided, and the Śiva portion sixteen-sided. / Brahmā extends from the foot to the knees; Viṣṇu up to the navel;

sanskrit_iast:
mūrdhvānto bhūtabhāgeśo vyakte 'vyakte ca tadvati /
pañcaliṅgavyavasthāyāṃ śiro vartulamucyate //
meaning:
मूर्ध्वान्तो भूतभागेशो व्यक्ते ऽव्यक्ते च तद्वति /
पञ्चलिङ्गव्यवस्थायां शिरो वर्तुलमुच्यते //
text_mt: up to the top is the Lord of the elements' portion, in the manifest and unmanifest having that form. / In the system of five liṅgas, the head is said to be circular,

sanskrit_iast:
chatrābhaṃ kukkuṭābhaṃ vā bālendupratimākṛtiḥ(6) /
ekaikasya caturbhedaiḥ(7) kāmyabhedāt phalaṃ vade //
meaning:
छत्राभं कुक्कुटाभं वा बालेन्दुप्रतिमाकृतिः(6) /
एकैकस्य चतुर्भेदैः(7) काम्यभेदात् फलं वदे //
text_mt: resembling an umbrella, or resembling a cock's egg, or having the shape of the crescent moon. / By four divisions for each one, I shall tell the fruit according to various desires.

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgamastakavistāraṃ vasubhaktantu kārayet /
ādyabhāgaṃ caturdhā tu(8) vistārocchrāyato bhajet //
meaning:
लिङ्गमस्तकविस्तारं वसुभक्तन्तु कारयेत् /
आद्यभागं चतुर्धा तु(8) विस्तारोच्छ्रायतो भजेत् //
text_mt: One should divide the width of the liṅga's crown into eight parts. / One should divide the first part into four, along width and height.

sanskrit_iast:
catvāri tatra sūtrāṇi(9) bhāgabhāgānupātanāt /
:n
1 pūjayet sarvameva ceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 nāḍhye devārcita iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 evamaṣṭāṅgualavinyāsa iti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 chindyāt koṇānīti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / chindyāt koṣāṇi
iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 dvibhāgādūrdhavamaṣṭāsra iti kha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
6 bālendutrapuṣākṛtiriti kha, ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
7 caturbhāgair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
8 antyabhāgamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
9 catvāri tatra chatrāṇi iti ga, gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakacatuṣṭyapāṭhaḥ
:p 155
puṇḍarīkantu bhāgena viśālākhyaṃ vilopanāt //
meaning:
चत्वारि तत्र सूत्राणि(9) भागभागानुपातनात् /
:न्
1 पूजयेत् सर्वमेव चेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 नाढ्ये देवार्चित इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 एवमष्टाङ्गुअलविन्यास इति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 छिन्द्यात् कोणानीति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / छिन्द्यात् कोषाणि
इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 द्विभागादूर्धवमष्टास्र इति ख, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
6 बालेन्दुत्रपुषाकृतिरिति ख, ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
7 चतुर्भागैर् इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
8 अन्त्यभागमिति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
9 चत्वारि तत्र छत्राणि इति ग, घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकचतुष्ट्यपाठः
:प् 155
पुण्डरीकन्तु भागेन विशालाख्यं विलोपनात् //
text_mt:
There are four cords by dropping division upon division.
[...]
1 "And one should worship all of it" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "In the Āḍhya worshipped by the gods" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ga.
3 "Thus is the arrangement of eight digits" is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and gha.
4 "One should cut the corners" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. "One should cut the chambers" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
5 "Above two parts it is eight-sided" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
6 "Having the shape of a cucumber [or] crescent moon" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha, ga, and gha.
7 "By four parts" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
8 "The last part" is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and gha.
9 "There are four umbrellas" is the reading in the four manuscripts marked ga, gha, and ṅa. / [Page 155]
The lotus [head is made] by one part, while that called wide is made by cutting away.

sanskrit_iast:
triśātanāttu śrīvatsaṃ śatrukṛdvedalopanāt /
śiraḥ sarvasame śreṣṭhaṃ kukkuṭābhaṃ surāhvaye(1) //
meaning:
त्रिशातनात्तु श्रीवत्सं शत्रुकृद्वेदलोपनात् /
शिरः सर्वसमे श्रेष्ठं कुक्कुटाभं सुराह्वये(1) //
text_mt: From paring three [parts] comes the śrīvatsa; by cutting away four, it creates enemies. / The head is best when all is equal; in the divine type, it resembles a cock's egg.

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhāgātmake liṅgetrapuṣaṃ dvayalopanāt /
anādyasya śiraḥ proktamardhacandraṃ śiraḥ śṛṇu //
meaning:
चतुर्भागात्मके लिङ्गेत्रपुषं द्वयलोपनात् /
अनाद्यस्य शिरः प्रोक्तमर्धचन्द्रं शिरः शृणु //
text_mt: In a liṅga consisting of four parts, the trapusa is made by paring away two. / This head of the Anāḍhya has been described; hear about the crescent moon head.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśāt prānte yugāṃśaiś ca tvekāhānyāmṛtākṣakaṃ(2) /
pūrṇabālendukumudaṃ dvitrivedakṣayāt kramāt //
meaning:
अंशात् प्रान्ते युगांशैश् च त्वेकाहान्यामृताक्षकं(2) /
पूर्णबालेन्दुकुमुदं द्वित्रिवेदक्षयात् क्रमात् //
text_mt: From the part at the end, by four parts, but with the loss of one [part] each day, [it is called] an amṛtākṣaka; / with the loss of two, three, or four parts successively, [it is called] pūrṇabālendu and kumuda.

sanskrit_iast:
catustrirekavadanaṃ mukhaliṅgamataḥ śṛṇu /
pūjābhāgaṃ prakartavyaṃ mūrtyagnipadakalpitaṃ(3) //
meaning:
चतुस्त्रिरेकवदनं मुखलिङ्गमतः शृणु /
पूजाभागं प्रकर्तव्यं मूर्त्यग्निपदकल्पितं(3) //
text_mt: Hear now of the mukhaliṅga having four, three, or one face. / The portion for worship should be made, measured as three parts of the image.

sanskrit_iast:
arkāṃśaṃ pūrvavat tyaktvā ṣaṭ sthānāni vivartayat /
śironnatiḥ prakartavyā lalāṭaṃ nāsikā tataḥ //
meaning:
अर्कांशं पूर्ववत् त्यक्त्वा षट् स्थानानि विवर्तयत् /
शिरोन्नतिः प्रकर्तव्या ललाटं नासिका ततः //
text_mt: Having omitted twelve parts as before, one should shape six sections: / the elevation of the head should be made, then the forehead, the nose,

sanskrit_iast:
vadanaṃ civukaṃ grīvā yugabhāgair bhujākṣibhiḥ /
karābhyāṃ mukulīkṛtya(4) pratimāyāḥ pramāṇataḥ //
meaning:
वदनं चिवुकं ग्रीवा युगभागैर् भुजाक्षिभिः /
कराभ्यां मुकुलीकृत्य(4) प्रतिमायाः प्रमाणतः //
text_mt: the mouth, the chin, and the neck, with four parts, arms, and eyes. / Forming a bud with both hands, according to the measure of the image,

sanskrit_iast:
mukhaṃ prati samaḥ kāryo vistārādaṣṭamāṃśataḥ /
caturmukhaṃ mayā proktaṃ trimukhañcocyate śṛṇu //
meaning:
मुखं प्रति समः कार्यो विस्तारादष्टमांशतः /
चतुर्मुखं मया प्रोक्तं त्रिमुखञ्चोच्यते शृणु //
text_mt: equal for each face, it should be made from one-eighth of the width. / The four-faced [liṅga] has been described by me; now hear of the three-faced [which] is declared:

sanskrit_iast:
karṇapādādhikāstasya lalāṭādīni nirdiśet /
bhujau caturbhirbhāgaistu kartavyau paścimorjitaṃ //
meaning:
कर्णपादाधिकास्तस्य ललाटादीनि निर्दिशेत् /
भुजौ चतुर्भिर्भागैस्तु कर्तव्यौ पश्चिमोर्जितं //
text_mt: His forehead and other [features] should be indicated as increased by a fourth of the ear. / The two arms are to be made with four parts, elevated in the west.

sanskrit_iast:
vistarādaṣṭamāṃśena mukhānāṃ pratinirgamaḥ /
ekavaktraṃ tathā kāryaṃ pūrvasyāṃ saumyalocanaṃ //
meaning:
विस्तरादष्टमांशेन मुखानां प्रतिनिर्गमः /
एकवक्त्रं तथा कार्यं पूर्वस्यां सौम्यलोचनं //
text_mt: The projection of the faces is by an eighth part of the width. / Likewise, a single-faced [liṅga] should be made with gentle eyes in the east.

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭanāsikāvaktragrīvāyāñca vivartayet /
:n
1 kukkuṭāṇḍaṃ sudhādvaye iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 dvaikahānyā sutāhvayamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 ṛtvagnipadakalpitamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ, mukhabhāgaṃ
prakartavyaṃ mūlāgnipadakalpitamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 karṇābhyāṃ kuṇḍalīkṛtveti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 156
bhujācca pañcamāṃśena(1) bhujahīnaṃ vivartayet //
meaning:
ललाटनासिकावक्त्रग्रीवायाञ्च विवर्तयेत् /
:न्
1 कुक्कुटाण्डं सुधाद्वये इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 द्वैकहान्या सुताह्वयमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ऋत्वग्निपदकल्पितमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः, मुखभागं
प्रकर्तव्यं मूलाग्निपदकल्पितमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 कर्णाभ्यां कुण्डलीकृत्वेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 156
भुजाच्च पञ्चमांशेन(1) भुजहीनं विवर्तयेत् //
text_mt:
And one should shape [the head] in the forehead, nose, face, and neck;
[Notes]
1. "kukkuṭāṇḍaṃ sudhādvaye" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "dvaikahānyā sutāhvayam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3. "ṛtvagnipadakalpitam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha; "mukhabhāgaṃ prakartavyaṃ mūlāgnipadakalpitam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "karṇābhyāṃ kuṇḍalīkṛtvā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga. / [Page 156]
and from the arm, by a fifth part, one should shape [it] devoid of arms.

sarveṣāṃ mukhaliṅgānāṃ trapuṣaṃ vātha kukkuṭaṃ //

catuḥpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ

piṇḍikālakṣaṇakathanaṃ

पिण्डिकालक्षणकथनं
text_mt:
The projection by the faces is beneficial as one-sixth of the width. / For all mukhaliṅgas, [the top] is like a cucumber or a cock's [egg].
Thus in the glorious and primal Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the fifty-fourth chapter, entitled “The Characteristics of the Manifest and Unmanifest [Liṅgas]”.
Now, the fifty-fifth chapter.
Declaration of the characteristics of the pedestal

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
ataḥ paraṃpravakṣyāmi pratimānāntu piṇḍikām /
dairghyeṇa pratimātulyā tadardhena tu vistṛtā //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
अतः परंप्रवक्ष्यामि प्रतिमानान्तु पिण्डिकाम् /
दैर्घ्येण प्रतिमातुल्या तदर्धेन तु विस्तृता //
text_mt: The Lord said: / Hereafter I shall declare the pedestal of images. / It is equal in length to the image, and wide by half of that.

sanskrit_iast:
ucchritāyāmatordhena suvistārārdhabhāgataḥ /
tṛtīyena tu vā tulyaṃ(2) tattribhāgeṇa mekhalā //
meaning:
उच्छ्रितायामतोर्धेन सुविस्तारार्धभागतः /
तृतीयेन तु वा तुल्यं(2) तत्त्रिभागेण मेखला //
text_mt: Its height is half of its length, from a half-portion of its well-proportioned width, / or equal to a third; its rim is with a third of that.

sanskrit_iast:
khātaṃ ca tatpramāṇaṃ tu kiñciduttarato natam /
vistārasya caturthena praṇālasya vinirgamaḥ //
meaning:
खातं च तत्प्रमाणं तु किञ्चिदुत्तरतो नतम् /
विस्तारस्य चतुर्थेन प्रणालस्य विनिर्गमः //
text_mt: And the excavation of that measure should be slightly inclined to the north. / The outlet of the water-channel is by a fourth of the width.

sanskrit_iast:
samūlasya vistāramagre kuryāttadardhataḥ /
vistārasya tṛtīyena toyamārgantu kārayet //
meaning:
समूलस्य विस्तारमग्रे कुर्यात्तदर्धतः /
विस्तारस्य तृतीयेन तोयमार्गन्तु कारयेत् //
text_mt: One should make the width of its base half of that at the tip. / One should make the water conduit with a third of the width.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍikārdhena vā tulyaṃ(3) dairghyamīśasya(4) kīrtitam /
īśaṃ vā(5) tulyadīrghañca jñātvā sūtraṃ prakalpayet //
:n
1 bhujārdhapañcamāṃśeneti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 tribhāgena tu bāhulyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 piṇḍikārdhena bāhulyamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 dairghyaṃ kuśasyeti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 kuśambāhulyadīrghañceti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 157
meaning:
पिण्डिकार्धेन वा तुल्यं(3) दैर्घ्यमीशस्य(4) कीर्तितम् /
ईशं वा(5) तुल्यदीर्घञ्च ज्ञात्वा सूत्रं प्रकल्पयेत् //
:न्
1 भुजार्धपञ्चमांशेनेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 त्रिभागेन तु बाहुल्यमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 पिण्डिकार्धेन बाहुल्यमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 दैर्घ्यं कुशस्येति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 कुशम्बाहुल्यदीर्घञ्चेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 157
text_mt:
Or the length of Śiva is declared to be equal to half of the pedestal; / or knowing Śiva to be of equal length, one should lay out the cord.
[Notes]
1. "bhujārdhapañcamāṃśena" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "tribhāgena tu bāhulyam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
3. "piṇḍikārdhena bāhulyam" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
4. "dairghyaṃ kuśasya" is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and ṅa.
5. "kuśambāhulyadīrghañca" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 157]

sanskrit_iast:
ucchrāyaṃ pūrvavat kuryādbhāgaṣoḍaśasaṅkhyayā /
adhaḥ ṣaṭkaṃ dvibhāgantu kaṇṭhaṃ kuryāttribhāgakam //
meaning:
उच्छ्रायं पूर्ववत् कुर्याद्भागषोडशसङ्ख्यया /
अधः षट्कं द्विभागन्तु कण्ठं कुर्यात्त्रिभागकम् //
text_mt: One should make the height as before, with a count of sixteen parts: / the lowest six [parts]; the neck should be two parts, [or] one should make it three parts.

sanskrit_iast:
śeṣāstvekaikaśaḥ kāryāḥ pratiṣṭhānirgamās tathā /
paṭṭikā piṇḍikā ceyaṃ sāmānyapratimāsu ca //
meaning:
शेषास्त्वेकैकशः कार्याः प्रतिष्ठानिर्गमास् तथा /
पट्टिका पिण्डिका चेयं सामान्यप्रतिमासु च //
text_mt: The remaining [parts] are to be made singly, as well as the projections of the base. / This molding and pedestal are for common images.

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādadvāramānena pratimādvāramucyate(1) /
gajavyālakasaṃyuktā prabhā syāt pratimāsu ca //
meaning:
प्रासादद्वारमानेन प्रतिमाद्वारमुच्यते(1) /
गजव्यालकसंयुक्ता प्रभा स्यात् प्रतिमासु च //
text_mt: The door of the image is declared according to the measure of the temple door. / And there should be an aureole endowed with elephants and vyālas for the images.

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍikāpi yathāśobhaṃ kartavyā satataṃ hareḥ /
sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ śiṣṇūktaṃ mānamucyate /
devīnāmapi sarvāsāṃ lakṣmyuktaṃ mānamucyate //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye piṇḍikālakṣaṇaṃ nāma
pañcapañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaṭpañcāśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dikpālayāgakathanaṃ
meaning:
पिण्डिकापि यथाशोभं कर्तव्या सततं हरेः /
सर्वेषामेव देवानां शिष्णूक्तं मानमुच्यते /
देवीनामपि सर्वासां लक्ष्म्युक्तं मानमुच्यते //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये पिण्डिकालक्षणं नाम
पञ्चपञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षट्पञ्चाशत्तमो ऽध्यायः
दिक्पालयागकथनं
text_mt:
The pedestal of Hari should also always be made according to beauty. / The measure stated for Viṣṇu is declared for all gods; / the measure stated for Lakṣmī is declared for all goddesses.
Thus in the glorious and primal Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the fifty-fifth chapter, entitled “The Characteristics of the Pedestal”.
Now, the fifty-sixth chapter.
Declaration of the sacrifice to the guardians of the directions

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
pratiṣṭhāpañcakaṃ vakṣye pratimātmā tu pūruṣaḥ /
prakṛtiḥ piṇḍikā lakṣmīḥ pratiṣṭhā yogakastayoḥ //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
प्रतिष्ठापञ्चकं वक्ष्ये प्रतिमात्मा तु पूरुषः /
प्रकृतिः पिण्डिका लक्ष्मीः प्रतिष्ठा योगकस्तयोः //
text_mt: The Lord said: / I shall declare the fivefold consecration: the image itself is Puruṣa, / the pedestal is Prakṛti, Lakṣmī, and consecration is the union of the two.

sanskrit_iast:
icchāphalārthibhistasmātpratiṣṭhā kriyate naraiḥ /
garbhasūtraṃ tu niḥsārya(2) prāsādasyāgrato guruḥ //
meaning:
इच्छाफलार्थिभिस्तस्मात्प्रतिष्ठा क्रियते नरैः /
गर्भसूत्रं तु निःसार्य(2) प्रासादस्याग्रतो गुरुः //
text_mt: Therefore consecration is performed by men desiring the fruit of their wishes. / Having drawn out the center-cord in front of the temple, the guru [should construct]

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭaṣoḍaśaviṃśāntaṃ maṇḍapañcādhamādikam /
snānaṃ kalaśārthañca yāgadravyārthamardhataḥ //
meaning:
अष्टषोडशविंशान्तं मण्डपञ्चाधमादिकम् /
स्नानं कलशार्थञ्च यागद्रव्यार्थमर्धतः //
text_mt: a pavilion of eight, sixteen, or up to twenty [cubits], lowest and so forth; / half of it for bathing and water-jars, and for sacrificial materials.

sanskrit_iast:
tribhāgeṇārdhabhāgena vediṃ kuryāttu śobhanām /
:n
1 pratimādravyamucyate iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 garbhasūtrantu nirmāyeti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 158
kalaśair ghaṭikābhiś ca vitānādyaiś ca bhūṣayet //
meaning:
त्रिभागेणार्धभागेन वेदिं कुर्यात्तु शोभनाम् /
:न्
1 प्रतिमाद्रव्यमुच्यते इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गर्भसूत्रन्तु निर्मायेति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 158
कलशैर् घटिकाभिश् च वितानाद्यैश् च भूषयेत् //
text_mt:
With a third or half portion, one should make a beautiful altar.
[Notes]
1. "pratimādravyamucyate" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ṅa.
2. "garbhasūtrantu nirmāya" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 158]
One should adorn it with jars, small pots, canopies, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyena samprokṣya sarvadravyāṇi dhārayet /
alaṅkṛto gururviṣṇuṃ dhyātvātmānaṃ prapūjayet //
meaning:
पञ्चगव्येन सम्प्रोक्ष्य सर्वद्रव्याणि धारयेत् /
अलङ्कृतो गुरुर्विष्णुं ध्यात्वात्मानं प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: Having sprinkled all materials with the five products of the cow, one should place them. / Adorned, the guru, having meditated on Viṣṇu, should worship himself.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgulīyaprabhṛtibhirmūrtipān valayādibhiḥ /
kuṇḍe kuṇḍe sthāpayecca mūrtipāṃstatra pāragān //
meaning:
अङ्गुलीयप्रभृतिभिर्मूर्तिपान् वलयादिभिः /
कुण्डे कुण्डे स्थापयेच्च मूर्तिपांस्तत्र पारगान् //
text_mt: With rings and the like, bracelets and the like, [he should honor] the guardians of the icons; / and he should station the guardians of the icons, who are proficient, at each fire-pit,

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣkoṇe cārdhakoṇe vartule padmasannibhe /
pūrvādau toraṇārthantu pippaloḍumbarau vaṭaṃ //
meaning:
चतुष्कोणे चार्धकोणे वर्तुले पद्मसन्निभे /
पूर्वादौ तोरणार्थन्तु पिप्पलोडुम्बरौ वटं //
text_mt: in the square, semicircular, circular, and lotus-like [fire-pits]. / In the east and other [directions], for the archways: the pippala, uḍumbara, banyan,

sanskrit_iast:
plakṣaṃ suśobhanaṃ pūrvaṃ subhadrandakṣatoraṇaṃ /
sukarma ca suhotrañca āpye saumye samucchrayam //
meaning:
प्लक्षं सुशोभनं पूर्वं सुभद्रन्दक्षतोरणं /
सुकर्म च सुहोत्रञ्च आप्ये सौम्ये समुच्छ्रयम् //
text_mt: and the very beautiful plakṣa [trees]. The eastern [archway] is Subhadra; the southern archway / is Sukarma; and in the western and northern [directions], the heights [are called] Suhotra [and Saumya].

sanskrit_iast:
pañcahastaṃ tu saṃsthāpya syonāpṛthvīti pūjayet /
toraṇastambhamūle tu kalaśānmaṅgalāṅkurān //
meaning:
पञ्चहस्तं तु संस्थाप्य स्योनापृथ्वीति पूजयेत् /
तोरणस्तम्भमूले तु कलशान्मङ्गलाङ्कुरान् //
text_mt: Having erected [an archway] of five cubits, one should worship it with “syonā pṛthivī...”. / At the base of the pillar of the archway, jars with auspicious sprouts

sanskrit_iast:
pradadyādupariṣṭācca kuryāccakraṃ sudarśanaṃ /
pañcahastapramāṇantu dhvajaṃ kuryāddvicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
प्रदद्यादुपरिष्टाच्च कुर्याच्चक्रं सुदर्शनं /
पञ्चहस्तप्रमाणन्तु ध्वजं कुर्याद्द्विचक्षणः //
text_mt: one should place, and above it one should make the Sudarśana discus. / The wise man should make a banner measuring five cubits,

sanskrit_iast:
vaipulyaṃ cāsya kurvīta ṣoḍaśāṅgulasanmitaṃ /
saptahastocchritaṃ vāsya kuryāt kuṇḍaṃ surottama(1) //
meaning:
वैपुल्यं चास्य कुर्वीत षोडशाङ्गुलसन्मितं /
सप्तहस्तोच्छ्रितं वास्य कुर्यात् कुण्डं सुरोत्तम(1) //
text_mt: and he should make its width measure sixteen inches; / or, O best of gods, one should make its fire-pit seven cubits high.

sanskrit_iast:
aruṇogninibhaś caiva kṛṣṇaḥ śuklotha pītakaḥ /
raktavarṇas tathā śvetaḥ śvetavarṇādikakramāt(2) //
meaning:
अरुणोग्निनिभश् चैव कृष्णः शुक्लोथ पीतकः /
रक्तवर्णस् तथा श्वेतः श्वेतवर्णादिकक्रमात्(2) //
text_mt: Reddish-brown, fire-like, black, white, and yellow; / red-colored and white, in the order of white and other colors:

sanskrit_iast:
kumudaḥ kumudākṣaś ca puṇḍarīkotha vāmanaḥ /
śaṅkukarṇaḥ sarvanetraḥ sumukhaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ //
meaning:
कुमुदः कुमुदाक्षश् च पुण्डरीकोथ वामनः /
शङ्कुकर्णः सर्वनेत्रः सुमुखः सुप्रतिष्ठितः //
text_mt: Kumuda, Kumudākṣa, Puṇḍarīka, then Vāmana, / Śaṅkukarṇa, Sarvanetra, Sumukha, and Supratiṣṭhita.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjyā koṭiguṇair yuktāḥ pūrvādyā dhvajadevatāḥ /
jalāḍhakasupūrāstu pakvavimbopamā ghaṭāḥ //
:n
1 samāhita iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 śvetavarnakramāt dhvajā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ /
kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kramāddhvajā iti ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 159
meaning:
पूज्या कोटिगुणैर् युक्ताः पूर्वाद्या ध्वजदेवताः /
जलाढकसुपूरास्तु पक्वविम्बोपमा घटाः //
:न्
1 समाहित इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 श्वेतवर्नक्रमात् ध्वजा इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः /
कृष्णवर्णः क्रमाद्ध्वजा इति ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 159
text_mt:
Endowed with ten million qualities, the banner deities in the east and other directions are to be worshipped. / The jars, resembling ripe bimba fruit, should be well filled with an āḍhaka of water.
[Notes]
1. "samāhitaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "śvetavarṇakramāt dhvajāḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
"kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ kramāddhvajāḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 159]

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāviṃśādhikaśataṃ kālamaṇḍanavarjitāḥ /
sahiraṇyā vastrakaṇṭhāḥ sodakāstoraṇādvahiḥ //
meaning:
अष्टाविंशाधिकशतं कालमण्डनवर्जिताः /
सहिरण्या वस्त्रकण्ठाः सोदकास्तोरणाद्वहिः //
text_mt: One hundred and twenty-eight [pots], devoid of dark adornment, / with gold, with cloth-wrapped necks, and with water, outside the archways,

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṭāḥ sthāpyāś ca pūrvādau vedikāyāś ca koṇagān /
caturaḥ sthāpayet kumbhānājighreti ca mantrataḥ //
meaning:
घटाः स्थाप्याश् च पूर्वादौ वेदिकायाश् च कोणगान् /
चतुरः स्थापयेत् कुम्भानाजिघ्रेति च मन्त्रतः //
text_mt: are the pots to be placed, beginning in the east; and at the corners of the altar / one should place four pots with the mantra, "Smell [the jar]."

sanskrit_iast:
kumbheṣvāvāhya śakrādīn pūrvādau pūjayet kramāt /
indrāgaccha devarāja vajrahasta gajasthita //
meaning:
कुम्भेष्वावाह्य शक्रादीन् पूर्वादौ पूजयेत् क्रमात् /
इन्द्रागच्छ देवराज वज्रहस्त गजस्थित //
text_mt: Having invoked Śakra and the others into the pots, he should worship them in order from the east: / "Come, O Indra, king of the gods, thunderbolt in hand, seated on an elephant!

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvadvārañca me rakṣa devaiḥ saha namostu te /
trātāramindramantreṇa arcayitvā yajed budhaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वद्वारञ्च मे रक्ष देवैः सह नमोस्तु ते /
त्रातारमिन्द्रमन्त्रेण अर्चयित्वा यजेद् बुधः //
text_mt: Protect my eastern door together with the gods; homage to you!" / Having worshiped Indra with the "trātāram" mantra, the wise man should make an offering.

sanskrit_iast:
āgacchāgre śaktiyuta(1) cchāgastha balasaṃyuta /
rakṣāgneyīṃ diśaṃ devaiḥ pūjāṃ gṛha namostu te //
meaning:
आगच्छाग्रे शक्तियुत(1) च्छागस्थ बलसंयुत /
रक्षाग्नेयीं दिशं देवैः पूजां गृह नमोस्तु ते //
text_mt: "Come before [us], possessing the spear, seated on a goat, endowed with strength! / Protect the south-eastern quarter with the gods; accept the worship; homage to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
agnimūrdhetimantreṇa(2) yajedvā āgneya namaḥ /
mahiṣastha yamāgaccha daṇḍahasta mahābala //
meaning:
अग्निमूर्धेतिमन्त्रेण(2) यजेद्वा आग्नेय नमः /
महिषस्थ यमागच्छ दण्डहस्त महाबल //
text_mt: One should worship him with the mantra, "Agni is the head...", or with: "Homage to Agni!" / "Come, O Yama, seated on a buffalo, staff in hand, possessed of great strength!

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣa tvaṃ dakṣiṇadvāraṃ vaivasvata namostu te /
vaivasvataṃ saṅgamanamityanena yajedyamaṃ //
meaning:
रक्ष त्वं दक्षिणद्वारं वैवस्वत नमोस्तु ते /
वैवस्वतं सङ्गमनमित्यनेन यजेद्यमं //
text_mt: Protect the southern door, O Vaivasvata; homage to you!" / One should worship Yama with this [mantra]: "To Vaivasvata, the gathering-place..."

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtāgaccha khaḍgāḍhya balavāhanasaṃyuta(3) /
idamarghyamidaṃ pādyaṃ rakṣa tvaṃ nairṛtīṃ diśaṃ //
meaning:
नैरृतागच्छ खड्गाढ्य बलवाहनसंयुत(3) /
इदमर्घ्यमिदं पाद्यं रक्ष त्वं नैरृतीं दिशं //
text_mt: "Come, O Nairṛta, rich in swords, accompanied by troops and a mount! / Here is the water offering, here is the foot-washing water; protect the south-western quarter!"

sanskrit_iast:
eṣa te nairṛte mantreṇa yajedarghyādibhir naraḥ /
makarārūḍha varuṇa pāśahasta mahābala //
meaning:
एष ते नैरृते मन्त्रेण यजेदर्घ्यादिभिर् नरः /
मकरारूढ वरुण पाशहस्त महाबल //
text_mt: A man should worship him with the mantra, "This is your [share], O Nairṛta...", with the water offering and the rest. / "O Varuṇa, mounted on a makara, noose in hand, possessed of great strength,

sanskrit_iast:
āgaccha paścimaṃ dvāraṃ rakṣa rakṣa namostu te /
uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaṃ yajedarghyādibhirguruḥ //
meaning:
आगच्छ पश्चिमं द्वारं रक्ष रक्ष नमोस्तु ते /
उरुं हि राजा वरुणं यजेदर्घ्यादिभिर्गुरुः //
text_mt: come, protect the western door, protect it; homage to you!" / The guru should worship King Varuṇa with the "uruṃ hi" [mantra] and with water offerings and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
āgaccha vāyo sabala dhvajahasta savāhana /
vāyavyaṃ rakṣa devaistvaṃ samarudbhir namostu te //
:n

text_mt:
"Come, O Vāyu, with your army, banner in hand, with your mount! / Protect the north-western quarter together with the gods and the Maruts; homage to you!"
[...]

sanskrit_iast:
vāta ity ādibhiścārvedonnamo vāyavepi vā /
āgaccha soma sabalā gadāhasta savāhana //

आगच्छ सोम सबला गदाहस्त सवाहन //
text_mt: And with "The wind..." and so forth he should offer homage, or with "Homage to Vāyu." / "Come, O Soma, with your army, mace in hand, with your mount!

sanskrit_iast:
rakṣa tvamuttaradvāraṃ sakuvera namostu te /
somaṃ rājānamiti vā yajetsomāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
रक्ष त्वमुत्तरद्वारं सकुवेर नमोस्तु ते /
सोमं राजानमिति वा यजेत्सोमाय वै नमः //
text_mt: Protect the northern door, along with Kubera; homage to you!" / Or one should worship with: "Soma the king...", or indeed, "Homage to Soma!"

sanskrit_iast:
āgaccheśāna sabala śūlahasta vṛṣasthita /
yajñamaṇḍapasyaiśānīṃ diśaṃ rakṣa namostu te //
meaning:
आगच्छेशान सबल शूलहस्त वृषस्थित /
यज्ञमण्डपस्यैशानीं दिशं रक्ष नमोस्तु ते //
text_mt: "Come, O Īśāna, with your army, trident in hand, mounted on a bull! / Protect the north-eastern quarter of the sacrificial pavilion; homage to you!"

sanskrit_iast:
īśānamasyeti yajedīśānāya namopi vā /
brahmannāgaccha haṃsastha sruksruvavyagrahastaka //
meaning:
ईशानमस्येति यजेदीशानाय नमोपि वा /
ब्रह्मन्नागच्छ हंसस्थ स्रुक्स्रुवव्यग्रहस्तक //
text_mt: One should worship with "Lord of this [world]...", or with: "Homage to Īśāna." / "Come, O Brahmā, seated on a swan, your hands occupied with the sruc and sruva ladles!

sanskrit_iast:
salokordhvāṃ diśaṃ rakṣa yajñasyāja namostu te /
hiraṇyagarbheti yajennamaste brahmaṇepi vā //
meaning:
सलोकोर्ध्वां दिशं रक्ष यज्ञस्याज नमोस्तु ते /
हिरण्यगर्भेति यजेन्नमस्ते ब्रह्मणेपि वा //
text_mt: Protect the upper direction of the sacrifice together with the worlds, O Unborn One; homage to you!" / One should worship with "The Golden Embryo...", or: "Homage to Brahmā!"

sanskrit_iast:

namostu sarpeti yajedanantāya namopi vā //

text_mt:
"Come, O Ananta, endowed with the discus, seated on a tortoise, lord of the serpent hosts! / Protect, protect the downward direction, O Lord Ananta; homage to you!" / One should worship with "Homage to the serpent...", or with: "Homage to Ananta."
Thus ends the fifty-sixth chapter, named "Sacrifice to the Guardians of the Directions", in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the fifty-seventh chapter.
The ritual of preliminary consecration of the jars.

sanskrit_iast:
bhagavānuvāca
bhūmeḥ parigrahaṃ kuryāt kṣipedbrīhīṃś ca sarṣapān /
nārasiṃhena rakṣoghnān prokṣoghnān prokṣayet pañcagavyataḥ //
meaning:
भगवानुवाच
भूमेः परिग्रहं कुर्यात् क्षिपेद्ब्रीहींश् च सर्षपान् /
नारसिंहेन रक्षोघ्नान् प्रोक्षोघ्नान् प्रोक्षयेत् पञ्चगव्यतः //
text_mt: The Holy One said: / One should take possession of the ground, and scatter rice and mustard seeds; / with the Nṛsiṃha [mantra] destroying demons, he should sprinkle [the site] with the five cow-products.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiṃ ghaṭe tu sampūjya saratne sāṅgakaṃ hariṃ /
astramantreṇa karakaṃ(1) tatra cāṣṭaśataṃ yajet //
meaning:
भूमिं घटे तु सम्पूज्य सरत्ने साङ्गकं हरिं /
अस्त्रमन्त्रेण करकं(1) तत्र चाष्टशतं यजेत् //
text_mt: Having worshiped the earth in the pot, and Hari with his limbs alongside jewels, / he should worship the water-pot there one hundred and eight times with the weapon-mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
acchinnadhārayā siñcan brīhīn saṃskṛtya dhārayet /
:n
1 astramantreṇa kavacamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 161
pradakṣiṇaṃ paribhrāmya kalaśaṃ vikiropari //
meaning:
अच्छिन्नधारया सिञ्चन् ब्रीहीन् संस्कृत्य धारयेत् /

प्रदक्षिणं परिभ्राम्य कलशं विकिरोपरि //
text_mt:
Sprinkling with an unbroken stream, having consecrated the rice grains, he should hold [them].
[...]
[Apparatus note 1: "astramantreṇa kavacam" is the variant reading in manuscript ṅa]
Circumambulating clockwise, he should scatter [them] over the pot.

sanskrit_iast:
savastre kalaśe bhūyaḥ pūjayedacyutaṃ śriyaṃ /
yoge yogeti mantreṇa nyasecchayyāntu maṇḍale //
meaning:
सवस्त्रे कलशे भूयः पूजयेदच्युतं श्रियं /
योगे योगेति मन्त्रेण न्यसेच्छय्यान्तु मण्डले //
text_mt: Upon the cloth-covered pot he should again worship Acyuta and Śrī; / with the mantra "In union after union...", he should place the bed on the maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśopari tūlikāñca śayyāyāṃ digvidikṣu ca /
vidyādhipān yajedviṣṇuṃ madhughātaṃ trivikramaṃ //
meaning:
कुशोपरि तूलिकाञ्च शय्यायां दिग्विदिक्षु च /
विद्याधिपान् यजेद्विष्णुं मधुघातं त्रिविक्रमं //
text_mt: And upon the kuśa grass [he should place] a mattress; on the bed and in the cardinal and intermediate directions / he should worship the lords of knowledge: Viṣṇu, the Slayer of Madhu, Trivikrama,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmanaṃ dikṣu vāyvādau(1) śrīdharañca hṛṣīkapaṃ /
padmanābhaṃ dāmodaramaiśānyāṃ snānamaṇḍape //
meaning:
वामनं दिक्षु वाय्वादौ(1) श्रीधरञ्च हृषीकपं /
पद्मनाभं दामोदरमैशान्यां स्नानमण्डपे //
text_mt: Vāmana in the directions starting with north-west, Śrīdhara, Hṛṣīkeśa, / Padmanābha, and Dāmodara; [and] in the north-east in the bathing pavilion.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcya paścādaiśānyāṃ catuṣkumbhe(2) savedike /
snānamaṇḍaṣake sarvadravyāṇyānīya nikṣipet //
meaning:
अभ्यर्च्य पश्चादैशान्यां चतुष्कुम्भे(2) सवेदिके /
स्नानमण्डषके सर्वद्रव्याण्यानीय निक्षिपेत् //
text_mt: Having worshiped, afterwards in the north-east, with four pots, equipped with an altar / in the small bathing pavilion, having brought all materials, he should deposit them.

sanskrit_iast:
snānakumbheṣu kumbhāṃstāṃś caturdikṣvadhivāsayet /
kalaśāḥ sthāpanīyāstu abhiṣekārthamādarāt //
meaning:
स्नानकुम्भेषु कुम्भांस्तांश् चतुर्दिक्ष्वधिवासयेत् /
कलशाः स्थापनीयास्तु अभिषेकार्थमादरात् //
text_mt: In the bathing pots, he should perform the preliminary consecration of those pots in the four directions; / jars must indeed be placed with care for the purpose of the consecration by aspersion.

sanskrit_iast:
vaṭodumbarakāśvatthāṃś campakāśokaśrīdrumān(3) /
palāśārjunaplakṣāṃstu kadambavakulāmrakān //

वटोदुम्बरकाश्वत्थांश् चम्पकाशोकश्रीद्रुमान्(3) /
पलाशार्जुनप्लक्षांस्तु कदम्बवकुलाम्रकान् //
text_mt: Banyan, udumbara, and aśvattha; campaka, aśoka, and śrī-trees; / palāśa, arjuna, and plakṣa; kadamba, bakula, and mango:

sanskrit_iast:
pallavāṃstu samānīya pūrvakumbhe(4) vinikṣipet /
padmakaṃ rocanāṃ dūrvāṃ darbhapiñjalameva ca //

पद्मकं रोचनां दूर्वां दर्भपिञ्जलमेव च //
text_mt: having collected their sprouts, he should place them into the eastern pot. / Padmaka wood, yellow orpiment, dūrvā grass, and tufts of darbha grass,

sanskrit_iast:
jātīpuṣpaṃ kundapuṣpacandanaṃ raktacandanaṃ /
siddhārthaṃ tagarañcaiva taṇḍulaṃ dakṣiṇe nyaset //

जातीपुष्पं कुन्दपुष्पचन्दनं रक्तचन्दनं /
सिद्धार्थं तगरञ्चैव तण्डुलं दक्षिणे न्यसेत् //
text_mt: jasmine flower, kunda flower, sandalwood, red sandalwood, / white mustard, tagara, and rice: he should place these in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
savarṇaṃ rajatañcaiva kūladvayamṛdantathā /
nadyāḥ samudragāminyā viśeṣāt jāhnavīmṛdaṃ //
meaning:
सवर्णं रजतञ्चैव कूलद्वयमृदन्तथा /
नद्याः समुद्रगामिन्या विशेषात् जाह्नवीमृदं //
text_mt: Gold, silver, and earth from both banks / of a river that flows into the ocean, especially earth from the Ganges,

sanskrit_iast:
gomayañca yavān śālīṃstilāṃś caivāpare nyaset /
viṣṇuparṇīṃ śyāmalatāṃ bhṛṅgarājaṃ śatāvarīṃ //

cow dung, barley, winter rice, and sesame seeds he should place in the west. / Viṣṇuparṇī, śyāmalatā, bhṛṅgarāja, śatāvarī,

sahadevāṃ mahādevīṃ(1) balāṃ vyaghrīṃ salakṣmaṇāṃ /

meaning:
सहदेवां महादेवीं(1) बलां व्यघ्रीं सलक्ष्मणां /
ऐशान्यामपरे कुम्भे मङ्गल्यान्विनिवेशयेत् //
text_mt: sahadevā, mahādevī, balā, vyāghrī, along with lakṣmaṇā: / in the north-east, in another pot, he should place these auspicious herbs.

sanskrit_iast:
valmīkamṛttikāṃ saptasthānotthāmapare nyaset /
jāhnavīvālukātoyaṃ vinyasedapare ghaṭe //

वल्मीकमृत्तिकां सप्तस्थानोत्थामपरे न्यसेत् /
जाह्नवीवालुकातोयं विन्यसेदपरे घटे //
text_mt: He should deposit ant-hill earth, taken from seven places, in another [pot]; / he should deposit water and sand from the Ganges in another pot.

sanskrit_iast:
varāhavṛṣanāgendraviṣāṇoddhṛtamṛttikāṃ /
mṛttikāṃ padmamūlasya kuśasya tvapare nyaset //
meaning:
वराहवृषनागेन्द्रविषाणोद्धृतमृत्तिकां /
मृत्तिकां पद्ममूलस्य कुशस्य त्वपरे न्यसेत् //
text_mt: Earth dug up by the tusks of a boar, a bull, and a noble elephant; / and earth from the root of a lotus and of kuśa grass he should place in another [pot].

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthaparvatamṛdbhiś ca yuktamapyapare nyaset /

तीर्थपर्वतमृद्भिश् च युक्तमप्यपरे न्यसेत् /
नागकेशरपुष्पञ्च काश्मीरमपरे न्यसेत् //
text_mt: He should also place [water] combined with earth from sacred fords and mountains in another [pot]; / and in another [pot] he should place the nāgakesara flower and saffron.

sanskrit_iast:
candanāgurukarpūraiḥ puṣpaṃ caivāpare nyaset /
vaidūryaṃ vidrumaṃ muktāṃ sphaṭikaṃ vajrameva ca //
