text_mt: having filled with the Hṛdaya mantra and worshipped with the six limbs, one should consecrate with mantras; / having protected it with the weapon mantra (heti), one should veil it with the Kavaca.

sanskrit_iast:
racayitvārghyamaṣṭāṅgaṃ secayeddhenumudrayā(2) /
abhiṣiñcedathātmānaṃ mūrdhni tattoyavindunā //
meaning:
रचयित्वार्घ्यमष्टाङ्गं सेचयेद्धेनुमुद्रया(2) /
अभिषिञ्चेदथात्मानं मूर्ध्नि तत्तोयविन्दुना //
text_mt: Having prepared the eight-limbed water offering, one should sprinkle it with the cow gesture (dhenumudrā); / then one should consecrate oneself on the head with a drop of that water.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrasthaṃ yāgasambhāraṃ prokṣayedastravāriṇā /
abhimantrya hṛdā piṇḍaistanutrāṇena veṣṭayet //
meaning:
तत्रस्थं यागसम्भारं प्रोक्षयेदस्त्रवारिणा /
अभिमन्त्र्य हृदा पिण्डैस्तनुत्राणेन वेष्टयेत् //
text_mt: One should sprinkle the sacrificial apparatus placed there with Astra water; / having consecrated [them] with the Hṛdaya mantra, one should encompass the lumps with the armour [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
darśayitvāmṛtāṃ mudrāṃ puṣpaṃ datvā nijāsane /
vidhāya tilakaṃ mūrdhni puṣpaṃ mūlena yojayet //
meaning:
दर्शयित्वामृतां मुद्रां पुष्पं दत्वा निजासने /
विधाय तिलकं मूर्ध्नि पुष्पं मूलेन योजयेत् //
text_mt: Having displayed the nectar gesture (amṛtāmudrā) and placed a flower on one's own seat, / having made a tilaka mark on the forehead, one should apply a flower with the root mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
snāne devārcane home bhojane yāgayogayoḥ /
āvaśyake jape dhīraḥ sadā vācaṃyamo bhavet //
meaning:
स्नाने देवार्चने होमे भोजने यागयोगयोः /
आवश्यके जपे धीरः सदा वाचंयमो भवेत् //
text_mt: During bathing, deity worship, fire oblation, eating, sacrificial rite, and yoga, / and during necessary recitation, the wise person should always remain silent.

sanskrit_iast:
nādāntoccāraṇānmantraṃ śodhayitvā susaṃskṛtaṃ /
pūjane 'bhyarcya gāyatryā sāmānyārghyamupāharet //
meaning:
नादान्तोच्चारणान्मन्त्रं शोधयित्वा सुसंस्कृतं /
पूजने ऽभ्यर्च्य गायत्र्या सामान्यार्घ्यमुपाहरेत् //
text_mt: Having purified the mantra by uttering it up to the end of nāda, making it well consecrated, / having worshipped with the gāyatrī in the rite, one should present the general water offering.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmapañcakamāvartya mālyamādāya liṅgataḥ /
aiśānyāndiśi caṇḍāya hṛdayena nivedayet //
meaning:
ब्रह्मपञ्चकमावर्त्य माल्यमादाय लिङ्गतः /
ऐशान्यान्दिशि चण्डाय हृदयेन निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: Having recited the group of five Brahma mantras and taken the garland from the liṅga, / one should offer it to Caṇḍa in the northeast direction with the Hṛdaya mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālya piṇdikāliṅge astratoye tato hṛdā /
arghyapātrāmbunā siñcediti liṅgaviśodhanaṃ //
meaning:
प्रक्षाल्य पिण्दिकालिङ्गे अस्त्रतोये ततो हृदा /
अर्घ्यपात्राम्बुना सिञ्चेदिति लिङ्गविशोधनं //
text_mt: Having washed the pedestal and liṅga with Astra water, then with the Hṛdaya mantra / one should sprinkle [them] with the water of the arghya vessel; this is the purification of the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
ātamadravyamantraliṅgaśuddhau sarvān surānyajet /
vāyavye gaṇapataye hāṃ gurubhyo 'rcayecchive //
:n
1 cintayet saparigrahamiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 rocayeddhenumudrayeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 215
meaning:
आतमद्रव्यमन्त्रलिङ्गशुद्धौ सर्वान् सुरान्यजेत् /
वायव्ये गणपतये हां गुरुभ्यो ऽर्चयेच्छिवे //
:न्
1 चिन्तयेत् सपरिग्रहमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 रोचयेद्धेनुमुद्रयेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 215
text_mt:
When the self, materials, mantras, and liṅga are purified, one should worship all the gods: / to Gaṇapati in the northwest, [and with] 'hāṃ' to the gurus, one should worship in Śiva.
[Gap in text]
[Footnote 1: "cintayet saparigraham" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.]
[Footnote 2: "rocayeddhenumudrayā" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha. / Page 215]

sanskrit_iast:
ādhāraśaktimaṅkuranibhāṃ kūrmaśilāsthitāṃ /
yajed brahmaśilārūḍhaṃ śivasyānantamāsanaṃ //
meaning:
आधारशक्तिमङ्कुरनिभां कूर्मशिलास्थितां /
यजेद् ब्रह्मशिलारूढं शिवस्यानन्तमासनं //
text_mt: One should worship the support-power (ādhāraśakti) resembling a sprout, resting on the tortoise-stone; / one should worship the infinite seat of Śiva, mounted upon the Brahma stone;

sanskrit_iast:
vicitrakeśaprakhyānamanyonyaṃ pṛṣṭadarśinaḥ /
kṛtatretādirūpeṇa śivasyāsanapādukāṃ //
meaning:
विचित्रकेशप्रख्यानमन्योन्यं पृष्टदर्शिनः /
कृतत्रेतादिरूपेण शिवस्यासनपादुकां //
text_mt: which resembles varied manes, [the lions] facing each other's backs, / in the form of Kṛta, Tretā, and the other [yugas], the footrest for the seat of Śiva;

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaṃ jñānañca vairāgyamaiśvaryañcāgnidiṅmukhān /
kūrpārakuṅkumasvarṇakajjalābhān yajet kramāt //
meaning:
धर्मं ज्ञानञ्च वैराग्यमैश्वर्यञ्चाग्निदिङ्मुखान् /
कूर्पारकुङ्कुमस्वर्णकज्जलाभान् यजेत् क्रमात् //
text_mt: Dharma, Knowledge, Dispassion, and Sovereignty, facing the directions beginning with fire [southeast], / having the luster of camphor, saffron, gold, and collyrium, one should worship in sequence;

sanskrit_iast:
padmañca karṇikāmadhye pūrvādau madhyato nava /
varadābhayahastāś ca śaktayo dhṛtacāmarāḥ //
meaning:
पद्मञ्च कर्णिकामध्ये पूर्वादौ मध्यतो नव /
वरदाभयहस्ताश् च शक्तयो धृतचामराः //
text_mt: and the lotus in the middle of the pericarp, the nine [śaktis] from the east and in the centre, / having hands granting boons and fearlessness, and holding chowries:

sanskrit_iast:
vāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca kālī kalavikāriṇī /
balavikaraṇī pūjyā balapramathanī kramāt //
meaning:
वामा ज्येष्ठा च रौद्री च काली कलविकारिणी /
बलविकरणी पूज्या बलप्रमथनी क्रमात् //
text_mt: Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Raudrī, Kālī, Kalavikāriṇī, / Balavikaraṇī, and Balapramathanī are to be worshipped in sequence;

sanskrit_iast:
hāṃ sarvabhūtadamanī keśarāgre manonmanī /
kṣittyādi śuddhavidyāntu tattvavyāpakamāsanaṃ //
meaning:
हां सर्वभूतदमनी केशराग्रे मनोन्मनी /
क्षित्त्यादि शुद्धविद्यान्तु तत्त्वव्यापकमासनं //
text_mt: 'hāṃ' Sarvabhūtadamanī, and Manonmanī at the tip of the filaments; / the seat pervades the principles beginning with earth and ending with Śuddhavidyā.

sanskrit_iast:
nyaset siṃhāsane devaṃ śuklaṃ pañcamukhaṃ vibhuṃ /
daśabāhuṃ ca khaṇḍenduṃ dadhānandakṣiṇaiḥ karaiḥ //
meaning:
न्यसेत् सिंहासने देवं शुक्लं पञ्चमुखं विभुं /
दशबाहुं च खण्डेन्दुं दधानन्दक्षिणैः करैः //
text_mt: One should deposit on the lion-throne the god: white, five-faced, the all-pervading lord, / ten-armed, holding the crescent moon with his right hands,

sanskrit_iast:
śaktyṛṣṭiśūlakhaṭvāṅgavaradaṃ vāmakaiḥ karaiḥ /
ḍamaruṃ vījapurañca nīlābjaṃ sūtrakotpalaṃ //
meaning:
शक्त्यृष्टिशूलखट्वाङ्गवरदं वामकैः करैः /
डमरुं वीजपुरञ्च नीलाब्जं सूत्रकोत्पलं //
text_mt: granting boons with a spear, dart, trident, and staff (khaṭvāṅga); with his left hands, / [holding] a drum, a citron, a blue lotus, a thread, and a water lily;

sanskrit_iast:
dvātriṃśallakṣaṇopetāṃ śaivīṃ mūrtintu madhyataḥ /
hāṃ haṃ hāṃ śivamūrtaye svaprakāśaṃ śivaṃ smaran //
meaning:
द्वात्रिंशल्लक्षणोपेतां शैवीं मूर्तिन्तु मध्यतः /
हां हं हां शिवमूर्तये स्वप्रकाशं शिवं स्मरन् //
text_mt: the Śaiva icon endowed with thirty-two marks in the centre; / [saying] 'hāṃ haṃ hāṃ to the Śiva-icon', remembering Śiva who is self-luminous.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādikāraṇatyāgānmantraṃ nītvā śivāspadaṃ /
tato lalātamadhyasthaṃ sphurattārāpatiprabhaṃ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मादिकारणत्यागान्मन्त्रं नीत्वा शिवास्पदं /
ततो ललातमध्यस्थं स्फुरत्तारापतिप्रभं //
text_mt: Having led the mantra to Śiva's abode by relinquishing Brahmā and the other causal deities, / then [Śiva] situated in the middle of the forehead, possessing the brilliance of the flashing moon,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍaṅgena samākīrṇaṃ vindurūpaṃ paraṃ śivaṃ /
puṣpāñjaligataṃ dhyātvā lakṣmīmūrtau niveśayet //
meaning:
षडङ्गेन समाकीर्णं विन्दुरूपं परं शिवं /
पुष्पाञ्जलिगतं ध्यात्वा लक्ष्मीमूर्तौ निवेशयेत् //
text_mt: accompanied by the six limbs, Supreme Śiva in the form of a bindu; / having meditated upon him in a folded-hand offering of flowers, one should install him in the auspicious icon.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hāṃ hauṃ śivāya nama āvāhanyā hṛddā tataḥ /
āvāhya sthāpya sthāpanyā sannidhāyāntikaṃ śivaṃ //
meaning:
ओं हां हौं शिवाय नम आवाहन्या हृद्दा ततः /
आवाह्य स्थाप्य स्थापन्या सन्निधायान्तिकं शिवं //
text_mt: [Saying] 'oṃ hāṃ hauṃ obeisance to Śiva', with the invoking gesture (āvāhanī) and the Hṛdaya mantra then, / having invoked him, installed him with the installing gesture (sthāpanī), bringing Śiva into proximity,

sanskrit_iast:
nirodhayenniṣṭhurayā kālakāntyā phaḍantataḥ /
:p 216
vighnānutsārya viṣṭhyātha(1) liṅgamudrāṃ namaskṛtiṃ //
meaning:
निरोधयेन्निष्ठुरया कालकान्त्या फडन्ततः /
:प् 216
विघ्नानुत्सार्य विष्ठ्याथ(1) लिङ्गमुद्रां नमस्कृतिं //
text_mt:
one should restrain him with the Niṣṭhurā gesture, [with the mantra] Kālakānti ending in 'phaṭ'.
[Page 216]
Having dispelled obstacles with the Viṣṭhi gesture, then [presenting] the liṅga gesture and obeisance,

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdāvaguṇṭhayet paścādāvāhaḥ sammukhī tataḥ /
niveśanaṃ sthāpanaṃ syātsannidhānaṃ tavāsmi bhoḥ //
meaning:
हृदावगुण्ठयेत् पश्चादावाहः सम्मुखी ततः /
निवेशनं स्थापनं स्यात्सन्निधानं तवास्मि भोः //
text_mt: one should veil him with the Hṛdaya mantra afterwards. Then invocation means turning towards; / installation is placement; proximity means 'O Lord, I am yours'.

sanskrit_iast:
ākarmakāṇḍaparyantaṃ sannedheyoparikṣayaḥ /
svabhakteś ca(2) prakāśoyastadbhavedavaguṇṭhanaṃ //
meaning:
आकर्मकाण्डपर्यन्तं सन्नेधेयोपरिक्षयः /
स्वभक्तेश् च(2) प्रकाशोयस्तद्भवेदवगुण्ठनं //
text_mt: The end of the upward destruction of proximity lasts until the ritual section; / and the illumination of one's own devotion: that is veiling.

sanskrit_iast:
sakalīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā mantraiḥ ṣaḍbhirathaikatāṃ /
aṅgānāmaṅginā sārdhaṃ vidadhyādamṛtīkṛtaṃ //
meaning:
सकलीकरणं कृत्वा मन्त्रैः षड्भिरथैकतां /
अङ्गानामङ्गिना सार्धं विदध्यादमृतीकृतं //
text_mt: Having performed the bodily integration (sakalīkaraṇa) with the six mantras, one should then effect the oneness / of the limbs with the possessor of the limbs, rendered immortal.

sanskrit_iast:
cicchaktihṛdayaṃ śambhoḥ śiva aiśvaryamaṣṭadhā(3) /
śikhāvaśitvaṃ cābhedyaṃ tejaḥ kavacamaiśvaraṃ //
meaning:
चिच्छक्तिहृदयं शम्भोः शिव ऐश्वर्यमष्टधा(3) /
शिखावशित्वं चाभेद्यं तेजः कवचमैश्वरं //
text_mt: The heart of Śambhu is the consciousness-power; the head is the eightfold sovereignty; / the tuft is mastery; and the divine armor is impenetrable splendor.

sanskrit_iast:
pratāpo duḥsahaścāstramantarāyāpahārakaṃ /
namaḥ svadhā ca svāhā ca vauṣaṭ ceti yathākramaṃ //
meaning:
प्रतापो दुःसहश्चास्त्रमन्तरायापहारकं /
नमः स्वधा च स्वाहा च वौषट् चेति यथाक्रमं //
text_mt: The weapon is irresistible majesty, which removes obstacles. / [The mantras end with] "namaḥ", "svadhā", "svāhā", and "vauṣaṭ", in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtpuraḥsaramuccārya pādyādīni nivedayet /
pādyaṃ pādāmbujadvandve vaktreṣvācamanīyakaṃ //
meaning:
हृत्पुरःसरमुच्चार्य पाद्यादीनि निवेदयेत् /
पाद्यं पादाम्बुजद्वन्द्वे वक्त्रेष्वाचमनीयकं //
text_mt: Pronouncing them preceded by the heart [mantra], one should offer water for washing the feet and so forth: / water for the feet at the pair of lotus feet; sipping-water at the mouths;

sanskrit_iast:
arghyaṃ śirasi devasya dūrvāpuṣpākṣatāni ca /
evaṃ saṃskṛtya saṃskārair daśabhiḥ parameśvaraṃ //
meaning:
अर्घ्यं शिरसि देवस्य दूर्वापुष्पाक्षतानि च /
एवं संस्कृत्य संस्कारैर् दशभिः परमेश्वरं //
text_mt: water offering at the head of the god, along with dūrvā grass, flowers, and unbroken grains. / Having thus consecrated the Supreme Lord with the ten consecrations,

sanskrit_iast:
yajet pañcopacāreṇa vidhinā kusumādibhiḥ /
abhyukṣyoddhartya nirmbhañjya rājikālavaṇādibhiḥ //
meaning:
यजेत् पञ्चोपचारेण विधिना कुसुमादिभिः /
अभ्युक्ष्योद्धर्त्य निर्म्भञ्ज्य राजिकालवणादिभिः //
text_mt: one should worship him with the fivefold offerings of flowers and so forth according to rule. / Having sprinkled, rubbed, and warded off [evil] with mustard seeds, salt, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
arghyodavindupuṣpādyair gaḍḍūkaiḥ(4) snāpayecchanaiḥ /
payodadhighṛtakṣaudraśarkarādyair anukramāt //
meaning:
अर्घ्योदविन्दुपुष्पाद्यैर् गड्डूकैः(4) स्नापयेच्छनैः /
पयोदधिघृतक्षौद्रशर्कराद्यैर् अनुक्रमात् //
text_mt: one should slowly bathe him with water offerings, drops of water, flowers, and so forth, from water-pots, / and successively with milk, curds, clarified butter, honey, and sugar,

sanskrit_iast:
īśādimantritardravyair arcya teṣāṃ(5) viparyayaḥ /
:n
1 choṭyātha iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 abhuktejyā iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 śivamaiśvaryamaṣṭadhā iti ga, gha,
cihnitapustakadvayapāṭhaḥ
4 gandhakair iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 ity ādimantritair bhakṣyaiś caiṣāmiti kha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 217
toyadhūpāntaraiḥ sarvair mūlena snapayecchivaṃ //
meaning:
ईशादिमन्त्रितर्द्रव्यैर् अर्च्य तेषां(5) विपर्ययः /
:न्
1 छोट्याथ इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अभुक्तेज्या इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 शिवमैश्वर्यमष्टधा इति ग, घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकद्वयपाठः
4 गन्धकैर् इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 इत्य् आदिमन्त्रितैर् भक्ष्यैश् चैषामिति ख,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 217
तोयधूपान्तरैः सर्वैर् मूलेन स्नपयेच्छिवं //
text_mt:
consecrated with the mantras beginning with Īśāna and worshiped with the substances, or in reverse order.
[Gap in text]
1. "choṭyātha" is the variant reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2. "abhuktejyā" is the variant reading in the manuscript marked ga.
3. "śivamaiśvaryamaṣṭadhā" is the variant reading in the two manuscripts marked ga and gha.
4. "gandhakaiḥ" is the variant reading in the manuscript marked kha.
5. "ity ādimantritair bhakṣyaiś caiṣām" is the variant reading in the manuscript marked kha. / Page 217
One should bathe Śiva with the root mantra, interspersing all [substances] with water and incense.

sanskrit_iast:
virūkṣya yavacūrṇena yatheṣṭaṃ śītalair jalaiḥ /
svaśaktyā gandhatoyena saṃsnāpya śucivāsasā //
meaning:
विरूक्ष्य यवचूर्णेन यथेष्टं शीतलैर् जलैः /
स्वशक्त्या गन्धतोयेन संस्नाप्य शुचिवाससा //
text_mt: Having rubbed [him] with barley powder and, at will, with cool waters, / and having bathed him according to one's capacity with scented water, [one should dry him] with a clean cloth.

sanskrit_iast:
nirmārjyārghyaṃ pradadyācca nopari bhrāmayet karaṃ /
na śūnyamastakaṃ liṅgaṃ puṣpaiḥ kuryāttato dadet //
meaning:
निर्मार्ज्यार्घ्यं प्रदद्याच्च नोपरि भ्रामयेत् करं /
न शून्यमस्तकं लिङ्गं पुष्पैः कुर्यात्ततो ददेत् //
text_mt: Having wiped [him], one should offer a water offering; one must not circle the hand over the top; / one should not leave the head of the liṅga bare of flowers; then one should present them.

sanskrit_iast:
candanādyaiḥ samālabhya puṣpaiḥ prārcya śivāṇunā(1) /
dhūpabhājanamastreṇa prokṣyābhyarcya śivāṇunā(2) //
meaning:
चन्दनाद्यैः समालभ्य पुष्पैः प्रार्च्य शिवाणुना(1) /
धूपभाजनमस्त्रेण प्रोक्ष्याभ्यर्च्य शिवाणुना(2) //
text_mt: Having anointed [him] with sandalwood paste and so forth, and having worshiped him with flowers using the Śiva-mantra, / having sprinkled the incense burner with the weapon [mantra] and worshiped it with the Śiva-mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
astreṇa pūjitāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ cādāya guggulaṃ dadet /
dadyādācamanaṃ paścāt svadhāntaṃ hṛdayāṇunā(3) //
meaning:
अस्त्रेण पूजितां घण्टां चादाय गुग्गुलं ददेत् /
दद्यादाचमनं पश्चात् स्वधान्तं हृदयाणुना(3) //
text_mt: and having taken up the bell worshiped with the weapon [mantra], one should offer bdellium resin. / Afterward, one should offer sipping-water ending with "svadhā" using the heart mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
ārātrikaṃ samuttārya tathaivācāmayet punaḥ /
praṇamyādāya devājñāṃ bhogāṅgāni prapūjayet //
meaning:
आरात्रिकं समुत्तार्य तथैवाचामयेत् पुनः /
प्रणम्यादाय देवाज्ञां भोगाङ्गानि प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: Having waved the waving-lamp (ārātrika) and likewise offered sipping-water again, / having bowed and received the command of the god, one should worship the enjoyable limbs:

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdagnau candrabhaṃ caiśe śivaṃ cāmīkaraprabhaṃ /
śikhāṃ raktāñca nairṛtye kṛṣṇaṃ varma ca vāyave //
meaning:
हृदग्नौ चन्द्रभं चैशे शिवं चामीकरप्रभं /
शिखां रक्ताञ्च नैरृत्ये कृष्णं वर्म च वायवे //
text_mt: in the southeast, the heart resembling the moon; in the northeast, Śiva shining like gold; / in the southwest, the red tuft; and in the northwest, the black armor.

sanskrit_iast:
caturvaktraṃ caturbāhuṃ(4) dalasthān(5) pūjayedimān /
daṃṣṭrākarālamapyastraṃ pūrvādau vajrasannibhaṃ //
meaning:
चतुर्वक्त्रं चतुर्बाहुं(4) दलस्थान्(5) पूजयेदिमान् /
दंष्ट्राकरालमप्यस्त्रं पूर्वादौ वज्रसन्निभं //
text_mt: One should worship these situated on the petals, having four faces and four arms; / and the weapon, fierce with fangs, resembling the thunderbolt, in the east and other [directions]:

sanskrit_iast:
mūle hauṃ śivāya namaḥ oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hīṃ hoṃ śiraś ca /
hṛṃ śikhāyai haiṃ varma haścāstraṃ parivārayutāya ca //
meaning:
मूले हौं शिवाय नमः ओं हां हूं हीं हों शिरश् च /
हृं शिखायै हैं वर्म हश्चास्त्रं परिवारयुताय च //
text_mt: "At the root: hauṃ śivāya namaḥ; oṃ hāṃ hūṃ hīṃ hoṃ, and the head; / hṛṃ to the tuft; haiṃ to the armor; and haḥ to the weapon, and to him accompanied by his retinue."

sanskrit_iast:
śivāya dadyāt pādyañca ācāmañcārghyameva ca /
gandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpadīpaṃ naivedyācamanīyakaṃ //
meaning:
शिवाय दद्यात् पाद्यञ्च आचामञ्चार्घ्यमेव च /
गन्धं पुष्पं धूपदीपं नैवेद्याचमनीयकं //
text_mt: To Śiva one should offer water for the feet, sipping-water, and the water offering, / perfume, flowers, incense, a lamp, food offering, and sipping-water,

karodvartanatāmbūlaṃ mukhavāsañca darpaṇaṃ /

unguent for the hands, betel, mouth-perfume, and a mirror.

Having placed upon the head of the god a pavitraka along with dūrvā grass and unbroken grains,

sanskrit_iast:
mūlamaṣṭaśataṃ japtvā hṛdayenābhimantritaṃ /
carmaṇāveṣṭitaṃ khaḍgaṃ rakṣitaṃ kuśapuṣpakaiḥ //
meaning:
मूलमष्टशतं जप्त्वा हृदयेनाभिमन्त्रितं /
चर्मणावेष्टितं खड्गं रक्षितं कुशपुष्पकैः //
text_mt: having recited the root mantra one hundred and eight times, consecrated it with the heart [mantra], / [and having visualized] a sword enveloped in skin, protected with kuśa grass and flowers,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣatair mudrāyā yuktaṃ śivamudbhavasañjñayā /
guhyātiguhyaguptyarthaṃ(1) gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japaṃ //
meaning:
अक्षतैर् मुद्राया युक्तं शिवमुद्भवसञ्ज्ञया /
गुह्यातिगुह्यगुप्त्यर्थं(1) गृहाणास्मत्कृतं जपं //
text_mt: accompanied by unbroken grains and the mudrā known as Udbhava: / "For the sake of guarding the secret of secrets, accept the recitation performed by us,

sanskrit_iast:
siddhirbhavatu me yena(2) tvatprasādāttvayi sthite /
bhogī ślokaṃ paṭhitvādyaṃ(3) dakṣahastena śambhave //
meaning:
सिद्धिर्भवतु मे येन(2) त्वत्प्रसादात्त्वयि स्थिते /

text_mt: by which may accomplishment be mine, by your grace, while abiding in you." / The enjoyer, having recited this first verse, [presents it] to Śambhu with the right hand;

sanskrit_iast:
mūlāṇunārghyatoyena varahaste(4) nivedayet /
yatkiñcit kurmahe deva sadā sukṛtaduskṛtaṃ //

मूलाणुनार्घ्यतोयेन वरहस्ते(4) निवेदयेत् /
यत्किञ्चित् कुर्महे देव सदा सुकृतदुस्कृतं //
text_mt: with the root mantra, he should offer it into [his] boon-granting hand with arghya water: / "Whatever good deed or bad deed we do always, O Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
tanme śivapadasthasya hūṃ kṣaḥ kṣepaya śaṅkara /
śivo dātā śivo bhoktā śivaḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat //
meaning:
तन्मे शिवपदस्थस्य हूं क्षः क्षेपय शङ्कर /
शिवो दाता शिवो भोक्ता शिवः सर्वमिदं जगत् //
text_mt: dispel that for me, who abide in the state of Śiva, hūṃ kṣaḥ, O Śaṅkara! / Śiva is the giver, Śiva is the enjoyer, Śiva is this entire world;

sanskrit_iast:
śivo jayati sarvatra yaḥ śivaḥ sohameva ca /
ślokadvayamadhītyaivaṃ japaṃ devāya cārpayet //
meaning:
शिवो जयति सर्वत्र यः शिवः सोहमेव च /
श्लोकद्वयमधीत्यैवं जपं देवाय चार्पयेत् //
text_mt: Śiva is victorious everywhere; that which is Śiva, that indeed am I." / Having thus recited these two verses, one should surrender the recitation to the god.

sanskrit_iast:
śivāṅgānāṃ(5) daśāṃśañca datvārghyaṃ stutimācaret /

text_mt:
Having offered an arghya worth a tenth part to the limbs of Śiva, one should perform praise. / Having circumambulated, one should bow with the eight limbs to the eightfold form; / and having bowed, one should worship [him] through meditation and other rites in paintings, fire, and so forth.
Thus ends the seventy-fourth chapter, named "The Worship of Śiva", in the venerable Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.

Now, the seventy-fifth chapter:
The ritual for the installation of the fire and other rites.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
arghapātrakaro yāyādagnyāgāraṃ susaṃvṛtaḥ /
yāgopakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ divyadṛṣṭyā ca kalpayet(1) //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
अर्घपात्रकरो यायादग्न्यागारं सुसंवृतः /
यागोपकरणं सर्वं दिव्यदृष्ट्या च कल्पयेत्(1) //
text_mt: The Lord said: / Holding the arghya vessel in hand, well covered, one should go to the fire hall; / and one should inspect all the sacrificial implements with a divine gaze.

sanskrit_iast:
udaṅmukhaḥ kuṇḍamīkṣet praokṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃkuśaiḥ /
vidadhyādastramantreṇa varmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ mataṃ //
meaning:
उदङ्मुखः कुण्डमीक्षेत् प्रओक्षणं ताडनंकुशैः /
विदध्यादस्त्रमन्त्रेण वर्मणाभ्युक्षणं मतं //
text_mt: Facing north, he should view the fire-pit. Sprinkling (prokṣaṇa) and striking with kuśa grass / should be performed with the weapon mantra; moistening (abhyukṣaṇa) is prescribed with the armor mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgena khātamuddhāraṃ pūraṇaṃ samatāmapi /
kurvīta varmaṇā sekaṃ kuṭṭanantu śarātmanā(2) //
meaning:
खड्गेन खातमुद्धारं पूरणं समतामपि /
कुर्वीत वर्मणा सेकं कुट्टनन्तु शरात्मना(2) //
text_mt: Excavation, removal, filling, and leveling [of the earth] should be done with the sword [mantra]; / watering should be done with the armor [mantra], and pounding with the arrow mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
sammārjanaṃ samālepaṃ kalārūpaprakalpanaṃ /
trisūtrīparidhānaṃ ca varmaṇābhyarcanaṃ sadā //
meaning:
सम्मार्जनं समालेपं कलारूपप्रकल्पनं /
त्रिसूत्रीपरिधानं च वर्मणाभ्यर्चनं सदा //
text_mt: Sweeping, smearing, conceiving the forms of the kalās, / encircling with three cords, and perpetual worship should be done with the armor mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
rekhātrayamudak kuryādekāṃ pūrvānanāmadhaḥ /
kuśena ca śivāstreṇa yadvā tāsāṃ viparyayaḥ //
meaning:
रेखात्रयमुदक् कुर्यादेकां पूर्वाननामधः /
कुशेन च शिवास्त्रेण यद्वा तासां विपर्ययः //
text_mt: One should draw three lines toward the north and one below facing east, / using a blade of kuśa grass and the Śiva-weapon mantra; or their reverse order [may be used].

sanskrit_iast:
vajrīkaraṇamantreṇa hṛdā darbhaiś catuṣpathaṃ /
akṣapātrantatanutreṇa vinyasedviṣṭaraṃ hṛdā //

वज्रीकरणमन्त्रेण हृदा दर्भैश् चतुष्पथं /
अक्षपात्रन्ततनुत्रेण विन्यसेद्विष्टरं हृदा //
text_mt: With the adamantine-making (vajrīkaraṇa) mantra, the heart mantra, and darbha grass, [one constructs] the crossroad. / One should deposit the rosary vessel with the armor mantra and the seat with the heart mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdā vāgīśvarīṃ tatra īśāmāvāhya pūjayet /
vahniṃ sadāśrayānītaṃ śuddhapātroparisthitaṃ //

हृदा वागीश्वरीं तत्र ईशामावाह्य पूजयेत् /
वह्निं सदाश्रयानीतं शुद्धपात्रोपरिस्थितं //
text_mt: Invoking Vāgīśvarī and the Lord there with the heart mantra, one should worship them. / The fire brought from a good source, placed upon a clean vessel,

sanskrit_iast:
kravyādāṃśaṃ parityajya vīkṣaṇādiviśodhitaṃ /
audaryaṃ caindavaṃ bhautaṃ ekīkṛtyānalatrayaṃ //

क्रव्यादांशं परित्यज्य वीक्षणादिविशोधितं /
औदर्यं चैन्दवं भौतं एकीकृत्यानलत्रयं //
text_mt: freed from the portion of the corpse-eating [fire], purified through viewing and other rites, / and uniting the three fires—the stomach fire, lunar fire, and elemental fire—

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hūṃ vahnicaitanyāya vahnivījena vinyaset /
saṃhitāmantritaṃ vahniṃ dhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtaṃ //

rakṣitaṃ hetimantreṇa kavacenāvaguṇṭhitaṃ /
pūjitantriḥ paribhrāmya kuṇḍasyordhvaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ //

tato 'ntasthitavījasya(1) nābhideśe samūhanaṃ //
meaning:
भूमिष्ठजानुक्को मन्त्री हृदात्मसम्मुखं क्षिपेत् /
ततो ऽन्तस्थितवीजस्य(1) नाभिदेशे समूहनं //
text_mt: With knees on the ground, the practitioner should cast [it] toward himself with the heart mantra. / Then [follows] the gathering together of the seed residing within, at the region of the navel,

sanskrit_iast:
sambhṛtiṃ paridhānasya śaucamācamanaṃ hṛdā /
garbhāgneḥ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā tadrakṣārthaṃ śarāṇunā(2) //
meaning:
सम्भृतिं परिधानस्य शौचमाचमनं हृदा /
गर्भाग्नेः पूजनं कृत्वा तद्रक्षार्थं शराणुना(2) //
text_mt: the procurement of clothing, and ritual purification and sipping of water with the heart mantra. / Having performed the worship of the fire in the womb, for its protection, with the arrow-mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
badhnīyādgarbhajaṃ devyāḥ kakaṅkaṇaṃ pāṇipallave /
garbhādhānāya sampūjya sadyojātena pāvakaṃ //
meaning:
बध्नीयाद्गर्भजं देव्याः ककङ्कणं पाणिपल्लवे /
गर्भाधानाय सम्पूज्य सद्योजातेन पावकं //
text_mt: one should tie the bracelet belonging to the womb on the goddess's lotus hand. / Having worshipped the fire for the impregnation rite with [the mantra of] Sadyojāta,

sanskrit_iast:
tato hṛdayamantreṇa juhuyādāhutitrayaṃ /
puṃsavanāya vāmena tṛtīye yāsi pūjayet //
meaning:
ततो हृदयमन्त्रेण जुहुयादाहुतित्रयं /
पुंसवनाय वामेन तृतीये यासि पूजयेत् //
text_mt: one should then offer three oblations with the heart mantra. / For the rite to produce a male child, one should worship [the fire] with Vāmadeva in the third month,

sanskrit_iast:
āhutitritayaṃ dadyācchirasāmbukaṇānvitaṃ /
sīmantonnayanaṃ ṣaṣṭhe māsi sampūjya rūpiṇā //
meaning:
आहुतित्रितयं दद्याच्छिरसाम्बुकणान्वितं /
सीमन्तोन्नयनं षष्ठे मासि सम्पूज्य रूपिणा //
text_mt: and offer three oblations with the head mantra, accompanied by drops of water. / Having worshipped [the fire] with the form-mantra in the sixth month for the rite of parting the hair,

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyādāhutīstisraḥ śikhayā śikhayaiva tu /
vaktrāṅgakalpanāṃ kuryādvaktrodghāṭananiṣkṛtī //
meaning:
जुहुयादाहुतीस्तिस्रः शिखया शिखयैव तु /
वक्त्राङ्गकल्पनां कुर्याद्वक्त्रोद्घाटननिष्कृती //
text_mt: one should offer three oblations with the tuft-mantra, indeed with the tuft-mantra alone. / One should perform the fashioning of the faces and limbs, and the expiation for the opening of the mouths.

sanskrit_iast:
jātakarmanṛkarmabhyāṃ daśame māsi pūrvavat /
vahniṃ sandhukṣya darbhādyaiḥ(3) snānaṃ garbhamalāpahaṃ //
meaning:
जातकर्मनृकर्मभ्यां दशमे मासि पूर्ववत् /
वह्निं सन्धुक्ष्य दर्भाद्यैः(3) स्नानं गर्भमलापहं //
text_mt: In the tenth month, with the rites of birth and rites for man, as before, / having rekindled the fire with darbha-grass and the like, [he provides] a bath removing the impurities of the womb.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇabandhanaṃ devyā kṛtaṃ dhyātvā hṛdārcayet /
sadyaḥsūtakanāśāya prokṣayedastravāriṇā //
meaning:
सुवर्णबन्धनं देव्या कृतं ध्यात्वा हृदार्चयेत् /
सद्यःसूतकनाशाय प्रोक्षयेदस्त्रवारिणा //
text_mt: Having visualized the tying of gold performed by the goddess, one should worship with the heart mantra. / For the destruction of the immediate impurity of childbirth, one should sprinkle it with water sanctified by the weapon mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhantu(4) vahirastreṇa tāḍayedvarmaṇokṣayet /
astreṇottarapūrvāgrānmekhalāsu vahiḥ kuśān //

One should strike the pot on the outside with the weapon mantra, and sprinkle it with the armour mantra. / With the weapon mantra, [placing] kuśa grasses with their tips to the northeast outside upon the girdles,

sanskrit_iast:
āsthāpya(1) sthāpayetteṣu hṛdā paridhivistaraṃ /
vaktāṇāmastramantreṇa tato nālāpannuttaye //
meaning:
आस्थाप्य(1) स्थापयेत्तेषु हृदा परिधिविस्तरं /
वक्ताणामस्त्रमन्त्रेण ततो नालापन्नुत्तये //
text_mt: having arranged [them], one should set upon them with the heart mantra an array of enclosing sticks. / Then, with the weapon mantra of the faces, for the removal of the umbilical cord,

sanskrit_iast:
samidhiḥ pañca hotavyāḥ prānte mūle ghṛtaplutāḥ /
brahmāṇaṃ śaṅkaraṃ viṣṇumanantañca hṛdārcayet //
meaning:
समिधिः पञ्च होतव्याः प्रान्ते मूले घृतप्लुताः /
ब्रह्माणं शङ्करं विष्णुमनन्तञ्च हृदार्चयेत् //
text_mt: five fire-sticks soaked in clarified butter at the tip and root are to be offered into the fire. / One should worship Brahmā, Śaṅkara, Viṣṇu, and Ananta with the heart mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
dūrvākṣataiś ca paryantaṃ paridhisthānanukramāt /
indrādīśānaparyantāntānviṣṭarasthānanukramāt //
meaning:
दूर्वाक्षतैश् च पर्यन्तं परिधिस्थाननुक्रमात् /
इन्द्रादीशानपर्यन्तान्तान्विष्टरस्थाननुक्रमात् //
text_mt: with dūrvā grass and unbroken grain all around, in sequence, situated on the enclosing sticks, / and those situated on seats in sequence, from Indra up to Īśāna,

sanskrit_iast:
agnerabhimukhībhūtān nijadikṣu hṛdārcayet /
nivārya vighnasaṅghātaṃ vālakaṃ pālayiṣyatha //
meaning:
अग्नेरभिमुखीभूतान् निजदिक्षु हृदार्चयेत् /
निवार्य विघ्नसङ्घातं वालकं पालयिष्यथ //
text_mt: facing toward the fire in their respective directions, one should worship with the heart mantra: / 'Having warded off the host of obstacles, may you protect the child!'

sanskrit_iast:
śaivīmājñābhimānteṣāṃ śrāvayettadanantaraṃ /
gṛhītvā sruksruvāvūrdhvavadanādhomukhaiḥ kramāt //
meaning:
शैवीमाज्ञाभिमान्तेषां श्रावयेत्तदनन्तरं /
गृहीत्वा स्रुक्स्रुवावूर्ध्ववदनाधोमुखैः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Thereupon, one should recite this Śaiva command to them. / Taking up the large and small ladles, respectively with face upwards and face downwards,

sanskrit_iast:
pratāpyāgnau tridhā darbhamūlamadhyāgrakaiḥ spṛśet /
kuśaspṛṣṭapradeśe tu ātmavidyāśivātmakaṃ //
meaning:
प्रताप्याग्नौ त्रिधा दर्भमूलमध्याग्रकैः स्पृशेत् /
कुशस्पृष्टप्रदेशे तु आत्मविद्याशिवात्मकं //
text_mt: and heating them in the fire three times, one should touch them with the base, middle, and tip of a darbha grass. / Then, upon the area touched by the kuśa, [one visualizes] the three principles consisting of soul, knowledge, and Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
kramāttattvatrayaṃ nyasya hāṃ hīṃ hūṃ saṃ(2) ravaiḥ kramāt /
sruvi śaktiṃ sruve śambhuṃ vinyasya hṛdayāṇunā //
meaning:
क्रमात्तत्त्वत्रयं न्यस्य हां हीं हूं सं(2) रवैः क्रमात् /
स्रुवि शक्तिं स्रुवे शम्भुं विन्यस्य हृदयाणुना //
text_mt: and having deposited the three principles in order with the sounds hāṃ, hīṃ, hūṃ, and saṃ in succession, / having deposited Śakti in the small ladle and Śambhu in the large ladle with the heart mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
trisūtrīveṣṭitagrīvo pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ /
kuśānāmupariṣṭāttau sthāpayitvā svadakṣiṇe //
meaning:
त्रिसूत्रीवेष्टितग्रीवो पूजितौ कुसुमादिभिः /
कुशानामुपरिष्टात्तौ स्थापयित्वा स्वदक्षिणे //
text_mt: their necks wound with triple cord, worshipped with flowers and the like, / having placed them upon the kuśa grasses to one's right,

sanskrit_iast:
gavyamājyaṃ samādāya vīkṣaṇādiviśodhitaṃ /
svakāṃ brahmamayīṃ mūrtiṃ sañcintyādāya tadghṛtaṃ //
meaning:
गव्यमाज्यं समादाय वीक्षणादिविशोधितं /
स्वकां ब्रह्ममयीं मूर्तिं सञ्चिन्त्यादाय तद्घृतं //
text_mt: taking cow's clarified butter purified by glancing and the like, / and meditating upon one's own form as composed of Brahmā, taking that clarified butter,

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍasyordhvaṃ hṛdāvartya bhrāmayitvāgnigocare /
punarviṣṇumayīṃ dhyātvā ghṛtamīśānagocare //
meaning:
कुण्डस्योर्ध्वं हृदावर्त्य भ्रामयित्वाग्निगोचरे /
पुनर्विष्णुमयीं ध्यात्वा घृतमीशानगोचरे //
text_mt: circling it above the fire-pit with the heart mantra and rotating it in the sphere of fire, / and again meditating [upon oneself] as composed of Viṣṇu, holding the clarified butter in the sphere of Īśāna,

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtvādāya kuśāgreṇa svāhāntaṃ śirasāṇunā(2) /
:n
1 āstīryeti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustadvayapāṭhaḥ
2 hāṃ hrīṃ hraṃ samiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / hūṃ hāṃ
krūṃ samiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 śirasātmanā iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

juhuyādviṣṇave vinduṃ rudrarūpamanantaraṃ //

धृत्वादाय कुशाग्रेण स्वाहान्तं शिरसाणुना(2) /
:न्
1 आस्तीर्येति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तद्वयपाठः
2 हां ह्रीं ह्रं समिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / हूं हां
क्रूं समिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 शिरसात्मना इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः

जुहुयाद्विष्णवे विन्दुं रुद्ररूपमनन्तरं //

and taking [it] with the tip of a kuśa grass, with the head mantra ending in svāhā,

bhāvayannijamātmānaṃ nābhau dhṛtvāplavettataḥ /
prādeśamātradarbhābhyāmaṅguṣṭānāmikāgrakaiḥ //
meaning:
भावयन्निजमात्मानं नाभौ धृत्वाप्लवेत्ततः /
प्रादेशमात्रदर्भाभ्यामङ्गुष्टानामिकाग्रकैः //
text_mt: meditating upon one's own self, holding [it] at the navel, one should then sprinkle [it]. / With two darbha blades of a span's measure held by the tips of the thumb and ring finger,

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtābhyāṃ sammukhaṃ vahnerastreṇāplavamācaret /
hṛdātmasammukhaṃ tadvat kuryāt samplavanantataḥ //
meaning:
धृताभ्यां सम्मुखं वह्नेरस्त्रेणाप्लवमाचरेत् /
हृदात्मसम्मुखं तद्वत् कुर्यात् सम्प्लवनन्ततः //
text_mt: facing the fire, one should perform the sprinkling with the weapon mantra. / In like manner, with the heart mantra facing oneself, one should then perform the sprinkling.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdālabdhadagdhadarbhaṃ śastrakṣepāt pavitayet /
dīptenāparadarbheṇa nivāhyānena dīpayet //
meaning:
हृदालब्धदग्धदर्भं शस्त्रक्षेपात् पवितयेत् /
दीप्तेनापरदर्भेण निवाह्यानेन दीपयेत् //
text_mt: One should purify the darbha touched by the heart [mantra] and scorched, by throwing the weapon [mantra] at it. / Carried with another burning darbha, one should ignite it with this.

sanskrit_iast:
astramantreṇa nirdagdhaṃ vahnau darbhaṃ punaḥ kṣipet /
kṣiptvā ghṛte kṛtagranthikuśaṃ prādeśasammitaṃ //

अस्त्रमन्त्रेण निर्दग्धं वह्नौ दर्भं पुनः क्षिपेत् /
क्षिप्त्वा घृते कृतग्रन्थिकुशं प्रादेशसम्मितं //
text_mt: Burnt by the weapon mantra, one should throw the darbha back into the fire. / Having thrown into the clarified butter a knotted kuśa measuring a span,

sanskrit_iast:
pakṣadvayamiḍādīnāṃ trayaṃ cājye vibhāvayet /
krāmādbhāgatrayādājyaṃ sruveṇādāya homayet //
meaning:
पक्षद्वयमिडादीनां त्रयं चाज्ये विभावयेत् /
क्रामाद्भागत्रयादाज्यं स्रुवेणादाय होमयेत् //
text_mt: one should visualize the two wings and the triad of Iḍā and the others in the clarified butter. / Taking clarified butter in sequence from the three portions with the ladle, one should offer it into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
svetyagnau hā ghṛte(1) bhāgaṃ śeṣamājyaṃ kṣipet kramāt /

agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā
udghāṭanāya netrāṇāṃ agnernetratraye mukhe //

स्वेत्यग्नौ हा घृते(1) भागं शेषमाज्यं क्षिपेत् क्रमात् /
ओं हां अग्नये स्वाहा / ओं हां सोमाय स्वाहा / ओं हां
अग्नीषोमाभ्यां स्वाहा
उद्घाटनाय नेत्राणां अग्नेर्नेत्रत्रये मुखे //
text_mt:
Saying 'svāhā' into the fire, [saying] 'hāṃ' into the clarified butter, one should pour the remaining clarified butter portion in sequence:
'oṃ hāṃ agnaye svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Agni, svāhā); 'oṃ hāṃ somāya svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Soma, svāhā); 'oṃ hāṃ agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Agni and Soma, svāhā).
For the opening of the eyes, [one offers] into the three eyes in the face of the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
sruveṇa ghṛtapūrṇena caturthīmāhutiṃ yajet /
oṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā
abhimantrya ṣaḍaṅgena bodhayeddhenumudrayā //

स्रुवेण घृतपूर्णेन चतुर्थीमाहुतिं यजेत् /
ओं हां अग्नये स्विष्टकृते स्वाहा
अभिमन्त्र्य षडङ्गेन बोधयेद्धेनुमुद्रया //
text_mt: With the ladle filled with clarified butter, one should sacrifice the fourth oblation: / 'oṃ hāṃ agnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā' (Oṃ hāṃ, to Agni maker of right sacrifice, svāhā). / Having consecrated it with the six limbs, one should awaken it with the cow mudrā,

/
avaguṇṭhya tanutreṇa rakṣedājyaṃ śarāṇunā(2) /
/
hṛdājyavinduvikṣepāt kuryādabhyukṣya śodhanaṃ //
