text_mt: and disciples desiring worldly enjoyment facing east, he should seat them there. / In the first, he should make [them] drink three mouthfuls of the five products of the cow (pañcagavya)

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇinā kuśayuktena arcitānantarāntaraṃ /
caruntatastṛtīye tu grāsatritayasammitaṃ //
meaning:
पाणिना कुशयुक्तेन अर्चितानन्तरान्तरं /
चरुन्ततस्तृतीये तु ग्रासत्रितयसम्मितं //
text_mt: with a hand joined with kuśa grass, immediately after the worship. / Then in the third, caru measuring three mouthfuls,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭagrāsapramāṇaṃ vā daśanasparśavarjitaṃ /
pālāśapuṭake muktau bhuktau pippalapatrake //
:n
1 kumbhamājyeneti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 nidadhyān pūrvavaddhṛdā iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 260
meaning:
अष्टग्रासप्रमाणं वा दशनस्पर्शवर्जितं /
पालाशपुटके मुक्तौ भुक्तौ पिप्पलपत्रके //
:न्
1 कुम्भमाज्येनेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 निदध्यान् पूर्ववद्धृदा इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 260
text_mt:
or the measure of eight mouthfuls, without touching the teeth, / in a palāśa-leaf cup for liberation, or in a pippala-leaf cup for worldly enjoyment.
[Footnote]
1. "kumbhamājyena" is the reading in the manuscript marked ga.
2. "nidadhyān pūrvavaddhṛdā" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 260]

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdā sambhojanaṃ datvā pūtair ācāmayejjalaiḥ /
dantakāṣṭhaṃ hṛdā kṛtvā prakṣipecchobhane śubhaṃ //
meaning:
हृदा सम्भोजनं दत्वा पूतैर् आचामयेज्जलैः /
दन्तकाष्ठं हृदा कृत्वा प्रक्षिपेच्छोभने शुभं //
text_mt: Offering the feeding with the heart [mantra], he should make [them] rinse the mouth with pure water. / Having consecrated the tooth-stick with the heart [mantra], he should cast it into an auspicious, beautiful place.

sanskrit_iast:
nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya mūlenāṣṭottaraṃ śataṃ /
vidhāya sthiṇḍileśāya sarvakarmasamarpaṇaṃ //
meaning:
न्यूनादिदोषमोषाय मूलेनाष्टोत्तरं शतं /
विधाय स्थिण्डिलेशाय सर्वकर्मसमर्पणं //
text_mt: To eradicate deficiencies and other faults, having performed one hundred and eight [oblations] with the root mantra, / and dedicating all actions to the Lord of the altar-mound,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāvisarjanañcāsya caṇḍeśasya ca pūjanaṃ /
nirmālyamapanīyātha śeṣamagnau yajeccaroḥ //
meaning:
पूजाविसर्जनञ्चास्य चण्डेशस्य च पूजनं /
निर्माल्यमपनीयाथ शेषमग्नौ यजेच्चरोः //
text_mt: and dismissing the worship of this [Lord] and the worship of Caṇḍeśa, / removing the floral offerings (nirmālya), he should then offer the remainder of the caru into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
kalaśaṃ lokapalāṃś ca pūjayitvā visṛjya ca /
visṛjedgaṇamagniñca rakṣitaṃ yadi vāhyataḥ //
meaning:
कलशं लोकपलांश् च पूजयित्वा विसृज्य च /
विसृजेद्गणमग्निञ्च रक्षितं यदि वाह्यतः //
text_mt: Having worshipped the water-jar and the guardians of the directions, and having dismissed [them], / he should dismiss the gaṇas and the fire, if preserved outside.

sanskrit_iast:
vāhyato lokapālānāṃ datvā saṅkṣepato baliṃ /
bhasmanā śuddhatoyair vā snātvā yā gālayaṃ viśet(1) //
meaning:
वाह्यतो लोकपालानां दत्वा सङ्क्षेपतो बलिं /
भस्मना शुद्धतोयैर् वा स्नात्वा या गालयं विशेत्(1) //
text_mt: Having offered a brief food-offering (bali) to the guardians of the directions outside, / bathing with ash or with pure waters, he should enter the sacrificial hall.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhasthān darbhaśayyāyāṃ pūrvaśīrṣān surakṣitān /
hṛdā sadbhasmaśayyāyāṃ yatīn dakṣiṇamastakān //
meaning:
गृहस्थान् दर्भशय्यायां पूर्वशीर्षान् सुरक्षितान् /
हृदा सद्भस्मशय्यायां यतीन् दक्षिणमस्तकान् //
text_mt: Householders on a bed of darbha grass, with heads to the east, well-protected, / [and] ascetics on a bed of good ash with the heart [mantra], with heads to the south,

sanskrit_iast:
śikhābaddhasikhānastrasaptamāṇavakānvitān /
vijñāya snāpayecchiṣyāṃstato yāyāt punarvahiḥ //
oṃ hili hili triśūlapāṇaye svāhā
meaning:
शिखाबद्धसिखानस्त्रसप्तमाणवकान्वितान् /
विज्ञाय स्नापयेच्छिष्यांस्ततो यायात् पुनर्वहिः //
ओं हिलि हिलि त्रिशूलपाणये स्वाहा
text_mt:
having their topknots bound with the śikhā-mantra, accompanied by the seven disciples [protected by] the astra-mantra— / knowing this, he should bathe the disciples, and then go outside again.
“oṃ hili hili triśūlapāṇaye svāhā”

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyañcaruṃ prāśya gṛhītvā dantadhāvanaṃ /
samācamya śivaṃ dhyātvā śayyāmāsthāya pāvanīṃ(2) //
meaning:
पञ्चगव्यञ्चरुं प्राश्य गृहीत्वा दन्तधावनं /
समाचम्य शिवं ध्यात्वा शय्यामास्थाय पावनीं(2) //
text_mt: Having consumed the five products of the cow and the caru, having taken the tooth-stick, / sipping water, meditating upon Śiva, and lying down upon the purifying bed,

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāgataṅkriyākāṇḍaṃ saṃsmaran saṃviśedguruḥ /
iti saṅkṣepataḥ prokto vidhirdīkṣādhivāsane //
:e ity ādimāhāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāmadhivāsanaṃ
nāma tryaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 yāgālayaṃ vrajediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vidyāmāsthāya pāvanīmiti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 261
:ś caturaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
nirvāṇadīkṣāvidhānaṃ
meaning:
दीक्षागतङ्क्रियाकाण्डं संस्मरन् संविशेद्गुरुः /
इति सङ्क्षेपतः प्रोक्तो विधिर्दीक्षाधिवासने //
:ए इत्य् आदिमाहापुराणे आग्नेये निर्वाणदीक्षायामधिवासनं
नाम त्र्यशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 यागालयं व्रजेदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 विद्यामास्थाय पावनीमिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 261
:श् चतुरशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
निर्वाणदीक्षाविधानं
text_mt:
the guru should go to sleep, recollecting the ritual procedures belonging to the initiation. / Thus the rule for preliminary consecration in initiation has been briefly spoken.
Thus ends the eighty-third chapter, named "Preliminary Consecration in Liberating Initiation," in the great and ancient Agni Purāṇa.
[Footnote]
1. "yāgālayaṃ vrajet" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2. "vidyāmāsthāya pāvanīm" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [Page 261]
Eighty-fourth chapter
Procedure for Liberating Initiation

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
atha prātaḥ samutthāya kṛtasnanādiko guruḥ /
dadhyārdramāṃsamadyādeḥ praśastābhyavahāritā //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
अथ प्रातः समुत्थाय कृतस्ननादिको गुरुः /
दध्यार्द्रमांसमद्यादेः प्रशस्ताभ्यवहारिता //
text_mt: The Lord said: / Then, having arisen in the morning and performed bathing and the like, the guru— / the consumption of curds, moist meat, wine, and the like is auspicious;

sanskrit_iast:
gajāśvarohaṇaṃ svapne śubhaṃ śuklāṃśukādikaṃ(1) /
tailābhyaṅgādikaṃ hīnaṃ homo ghoreṇa śāntaye(2) //
meaning:
गजाश्वरोहणं स्वप्ने शुभं शुक्लांशुकादिकं(1) /
तैलाभ्यङ्गादिकं हीनं होमो घोरेण शान्तये(2) //
text_mt: mounting an elephant or a horse, white garments, and the like seen in a dream are auspicious; / anointing with oil and the like is bad, [for which] a fire oblation with the ghora mantra is performed for pacification.

sanskrit_iast:
nityakarmadvayaṃ kṛtvā praviśya makhamaṇḍapaṃ /
svācānto nityavat karma kuryānnaimittike vidhau //
meaning:
नित्यकर्मद्वयं कृत्वा प्रविश्य मखमण्डपं /
स्वाचान्तो नित्यवत् कर्म कुर्यान्नैमित्तिके विधौ //
text_mt: Having performed both daily rites and entered the sacrificial pavilion, / having sipped water, he should perform the rites as if daily in this occasional ritual.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ saṃśodhya cātmānaṃ śivahastaṃ tathātmani /
vinyasya kumbhagaṃ prārcya indrādīnāmanukramāt //
meaning:
ततः संशोध्य चात्मानं शिवहस्तं तथात्मनि /
विन्यस्य कुम्भगं प्रार्च्य इन्द्रादीनामनुक्रमात् //
text_mt: Then, having purified himself and placed the Hand of Śiva upon himself, / having worshipped [the deity] in the pot, and Indra and the other [guardians] in order,

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍale sthaṇḍile vāpi prakurvīta śivarcanaṃ /
tarpaṇaṃ pūjanaṃ vahneḥ pūrṇāntaṃ mantratarpaṇaṃ //
meaning:
मण्डले स्थण्डिले वापि प्रकुर्वीत शिवर्चनं /
तर्पणं पूजनं वह्नेः पूर्णान्तं मन्त्रतर्पणं //
text_mt: he should perform the worship of Śiva on a maṇḍala or on an altar-mound, / the propitiation and worship of the fire, and the propitiation with mantras up to the final oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhapradoṣamoṣāya śastreṇāṣṭādhikaṃ śataṃ /
hutvā hūṃ sampuṭenaiva vidadhyāt mantradīpanaṃ //
meaning:
दुःखप्रदोषमोषाय शस्त्रेणाष्टाधिकं शतं /
हुत्वा हूं सम्पुटेनैव विदध्यात् मन्त्रदीपनं //
text_mt: To destroy faults that bestow distress, having offered one hundred and eight [oblations] / with the weapon-mantra, enveloped with "hūṃ", he should perform the illumination of the mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
antarbalividhānañca madhye sthaṇḍilakumbhayoḥ /
kṛtvā śiṣyapraveśāya labdhānujño vahirvrajet //
meaning:
अन्तर्बलिविधानञ्च मध्ये स्थण्डिलकुम्भयोः /
कृत्वा शिष्यप्रवेशाय लब्धानुज्ञो वहिर्व्रजेत् //
text_mt: And having performed the internal bali offering between the altar-mound and the pot, / having obtained permission for the entrance of the disciple, he should go outside.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryātsamayavattatra maṇḍalāropaṇādikaṃ /
sampātahomaṃ tannāḍīrūpadarbhakarānugaṃ //
meaning:
कुर्यात्समयवत्तत्र मण्डलारोपणादिकं /
सम्पातहोमं तन्नाडीरूपदर्भकरानुगं //
text_mt: There he should perform the placement on the maṇḍala and other rites in accordance with the rules, / [and then] the oblation of sacrificial residue following the darbha grass held in hand, which represents the channels [of the body].

sanskrit_iast:
tatsannidhānāya tistro hutvā mūlāṇunā.ahutīḥ /
kumbhasthaṃ śivamabhyarcya pāśasūtramupāharet(3) //
:n
1 śuklāmbarādikamiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 asmallabdhapañcapustakeṣu dadhyārdramāṃsamadyāderityārabhya homo
ghoreṇa śāntaye ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ pūrveṇānanvita iva
pratibhāti
3 pāśasūtraṃ samāharediti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 262
meaning:
तत्सन्निधानाय तिस्त्रो हुत्वा मूलाणुना.अहुतीः /
कुम्भस्थं शिवमभ्यर्च्य पाशसूत्रमुपाहरेत्(3) //
:न्
1 शुक्लाम्बरादिकमिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 अस्मल्लब्धपञ्चपुस्तकेषु दध्यार्द्रमांसमद्यादेरित्यारभ्य होमो
घोरेण शान्तये इत्य् अन्तः पाठः पूर्वेणानन्वित इव
प्रतिभाति
3 पाशसूत्रं समाहरेदिति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 262
text_mt:
Having offered three oblations with the root mantra for His presence, / [and] having worshipped Śiva residing in the pitcher, he should take up the cord of bondage.
[Footnotes]
1 "śuklāmbarādikam" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
2 In the five manuscripts obtained by us, the reading beginning from "dadhyārdramāṃsamadyādeḥ" and ending with "homo ghoreṇa śāntaye" appears unconnected with what precedes.
3 "pāśasūtraṃ samāharet" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [p. 262]

sanskrit_iast:
svadakṣiṇordhvakāyasya śiṣyasyābhyarcitasya ca /
tacchikhāyāṃ nibadhnīyāt pādāṅguṣṭhāvalambitaṃ //
meaning:
स्वदक्षिणोर्ध्वकायस्य शिष्यस्याभ्यर्चितस्य च /
तच्छिखायां निबध्नीयात् पादाङ्गुष्ठावलम्बितं //
text_mt: The disciple being seated to his own right, facing upwards, and having been worshipped, / he should bind [the cord] to his topknot, hanging down to the big toe of his foot.

sanskrit_iast:
taṃ niveśya nivṛttestu vyāptimālokya cetasā /
jñeyāni bhuvanānyasyāṃ śatamaṣṭādhikaṃ tataḥ //
meaning:
तं निवेश्य निवृत्तेस्तु व्याप्तिमालोक्य चेतसा /
ज्ञेयानि भुवनान्यस्यां शतमष्टाधिकं ततः //
text_mt: Having established him, and having perceived with the mind the pervasive extent of Nivṛtti, / one hundred and eight cosmic realms are then to be known within it:

sanskrit_iast:
kapālo 'jaś ca buddhaś ca vajradehaḥ pramardanaḥ(1) /
vibhūtiravyayaḥ śāstā pinākī tridaśādhipaḥ //
meaning:
कपालो ऽजश् च बुद्धश् च वज्रदेहः प्रमर्दनः(1) /
विभूतिरव्ययः शास्ता पिनाकी त्रिदशाधिपः //
text_mt: Kapāla, Aja, Buddha, Vajradeha, Pramardana, / Vibhūti, Avyaya, Śāstā, Pinākin, and Tridaśādhipa;

sanskrit_iast:
agnī rudro hutāśo ca piṅgalaḥ khādako haraḥ /
jvalano dahano babhrurbhasmāntakakṣapāntakau //
meaning:
अग्नी रुद्रो हुताशो च पिङ्गलः खादको हरः /
ज्वलनो दहनो बभ्रुर्भस्मान्तकक्षपान्तकौ //
text_mt: Agni, Rudra, Hutāśa, Piṅgala, Khādaka, Hara, / Jvalana, Dahana, Babhru, Bhasmāntaka, and Kṣapāntaka;

sanskrit_iast:
yāmyamṛtyuharo dhātā vidhātā kāryarañjakaḥ /
kālo dharmo 'pyadharmaś ca saṃyoktā ca viyogakaḥ //
meaning:
याम्यमृत्युहरो धाता विधाता कार्यरञ्जकः /
कालो धर्मो ऽप्यधर्मश् च संयोक्ता च वियोगकः //
text_mt: Yāmya, Mṛtyuhara, Dhātṛ, Vidhātṛ, Kāryarañjaka, / Kāla, Dharma, Adharma, Saṃyoktṛ, and Viyogaka;

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛto māraṇo(2) hantā krūradṛṣṭirbhayānakaḥ /
ūrdhvāṃśako virūpākṣo dhūmralohitadaṃṣṭravān //
meaning:
नैरृतो मारणो(2) हन्ता क्रूरदृष्टिर्भयानकः /
ऊर्ध्वांशको विरूपाक्षो धूम्रलोहितदंष्ट्रवान् //
text_mt: Nairṛta, Māraṇa, Hantṛ, Krūradṛṣṭi, Bhayānaka, / Ūrdhvāṃśaka, Virūpākṣa, and Dhūmralohitadaṃṣṭravat;

sanskrit_iast:
balaścātibalaś caiva pāśahasto mahābalaḥ /
śvetaś ca jayabhadraś ca dīrghabāhurjalāntakaḥ(3) //
meaning:
बलश्चातिबलश् चैव पाशहस्तो महाबलः /
श्वेतश् च जयभद्रश् च दीर्घबाहुर्जलान्तकः(3) //
text_mt: Bala, Atibala, Pāśahasta, Mahābala, / Śveta, Jayabhadra, Dīrghabāhu, Jalāntaka,

sanskrit_iast:
vaḍavāsyaś ca bhīmaś ca daśaite vāruṇāḥ smṛtāḥ /
śīghro laghurvāyuvegaḥ sūkṣmastīkṣṇaḥ kṣapāntakaḥ //
meaning:
वडवास्यश् च भीमश् च दशैते वारुणाः स्मृताः /
शीघ्रो लघुर्वायुवेगः सूक्ष्मस्तीक्ष्णः क्षपान्तकः //
text_mt: Vaḍavāsya, and Bhīma—these ten are recorded as belonging to Varuṇa. / Śīghra, Laghu, Vāyuvega, Sūkṣma, Tīkṣṇa, Kṣapāntaka,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāntakaḥ pañcaśikhaḥ kapardī meghavāhanaḥ /
jaṭāmukuṭadhārī ca nānāratnadharas tathā //
meaning:
पञ्चान्तकः पञ्चशिखः कपर्दी मेघवाहनः /
जटामुकुटधारी च नानारत्नधरस् तथा //
text_mt: Pañcāntaka, Pañcaśikha, Kapardin, Meghavāhana, / the bearer of the crown of matted locks, and likewise the bearer of various gems;

sanskrit_iast:
nidhīśo rūpavān dhanyo saumyadehaḥ prasādakṛt /
prakāśo 'pyatha lakṣmīvān kāmarūpo daśottare //
meaning:
निधीशो रूपवान् धन्यो सौम्यदेहः प्रसादकृत् /
प्रकाशो ऽप्यथ लक्ष्मीवान् कामरूपो दशोत्तरे //
text_mt: Nidhīśa, Rūpavat, Dhanya, Saumyadeha, Prasādakṛt, / Prakāśa, Lakṣmīvat, and Kāmarūpa in the north [group of] ten;

sanskrit_iast:
vidyādharo jñānadharaḥ sarvajño vedapāragaḥ /
mātṛvṛttaś ca piṅgākṣo bhūtapālo balipriyaḥ //
:n
1 pravardhana iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 varuṇa iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 janāntaka iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 263
meaning:
विद्याधरो ज्ञानधरः सर्वज्ञो वेदपारगः /
मातृवृत्तश् च पिङ्गाक्षो भूतपालो बलिप्रियः //
:न्
1 प्रवर्धन इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 वरुण इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 जनान्तक इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 263
text_mt:
Vidyādhara, Jñānadhara, Sarvajña, Vedapāraga, / Mātṛvṛtta, Piṅgākṣa, Bhūtapāla, Balipriya,
[Footnotes]
1 "pravardhanaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "varuṇaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
3 "janāntakaḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa. / [p. 263]

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavidyāvidhatā ca sukhaduḥkhaharā daśa /
anantaḥ pālako dhīraḥ(1) pātālādhipatis tathā //
meaning:
सर्वविद्याविधता च सुखदुःखहरा दश /
अनन्तः पालको धीरः(1) पातालाधिपतिस् तथा //
text_mt: Sarvavidyāvidhātṛ, and the ten dispellers of pleasure and pain; / Ananta, Pālaka, Dhīra, and the lord of the netherworld;

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣo vṛṣadharo vīryo grasanaḥ(2) sarvatomukhaḥ /
lohitaś caiva vijñeyā daśa rudrāḥ phaṇisthitāḥ //
meaning:
वृषो वृषधरो वीर्यो ग्रसनः(2) सर्वतोमुखः /
लोहितश् चैव विज्ञेया दश रुद्राः फणिस्थिताः //
text_mt: Vṛṣa, Vṛṣadhara, Vīrya, Grasana, Sarvatomukha, / and Lohita—these are to be known as the ten Rudras residing on the serpent;

sanskrit_iast:
śambhurvibhurgaṇādhyakṣastryakṣastridaśavanditaḥ /
saṃhāraś ca vihāraś ca lābho lipsurvicakṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
शम्भुर्विभुर्गणाध्यक्षस्त्र्यक्षस्त्रिदशवन्दितः /
संहारश् च विहारश् च लाभो लिप्सुर्विचक्षणः //
text_mt: Śambhu, Vibhu, Gaṇādhyakṣa, Tryakṣa, Tridaśavandita, / Saṃhāra, Vihāra, Lābha, Lipsu, Vicakṣaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
attā kuhakakālāgnirudro(3) hāṭaka eva ca /
kuṣmāṇḍaś caiva satyaś ca brahmā viṣṇuś ca saptamaḥ //
meaning:
अत्ता कुहककालाग्निरुद्रो(3) हाटक एव च /
कुष्माण्डश् चैव सत्यश् च ब्रह्मा विष्णुश् च सप्तमः //
text_mt: Attṛ, Kuhakakālāgnirudra, and Hāṭaka, / Kuṣmāṇḍa, Satya, Brahmā, and Viṣṇu as the seventh,

sanskrit_iast:
rudraścāṣṭāvime rudrāḥ kaṭāhābhyantare sthitāḥ /
eteṣāmeva nāmāni bhuvanānāmapi smaret //
meaning:
रुद्रश्चाष्टाविमे रुद्राः कटाहाभ्यन्तरे स्थिताः /
एतेषामेव नामानि भुवनानामपि स्मरेत् //
text_mt: and Rudra—these eight are Rudras located within the cosmic shell. / One should contemplate the names of these as the names of the cosmic realms.

sanskrit_iast:
bhavodbhavaḥ sarvabhūtaḥ sarvabhūtasukhapradaḥ /
sarvasānnidhyakṛd brahmaviṣṇurudraśarārcitaḥ //
saṃstuta pūrvasthita oṃ sākṣin oṃ rudrāntaka oṃ pataṅga oṃ
śabda oṃ sūkṣma oṃ śiva sarvasarvada sarvasānnidhyakara
brahmaviṣṇurudrakara oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ(4)
meaning:
भवोद्भवः सर्वभूतः सर्वभूतसुखप्रदः /
सर्वसान्निध्यकृद् ब्रह्मविष्णुरुद्रशरार्चितः //
संस्तुत पूर्वस्थित ओं साक्षिन् ओं रुद्रान्तक ओं पतङ्ग ओं
शब्द ओं सूक्ष्म ओं शिव सर्वसर्वद सर्वसान्निध्यकर
ब्रह्मविष्णुरुद्रकर ओं नमः शिवाय ओं नमो नमः(4)
text_mt:
The Origin of Becoming, Omnipresent Being, Bestower of Happiness on All Beings, / Producer of the Presence of All, Worshipped by the arrows of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra:
"O Praised One, Dwelling in the East, oṃ Witness, oṃ Rudrāntaka, oṃ Sun, oṃ Sound, oṃ Subtle One, oṃ Śiva, Omnipresent Bestower of All, Maker of the Presence of All, Maker of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra, oṃ obeisance to Śiva, oṃ obeisance, obeisance!"

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāviṃśati pādāni vyomavyāpi mano guha /
sadyohṛdastranetrāṇi mantravarṇāṣṭako mataḥ //

1 ghora iti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vīryāprasanna iti kha, ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 atha śuklakakālāgnirudra iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 anarcita saṃstuta pūrvasthita sākṣin tuṅga 2 pataṅga 2 jñāna 2
śabda sūkṣma śiva sarvada sarvādhyakṣakara brahmaviṣṇurudra oṃ
namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo
namaḥ iti / anarcita saṃstuta pūrvavinda oṃ sākṣiṇa oṃ rudrāntaka
oṃ pataṅga oṃ jñāna oṃ śabda oṃ sūkṣma oṃ śiva oṃ sarva
oṃ sarvada oṃ sarvasānnidhyakara brahmaviṣṇu rudrakara oṃ namaḥ
śivāya oṃ namo nama iti ca, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 264
meaning:
अष्टाविंशति पादानि व्योमव्यापि मनो गुह /
सद्योहृदस्त्रनेत्राणि मन्त्रवर्णाष्टको मतः //
:न्
1 घोर इति ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 वीर्याप्रसन्न इति ख, ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 अथ शुक्लककालाग्निरुद्र इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 अनर्चित संस्तुत पूर्वस्थित साक्षिन् तुङ्ग 2 पतङ्ग 2 ज्ञान 2
शब्द सूक्ष्म शिव सर्वद सर्वाध्यक्षकर ब्रह्मविष्णुरुद्र ओं
नमः शिवाय ओं नमो नमः ओं नमः शिवाय ओं नमो
नमः इति / अनर्चित संस्तुत पूर्वविन्द ओं साक्षिण ओं रुद्रान्तक
ओं पतङ्ग ओं ज्ञान ओं शब्द ओं सूक्ष्म ओं शिव ओं सर्व

शिवाय ओं नमो नम इति च, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः

text_mt:
The twenty-eight feet, Vyomavyāpin, Manas, Guha, / Sadyojāta, Hṛdaya, Astra, and Netra are considered the eightfold mantra syllables.
[Footnotes]
1 "ghoraḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked ṅa.
2 "vīryāprasannaḥ" is the reading in the manuscripts marked kha and ga.
3 "atha śuklakakālāgnirudraḥ" is the reading in the manuscript marked kha.
4 "anarcita saṃstuta pūrvasthita sākṣin tuṅga 2 pataṅga 2 jñāna 2 śabda sūkṣma śiva sarvada sarvādhyakṣakara brahmaviṣṇurudra oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ" and "anarcita saṃstuta pūrvavinda oṃ sākṣiṇa oṃ rudrāntaka oṃ pataṅga oṃ jñāna oṃ śabda oṃ sūkṣma oṃ śiva oṃ sarva oṃ sarvada oṃ sarvasānnidhyakara brahmaviṣṇu rudrakara oṃ namaḥ śivāya oṃ namo namaḥ" are the readings in the marked manuscripts. / [p. 264]

sanskrit_iast:
vījākāro makāraś ca(1) nāḍyāviḍāpiṅgalāhvaye /
prāṇāpānāvubhau vāyū ghrāṇopasthau tathendriye //
meaning:
वीजाकारो मकारश् च(1) नाड्याविडापिङ्गलाह्वये /
प्राणापानावुभौ वायू घ्राणोपस्थौ तथेन्द्रिये //
text_mt: The seed-form is the letter 'ma', and the two channels are called Iḍā and Piṅgalā; / the two breaths are Prāṇa and Apāna; likewise the two organs of sense and action are the nose and the genitals.

sanskrit_iast:
gandhastu viṣayaḥ prokto gandhādiguṇapañcake /
pārthivaṃ maṇḍalaṃ pītaṃ vajrāṅgaṃ caturasrakaṃ //
meaning:
गन्धस्तु विषयः प्रोक्तो गन्धादिगुणपञ्चके /
पार्थिवं मण्डलं पीतं वज्राङ्गं चतुरस्रकं //
text_mt: Smell is declared to be the sense object among the five qualities of smell and the rest; / the earthly maṇḍala is yellow, marked with a vajra, and four-sided.

sanskrit_iast:
vistāro yojanānāntu koṭirasya śatāhatā /
atraivāntargatā jñeyā yonayo 'pi caturdaśa //
meaning:
विस्तारो योजनानान्तु कोटिरस्य शताहता /
अत्रैवान्तर्गता ज्ञेया योनयो ऽपि चतुर्दश //
text_mt: Its extent in leagues is one hundred times a crore; / and the fourteen wombs of existence should be known to be included right here:

sanskrit_iast:
prathamā sarvadevānāṃ manvādyā devayonayaḥ /
mṛgapakṣī ca paśavaś caturdhā tu sarīsṛpāḥ //
meaning:
प्रथमा सर्वदेवानां मन्वाद्या देवयोनयः /
मृगपक्षी च पशवश् चतुर्धा तु सरीसृपाः //
text_mt: The first of all gods, the wombs of the gods beginning with Manu; / beasts and birds, animals, and reptiles of four kinds;

sanskrit_iast:
sthāvaraṃ pañcamaṃ sarvaṃ yoniḥ ṣaṣṭhī amānuṣī(2) /
paiśācaṃ rākṣasaṃ yākṣaṃ gāndharvaṃ caindrameva ca //
meaning:
स्थावरं पञ्चमं सर्वं योनिः षष्ठी अमानुषी(2) /
पैशाचं राक्षसं याक्षं गान्धर्वं चैन्द्रमेव च //
text_mt: immobile beings form the fifth entirely; the sixth womb is the non-human: / of ghosts, demons, yakṣas, gandharvas, and that of Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
saumyaṃ prāṇeśvaraṃ(3) brāhmamaṣṭamaṃ parikīrtitaṃ /
aṣṭānāṃ pārthivantattvamadhikārāspadaṃ mataṃ //
meaning:
सौम्यं प्राणेश्वरं(3) ब्राह्ममष्टमं परिकीर्तितं /
अष्टानां पार्थिवन्तत्त्वमधिकारास्पदं मतं //
text_mt: of Soma, of the lord of breaths, and that of Brahmā is declared the eighth; / the earthly reality is considered the seat of authority for the eight.

sanskrit_iast:
layastu prakṛtau buddhau bhogo brahmā ca kāraṇaṃ /
tato jāgradavasthānaiḥ samastair bhuvanādibhiḥ //
meaning:
लयस्तु प्रकृतौ बुद्धौ भोगो ब्रह्मा च कारणं /
ततो जाग्रदवस्थानैः समस्तैर् भुवनादिभिः //
text_mt: Absorption is in the primal nature; experience is in the intellect; and Brahmā is the instrumental cause; / then, through the waking state, through all cosmic realms and the rest,

nivṛttiṃ garbhitāṃ dhyātvā svamantreṇa niyojya ca /
oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(4) nivṛttikalāpāśāya hūṃ phaṭ tata
oṃ hāṃ hāṃ(5) nivṛttikalāpāśāya

cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

निवृत्तिं गर्भितां ध्यात्वा स्वमन्त्रेण नियोज्य च /

text_mt:
having contemplated Nivṛtti as enclosed within, and having joined it with its own mantra,
with "oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ to the cord of Nivṛttikalā hūṃ phaṭ", then drawing it forth by inhalation with the ritual gesture of the elephant hook reciting "oṃ hāṃ hāṃ to the cord of Nivṛttikalā svāhā", [and] with "oṃ hrūṃ hrāṃ hrūṃ to the cord of Nivṛttikalā hūṃ phaṭ", by retention with the gesture of dissolution downwards-[…]

sanskrit_iast:
sthānādādāya oṃ oṃ hrāṃ hāṃ(1) nivṛttikalāpāśāya nama
ity anenodbhavamudrayā recakena kumbhe saṃsthāpya oṃ hāṃ
nivṛttikalāpāśāya nama ity anenārghyaṃ datvā sampūjya vimukhenaiva
svāhāntenai sannidhānāyāhutitrayaṃ santarpaṇāhutitrayaṃ ca datvā
oṃ hāṃ brahmaṇe nama iti brahmāṇamāvāhya sampūjya ca
svāhāntena santarpya
brahman tavādhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dokṣyayāmyahaṃ //
meaning:
स्थानादादाय ओं ओं ह्रां हां(1) निवृत्तिकलापाशाय नम
इत्य् अनेनोद्भवमुद्रया रेचकेन कुम्भे संस्थाप्य ओं हां
निवृत्तिकलापाशाय नम इत्य् अनेनार्घ्यं दत्वा सम्पूज्य विमुखेनैव
स्वाहान्तेनै सन्निधानायाहुतित्रयं सन्तर्पणाहुतित्रयं च दत्वा
ओं हां ब्रह्मणे नम इति ब्रह्माणमावाह्य सम्पूज्य च
स्वाहान्तेन सन्तर्प्य
ब्रह्मन् तवाधिकारे ऽस्मिन् मुमुक्षुं दोक्ष्ययाम्यहं //
text_mt:
Taking it from its place with “Oṃ oṃ hrāṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the fetter of the sphere of nivṛtti,” having deposited it in the pot by means of the gesture of arising (udbhavamudrā) during exhalation, having offered an arghya with “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the fetter of the sphere of nivṛtti,” having worshipped it, having given three oblations for presence with an aversion [of the face] and ending in svāhā, and three satiating oblations, and having invoked Brahmā with “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to Brahmā,” having worshipped him and satiated him with mantras ending in svāhā,
“O Brahmā, in this jurisdiction of yours, I am going to initiate a seeker of liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena vidhiṃ vijñāpayediti /
āvāhayettato devīṃ rakṣāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ hṛdā //
meaning:
भाव्यं त्वयानुकूलेन विधिं विज्ञापयेदिति /
आवाहयेत्ततो देवीं रक्षां वागीश्वरीं हृदा //
text_mt: You ought to be favorable.” He should inform the Creator in this way. / Then he should invoke the goddess Vāgīśvarī as protection using the heart mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
icchājñānakriyārūpāṃ ṣaḍvidhāṃ hy ekakāraṇaṃ /
pūjayettarpayeddevīṃ prakāreṇāmunā tataḥ //
meaning:
इच्छाज्ञानक्रियारूपां षड्विधां ह्य् एककारणं /
पूजयेत्तर्पयेद्देवीं प्रकारेणामुना ततः //
text_mt: Having the nature of will, knowledge, and action, sixfold, yet a single cause; / then he should worship and satiate the goddess in this manner.

sanskrit_iast:
vāgīśvarīṃ viniḥśeṣayonivikṣobhakāraṇaṃ /
hṛtsampuṭārthavījādihūṃ phaḍantaśarāṇunā //
meaning:
वागीश्वरीं विनिःशेषयोनिविक्षोभकारणं /
हृत्सम्पुटार्थवीजादिहूं फडन्तशराणुना //
text_mt: Vāgīśvarī, the cause of agitating all wombs without exception; / with the arrow-mantra ending in hūṃ phaṭ, containing the seed-syllables in the enclosure of the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
tāḍayeddhṛdaye tasya praviśetsa(2) vidhānavit /
tataḥ śiṣyasya caitanyaṃ hṛdi vahnikaṇopamaṃ //
meaning:
ताडयेद्धृदये तस्य प्रविशेत्स(2) विधानवित् /
ततः शिष्यस्य चैतन्यं हृदि वह्निकणोपमं //
text_mt: the knower of rites should strike him in the heart and enter [it]. / Then the consciousness of the pupil, resembling a spark of fire in the heart,

sanskrit_iast:
nivṛttisthaṃ yutaṃ pāśair jyeṣṭhayā vibhajedyathā /
oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haḥ hūṃ phaṭoṃ hāṃ svāhetyanenātha pūrakeṇāṅkuśamudrayā //
meaning:
निवृत्तिस्थं युतं पाशैर् ज्येष्ठया विभजेद्यथा /
ओं हां हूं हः हूं फटों हां स्वाहेत्यनेनाथ पूरकेणाङ्कुशमुद्रया //
text_mt: situated in nivṛtti, bound by fetters, he should divide as [prescribed] by Jyeṣṭhā; / then with “Oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haḥ hūṃ phaṭ oṃ hāṃ svāhā,” during inhalation, with the hook gesture (aṅkuśamudrā),

sanskrit_iast:
tadākṛṣya svamantreṇa gṛhītvā.atmani yojayet /
oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(3) ātmane namaḥ
pitrorvibhāvya saṃyogaṃ caitanyaṃ recakena tat //
meaning:
तदाकृष्य स्वमन्त्रेण गृहीत्वा.अत्मनि योजयेत् /
ओं हां ह्रूं हां(3) आत्मने नमः
पित्रोर्विभाव्य संयोगं चैतन्यं रेचकेन तत् //
text_mt:
having drawn it forth, having grasped it with his own mantra, he should unite it with himself:
“Oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the Self.”
Contemplating the union of the parents, that consciousness, by means of exhalation,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmādikāraṇatyāgakramānnītvā śivāspadaṃ /
:n
1 oṃ hūṃ hrīṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 praviśyecceti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 oṃ hāṃ hāṃ kṣaṃ hāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

garbhādhānārthamādāya yugapat sarvayoniṣu //

ब्रह्मादिकारणत्यागक्रमान्नीत्वा शिवास्पदं /

having led it in sequence through the abandonment of the causal deities beginning with Brahmā to the abode of Śiva,
[Note]

taking it for the sake of conception simultaneously in all wombs,

kṣipedvāgīśvarīyonau vāmayodbhavamudrayā /

pūjayedapyanenaiva tarpayedapi pañcadhā //

क्षिपेद्वागीश्वरीयोनौ वामयोद्भवमुद्रया /
ओं हां हां हां आत्मने नमः(1)
पूजयेदप्यनेनैव तर्पयेदपि पञ्चधा //
text_mt:
he should deposit it in the womb of Vāgīśvarī by means of the Vāmā and the gesture of arising:
“Oṃ hāṃ hāṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the Self.”
With this very [mantra] he should worship and satiate five times.

sanskrit_iast:
anyayoniṣu sarvāsu dehaśuddhiṃ hṛdā caret /
nātra puṃsavanaṃ stryādiśarīrasyāpi sambhavāt //
meaning:
अन्ययोनिषु सर्वासु देहशुद्धिं हृदा चरेत् /
नात्र पुंसवनं स्त्र्यादिशरीरस्यापि सम्भवात् //
text_mt: In all other wombs, he should perform the purification of the body with the heart-mantra. / Here there is no rite of quickening a male (puṃsavana), since female and other bodies also occur.

sanskrit_iast:
sīmantonnayanaṃ vāpi daivānyaṅgāni dehavat /
śirasā janma kurvīta jugupsan sarvadehināṃ //

सीमन्तोन्नयनं वापि दैवान्यङ्गानि देहवत् /
शिरसा जन्म कुर्वीत जुगुप्सन् सर्वदेहिनां //
text_mt: Nor the parting of the hair (sīmantonnayana); the other bodily parts are divine like the body. / He should effect birth with the head-mantra, despising [the births] of all embodied beings.

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva bhāvayedeṣāmadhikāraṃ śivāṇunā(2) /
bhogaṃ kavacamantreṇa śastreṇa viṣayātmanā //

भोगं कवचमन्त्रेण शस्त्रेण विषयात्मना //
text_mt: Likewise, he should contemplate their jurisdiction with the Śiva-mantra, / worldly experience with the armor-mantra, and with the weapon-mantra having the nature of sense objects,

sanskrit_iast:
moharūpamabhedaś ca layasajñaṃ vibhāvayet /
śivena śrotasāṃ śuddhiṃ hṛdā tattvaviśodhanaṃ //
meaning:
मोहरूपमभेदश् च लयसज्ञं विभावयेत् /
शिवेन श्रोतसां शुद्धिं हृदा तत्त्वविशोधनं //
text_mt: he should contemplate the state called dissolution as having the form of delusion and non-differentiation; / with the Śiva-mantra, the purification of the channels; and with the heart-mantra, the purification of the cosmic principles.

sanskrit_iast:
pañca pañcāhutīḥ kuryāt(3) garbhādhānādiṣu kramāt /
māyayā malakarmādipāśabandhanivṛttaye //
meaning:
पञ्च पञ्चाहुतीः कुर्यात्(3) गर्भाधानादिषु क्रमात् /
मायया मलकर्मादिपाशबन्धनिवृत्तये //
text_mt: He should offer five oblations each in sequence at the rites of conception and the rest, / for the cessation of the bondage of fetters such as impurity and karma caused by māyā.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkṛtyaiva hṛdā paścād yajeta śatamāhutīḥ /
malaśaktinirodhena pāśānāñca viyojanaṃ //
meaning:
निष्कृत्यैव हृदा पश्चाद् यजेत शतमाहुतीः /
मलशक्तिनिरोधेन पाशानाञ्च वियोजनं //
text_mt: After this expiation, he should subsequently sacrifice a hundred oblations with the heart-mantra. / By blocking the power of impurity, the detachment of the fetters [is achieved].

sanskrit_iast:
svāhāntāyudhamantreṇa pañcapañcāhutīryajet /
māyādyantasya pāśasya saptavārāstrajaptayā //
meaning:
स्वाहान्तायुधमन्त्रेण पञ्चपञ्चाहुतीर्यजेत् /
मायाद्यन्तस्य पाशस्य सप्तवारास्त्रजप्तया //
text_mt: With the weapon-mantra ending in svāhā, he should sacrifice five oblations each. / For the fetter whose beginning and end are māyā, with [the scissors] consecrated seven times with the weapon-mantra,

kartaryā chedanaṃ kuryāt kalpaśastreṇa tadyathā /

he should cut it with scissors as the ritual weapon, in this manner:
“Oṃ hūṃ, to the fetter of the sphere of nivṛtti, hūṃ phaṭ.”
[Note]
1. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is “oṃ haṃ haṃ hāṃ ātmane namaḥ”.
2. In the manuscript marked kha, the reading is “śikhātmanā”.

And having removed the binding power with both hands and the arrow-mantra,

विसृज्य वर्तुलीकृत्य घृतपूर्णे स्रुवे धरेत् /
दहेदनुकलास्त्रेण केवलास्त्रेण भस्मसात् //

कुर्यात् पञ्चाहुतीर्दत्वा पाशाङ्कुशनिवृत्तये /

Having offered five oblations for the removal of the goad of fetters, he should do:
“Oṃ haḥ, to the weapon, hūṃ phaṭ.”
Then he should perform expiation with eight oblations of the weapon-mantra.

Then, having invoked the Creator, he should worship and satiate him likewise.
Then, with three oblations, “Oṃ hāṃ, O Brahmā purified of sound and touch, accept, svāhā,” he should surrender his jurisdiction [over the soul]:
“O Brahmā, of this bound soul whose sins have been entirely burnt away,

sanskrit_iast:
bandhāya na punaḥ stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti /
tato visṛjya dhātāraṃ nāḍyā dakṣiṇayā śanaiḥ //

बन्धाय न पुनः स्थेयं शिवाज्ञां श्रावयेदिति /
ततो विसृज्य धातारं नाड्या दक्षिणया शनैः //

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhāramudrayātmānaṃ kumbhakena nijātmanā /
rāhuyuktaikadeśena candravimbena sannibhaṃ //

संहारमुद्रयात्मानं कुम्भकेन निजात्मना /
राहुयुक्तैकदेशेन चन्द्रविम्बेन सन्निभं //

pūjayitvārghyapātrasthatoyavindusudhopamaṃ //

पूजयित्वार्घ्यपात्रस्थतोयविन्दुसुधोपमं //

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt:
having dismissed the parents, he should give [oblations] with the Śiva-mantra ending in vauṣaṭ. / For completion, the rite is completed; thus the sphere of nivṛtti has been purified.
Thus ends the eighty-fourth chapter, entitled “The Purification of the Sphere of Nivṛtti in the Liberating Initiation,” in the venerable and great Āgneya Purāṇa.

Now, eighty-fifth chapter:
Statement of the purification of the sphere of pratiṣṭhā.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
tattvayoratha sandhānaṃ kuryācchuddhaviśuddhayoḥ /
hrasvadīrghaprayogeṇa nādanādāntasaṅginā //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
तत्त्वयोरथ सन्धानं कुर्याच्छुद्धविशुद्धयोः /
ह्रस्वदीर्घप्रयोगेण नादनादान्तसङ्गिना //
text_mt: The Lord said: / Then one should effect the junction of the two principles, the pure and the purified, / by the use of the short and long [vowels] accompanied by resonance and the end of resonance:

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ(1)aptejo vāyurākāśaṃ tanmātrendriyabuddhayaḥ /
guṇatrayamahaṅkāraś caturviṃśaḥ pumāniti //
meaning:
ओं हां ह्रूं हां(1)अप्तेजो वायुराकाशं तन्मात्रेन्द्रियबुद्धयः /
गुणत्रयमहङ्कारश् चतुर्विंशः पुमानिति //
text_mt: “Oṃ hāṃ hrūṃ hāṃ.” Water, fire, wind, space, the subtle elements, sense organs, intellect, / the three guṇas, egoity, and the twenty-fourth, the soul—

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāyāṃ niviṣṭhāni tattvānyetāni bhāvayet /
pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyāni khādiyāntākṣarāṇi ca //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठायां निविष्ठानि तत्त्वान्येतानि भावयेत् /
पञ्चविंशतिसङ्ख्यानि खादियान्ताक्षराणि च //
text_mt: he should contemplate these cosmic principles as deposited in the sphere of pratiṣṭhā, / twenty-five in number, and the letters beginning with kha and ending with ya.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśadadhikā ṣaṣṭirbhuvanaistulyasañjñitāḥ /
tāvanta eva rudrāś ca vijñeyāstatra tadyathā //
meaning:
पञ्चाशदधिका षष्टिर्भुवनैस्तुल्यसञ्ज्ञिताः /
तावन्त एव रुद्राश् च विज्ञेयास्तत्र तद्यथा //
text_mt: There are sixty plus fifty [worlds] identically designated with the worlds; / just so many Rudras are to be known there, namely:

sanskrit_iast:
amareśaḥ prabhāvaś ca nemiṣaḥ puṣkaro 'pi ca /
tathā pādiś ca daṇḍiś ca bhāvabhūtirathāṣṭamaḥ //
meaning:
अमरेशः प्रभावश् च नेमिषः पुष्करो ऽपि च /
तथा पादिश् च दण्डिश् च भावभूतिरथाष्टमः //
text_mt: Amareśa, Prabhāva, Nemiṣa, and Puṣkara, / likewise Pādin, Daṇḍin, and Bhāvabhūti as the eighth;

sanskrit_iast:
nakulīśo hariś candraḥ śrīśailo daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ /
anvīśo 'srātikeśaś ca(2) mahākālo 'tha madhyamaḥ //
meaning:
नकुलीशो हरिश् चन्द्रः श्रीशैलो दशमः स्मृतः /
अन्वीशो ऽस्रातिकेशश् च(2) महाकालो ऽथ मध्यमः //
text_mt: Nakulīśa, Hariścandra, and Śrīśaila is recorded as the tenth; / Anvīśa, Asrātikeśa, Mahākāla, then Madhyama;

sanskrit_iast:
kedāro bhairavaś caiva dvitīyāṣṭakamīritaṃ /
tato gayākurukṣetrakhalānādikanādike //

बाहुमुक्तार्धदृश्येन चन्द्रविम्बेन सन्निभं /
संहारमुद्रया स्वस्थं(2) विधायोद्भवमुद्रया //

uniting it to the thread, having deposited a drop of water as before, / having dismissed the parents of the fire worshipped with flowers and other offerings,

Now the eighty-sixth chapter:
The Procedure for the Purification of Vidyā

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
sandhānamatha vidyāyāḥ prācīnakalayā saha /
kurvīta pūrvavat kṛtvā(1) tattvaṃ varṇaya tadyathā //
oṃ hoṃ kṣīmiti sandhānaṃ
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
सन्धानमथ विद्यायाः प्राचीनकलया सह /
कुर्वीत पूर्ववत् कृत्वा(1) तत्त्वं वर्णय तद्यथा //
ओं हों क्षीमिति सन्धानं
text_mt:
The Lord said: / Then one should perform the conjunction of Vidyā with the preceding kalā / having done as before. Describe the principles, namely as follows:
'oṃ hoṃ kṣīm'—this is the conjunction.

sanskrit_iast:
rāgś ca śuddhavidyā ca niyatiḥ kalayā saha /
kālo mayā tathāvidyā tattvānāmiti saptakaṃ //
meaning:
राग्श् च शुद्धविद्या च नियतिः कलया सह /
कालो मया तथाविद्या तत्त्वानामिति सप्तकं //
text_mt: Rāga, Śuddhavidyā, Niyati together with Kalā, / Kāla, Māyā, and likewise Avidyā: this is the group of seven principles.

sanskrit_iast:
ralavāḥ śaṣasāḥ varṇāḥ ṣaḍ vidyāyāṃ prakīrtitāḥ /
padāni praṇavādīni ekaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā //
oṃ namaḥ śivāya sarvaprabhave haṃ śivāya(2) īśānamūrdhāya
tatpuruṣavaktrāya aghorahṛdayāya vāmadevaguhyāya(3)
sadyojātamūrtaye(4) oṃ namo namo guhyātiguhyāya goptre anidhāya
sarvādhipāya(5) jyotirūpāya prameśvārāya bhavena oṃ vyoma
:n

2 iṃ śivāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 vacoguhyāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 sadyojātāya mūrtaye iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 atha nidhāya sarvādhipataya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 273
meaning:
रलवाः शषसाः वर्णाः षड् विद्यायां प्रकीर्तिताः /
पदानि प्रणवादीनि एकविंशतिसङ्ख्यया //
ओं नमः शिवाय सर्वप्रभवे हं शिवाय(2) ईशानमूर्धाय
तत्पुरुषवक्त्राय अघोरहृदयाय वामदेवगुह्याय(3)
सद्योजातमूर्तये(4) ओं नमो नमो गुह्यातिगुह्याय गोप्त्रे अनिधाय
सर्वाधिपाय(5) ज्योतिरूपाय प्रमेश्वाराय भवेन ओं व्योम
:न्
1 पूर्ववत् धृत्वेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 इं शिवाय इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 वचोगुह्याय इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 सद्योजाताय मूर्तये इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 अथ निधाय सर्वाधिपतय इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 273
text_mt:
The six letters *ra*, *la*, *va*, *śa*, *ṣa*, and *sa* are declared to belong to Vidyā [Kalā]. / The words beginning with the Praṇava (oṃ) are twenty-one in number:
“Oṃ namaḥ śivāya, to the all-sovereign, haṃ to Śiva, to the one whose head is Īśāna, / whose face is Tatpuruṣa, whose heart is Aghora, whose secret part is Vāmadeva, / whose form is Sadyojāta; oṃ homage, homage to the most secret of secrets, to the protector, to the boundless one, / to the ruler of all, whose nature is light, to the supreme lord, by Bhava, oṃ vyoma-…”
[Gap in text]
1. "Holding as before" is the reading of the book marked kha.
2. "iṃ śivāya" is the reading of the book marked kha.
3. "vacoguhyāya" is the reading of the book marked kha.
4. "sadyojātāya mūrtaye" is the reading of the book marked kha.
5. "atha nidhāya sarvādhipataye" is the reading of the book marked kha. / [p. 273]

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ rudrāṇāṃ bhuvanānāñca svarūpamatha kaśyape /
prathamo vāmadevaḥ syāttataḥ sarvabhavodbhavaḥ //
meaning:
ओं रुद्राणां भुवनानाञ्च स्वरूपमथ कश्यपे /
प्रथमो वामदेवः स्यात्ततः सर्वभवोद्भवः //
text_mt: Now, O Kaśyapa, regarding the true nature of the Rudras and worlds: / The first is Vāmadeva, and then Sarvabhavodbhava,

sanskrit_iast:
vajradehaḥ prabhurdhātā kravikramasuprabhāḥ /
vaṭuḥ(1) praśāntanāmā ca paramākṣarasañjñakaḥ //
meaning:
वज्रदेहः प्रभुर्धाता क्रविक्रमसुप्रभाः /
वटुः(1) प्रशान्तनामा च परमाक्षरसञ्ज्ञकः //
text_mt: Vajradeha, Prabhu, Dhātṛ, Kravikrama, Suprabha, / Vaṭu, Praśānta by name, and the one designated Paramākṣara,

sanskrit_iast:
śivaś ca saśivo babhrurakṣayaḥ śambhureva ca /
adṛṣṭarūpanāmānau tathānyo rūpavardhanaḥ //
meaning:
शिवश् च सशिवो बभ्रुरक्षयः शम्भुरेव च /
अदृष्टरूपनामानौ तथान्यो रूपवर्धनः //
text_mt: Śiva, Saśiva, Babhru, Akṣaya, Śambhu, / Adṛṣṭarūpa, [Adṛṣṭa]nāman, and another, Rūpavardhana,

sanskrit_iast:
manonmano mahāvīryaścitrāṅgastadanantaraṃ /
kalyāṇa iti vijñeyāḥ pañcaviṃśatisaṅkhyayā //
meaning:
मनोन्मनो महावीर्यश्चित्राङ्गस्तदनन्तरं /
कल्याण इति विज्ञेयाः पञ्चविंशतिसङ्ख्यया //
text_mt: Manonmana, Mahāvīrya, Citrāṅga, and after him / Kalyāṇa; these should be known to be twenty-five in number.

sanskrit_iast:
mantro ghorāmarau vīje nāḍyau dve tatra te yathā /
pūṣā ca hastijihvā ca vyānanāgau prabhañjanau //
meaning:
मन्त्रो घोरामरौ वीजे नाड्यौ द्वे तत्र ते यथा /
पूषा च हस्तिजिह्वा च व्याननागौ प्रभञ्जनौ //
text_mt: The mantras are Aghora and Amara; there are two seed-syllables; the two channels there are likewise / Pūṣā and Hastijihvā; the two winds are Vyāna and Nāga.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣayo rūpamevaikamindriye pādacakṣuṣī /
śabdaḥ sparśaś ca rūpañca traya ete guṇāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
विषयो रूपमेवैकमिन्द्रिये पादचक्षुषी /
शब्दः स्पर्शश् च रूपञ्च त्रय एते गुणाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: The sense-object is form alone; the sense-organs are the foot and the eye; / sound, touch, and form—these three are remembered as the qualities.

sanskrit_iast:
avasthātra ṣuptiś ca rudro devastu kāraṇaṃ /
vidyāmadhyagataṃ sarvaṃ bhāvayedbhavanādikaṃ //
meaning:
अवस्थात्र षुप्तिश् च रुद्रो देवस्तु कारणं /
विद्यामध्यगतं सर्वं भावयेद्भवनादिकं //
text_mt: The state here is deep sleep; the presiding deity is Rudra; / one should visualize all that belongs to Vidyā, such as the worlds.

sanskrit_iast:
tāḍanaṃ chedanaṃ tatra praveśañcāpi yojanaṃ /
ākṛṣya grahaṇaṃ kuryādvidyayā hṛtpradeśataḥ //
meaning:
ताडनं छेदनं तत्र प्रवेशञ्चापि योजनं /
आकृष्य ग्रहणं कुर्याद्विद्यया हृत्प्रदेशतः //
text_mt: Thereupon one should perform striking, severing, entry, and unlinking; / drawing [the soul] out from the region of the heart, one should seize it by means of Vidyā.

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanyāropya saṅgṛhya kalāṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet /
rudraṃ kāraṇamāvāhya vijñāpya ca śiśuṃ prati //
meaning:
आत्मन्यारोप्य सङ्गृह्य कलां कुण्डे निवेशयेत् /
रुद्रं कारणमावाह्य विज्ञाप्य च शिशुं प्रति //
text_mt: Imposing it upon oneself and grasping the Kalā, one should place it in the fire-pit. / Invoking Rudra as the cause and petitioning [him] concerning the child [initiate],

sanskrit_iast:
pitrorāvahanaṃ kṛtvā(2) hṛdaye tāḍayecchiśuṃ /
praviśya pūrvamantreṇa tadātmani niyojayet //
meaning:
पित्रोरावहनं कृत्वा(2) हृदये ताडयेच्छिशुं /
प्रविश्य पूर्वमन्त्रेण तदात्मनि नियोजयेत् //
text_mt: and invoking the parents, one should strike the child in the heart; / entering with the previous mantra, one should unite it with one's own self.

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣyādāya pūrvoktavidhinā.atmani yojayet /
vāmayā yojayet yonau gṛhītvā dvādaśāntataḥ //
:n
1 buddha iti gha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 āvāhanaṃ kuryāditi ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 274
meaning:
आकृष्यादाय पूर्वोक्तविधिना.अत्मनि योजयेत् /
वामया योजयेत् योनौ गृहीत्वा द्वादशान्ततः //
:न्
1 बुद्ध इति घ, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 आवाहनं कुर्यादिति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 274
text_mt:
Drawing it out and taking it according to the rule declared before, one should join it to oneself; / taking it from the dvādaśānta, one should unite it with the womb by means of Vāmā.
[Gap in text]
1. "buddha" is the reading of the books marked gha and ṅa.
2. "āvāhanaṃ kuryāt" is the reading of the books marked ga and gha. / [p. 274]

sanskrit_iast:
kurvīta dehasampattiṃ janmādhikārameva ca /
bhogaṃ layantathā śrotaḥśuddhitattvaviśodhanaṃ //
meaning:
कुर्वीत देहसम्पत्तिं जन्माधिकारमेव च /
भोगं लयन्तथा श्रोतःशुद्धितत्त्वविशोधनं //
text_mt: One should effect the acquisition of a body, birth, qualification, / experience, dissolution, purification of the current [of faculties], and purification of the cosmic principles,

sanskrit_iast:
niḥśeṣamalakarmādipāśabandhanivṛttaye /
niṣkṛtyaiva vidhānena yajeta śatamāhutīḥ //
meaning:
निःशेषमलकर्मादिपाशबन्धनिवृत्तये /
निष्कृत्यैव विधानेन यजेत शतमाहुतीः //
text_mt: for the cessation of all bonds such as impurity and karma. / For expiation according to the rule, one should offer a hundred oblations into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
astreṇa pāśaśaithilyaṃ malaśaktiṃ tirohitāṃ /
chedanaṃ mardanaṃ teṣāṃ vartulīkaraṇaṃ tathā(1) //
meaning:
अस्त्रेण पाशशैथिल्यं मलशक्तिं तिरोहितां /
छेदनं मर्दनं तेषां वर्तुलीकरणं तथा(1) //
text_mt: By means of the Astra [mantra], loosening of the fetter, concealment of the power of impurity, / severing and crushing of them, as well as rolling them into a ball,

sanskrit_iast:
dāhaṃ tadakṣarābhāvaṃ prāyaścittamathoditaṃ /
rudrāṇyāvāhanaṃ pūjā rūpagandhasamarpaṇaṃ //
oṃ hrīṃ rūpagandhau śulkaṃ rudra gṛhāṇa svāhā
meaning:
दाहं तदक्षराभावं प्रायश्चित्तमथोदितं /
रुद्राण्यावाहनं पूजा रूपगन्धसमर्पणं //
ओं ह्रीं रूपगन्धौ शुल्कं रुद्र गृहाण स्वाहा
text_mt:
burning, non-existence of their syllables, and then the expiation are declared; / invocation of Rudrāṇī, worship, and offering of form and fragrance.
“Oṃ hrīṃ, form and fragrance are the fee; O Rudra, accept it, svāhā.”

sanskrit_iast:
saṃśrāvya śāmbhavīmājñāṃ rudraṃ visṛjya kāraṇaṃ /
vidhāyātmani caitanyaṃ pāśasūtre niveśayet //
meaning:
संश्राव्य शाम्भवीमाज्ञां रुद्रं विसृज्य कारणं /
विधायात्मनि चैतन्यं पाशसूत्रे निवेशयेत् //
text_mt: Proclaiming the command of Śiva and dismissing the cause, Rudra, / having established consciousness in oneself, one should place it on the thread of bonds.

sanskrit_iast:
vinduṃ śirasi vinyasya visṛjet pitarau tataḥ /
dadyāt pūrṇāṃ vidhānena samastavidhipūraṇīṃ //
meaning:
विन्दुं शिरसि विन्यस्य विसृजेत् पितरौ ततः /
दद्यात् पूर्णां विधानेन समस्तविधिपूरणीं //
text_mt: Having placed the bindu on the head, one should then dismiss the parents; / one should offer the full oblation according to rule, fulfilling all procedures.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvoktavidhinā kāryaṃ vidyāyāṃ tāḍanādikaṃ /
svavījantu viśeṣaḥ syāditi vidyā viśodhitā //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ
vidyāviśodhanaṃ nāma ṣaḍaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha saptāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śāntiśodhanakathanaṃ
meaning:
पूर्वोक्तविधिना कार्यं विद्यायां ताडनादिकं /
स्ववीजन्तु विशेषः स्यादिति विद्या विशोधिता //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये निर्वाणदीक्षायां
विद्याविशोधनं नाम षडशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ सप्ताशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
शान्तिशोधनकथनं
text_mt:
Striking and the rest should be performed in Vidyā according to the rule declared before; / the distinction, however, is its own seed-syllable. Thus Vidyā is purified.
Thus ends the eighty-sixth chapter, entitled “The Purification of Vidyā,” in the liberating initiation of the venerable and primeval Agni Purāṇa.
Now, the eighty-seventh chapter.
The account of the purification of Śānti [Kalā].

सन्दध्यादधुना विद्यां शान्त्या सार्धं यथाविधि /
शान्तौ तत्त्वद्वयं लीनं भावेश्वरसदाशिवौ //

चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 275
text_mt:
The Lord said: / One should now combine Vidyā with Śānti according to rule; / in Śānti two cosmic principles are dissolved: Īśvara and Sadāśiva.
[Gap in text]
1. "severing, splitting, and multiplying them" is the reading of the book marked ga. / [p. 275]

sanskrit_iast:
hakāraś ca kṣakāraś ca dvau varṇau parikīrtitau /
rudrāḥ samānanāmāno bhuvanaiḥ saha tadyathā //
meaning:
हकारश् च क्षकारश् च द्वौ वर्णौ परिकीर्तितौ /
रुद्राः समाननामानो भुवनैः सह तद्यथा //
text_mt: The two letters *ha* and *kṣa* are proclaimed; / the Rudras have the same names as the worlds, as follows:

sanskrit_iast:
prabhavaḥ samayaḥ kṣudro vimalaḥ śiva ity api /
ghanau nirañjanākārau svaśivau dīptikāraṇau //
meaning:
प्रभवः समयः क्षुद्रो विमलः शिव इत्य् अपि /
घनौ निरञ्जनाकारौ स्वशिवौ दीप्तिकारणौ //
text_mt: Prabhava, Samaya, Kṣudra, Vimala, and Śiva, / Ghana, Nirañjanākāra, Svaśiva, Dīptikāraṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
tridaśeśvaranāmā ca tridaśaḥ kālasajjñakaḥ /
sūkṣmāmbujeśvaraśceti(1) rudrāḥ śāntau pratiṣṭhitāḥ //
vyomavyāpine vyomavyāpyarūpāya(2) sarvavyāpine śivāya anantāya
anāthāya anāśritāya dhruvāya śāśvatāya yogapīṭhasaṃsthitāya
nityayogine dhyānāhārāyeti(3) dvādaśapādāni
meaning:
त्रिदशेश्वरनामा च त्रिदशः कालसज्ज्ञकः /
सूक्ष्माम्बुजेश्वरश्चेति(1) रुद्राः शान्तौ प्रतिष्ठिताः //
व्योमव्यापिने व्योमव्याप्यरूपाय(2) सर्वव्यापिने शिवाय अनन्ताय
अनाथाय अनाश्रिताय ध्रुवाय शाश्वताय योगपीठसंस्थिताय
नित्ययोगिने ध्यानाहारायेति(3) द्वादशपादानि
text_mt:
the one named Tridaśeśvara, Tridaśa, the one designated Kāla, / and Sūkṣmāmbujeśvara; these Rudras are established in Śānti.
“To the one who pervades space, whose form pervades space, to the all-pervading Śiva, to the endless, / to the lordless, to the unconditioned, to the firm, to the eternal, to the one seated upon the yogic throne, / to the eternal yogin, to the one whose sustenance is meditation”—these are twelve words.

sanskrit_iast:
puruṣaḥ kavacau mantrau vīje vindūpakārakau /
alambuṣāyasānāḍyau vāyū kṛkarakarmakau //
meaning:
पुरुषः कवचौ मन्त्रौ वीजे विन्दूपकारकौ /
अलम्बुषायसानाड्यौ वायू कृकरकर्मकौ //
text_mt: The Puruṣa and Kavaca are the two mantras; the two seed-syllables are those ending in bindu; / the two channels are Alambuṣā and Yasas; the two vital winds are Kṛkara and Kūrma.

sanskrit_iast:
indriye tvakkarāvasyā sparśastu viṣayo mataḥ /
guṇau sparśaninādau dvāvekaḥ kāraṇamīśvaraḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रिये त्वक्करावस्या स्पर्शस्तु विषयो मतः /
गुणौ स्पर्शनिनादौ द्वावेकः कारणमीश्वरः //
text_mt: Its two sense-organs are the skin and the hand; touch is considered its sense-object; / the two qualities are touch and sound; the single causal deity is Īśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
turmyāvastheti śāntisthaṃ sambhāvya bhuvanādikaṃ /
vidadhyāttāḍanaṃ bhedaṃ praveśañca viyojanaṃ //
meaning:
तुर्म्यावस्थेति शान्तिस्थं सम्भाव्य भुवनादिकं /
विदध्यात्ताडनं भेदं प्रवेशञ्च वियोजनं //
text_mt: The fourth state (turīya) is its state. Visualizing the worlds and the rest residing in Śānti, / one should carry out striking, splitting, entering, and unlinking.

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣya grahaṇaṃ kuryācchāntervadanasūtrataḥ /
ātmanyāropya saṅgṛhya kalāṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet //
meaning:
आकृष्य ग्रहणं कुर्याच्छान्तेर्वदनसूत्रतः /
आत्मन्यारोप्य सङ्गृह्य कलां कुण्डे निवेशयेत् //
text_mt: Drawing [the soul] out, one should grasp it from the thread of Śānti's mouth; / imposing it upon oneself and grasping the Kalā, one should place it in the fire-pit.

sanskrit_iast:
īśaṃ tavādhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ /
bhavyaṃ tvayānukūlena(4) kuryāt vijñāpanāmiti //
meaning:
ईशं तवाधिकारे ऽस्मिन् मुमुक्षुं दीक्षयाम्यहं /
भव्यं त्वयानुकूलेन(4) कुर्यात् विज्ञापनामिति //
text_mt: “O Lord, in this jurisdiction of yours I initiate one desiring liberation; / you must be favorably disposed towards him”—thus one should make petition.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhanādikaṃ pitroḥ śiṣyasya tāḍanādikaṃ /
:n
1 sūkṣmāsūkṣmeśvaraś caiva iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 vyomavyāpakarūpāya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / vyomarūpāyeti
ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 dhyāyaparāyeti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / vyānāhārāyeti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 bhāvyaṃ tvayā ca śuddhena iti ga, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 276
vidhāyādāya caitanyaṃ vidhinā.atmani yojayet //
meaning:
आवाहनादिकं पित्रोः शिष्यस्य ताडनादिकं /
:न्
1 सूक्ष्मासूक्ष्मेश्वरश् चैव इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 व्योमव्यापकरूपाय इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / व्योमरूपायेति
ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 ध्यायपरायेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / व्यानाहारायेति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 भाव्यं त्वया च शुद्धेन इति ग, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 276
विधायादाय चैतन्यं विधिना.अत्मनि योजयेत् //
text_mt:
The invocation and other rites of the parents, the striking and other rites of the disciple,
[Gap in text]
1. "sūkṣmāsūkṣmeśvaraś caiva" is the reading of the book marked ga.
2. "vyomavyāpakarūpāya" is the reading of the book marked kha; "vyomarūpāya" is the reading of the book marked ga.
3. "dhyānaparāya" is the reading of the book marked kha; "vyānāhārāya" is the reading of the book marked ga.
4. "bhāvyaṃ tvayā ca śuddhena" is the reading of the books marked ga and ṅa. / [p. 276]
having performed, and taking consciousness, one should unite it with oneself according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavat pitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā /
hṛtsampuṭātmavījena devīgarbhe niyojayet //
meaning:
पूर्ववत् पितृसंयोगं भावयित्वोद्भवाख्यया /
हृत्सम्पुटात्मवीजेन देवीगर्भे नियोजयेत् //
text_mt: Visualizing the union of the parents as before by means of the [mantra] named Udbhava, / one should place it in the womb of the goddess with one's own seed-syllable enclosed by the Hṛd [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
dehotpattau hṛdā pañca śirasā janmahetave /
śikhayā vādhikārāya bhogāya kavacāṇunā //
meaning:
देहोत्पत्तौ हृदा पञ्च शिरसा जन्महेतवे /
शिखया वाधिकाराय भोगाय कवचाणुना //
text_mt: For the production of the body, [five oblations] with the Hṛd mantra; five with the Śiras for the sake of birth; / with the Śikhā for qualification; for experience with the Kavaca mantra;

sanskrit_iast:
layāya śastramantreṇa śrotaḥśuddhau śivena ca /
tattvaśuddhau hṛdā hy evaṃ garbhādhānādi pūrvavat //
meaning:
लयाय शस्त्रमन्त्रेण श्रोतःशुद्धौ शिवेन च /
तत्त्वशुद्धौ हृदा ह्य् एवं गर्भाधानादि पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: for dissolution with the Śastra (Astra) mantra; for purification of the faculties with Śiva; / and for purification of the cosmic principles with the Hṛd mantra. Thus the impregnation and other rites are as before.

sanskrit_iast:
varmaṇā pāśaśaithilyaṃ niṣkṛtyaivaṃ śataṃ japet /
malaśaktitirodhane śastreṇāhutipañcakaṃ //
meaning:
वर्मणा पाशशैथिल्यं निष्कृत्यैवं शतं जपेत् /
मलशक्तितिरोधने शस्त्रेणाहुतिपञ्चकं //
text_mt: For loosening the bonds, one should repeat [the mantra] with the Varma (Kavaca) a hundred times for expiation; / for concealing the power of impurity, five oblations with the weapon (Astra) mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pāśaviyoge 'pi(1) tataḥ saptāstrajaptayā /
chindyādastreṇa kartaryā pāśānvījavatā yathā //
oṃ hauṃ(2) śāntikalāpāśāya haḥ hūṃ phaṭ
meaning:
एवं पाशवियोगे ऽपि(1) ततः सप्तास्त्रजप्तया /
छिन्द्यादस्त्रेण कर्तर्या पाशान्वीजवता यथा //
ओं हौं(2) शान्तिकलापाशाय हः हूं फट्
text_mt:
Likewise, in unlinking the bonds, one should then, with the Astra recited seven times, / cut the bonds by means of the Astra as a pair of scissors, endowed with the seed-syllable.
"Oṃ hauṃ, to the bond of the Śānti-kalā: haḥ hūṃ phaṭ!"

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjya vartulīkṛtya pāśamantreṇa pūrvavat /
ghṛtapūrṇe śruve datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet //
meaning:
विसृज्य वर्तुलीकृत्य पाशमन्त्रेण पूर्ववत् /
घृतपूर्णे श्रुवे दत्वा कलास्त्रेणैव होमयेत् //
text_mt: Having released [the bonds] and rolled them into a ball, as before, with the bond mantra, / placing them in a ladle filled with ghee, he should offer them into the fire with the weapon mantra of the [Śānti]-kalā.

sanskrit_iast:
astreṇa juhuyāt pañca pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye /
prāyaścittaniṣedhāya dadyādaṣṭāhutīratha //
oṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ
meaning:
अस्त्रेण जुहुयात् पञ्च पाशाङ्कुशनिवृत्तये /
प्रायश्चित्तनिषेधाय दद्यादष्टाहुतीरथ //
ओं हः अस्त्राय हूं फट्
text_mt:
He should offer five oblations with the weapon [mantra] to remove the bond-goad; / then he should offer eight oblations to counteract [any need for] expiation.
"Oṃ haḥ to the weapon: hūṃ phaṭ!"

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdeśvaraṃ samāvāhya kṛtvā pūjanatarpaṇe /
vidadhīta vidhānena tasmai śulkasamarpaṇaṃ //
oṃ hāṃ īśvara buddhyahaṅkārau śulkaṃ gṛhāṇa
svāhā
meaning:
हृदेश्वरं समावाह्य कृत्वा पूजनतर्पणे /
विदधीत विधानेन तस्मै शुल्कसमर्पणं //
ओं हां ईश्वर बुद्ध्यहङ्कारौ शुल्कं गृहाण
स्वाहा
text_mt:
Having invoked Īśvara with the heart [mantra] and performed worship and libation, / he should duly present the toll to him according to rule:
"Oṃ hāṃ, Īśvara, accept the intellect and ego as your toll, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast:
niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasyeśvara tvayā /
na stheyaṃ bandhakatvena śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti //
:n
1 ekaṃ pāśaviyogārthamiti ga, gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hy aimiti ka, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ omiti ga,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ yaimiti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 277
meaning:
निःशेषदग्धपाशस्य पशोरस्येश्वर त्वया /
न स्थेयं बन्धकत्वेन शिवाज्ञां श्रावयेदिति //
:न्
1 एकं पाशवियोगार्थमिति ग, घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं ह्य् ऐमिति क, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं ओमिति ग,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं यैमिति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 277
text_mt:
"O Īśvara, of this bound soul whose bonds are completely burned away, / you must not remain as a binder!" Thus he should proclaim Śiva's command.
[Notes]
1 "ekaṃ pāśaviyogārtham" is the reading in the books marked ga and gha.
2 "oṃ hy aim" is the reading in the books marked ka and ṅa; "oṃ om" is the reading in ga; "oṃ yaim" is the reading in gha. / [p. 277]

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjedīśvarandevaṃ raudrātmānaṃ niyojayet /
īṣaccandramivātmānaṃ vidhinā.atmani yojayet //
meaning:
विसृजेदीश्वरन्देवं रौद्रात्मानं नियोजयेत् /
ईषच्चन्द्रमिवात्मानं विधिना.अत्मनि योजयेत् //
text_mt: He should dismiss the god Īśvara and apply his Rudra nature; / he should duly unite the soul, shining slightly like the moon, into his own soul.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtre saṃyojayedenaṃ śuddhayodbhavamudrayā /
dadyāt mūlena śiṣyasya śirasyamṛtavindukaṃ //
meaning:
सूत्रे संयोजयेदेनं शुद्धयोद्भवमुद्रया /
दद्यात् मूलेन शिष्यस्य शिरस्यमृतविन्दुकं //
text_mt: He should unite this [soul] into the cord with the pure Udvhava-mudrā; / with the root mantra, he should place a drop of nectar upon the disciple's head.

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjya pitarau vahneḥ pūjitau kusumādibhiḥ /
dadyāt pūrṇāṃ vidhānajño niḥśeṣavidhipūraṇīṃ //
meaning:
विसृज्य पितरौ वह्नेः पूजितौ कुसुमादिभिः /
दद्यात् पूर्णां विधानज्ञो निःशेषविधिपूरणीं //
text_mt: Having dismissed the parents of the fire after worshipping them with flowers and other offerings, / the knower of the ritual should offer the full oblation that completes every rite without remainder.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāmapi vidhātavyaṃ pūrvavattāḍanādiakaṃ /
svavījantu viśeṣaḥ syācchuddhiḥ śānterapīḍitā //
:e ity ādimahāpurāṇe āgneye nirvāṇadīkṣāyāṃ
śāntiśodhanaṃ nāma saptaśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
nirvāṇadīkṣākathanaṃ
meaning:
अस्यामपि विधातव्यं पूर्ववत्ताडनादिअकं /
स्ववीजन्तु विशेषः स्याच्छुद्धिः शान्तेरपीडिता //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहापुराणे आग्नेये निर्वाणदीक्षायां
शान्तिशोधनं नाम सप्तशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः
निर्वाणदीक्षाकथनं
text_mt:
In this [kalā] also, striking and the other rites should be performed as before; / the distinction lies in its own seed-syllable, and the purification of Śānti is thus accomplished.
Thus ends the eighty-seventh chapter, entitled "Purification of Śānti in the Liberating Initiation," in the great and ancient Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the eighty-eighth chapter:
Instruction on Liberating Initiation.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
sandhānaṃ śāntyatītāyāḥ śāntyā sārdhaṃ viśuddhayā /
kurvīta pūrvavattatra tattvavarṇādi tad yathā //
oṃ hīṃ kṣauṃ hauṃ hāṃ iti sandhānāni
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
सन्धानं शान्त्यतीतायाः शान्त्या सार्धं विशुद्धया /
कुर्वीत पूर्ववत्तत्र तत्त्ववर्णादि तद् यथा //
ओं हीं क्षौं हौं हां इति सन्धानानि
text_mt:
The Lord said: / One should perform the junction of Śāntyatītā together with the purified Śānti / as before; there the principles, phonemes, and so forth are as follows:
"Oṃ hīṃ kṣauṃ hauṃ hāṃ"—these are the junctions.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhau śaktiśivau tattve bhuvanāṣṭakasiddhikaṃ /
dīpakaṃ rocikañcaiva mocakaṃ cordhvagāmi ca //
meaning:
उभौ शक्तिशिवौ तत्त्वे भुवनाष्टकसिद्धिकं /
दीपकं रोचिकञ्चैव मोचकं चोर्ध्वगामि च //
text_mt: Both Śakti and Śiva are the principles; the eight worlds to be attained are: / Dīpaka, Rocika, Mocaka, Ūrdhvagāmin,

sanskrit_iast:
vyomarūpamanāthañca syādanāśritanaṣṭamaṃ /
oṅkārapadamīśāne mantro varṇāś ca ṣoḍaśa //
meaning:
व्योमरूपमनाथञ्च स्यादनाश्रितनष्टमं /
ओङ्कारपदमीशाने मन्त्रो वर्णाश् च षोडश //
text_mt: Vyomarūpa, Anātha, and Anāśrita is the eighth; / the word is the Oṅkāra in the Īśāna [direction]; the mantra and sixteen phonemes:

sanskrit_iast:
akārādivisargāntā vījena dehakārakau /
kuhūś ca śaṅkhinī nāḍyau devadattadhanañjayau //
meaning:
अकारादिविसर्गान्ता वीजेन देहकारकौ /
कुहूश् च शङ्खिनी नाड्यौ देवदत्तधनञ्जयौ //
text_mt: Beginning with "a" and ending with visarga; the body-makers through the seed-syllable; / the channels are Kuhū and Śaṅkhinī; the two winds Devadatta and Dhanañjaya;

sanskrit_iast:
marutau sparśanaṃ śrotraṃ indriye viṣayo nabhaḥ /
:p 278
śabdo guṇo 'syāvasthā tu turyātītā tu pañcamī //
meaning:
मरुतौ स्पर्शनं श्रोत्रं इन्द्रिये विषयो नभः /
:प् 278
शब्दो गुणो ऽस्यावस्था तु तुर्यातीता तु पञ्चमी //

sanskrit_iast:
hetuḥ sadāśivo deva iti tattvādisañcayaṃ /
sañcintya śāntyatītākhyaṃ vidadhyāttāḍanādikaṃ //
meaning:
हेतुः सदाशिवो देव इति तत्त्वादिसञ्चयं /
सञ्चिन्त्य शान्त्यतीताख्यं विदध्यात्ताडनादिकं //
text_mt: The presiding cause is the god Sadāśiva. Having thus contemplated the collection of principles / belonging to Śāntyatītā, he should perform striking and the other rites.

sanskrit_iast:
kalāpāśaṃ samātāḍya phaḍantena vibhidya ca /
praviśyāntar namo 'ntena phaḍantena viyojayet //
meaning:
कलापाशं समाताड्य फडन्तेन विभिद्य च /
प्रविश्यान्तर् नमो ऽन्तेन फडन्तेन वियोजयेत् //
text_mt: Having struck the bond of the kalā, pierced it with [a mantra] ending in "phaṭ", / entered within with [one] ending in "namaḥ", he should sever it with [one] ending in "phaṭ".

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāhṛtsampuṭībhūtaṃ svāhāntaṃ sṛṇimudrayā /
pūrakeṇa samākṛṣya pāśaṃ mastakasūtrataḥ //
meaning:
शिखाहृत्सम्पुटीभूतं स्वाहान्तं सृणिमुद्रया /
पूरकेण समाकृष्य पाशं मस्तकसूत्रतः //
text_mt: Enclosed by the crest and heart [mantras] and ending in "svāhā", with the goad gesture, / drawing the bond out from the cord on the head by inhalation,

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhakena samādāya recakenodbhavākhyayā /
hṛtsampuṭanamo 'ntena vahniṃ kuṇḍe niveśayet //
meaning:
कुम्भकेन समादाय रेचकेनोद्भवाख्यया /
हृत्सम्पुटनमो ऽन्तेन वह्निं कुण्डे निवेशयेत् //
text_mt: Holding it by retention, and by exhalation with the gesture called Udbhava / and [the mantra] enclosed by the heart and ending in "namaḥ", he should deposit it in the fire in the fire-pit.

sanskrit_iast:
asyāḥ pūjādikaṃ sarvaṃ nivṛtteriva sādhayet /
sadāśivaṃ samāvāhya pūjayitvā pratarpya ca //
meaning:
अस्याः पूजादिकं सर्वं निवृत्तेरिव साधयेत् /
सदाशिवं समावाह्य पूजयित्वा प्रतर्प्य च //
text_mt: He should perform all the worship and other rites of this [kalā] just like those of Nivṛtti; / having invoked Sadāśiva, worshipped him, and offered libation,

sanskrit_iast:
sadā khyāte 'dhikāre 'smin mumukṣuṃ dīkṣayāmyahaṃ /
bhāvyaṃ tvayānukūlena bhaktyā vijñāpayediti //
meaning:
सदा ख्याते ऽधिकारे ऽस्मिन् मुमुक्षुं दीक्षयाम्यहं /
भाव्यं त्वयानुकूलेन भक्त्या विज्ञापयेदिति //
text_mt: He should devoutly address him thus: "In this jurisdiction that is ever renowned, I initiate one who desires liberation; / you should be favorable [to him]!"

sanskrit_iast:
pitrorāvāhanaṃ pūjāṃ kṛtvā tarpaṇasannidhī /
hṛtsampuṭātmavījena śiṣyaṃ vakṣasi tāḍayet //
oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ
meaning:
पित्रोरावाहनं पूजां कृत्वा तर्पणसन्निधी /
हृत्सम्पुटात्मवीजेन शिष्यं वक्षसि ताडयेत् //
ओं हां हूं हं फट्
text_mt:
Having performed the invocation and worship of the [divine] parents and libation in their presence, / he should strike the disciple on the chest with his own seed-syllable enclosed by the heart [mantra]:
"Oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ!"

sanskrit_iast:
praviśya cāpyanenaiva caitanyaṃ vibhajettataḥ /
śastreṇa pāśasaṃyuktaṃ jyeṣṭhayāṅkuśamudrayā //
oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ(1)
meaning:
प्रविश्य चाप्यनेनैव चैतन्यं विभजेत्ततः /
शस्त्रेण पाशसंयुक्तं ज्येष्ठयाङ्कुशमुद्रया //
ओं हां हूं हं फट्(1)
text_mt:
And entering with this very [mantra], he should then separate consciousness / bound to the bond with the weapon [mantra], using the supreme goad gesture.
"Oṃ hāṃ hūṃ haṃ phaṭ!"

sanskrit_iast:
svāhāntena tadākṛṣya tenaiva puṭitātmanā /
gṛhītvā tannamo 'ntena nijātmani niyojayet //
oṃ hāṃ haṃ hīṃ ātmane namaḥ(2)
:n
1 oṃ hāṃ huṃ haḥ phaṭ iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 oṃ hāṃ haṃ hrīmātmane nama iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 279
meaning:
स्वाहान्तेन तदाकृष्य तेनैव पुटितात्मना /
गृहीत्वा तन्नमो ऽन्तेन निजात्मनि नियोजयेत् //
ओं हां हं हीं आत्मने नमः(2)
:न्
1 ओं हां हुं हः फट् इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 ओं हां हं ह्रीमात्मने नम इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 279
text_mt:
Drawing it out with [the mantra] ending in "svāhā", with the self enclosed by that very [mantra], / taking it with [the mantra] ending in "namaḥ", he should unite it into his own soul:
"Oṃ hāṃ haṃ hīṃ to the soul, namaḥ!"
[Notes]
1 "oṃ hāṃ huṃ haḥ phaṭ" is the reading in the book marked kha.
2 "oṃ hāṃ haṃ hrīmātmane namaḥ" is the reading in the book marked kha. / [p. 279]

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavat pitṛsaṃyogaṃ bhāvayitvodbhavākhyayā /
vāmayā tadanenaiva(1) devyā garbhe niyojayet //
meaning:
पूर्ववत् पितृसंयोगं भावयित्वोद्भवाख्यया /
वामया तदनेनैव(1) देव्या गर्भे नियोजयेत् //
text_mt: Having meditated on the union of the parents as before, with the [gesture] called Udbhava, / he should deposit [the soul] into the womb of the goddess with Vāmā and with this very [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
garbhādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvoktavidhinā caret /
mūlena pāśaśaithilye niṣkṛtyaiva śataṃ japet //
meaning:
गर्भाधानादिकं सर्वं पूर्वोक्तविधिना चरेत् /
मूलेन पाशशैथिल्ये निष्कृत्यैव शतं जपेत् //
text_mt: He should perform all [rites] such as impregnation according to the previously stated rule; / with the root mantra, having performed expiation for the loosening of the bonds, he should recite a hundred times.

sanskrit_iast:
malaśaktitirodhāne pāśānāñca viyojane /
pañcapañcāhutīrdadyādāyudhena yathā purā //
meaning:
मलशक्तितिरोधाने पाशानाञ्च वियोजने /
पञ्चपञ्चाहुतीर्दद्यादायुधेन यथा पुरा //
text_mt: For the obscuration of the power of impurity and the severing of the bonds, / he should offer five oblations for each with the weapon [mantra] as before.

sanskrit_iast:
pāśānāyudhamantreṇa sapravārābhijaptayā /
chindyādastreṇa kartaryā kalāvījayujā yathā //
oṃ hāṃ śāntyatītakalāpāśāya haḥ hūṃ phaṭ
meaning:
पाशानायुधमन्त्रेण सप्रवाराभिजप्तया /
छिन्द्यादस्त्रेण कर्तर्या कलावीजयुजा यथा //
ओं हां शान्त्यतीतकलापाशाय हः हूं फट्
text_mt:
With the weapon mantra consecrated with a single recitation, / he should cut the bonds with scissors [formed of] the weapon [mantra] joined with the seed-syllable of the kalā, as before:
"Oṃ hāṃ, to the bond of the Śāntyatīta-kalā: haḥ hūṃ phaṭ!"

sanskrit_iast:
visṛjya vartulīkṛtya pāśānastreṇa pūrvavat /
ghṛtapūrṇe śruve datvā kalāstreṇaiva homayet //
meaning:
विसृज्य वर्तुलीकृत्य पाशानस्त्रेण पूर्ववत् /
घृतपूर्णे श्रुवे दत्वा कलास्त्रेणैव होमयेत् //
text_mt: Having released the bonds and rolled them into a ball with the weapon [mantra] as before, / placing them in a ladle filled with ghee, he should offer them into the fire with the weapon mantra of the kalā.

sanskrit_iast:
astreṇa juhuyāt pajca pāśāṅkuśanivṛttaye /
prāyaścittaniṣedhārthaṃ dadyādaṣṭāhutīstataḥ //
meaning:
अस्त्रेण जुहुयात् पज्च पाशाङ्कुशनिवृत्तये /
प्रायश्चित्तनिषेधार्थं दद्यादष्टाहुतीस्ततः //
text_mt: He should offer five oblations with the weapon [mantra] to remove the bond-goad; / then he should offer eight oblations to prevent [any need for] expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivaṃ hṛdāvāhya kṛtvā pūjanatarpaṇe /
pūrvoktavidhinā kuryādadhikārasamarpaṇaṃ //
oṃ hāṃ sadāśiva manovindu śulkaṃ gṛhāṇa svāhā
meaning:
सदाशिवं हृदावाह्य कृत्वा पूजनतर्पणे /
पूर्वोक्तविधिना कुर्यादधिकारसमर्पणं //
ओं हां सदाशिव मनोविन्दु शुल्कं गृहाण स्वाहा
text_mt:
Having invoked Sadāśiva with the heart [mantra] and performed worship and libation, / he should make the offering of the jurisdiction according to the previously stated rule:
"Oṃ hāṃ, Sadāśiva, accept the mind and bindu as your toll, svāhā!"

sanskrit_iast:
niḥśeṣadagdhapāśasya paśorasya sadāśiva /
bandhāya na tvayā stheyaṃ śivājñāṃ śrāvayediti //
meaning:
निःशेषदग्धपाशस्य पशोरस्य सदाशिव /
बन्धाय न त्वया स्थेयं शिवाज्ञां श्रावयेदिति //
text_mt: "O Sadāśiva, of this bound soul whose bonds are completely burned away, / you must not remain for bonding!" Thus he should proclaim Śiva's command.

sanskrit_iast:
mūlena juhuyāt pūrṇāṃ visṛjettu sadāśivaṃ /
tato viśuddhamātmānaṃ śaraccandramivoditaṃ //
meaning:
मूलेन जुहुयात् पूर्णां विसृजेत्तु सदाशिवं /
ततो विशुद्धमात्मानं शरच्चन्द्रमिवोदितं //
text_mt: He should offer the full oblation with the root mantra and dismiss Sadāśiva; / then [regarding] the purified soul risen like an autumn moon,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃhāramudrayā raudryā saṃyojya gururātmani /
kurvīta śiṣyadehasthamuddhṛtyodbhavamudrayā //
meaning:
संहारमुद्रया रौद्र्या संयोज्य गुरुरात्मनि /
कुर्वीत शिष्यदेहस्थमुद्धृत्योद्भवमुद्रया //
text_mt: Uniting it into himself by the fierce Saṃhāra-mudrā, the guru / should extract it with the Udbhava-mudrā and place it in the disciple's body.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādāpyāyanāyāsya mastake 'rghyāmbuvindukaṃ /
kṣamayitvā mahābhaktyā pitarau visṛjettathā //
:n
1 vāmayā hṛdayenaiveti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 280
meaning:
दद्यादाप्यायनायास्य मस्तके ऽर्घ्याम्बुविन्दुकं /
क्षमयित्वा महाभक्त्या पितरौ विसृजेत्तथा //
:न्
1 वामया हृदयेनैवेति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 280
text_mt:
To invigorate him, he should place a drop of water from the water offering upon his head; / having asked forgiveness with great devotion, he should likewise dismiss the [divine] parents:
[Notes]
1 "vāmayā hṛdayenaiva" is the reading in the book marked ga. / [p. 280]

sanskrit_iast:
kheditau śiṣyadīkṣāyai yanmayā pitarau yuvāṃ /
kāruṇyanānmokṣayitvā tadvraja tvaṃ sthānamātmanaḥ //
meaning:
खेदितौ शिष्यदीक्षायै यन्मया पितरौ युवां /
कारुण्यनान्मोक्षयित्वा तद्व्रज त्वं स्थानमात्मनः //
text_mt: "O parents, because you were troubled by me for the initiation of the disciple, / release [me] out of compassion; therefore go to your own abode!"

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāmantritakartaryā bodhaśaktisvarūpiṇīṃ /
śikhāṃ chidyācchivāstreṇa śiṣyasya caturaṅgulāṃ //
oṃ klīṃ śikhāyai hūṃ phaṭ(1) oṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ
phaṭ
meaning:
शिखामन्त्रितकर्तर्या बोधशक्तिस्वरूपिणीं /
शिखां छिद्याच्छिवास्त्रेण शिष्यस्य चतुरङ्गुलां //
ओं क्लीं शिखायै हूं फट्(1) ओं हः अस्त्राय हूं
फट्
text_mt:
With scissors consecrated with the crest mantra, he should cut the disciple's topknot, / four fingers [long], embodying the power of awareness, with the weapon mantra of Śiva:
"Oṃ klīṃ to the crest: hūṃ phaṭ! Oṃ haḥ to the weapon: hūṃ phaṭ!"

sanskrit_iast:
sruci tāṃ ghṛtapūrṇāyāṃ goviḍgolakamadhyagāṃ(2) /
saṃvidhāyāstramantreṇa hūṃ phaḍantena homayet //
oṃ hauṃ haḥ astrāya hūṃ phaṭ
meaning:
स्रुचि तां घृतपूर्णायां गोविड्गोलकमध्यगां(2) /
संविधायास्त्रमन्त्रेण हूं फडन्तेन होमयेत् //
ओं हौं हः अस्त्राय हूं फट्
text_mt:
Placing it inside a ball of cow dung in an offering spoon filled with clarified butter, / he should offer it as a fire oblation with the weapon mantra ending in hūṃ phaṭ.
“Oṃ hauṃ haḥ, to the weapon, hūṃ phaṭ!”

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣālya sruksruvau śiṣyaṃ saṃsnāpyācamya ca svayaṃ /
yojanikāsthānamātmānaṃ śastramantreṇa tāḍayet //
meaning:
प्रक्षाल्य स्रुक्स्रुवौ शिष्यं संस्नाप्याचम्य च स्वयं /
योजनिकास्थानमात्मानं शस्त्रमन्त्रेण ताडयेत् //
text_mt: Having washed the two ladles, bathed the disciple, and sipped water himself, / he should strike his own self, the site of union, with the weapon mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
viyojyākṛṣya sampūjya(3) pūrvavad dvādaśāntataḥ /
ātmīyahṛdayāmbhojakarṇikāyāṃ niveśayet //
meaning:
वियोज्याकृष्य सम्पूज्य(3) पूर्ववद् द्वादशान्ततः /
आत्मीयहृदयाम्भोजकर्णिकायां निवेशयेत् //
text_mt: Having detached, drawn forth, and worshipped [it] as before, from the dvādaśānta, / he should place [it] in the pericarp of the lotus of his own heart.

sanskrit_iast:
pūritaṃ śruvamājyena vihitādhomukhaśrucā /
nityoktavidhinā.adāya śaṅkhasannibhamudrayā //
meaning:
पूरितं श्रुवमाज्येन विहिताधोमुखश्रुचा /
नित्योक्तविधिना.अदाय शङ्खसन्निभमुद्रया //
text_mt: Having taken up the sruva filled with clarified butter with the sruc turned downwards, / according to the procedure stated for daily rites, using the gesture resembling a conch,

sanskrit_iast:
prasāritaśirogrīvo nādoccārānusārataḥ /
samadṛṣṭiśivaścāntaḥ parabhāvasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रसारितशिरोग्रीवो नादोच्चारानुसारतः /
समदृष्टिशिवश्चान्तः परभावसमन्वितः //
text_mt: with head and neck stretched out, following the resonance of the nāda, / with an even gaze, composed within, endowed with the supreme state,

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhamaṇḍalavahnibhyaḥ(4) śiṣyādapi nijātmanaḥ /
gṛhītvā ṣaḍvidhavidhānaṃ śrugagre prāṇanāḍikaṃ //
meaning:
कुम्भमण्डलवह्निभ्यः(4) शिष्यादपि निजात्मनः /
गृहीत्वा षड्विधविधानं श्रुगग्रे प्राणनाडिकं //
text_mt: taking from the pot, the maṇḍala, the fire, / from the disciple, and also from himself, the sixfold order [of the channels] of the prāṇa-nāḍī at the tip of the sruc,

sanskrit_iast:
sañcintya vinduvad dhyātvā kramaśaḥ saptadhā yathā /
prathamaṃ prāṇasaṃyogasvarūpamaparantataḥ //
:n
1 oṃ hūṃ śikhāyai hūṃ phaṭ iti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
/ oṃ hrīṃ śikhāyai hraṃ phaḍiti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
2 govindalokamadhyagāmiti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 viyojyākṛṣya saṅgṛhyeti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 kuṇḍamaṇḍalavahnibhya iti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 281
meaning:
सञ्चिन्त्य विन्दुवद् ध्यात्वा क्रमशः सप्तधा यथा /
प्रथमं प्राणसंयोगस्वरूपमपरन्ततः //
:न्
1 ओं हूं शिखायै हूं फट् इति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
/ ओं ह्रीं शिखायै ह्रं फडिति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
2 गोविन्दलोकमध्यगामिति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
3 वियोज्याकृष्य सङ्गृह्येति ख, ङ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 कुण्डमण्डलवह्निभ्य इति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 281
text_mt:
contemplating [it] as a bindu, meditating [on it] progressively as sevenfold: / first the nature of the conjunction of prāṇa, and then the next.
[Gap in text]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note]

sanskrit_iast:
hṛdayādikramoccāravisṛṣṭaṃ mantrasañjñakaṃ /
pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā vyādāya vadanaṃ manāk //
meaning:
हृदयादिक्रमोच्चारविसृष्टं मन्त्रसञ्ज्ञकं /
पूरकं कुम्भकं कृत्वा व्यादाय वदनं मनाक् //
text_mt: Uttered in sequence from the heart and so forth, emitted and called mantra; / having performed inhalation and retention, opening the mouth slightly,

sanskrit_iast:
suṣumṇānugataṃ nādasvarūpantu tṛtīyakaṃ /
saptame kāraṇe tyāgātpraśāntavikharaṃ layaḥ //
meaning:
सुषुम्णानुगतं नादस्वरूपन्तु तृतीयकं /
सप्तमे कारणे त्यागात्प्रशान्तविखरं लयः //
text_mt: the third is that which follows the suṣumṇā and has the nature of nāda; / by renunciation at the seventh cause, dissolution is the tranquil peak.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktinādordhvasañcārastacchaktivikharaṃ mataṃ /
prāṇasya nikhilasyāpi śaktiprameyavarjitaṃ //
meaning:
शक्तिनादोर्ध्वसञ्चारस्तच्छक्तिविखरं मतं /
प्राणस्य निखिलस्यापि शक्तिप्रमेयवर्जितं //
text_mt: The upward movement of energy and sound is considered the peak of energy; / devoid of the knowables of energy, of the entire prāṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
tatkālavikharaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ śaktyatītañca saptamaṃ /
tadetad yojanāsthānaṃ vikharantattvasañjñakaṃ //
meaning:
तत्कालविखरं षष्ठं शक्त्यतीतञ्च सप्तमं /
तदेतद् योजनास्थानं विखरन्तत्त्वसञ्ज्ञकं //
text_mt: the sixth is the peak of time, and the seventh transcends energy. / That is the place of union, called the highest principle.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrakaṃ kumbhakaṃ kṛtvā vyādāya vadanaṃ manāk /
śanair udīrayan mūlaṃ kṛtvā śiṣyātmano layaṃ //
meaning:
पूरकं कुम्भकं कृत्वा व्यादाय वदनं मनाक् /
शनैर् उदीरयन् मूलं कृत्वा शिष्यात्मनो लयं //
text_mt: Having performed inhalation and retention, opening the mouth slightly, / softly uttering the root mantra, having effected the dissolution of the disciple's self

sanskrit_iast:
hakāre taḍidākāre ṣaḍadhvajaprāṇarūpiṇi /
ukāraṃ parato nābhervitastiṃ vyāpya saṃsthitaṃ //
meaning:
हकारे तडिदाकारे षडध्वजप्राणरूपिणि /
उकारं परतो नाभेर्वितस्तिं व्याप्य संस्थितं //
text_mt: into the syllable Ha, which has the form of lightning and the nature of the vital breath of the six pathways; / then the syllable U, situated occupying a span from the navel;

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ paraṃ makārantu hṛdayāccaturaṅgulaṃ /
oṅkāraṃ vācakaṃ viṣṇostato 'ṣṭāṅgulakaṇṭhakaṃ //
meaning:
ततः परं मकारन्तु हृदयाच्चतुरङ्गुलं /
ओङ्कारं वाचकं विष्णोस्ततो ऽष्टाङ्गुलकण्ठकं //
text_mt: then beyond that, the syllable Ma, four fingers above the heart; / the oṅkāra, expressing Viṣṇu, eight fingers from there up to the throat;

sanskrit_iast:
caturaṅgulatālusthaṃ makāraṃ rudravācakaṃ /
tadvallalāṭamadhyasthaṃ vindumīśvaravācakaṃ //
meaning:
चतुरङ्गुलतालुस्थं मकारं रुद्रवाचकं /
तद्वल्ललाटमध्यस्थं विन्दुमीश्वरवाचकं //
text_mt: the syllable Ma situated in the palate, four fingers [above], expressing Rudra; / likewise the bindu situated in the middle of the forehead, expressing Īśvara;

sanskrit_iast:
nādaṃ sadāśivaṃ devaṃ brahmarandhrāvasānakaṃ /
śaktiṃ ca brahmarandhrasthāṃ tyajannityamanukramāt //
meaning:
नादं सदाशिवं देवं ब्रह्मरन्ध्रावसानकं /
शक्तिं च ब्रह्मरन्ध्रस्थां त्यजन्नित्यमनुक्रमात् //
text_mt: nāda, [which is] the god Sadāśiva, ending at the brahmarandhra; / and leaving the energy located in the brahmarandhra in this regular order,

sanskrit_iast:
divyaṃ pipīlikāsparśaṃ tasminnevānubhūya ca /
dvādaśānte pare tattve paramānandalakṣaṇe //
meaning:
दिव्यं पिपीलिकास्पर्शं तस्मिन्नेवानुभूय च /
द्वादशान्ते परे तत्त्वे परमानन्दलक्षणे //
text_mt: and experiencing in that very state the divine sensation [like] crawling ants, / in the supreme principle at the dvādaśānta, characterized by supreme bliss,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvaśūnye mano 'tīte śive nityaguṇodaye /
vilīya mānase tasmin śiṣyātmānaṃ vibhāvayet //
meaning:
भावशून्ये मनो ऽतीते शिवे नित्यगुणोदये /
विलीय मानसे तस्मिन् शिष्यात्मानं विभावयेत् //
text_mt: in Śiva, devoid of objective existence, beyond the mind, in whom eternal qualities arise; / having dissolved [it] mentally therein, he should meditate on the disciple's self,

sanskrit_iast:
vimuñcan sarpiṣo dhārāṃ jvālānte 'pi pare śive /
yojanikāsthiratvāya vauṣaḍantaśivāṇunā(1) //
:n
1 vauṣaḍantaśivātmaneti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 282
meaning:
विमुञ्चन् सर्पिषो धारां ज्वालान्ते ऽपि परे शिवे /
योजनिकास्थिरत्वाय वौषडन्तशिवाणुना(1) //
:न्
1 वौषडन्तशिवात्मनेति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 282
text_mt:
releasing a stream of clarified butter into the supreme Śiva even at the end of the flame, / with the Śiva-mantra ending in vauṣaṭ, for the stability of the union.

sanskrit_iast:
datvā pūrṇāṃ vidhānena guṇāpadānamacaret /
oṃ hāṃ ātmane(1) sarvajño bhava svāhā / oṃ hāṃ ātmane(2)
paritṛpto bhava svāhā / oṃ hrūṃ ātmane(3) anādibodho bhava svāhā
/ oṃ hauṃ ātmane(4) svatantro bhava svāhā / oṃ hauṃ ātman(5)
aluptaśaktirbhava svāhā / oṃ haḥ ātmane(6) anantaśaktirbhava
svāhāitthaṃ ṣaḍguṇamātmānaṃ gṛhītvā paramākṣarāt //
meaning:
दत्वा पूर्णां विधानेन गुणापदानमचरेत् /
ओं हां आत्मने(1) सर्वज्ञो भव स्वाहा / ओं हां आत्मने(2)
परितृप्तो भव स्वाहा / ओं ह्रूं आत्मने(3) अनादिबोधो भव स्वाहा
/ ओं हौं आत्मने(4) स्वतन्त्रो भव स्वाहा / ओं हौं आत्मन्(5)
अलुप्तशक्तिर्भव स्वाहा / ओं हः आत्मने(6) अनन्तशक्तिर्भव
स्वाहाइत्थं षड्गुणमात्मानं गृहीत्वा परमाक्षरात् //
text_mt:
Having offered the full oblation according to rule, he should perform the conferral of attributes:
“Oṃ hāṃ, to the Self, be omniscient, svāhā! Oṃ hāṃ, to the Self,
be fully satisfied, svāhā! Oṃ hrūṃ, to the Self, be of beginningless wisdom, svāhā!
/ Oṃ hauṃ, to the Self, be independent, svāhā! Oṃ hauṃ, O Self,
be of unfailing power, svāhā! Oṃ haḥ, to the Self, be of boundless power,
svāhā!” Having thus received the self endowed with six qualities from the supreme syllable,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhinā bhāvanopetaḥ śiṣyadehe niyojayet /
tīvrāṇuśaktisampātajanitaśramaśāntaye //
meaning:
विधिना भावनोपेतः शिष्यदेहे नियोजयेत् /
तीव्राणुशक्तिसम्पातजनितश्रमशान्तये //
text_mt: endowed with contemplation according to rule, he should unite it in the body of the disciple. / To calm the fatigue caused by the intense descent of the power of the soul,

sanskrit_iast:
śiṣyamūrdhani vinyasyedarghyādamṛtavindukaṃ /
praṇamayyeśakumbhādīn śivāddakṣiṇamaṇḍale(7) //
meaning:
शिष्यमूर्धनि विन्यस्येदर्घ्यादमृतविन्दुकं /
प्रणमय्येशकुम्भादीन् शिवाद्दक्षिणमण्डले(7) //
text_mt: he should deposit a drop of nectar from the arghya offering on the disciple's head. / Having caused him to bow down to the pot of Īśa and the rest, in the southern circle from Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
saumyavaktraṃ vyavasthāpya śiṣyaṃ dakṣiṇamātmanaḥ /
tvayaivānugṛhīto 'yaṃ mūrtimāsthāya māmakīṃ //
meaning:
सौम्यवक्त्रं व्यवस्थाप्य शिष्यं दक्षिणमात्मनः /
त्वयैवानुगृहीतो ऽयं मूर्तिमास्थाय मामकीं //
text_mt: having placed the disciple to his right, with a pleasant countenance, [the guru prays]: / “This one has been graced by you alone, taking on my form.

sanskrit_iast:
deve vahnau gurau tasmādbhaktiṃ cāpyasya vardhaya(8) /
iti vijñāpya deveśaṃ praṇamya ca guruḥ svayaṃ //

1 oṃ hrīṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hauṃ
ātmanniti gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ

ātmanniti ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
3 oṃ hraiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ ātmanniti ga,
gha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
4 oṃ hraiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ huṃ ātmanniti
ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ / oṃ hauṃ ātmanniti gha, ṅa,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
5 oṃ haiṃ ātmanniti kha, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
7 śivadakṣiṇamaṇḍale iti ga, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
8 bhaktiṃ nāthāsya vardhayeti kha, ṅa, cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 283
meaning:
देवे वह्नौ गुरौ तस्माद्भक्तिं चाप्यस्य वर्धय(8) /
इति विज्ञाप्य देवेशं प्रणम्य च गुरुः स्वयं //
:न्
1 ओं ह्रीं आत्मन्निति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं हौं
आत्मन्निति घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः

3 ओं ह्रैं आत्मन्निति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं आत्मन्निति ग,
घ, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
4 ओं ह्रैं आत्मन्निति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं हुं आत्मन्निति
ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः / ओं हौं आत्मन्निति घ, ङ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
5 ओं हैं आत्मन्निति ख, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
7 शिवदक्षिणमण्डले इति ग, चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः

Therefore, increase his devotion to the god, the fire, and the guru.” / Having thus addressed the Lord of the gods and bowed down himself, the guru

tataḥ paramayā bhaktyā datvā deve 'ṣṭapuṣpikāṃ /
putrakaṃ śivakumbhena saṃsnāpya visṛjenmakhaṃ //

aṣṭāśītitamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||

ekatattvadīkṣākathanaṃ

श्रेयस्तवास्त्विति ब्रूयादाशिषं शिष्यमादरात् /
ततः परमया भक्त्या दत्वा देवे ऽष्टपुष्पिकां /
पुत्रकं शिवकुम्भेन संस्नाप्य विसृजेन्मखं //

अष्टाशीतितमो ऽध्यायः ||
