text_mt:
should respectfully speak the blessing to the disciple: “May you have welfare!” / Then, having offered the eight-flower offering to the god with supreme devotion, / and having bathed the spiritual son with the Śiva-pot, he should conclude the sacrifice.
Thus ends the eighty-eighth chapter, called “The Completion of Liberating Initiation”, in the ancient Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now, eighty-ninth chapter.
The teaching of initiation through a single principle.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
athaikatāttvikī dīkṣā laghutvādupadiśyate /
sūtrabandhādi kurvīta yathāyogaṃ nijātmanā //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
अथैकतात्त्विकी दीक्षा लघुत्वादुपदिश्यते /
सूत्रबन्धादि कुर्वीत यथायोगं निजात्मना //
text_mt: Īśvara said: / Now initiation consisting of a single principle is taught on account of its brevity. / One should perform the binding of the thread and the rest as appropriate with one's own self.

sanskrit_iast:
kālāgnyādiśivāntāni tattvāni parabhāvayet /
samatattve samagrāṇi sūtre maṇigaṇāniva //
meaning:
कालाग्न्यादिशिवान्तानि तत्त्वानि परभावयेत् /
समतत्त्वे समग्राणि सूत्रे मणिगणानिव //
text_mt: He should contemplate the principles from Kālāgni up to Śiva as supreme, / all of them in equal principles, like a collection of gems upon a string.

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhya śivatattvādi garbhādhānādi pūrvavat /
mūlena kintu kurvīta sarvaśulkasamarpaṇaṃ //
meaning:
आवाह्य शिवतत्त्वादि गर्भाधानादि पूर्ववत् /
मूलेन किन्तु कुर्वीत सर्वशुल्कसमर्पणं //
text_mt: Having invoked the Śiva principle and the rest, the impregnation rite and the rest are as before. / But with the root mantra he should perform the surrender of all fees.

sanskrit_iast:
pradadīta tataḥ pūrṇāṃ tattvavātopagarbhitāṃ /
ekayaiva yayā śiṣyo nirvāṇamadhigacchati //
meaning:
प्रददीत ततः पूर्णां तत्त्ववातोपगर्भितां /
एकयैव यया शिष्यो निर्वाणमधिगच्छति //
text_mt: He should then offer the full oblation impregnated with the breath of the principles, / by which alone the disciple attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
yojanāyai śive cānyāṃ sthiratvāpādanāya ca /
datvā pūrṇāṃ prakurvīta śivakumbhābhiṣecanaṃ //

ūnanavatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:p 284
:ś atha navatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ
abhiṣekādikathanaṃ
meaning:
योजनायै शिवे चान्यां स्थिरत्वापादनाय च /
दत्वा पूर्णां प्रकुर्वीत शिवकुम्भाभिषेचनं //
:ए इत्य् आदिमहपुराणे आग्नेये एकतत्त्वदीक्षाकथनं नाम
ऊननवतितमो ऽध्यायः
:प् 284
:श् अथ नवतितमो ऽध्यायः
अभिषेकादिकथनं
text_mt:
And having offered another full oblation for union in Śiva and to bring about stability, / he should perform consecration by aspersion with the Śiva-pot.
Thus ends the eighty-ninth chapter, called “The Teaching of Initiation through a Single Principle”, in the ancient Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now, ninetieth chapter.
The teaching on consecration by aspersion and other rites.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
śivamabhyarcyābhiṣekaṃ kuryācchiṣyādike śriye /
kumbhānīśādikāṣṭhāsu kramaśo nava vinyaset //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
शिवमभ्यर्च्याभिषेकं कुर्याच्छिष्यादिके श्रिये /
कुम्भानीशादिकाष्ठासु क्रमशो नव विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: Īśvara said: / Having worshipped Śiva, one should perform consecration by aspersion for the disciple and others for prosperity. / He should arrange nine pots in sequence in the directions starting with Īśāna.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣu kṣārodaṃ kṣīrodaṃ dadhyudaṃ ghṛtasāgaraṃ /
ikṣukādambarīsvādumastūdānaṣṭasāgarān(1) //
meaning:
तेषु क्षारोदं क्षीरोदं दध्युदं घृतसागरं /
इक्षुकादम्बरीस्वादुमस्तूदानष्टसागरान्(1) //
text_mt: In them, [he places waters representing] the eight oceans: salt water, milk ocean, curd water, clarified butter ocean, / sugarcane juice, wine, sweet water, and whey water.

sanskrit_iast:
niveśayed yathāsaṅkhyamaṣṭau vidyeśvarānatha /
ekaṃ śikhaṇḍinaṃ rudraṃ śrīkaṇṭhantu dvitīyakaṃ //
meaning:
निवेशयेद् यथासङ्ख्यमष्टौ विद्येश्वरानथ /
एकं शिखण्डिनं रुद्रं श्रीकण्ठन्तु द्वितीयकं //
text_mt:
Then one should seat the eight Lord-of-Knowledge deities in order:
first Śikhaṇḍin the Rudra, and Śrīkaṇṭha second,

sanskrit_iast:
trimūrtamekarudrākṣamekanetraṃ śivottamaṃ /
saptamaṃ sūkṣmanāmānamanantaṃ rudramaṣṭamaṃ //
meaning:
त्रिमूर्तमेकरुद्राक्षमेकनेत्रं शिवोत्तमं /
सप्तमं सूक्ष्मनामानमनन्तं रुद्रमष्टमं //
text_mt:
Trimūrti, Ekarudrākṣa, Ekanetra, Śivottama,
the seventh named Sūkṣma, and Ananta the Rudra as the eighth.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye śivaṃ samudrañca śivamantraṃ ca vinyaset /
yāgālayān digīśasya racite snānamaṇḍape //
meaning:
मध्ये शिवं समुद्रञ्च शिवमन्त्रं च विन्यसेत् /
यागालयान् दिगीशस्य रचिते स्नानमण्डपे //
text_mt:
In the center, one should place Śiva, the ocean, and the Śiva mantra.
In a bathing pavilion constructed [facing the direction] of the Regent of the Quarter from the sacrificial pavilion,

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāt karadvayāyāmāṃ vedīmaṣṭāṅgulocchritāṃ /
śrīparṇādyāsane tatra vinyasyānantamānasaṃ //
meaning:
कुर्यात् करद्वयायामां वेदीमष्टाङ्गुलोच्छ्रितां /
श्रीपर्णाद्यासने तत्र विन्यस्यानन्तमानसं //
text_mt:

A turban, a meditation-band, a crown, a pair of scissors, a water vessel,

ईश्वर उवाच
प्रतिष्ठां सम्प्रवक्ष्यामि क्रमात् सङ्क्षेपतो गुह /
पीठं शक्तिं शिवो लिङ्गं तद्योगः सा शिवाणुभिः //
text_mt:
Īśvara said:
I shall explain consecration in sequence and in brief, O Guha.
The pedestal is Śakti, Śiva is the liṅga; their union is that [consecration] through Śiva mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhāyāḥ pañca bhedāsteṣāṃ rūpaṃ vadāmi te /
yatra brahmaśilāyogaḥ sā pratiṣṭhā viśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठायाः पञ्च भेदास्तेषां रूपं वदामि ते /
यत्र ब्रह्मशिलायोगः सा प्रतिष्ठा विशेषतः //
text_mt:
There are five varieties of consecration; I shall describe their nature to you.
Where there is union with the Brahmā stone, that is consecration in the specific sense.

sanskrit_iast:
sthāpanantu yathāyogaṃ pīṭha eva niveśanaṃ /
pratiṣṭhābhinnapīṭhasya sthitasthāpanamucyate //
meaning:
स्थापनन्तु यथायोगं पीठ एव निवेशनं /
प्रतिष्ठाभिन्नपीठस्य स्थितस्थापनमुच्यते //
text_mt:
Installation (sthāpana), however, is placement in the pedestal according to rule.
The placement of an already existing [liṅga] whose pedestal is separate is called sthitasthāpana.

sanskrit_iast:
utthāpanañca sā proktā liṅgoddhārapuraḥsarā /
yasyāṃ tu liṅgamāropya saṃskāraḥ kriyate budhaiḥ //
:n
1 tathā kṣau hrau mantrāḥ sūryasyeti ga, gha,
cihnitapustakapāṭhaḥ
:p 288
meaning:
उत्थापनञ्च सा प्रोक्ता लिङ्गोद्धारपुरःसरा /
यस्यां तु लिङ्गमारोप्य संस्कारः क्रियते बुधैः //
:न्
1 तथा क्षौ ह्रौ मन्त्राः सूर्यस्येति ग, घ,
चिह्नितपुस्तकपाठः
:प् 288
text_mt:
And raising (utthāpana) is proclaimed as that which is preceded by the removal of the liṅga,
wherein having erected the liṅga, consecration is performed by the wise.
[...]
1 'tathā kṣau hrau mantrāḥ sūryasya' is the reading in the manuscripts marked ga and gha. / [page 288]

sanskrit_iast:
āthāpanaṃ taduddiṣṭaṃ dvidhā viṣṇvādikasya ca(1) /
āsu sarvāsu caitanyaṃ niyuñjīta paraṃ śivam //
meaning:
आथापनं तदुद्दिष्टं द्विधा विष्ण्वादिकस्य च(1) /
आसु सर्वासु चैतन्यं नियुञ्जीत परं शिवम् //
text_mt:
Fixing (āsthāpana) is declared to be of two kinds, for Viṣṇu and others.
In all of these, one should unite consciousness with supreme Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
yadādhārādibhedena(2) prāsādeṣvapi pañcadhā /
parīkṣamatha medinyāḥ kuryātprāsādakāmyayā //
meaning:
यदाधारादिभेदेन(2) प्रासादेष्वपि पञ्चधा /
परीक्षमथ मेदिन्याः कुर्यात्प्रासादकाम्यया //
text_mt:
According to the distinction of receptacle and the like, [consecration] is also fivefold in temples.
Then one should perform examination of the earth with the desire of [building] a temple.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklājyagandhā raktā ca raktagandhā sugandhinī(3) /
pītā kṛṣṇā surāgandhā viprādīnāṃ mahī kramāt //
meaning:
शुक्लाज्यगन्धा रक्ता च रक्तगन्धा सुगन्धिनी(3) /
पीता कृष्णा सुरागन्धा विप्रादीनां मही क्रमात् //
text_mt:
White with the smell of clarified butter, red with the smell of blood, fragrant,
yellow, and black with the smell of liquor: such is the ground in order for Brahmins and the other [castes].

sanskrit_iast:
pūrveśottarasarvatra pūrvā caiṣāṃ viśiṣyate(4) /
ākhāte hāstike yasyāḥ pūrṇe mṛdadhikā bhavet //
meaning:
पूर्वेशोत्तरसर्वत्र पूर्वा चैषां विशिष्यते(4) /
आखाते हास्तिके यस्याः पूर्णे मृदधिका भवेत् //
text_mt:
In the east, northeast, or north everywhere, and among these the east is distinguished
[The soil] on which, when a cubit-sized pit is dug and refilled, the earth exceeds [the pit]—

sanskrit_iast:
uttamāntāṃ mahīṃ vidyāttoyādyair vā samukṣitāṃ /
asthyaṅgārādibhirduṣṭāmatyantaṃ śodhayed guruḥ(5) //
meaning:
उत्तमान्तां महीं विद्यात्तोयाद्यैर् वा समुक्षितां /
अस्थ्यङ्गारादिभिर्दुष्टामत्यन्तं शोधयेद् गुरुः(5) //
text_mt:
The teacher should recognize that earth as excellent, or [test it] when sprinkled with water and the like
If corrupted with bones, charcoal, and the like, he should purify it thoroughly.

sanskrit_iast:
nagaragrāmadurgārthaṃ gṛhaprāsādakāraṇaṃ(6) /
khananair gokulāvāsaiḥ karṣaṇair vā muhurmuhuḥ //
meaning:
नगरग्रामदुर्गार्थं गृहप्रासादकारणं(6) /
खननैर् गोकुलावासैः कर्षणैर् वा मुहुर्मुहुः //
text_mt:
For a city, a village, or a fort, or to prepare [ground] for a house or temple,
by repeated digging, by pasturing herds of cattle, or by plowing [he should purify it].

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍape dvārapūjādi mantratṛptyavasānakaṃ(7) /
karma nirvartyāghorāstraṃ sahasraṃ(8) vidhinā yajet //
meaning:
मण्डपे द्वारपूजादि मन्त्रतृप्त्यवसानकं(7) /
कर्म निर्वर्त्याघोरास्त्रं सहस्रं(8) विधिना यजेत् //
text_mt:
In the pavilion, having performed the rites beginning with the worship of the door and ending with the satisfaction of mantras,
he should worship the Aghorāstra [mantra] a thousand times according to the rules.

sanskrit_iast:
samīkṛtyopaliptāyāṃ bhūmau saṃśodhayeddiśaḥ /
svarṇadadhyakṣatai rekhāḥ prakurvīta(9) pradakṣiṇaṃ //
meaning:
समीकृत्योपलिप्तायां भूमौ संशोधयेद्दिशः /
स्वर्णदध्यक्षतै रेखाः प्रकुर्वीत(9) प्रदक्षिणं //
text_mt:
Having leveled and smeared the ground, he should purify the directions
With gold, curd, and unbroken grains he should draw lines in a clockwise direction.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyādīśānakoṣṭasthe pūrṇakumbhe(10) śivaṃ yajet /
vāstumabhyarcya tattoyaiḥ siñcet kuddālakādikaṃ //
:n
1 utthāpanaścetyādi, viṣṇvādikasya cetyetyantaḥ
sārdhaikaślokātmakapāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
2 yathādhārābhibhedeneti ga..
3 raktagandhānugandhīti kha..
4 praśasyate iti gha..
5 śodhayetdhruvamiti gha..
6 nagaragrāmetyardhaśloko gha. pustake nāsti
7 mantradīptyavasānakamiti ga.. / mantrabhūmyavasānakamiti gha..
8 nirvartya ghorāstraṃ mahāstramiti ga..
10 svarṇakuṇḍe iti ga.. / svarṇakumbhe iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ca
:p 289
meaning:
मध्यादीशानकोष्टस्थे पूर्णकुम्भे(10) शिवं यजेत् /
वास्तुमभ्यर्च्य तत्तोयैः सिञ्चेत् कुद्दालकादिकं //
:न्
1 उत्थापनश्चेत्यादि, विष्ण्वादिकस्य चेत्येत्यन्तः
सार्धैकश्लोकात्मकपाठो ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
2 यथाधाराभिभेदेनेति ग..
3 रक्तगन्धानुगन्धीति ख..
4 प्रशस्यते इति घ..
5 शोधयेत्ध्रुवमिति घ..
6 नगरग्रामेत्यर्धश्लोको घ. पुस्तके नास्ति
7 मन्त्रदीप्त्यवसानकमिति ग.. / मन्त्रभूम्यवसानकमिति घ..
8 निर्वर्त्य घोरास्त्रं महास्त्रमिति ग..
10 स्वर्णकुण्डे इति ग.. / स्वर्णकुम्भे इति घ.. , ङ.. , च
:प् 289
text_mt:
In a full pitcher placed in the chamber of Īśāna [northeast] from the center, he should worship Śiva
Having worshipped the site architecture, he should sprinkle the spade and other tools with that water.
[...]
1 The reading of one and a half verses, beginning with 'utthāpanaś ca...' and ending with 'viṣṇvādikasya ca...', is absent in manuscript ga.
2 'yathādhārābhibhedena' in ga.
3 'raktagandhānugandhī' in kha.
4 'praśasyate' in gha.
5 'śodhayed dhruvam' in gha.
6 The half-verse 'nagaragrāma...' is absent in manuscript gha.
7 'mantradīptyavasānakam' in ga. / 'mantrabhūmyavasānakam' in gha.
8 'nirvartya ghorāstraṃ mahāstram' in ga.
10 'svarṇakuṇḍe' in ga. / 'svarṇakumbhe' in gha., ṅa., and ca.
[Page 289]

sanskrit_iast:
bāhye rakṣogaṇāniṣṭvā vidhinā digbalaṃ kṣipet /
bhūmiṃ saṃsicya saṃsnāpya(1) kuddālādyaṃ(2) prapūjayet //
meaning:
बाह्ये रक्षोगणानिष्ट्वा विधिना दिग्बलं क्षिपेत् /
भूमिं संसिच्य संस्नाप्य(1) कुद्दालाद्यं(2) प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt:
Having worshipped the hosts of demons outside, he should cast the directional offering according to rule
Having sprinkled and bathed the ground, he should worship the spade and other [tools].

sanskrit_iast:
anyaṃ vastrayugacchajñaṃ kumbhaṃ skandhe dvijanmanaḥ /
nidhāya gītavādyādibrahmagoṣasamākulaṃ //
meaning:
अन्यं वस्त्रयुगच्छज्ञं कुम्भं स्कन्धे द्विजन्मनः /
निधाय गीतवाद्यादिब्रह्मगोषसमाकुलं //
text_mt:
Having placed another pitcher covered with a pair of cloths upon the shoulder of a twice-born,
resounding with singing, musical instruments, and the recitation of Vedic mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjāṃ kumbhe samāhṛtya prāpte lagne 'gnikoṣṭhake /
kuddālenābhiṣiktena madhvaktena tu khānayet //
meaning:
पूजां कुम्भे समाहृत्य प्राप्ते लग्ने ऽग्निकोष्ठके /
कुद्दालेनाभिषिक्तेन मध्वक्तेन तु खानयेत् //
text_mt:
and having performed worship in the pitcher, when the astrological moment arrives in the fire [southeast] chamber,
he should dig with the consecrated spade smeared with honey.

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtyāṃ kṣepayenmṛtsnāṃ khāte kumbhajalaṃ kṣipet /
purasya pūrvasīmantaṃ(3) nayed yāvadabhīpsitaṃ //
meaning:
नैरृत्यां क्षेपयेन्मृत्स्नां खाते कुम्भजलं क्षिपेत् /
पुरस्य पूर्वसीमन्तं(3) नयेद् यावदभीप्सितं //
text_mt:
He should throw the earth toward the southwest, and pour the pitcher's water into the pit
He should lead it to the eastern boundary of the town, as far as desired.

sanskrit_iast:
atha tatra kṣaṇaṃ sthitvā bhrāmayet(4) paritaḥ puraṃ /
siñcan sīmantacihnāni yāvadīśānagocaraṃ //
meaning:
अथ तत्र क्षणं स्थित्वा भ्रामयेत्(4) परितः पुरं /
सिञ्चन् सीमन्तचिह्नानि यावदीशानगोचरं //
text_mt:
Then, staying there for a moment, he should circumambulate around the town,
sprinkling boundary-marks as far as the domain of Īśāna [northeast].

sanskrit_iast:
arghyadānamidaṃ proktaṃ tatra kumbhaparibramāt /
itthaṃ parigrahaṃ bhūmeḥ kurvīta tadanantaraṃ //
meaning:
अर्घ्यदानमिदं प्रोक्तं तत्र कुम्भपरिब्रमात् /
इत्थं परिग्रहं भूमेः कुर्वीत तदनन्तरं //
text_mt:
This is declared to be the offering of water because of the circumambulation with the pitcher
In this manner he should take possession of the ground; thereafter:

sanskrit_iast:
karkarāntaṃ jalāntaṃ vā śalyadoṣajighāṃsayā /
khānayed bhūḥ kumārīṃ ced vidhinā śalyamuddharet //
meaning:
कर्करान्तं जलान्तं वा शल्यदोषजिघांसया /
खानयेद् भूः कुमारीं चेद् विधिना शल्यमुद्धरेत् //
text_mt:
Down to gravel or down to water, wishing to destroy the flaw of hidden foreign matter,
he should have it excavated; if the earth is virgin, he should extract the foreign matter according to rule.

sanskrit_iast:
akacaṭatapayaśahān mānavaścet praśnākṣarāṇi tu(5) /
agnerdhvajādipātitāḥ svasthāne śalyamākhyānti //
meaning:
अकचटतपयशहान् मानवश्चेत् प्रश्नाक्षराणि तु(5) /
अग्नेर्ध्वजादिपातिताः स्वस्थाने शल्यमाख्यान्ति //
text_mt:
From the letters A, Ka, Ca, Ṭa, Ta, Pa, Ya, and Śa, if a person [asks], the query's syllables
projected from Agni onto the banner [series] indicate the foreign matter in its proper place.

sanskrit_iast:
kartuścāṅgavikāreṇa jānīyāttatpramāṇataḥ /
paśvādīnāṃ praveśena kīrtanair virutair diśaḥ //
meaning:
कर्तुश्चाङ्गविकारेण जानीयात्तत्प्रमाणतः /
पश्वादीनां प्रवेशेन कीर्तनैर् विरुतैर् दिशः //
text_mt:
And from the bodily movement of the client he should know its measure
From the entrance of animals and the like, by the mentions and cries, [he should know] the directions.

sanskrit_iast:
mātṛkāmaṣṭavargāḍhyāṃ phalake bhuvi vā likhet /
śalyajñānaṃ vargavaśāt pūrvādīśāntataḥ(6) kramāt //
meaning:
मातृकामष्टवर्गाढ्यां फलके भुवि वा लिखेत् /
शल्यज्ञानं वर्गवशात् पूर्वादीशान्ततः(6) क्रमात् //
text_mt:
He should write the syllabary rich in eight groups on a board or on the ground
The knowledge of foreign matter is by virtue of the groups, in order from the east ending with the northeast.

sanskrit_iast:
avarge caiva lohantu kavarge 'ṅgāramagnitaḥ /
:n
1 bhūmiṃ saṃsicya saṃsthāpyeti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
2 kuddālākhyamiti ga..
3 pūrvamīśāntamiti kha..
4 srāvayet iti kha..
5 nava cet praśnākṣarāṇi bhāṣante iti ga.. , gha.. ca
6 pūrvādīnāṃ tata iti kha..
:p 290
cavarge bhasma dakṣe syāṭ ṭavarge 'sthi ca nairṛte //
meaning:
अवर्गे चैव लोहन्तु कवर्गे ऽङ्गारमग्नितः /
:न्
1 भूमिं संसिच्य संस्थाप्येति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
2 कुद्दालाख्यमिति ग..
3 पूर्वमीशान्तमिति ख..
4 स्रावयेत् इति ख..
5 नव चेत् प्रश्नाक्षराणि भाषन्ते इति ग.. , घ.. च
6 पूर्वादीनां तत इति ख..
:प् 290
चवर्गे भस्म दक्षे स्याट् टवर्गे ऽस्थि च नैरृते //
text_mt:
In the A-group [there is] iron; in the Ka-group, charcoal from fire
[...]
1 'bhūmiṃ saṃsicya saṃsthāpya' in ga., gha., and ṅa.
2 'kuddālākhyam' in ga.
3 'pūrvamīśāntam' in kha.
4 'srāvayet' in kha.
5 'nava cet praśnākṣarāṇi bhāṣante' in ga. and gha.
6 'pūrvādīnāṃ tataḥ' in kha.
[Page 290]
In the Ca-group, there would be ashes in the south; in the Ṭa-group, bone in the southwest

sanskrit_iast:
tavarge ceṣṭakā cāpye kapālañca pavargake /
yavarge śavakītādi śavarge lohamādiśet //
meaning:
तवर्गे चेष्टका चाप्ये कपालञ्च पवर्गके /
यवर्गे शवकीतादि शवर्गे लोहमादिशेत् //
text_mt:
In the Ta-group, a brick in the west; and a skull in the Pa-group
In the Ya-group, a corpse, worms, and the like; in the Śa-group, he should declare iron

sanskrit_iast:
havarge rajataṃ tadvadavargāccānarthakarānapi /
prīkṣyātmabhiḥ karāpūrair aṣṭāṅgulamṛdantaraiḥ //
meaning:
हवर्गे रजतं तद्वदवर्गाच्चानर्थकरानपि /
प्रीक्ष्यात्मभिः करापूरैर् अष्टाङ्गुलमृदन्तरैः //
text_mt:
In the Ha-group, silver; likewise from the vowel-group [he should determine] baneful objects as well
Having inspected [these], with the soil at intervals of eight inches filling cubit-measures,

sanskrit_iast:
pādonaṃ khātamāpūrya sajalair mudgarāhataiḥ(1) /
liptāṃ samaplavāṃ tatra kārayitvā bhuvaṃ guruḥ //
meaning:
पादोनं खातमापूर्य सजलैर् मुद्गराहतैः(1) /
लिप्तां समप्लवां तत्र कारयित्वा भुवं गुरुः //
text_mt:
filling the pit to three-quarters with [earth] moistened with water and beaten with mallets,
and having the ground smeared and leveled there, the teacher,

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyārghyakaro yāyānmaṇḍapaṃ vakṣyāmāṇakaṃ /
toraṇadvāḥpatīniṣṭvā pratyagdvāreṇa saṃviśet //
meaning:
सामान्यार्घ्यकरो यायान्मण्डपं वक्ष्यामाणकं /
तोरणद्वाःपतीनिष्ट्वा प्रत्यग्द्वारेण संविशेत् //
text_mt:
holding the general water offering, should proceed to the pavilion to be described
Having worshipped the guardian deities of the arched gateway and doors, he should enter through the western door.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryāttatrātmaśuddhyādi kuṇḍamaṇḍapasaṃskṛtiṃ /
kalasaṃ vardhanīsaktaṃ(2) lokapālaśivārcanaṃ //
meaning:
कुर्यात्तत्रात्मशुद्ध्यादि कुण्डमण्डपसंस्कृतिं /
कलसं वर्धनीसक्तं(2) लोकपालशिवार्चनं //
text_mt:
He should perform the purification of himself and other rites there, the consecration of the fire-pit and pavilion,
the water-pot associated with the Vardhanī pitcher, and the worship of Śiva and the world-protectors.

sanskrit_iast:
agnerjananapūjādi sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaret /
yajamānānvito(3) yāyācchilānāṃ snānamaṇḍapaṃ //
meaning:
अग्नेर्जननपूजादि सर्वं पूर्ववदाचरेत् /

Accompanied by the patron, he should go to the bathing pavilion of the stones.

The stones should be made of rock, or of brick [at] half of that [size]
In a stone temple they are stone slabs; in a brick [temple], made of brick.

text_mt:
He should deposit in sequence the three cosmic principles that pervade the three sections, / from intellect down to the mind, extending up to the subtle elements of perception;
[...]
1. 'puṣpadantaka' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, and ṅa.
2. 'eastern and likewise northern' in gha.
3. 'having given the praṇava' in kha.
4. 'by means of an arrow' in kha and ga.
5. 'veiling with the subtle element' in kha.
6. 'ending with huṃ phaṭ' in ga.
7. 'he should make it marked with the name of the twice-born' in kha; 'he should make it marked with his own name' in ga.
8. 'having smeared completely' in ga.
9. 'or upon a bed of kuśa grass he should distinguish with the heart mantra' in kha; 'and upon a bed of kuśa grass he should deposit with the heart mantra' in ga.
10. 'from intellect down to the mind, extending up to the mind and subtle elements' in gha. / The text of one and a half verses beginning with 'having cooked' and ending with 'extending up to the subtle elements' is absent in manuscript ga. / Page 292.

one should give honey to Gṛhakṣata, and meat-rice to Yamarāja;

sanskrit_iast:
gandhaṃ gandharvanāthāya jihvāṃ bhṛṅgāya pakṣiṇaḥ /
mṛgāya padmaparṇāni(3) yāmyāmityaṣṭadevatāḥ(4) //
meaning:
गन्धं गन्धर्वनाथाय जिह्वां भृङ्गाय पक्षिणः /
मृगाय पद्मपर्णानि(3) याम्यामित्यष्टदेवताः(4) //
text_mt: perfume to the lord of Gandharvas, the tongue of a bird to Bhṛṅga, / and lotus petals to Mṛga. Thus are the eight deities in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
pitre tilodakaṃ kṣīraṃ vṛkṣajaṃ dantadhāvanaṃ /
dauvārikāya devāya pradadyād dhenumudrayā(5) //
meaning:
पित्रे तिलोदकं क्षीरं वृक्षजं दन्तधावनं /
दौवारिकाय देवाय प्रदद्याद् धेनुमुद्रया(5) //
text_mt: One should offer water with sesamum seeds to the Ancestor, and milk and a tree-twig tooth-cleaner / to the deity Dauvārika with the cow gesture.

sanskrit_iast:
sugrīvāya diśet pūpān puṣpadantāya darbhakaṃ /
raktaṃ pracetase padmamasurāya(6) surāsavaṃ //
meaning:
सुग्रीवाय दिशेत् पूपान् पुष्पदन्ताय दर्भकं /
रक्तं प्रचेतसे पद्ममसुराय(6) सुरासवं //
text_mt: One should assign cakes to Sugrīva, darbhā-grass to Puṣpadanta, / a red lotus to Pracetas, and liquor and distilled spirits to Asura;

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtaṃ guḍaudanaṃ śeṣe rogāya ghṛtamaṇḍakān /
lājān vā paścimāśāyāṃ devāṣṭakamitīritaṃ //
meaning:
घृतं गुडौदनं शेषे रोगाय घृतमण्डकान् /
लाजान् वा पश्चिमाशायां देवाष्टकमितीरितं //
text_mt: clarified butter and jaggery-rice to Śeṣa, and flatbreads cooked in clarified butter to Roga, / or parched grain. Thus are declared the eight deities in the western direction.

sanskrit_iast:
mārutāya dhvajaṃ pītaṃ nāgāya nāgakeśaraṃ /
mukhye bhakṣyāṇi bhallāṭe mudgasūpaṃ susaṃskṛtaṃ //
meaning:
मारुताय ध्वजं पीतं नागाय नागकेशरं /
मुख्ये भक्ष्याणि भल्लाटे मुद्गसूपं सुसंस्कृतं //
text_mt: To Māruta, a yellow banner; to Nāga, nāgakeśara flowers; / to Mukhya, cooked savouries; to Bhallāṭa, well-prepared mung-bean soup;

sanskrit_iast:
somāya pāyasaṃ sājyaṃ śālūkamūṣaye(7) diśet /
lopīmaditaye dityai purīmityuttarāṣṭakaṃ(8) //
meaning:
सोमाय पायसं साज्यं शालूकमूषये(7) दिशेत् /
लोपीमदितये दित्यै पुरीमित्युत्तराष्टकं(8) //
text_mt: to Soma, sweet milk-rice with clarified butter; to the sage, one should assign water-lily roots; / sweet pastries to Aditi, and a city-offering to Diti. Thus are the eight deities of the north.

sanskrit_iast:
modakān brahmaṇaḥ prācyāṃ ṣaṭpādāya marīcaye /
savitre raktapuṣpāṇi vahnyadhaḥkoṇakoṣṭhake //
meaning:
मोदकान् ब्रह्मणः प्राच्यां षट्पादाय मरीचये /
सवित्रे रक्तपुष्पाणि वह्न्यधःकोणकोष्ठके //
text_mt: One should offer sweet dumplings to Marīci, who occupies six squares to the east of Brahmā; / red flowers to Savitṛ in the square below the fire corner;

sanskrit_iast:
tadadhaḥkoṣṭhake dadyāt sāvitryai ca kuśodakaṃ(9) /
dakṣiṇe candanaṃ(10) raktaṃ ṣaṭpadāya vivasvate //
meaning:
तदधःकोष्ठके दद्यात् सावित्र्यै च कुशोदकं(9) /
दक्षिणे चन्दनं(10) रक्तं षट्पदाय विवस्वते //
text_mt: and in the square below that, one should give water with kuśa-grass to Sāvitrī; / in the south, red sandalwood to Vivasvat, who occupies six squares;

sanskrit_iast:
haridraudanamindrāya rakṣodhaḥkrīṇakoṣṭhake /

gha..

घ..
2 फलौदनमिति ख. घ.. च
3 यवपर्णानीति घ.. / पद्मवर्णानीति ख.. छ.. च
4 याम्यामित्यष्टदेवता इति ख..
5 प्रदद्यादघमुद्रयेति ख.. / प्रदद्याद्वनमुद्रयेति घ.. , छ.. च
6 पद्मं सम्बरायेति घ..
7 शालूकं शृणयेति ख.. , छ.. च
8 पुरीमित्यवराष्टकमिति ग..
9 सवित्रे च कुशोदकमिति ग..
10 सावित्र्यै चन्दनमिति ग..

इन्द्रजयाय मिश्रान्नमिन्द्राधस्तान्निवेदयेत् //
text_mt:
rice cooked with turmeric to Indra in the square below the demon [south-west] corner;
[Gap in text]

one should present mixed rice to Indrajaya beneath Indra;

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇyāṃ ṣaṭpadāsīne mitre saṅuḍamodanaṃ /
rudrāya ghṛtasiddhānnaṃ vāyukoṇādhare pade //
meaning:
वरुण्यां षट्पदासीने मित्रे सङुडमोदनं /
रुद्राय घृतसिद्धान्नं वायुकोणाधरे पदे //
text_mt: in the western direction, boiled rice mixed with jaggery to Mitra seated on six squares; / rice cooked with clarified butter to Rudra in the square below the wind corner;

sanskrit_iast:
tadadho rudradāsāya māsaṃ mārgamathottare /
dadīta māṣanaivedyaṃ(1) ṣaṭpadasthe dharādhare(2) //
meaning:
तदधो रुद्रदासाय मासं मार्गमथोत्तरे /
ददीत माषनैवेद्यं(1) षट्पदस्थे धराधरे(2) //
text_mt: beneath that, deer meat to Rudradāsa; then in the north, / one should give an offering of black gram to Dharādhara, who is stationed on six squares;

sanskrit_iast:
āpāya śivakoṇādhaḥ tadvatsāya ca tatsthale(3) /
kramāddadyāddadhikṣīraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
आपाय शिवकोणाधः तद्वत्साय च तत्स्थले(3) /
क्रमाद्दद्याद्दधिक्षीरं पूजयित्वा विधानतः //
text_mt: to Āpa beneath the Śiva corner, and to his son in that same place, / one should duly worship and give curd and milk in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpade niviṣṭāya brahmaṇe madhmadeśataḥ /
pañcagavyākṣatopetañcaruṃ sājyaṃ nivedayet //
meaning:
चतुष्पदे निविष्टाय ब्रह्मणे मध्मदेशतः /
पञ्चगव्याक्षतोपेतञ्चरुं साज्यं निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: To Brahmā, who is seated on four squares in the central region, / one should present boiled sacrificial rice mixed with clarified butter, accompanied by the five products of the cow and unbroken grains.

sanskrit_iast:
īśādivāyuparyantakoṇeṣvatha yathākramaṃ /
vāstuvāhye carakyādyāś catasraḥ pūjayed yathā //
meaning:
ईशादिवायुपर्यन्तकोणेष्वथ यथाक्रमं /
वास्तुवाह्ये चरक्याद्याश् चतस्रः पूजयेद् यथा //
text_mt: Then, in succession, in the corners from the north-east to the north-west, / outside the site architecture area, one should worship the four goddesses beginning with Carakī accordingly:

sanskrit_iast:
carakyai(4) saghṛtaṃ māṃsaṃ vidāryai(5) dadhipaṅkaje /
pūtanāyai palaṃ pittaṃ rudhiraṃ ca nivedayet //
meaning:
चरक्यै(4) सघृतं मांसं विदार्यै(5) दधिपङ्कजे /
पूतनायै पलं पित्तं रुधिरं च निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: meat with clarified butter to Carakī; curd and lotus flowers to Vidārī; / flesh, bile, and blood to Pūtanā;

sanskrit_iast:
asthīni pāparākṣasyai raktapittapalāni ca /
tato māṣaudanaṃ(6) prācyāṃ skandāya vinivedayet //
meaning:
अस्थीनि पापराक्षस्यै रक्तपित्तपलानि च /
ततो माषौदनं(6) प्राच्यां स्कन्दाय विनिवेदयेत् //
text_mt: bones, blood, bile, and flesh to Pāparākṣasī. / Then, in the east, one should present black gram cooked with rice to Skanda.

sanskrit_iast:
aryamṇe dakṣiṇāśāyāṃ pūpān kṛsarayā yutān /
jambhakāya(7) ca vāruṇyāmāmiṣaṃ rudhirānvitaṃ //
meaning:
अर्यम्णे दक्षिणाशायां पूपान् कृसरया युतान् /
जम्भकाय(7) च वारुण्यामामिषं रुधिरान्वितं //
text_mt: To Aryaman in the southern quarter [one should offer] cakes mixed with rice cooked with sesame and pulses, / and to Jambhaka in the western quarter, meat accompanied by blood.

sanskrit_iast:
udīcyāṃ pilipiñjāya(8) raktānnaṃ kusumāni ca /
yajedvā sakalaṃ vāstuṃ kuśadadhyakṣaterjalaiḥ //
:n
1 māṃsanaivedyamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca
2 varādhare iti gha..
3 āpavatsacatuṣṭaye iti kha.. / tadvatsāyai ca tattale iti gha.. , ja.. ca
4 vārāhyai iti ṅa.. , cha.. ca
5 vipace iti kha.. , cha.. ca
6 tato māṃsaudanamiti kha. gha.. cha.. ca
7 kumbhakāyeti cha..
8 pilipicchāyeti ṅa.. / lipipiñjāyeti cha..
:p 298
meaning:
उदीच्यां पिलिपिञ्जाय(8) रक्तान्नं कुसुमानि च /
यजेद्वा सकलं वास्तुं कुशदध्यक्षतेर्जलैः //
:न्
1 मांसनैवेद्यमिति ख.. , छ.. , च
2 वराधरे इति घ..
3 आपवत्सचतुष्टये इति ख.. / तद्वत्सायै च तत्तले इति घ.. , ज.. च
4 वाराह्यै इति ङ.. , छ.. च
5 विपचे इति ख.. , छ.. च
6 ततो मांसौदनमिति ख. घ.. छ.. च
7 कुम्भकायेति छ..
8 पिलिपिच्छायेति ङ.. / लिपिपिञ्जायेति छ..
:प् 298
text_mt:
In the northern quarter, to Pilipiñja, red rice and flowers. / Or one may worship the entire site architecture with kuśa grass, curd, unbroken rice grains, and water.
[Notes]

2 gha reads varādhare.
3 kha reads āpavatsacatuṣṭaye; gha and ja read tadvatsāyai ca tattale.
4 ṅa and cha read vārāhyai.
5 kha and cha read vipace.
6 kha, gha, and cha read tato māṃsaudanam.
7 cha reads kumbhakāya.
8 ṅa reads pilipicchāya; cha reads lipipiñjāya. / [Page 298]

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhe ca nagarādau ca ekāśītipadair yajet /
tripadā rajjavaḥ kāryāḥ ṣaṭpadāś ca vikoṇake //
meaning:
गृहे च नगरादौ च एकाशीतिपदैर् यजेत् /
त्रिपदा रज्जवः कार्याः षट्पदाश् च विकोणके //
text_mt: In a house and in a city and the like, one should worship with eighty-one squares. / Cords should be made of three squares [in length], and six squares in the corner-spaces.

sanskrit_iast:
īśādyāḥ pādikāstasminnāgadyāś ca dvikoṣṭhagāḥ(1) /
ṣaṭpadasthā marīcyādyā brahmā navapadaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
ईशाद्याः पादिकास्तस्मिन्नागद्याश् च द्विकोष्ठगाः(1) /
षट्पदस्था मरीच्याद्या ब्रह्मा नवपदः स्मृतः //
text_mt: In it, [deities] beginning with Īśa occupy one square; those beginning with Nāga occupy two compartments. / Those beginning with Marīci stand in six squares; Brahmā is traditionally known to have nine squares.

sanskrit_iast:
nagaragrāmakheṭādau vāstuḥ śatapado 'pi(2) vā /
vaṃśadvayaṃ koṇagataṃ durjayaṃ durdharaṃ sadā //
meaning:
नगरग्रामखेटादौ वास्तुः शतपदो ऽपि(2) वा /
वंशद्वयं कोणगतं दुर्जयं दुर्धरं सदा //
text_mt: In a city, village, market-town, and the like, the site architecture may also have a hundred squares. / The pair of bamboo axes going through the corners is always invincible and difficult to support.

sanskrit_iast:
yathā devālaye nyasas tathā śatapade hitaḥ /
grahāḥ skandādayastatra vijñeyāś caiva ṣaṭpadāḥ //
meaning:
यथा देवालये न्यसस् तथा शतपदे हितः /
ग्रहाः स्कन्दादयस्तत्र विज्ञेयाश् चैव षट्पदाः //
text_mt: As ritual deposition is performed in a temple, so it is beneficially done on [a site of] a hundred squares. / The planets, Skanda, and others there are known indeed to occupy six squares.

sanskrit_iast:
carakyādyā bhūtapadā rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat /
deśasaṃsthāpane(3) vāstu catustriṃśacchataṃ(4) bhavet //
meaning:
चरक्याद्या भूतपदा रज्जुवंशादि पूर्ववत् /
देशसंस्थापने(3) वास्तु चतुस्त्रिंशच्छतं(4) भवेत् //
text_mt: Carakī and the others have five squares; the cords, bamboos, and so forth are as before. / In laying out a territory, the site architecture should consist of one hundred and thirty-four [squares].

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥṣaṣṭipado(5) brahmā marīcyādyāś ca devatāḥ /
catuḥpañcāśatpadikā āpādyaṣṭau rasāgnibhiḥ //
meaning:
चतुःषष्टिपदो(5) ब्रह्मा मरीच्याद्याश् च देवताः /
चतुःपञ्चाशत्पदिका आपाद्यष्टौ रसाग्निभिः //
text_mt: Brahmā occupies sixty-four squares, and the deities beginning with Marīci / occupy fifty-four squares; the eight beginning with Āpa [occupy] thirty-six squares.

sanskrit_iast:
īśānādyā navapadāḥ skandādyāḥ śaktikāḥ(6) smṛtāḥ /
carakyādyāstadvadeva rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat(7) //
meaning:
ईशानाद्या नवपदाः स्कन्दाद्याः शक्तिकाः(6) स्मृताः /
चरक्याद्यास्तद्वदेव रज्जुवंशादि पूर्ववत्(7) //
text_mt: Those beginning with Īśāna have nine squares; those beginning with Skanda are remembered as occupying one square. / Those beginning with Carakī are likewise; the cords, bamboos, and the rest are as before.

sanskrit_iast:
jñeyo vaṃśasahasraistu vāstumaṇḍalagaḥ padaiḥ /
nyāso navaguṇastatra kartavyo deśavāstuvit //
meaning:
ज्ञेयो वंशसहस्रैस्तु वास्तुमण्डलगः पदैः /
न्यासो नवगुणस्तत्र कर्तव्यो देशवास्तुवित् //
text_mt: Site architecture on a maṇḍala is known by squares through a thousand bamboo lines; / one who knows the site architecture of a territory must perform a ninefold ritual deposition there.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaciṃśatpado vāsturvaitālākhyaścitau smṛtaḥ /
anyo navapado vāstuḥ ṣoḍaśāṅghris tathāparaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चचिंशत्पदो वास्तुर्वैतालाख्यश्चितौ स्मृतः /
अन्यो नवपदो वास्तुः षोडशाङ्घ्रिस् तथापरः //
text_mt: The site architecture of thirty-five squares is taught as named Vaitāla on a funeral pyre; / another site architecture has nine squares, and yet another has sixteen squares.

ṣaḍasratryasravṛttādermadhye syāccaturasrakaṃ /

'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ / catuḥṣaṣṭipado brahmā ity ādiḥ,

षडस्रत्र्यस्रवृत्तादेर्मध्ये स्याच्चतुरस्रकं /

ऽधिकः पाठः / चतुःषष्टिपदो ब्रह्मा इत्य् आदिः,

खाते वास्तोः समं पृष्ठे(1) न्यासे ब्रह्मशिलात्मके //
text_mt:
In the middle of a hexagon, triangle, circle, and the like, there should be a square.
[Notes]

7 Manuscript gha contains the additional reading samañca sthāpane vāstuś catustriṃśacchataṃ bhavet. The reading from catuḥṣaṣṭipado brahmā up to rajjuvaṃśādi pūrvavat is absent in manuscript ga. / [Page 299]
When the foundation trench of the site architecture is level on the surface, at the time of ritual deposition consisting of the foundation stone of Brahmā,

sanskrit_iast:
śāṣākasya niveśe ca(2) mūrtisaṃsthāpane tathā /
pāyasena tu naivedyaṃ sarveṣāṃ vā pradāpayet //

शाषाकस्य निवेशे च(2) मूर्तिसंस्थापने तथा /
पायसेन तु नैवेद्यं सर्वेषां वा प्रदापयेत् //
text_mt: and at the erection of the doorframe, as well as at the installation of the image, / one should present an offering of milk-rice to all [the deities].

शिलाविन्यासविधानं
text_mt:
Whether prescribed or unprescribed, the site architecture is five cubits in measure; / the site architecture proportioned to the house or temple is always supreme.
Thus ends the ninety-third chapter, entitled “The Teaching on the Worship of the Site Architecture,” in the glorious and great Agni Purāṇa.
Now, the ninety-fourth chapter.
The Procedure for the Laying of the Foundation Stone

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
īśādiṣu carakyādyāḥ(5) pūrvavat pūjayedvahiḥ /
āhutitritayaṃ dadyāt pratidevamanukramāt //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
ईशादिषु चरक्याद्याः(5) पूर्ववत् पूजयेद्वहिः /
आहुतित्रितयं दद्यात् प्रतिदेवमनुक्रमात् //
text_mt: The Lord said: / Outside, in the directions beginning with the northeast, one should worship Carakī and others as before; / one should offer three oblations in sequence for each deity.

sanskrit_iast:
datvā bhūtabaliṃ lagne śilānyāsamanukramāt /
madhyasūtre(6) nyasecchaktiṃ kumbhañcānantamuttamaṃ(7) //
meaning:
दत्वा भूतबलिं लग्ने शिलान्यासमनुक्रमात् /
मध्यसूत्रे(6) न्यसेच्छक्तिं कुम्भञ्चानन्तमुत्तमं(7) //
text_mt: Having offered an oblation to the spirits at the astrological moment, for the sequential laying of the stones, / on the central cord-line one should place the Śakti and the excellent jar Ananta.

sanskrit_iast:
nakārārūḍhamūlena kumbhe 'smin dhārayecchilāṃ /
kumbhānaṣṭau sabhadrādīn dikṣu pūrvādiṣu kramāt //
meaning:
नकारारूढमूलेन कुम्भे ऽस्मिन् धारयेच्छिलां /
कुम्भानष्टौ सभद्रादीन् दिक्षु पूर्वादिषु क्रमात् //

text_mt:
Having deposited them with the mantras of the World Protectors in the pits where Śaktis have been deposited,
[Notes]
1 ṅa reads khātārambhe samaṃ pṛṣṭhe; cha reads khāto bāloḥ samaḥ pṛṣṭhe.

6 gha reads madhye śvabhre.

one should then place the stones Nandā and others into them in order,

sanskrit_iast:
śambarair mūrtināthānāṃ(3) yathā syurbhittimadhyataḥ /
tāsu dharmādikānaṣṭau(4) koṇāt koṇaṃ vibhāgaśaḥ(5) //
meaning:
शम्बरैर् मूर्तिनाथानां(3) यथा स्युर्भित्तिमध्यतः /
तासु धर्मादिकानष्टौ(4) कोणात् कोणं विभागशः(5) //
text_mt: so that they lie in the middle of the wall by the measures of the lords of the idols; / on them [one should place] the eight deities beginning with Dharma, portion by portion from corner to corner.

sanskrit_iast:
subhadrādiṣu nandādyāś catasro 'gnyādikoṇagāḥ /
ajitādyāś ca pūrvādijayādiṣvatha(6) vinyaset //

सुभद्रादिषु नन्दाद्याश् चतस्रो ऽग्न्यादिकोणगाः /
अजिताद्याश् च पूर्वादिजयादिष्वथ(6) विन्यसेत् //
text_mt: On the [jars] beginning with Subhadra, the four stones Nandā and the rest [are deposited] in the corners beginning with the southeast; / and one should then place Ajitā and others in the directions beginning with the east, on the [jars] Jayā and others.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇaṃ copari masya(7) vyāpakaṃ ca maheśvaraṃ /

चिन्तयेदेषु चाधानं व्योमप्रसादमध्यगं //
text_mt: And above it, one should meditate upon Brahmā and the all-pervading Maheśvara; / and one should contemplate their establishment situated in the center of the celestial temple.

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

padmādiṣu ca nandādyāḥ koṇeṣvagnyādiṣu kramāt //

मध्ये पूर्णशिलान्यासः(9) सुभद्रकलशे ऽर्धतः /
पद्मादिषु च नन्दाद्याः कोणेष्वग्न्यादिषु क्रमात् //
text_mt: In the center is the placement of the Pūrṇā stone, by half on the Subhadra jar; / and on the Padmā and other [jars], Nandā and the others [are placed] in the corners beginning with the southeast in order.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyabhāve(10) catasro 'pi mātṛvadbhāvasammatāḥ /
oṃ pūrṇe tvaṃ mahāviśve(11) sarvasandohalakṣaṇe //

मध्यभावे(10) चतस्रो ऽपि मातृवद्भावसम्मताः /
ओं पूर्णे त्वं महाविश्वे(11) सर्वसन्दोहलक्षणे //
text_mt: In the absence of a center, even the four [stones] are accepted as having the nature of mothers: / “Oṃ, O Pūrṇā! You are the great universe, characterized by all abundance;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasampūrṇamevātra kuruṣvāṅgirasaḥ sute /
oṃ nande tvaṃ nandinī puṃsāṃ tvāmatra sthāpayāmyahaṃ //
meaning:
सर्वसम्पूर्णमेवात्र कुरुष्वाङ्गिरसः सुते /
ओं नन्दे त्वं नन्दिनी पुंसां त्वामत्र स्थापयाम्यहं //
text_mt: make everything entirely full here, O daughter of Aṅgiras! / Oṃ, O Nandā! You are the rejoicer of people; I establish you here.

मूर्तिमाधानमिति ङ..

Remain well satisfied in the temple as long as the moon, sun, and stars [endure]; / grant lifespan, desire, and prosperity to embodied beings, O Nandā, [daughter] of Vasiṣṭha!”

3. "śambarair mūrtinādhānam" in manuscripts kha, cha, and ca; "śambarair mūrtim ādhānam" in manuscript ṅa.
4. "tān sudharmādikān aṣṭau" in manuscript kha.
5. "vibhāgataḥ" in manuscript gha.
6. "pūrvādijayādiṣu ca" in manuscript ga.
7. "brahmāṇaṃ copavinyasya" in manuscripts kha, gha, ṅa, cha, and ca.
8. "vighnadoṣanivārakam" in manuscript ga.
9. "pūrvaśilānyāsaḥ" in manuscript gha.
12. "dehi mām" in manuscripts kha and cha; "dehi naḥ" in manuscript gha.

sanskrit_iast:
asmin rakṣā sadā(1) kāryā prāsāde yatnatastvayā /
oṃ bhadre tvaṃ sarvadā bhadraṃ lokānāṃ kuru kāśyapi //
meaning:
अस्मिन् रक्षा सदा(1) कार्या प्रासादे यत्नतस्त्वया /
ओं भद्रे त्वं सर्वदा भद्रं लोकानां कुरु काश्यपि //
text_mt: Protection must always be maintained by you with effort in this temple. / Om, auspicious one, daughter of Kaśyapa, always bring welfare to the worlds!

sanskrit_iast:
āyurdā kāmadā devi(2) śrīpradā ca sadā bhava /
oṃ jaye 'tra sarvadā devi śrīdā.ayurdā ca sadā bhava(3) //

आयुर्दा कामदा देवि(2) श्रीप्रदा च सदा भव /
ओं जये ऽत्र सर्वदा देवि श्रीदा.अयुर्दा च सदा भव(3) //
text_mt: O goddess, granter of longevity and desires, always bestow prosperity. / Om, victorious one, goddess here always grant prosperity and longevity!

sanskrit_iast:

नित्यञ्जयाय भूत्यै च स्वामिनी भव भार्गवि //
text_mt: Om, victorious one, o goddess, remain here always, established by me! / O daughter of Bhṛgu, be the mistress for constant victory and prosperity!

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ rikte 'tiriktadoṣaghne(6) siddhimuktiprade śubhaṃ /
sarvadā sarvadeśasthe tiṣṭhāsmin viśvarūpiṇi(7) //

ओं रिक्ते ऽतिरिक्तदोषघ्ने(6) सिद्धिमुक्तिप्रदे शुभं /
सर्वदा सर्वदेशस्थे तिष्ठास्मिन् विश्वरूपिणि(7) //
text_mt: Om, Riktā, destroyer of excessive defects, granter of success and liberation, auspicious one, / residing always in every region, remain in this [temple], you whose form is the universe!

pratiṣṭhā sāmagrīvidhānaṃ

text_mt:
Having meditated on the sky-shrine, one should deposit the triad of principles there. / Then, having offered the expiation into the fire, one should discharge the sacrifice according to the rule.
Thus ends the ninety-fourth chapter, entitled "The Description of the Laying of the Foundation Stone," in the primary Mahāpurāṇa, the Āgneya.
Now, the ninety-fifth chapter.
The Rules for the Materials of Consecration.

sanskrit_iast:

vakṣye liṅgapratiṣṭhāṃ ca prāsāde bhuktimuktidāṃ /
tāś caret sarvadā muktau bhuktau devadine sati //

ईश्वर उवाच
वक्ष्ये लिङ्गप्रतिष्ठां च प्रासादे भुक्तिमुक्तिदां /
ताश् चरेत् सर्वदा मुक्तौ भुक्तौ देवदिने सति //
text_mt: The Lord said: / I shall explain the consecration of the liṅga in the temple, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation. / One should perform it at all times for liberation, and during a day of the gods for worldly enjoyment.

गुरुशुक्रोदये कार्या प्रथमे करणेत्रये //
text_mt:
Excepting Caitra, consecration [is done] in the five months beginning with Māgha,
[Apparatus notes]
1. "mudā" in manuscripts kha, cha, and ca.
2. "kāmade devi" in manuscript gha.
3. The half-verse "jayetre..." is absent in manuscript cha.
4. "oṃ jaya enaṃ sadā" in manuscripts kha, cha, and ca.
5. "mama" in manuscript ṅa.
6. "raktātiraktadoṣaghne" in manuscript cha; "raktātriraktadoṣaghne" in manuscript kha.
7. "santiṣṭhāsminnīśarūpiṇī" in manuscript gha; "śarparūpiṇī" in manuscript ja.
8. "tattve tattvatrayam" in manuscript gha.
9. "sarvadā muktau devādeve grahe sati" in manuscript gha; "sarvadā muktyai bhuktyai daivadine sati" in manuscript ṅa.
when Jupiter and Venus rise, in the first three astrological divisions.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklapakṣe viśeṣeṇa kṛṣṇe vā pañcamandinaṃ(1) /
caturthīṃ navamīṃ ṣaṣṭhīṃ varjayitvā caturdaśīṃ //
meaning:
शुक्लपक्षे विशेषेण कृष्णे वा पञ्चमन्दिनं(1) /
चतुर्थीं नवमीं षष्ठीं वर्जयित्वा चतुर्दशीं //
text_mt: Especially in the bright fortnight, or in the dark [fortnight] up to the fifth lunar day, / avoiding the fourth, ninth, sixth, and fourteenth [lunar days].

sanskrit_iast:
śobhanāstithayaḥ śaṣāḥ krūravāravivarjitāḥ /
śatabhiṣā dhaniṣṭhārdrā anurodhottaratrayaṃ(2) //
meaning:
शोभनास्तिथयः शषाः क्रूरवारविवर्जिताः /
शतभिषा धनिष्ठार्द्रा अनुरोधोत्तरत्रयं(2) //
text_mt: The remaining lunar days are auspicious, excluding cruel weekdays. / Śatabhiṣaj, Dhaniṣṭhā, Ārdrā, Anurādhā, and the three Uttarās,

sanskrit_iast:
rohiṇī śravaṇaśceti(3) sthirārambhe mahodayāḥ /
lagnañca kumbhasiṃhālitulāstrīvṛṣadhanvināṃ //
meaning:
रोहिणी श्रवणश्चेति(3) स्थिरारम्भे महोदयाः /
लग्नञ्च कुम्भसिंहालितुलास्त्रीवृषधन्विनां //
text_mt: Rohiṇī and Śravaṇa bring great fortune for a stable undertaking; / and the ascendant among Aquarius, Leo, Scorpio, Libra, Virgo, Taurus, and Sagittarius.

sanskrit_iast:
śasto jīvo navarkṣeṣu saptasthāneṣu sarvadā /
budhaḥ ṣaḍaṣṭadiksaptaturyeṣu vinartuṃ(4) śitaḥ //
meaning:
शस्तो जीवो नवर्क्षेषु सप्तस्थानेषु सर्वदा /
बुधः षडष्टदिक्सप्ततुर्येषु विनर्तुं(4) शितः //
text_mt: Jupiter is always auspicious in the nine lunar mansions and in the seventh house. / Mercury is sharp in the sixth, eighth, tenth, seventh, and fourth, without a season.

sanskrit_iast:
saptartutridaśādisthaḥ(5) śaśāṅkobaladaḥ sadā(6) /
ravirdaśatriṣaṭsaṃstho rāhustridaśaṣaḍgataḥ //
meaning:
सप्तर्तुत्रिदशादिस्थः(5) शशाङ्कोबलदः सदा(6) /
रविर्दशत्रिषट्संस्थो राहुस्त्रिदशषड्गतः //
text_mt: Stationed in the seventh, sixth, or thirteenth and following, the moon always gives strength. / The sun is situated in the tenth, third, or sixth, and Rāhu in the third, tenth, or sixth.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṭtristhānagatāḥ śastā mandāṅgārārkaketavaḥ /
śubhrāḥ krūraś ca pāpāś ca sarva ekādaśasthitāḥ //
meaning:
षट्त्रिस्थानगताः शस्ता मन्दाङ्गारार्ककेतवः /
शुभ्राः क्रूरश् च पापाश् च सर्व एकादशस्थिताः //
text_mt: Saturn, Mars, the sun, and Ketu are auspicious when situated in the sixth and third places. / Benefics, malefics, and cruels are all [auspicious] situated in the eleventh.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāṃ dṛṣṭirmunau pūrṇā(7) tvārdhikī grahabhūtayoḥ /
pādikī rāmadiksthāne caturaṣṭau(8) pādavarjitā //
meaning:
एषां दृष्टिर्मुनौ पूर्णा(7) त्वार्धिकी ग्रहभूतयोः /
पादिकी रामदिक्स्थाने चतुरष्टौ(8) पादवर्जिता //
text_mt: Their aspect is full on the seventh, half on the ninth and fifth, / a quarter on the third and tenth places, and diminished by a quarter on the fourth and eighth.

sanskrit_iast:
pādānyūnacaturnāḍī bhogaḥ syānmīnameṣayoḥ /
vṛṣakumbhau ca bhuñjāte catasraḥ pādavarjitāḥ //
meaning:
पादान्यूनचतुर्नाडी भोगः स्यान्मीनमेषयोः /
वृषकुम्भौ च भुञ्जाते चतस्रः पादवर्जिताः //
text_mt: The duration of Pisces and Aries is four nāḍīs diminished by a quarter; / and Taurus and Aquarius endure for four [nāḍīs] diminished by a quarter.

text_mt:
Capricorn and Gemini are five; Sagittarius, Scorpio, Leo, and Cancer / are six diminished by a quarter; Libra and Virgo are five and a half ghaṭikās.
[Apparatus notes]

8. "vasvaṣṭau" in manuscripts kha and cha.

sanskrit_iast:
keśarī vṛṣabhaḥ kumbhaḥ sthirāḥ syuḥ siddhidāyakāḥ /
carā dhanustulāmeṣā dviḥsvabhāvāstṛtīyakāḥ(1) //
meaning:
केशरी वृषभः कुम्भः स्थिराः स्युः सिद्धिदायकाः /
चरा धनुस्तुलामेषा द्विःस्वभावास्तृतीयकाः(1) //
text_mt: Leo, Taurus, and Aquarius are fixed [signs] that bestow success; / movable are Sagittarius, Libra, and Aries; the dual-natured are the third class.

sanskrit_iast:
śubhaḥ(2) śubhagrahair dṛṣṭaḥ śasto lagnaḥśubhāśritaḥ(3) /
guruśukrabudhe yukto lagno dadyādbalāyudhī(4) //
meaning:
शुभः(2) शुभग्रहैर् दृष्टः शस्तो लग्नःशुभाश्रितः(3) /
गुरुशुक्रबुधे युक्तो लग्नो दद्याद्बलायुधी(4) //
text_mt: An auspicious ascendant aspected by benefic planets, or occupied by benefics, is favored. / An ascendant conjoined with Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury bestows strength and weapons,

sanskrit_iast:
rājyaṃ śauryaṃ(5) balaṃ putrān yaśodharmādikaṃ bahu /
prathamaḥ saptamasturyo daśamaḥ kendra ucyate //
meaning:
राज्यं शौर्यं(5) बलं पुत्रान् यशोधर्मादिकं बहु /
प्रथमः सप्तमस्तुर्यो दशमः केन्द्र उच्यते //
text_mt: kingship, valor, strength, sons, fame, righteousness, and much else. / The first, seventh, fourth, and tenth [houses] are called cardinal.

sanskrit_iast:
guruśukrabudhāstatra sarvasiddhiprasādakāḥ /
tryekādaśacaturthasthā(6) lagnāt pāpagrahāḥ śubhāḥ //
meaning:
गुरुशुक्रबुधास्तत्र सर्वसिद्धिप्रसादकाः /
त्र्येकादशचतुर्थस्था(6) लग्नात् पापग्रहाः शुभाः //
text_mt: Jupiter, Venus, and Mercury there bestow all success. / Malefic planets are auspicious in the third, eleventh, and fourth from the ascendant.

sanskrit_iast:
atopyanīcakarmāthaṃ(7) yojyāstithyādayo budhaiḥ /
dhāmnaḥ pañcaguṇāṃ bhūmiṃ tyaktvā vā dhānasammitāṃ(8) //
meaning:
अतोप्यनीचकर्माथं(7) योज्यास्तिथ्यादयो बुधैः /
धाम्नः पञ्चगुणां भूमिं त्यक्त्वा वा धानसम्मितां(8) //
text_mt: Therefore, the lunar days and other factors should be employed by the wise for non-ignoble undertakings. / Leaving aside land five times the temple, or equal to the temple,

sanskrit_iast:
hastād dvādaśasopānāt(9) kuryānmaṇḍamagrataḥ /
caturasraṃ caturdvāraṃ snānārthantu(10) tadardhataḥ //
meaning:
हस्ताद् द्वादशसोपानात्(9) कुर्यान्मण्डमग्रतः /
चतुरस्रं चतुर्द्वारं स्नानार्थन्तु(10) तदर्धतः //
text_mt: one should construct a pavilion in front, [measuring] from a cubit up to twelve steps, / square with four entrances, or half that for the purpose of bathing,

sanskrit_iast:
ekāsyaṃ caturāsyaṃ vā raudryāṃ prācyuttarethavā(11) /
hāstiko daśahasto vai maṇḍaporkakaro 'thavā //
meaning:
एकास्यं चतुरास्यं वा रौद्र्यां प्राच्युत्तरेथवा(11) /
हास्तिको दशहस्तो वै मण्डपोर्ककरो ऽथवा //
text_mt: with one entrance or with four entrances, in the northeast, the east, or the north; / the pavilion may be one cubit, ten cubits, or twelve cubits.

text_mt:
With an increase of two cubits each, the remaining eight pavilions should be made.
[Notes]:
1. "Cancer and Capricorn situated in the second [house] destroy ascetism and endeavors;
Jupiter, Indra [Venus], and Mercury situated there bestow all perfections" is an additional reading in manuscripts ga and gha.
2. "sthira" in manuscript ga.
3. "śubhānvitaḥ" in manuscripts kha and cha.
4. "dhanāyuṣī" in manuscript ga.
5. "rājyaṃ saukhyam" in manuscript kha.
6. "dvyekādaśacaturthasthāḥ" in manuscript cha. / The half-verse "tryekādaśa…" is not present in manuscript ga.
7. "ato 'nye 'niṣṭhakarmārtham" in manuscripts kha, gha, and cha.
8. "tyaktvā vā cāpasammitām" in manuscript kha; / "tyaktvā vā rāmasammitām" in manuscript cha.
9. "hastādvā daśasopānāt" in manuscript kha; / "hastān vā daśa sopānāt" in manuscript kha.
10. "snānārhañca" in manuscript ṅa.
11. "prācyuttare tathā" in manuscript ṅa.
12. "dvihastottarayā vṛttyā" in manuscript gha.
[Page 304]
In the center there should be an altar of four cubits, furnished with corner pillars.

sanskrit_iast:
vedīpādāntaraṃ tyaktvā(2) kuṇḍāni nava pañca vā /
ekaṃ vā śivakāṣṭhāyāṃ(3) prācyāṃ vā tadguroḥ paraṃ //
meaning:
वेदीपादान्तरं त्यक्त्वा(2) कुण्डानि नव पञ्च वा /
एकं वा शिवकाष्ठायां(3) प्राच्यां वा तद्गुरोः परं //
text_mt: Leaving a distance equal to a leg of the altar, there should be nine or five fire-pits, / or one in the direction of Śiva [the northeast] or in the east, which is for the guru.

sanskrit_iast:
muṣṭimātraṃ śatārdhe syācchate cāratrimātrakaṃ(4) /
hastaṃ sahasrahome syānniyute tu dvihāstikaṃ(5) //
meaning:
मुष्टिमात्रं शतार्धे स्याच्छते चारत्रिमात्रकं(4) /
हस्तं सहस्रहोमे स्यान्नियुते तु द्विहास्तिकं(5) //
text_mt: For fifty [oblations] it should measure a fist; for a hundred, an aratni [cubit without fingers]; / for a thousand fire oblations, one cubit; and for a hundred thousand, two cubits.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣe catuṣkāraṃ kuṇḍaṃ koṭihome 'ṣṭahastakaṃ /
bhagābhamagnau(6) khaṇḍendu dakṣe tryasrañca nairṛte //
meaning:
लक्षे चतुष्कारं कुण्डं कोटिहोमे ऽष्टहस्तकं /
भगाभमग्नौ(6) खण्डेन्दु दक्षे त्र्यस्रञ्च नैरृते //
text_mt: For a hundred thousand, the fire-pit should be four cubits; for ten million fire oblations, eight cubits. / Resembling a vulva in the southeast; a crescent moon in the south; and triangular in the southwest;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍasraṃ vāyave padmaṃ(7) saumye cāṣṭāsrakaṃ śive /
tiryakpātaśivaṃ khātamūrdhvaṃ(8) mekhalayā saha //
meaning:
षडस्रं वायवे पद्मं(7) सौम्ये चाष्टास्रकं शिवे /
तिर्यक्पातशिवं खातमूर्ध्वं(8) मेखलया सह //
text_mt: hexagonal in the northwest; a lotus in the north; and octagonal in the northeast. / The depth should be equal to its crosswise fall, together with the upper rim.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvahirmekhalāstisro vedavahniyamāṅgulaiḥ(9) /
aṅgulaiḥ ṣaḍbhirekā vā kuṇḍākārāstu mekhalāḥ //
meaning:
तद्वहिर्मेखलास्तिस्रो वेदवह्नियमाङ्गुलैः(9) /
अङ्गुलैः षड्भिरेका वा कुण्डाकारास्तु मेखलाः //
text_mt: Outside that there should be three rims of four, three, and two digits; / or one rim of six digits; the rims should have the shape of the fire-pit.

sanskrit_iast:
tāsāmupari yoniḥ syānmadhye 'śvatthadalākṛtiḥ /
ucchrāyeṇāṅgulaṃ tasmādvistāreṇāṅgulāṣṭakaṃ(10) //
meaning:
तासामुपरि योनिः स्यान्मध्ये ऽश्वत्थदलाकृतिः /
उच्छ्रायेणाङ्गुलं तस्माद्विस्तारेणाङ्गुलाष्टकं(10) //
text_mt: Above them should be the vulva-spout, in the shape of a peepal leaf in the middle; / one digit in height, and eight digits in width from it;

sanskrit_iast:
dairghyaṃ kuṇḍārdhamānena kuṇḍakaṇṭhasamo 'dharaḥ /
pūrvāgniyāmyakuṇḍānāṃ yoniḥ syāduttarānanā //

प्लक्षोदुम्वरकाश्वत्थवटजास्तोरणाः क्रमात् /
शान्तिभूतिबलारोग्यपूर्वाद्या नामतः क्रमात् //
text_mt: The archways are made of plakṣa, udumbara, aśvattha, and vaṭa in sequence, / named respectively according to their presiding deities from the east: Tranquility, Prosperity, Strength, and Health.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaṣaṭsaptahastāni hastakhātasthitāni ca /
tadardhavistarāṇi syuryutānyāmradalādibhiḥ //

पञ्चषट्सप्तहस्तानि हस्तखातस्थितानि च /
तदर्धविस्तराणि स्युर्युतान्याम्रदलादिभिः //
text_mt: They should be five, six, and seven cubits [in height], set in pits of one cubit, / half that in width, and adorned with mango leaves and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
indrāyudhopamā raktā kṛṣṇā dhūmrā śaśiprabhā /
śuklābhā(1) hemavarṇā ca patākā sphāṭikopamā //

इन्द्रायुधोपमा रक्ता कृष्णा धूम्रा शशिप्रभा /
शुक्लाभा(1) हेमवर्णा च पताका स्फाटिकोपमा //
text_mt: Resembling a rainbow, red, black, smoky, moon-bright, / white-shining, gold-colored, and crystal-like flags

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāditobjaje(2) raktā nīlānantasya(3) nairṛte /

text_mt: should be [set] from the east onwards, red for the lotus-born [Brahmā] above, and dark blue for Ananta in the southwest. / The flags are five cubits in length and half that in width.

sanskrit_iast:
hastapradeśitā daṇḍā dhvajānāṃ pañcahastakāḥ /

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: from a lotus bed, a boar's [dwelling], a cowpen, and a crossroads— / twelve soils are to be taken for Vaikuṇṭha, eight for the wielder of Pināka [Śiva].

oṃ kauṃ kumudāya nama ity ādimantraiḥ //
meaning:
ध्वजाष्टदेवताः(7) पूज्याः पूर्वादौ(8) भूतकोटिभिः /
ओं कौं कुमुदाय नम इत्य् आदिमन्त्रैः //
text_mt: the deities of the eight banners are to be worshipped beginning in the east with crores of spirits, / with mantras beginning with: "Oṃ kauṃ, homage to Kumuda."

sanskrit_iast:
hetukaṃ tripuraghnañca śaktyākhyaṃ(9) yamajihvakaṃ(10) /
kālaṃ karālinaṃ ṣaṣṭhamekāṅghrimbhīmamaṣṭakaṃ //
meaning:
हेतुकं त्रिपुरघ्नञ्च शक्त्याख्यं(9) यमजिह्वकं(10) /
कालं करालिनं षष्ठमेकाङ्घ्रिम्भीममष्टकं //
text_mt: Hetuka, Tripuraghna, the one called Śakti, Yamajihvaka, / Kāla, the sixth Karālin, Ekāṅghri, and the eighth Bhīma:

sanskrit_iast:
tathaiva pūjayed dikṣu kṣetrapālānanukramāt /
:n
1 bhānutrayaṃ yugaṃ vedo lakṣmīkulapatistatheti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca /
bhānutrayayugaṃ vedo vedo lakṣmīpatistatheti ja..
2 devāmarāgare iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
3 tathā kuṇḍamiti kha.. , cha.. ca / tathā caṇḍamiti ja..
4 patākāmarcayediti ga.. / patākāsu yajediti ṅa..
5 huṃ phaṭ namaḥ, oṃ huṃ phaṭ dvāḥsthaśaktaye huṃ phaṭ
nama iti kha.. / oṃ krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ krūṃ phaṭ
dvāḥsthaśaktaye krūṃ phaṭ nama iti cha./ oṃ huṃ phaṭ vakrāya
huṃ phaṭ nama iti ga.. / oṃ huṃ phaṭ vajrāya huṃ phaṭ nama iti
ṅa..
6 pramukha iti ja..
7 dhvajāś ca devatā iti ga..
8 pūjādau iti ṅa.. , ja.. ca
9 buddhākhyamiti ga.. / buddhyākhyamiti ja..
10 ajajihvakamiti ja..
:p 311
balibhiḥ kusumair dhūpaiḥ santuṣṭān paribhāvayet(1) //
meaning:
तथैव पूजयेद् दिक्षु क्षेत्रपालाननुक्रमात् /
:न्
1 भानुत्रयं युगं वेदो लक्ष्मीकुलपतिस्तथेति ख.. , ग.. , छ.. च /
भानुत्रययुगं वेदो वेदो लक्ष्मीपतिस्तथेति ज..
2 देवामरागरे इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
3 तथा कुण्डमिति ख.. , छ.. च / तथा चण्डमिति ज..
4 पताकामर्चयेदिति ग.. / पताकासु यजेदिति ङ..
5 हुं फट् नमः, ओं हुं फट् द्वाःस्थशक्तये हुं फट्
नम इति ख.. / ओं क्रूं फट् नमः / ओं क्रूं फट्
द्वाःस्थशक्तये क्रूं फट् नम इति छ./ ओं हुं फट् वक्राय
हुं फट् नम इति ग.. / ओं हुं फट् वज्राय हुं फट् नम इति
ङ..
6 प्रमुख इति ज..
7 ध्वजाश् च देवता इति ग..
8 पूजादौ इति ङ.. , ज.. च
9 बुद्धाख्यमिति ग.. / बुद्ध्याख्यमिति ज..
10 अजजिह्वकमिति ज..
:प् 311
बलिभिः कुसुमैर् धूपैः सन्तुष्टान् परिभावयेत्(1) //
text_mt:
just so one should worship the guardians of the field in the directions in order;
[Footnotes]
[Footnote 1: "bhānutrayaṃ yugaṃ vedo lakṣmīkulapatistathā" in kha., ga., and cha.;]
"bhānutrayayugaṃ vedo vedo lakṣmīpatistathā" in ja.]
[Footnote 2: "devāmarāgare" in kha., ga., gha., ṅa., and cha.]
[Footnote 3: "tathā kuṇḍam" in kha. and cha.; "tathā caṇḍam" in ja.]
[Footnote 4: "patākāmarcayet" in ga.; "patākāsu yajet" in ṅa.]
[Footnote 5: "huṃ phaṭ namaḥ, oṃ huṃ phaṭ dvāḥsthaśaktaye huṃ phaṭ namaḥ" in kha.; "oṃ krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ krūṃ phaṭ dvāḥsthaśaktaye krūṃ phaṭ namaḥ" in cha.; "oṃ huṃ phaṭ vakrāya huṃ phaṭ namaḥ" in ga.; "oṃ huṃ phaṭ vajrāya huṃ phaṭ namaḥ" in ṅa.]
[Footnote 6: "pramukhaḥ" in ja.]
[Footnote 7: "dhvajāś ca devatāḥ" in ga.]
[Footnote 8: "pūjādau" in ṅa. and ja.]
[Footnote 9: "buddhākhyam" in ga.; "buddhyākhyam" in ja.]
[Footnote 10: "ajajihvakam" in ja. / p. 311]
one should contemplate them gratified with offerings, flowers, and incenses.

sanskrit_iast:
kambalāstṛteṣu varṇeṣu vaṃśasthūṇāsvanukramāt(2) /
pañca kṣityāditattvāni sadyojātādibhiryajet //
meaning:
कम्बलास्तृतेषु वर्णेषु वंशस्थूणास्वनुक्रमात्(2) /
पञ्च क्षित्यादितत्त्वानि सद्योजातादिभिर्यजेत् //
text_mt: On the syllables inscribed upon the blanket spread out, and on the bamboo pillars in order, / one should worship the five principles, beginning with Earth, with [the mantras of] Sadyojāta and the others.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivapadavyāpi maṇḍapaṃ(3) dhāma śāṅkaraṃ /
patākāśaktisaṃyuktaṃ(4) tattvadṛṣṭyāvalokayet(5) //
meaning:
सदाशिवपदव्यापि मण्डपं(3) धाम शाङ्करं /
पताकाशक्तिसंयुक्तं(4) तत्त्वदृष्ट्यावलोकयेत्(5) //
text_mt: One should look upon the pavilion, the Śaiva abode pervaded by the state of Sadāśiva, / endowed with the power of the banners, with the vision of reality.

sanskrit_iast:
divyāntarikṣabhūmiṣṭhavighnānutsārya pūrvavat /
praviśet paścimadvārā śeṣadvārāṇi darśayet(6) //
meaning:
दिव्यान्तरिक्षभूमिष्ठविघ्नानुत्सार्य पूर्ववत् /
प्रविशेत् पश्चिमद्वारा शेषद्वाराणि दर्शयेत्(6) //
text_mt: Having expelled celestial, atmospheric, and terrestrial obstacles as before, / one should enter through the western door and survey the remaining doors.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇakramādgatvā niviṣṭovedidakṣiṇe /
uttarābhimukhaḥ kuryād bhūtaśuddhiṃ yathā purā //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणक्रमाद्गत्वा निविष्टोवेदिदक्षिणे /
उत्तराभिमुखः कुर्याद् भूतशुद्धिं यथा पुरा //
text_mt: Going in clockwise circumambulation and sitting to the south of the altar, / facing north, one should perform the purification of the elements as before.

sanskrit_iast:
antaryāgaṃ viśeṣārghyaṃ mantradravyādiśodhanaṃ /
kurvīta ātmanaḥ(7) pūjāṃ pañcagavyādi pūrvavat //
meaning:
अन्तर्यागं विशेषार्घ्यं मन्त्रद्रव्यादिशोधनं /
कुर्वीत आत्मनः(7) पूजां पञ्चगव्यादि पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: One should perform the internal sacrifice, the special water offering, the purification of mantras and articles, / the worship of oneself, the five products of the cow, and so forth, as before.

sanskrit_iast:
sādhāraṅkalasantasmin vinyasettadanantaraṃ /
viśeṣācchivatattvāya tattvatrayamanukramāt //
meaning:
साधारङ्कलसन्तस्मिन् विन्यसेत्तदनन्तरं /
विशेषाच्छिवतत्त्वाय तत्त्वत्रयमनुक्रमात् //
text_mt: Then, one should deposit upon that supported jar / the three principles in succession, specifically for the Śiva principle:

sanskrit_iast:
lalāṭaskandhapādāntaṃ śivavidyātmakaṃ paraṃ /
rudranārāyaṇabrahmadaivataṃ nijasañcaraiḥ(8) //
:n
1 pravibhāvayediti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 kākṣītṛṇeṣu vargeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramāt iti kha.. /
kāṣṭhātṛṇeṣu varṇeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramāt iti cha.. /
kākṣītṛṇeṣu vaṃśeṣu sthūṇāsvanyeṣvanukramāt iti gha.. /
kakṣāṃ dṛśembarāṃśe ca tṛṇānanyeṣvānukramāditi ja.. /
kanyātṛṇeṣu ratneṣu vaṃśesthūṇānanukramāditi ṅa..
3 maṇḍalamiti ṅa..
4 pinākaśaktisaṃyuktāmiti gha..
5 tattu dṛṣṭyāvalokayediti kha.. , cha.. ca
6 śeṣadvārāṇi caṅkramediti kha.. , cha.. ca / śeṣadvārāṇi
pūjayediti cha..
7 svātmana iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
8 nijasaṃvarair iti ga.. , ṅa.. ca / nijasañcayair iti gha..
:p 312
oṃ haṃ hāṃ(1)
meaning:
ललाटस्कन्धपादान्तं शिवविद्यात्मकं परं /
रुद्रनारायणब्रह्मदैवतं निजसञ्चरैः(8) //
:न्
1 प्रविभावयेदिति ख.. , छ.. च
2 काक्षीतृणेषु वर्गेषु वंशे स्थूलाननुक्रमात् इति ख.. /
काष्ठातृणेषु वर्णेषु वंशे स्थूलाननुक्रमात् इति छ.. /
काक्षीतृणेषु वंशेषु स्थूणास्वन्येष्वनुक्रमात् इति घ.. /
कक्षां दृशेम्बरांशे च तृणानन्येष्वानुक्रमादिति ज.. /
कन्यातृणेषु रत्नेषु वंशेस्थूणाननुक्रमादिति ङ..
3 मण्डलमिति ङ..
4 पिनाकशक्तिसंयुक्तामिति घ..
5 तत्तु दृष्ट्यावलोकयेदिति ख.. , छ.. च
6 शेषद्वाराणि चङ्क्रमेदिति ख.. , छ.. च / शेषद्वाराणि
पूजयेदिति छ..
7 स्वात्मन इति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
8 निजसंवरैर् इति ग.. , ङ.. च / निजसञ्चयैर् इति घ..
:प् 312
ओं हं हां(1)
text_mt:
ending at the forehead, shoulders, and feet, consisting of Śiva, Vidyā, and Ātman, the supreme, / whose presiding deities are Rudra, Nārāyaṇa, and Brahmā, with their proper movements.
[Footnotes]
[Footnote 1: "pravibhāvayet" in kha. and cha.]
[Footnote 2: "kākṣītṛṇeṣu vargeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramāt" in kha.;]
"kāṣṭhātṛṇeṣu varṇeṣu vaṃśe sthūlānanukramāt" in cha.;]
"kākṣītṛṇeṣu vaṃśeṣu sthūṇāsvanyeṣvanukramāt" in gha.;]
"kakṣāṃ dṛśembarāṃśe ca tṛṇānanyeṣvānukramāt" in ja.;]
"kanyātṛṇeṣu ratneṣu vaṃśesthūṇānanukramāt" in ṅa.]
[Footnote 3: "maṇḍalam" in ṅa.]
[Footnote 4: "pinākaśaktisaṃyuktām" in gha.]
[Footnote 5: "tattu dṛṣṭyāvalokayet" in kha. and cha.]
[Footnote 6: "śeṣadvārāṇi caṅkramet" in kha. and cha.; "śeṣadvārāṇi pūjayet" in cha.]
[Footnote 7: "svātmanaḥ" in kha., gha., cha., and ja.]
[Footnote 8: "nijasaṃvaraiḥ" in ga. and ṅa.; "nijasañcayaiḥ" in gha. / p. 312]
"Oṃ haṃ hāṃ."

sanskrit_iast:
mūrtīstadīśvarāṃstatra pūrvavadviniveśayet /
tadvyāpakaṃ śivaṃ sāṅgaṃ śivahastañca mūrdhani //
meaning:
मूर्तीस्तदीश्वरांस्तत्र पूर्ववद्विनिवेशयेत् /
तद्व्यापकं शिवं साङ्गं शिवहस्तञ्च मूर्धनि //
text_mt: One should establish their forms and their lords there as before, / and the all-pervading Śiva along with his limbs, and the Śiva-hand upon the head.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmarandhrapraviṣṭena tejasā vāhyasāntaraṃ(2) /
tamaḥpaṭalamādhūya pradyotitadigantaraṃ(3) //
meaning:
ब्रह्मरन्ध्रप्रविष्टेन तेजसा वाह्यसान्तरं(2) /
तमःपटलमाधूय प्रद्योतितदिगन्तरं(3) //
text_mt: With the splendor entering through the aperture of Brahmā, which illuminates the directions, / having shaken off the veil of darkness, both outer and inner,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmānaṃ mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ sragvastrakusumādibhiḥ(4) /
bhūṣayitvā śivosmīti dhyātvā boghāsimuddharet //
meaning:
आत्मानं मूर्तिपैः सार्धं स्रग्वस्त्रकुसुमादिभिः(4) /
भूषयित्वा शिवोस्मीति ध्यात्वा बोघासिमुद्धरेत् //
text_mt: and having adorned oneself together with the icon-keepers with garlands, garments, flowers, and the like, / meditating "I am Śiva," one should raise the sword of enjoyment.

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpadāntasaṃskāraiḥ(5) saṃskuryānmakhamaṇḍapaṃ /
vikṣipya vikirādīni kuśakūrcopasaṃharet(6) //
meaning:
चतुष्पदान्तसंस्कारैः(5) संस्कुर्यान्मखमण्डपं /
विक्षिप्य विकिरादीनि कुशकूर्चोपसंहरेत्(6) //
text_mt: One should consecrate the sacrificial pavilion with the rites concluding with the four steps; / having scattered the scattered grain and other offerings, one should sweep them up with a kuśa broom.

sanskrit_iast:
āsanīkṛtya vardhanyāṃ vāstvādīn pūrvavadyajet /
śivakumbhāstravardhanyau pūjayecca sthirāsane(7) //
meaning:
आसनीकृत्य वर्धन्यां वास्त्वादीन् पूर्ववद्यजेत् /
शिवकुम्भास्त्रवर्धन्यौ पूजयेच्च स्थिरासने(7) //
text_mt: Having made a seat in the Vardhanī pitcher, one should worship the site deities and others as before, / and on a firm seat one should worship the Śiva jar and the weapon pitcher.

sanskrit_iast:
svadikṣu kalaśārūḍhāṃllokapālānanukramāt /
vāhāyudhādisaṃyuktān pūjayedvidhinā yathā //
meaning:
स्वदिक्षु कलशारूढांल्लोकपालाननुक्रमात् /
वाहायुधादिसंयुक्तान् पूजयेद्विधिना यथा //
text_mt: In their respective directions, mounted on the water-jars in proper sequence, / one should worship the guardians of the directions equipped with their mounts, weapons and attributes according to rule:

sanskrit_iast:
airāvatagajārūḍhaṃ svarṇavarṇaṃ(8) kirīṭinaṃ /
sahasranayanaṃ śakraṃ vajrapāṇiṃ vibhāvayet //
meaning:
ऐरावतगजारूढं स्वर्णवर्णं(8) किरीटिनं /
सहस्रनयनं शक्रं वज्रपाणिं विभावयेत् //
text_mt: One should visualize Śakra mounted on the elephant Airāvata, golden-complexioned, diademed, / thousand-eyed, with the thunderbolt in his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
saptārciṣaṃ ca vibhrāṇamakṣamālāṃ kamaṇḍaluṃ /
jvālāmālākulaṃ raktaṃ(9) śaktihastamajāsanaṃ //
:n
1 uṃ hāṃ hāṃ iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / oṃ īṃ āṃ iti
gha.. , ja.. ca
2 tejasā vāhyamantaramiti kha.. / tejasā vāhyābhyantaramiti cha.. / tejasā
vāhyamāntaramiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
3 praviṣṭonudigantaramiti gha.. , ja.. ca
4 sragvastramukuṭādibhiriti gha.. , ja.. ca
5 catuṣpathārṇasaṃskārair iti cha..
6 kuśadūrvopasaṃharediti ga..
7 śivakumbhāstravardhanyāṃ pūjayedasthirāsane iti gha.. , ja.. ca
8 varṇavastramiti ga.. / svarṇavastramiti kha.. , ja.. , ca
9 kālaṃ mālākulaṃ raktamiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / kālaṃ
mālākulaṃ, vyaktamiti ga.. / jvālāmālākulaṃ saktamiti gha..
:p 313
meaning:
सप्तार्चिषं च विभ्राणमक्षमालां कमण्डलुं /
ज्वालामालाकुलं रक्तं(9) शक्तिहस्तमजासनं //
:न्
1 उं हां हां इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च / ओं ईं आं इति
घ.. , ज.. च
2 तेजसा वाह्यमन्तरमिति ख.. / तेजसा वाह्याभ्यन्तरमिति छ.. / तेजसा
वाह्यमान्तरमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
3 प्रविष्टोनुदिगन्तरमिति घ.. , ज.. च
4 स्रग्वस्त्रमुकुटादिभिरिति घ.. , ज.. च
5 चतुष्पथार्णसंस्कारैर् इति छ..
6 कुशदूर्वोपसंहरेदिति ग..
7 शिवकुम्भास्त्रवर्धन्यां पूजयेदस्थिरासने इति घ.. , ज.. च
8 वर्णवस्त्रमिति ग.. / स्वर्णवस्त्रमिति ख.. , ज.. , च
9 कालं मालाकुलं रक्तमिति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. , छ.. च / कालं
मालाकुलं, व्यक्तमिति ग.. / ज्वालामालाकुलं सक्तमिति घ..
:प् 313
text_mt:
And [Agni] seven-rayed, bearing a rosary and a water-pot, / enveloped in a garland of flames, red, holding a spear in hand, seated on a goat.
:n
1 'uṃ hāṃ hāṃ' in kha, ga, gha, ṅa, and cha; 'oṃ īṃ āṃ' in gha and ja.
2 'tejasā vāhyamantaram' in kha; 'tejasā vāhyābhyantaram' in cha; 'tejasā vāhyamāntaram' in ga, gha, and ṅa.
3 'praviṣṭonudigantaram' in gha and ja.
4 'sragvastramukuṭādibhiḥ' in gha and ja.
5 'catuṣpathārṇasaṃskāraiḥ' in cha.
6 'kuśadūrvopasaṃharet' in ga.
7 'śivakumbhāstravardhanyāṃ pūjayedasthirāsane' in gha and ja.
8 'varṇavastram' in ga; 'svarṇavastram' in kha, ja, and ca.
9 'kālaṃ mālākulaṃ raktam' in kha, ga, ṅa, and cha; 'kālaṃ mālākulaṃ vyaktam' in ga; 'jvālāmālākulaṃ saktam' in gha. / :p 313

sanskrit_iast:
mahiṣasthaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ yamaṃ kālānalaṃ smaret /
raktanetraṃ svarārūḍhaṃ(1) khaḍgahastañca nairṛtaṃ //
meaning:
महिषस्थं दण्डहस्तं यमं कालानलं स्मरेत् /
रक्तनेत्रं स्वरारूढं(1) खड्गहस्तञ्च नैरृतं //
text_mt: One should contemplate Yama seated on a buffalo, holding a staff, [like] the cosmic fire of dissolution; / and Nairṛta mounted on a dog, red-eyed, with a sword in his hand.

sanskrit_iast:
varuṇaṃ makare śvetaṃ nāgapāśadharaṃ smaret /
vāyuṃ ca hariṇe nīlaṃ kuveraṃ meghasaṃsthitaṃ(2) //
meaning:
वरुणं मकरे श्वेतं नागपाशधरं स्मरेत् /
वायुं च हरिणे नीलं कुवेरं मेघसंस्थितं(2) //
text_mt: One should contemplate Varuṇa white upon a makara, holding a serpent-noose; / Vāyu blue upon a deer, and Kuvera positioned upon a cloud;

sanskrit_iast:
triśūlinaṃ vṛṣe ceśaṃ kūrmenantantu cakriṇaṃ /
brāhmāṇaṃ haṃsagaṃ dhyāyeccaturvaktraṃ caturbhujaṃ //
meaning:
त्रिशूलिनं वृषे चेशं कूर्मेनन्तन्तु चक्रिणं /
ब्राह्माणं हंसगं ध्यायेच्चतुर्वक्त्रं चतुर्भुजं //
text_mt: and Īśa with a trident on a bull; Ananta with the discus upon the tortoise; / and one should meditate on Brahmā mounted on a swan, four-faced and four-armed.

sanskrit_iast:
stambhamūleṣu kumbheṣu vedyāṃ dharmādikān(3) yajet /
dikṣu kumbheṣvanantādīn pūjayantyapi kecana //
meaning:
स्तम्भमूलेषु कुम्भेषु वेद्यां धर्मादिकान्(3) यजेत् /
दिक्षु कुम्भेष्वनन्तादीन् पूजयन्त्यपि केचन //
text_mt: At the bases of the pillars, on the water-jars, and on the altar, one should worship Dharma and the others; / some also worship Ananta and others on the water-jars in the cardinal directions.

sanskrit_iast:
śivājñāṃ śrāvayet kumbhaṃ bhrāmayedātmapṛṣṭhagaṃ(4) /
pūrvavat sthāpayedādau kumbhaṃ tadanu vardhanīṃ //
meaning:
शिवाज्ञां श्रावयेत् कुम्भं भ्रामयेदात्मपृष्ठगं(4) /
पूर्ववत् स्थापयेदादौ कुम्भं तदनु वर्धनीं //
text_mt: One should proclaim Śiva's command, circumambulate the water-jar keeping it behind oneself, / and deposit first the water-jar as before, and after that the ritual pitcher.

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ sthirāsanaṃ(5) kumbhe śastrārthañca(6) dhruvāsanaṃ /
pūjayitvā yathāpūrvaṃ spṛśedudbhavamudrayā //
meaning:
शिवं स्थिरासनं(5) कुम्भे शस्त्रार्थञ्च(6) ध्रुवासनं /
पूजयित्वा यथापूर्वं स्पृशेदुद्भवमुद्रया //
text_mt: Having worshipped Śiva upon a firm seat in the water-jar, and for the sake of the weapon upon a permanent seat, / as previously, one should touch [it] with the manifestation gesture.

sanskrit_iast:
nijayāgaṃ(7) jagannātha rakṣa bhaktānukampayā /
ebhiḥ saṃśrāvya rakṣārthaṃ kumbhe khaḍgaṃ niveśayet(8) //
meaning:
निजयागं(7) जगन्नाथ रक्ष भक्तानुकम्पया /
एभिः संश्राव्य रक्षार्थं कुम्भे खड्गं निवेशयेत्(8) //
text_mt: "O Lord of the Universe, protect your own sacrifice out of compassion for your devotees!" / Having proclaimed [this] with these [words] for the sake of protection, one should place a sword upon the water-jar.

sanskrit_iast:
dīkṣāsthāpanayoḥ kumbhe sthaṇḍile maṇḍale 'thavā /
maṇḍalebhyarcya deveśaṃ vrajedvai kuṇḍasannidhau //
meaning:
दीक्षास्थापनयोः कुम्भे स्थण्डिले मण्डले ऽथवा /
मण्डलेभ्यर्च्य देवेशं व्रजेद्वै कुण्डसन्निधौ //
text_mt: In the case of initiation and installation, in a water-jar, on a mound of earth, or in a maṇḍala, / having worshipped the Lord of Gods in the maṇḍala, one should proceed to the vicinity of the fire-pit.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍanābhiṃ puraskṛtya niniṣṭhā mūrtidhāriṇaḥ /
gurorādeśataḥ kuryur nijakuṇḍeṣu(9) saṃskṛtiṃ //
:n
1 śavārūḍhamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
2 mānuṣasthitamiti gha..
3 karmādikāniti ja..
4 bhrāmayedanupūjya tamiti ja.. / bhrāmayedanupṛṣṭhagamiti gha..
5 sthirāsane iti kha.. , gha.. ca
6 śastrāṇuñceti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca
7 imaṃ yāgamiti ṅa..
8 śaṅkhannivedayediti ga.. / khaḍgannivedayediti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
9 kuryur nijakumbheṣviti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
:p 314
meaning:
कुण्डनाभिं पुरस्कृत्य निनिष्ठा मूर्तिधारिणः /
गुरोरादेशतः कुर्युर् निजकुण्डेषु(9) संस्कृतिं //
:न्
1 शवारूढमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
2 मानुषस्थितमिति घ..
3 कर्मादिकानिति ज..
4 भ्रामयेदनुपूज्य तमिति ज.. / भ्रामयेदनुपृष्ठगमिति घ..
5 स्थिरासने इति ख.. , घ.. च
6 शस्त्राणुञ्चेति ख.. , ग.. , छ.. च
7 इमं यागमिति ङ..
8 शङ्खन्निवेदयेदिति ग.. / खड्गन्निवेदयेदिति घ.. , ङ.. च
9 कुर्युर् निजकुम्भेष्विति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
:प् 314
text_mt:
Focusing upon the navel of the fire-pit, steady, the assistants bearing the forms of the deities / should perform the consecration in their own fire-pits at the command of the guru.
:n
1 'śavārūḍham' in ga, gha, ṅa, and ja.
2 'mānuṣasthitam' in gha.
3 'karmādikān' in ja.
4 'bhrāmayedanupūjya tam' in ja; 'bhrāmayedanupṛṣṭhagam' in gha.
5 'sthirāsane' in kha and gha.
6 'śastrāṇuñca' in kha, ga, and cha.
7 'imaṃ yāgam' in ṅa.
8 'śaṅkhannivedayet' in ga; 'khaḍgannivedayet' in gha and ṅa.
9 'kuryur nijakumbheṣu' in kha, gha, cha, and ja. / :p 314

sanskrit_iast:
japeyurjāpinaḥ saṅkhyaṃ(1) mantramanye tu saṃhitāṃ(2) /
paṭheyurbrāhmaṇāḥ śāntiṃ svaśākhāvedapāragāḥ //
meaning:
जपेयुर्जापिनः सङ्ख्यं(1) मन्त्रमन्ये तु संहितां(2) /
पठेयुर्ब्राह्मणाः शान्तिं स्वशाखावेदपारगाः //
text_mt: The reciters should recite the prescribed number of mantras, while others [recite] the saṃhitā; / the brāhmaṇas who have mastered the Vedas of their own Vedic branches should chant the propitiatory verses.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānīś ca(3) maitrakañca vṛṣākapiṃ /
ṛgvedī sarvadigbhāge sarvametat samuccaret(4) //
meaning:
श्रीसूक्तं पावमानीश् च(3) मैत्रकञ्च वृषाकपिं /
ऋग्वेदी सर्वदिग्भागे सर्वमेतत् समुच्चरेत्(4) //
text_mt: The Ṛgvedic priest should chant in all quarters all these: / the Śrīsūkta, the Pāvamānī hymns, the Maitraka hymn, and the Vṛṣākapi hymn.

sanskrit_iast:
devavratantu bhāruṇḍaṃ(5) jyeṣṭhasāma rathantaraṃ /
puruṣaṃ gītimetāni sāmavedī tu dakṣiṇe //
meaning:
देवव्रतन्तु भारुण्डं(5) ज्येष्ठसाम रथन्तरं /
पुरुषं गीतिमेतानि सामवेदी तु दक्षिणे //
text_mt: The Sāmavedic priest in the south, however, [should sing] these: / the Devavrata, the Bhāruṇḍa, the Jyeṣṭhasāma, the Rathantara, the Puruṣa, and the chant.

sanskrit_iast:
rudraṃ puruṣasūktañca ślokādhyāyaṃ viśeṣataḥ /
brāhmaṇañca yajurvedī paścimāyāṃ samuccaret(6) //
meaning:
रुद्रं पुरुषसूक्तञ्च श्लोकाध्यायं विशेषतः /
ब्राह्मणञ्च यजुर्वेदी पश्चिमायां समुच्चरेत्(6) //
text_mt: The Yajurvedic priest should recite in the west: / the Rudra, the Puruṣasūkta, especially the Ślokādhyāya, and the Brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
nīlarudraṃ tathātharvī sūkṣmāsūkṣmantathaiva ca /
uttare 'tharvaśīrṣañca(7) tatparastu samuddharet //
meaning:
नीलरुद्रं तथाथर्वी सूक्ष्मासूक्ष्मन्तथैव च /
उत्तरे ऽथर्वशीर्षञ्च(7) तत्परस्तु समुद्धरेत् //
text_mt: And likewise the Atharvavedic priest in the north, intent on that, / should chant the Nīlarudra, as well as the subtle and gross [hymns], and the Atharvaśīrṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
ācāryaścāgnimutpādya pratikuṇḍaṃ pradāpayet(8) /
vahneḥ pūrvādikān bhāgān(9) pūrvakuṇḍāditaḥ(10) kramāt //
meaning:
आचार्यश्चाग्निमुत्पाद्य प्रतिकुण्डं प्रदापयेत्(8) /
वह्नेः पूर्वादिकान् भागान्(9) पूर्वकुण्डादितः(10) क्रमात् //
text_mt: And the master, having produced the fire, should distribute it to each fire-pit, / into the portions of fire from the east onwards, in order starting from the eastern fire-pit.

sanskrit_iast:
dhūpadīpacarūṇāñca dadītāgniṃ samuddharet(11) /
pūrvavacchivamabhyarcya śivāgnau mantratarpaṇaṃ //
meaning:
धूपदीपचरूणाञ्च ददीताग्निं समुद्धरेत्(11) /
पूर्ववच्छिवमभ्यर्च्य शिवाग्नौ मन्त्रतर्पणं //
text_mt: He should offer incense, lamps, and sacrificial boiled rice, and raise up the fire. / Having worshipped Śiva as before, [performing] satisfaction of mantras in the Śiva-fire,

sanskrit_iast:
deśakālādisampattau(12) dur nimittapraśāntaye /
:n
1 jāpinosaṅkhyamiti ka.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
2 astramanye tu saṃsthitamiti ga.. / astramanye tu saṃhitāmiti ṅa..
3 pāvamānīntu iti ja..
4 sarvametat samuddharediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca / sarvamastraṃ
samuddharediti ṅa..

6 samuddharediti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
7 uttaretharvasūktañceti ga..
8 pradīpayediti gha..
9 pūrvādidigbhāgāditi ja.. / pūrvādikādbhāgāditi gha..
10 sarvakuṇḍādita iti kha.. , cha.. , ca
11 ācāryaścāgnimutpādyetyādiḥ dadītāgniṃ samuddharedityantaḥ
pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
12 deśakālādisaṅkhyāptau iti gha..

homaṅkṛtvā tu mantrajñaḥ pūrṇāṃ dattvā śubhāvahāṃ //
meaning:
देशकालादिसम्पत्तौ(12) दुर् निमित्तप्रशान्तये /
:न्
1 जापिनोसङ्ख्यमिति क.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
2 अस्त्रमन्ये तु संस्थितमिति ग.. / अस्त्रमन्ये तु संहितामिति ङ..
3 पावमानीन्तु इति ज..
4 सर्वमेतत् समुद्धरेदिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , छ.. , ज.. च / सर्वमस्त्रं
समुद्धरेदिति ङ..
5 भावज्ञमिति छ.. / श्रीकुण्डमिति ङ..
6 समुद्धरेदिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
7 उत्तरेथर्वसूक्तञ्चेति ग..
8 प्रदीपयेदिति घ..
9 पूर्वादिदिग्भागादिति ज.. / पूर्वादिकाद्भागादिति घ..
10 सर्वकुण्डादित इति ख.. , छ.. , च
11 आचार्यश्चाग्निमुत्पाद्येत्यादिः ददीताग्निं समुद्धरेदित्यन्तः
पाठो ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
12 देशकालादिसङ्ख्याप्तौ इति घ..
:प् 315
होमङ्कृत्वा तु मन्त्रज्ञः पूर्णां दत्त्वा शुभावहां //
text_mt:
upon the attainment of proper place, time, and circumstances, for the pacification of inauspicious portents,
:n
1 'jāpinosaṅkhyam' in ka, ṅa, and cha.
2 'astramanye tu saṃsthitam' in ga; 'astramanye tu saṃhitām' in ṅa.
3 'pāvamānīntu' in ja.
4 'sarvametat samuddharet' in kha, ga, gha, cha, and ja; 'sarvamastraṃ samuddharet' in ṅa.
5 'bhāvajñam' in cha; 'śrīkuṇḍam' in ṅa.
6 'samuddhared' in kha, gha, ṅa, and ja.
7 'uttaretharvasūktañceti' in ga.
8 'pradīpayet' in gha.
9 'pūrvādidigbhāgāt' in ja; 'pūrvādikādbhāgāt' in gha.
10 'sarvakuṇḍāditaḥ' in kha and cha.
11 The reading beginning with 'ācāryaścāgnimutpādya' and ending with 'dadītāgniṃ samuddharet' is not present in manuscript ga.
12 'deśakālādisaṅkhyāptau' in gha. / :p 315
having performed the fire oblation, the knower of mantras, offering the auspicious full oblation,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvavaccarukaṃ kṛtvā pratikuṇḍaṃ nivedayet(1) /
yajamānālaṅkṛtāstu vrajeyuḥ snānamaṇḍapaṃ //
meaning:
पूर्ववच्चरुकं कृत्वा प्रतिकुण्डं निवेदयेत्(1) /
यजमानालङ्कृतास्तु व्रजेयुः स्नानमण्डपं //
text_mt: having prepared the sacrificial rice as before, should present it to each fire-pit. / Adorned, the patrons should proceed to the bathing pavilion.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadrapīṭhe nidhāyeśaṃ(2) tāḍayitvāvaguṇṭhayet /
snāpayet(3) pūjayitvā tu mṛdā kāṣāyavāriṇā //
meaning:
भद्रपीठे निधायेशं(2) ताडयित्वावगुण्ठयेत् /
स्नापयेत्(3) पूजयित्वा तु मृदा काषायवारिणा //
text_mt: Having placed the Lord upon an auspicious seat, having struck and veiled [him], / and having worshipped him, one should bathe [him] with clay and with astringent water,

sanskrit_iast:
gomūtrair gomayenāpi vāriṇā cāntarāntarā /
bhasmanā gandhatoyena phaḍantāstreṇa vāriṇā //
meaning:
गोमूत्रैर् गोमयेनापि वारिणा चान्तरान्तरा /
भस्मना गन्धतोयेन फडन्तास्त्रेण वारिणा //
text_mt: with cow-urine and also cow-dung, and with water at intervals, / with ash, scented water, and water accompanied by the weapon mantra ending in 'phaṭ'.

sanskrit_iast:
deśiko mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā kāraṇaśodhanaṃ(4) /
dharmajaptena sañchāṭya(5) pītavarṇena vāsasā //
meaning:
देशिको मूर्तिपैः सार्धं कृत्वा कारणशोधनं(4) /
धर्मजप्तेन सञ्छाट्य(5) पीतवर्णेन वाससा //
text_mt: The spiritual master, having performed the purification of elements together with the guardians of the icons, / covering [the deity] with a yellow garment consecrated with the dharma mantra,

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya sitapuṣpaiś ca(6) nayeduttaravedikāṃ /
tatra dattāsanāyāñca śayyāyāṃ sanniveśya ca(7) //
meaning:
सम्पूज्य सितपुष्पैश् च(6) नयेदुत्तरवेदिकां /
तत्र दत्तासनायाञ्च शय्यायां सन्निवेश्य च(7) //
text_mt: and having worshipped with white flowers, should lead [him] to the northern altar; / and having installed [him] there on a couch provided with a seat,

sanskrit_iast:
kuṅkumāliptasūtreṇa vibhajya gururālikhet /
śalākayā suvarṇasya akṣiṇī śastrakarmaṇā(8) //
meaning:
कुङ्कुमालिप्तसूत्रेण विभज्य गुरुरालिखेत् /
शलाकया सुवर्णस्य अक्षिणी शस्त्रकर्मणा(8) //
text_mt: measuring with a cord smeared with saffron, the guru should draw / the two eyes with a golden probe by surgical operation.

sanskrit_iast:
añjayellakṣmakṛt paścācchāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā /
kṛtakarmā ca śastreṇa lakṣmī śilpī samutkṣipet(9) //
meaning:
अञ्जयेल्लक्ष्मकृत् पश्चाच्छास्त्रदृष्टेन कर्मणा /
कृतकर्मा च शस्त्रेण लक्ष्मी शिल्पी समुत्क्षिपेत्(9) //
text_mt: The maker of the marks should then apply collyrium according to the procedure prescribed in scripture. / And when the work has been done with the tool, the artisan should remove the [effigy of] Lakṣmī.

sanskrit_iast:
tryaṃśādardhotha(10) pādārdhādardhāyā /
ardhayothavā(11)
:n
1 niveśayediti kha.. ,gha.. ca
2 bhadrapīṭhe nidhāyainamiti kha.. , cha.. , ca / tatra pīṭhe vidhāyeśamiti
ṅa.. / bhadrapīṭhe vidhāyeśamiti gha..
3 snapayediti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. ca
4 kṛcā cākāraśodhanāmiti gha.. , ja.. ca
5 dharmajaptena saṃsthāpyeti ga.. / dharmajalena sañchādyeti ṅa..
6 sampūjya sitavastraiśceti ga.. / sampūjyasitapuṣpaistu iti gha..
7 sanniveśayediti cha..
8 śāstrakarmaṇeti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. , ja.. ca / śāstravarmaṇeti gha.. /
śāstrakarmaṇi iti ḍa..
9 samutkiret iti gha.. , ja.. ca
10 tryaṃśādapyatheti gha.. / tryaṃśādadhotheti ja..
11 ardhato 'piveti ga.. / ardhato varamiti ja..

meaning:
त्र्यंशादर्धोथ(10) पादार्धादर्धाया /
अर्धयोथवा(11)
:न्
1 निवेशयेदिति ख.. ,घ.. च

मण्डपे पश्चिमद्वारे शय्यायां विनिवेशयेत् //
text_mt: He should quickly carry the deity and the substances in the chariot of Brahmā. / In the pavilion, at the western door, he should place him upon the couch.

text_mt: the four-sided, eight-sided, and round [parts], up to the region of Māyā and the Śakti. / There, in the order of creation, [he should deposit] the Soul-principle, the Knowledge[-principle], and Śiva,

text_mt: Or, in a sacrifice consisting of five fire-pits, he should deposit the five forms: / earth, water, fire, wind, and space;

rudramīśaṃ sadākhyañca sṛṣṭinyāyena mantravit(5) //

text_mt: Or, for one desirous of liberation, the [kalās] beginning with Nivṛtti, their lords beginning with Ajāta, / or everywhere he should deposit the three principles, the causes possessing all-pervading nature.

“Obeisance to Śiva” and so forth; “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to the icon of the earth”; “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to Brahmā, the lord of icons” and so forth; “Oṃ hāṃ, obeisance to Rudra, the lord of the principle of Śiva” and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:

dvādaśāntātsamānīya niṣkalaṃ(4) vyāpakaṃ śivaṃ //

द्वादशान्तात्समानीय निष्कलं(4) व्यापकं शिवं //
text_mt: and bringing down from the twelve-finger aperture the mantra distinguished by the mind, / resembling the rasa of attained bliss, [namely] partless, all-pervading Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭatriṃśatkalopetaṃ sahasrakiraṇojjvalaṃ /

text_mt: endowed with the thirty-eight kalās, radiant with a thousand rays, / consisting of all powers, complete with his limbs—having meditated [on Him thus], one should deposit [Him] into the liṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
jīvanyāso bhavedevaṃ liṅge sarvārthasādhakaḥ /
piṇḍikādiṣu tu nyāsaḥ(6) procyate sāmprataṃ yathā //
meaning:
जीवन्यासो भवेदेवं लिङ्गे सर्वार्थसाधकः /
पिण्डिकादिषु तु न्यासः(6) प्रोच्यते साम्प्रतं यथा //
text_mt: Thus the ritual deposition of life into the liṅga, accomplishing all aims, is accomplished. / Now the ritual deposition upon the pedestal and so forth is described as follows:

sanskrit_iast:
piṇḍikāñca kṛtasnānāṃ(7) viliptāñcandanādibhiḥ /
sadvastraiś ca samācchādya(8) randhre ca bhagalakṣaṇe //

पिण्डिकाञ्च कृतस्नानां(7) विलिप्ताञ्चन्दनादिभिः /
सद्वस्त्रैश् च समाच्छाद्य(8) रन्ध्रे च भगलक्षणे //
text_mt: The pedestal, having been bathed, smeared with sandal and other [pastes], / covered with fine garments, and in its cavity having the mark of the vulva,

text_mt: furnished with the five jewels and other [items], situated to the north of the liṅga, / having its ritual deposition performed just like the liṅga, one should properly worship according to rule.
