text_mt: Here too, upon the pedestal, the foundation stone of Brahmā, and others, according to rule, / one should perform everything as before, with the coverings of Gaurī and the rest.

text_mt: Having performed the deposition thus, then going near the fire-pit, / [one should deposit] Maheśāna in the middle of the fire-pit, Maheśvara upon the tiers,

text_mt: Kriyāśakti on the others, and Nādam upon the lip. / Then, [one should perform] the union of channels between the pitcher, the sacrificial ground, the fire, and the Lord:

text_mt: visualising one's own power, which is like a lotus-fibre, raised by the upward breath, / entering along the solar path, issuing forth, arisen,

text_mt: and entering again through the path of the void. / In this way union should be effected everywhere mutually by the guardians of the icons.

text_mt:
Residing at night accompanied by the guru and others, preceded by vows— / that is preliminary consecration (adhivāsa), declared from the verbal root vas ('to dwell') with the sense of [following] a rule.
Thus ends the ninety-sixth chapter, named 'The Rule of Preliminary Consecration,' in the great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now begins the ninety-seventh chapter:
The description of the consecration of Śiva.

entering according to the prior injunction, one should carry out the purification of the body and other [preliminaries].

having offered according to ability, and having sipped water, [addressing] Maheśvara,

sanskrit_iast:
datvārghaṃ ca japaṃ kṛtvā(1) nivedya varade kare(2) /
candrārkatārakaṃ yāvan mantreṇa śaivamūrtipaiḥ(3) //
meaning:
दत्वार्घं च जपं कृत्वा(1) निवेद्य वरदे करे(2) /
चन्द्रार्कतारकं यावन् मन्त्रेण शैवमूर्तिपैः(3) //
text_mt: and having given the arghya, and having performed japa, offering it into the boon-granting hand, / [proclaiming] 'As long as the moon, sun, and stars endure,' with the mantra by the Śaiva mūrtipas:

sanskrit_iast:
svecchayaiva tvayā nātha sthātavyamiha mandire /
praṇamyeva vahirgatvā(4) hṛdā vā praṇavena vā //
meaning:
स्वेच्छयैव त्वया नाथ स्थातव्यमिह मन्दिरे /
प्रणम्येव वहिर्गत्वा(4) हृदा वा प्रणवेन वा //
text_mt: 'By your own will alone, O Lord, you should remain here in this temple!' / Bowing and going outside, either with the Heart [mantra] or with the Praṇava,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpya vṛṣabhaṃ paścāt pūrvavadvalimācaret /
nyūnādidoṣamoṣāya(5) tato mṛtyujitā śataṃ //
meaning:
संस्थाप्य वृषभं पश्चात् पूर्ववद्वलिमाचरेत् /
न्यूनादिदोषमोषाय(5) ततो मृत्युजिता शतं //
text_mt: having installed the bull behind, he should perform the bali offering as before. / Then, for the destruction of deficiencies and other defects, one hundred [oblations] with the Mṛtyujit [mantra]

sanskrit_iast:
śivena saśivo hutvā śāntyarthaṃ pāyasena ca /
jñānājñānakṛtaṃ yacca tat pūraya mahāvibho(6) //
meaning:
शिवेन सशिवो हुत्वा शान्त्यर्थं पायसेन च /
ज्ञानाज्ञानकृतं यच्च तत् पूरय महाविभो(6) //
text_mt: being identical with Śiva, should be offered to Śiva with milk-rice for the sake of pacification: / 'Whatever has been done knowingly or unknowingly, fulfill that, O great Lord!'

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyapaśubhūmyādi(7) gītavādyādihetave /
ambikeśāya tad bhaktyā śaktyā sarvaṃ nivedayet //
meaning:
हिरण्यपशुभूम्यादि(7) गीतवाद्यादिहेतवे /
अम्बिकेशाय तद् भक्त्या शक्त्या सर्वं निवेदयेत् //
text_mt: Gold, cattle, land, and so forth, for the sake of songs, musical instruments, and the like, / he should offer all that with devotion according to ability to the Lord of Ambikā.

sanskrit_iast:
dānaṃ mahotsavaṃ paścāt kuryāddinacatuṣṭayaṃ /
trisandhyaṃ tridinaṃ mantrī homayen mūrtipaiḥ saha //
meaning:
दानं महोत्सवं पश्चात् कुर्याद्दिनचतुष्टयं /
त्रिसन्ध्यं त्रिदिनं मन्त्री होमयेन् मूर्तिपैः सह //
text_mt: Afterward, he should celebrate gifts and a great festival for four days. / For three days at the three junctions of the day, the mantrin together with the mūrtipas should offer oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthehani pūrṇāñca carukaṃ bahurūpiṇā /
nivedya sarvakuṇḍeṣu sampātāhutisodhitam(8) //
meaning:
चतुर्थेहनि पूर्णाञ्च चरुकं बहुरूपिणा /
निवेद्य सर्वकुण्डेषु सम्पाताहुतिसोधितम्(8) //
text_mt: On the fourth day, having presented the full oblation and the sacrificial cooked rice with the Bahurūpa [mantra], / purified with sampātāhuti offerings in all the fire-pits,

sanskrit_iast:
dinacatuṣṭayaṃ yāvattannirmālyantadūrdhataḥ /
nirmālyāpanayaṃ kṛtvā snāpayitvā tu(9) pūjayet //
meaning:
दिनचतुष्टयं यावत्तन्निर्माल्यन्तदूर्धतः /
निर्माल्यापनयं कृत्वा स्नापयित्वा तु(9) पूजयेत् //
text_mt: the floral offerings of the deity remain for four days; after that, / having removed the floral offerings of the deity and bathed [the liṅga], he should worship it.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjā sāmānyaliṅgeṣu kāryā sādhāraṇāṇubhiḥ(10) /
:n
1 jalaṃ hutvā iti ga..
2 nivedya varadevake iti ja..
3 mantreśair mūrtipaiḥ saha iti jha.. / mantreśair mūrtijaiḥ saha iti
gha..
4 vahiṣkṛtvā iti jha.. / vahirhatvā iti gha..
5 nyūnādidoṣamokṣāyeti ja.. / nyānādidoṣanāśāyeti ṅa..
6 mahāprabho iti jha..
7 hiraṇyavastradhūpādi iti jha..
8 pāyasāhutisodhitamiti jha.. / sampātāhutiśodhanamiti ga..
9 snāpayitvā ca iti ga..
10 sādhāraṇāṃśubhiriti kha.. / sādhāraṇādikamiti ga..
:p 333
vihāya liṅgacaitanyaṃ kuryāt sthāṇuvisarjanaṃ //
meaning:
पूजा सामान्यलिङ्गेषु कार्या साधारणाणुभिः(10) /
:न्
1 जलं हुत्वा इति ग..
2 निवेद्य वरदेवके इति ज..
3 मन्त्रेशैर् मूर्तिपैः सह इति झ.. / मन्त्रेशैर् मूर्तिजैः सह इति
घ..
4 वहिष्कृत्वा इति झ.. / वहिर्हत्वा इति घ..
5 न्यूनादिदोषमोक्षायेति ज.. / न्यानादिदोषनाशायेति ङ..
6 महाप्रभो इति झ..
7 हिरण्यवस्त्रधूपादि इति झ..
8 पायसाहुतिसोधितमिति झ.. / सम्पाताहुतिशोधनमिति ग..
9 स्नापयित्वा च इति ग..
10 साधारणांशुभिरिति ख.. / साधारणादिकमिति ग..
:प् 333
विहाय लिङ्गचैतन्यं कुर्यात् स्थाणुविसर्जनं //
text_mt:
Worship in common liṅgas is to be performed with common mantras.
:n
1 'having offered water in fire' in manuscript ga..
2 'having presented to the eminent deity' in manuscript ja..
3 'along with the lords of mantras and the guardians of icons' in manuscript jha.. / 'along with the lords of mantras and those born of icons' in manuscript gha..
4 'having expelled outside' in manuscript jha.. / 'having struck outside' in manuscript gha..
5 'for liberation from faults such as deficiency' in manuscript ja.. / 'for the destruction of faults such as deficiency' in manuscript ṅa..
6 'O great lord' in manuscript jha..
7 'gold, garments, incense, and so forth' in manuscript jha..
8 'purified by oblations of milk-rice' in manuscript jha.. / 'the purification by fallen oblation remnants' in manuscript ga..
9 'and having bathed' in manuscript ga..
10 'with common rays' in manuscript kha.. / 'the common and so forth' in manuscript ga..
:p 333
Leaving aside the consciousness of the liṅga, one should perform the dismissal from the pillar.

sanskrit_iast:
asādhāraṇaliṅgeṣu kṣamasveti visarjanaṃ /
āvāhanamabhivyaktirvisargaḥ śaktirūpatā //
meaning:
असाधारणलिङ्गेषु क्षमस्वेति विसर्जनं /
आवाहनमभिव्यक्तिर्विसर्गः शक्तिरूपता //
text_mt: In uncommon liṅgas, the dismissal is with the formula 'Forgive!' / Invocation is manifestation; dismissal is [return to] the state of power.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣṭhānte kvacit proktaṃ sthirādyāhutisaptakaṃ /
sthiras tathāprameyaścānādibodhastathaiva ca //
meaning:
प्रतिष्ठान्ते क्वचित् प्रोक्तं स्थिराद्याहुतिसप्तकं /
स्थिरस् तथाप्रमेयश्चानादिबोधस्तथैव च //
text_mt: At the conclusion of consecration, a group of seven fire oblations beginning with 'Fixed' is elsewhere taught: / 'Fixed', and likewise 'Immeasurable', and likewise 'Of Beginningless Awakening',

sanskrit_iast:
nityotha sarvagaś caivāvināśī dṛṣṭa eva ca(1) /
ete guṇā maheśasya sannidhānāya kīrtitāḥ(2) //
meaning:
नित्योथ सर्वगश् चैवाविनाशी दृष्ट एव च(1) /
एते गुणा महेशस्य सन्निधानाय कीर्तिताः(2) //
text_mt: 'Eternal', then 'All-Pervading', and 'Imperishable', and 'Visible'. / These qualities of the Great Lord are proclaimed to secure His presence.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namaḥ śivāya sthiro bhavetyāhutīnāṃ kramaḥ /
evametañca sampādya vidhāya śivakumbhavat(3) //
meaning:
ओं नमः शिवाय स्थिरो भवेत्याहुतीनां क्रमः /
एवमेतञ्च सम्पाद्य विधाय शिवकुम्भवत्(3) //
text_mt: "Oṃ, homage to Śiva; be fixed!" is the order of the fire oblations. / Having accomplished this in this way and prepared like the Śiva-pitcher,

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhadvayañca tanmadhyādekakumbhāmbhasā bhavaṃ /
saṃsnāpya tad dvitīyantu kartṛsnānāya dhārayet //
meaning:
कुम्भद्वयञ्च तन्मध्यादेककुम्भाम्भसा भवं /
संस्नाप्य तद् द्वितीयन्तु कर्तृस्नानाय धारयेत् //
text_mt: two pitchers, with the water of one pitcher from between them / having bathed Bhava, he should keep the second for the bath of the patron.

sanskrit_iast:
datvā baliṃ samācamya vahirgacchet śivājñayā(4) /
jagatīvāhyataś caṇḍamaiśānyāndiśi mandire //
meaning:
दत्वा बलिं समाचम्य वहिर्गच्छेत् शिवाज्ञया(4) /
जगतीवाह्यतश् चण्डमैशान्यान्दिशि मन्दिरे //
text_mt: Having offered the bali offering and sipped water, he should go outside by Śiva's command. / Outside the terrace, [he should install] Caṇḍa in the northeastern direction in the temple,

sanskrit_iast:
dhāmagarbhapramāṇe ca(5) supīṭhe(6) kalpitāsane /
pūrvavan nyāsahomādi vidhāya dhyānapūrvakaṃ //
meaning:
धामगर्भप्रमाणे च(5) सुपीठे(6) कल्पितासने /
पूर्ववन् न्यासहोमादि विधाय ध्यानपूर्वकं //
text_mt: proportioned to the sanctum of the shrine, on an excellent pedestal, on a prepared seat. / Having performed the ritual deposition, fire oblations, and so on as before, preceded by meditation,

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsthāpya vidhivattatra brahmāṅgaiḥ(7) pūjayettataḥ /
aṅgāni pūrvayuktāni(8) brahmāṇī tvarcanā yathā(9) //
:n
1 vilāsī tṛpta eva ca iti kha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca / avināśī tṛpta eva ca
iti ṅa..
2 sannidhāya prakīrtitā iti kha.. , cha.. ca
3 oṃ nama ity ādi, śivakumbhavat ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti /
śivāya śivakumbhavat iti ga..
4 vahiḥ kumbhe śivājñayā iti jha..
5 vāmagarbhapramāṇena iti jha..
6 svapīṭhe iti ga..
7 brahmādyair iti ga.. , jha.. ca
8 pūrvamuktāni iti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / pūrvabhuktānīti ja..
9 tvadhunā yathā iti kha..
:p 334
evaṃ sadyojātāya oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ(1) namaḥ / oṃ viṃ
vāmadevāya hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ buṃ(2) aghorāya hrūṃ
phaṭ namaḥ / oṃ(3) tatpuruṣāya vaumīśānāya ca hrūṃ phaṭ
||
meaning:
संस्थाप्य विधिवत्तत्र ब्रह्माङ्गैः(7) पूजयेत्ततः /
अङ्गानि पूर्वयुक्तानि(8) ब्रह्माणी त्वर्चना यथा(9) //
:न्
1 विलासी तृप्त एव च इति ख.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च / अविनाशी तृप्त एव च
इति ङ..
2 सन्निधाय प्रकीर्तिता इति ख.. , छ.. च
3 ओं नम इत्य् आदि, शिवकुम्भवत् इत्य् अन्तः पाठो झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति /
शिवाय शिवकुम्भवत् इति ग..
4 वहिः कुम्भे शिवाज्ञया इति झ..
5 वामगर्भप्रमाणेन इति झ..
6 स्वपीठे इति ग..
7 ब्रह्माद्यैर् इति ग.. , झ.. च
8 पूर्वमुक्तानि इति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. , छ.. च / पूर्वभुक्तानीति ज..
9 त्वधुना यथा इति ख..
:प् 334
एवं सद्योजाताय ओं ह्रूं फट्(1) नमः / ओं विं
वामदेवाय ह्रूं फट् नमः / ओं बुं(2) अघोराय ह्रूं
फट् नमः / ओं(3) तत्पुरुषाय वौमीशानाय च ह्रूं फट्
||
text_mt:
and having properly installed [him] there, he should then worship with the brahmāṅga mantras. / The secondary limbs are as stated before, while the Brahmā mantras for the worship are as follows:
:n
1 'playful and satisfied' in manuscripts kha.., ṅa.., cha.., and ja.. / 'imperishable and satisfied' in manuscript ṅa..
2 'proclaimed for presence' in manuscripts kha.. and cha..
3 The reading beginning with 'oṃ nama' up to 'śivakumbhavat' is absent in the manuscript jha..
'to Śiva, like the Śiva-pitcher' in manuscript ga..
4 'in the outer pitcher by Śiva's command' in manuscript jha..
5 'by the measurement of the left interior' in manuscript jha..
6 'on his own pedestal' in manuscript ga..
7 'with those beginning with Brahmā' in manuscripts ga.. and jha..
8 'stated before' in manuscripts kha.., ga.., ṅa.., and cha.. / 'enjoyed before' in manuscript ja..
9 'now as follows' in manuscript kha..
:p 334
Thus: Oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ, homage to Sadyojāta; oṃ viṃ hrūṃ phaṭ, homage to Vāmadeva; oṃ buṃ hrūṃ phaṭ, homage to Aghora; oṃ vaum hrūṃ phaṭ to Tatpuruṣa and to Īśāna.

sanskrit_iast:
japaṃ vivedya(4) santarpya vijñāpya natipūrvakaṃ /
devaḥ sannihito yāvattāvattvaṃ sannidho bhava //
meaning:
जपं विवेद्य(4) सन्तर्प्य विज्ञाप्य नतिपूर्वकं /
देवः सन्निहितो यावत्तावत्त्वं सन्निधो भव //
text_mt: Having offered recitation, having made water libations, having petitioned preceded by prostration: / 'As long as the God is present, for that long be present!

sanskrit_iast:
nyūnādhikañca yatkiñcit kṛtamajñānato mayā(5) /
tavatprasādena caṇḍeśa tat sarvaṃ paripūraya //
meaning:
न्यूनाधिकञ्च यत्किञ्चित् कृतमज्ञानतो मया(5) /
तवत्प्रसादेन चण्डेश तत् सर्वं परिपूरय //
text_mt: Whatever has been done in defect or in excess by me through ignorance, / by your grace, O Caṇḍeśa, make all that complete!'

sanskrit_iast:
vāṇaliṅge vāṇarohe(6) siddhaliṅge svayambhuvi /
pratimāsu ca sarvāsu na caṇḍo 'dhikṛto bhavet //
meaning:
वाणलिङ्गे वाणरोहे(6) सिद्धलिङ्गे स्वयम्भुवि /
प्रतिमासु च सर्वासु न चण्डो ऽधिकृतो भवेत् //
text_mt: In a bāṇaliṅga, an elevated bāṇaliṅga, a siddhaliṅga, a self-manifested one, / and in all images, Caṇḍa has no authority.

sanskrit_iast:
advaitabhāvanāyukte sthaṇḍileśavidhāvapi(7) /
abhyarcya caṇḍaṃ sasutaṃ yajamānaṃ hi bhāryayā //
meaning:
अद्वैतभावनायुक्ते स्थण्डिलेशविधावपि(7) /
अभ्यर्च्य चण्डं ससुतं यजमानं हि भार्यया //
text_mt: Even in the rite of the Lord of the altar accompanied by non-dual contemplation, / having worshipped Caṇḍa, the patron indeed with his wife and son

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasthāpitakumbhe na snāpayet snāpakaḥ(8) svayaṃ /
sthāpakaṃ yajamānopi sampūjya ca(9) maheśavat(10) //
meaning:
पूर्वस्थापितकुम्भे न स्नापयेत् स्नापकः(8) स्वयं /
स्थापकं यजमानोपि सम्पूज्य च(9) महेशवत्(10) //
text_mt: the bather himself should bathe with the pitcher previously set up. / The patron also, having worshipped the master of ceremonies like the Great Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
vittaśāṭhyaṃ vinā dadyād bhūhiraṇyādi(11) dakṣiṇāṃ /
:n
1 oṃ sadyojātāya hūṃ phaṭ iti jha.. / evaṃ sadyojātāya oṃ hrūṃ
phaṭ nama iti kha.. , cha.. ca / oṃ evaṃ sadyo jātāya hūṃ phaṭ nama iti
ga.. , ja.. ca
2 oṃ vaṃ iti jha..
3 oṃ evaṃ ceti cha.. / oṃ evaṃ cediti ṅa.. / oṃ vai iti ja..
4 dhūpaṃ nivedya iti gha..
5 kṛtamajñānatopi vā iti ga..
6 bāṇaliṅge cale lohe iti ja..
7 sthaṇḍile sannidhāvapi iti ja.. , jha.. ca
8 sthāpaka iti ja..
9 prapūjya ca iti ja..
10 maheśvaramiti kha.. , cha.. ca
11 gohiraṇyādi iti ja.. , jha.. ca
:p 335
mūrtimān vidhivat paścāt jāpakān brāhmaṇāṃs tathā //
meaning:
वित्तशाठ्यं विना दद्याद् भूहिरण्यादि(11) दक्षिणां /
:न्
1 ओं सद्योजाताय हूं फट् इति झ.. / एवं सद्योजाताय ओं ह्रूं
फट् नम इति ख.. , छ.. च / ओं एवं सद्यो जाताय हूं फट् नम इति
ग.. , ज.. च
2 ओं वं इति झ..
3 ओं एवं चेति छ.. / ओं एवं चेदिति ङ.. / ओं वै इति ज..
4 धूपं निवेद्य इति घ..
5 कृतमज्ञानतोपि वा इति ग..
6 बाणलिङ्गे चले लोहे इति ज..
7 स्थण्डिले सन्निधावपि इति ज.. , झ.. च
8 स्थापक इति ज..
9 प्रपूज्य च इति ज..
10 महेश्वरमिति ख.. , छ.. च
11 गोहिरण्यादि इति ज.. , झ.. च
:प् 335
मूर्तिमान् विधिवत् पश्चात् जापकान् ब्राह्मणांस् तथा //
text_mt:
should give sacrificial fees such as land and gold without deceit in wealth.
:n
1 'oṃ sadyojātāya hūṃ phaṭ' in manuscript jha.. / 'evaṃ sadyojātāya oṃ hrūṃ phaṭ namaḥ' in manuscripts kha.. and cha.. / 'oṃ evaṃ sadyo jātāya hūṃ phaṭ namaḥ' in manuscripts ga.. and ja..
2 'oṃ vaṃ' in manuscript jha..
3 'oṃ evaṃ ca' in manuscript cha.. / 'oṃ evaṃ cet' in manuscript ṅa.. / 'oṃ vai' in manuscript ja..
4 'having offered incense' in manuscript gha..
5 'done even out of ignorance' in manuscript ga..
6 'in a bāṇaliṅga, a movable one, a metal one' in manuscript ja..
7 'on the altar, even in proximity' in manuscripts ja.. and jha..
8 'the master of ceremonies' in manuscript ja..

text_mt: Having honored the astrologer and the artisan, he should feed the poor, the helpless, and others: / 'Whatever distress has been caused by me toward your presence here, O Lord,

iti vijñaptiyuktāya yajamānāya sadguruḥ //

text_mt: And the realm of the lords of the worlds, wherever their location is: / The triad of principles, ending with the expansion of the cosmic egg up to Pradhāna, is the realm of Brahmā.

text_mt: This triad of realms, from the subtle elements up to Pradhāna, belongs to Hari; / [and also] of the lord of dance, the Gaṇas, the Mothers, the lord of the Yakṣas, and the reed-born [Skanda].

"Oṃ aṃ, reverence to the lower covering. Oṃ, reverence to the lotus seat. Oṃ, reverence to the upper covering. Oṃ, reverence to the lotus seat." Then the Keśavas are likewise to be worshipped: "Oṃ hrīṃ, reverence to the pericarp. Oṃ kṣaṃ, to the lotus-eyed ones"—here he should worship. "Oṃ hāṃ, reverence to Puṣṭi; hrīṃ, to Jñānā; hrūṃ, to Kriyā." Then, "Reverence: oṃ, reverence to the stalk. Ruṃ, reverence to Dharma. Ruṃ, indeed reverence to Jñāna. Oṃ, indeed reverence to Vairāgya. Oṃ, indeed reverence to Adharma. Oṃ ruṃ, indeed reverence to Ajñāna.
Reverence: oṃ, indeed reverence to Avairāgya. Aṃ, reverence to Anaiśvarya."

text_mt:
"Huṃ, to Vāc; huṃ, and to Rāgiṇī; kraiṃ, to Jvālinī." Then, "Reverence: oṃ hrauṃ, and reverence to Śamā; hruṃ, then reverence to Jyeṣṭhā. Oṃ hrauṃ rauṃ krauṃ, to the nine Śaktis; gauṃ, and to the seat of Gaurī; gauṃ, reverence to the icon of Gaurī." Now the root mantra of Gaurī is stated: "Oṃ hrīṃ saḥ, O Mahāgaurī, beloved of Rudra, svāhā; reverence to Gaurī. Gāṃ hrūṃ hrīṃ, let Śiva be gūṃ, to Śivā, to the armor; goṃ, to the eye; goṃ, to the weapon; oṃ gauṃ, to Vijñānaśakti; oṃ gūṃ, reverence to Kriyāśakti." In the east and other [quarters], the regents led by Śakra: "Oṃ suṃ, reverence to Subhagā"; then, the seed-syllable hrīṃ with Lalitā; "Oṃ hrīṃ, and reverence to Kāminī; oṃ hrūṃ, Kāmaśālinī." Having consecrated Gaurī with these mantras, having worshipped, and then having recited, one enjoys all.
Thus in the Mahāpurāṇa of Agni, the ninety-eighth chapter, entitled "The Consecration of Gaurī."

Now the one hundred and first chapter.
Consecration of the temple.

4 cūḍake dhvajadaṇḍe vā iti ja..
5 yathādiṣṭā iti jha..
6 tathā hy ahaṃ vadāmi te iti ṅa..
7 aiṣṭe dārubhava iti gha.. , ja.. ca
8 taḍāgārdhetyādiḥ, śailaja ity antaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti
9 agraṃ cūḍābhidho mata iti gha.. / asracūlādidoṣata iti cha.. /
gṛhacūḍābhidho mata iti ṅa.. / agraṃ cūḍādidoṣata iti kha..

meaning:
वैष्णवादौ च चक्राढ्यः कुम्भः स्यान्मूर्तिमानतः /
स च त्रिशूलयुक्तस्तु अग्रचूलाभिधो मतः(9) //
:न्

9 अग्रं चूडाभिधो मत इति घ.. / अस्रचूलादिदोषत इति छ.. /
गृहचूडाभिधो मत इति ङ.. / अग्रं चूडादिदोषत इति ख..

text_mt:
And on a Vaiṣṇava [temple] or the like, there should be an embodied pitcher adorned with a discus; / but that which is equipped with a trident is regarded as named the upper crest-pole.

'gṛhacūḍābhidho mataḥ' in manuscript ṅa..; 'agraṃ cūḍādidoṣataḥ' in kha..

sanskrit_iast:
īśaśūlaḥ(1) samākhyāto mūrdhni liṅgasamanvitaḥ /
vījapūrakayukto vā śivaśāstreṣu tadvidhaḥ //
meaning:
ईशशूलः(1) समाख्यातो मूर्ध्नि लिङ्गसमन्वितः /
वीजपूरकयुक्तो वा शिवशास्त्रेषु तद्विधः //
text_mt: The trident of the Lord is proclaimed to be furnished with a liṅga at its summit, / or equipped with a citron fruit; such is its description in the Śiva scriptures.

sanskrit_iast:
citro dhvajaś ca jaṅghāto yathā jaṅgārdhato bhavet(2) /
bhavedvā daṇḍamānastu yadi vā tadyadṛcchayā(3) //
meaning:
चित्रो ध्वजश् च जङ्घातो यथा जङ्गार्धतो भवेत्(2) /
भवेद्वा दण्डमानस्तु यदि वा तद्यदृच्छया(3) //
text_mt: The variegated flag may be [equal in measure] to the shrine-wall, or to half the shrine-wall, / or its measure may be that of the staff, or else it may be at will.

sanskrit_iast:
mahādhvajaḥ samākhyāto yastu pīṭhasya veṣṭakaḥ(4) /
śakrair grahai rasaivāpi hastair daṇḍastu sambhitaḥ //
meaning:
महाध्वजः समाख्यातो यस्तु पीठस्य वेष्टकः(4) /
शक्रैर् ग्रहै रसैवापि हस्तैर् दण्डस्तु सम्भितः //
text_mt: The great flag is proclaimed to be that which wraps around the pedestal; / the staff is measured at fourteen, nine, or six cubits.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamādikrameṇaiva vijñeyaḥ śūribhistataḥ /
vaṃśajaḥ śālajātirvā sa daṇḍaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ //
meaning:
उत्तमादिक्रमेणैव विज्ञेयः शूरिभिस्ततः /
वंशजः शालजातिर्वा स दण्डः सर्वकामदः //
text_mt: It should be understood by wise men in the order of excellent [downwards]; / made of bamboo or of the śāla tree, that staff grants all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
ayamāropyamāṇastu bhaṅgamāyāti vai yadi /
rājñoniṣṭaṃ(5) vijānīyādyajamānasya vā tathā(6) //
meaning:
अयमारोप्यमाणस्तु भङ्गमायाति वै यदि /
राज्ञोनिष्टं(5) विजानीयाद्यजमानस्य वा तथा(6) //
text_mt: If this [flagstaff], while being raised, should indeed break, / one should know it portends misfortune for the king or for the patron of the sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
mantreṇa bahurūpeṇa pūrvavacchāntimācaret /
dvārapālādipūjāñca mantrāṇāntarpyaṇantathā //
meaning:
मन्त्रेण बहुरूपेण पूर्ववच्छान्तिमाचरेत् /
द्वारपालादिपूजाञ्च मन्त्राणान्तर्प्यणन्तथा //
text_mt: He should perform a pacification rite as before with the Bahurūpa mantra, / and having performed the worship of the door-guardians and the satiation of the mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
vidhāya cūlakaṃ(7) daṇḍaṃ snāpayedastramantrataḥ /
anenaiva tu mantreṇa dhvajaṃ samprokṣya deśikaḥ //
meaning:
विधाय चूलकं(7) दण्डं स्नापयेदस्त्रमन्त्रतः /
अनेनैव तु मन्त्रेण ध्वजं सम्प्रोक्ष्य देशिकः //
text_mt: he should bathe the crest-pole and the staff with the astra-mantra. / Having sprinkled the flag with this very mantra, the preceptor

sanskrit_iast:
mṛdu kaṣāyādibhiḥ(8) snānaṃ prāsādaṅkārayettataḥ /
vilipya rasamācchādya(9) śayyāyāṃ nyasya pūrvavat //
meaning:
मृदु कषायादिभिः(8) स्नानं प्रासादङ्कारयेत्ततः /
विलिप्य रसमाच्छाद्य(9) शय्यायां न्यस्य पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: should then have the temple bathed gently with decoctions and other [liquids]; / having smeared it, covered it with sap, and deposited it upon the couch as before,

sanskrit_iast:
cūḍake(20) liṅgavaṇanyāso na ca jñānaṃ na ca kriyā /
:n
1 īśaścūḍa iti iti ga.. / īśaścūla iti ṅa.. / īṣaścūla iti cha.. /
śaśaḥ śūla iti ja..
2 jaṅghāto yadvā jaṅghārdhato bhavediti kha.. / saṅghāto yathā
jaṅghārdhato yajediti gha..
3 yadi vā tadvidicchayā iti kha..
4 yastu syāt pīṭhaveṣṭaka iti ṅa..
5 rājñoriṣṭamiti ja..
6 vai tathā iti ja..
7 cūḍakamiti ja..
8 bhṛtkāṣāyādibhiriti kha.. , cha.. ca
9 vilipya rasamādāyeti ja..
10 cūlake iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
:p 346
viśeṣārthā(1) caturthī ca na kuṇḍasya(2) kalpanā //
meaning:
चूडके(20) लिङ्गवणन्यासो न च ज्ञानं न च क्रिया /
:न्
1 ईशश्चूड इति इति ग.. / ईशश्चूल इति ङ.. / ईषश्चूल इति छ.. /
शशः शूल इति ज..
2 जङ्घातो यद्वा जङ्घार्धतो भवेदिति ख.. / सङ्घातो यथा
जङ्घार्धतो यजेदिति घ..
3 यदि वा तद्विदिच्छया इति ख..
4 यस्तु स्यात् पीठवेष्टक इति ङ..
5 राज्ञोरिष्टमिति ज..
6 वै तथा इति ज..
7 चूडकमिति ज..
8 भृत्काषायादिभिरिति ख.. , छ.. च
9 विलिप्य रसमादायेति ज..
10 चूलके इति घ.. , ङ.. च
:प् 346
विशेषार्था(1) चतुर्थी च न कुण्डस्य(2) कल्पना //
text_mt:
on the crest-pole there is the deposition of the phonemes of the liṅga, but neither cognition nor ritual action.
[Variant reading note]
[Variant reading note] 1 'īśaścūḍaḥ' in manuscript ga..; 'īśaścūlaḥ' in ṅa..; 'īṣaścūlaḥ' in cha..
[Variant readings:] 1. 'śaśaḥ śūlaḥ' in manuscript ja.
2. 'jaṅghāto yadvā jaṅghārdhato bhavet' in kha.; 'saṅghāto yathā jaṅghārdhato yajet' in gha.
3. 'yadi vā tadvidicchayā' in kha.
4. 'yastu syāt pīṭhaveṣṭakaḥ' in ṅa.
5. 'rājñoriṣṭam' in ja.
6. 'vai tathā' in ja.
7. 'cūḍakam' in ja.
8. 'bhṛtkāṣāyādibhiḥ' in kha. and cha.
9. 'vilipya rasamādāya' in ja.
10. 'cūlake' in gha. and ṅa.
And the fourth [offering] is for special purpose; no fire-pit is constructed [for it].

sanskrit_iast:
daṇḍe tayārthatattvañca(3) vidyātattvaṃ dvitīyakaṃ /
sadyojātāni vakrāṇi(4) śivatattvaṃ punardhvaje //
meaning:
दण्डे तयार्थतत्त्वञ्च(3) विद्यातत्त्वं द्वितीयकं /
सद्योजातानि वक्राणि(4) शिवतत्त्वं पुनर्ध्वजे //
text_mt: On the staff, [one should deposit] the reality of the self (ātmatattva), and the reality of knowledge (vidyātattva) as the second, / [with] the faces beginning with Sadyojāta; and the reality of Śiva (śivatattva) on the banner.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkalañca śivantatra nyasyāṅgāni prapūjayet /
cūḍake ca(4) tato mantro sānnidhye sahitāṇubhiḥ(6) //
meaning:
निष्कलञ्च शिवन्तत्र न्यस्याङ्गानि प्रपूजयेत् /
चूडके च(4) ततो मन्त्रो सान्निध्ये सहिताणुभिः(6) //
text_mt: Having deposited the partless Śiva there, one should worship the limbs. / And on the crest, then, the mantra in proximity with the saṃhitā mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
homayet pratibhāgañca dhvaje taistu phaḍantikaiḥ(7) /
anyathāpi kṛtaṃ yacca dhvajasaṃskāraṇaṃ(8) kvacit //
meaning:
होमयेत् प्रतिभागञ्च ध्वजे तैस्तु फडन्तिकैः(7) /
अन्यथापि कृतं यच्च ध्वजसंस्कारणं(8) क्वचित् //
text_mt: One should offer fire oblations for each part, and upon the banner with [mantras] ending in 'phaṭ'. / And whatever consecration of the banner has been performed otherwise,

sanskrit_iast:
astrayāgavidhāvevaṃ(9) tatsarvamupadarśitaṃ /
prāsāde kārite sthāne(10) sragvastrādivibhūṣite //
meaning:
अस्त्रयागविधावेवं(9) तत्सर्वमुपदर्शितं /
प्रासादे कारिते स्थाने(10) स्रग्वस्त्रादिविभूषिते //
text_mt: all of that has thus been shown in the rule for the ritual of the weapon. / In the temple constructed in that place, adorned with garlands, garments, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
jaṅghā vedī tadūrdhve tu tritattvādi niveśya ca /
homādikaṃ vidhāyātha śivaṃ sampūjya pūrvavat //
meaning:
जङ्घा वेदी तदूर्ध्वे तु त्रितत्त्वादि निवेश्य च /
होमादिकं विधायाथ शिवं सम्पूज्य पूर्ववत् //
text_mt: above the thigh-wall and altar, having installed the triad of realities and the rest, / and having performed fire oblations and the like, then worshiping Śiva as before,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatattvamayaṃ dhyātvā śivañca vyāpakaṃ nyaset /
anantaṃ kālarudrañca vibhāvya ca padāmbuje //
meaning:
सर्वतत्त्वमयं ध्यात्वा शिवञ्च व्यापकं न्यसेत् /
अनन्तं कालरुद्रञ्च विभाव्य च पदाम्बुजे //
text_mt: meditating upon Śiva as consisting of all realities, one should deposit the all-pervading [deity]. / Having meditated on Ananta and Kālarudra at the lotus feet,

sanskrit_iast:
kuṣmāṇḍahāṭakau pīṭhe pātālanarakaiḥ(11) saha /
bhuvanair lokapālaiś ca śatarudrādibhirvṛtaṃ //
meaning:
कुष्माण्डहाटकौ पीठे पातालनरकैः(11) सह /
भुवनैर् लोकपालैश् च शतरुद्रादिभिर्वृतं //
text_mt: on Kūṣmāṇḍa and Hāṭaka on the base, together with the netherworlds and hells, / surrounded by the worlds, the world-protectors, and the hundred Rudras and others,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇdakamidaṃ dhyātvā jaṅghātāñca vibhāvayet /
vāritejonilavyomapañcāṣṭakasamanvitaṃ(12) //
:n

2 navadaṇḍasyeti jha..
3 tathātmatattvañceti ga.. , gha.. ca

gha..

11 pātālanavakair iti ṅa.. , ja.. ca

ब्रह्माण्दकमिदं ध्यात्वा जङ्घाताञ्च विभावयेत् /
वारितेजोनिलव्योमपञ्चाष्टकसमन्वितं(12) //

1 विशेषाद्या इति घ..
2 नवदण्डस्येति झ..
3 तथात्मतत्त्वञ्चेति ग.. , घ.. च

घ..
9 अस्त्रयागे विधाने चेति ज..
10 प्रासादकारितस्थाने इति ख.. , झ.. च / प्रासादे कारितस्थाने इति ज..

12 पञ्चाग्गकसमन्वितमिति ग..
:प् 347
text_mt:
having meditated on this cosmic egg, one should visualize the thigh-wall, / endowed with water, fire, wind, ether, and the five groups of eight,
[Gap in text]
[Variant readings:] 1. 'viśeṣādyā' in gha.
2. 'navadaṇḍasya' in jha.
3. 'tathātmatattvañca' in ga. and gha.
4. 'sadyojātādi vakrāṇi' in jha.
5. 'cūlake ca' in kha. and ja.
6. 'saṃhitātmabhiḥ' in kha. and ga.
7. The verse containing 'cūlake' is missing in manuscript jha.
8. 'tacca dhvaje saṃharaṇam' in kha. and cha.; 'yacca dhvajasaṃskaraṇam' in gha.
9. 'astrayāge vidhāne ca' in ja.
10. 'prāsādakāritasthāne' in kha. and jha.; 'prāsāde kāritasthāne' in ja.
11. 'pātālanavakair' in ṅa. and ja.
12. 'pañcāggakasamanvitam' in ga.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāvaraṇasañjñañca vṛddhayonyavṛkānvitaṃ(1) /
yogāṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ(2) nāśāvidhi guṇatrayaṃ //
meaning:
सर्वावरणसञ्ज्ञञ्च वृद्धयोन्यवृकान्वितं(1) /
योगाष्टकसमायुक्तं(2) नाशाविधि गुणत्रयं //
text_mt: designated as all the coverings, endowed with the increase and source, / endowed with the eight yogas, the rule of destruction, and the three guṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
paṭasthaṃ puruṣaṃ siṃhaṃ vāmañca(3) paribhāvayet /
mañjarīvedikāyāñca vidyādikacatuṣṭayaṃ //
meaning:
पटस्थं पुरुषं सिंहं वामञ्च(3) परिभावयेत् /
मञ्जरीवेदिकायाञ्च विद्यादिकचतुष्टयं //
text_mt: One should visualize the Puruṣa, the lion, and the left side situated on the cloth, / and on the cornice platform the group of four beginning with knowledge (vidyā);

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhe māyāṃ sarudrāñca(4) vidyāścāmalasārake(5) /
kalase ceśvaraṃ vinduṃ vidyeśvarasamanvitaṃ(6) //
meaning:
कण्ठे मायां सरुद्राञ्च(4) विद्याश्चामलसारके(5) /
कलसे चेश्वरं विन्दुं विद्येश्वरसमन्वितं(6) //
text_mt: on the neck Māyā with Rudra, and the vidyās on the āmalasāraka; / and on the pot Īśvara, the point (bindu), accompanied by the lords of knowledge (vidyeśvara);

sanskrit_iast:
jaṭājūṭañca taṃ vidyācchūlaṃ candrārdharūpakaṃ /
śaktitrayaṃ ca tatraiva daṇḍe nādaṃ vibhāvya ca //
meaning:
जटाजूटञ्च तं विद्याच्छूलं चन्द्रार्धरूपकं /
शक्तित्रयं च तत्रैव दण्डे नादं विभाव्य च //
text_mt: one should know the trident to be his matted hair, having the form of a crescent moon, / and the triad of powers right there; and having visualized the resonance (nāda) on the staff,

sanskrit_iast:
dhvaje ca kuṇḍalīṃ śaktimiti dhāmni vibhāvayet /
jagatyā vātha sandhāya liṅgaṃ piṇḍikayāthavā(7) //
meaning:
ध्वजे च कुण्डलीं शक्तिमिति धाम्नि विभावयेत् /
जगत्या वाथ सन्धाय लिङ्गं पिण्डिकयाथवा(7) //
text_mt: and the Kuṇḍalī power on the banner, one should visualize thus in the abode. / Either joining [it] with the plinth, or the liṅga with the pedestal,

sanskrit_iast:
samutthāpya sumantraiś ca(8) vinyaste śaktipaṅkaje /
nyastaratnādike tatra svādhāre viniveśayet //
meaning:

text_mt:
As many atoms as there are in an image, a liṅga, and pedestals, / for that many thousands of cosmic ages is the fruit enjoyed by the patron.
Thus ends the one hundred and second chapter, entitled 'The Rule of Raising the Banner and the Like', in the great Purāṇa composed by Agni.
Now the one hundred and third chapter:
Renovation.

One may perform installation with a hundred [mantras/oblations], but removal requires a thousand.
Accompanied by worship and the rest, even an aged [liṅga] is well-placed.

Having erected a pavilion in the south or northeast, with a single archway and a west-facing entrance,
and having performed the worship of the doorway and other rites, [one should perform] the worship of the mantras on a bare mound.

Having gratified and worshipped the mantras, and the site deities as before,
and having offered the oblation to the quarters outside, the guru himself, having sipped water,

duṣṭaliṅgamidaṃ śaṃbhoḥ śāntiruddhāraṇasya cet(6) //

‘This liṅga of Śambhu is defective; if there is pacification for its removal,

Having thus addressed the Lord of gods, he should perform the pacification fire oblation

Then, having positioned the liṅga, he should worship it likewise on the bare mound.

having bound it with a golden cord, or with a rope placed on the shoulders of a bull,

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

the ritual master should cast it into water; he should offer a hundred oblations for prospering,

text_mt:
and a hundred each for the satisfaction of the guardians of the directions and for the purification of the site.
Having performed protection in that abode with the Mahāpāśupata [mantra], then

the guru should properly install another liṅga there.

jīrṇaṃ vāpyathavā bhagnaṃ(1) vidhināpi nacālayet /

जीर्णं वाप्यथवा भग्नं(1) विधिनापि नचालयेत् /

text_mt:
even if dilapidated or broken, one should not move even according to rule.
This very procedure should be followed in the restoration of a dilapidated abode.

text_mt:
Having deposited the host of mantras upon a sword, one should build another temple.
Death is stated [to result] from reduction [in size], and loss of wealth from expansion.
Using that same material, or a superior material, that is to be made with those [same] dimensions.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and third chapter, entitled ‘Restoration of the Dilapidated.’
Now the one hundred and fourth chapter.
Characteristics of a temple.

īśvara uvāca
vakṣye prāsādasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ te śikhadhvaja /
caturbhāgīkṛte kṣetre bhitterbhāgena vistarāt //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
वक्ष्ये प्रासादसामान्यलक्षणं ते शिखध्वज /

adribhāgena(3) garbhaḥ syāt piṇḍikā pādavistarāt /

पञ्चभागीकृते क्षेत्रेन्तर्भागे(4) तु पिण्डिका //
text_mt:
the sanctum should be half a part, and the pedestal a quarter-part in width.
When the site is divided into five parts, the pedestal is in the interior portion;

the hollow interior is one part wide, and the walls are one part in width.
There are two parts for the middle sanctum, and two parts for the largest;

ṣoḍhābhakyethavā kṣetre bhittirbhāgaikavistarāt //
meaning:
त्रिभिस्तु कन्यसागर्भः(1) शेषो भित्तिरिति क्वचित् /
षोढाभक्येथवा क्षेत्रे भित्तिर्भागैकविस्तरात् //
text_mt:
with three [parts], however, the smallest sanctum [is made], and the remainder is the wall, according to some.
Or, when the site is divided into six parts, the wall is one part in width;

sanskrit_iast:
garbho bhāgena vistīrṇo bhāgadvayena piṇḍikā /
vistārād dviguṇo vāpi sapādadviguṇo 'pi vā //
meaning:
गर्भो भागेन विस्तीर्णो भागद्वयेन पिण्डिका /
विस्ताराद् द्विगुणो वापि सपादद्विगुणो ऽपि वा //
text_mt:
the sanctum is one part in width, and the pedestal is two parts.
The height is twice the width, or two and a quarter times,

sanskrit_iast:
ardhārdhadviguṇo vāpi(2) triguṇaḥ kvacittriducchrayaḥ /
jagatī vistarārdhena tribhāgena kvacidbhavet //
meaning:
अर्धार्धद्विगुणो वापि(2) त्रिगुणः क्वचित्त्रिदुच्छ्रयः /
जगती विस्तरार्धेन त्रिभागेन क्वचिद्भवेत् //
text_mt:
or two and a half times; in some places, it is three times [the width].
The plinth should be half the width, or in some places one-third.

sanskrit_iast:
nemiḥ pādonaviestīrṇā(3) prāsādasya samantataḥ /
paridhistrayaṃ śako madhye rathakāṃstatra kārayet //
meaning:

परिधिस्त्रयं शको मध्ये रथकांस्तत्र कारयेत् //
text_mt:
The circumambulatory path around the temple is three-quarters [of a part] in width.
Dividing the perimeter into three parts, one should construct projections in the middle;

sanskrit_iast:

prāsādārdhena devānāmaṣṭau vā caturo 'pi vā //
meaning:
चामुण्डं भैरवं तेषु नाट्येशं च निवेशयेत् /
प्रासादार्धेन देवानामष्टौ वा चतुरो ऽपि वा //
text_mt:
upon them one should install Cāmuṇḍā, Bhairava, and the Lord of Dance,
or four, or eight deities, measuring half [the height of] the temple.

sanskrit_iast:

meaning:

One should make a circumambulatory path outside, or nine [shrines] around the temple and other structures.
The Ādityas should be placed in the east; Skanda, Agni, [and others] in the realm of Vāyu (north-west).

sanskrit_iast:

चतुर्धा शिखरं कृत्वा शुकनासा द्विभागिका //
text_mt:
Thus Yama and the others are to be deposited, situated in each their own direction.
Dividing the spire (śikhara) into four parts, the antefix (śukanāsā) is of two parts.

sanskrit_iast:
vardhanī vānya uṣṇīṣaḥ(7) śaṅkhaś ca kalasas tathā /
svavṛkṣaś ca tathāpyete vṛttāḥ kailāsasambhavāḥ(8) //
meaning:
वर्धनी वान्य उष्णीषः(7) शङ्खश् च कलसस् तथा /
स्ववृक्षश् च तथाप्येते वृत्ताः कैलाससम्भवाः(8) //
text_mt:
Vardhanī, or another, Uṣṇīṣa, Śaṅkha, and Kalaśa,
as well as Svavṛkṣa: these circular ones originate from Kailāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
gajotha vṛṣabho haṃso garutmānnṛkṣanāyakaḥ /
bhūṣaṇo(9) bhūdharaścānnye śrījayaḥ pṛthavīdharaḥ(10) //
meaning:
गजोथ वृषभो हंसो गरुत्मान्नृक्षनायकः /
भूषणो(9) भूधरश्चान्न्ये श्रीजयः पृथवीधरः(10) //
text_mt:
Gaja, then Vṛṣabha, Haṃsa, Garutmat, Ṛkṣanāyaka,
Bhūṣaṇa, and another, Bhūdhara, Śrījaya, and Pṛthivīdhara:

sanskrit_iast:

vajraṃ cakrantathā cānyat svastikaṃ vajrasvastikaṃ(12) //

1 caturvṛttāyataścānya iti gha..
2 rucakā iti ka..
3 viśālaś ca mano brahmeti kha.. , gha.. ca / viśālaś ca tathā brahmeti
ga..

6 śakunī cāsya uṣṇīṣa iti ja..

nāsti
9 vṛṣaṇa iti ṅa..
10 khavṛkṣaścetyādiḥ, pṛthivīdhara ity antaḥ pāṭho ja..
pustake nāsti
11 maṇikākṣayāt iti ja..
12 vajrahastikamiti kha.. , ga.. , cha.. ca / vajramuṣṭikamiti ja..

वृत्तायतात् समुद्भूता नवैते मणिकाह्वयात्(11) /
वज्रं चक्रन्तथा चान्यत् स्वस्तिकं वज्रस्वस्तिकं(12) //

2 रुचका इति क..
3 विशालश् च मनो ब्रह्मेति ख.. , घ.. च / विशालश् च तथा ब्रह्मेति
ग..
4 पणव इति ज..
5 महापद्मश् च इति क..
6 शकुनी चास्य उष्णीष इति ज..

9 वृषण इति ङ..
10 खवृक्षश्चेत्यादिः, पृथिवीधर इत्य् अन्तः पाठो ज..
पुस्तके नास्ति

these nine originate from the elliptical one named Maṇika.
Vajra, Cakra, and another, Svastika, Vajrasvastika,

sanskrit_iast:
citraṃ svastikakhaḍgañca gadā śrīkaṇṭha eva ca /
vijayo nāmataś caite(1) triviṣṭapasamudbhavāḥ //
meaning:
चित्रं स्वस्तिकखड्गञ्च गदा श्रीकण्ठ एव च /
विजयो नामतश् चैते(1) त्रिविष्टपसमुद्भवाः //
text_mt:
Citra, Svastikakhaḍga, Gadā, Śrīkaṇṭha,
and by name Vijaya: these originate from Triviṣṭapa.

sanskrit_iast:
nagarāṇāmimāḥ sañjñā lāṭādīnāmimās tathā(2) /
grīvārdhenonnatañcūlampṛthulañca vibhāgataḥ(3) //
meaning:
नगराणामिमाः सञ्ज्ञा लाटादीनामिमास् तथा(2) /
ग्रीवार्धेनोन्नतञ्चूलम्पृथुलञ्च विभागतः(3) //
text_mt:
These are the names of the Nāgara [orders], and likewise these of the Lāṭa and other [orders].
The finial (cūla) is elevated by half the neck, and broadened according to proportions.

sanskrit_iast:
daśadhā vedikāṅkṛtvā pañcabhiḥ skandhavistaraḥ /
tribhiḥ kaṇṭhaṃ tu kartavyaṃ caturbhistu pracaṇḍakaṃ(4) //
meaning:
दशधा वेदिकाङ्कृत्वा पञ्चभिः स्कन्धविस्तरः /
त्रिभिः कण्ठं तु कर्तव्यं चतुर्भिस्तु प्रचण्डकं(4) //
text_mt:
Dividing the platform (vedikā) into ten parts, the width of the shoulder (skandha) is five [parts];
the neck (kaṇṭha) should be made of three parts, and the dome (pracaṇḍaka / aṇḍaka) of four.

sanskrit_iast:
dikṣu dvārāṇi kāryāṇi na vidikṣu kadācana /
piṇḍikā koṇavistīrṇā madhyamāntā hy udāhṛtā //
meaning:
दिक्षु द्वाराणि कार्याणि न विदिक्षु कदाचन /
पिण्डिका कोणविस्तीर्णा मध्यमान्ता ह्य् उदाहृता //
text_mt:
Doors should be made in the cardinal directions, never in the intermediate directions.
The pedestal is said to extend to the corner, ending at the center.

sanskrit_iast:
kvacit pañcamabhāgena mahatāṅgarbhapādataḥ /
ucchrāyā dviguṇāsteṣāmanyathā vā nigadyate //
meaning:
क्वचित् पञ्चमभागेन महताङ्गर्भपादतः /
उच्छ्राया द्विगुणास्तेषामन्यथा वा निगद्यते //
text_mt:
In some cases [it is] by a fifth part, [or] from the fourth part of the interior of large [temples].
Their heights are double [their widths]; or it is described otherwise:

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭyādhikāt samārabhya aṅgulānāṃ śatādiha(5) /
uttamānyapi catvāri dvārāṇi daśahānitaḥ(6) //
meaning:
षष्ट्याधिकात् समारभ्य अङ्गुलानां शतादिह(5) /
उत्तमान्यपि चत्वारि द्वाराणि दशहानितः(6) //
text_mt:
beginning from sixty digits (aṅgula) up to one hundred digits here,
there are four superior doors, decreasing by ten [digits] each;

sanskrit_iast:
trīṇyeva madhyamāni syustrīṇyeva kanyasānyataḥ /
ucchrāyārdhena vistāro hy ucchrāyo 'bhyadhikastridhā //
meaning:
त्रीण्येव मध्यमानि स्युस्त्रीण्येव कन्यसान्यतः /
उच्छ्रायार्धेन विस्तारो ह्य् उच्छ्रायो ऽभ्यधिकस्त्रिधा //
text_mt:
there are three intermediate ones, and then three inferior ones.
The width is half the height; the height is increased threefold,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhiraṣṭabhirvāpi daśabhiraṅgulaistataḥ(7) /
ucchrāyāt pādavistīrṇā viśākhāstaduduṃvare(8) //
meaning:
चतुर्भिरष्टभिर्वापि दशभिरङ्गुलैस्ततः(7) /
उच्छ्रायात् पादविस्तीर्णा विशाखास्तदुदुंवरे(8) //
text_mt:
or by four, eight, or ten digits thereafter.
The doorposts (śākhā) and lintel/sill (udumbara) are wide by a quarter of the height.

sanskrit_iast:

dvipañcasaptanavabhiḥ śākhābhirdvāramiṣṭadaṃ //
meaning:
विस्तरार्धेन बाहुल्यं(9) सर्वेषामेव कीर्तितम् /

ग.. , घ.., छ.. च / नादादीनामिमास्तथेति ज..

ज..

ज..
6 उत्तमान्यपि चत्वारि चत्वारि दशहानित इति ज..

द्विपञ्चसप्तनवभिः शाखाभिर्द्वारमिष्टदं //

The thickness of all of them is declared to be half of the width.

A door with two, five, seven, or nine jamb-bands (śākhā) grants desires.

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥśākhācaturthāṃśe pratīhārau niveśayet /
mithunaiḥ pādavarṇābhiḥ(1) śākhāśeṣaṃ vibhūṣayet //
meaning:
अधःशाखाचतुर्थांशे प्रतीहारौ निवेशयेत् /
मिथुनैः पादवर्णाभिः(1) शाखाशेषं विभूषयेत् //
text_mt:
On the lowest fourth part of the jamb, one should place the two door-guardians;
one should decorate the remainder of the jambs with couples (mithuna) and foliated scrolls.

sanskrit_iast:
stambhabiddhe bhṛtyatā syāt vṛkṣabiddhe tvabhūtitā /
kūpabiddhe bhayaṃ dvāre kṣetrabiddhe(2) dhanakṣayaḥ //
meaning:
स्तम्भबिद्धे भृत्यता स्यात् वृक्षबिद्धे त्वभूतिता /
कूपबिद्धे भयं द्वारे क्षेत्रबिद्धे(2) धनक्षयः //
text_mt:
If [the doorway is] obstructed by a pillar, servitude will result; if obstructed by a tree, lack of prosperity;
if obstructed by a well, danger at the door; if obstructed by a field, loss of wealth;

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādagṛhaśilādimārgaviddheṣu(3) bandhanaṃ /
sabhābiddhe na dāridryaṃ varṇabiddhe(4) nirākṛtiḥ //
meaning:
प्रासादगृहशिलादिमार्गविद्धेषु(3) बन्धनं /
सभाबिद्धे न दारिद्र्यं वर्णबिद्धे(4) निराकृतिः //
text_mt:
if obstructed by a temple, house, stones, or a road, imprisonment;
if obstructed by an assembly hall, poverty; if obstructed by [a person of low] caste, exclusion;

sanskrit_iast:
ulūkhalena dāridryaṃ śilābiddhena śatrutā(5) /
chāyābiddhena dāridryaṃ bedhadoṣo na jāyate //
meaning:
उलूखलेन दारिद्र्यं शिलाबिद्धेन शत्रुता(5) /
छायाबिद्धेन दारिद्र्यं बेधदोषो न जायते //
text_mt:
by a mortar, poverty; if obstructed by a stone, enmity;
if obstructed by a shadow, poverty: [yet] the defect of obstruction does not arise

sanskrit_iast:
chedādutpāṭanādvāpi tathā prākāralakṣaṇāt /
sīmāyā dviguṇatyāgād bedhadoṣo na jāyate //

caturadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha pañcādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
nagarādivāstukathanaṃ
meaning:
छेदादुत्पाटनाद्वापि तथा प्राकारलक्षणात् /
सीमाया द्विगुणत्यागाद् बेधदोषो न जायते //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे सामान्यप्रासादलक्षणं नाम
चतुरधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ पञ्चाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
नगरादिवास्तुकथनं
text_mt:
by cutting or uprooting, or by the characteristic of an enclosure wall;
by leaving a space twice the boundary, the defect of obstruction does not arise.
Thus ends the one hundred fourth chapter, entitled 'General Characteristics of Temples', in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred and fifth chapter.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgāsyā daśadhā nāḍyāstāsāṃ nāmāni ca bruve /
śāntā yaśovatī kāntā viśālā prāṇavāhinī //
meaning:
प्रागास्या दशधा नाड्यास्तासां नामानि च ब्रुवे /
शान्ता यशोवती कान्ता विशाला प्राणवाहिनी //
text_mt: There are ten cords facing east, and I will declare their names: / Śāntā, Yaśovatī, Kāntā, Viśālā, Prāṇavāhinī,

sanskrit_iast:
satī vasumatī nandā subhadrātha(1) manoramā(2) /
uttarā dvādaśānyāś ca(3) ekāśītyaṅghrikārikā //
meaning:
सती वसुमती नन्दा सुभद्राथ(1) मनोरमा(2) /
उत्तरा द्वादशान्याश् च(3) एकाशीत्यङ्घ्रिकारिका //
text_mt: Satī, Vasumatī, Nandā, Subhadrā, and Manoramā; / and twelve other [cords] facing north, making eighty-one squares:

text_mt: Hariṇī, Suprabhā, Lakṣmī, Vibhūti, Vimalā, Priyā, / Jayā, Jvālā, and Viśokā, remembered from the laying of the cords.

sanskrit_iast:

sanskrit_iast:
havyavāhañca pūrvāṇi vitathaṃ bhaumameva ca /
kṛtāntamatha gandharvaṃ bhṛgaṃ mṛgañca dakṣiṇe //
meaning:
हव्यवाहञ्च पूर्वाणि वितथं भौममेव च /
कृतान्तमथ गन्धर्वं भृगं मृगञ्च दक्षिणे //
text_mt: and Havyavāha as the eastern ones; Vitatha and Bhauma, / Kṛtānta, Gandharva, Bhṛga, and Mṛga in the south;

sanskrit_iast:
pitaraṃ dvārapālañca sugrīvaṃ puṣpadantakaṃ /
varuṇaṃ daityaśeṣau ca yakṣmāṇaṃ paścime sadā //
meaning:
पितरं द्वारपालञ्च सुग्रीवं पुष्पदन्तकं /
वरुणं दैत्यशेषौ च यक्ष्माणं पश्चिमे सदा //
text_mt: Pitar, Dvārapāla, Sugrīva, Puṣpadantaka, / Varuṇa, Daitya, Śeṣa, and Yakṣman in the west always;

sanskrit_iast:
rogāhimukhyo(6) bhallāṭaḥ saubhāgyamaditirditiḥ(7) /
navāntaḥ padago brahmā pūjyordhe ca ṣaḍaṅghigāḥ(8) //
meaning:
रोगाहिमुख्यो(6) भल्लाटः सौभाग्यमदितिर्दितिः(7) /
नवान्तः पदगो ब्रह्मा पूज्योर्धे च षडङ्घिगाः(8) //
text_mt: Roga, Ahi, Mukhya, Bhallāṭa, Saubhāgya, Aditi, and Diti. / Brahmā occupies the nine inner squares, and those occupying six squares above are to be worshipped:

sanskrit_iast:
brahmeśāntarakoṣṭhastha(9) māyākhyāntu paddvaye /
tadadhaścāpavatsākhyaṃ kendrantareṣu ṣaṭpade //

sanskrit_iast:
marīcikāgnimadhye tu savitā dvipadasthitaḥ /
sāvitrī tadadho dvyaṃśe vivasvān ṣaṭpade tvadhaḥ //
meaning:
मरीचिकाग्निमध्ये तु सविता द्विपदस्थितः /
सावित्री तदधो द्व्यंशे विवस्वान् षट्पदे त्वधः //
text_mt: Savitar stands on two squares between Marīci and Agni; / Sāvitrī below him on two divisions, and Vivasvān below on six squares;

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbrahmāntare viṣṇumindumindraṃ tvadho jayaṃ /
varuṇabrahmaṇormadhye mitrākhyaṃ ṣaṭpade yajet //
meaning:
पितृब्रह्मान्तरे विष्णुमिन्दुमिन्द्रं त्वधो जयं /
वरुणब्रह्मणोर्मध्ये मित्राख्यं षट्पदे यजेत् //
text_mt: between Pitṛ and Brahmā [worship] Viṣṇu, Indu, Indra, and below them Jaya; / between Varuṇa and Brahmā one should worship the one named Mitra on six squares;

sanskrit_iast:
rogabrahmāntare nityaṃ dvipañca(1) rudradāsakam /
tadadho dvyaṅghrigaṃ yakṣma ṣaṭsaumyeṣu dharādharaṃ(2) //
meaning:
रोगब्रह्मान्तरे नित्यं द्विपञ्च(1) रुद्रदासकम् /
तदधो द्व्यङ्घ्रिगं यक्ष्म षट्सौम्येषु धराधरं(2) //
text_mt: between Roga and Brahmā constantly [worship] Rudradāsa on two [squares]; / below him Yakṣma occupying two squares, and Dharādhara in the six northern squares.

sanskrit_iast:
carakīṃ skandavikaṭaṃ vidārīṃ pūtanāṃ kramāt /
jammaṃ pāpaṃ(3) pilipicchaṃ(4) yajedīśādivāhyataḥ(5) //
meaning:
चरकीं स्कन्दविकटं विदारीं पूतनां क्रमात् /
जम्मं पापं(3) पिलिपिच्छं(4) यजेदीशादिवाह्यतः(5) //
text_mt: Carakī, Skanda, Vikaṭa, Vidārī, Pūtanā in order, / Jāmbha, Pāpa, and Pilipiccha—one should worship [them] on the outside, beginning from the northeast.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāśīpadaṃ veśma maṇḍapaś ca śatāṅghrikaḥ(6) /
pūrvavaddevatāḥ pūjyā brahmā tu ṣoḍaśāṃśake(7) //
meaning:
एकाशीपदं वेश्म मण्डपश् च शताङ्घ्रिकः(6) /
पूर्ववद्देवताः पूज्या ब्रह्मा तु षोडशांशके(7) //
text_mt: The house consists of eighty-one squares, and the pavilion of one hundred squares; / the deities are to be worshipped as before, but Brahmā on sixteen portions.

sanskrit_iast:
marīciś ca vivasvāṃś ca mitraṃ pṛthvīdharas tathā(8) /
daśakoṣṭhasthitā dikṣu tvanye beśādikoṇagāḥ(9) //
meaning:
मरीचिश् च विवस्वांश् च मित्रं पृथ्वीधरस् तथा(8) /
दशकोष्ठस्थिता दिक्षु त्वन्ये बेशादिकोणगाः(9) //
text_mt: Marīci, Vivasvān, Mitra, and Dharādhara / stand on ten squares in the cardinal directions, while others occupy the corners beginning with the northeast:

sanskrit_iast:
daityamātā tatheśāgnī(10) mṛgākhyau pitarau tathā /
pāpayakṣmānilau devāḥ sarve sārdhāṃśake sthitāḥ //
meaning:
दैत्यमाता तथेशाग्नी(10) मृगाख्यौ पितरौ तथा /
पापयक्ष्मानिलौ देवाः सर्वे सार्धांशके स्थिताः //
text_mt: the Mother of the Daityas, likewise Īśa and Agni, those named Mṛga, the two Pitṛs, / Pāpayakṣman and Anila—all these deities stand on one and a half portions.

with thirty cubits in length and twenty-eight in width.

sanskrit_iast:
śiśirāśrayaḥ śivākhyaś ca(2) rudrahīnaḥ sadobhayoḥ /
rudradviguṇitā nāhāḥ pṛthuṣṇobhirvinā tribhiḥ //
meaning:
शिशिराश्रयः शिवाख्यश् च(2) रुद्रहीनः सदोभयोः /
रुद्रद्विगुणिता नाहाः पृथुष्णोभिर्विना त्रिभिः //
text_mt: The [temple] named Śiva has cold shelter, devoid of eleven [parts] in both [dimensions]; / its perimeters are doubled by eleven, except for three broad [divisions].

sanskrit_iast:
syādgrahadviguṇaṃ dairghyāttithibhiś caiva(3) vistarāt(4) /
sāvitraḥ sālayaḥ kuḍyā(5) anyeṣāṃ pṛthakstriṃśāṃśataḥ //
meaning:
स्याद्ग्रहद्विगुणं दैर्घ्यात्तिथिभिश् चैव(3) विस्तरात्(4) /
सावित्रः सालयः कुड्या(5) अन्येषां पृथक्स्त्रिंशांशतः //
text_mt: It should be twice nine [cubits] in length and fifteen in width; / the Sāvitra [temple] has a wall-enclosure, from the separate thirtieth parts of the others.

sanskrit_iast:
kuḍyapṛthupajaṅghoccāt kuḍyantu triguṇocchayaṃ /
kuḍyasūtrasamā pṛthvī vīthī bhedādanekadhā //
meaning:
कुड्यपृथुपजङ्घोच्चात् कुड्यन्तु त्रिगुणोच्छयं /
कुड्यसूत्रसमा पृथ्वी वीथी भेदादनेकधा //
text_mt: From the height of the wall-breadth and shank, the wall should be three times the height. / The broad corridor is equal to the wall-line, manifold according to divisions.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadre tulyañca vīthībhirdvāravīthī vināgrataḥ /
śrījayaṃ pṛṣṭhato hīnaṃ bhadroyaṃ pārś cayorvinā //
meaning:
भद्रे तुल्यञ्च वीथीभिर्द्वारवीथी विनाग्रतः /
श्रीजयं पृष्ठतो हीनं भद्रोयं पार्श् चयोर्विना //
text_mt: In a bhadra type, [it is] equal to the corridors, without a gate-corridor in front; / the Śrījaya type is deficient at the back; this bhadra type is without both flanks.

sanskrit_iast:
garbhapṛthusamā(9) vīthī tadardhārdhena vā kvacit /
vīthyardhenopavīthyādyamekadvitripurānvitam //
meaning:
गर्भपृथुसमा(9) वीथी तदर्धार्धेन वा क्वचित् /
वीथ्यर्धेनोपवीथ्याद्यमेकद्वित्रिपुरान्वितम् //
text_mt: The corridor is equal to the width of the womb-chamber, or elsewhere half of its half; / with an auxiliary corridor of half a corridor, [a hall] provided with one, two, or three towers.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmānyānātha gṛhaṃ vakṣye sarveṣāṃ sarvakāmadaṃ /
ekadvitricatuḥśālamaṣṭaśālaṃ yathākramāt //
meaning:
सामान्यानाथ गृहं वक्ष्ये सर्वेषां सर्वकामदं /
एकद्वित्रिचतुःशालमष्टशालं यथाक्रमात् //
text_mt: Now I shall declare common houses for all [castes], which grant all desires: / with one, two, three, four, or eight halls, in due order.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ yāmye ca saumāsyaṃ dve cet paścāt puromukham(7) /
catuḥśālantu sāmmukhyāttayorindrendramuktayoḥ //
meaning:
एकं याम्ये च सौमास्यं द्वे चेत् पश्चात् पुरोमुखम्(7) /
चतुःशालन्तु साम्मुख्यात्तयोरिन्द्रेन्द्रमुक्तयोः //
text_mt: One [hall] is on the south facing north; if two, at the back facing east; / a four-halled house, however, is formed by their facing each other in the east and west quarters.

शिवास्यमम्बुपास्यैष इन्द्रास्ये यमसूर्यकं(8) /

शिवाग्रकशिवाख्यस्येति ग.. / शिवाग्रगः शिवाख्यस्येति ङ.. , ज.. च /
शिवाश्रयः शिवाख्यस्येति छ..

पश्चादधोमुखमिति झ..
8 सावित्रः सालयः कोटीनां तपसा
:प् 359
प्राक्सौम्यस्थे च दण्दाख्यं प्राग्याम्ये वातसञ्ज्ञकं //
text_mt:
[There are rooms] facing Śiva [northeast] and facing the water-guardian [west]; in an east-facing one, [rooms in the directions of] Yama [south] and the Sun [east].
[Footnote]:
1. "sāṣṭāviṃśati" in kha and ṅa.
2. "śivāśramaḥ śivākhyasya" in kha, gha, and jha;
"śivāgrakaśivākhyasya" in ga; "śivāgragaḥ śivākhyasya" in ṅa and ja;
"śivāśrayaḥ śivākhyasya" in cha.
3. "dairghyādṛṣibhiś caiva" in gha.
4. "dairghyāt sāṣṭāviṃśativistarāt" in cha.
5. "sāvitryālayaḥ kulāḥ" in kha; the text beginning with "sāvitra" up to "triguṇocchrayam" is not present in manuscript jha.
6. "garbhapīṭhasamā" in kha, gha, and jha.
7. "saumyāsyaṃ dve dve paścātpuromukham" in kha; "saumyākhyaṃ dve ca paścādadhomukham" in jha. / 8. [See manuscript notes on cosmological insertion below].
When situated in the east and north, it is named Daṇḍa; in the east and south, it is called Vāta.

sanskrit_iast:
āpyendau gṛhavalyākhyaṃ(1) triśūlaṃ tadvinardhikṛt /
pūrvaśalāvihīnaṃ(2) syāt sukṣetraṃ vṛddhidāyakaṃ //
meaning:
आप्येन्दौ गृहवल्याख्यं(1) त्रिशूलं तद्विनर्धिकृत् /
पूर्वशलाविहीनं(2) स्यात् सुक्षेत्रं वृद्धिदायकं //
text_mt: In the west and north, it is called Gṛhavalī; a Triśūla causes depletion. / One devoid of an eastern hall is Sukṣetra, conferring prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmye hīne bhavecchūlī triśālaṃ vṛddhikṛt paraṃ(3) /
yakṣaghnaṃ jalahīnaukaḥ sutaghnaṃ bahuśatrukṛt //
:n
meaning:
याम्ये हीने भवेच्छूली त्रिशालं वृद्धिकृत् परं(3) /
यक्षघ्नं जलहीनौकः सुतघ्नं बहुशत्रुकृत् //
:न्
text_mt:
When deficient in the south, it becomes a Śūlin; a three-halled house is supremely prosperous; / a house lacking [a hall on the side of] the water-guardian kills Yakṣas, slays sons, and generates many enemies.
[Footnote]:

samāvṛtya pradhānaṃ samavasthitaṃ / anantasya na tasyāntaḥ
saṃsthānaṃ na ca vidyate / hetubhūtamaśeṣasya prakṛtiḥ sā purā
mune / asaṅkhyātāni cāṇḍāni tatra jātāni ca dṛśāṃ /
daruṇyagniryathā tailaṃ tena tadvat pumāniti / pradhānevasthito vyāpī
cetanātmātmavedanaḥ / pradhānaś ca pumāṃś caiva
sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmabhūs tathā / viṣṇuśaktyā
mahatprājñavṛttau saṃśrayadharmiṇau / tayoḥ saiva pṛthagbhāve
karaṇaṃ saṃśayasya ca / mahākhyaṃ svatalaścākhyaṃ pātālaṃ
cāpi sattama / kṛṣṇapītāruṇāḥ
śukraśarkarāśailakāñcanāḥ / bhūmayasteṣu cānyeṣu santi
daityādayaḥ sukhaṃ / pātālānāmadhaścānte śeṣo viṣṇoś ca
tāmasaḥ / guṇānanyān sa cānantaḥ śirasā dhārayanmahīṃ /
bhuvodho narakā lokaṃ nayate kṣatravaiṣṇavaḥ / vāriṇā bhāvitā
pṛthvī yāvattāvannabho mataṃ / siddhāntamastuyābhyaiva, indrāsthe
yamasūryakaṃ / mallabdheṣu ka.. , kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , jha..
cihnitapustakeṣu sāvitraḥ sālayaḥ ity ataḥ paraṃ naiṣa pāṭho
vartate / teṣu tu mudritapāṭha eva vartate punaḥ ja.. cihnitapustake
sāvitraḥ sālaya ity ataḥ paraṃ indrāsyeyamasūryakamityantaḥ
pāṭho nāsti / ja.. cihnitapustake ya uktapāṭho dṛśyate tatra
pūrvāparasaṅgatirnāsti / prakaraṇāntarīyapāthoyamatra
lekhakabhramāt samāgata iti bhāti
meaning:
सत्यलोकतः / अपुनर्मारका यत्र ब्रह्मलोको हि स्मृतः /
पादाद्यधस्तुर्भूलोको भुवः सूर्याद्ववः स्मृतः / स्वर्लोको
भुवान्तश् च नियुतानि चतुर्दश / एकदण्डं कटाहेन वृतो
ब्रह्माण्डविस्तरः / वारिवह्न्यानलाशैस्ततो भूतादिनावधि /
वृतं दशगुणैर् अण्डं भूतादिर्महता तथा /
दशोत्तराण्यशेषाणि शुक्र कस्मान्मामुने / महान्तञ्च
समावृत्य प्रधानं समवस्थितं / अनन्तस्य न तस्यान्तः
संस्थानं न च विद्यते / हेतुभूतमशेषस्य प्रकृतिः सा पुरा
मुने / असङ्ख्यातानि चाण्डानि तत्र जातानि च दृशां /
दरुण्यग्निर्यथा तैलं तेन तद्वत् पुमानिति / प्रधानेवस्थितो व्यापी
चेतनात्मात्मवेदनः / प्रधानश् च पुमांश् चैव
सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मभूस् तथा / विष्णुशक्त्या
महत्प्राज्ञवृत्तौ संश्रयधर्मिणौ / तयोः सैव पृथग्भावे
करणं संशयस्य च / महाख्यं स्वतलश्चाख्यं पातालं
चापि सत्तम / कृष्णपीतारुणाः
शुक्रशर्कराशैलकाञ्चनाः / भूमयस्तेषु चान्येषु सन्ति
दैत्यादयः सुखं / पातालानामधश्चान्ते शेषो विष्णोश् च
तामसः / गुणानन्यान् स चानन्तः शिरसा धारयन्महीं /
भुवोधो नरका लोकं नयते क्षत्रवैष्णवः / वारिणा भाविता
पृथ्वी यावत्तावन्नभो मतं / सिद्धान्तमस्तुयाभ्यैव, इन्द्रास्थे
यमसूर्यकं / मल्लब्धेषु क.. , ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , झ..
चिह्नितपुस्तकेषु सावित्रः सालयः इत्य् अतः परं नैष पाठो
वर्तते / तेषु तु मुद्रितपाठ एव वर्तते पुनः ज.. चिह्नितपुस्तके
सावित्रः सालय इत्य् अतः परं इन्द्रास्येयमसूर्यकमित्यन्तः
पाठो नास्ति / ज.. चिह्नितपुस्तके य उक्तपाठो दृश्यते तत्र
पूर्वापरसङ्गतिर्नास्ति / प्रकरणान्तरीयपाथोयमत्र
लेखकभ्रमात् समागत इति भाति
text_mt: "From the realm of truth... [a long cosmological passage found in manuscript ja describing the worlds, Brahmāṇḍa, Prakṛti, Puruṣa, Pātālas, and Śeṣa up to 'yamasūryakam']. In the manuscripts marked ka, kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, and jha consulted by me, this reading is not present after 'sāvitraḥ sālayaḥ'; in those, only the printed reading is found. Furthermore, in manuscript ja, the text between 'sāvitraḥ sālayaḥ' and 'indrāsyeyamasūryakam' is missing. The aforementioned text visible in manuscript ja lacks connection with what precedes and follows. It appears this reading belonging to another section has entered here through scribal error."

sanskrit_iast:
indrādikramato vacmi(1) dhvajādyaṣṭau gṛhāṇyahaṃ /
prakṣālānusragāvāsamagnau(2) tasya mahānasaṃ //
meaning:
इन्द्रादिक्रमतो वच्मि(1) ध्वजाद्यष्टौ गृहाण्यहं /
प्रक्षालानुस्रगावासमग्नौ(2) तस्य महानसं //
text_mt: I shall state the eight [types of] houses, Dhvaja and the others, in order starting with Indra [the east]: / an abode for washing and ladles [in the east], and in the Fire quarter [southeast] one's kitchen.

sanskrit_iast:
yāmye rasakriyā śayyā dhanuḥśastrāṇi rakṣasi /
dhanamuktyamvupeśākhye(3) samyagandhau ca(4) mārute //
meaning:
याम्ये रसक्रिया शय्या धनुःशस्त्राणि रक्षसि /
धनमुक्त्यम्वुपेशाख्ये(3) सम्यगन्धौ च(4) मारुते //
text_mt: In the south, chemical operations and bed; bows and weapons in the Rakṣas quarter [southwest]; / dining and wealth in the water-guardian's quarter [west]; and properly [stored] blind-corn in the Wind quarter [northwest].

sanskrit_iast:
saumye(5) dhanapaśū kuryādīśe dīkṣāvarālayaṃ(6) /
svāmihastamitaṃ veśma vistārāyāmapiṇḍikaṃ //
meaning:
सौम्ये(5) धनपशू कुर्यादीशे दीक्षावरालयं(6) /
स्वामिहस्तमितं वेश्म विस्तारायामपिण्डिकं //
text_mt: In the north, one should place wealth and cattle; in the Īśa quarter [northeast], an abode for best initiation. / A house measured in the master's cubits has length, breadth, and height.

sanskrit_iast:
triguṇaṃ hastasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvāṣṭāṃśaihṛtaṃ tathā(7) /
taccheṣoyaṃ sthitastena vāyasāntaṃ dhvajādikaṃ //
meaning:
त्रिगुणं हस्तसंयुक्तं कृत्वाष्टांशैहृतं तथा(7) /
तच्छेषोयं स्थितस्तेन वायसान्तं ध्वजादिकं //
text_mt: Having multiplied [the dimension] by three, joined with the cubits, and likewise divided by eight parts, / this remainder that remains yields [the eight orientations] beginning with Dhvaja and ending with Vāyasa.

sanskrit_iast:
trayaḥ pakṣāgnivedeṣu rasarṣivasuto bhavet /
sarvanāśakaraṃ veśma madhye cānte ca saṃsthitaṃ //
meaning:
त्रयः पक्षाग्निवेदेषु रसर्षिवसुतो भवेत् /
सर्वनाशकरं वेश्म मध्ये चान्ते च संस्थितं //
text_mt: [The remainders] three from the wings [two], fires [three], and Vedas [four] become [inauspicious] from the tastes [six], sages [seven], and Vasus [eight]; / a house situated in the center and at the boundary brings total destruction.

sanskrit_iast:
tasmācca(8) navame bhāge śubhakṛnnilayo mataḥ /
tanmadhe maṇḍapaḥ śastaḥ samo vā dviguṇāyataḥ //
meaning:
तस्माच्च(8) नवमे भागे शुभकृन्निलयो मतः /
तन्मधे मण्डपः शस्तः समो वा द्विगुणायतः //
text_mt: Therefore, a dwelling is considered auspicious in the ninth division. / A pavilion in its middle is praised, either square or twice as long.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyagāpye cenduyame(9) haṭṭa eva gṛhāvalī /
ekaikabhavanākhyāni dikṣvaṣṭāṣṭakasaṅkhyayā(10) //
meaning:
प्रत्यगाप्ये चेन्दुयमे(9) हट्ट एव गृहावली /
एकैकभवनाख्यानि दिक्ष्वष्टाष्टकसङ्ख्यया(10) //
text_mt: In the west, northwest, and southwest, rows of houses form a market; / in the eight directions, there are names for each individual dwelling according to the number eight times eight,

text_mt:
beginning with Īśa and ending with Aditi; their fruits in due order are: / fear, a woman, unsteadiness, victory, prosperity, and majesty.
[Footnote]:
1. "indrādikramato vahni" in kha and cha.
2. "prakṣālanātmabhāgāraḥ samagnau" in cha;
"prakṣālānugrahāvāsamagrau" in ja.
3. "dhanabhktāmbupaśākhye" in kha and cha.
4. "śasyamañcau ca" in jha.
5. "yāmye" in jha.
6. "dīkṣāsurālayam" in kha, ja, and jha.
[Variant readings:] 7 'kṛtvāṣṭāṃśair hataṃ tathā' in manuscript ga; 'kṛtvāṣṭāṅgair hataṃ tathā' in manuscripts gha and ja; 'kṛtvāṣṭāṃśahatastathā' in manuscript jha.
8 'tasmāttu' in manuscript jha.
9 'prāgīśe cenduyāmye vā' in manuscript kha; 'prāgāpye cenduyāmye' in manuscripts cha and jha.
10 The text beginning with 'sarvanāśakaram' and ending with 'yathākramam' is missing in manuscript ja.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaḥ kaliś ca naisvyañca prāgdvāreṣvaṣṭasu dhruvaṃ /
dāho 'sukhaṃ suhṛnnāśo dhananāśo mṛtirdhanaṃ(1) //
meaning:
धर्मः कलिश् च नैस्व्यञ्च प्राग्द्वारेष्वष्टसु ध्रुवं /
दाहो ऽसुखं सुहृन्नाशो धननाशो मृतिर्धनं(1) //
text_mt: In the eight eastern doorways, there are certainly [the effects]: virtue, discord, poverty, / burning, unhappiness, loss of friends, loss of wealth, death, and wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
śilpitvaṃ tanayaḥ syācca yāmyadvāraphalāṣṭakam /
āyuḥprāvrājyaśasyāni(2) dhanaśāntyarthasaṅkṣayāḥ //
meaning:
शिल्पित्वं तनयः स्याच्च याम्यद्वारफलाष्टकम् /
आयुःप्राव्राज्यशस्यानि(2) धनशान्त्यर्थसङ्क्षयाः //
text_mt: Skill in arts and a son are [the rest of] the eightfold fruits of southern doorways. / Long life, renunciation, crops, wealth, peace, loss of wealth,

sanskrit_iast:
śoṣaṃ bhogaṃ cāpatyañca(3) jaladvāraphalāni ca /
rogo madārtimukhyatvaṃ cārthāyuḥ kṛśatā matiḥ //
meaning:
शोषं भोगं चापत्यञ्च(3) जलद्वारफलानि च /
रोगो मदार्तिमुख्यत्वं चार्थायुः कृशता मतिः //
text_mt: emaciation, enjoyment, and offspring are the fruits of western doorways. / Disease, intoxication, affliction, pre-eminence, wealth, longevity, weakness, intelligence,

'dhyāyaḥ ||

:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे गृहादिवास्तुर्नाम पञ्चाधिकशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||

text_mt:
and honor are proclaimed from the doorway of the northern direction in sequence.
Thus ends the one hundred and fifth chapter, entitled 'Site Architecture for Houses and the Like', in the great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now begins the one hundred and sixth chapter:
Site Architecture for Cities and the Like

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
nagarādikavāstuś ca vakṣye rājyādivṛddhaye /
yojanaṃ yojanārdhaṃ vā(5) tadarthaṃ sthānamāśrayet //
:n
1 vanavāsī mṛtirdhanamiti gha.. / dharmaḥ kaliścetyādiḥ,
mṛtirdhanamityantaḥ pāṭho jha.. pustake nāsti
2 āyuḥ prāvāhyaśasyānīti kha.. , cha.. ca
3 bhogaṃ ca patyaṃ ceti kha.. , cha.. ca
4 dvārataḥ prokta iti gha..
5 bhojanārdhantadardhaṃ ca iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
:p 362
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
नगरादिकवास्तुश् च वक्ष्ये राज्यादिवृद्धये /
योजनं योजनार्धं वा(5) तदर्थं स्थानमाश्रयेत् //
:न्
1 वनवासी मृतिर्धनमिति घ.. / धर्मः कलिश्चेत्यादिः,
मृतिर्धनमित्यन्तः पाठो झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
2 आयुः प्रावाह्यशस्यानीति ख.. , छ.. च
3 भोगं च पत्यं चेति ख.. , छ.. च
4 द्वारतः प्रोक्त इति घ..
5 भोजनार्धन्तदर्धं च इति घ.. , ङ.. च
:प् 362
text_mt:
Īśvara said: / I shall explain site architecture for cities and the like for the prosperity of the kingdom and the like. / One should occupy a site of a yojana, or half a yojana, or half of that.
[Notes:]
1 “vanavāsī mṛtirdhanam” in manuscript gha. The reading beginning with “dharmaḥ kaliśca” and ending with “mṛtirdhanam” is absent in manuscript jha.
2 'āyuḥ prāvāhyaśasyāni' in manuscripts kha and cha.
3 'bhogaṃ ca patyaṃ ca' in manuscripts kha and cha.
4 'dvārataḥ proktaḥ' in manuscript gha. / 5 'bhojanārdhantadardhaṃ ca' in manuscripts gha and ṅa.

sanskrit_iast:
abhyarcya vāstu nagaraṃ prākārādyantu kārayet /
īśāditriṃśatpadake pūrvadvāraṃ ca sūryake //
meaning:
अभ्यर्च्य वास्तु नगरं प्राकाराद्यन्तु कारयेत् /
ईशादित्रिंशत्पदके पूर्वद्वारं च सूर्यके //
text_mt: Having worshipped the site, one should construct the city, the ramparts, and the like. / In a grid of thirty-two plots beginning from Īśa, [place] the eastern gate at Sūrya;

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvābhyāṃ(1) dakṣiṇe syādvāruṇye paścime tathā /
saumyadvāraṃ saumyapade kāryā haṭṭāstu vistarāḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वाभ्यां(1) दक्षिणे स्याद्वारुण्ये पश्चिमे तथा /
सौम्यद्वारं सौम्यपदे कार्या हट्टास्तु विस्तराः //
text_mt: on the south it should be at Gandharva, and likewise on the west at Vāruṇa; / the northern gate at the Saumya plot; and extensive marketplaces should be made.

sanskrit_iast:
yenebhādi sukhaṃ gacchet kuryād dvāraṃ tu ṣaṭkaraṃ /
chinnakarṇaṃ vibhinnañca candrārdhābhaṃ puraṃ na hi //
meaning:
येनेभादि सुखं गच्छेत् कुर्याद् द्वारं तु षट्करं /
छिन्नकर्णं विभिन्नञ्च चन्द्रार्धाभं पुरं न हि //
text_mt: So that elephants and the like may pass comfortably, one should make a gate of six cubits. / A city broken at the corners, ruptured, or resembling a half-moon [should] not [be built].

sanskrit_iast:
vajrasūcīmukhaṃ neṣṭaṃ(2) sakṛd dvitrisamāgamaṃ /
cāpābhaṃ vajranāgābhaṃ(3) purārambhe hi śāntikṛt //
meaning:
वज्रसूचीमुखं नेष्टं(2) सकृद् द्वित्रिसमागमं /
चापाभं वज्रनागाभं(3) पुरारम्भे हि शान्तिकृत् //
text_mt: A city resembling the point of a diamond needle is undesirable, as is one with junctions of two or three roads at once; / one resembling a bow or a vajranāga brings peace at the commencement of a city.

sanskrit_iast:
prārcya viṣṇu harārkādīnnatvā dadyād baliṃ balī(4) /
āgneye svarṇakarmārān(5) purasya viniveśayet //
meaning:
प्रार्च्य विष्णु हरार्कादीन्नत्वा दद्याद् बलिं बली(4) /
आग्नेये स्वर्णकर्मारान्(5) पुरस्य विनिवेशयेत् //
text_mt: Having first worshipped Viṣṇu, Śiva, the Sun, and others, and having bowed, the strong [king] should offer an oblation. / One should settle goldsmiths in the south-east of the city;

sanskrit_iast:
dakṣiṇe nṛtyavṛttīnāṃ(6) veśyāstrīṇāṃ gṛhāṇi ca /
naṭānāñcakrikādīnāṃ(7) kaivartādeś ca nairṛte //
meaning:
दक्षिणे नृत्यवृत्तीनां(6) वेश्यास्त्रीणां गृहाणि च /
नटानाञ्चक्रिकादीनां(7) कैवर्तादेश् च नैरृते //
text_mt: the houses of dancers and courtesans in the south; / actors, carriage-drivers, and fishermen in the south-west;

sanskrit_iast:
rathānāmāyudhānāñca kṛpāṇāñca vāruṇe /
śauṇḍikāḥ karmādhikṛtā vāyavye parikarmaṇaḥ(8) //
meaning:
रथानामायुधानाञ्च कृपाणाञ्च वारुणे /
शौण्डिकाः कर्माधिकृता वायव्ये परिकर्मणः(8) //
text_mt: [makers] of chariots, weapons, and swords in the west; / distillers, revenue officials, and servants in the north-west;

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇā yatayaḥ siddhāḥ puṇyavantaś ca cottare /
phalādyādivikrayiṇa īśāne ca vaṇigjanāḥ //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणा यतयः सिद्धाः पुण्यवन्तश् च चोत्तरे /
फलाद्यादिविक्रयिण ईशाने च वणिग्जनाः //
text_mt: brāhmaṇas, ascetics, perfected beings, and virtuous people in the north; / and sellers of fruits and the like, and merchants in the north-east.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvataś ca balādhyakṣā āgneye vividhaṃ balaṃ /
strīṇāmādeśino dakṣe kāṇḍārānnairṛte nyaset //
meaning:
पूर्वतश् च बलाध्यक्षा आग्नेये विविधं बलं /
स्त्रीणामादेशिनो दक्षे काण्डारान्नैरृते न्यसेत् //
text_mt: Military commanders in the east; diverse forces in the south-east; / directors of women in the south; and one should place cane-workers in the south-west;

sanskrit_iast:
paścime ca mahāmātyān koṣapālāṃś ca kārukān /

ṅa..

6 dakṣiṇe bhṛtyadhūrtānāmiti cha..
7 naṭānāṃ vāhlikādīnāmiti kha.. , ja.. ca
8 parikarmaṇa iti cha.. , ja.. ca

uttare daṇḍanāthāṃś ca nāyakadvijasaṅkulān //
meaning:
पश्चिमे च महामात्यान् कोषपालांश् च कारुकान् /

ङ..

8 परिकर्मण इति छ.. , ज.. च

उत्तरे दण्डनाथांश् च नायकद्विजसङ्कुलान् //
text_mt:
prime ministers, treasurers, and artisans in the west;
[Notes:]
1 'gandharvādyāḥ' in manuscripts ga and ja.
2 'sūcīmukhaṃ naṣṭam' in manuscripts jha and cha.
3 'vyāyataṃ vajranāsābham' in manuscript gha; 'cāpābhaṃ cakranābhābham' in manuscript ṅa.
4 'stutvā natvā baliṃ balī' in manuscript ṅa.
5 'āgneye tu karmakārān' in manuscript kha.
6 'dakṣiṇe bhṛtyadhūrtānām' in manuscript cha.
7 'naṭānāṃ vāhlikādīnām' in manuscripts kha and ja.
8 'parikarmaṇaḥ' in manuscripts cha and ja.
and army generals along with leaders and brāhmaṇas in the north.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvataḥ kṣatriyān dakṣe vaiśyāñchūndrāṃś ca paścime /
dikṣu vaidyān vājinaś ca balāni ca caturdiśaṃ //
meaning:
पूर्वतः क्षत्रियान् दक्षे वैश्याञ्छून्द्रांश् च पश्चिमे /
दिक्षु वैद्यान् वाजिनश् च बलानि च चतुर्दिशं //
text_mt: Kṣatriyas in the east, vaiśyas in the south, and śūdras in the west; / physicians and horses in the intermediate directions, and troops on all four sides.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrveṇa caraliṅgyādīñchmaśānādīni dakṣiṇe /
paścime godhanādyañca kṛṣikartṝṃstathottare //
meaning:
पूर्वेण चरलिङ्ग्यादीञ्छ्मशानादीनि दक्षिणे /
पश्चिमे गोधनाद्यञ्च कृषिकर्तॄंस्तथोत्तरे //
text_mt: Wandering mendicants and the like to the east, cremation grounds and the like in the south, / herds of cattle and the like in the west, and cultivators in the north.

sanskrit_iast:
nyasenmlecchāṃś ca koṇeṣu grāmādiṣu tathā smṛtiṃ(1) /
śriyaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ dvāri(2) pūrve tau(3) paśyatāṃ śriyaṃ //
meaning:
न्यसेन्म्लेच्छांश् च कोणेषु ग्रामादिषु तथा स्मृतिं(1) /
श्रियं वैश्रवणं द्वारि(2) पूर्वे तौ(3) पश्यतां श्रियं //
text_mt: One should place foreigners in the corner directions, and likewise the law in villages and the like. / At the eastern gate, Śrī and Vaiśravaṇa; both should behold Śrī.

sanskrit_iast:
devādīnāṃ paścimataḥ pūrvāsyāni gṛhāṇi hi /
pūrvataḥ paścimāsyāni dakṣiṇe cottarānanān(4) //
meaning:
देवादीनां पश्चिमतः पूर्वास्यानि गृहाणि हि /
पूर्वतः पश्चिमास्यानि दक्षिणे चोत्तराननान्(4) //
text_mt: To the west of the gods and others, houses should face east; / to the east, facing west; and to the south, facing north.

sanskrit_iast:
nākeśaviṣṇvādidhāmāni rakṣārthaṃ nagarasya ca(5) /
nirdaivatantu nagaragrāmadurgagṛhādikaṃ //
meaning:
नाकेशविष्ण्वादिधामानि रक्षार्थं नगरस्य च(5) /
निर्दैवतन्तु नगरग्रामदुर्गगृहादिकं //
text_mt: Abodes of Indra, Viṣṇu, and others [should be established] for the protection of the city. / A city, village, fortress, house, or the like that is devoid of deities

sanskrit_iast:
bhujyate tat piśācādyai rogādyaiḥ paribhūyate /
nagarādi sadaivaṃ hi jayadaṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ //
meaning:
भुज्यते तत् पिशाचाद्यै रोगाद्यैः परिभूयते /
नगरादि सदैवं हि जयदं भुक्तिमुक्तिदं //
text_mt: is consumed by piśācas and others and overcome by diseases and the like. / Thus, a city and the like always bestows victory, worldly enjoyment, and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāyāṃ śrīgṛhaṃ proktamāgneyyāṃ vai mahānasaṃ /
śanayaṃ dakṣiṇasyāntu(7) nairṛtyāmāyudhāśrayaṃ //
meaning:
पूर्वायां श्रीगृहं प्रोक्तमाग्नेय्यां वै महानसं /
शनयं दक्षिणस्यान्तु(7) नैरृत्यामायुधाश्रयं //
text_mt: A room for prosperity is prescribed in the east, a kitchen in the south-east, / a bedroom in the south, and an armory in the south-west;

sanskrit_iast:
bhojanaṃ paścimāyāntu vāyavyāṃ dhānyasaṅgrahaḥ /
uttare dravyasaṃsthānamaiśānyāṃ devatāgṛhaṃ(8) //
meaning:
भोजनं पश्चिमायान्तु वायव्यां धान्यसङ्ग्रहः /
उत्तरे द्रव्यसंस्थानमैशान्यां देवतागृहं(8) //
text_mt: a dining room in the west, a store of grain in the north-west, / storage for wealth in the north, and a shrine for deities in the north-east.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥśālaṃ triśālaṃ vā dviśālaṃ caikaśālakaṃ /
catuḥśālagṛhāṇāntu śālālindakabhedataḥ(9) //

1 tathā sthitamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca / yathāsthitamiti ja..
2 vaiśravaṇaṃ vāpi iti ga..
3 pūrvata iti kha..
4 dakṣiṇe cottareṇa ceti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. ca
5 nagarasya hīti kha.. , cha.. ca
6 rogādyair abhibhūyate iti ja..
7 dakṣiṇāyāṃ tviti ga.. , gha.. , jha ca
8 devatālayamiti jha..
9 śālālindaprabhedata iti ka..

चतुःशालं त्रिशालं वा द्विशालं चैकशालकं /
चतुःशालगृहाणान्तु शालालिन्दकभेदतः(9) //
:न्
1 तथा स्थितमिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च / यथास्थितमिति ज..
2 वैश्रवणं वापि इति ग..
3 पूर्वत इति ख..
4 दक्षिणे चोत्तरेण चेति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. च
5 नगरस्य हीति ख.. , छ.. च
6 रोगाद्यैर् अभिभूयते इति ज..
7 दक्षिणायां त्विति ग.. , घ.. , झ च
8 देवतालयमिति झ..
9 शालालिन्दप्रभेदत इति क..
:प् 364
text_mt:
A house may have four halls, three halls, two halls, or a single hall. / In four-hall houses, according to the distinction of halls and porticos,
[Notes:]
1 'tathā sthitam' in manuscripts kha, gha, ṅa, and cha; 'yathāsthitam' in manuscript ja.
2 'vaiśravaṇaṃ vāpi' in manuscript ga.
3 'pūrvataḥ' in manuscript kha.
4 'dakṣiṇe cottareṇa ca' in manuscripts kha, ga, and gha.
5 'nagarasya hi' in manuscripts kha and cha.
6 'rogādyair abhibhūyate' in manuscript ja.
7 'dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu' in manuscripts ga, gha, and jha.
8 'devatālayam' in manuscript jha.
9 'śālālindaprabhedataḥ' in manuscript ka.

sanskrit_iast:
śatadvayantu jāyante pañcāśat pañca teṣvapi /
triśālāni tu catvāri dviśālāni tu pañcadhā //
meaning:
शतद्वयन्तु जायन्ते पञ्चाशत् पञ्च तेष्वपि /
त्रिशालानि तु चत्वारि द्विशालानि तु पञ्चधा //
text_mt: two hundred and fifty-five types arise among them. / There are four three-hall houses, and five types of two-hall houses;

sanskrit_iast:
ekaśālāni catvāri ekālindāni vacmi ca /
aṣṭāviṃśadalindāni gṛhāṇi nagarāṇi ca(1) //
meaning:
एकशालानि चत्वारि एकालिन्दानि वच्मि च /
अष्टाविंशदलिन्दानि गृहाणि नगराणि च(1) //
text_mt: there are four single-hall houses; and I shall state those with single porticos. / Houses and cities have twenty-eight porticos,

sanskrit_iast:
caturbhiḥ saprabhiś caiva pañcapañcāśadeva tu /
ṣaḍalindāni viṃśaiva aṣṭābhirviṃśa eva hi(2) //
meaning:
चतुर्भिः सप्रभिश् चैव पञ्चपञ्चाशदेव तु /
षडलिन्दानि विंशैव अष्टाभिर्विंश एव हि(2) //
text_mt: fifty-five with four and seven, / twenty with six porticos, and twenty with eight.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭālindaṃ bhavedevaṃ(3) nagarādau gṛhāṇi hi /

'dhyāyaḥ ||

svāyambhuvasargaḥ
agnir uvāca(4)

ऽध्यायः ||
