Mantras, Herbs, and Other [Remedies]

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
mantrauṣadhāni cakrāṇi(1) vakṣye sarvapradāni ca /
cauranāmno varṇaguṇo dvighno mātrāś caturguṇāḥ //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
मन्त्रौषधानि चक्राणि(1) वक्ष्ये सर्वप्रदानि च /
चौरनाम्नो वर्णगुणो द्विघ्नो मात्राश् चतुर्गुणाः //
text_mt: The Lord said: / I shall declare the diagrams of mantras and herbs that grant all desires. / The letters of a thief's name multiplied by three and doubled, and the morae multiplied by four,

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnā hṛte bhaveccheṣadyauro 'tha jātakaṃ vade /
praśne ye viṣamā varṇāste garbhe putrajanmadāḥ //
meaning:
नाम्ना हृते भवेच्छेषद्यौरो ऽथ जातकं वदे /
प्रश्ने ये विषमा वर्णास्ते गर्भे पुत्रजन्मदाः //
text_mt: when divided by the name, the remainder will reveal the thief. Now I declare the nativity: / In divination, the odd syllables indicate the birth of a son in the womb;

sanskrit_iast:
nāmavarṇaiḥ samaiḥ kāṇo vāme 'kṣṇi viṣamaiḥ punaḥ /
dakṣiṇākṣi bhavet kāṇaṃ strīpunnāmākṣarasya ca //
meaning:
नामवर्णैः समैः काणो वामे ऽक्ष्णि विषमैः पुनः /
दक्षिणाक्षि भवेत् काणं स्त्रीपुन्नामाक्षरस्य च //
text_mt: if the letters of the name are even, [the child] will be blind in the left eye; if odd, / the right eye will be blind. And from the syllables of female and male names,

sanskrit_iast:
mātrāvarṇāś caturnighanā varṇapiṇḍe guṇe kṛte /
same strī viṣame nā syādviśeṣe ca(2) mṛtiḥ striyāḥ //
meaning:
मात्रावर्णाश् चतुर्निघना वर्णपिण्डे गुणे कृते /
समे स्त्री विषमे ना स्याद्विशेषे च(2) मृतिः स्त्रियाः //
text_mt: the morae and syllables multiplied by four, when multiplied by the letter-total: / if even, it will be female; if odd, male; and in case of difference, death of the woman [results].

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ rūpaśūnye 'tha prathamaṃ mriyate pumān /
praśnaṃ sūkṣmākṣarair gṛhya dravyair bhāge 'khile matam //
meaning:
प्रथमं रूपशून्ये ऽथ प्रथमं म्रियते पुमान् /
प्रश्नं सूक्ष्माक्षरैर् गृह्य द्रव्यैर् भागे ऽखिले मतम् //
text_mt: If the first [digit] is zero, then the man dies first. / Having grasped the query through subtle syllables, it is considered across all divisions by the matters [queried].

sanskrit_iast:
śanicakraṃ pravakṣyāmi tasya dṛṣṭiṃ parityajet /
rāśisthaḥ saptame dṛṣṭiś caturdaśaśaterdhikā //
meaning:
शनिचक्रं प्रवक्ष्यामि तस्य दृष्टिं परित्यजेत् /
राशिस्थः सप्तमे दृष्टिश् चतुर्दशशतेर्धिका //
text_mt: I shall declare the Saturn-diagram; one should avoid his gaze. / Standing in a zodiac sign, his aspect is on the seventh, exceeding fourteen hundred;

sanskrit_iast:
ekadvyaṣṭadvādaśamaḥ pādadṛṣṭiś ca taṃ tyajet /
dinādhipaḥ praharabhāk śeṣā yāmārdhabhāginaḥ(3) //
:n
1 mantrauṣadhādicakrāṇīti gha.. , ña.. ca
2 viśeṣeṇeti kha..
3 yāmārdhabhogina iti ka.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
:p 93
meaning:
एकद्व्यष्टद्वादशमः पाददृष्टिश् च तं त्यजेत् /
दिनाधिपः प्रहरभाक् शेषा यामार्धभागिनः(3) //
:न्
1 मन्त्रौषधादिचक्राणीति घ.. , ञ.. च
2 विशेषेणेति ख..
3 यामार्धभोगिन इति क.. , ग.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
:प् 93
text_mt:
and on the first, second, eighth, and twelfth his gaze is a quarter; one should avoid that. / The lord of the day takes a three-hour watch; the remaining [planets] share half-watches.
[Footnote]
[Variant reading note 1]
[Variant reading note 2]
[Variant reading note 3]

sanskrit_iast:
śanibhāgantyajedyuddhe dinarāhuṃ vadāmi te /
ravau pūrve 'nile mande gurau yāmye 'nale bhṛgau //
meaning:
शनिभागन्त्यजेद्युद्धे दिनराहुं वदामि ते /
रवौ पूर्वे ऽनिले मन्दे गुरौ याम्ये ऽनले भृगौ //
text_mt: One should avoid the portion of Saturn in battle. I tell you the daily Rāhu: / on Sunday in the east, on Saturday in the north-west, on Thursday in the south, on Friday in the south-east,

sanskrit_iast:
agnau kuje bhavet somye sthite rāhurbudhe sadā /
phaṇirāhustu praharamaiśe vahnau ca rākṣase //
meaning:
अग्नौ कुजे भवेत् सोम्ये स्थिते राहुर्बुधे सदा /
फणिराहुस्तु प्रहरमैशे वह्नौ च राक्षसे //
text_mt: on Tuesday in the south-east, and when Mercury is in the north, Rāhu is always there. / The serpent Rāhu strikes in a watch, having encircled [the enemy] in the north-east, south-east, south-west,

sanskrit_iast:
vāyau saṃveṣṭayitvā ca śatruṃ hantīśasanmukhaṃ /
tithirāhuṃ pravakṣyāmi pūrṇimāgneyagocare //
meaning:
वायौ संवेष्टयित्वा च शत्रुं हन्तीशसन्मुखं /
तिथिराहुं प्रवक्ष्यामि पूर्णिमाग्नेयगोचरे //
text_mt: and north-west, and slays the enemy facing the lord [Śiva, north-east]. / I shall declare the tithi-Rāhu: on the full moon in the south-east quarter,

sanskrit_iast:
amāvāsyā vāyave ca rāhuḥ sammukhaśatruhā /
kādyā jāntāḥ sammukhe syuḥ sādyā dāntāś ca dakṣiṇe //
meaning:
अमावास्या वायवे च राहुः सम्मुखशत्रुहा /
काद्या जान्ताः सम्मुखे स्युः साद्या दान्ताश् च दक्षिणे //
text_mt: and on the new moon in the north-west, Rāhu slays the enemy facing him. / Those beginning with 'ka' up to 'ja' are in front; those beginning with 'sa' up to 'da' are in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
akle tyajet kujagaṇān dhādyā māntāś ca pūrvataḥ /
yādyā hāntā uttare syustithidṛṣṭiṃ vivarjayet //
meaning:
अक्ले त्यजेत् कुजगणान् धाद्या मान्ताश् च पूर्वतः /
याद्या हान्ता उत्तरे स्युस्तिथिदृष्टिं विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: At a disadvantage, one should avoid the groups of Mars. Those from 'dha' to 'ma' are in the east; / those from 'ya' to 'ha' are in the north. One should avoid the aspect of the tithi.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvāś ca dakṣiṇāstisro rekhā vai mūlabhedake /
sūryarāśyādi saṃlikhya dṛṣṭau hānirjayo 'nyathā //
meaning:
पूर्वाश् च दक्षिणास्तिस्रो रेखा वै मूलभेदके /
सूर्यराश्यादि संलिख्य दृष्टौ हानिर्जयो ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: Three lines drawn toward the east and three south in piercing the root: / having inscribed the sun, sign, and so forth, if aspected, loss [results]; otherwise, victory.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṭirāhuṃ pravakṣyāmi aṣṭau rekhāstu pātayet /
śivādyamaṃ yamādvāyuṃ vāyorindraṃ tato 'mbupaṃ //
meaning:
विष्टिराहुं प्रवक्ष्यामि अष्टौ रेखास्तु पातयेत् /
शिवाद्यमं यमाद्वायुं वायोरिन्द्रं ततो ऽम्बुपं //
text_mt: I shall declare the Viṣṭi-Rāhu: one should draw eight lines. / From north-east to south, from south to north-west, from north-west to east, then to west,

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtācca nayeccandraṃ candrādagniṃ tato jale /
jalādīśe caredrāhurviṣṭyā saha mahābalaḥ //
meaning:
नैरृताच्च नयेच्चन्द्रं चन्द्रादग्निं ततो जले /
जलादीशे चरेद्राहुर्विष्ट्या सह महाबलः //
text_mt: and from south-west one should take [a line] to north, from north to south-east, then to west; / from west to north-east mighty Rāhu moves together with Viṣṭi.

sanskrit_iast:
aiśānyāṃ ca tṛtīyādau saptamyādau ca yāmyake /
evaṃ kṛṣṇe site pakṣe vāyau rāhuś ca hantyarīn //
meaning:
ऐशान्यां च तृतीयादौ सप्तम्यादौ च याम्यके /
एवं कृष्णे सिते पक्षे वायौ राहुश् च हन्त्यरीन् //
text_mt: In the north-east on the third and other [tithis], and in the south on the seventh and other [tithis], / thus in the dark and bright fortnights, Rāhu in the north-west slays enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
indrādīn bhairavādīṃś ca brahmāṇyādīn grahādikān /
aṣṭāṣṭakañca pūrvādau yāmyādau vātayoginīṃ //
meaning:
इन्द्रादीन् भैरवादींश् च ब्रह्माण्यादीन् ग्रहादिकान् /
अष्टाष्टकञ्च पूर्वादौ याम्यादौ वातयोगिनीं //
text_mt: Indra and the other [guardians], Bhairava and the others, Brahmāṇī and the other [mothers], and the planets and the rest, / the eight-by-eight in the east and other [quarters], and the Wind Yoginī in the south and other [directions]:

sanskrit_iast:
yāndiśaṃ vahate vāyustatrastho ghātayedarīn /
dṛḍhīkaraṇamākhyāsye kaṇṭhe bāhvādidhāritā //
meaning:
यान्दिशं वहते वायुस्तत्रस्थो घातयेदरीन् /
दृढीकरणमाख्यास्ये कण्ठे बाह्वादिधारिता //
text_mt: in whichever direction the wind blows, stationed there, one should slay the enemies. / I shall declare fortifying [the body]: worn on the neck, arms, and so forth,

sanskrit_iast:
puṣyoddhṛtā kāṇḍalakṣyaṃ vārayet śarapuṅkhikā /
:p 94
tathā parājitā pāṭhā dvābhyāṃ khaḍgaṃ nivārayet //
meaning:
पुष्योद्धृता काण्डलक्ष्यं वारयेत् शरपुङ्खिका /
:प् 94
तथा पराजिता पाठा द्वाभ्यां खड्गं निवारयेत् //

text_mt:
"Oṃ, homage to the Blessed Goddess Vajraśṛṅkhalā! Strike, strike! Oṃ, devour, devour! Oṃ, eat! Oṃ, / hey, drink blood with a skull! Red-eyed one, clad in red garments, ash-limbed one, / whose body is smeared with ashes, wielding a vajra weapon, dense with vajra forms, bind the eastern direction, bind! / Oṃ, bind the southern direction, bind! Oṃ, bind the western direction, bind! / Bind the northern direction, bind! Bind the nāgas, bind! Bind the serpent-wives, bind! Oṃ, bind the asuras, / bind! Oṃ, bind the yakṣas, rākṣasas, and piśācas, bind! Oṃ, / protect, protect from preta-ghosts, spirits, gandharvas, and whatever afflictions there may be! Oṃ, protect above, / protect! Protect below, protect! Oṃ, dagger, bind, bind! Oṃ, blaze, O exceedingly powerful one, shatter, shatter! / Oṃ, crush, crush, O you with rows of manes, whose vajra-fire is a vajra-rampart! Huṃ phaṭ hrīṃ hrūṃ / śrīṃ phaṭ hrīṃ haḥ phūṃ pheṃ phaḥ! From all planets, / from all diseases, from all evil afflictions, hrīṃ, from everything without remainder, protect, / protect!" / One should employ [this mantra] in cases of planetary seizure, fever, spirits, and in all rites. //20
Thus in the great Agni Purāṇa, in the 'Ocean of Victory in Battle', the one hundred and forty-second chapter, entitled 'Mantras, Herbs, and Other [Remedies]'.

sanskrit_iast:
māyābījaṃ ca guhyāṅge ṣaṭkamastraṃ kare nyaset /
kālī kālīti hṛdayaṃ duṣṭacāṇḍālikā śiraḥ //

काली कालीति हृदयं दुष्टचाण्डालिका शिरः //
text_mt: One should deposit the Māyā seed-syllable on the secret limb, the sixfold weapon on the hand: / 'Kālī Kālī' is the heart; 'Duṣṭacāṇḍālikā' is the head;

sanskrit_iast:
hrauṃ spheṃ ha sa kha ka cha ḍa oṃ kāro bhairavaḥ śikhā /

meaning:
ह्रौं स्फें ह स ख क छ ड ओं कारो भैरवः शिखा /
भेलखी कवचं दूती नेत्राख्या रक्तचण्डिका //
text_mt: 'hrauṃ spheṃ ha sa kha ka cha ḍa' with the syllable 'oṃ' is Bhairava, the crest; / Bhelakhī is the armour; Dūtī is named as the eyes; [and] Raktacaṇḍikā [is the weapon].

sanskrit_iast:
tato guhyakruñjikāstraṃ maṇḍale sthānake yajet /
agnau kūrcaśiro rudre nairṛtye 'tha śikhānile //

ततो गुह्यक्रुञ्जिकास्त्रं मण्डले स्थानके यजेत् /
अग्नौ कूर्चशिरो रुद्रे नैरृत्ये ऽथ शिखानिले //
text_mt: Then one should worship the secret weapon of Kubjikā in its place in the maṇḍala: / the heart-kūrca in the south-east, the head in the north-east, the crest in the south-west, [and the armour] in the north-west;

sanskrit_iast:
kavacammadhyato netraṃ astrandikṣu ca maṇḍale /
dvātriṃśatā karṇikāyāṃ sroṃhasakṣamalanavavaṣaḍasacātmamantravījakaṃ //
meaning:
कवचम्मध्यतो नेत्रं अस्त्रन्दिक्षु च मण्डले /
द्वात्रिंशता कर्णिकायां स्रोंहसक्षमलनववषडसचात्ममन्त्रवीजकं //
text_mt: the armour in the centre, the eyes [and] the weapon in the cardinal directions of the maṇḍala; / in the pericarp, with thirty-two [petals], the seed-syllable of her own mantra: 'sroṃ hasakṣamalanavavaṣaḍasacātmā'.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṇī caiva māheśo kaumārī vaiṣṇavī tathā /
vārāhī caiva māhendrī cāmuṇḍā caṇḍikendrakāt //
meaning:
ब्रह्माणी चैव माहेशो कौमारी वैष्णवी तथा /
वाराही चैव माहेन्द्री चामुण्डा चण्डिकेन्द्रकात् //
text_mt: And Brahmāṇī, Māheśvarī, Kaumārī, Vaiṣṇavī, / Vārāhī, Māhendrī, Cāmuṇḍā, and Caṇḍikā, beginning from the east;

sanskrit_iast:
yajedravalakasahān śivendāgniyame 'dnipe /
jale tu kusumamālāmadrikāṇāṃ ca pañcakaṃ //

यजेद्रवलकसहान् शिवेन्दाग्नियमे ऽद्निपे /
जले तु कुसुममालामद्रिकाणां च पञ्चकं //
text_mt: one should worship the letters ra-va-la-ka-sa-ha in the north-east, east, south-east, south, and west; / and in the west, the garland of flowers and the group of five mountains.

sanskrit_iast:
jālandharaṃ pūrṇagiriṃ kāmarūpaṃ kramādyajet /
marudeśāgninairṛtye madhye vai vajrakubjikāṃ //
meaning:
जालन्धरं पूर्णगिरिं कामरूपं क्रमाद्यजेत् /
मरुदेशाग्निनैरृत्ये मध्ये वै वज्रकुब्जिकां //
text_mt: One should worship Jālandhara, Pūrṇagiri, and Kāmarūpa in order / in the north-west, north-east, south-east, and south-west, and in the centre Vajrakubjikā;

sanskrit_iast:
anādivimalaḥ pūjyaḥ sarvajñavimalastutaḥ /
prasiddhavimalaścātha saṃyogavimalastutaḥ //
meaning:
अनादिविमलः पूज्यः सर्वज्ञविमलस्तुतः /
प्रसिद्धविमलश्चाथ संयोगविमलस्तुतः //
text_mt: Anādivimala is to be worshipped, then praised as Sarvajñavimala, / and Prasiddhavimala, then praised as Saṃyogavimala,

sanskrit_iast:
samayākhyo 'tha vimala etadvimalapañcakaṃ /
marudīśānanairṛtye vahnau cottaraśṛṅgake //
meaning:
समयाख्यो ऽथ विमल एतद्विमलपञ्चकं /
मरुदीशाननैरृत्ये वह्नौ चोत्तरशृङ्गके //
text_mt: and the Vimala named Samaya—this group of five Vimalas / in the north-west, north-east, south-west, south-east, and on the northern peak.

sanskrit_iast:
kubjārthaṃ khiṃkhinī ṣaṣṭhā sopannā susthirā tathā /
ratnasundarī caiśāne śṛṅge cāṣṭādināthakāḥ //
meaning:
कुब्जार्थं खिंखिनी षष्ठा सोपन्ना सुस्थिरा तथा /
रत्नसुन्दरी चैशाने शृङ्गे चाष्टादिनाथकाः //
text_mt: For the sake of Kubjikā: Khiṃkhinī, the sixth [named] Sopannā, likewise Susthirā, / and Ratnasundarī in the north-east, and the eight Adināthas on the peak.

sanskrit_iast:

text_mt: These three are the Mahāvṛddhās; all of them [emanate] from the five praṇavas. / Worship is twofold according to the division of twenty-seven and twenty-eight.

And the eight starting with Brahmā all around, and in the middle of that the ninefold one. / Kubjikā and Kulaṭā: the Krama worship is always [performed thus].

Having performed the nyāsa on the hands and limbs, one should perform the twilight adoration; / in succession to the three twilights: Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, and Raudrī.
"We know the mistress of the Kula speech; we meditate upon Mahākālī; / may that Kaulī inspire us."

text_mt: Śrīkaṇṭhanātha, Kauleśa, Gaganānandanāthaka, / Caṭulā Devī, Maitrīśī, Karālī, Tūrṇanāthaka,

:प् 98
text_mt:
The threefold purity is the purity of Vidyā, Devī, and Guru; I proclaim it to you: / Gagana, Caṭulī, Ātman, Padmānanda, Maṇi, Kalā,
[Footnote]
[Variant notes] / [Page 98]

sanskrit_iast:
kamalo māṇikyakaṇṭho gaganaḥ kumudastataḥ /
śrīpadmo bhairavānando devaḥ kamala ity ataḥ //
meaning:
कमलो माणिक्यकण्ठो गगनः कुमुदस्ततः /
श्रीपद्मो भैरवानन्दो देवः कमल इत्य् अतः //
text_mt: Kamala, Māṇikyakaṇṭha, Gagana, then Kumuda, / Śrīpadma, Bhairavānanda, Deva, [and] Kamala, hence thereafter:

sanskrit_iast:
śivo bhavo 'tha kṛṣṇaś ca navasiddhāś ca ṣoḍaśa /
candrapūro 'tha gulmaś ca śubhaḥ kāmo 'timuktakaḥ(1) //
meaning:
शिवो भवो ऽथ कृष्णश् च नवसिद्धाश् च षोडश /
चन्द्रपूरो ऽथ गुल्मश् च शुभः कामो ऽतिमुक्तकः(1) //
text_mt: Śiva, Bhava, and Kṛṣṇa; and the nine Siddhas, and the sixteen: / Candrapūra, then Gulma, Śubha, Kāma, Atimuktaka,

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭho vīraḥ(2) prayogo 'tha kuśalo devabhogakaḥ /
viśvadevaḥ khaḍgadevo rudro dhātāsireva ca //
meaning:
कण्ठो वीरः(2) प्रयोगो ऽथ कुशलो देवभोगकः /
विश्वदेवः खड्गदेवो रुद्रो धातासिरेव च //
text_mt: Kaṇṭha, Vīra, Prayoga, then Kuśala, Devabhogaka, / Viśvadeva, Khaḍgadeva, Rudra, Dhātā, and Asir,

sanskrit_iast:
mudrāsphīṭī vaṃśapūro bhojaḥ ṣoḍaśa siddhakāḥ /
samayānyastu dehastu ṣoḍhānyāsena yantritaḥ //
meaning:
मुद्रास्फीटी वंशपूरो भोजः षोडश सिद्धकाः /
समयान्यस्तु देहस्तु षोढान्यासेन यन्त्रितः //
text_mt: Mudrāsphīṭī, Vaṃśapūra, [and] Bhoja—the sixteen Siddhas. / One whose body is deposited according to the pledge (samaya) is bound by the sixfold nyāsa.

sanskrit_iast:
prakṣipya maṇḍale puṣpaṃ maṇḍalānyatha pūjayet /
anantañca mahāntañca sarvadā śivapādukāṃ //
meaning:
प्रक्षिप्य मण्डले पुष्पं मण्डलान्यथ पूजयेत् /
अनन्तञ्च महान्तञ्च सर्वदा शिवपादुकां //
text_mt: Having thrown a flower into the maṇḍala, one should then worship the maṇḍalas: / Ananta, Mahant, and always the sandals of Śiva,

sanskrit_iast:
mahāvyāptiś ca śūnyañca pañcatattvātmamaṇḍalaṃ /
śrīkaṇṭhanāthapādukāṃ śaṅkarānantakau yajet //
meaning:
महाव्याप्तिश् च शून्यञ्च पञ्चतत्त्वात्ममण्डलं /
श्रीकण्ठनाथपादुकां शङ्करानन्तकौ यजेत् //
text_mt: Mahāvyāpti, Śūnya, the maṇḍala consisting of the five tattvas; / one should worship the sandals of Śrīkaṇṭhanātha, [and] Śaṅkara and Ananta.

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivaḥ piṅgalaś ca bhṛgvānandaś ca nāthakaḥ /
lāṅgūlānandasaṃvartau maṇḍalasthānake yajet //
meaning:
सदाशिवः पिङ्गलश् च भृग्वानन्दश् च नाथकः /
लाङ्गूलानन्दसंवर्तौ मण्डलस्थानके यजेत् //
text_mt: Sadāśiva, Piṅgala, Bhṛgvānandanātha, / Lāṅgūlānanda, and Saṃvarta: one should worship them in the place of the maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
nairṛtye śrīmahakālaḥ pinākī ca mahendrakaḥ /
khaḍgo bhujaṅgo vāṇaś ca aghāsiḥ śabdako vaśaḥ //
meaning:
नैरृत्ये श्रीमहकालः पिनाकी च महेन्द्रकः /
खड्गो भुजङ्गो वाणश् च अघासिः शब्दको वशः //
text_mt: In the south-west: Śrī-Mahākāla, Pinākin, and Mahendraka, / Khaḍga, Bhujaṅga, Bāṇa, Aghāsi, Śabdaka, Vaśa,

sanskrit_iast:
ājñārūpo nandarūpo balindatvā kramaṃ yajet /
hrīṃ khaṃ khaṃ hūṃ sauṃ vaṭukāya aru 2 arghaṃ puṣpaṃ
dhūpaṃ dīpaṃgandhaṃ baliṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇa 2 namastubhyaṃ /
oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ kṣeṃ kṣetrapālāya avatara 2
mahākapilajaṭābhāra bhāsvaratrinetrajvālāmukha ehyehi
ganhdapuṣpabalipūjāṃ gṛhṇa 2 khaḥ khaḥ oṃ kaḥ oṃ
laḥ oṃ mahāḍāmarādhipataye(3) svāhā
:n
1 kāmo 'tha muktaka iti ja.. , cha.. , ña.. ca
2 vaṭo vīra iti ja.. , cha.. ca
3 pramathādhipataye iti ṅa.. / mahāmāyādhipataye iti ja..
:p 99
baliśeṣe 'tha yajet hrīṃ hrūṃ hāṃ śrīṃ vai trikūṭakaṃ //
meaning:
आज्ञारूपो नन्दरूपो बलिन्दत्वा क्रमं यजेत् /
ह्रीं खं खं हूं सौं वटुकाय अरु 2 अर्घं पुष्पं
धूपं दीपंगन्धं बलिं पूजां गृह्ण 2 नमस्तुभ्यं /
ओं ह्रां ह्रीं ह्रूं क्षें क्षेत्रपालाय अवतर 2
महाकपिलजटाभार भास्वरत्रिनेत्रज्वालामुख एह्येहि
गन्ह्दपुष्पबलिपूजां गृह्ण 2 खः खः ओं कः ओं
लः ओं महाडामराधिपतये(3) स्वाहा
:न्
1 कामो ऽथ मुक्तक इति ज.. , छ.. , ञ.. च
2 वटो वीर इति ज.. , छ.. च
3 प्रमथाधिपतये इति ङ.. / महामायाधिपतये इति ज..
:प् 99
बलिशेषे ऽथ यजेत् ह्रीं ह्रूं हां श्रीं वै त्रिकूटकं //
text_mt:
Ājñārūpa, [and] Nandarūpa; having given an oblation, one should worship the Krama.
"hrīṃ khaṃ khaṃ hūṃ sauṃ, to Vaṭuka, aru 2, accept 2 water offering, flower, incense, lamp, fragrant paste, oblation, and worship; homage to you! / oṃ hrāṃ hrīṃ hrūṃ kṣeṃ, to the guardian of the field (kṣetrapāla), descend 2, O you who have a heavy mass of tawny matted hair, blazing three-eyed one with a fiery face, come, come! Accept 2 the fragrant paste, flower, oblation, and worship, khaḥ khaḥ oṃ kaḥ oṃ laḥ oṃ, svāhā to the sovereign lord of great tumult!"
[Footnote]
[Variant notes]
[Variant notes]
[Variant notes] / [Page 99]
After the remaining oblation, one should worship the triad with 'hrīṃ hrūṃ hāṃ śrīṃ':

sanskrit_iast:
vāme ca dakṣiṇe hy agre yāmye niśānāthapādukāḥ /
dakṣe tamorināthasya hagre kālānalasya ca //
meaning:
वामे च दक्षिणे ह्य् अग्रे याम्ये निशानाथपादुकाः /
दक्षे तमोरिनाथस्य हग्रे कालानलस्य च //
text_mt: On the left, on the right, and in front; in the south, the sandals of Niśānātha; / on the right, [those] of Tamorinātha; and in front, [those] of Kālānala;

sanskrit_iast:
uḍḍiyāṇaṃ jālandharaṃ pūrṇaṃ vai kāmarupakaṃ /
gaganānandadevañca svargānandaṃ savargakaṃ(1) //
meaning:
उड्डियाणं जालन्धरं पूर्णं वै कामरुपकं /
गगनानन्ददेवञ्च स्वर्गानन्दं सवर्गकं(1) //
text_mt: Uḍḍiyāṇa, Jālandhara, Pūrṇa, and Kāmarūpa; / Gaganānandadeva, Svargānanda, Savargaka,

sanskrit_iast:
paramānandadevañca(2) satyānandasya pādukāṃ(3) /
nāgānandañca vargākhyamuktānte ratnapañcakaṃ //
meaning:
परमानन्ददेवञ्च(2) सत्यानन्दस्य पादुकां(3) /
नागानन्दञ्च वर्गाख्यमुक्तान्ते रत्नपञ्चकं //
text_mt: Paramānandadeva, and the sandals of Satyānanda, / Nāgānanda, and the five jewels at the end of what is called the Varga-release.

sanskrit_iast:
saumye śive yajet ṣaṭkaṃ suranāthasya pādukāṃ /
śrīmatsamayakoṭīśaṃ vidyākoṭīśvaraṃ yajet //
meaning:
सौम्ये शिवे यजेत् षट्कं सुरनाथस्य पादुकां /
श्रीमत्समयकोटीशं विद्याकोटीश्वरं यजेत् //
text_mt: In the north, in the auspicious [quarter], one should worship the sextet: the sandals of Suranātha; / one should worship the venerable Samayakoṭīśa and Vidyākoṭīśvara;

sanskrit_iast:
koṭīśaṃ vindukoṭīśaṃ siddhakoṭīśvarantathā /
siddhacatuṣkamāgneyyāṃ amarīśeśvaraṃ yajet //
meaning:
कोटीशं विन्दुकोटीशं सिद्धकोटीश्वरन्तथा /
सिद्धचतुष्कमाग्नेय्यां अमरीशेश्वरं यजेत् //
text_mt: Koṭīśa, Bindukoṭīśa, and likewise Siddhakoṭīśvara. / In the south-east, one should worship the four Siddhas [and] Amarīśeśvara;

sanskrit_iast:
cakrīśanāthaṃ kuruṅgeśaṃ vṛtreśañcandranāthakaṃ(4) /
yajedgandhādibhiś caitān yāmye vimalapañcakaṃ //
meaning:
चक्रीशनाथं कुरुङ्गेशं वृत्रेशञ्चन्द्रनाथकं(4) /
यजेद्गन्धादिभिश् चैतान् याम्ये विमलपञ्चकं //
text_mt: Cakrīśanātha, Kuruṅgeśa, Vṛtreśa, and Candranāthaka; / one should worship these with fragrances and the like, and the five Vimalas in the south.

sanskrit_iast:
yajedanādivimalaṃ sarvajñavimalaṃ tataḥ /
yajedyogīśavimalaṃ siddhākhyaṃ samayākhyakaṃ //
meaning:
यजेदनादिविमलं सर्वज्ञविमलं ततः /
यजेद्योगीशविमलं सिद्धाख्यं समयाख्यकं //
text_mt: One should worship Anādivimala, then Sarvajñavimala, / one should worship Yogīśavimala, the one named Siddha, and the one named Samaya.

sanskrit_iast:
naiṛtye caturo devān(5) jayet kandarpanāthakaṃ /
pūrvāḥ śaktīś ca sarvāś ca(6) kubjikāpādukāṃ yajet //
:n
1 svargānandañca devakamiti gha.. , ña.. ca
2 pannagānandadevañceti ña.. / pavanānandadevañceti ja..
3 martyānandasya pādukāmiti kha.. , ga.. , ṅa.. , jha.. , ja.. ca
4 bhūtośaṃ mantranāyakamiti ja.. / bhūtīśaṃ mantranāyakamiti
ña..
5 caturo vedāniti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
6 pūrvān saśaktīn sarvāṃśceti ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 100
meaning:
नैऋत्ये चतुरो देवान्(5) जयेत् कन्दर्पनाथकं /
पूर्वाः शक्तीश् च सर्वाश् च(6) कुब्जिकापादुकां यजेत् //
:न्
1 स्वर्गानन्दञ्च देवकमिति घ.. , ञ.. च
2 पन्नगानन्ददेवञ्चेति ञ.. / पवनानन्ददेवञ्चेति ज..
3 मर्त्यानन्दस्य पादुकामिति ख.. , ग.. , ङ.. , झ.. , ज.. च
4 भूतोशं मन्त्रनायकमिति ज.. / भूतीशं मन्त्रनायकमिति
ञ..
5 चतुरो वेदानिति ख.. , छ.. , ज.. च
6 पूर्वान् सशक्तीन् सर्वांश्चेति ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 100
text_mt:
In the south-west, one should worship the four gods, Kandarpanātha, / all the eastern Śaktis, and the sandals of Kubjikā.
[Footnote]
[Variant notes]
[Variant notes]
[Variant notes]
[Variant notes]
[Variant notes]
6. “The eastern [deities] along with their Śaktis, and all of them” thus in manuscripts ja and ña.

sanskrit_iast:
navātamkena mantreṇa pañcapraṇavakena vā /
sahasrākṣamanavadyaṃ viṣṇuṃ śivaṃ sadā yajet(1) //
meaning:
नवातम्केन मन्त्रेण पञ्चप्रणवकेन वा /
सहस्राक्षमनवद्यं विष्णुं शिवं सदा यजेत्(1) //
text_mt: With the nine-syllabled mantra or with the fivefold praṇava, / one should constantly worship Viṣṇu, who is thousand-eyed and flawless, [and] Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvācchivāntaṃ brahmādi brahmāṇī ca maheśvarī /
kaumārī vaiṣṇavī caiva vārāhī śakraśaktikā //
meaning:
पूर्वाच्छिवान्तं ब्रह्मादि ब्रह्माणी च महेश्वरी /
कौमारी वैष्णवी चैव वाराही शक्रशक्तिका //
text_mt: From the east ending at the northeast: Brahmā and the others; then Brahmāṇī, Maheśvarī, / Kaumārī, Vaiṣṇavī, Vārāhī, and the Śakti of Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
cāmuṇḍā ca mahālakṣmīḥ pūrvādīśāntamarcayet /
ḍākinī rākinī pūjyā lākinī kākinī tathā //
meaning:
चामुण्डा च महालक्ष्मीः पूर्वादीशान्तमर्चयेत् /
डाकिनी राकिनी पूज्या लाकिनी काकिनी तथा //
text_mt: and Cāmuṇḍā, and Mahālakṣmī—one should worship them starting from the east ending in the northeast. / Ḍākinī, Rākinī are to be worshipped, and likewise Lākinī, Kākinī,

sanskrit_iast:
śākinī yākinī pūjyā vāyavyādugraṣaṭṣu ca /
yajed dhyātvā tato devīṃ dvātriṃśadvarṇakātmakāṃ //
meaning:
शाकिनी याकिनी पूज्या वायव्यादुग्रषट्षु च /
यजेद् ध्यात्वा ततो देवीं द्वात्रिंशद्वर्णकात्मकां //
text_mt: Śākinī, and Yākinī are to be worshipped in the six [directions] starting from the northwest in fierce forms. / Having meditated on the goddess whose nature consists of thirty-two syllables, one should then worship [her].

sanskrit_iast:
pañcapraṇavakenāpi hrīṃ kāreṇāthavā yajet /
nīlotpaladalaśyāmā ṣaḍvaktrā(2) ṣaṭprakārikā //
meaning:
पञ्चप्रणवकेनापि ह्रीं कारेणाथवा यजेत् /
नीलोत्पलदलश्यामा षड्वक्त्रा(2) षट्प्रकारिका //
text_mt: One should worship her with the fivefold praṇava or with the syllable hrīṃ. / Dark as the petal of a blue lotus, six-faced, of six modes,

sanskrit_iast:
cicchaktiktiraṣṭādaśākhyā bāhudvādaśasaṃyutā /
siṃhāsanasukhāsīnā pretapadmoparisthitā //
meaning:
चिच्छक्तिक्तिरष्टादशाख्या बाहुद्वादशसंयुता /
सिंहासनसुखासीना प्रेतपद्मोपरिस्थिता //
text_mt: she is the power of consciousness called eighteen-fold, endowed with twelve arms, / comfortably seated on a lion-throne, situated on a corpse and a lotus,

sanskrit_iast:
kulakoṭisahasrāḍhyā karkoṭo mekhalāsthitaḥ /
takṣakeṇopariṣṭācca gale hāraś ca vāsukiḥ //
meaning:
कुलकोटिसहस्राढ्या कर्कोटो मेखलास्थितः /
तक्षकेणोपरिष्टाच्च गले हारश् च वासुकिः //
text_mt: abounding with ten million families. Karkoṭa is situated as her girdle, / Takṣaka is above, and Vāsuki is the necklace around her throat.

sanskrit_iast:
kulikaḥ karṇayoryasyāḥ kūrmaḥ kuṇḍalamaṇḍalahḥ /
bhruvoḥ padmo makāpadmo vāme nāgaḥ kapālakaḥ //
meaning:
कुलिकः कर्णयोर्यस्याः कूर्मः कुण्डलमण्डलह्ः /
भ्रुवोः पद्मो मकापद्मो वामे नागः कपालकः //
text_mt: Kulika is in her ears; Kūrma is the circular earring. / Padma and Mahāpadma are upon her brows; on her left [hands] are a serpent, a skull-bowl,

sanskrit_iast:
akṣasūtrañca khaṭvāṅgaṃ śaṅkaṃ pustañca dakṣiṇe /
triśūlantadarpaṇaṃ khaḍgaṃ ratnamālāṅkuśandhanuḥ(3) //
meaning:
अक्षसूत्रञ्च खट्वाङ्गं शङ्कं पुस्तञ्च दक्षिणे /
त्रिशूलन्तदर्पणं खड्गं रत्नमालाङ्कुशन्धनुः(3) //
text_mt: a rosary, and a khaṭvāṅga; on her right, a conch and a manuscript; / a trident, a mirror, a sword, a jeweled garland, a goad, and a bow.

sanskrit_iast:
śvetamūrdhvamukhandevyā ūrdhvaśvetantathāparaṃ /
pūrvāsyaṃ pāṇḍaraṃ krodhi dakṣiṇaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇakaṃ //
:n
1 sadāśivaṃ svayaṃ yajediti ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
2 ṣaḍvarṇeti ja..
3 vanamālaṅkuśaṃ dhanuriti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
:p 101
meaning:
श्वेतमूर्ध्वमुखन्देव्या ऊर्ध्वश्वेतन्तथापरं /
पूर्वास्यं पाण्डरं क्रोधि दक्षिणं कृष्णवर्णकं //
:न्
1 सदाशिवं स्वयं यजेदिति ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
2 षड्वर्णेति ज..
3 वनमालङ्कुशं धनुरिति घ.. , ङ.. च
:प् 101
text_mt:
The goddess's upward face is white, and another [is also] white above; / the eastern face is pale and wrathful, and the southern one is black-colored.
[Footnote]
1. “One should oneself worship Sadāśiva” thus in manuscripts ṅa, cha, and ja.
2. “Of six syllables” thus in manuscript ja.
3. “A woodland garland, a goad, and a bow” thus in manuscripts gha and ṅa.

sanskrit_iast:
himakundendabhaṃ saumyaṃ brahmā pādatale sthitaḥ /
viṣṇustu jaghane rudro hṛdi kaṇṭhe tatheśvaraḥ //
meaning:
हिमकुन्देन्दभं सौम्यं ब्रह्मा पादतले स्थितः /
विष्णुस्तु जघने रुद्रो हृदि कण्ठे तथेश्वरः //
text_mt: en:

sanskrit_iast:
sadāśivo lalāṭe syācchivastasyordhvataḥ sthitaḥ /
āghūrṇitā kubjikaivandhyeyā pūjādikarmasu //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe yuddhajayārṇave kubjikāpūjā nāma catuś
catvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
mālinīnānāmantrāḥ
meaning:
सदाशिवो ललाटे स्याच्छिवस्तस्योर्ध्वतः स्थितः /
आघूर्णिता कुब्जिकैवन्ध्येया पूजादिकर्मसु //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे युद्धजयार्णवे कुब्जिकापूजा नाम चतुश्
चत्वारिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चचत्वारिंशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
मालिनीनानामन्त्राः
text_mt:
Sadāśiva should be on the forehead, and Śiva is situated above him. / In rites such as worship, Kubjikā is thus to be meditated upon as whirling.
Thus, in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, in the Yuddhājayārṇava, the one hundred and forty-fourth chapter, entitled “The Worship of Kubjikā.”
Now, the one hundred and forty-fifth chapter:
Various Mantras of Mālinī.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
nānāmantrān pravakṣyāmi ṣoḍhānyāsapuraḥsaram /
nyāsastridhā tu ṣoḍhā syuḥ śāktaśāmbhavayāmalāḥ //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
नानामन्त्रान् प्रवक्ष्यामि षोढान्यासपुरःसरम् /
न्यासस्त्रिधा तु षोढा स्युः शाक्तशाम्भवयामलाः //
text_mt: The Lord said: / I shall explain the various mantras preceded by the sixfold deposition. / The deposition is threefold, but becomes sixfold: Śākta, Śāmbhava, and Yāmala.

sanskrit_iast:
śāmbhave śabdarāśiḥ ṣaṭṣoḍaśagranthirūpavān(1) /
trividyā tadgraho nyāsastritattvātmābhidhānakaḥ //
meaning:
शाम्भवे शब्दराशिः षट्षोडशग्रन्थिरूपवान्(1) /
त्रिविद्या तद्ग्रहो न्यासस्त्रितत्त्वात्माभिधानकः //
text_mt: In the Śāmbhava [system], the aggregate of phonemes has the form of six times sixteen knots; / the three Vidyās [and] their seizure are the deposition named as consisting of the three principles.

sanskrit_iast:
caturtho vanamālāyāḥ ślokadvādaśarūpavān /
pañcamo ratnapañcātmā navātmā ṣaṣṭha īritaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थो वनमालायाः श्लोकद्वादशरूपवान् /
पञ्चमो रत्नपञ्चात्मा नवात्मा षष्ठ ईरितः //
text_mt: The fourth [deposition] is of the garland of forest flowers, consisting of twelve verses; / the fifth consists of the five jewels; the sixth is declared as the nine-fold [mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
śākte pakṣe ca mālinyāstrividyātmā dvitīyakaḥ /
:n
1 ṣoḍaśapratirūpavāniti jha..
:p 102
adhoryaṣṭakarūpo 'nyo dvādaśāṅgaś caturthakaḥ /
meaning:
शाक्ते पक्षे च मालिन्यास्त्रिविद्यात्मा द्वितीयकः /
:न्
1 षोडशप्रतिरूपवानिति झ..
:प् 102
अधोर्यष्टकरूपो ऽन्यो द्वादशाङ्गश् चतुर्थकः /

sanskrit_iast:
pañcamastu ṣaḍaṅgaḥ syācchaktiścānyāstracaṇḍikā(1) /
krīṃ hrauṃ klīṃ śrīṃ krūṃ phaṭ trayaṃ syātturyākhyaṃsarvasādhakaṃ(2) //
meaning:
पञ्चमस्तु षडङ्गः स्याच्छक्तिश्चान्यास्त्रचण्डिका(1) /
क्रीं ह्रौं क्लीं श्रीं क्रूं फट् त्रयं स्यात्तुर्याख्यंसर्वसाधकं(2) //
text_mt: the fifth has six limbs; and the other Śakti is Astracaṇḍikā. / “Krīṃ hrauṃ klīṃ śrīṃ krūṃ phaṭ,” this triad is called the fourth, achieving all objectives.

sanskrit_iast:
mālinyā nādikāntaṃ syāt nādinī ca śikhā smṛtā /
agrasenī(3) śirasi syāt śiromālānivṛttiḥ śaḥ //
meaning:
मालिन्या नादिकान्तं स्यात् नादिनी च शिखा स्मृता /
अग्रसेनी(3) शिरसि स्यात् शिरोमालानिवृत्तिः शः //
text_mt: Of Mālinī, na ends in ka; Nādinī is stated to be on the crest; / Agrasenī on the head; śa is Nivṛtti in the garland of the head.

sanskrit_iast:
ṭa śāntiś ca śiro bhūyāc cāmuṇḍā ca trinetragā /
ḍha priyadṛṣṭirdvinetre ca nāsāgā guhyaśaktinī //
meaning:
ट शान्तिश् च शिरो भूयाच् चामुण्डा च त्रिनेत्रगा /
ढ प्रियदृष्टिर्द्विनेत्रे च नासागा गुह्यशक्तिनी //
text_mt: ṭa: Śānti on the head; Cāmuṇḍā on the third eye; / ḍha: Priyadṛṣṭi on the two eyes; Guhyaśaktinī on the tip of the nose;

sanskrit_iast:
na nārāyaṇī dvikarṇe ca dakṣakarṇe ta mohanau /
ja prajñā vāmakarnasthā vaktre ca vajriṇī smṛtā //
meaning:
न नारायणी द्विकर्णे च दक्षकर्णे त मोहनौ /
ज प्रज्ञा वामकर्नस्था वक्त्रे च वज्रिणी स्मृता //
text_mt: na: Nārāyaṇī on the two ears; and on the right ear, ta: Mohana; / ja: Prajñā situated in the left ear; and Vajriṇī is stated to be in the mouth;

sanskrit_iast:
ka karālī dakṣadaṃṣṭrā vāmāṃsā kha kapālinī /
ga śivā ūrdhvadaṃṣṭrā syād gha ghorā vāmadaṃṣṭrikā //
meaning:
क कराली दक्षदंष्ट्रा वामांसा ख कपालिनी /
ग शिवा ऊर्ध्वदंष्ट्रा स्याद् घ घोरा वामदंष्ट्रिका //
text_mt: ka: Karālī on the right fang; on the left shoulder, kha: Kapālinī; / ga: Śivā on the upper fang; gha: Ghorā on the left fang;

sanskrit_iast:
u śikhā dantavinyāsā ī māyā jihvayā smṛtā /
a syānnāgeśvarī vāci va kaṇṭhe śikhivāhinī //
meaning:
उ शिखा दन्तविन्यासा ई माया जिह्वया स्मृता /
अ स्यान्नागेश्वरी वाचि व कण्ठे शिखिवाहिनी //
text_mt: u: Śikhā deposited on the teeth; ī: Māyā stated to be on the tongue; / a: Nāgeśvarī in speech; va: Śikhivāhinī in the throat;

sanskrit_iast:
bha bhīṣaṇī dakṣaskandhe vāyuvegā ma vāmake /
ḍanāmā dakṣabāhau tu ḍha vāme ca vināyakā //
meaning:
भ भीषणी दक्षस्कन्धे वायुवेगा म वामके /
डनामा दक्षबाहौ तु ढ वामे च विनायका //
text_mt: bha: Bhīṣaṇī on the right shoulder; ma: Vāyuvegā on the left; / [the one] named ḍa on the right arm; and ḍha: Vināyakā on the left;

sanskrit_iast:
pa pūrṇimā dvihaste tu okārādyaṅgulīyake /
aṃ darśanī vāmāṅgulya aḥ syātsañjīvanī kare //
meaning:
प पूर्णिमा द्विहस्ते तु ओकाराद्यङ्गुलीयके /
अं दर्शनी वामाङ्गुल्य अः स्यात्सञ्जीवनी करे //
text_mt: pa: Pūrṇimā on the two hands; on the fingers beginning with the letter o; / aṃ: Darśanī on the left fingers; aḥ: Sañjīvanī on the [right] hand;

sanskrit_iast:
ṭa kapālinī kapālaṃ śūladaṇḍe ta dīpanī /
triśūle ja jayantī syādvṛddhiryaḥ sādhanī(4) smṛtā //
:n
1 śaktiḥ syādyā vivarṇikā iti ja.. / śaktiścānyā trikhaṇḍiketi
ña..
2 phaṭatrayaṃ syāt taryuddhe sarvasāddhakamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
3 khaśvasanīti kha.. , cha.. ca
4 pāvanīti ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 103
meaning:
ट कपालिनी कपालं शूलदण्डे त दीपनी /
त्रिशूले ज जयन्ती स्याद्वृद्धिर्यः साधनी(4) स्मृता //
:न्
1 शक्तिः स्याद्या विवर्णिका इति ज.. / शक्तिश्चान्या त्रिखण्डिकेति
ञ..
2 फटत्रयं स्यात् तर्युद्धे सर्वसाद्धकमिति ख.. , छ.. च
3 खश्वसनीति ख.. , छ.. च
4 पावनीति ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 103
text_mt:
ṭa: Kapālinī on the skull-bowl; ta: Dīpanī on the shaft of the trident; / ja: Jayantī on the trident; ya: Sādhanī stated to be prosperity;
[Footnote]
1. “The Śakti which is colorless” thus in manuscript ja; “And another Śakti, Trikhaṇḍikā” thus in manuscript ña.
2. “The triad of phaṭ accomplishes everything in that battle” thus in manuscripts kha and cha.
3. “Khaśvasanī” thus in manuscripts kha and cha.
4. “Pāvanī” thus in manuscripts ja and ña.

sanskrit_iast:
jīve śa paramākhyā syād ha prāṇe cāmbikā smṛtā /
dakṣastane cha śarīrā na vāme pūtanā stane //
meaning:
जीवे श परमाख्या स्याद् ह प्राणे चाम्बिका स्मृता /
दक्षस्तने छ शरीरा न वामे पूतना स्तने //
text_mt: śa is named Paramā in the individual soul; ha is remembered as Ambikā in the vital breath; / cha: Śarīrā on the right breast; na: Pūtanā on the left breast;

sanskrit_iast:
a stanakṣīrā ā moṭo lambodaryudare ca tha /
nābhau saṃhārikā kṣa syān mahākālī nitambama //
meaning:
अ स्तनक्षीरा आ मोटो लम्बोदर्युदरे च थ /
नाभौ संहारिका क्ष स्यान् महाकाली नितम्बम //
text_mt: a: Stanakṣīrā; ā: Moṭā; and tha: Lambodarī in the belly; / kṣa: Saṃhārikā at the navel; Mahākālī on the hips;

sanskrit_iast:
guhye sa kusumamālā ṣa śukre śukradevikā /
urudvaye ta tārāsyāha jñānā dakṣajānuni //
meaning:
गुह्ये स कुसुममाला ष शुक्रे शुक्रदेविका /
उरुद्वये त तारास्याह ज्ञाना दक्षजानुनि //
text_mt: sa: Kusumamālā on the private parts; ṣa: Śukradevikā on the semen; / ta: Tārā on the two thighs; ha: Jñānā on the right knee;

sanskrit_iast:
vāme syādau kriyāśaktiro gāyatrī ca jaṅghagā /
o sāvitrī vāmajaṅghā dakṣe do dohanī pade //
meaning:
वामे स्यादौ क्रियाशक्तिरो गायत्री च जङ्घगा /
ओ सावित्री वामजङ्घा दक्षे दो दोहनी पदे //
text_mt: au: Kriyāśakti on the left; o: Gāyatrī situated on the [right] shank; / o: Sāvitrī on the left shank; do: Mohanī on the right foot;

sanskrit_iast:
pha phetkārī vāmapāde navātmā mālinī manuḥ /
a śrīkaṇṭhaḥ śikhāyāṃ syādāvaktre syādanantakaḥ //
meaning:
फ फेत्कारी वामपादे नवात्मा मालिनी मनुः /
अ श्रीकण्ठः शिखायां स्यादावक्त्रे स्यादनन्तकः //
text_mt: pha: Phetkārī on the left foot. [This is] the Navātman Mālinī mantra. / a: Śrīkaṇṭha on the crest; ā: Ananta in the mouth;

sanskrit_iast:
i sūkṣmo dakṣanetre syādī trimūrtistu vāmake /
u dakṣakarṇe 'marauśa ū karṇerghāṃśako 'pare //
meaning:
इ सूक्ष्मो दक्षनेत्रे स्यादी त्रिमूर्तिस्तु वामके /
उ दक्षकर्णे ऽमरौश ऊ कर्णेर्घांशको ऽपरे //
text_mt: i: Sūkṣma in the right eye; ī: Trimūrti in the left; / u: Amareśa in the right ear; ū: Arghīśa in the other ear;

sanskrit_iast:
ṛ bhāṣabhūtirnāsāgre vāmanāsā tithīśa ṛ /
ḷ sthāṇurdakṣagaṇḍe syādvāmagaṇḍe haraś ca ḹ //
meaning:
ऋ भाषभूतिर्नासाग्रे वामनासा तिथीश ऋ /
ऌ स्थाणुर्दक्षगण्डे स्याद्वामगण्डे हरश् च ॡ //
text_mt: ṛ: Bhārabhūti on the tip of the nose; ṝ: Tithīśa on the left nostril; / ḷ: Sthāṇu on the right cheek; and ḹ: Hara on the left cheek;

sanskrit_iast:
kaṭīśo dantapaṅktāve bhūtīśaścordhvadanta ai /
sadyojāta o adhare ūrdhvauṣṭhe 'nugrahīśa au //
meaning:
कटीशो दन्तपङ्क्तावे भूतीशश्चोर्ध्वदन्त ऐ /
सद्योजात ओ अधरे ऊर्ध्वौष्ठे ऽनुग्रहीश औ //
text_mt: e: Kaṭīśa on the row of teeth; ai: Bhūtīśa on the upper teeth; / o: Sadyojāta on the lower lip; au: Anugrahīśa on the upper lip;

sanskrit_iast:
aṃ krūro ghāṭakāyāṃ syādaḥ mahāsenajihvayā /
ka krodhīśo dakṣaskandhe khaś caṇḍīśaś ca bāhuṣu //
meaning:
अं क्रूरो घाटकायां स्यादः महासेनजिह्वया /
क क्रोधीशो दक्षस्कन्धे खश् चण्डीशश् च बाहुषु //
text_mt: aṃ: Krūra on the nape of the neck; aḥ: Mahāsena on the tongue; / ka: Krodhīśa on the right shoulder; kha: Caṇḍīśa on the arms;

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāntakaḥ kūrpare go gha śikhī dakṣakaṅgaṇe /
ṅa ekapādaścāṅgulyo tāmaskandhe ca kūrmakaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चान्तकः कूर्परे गो घ शिखी दक्षकङ्गणे /
ङ एकपादश्चाङ्गुल्यो तामस्कन्धे च कूर्मकः //
text_mt: ga: Pañcāntaka on the elbow; gha: Śikhin on the right wrist; / ṅa: Ekapāda on the fingers; ca: Kūrmaka on the left shoulder;

sanskrit_iast:
cha ekanetro bāhau syāccaturvaktro ja kūrpare /
jha rājasaḥ kaṅkaṇagaḥ ñaḥ sarvakāmado 'ṅgulī //
meaning:
छ एकनेत्रो बाहौ स्याच्चतुर्वक्त्रो ज कूर्परे /
झ राजसः कङ्कणगः ञः सर्वकामदो ऽङ्गुली //
text_mt: cha: Ekanetra on the arm; ja: Caturvaktra on the elbow; / jha: Rājasa on the wrist; ña: Sarvakāmada on the fingers;

sanskrit_iast:
ṭa spmeśo nitambe syāddakṣa ūrurṭha lāṅgalī /
:p 104
ḍa dāruko dakṣajānau jaṅghā ḍho 'rdhajaleśvaraḥ //
meaning:
ट स्प्मेशो नितम्बे स्याद्दक्ष ऊरुर्ठ लाङ्गली /
:प् 104
ड दारुको दक्षजानौ जङ्घा ढो ऽर्धजलेश्वरः //

sanskrit_iast:
ṇa umākāntako 'ṅgulyasta āṣāḍho nitambake /
tha daṇḍī vāma ūrau syādda bhido vāmajānuni //
meaning:
ण उमाकान्तको ऽङ्गुल्यस्त आषाढो नितम्बके /
थ दण्डी वाम ऊरौ स्याद्द भिदो वामजानुनि //
text_mt: ṇa: Umākānta on the toes; ta: Āṣāḍha on the hip; / tha: Daṇḍin on the left thigh; da: Bhida on the left knee;

sanskrit_iast:
dha mīno vāmajaṅghāyānna meṣaś caraṇāṅgulī /
pa lohito dakṣakukṣau pha śikhī vāmakukṣigaḥ //
meaning:
ध मीनो वामजङ्घायान्न मेषश् चरणाङ्गुली /
प लोहितो दक्षकुक्षौ फ शिखी वामकुक्षिगः //
text_mt: dha: Mīna on the left shank; na: Meṣa on the toes of the foot; / pa: Lohita on the right side of the belly; pha: Śikhin on the left side of the belly;

sanskrit_iast:
ba galaṇḍaḥ pṛṣṭhavaṃśe bho nābhau ca dviraṇḍakaḥ /
ma mahākālo hṛdaye ya vāṇīśastvavismṛtaḥ(1) //
meaning:
ब गलण्डः पृष्ठवंशे भो नाभौ च द्विरण्डकः /
म महाकालो हृदये य वाणीशस्त्वविस्मृतः(1) //
text_mt: ba: Galaṇḍa on the spine; bha: Dviraṇḍaka on the navel; / ma: Mahākāla in the heart; ya: Vāṇīśa on the skin;

sanskrit_iast:
ra rakte syādbhujaṅge śo la pinākī ca māṃsake /
va khaḍgīśaḥ svātmani syādvakaścāthini śaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
र रक्ते स्याद्भुजङ्गे शो ल पिनाकी च मांसके /
व खड्गीशः स्वात्मनि स्याद्वकश्चाथिनि शः स्मृतः //
text_mt: ra: Bhujaṅga in the blood; la: Pinākin in the flesh; / va: Khaḍgīśa in one's own self; śa is stated to be Baka in the bone;

sanskrit_iast:
ṣa śvetaś caiva majjāyāṃ sa bhṛguḥ śukradhātuke /
prāṇe ho nakulīśaḥ syāt kṣa saṃvartaś ca koṣagaḥ //
meaning:
ष श्वेतश् चैव मज्जायां स भृगुः शुक्रधातुके /
प्राणे हो नकुलीशः स्यात् क्ष संवर्तश् च कोषगः //
text_mt: ṣa: Śveta in the marrow; sa: Bhṛgu in the semen tissue; / ha: Nakulīśa in the breath; and kṣa: Saṃvarta in the sheath.

sanskrit_iast:
rudraśaktīḥ prapūjya hrīṃvījenākhilamāpnuyāt //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe mālinīmantrādinyāso nāma
pañcacatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ

Having worshipped the energies of Rudra with the seed-syllable hrīṃ, one will obtain everything.

The Lord said: / I shall explain the tripartite [formula] belonging to Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Maheśvara:
[Footnote]
1 …
“Oṃ, homage to the blessed Rudra! Homage! Homage, O Cāmuṇḍā, homage to the mothers of the sky, / who accomplish all desired aims, who are free from old age and death, / whose movement is unhindered everywhere, who alter forms and their intrinsic nature, / who engage in all acts of subjugating, eradicating, and uprooting all living beings, / the secret of all Mothers, the heart, supreme accomplishment, that cuts through others’ rites, / granting supreme perfection, the auspicious word of the Mothers!” / With the Rudras, in the division of the Brahmā-section, there are one hundred and twenty-one.

“Oṃ homage, O Cāmuṇḍā whose hair stands upright, blazing-crested, lightning-tongued, / star-eyed, brown-browed, deformed-fanged, enraged! Oṃ, / O you fond of flesh, blood, and liquor! Laugh, laugh! Oṃ strike, strike! ciri ciri, hiri hiri, bhiri bhiri, terrifier, terrifier, whirl-causer, whirl-causer! Oṃ liquefier, liquefier, shaker, shaker!

Now, the one hundred and forty-seventh chapter.
Worship of Tvaritā and Others
The Lord said: / “Oṃ Guhyakubjikā, huṃ phaṭ! Whoever has performed, caused to be performed, performs, will perform, or will cause to be performed all afflictions against me through the application of yantras, mantras, tantras, powders, and so on—strike them all, strike them! O fanged and terrible one! Hraiṃ
hrīṃ huṃ, to Guhyakubjikā, svāhā! Hrauṃ oṃ khe voṃ,

Now the one hundred forty-eighth chapter:

The Lord said: “Oṃ ḍe kha khyāṃ sūryāya saṅgrāmavijayāya namaḥ; hrāṃ hroṃ hrūṃ hreṃ hrauṃ hraḥ” —

hroṃ kreṃ
prabhūtaṃ vimalaṃ sārasārādhyaṃ paramaṃ mukhaṃ //

ओं हं खं खशोक्लाय स्वाहा / स्पूं ह्रूं हुं क्रूं ओं
ह्रों क्रें
प्रभूतं विमलं सारसाराध्यं परमं मुखं //

these are the six limbs of Sūrya, who indeed bestows victory in battle:
“Oṃ haṃ khaṃ khaśoklāya svāhā; spūṃ hrūṃ huṃ krūṃ oṃ hroṃ kreṃ” —
abundant, immaculate, the supreme mouth to be worshiped by the essence of the core.

:श् अथोनपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
लक्षकोटिहोमः
text_mt:
one should worship the Sun, Caṇḍa, and Pracaṇḍa with fragrant unguents and the like. Victory in battle and other ventures will arise through worship, recitation, fire oblation, and other rites.
Thus ends the one hundred forty-eighth chapter, named Worship for Victory in Battle in the Ocean of Victory in Battle, in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now the one hundred forty-ninth chapter:
The Hundred-Thousand and Ten-Million Fire Oblations.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
homādraṇādau vijayo rājyāptirvighnanāśanaṃ /
kṛcchreṇa śuddhimutpādya prāṇāyāmaśatena ca //
:n
1 dīptā dhūmeti jha..
2 vindu vindu samāyuktā iti cha..
:p 112
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
होमाद्रणादौ विजयो राज्याप्तिर्विघ्ननाशनं /
कृच्छ्रेण शुद्धिमुत्पाद्य प्राणायामशतेन च //
:न्
1 दीप्ता धूमेति झ..
2 विन्दु विन्दु समायुक्ता इति छ..
:प् 112
text_mt:
The Lord said: / From fire oblation comes victory in battle and the like, acquisition of a kingdom, and destruction of obstacles. Having effected purification by a kṛcchra penance and by a hundred breath-controls,
[Footnote mark]
[Variant] 1. "dīptā dhūmā" in ms. jha.
[Variant] 2. "vindu vindu samāyuktā" in ms. cha. / :p 112

sanskrit_iast:
antarjale ca gāyatrīṃ japtvā ṣoḍaśadhācaret /
prāṇāyāmāṃś ca pūrvāhṇe juhuyāt pāvake haviḥ //
meaning:
अन्तर्जले च गायत्रीं जप्त्वा षोडशधाचरेत् /
प्राणायामांश् च पूर्वाह्णे जुहुयात् पावके हविः //
text_mt: and having recited the Gāyatrī underwater sixteen times, one should perform / breath-controls and offer the sacrificial substance into the fire in the forenoon.

sanskrit_iast:
bhaikṣyayāvakabhakṣī ca phalamūlāśano 'pi vā /
kṣīraśaktughṛtāhāra ekamāhāramāśrayet //
meaning:
भैक्ष्ययावकभक्षी च फलमूलाशनो ऽपि वा /
क्षीरशक्तुघृताहार एकमाहारमाश्रयेत् //
text_mt: Feeding on alms and barley gruel, or eating fruits and roots, / subsisting on milk, roasted barley flour, or clarified butter, one should rely on a single diet

sanskrit_iast:
yāvatsamāptirbhavati lakṣahomasya pārvati /
dakṣiṇā lakṣahomānte gāvo vastrāṇi kāñcanaṃ //
meaning:
यावत्समाप्तिर्भवति लक्षहोमस्य पार्वति /
दक्षिणा लक्षहोमान्ते गावो वस्त्राणि काञ्चनं //
text_mt: until the completion of the hundred-thousand fire oblation, O Pārvatī. / At the end of the hundred-thousand fire oblation, the sacrificial fee is cattle, garments, and gold.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvotpātasamutpattau pañcabhirdaśabhirdvijaiḥ /
nāsti loke sa utpāto yo hy anena na śāmyati //
meaning:
सर्वोत्पातसमुत्पत्तौ पञ्चभिर्दशभिर्द्विजैः /
नास्ति लोके स उत्पातो यो ह्य् अनेन न शाम्यति //
text_mt: When all kinds of portents arise, [it should be performed] by five or ten twice-born men. / There is no portent in the world that is not pacified by this.

sanskrit_iast:
maṅgalyaṃ paramaṃ nāsti yadasmādatiricyate /
koṭihomantu yo rājā kārayet pūrvavaddvijaiḥ //
meaning:
मङ्गल्यं परमं नास्ति यदस्मादतिरिच्यते /
कोटिहोमन्तु यो राजा कारयेत् पूर्ववद्द्विजैः //
text_mt: There is no supreme auspiciousness that surpasses this. / The king who causes a ten-million fire oblation to be performed as before by twice-born men—

sanskrit_iast:
na tasya śatravaḥ saṅkhye jātu tiṣṭhanti karhicit /
na tasya mārako deśe vyādhirvā jāyate kvacit //
meaning:
न तस्य शत्रवः सङ्ख्ये जातु तिष्ठन्ति कर्हिचित् /
न तस्य मारको देशे व्याधिर्वा जायते क्वचित् //
text_mt: his enemies never stand anywhere in battle; / no pestilence or disease is ever born in his country.

sanskrit_iast:
ativṛṣṭiranāvṛṣṭirmūṣakāḥ śalabhāḥ śukāḥ /
rākṣasādyāś ca śāmyanti sarve ca ripavo raṇe //
meaning:
अतिवृष्टिरनावृष्टिर्मूषकाः शलभाः शुकाः /
राक्षसाद्याश् च शाम्यन्ति सर्वे च रिपवो रणे //
text_mt: Excessive rain, drought, mice, locusts, parrots, / rākṣasas and the like are all pacified, and all enemies in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭihome tu varayedbrāhmaṇānviṃśatiṃ tathā /
śatañcātha sahasraṃ vā yatheṣṭāmbhūtimāpnuyāt //
meaning:
कोटिहोमे तु वरयेद्ब्राह्मणान्विंशतिं तथा /
शतञ्चाथ सहस्रं वा यथेष्टाम्भूतिमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: For a ten-million fire oblation, one should choose twenty brahmins, / or one hundred, or one thousand; one obtains prosperity as desired.

sanskrit_iast:
koṭihomantu yaḥ kuryād dvijo bhūpo 'thavā ca viṭ /
yadicchet prāpnuyāttattat saśarīro divaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
कोटिहोमन्तु यः कुर्याद् द्विजो भूपो ऽथवा च विट् /
यदिच्छेत् प्राप्नुयात्तत्तत् सशरीरो दिवं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: The twice-born, the king, or the vaiśya who performs a ten-million fire oblation / obtains whatever he desires, and goes to heaven in his physical body.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryā grahamantrair vā kuṣmāṇḍījātavedasaiḥ /
aindravāruṇavāyavyayāmyāgneyaiś ca vaiṣṇavaiḥ //
meaning:
गायत्र्या ग्रहमन्त्रैर् वा कुष्माण्डीजातवेदसैः /
ऐन्द्रवारुणवायव्ययाम्याग्नेयैश् च वैष्णवैः //
text_mt: By means of the Gāyatrī, or planetary mantras, or the Kuṣmāṇḍī and Jātavedas mantras, / or mantras of Indra, Varuṇa, Vāyu, Yama, Agni, and Viṣṇu,

sanskrit_iast:
śākteyaiś ca śāmbhavaiḥ saurair mantrair homārcanāttataḥ /
ayutenālpasiddhiḥ syāllakṣahomo 'khilārtinut //
meaning:
शाक्तेयैश् च शाम्भवैः सौरैर् मन्त्रैर् होमार्चनात्ततः /
अयुतेनाल्पसिद्धिः स्याल्लक्षहोमो ऽखिलार्तिनुत् //
text_mt: or mantras of Śakti, Śiva, and Sūrya, through fire oblation and worship: / through ten thousand, there is minor attainment; the hundred-thousand fire oblation dispels all distress;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapīḍādinaśāya koṭihomo 'khilārthadaḥ /
:p 113
yavavrīhitilakṣīraghṛtakuśapramātikāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वपीडादिनशाय कोटिहोमो ऽखिलार्थदः /
:प् 113
यवव्रीहितिलक्षीरघृतकुशप्रमातिकाः //
text_mt:
for the destruction of all afflictions and the like, the ten-million fire oblation grants all aims.
:p 113
Barley, rice, sesamum, milk, clarified butter, kuśa grass, and arālikā,

sanskrit_iast:
paṅkajośīravilvāmradalā home prakīrtitāḥ /
aṣṭahastapramāṇena koṭihomeṣu khātakaṃ //
meaning:
पङ्कजोशीरविल्वाम्रदला होमे प्रकीर्तिताः /
अष्टहस्तप्रमाणेन कोटिहोमेषु खातकं //
text_mt: lotus, uśīra root, and leaves of vilva and mango are proclaimed for fire oblation. / The excavated pit in ten-million fire oblations should measure eight cubits;

sanskrit_iast:
tasmādardhapramāṇena lakṣahome vidhīyate /
homo 'yutena lakṣeṇa kodyājyādyaiḥ prakīrtitaḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe yuddhajayārṇave ayutalakṣakoṭihomo
nāmonapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
manvantarāṇi
meaning:
तस्मादर्धप्रमाणेन लक्षहोमे विधीयते /
होमो ऽयुतेन लक्षेण कोद्याज्याद्यैः प्रकीर्तितः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे युद्धजयार्णवे अयुतलक्षकोटिहोमो
नामोनपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
मन्वन्तराणि
text_mt:
half of that measure is prescribed for a hundred-thousand fire oblation. / A fire oblation is proclaimed by ten thousand, a hundred thousand, and ten million with clarified butter and other substances.
Thus ends the one hundred forty-ninth chapter, named The Fire Oblation of Ten Thousand, a Hundred Thousand, and Ten Million in the Ocean of Victory in Battle, in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now the one hundred fiftieth chapter:
[The eras of the Manus]

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
manvantarāṇi vakṣyāmi ādyāḥ svāyambhuvo manuḥ /
agnīdhrādyāstasya sutā yamo nāma tadā surāḥ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
मन्वन्तराणि वक्ष्यामि आद्याः स्वायम्भुवो मनुः /
अग्नीध्राद्यास्तस्य सुता यमो नाम तदा सुराः //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall declare the cosmic eras of the Manus. The first Manu is Svāyambhuva; / his sons are Agnīdhra and the others; the gods then were called the Yamas.

sanskrit_iast:
aurvādyāś ca saptarṣaya indraś caiva śatakratuḥ /
pārāvatāḥ satuṣitā devāḥ svārociṣe 'ntare //
meaning:
और्वाद्याश् च सप्तर्षय इन्द्रश् चैव शतक्रतुः /
पारावताः सतुषिता देवाः स्वारोचिषे ऽन्तरे //
text_mt: Aurva and others were the seven seers, and Indra was Śatakratu. / The Pārāvatas along with the Tuṣitas were the gods in the era of Svārociṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
vipaścittatra devendra ūrjastambhādayo dvijāḥ /
caitrakimpuruṣāḥ putrāstṛtīyaścottotamo manuḥ //
meaning:
विपश्चित्तत्र देवेन्द्र ऊर्जस्तम्भादयो द्विजाः /
चैत्रकिम्पुरुषाः पुत्रास्तृतीयश्चोत्तोतमो मनुः //
text_mt: Vipaścit was Indra there, and Ūrjastambha and others were the twice-born seers; / Caitra, Kimpuruṣa, and others were his sons. And the third was the Manu Uttama.

sanskrit_iast:
suśāntirindro devāś ca sudhāmādyā vaśiṣṭhajāḥ /
saptarṣayo 'jādyāḥ putrāś caturthastāmasī manuḥ //
:p 114
meaning:
सुशान्तिरिन्द्रो देवाश् च सुधामाद्या वशिष्ठजाः /
सप्तर्षयो ऽजाद्याः पुत्राश् चतुर्थस्तामसी मनुः //
:प् 114
text_mt:
Suśānti was Indra, and the gods were the Sudhāmans and others born of Vasiṣṭha; / the seven seers and Aja and others were his sons. The fourth is the Manu Tāmasa.
[p. 114]

sanskrit_iast:
svarūpādyāḥ suragaṇāḥ śikhirindraḥ sureśvaraḥ /
jyotirdhāmādayo viprā nava khyātimukhāḥ sutāḥ //
meaning:
स्वरूपाद्याः सुरगणाः शिखिरिन्द्रः सुरेश्वरः /
ज्योतिर्धामादयो विप्रा नव ख्यातिमुखाः सुताः //
text_mt: Svarūpa and others were the hosts of gods; Śikhi was Indra, ruler of the gods; / Jyotirdhāman and others were the seers; and his nine sons were headed by Khyāti.

sanskrit_iast:
raivate vitathaścendro amitābhās tathā surāḥ /
hiraṇyaromādyā munayo(1) balabandhādayaḥ sutāḥ //
meaning:
रैवते वितथश्चेन्द्रो अमिताभास् तथा सुराः /
हिरण्यरोमाद्या मुनयो(1) बलबन्धादयः सुताः //
text_mt: In the era of Raivata, Indra was Vitatha, and the gods were the Amitābhas; / Hiraṇyaroman and others were the seers, and Balabandhu and others were his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
manojavaścākṣuṣe 'tha indraḥ svātyādayaḥ surāḥ /
sumedhādyā maharṣayaḥ puruprabhṛtayaḥ sutāḥ //
meaning:
मनोजवश्चाक्षुषे ऽथ इन्द्रः स्वात्यादयः सुराः /
सुमेधाद्या महर्षयः पुरुप्रभृतयः सुताः //
text_mt: In the era of Cākṣuṣa, Manojava was Indra, and the Svātis and others were the gods; / Sumedhas and others were the great seers, and Puru and others were his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
vivasvataḥ suto vipraḥ śrāddhadevo manustataḥ /
ādityavasurudrādyā devā indraḥ purandaraḥ //
meaning:
विवस्वतः सुतो विप्रः श्राद्धदेवो मनुस्ततः /
आदित्यवसुरुद्राद्या देवा इन्द्रः पुरन्दरः //
text_mt: Then came the son of Vivasvat, the twice-born Manu Śrāddhadeva; / the gods are the Ādityas, Vasus, Rudras, and others; Indra is Purandara.

sanskrit_iast:
vaśiṣṭhaḥ kāśyapo 'thātrirjamadagniḥ sagotamaḥ /
viśvāmitrabharadvājau munayaḥ sapta sāmprataṃ //
meaning:
वशिष्ठः काश्यपो ऽथात्रिर्जमदग्निः सगोतमः /
विश्वामित्रभरद्वाजौ मुनयः सप्त साम्प्रतं //
text_mt: Vasiṣṭha, Kaśyapa, and Atri, Jamadagni together with Gautama, / Viśvāmitra, and Bharadvāja are now the seven seers.

sanskrit_iast:
ikṣvākupramukhāḥ putrā aṃśena harirābhavat /
svāyambhuve mānaso 'bhūdajitastadanantare //
meaning:
इक्ष्वाकुप्रमुखाः पुत्रा अंशेन हरिराभवत् /
स्वायम्भुवे मानसो ऽभूदजितस्तदनन्तरे //
text_mt: Ikṣvāku and others are his sons. Hari incarnated with a part of himself: / in the era of Svāyambhuva he became Mānasa, and in the next, Ajita;

sanskrit_iast:
satyo harirdevadaro vaikuṇṭho vāmanaḥ kramāt /
chāyājaḥ sūryaputrastu bhavitā cāṣṭamo manuḥ //
meaning:
सत्यो हरिर्देवदरो वैकुण्ठो वामनः क्रमात् /
छायाजः सूर्यपुत्रस्तु भविता चाष्टमो मनुः //
text_mt: in succession, Satya, Hari, Devadara, Vaikuṇṭha, and Vāmana. / Born of Chāyā, the son of the Sun, will be the eighth Manu.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvasya ca savarṇo 'sau sāvarṇirbhavitāṣṭamaḥ /
sutapādyā devagaṇā dīptimaddrauṇikādayaḥ //
meaning:
पूर्वस्य च सवर्णो ऽसौ सावर्णिर्भविताष्टमः /
सुतपाद्या देवगणा दीप्तिमद्द्रौणिकादयः //
text_mt: And being of equal status to the former, this Sāvarṇi will be the eighth; / the classes of gods will be the Sutapas and others; Dīptimat, Drauṇi, and others

sanskrit_iast:
munayo balirindraś ca virajapramukhāḥ sutāḥ /
navamo dakṣasāvarṇiḥ pārādyāś ca tadā surāḥ(2) //
meaning:
मुनयो बलिरिन्द्रश् च विरजप्रमुखाः सुताः /
नवमो दक्षसावर्णिः पाराद्याश् च तदा सुराः(2) //
text_mt: will be the seers; Bali will be Indra, and Virajas and others his sons. / The ninth will be Dakṣasāvarṇi, and the gods then will be the Pāras and others;

sanskrit_iast:
indraś caivādbhutasteṣāṃ savanādyā dvijottamāḥ /
dhṛtaketvādayaḥ putrā brahmasāvarṇirityataḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रश् चैवाद्भुतस्तेषां सवनाद्या द्विजोत्तमाः /
धृतकेत्वादयः पुत्रा ब्रह्मसावर्णिरित्यतः //
text_mt: and Adbhuta will be their Indra; Savana and others will be the best twice-born seers; / Dhṛtaketu and others will be his sons. Following this is Brahmasāvarṇi;

sanskrit_iast:
sukhādayo devagaṇāsteṣāṃ śāntiḥ śatakratuḥ /
:n
1 hiraṇyaromādyā ṛṣaya iti ña..
2 tathā surā iti cha..
:p 115
haviṣyādyāś ca munayaḥ sukṣetrādyāś ca tatsutāḥ //
meaning:
सुखादयो देवगणास्तेषां शान्तिः शतक्रतुः /
:न्
1 हिरण्यरोमाद्या ऋषय इति ञ..
2 तथा सुरा इति छ..
:प् 115
हविष्याद्याश् च मुनयः सुक्षेत्राद्याश् च तत्सुताः //
text_mt:
the Sukhas and others will be the classes of gods; their Śatakratu will be Śānti;
[Note]
1. ña reads: 'hiraṇyaromādyā ṛṣayaḥ'.
2. cha reads: 'tathā surāḥ'. / [p. 115]
Haviṣmat and others will be the seers, and Sukṣetra and others his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmasāvarṇikaścātha vihaṅgādyāstadā surāḥ /
gaṇeśaścendro naś carādyā munayaḥ putrakāmayoḥ //
meaning:
धर्मसावर्णिकश्चाथ विहङ्गाद्यास्तदा सुराः /
गणेशश्चेन्द्रो नश् चराद्या मुनयः पुत्रकामयोः //
text_mt: Then is Dharmasāvarṇika; the Vihaṅgas and others will then be the gods; / Gaṇeśa will be Indra; and Naścara and others will be the seers among the sons of the two longing for sons;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatragādyā rudrākhyaḥ sāvarṇibhavitā manuḥ /
ṛtadhāmā surendraś ca haritādyāś ca devatāḥ //
meaning:
सर्वत्रगाद्या रुद्राख्यः सावर्णिभविता मनुः /
ऋतधामा सुरेन्द्रश् च हरिताद्याश् च देवताः //
text_mt: Sarvatraga and others [will be his sons]. The Manu named Rudrasāvarṇi will come; / Ṛtadhāman will be the ruler of the gods, and the Haritas and others the deities;

sanskrit_iast:
tapasyādyāḥ saptarṣayaḥ sutā vaidevavanmukhāḥ /
manustrayodaśo raucyaḥ sūtrāmāṇādayaḥ surāḥ //
meaning:
तपस्याद्याः सप्तर्षयः सुता वैदेववन्मुखाः /
मनुस्त्रयोदशो रौच्यः सूत्रामाणादयः सुराः //
text_mt: Tapasvin and others will be the seven seers; the sons will be headed by Devavat. / The thirteenth Manu will be Raucya; the Sūtrāmans and others will be the gods;

sanskrit_iast:
indro divaspatisteṣāṃ dānavādivimardanaḥ /
nirmohādyāḥ saptarṣayaścitrasenādayaḥ sutāḥ //
meaning:
इन्द्रो दिवस्पतिस्तेषां दानवादिविमर्दनः /
निर्मोहाद्याः सप्तर्षयश्चित्रसेनादयः सुताः //
text_mt: their Indra will be Divaspati, the crusher of Dānavas and others; / Nirmoha and others will be the seven seers, and Citrasena and others his sons.

sanskrit_iast:
manuś caturdaśo bhautyaḥ śucirindro bhaviṣyati /
cākṣuṣādyāḥ suragaṇā agnibāhṇādayo dvijāḥ //
meaning:
मनुश् चतुर्दशो भौत्यः शुचिरिन्द्रो भविष्यति /
चाक्षुषाद्याः सुरगणा अग्निबाह्णादयो द्विजाः //
text_mt: The fourteenth Manu will be Bhautya; Śuci will be Indra; / the Cākṣuṣas and others will be the classes of gods; Agnibāhu and others the twice-born seers;

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśasya bhautyasya putrā ūrumukhā manoḥ /
prayartayanti devāṃś ca bhuvi saptarṣayo divaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्दशस्य भौत्यस्य पुत्रा ऊरुमुखा मनोः /
प्रयर्तयन्ति देवांश् च भुवि सप्तर्षयो दिवः //
text_mt: the sons of the fourteenth Manu, Bhautya, will be headed by Ūru. / The seven seers in heaven bring forth the gods on earth.

sanskrit_iast:
devā yajñabhujaste tu bhūḥ putraiḥ paripālyate /
brahmaṇo divase brahmanmanavastu caturdaśa //
meaning:
देवा यज्ञभुजस्ते तु भूः पुत्रैः परिपाल्यते /
ब्रह्मणो दिवसे ब्रह्मन्मनवस्तु चतुर्दश //
text_mt: Those gods are the consumers of the sacrifice, while the earth is protected by the sons. / In a day of Brahmā, O Brahmin, there are fourteen Manus.

sanskrit_iast:
manvādyāś ca harirvedaṃ dvāparānte vibheda saḥ /
ādyo vedaś catuṣpādaḥ śatasāhasrasammitaḥ //
meaning:
मन्वाद्याश् च हरिर्वेदं द्वापरान्ते विभेद सः /
आद्यो वेदश् चतुष्पादः शतसाहस्रसम्मितः //
text_mt: The Manus and others [reign], and Hari divided the Veda at the end of the Dvāpara age. / The original Veda had four quarters, measuring a hundred thousand [verses].

sanskrit_iast:
ekaścāsīd yajurvedastaṃ caturdhā vyakalpayat /
ādhvaryavaṃ yajurbhistu ṛgbhirhotraṃ tathā muniḥ //
meaning:
एकश्चासीद् यजुर्वेदस्तं चतुर्धा व्यकल्पयत् /
आध्वर्यवं यजुर्भिस्तु ऋग्भिर्होत्रं तथा मुनिः //
text_mt: And the Yajurveda was one; he arranged it into four parts. / The sage [constituted] the duty of the adhvaryu priest with the Yajuses, and that of the hotṛ priest with the Ṛcs;

sanskrit_iast:
audgātraṃ sāmabhioś cakre brahmatvañcāpyatharvabhiḥ /
prathamaṃ vyāsaśiṣyastu pailo hy ṛgvedapāragaḥ //
meaning:
औद्गात्रं सामभिओश् चक्रे ब्रह्मत्वञ्चाप्यथर्वभिः /
प्रथमं व्यासशिष्यस्तु पैलो ह्य् ऋग्वेदपारगः //
text_mt: the duty of the udgātṛ priest he made with the Sāmans, and the office of the brahman priest with the Atharvans. / First, Paila, a disciple of Vyāsa, was master of the Ṛgveda;

sanskrit_iast:
indraḥ pramataye prādādvāskalāya ca saṃhitāṃ /
baudhyādibhyo dadau sopi caturdhā nijasaṃhitāṃ //
:p 116
meaning:
इन्द्रः प्रमतये प्रादाद्वास्कलाय च संहितां /
बौध्यादिभ्यो ददौ सोपि चतुर्धा निजसंहितां //
:प् 116
text_mt:
he gave the collection to Indrapramati and to Bāṣkala. / He too gave his own collection fourfold to Baudhya and others.
[p. 116]

sanskrit_iast:
yajurvedataroḥ śākhāḥ saptaviṃśanmahāmatiḥ /
vaiśampāyananāmāsau vyāsaśiṣyaś cakāra vai //
meaning:
यजुर्वेदतरोः शाखाः सप्तविंशन्महामतिः /
वैशम्पायननामासौ व्यासशिष्यश् चकार वै //
text_mt: That highly intelligent disciple of Vyāsa, named Vaiśampāyana, / made twenty-seven branches of the tree of the Yajurveda.

sanskrit_iast:
kāṇvā vājasaneyādyā yājñavalkyādibhiḥ smṛtāḥ /
sāmavedataroḥ śākhā vyāsaśiṣyaḥ sajaiminiḥ //
meaning:
काण्वा वाजसनेयाद्या याज्ञवल्क्यादिभिः स्मृताः /
सामवेदतरोः शाखा व्यासशिष्यः सजैमिनिः //
text_mt: The Kāṇvas, the Vājasaneyas, and others are remembered [as taught] by Yājñavalkya and others. / The disciple of Vyāsa, Jaimini, [arranged] the branches of the tree of the Sāmaveda.

sanskrit_iast:
sumantuś ca sukarmā ca ekaikāṃ saṃhitāṃ tataḥ /
gṛhṇate ca sukarmākhyaḥ sahasraṃ saṃhitāṃ guruḥ //
meaning:
सुमन्तुश् च सुकर्मा च एकैकां संहितां ततः /
गृह्णते च सुकर्माख्यः सहस्रं संहितां गुरुः //
text_mt: Then Sumantu and Sukarman each received one collection. / The teacher named Sukarman [divided] the collection into a thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
sumantuścātharvataruṃ vyāsaśiṣyo vibheda taṃ /
śiṣyānadhyāpayāmāsa paipyalādān sahasraśaḥ //
meaning:
सुमन्तुश्चाथर्वतरुं व्यासशिष्यो विभेद तं /
शिष्यानध्यापयामास पैप्यलादान् सहस्रशः //
text_mt: And Sumantu, a disciple of Vyāsa, divided the tree of the Atharvaveda; / he taught disciples by the thousands, [such as] the Paippalādas.

sanskrit_iast:
purāṇasaṃhitāṃ cakre suto vyāsaprasādataḥ //31//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe manvantarāṇi nāma
pañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikapañcāśadadhikaśatatano 'dhyāyaḥ
varṇetaradharmāḥ
meaning:
पुराणसंहितां चक्रे सुतो व्यासप्रसादतः //31//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे मन्वन्तराणि नाम
पञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकपञ्चाशदधिकशततनो ऽध्यायः
वर्णेतरधर्माः
text_mt:
Sūta composed the Purāṇa collection through the grace of Vyāsa.
Thus ends the one hundred and fiftieth chapter, entitled 'The Cosmic Eras of the Manus', in the Great Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred and fifty-first chapter.
[Duties beyond caste]

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
manvādayo bhuktimuktidharmāṃścīrtvāpnuvanti yān /
proce paraśurāmāya varuṇoktantu puṣkaraḥ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
मन्वादयो भुक्तिमुक्तिधर्मांश्चीर्त्वाप्नुवन्ति यान् /
प्रोचे परशुरामाय वरुणोक्तन्तु पुष्करः //
text_mt: Agni said: / Puṣkara spoke to Paraśurāma that which was declared by Varuṇa, / the duties of worldly enjoyment and liberation, practising which Manu and others attain [their goals].

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
varṇāśrametarāṇānte dharmānvakṣyāmi sarvadān /
manvādibhir nigaditān vāsudevādituṣṭidān //
:p 117
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
वर्णाश्रमेतराणान्ते धर्मान्वक्ष्यामि सर्वदान् /
मन्वादिभिर् निगदितान् वासुदेवादितुष्टिदान् //
:प् 117
text_mt:
Puṣkara said: / I will declare to you the all-granting duties common to all castes and stages of life, / proclaimed by Manu and others, which grant satisfaction to Vāsudeva and others:
[p. 117]

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā satyavacanandayā bhūteṣvanugrahaḥ /
tīrthānusaraṇaṃ dānaṃ brahmacaryammatsaraḥ //
meaning:
अहिंसा सत्यवचनन्दया भूतेष्वनुग्रहः /
तीर्थानुसरणं दानं ब्रह्मचर्यम्मत्सरः //
text_mt: non-violence, truthful speech, compassion, kindness to living beings, / visiting sacred fords, generosity, celibacy, absence of malice,

sanskrit_iast:
devadvijātiśuśrūṣā gurūṇāñca bhṛgūttama /
śravaṇaṃ sarvadharmāṇāṃ pitṝṇāṃ pūjanaṃ tathā //
meaning:
देवद्विजातिशुश्रूषा गुरूणाञ्च भृगूत्तम /
श्रवणं सर्वधर्माणां पितॄणां पूजनं तथा //
text_mt: service to gods and twice-born persons, and of gurus, O best of the Bhṛgus, / listening to all duties, and likewise the worship of the ancestors,

sanskrit_iast:
bhaktiś ca nṛpatau nityaṃ tathā sacchāstranetratā /
ānṛśaṃṣyantitikṣā ca tathā cāstikyameva ca //
meaning:
भक्तिश् च नृपतौ नित्यं तथा सच्छास्त्रनेत्रता /
आनृशंष्यन्तितिक्षा च तथा चास्तिक्यमेव च //
text_mt: constant devotion to the king, and viewing things through the excellent scriptures, / non-cruelty, endurance, and firm faith.

sanskrit_iast:
varṇāśramāṇāṃ sāmānyaṃ dharmādharmaṃ(1) samīritaṃ /
yajanaṃ yājanaṃ dānaṃ vedādyadhyāpanakriyā //
meaning:
वर्णाश्रमाणां सामान्यं धर्माधर्मं(1) समीरितं /
यजनं याजनं दानं वेदाद्यध्यापनक्रिया //
text_mt: The common duty and non-duty of the castes and stages of life has been declared. / Sacrificing for oneself, officiating at sacrifices for others, giving gifts, teaching the Vedas and other texts,

sanskrit_iast:
pratigrahañcādhyayanaṃ viprakarmāṇi nirdiśet /
dānamadhyayanañcaiva yajanañca yathāvidhiḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिग्रहञ्चाध्ययनं विप्रकर्माणि निर्दिशेत् /
दानमध्ययनञ्चैव यजनञ्च यथाविधिः //
text_mt: receiving gifts, and studying: these are prescribed as the activities of a Brahmin. / Giving gifts, studying, and sacrificing in accordance with the rule:

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyasya savaiśyasya karmedaṃ parikīrtitaṃ /
kṣatriyasya viśeṣeṇa pālanaṃ duṣṭanigrahaḥ //
meaning:
क्षत्रियस्य सवैश्यस्य कर्मेदं परिकीर्तितं /
क्षत्रियस्य विशेषेण पालनं दुष्टनिग्रहः //
text_mt: this duty is proclaimed for the Kṣatriya and the Vaiśya. / For the Kṣatriya in particular, [his duty is] protection and punishing the wicked.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣigorakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyasya parikīrtitaṃ /
śūdrasya dvijaśuśrūṣā sarvaśilpāni vāpyatha //
meaning:
कृषिगोरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यस्य परिकीर्तितं /
शूद्रस्य द्विजशुश्रूषा सर्वशिल्पानि वाप्यथ //
text_mt: Agriculture, cattle rearing, and trade are proclaimed for the Vaiśya. / For the Śūdra, service to the twice-born, or all craft traditions.

sanskrit_iast:
mauñjībandhanato janma viprādeś ca dvitīyakaṃ /
ānulomyena varṇānāṃ jātirmātṛsamā smṛtā //
meaning:
मौञ्जीबन्धनतो जन्म विप्रादेश् च द्वितीयकं /
आनुलोम्येन वर्णानां जातिर्मातृसमा स्मृता //
text_mt: From the tying of the muñja grass cord comes the second birth of the Brahmin and others. / In the natural order of the castes, the offspring is remembered to be equal to the mother.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍālo brāhmaṇīputraḥ śūdrācca pratilomataḥ /
sūtastu kṣatriyājjāto vaiśyādvai devalas tathā //
meaning:
चण्डालो ब्राह्मणीपुत्रः शूद्राच्च प्रतिलोमतः /
सूतस्तु क्षत्रियाज्जातो वैश्याद्वै देवलस् तथा //
text_mt: A Caṇḍāla is born against the natural order from a Śūdra by a Brahmin woman; / a Sūta is born from a Kṣatriya woman, and a Devala from a Vaiśya woman;

sanskrit_iast:
pukkasaḥ kṣatriyāputraḥ śūdrāt syāt pratilomajaḥ /
māgadhaḥ syāttathā vaiśyācchūdrādayogavo bhavet //
meaning:
पुक्कसः क्षत्रियापुत्रः शूद्रात् स्यात् प्रतिलोमजः /
मागधः स्यात्तथा वैश्याच्छूद्रादयोगवो भवेत् //
text_mt: a Pukkasa is born against the order from a Śūdra by a Kṣatriya woman; / a Māgadha from a Vaiśya woman, and an Āyogava from a Śūdra woman.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyāyāṃ pratilomebhyaḥ pratilomāḥ sahasraśaḥ /
:n
1 dharmarūpamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca
:p 118
vivāhaḥ sadṛśaisteṣāṃ nottamair nādhamais tathā //
meaning:
वैश्यायां प्रतिलोमेभ्यः प्रतिलोमाः सहस्रशः /
:न्
1 धर्मरूपमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 118
विवाहः सदृशैस्तेषां नोत्तमैर् नाधमैस् तथा //
text_mt:
Through unions against the natural order with a Vaiśya woman, thousands of mixed castes against the natural order arise.
[Note]
1. ga, gha, ṅa, and ña read: 'dharmarūpam'. / [p. 118]
Their marriage is with their equals, not with those higher, nor with those lower.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍālakarma nirdiṣṭaṃ badhyānāṃ ghātanaṃ tathā /
strījīvantu tadrakṣāproktaṃ(1) vaidehakasya ca //
meaning:
चण्डालकर्म निर्दिष्टं बध्यानां घातनं तथा /
स्त्रीजीवन्तु तद्रक्षाप्रोक्तं(1) वैदेहकस्य च //
text_mt: The duty of a caṇḍāla is prescribed as the execution of those condemned to death. / The duty of a Vaidehaka is declared to be living off women and guarding them.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtānāmaśvasārathyaṃ pukkasānāñca vyādhatā /
stutikriyā māghdhānāṃ tathā cāyogaśasya ca //
meaning:
सूतानामश्वसारथ्यं पुक्कसानाञ्च व्याधता /
स्तुतिक्रिया माघ्धानां तथा चायोगशस्य च //
text_mt: For Sūtas, driving horses and chariots; for Pukkasas, hunting; / for Māgadhas, the act of singing praises; and likewise for an Āyogava,

sanskrit_iast:
raṅgāvataraṇaṃ proktaṃ tathā śilpaiś ca jīvanaṃ /
vahirgrāmanivāsaś ca mṛtacelasya dhāraṇaṃ //
meaning:
रङ्गावतरणं प्रोक्तं तथा शिल्पैश् च जीवनं /
वहिर्ग्रामनिवासश् च मृतचेलस्य धारणं //
text_mt: entering the stage is prescribed, as well as living by crafts. / Dwelling outside the village, wearing the clothes of the dead,

sanskrit_iast:
na saṃsparśastathaivānyaiś caṇḍālasya vidhīyate /
brāhmaṇārthe gavārthe vā dehatyāgo 'tra yaḥ kṛtaḥ //
meaning:
न संस्पर्शस्तथैवान्यैश् चण्डालस्य विधीयते /
ब्राह्मणार्थे गवार्थे वा देहत्यागो ऽत्र यः कृतः //
text_mt: and no physical contact with others is prescribed for a caṇḍāla. / Whoever here gives up their body for the sake of a brāhmaṇa or a cow,

sanskrit_iast:
strībālādyupapato vā vāhyāṇāṃ siddhikāraṇaṃ /
saṅkare jātayo jñeyāḥ piturmātuś ca karmataḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe varṇāntaradharmā
nāmaikapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvipañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
gṛhasthavṛttiḥ
meaning:
स्त्रीबालाद्युपपतो वा वाह्याणां सिद्धिकारणं /
सङ्करे जातयो ज्ञेयाः पितुर्मातुश् च कर्मतः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे वर्णान्तरधर्मा
नामैकपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्विपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
गृहस्थवृत्तिः
text_mt:
or in defense of women, children, and others, is the cause of spiritual success for outcastes. / Castes arising in miscegenation should be known through the acts of father and mother.
Thus ends the one hundred fifty-first chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, entitled “Duties of the Intermediate Castes.”
Now, the one hundred fifty-second chapter:
The Livelihood of the Householder.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
ājīvaṃstu yathoktena brāhmaṇaḥ svena karmaṇā /
kṣatraviṭśūdradharmeṇa jīvennaiva tu śūdrajāt //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
आजीवंस्तु यथोक्तेन ब्राह्मणः स्वेन कर्मणा /
क्षत्रविट्शूद्रधर्मेण जीवेन्नैव तु शूद्रजात् //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / A brāhmaṇa unable to make a living by his own prescribed duty / may live by the duty of a kṣatriya, vaiśya, or śūdra, but never from a śūdra's birth.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣibāṇijyagorakṣyaṃ kuśīdañca dvijaś caret /
gorasaṃ guḍalavaṇalākṣāmāṃsāni varjayet //
:n
1 śrījīvanañca tatra syāt proktamiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca
:p 119
meaning:
कृषिबाणिज्यगोरक्ष्यं कुशीदञ्च द्विजश् चरेत् /
गोरसं गुडलवणलाक्षामांसानि वर्जयेत् //
:न्
1 श्रीजीवनञ्च तत्र स्यात् प्रोक्तमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 119
text_mt:
A twice-born may engage in agriculture, trade, cattle-rearing, and usury; / he must avoid milk products, molasses, salt, lac, and meat.
[Footnote]
1. "And prosperous living may be there" is stated in ga, gha, ṅa, and ña.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiṃ bhitvauṣadhīśchitvā hutvā koṭapipīlikān /
punanti khalu yajñena karṣakā devapūjanāt //
meaning:
भूमिं भित्वौषधीश्छित्वा हुत्वा कोटपिपीलिकान् /
पुनन्ति खलु यज्ञेन कर्षका देवपूजनात् //
text_mt: Having tilled the earth, cut down plants, and immolated worms and ants, / farmers indeed purify themselves through sacrifice by worshipping the gods.

sanskrit_iast:
halamaṣṭagavaṃ dharmyaṃ ṣaḍgavaṃ jīvitārthināṃ /
carturgavaṃ nṛśaṃsānāṃ dvigavaṃ dharmaghātināṃ //
meaning:
हलमष्टगवं धर्म्यं षड्गवं जीवितार्थिनां /
चर्तुर्गवं नृशंसानां द्विगवं धर्मघातिनां //
text_mt: A plow with eight oxen is righteous; with six oxen, for those seeking a livelihood; / with four oxen, for the cruel; with two oxen, for the slayers of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtāmṛtābhyāṃ jīveta mṛtena pramṛtena vā /
satyānṛtābhyāmapivā na svavṛttyā kadā ca na //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe gṛhasthavṛttayo nāma
vripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
brahmacaryāśramadharmaḥ
meaning:
ऋतामृताभ्यां जीवेत मृतेन प्रमृतेन वा /
सत्यानृताभ्यामपिवा न स्ववृत्त्या कदा च न //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे गृहस्थवृत्तयो नाम
व्रिपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ त्रिपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमधर्मः
text_mt:
He may live by the gleaning or the ungleaned, by what is dead or what is cultivated, / or even by truth and falsehood, but never by dog-like service.
Thus ends the one hundred fifty-second chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, entitled “Livelihoods of the Householder.”
Now, the one hundred fifty-third chapter:
Duties of the Stage of Celibate Studenthood.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
dharmamāśramiṇāṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu /
ṣoḍaśartuniśā strīṇāmādyastisrastu garhitāḥ //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
धर्ममाश्रमिणां वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शृणु /
षोडशर्तुनिशा स्त्रीणामाद्यस्तिस्रस्तु गर्हिताः //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / I shall state the duty of those in the life stages, which bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation; listen. / The fertile period of women consists of sixteen nights; the first three are censured.

sanskrit_iast:
vrajedyugmāsu putrārthī karmādhānikamiṣyate /
garbhasya spaṣṭatājñāne savanaṃ spandanāt purā //
meaning:
व्रजेद्युग्मासु पुत्रार्थी कर्माधानिकमिष्यते /
गर्भस्य स्पष्टताज्ञाने सवनं स्पन्दनात् पुरा //
text_mt: Desiring a son, he should approach her on even nights; this is desired as the rite of conception. / When the embryo is clearly discerned, the rite to produce a male child [is performed] before it quickens.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhe 'ṣṭame vā sīmantaṃ putrīyaṃ nāmabhaṃ śubhaṃ /
acchinnanāḍyāṃ kartavyaṃ jātakarma vicakṣaṇaiḥ //
meaning:
षष्ठे ऽष्टमे वा सीमन्तं पुत्रीयं नामभं शुभं /
अच्छिन्ननाड्यां कर्तव्यं जातकर्म विचक्षणैः //
text_mt: In the sixth or eighth month, the parting of the hair [is performed]; an auspicious asterism suited for a son [is chosen]. / Before the umbilical cord is severed, the birth-rite must be performed by the wise.

sanskrit_iast:
aśauce tu vyatikrānte nāmakarma vidhīyate /
śarmāntaṃ brāhmasyoktaṃ varmāntaṃ kṣatriyasya tu //
meaning:
अशौचे तु व्यतिक्रान्ते नामकर्म विधीयते /
शर्मान्तं ब्राह्मस्योक्तं वर्मान्तं क्षत्रियस्य तु //
text_mt: When ritual impurity has passed, the naming rite is prescribed: / ending in -śarman is stated for a brāhmaṇa, and ending in -varman for a kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast:
guptadāsātmakaṃ nāma praśastaṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ /
:p 120
śarmāntaṃ brahmaṇasyoktaṃ varmāntaṃ kṣatriyasya ca //
meaning:
गुप्तदासात्मकं नाम प्रशस्तं वैश्यशूद्रयोः /
:प् 120
शर्मान्तं ब्रह्मणस्योक्तं वर्मान्तं क्षत्रियस्य च //
text_mt:
A name consisting of -gupta and -dāsa is commended for a vaiśya and a śūdra.
[Page] 120
Ending in -śarman is stated for a brāhmaṇa, and ending in -varman for a kṣatriya.

sanskrit_iast:
guptadāsātmakaṃ nāma praśastaṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoḥ /
bālaṃ nivedayedbhartre tava putro 'yamityuta //
meaning:
गुप्तदासात्मकं नाम प्रशस्तं वैश्यशूद्रयोः /
बालं निवेदयेद्भर्त्रे तव पुत्रो ऽयमित्युत //
text_mt: A name consisting of -gupta and -dāsa is commended for a vaiśya and a śūdra. / One should present the child to the husband, saying: “This is your son.”

sanskrit_iast:
yathākulantu cūḍākṛd brāhmaṇasyopanāyanaṃ /
garbhāṣṭame 'ṣṭame vābde garbhādekādaśe nṛpe //
meaning:
यथाकुलन्तु चूडाकृद् ब्राह्मणस्योपनायनं /
गर्भाष्टमे ऽष्टमे वाब्दे गर्भादेकादशे नृपे //
text_mt: Tonsure is performed according to family custom. The initiation of a brāhmaṇa / is in the eighth year from conception or the eighth year [from birth]; for a king, in the eleventh from conception;

sanskrit_iast:
garbhāttu dvādaśe vaiśye ṣoḍaśābdādito na hi /
muñjānāṃ valkalānāntu kramānmaujjyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
गर्भात्तु द्वादशे वैश्ये षोडशाब्दादितो न हि /
मुञ्जानां वल्कलानान्तु क्रमान्मौज्ज्याः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: in the twelfth from conception for a vaiśya; never beyond the sixteenth year. / The girdles are declared to be made of muñja grass, bark fibers, [and wool] respectively.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgavaiyādhravāstāni carmāṇi vratacāriṇāṃ /
parṇapippalavilvānāṃ kramāddaṇḍāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
मार्गवैयाध्रवास्तानि चर्माणि व्रतचारिणां /
पर्णपिप्पलविल्वानां क्रमाद्दण्डाः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Antelope, tiger, and goat skins are for those observing the vows. / The staffs are declared to be of parṇa, pippala, and bilva respectively,

sanskrit_iast:
keśadeśalalāṭāsyatulyāḥ proktāḥ krameṇa tu /
avakrāḥ satvacaḥ sarve nāvipluṣṭāstu daṇḍakāḥ //
meaning:
केशदेशललाटास्यतुल्याः प्रोक्ताः क्रमेण तु /
अवक्राः सत्वचः सर्वे नाविप्लुष्टास्तु दण्डकाः //
text_mt: reaching up to the hair line, forehead, and mouth respectively, / all unbent, with bark, and unburnt.

sanskrit_iast:
vāsopavīte kārpāsakṣaumorṇānāṃ yathākramaṃ /
ādimadhyāvasāneṣu bhavacchabdopalakṣitaṃ //
meaning:
वासोपवीते कार्पासक्षौमोर्णानां यथाक्रमं /
आदिमध्यावसानेषु भवच्छब्दोपलक्षितं //
text_mt: The upper garment and sacred thread are made of cotton, flax, and wool respectively. / Characterized by the word bhavat at the beginning, middle, and end,

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ tatra bhhikṣeta yatra bhikṣā dhruvaṃ bhavet /
strīṇāmamantratastāni vivāhastu samantrakaḥ //
meaning:
प्रथमं तत्र भ्हिक्षेत यत्र भिक्षा ध्रुवं भवेत् /
स्त्रीणाममन्त्रतस्तानि विवाहस्तु समन्त्रकः //
text_mt: he should beg first where alms are certain. / For women, those [rites] are without mantras; marriage, however, is with mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
upanīya guruḥ śiṣyaṃ sikṣayecchaucamāditaḥ /
ācāramagnikāryaṃ ca sandhyopāsanameva ca //
meaning:
उपनीय गुरुः शिष्यं सिक्षयेच्छौचमादितः /
आचारमग्निकार्यं च सन्ध्योपासनमेव च //
text_mt: Having initiated the disciple, the guru should instruct him first in ritual purity, / right conduct, the fire ritual, and the twilight worship.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkte yaśasyaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ /
śriyaṃ pratyaṅmukhī bhuṅkte ṛtaṃ bhuṅkte udaṅmukhaḥ //
meaning:
आयुष्यं प्राङ्मुखो भुङ्क्ते यशस्यं दक्षिणामुखः /
श्रियं प्रत्यङ्मुखी भुङ्क्ते ऋतं भुङ्क्ते उदङ्मुखः //
text_mt: Facing east he eats longevity; facing south he eats fame; / facing west he eats prosperity; facing north he eats truth.

sanskrit_iast:
sāyaṃ prātaś ca juhuyān nāmedhyaṃ vyastahastakaṃ /
madhu māṃsa janaiḥ sārdhaṃ gītaṃ nṛtyañca vai tyajet(1) //
:n
1 nṛtyañca varjayediti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca / sāyaṃ
prātaścetyādiḥ, nṛtyañca vai tyajedityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. pustake
nāsti
:p 121
meaning:
सायं प्रातश् च जुहुयान् नामेध्यं व्यस्तहस्तकं /
मधु मांस जनैः सार्धं गीतं नृत्यञ्च वै त्यजेत्(1) //
:न्
1 नृत्यञ्च वर्जयेदिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च / सायं
प्रातश्चेत्यादिः, नृत्यञ्च वै त्यजेदित्यन्तः पाठः ज.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
:प् 121
text_mt:
He should offer oblations evening and morning, not touch anything impure with crossed hands, / and he should abandon honey, meat, singing, and dancing with other people.
[Footnote]
1. "And he should avoid dancing" is the variant in kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, ña, and ṭa. The reading beginning with "evening and morning" and ending with "and he should abandon dancing" is missing in manuscript ja.

sanskrit_iast:
hiṃsāmparāpavādaṃ ca aślīlaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ /
daṇḍādi dhārayennaṣṭamapsu kṣiptvānyadhāraṇaṃ //
meaning:
हिंसाम्परापवादं च अश्लीलं च विशेषतः /
दण्डादि धारयेन्नष्टमप्सु क्षिप्त्वान्यधारणं //
text_mt: Violence, blaming others, and especially vulgar speech [must be avoided]. / When the staff and other articles are damaged, he should throw them into the water and take others.

sanskrit_iast: vedasvīkaraṇaṃ kṛtvā srāyādvai dattadakṣiṇaḥ /
meaning: वेदस्वीकरणं कृत्वा स्रायाद्वै दत्तदक्षिणः /
text_mt: Having mastered the Veda and having given the sacrificial fee, he should bathe [as an initiate];

sanskrit_iast:
17cd /. naiṣṭhiko brahmacārī vā dehāntaṃ nivasedgurau //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe brahmacaryāśramo nāma
tripañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha catuḥpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vivāhaḥ
meaning:
17च्द् /. नैष्ठिको ब्रह्मचारी वा देहान्तं निवसेद्गुरौ //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे ब्रह्मचर्याश्रमो नाम
त्रिपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ चतुःपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
विवाहः
text_mt:
or, as a lifelong celibate student, he should reside with the guru until the end of his body.
Thus ends the one hundred fifty-third chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, entitled “The Stage of Celibate Studenthood.”
Now, the one hundred fifty-fourth chapter:
Marriage.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
vipraś catasro vindeta bhāryāstisrastu bhūmipaḥ /
dve ca vaiśyo yathākāmaṃ bhāryaikāmapi cāntyajaḥ //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
विप्रश् चतस्रो विन्देत भार्यास्तिस्रस्तु भूमिपः /
द्वे च वैश्यो यथाकामं भार्यैकामपि चान्त्यजः //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / A brāhmaṇa may take four wives; a king, three; / a vaiśya, two, according to desire; and the lowest born, one wife.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmakāryāṇi sarvāṇi na kāryāṇyasavarṇayā /
pāṇirgrāhyaḥ savarṇāsu gṛhṇīyāt ksatriyā śaraṃ //
meaning:
धर्मकार्याणि सर्वाणि न कार्याण्यसवर्णया /
पाणिर्ग्राह्यः सवर्णासु गृह्णीयात् क्सत्रिया शरं //
text_mt: All acts of dharma are not to be performed with a wife of another caste. / The hand is to be taken among women of the same caste; a kṣatriya woman should hold an arrow;

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśyā pratīdamādadyāddaśāṃ vai cāntyajā tathā /
sakṛt kanyā pradātavyā haraṃstāṃ cauradaṇḍabhāk //
meaning:
वैश्या प्रतीदमादद्याद्दशां वै चान्त्यजा तथा /
सकृत् कन्या प्रदातव्या हरंस्तां चौरदण्डभाक् //
text_mt: a vaiśyā should take a goad, and the lowest-born woman the skirt of a garment. / A maiden is to be given away only once; one who abducts her incurs the punishment of a thief.

sanskrit_iast:
apatyavikrayāsakte niṣkṛtir na vidhīyate /
kanyādānaṃ śacīyogo(1) vivāho 'tha caturthikā //
:n
1 satīyoga iti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 122
meaning:
अपत्यविक्रयासक्ते निष्कृतिर् न विधीयते /
कन्यादानं शचीयोगो(1) विवाहो ऽथ चतुर्थिका //
:न्
1 सतीयोग इति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 122
text_mt:
For one intent on the sale of offspring, no expiation is prescribed. / The giving of a maiden, the union with Indrāṇī, the wedding, and the rite of the fourth day:
[Footnote]
1. "The union with a virtuous woman" is the variant in kha and cha.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhametat kathitaṃ nāmakarmacatuṣṭayaṃ /
naṣṭe mṛte pravrajite klīve ca patite patau //
meaning:
विवाहमेतत् कथितं नामकर्मचतुष्टयं /
नष्टे मृते प्रव्रजिते क्लीवे च पतिते पतौ //
text_mt: this fourfold named rite is declared to constitute marriage. / If the husband is disappeared, dead, renounced, impotent, or degraded,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcasvāpatsu nārīṇāṃ patiranyo vidhīyate /
mṛte tu devare deyāt tadabhāve yathecchayā //
meaning:
पञ्चस्वापत्सु नारीणां पतिरन्यो विधीयते /
मृते तु देवरे देयात् तदभावे यथेच्छया //
text_mt: in these five misfortunes another husband is prescribed for women. / Upon his death, she should be given to a brother-in-law; in his absence, as she pleases.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvātritayamāgneyaṃ vāyavyaṃ cottarātrayaṃ /
rohiṇau ceti caraṇe bhagaṇaḥ śasyate sadā //
meaning:
पूर्वात्रितयमाग्नेयं वायव्यं चोत्तरात्रयं /
रोहिणौ चेति चरणे भगणः शस्यते सदा //
