text_mt: The triad of Pūrvā asterisms, the Āgneya, the Vāyavya, the triad of Uttarā asterisms, / and the two Rohiṇīs—these asterisms are always commended in the foot.

sanskrit_iast:
naikagotrāntu varayennaikārṣeyāñca bhārgava /
pitṛtaḥ saptamādūrdhvaṃ mātṛtaḥ pañcamāttathā //
meaning:
नैकगोत्रान्तु वरयेन्नैकार्षेयाञ्च भार्गव /
पितृतः सप्तमादूर्ध्वं मातृतः पञ्चमात्तथा //
text_mt: One should not choose a maiden of the same gotra or same ancestral lineage, O descendant of Bhṛgu; / [she should be] beyond the seventh degree on the father's side and beyond the fifth from the mother's side.

sanskrit_iast:
āhūya dānaṃ brāhmaḥ syāt kulaśīlayutāya tu /
puruṣāṃstārayettajjo nityaṃ kanyapradānataḥ //
meaning:
आहूय दानं ब्राह्मः स्यात् कुलशीलयुताय तु /
पुरुषांस्तारयेत्तज्जो नित्यं कन्यप्रदानतः //
text_mt: The gift [of a maiden] after having invited a man endowed with good lineage and conduct is the Brāhma rite; / one born of that [union] always liberates his ancestors through the gift of the maiden.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā gomithunādānādvivāhastvārṣa ucyate /
prārthitā dīyate yasya prājāpatyaḥ sa dharmakṛt //
meaning:
तथा गोमिथुनादानाद्विवाहस्त्वार्ष उच्यते /
प्रार्थिता दीयते यस्य प्राजापत्यः स धर्मकृत् //
text_mt: So too, by the receipt of a pair of cattle, a marriage is said to be Ārṣa. / The Prājāpatya rite, which produces merit, is that where she is given when requested.

sanskrit_iast:
śulkena cāsuro mando gāndharvo varaṇānmithaḥ /
rākṣaso yuddhaharaṇāt paiśācaḥ kanyakācchalāt //
meaning:
शुल्केन चासुरो मन्दो गान्धर्वो वरणान्मिथः /
राक्षसो युद्धहरणात् पैशाचः कन्यकाच्छलात् //
text_mt: The Asura is inferior, by means of a bride-price; the Gāndharva is by mutual choice; / the Rākṣasa is by taking by battle; the Paiśāca is through deceit of the maiden.

sanskrit_iast:
vaivāhike 'hni(1) kurvīta kumbhakāramṛdā śucīṃ /
jalāśaye tu tāṃ pūjya vādyādyaiḥ(2) strīṃ gṛhatrayet //
meaning:
वैवाहिके ऽह्नि(1) कुर्वीत कुम्भकारमृदा शुचीं /
जलाशये तु तां पूज्य वाद्याद्यैः(2) स्त्रीं गृहत्रयेत् //
text_mt: On the day of marriage, one should purify [the earth] using clay from a potter; / having worshipped it at a reservoir of water with musical instruments and the like, [the women] should take the woman to the house.

sanskrit_iast:
praśupte keśave naiva vivāhaḥ kārya eva hi /
poṣe caitre kujadine riktāviṣṭitatho na ca //
meaning:
प्रशुप्ते केशवे नैव विवाहः कार्य एव हि /
पोषे चैत्रे कुजदिने रिक्ताविष्टितथो न च //
text_mt: Marriage should not be performed when Keśava is asleep, / nor in Pauṣa, Caitra, on Tuesday, or on an empty lunar day (riktā) or viṣṭi (karaṇa).

sanskrit_iast:
na śukrajīve 'stamite na śaśāṅke grahārdite /
arkārkabhaumayukte bhe vyatīpātahate na hi //
meaning:
न शुक्रजीवे ऽस्तमिते न शशाङ्के ग्रहार्दिते /
अर्कार्कभौमयुक्ते भे व्यतीपातहते न हि //
text_mt: Nor when Venus or Jupiter has set; nor when the moon is afflicted by a planet; / not under a constellation joined with the Sun, Saturn, or Mars, nor when struck by Vyatīpāta.

sanskrit_iast:
somyaṃ pitryañca vāyavyaṃ sāvitraṃ rohiṇī tathā /
:n
1 vaivāhikebde iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
2 vādyaughair iti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
:p 123
uttarātritayaṃ mūlaṃ maitraṃ pauṣṇaṃ vivāhabhaṃ //
meaning:
सोम्यं पित्र्यञ्च वायव्यं सावित्रं रोहिणी तथा /
:न्
1 वैवाहिकेब्दे इति घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
2 वाद्यौघैर् इति ग.. , घ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 123
उत्तरात्रितयं मूलं मैत्रं पौष्णं विवाहभं //
text_mt:
Mṛgaśīrṣā (saumya), Maghā (pitrya), Svātī (vāyavya), Hasta (sāvitra), and Rohiṇī,
:n
1 'vaivāhikebde' in gha, ṅa, ña, and ṭa.
2 'vādyaughaiḥ' in ga, gha, and ña.
:p 123
the triad of Uttarās (Uttaraphālgunī, Uttarāṣāḍhā, Uttarabhādrapadā), Mūla, Anurādhā (maitra), and Revatī (pauṣṇa)—these are the marriage asterisms.

sanskrit_iast:
mānuṣākhyas tathā lagno mānuṣākhyāṃśakaḥ śubhaḥ /
tṛtīye ca tathā ṣaṣṭhe daśamaikādaśe 'ṣṭame //
meaning:
मानुषाख्यस् तथा लग्नो मानुषाख्यांशकः शुभः /
तृतीये च तथा षष्ठे दशमैकादशे ऽष्टमे //
text_mt: An ascendant called human (mānuṣa) and a navāṃśa called human are auspicious. / In the third, sixth, tenth, eleventh, and eighth [houses],

sanskrit_iast:
arkārkicandatanayāḥ praśastā na kujo 'ṣṭamaḥ /
saptāntyāṣṭamavargeṣu śeṣāḥ śastā grahottamāḥ //
meaning:
अर्कार्किचन्दतनयाः प्रशस्ता न कुजो ऽष्टमः /
सप्तान्त्याष्टमवर्गेषु शेषाः शस्ता ग्रहोत्तमाः //
text_mt: the Sun, Saturn, and Mercury (candratanaya) are praised; Mars in the eighth is not [praised]. / In the seventh, twelfth, and eighth divisions, the remaining excellent planets are praised.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmapi tathā madhyāt ṣaṣṭhaḥ śukro na śasyate /
vaivāhike bhe kartavyā tathaiva ca caturthikā //
meaning:
तेषामपि तथा मध्यात् षष्ठः शुक्रो न शस्यते /
वैवाहिके भे कर्तव्या तथैव च चतुर्थिका //
text_mt: Among them, Venus in the sixth is not commended. / The fourth-day rite (caturthikā) likewise should be performed under the marriage asterism.

sanskrit_iast:
na dātavyā grahāstatra caturādyāstathaikagāḥ /
parvavarjaṃ striyaṃ gacchet satyā dattā sadā ratiḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe vivāho nāma
satuḥpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
ācāraḥ
meaning:
न दातव्या ग्रहास्तत्र चतुराद्यास्तथैकगाः /
पर्ववर्जं स्त्रियं गच्छेत् सत्या दत्ता सदा रतिः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे विवाहो नाम
सतुःपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
आचारः
text_mt:
Planets in the fourth and other houses, or occupying one [house], should not be given. / Avoiding the parvan days, one should approach his wife; sexual enjoyment given to a truthful wife is constant.
Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-fourth chapter, named 'Marriage,' in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now begins the one hundred and fifty-fifth chapter.
Right Conduct.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
brāhme muhūrte cotthāya viṣṇvādīn daivatān smaret /
ubhe mūtrapurīṣe tu divā kuryādudaṅmukhaḥ //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
ब्राह्मे मुहूर्ते चोत्थाय विष्ण्वादीन् दैवतान् स्मरेत् /
उभे मूत्रपुरीषे तु दिवा कुर्यादुदङ्मुखः //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / Rising at the hour of Brahmā (brāhmamuhūrta), one should remember the deities headed by Viṣṇu. / Facing north, one should pass both urine and feces by day;

sanskrit_iast:
rātau ca dakṣiṇe kuryādubhe sandhye yathā divā /
na mārgādau jale vīpyāṃ satṛṇāyāṃ sadācaret //
:p 124
meaning:
रातौ च दक्षिणे कुर्यादुभे सन्ध्ये यथा दिवा /
न मार्गादौ जले वीप्यां सतृणायां सदाचरेत् //
:प् 124
text_mt:
and by night, one should do so facing south; at both twilights, as by day. / One must never do so on a road, in water, in a well, or on grass.
:p 124

sanskrit_iast:
śaucaṃ kṛtvā mṛdācamya bhakṣayeddantadhāvanaṃ /
nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ kriyāṅgaṃ malakarṣaṇaṃ //
meaning:
शौचं कृत्वा मृदाचम्य भक्षयेद्दन्तधावनं /
नित्यं नैमित्तिकं काम्यं क्रियाङ्गं मलकर्षणं //
text_mt: Having performed purification with earth and sipped water (ācamana), one should use a tooth-stick. / Daily, occasional, motivated, ancillary to rites, and removal of impurities—

sanskrit_iast:
kriyāsnānaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ ṣoḍhāsnānaṃ prakīrtitaṃ /
asnātasyāphalaṃ karma prātaḥsnānaṃ carettataḥ //
meaning:
क्रियास्नानं तथा षष्ठं षोढास्नानं प्रकीर्तितं /
अस्नातस्याफलं कर्म प्रातःस्नानं चरेत्ततः //
text_mt: together with bathing for ritual actions as the sixth—bathing is declared to be sixfold. / The work of one who has not bathed bears no fruit; therefore, one should perform the morning bath.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiṣṭhamuddhṛtāt puṇyaṃ tataḥ prasravaṇodakaṃ /
tato 'pi sārasaṃ puṇyaṃ tasmānnādeyamucyate //
meaning:
भूमिष्ठमुद्धृतात् पुण्यं ततः प्रस्रवणोदकं /
ततो ऽपि सारसं पुण्यं तस्मान्नादेयमुच्यते //
text_mt: Water found on the ground is more meritorious than drawn water; spring water is more meritorious than that; / lake water is more meritorious than that; river water is declared to be even more meritorious than that;

sanskrit_iast:
tīrthatoyaṃ tataḥ puṇyaṃ gāṅgaṃ puṇyantu sarvataḥ /
saṃśodhitamalaḥ pūrvaṃ nimagnaś ca jalāśaye //
meaning:
तीर्थतोयं ततः पुण्यं गाङ्गं पुण्यन्तु सर्वतः /
संशोधितमलः पूर्वं निमग्नश् च जलाशये //
text_mt: water from a sacred ford (tīrtha) is more meritorious than that, but water from the Gaṅgā is meritorious above all. / Having first washed away impurities and submerged himself in a body of water,

sanskrit_iast:
upaspṛśya tataḥ kuryādambhasaḥ parimārjanaṃ /
hiraṇyavarṇāstisṛbhiḥ śanno devīti cāpyatha //
meaning:
उपस्पृश्य ततः कुर्यादम्भसः परिमार्जनं /
हिरण्यवर्णास्तिसृभिः शन्नो देवीति चाप्यथ //
text_mt: and having touched water (upaspṛśya), one should then sprinkle oneself with water, / reciting the three verses beginning with 'hiraṇyavarṇāḥ' and also 'śanno devīḥ',

sanskrit_iast:
āpohiṣṭheti tisṛbhiridamāpastathaiva ca /
tato jalāśaye magnaḥ kuryādantarjalaṃ japaṃ //
meaning:
आपोहिष्ठेति तिसृभिरिदमापस्तथैव च /
ततो जलाशये मग्नः कुर्यादन्तर्जलं जपं //
text_mt: with the three verses beginning with 'āpo hi ṣṭhā', and likewise 'idam āpaḥ'. / Then, submerged in the reservoir of water, one should perform recitation under water.

sanskrit_iast:
tatrāghamarṣaṇaṃ sūktaṃ drupadāṃ vā tathā japet /
yuñjate mana ity evaṃ sūktaṃ sūktaṃ vāpyatha pauruṣaṃ //
meaning:
तत्राघमर्षणं सूक्तं द्रुपदां वा तथा जपेत् /
युञ्जते मन इत्य् एवं सूक्तं सूक्तं वाप्यथ पौरुषं //
text_mt: There one should recite the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn, or the Drupadā hymn, / or the hymn 'yuñjate manaḥ', or the Puruṣa hymn (pauruṣasūkta).

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrīṃ tu viśeṣeṇa aghamarṣaṇasūktake /
devatā bhāvavṛttastu ṛṣiś caivāghamarṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
गायत्रीं तु विशेषेण अघमर्षणसूक्तके /
देवता भाववृत्तस्तु ऋषिश् चैवाघमर्षणः //
text_mt: Especially the Gāyatrī. In the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn, / the deity is Bhāvavṛtta, and the sage is Aghamarṣaṇa;

sanskrit_iast:
chandaścānuṣṭubhaṃ tasya bhāvavṛtto hariḥ smṛtaḥ /
āpīḍamānaḥ śāṭīṃ tu devatāpitṛtarpaṇaṃ(1) //
meaning:
छन्दश्चानुष्टुभं तस्य भाववृत्तो हरिः स्मृतः /
आपीडमानः शाटीं तु देवतापितृतर्पणं(1) //
text_mt: its metre is anuṣṭubh, and Hari is remembered as Bhāvavṛtta. / Wringing out his garment, he should offer libations (tarpaṇa) to the deities and ancestors.

sanskrit_iast:
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena dadeccaivodakāñjaliṃ /
tato 'gnihavanaṃ(2) kuryāddānaṃ datvā(3) tu śaktitaḥ //
:n
1 tatrāghamarṣaṇamityādiḥ devatāpitṛtarpaṇamityantaḥ
pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
2 tato 'gniharaṇamiti ṅa.. , cha.. ca
3 dīpaṃ datveti jha..
:p 125
meaning:
पौरुषेण तु सूक्तेन ददेच्चैवोदकाञ्जलिं /
ततो ऽग्निहवनं(2) कुर्याद्दानं दत्वा(3) तु शक्तितः //
:न्
1 तत्राघमर्षणमित्यादिः देवतापितृतर्पणमित्यन्तः
पाठः झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
2 ततो ऽग्निहरणमिति ङ.. , छ.. च
3 दीपं दत्वेति झ..
:प् 125
text_mt:
With the Puruṣa hymn, he should offer a handful of water. / Then he should perform the fire-oblation (agnihavana), having given a gift according to his ability.
:n
1 The passage from 'tatrāghamarṣaṇam' to 'devatāpitṛtarpaṇam' is not in manuscript jha.
2 'tato 'gniharaṇam' in ṅa and cha.
3 'dīpaṃ datvā' in jha.
:p 125

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samabhigaccheta yogākṣemārthamīśvaraṃ /
āsanaṃ śayanaṃ yānaṃ jāyāpatyaṅkamaṇḍaluḥ //
meaning:
ततः समभिगच्छेत योगाक्षेमार्थमीश्वरं /
आसनं शयनं यानं जायापत्यङ्कमण्डलुः //
text_mt: Then he should approach the lord for the sake of prosperity and security (yogakṣema). / One's seat, bed, vehicle, wife, child, and water-pot—

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanaḥ śuciretāni pareṣāṃ na śucirbhavet /
bhārākrāntasya gurviṇyāḥ panthā deyo guruṣvapi //
meaning:
आत्मनः शुचिरेतानि परेषां न शुचिर्भवेत् /
भाराक्रान्तस्य गुर्विण्याः पन्था देयो गुरुष्वपि //
text_mt: these are pure for oneself; they are not pure for others. / Way should be given to one laden with a burden, to a pregnant woman, and to elders.

sanskrit_iast:
na paśyeccārkamudyantannāstaṃ yāntaṃ na cāmbhasi /
nekṣennagnāṃ striyaṃ kūpaṃ śūnāsthānamaghaughinaṃ //
meaning:
न पश्येच्चार्कमुद्यन्तन्नास्तं यान्तं न चाम्भसि /
नेक्षेन्नग्नां स्त्रियं कूपं शूनास्थानमघौघिनं //
text_mt: One should not look at the rising sun, nor at it setting, nor in water; / one should not look at a naked woman, into a well, at a slaughterhouse, or at a heap of sins.

sanskrit_iast:
kārpāsāthi tayā bhasma nākrāmed yacca kutsitaṃ /
antaḥpuraṃ vittigṛhaṃ paradautyaṃ brajenna hi(1) //
meaning:
कार्पासाथि तया भस्म नाक्रामेद् यच्च कुत्सितं /
अन्तःपुरं वित्तिगृहं परदौत्यं ब्रजेन्न हि(1) //
text_mt: One should not step on cotton seeds, bones, or ashes, or anything contemptible; / nor enter the royal women's quarters, the house of finance, or undertake another's embassy.

sanskrit_iast:
nārohedviṣamānnāvanna vṛkṣaṃ na ca parvataṃ /
arthāyatanaśāstreṣu tathaiva syāt kutūhalī //
meaning:
नारोहेद्विषमान्नावन्न वृक्षं न च पर्वतं /
अर्थायतनशास्त्रेषु तथैव स्यात् कुतूहली //
text_mt: One should not board a precarious boat, nor climb a tree or a mountain; / one should likewise be curious about treatises dealing with the acquisition of wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
loṣṭamardo tṛṇacchedī nakhakhādī vinaśyati /
mukhādivādanaṃ nehed vinā dīpaṃ na rātrigaḥ(2) //
meaning:
लोष्टमर्दो तृणच्छेदी नखखादी विनश्यति /
मुखादिवादनं नेहेद् विना दीपं न रात्रिगः(2) //
text_mt: One who crushes clods of earth, tears grass, or bites nails perishes. / One should not make sounds with one's mouth or the like; one should not walk at night without a lamp.

sanskrit_iast:
nādvāreṇa viśedveśma na ca vaktraṃ virāgayet /
kathābhaṅgaṃ na kurvīta na ca vāsoviparyayaṃ //
meaning:
नाद्वारेण विशेद्वेश्म न च वक्त्रं विरागयेत् /
कथाभङ्गं न कुर्वीत न च वासोविपर्ययं //
text_mt: One should not enter a house except by the door, nor make a distorted face; / one should not interrupt a conversation, nor wear clothes inside out.

sanskrit_iast:
bhadraṃ bhadramiti brūyānnāniṣṭaṃ kīrtayet kvacit /
pālāśamāsanaṃ varjyaṃ devādicchāyayā(3) vrajet //
meaning:
भद्रं भद्रमिति ब्रूयान्नानिष्टं कीर्तयेत् क्वचित् /
पालाशमासनं वर्ज्यं देवादिच्छायया(3) व्रजेत् //
text_mt: One should say 'auspicious, auspicious', and never mention what is disagreeable. / A seat of palāśa wood is to be avoided; one should walk through the shadow of deities and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
na madhye pūjyayoryāyāt nocchiṣṭastārakādidṛk /
nadyānnānyāṃ nadīṃ brūyānna kaṇḍūyed dvihastakaṃ //
meaning:
न मध्ये पूज्ययोर्यायात् नोच्छिष्टस्तारकादिदृक् /
नद्यान्नान्यां नदीं ब्रूयान्न कण्डूयेद् द्विहस्तकं //
text_mt: One should not walk between two venerable persons, nor look at the stars or the like while impure with food remnants; / one should not speak of one river while at another, nor scratch with both hands.

sanskrit_iast:
asantarpya pitṝn devānnadīpārañca na vrajet /
malādiprakṣipennāpsu(4) na nagnaḥ snānamācaret //
:n
1 parabhṛto bhavenna hi iti jha..
2 loṣṭamaddītyādiḥ, na rātriga ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ, ga.pustake
nāsti
3 devādricchāyayeti kha.. , cha.. , ga.. ca
4 malādikṣepayennāpsu iti kha.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 126
meaning:
असन्तर्प्य पितॄन् देवान्नदीपारञ्च न व्रजेत् /
मलादिप्रक्षिपेन्नाप्सु(4) न नग्नः स्नानमाचरेत् //
:न्
1 परभृतो भवेन्न हि इति झ..
2 लोष्टमद्दीत्यादिः, न रात्रिग इत्य् अन्तः पाठः, ग.पुस्तके
नास्ति
3 देवाद्रिच्छाययेति ख.. , छ.. , ग.. च
4 मलादिक्षेपयेन्नाप्सु इति ख.. , ट.. च
:प् 126
text_mt:
Without satisfying the ancestors and the deities, one should not cross to the other side of a river. / One should not throw excrement or the like into water, nor bathe naked.
:n
1 'parabhṛto bhaven na hi' in jha.
2 The passage from 'loṣṭamaddī' to 'na rātrigaḥ' is missing in manuscript ga.
3 'devādricchāyayā' in kha, cha, and ga.
4 'malādikṣepayennāpsu' in kha and ṭa.
:p 126

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ samabhigaccheta yogakṣemārthamīśvaraṃ /
srajannātmanāppanayet kharādikarajastyajet //
meaning:
ततः समभिगच्छेत योगक्षेमार्थमीश्वरं /
स्रजन्नात्मनाप्पनयेत् खरादिकरजस्त्यजेत् //
text_mt: Then he should approach the lord for the sake of prosperity and security. / One should not remove a garland oneself; one should discard dust from donkeys and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
hīnānnāvahaset gacchennādeśe niyasecca taiḥ /
vaidyarājanadīhīne mlecchastrībahunāyake //
meaning:
हीनान्नावहसेत् गच्छेन्नादेशे नियसेच्च तैः /
वैद्यराजनदीहीने म्लेच्छस्त्रीबहुनायके //
text_mt: One should not mock inferior persons, nor reside with them in an improper place, / or in a place lacking physicians, a king, or a river, or where barbarians, women, or many leaders rule.

sanskrit_iast:
rajasvalādipatitair na bhāṣeta keśavaṃ smaret /
nāsaṃvṛtamukhaḥ kuryāddhāsaṃ(1) jṛmbhāṃ tathā kṣutaṃ //
meaning:
रजस्वलादिपतितैर् न भाषेत केशवं स्मरेत् /
नासंवृतमुखः कुर्याद्धासं(1) जृम्भां तथा क्षुतं //
text_mt: One should not converse with menstruating women or fallen outcasts; one should remember Keśava. / One should not laugh, yawn, or sneeze without covering one's mouth.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhorapyavamanaṃ khadgopayedvacanaṃ budhaḥ /
indriyāṇāṃ nānukūlī vedarodhaṃ na kārayet //
meaning:
प्रभोरप्यवमनं खद्गोपयेद्वचनं बुधः /
इन्द्रियाणां नानुकूली वेदरोधं न कारयेत् //
text_mt: Even if the master shows disrespect, a wise man should conceal his speech. / He should not indulge the senses, nor cause obstruction to the Vedas.

sanskrit_iast:
nopekṣitavyo vyādhiḥ syādripuralpo 'pi(2) bhārgava /
rathyātigaḥ sadācāmet(3) vibhṛyānnāgnivāriṇī //
meaning:
नोपेक्षितव्यो व्याधिः स्याद्रिपुरल्पो ऽपि(2) भार्गव /
रथ्यातिगः सदाचामेत्(3) विभृयान्नाग्निवारिणी //
text_mt: A disease should not be ignored, nor an enemy even if small, O descendant of Bhṛgu. / One who crosses a street should always sip water; one should not carry fire and water [together].

sanskrit_iast:
na huṅkuryācchivaṃ pūjyaṃ pādaṃ pādena nākramet /
pratyakṣaṃ vā parokṣaṃ vā kasya cinnāpriyaṃ vadet //
meaning:
न हुङ्कुर्याच्छिवं पूज्यं पादं पादेन नाक्रमेत् /
प्रत्यक्षं वा परोक्षं वा कस्य चिन्नाप्रियं वदेत् //
text_mt: One should not utter 'hum' against Śiva or a venerable person; one should not step on foot with foot; / one should not speak unpleasant words to anyone, whether directly or behind their back.

sanskrit_iast:
vedaśāstranarendrarṣidevanindāṃ vivarjayet /
strīṇāmīrṣā(4) na kartavyā triśvāsantāsu varjayet //
meaning:
वेदशास्त्रनरेन्द्रर्षिदेवनिन्दां विवर्जयेत् /
स्त्रीणामीर्षा(4) न कर्तव्या त्रिश्वासन्तासु वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: One should avoid reviling the Vedas, treatises, kings, sages, and gods. / Jealousy should not be felt toward women; in three situations, one should avoid them.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaśrutiṃ devaratiṃ(5) kuryāddharmādi nityaśaḥ(6) /
somasya pūjāṃ janmarkṣe vipradevādipūjanaṃ //
:n
1 kuryāddhāsyamiti kha.. ,ṭa.. ca
2 ripurvatsopi iti ṅa..
3 samācāmediti cha..
4 strīṇāmiccheti ka..
5 devanatimiti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca / vedanatimiti kha.. ,cha.. ca
6 bhadraṃ bhadramiti brūyādityādiḥ, kuryāddharmādi nityaśa ity
antaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
:p 127
meaning:
धर्मश्रुतिं देवरतिं(5) कुर्याद्धर्मादि नित्यशः(6) /
सोमस्य पूजां जन्मर्क्षे विप्रदेवादिपूजनं //
:न्
1 कुर्याद्धास्यमिति ख.. ,ट.. च
2 रिपुर्वत्सोपि इति ङ..
3 समाचामेदिति छ..
4 स्त्रीणामिच्छेति क..
5 देवनतिमिति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च / वेदनतिमिति ख.. ,छ.. च
6 भद्रं भद्रमिति ब्रूयादित्यादिः, कुर्याद्धर्मादि नित्यश इत्य्
अन्तः पाठः झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 127
text_mt:
One should always listen to dharma, take delight in the gods, and practice dharma and the like daily; / one should worship the Moon, and worship brāhmaṇas, gods, and the like on one's birth asterism.
:n
1 'kuryāddhāsyam' in kha and ṭa.
2 'ripur vatsopi' in ṅa.
3 'samācāmet' in cha.
4 "strīṇāmiccha" in manuscript ka.
5 "devanatim" in ga, gha, ṅa, ña, and ṭa; / "vedanatim" in kha and cha.
6 The reading beginning with "bhadraṃ bhadramiti brūyāt" and ending with "kuryāddharmādi nityaśaḥ" is absent in manuscript jha. / [Page 127]

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṣṭhīcaturdaśyaṣṭamyāmabhyaṅgaṃ varjayettathā /
dūrādgṛhān mūtraviṣṭhe nottamaivairamācaret //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe ācārādhyāyo nāma
pañcapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dravyacuddhiḥ
meaning:
षष्ठीचतुर्दश्यष्टम्यामभ्यङ्गं वर्जयेत्तथा /
दूराद्गृहान् मूत्रविष्ठे नोत्तमैवैरमाचरेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे आचाराध्यायो नाम
पञ्चपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षट्पञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
द्रव्यचुद्धिः
text_mt:
Likewise, one should avoid anointing oneself with oil on the sixth, fourteenth, and eighth [tithis]. / One should pass urine and feces far from the house, and not practice enmity against superiors.
Thus ends the one hundred fifty-fifth chapter, titled "Proper Conduct", in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred fifty-sixth chapter.
Purification of Materials

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
dravyaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi punaḥpākena mṛṇmayaṃ /
śuddhyen mūtrapurīṣādyaiḥ spṛṣṭāmraṃ suvarṇakaṃ //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
द्रव्यशुद्धिं प्रवक्ष्यामि पुनःपाकेन मृण्मयं /
शुद्ध्येन् मूत्रपुरीषाद्यैः स्पृष्टाम्रं सुवर्णकं //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / I shall explain the purification of materials. An earthenware vessel is purified by rebaking. / Gold touched by urine, feces, and the like, [is purified by melting],

sanskrit_iast:
āvartitañcānyathā tu vāriṇāmllena tāmrakaṃ /
kṣāreṇa kāṃsyalohānāṃ muktādeḥ kṣālanena tu //
meaning:
आवर्तितञ्चान्यथा तु वारिणाम्ल्लेन ताम्रकं /
क्षारेण कांस्यलोहानां मुक्तादेः क्षालनेन तु //
text_mt: and by being remelted. Otherwise, copper is purified with acid water, / bell-metal and iron with alkaline ash, and pearls and the like with washing.

sanskrit_iast:
abjānāṃ(1) caiva bhāṇḍānāṃ sarvasyāśmamayasya ca /
śākarajjumūlaphalavaidalānāṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
अब्जानां(1) चैव भाण्डानां सर्वस्याश्ममयस्य च /
शाकरज्जुमूलफलवैदलानां तथैव च //
text_mt: And [the purification] of lotus-derived vessels and everything made of stone, / and likewise of vegetables, ropes, roots, fruits, and split-reed items,

sanskrit_iast:
mārjanādyajñapātrāṇāṃ pāṇinā yajñakarmaṇi /
uṣṇāmbunā sasnehānāṃ śuddhiḥ sammārjanādgṛhe //
:n
1 duṣṭānāmiti ṭa..
:p 128
meaning:
मार्जनाद्यज्ञपात्राणां पाणिना यज्ञकर्मणि /
उष्णाम्बुना सस्नेहानां शुद्धिः सम्मार्जनाद्गृहे //
:न्
1 दुष्टानामिति ट..
:प् 128
text_mt:
is by wiping; of sacrificial vessels, by the hand during the sacrificial rite; / of oily objects, with hot water; and in the house, purity is achieved by sweeping.
[Note]
1 "duṣṭānām" in ṭa. / [Page 128]

sanskrit_iast:
śodhanānmrakṣaṇādvastre(1) mṛttikādbhirviśodhanaṃ /
bahuvastre prokṣaṇācca dāravāṇāñca takṣaṇāt //
meaning:
शोधनान्म्रक्षणाद्वस्त्रे(1) मृत्तिकाद्भिर्विशोधनं /
बहुवस्त्रे प्रोक्षणाच्च दारवाणाञ्च तक्षणात् //
text_mt: Purification of cloth is by cleansing or washing with earth and water; / for a large amount of cloth, by sprinkling; and for wooden objects, by planing.

sanskrit_iast:
prokṣaṇāt saṃhatānāntu dravāṇāñca tathotplavāt /
śayanāsanayānānāṃ śūrpasya śakaṭasya ca //
meaning:
प्रोक्षणात् संहतानान्तु द्रवाणाञ्च तथोत्प्लवात् /
शयनासनयानानां शूर्पस्य शकटस्य च //
text_mt: Solid objects [in large amounts] are purified by sprinkling, and liquids by skimming off. / Of beds, seats, vehicles, winnowing baskets, and carts,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhiḥ samprokṣaṇāj jñeyā palālendhanayos tathā /
śuddhārthakānāṅkalkena śṛṅgadantamayasya ca //
meaning:
शुद्धिः सम्प्रोक्षणाज् ज्ञेया पलालेन्धनयोस् तथा /
शुद्धार्थकानाङ्कल्केन शृङ्गदन्तमयस्य च //
text_mt: purification should be known to be by sprinkling; likewise of straw and firewood. / Items meant for purification [are cleaned] with paste; of horn and ivory items,

sanskrit_iast:
gobālaiḥ palapātrāṇāmasthnāṃ syācchṛṅgavattathā /
niryāsānāṃ guḍānāñca lavaṇānāṃ ca śoṣaṇāt //
meaning:
गोबालैः पलपात्राणामस्थ्नां स्याच्छृङ्गवत्तथा /
निर्यासानां गुडानाञ्च लवणानां च शोषणात् //
text_mt: and of meat vessels, [purification is] by cow hair; of bones, it is like horn. / Of resins, jaggery, and salts, [it is] by drying.

sanskrit_iast:
kuśumbhakusumānāñca ūrṇākārpāsayos tathā /
śuddhannadīgataṃ toyaṃ puṇyantadvat prasāritaṃ //
meaning:
कुशुम्भकुसुमानाञ्च ऊर्णाकार्पासयोस् तथा /
शुद्धन्नदीगतं तोयं पुण्यन्तद्वत् प्रसारितं //
text_mt: And likewise of safflower blossoms, wool, and cotton. / Water located in a river is pure, and holy likewise when drawn out.

sanskrit_iast:
mukhavarjañca gauḥ śuddhā śuddhamaśvājayormukhaṃ /
nārīṇāñcaiva vatsānāṃ śakunīnāṃ śuno mukhaṃ //
meaning:
मुखवर्जञ्च गौः शुद्धा शुद्धमश्वाजयोर्मुखं /
नारीणाञ्चैव वत्सानां शकुनीनां शुनो मुखं //
text_mt: A cow is pure except for its mouth; the mouth of a horse and a goat is pure. / The mouth of women, calves, birds, and dogs,

sanskrit_iast:
mukhaiḥ prasravaṇe vṛtte mṛgayāyāṃ sadā śuci /
bhuktvā kṣutvā tathā suptvā pītvā cāmbho vigāhya ca //
meaning:
मुखैः प्रस्रवणे वृत्ते मृगयायां सदा शुचि /
भुक्त्वा क्षुत्वा तथा सुप्त्वा पीत्वा चाम्भो विगाह्य च //
text_mt: when their mouths are engaged in catching prey during hunting, is always pure. / Having eaten, sneezed, slept, drunk water, bathed,

sanskrit_iast:
rathyāmākramya cācāmedvāso viparidhāya ca /
mārjāraś caṅkramācchuddhaś caturythe 'hni rajasvalā //
meaning:
रथ्यामाक्रम्य चाचामेद्वासो विपरिधाय च /
मार्जारश् चङ्क्रमाच्छुद्धश् चतुर्य्थे ऽह्नि रजस्वला //
text_mt: walked upon a public street, and changed one's garment, one should sip water. / A cat is pure while walking around. A menstruating woman [becomes pure] on the fourth day;

sanskrit_iast:
snātā strī pañcame yogyā daive pitrye ca karmaṇi /
pañcāpāne daśaikasminnubhayoḥ sapta mṛttikāḥ //
meaning:
स्नाता स्त्री पञ्चमे योग्या दैवे पित्र्ये च कर्मणि /
पञ्चापाने दशैकस्मिन्नुभयोः सप्त मृत्तिकाः //
text_mt: having bathed on the fifth day, the woman is fit for rites to the gods and ancestors. / Five [applications of] clay to the anus, ten to the left hand, and seven to both hands [are prescribed].

sanskrit_iast:
ekāṃ liṅge mṛdaṃ dadyāt karayostridvimṛttikāḥ /
brahmacārivanasthānāṃ yatīnāñca caturguṇaṃ //
meaning:
एकां लिङ्गे मृदं दद्यात् करयोस्त्रिद्विमृत्तिकाः /
ब्रह्मचारिवनस्थानां यतीनाञ्च चतुर्गुणं //
text_mt: One should apply clay once to the penis, and three and two times to both hands. / For celibate students, forest hermits, and ascetics, it is fourfold.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīphalair aṃśupaṭṭānāṃ kṣaumāṇāṅgaurasarṣapaiḥ /
:n
1 śodhanābhyukṣaṇādvastre iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
:p 129
śuddhiḥ paryukṣya toyena mṛgalomnāṃ prakīrtitā //
meaning:
श्रीफलैर् अंशुपट्टानां क्षौमाणाङ्गौरसर्षपैः /
:न्
1 शोधनाभ्युक्षणाद्वस्त्रे इति घ.. , ङ.. च
:प् 129
शुद्धिः पर्युक्ष्य तोयेन मृगलोम्नां प्रकीर्तिता //
text_mt:
[Purification] of silk cloth is with bilva fruits; of linen cloth, with white mustard seeds.
[Note]
1 "śodhanābhyukṣaṇādvastre" in gha and ṅa. / [Page 129]
Purification of deer hair is declared to be by sprinkling with water.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpāṇāñca phalānāñca prokṣaṇājjalato 'khilaṃ /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe dravyaśuddhirnāma
ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha saptapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śāvāśaucādiḥ
meaning:
पुष्पाणाञ्च फलानाञ्च प्रोक्षणाज्जलतो ऽखिलं /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे द्रव्यशुद्धिर्नाम
षट्पञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ सप्तपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
शावाशौचादिः
text_mt:
The entire [purity] of flowers and fruits is through sprinkling with water.
Thus ends the one hundred fifty-sixth chapter, titled "Purification of Materials", in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred fifty-seventh chapter.
Impurity on Death and Childbirth

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
pretaśuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi sūtikāśudhhimeva ca /
daśāhaṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ sapiṇdeṣu vidhīyate //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
प्रेतशुद्धिं प्रवक्ष्यामि सूतिकाशुध्हिमेव च /
दशाहं शावमाशौचं सपिण्देषु विधीयते //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / I shall explain the purification regarding a deceased person and the purification regarding childbirth. / A ten-day ritual impurity on death is prescribed among sapiṇḍa relatives,

sanskrit_iast:
janane ca tathā śuddhirbrāhmaṇānāṃ bhṛgūttama /
dvādaśāhena rājanyaḥ pakṣādvaiśyo 'tha māsataḥ //
meaning:
जनने च तथा शुद्धिर्ब्राह्मणानां भृगूत्तम /
द्वादशाहेन राजन्यः पक्षाद्वैश्यो ऽथ मासतः //
text_mt: and purification occurs in the same way on childbirth for Brahmins, O best of the Bhṛgus. / A kṣatriya [becomes pure] through twelve days, a vaiśya through a fortnight, and a śūdra

sanskrit_iast:
śūdro 'nulomato dāse svāmitulyantvaśaucakaṃ /
ṣaṭbhistribhirathaikena kṣatraviṭśūdrayoniṣu //
meaning:
शूद्रो ऽनुलोमतो दासे स्वामितुल्यन्त्वशौचकं /
षट्भिस्त्रिभिरथैकेन क्षत्रविट्शूद्रयोनिषु //
text_mt: through a month. For a servant of the anuloma order, the ritual impurity is equal to the master's. / By six, three, and one [day], respectively, [in the case of relations] born of the womb of a kṣatriya, vaiśya, and śūdra,

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇaḥ śuddhimāpnoti kṣatriyastu tathaiva ca /
viṭśūdrayoneḥ śuddhiḥ syāt kramāt paraśurāmaka //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणः शुद्धिमाप्नोति क्षत्रियस्तु तथैव च /
विट्शूद्रयोनेः शुद्धिः स्यात् क्रमात् परशुरामक //
text_mt: a Brahmin attains purity; and so does a kṣatriya. / Purity for one born from the womb of a vaiśya and śūdra takes place in order, O Paraśurāma,

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍrātreṇa trirātreṇa ṣaḍbhiḥ śūdre tathā viśaḥ /
:p 130
ādantajananāt sadya ācūḍānnaiśikī śrutiḥ(1) //
meaning:
षड्रात्रेण त्रिरात्रेण षड्भिः शूद्रे तथा विशः /
:प् 130
आदन्तजननात् सद्य आचूडान्नैशिकी श्रुतिः(1) //
text_mt:
by six nights and three nights; likewise, for a vaiśya in the case of a śūdra, by six [nights].
[Page 130]
Up to the eruption of teeth, [purification is] immediate; up to tonsure, a single night's [impurity] is the traditional teaching.

sanskrit_iast:
trirātramāvratādeśāddaśarātramataḥ paraṃ /
ūnatraivārṣike śūdre pañcāhācchuddhiriṣyate //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रमाव्रतादेशाद्दशरात्रमतः परं /
ऊनत्रैवार्षिके शूद्रे पञ्चाहाच्छुद्धिरिष्यते //
text_mt: Three nights [of impurity] up to the investiture with vows; beyond that, ten nights. / For a śūdra under three years of age, purity is recognized after five days.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāhene śuddhiḥ syādatīte vatsaratraye /
gataiḥ saṃvatsaraiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ śuddhirmāsena kīrtitā //
meaning:
द्वादशाहेने शुद्धिः स्यादतीते वत्सरत्रये /
गतैः संवत्सरैः षड्भिः शुद्धिर्मासेन कीर्तिता //
text_mt: When three years have passed, purity occurs through twelve days. / When six years have elapsed, purity is proclaimed to be after one month.

sanskrit_iast:
strīṇāmakṛtacūḍānāṃ viśuddhir naiśikī smṛtā /
tathā ca kṛtacuḍānāṃ tryahācchuddhyanti bāndhavāḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रीणामकृतचूडानां विशुद्धिर् नैशिकी स्मृता /
तथा च कृतचुडानां त्र्यहाच्छुद्ध्यन्ति बान्धवाः //
text_mt: For girls who have not undergone tonsure, purification is remembered to be for a single night; / and for those whose tonsure has been performed, the relatives are purified after three days.

sanskrit_iast:
vivāhitāsu nāśaucaṃ pitṛpakṣe vidhīyate /
piturgṛhe prasūtānāṃ viśuddhir naiśikī smṛtā //
meaning:
विवाहितासु नाशौचं पितृपक्षे विधीयते /
पितुर्गृहे प्रसूतानां विशुद्धिर् नैशिकी स्मृता //
text_mt: For married women, no ritual impurity is ordained on the father's side. / For those who give birth in their father's house, purification is remembered to be for a single night.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtikā daśarātreṇa śuddhimāpnoti nānyathā /
vivāhitā hi cet kanyā mriyate pitṛveśmani //
meaning:
सूतिका दशरात्रेण शुद्धिमाप्नोति नान्यथा /
विवाहिता हि चेत् कन्या म्रियते पितृवेश्मनि //
text_mt: A woman who has given birth attains purity in ten nights, not otherwise. / If a married maiden dies in her father's home,

sanskrit_iast:
tasyāstrirātrācchuddhyanti bāndhavā nātra saṃśayaḥ /
samānaṃ labdhaśaucantu prathamena samāpayet //
meaning:
तस्यास्त्रिरात्राच्छुद्ध्यन्ति बान्धवा नात्र संशयः /
समानं लब्धशौचन्तु प्रथमेन समापयेत् //
text_mt: her relatives are purified after three nights; of this there is no doubt. / However, when an equal [period of] ritual impurity is incurred, one completes it with the first.

sanskrit_iast:
asamānaṃ dvitīyena dharmarājavaco yathā /
deśāntarasthaḥ śrutvā tu kulyāṇāṃ maraṇodbhavau //
meaning:
असमानं द्वितीयेन धर्मराजवचो यथा /
देशान्तरस्थः श्रुत्वा तु कुल्याणां मरणोद्भवौ //
text_mt: When it is unequal, [one completes it] with the second, according to the word of Dharmarāja. / If a person residing in another region hears of the death or birth of relatives,

sanskrit_iast:
yaccheṣaṃ daśarātrasya tāvadevaśucirbhavet /
atīte daśarātre tu trirātramaśucirbhavet //
meaning:
यच्छेषं दशरात्रस्य तावदेवशुचिर्भवेत् /
अतीते दशरात्रे तु त्रिरात्रमशुचिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: he remains impure for whatever is left of the ten nights. / But when the ten nights have passed, he is impure for three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
tathā saṃvatsare 'tīte snāta eva viśuddhyati /
mātāmahe tathātīte ācārye ca tathā mṛte //
meaning:
तथा संवत्सरे ऽतीते स्नात एव विशुद्ध्यति /
मातामहे तथातीते आचार्ये च तथा मृते //
text_mt: Likewise, when a year has passed, he is purified immediately upon bathing. / Likewise, when a maternal grandfather passes away, or when a teacher dies,

sanskrit_iast:
rātribhirmāsatulyābhirgarbhasrāve viśodhanaṃ /
sapiṇde brāhmaṇe varṇāḥ sarva evāviśeṣataḥ //
:n
1 ācaḍānnaiśikī tatheti ṭa..
:p 131
meaning:
रात्रिभिर्मासतुल्याभिर्गर्भस्रावे विशोधनं /
सपिण्दे ब्राह्मणे वर्णाः सर्व एवाविशेषतः //
:न्
1 आचडान्नैशिकी तथेति ट..
:प् 131
text_mt:
purification in the case of a miscarriage is by a number of nights equal to the months [of gestation]. / In the case of a Brahmin sapiṇḍa, all classes without distinction
[Note]
1 "ācaḍānnaiśikī tathā" in ṭa. / [Page 131]

sanskrit_iast:
daśarātreṇa śuddhyanti dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ /
vaiśyāḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdrā māsena bhārgava //
meaning:
दशरात्रेण शुद्ध्यन्ति द्वादशाहेन भूमिपः /
वैश्याः पञ्चदशाहेन शूद्रा मासेन भार्गव //
text_mt: are purified in ten nights; a king in twelve days; / vaiśyas in fifteen days; and śūdras in a month, O Bhārgava.

sanskrit_iast:
ucchiṣṭasannidhāvekaṃ tathā piṇḍaṃ nivedayet /
kīrtayecca tathā tasya namagotre samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
उच्छिष्टसन्निधावेकं तथा पिण्डं निवेदयेत् /
कीर्तयेच्च तथा तस्य नमगोत्रे समाहितः //
text_mt: One should also offer a piṇḍa in the vicinity of the food leavings, / and, concentrated in mind, pronounce the name and gotra of the deceased.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktavatsu dvijendreṣu pūjiteṣu dhanena ca(1) /
visṛṣṭākṣatatoyeṣu gotranāmānukīrtanaiḥ //
meaning:
भुक्तवत्सु द्विजेन्द्रेषु पूजितेषु धनेन च(1) /
विसृष्टाक्षततोयेषु गोत्रनामानुकीर्तनैः //
text_mt: When the foremost twice-born have eaten, have been honored with wealth, / and have dismissed the unbroken rice and water with the recitation of the gotra and name,

sanskrit_iast:
caturaṅgulavistāraṃ tatkhātantāvadantaraṃ /
vitastidīrghaṃ kartavyaṃ vikarṣūṇāṃ tathā trayaṃ //
meaning:
चतुरङ्गुलविस्तारं तत्खातन्तावदन्तरं /
वितस्तिदीर्घं कर्तव्यं विकर्षूणां तथा त्रयं //
text_mt: three furrows are to be made, each four finger-breadths wide, / with that much space between them, and one span long.

sanskrit_iast:
vikarṣūṇāṃ samīpe ca jvālayej jvalanatrayaṃ /
somāya vahnaye rāma yamāya ca samāsataḥ //
meaning:
विकर्षूणां समीपे च ज्वालयेज् ज्वलनत्रयं /
सोमाय वह्नये राम यमाय च समासतः //
text_mt: Near the furrows, one should ignite three fires. / In brief, O Rāma, for Soma, Agni, and Yama,

sanskrit_iast:
juhuyādāhutīḥ samyak sarvatraiva catustrayaḥ /
piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ kuryāt prāgvadeva pṛthak pṛthak //
meaning:
जुहुयादाहुतीः सम्यक् सर्वत्रैव चतुस्त्रयः /
पिण्डनिर्वपणं कुर्यात् प्राग्वदेव पृथक् पृथक् //
text_mt: one should properly offer oblations, three or four in every case. / One should make the offering of piṇḍas separately, just as before.

sanskrit_iast:
annena dadhnā madhunā tathā māṃsena pūrayet /
madhye cedadhimāsaḥ syāt kuryādabhyadhikantu tat //
meaning:
अन्नेन दध्ना मधुना तथा मांसेन पूरयेत् /
मध्ये चेदधिमासः स्यात् कुर्यादभ्यधिकन्तु तत् //
text_mt: One should fill it with cooked rice, curd, honey, and meat. / If an intercalary month occurs in the middle, one should perform that additionally.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā dvādaśāhena sarvametat samāpayet /
saṃvatsarasya madhye ca yadi syādadhimāsakaḥ //
meaning:
अथवा द्वादशाहेन सर्वमेतत् समापयेत् /
संवत्सरस्य मध्ये च यदि स्यादधिमासकः //
text_mt: Or else one should conclude all of this within twelve days, / even if an intercalary month occurs in the middle of the year.

sanskrit_iast:
tadā dvādaśake śrāddhe kāryaṃ tadadhikaṃ bhavet /
saṃvatsare samāpte tu śrāddhaṃ śrāddhavadācaret //
meaning:
तदा द्वादशके श्राद्धे कार्यं तदधिकं भवेत् /
संवत्सरे समाप्ते तु श्राद्धं श्राद्धवदाचरेत् //
text_mt:
Then, during the twelfth ancestral rite, that extra [rite] should be performed.
When the year has ended, he should perform the ancestral rite just like an [ordinary] ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast:
pretāya tata ūrdhavaṃ ca tasyaiva puruṣatraye /
piṇḍān vinirvapettadvaccaturastu samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रेताय तत ऊर्धवं च तस्यैव पुरुषत्रये /
पिण्डान् विनिर्वपेत्तद्वच्चतुरस्तु समाहितः //
text_mt:
Thereafter, for the deceased and for three generations of his [ancestors],
he should carefully offer four balls of food in the same manner.

sanskrit_iast:
sampūjya datvā pṛthivī samānā iti cāpyatha /
:n
1 dhaneṣu ceti ka.. , kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 132
yojayet pretapiṇḍaṃ tu piṇḍeṣvanyeṣu bhārgava //
meaning:
सम्पूज्य दत्वा पृथिवी समाना इति चाप्यथ /
:न्
1 धनेषु चेति क.. , ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 132
योजयेत् प्रेतपिण्डं तु पिण्डेष्वन्येषु भार्गव //
text_mt:
Having worshipped, having given, and reciting "May the earth be equal…" and so on,
[Footnote]
1. "dhaneṣu ca" in manuscripts ka, kha, gha, ṅa, cha, ja, and ña.
[Page] 132
he should join the ball of food for the deceased with the other balls of food, O descendant of Bhṛgu.

sanskrit_iast:
pretapātraṃ ca pātreṣu tathaiva viniyojayet /
pṛthak pṛthak prakartavyaṃ karmaitat karmapātrake //
meaning:
प्रेतपात्रं च पात्रेषु तथैव विनियोजयेत् /
पृथक् पृथक् प्रकर्तव्यं कर्मैतत् कर्मपात्रके //
text_mt:
And he should likewise join the vessel of the deceased with the [ancestral] vessels.
This rite should be performed separately in the ritual vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
mantravarjamidaṃ karma śūdrasya tu vidhīyate /
sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ strīṇāṃ kāryamevaṃ tadā bhavet(1) //
meaning:
मन्त्रवर्जमिदं कर्म शूद्रस्य तु विधीयते /
सपिण्डीकरणं स्त्रीणां कार्यमेवं तदा भवेत्(1) //
text_mt:
This rite is prescribed for a Śūdra without mantras.
The sapindisation of women should then be performed in this manner.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhaṃ kuryācca pratyabdaṃ prete kumbhānnamabdakaṃ /
gaṅgāyāḥ sikatā dhārā yathā varṣati vāsave //
meaning:
श्राद्धं कुर्याच्च प्रत्यब्दं प्रेते कुम्भान्नमब्दकं /
गङ्गायाः सिकता धारा यथा वर्षति वासवे //
text_mt:
He should perform the ancestral rite every year, and for a full year provide a pot of water and food for the deceased.
Just as the grains of sand of the Gaṅgā, or streams of water when Indra rains,

sanskrit_iast:
śakyā gaṇayituṃ loke natvatītāḥ pitāmahāḥ /
kāle satatage sthairyaṃ nāsti tasmāt kriyāṃ caret //
meaning:
शक्या गणयितुं लोके नत्वतीताः पितामहाः /
काले सततगे स्थैर्यं नास्ति तस्मात् क्रियां चरेत् //
text_mt:
are capable of being counted in the world, but not departed ancestors;
there is no permanence in time which constantly moves; therefore one should perform the rites.

sanskrit_iast:
devatve yātanāsthāne pretaḥ śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ labhet /
nopakuryānnaraḥ śocan pretasyātmana eva vā //
meaning:
देवत्वे यातनास्थाने प्रेतः श्राद्धं कृतं लभेत् /
नोपकुर्यान्नरः शोचन् प्रेतस्यात्मन एव वा //
text_mt:
Whether in godhead or in a place of torment, the deceased receives what is performed in the ancestral rite.
A person achieves nothing by lamenting, either for the deceased or for oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
bhṛgvagnipāśakāmbhobhirmṛtānāmātmaghātināṃ /
patitānāṃ ca nāśaucaṃ vidyucchastrahatāś ca ye //
meaning:
भृग्वग्निपाशकाम्भोभिर्मृतानामात्मघातिनां /
पतितानां च नाशौचं विद्युच्छस्त्रहताश् च ये //
text_mt:
There is no ritual impurity for suicides who died by falling from a precipice, by fire, by a noose, or by water,
nor for the degraded, or those killed by lightning or weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
yatibratibrahmacārinṛpakārukadīkṣitāḥ /
rājājñākāriṇo(2) ye ca snāyādvai pretagāmyapi //
meaning:
यतिब्रतिब्रह्मचारिनृपकारुकदीक्षिताः /
राजाज्ञाकारिणो(2) ये च स्नायाद्वै प्रेतगाम्यपि //
text_mt:
Renunciants, vow-holders, celibate students, kings, artisans, and initiated persons,
and those who execute the king's orders [incur no ritual impurity]; but one who attends a corpse should certainly bathe.

sanskrit_iast:
maithune kaṭadhūme ca sadyaḥ snānaṃ vidhīyate /
dvijaṃ na nirharet(3) pretaṃ śūdreṇa tu kathañcana //
meaning:
मैथुने कटधूमे च सद्यः स्नानं विधीयते /
द्विजं न निर्हरेत्(3) प्रेतं शूद्रेण तु कथञ्चन //
text_mt:
Immediate bathing is prescribed after sexual intercourse and from the smoke of a funeral pyre.
A twice-born corpse must never be carried out by a Śūdra,

sanskrit_iast:
na ca śūdraṃ dvijenāpi tayordoṣo hi jāyate(4) /
anāthaviprapretasya vahanāt svaragalokabhāk //
:n
1 kāryameva tathā bhavediti cha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca / kāryametattathā bhavediti
jha..
2 rājājñākārakā iti ṭa..
3 na nirdahediti kha..
4 tayordoṣo 'bhijāyate iti ṅa..
:p 133
meaning:
न च शूद्रं द्विजेनापि तयोर्दोषो हि जायते(4) /
अनाथविप्रप्रेतस्य वहनात् स्वरगलोकभाक् //
:न्
1 कार्यमेव तथा भवेदिति छ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च / कार्यमेतत्तथा भवेदिति
झ..
2 राजाज्ञाकारका इति ट..
3 न निर्दहेदिति ख..
4 तयोर्दोषो ऽभिजायते इति ङ..
:प् 133
text_mt:
nor a Śūdra by a twice-born, for a fault is indeed incurred by both of them.
By carrying the corpse of an unprotected Brahmin, one attains the heavenly world.
[Footnote]
1. "kāryameva tathā bhavet" in cha, ṅa, and ña; / "kāryametattathā bhavet" in jha.
2. "rājājñākārakāḥ" in ṭa.
3. "na nirdahet" in kha.
4. "tayordoṣo 'bhijāyate" in ṅa.
[Page] 133

sanskrit_iast:
saṅgrāme jayamāpnoti prete 'nāthe ca kāṣṭhadaḥ /
saṅkalpya bāndhavaṃ pretamapasavyena tāṃ citiṃ //
meaning:
सङ्ग्रामे जयमाप्नोति प्रेते ऽनाथे च काष्ठदः /
सङ्कल्प्य बान्धवं प्रेतमपसव्येन तां चितिं //
text_mt:
He who provides firewood for an unprotected deceased person wins victory in battle.
Having intended [the rite] for the deceased relative, [circumambulating] that pyre to the left,

sanskrit_iast:
parikramya tataḥ snānaṃ kuryuḥ sarve savāsasaḥ /
pretāya ca tathā dadyustrīṃstrīṃś caivodakāñjalīn //
meaning:
परिक्रम्य ततः स्नानं कुर्युः सर्वे सवाससः /
प्रेताय च तथा दद्युस्त्रींस्त्रींश् चैवोदकाञ्जलीन् //
text_mt:
and walking around it, they all should then bathe along with their clothes,
and they should likewise offer three handfuls of water each to the deceased.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāryaśmani padaṃ datvā praviśeyus tathā gṛhaṃ /
akṣatānnikṣipedvahnau nimbapatraṃ vidaśya ca //
meaning:
द्वार्यश्मनि पदं दत्वा प्रविशेयुस् तथा गृहं /
अक्षतान्निक्षिपेद्वह्नौ निम्बपत्रं विदश्य च //
text_mt:
Placing a foot upon a stone at the doorway, they should then enter the house;
and having bitten a neem leaf, one should throw unbroken grains into the fire.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthak śayīran bhūmau ca krītalabdhāśano bhavet /
ekaḥ piṇdo daśāhe tu śmaśrukarmakaraḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
पृथक् शयीरन् भूमौ च क्रीतलब्धाशनो भवेत् /
एकः पिण्दो दशाहे तु श्मश्रुकर्मकरः शुचिः //
text_mt:
They should sleep separately on the ground, and one should eat food that was bought or obtained [unasked].
One ball of food [is offered] during the ten days; shaving the hair and beard, he becomes pure.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhārthakaistilair vidvān majjedvāsoparaṃ dadhat(1) /
ajātadante tanaye śiśau garbhasrute tathā //
meaning:
सिद्धार्थकैस्तिलैर् विद्वान् मज्जेद्वासोपरं दधत्(1) /
अजातदन्ते तनये शिशौ गर्भस्रुते तथा //
text_mt:
The wise man should bathe with white mustard and sesame seeds, wearing another garment.
When a son dies whose teeth have not erupted, or an infant, or in the case of a miscarriage,

sanskrit_iast:
kāryo naivāgnisaṃskāro naiva cāsyodakakriyā /
caturthe ca dinekāryas tathāsthnāṃ caiva sañcayaḥ //
meaning:
कार्यो नैवाग्निसंस्कारो नैव चास्योदकक्रिया /
चतुर्थे च दिनेकार्यस् तथास्थ्नां चैव सञ्चयः //
text_mt:
cremation is not to be performed, nor the rite of offering water for him.
And on the fourth day, the collection of bones should be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
asthisañcayanādūrdhvamaṅgasparśo vidhīyate //42//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe śāvāśaucaṃ nāma
saptapañcāśadādhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
srāvādyaśaucaṃ
meaning:
अस्थिसञ्चयनादूर्ध्वमङ्गस्पर्शो विधीयते //42//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे शावाशौचं नाम
सप्तपञ्चाशदाधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
स्रावाद्यशौचं
text_mt:
Touching of limbs is prescribed after the collection of the bones. //42
Thus in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and fifty-seventh chapter, entitled “Ritual Impurity from Death”.
Now, the one hundred and fifty-eighth chapter.
Ritual Impurity from Miscarriage and the Like

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
srāvāśaucaṃ pravakṣyāmi manvādimunisammataṃ /
:n
1 siddhārthakaistilair viprān yajadvāso 'paraṃ dadhaditi gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca /
siddhārthastilair vidvān snāyādvāso 'paraṃ dadhaditi ga.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 134
rātribhirmāsatulyābhirgarbhasrāve tryaheṇa yā //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
स्रावाशौचं प्रवक्ष्यामि मन्वादिमुनिसम्मतं /
:न्
1 सिद्धार्थकैस्तिलैर् विप्रान् यजद्वासो ऽपरं दधदिति घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च /
सिद्धार्थस्तिलैर् विद्वान् स्नायाद्वासो ऽपरं दधदिति ग.. , ट.. च
:प् 134
रात्रिभिर्मासतुल्याभिर्गर्भस्रावे त्र्यहेण या //
text_mt:
Puṣkara said:
I shall explain the ritual impurity from miscarriage, as agreed upon by sages such as Manu.
[Footnote]
1. "siddhārthakaistilair viprān yajadvāso 'paraṃ dadhat" in gha, ṅa, and ña; / "siddhārthastilair vidvān snāyādvāso 'paraṃ dadhat" in ga and ṭa.
[Page] 134
In a miscarriage [in the first three months, ritual impurity lasts] for three days, or for nights equal to the number of months.

sanskrit_iast:
cāturmāsikapātānte daśāhaṃ pañcamāsataḥ /
rājanye ca catūrātraṃ vaiśye pañcāhameva ca //
meaning:
चातुर्मासिकपातान्ते दशाहं पञ्चमासतः /
राजन्ये च चतूरात्रं वैश्ये पञ्चाहमेव च //
text_mt:
At the end of a four-month miscarriage, [impurity lasts four days]; from the fifth month, it is ten days.
For a Kṣatriya it is four nights, and for a Vaiśya it is five days;

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭāhena tu śūdrasya dvādaśāhādataḥ paraṃ /
strīṇāṃ viśuddhiruditā(1) snānamātreṇa vai pituḥ //
meaning:
अष्टाहेन तु शूद्रस्य द्वादशाहादतः परं /
स्त्रीणां विशुद्धिरुदिता(1) स्नानमात्रेण वै पितुः //
text_mt:
for a Śūdra it is eight days, and beyond this it is twelve days.
Purification is declared for women [in this manner]; for the father it is indeed by a simple bath.

sanskrit_iast:
na snānaṃ hi sapiṇḍe syāttrirātraṃ saptamāṣṭayoḥ /
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sapiṇḍānāmādantajananāttathā //
meaning:
न स्नानं हि सपिण्डे स्यात्त्रिरात्रं सप्तमाष्टयोः /
सद्यः शौचं सपिण्डानामादन्तजननात्तथा //
text_mt:
There is no bathing [required] for a sapinda [relative]; in the seventh and eighth [months], it is three nights.
Immediate purity is prescribed for sapindas [upon the death of a child] prior to the eruption of teeth.

sanskrit_iast:
ācūḍādekarātraṃ syādāvratācca trirātrakaṃ /
daśarātraṃ bhavedasmānmātāpitrostrirātrakaṃ //
meaning:
आचूडादेकरात्रं स्यादाव्रताच्च त्रिरात्रकं /
दशरात्रं भवेदस्मान्मातापित्रोस्त्रिरात्रकं //
text_mt:
Until tonsure, it is one night; until initiation into vows, it is three nights;
after this, it is ten nights; for the mother and father, it is three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
ajātadante tu mṛte kṛtacūḍe 'rbhake tathā /
prete nyūne tribhirvarṣair mṛte śuddhistu naiśilkī //
meaning:
अजातदन्ते तु मृते कृतचूडे ऽर्भके तथा /
प्रेते न्यूने त्रिभिर्वर्षैर् मृते शुद्धिस्तु नैशिल्की //
text_mt:
When a child dies without erupted teeth, or an infant whose tonsure has been performed,
or if the deceased died when under three years of age, purification takes one night.

sanskrit_iast:
dvyaheṇa kṣatriye śuddhistribhirvaiśye mṛte tathā /
śuddhiḥ śūdre pañcabhiḥ syāt prāgvivāhad dviṣaṭtvahaḥ(2) //
meaning:
द्व्यहेण क्षत्रिये शुद्धिस्त्रिभिर्वैश्ये मृते तथा /
शुद्धिः शूद्रे पञ्चभिः स्यात् प्राग्विवाहद् द्विषट्त्वहः(2) //
text_mt:
Purification for a Kṣatriya is in two days, and when a Vaiśya dies, in three;
purification for a Śūdra is in five; prior to marriage, it is twelve days.

sanskrit_iast:
yatra trirātraṃ viprāṇāmaśaucaṃ sampradṛśyate /
tatra śūdre dvādaśāhaḥ ṣaṇṇava kṣatravaiśayyoḥ //
meaning:
यत्र त्रिरात्रं विप्राणामशौचं सम्प्रदृश्यते /
तत्र शूद्रे द्वादशाहः षण्णव क्षत्रवैशय्योः //
text_mt:
Where three nights of ritual impurity are observed for Brahmins,
there it is twelve days for a Śūdra, and six and nine for a Kṣatriya and a Vaiśya [respectively].

sanskrit_iast:
dvyabde naivāgnisaṃskāro mṛte tannikhaned bhuvi /
na codakakriyā tasya nāmni cāpi kṛte sati //
meaning:
द्व्यब्दे नैवाग्निसंस्कारो मृते तन्निखनेद् भुवि /
न चोदकक्रिया तस्य नाम्नि चापि कृते सति //
text_mt:
When [a child] dies at two years of age, cremation is not performed; one should bury it in the ground;
and there is no rite of water for him, even if the naming rite has been performed.

sanskrit_iast:
jātadantasya vā kāryā syādupanayanāddaśa /
ekāhācchuddhyate vipro yo 'gnivedasamanvitaḥ //
meaning:
जातदन्तस्य वा कार्या स्यादुपनयनाद्दश /
एकाहाच्छुद्ध्यते विप्रो यो ऽग्निवेदसमन्वितः //
text_mt:
Or it should be performed for one whose teeth have erupted; up to the sacred thread ceremony, it is ten [days].
A Brahmin who is endowed with the sacred fires and the Veda is purified in one day.

sanskrit_iast:
hīne hīnatare caiva tryahaś caturahas tathā /
pañcāhenāgnihīnastu daśāhādbrāhmaṇavruvaḥ //
:n
1 viśuddhiḥ kathiteti gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca
2 dviṣaṭkakamiti ṭa..
:p 135
meaning:
हीने हीनतरे चैव त्र्यहश् चतुरहस् तथा /
पञ्चाहेनाग्निहीनस्तु दशाहाद्ब्राह्मणव्रुवः //
:न्
1 विशुद्धिः कथितेति घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च
2 द्विषट्ककमिति ट..
:प् 135
text_mt:
For one lacking in these and further lacking, it is three days and four days respectively;
one without sacred fires is purified in five days, and a nominal Brahmin in ten days.
[Footnote]
1. "viśuddhiḥ kathitā" in gha, ṅa, and ña.
2. "dviṣaṭkakam" in ṭa.
[Page] 135

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatriyo navasaptāhacchuddhyedvipro guṇair yutaḥ /
daśāhāt saguṇo vaiśyo viṃśāhācchūdra eva ca //
meaning:
क्षत्रियो नवसप्ताहच्छुद्ध्येद्विप्रो गुणैर् युतः /
दशाहात् सगुणो वैश्यो विंशाहाच्छूद्र एव च //
text_mt:
A Kṣatriya endowed with virtues is purified in nine or seven days, a Brahmin in one,
a virtuous Vaiśya in ten days, and a Śūdra in twenty days.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāhācchuddhyate vipro dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ /
vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena śuddhyati //
meaning:
दशाहाच्छुद्ध्यते विप्रो द्वादशाहेन भूमिपः /
वैश्यः पञ्चदशाहेन शूद्रो मासेन शुद्ध्यति //
text_mt:
A Brahmin is purified in ten days, a king in twelve days,
a Vaiśya in fifteen days, and a Śūdra is purified in a month.

sanskrit_iast:
guṇotkarṣe daśāhāptau tryahamekāhakaṃ tryahe /
ekāhāptau sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sarvatraivaṃ samūhayet //
meaning:
गुणोत्कर्षे दशाहाप्तौ त्र्यहमेकाहकं त्र्यहे /
एकाहाप्तौ सद्यः शौचं सर्वत्रैवं समूहयेत् //
text_mt:
Where ten days apply, through excellence of virtues it is three days; where three days apply, it is one day;
where one day applies, it becomes immediate purity; one should deduce similarly everywhere.

sanskrit_iast:
dāsāntevāsibhṛtakāḥ śiṣyāś caivātra vāsinaḥ /
svāmitulyamaśaucaṃ syānmṛte pṛthak pṛthagbhavet //
meaning:
दासान्तेवासिभृतकाः शिष्याश् चैवात्र वासिनः /
स्वामितुल्यमशौचं स्यान्मृते पृथक् पृथग्भवेत् //
text_mt:
Slaves, resident pupils, hired servants, disciples, and those residing here
have ritual impurity equal to the master's; upon death, each should be separate.

sanskrit_iast:
maraṇādeva kartavyaṃ saṃyogo yasya nāgnibhiḥ /
dāhādūrdhvamaśaucaṃ syādyasya vaitāniko vidhiḥ //
meaning:
मरणादेव कर्तव्यं संयोगो यस्य नाग्निभिः /
दाहादूर्ध्वमशौचं स्याद्यस्य वैतानिको विधिः //
text_mt:
[Impurity] is to be reckoned from death itself for one who has no connection with the [sacred] fires;
for one who follows the solemn rites of the Veda, ritual impurity begins after cremation.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāmeva varṇānāntribhāgāt sparśanambhavet /
tricatuḥpañcadaśabhiḥ spṛśyavarṇāḥ krameṇa tu //
meaning:
सर्वेषामेव वर्णानान्त्रिभागात् स्पर्शनम्भवेत् /
त्रिचतुःपञ्चदशभिः स्पृश्यवर्णाः क्रमेण तु //
text_mt:
For all castes, touching is allowed after a third [of the impurity period has passed];
the castes become touchable after three, four, five, and ten [days] in order.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthe pañcame caiva saptame navame tathā /
asthisañcayanaṃ kāryaṃ varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थे पञ्चमे चैव सप्तमे नवमे तथा /
अस्थिसञ्चयनं कार्यं वर्णानामनुपूर्वशः //
text_mt:
On the fourth, fifth, seventh, and ninth [day] respectively,
the collection of bones should be performed for the castes in order.

sanskrit_iast:
ahastvadattakanyāsu pradattāsu tryahaṃ bhavet /
pakṣiṇī saṃskṛtāsveva svasrādiṣu vidhīyate //
meaning:
अहस्त्वदत्तकन्यासु प्रदत्तासु त्र्यहं भवेत् /
पक्षिणी संस्कृतास्वेव स्वस्रादिषु विधीयते //
text_mt:
In the case of unbetrothed maidens, it is one day; for betrothed ones, it is three days.
A day and two nights is prescribed for married women, sisters, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛgotraṃ kumārīṇāṃ vyūḍhānāṃ bhartṛgotratā /
jalapradānaṃ pitre ca udvāhe cobhayatra tu //
meaning:
पितृगोत्रं कुमारीणां व्यूढानां भर्तृगोत्रता /
जलप्रदानं पित्रे च उद्वाहे चोभयत्र तु //
text_mt:
Unmarried girls belong to the lineage of the father; married women belong to the lineage of the husband.
The offering of water is to the father, but at marriage it is to both.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāhopari pitroś ca duhiturmaraṇe tryahaṃ /
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ pūrvaṃ cūḍākṛterdvija //
meaning:
दशाहोपरि पित्रोश् च दुहितुर्मरणे त्र्यहं /
सद्यः शौचं सपिण्डानां पूर्वं चूडाकृतेर्द्विज //
text_mt:
Upon the death of a daughter after ten days [of life], it is three days for the parents.
Prior to the tonsure rite, O twice-born, there is immediate purity for sapindas.

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhato hy āvivihādūrdhvaṃ hastodakāt tryahaṃ /
pakṣiṇī bhrātṛputrasya sapiṇḍānāṃ ca sadyataḥ //
meaning:
एकाहतो ह्य् आविविहादूर्ध्वं हस्तोदकात् त्र्यहं /
पक्षिणी भ्रातृपुत्रस्य सपिण्डानां च सद्यतः //
text_mt: [Ritual impurity lasts] for one day prior to marriage, but for three days after the ritual pouring of water on the bride's hand; / for a brother's son it lasts a day and a night with the intervening night or day, and for sapindas [it terminates] immediately.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāhācchuddhyate vipro janmahānau svayoniṣu /
:p 136
ṣadbhistribhirahaikena kṣatraviṭśūdrayoniṣu //
meaning:
दशाहाच्छुद्ध्यते विप्रो जन्महानौ स्वयोनिषु /
:प् 136
षद्भिस्त्रिभिरहैकेन क्षत्रविट्शूद्रयोनिषु //
text_mt:
A Brahmin is purified after ten days in the event of birth or death among his own kin,
[Page 136]
[and] after six days, three days, and a single day [respectively] among Kṣatriya, Vaiśya, and Śūdra kin.

sanskrit_iast:
etajjñeyaṃ sapiṇḍānāṃ vakṣye cānaurasādiṣu /
anauraseṣu putreṣu bhāryāsvanyagatāsu ca //
meaning:
एतज्ज्ञेयं सपिण्डानां वक्ष्ये चानौरसादिषु /
अनौरसेषु पुत्रेषु भार्यास्वन्यगतासु च //
text_mt: This is to be known regarding sapindas; and I shall state [it] regarding non-aurasa sons and others: / in the case of non-aurasa sons, and wives who have gone to another,

sanskrit_iast:
parapūrvāsu ca strīṣu trirātrācchuddhiriṣyate /
vṛthāsaṅkarajātānāṃ pravrajyāsu ca tiṣṭhatāṃ //
meaning:
परपूर्वासु च स्त्रीषु त्रिरात्राच्छुद्धिरिष्यते /
वृथासङ्करजातानां प्रव्रज्यासु च तिष्ठतां //
text_mt: and in the case of women who previously had another husband, purification is prescribed after three nights. / For those born of improper miscegenation, and those residing in the ascetic life,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanastyāgināñcaiva nivartetodakakriyā /
mātraikayā dvipitarau bhratarāvanyagāminau //
meaning:
आत्मनस्त्यागिनाञ्चैव निवर्तेतोदकक्रिया /
मात्रैकया द्विपितरौ भ्रतरावन्यगामिनौ //
text_mt: and for those who commit suicide, the water-libation rite ceases. / Two brothers with different fathers by one mother, who have gone to another,

sanskrit_iast:
ekāhaḥ sūtake tatra mṛtake tu dvyaho bhavet(1) /
sapiṇḍānāmaśaucaṃ hi samānodakatāṃ vade //
meaning:
एकाहः सूतके तत्र मृतके तु द्व्यहो भवेत्(1) /
सपिण्डानामशौचं हि समानोदकतां वदे //
text_mt: in that case have [ritual impurity of] one day upon birth, but upon death there would be two days. / Indeed, I shall now declare the ritual impurity of sapindas and samānodakas.

sanskrit_iast:
bāle deśāntarasthe ca pṛthakpiṇḍe ca saṃsthite /
savāsā jalamāplutya sadya eva viśuddhyati //
meaning:
बाले देशान्तरस्थे च पृथक्पिण्डे च संस्थिते /
सवासा जलमाप्लुत्य सद्य एव विशुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: When a child, or one residing in a distant country, or a relative offering separate funerary cakes dies, / one becomes purified immediately upon bathing in water together with one's clothes.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāhena sapiṇḍāstu śuddhyanti pretasūtake /
trirātreṇa sukulyāstu snānāt(2) śuddhyanti gotriṇaḥ //
meaning:
दशाहेन सपिण्डास्तु शुद्ध्यन्ति प्रेतसूतके /
त्रिरात्रेण सुकुल्यास्तु स्नानात्(2) शुद्ध्यन्ति गोत्रिणः //
text_mt: Sapindas are purified in ten days upon birth or death; / relatives of good family [are purified] in three nights, and clan-members are purified through bathing.

sanskrit_iast:
sapiṇḍatā tu puruṣe saptame vinivartate /
samānodakabhāvastu nivartetācaturdaśāt //
meaning:
सपिण्डता तु पुरुषे सप्तमे विनिवर्तते /
समानोदकभावस्तु निवर्तेताचतुर्दशात् //
text_mt: The status of sapinda ceases in the seventh generation, / but the status of samānodaka ceases up to the fourteenth [generation],

sanskrit_iast:
janmanāmasmṛte vaitat tatparaṃ gotramucyate /
vigatantu videśasthaṃ śṛṇuyādyo hy anirdaśaṃ //
meaning:
जन्मनामस्मृते वैतत् तत्परं गोत्रमुच्यते /
विगतन्तु विदेशस्थं शृणुयाद्यो ह्य् अनिर्दशं //
text_mt: or when the birth and name are forgotten; beyond that, it is merely called a gotra. / If one hears of a deceased person living abroad before ten days have elapsed,

sanskrit_iast:
yaccheṣaṃ daśarātrasya tāvadevāśucirbhavet /
atikrānte daśāhe tu trirātramaśucirbhavet //
meaning:
यच्छेषं दशरात्रस्य तावदेवाशुचिर्भवेत् /
अतिक्रान्ते दशाहे तु त्रिरात्रमशुचिर्भवेत् //
text_mt: he remains impure only for whatever is left of the ten nights; / but if the ten days have elapsed, he remains impure for three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃvatsare vyatīte tu spṛṣṭvaivāpo viśuddhyati /
:n
1 mṛtake tu tryaho bhavediti gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca / matake tu tathā bhavediti
jha..
2 snātā iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
:p 137
mātule pakṣiṇo rātriḥ śiṣyatvigbāndhaveṣu ca //
meaning:
संवत्सरे व्यतीते तु स्पृष्ट्वैवापो विशुद्ध्यति /
:न्
1 मृतके तु त्र्यहो भवेदिति घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च / मतके तु तथा भवेदिति
झ..
2 स्नाता इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
:प् 137
मातुले पक्षिणो रात्रिः शिष्यत्विग्बान्धवेषु च //
text_mt:
When a year has elapsed, he is purified simply by touching water.
[Note]
1 In manuscripts gha, ṅa, and ña: "mṛtake tu tryaho bhaved" [there would be three days upon death]; in jha: "matake tu tathā bhaved".
2 In manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, and ja: "snātā" [having bathed].
[Page 137]
Upon [the death of] a maternal uncle, a day and two nights, and likewise for a pupil, an officiating priest, and a relative.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛṭe jāmātari prete daihitre bhaginīsute(1) /
śyālake tatsute caiva snānamātraṃ vidhīyate //
meaning:
मृटे जामातरि प्रेते दैहित्रे भगिनीसुते(1) /
श्यालके तत्सुते चैव स्नानमात्रं विधीयते //
text_mt: When a son-in-law dies, or a daughter's son, or a sister's son, / or a brother-in-law, or his son, mere bathing is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
mātāmahyāṃ tathācārye mṛte mātāmahe tryahaṃ /
durbhikṣe rāṣṭrasampāte āgatāyāṃ tathāpadi //
meaning:
मातामह्यां तथाचार्ये मृते मातामहे त्र्यहं /
दुर्भिक्षे राष्ट्रसम्पाते आगतायां तथापदि //
text_mt: Upon the death of a maternal grandmother, or likewise a teacher, or a maternal grandfather, [it lasts] three days. / In a famine, a calamity in the kingdom, or when a sudden disaster has arrived,

sanskrit_iast:
upasargamṛtānāñca dāhe brahmavidāntathā /
satrivrati(2) brahmattārisaṅgrāme deśaviplave //
meaning:
उपसर्गमृतानाञ्च दाहे ब्रह्मविदान्तथा /
सत्रिव्रति(2) ब्रह्मत्तारिसङ्ग्रामे देशविप्लवे //
text_mt: at the cremation of those who died of a pestilence, and likewise of knowers of the Veda, / during a sacrifice, an observance, for a student of the Veda, in battle, in the devastation of the land,

sanskrit_iast:
dāne yajñe vivāhe ca sadyaḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate /
vipragonṛpahantṝṇāmanuktaṃ cātmaghātināṃ //
meaning:
दाने यज्ञे विवाहे च सद्यः शौचं विधीयते /
विप्रगोनृपहन्तॄणामनुक्तं चात्मघातिनां //
text_mt: in making a gift, at a sacrifice, and during a marriage, immediate ritual purity is prescribed. / None is declared for the killers of Brahmins, cows, or kings, or for suicides.

sanskrit_iast:
asādhyavyādhiyuktasya svādhyāye cākṣamasya ca /
prāyaścittamanujñātamagnitoyapraveśanaṃ //
meaning:
असाध्यव्याधियुक्तस्य स्वाध्याये चाक्षमस्य च /
प्रायश्चित्तमनुज्ञातमग्नितोयप्रवेशनं //
text_mt: For one afflicted with an incurable disease and unable to perform sacred study, / entering into fire or water is permitted as an expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
apamānāttathā(3) krodhāt snehātparibhavādbhayāt /
udbadhya mriyate nārī puruṣo vā kathañcana //
meaning:
अपमानात्तथा(3) क्रोधात् स्नेहात्परिभवाद्भयात् /
उद्बध्य म्रियते नारी पुरुषो वा कथञ्चन //
text_mt: If out of insult, anger, attachment, humilation, or fear, / a woman or a man dies by hanging in any way,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmaghātī caikalakṣaṃ vasetsa narake śucau /
vṛddhaḥ śrautasmṛterluptaḥ parityajati yastvasūn //
meaning:
आत्मघाती चैकलक्षं वसेत्स नरके शुचौ /
वृद्धः श्रौतस्मृतेर्लुप्तः परित्यजति यस्त्वसून् //
text_mt: such a suicide will dwell for one hundred thousand [years] in a terrifying hell. / An elderly person, whose Vedic and traditional duties have lapsed, who abandons his life,

sanskrit_iast:
trirātraṃ tatra śāśaucaṃ dvitīye cāsthisañcayaṃ /
tṛtīye tūdakaṃ kāryaṃ caturthe śrāddhamācaret //
meaning:
त्रिरात्रं तत्र शाशौचं द्वितीये चास्थिसञ्चयं /
तृतीये तूदकं कार्यं चतुर्थे श्राद्धमाचरेत् //
text_mt: in that case there is ritual impurity for three nights, collection of the bones on the second [day], / water offering to be performed on the third, and on the fourth one should perform the ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast:
vidyudagnihatānāñca tryahaṃ śuddhiḥ sapiṇḍike(4) /
pāṣaṇḍāśritā bhartṛghnyo nāśaucodakagāḥ striyaḥ //
meaning:
विद्युदग्निहतानाञ्च त्र्यहं शुद्धिः सपिण्डिके(4) /
पाषण्डाश्रिता भर्तृघ्न्यो नाशौचोदकगाः स्त्रियः //
text_mt: For those killed by lightning or fire, purification among sapindas takes three days. / Women who have taken refuge in heretical sects or who are husband-slayers are not entitled to rites of ritual impurity or water libations.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛmātrādipāte tu ārdravāsā hy upoṣitaḥ /
:n
1 prete, bhaginīsuta ity api iti ṭa..
2 yativratīti ja..
3 apamānādatheti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
4 vidyudādihatānāñca tryahācchuddhirvidhīyate iti ṭa..
:p 138
atītebde prakurvīta pretakāryaṃ yathāvidhi //
meaning:
पितृमात्रादिपाते तु आर्द्रवासा ह्य् उपोषितः /
:न्
1 प्रेते, भगिनीसुत इत्य् अपि इति ट..
2 यतिव्रतीति ज..
3 अपमानादथेति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
4 विद्युदादिहतानाञ्च त्र्यहाच्छुद्धिर्विधीयते इति ट..
:प् 138
अतीतेब्दे प्रकुर्वीत प्रेतकार्यं यथाविधि //
text_mt:
Upon the demise of one's father, mother, or others, having wet garments and having fasted,
[Note]
1 Manuscript ṭa reads: "prete, bhaginīsuta ity api".
2 Manuscript ja reads: "yativratī".
3 Manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, and ja read: "apamānādathe".
4 Manuscript ṭa reads: "vidyudādihatānāñca tryahācchuddhirvidhīyate".
[Page 138]
when a year has passed, one should perform the funeral rites according to the rule.

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ kaścittu haret pretamasapiṇḍaṃ kathañcana /
snātvā scelaḥ spṛṣṭvāgniṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati //
meaning:
यः कश्चित्तु हरेत् प्रेतमसपिण्डं कथञ्चन /
स्नात्वा स्चेलः स्पृष्ट्वाग्निं घृतं प्राश्य विशुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: Whoever carries a deceased person who is not a sapinda in any manner, / having bathed with his clothes on, touched fire, and tasted clarified butter, becomes purified.

sanskrit_iast:
yadyannamatti teṣāntu daśāhenaiva śuddhyati /
anadannannamahnyeva na vai tasmin gṛhe vaset //
meaning:
यद्यन्नमत्ति तेषान्तु दशाहेनैव शुद्ध्यति /
अनदन्नन्नमह्न्येव न वै तस्मिन् गृहे वसेत् //
text_mt: If he eats their food, he is purified only after ten days; / if not eating their food, [he is purified] on that very day, but he must not dwell in that house.

sanskrit_iast:
anāthaṃ vrāhmaṇaṃ pretaṃ ye vahanti dvijātayaḥ /
pade pade yajñaphalaṃ śuddhiḥ syāt snānamātrataḥ //
meaning:
अनाथं व्राह्मणं प्रेतं ये वहन्ति द्विजातयः /
पदे पदे यज्ञफलं शुद्धिः स्यात् स्नानमात्रतः //
text_mt: Whatever twice-born persons carry a deceased Brahmin who is destitute, / at every step they obtain the fruit of a sacrifice, and purity is attained merely by bathing.

sanskrit_iast:
pretībhūtaṃ dvijaḥ śūdramanugacchaṃstryahācchuciḥ /
mṛtasya bāndhavaiḥ sārdhaṃ kṛtvā ca paridevanaṃ //
meaning:
प्रेतीभूतं द्विजः शूद्रमनुगच्छंस्त्र्यहाच्छुचिः /
मृतस्य बान्धवैः सार्धं कृत्वा च परिदेवनं //
text_mt: A twice-born person who follows a Śūdra corpse becomes pure after three days, / having made lamentation together with the deceased's relatives.

sanskrit_iast:
varjayettadahorātraṃ dānaśrāddhādi kāmataḥ(1) /
śūdrāyāḥ prasavo gehe śūdrasya maraṇaṃ tathā //
meaning:
वर्जयेत्तदहोरात्रं दानश्राद्धादि कामतः(1) /
शूद्रायाः प्रसवो गेहे शूद्रस्य मरणं तथा //
text_mt: For that day and night he should intentionally avoid gifts, ancestral rites, and the like. / When there is a birth from a Śūdra woman or the death of a Śūdra in the house,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāṇḍāni tu parityajya tryahādbhūlepataḥ śuciḥ /
na vipraṃ sveṣu tiṣṭhatsu mṛtaṃ śūdreṇa nāyayet //
meaning:
भाण्डानि तु परित्यज्य त्र्यहाद्भूलेपतः शुचिः /
न विप्रं स्वेषु तिष्ठत्सु मृतं शूद्रेण नाययेत् //
text_mt: having abandoned the earthen vessels, one becomes pure after three days by smearing the ground. / One should not have a deceased Brahmin carried by a Śūdra when his own kin are present.

sanskrit_iast:
nayet pretaṃ snāpitañca pūjitaṃ kusumair dahet /
nagnadehaṃ dahen naiva kiñciddehaṃ parityajet //
meaning:
नयेत् प्रेतं स्नापितञ्च पूजितं कुसुमैर् दहेत् /
नग्नदेहं दहेन् नैव किञ्चिद्देहं परित्यजेत् //
text_mt: One should carry the corpse, bathe it, and burn it after worshiping it with flowers; / one should not burn the body naked, nor leave behind any part of the body.

sanskrit_iast:
gotrajastu gṛhītvā tu citāṃ cāropayettadā /
āhitāgniryathānyāyaṃ dagdhavyastibhiragnibhiḥ //
meaning:
गोत्रजस्तु गृहीत्वा तु चितां चारोपयेत्तदा /
आहिताग्निर्यथान्यायं दग्धव्यस्तिभिरग्निभिः //
text_mt: A clan member should then take [the corpse] and raise it onto the pyre. / A maintainer of the sacred fires should be burned with the three fires according to the rule,

sanskrit_iast:
anāhitāgnirekena laukikenāparas tathā /
asmāt tvamabhijāto 'si tvadayaṃ jāyatāṃ punaḥ //
meaning:
अनाहिताग्निरेकेन लौकिकेनापरस् तथा /
अस्मात् त्वमभिजातो ऽसि त्वदयं जायतां पुनः //
text_mt: and one who is not a maintainer of the sacred fires with one, while another [ordinary person is burned] with the worldly fire: / "From this you were born; may this be born again from you!"

sanskrit_iast:
asau svargāya lokāya sukhāgniṃ pradadetsutaḥ /
sakṛtprasiñcantyudakaṃ nāmagotreṇa bāndhavāḥ //
:n
1 dānaśrāddhādikarma ceti jha..
:p 139
meaning:
असौ स्वर्गाय लोकाय सुखाग्निं प्रददेत्सुतः /
सकृत्प्रसिञ्चन्त्युदकं नामगोत्रेण बान्धवाः //
:न्
1 दानश्राद्धादिकर्म चेति झ..
:प् 139
text_mt:
For the sake of that heavenly realm, the son should present the auspicious fire. / The relatives pour water once with the name and clan name [of the deceased].
[Note]
1 Manuscript jha reads: "dānaśrāddhādikarma ca".
[Page 139]

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ mātāmahācāryapretānāñcodakakriyā /
kāmyodakaṃ sakhipretasvasrīyaśvaśrurartvijāṃ //
meaning:
एवं मातामहाचार्यप्रेतानाञ्चोदकक्रिया /
काम्योदकं सखिप्रेतस्वस्रीयश्वश्रुरर्त्विजां //
text_mt: Such is the water rite for a deceased maternal grandfather or teacher. / Water is optionally offered for a deceased friend, a sister's son, mother-in-law, father-in-law, or officiating priests.

sanskrit_iast:
apo naḥ śośucidayaṃ daśāhañca suto 'rpayet /
brāhmaṇe daśapiṇḍāḥ syuḥ kṣatriye dvādaśa smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
अपो नः शोशुचिदयं दशाहञ्च सुतो ऽर्पयेत् /
ब्राह्मणे दशपिण्डाः स्युः क्षत्रिये द्वादश स्मृताः //
text_mt: Reciting "apo naḥ śośucad aghaṃ", the son should offer [water] for ten days. / For a Brahmin there should be ten funerary cakes, for a Kṣatriya twelve are prescribed,

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśye pañcadaśa proktāḥ śūdre triṃśat prakīrtitā /
putro vā putrikānyo vā piṇḍaṃ dadyācca putravat //
meaning:
वैश्ये पञ्चदश प्रोक्ताः शूद्रे त्रिंशत् प्रकीर्तिता /
पुत्रो वा पुत्रिकान्यो वा पिण्डं दद्याच्च पुत्रवत् //
text_mt: for a Vaiśya fifteen are stated, and for a Śūdra thirty are proclaimed. / A son, an appointed daughter, or another should offer the funerary cake like a son.

sanskrit_iast:
vidiśya nimbapatrāṇi niyato dvāri veśmanaḥ /
ācamya cāgnimudakaṃ gomayaṃ gaurasarṣapān //
meaning:
विदिश्य निम्बपत्राणि नियतो द्वारि वेश्मनः /
आचम्य चाग्निमुदकं गोमयं गौरसर्षपान् //
text_mt: Restrained at the doorway of the house, chewing neem leaves, / sipping water, touching fire, water, cow dung, and white mustard seeds,

sanskrit_iast:
praviśeyuḥ samālabhya kṛtvāśmani padaṃ śanaiḥ /
akṣaralavaṇānnaḥ syur nirmāṃsā bhūmiśāyinaḥ //
meaning:
प्रविशेयुः समालभ्य कृत्वाश्मनि पदं शनैः /
अक्षरलवणान्नः स्युर् निर्मांसा भूमिशायिनः //
text_mt: they should enter, placing their foot slowly upon a stone. / They should eat food without alkaline or salt, abstain from meat, and sleep on the ground,

sanskrit_iast:
krītalabdhāśanāḥ snātā ādikartā daśāhakṛt /
abhāve brahmacārī tu kuryātpiṇḍodakādikaṃ //
meaning:
क्रीतलब्धाशनाः स्नाता आदिकर्ता दशाहकृत् /
अभावे ब्रह्मचारी तु कुर्यात्पिण्डोदकादिकं //
text_mt: eating food that is bought or obtained [unasked], having bathed; the primary performer observes the ten days. / In the absence [of a son], a student of the Veda may perform the funerary cake, water offerings, and other rites.

sanskrit_iast:
yathedaṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ sapiṇḍeṣu vidhīyate /
jananepyevaṃ syānnipuṇāṃ śuddhimicchatāṃ //
meaning:
यथेदं शावमाशौचं सपिण्डेषु विधीयते /
जननेप्येवं स्यान्निपुणां शुद्धिमिच्छतां //
text_mt: Just as this ritual impurity from death is prescribed among sapindas, / so it should be upon a birth for those desiring complete purity.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveṣāṃ śāvamāśaucaṃ mātāpitroś ca sūtakaṃ /
sūtakaṃ mātureva syādupaspṛśya pitā śuciḥ //
meaning:
सर्वेषां शावमाशौचं मातापित्रोश् च सूतकं /
सूतकं मातुरेव स्यादुपस्पृश्य पिता शुचिः //
text_mt: For all relatives there is ritual impurity from death, but ritual impurity from birth applies to the mother and father; / ritual impurity from birth [properly] pertains only to the mother; the father is pure upon sipping water.

sanskrit_iast:
putrajanmadine śrāddhaṃ kartavyamiti niścitaṃ /
tadahastatpradānārthaṃ gohiraṇyādivāsasāṃ //
meaning:
पुत्रजन्मदिने श्राद्धं कर्तव्यमिति निश्चितं /
तदहस्तत्प्रदानार्थं गोहिरण्यादिवाससां //
text_mt: On the day of a son's birth, an ancestral rite must certainly be performed; / that day is for the purpose of giving gifts of cows, gold, garments, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
maraṇaṃ maraṇenaiva sūtakaṃ sūtakena tu /
ubhayorapi yat pūrvaṃ tenāśaucena śuddhyati //
meaning:
मरणं मरणेनैव सूतकं सूतकेन तु /
उभयोरपि यत् पूर्वं तेनाशौचेन शुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: A death overlaps with a death, and a birth with a birth; / one is purified by that ritual impurity which occurred first among the two.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtake mṛtakaṃ cetsyān mṛtake tvatha sūtakaṃ /
tatrādhikṛtya mṛtakaṃ śaucaṃ kuryānna sūtakaṃ //
meaning:
सूतके मृतकं चेत्स्यान् मृतके त्वथ सूतकं /
तत्राधिकृत्य मृतकं शौचं कुर्यान्न सूतकं //
text_mt: If a death occurs during [impurity from] a birth, or a birth during [impurity from] a death, / one should observe ritual purity concerning the death, not the birth.

sanskrit_iast:
samānaṃ laghvaśaucantu prathamena samāpayet /
:p 140
asamānaṃ dvitīyena dharmarājavaco yathā //
meaning:
समानं लघ्वशौचन्तु प्रथमेन समापयेत् /
:प् 140
असमानं द्वितीयेन धर्मराजवचो यथा //

sanskrit_iast:
śāvāntaḥ śāva āyāte(1) pūrvāśaucena śuddhyati /
guruṇā laghu bādhyeta laghunā naiva tadguru //
meaning:
शावान्तः शाव आयाते(1) पूर्वाशौचेन शुद्ध्यति /
गुरुणा लघु बाध्येत लघुना नैव तद्गुरु //
text_mt: When a death occurs within the period of ritual impurity for a death, one becomes pure by the first ritual impurity. / A lighter [period] is superseded by a heavier one; a heavier one is never [superseded] by a lighter.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtake sūtake vāpi rātrimadhye 'nyadāpatet /
taccheṣeṇaiva suddhyeran rātriśeṣe dvyahādhikāt //
meaning:
मृतके सूतके वापि रात्रिमध्ये ऽन्यदापतेत् /
तच्छेषेणैव सुद्ध्येरन् रात्रिशेषे द्व्यहाधिकात् //
text_mt: If another [death] occurs during the night in the case of a death or birth, / they become pure with the remainder of that [period], or by two extra days if it falls at the end of the night.

sanskrit_iast:
prabhāte yadyaśaucaṃ syācchuddheraṃś ca tribhirdinaiḥ /
ubhayatra daśāhāni kulasyānnaṃ na bhujyate //
meaning:
प्रभाते यद्यशौचं स्याच्छुद्धेरंश् च त्रिभिर्दिनैः /
उभयत्र दशाहानि कुलस्यान्नं न भुज्यते //
text_mt: If ritual impurity arises at dawn, they become pure after three days. / In both cases, for ten days the family's food is not to be eaten.

sanskrit_iast:
dānādi ninivarteta kulasyānnaṃ na bhujyate /
ajñāte pātakaṃ nādye bhokturekamaho 'nyathā(2) //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe srāvādyaśaucaṃ nāma
aṣṭapañcāśadadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikonaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
asaṃskṛtādiśaucaṃ
meaning:
दानादि निनिवर्तेत कुलस्यान्नं न भुज्यते /
अज्ञाते पातकं नाद्ये भोक्तुरेकमहो ऽन्यथा(2) //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे स्रावाद्यशौचं नाम
अष्टपञ्चाशदधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकोनषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
असंस्कृतादिशौचं
text_mt:
Gifts and other [acts] cease; the family's food is not to be eaten. / If it is unknown, the eater incurs no sin; otherwise, [ritual impurity lasts] for one day.
Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-eighth chapter, entitled "Ritual Impurity Caused by Death and Other Occurrences," in the great Āgneya Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred and fifty-ninth chapter.
Ritual purity for the unconsecrated and others.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
saṃskṛtasyāsaṃskṛtasya svargo mokṣo harimmṛteḥ /
asthnāṅgaṅgāmbhasi kṣepāt pretasyābhyudayo bhavet //
:n
1 āpāta iti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 ananepyevamevaṃ syādityādiḥ, bhokturekamahonyathetyantaḥ
pāṭhaḥ gha.. , jha.. , ña.. pustakatrayeṣu nāsti
:p 141
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
संस्कृतस्यासंस्कृतस्य स्वर्गो मोक्षो हरिम्मृतेः /
अस्थ्नाङ्गङ्गाम्भसि क्षेपात् प्रेतस्याभ्युदयो भवेत् //
:न्
1 आपात इति ख.. , छ.. च
2 अननेप्येवमेवं स्यादित्यादिः, भोक्तुरेकमहोन्यथेत्यन्तः
पाठः घ.. , झ.. , ञ.. पुस्तकत्रयेषु नास्ति
:प् 141
text_mt:
Puṣkara said: / For one consecrated or unconsecrated, heaven and liberation come from remembering Hari at death. / From casting the bones into the waters of the Gaṅgā, the deceased prospers.
[Apparatus]
1 āpātaḥ in manuscripts kha and cha.
2 The reading beginning with ananepyevamevaṃ syād and ending with bhokturekamahonyathā is absent in the three manuscripts gha, jha, and ña. / [Page 141]

sanskrit_iast:
gaṅgātoye narasyāsthi yāvattāvaddivi sthatiḥ /
ātmanastyāgināṃ nāsti patitānāṃ tathā kriyā //
meaning:
गङ्गातोये नरस्यास्थि यावत्तावद्दिवि स्थतिः /
आत्मनस्त्यागिनां नास्ति पतितानां तथा क्रिया //
text_mt: For as long as a person's bone remains in the water of the Gaṅgā, so long is their stay in heaven. / For those who commit suicide and those who have fallen, there are no rites.

sanskrit_iast:
teṣāmapi tathā gāṅge toye 'sthnāṃ patanaṃ hitaṃ /
teṣāṃ dattaṃ jalaṃ cānnaṃ gagane tat pralīyate //
meaning:
तेषामपि तथा गाङ्गे तोये ऽस्थ्नां पतनं हितं /
तेषां दत्तं जलं चान्नं गगने तत् प्रलीयते //
text_mt: Yet for them too, the falling of their bones into the water of the Gaṅgā is beneficial. / Water and food offered to them vanishes in the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
anugraheṇa mahatā pretasya patitasya ca /
nārāyaṇabaliḥ kāryastenānugrahamaśnute //
meaning:
अनुग्रहेण महता प्रेतस्य पतितस्य च /
नारायणबलिः कार्यस्तेनानुग्रहमश्नुते //
text_mt: Out of great compassion for a deceased person or a fallen person, / the Nārāyaṇa-bali should be performed; through it, one obtains grace.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣastatra dattaṃ na naśyati /
patanātrāyate yasmāt tasmāt pātraṃ janārdanaḥ //
meaning:
अक्षयः पुण्डरीकाक्षस्तत्र दत्तं न नश्यति /
पतनात्रायते यस्मात् तस्मात् पात्रं जनार्दनः //
text_mt: The lotus-eyed one is imperishable; what is offered there does not perish. / Because he protects from falling, Janārdana is the recipient.

sanskrit_iast:
patatāṃ bhuktimuktyādiprada eko harirdhruvaṃ /
dṛṣṭvā lokān mriyamāṇān sahāyaṃ dharmamācaret //
meaning:
पततां भुक्तिमुक्त्यादिप्रद एको हरिर्ध्रुवं /
दृष्ट्वा लोकान् म्रियमाणान् सहायं धर्ममाचरेत् //
text_mt: For those who are falling, Hari alone is certainly the bestower of worldly enjoyment and liberation. / Seeing people dying, one should practice dharma as one's companion.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛto 'pi bāndhavaḥ śakto nānugantuṃ naraṃ mṛtaṃ /
jāyāvarjaṃ hi sarvasya yāmyaḥ panthā vibhidyate(1) //
meaning:
मृतो ऽपि बान्धवः शक्तो नानुगन्तुं नरं मृतं /
जायावर्जं हि सर्वस्य याम्यः पन्था विभिद्यते(1) //
text_mt: Even a kinsman who has died cannot follow a dead man; / for, except for a wife, the path to Yama is different for everyone.

sanskrit_iast:
dharma eko(2) vrajatyenaṃ yatra kvacana gāminaṃ /
śvaḥ kāryamadya kurvīta pūrvāhṇe cāparāhṇikaṃ //
meaning:
धर्म एको(2) व्रजत्येनं यत्र क्वचन गामिनं /
श्वः कार्यमद्य कुर्वीत पूर्वाह्णे चापराह्णिकं //
text_mt: Dharma alone accompanies him wherever he goes. / One should do today what is to be done tomorrow, and in the morning what is to be done in the afternoon.

sanskrit_iast:
na hi pratīkṣate mṛtyuḥ kṛtaḥ vāsya na vā kṛtaṃ /
kṣetrāpaṇagṛhāsaktamanyatragatamānasaṃ //
meaning:
न हि प्रतीक्षते मृत्युः कृतः वास्य न वा कृतं /
क्षेत्रापणगृहासक्तमन्यत्रगतमानसं //
text_mt: For death does not wait to see whether a person's work is done or not done. / Death seizes and carries off one who is attached to fields, markets, and homes,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛkīvīraṇamāsādya mṛtyurādāya gacchati /
na kālasya priyaḥ kaścid dveṣyaścāsya na vidyate //
meaning:
वृकीवीरणमासाद्य मृत्युरादाय गच्छति /
न कालस्य प्रियः कश्चिद् द्वेष्यश्चास्य न विद्यते //
text_mt: whose mind is directed elsewhere, as a wolf seizes and carries off a sheep. / Death has no favorite, nor does he possess any enemy.

sanskrit_iast:
āyuṣye karmaṇi kṣīṇe prasahya harite janaṃ /
nāprāptakālo mriyate biddhaḥ śaraśatair api //
meaning:
आयुष्ये कर्मणि क्षीणे प्रसह्य हरिते जनं /
नाप्राप्तकालो म्रियते बिद्धः शरशतैर् अपि //
text_mt: When life-span and karmic merit are exhausted, he forcefully snatches the person away. / One whose time has not come does not die, even when pierced by hundreds of arrows;

sanskrit_iast:
kuśāgreṇāpi saṃspṛṣṭaḥ prāptakālo na jīvati /
:n
1 panthā vibhajyate iti ga..
2 dharma eveti ja..
:p 142
auṣadhāni(1) na mantrādyāstrāyante mṛtyunānvitaṃ //
meaning:
कुशाग्रेणापि संस्पृष्टः प्राप्तकालो न जीवति /
:न्
1 पन्था विभज्यते इति ग..
2 धर्म एवेति ज..
:प् 142
औषधानि(1) न मन्त्राद्यास्त्रायन्ते मृत्युनान्वितं //
text_mt:
one whose time has come does not live, even if merely touched by the tip of a kuśa blade.
[Apparatus]
1 panthā vibhajyate in manuscript ga.
2 dharma eva in manuscript ja. / [Page 142]
Medicines, mantras, and the like do not protect one overtaken by death.

sanskrit_iast:
vatsavat prākṛtaṃ karma kartāraṃ vindati dhruvaṃ /
avyaktādi vyaktamadhyamavyaktanidhanaṃ jagat //
meaning:
वत्सवत् प्राकृतं कर्म कर्तारं विन्दति ध्रुवं /
अव्यक्तादि व्यक्तमध्यमव्यक्तनिधनं जगत् //
text_mt: Past karma certainly finds its doer, just as a calf [finds its mother]. / The universe has an unmanifest beginning, a manifest middle, and an unmanifest end.

sanskrit_iast:
kaumārādi yathā dehe tathā dehāntarāgamaḥ /
navamanyadyathā vastraṃ gṛhṇātyevaṃ śarīrikaṃ //
meaning:
कौमारादि यथा देहे तथा देहान्तरागमः /
नवमन्यद्यथा वस्त्रं गृह्णात्येवं शरीरिकं //
text_mt: Just as childhood and [other stages occur] in the body, so is the arrival of another body. / Just as one takes on new, different clothing, so does the embodied self.

sanskrit_iast:
dehī nityamabadhyo 'yaṃ yataḥ śokaṃ tatastyajet //15//
:e ity ādyāgneye mahāpurāṇe śaucaṃ
nāmaikonaṣṭyadhikataśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vānaprasthāśramaḥ
meaning:
देही नित्यमबध्यो ऽयं यतः शोकं ततस्त्यजेत् //15//
:ए इत्य् आद्याग्नेये महापुराणे शौचं
नामैकोनष्ट्यधिकतशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
वानप्रस्थाश्रमः
text_mt:
Since this embodied self is eternally indestructible, one should therefore cast off grief.
Thus ends the one hundred and fifty-ninth chapter, entitled "Ritual Purity," in the great Āgneya Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred and sixtieth chapter.
The stage of life of the forest hermit.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
vānaprasthayatīnāñca(2) dharmaṃ vakṣye 'dhunā śṛṇu /
