jaṭitvamagnihotritvaṃ bhūśayyājinadhāraṇaṃ //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
वानप्रस्थयतीनाञ्च(2) धर्मं वक्ष्ये ऽधुना शृणु /
जटित्वमग्निहोत्रित्वं भूशय्याजिनधारणं //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / I shall now declare the duty of forest hermits and ascetics; listen: / wearing matted hair, maintaining the sacred fire, sleeping on the ground, wearing an animal hide,

sanskrit_iast:
vane vāsaḥ payomūlanīvāraphalavṛttitā /
pratigrahanivṛttiś ca triḥsnānaṃ brahmacāritā //
meaning:
वने वासः पयोमूलनीवारफलवृत्तिता /
प्रतिग्रहनिवृत्तिश् च त्रिःस्नानं ब्रह्मचारिता //
text_mt: dwelling in the forest, subsisting on milk, roots, wild rice, and fruits, / abstaining from accepting gifts, bathing three times a day, practicing celibacy,

sanskrit_iast:
devātithīnāṃ pūjā ca dharmo 'yaṃ vanavāsinaḥ /
:n
1 auṣadhādīti ka..
2 yatīnāntu iti ṅa..
:p 143
gṛhī hy apatyāpatyañca dṛṣṭvāraṇyaṃ(1) samāśrayet //
meaning:
देवातिथीनां पूजा च धर्मो ऽयं वनवासिनः /
:न्
1 औषधादीति क..
2 यतीनान्तु इति ङ..
:प् 143
गृही ह्य् अपत्यापत्यञ्च दृष्ट्वारण्यं(1) समाश्रयेत् //
text_mt:
and worship of deities and guests—this is the duty of a forest dweller.
[Apparatus]
1 auṣadhādi in manuscript ka.
2 yatīnāntu in manuscript ṅa. / [Page 143]
Having seen the offspring of his offspring, a householder should indeed resort to the forest.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyamāyuṣo bhāgamekākī vā sabhāryakaḥ /
grīṣme pañcatapā nityaṃ varṣāsvabhrāvikāśikaḥ //
meaning:
तृतीयमायुषो भागमेकाकी वा सभार्यकः /
ग्रीष्मे पञ्चतपा नित्यं वर्षास्वभ्राविकाशिकः //
text_mt: [He should spend] the third part of his life alone or with his wife; / in summer, constantly practicing the five fires penance; in the rainy season, exposed to the rain from the clouds;

sanskrit_iast:
ārdravāsāś ca hemante tapaścograñcaredbalī(2) /
aparāvṛttimāsthāya vrajeddiśamajihmagaḥ(3) //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe vānaprasthāśramo nāma
ṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athaikaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
yatidharmaḥ
meaning:
आर्द्रवासाश् च हेमन्ते तपश्चोग्रञ्चरेद्बली(2) /
अपरावृत्तिमास्थाय व्रजेद्दिशमजिह्मगः(3) //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे वानप्रस्थाश्रमो नाम
षष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथैकषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
यतिधर्मः
text_mt:
in winter, wearing wet clothes; and a strong man should practice severe ascetic austerity. / Resolving upon never returning, he should go straight in whatever direction he chooses.
Thus ends the one hundred and sixtieth chapter, entitled "The Stage of Life of the Forest Hermit," in the great Āgneya Purāṇa.
Now begins the one hundred and sixty-first chapter.
The duty of an ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
yatirdharmaṃ pravakṣyāmi jñānamokṣādidarśakaṃ /
caturdhamāyuṣo bhāgaṃ prāpya saṅgāt parivarjayet(4) //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
यतिर्धर्मं प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानमोक्षादिदर्शकं /
चतुर्धमायुषो भागं प्राप्य सङ्गात् परिवर्जयेत्(4) //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / I will proclaim the duty of an ascetic, which leads to knowledge, liberation, and the like. / Having reached the fourth portion of life, he should completely abandon attachments.

sanskrit_iast:
yadahni virajeddhīrastadahni(5) ca parivrajet /
prajāpatyāṃ nirūpyeṣṭiṃ sarvadevasadakṣiṇāṃ //
meaning:
यदह्नि विरजेद्धीरस्तदह्नि(5) च परिव्रजेत् /
प्रजापत्यां निरूप्येष्टिं सर्वदेवसदक्षिणां //
text_mt: On whichever day the wise man becomes detached, on that day he should renounce the world. / Having performed the sacrifice to Prajāpati with all his possessions given as sacrificial fee,

sanskrit_iast:
ātmanyagnīn samāropya pravrajedbrāhmaṇo gṛhāt /
:n
1 dṛṣṭvāvaśyamiti ṅa..
2 tapaścograṃ vane carediti ṅa..
3 bhajeddiśamajimhaga iti ṅa..
4 saṅgān parityajediti ṅa..
5 virajedvāpi tadahni iti ṅa..
:p 144
eka eva carennityaṃ grāsamannāthamāśrayet //
meaning:
आत्मन्यग्नीन् समारोप्य प्रव्रजेद्ब्राह्मणो गृहात् /
:न्
1 दृष्ट्वावश्यमिति ङ..
2 तपश्चोग्रं वने चरेदिति ङ..
3 भजेद्दिशमजिम्हग इति ङ..
4 सङ्गान् परित्यजेदिति ङ..
5 विरजेद्वापि तदह्नि इति ङ..
:प् 144
एक एव चरेन्नित्यं ग्रासमन्नाथमाश्रयेत् //
text_mt:
and having deposited the sacred fires within himself, the brāhmaṇa should renounce his home.
[Apparatus]
1 dṛṣṭvāvaśyam in manuscript ṅa.
2 tapaścograṃ vane caret in manuscript ṅa.
3 bhajeddiśamajimhagaḥ in manuscript ṅa.
4 saṅgān parityajet in manuscript ṅa.
5 virajedvāpi tadahni in manuscript ṅa. / [Page 144]
He should always wander alone and rely on mouthfuls of food only for sustenance.

sanskrit_iast:
upekṣako 'siñcayiko munirjñānasamanvitaḥ /
kapālaṃ vṛkṣamūlañca(1) kucelamasahāyātā //
meaning:
उपेक्षको ऽसिञ्चयिको मुनिर्ज्ञानसमन्वितः /
कपालं वृक्षमूलञ्च(1) कुचेलमसहायाता //
text_mt: Indifferent, accumulating nothing, a sage endowed with knowledge, / having a skull bowl, the foot of a tree, ragged clothes, solitude,

sanskrit_iast:
samatā caiva sarvasminnetanmuktasya(2) lakṣaṇaṃ /
nābhinandena maraṇaṃ nābhinandeta jīvanaṃ(3) //
meaning:
समता चैव सर्वस्मिन्नेतन्मुक्तस्य(2) लक्षणं /
नाभिनन्देन मरणं नाभिनन्देत जीवनं(3) //
text_mt: and equanimity towards everything—this is the characteristic of one who is liberated. / He should not rejoice at death, nor should he rejoice at life;

sanskrit_iast:
kālameva pratīkṣeta nideśaṃ bhṛtako yathā /
dṛṣṭipūtaṃ nyasetpādaṃ vastrapūtaṃ jalaṃ pivet //
meaning:
कालमेव प्रतीक्षेत निदेशं भृतको यथा /
दृष्टिपूतं न्यसेत्पादं वस्त्रपूतं जलं पिवेत् //
text_mt: he should simply await his time, just as a servant awaits his order. / He should place his foot down purified by sight, and drink water purified by a cloth.

sanskrit_iast:
satyapūtāṃ vadedvācaṃ manaḥpūtaṃ samācaret /
alāvudārupatrāṇi mṛṇmayaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ yateḥ //
meaning:
सत्यपूतां वदेद्वाचं मनःपूतं समाचरेत् /
अलावुदारुपत्राणि मृण्मयं वैष्णवं यतेः //
text_mt: He should speak words purified by truth; he should act [in a manner] purified by the mind. / [Vessels made of] bottle-gourds, wood, and earthenware belong to a renunciant devoted to Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
vidhūme nyastamuṣale vyaṅgāre bhuktavajjane /
vṛtte śarāvasampāte bhikṣāṃ nityaṃ yatiś caret //
meaning:
विधूमे न्यस्तमुषले व्यङ्गारे भुक्तवज्जने /
वृत्ते शरावसम्पाते भिक्षां नित्यं यतिश् चरेत् //
text_mt: When the smoke has cleared, the pestle is laid down, the embers are extinguished, and people have finished eating, / when the clearing away of bowls is completed, the renunciant should always wander for alms.

sanskrit_iast:
madhūkaramasaṅkliptaṃ prākpraṇītamayācitaṃ /
tātkālikañcopapannaṃ bhaikṣaṃ pañcavidhaṃ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
मधूकरमसङ्क्लिप्तं प्राक्प्रणीतमयाचितं /
तात्कालिकञ्चोपपन्नं भैक्षं पञ्चविधं स्मृतं //
text_mt: Gathered like a bee, unplanned, previously prepared, unasked for, / and obtained at that very moment—alms is traditionally considered fivefold.

sanskrit_iast:
pāṇipātrī bhavedvāpi pātre pātrāt samācaret /
avekṣeta gatiṃ nṝṇāṃ karmadoṣasamudbhavāṃ //
meaning:
पाणिपात्री भवेद्वापि पात्रे पात्रात् समाचरेत् /
अवेक्षेत गतिं नॄणां कर्मदोषसमुद्भवां //
text_mt: He may use his hands as a bowl, or eat from bowl to bowl. / He should observe the fate of men arising from the faults of their actions.

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhabhāvaś caredbharmaṃ yatra tatrāśrame rataḥ /
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu na liṅgaṃ dharmakāraṇaṃ //
meaning:
शुद्धभावश् चरेद्भर्मं यत्र तत्राश्रमे रतः /
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु न लिङ्गं धर्मकारणं //
text_mt: Pure in intention, one should practice dharma, devoted to whatever stage of life [he is in], / equal toward all beings; the outward mark is not the cause of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
phalaṃ katakavṛkṣasya yadyapyambuprasādakaṃ /
na nāmagrahaṇādeva tasya vāri prasīdati //
:n
1 vṛkṣamūlāni kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , jha.. ca / vṛkṣamūlādi iti
ṭa..
2 etacchuddhasyeti ṅa..
3 jīvitamiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
:p 145
meaning:
फलं कतकवृक्षस्य यद्यप्यम्बुप्रसादकं /
न नामग्रहणादेव तस्य वारि प्रसीदति //
:न्
1 वृक्षमूलानि ख.. , घ.. , छ.. , झ.. च / वृक्षमूलादि इति
ट..
2 एतच्छुद्धस्येति ङ..
3 जीवितमिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. च
:प् 145
text_mt:
Although the fruit of the clearing-nut tree purifies water, / water does not become clear merely by uttering its name.
[Footnotes]
1 "vṛkṣamūlāni" in manuscripts kha, gha, cha, and jha; "vṛkṣamūlādi" in ṭa.
2 "etacchuddhasya" in ṅa.
3 "jīvitam" in kha, gha, ṅa, cha, and ja. / [page 145]

sanskrit_iast:
ajihmaḥ paṇḍakaḥ paṅgurandho badhira eva ca /
sadbhiś ca mucyate madbhirajñānāt saṃsṛto dvijaḥ //
meaning:
अजिह्मः पण्डकः पङ्गुरन्धो बधिर एव च /
सद्भिश् च मुच्यते मद्भिरज्ञानात् संसृतो द्विजः //
text_mt: Straightforward, [acting as if] a eunuch, lame, blind, or deaf— / [such a person] is freed by the virtuous and wise; out of ignorance the twice-born transmigrates.

sanskrit_iast:
ahni rātryāñca yān jantūn hinastyajñānato yatiḥ /
teṣāṃ snātvā viśuddhyarthaṃ prāṇāyāmān ṣaḍācaret(1) //
meaning:
अह्नि रात्र्याञ्च यान् जन्तून् हिनस्त्यज्ञानतो यतिः /
तेषां स्नात्वा विशुद्ध्यर्थं प्राणायामान् षडाचरेत्(1) //
text_mt: The creatures that an ascetic kills out of ignorance by day or by night, / for their purification he should bathe and perform six breath-controls.

sanskrit_iast:
asthisthūṇaṃ snāyuyutaṃ māṃsaśoṇitalepanaṃ /
carmāvanaddhaṃ durgandhaṃ pūrṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayoḥ //
meaning:
अस्थिस्थूणं स्नायुयुतं मांसशोणितलेपनं /
चर्मावनद्धं दुर्गन्धं पूर्णं मूत्रपुरीषयोः //
text_mt: Supported by pillars of bone, bound with sinews, plastered with flesh and blood, / covered with skin, foul-smelling, full of urine and feces,

sanskrit_iast:
jarāśokasamāviṣṭaṃ rogāyatanamāturaṃ /
rajasvalamanityañca bhūtāvāsamimantyajet //
meaning:
जराशोकसमाविष्टं रोगायतनमातुरं /
रजस्वलमनित्यञ्च भूतावासमिमन्त्यजेत् //
text_mt: afflicted by old age and sorrow, an abode of disease, miserable, / tainted with impurity and impermanent: this dwelling-place of the elements one should abandon.

sanskrit_iast:
dhṛtiḥ kṣamā damo 'steyaṃ(2) śaucamindriyanigrahaḥ /
hrīrvidyā satyamakrodho daśakaṃ dharmalakṣaṇaṃ //
meaning:
धृतिः क्षमा दमो ऽस्तेयं(2) शौचमिन्द्रियनिग्रहः /
ह्रीर्विद्या सत्यमक्रोधो दशकं धर्मलक्षणं //
text_mt: Steadfastness, forgiveness, self-restraint, non-stealing, ritual purity, control of the senses, / modesty, knowledge, truth, and absence of anger: this is the tenfold mark of dharma.

sanskrit_iast:
caturvidhaṃ bhaikṣavastu kuṭīrakavahūdake /
haṃsaḥ paramahaṃsaś ca yo yaḥ paścāt sa uttamaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्विधं भैक्षवस्तु कुटीरकवहूदके /
हंसः परमहंसश् च यो यः पश्चात् स उत्तमः //
text_mt: The mendicant [stage] is of four kinds: the Kuṭīcaka, the Bahūdaka, / the Haṃsa, and the Paramahaṃsa; each later one is superior [to the previous].

sanskrit_iast:
ekadaṇḍī tridaṇḍī vā(3) yogī mucyate bandhanāt /
ahiṃsā satyamasteyaṃ brahmacaryāparigrahau //
meaning:
एकदण्डी त्रिदण्डी वा(3) योगी मुच्यते बन्धनात् /
अहिंसा सत्यमस्तेयं ब्रह्मचर्यापरिग्रहौ //
text_mt: Bearing a single staff or bearing three staves, the yogin is released from bondage. / Non-violence, truthfulness, non-stealing, celibacy, and non-possessiveness:

sanskrit_iast:
yamāḥ pañcātha niyamāḥ śaucaṃ santoṣaṇantapaḥ /
svādhyāyeśvarapūjā ca padmakādyāsanaṃ yateḥ(4) //
meaning:
यमाः पञ्चाथ नियमाः शौचं सन्तोषणन्तपः /
स्वाध्यायेश्वरपूजा च पद्मकाद्यासनं यतेः(4) //
text_mt: these are the five restraints; then the observances: ritual purity, contentment, ascetic austerity, / Vedic study, and worship of God; and the lotus posture and others for an ascetic.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmastu dvividhaḥ sa garbho 'garbha eva ca /
japadhyānayuto garbho viparītastvagarbhakaḥ //
meaning:
प्राणायामस्तु द्विविधः स गर्भो ऽगर्भ एव च /
जपध्यानयुतो गर्भो विपरीतस्त्वगर्भकः //
text_mt: Breath-control is of two kinds: with seed and without seed; / accompanied by recitation and meditation it is with seed, while the opposite is without seed.

sanskrit_iast:
pratyekaṃ trividhaṃ sopi pūrakumbhakarecakaiḥ /
pūraṇāt pūrako vāyor niś calatvācca kumbhakaḥ //
:n
1 samācarediti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 dayāsteyamiti ṅa..
3 tridaṇḍī ceti ṅa..
4 padmakādyāsanaṃ mahat iti ṭa..
:p 146
meaning:
प्रत्येकं त्रिविधं सोपि पूरकुम्भकरेचकैः /
पूरणात् पूरको वायोर् निश् चलत्वाच्च कुम्भकः //
:न्
1 समाचरेदिति ख.. , छ.. च
2 दयास्तेयमिति ङ..
3 त्रिदण्डी चेति ङ..
4 पद्मकाद्यासनं महत् इति ट..
:प् 146
text_mt:
Each [kind] is also threefold: through inhalation, retention, and exhalation; / it is an inhalation from filling with air, and a retention from [air's] motionless state;
[Footnotes]
1 "samācaret" in kha and cha.
2 "dayāsteyam" in ṅa.
3 "tridaṇḍī ca" in ṅa.
4 "padmakādyāsanaṃ mahat" in ṭa. / [page 146]

sanskrit_iast:
recanādrecakaḥ prokto mātrābhedena ca tridhā /
dvādaśāttu caturviṃśaḥ ṣaṭtriṃśanmātriko 'paraḥ //
meaning:
रेचनाद्रेचकः प्रोक्तो मात्राभेदेन च त्रिधा /
द्वादशात्तु चतुर्विंशः षट्त्रिंशन्मात्रिको ऽपरः //
text_mt: it is called an exhalation from expelling [the air]; and it is threefold by difference of duration: / one of twelve [measures], another of twenty-four, and another consisting of thirty-six measures.

sanskrit_iast:
tālo laghvakṣaro mātrā praṇavādi carecchanaiḥ /
pratyāhāro jāpakānāṃ dhyānamīśvaracintanaṃ //
meaning:
तालो लघ्वक्षरो मात्रा प्रणवादि चरेच्छनैः /
प्रत्याहारो जापकानां ध्यानमीश्वरचिन्तनं //
text_mt: A measure is the duration of a short syllable; one should practice slowly with the praṇava and the like. / Withdrawal of the senses belongs to those who recite; meditation is contemplation of God.

sanskrit_iast:
manodhṛtirdhāraṇā syāt samādhirbrahmaṇi sthitiḥ /
ayamātmā paraṃ brahma satyaṃ jñānamanantakaṃ //
meaning:
मनोधृतिर्धारणा स्यात् समाधिर्ब्रह्मणि स्थितिः /
अयमात्मा परं ब्रह्म सत्यं ज्ञानमनन्तकं //
text_mt: Fixation of the mind is concentration; absorption is abiding in Brahman: / "This self is the supreme Brahman, truth, knowledge, endless,

sanskrit_iast:
vijñānamānandaṃ brahma tattvamasya.ahamasmi tat /
param brahma jyotirātmā vāsudevo vimukta oṃ //
meaning:
विज्ञानमानन्दं ब्रह्म तत्त्वमस्य.अहमस्मि तत् /
परम् ब्रह्म ज्योतिरात्मा वासुदेवो विमुक्त ओं //
text_mt: consciousness, bliss, Brahman; you are that; I am that; / the supreme Brahman, the light, the Self, Vāsudeva, liberated, Oṃ,

sanskrit_iast:
dehendriyamanobuddhiprāṇāhaṅkāravarjitaṃ /
jāgratsvapnasusuptyādimuktaṃ(1) brahma turoyakaṃ //
meaning:
देहेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिप्राणाहङ्कारवर्जितं /
जाग्रत्स्वप्नसुसुप्त्यादिमुक्तं(1) ब्रह्म तुरोयकं //
text_mt: devoid of body, sense-organs, mind, intellect, vital breath, and ego, / freed from waking, dreaming, deep sleep, and the rest: Brahman, the fourth [state],

sanskrit_iast:
nityaśuddhabuddhayuktasatyamānandamadvayaṃ(2) /
ahaṃ brahma paraṃ jyotirakṣaraṃ sarvagaṃ hariḥ //
meaning:
नित्यशुद्धबुद्धयुक्तसत्यमानन्दमद्वयं(2) /
अहं ब्रह्म परं ज्योतिरक्षरं सर्वगं हरिः //
text_mt: ever pure, endowed with awakening, truth, bliss, non-dual; / I am Brahman, the supreme light, the imperishable, all-pervading Hari,

sanskrit_iast:
so 'sāvādityapuruṣaḥ so 'sāvahamakhaṇḍa oṃ /
sarvārambhaparityāgī samaduḥkhasukhaṃ kṣamī //
meaning:
सो ऽसावादित्यपुरुषः सो ऽसावहमखण्ड ओं /
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी समदुःखसुखं क्षमी //
text_mt: that Person in the sun is he, that am I, undivided, Oṃ." / Abandoning all undertakings, equal in sorrow and joy, forgiving,

sanskrit_iast:
bhāvaśuddhaś ca brahmāṇḍaṃ bhittvā brahma bhavennaraḥ /
āṣaḍhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāñca cāturmāsyaṃ vratañcaret //
meaning:
भावशुद्धश् च ब्रह्माण्डं भित्त्वा ब्रह्म भवेन्नरः /
आषढ्यां पौर्णमास्याञ्च चातुर्मास्यं व्रतञ्चरेत् //
text_mt: and pure in intention, a man, piercing the cosmic egg, becomes Brahman. / On the full moon day of Āṣāḍha he should observe the four-month votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
tato jrajet navamyādau hy ṛtusandhiṣu vāpayet /
prāyaścittaṃ yatīnāñca dhyānaṃ vāyuyamas tathā //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe yatirdharmā
nāmaikaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||

2 ity āgneye aśaucanirṇaya ity ādiḥ, satyamānandamadvayamityantaḥ
pāṭho ga.. pustake nāsti
:p 147

dharmaśāstrakathanaṃ
meaning:
ततो ज्रजेत् नवम्यादौ ह्य् ऋतुसन्धिषु वापयेत् /
प्रायश्चित्तं यतीनाञ्च ध्यानं वायुयमस् तथा //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे यतिर्धर्मा
नामैकषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 आग्रत्स्वप्नसुसुप्त्यान्तमुक्तमिति ङ.. , छ.. , ञ.. च
2 इत्य् आग्नेये अशौचनिर्णय इत्य् आदिः, सत्यमानन्दमद्वयमित्यन्तः
पाठो ग.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 147
:श् अथ द्विषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
धर्मशास्त्रकथनं
text_mt:
Then he should wander; on the ninth [day] and so forth, at the junctions of the seasons, he should have his hair shaved; / and for ascetics, expiation is meditation as well as control of the breath.
Thus in the great Agni Purāṇa, the one hundred and sixty-first chapter, entitled "The Duties of an Ascetic."
[Footnotes]
1 "jāgratsvapnasusuptyāntamuktam" in ṅa, cha, and ña.
2 The passage beginning "ity āgneye aśaucanirṇaya" and ending "satyamānandamadvayam" is missing in manuscript ga. / [page 147]
Now the one hundred and sixty-second chapter.
The Exposition of the Dharmaśāstras.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
manurviṣṇuryājñavalko hārīto 'triryamo 'ṅigirāḥ /
vasiṣṭhadakṣasaṃvartaśātātapaparāśarāḥ //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
मनुर्विष्णुर्याज्ञवल्को हारीतो ऽत्रिर्यमो ऽङिगिराः /
वसिष्ठदक्षसंवर्तशातातपपराशराः //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / Manu, Viṣṇu, Yājñavalkya, Hārīta, Atri, Yama, Aṅgiras, / Vasiṣṭha, Dakṣa, Saṃvarta, Śātātapa, Parāśara,

sanskrit_iast:
āpastambośanovyāsāḥ kātyayanabṛhaspatī /
gotamaḥ śaṅkhalikhitau dharmamete yathābruvan //
meaning:
आपस्तम्बोशनोव्यासाः कात्ययनबृहस्पती /
गोतमः शङ्खलिखितौ धर्ममेते यथाब्रुवन् //
text_mt: Āpastamba, Uśanas, Vyāsa, Kātyāyana, Bṛhaspati, / Gautama, Śaṅkha, and Likhita—as these declared dharma,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā vakṣye samāsena bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu /
pravṛttañca nivṛttañca dvividhaṅkarma vaidikaṃ //
meaning:
तथा वक्ष्ये समासेन भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शृणु /
प्रवृत्तञ्च निवृत्तञ्च द्विविधङ्कर्म वैदिकं //
text_mt: so I shall declare it in brief, bestowing worldly enjoyment and liberation; listen! / Vedic action is of two kinds: directed toward engagement and directed toward cessation.

sanskrit_iast:
kāmyaṃ karma pravṛttaṃ syānnivṛttaṃ jñānapūrvakaṃ /
vedābhyāsastapo jñānamindiyāṇāñca saṃyamaḥ //
meaning:
काम्यं कर्म प्रवृत्तं स्यान्निवृत्तं ज्ञानपूर्वकं /
वेदाभ्यासस्तपो ज्ञानमिन्दियाणाञ्च संयमः //
text_mt: Action done with desire is directed toward engagement, while that preceded by knowledge is directed toward cessation. / Study of the Veda, ascetic austerity, knowledge, and restraint of the senses,

sanskrit_iast:
ahiṃsā gurusevā ca niḥśreyasakaraṃ paraṃ /
sarveṣāmapi caiteṣāmatmajñānaṃ paraṃ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
अहिंसा गुरुसेवा च निःश्रेयसकरं परं /
सर्वेषामपि चैतेषामत्मज्ञानं परं स्मृतं //
text_mt: non-violence, and service to the guru are the supreme cause of the highest good. / And of all these, knowledge of the Self is declared to be supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
taccagryaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ prāpyate hy amṛtaṃ tataḥ /
sarvabhūteṣu cātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani //
meaning:
तच्चग्र्यं सर्वविद्यानां प्राप्यते ह्य् अमृतं ततः /
सर्वभूतेषु चात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि //
text_mt: For that is the foremost of all sciences; immortality is indeed attained from it. / Seeing the Self in all beings and all beings in the Self

sanskrit_iast:
samampaśyannātmayājī svārājyamadhigacchati /
ātmajñāne same ca syādvedābhyāse ca yatnavān //
meaning:
समम्पश्यन्नात्मयाजी स्वाराज्यमधिगच्छति /
आत्मज्ञाने समे च स्याद्वेदाभ्यासे च यत्नवान् //
text_mt: equally, one who sacrifices to the Self attains autonomy. / One should be steadfast in knowledge of the Self and equanimity, and diligent in the study of the Veda.

sanskrit_iast:
etaddvijanmasāmarthyaṃ(1) brāhmaṇasya viśeṣataḥ /
:n
1 etaddvijanmasāgryamiti kha.. , ṅa.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca /
etaddvijanmasāmagrīti gha.
:p 148
vedaśāstrārthatattvajño yatra tatrāśrame vasan //
meaning:
एतद्द्विजन्मसामर्थ्यं(1) ब्राह्मणस्य विशेषतः /
:न्
1 एतद्द्विजन्मसाग्र्यमिति ख.. , ङ.. , झ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च /
एतद्द्विजन्मसामग्रीति घ.
:प् 148
वेदशास्त्रार्थतत्त्वज्ञो यत्र तत्राश्रमे वसन् //
text_mt:
This is the capability of the twice-born, especially of a brāhmaṇa,
[Footnotes]
1 "etaddvijanmasāgryam" in kha, ṅa, jha, ña, and ṭa; "etaddvijanmasāmagrī" in gha. / [page 148]
knowing the true meaning of the Veda and the Śāstras, residing in whatever stage of life [he is in].

sanskrit_iast:
ihaiva loke tiṣṭhan hi brahmabhūyāya kalpyate(1) /
svādhyāyānāmupākarma śrāvaṇyāṃ śrāvaṇena tu //
meaning:
इहैव लोके तिष्ठन् हि ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्प्यते(1) /
स्वाध्यायानामुपाकर्म श्रावण्यां श्रावणेन तु //
text_mt: Abiding right here in this world, he is fit to become Brahman. / The commencement rite of Vedic studies [is performed] on the full moon day of Śrāvaṇa, under [the asterism] Śravaṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
haste cauṣadhivāre ca pañcamyāṃ śrāvaṇasya vā /
pauṣamāsasya rohiṇyāmaṣṭakāyāmathāpi vā //
meaning:
हस्ते चौषधिवारे च पञ्चम्यां श्रावणस्य वा /
पौषमासस्य रोहिण्यामष्टकायामथापि वा //
text_mt: or on [the asterism] Hasta, on the day of herbs, or on the fifth lunar day of Śrāvaṇa; / or on [the asterism] Rohiṇī in the month of Pauṣa, or on an aṣṭakā day,

sanskrit_iast:
jalānte chandasāṅkuryādutsargaṃ vidhivadvahiḥ /
tryahaṃ preteṣvanadhyāyaḥ śiṣyartviggurubandhuṣu //
meaning:
जलान्ते छन्दसाङ्कुर्यादुत्सर्गं विधिवद्वहिः /
त्र्यहं प्रेतेष्वनध्यायः शिष्यर्त्विग्गुरुबन्धुषु //
text_mt: he should perform the suspension rite of the metres outdoors near water according to the rule. / There is a suspension of study for three days when pupils, officiating priests, gurus, or relatives have died,

sanskrit_iast:
upākarmaṇi cotsargaṃ svaśākhāśrotriye tathā(2) /
sandhyāgarjitanirghāte bhūkampolkānipātane //
meaning:
उपाकर्मणि चोत्सर्गं स्वशाखाश्रोत्रिये तथा(2) /
सन्ध्यागर्जितनिर्घाते भूकम्पोल्कानिपातने //
text_mt: and at the commencement and suspension rites, and likewise [on the death of] a Vedic scholar of one's own branch; / when there is thunder at twilight, a thunderbolt, an earthquake, or the fall of a meteor;

sanskrit_iast:
samāpya vedaṃ hy aniśamāraṇyakamadhītya ca /
pañcadaśyāṃ caturdaśyāmaṣṭamyāṃ rāhusūtake //
meaning:
समाप्य वेदं ह्य् अनिशमारण्यकमधीत्य च /
पञ्चदश्यां चतुर्दश्यामष्टम्यां राहुसूतके //
text_mt: and having completed the Veda, having studied the Āraṇyaka by night, / on the fifteenth, fourteenth, or eighth lunar day, during an eclipse of Rāhu,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛtusandhiṣu bhuktvā vā śrādvikaṃ pratigṛhya ca /
paśumaṇḍūkanakulaśvāhimārjāraśūkaraiḥ(3) //
meaning:
ऋतुसन्धिषु भुक्त्वा वा श्राद्विकं प्रतिगृह्य च /
पशुमण्डूकनकुलश्वाहिमार्जारशूकरैः(3) //
text_mt: or at the junctions of the seasons; having eaten food of an ancestral rite or accepted [a gift for it]; / when an interruption has been caused by an animal, a frog, a mongoose, a dog, a snake, a cat, or a boar,

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtentare tvahorātraṃ śakrapāte tathocchriye /
śvakroṣṭugardhabholūkamāsavāṇartunisvane //
meaning:
कृतेन्तरे त्वहोरात्रं शक्रपाते तथोच्छ्रिये /
श्वक्रोष्टुगर्धभोलूकमासवाणर्तुनिस्वने //
text_mt: [suspension lasts] for a day and a night; likewise at the fall or raising of Indra's banner; / when there is the sound of a dog, a jackal, a donkey, an owl, a wine-pipe, or a musical instrument;

sanskrit_iast:
amedhyaśavaśūdrāntyaśmaśānapatitāntike /
aśubhāsu ca tārāsu vidyutstanitasamplave //
meaning:
अमेध्यशवशूद्रान्त्यश्मशानपतितान्तिके /
अशुभासु च तारासु विद्युत्स्तनितसम्प्लवे //
text_mt: near impure things, a corpse, a śūdra, an outcaste, a cremation ground, or a fallen person; / under inauspicious stars, during a confluence of lightning and thunder,

sanskrit_iast:
bhutkvārdrapāṇirambhontarardharātre 'timārute /
pāṃśuvarṣe diśāndāhe sandhyānīhārabhītiṣu //
meaning:
भुत्क्वार्द्रपाणिरम्भोन्तरर्धरात्रे ऽतिमारुते /
पांशुवर्षे दिशान्दाहे सन्ध्यानीहारभीतिषु //
text_mt: having eaten with wet hands, in water, at midnight, in a violent wind, / during a shower of dust, a burning of the directions, at twilight, in fog, or in times of fear,

sanskrit_iast:
dhāvataḥ prāṇibādhe ca viśiṣṭe gṛhamāgate /
:n
1 brahmacaryāya kalpyate iti ṅa..
2 svaśākhāśrotriye mṛte iti gha.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa ca
3 śaśamārjāraśūkarair iti ṅa..
:p 149
kharoṣṭrayānahastyaśvanaukāvṛkṣādirohaṇe //
meaning:
धावतः प्राणिबाधे च विशिष्टे गृहमागते /
:न्
1 ब्रह्मचर्याय कल्प्यते इति ङ..
2 स्वशाखाश्रोत्रिये मृते इति घ.. , झ.. , ञ.. , ट च
3 शशमार्जारशूकरैर् इति ङ..
:प् 149
खरोष्ट्रयानहस्त्यश्वनौकावृक्षादिरोहणे //
text_mt:
while running, when living beings are distressed, and when a distinguished guest has arrived at the house.
[Footnote]
1. ṅa reads 'brahmacaryāya kalpyate'.
2 "Upon the death of a Vedic scholar of one's own branch" in gha, jha, ña, and ṭa.
3 "By hares, cats, and pigs" in ṅa. / [p. 149]
[and] upon mounting a donkey, camel, vehicle, elephant, horse, boat, tree, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
saptatriṃśadanadhyāyānetāṃstātkālikānviduḥ
//19//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe dharmaśāstraṃ nāma
dviṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha triṣaṣṭhyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śrāddhakalpakathanaṃ
meaning:
सप्तत्रिंशदनध्यायानेतांस्तात्कालिकान्विदुः
//19//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे धर्मशास्त्रं नाम
द्विषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ त्रिषष्ठ्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
श्राद्धकल्पकथनं
text_mt:
These thirty-seven are known as temporary suspensions of Vedic study. //19
Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-second chapter, entitled "Dharmaśāstra", in the Mahāpurāṇa called the Āgneya.
Now follows the one hundred and sixty-third chapter.
Explanation of the Rules for the Ancestral Rite

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
śrāddhakalpaṃ pravakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu /
nimantrya viprān pūrvedyuḥ svāgatenāparāhṇataḥ //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
श्राद्धकल्पं प्रवक्ष्यामि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शृणु /
निमन्त्र्य विप्रान् पूर्वेद्युः स्वागतेनापराह्णतः //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / I shall declare the rules for the ancestral rite, which grant worldly enjoyment and liberation; listen. / Having invited the brāhmaṇas on the preceding day in the afternoon with a welcome,

sanskrit_iast:
prācyopaveśayet pīṭhe yugmāndaive 'tha pitrake /
ayugmān prāṅmukhāndaive trīn paitre caikameva vā //
meaning:
प्राच्योपवेशयेत् पीठे युग्मान्दैवे ऽथ पित्रके /
अयुग्मान् प्राङ्मुखान्दैवे त्रीन् पैत्रे चैकमेव वा //
text_mt: he should seat an even number facing east on a seat for the gods, and for the ancestors, / an odd number facing east for the gods, or three for the ancestors, or even one.

sanskrit_iast:
mātāmahānāmapyevantantraṃ vā vaiśyadevikaṃ /
prāṇiprakṣālanaṃ dattvā viṣṭarārthaṃ kuśānapi //
meaning:
मातामहानामप्येवन्तन्त्रं वा वैश्यदेविकं /
प्राणिप्रक्षालनं दत्त्वा विष्टरार्थं कुशानपि //
text_mt: The procedure is the same for the maternal grandfathers, or the rite for the gods may be common to both. / Having offered water for washing hands and also kuśa grass for seats,

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayedanujñāto viśve devāsa ity ṛcā /
yavairanvavakīryātha(?) bhājane sapavitrake //
meaning:
आवाहयेदनुज्ञातो विश्वे देवास इत्य् ऋचा /
यवैरन्ववकीर्याथ(?) भाजने सपवित्रके //
text_mt: he should invoke [the deities], being permitted, with the verse "viśve devāsaḥ". / Having scattered barley grains into a vessel containing a purifier,

sanskrit_iast:
śannodevyā payaḥ kṣiptvā yavosīti yavāṃs tathā /
yādivyā itimantreṇa haste hy arghaṃ vinikṣipet //
meaning:
शन्नोदेव्या पयः क्षिप्त्वा यवोसीति यवांस् तथा /
यादिव्या इतिमन्त्रेण हस्ते ह्य् अर्घं विनिक्षिपेत् //
text_mt: pouring water with "śan no devī" and barley with "yavo 'si", / he should indeed pour the water offering into the hand with the mantra "yā divyāḥ".

sanskrit_iast:
datvodakaṃ gandhamālyaṃ dhūpadānaṃ pradīpakaṃ /
apasavyaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pitṝṇāmapradakṣiṇaṃ //
:p 150
meaning:
दत्वोदकं गन्धमाल्यं धूपदानं प्रदीपकं /
अपसव्यं ततः कृत्वा पितॄणामप्रदक्षिणं //
:प् 150
text_mt:
Having offered water, perfume, a garland, the presentation of incense, and a lamp, / then placing the sacred thread over the right shoulder, he performs the rites counter-clockwise for the ancestors.
[p. 150]

sanskrit_iast:
dviguṇāṃstu kuśān kṛtvā hy uśantastvetyṛcā pitṝn /
āvāhya tadanujñāto japedāyāntu nastataḥ //
meaning:
द्विगुणांस्तु कुशान् कृत्वा ह्य् उशन्तस्त्वेत्यृचा पितॄन् /
आवाह्य तदनुज्ञातो जपेदायान्तु नस्ततः //
text_mt: Having folded kuśa grasses double, he invokes the ancestors with the verse "uśantas tvā"; / having been permitted by them, he should then recite "ā yāntu naḥ".

sanskrit_iast:
yavārthāstu tilaiḥ kāryāḥ kuryādarghyādi pūrvavat /
dattvārghyaṃ saṃśravān śeṣān pātre kṛtvā vidhānataḥ //
meaning:
यवार्थास्तु तिलैः कार्याः कुर्यादर्घ्यादि पूर्ववत् /
दत्त्वार्घ्यं संश्रवान् शेषान् पात्रे कृत्वा विधानतः //
text_mt: The purposes of barley are to be served with sesame seeds; he should perform the water offering and other rites as before. / Having offered the water offering and poured the remaining wash-waters into a vessel according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛbhyaḥ sthānamasīti nyubjaṃ pātraṃ karotyadhaḥ /
agnau kariṣya ādāya pṛcchatyannaṃ ghṛtaplutaṃ //
meaning:
पितृभ्यः स्थानमसीति न्युब्जं पात्रं करोत्यधः /
अग्नौ करिष्य आदाय पृच्छत्यन्नं घृतप्लुतं //
text_mt: he turns the vessel upside down below with "pitṛbhyaḥ sthānam asi". / Taking food steeped in clarified butter, he asks, "I shall make the offering into fire."

sanskrit_iast:
kuruṣveti hy anujñāto hutvāgnau pitṛyajñavat /
hutaśeṣaṃ pradadyāttu bhājaneṣu samāhitaḥ //
meaning:
कुरुष्वेति ह्य् अनुज्ञातो हुत्वाग्नौ पितृयज्ञवत् /
हुतशेषं प्रदद्यात्तु भाजनेषु समाहितः //
text_mt: Having been permitted with "Perform it!", having offered into fire as in the ancestral sacrifice, / attentive, he should distribute what remains of the oblation into the dishes,

sanskrit_iast:
yathālābhopapanneṣu raupyeṣu tu viśeṣataḥ /
datvānnaṃ pṛthivīpātramiti pātrābhimantraṇaṃ //
meaning:
यथालाभोपपन्नेषु रौप्येषु तु विशेषतः /
दत्वान्नं पृथिवीपात्रमिति पात्राभिमन्त्रणं //
text_mt: which are obtained according to means, but especially silver ones. / Having offered the food, consecrating the vessel with "pṛthivīpātram",

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvedaṃ viṣṇurityanne dvijāṅguṣṭhaṃ niveśayet /
savyāhṛtikāṃ gāyatrīṃ madhuvātā iti tyacaṃ //
meaning:
कृत्वेदं विष्णुरित्यन्ने द्विजाङ्गुष्ठं निवेशयेत् /
सव्याहृतिकां गायत्रीं मधुवाता इति त्यचं //
text_mt: and having recited "idam viṣṇuḥ", he should place the brāhmaṇa's thumb in the food. / Having recited the Gāyatrī with the sacred utterances and the triplet "madhu vātāḥ",

sanskrit_iast:
japtvā yathāsukhaṃ vācyaṃ bhuñjīraṃste 'pi vāgyatāḥ /
annamiṣṭaṃ haviṣyañca dadyājjaptvā pavitrakaṃ //
meaning:
जप्त्वा यथासुखं वाच्यं भुञ्जीरंस्ते ऽपि वाग्यताः /
अन्नमिष्टं हविष्यञ्च दद्याज्जप्त्वा पवित्रकं //
text_mt: he should say, "Eat at your ease," and they should eat, restraining their speech. / Having recited the purifier, he should give the food they desire and sacrificial food.

sanskrit_iast:
annamādāya tṛptāḥ stha śeṣaṃ caivānnamasya ca /
tadannaṃ vikired bhūmau dadyāccāpaḥ sakṛt sakṛt //
meaning:
अन्नमादाय तृप्ताः स्थ शेषं चैवान्नमस्य च /
तदन्नं विकिरेद् भूमौ दद्याच्चापः सकृत् सकृत् //
text_mt: Taking the food, [he asks,] "Are you satisfied?" and [they reply,] "Let the remainder of the food be his." / He should scatter that food on the ground and offer water once each time.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvamannamupādāya satilaṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ /
ucchiṣṭasannidhau piṇḍān pradadyāt pitṛyajñavat //
meaning:
सर्वमन्नमुपादाय सतिलं दक्षिणामुखः /
उच्छिष्टसन्निधौ पिण्डान् प्रदद्यात् पितृयज्ञवत् //
text_mt: Taking all the food mixed with sesame, facing south, / he should offer rice balls near the leftovers, as in the ancestral sacrifice.

sanskrit_iast:
mātāmahānāmapyevaṃ dadyādācamanaṃ tataḥ /
svasti vācyaṃ tataḥ kuryādakṣayyodakameva ca //
meaning:
मातामहानामप्येवं दद्यादाचमनं ततः /
स्वस्ति वाच्यं ततः कुर्यादक्षय्योदकमेव च //
text_mt: He should do likewise for the maternal grandfathers; then he should give sipping-water. / Then he should recite the svasti-blessing and offer water for imperishable satisfaction.

sanskrit_iast:
datvā tu dakṣiṇāṃ śaktyā svadhākāramudāharet /
vācyatāmityanujñātaḥ svapitṛbhyaḥ svadhocyatāṃ(1) //
:n
1 mātāmahānāmityādiḥ, svapitṛbhyaḥ svadhocyatāmityantaḥ
pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
:p 151
meaning:
दत्वा तु दक्षिणां शक्त्या स्वधाकारमुदाहरेत् /
वाच्यतामित्यनुज्ञातः स्वपितृभ्यः स्वधोच्यतां(1) //
:न्
1 मातामहानामित्यादिः, स्वपितृभ्यः स्वधोच्यतामित्यन्तः
पाठः झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 151
text_mt:
Having given the sacrificial fee according to ability, he should utter the word "svadhā". / Being permitted with "Let it be uttered", [he says,] "Let svadhā be uttered to one's own ancestors!"
[Footnote]
1 The text beginning with "mātāmahānām" and ending with "svapitṛbhyaḥ svadhocyatām" is absent in manuscript jha. / [p. 151]

sanskrit_iast:
kuryurastu svadhetyukte bhūmau siñcettato jalaṃ /
prīyantāmiti vā daivaṃ viśve devā jalaṃ dadet //
meaning:
कुर्युरस्तु स्वधेत्युक्ते भूमौ सिञ्चेत्ततो जलं /
प्रीयन्तामिति वा दैवं विश्वे देवा जलं ददेत् //
text_mt: When they say, "Let there be svadhā," he should then sprinkle water on the ground, / or he should offer water to the divine All-Gods with "May they be pleased!"

sanskrit_iast:
dātāro no 'bhivardhantāṃ vedāḥ santatireva ca /
śraddhā ca no māvyagamadbahudeyaṃ ca no .stviti //
meaning:
दातारो नो ऽभिवर्धन्तां वेदाः सन्ततिरेव च /
श्रद्धा च नो माव्यगमद्बहुदेयं च नो .स्त्विति //
text_mt: "May our benefactors prosper, and also the Vedas and progeny; / and may our faith never waver, and may we have much to give."

sanskrit_iast:
ityuktvā tu priyā vācaḥ praṇipatya visarjayet /
vāje vāja iti prītapitṛpūrvaṃ visarjanaṃ(1) //
meaning:
इत्युक्त्वा तु प्रिया वाचः प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् /
वाजे वाज इति प्रीतपितृपूर्वं विसर्जनं(1) //
text_mt: Having spoken these pleasant words and bowed down, he should dismiss them. / The dismissal is preceded by the ancestors being pleased, with "vāje vāje".

sanskrit_iast:
yasmiṃstu saṃśravāḥ pūrvamarghapātre nipātitāḥ /
pitṛpātraṃ taduttānaṃ kṛtvā viprān visarjayet //
meaning:
यस्मिंस्तु संश्रवाः पूर्वमर्घपात्रे निपातिताः /
पितृपात्रं तदुत्तानं कृत्वा विप्रान् विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt: Having turned upright that ancestral vessel in which the wash-waters were previously collected, / he should dismiss the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
pradakṣiṇamanubrajya bhaktvā tu pitṛsevitaṃ /
brahmacārī bhavettāntu rajanīṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha //
meaning:
प्रदक्षिणमनुब्रज्य भक्त्वा तु पितृसेवितं /
ब्रह्मचारी भवेत्तान्तु रजनीं ब्राह्मणैः सह //
text_mt: Having circumambulated them and walked after them, and having eaten what was enjoyed by the ancestors, / he should remain celibate for that night, together with the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
evaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vṛddhau nāndīmukhān pitṝn /
yajeta dadhikarkandhumiśrān piṇḍān yavaiḥ kriyā //
meaning:
एवं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा वृद्धौ नान्दीमुखान् पितॄन् /
यजेत दधिकर्कन्धुमिश्रान् पिण्डान् यवैः क्रिया //
text_mt: Having circumambulated thus, at an auspicious occasion he should worship the Nāndīmukha ancestors / with rice balls mixed with curds and jujube fruits; the rite is performed with barley.

sanskrit_iast:
ekoddiṣṭaṃ daivahīnamekārghaikapavitrakaṃ /
āvāhanāgnaukaraṇarahitaṃ hy apasavyavat //
meaning:
एकोद्दिष्टं दैवहीनमेकार्घैकपवित्रकं /
आवाहनाग्नौकरणरहितं ह्य् अपसव्यवत् //
text_mt: The rite for a single ancestor is devoid of the rite for the gods, has a single water offering and a single purifier, / is without invocation and the offering into fire, and is performed with the sacred thread over the right shoulder.

sanskrit_iast:
upatiṣṭhatāmityakṣayyasthāne pitṛvisarjane /
abhiramyatāmiti vaded brūyuste 'bhiratāḥ sma ha //
meaning:
उपतिष्ठतामित्यक्षय्यस्थाने पितृविसर्जने /
अभिरम्यतामिति वदेद् ब्रूयुस्ते ऽभिरताः स्म ह //
text_mt: Instead of "akṣayya", he says "upatiṣṭhatām"; at the dismissal of the ancestors, / he should say, "Be pleased!", and they should say, "We are pleased."

sanskrit_iast:
gandhodakatilair yuktaṃ kuryāt pātracatuṣṭayaṃ /
arghārthapitṛpātreṣu pretapātraṃ prasecayet //
meaning:
गन्धोदकतिलैर् युक्तं कुर्यात् पात्रचतुष्टयं /
अर्घार्थपितृपात्रेषु प्रेतपात्रं प्रसेचयेत् //
text_mt: He should prepare four vessels supplied with scented water and sesame seeds; / into the ancestors' vessels meant for the water offering, he should pour the vessel for the newly deceased,

sanskrit_iast:
ye samānā iti dvābhyāṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret /
etat sapiṇḍīkaraṇamekoddiṣṭaṃ stiyā saha(2) //
meaning:
ये समाना इति द्वाभ्यां शेषं पूर्ववदाचरेत् /
एतत् सपिण्डीकरणमेकोद्दिष्टं स्तिया सह(2) //
text_mt: with the two verses "ye samānāḥ"; the rest he should perform as before. / This is the rite of sapindisation, or the rite for a single deceased woman.

sanskrit_iast:
arvāksapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ yasya saṃvatsarād bhavet /
:n
1 pitṛpūrvaṃ visarjayediti kha.. , cha.. , jha.. ca
2 stryā apīti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 152
tasyāpyannaṃ sodakumbhaṃ dadyāt saṃvatsaraṃ dvije //
meaning:
अर्वाक्सपिण्डीकरणं यस्य संवत्सराद् भवेत् /
:न्
1 पितृपूर्वं विसर्जयेदिति ख.. , छ.. , झ.. च
2 स्त्र्या अपीति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 152
तस्याप्यन्नं सोदकुम्भं दद्यात् संवत्सरं द्विजे //
text_mt:
He whose sapindisation takes place within a year—
[Footnote]
1 "pitṛpūrvaṃ visarjayet" in kha, cha, and jha.
2 "stryā api" in kha and cha. / [p. 152]
food and a water-pot should be given to a brāhmaṇa for him for a year.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtāhani ca kartavyaṃ pratimāsantu vatsaraṃ /
pratisaṃvatsaraṃ kāryaṃ śrāddhaṃ vai māsikānnavat //
meaning:
मृताहनि च कर्तव्यं प्रतिमासन्तु वत्सरं /
प्रतिसंवत्सरं कार्यं श्राद्धं वै मासिकान्नवत् //
text_mt: And the rite is to be performed on the day of death every month for a year; / an ancestral rite is to be performed every year, just like the monthly food.

sanskrit_iast:
haviṣyānnena vai māsaṃ pāyasena tu vatsaraṃ /
mātsyahāriṇakaurabhraśākunacchāgapārṣataiḥ(1) //
meaning:
हविष्यान्नेन वै मासं पायसेन तु वत्सरं /
मात्स्यहारिणकौरभ्रशाकुनच्छागपार्षतैः(1) //
text_mt: With sacrificial food [they are satisfied] for a month, but with milk-rice for a year; / with the meat of fish, deer, sheep, birds, goats, and spotted deer,

sanskrit_iast:
aiṇarauravavārāhaśāśair māṃsair yathākramaṃ /
māsavṛddhyābhitṛpyanti dattair eva(2) pitāmahāḥ //
meaning:
ऐणरौरववाराहशाशैर् मांसैर् यथाक्रमं /
मासवृद्ध्याभितृप्यन्ति दत्तैर् एव(2) पितामहाः //
text_mt: and with the meat of black buck, the ruru deer, wild boar, and hare, in that order, / the ancestors are completely satisfied with an increase of one month [for each] when they are offered.

sanskrit_iast:
khaḍgāmiṣaṃ mahāśalkaṃ madhuyuktānnameva ca(3) /
lohāmiṣaṃ kālaśākaṃ māṃsaṃ vārdhīnasasya ca //
meaning:
खड्गामिषं महाशल्कं मधुयुक्तान्नमेव च(3) /
लोहामिषं कालशाकं मांसं वार्धीनसस्य च //
text_mt: Rhinoceros meat, large-scaled fish, food mixed with honey, / red meat, kālaśāka greens, and the meat of a rhinoceros or old goat,

sanskrit_iast:
yaddadāti gayāsthañca sarvamānantyamucyate(4) /
tathā varṣātrayodaśyāṃ maghāsu ca na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
यद्ददाति गयास्थञ्च सर्वमानन्त्यमुच्यते(4) /
तथा वर्षात्रयोदश्यां मघासु च न संशयः //
text_mt: and whatever one gives while staying at Gayā—all that is declared to grant infinity; / likewise on the thirteenth lunar day of the rainy season and in the Maghā constellation, without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāṃ prajāṃ vandinaś ca paśūn mukhyān sutānapi /
ghṛtaṃ kṛṣiṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ dviśaphaikaśaphaṃ tathā //
meaning:
कन्यां प्रजां वन्दिनश् च पशून् मुख्यान् सुतानपि /
घृतं कृषिं च वाणिज्यं द्विशफैकशफं तथा //
text_mt: A maiden, offspring, panegyrists, cattle, and pre-eminent sons, / clarified butter, agriculture, commerce, cloven-hoofed and single-hoofed beasts,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmavarcasvinaḥ putrān svarṇarūpye sakupyake /
jñātiśraiṣṭhyaṃ sarvakāmānāpnoti śrāddhadaḥ sadā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मवर्चस्विनः पुत्रान् स्वर्णरूप्ये सकुप्यके /
ज्ञातिश्रैष्ठ्यं सर्वकामानाप्नोति श्राद्धदः सदा //
text_mt: sons endowed with spiritual luster, gold and silver along with base metal, / pre-eminence among kin, and all desires the giver of ancestral rites obtains at all times.

sanskrit_iast:
pratipatprabhṛtiṣvetānvarjayitvā caturdaśīṃ /
śastreṇa tu hatā ye vai teṣāṃ tatra pradīyate //
meaning:
प्रतिपत्प्रभृतिष्वेतान्वर्जयित्वा चतुर्दशीं /
शस्त्रेण तु हता ये वै तेषां तत्र प्रदीयते //
text_mt: On these [days] beginning with the first lunar day, excluding the fourteenth lunar day; / but for those who were killed by a weapon, [an ancestral rite] is offered on that [fourteenth day].

sanskrit_iast:
svargaṃ(5) hy apatyamojaś ca śauryaṃ kṣetraṃ balaṃ tathā /
putraśraiṣṭhyaṃ sasaubhāgyamapatyaṃ mukhyatāṃ sutān //
:n
1 mātsyāvihāriṇaurabhraśākunacchāgapārṣatair iti cha..
2 dattair iheti gha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca
3 madhumudgānnameva veti ṅa..
4 sarvamānantyamaśnute iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
5 svarṇamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 153
meaning:
स्वर्गं(5) ह्य् अपत्यमोजश् च शौर्यं क्षेत्रं बलं तथा /
पुत्रश्रैष्ठ्यं ससौभाग्यमपत्यं मुख्यतां सुतान् //
:न्
1 मात्स्याविहारिणौरभ्रशाकुनच्छागपार्षतैर् इति छ..
2 दत्तैर् इहेति घ.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च
3 मधुमुद्गान्नमेव वेति ङ..
4 सर्वमानन्त्यमश्नुते इति घ.. , ङ.. च
5 स्वर्णमिति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 153
text_mt:
Heaven, offspring, vigor, valor, land, and strength, / superiority among sons, good fortune, progeny, eminence, sons,
[Footnote]
1 "mātsyāvihāriṇaurabhraśākunacchāgapārṣataiḥ" in cha.
2 "dattair iha" in gha, ṅa, and ña.
3 "madhumudgānnameva vā" in ṅa.
4 "sarvamānantyamaśnute" in gha and ṅa.
5 "svarṇam" in kha and cha. / [p. 153]

sanskrit_iast:
pravṛttacakratāṃ putrān vāṇijyaṃ prasutāṃ tathā /
arogitvaṃ yaśo vītaśokatāṃ paramāṅgatiṃ //
meaning:
प्रवृत्तचक्रतां पुत्रान् वाणिज्यं प्रसुतां तथा /
अरोगित्वं यशो वीतशोकतां परमाङ्गतिं //
text_mt: unobstructed authority, sons, trade, and progeny, / freedom from illness, fame, freedom from sorrow, the highest state,

sanskrit_iast:
ghanaṃ vidyāṃ bhiṣakasiddhiṃ rūpyaṃ gāścāpyajāvikaṃ /
aśvānāyuś ca vidhivat yaḥ śrāddhaṃ samprayacchati //
meaning:
घनं विद्यां भिषकसिद्धिं रूप्यं गाश्चाप्यजाविकं /
अश्वानायुश् च विधिवत् यः श्राद्धं सम्प्रयच्छति //
text_mt: wealth, knowledge, medical success, silver, cows, goats and sheep, / horses, and long life—[all these] he who properly performs the ancestral rite receives.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛttikādibharaṇyante sa kāmānāpnuyādimān /
vasurudrāditisutāḥ pitaraḥ śrāddhadevatāḥ //
meaning:
कृत्तिकादिभरण्यन्ते स कामानाप्नुयादिमान् /
वसुरुद्रादितिसुताः पितरः श्राद्धदेवताः //
text_mt: Beginning with Kṛttikā and ending with Bharaṇī, he obtains these desires. / The Vasus, Rudras, and sons of Aditi are the ancestors, the deities of the ancestral rite.

sanskrit_iast:
prīṇayanti manuṣyāṇāṃ(1) pitṝn śrāddhena tarpitāḥ /
āyuḥ prajāṃ dhanaṃ(2) vidyāṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ sukhāni ca //
meaning:
प्रीणयन्ति मनुष्याणां(1) पितॄन् श्राद्धेन तर्पिताः /
आयुः प्रजां धनं(2) विद्यां स्वर्गं मोक्षं सुखानि च //
text_mt: Gratified by the ancestral rite, they please the ancestors of men; / they grant long life, offspring, wealth, knowledge, heaven, liberation, pleasures,

sanskrit_iast:
prayacchanti tathā rājyaṃ prītā nṝṇāṃ pitāmahāḥ(3) //42//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe śrāddhakalpo nāma
triṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
navagrahahomaḥ
meaning:
प्रयच्छन्ति तथा राज्यं प्रीता नॄणां पितामहाः(3) //42//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे श्राद्धकल्पो नाम
त्रिषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ चतुःषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
नवग्रहहोमः
text_mt:
and likewise sovereignty, when pleased, to men's forefathers. //42
Thus ends the one hundred sixty-third chapter, entitled 'Rules for the Ancestral Rite', in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now, the one hundred sixty-fourth chapter.
Fire Oblation to the Nine Planets

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
śrīkāmaḥ śāntikāmo vā grahayajñaṃ samārabhet /
vṛṣṭyāyuḥpuṣṭikāmo vā tathaivābhicaran punaḥ //
:n
1 manuṣyādīniti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 āyuḥ prajñādhanamiti ja.. / āyuḥ prajāṃ balamiti gha..
3 prītāḥ pitṛpitāmahā iti ṅa..
:p 154
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
श्रीकामः शान्तिकामो वा ग्रहयज्ञं समारभेत् /
वृष्ट्यायुःपुष्टिकामो वा तथैवाभिचरन् पुनः //
:न्
1 मनुष्यादीनिति ख.. , छ.. च
2 आयुः प्रज्ञाधनमिति ज.. / आयुः प्रजां बलमिति घ..
3 प्रीताः पितृपितामहा इति ङ..
:प् 154
text_mt:
Puṣkara said: / One who desires prosperity or peace should undertake the planetary sacrifice, / or one who desires rain, longevity, and nourishment, or likewise when performing sorcery.
[Footnote]
1. kha and cha read 'manuṣyādīn'.
2. ja reads 'āyuḥ prajñādhanaṃ'; gha reads 'āyuḥ prajāṃ balam'.
3. ṅa reads 'prītāḥ pitṛpitāmahāḥ'.

sanskrit_iast:
sūryaḥ somo maṅgalaś ca budhaścātha bṛhaspatiḥ /
śukraḥ śanaiś caro rāhuḥ ketuśceti grahāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
सूर्यः सोमो मङ्गलश् च बुधश्चाथ बृहस्पतिः /
शुक्रः शनैश् चरो राहुः केतुश्चेति ग्रहाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: The Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, and Jupiter, / Venus, Saturn, Rāhu, and Ketu—these are known as the planets.

sanskrit_iast:
tāmrakāt sphaṭikādraktacandanāt svarṇarkādubhau /
rajatādayasaḥ śīśāt grahāḥ kāryāḥ kramādime //
meaning:
ताम्रकात् स्फटिकाद्रक्तचन्दनात् स्वर्णर्कादुभौ /
रजतादयसः शीशात् ग्रहाः कार्याः क्रमादिमे //
text_mt: From copper, crystal, red sandalwood, gold, and gold [and iron], both / from silver, iron, and lead, these planets are to be fashioned in order.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇair vāyajellikhya gandhamaṇḍalakeṣu vā /
yathāvarṇaṃ pradeyāni vāsāṃsi kusumāni ca //
meaning:
सुवर्णैर् वायजेल्लिख्य गन्धमण्डलकेषु वा /
यथावर्णं प्रदेयानि वासांसि कुसुमानि च //
text_mt: Or one should worship them drawn in gold, or upon scented circles. / Garments and flowers are to be presented according to their respective colours,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhāś ca valayaś caiva dhūpo deyastu gugguluḥ /
kartavyā mantrayantaś ca caravaḥ pratidaivataṃ //
meaning:
गन्धाश् च वलयश् चैव धूपो देयस्तु गुग्गुलुः /
कर्तव्या मन्त्रयन्तश् च चरवः प्रतिदैवतं //
text_mt: as well as perfumes and offerings; and the incense to be given is bdellium. / Boiled rice offerings must be prepared for each deity while reciting the mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
ākṛṣṇena imaṃ devā agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakut /
udbuddhyasveti ca ṛco yathāsaṅkhyaṃ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
आकृष्णेन इमं देवा अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत् /
उद्बुद्ध्यस्वेति च ऋचो यथासङ्ख्यं प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: "ākṛṣṇena", "imaṃ devāḥ", "agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakut", / and "udbuddhyasva" are the verses proclaimed in order,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛhaspate atiyadaryastathaivālpāt pariśrutaḥ /
śanno devīs tathā kāṇḍāt ketuṃ kṛnvannimās tathā //
meaning:
वृहस्पते अतियदर्यस्तथैवाल्पात् परिश्रुतः /
शन्नो देवीस् तथा काण्डात् केतुं कृन्वन्निमास् तथा //
text_mt: and likewise "bṛhaspate atiyadaryaḥ", "annāt pariśrutaḥ", / "śaṃ no devīḥ", as well as "kāṇḍāt kāṇḍāt", and "ketuṃ kṛṇvan".

sanskrit_iast:
arkaḥ pālāśaḥ khadiro hy apāmārgotha(1) pippalaḥ /
udumbaraḥ śamī durvā kuśāś ca samidhaḥ kramāt //
meaning:
अर्कः पालाशः खदिरो ह्य् अपामार्गोथ(1) पिप्पलः /
उदुम्बरः शमी दुर्वा कुशाश् च समिधः क्रमात् //
text_mt: Calotropis, flame-of-the-forest, catechu, apāmārga, peepal, / cluster fig, śamī, dūrvā grass, and kuśa grass are the firewood sticks in order.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikasyātrāṣṭaśatamaṣṭāviṃśatireva vā /
hotavyā madhusarpirbhyāṃ dadhnā caiva samanvitāḥ //
meaning:
एकैकस्यात्राष्टशतमष्टाविंशतिरेव वा /
होतव्या मधुसर्पिर्भ्यां दध्ना चैव समन्विताः //
text_mt: For each one, one hundred and eight, or indeed twenty-eight, / should be offered into the fire, combined with honey, clarified butter, and curd.

sanskrit_iast:
guḍaudanaṃ pāyasaṃ ca haviṣyaṃ kṣīrayaṣṭikaṃ /
dadhyodanaṃ haviḥ pūpān māṃsaṃ citrānnameva ca //
meaning:
गुडौदनं पायसं च हविष्यं क्षीरयष्टिकं /
दध्योदनं हविः पूपान् मांसं चित्रान्नमेव च //
text_mt: Rice with jaggery, milk porridge, sacrificial food, milk rice, / curd rice, clarified butter, cakes, meat, and variegated food,

sanskrit_iast:
dadyādgrahakramadetaddvijebhyo bhojanaṃ budhaḥ /
śaktito vā yathālābhaṃ satkṛtya vidhipūrvakaṃ //
meaning:
दद्याद्ग्रहक्रमदेतद्द्विजेभ्यो भोजनं बुधः /
शक्तितो वा यथालाभं सत्कृत्य विधिपूर्वकं //
text_mt: the wise man should give as food to the twice-born in order of the planets, / or according to his capacity, or as available, having honoured them according to the rules.

sanskrit_iast:
dhenuḥ śaṅkhas tathānaḍvān hema vāso hayas tathā /
:n
1 khadirastvapāmārgo 'theti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
:p 155
kṛṣṇā gaurāyasaśchāga etā vai dakṣiṇāḥ kramāt //
meaning:
धेनुः शङ्खस् तथानड्वान् हेम वासो हयस् तथा /
:न्
1 खदिरस्त्वपामार्गो ऽथेति ग.. , घ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 155
कृष्णा गौरायसश्छाग एता वै दक्षिणाः क्रमात् //
text_mt:
A cow, a conch, an ox, gold, a garment, a horse,
[Footnote]
1. ga, gha, and ña read 'khadirastvapāmārgo 'tha'.
a black cow, iron, and a goat—these are indeed the sacrificial fees in order.

sanskrit_iast:
yaś ca yasya yadā dūṣyaḥ(1) sa taṃ yatnena pūjayet /
brahmaṇaiṣāṃ varo dattaḥ pūjitāḥ pūjitasya ca //
meaning:
यश् च यस्य यदा दूष्यः(1) स तं यत्नेन पूजयेत् /
ब्रह्मणैषां वरो दत्तः पूजिताः पूजितस्य च //
text_mt: Whichever planet is harmful to whomever at any time, he should diligently worship that one. / A boon was granted to them by Brahmā: when worshipped, [they bring prosperity] to the worshipper.

sanskrit_iast:
grahādhīnā narendrāṇā(2) muchrayāḥ patanāni ca /
bhāvabhāvo ca jagatastasmāt pūjyatamā grahāḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe navagrahahomo nāma
catuḥṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcaṣaṣtyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
nānādharmāḥ
meaning:
ग्रहाधीना नरेन्द्राणा(2) मुछ्रयाः पतनानि च /
भावभावो च जगतस्तस्मात् पूज्यतमा ग्रहाः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे नवग्रहहोमो नाम
चतुःषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चषष्त्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
नानाधर्माः
text_mt:
The rise and fall of kings are subject to the planets, / as are the existence and non-existence of the world; therefore, the planets are most worthy of worship.
Thus ends the one hundred sixty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Fire Oblation to the Nine Planets', in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now, the one hundred sixty-fifth chapter.
Miscellaneous Duties

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
dhyeya ātmā sthito yo 'sau hṛdaye dīpavat prabhuḥ /
ananyaviṣayaṃ kṛtvā mano buddhismṛtīndriyaṃ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
ध्येय आत्मा स्थितो यो ऽसौ हृदये दीपवत् प्रभुः /
अनन्यविषयं कृत्वा मनो बुद्धिस्मृतीन्द्रियं //
text_mt: Agni said: / The sovereign Self, situated like a lamp in the heart, is to be meditated upon, / having made the mind, intellect, memory, and sense faculties free of any other object.

sanskrit_iast:
śrāddhantu dhyāyine deyaṃ(3) gavyaṃ dadhi ghṛtaṃ payaḥ /
priyaṅgavo masūrāś ca vārtākuḥ kodravo na hi //
meaning:
श्राद्धन्तु ध्यायिने देयं(3) गव्यं दधि घृतं पयः /
प्रियङ्गवो मसूराश् च वार्ताकुः कोद्रवो न हि //
text_mt: In an ancestral rite, what should be given to a meditator is produce of cows: curd, clarified butter, and milk; / priyaṅgu and lentils [may be given], but definitely not eggplants or kodo millet.

sanskrit_iast:
saiṃhikayo yadā sūryaṃ grasate parvasandhiṣu /
hasticchāyā tu sā jñeyā śrāddhadānādike 'kṣyā //
:n
1 sadā duḥstha iti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 manuṣyāṇāmiti ṅa..
3 vyāpine deyamiti ṅa..
:p 156
meaning:
सैंहिकयो यदा सूर्यं ग्रसते पर्वसन्धिषु /
हस्तिच्छाया तु सा ज्ञेया श्राद्धदानादिके ऽक्ष्या //
:न्
1 सदा दुःस्थ इति ख.. , छ.. च
2 मनुष्याणामिति ङ..
3 व्यापिने देयमिति ङ..
:प् 156
text_mt:
When the son of Siṃhikā eclipses the sun at the conjunctions of the lunar phases, / that is known as the shadow of the elephant, yielding imperishable fruit in ancestral rites, gifts, and the like.
[Footnote]
1. kha and cha read 'sadā duḥsthaḥ'.
2. ṅa reads 'manuṣyāṇām'.
3. ṅa reads 'vyāpine deyam'.

sanskrit_iast:
pitre caiva yadā somo haṃse caiva kare sthite /
tithirvaivasvato nāma sā chāyā kuñjarasya tu //
meaning:
पित्रे चैव यदा सोमो हंसे चैव करे स्थिते /
तिथिर्वैवस्वतो नाम सा छाया कुञ्जरस्य तु //
text_mt: When the moon is in the asterism of the ancestors and the sun is situated in Hasta, / on the lunar day called Vaivasvata—that indeed is the shadow of an elephant.

sanskrit_iast:
agnaukaraṇaśeṣantu na dadyādvaiśvadevike /
agnyabhāve tu viprasya haste dadyāttu dakṣiṇe //
meaning:
अग्नौकरणशेषन्तु न दद्याद्वैश्वदेविके /
अग्न्यभावे तु विप्रस्य हस्ते दद्यात्तु दक्षिणे //
text_mt: One should not give the remnant of the offering into the fire during the Vaiśvadeva rite; / but in the absence of the fire, he should place it in the right hand of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
na strī duṣyati jāreṇa na vipro vedakarmaṇā /
balātkāropabhuktā cedvairihastagatāpi vā(1) //
meaning:
न स्त्री दुष्यति जारेण न विप्रो वेदकर्मणा /
बलात्कारोपभुक्ता चेद्वैरिहस्तगतापि वा(1) //
text_mt: A woman is not defiled by an adulterer, nor a brāhmaṇa by Vedic rites; / if she was enjoyed by force, or even fallen into the hands of an enemy,

sanskrit_iast:
santyajed dūṣitānnārīmṛtukāle na śuddhyati /
ya ātmatryatirekeṇa dvitīyaṃ nātra paśyati(2) //
meaning:
सन्त्यजेद् दूषितान्नारीमृतुकाले न शुद्ध्यति /
य आत्मत्र्यतिरेकेण द्वितीयं नात्र पश्यति(2) //
text_mt: one should not abandon the defiled woman; she becomes purified at the time of her period. / One who sees no second reality here apart from the Self—

sanskrit_iast:
brahmabhūtaḥ sa eveha yogī cātmarato 'malaḥ /
viṣayendriyasaṃyogāt kecid yogaṃ vadanti vai //
meaning:
ब्रह्मभूतः स एवेह योगी चात्मरतो ऽमलः /
विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगात् केचिद् योगं वदन्ति वै //
text_mt: he alone becomes one with Brahman in this world, an unblemished yogi delighting in the Self. / Some indeed say that yoga is the union of the sense organs with their objects;

sanskrit_iast:
adharmo dharmabuddhyā tu gṛhītastair apaṇḍitaiḥ /
ātmano manasaś caiva saṃyogañca tathā pare //
meaning:
अधर्मो धर्मबुद्ध्या तु गृहीतस्तैर् अपण्डितैः /
आत्मनो मनसश् चैव संयोगञ्च तथा परे //
text_mt: unrighteousness was grasped by those foolish people with the notion that it is righteousness. / Others likewise [say it is] the union of the mind and the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
vṛttihīnaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā kṣetrajñaṃ paramātmani /
ekīkṛtya vimucyeta bandhādyogo 'yamuttamaḥ //
meaning:
वृत्तिहीनं मनः कृत्वा क्षेत्रज्ञं परमात्मनि /
एकीकृत्य विमुच्येत बन्धाद्योगो ऽयमुत्तमः //
text_mt: Having rendered the mind free of mental modifications, unifying the knower of the field / with the Supreme Self, one is liberated from bondage; this is the supreme yoga.

sanskrit_iast:
kuṭumbaiḥ pañcabhiryāmaḥ ṣaṣṭhastatra mahattaraḥ /
devāsuramanuṣyair vā sa jetuṃ naiva śakyate(3) //
meaning:
कुटुम्बैः पञ्चभिर्यामः षष्ठस्तत्र महत्तरः /
देवासुरमनुष्यैर् वा स जेतुं नैव शक्यते(3) //
text_mt: Restraint is [practised] with five family members; the sixth among them is the greatest. / It cannot be conquered even by gods, demons, or men.

sanskrit_iast:
vahirmukhāni sarvāṇi kṛtvā cābhimukhāni vai /
manasyevendriyagrāmaṃ manaścātmani yojayet //
meaning:
वहिर्मुखानि सर्वाणि कृत्वा चाभिमुखानि वै /
मनस्येवेन्द्रियग्रामं मनश्चात्मनि योजयेत् //
text_mt: Having turned all outward-facing senses toward the inside, / one should unite the collection of senses in the mind, and the mind in the Self.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvabhāvavinirmuktaṃ kṣetrajñaṃ brahmaṇi nyaset /
etajjñānañca dhyānañca śeṣo 'nyo granthavistaraḥ(4) //
:n
1 caurahastagatāpi veti kha.. , gha.. , ña ca
2 dvitīyaṃ nānupaśyatīti gha.. , ṭa.. ca
3 sa jetuṃ na ca śakyata iti ga.. , ṅa.. ca
4 śeṣā ye granthavistarā iti ṅa
:p 157
meaning:
सर्वभावविनिर्मुक्तं क्षेत्रज्ञं ब्रह्मणि न्यसेत् /
एतज्ज्ञानञ्च ध्यानञ्च शेषो ऽन्यो ग्रन्थविस्तरः(4) //
:न्
1 चौरहस्तगतापि वेति ख.. , घ.. , ञ च
2 द्वितीयं नानुपश्यतीति घ.. , ट.. च
3 स जेतुं न च शक्यत इति ग.. , ङ.. च
4 शेषा ये ग्रन्थविस्तरा इति ङ
:प् 157
text_mt:
One should place the knower of the field, freed from all states of being, into Brahman. / This is knowledge and meditation; the rest is merely the expansion of texts.
[Footnote]
1. kha, gha, and ña read 'caurahastagatāpi vā'.
2 "he sees no second" in manuscripts gha and ṭa
3 "and he cannot be conquered" in manuscripts ga and ṅa
4 "the remaining text-expansions" in manuscript ṅa

sanskrit_iast:
yannāsti sarvalokasya tadastīti virudhyate /
kathyamānaṃ tathānyasya hṛdaye nāvatiṣṭhate //
meaning:
यन्नास्ति सर्वलोकस्य तदस्तीति विरुध्यते /
कथ्यमानं तथान्यस्य हृदये नावतिष्ठते //
text_mt: What does not exist for the whole world is contradicted by [saying] "it exists"; / likewise, being spoken, it does not remain in the heart of another.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃvedyaṃ hi tad brahma(1) kumārī strīmukhaṃ yathā /
ayogī naiva jānāti jātyandho hi ghaṭaṃ yathā //
meaning:
असंवेद्यं हि तद् ब्रह्म(1) कुमारी स्त्रीमुखं यथा /
अयोगी नैव जानाति जात्यन्धो हि घटं यथा //
text_mt: For that Brahman is incomprehensible, just as the face of a woman is to a virgin maiden; / a non-yogin never knows it, just as a man blind from birth does not know a jar.

sanskrit_iast:
satryasantaṃ dvijaṃ dṛṣṭvā sthānāccalati bhāskaraḥ /
eṣa me maṇḍalaṃ bhittvā paraṃ brahmādhigacchati //
meaning:
सत्र्यसन्तं द्विजं दृष्ट्वा स्थानाच्चलति भास्करः /
एष मे मण्डलं भित्त्वा परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति //
text_mt: Seeing a twice-born man terrified of birth and death, the sun departs from its station: / "This man, piercing through my disc, attains the supreme Brahman."

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsavratañcaiva snānantīrthaṃ phalantapaḥ /
dvijasampādanañcaiva sampannantasya tat phalaṃ //
meaning:
उपवासव्रतञ्चैव स्नानन्तीर्थं फलन्तपः /
द्विजसम्पादनञ्चैव सम्पन्नन्तस्य तत् फलं //
text_mt: The votive observance of fasting, bathing at a sacred ford, ascetic austerity as fruit, / and making gifts to twice-born men—that fruit belongs to him fully accomplished.

sanskrit_iast:
ekākṣaraṃ paraṃ brahma prāṇāyāmaḥ parantapaḥ /
sāvitryāstu paraṃ nāsti pāvanaṃ paramaṃ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
एकाक्षरं परं ब्रह्म प्राणायामः परन्तपः /
सावित्र्यास्तु परं नास्ति पावनं परमं स्मृतः //
text_mt: The single syllable is the supreme Brahman; breath control is the highest ascetic austerity; / but there is nothing higher than the Sāvitrī: it is remembered as the supreme purifier.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ striyaḥ surair bhuktāḥ somagandharvavahnibhiḥ /
bhuñjate mānuṣāḥ paścānnaitā duṣyanti kenacit //
meaning:
पूर्वं स्त्रियः सुरैर् भुक्ताः सोमगन्धर्ववह्निभिः /
भुञ्जते मानुषाः पश्चान्नैता दुष्यन्ति केनचित् //
text_mt: Formerly women were enjoyed by the gods: by Soma, the Gandharvas, and Agni; / men enjoy them afterwards; they are not defiled by anything.

sanskrit_iast:
asavarṇena yo garbhaḥ strīṇāṃ yonau niṣicyate /
aśuddhā tu bhavennārī yāvatchalyaṃ na muñcati //
meaning:
असवर्णेन यो गर्भः स्त्रीणां योनौ निषिच्यते /
अशुद्धा तु भवेन्नारी यावत्छल्यं न मुञ्चति //
text_mt: When a fetus is deposited in the womb of women by a man of different caste, / the woman remains impure as long as she has not released that dart.

sanskrit_iast:
niḥsṛte tu tataḥ śalye rajasā śuddhyate tataḥ /
dhyānena sadṛśannāsti śodhanaṃ pāpakarmaṇāṃ //
meaning:
निःसृते तु ततः शल्ये रजसा शुद्ध्यते ततः /
ध्यानेन सदृशन्नास्ति शोधनं पापकर्मणां //
text_mt: Once that dart has come forth, she is purified by her menstrual flux thereafter. / There is no purification for sinful actions equal to meditation:

sanskrit_iast:
śvapākeṣvapi bhuñjāno dhyānena hi viśuddhyati /
ātmā dhyātā mano dhyānaṃ dhyeyo viṣṇuḥ phalaṃ hariḥ //
meaning:
श्वपाकेष्वपि भुञ्जानो ध्यानेन हि विशुद्ध्यति /
आत्मा ध्याता मनो ध्यानं ध्येयो विष्णुः फलं हरिः //
text_mt: Even one eating among dog-cookers is purified by meditation. / The self is the meditator, the mind is meditation, Viṣṇu is the object of meditation, and Hari is the fruit.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣayāya yatiḥ śrāddhe paṅktipāvanapāvanaḥ /
ārūḍho naiṣṭhikandharmaṃ yastu pracyavate dvijaḥ //
:n
1 svasaṃvedyaṃ hi tad brahma iti ga.. , ṅa.. ca / susaṃvedyaṃ hi tad brahma
iti ja.. , ṭa.. ca / svayaṃ vedyaṃ hi tad brahma iti gha.. , ña.. ca
:p 158
meaning:
अक्षयाय यतिः श्राद्धे पङ्क्तिपावनपावनः /
आरूढो नैष्ठिकन्धर्मं यस्तु प्रच्यवते द्विजः //
:न्
1 स्वसंवेद्यं हि तद् ब्रह्म इति ग.. , ङ.. च / सुसंवेद्यं हि तद् ब्रह्म
इति ज.. , ट.. च / स्वयं वेद्यं हि तद् ब्रह्म इति घ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 158
text_mt:
An ascetic at an ancestral rite secures imperishable [benefit]; he purifies even those who purify the row. / But whichever twice-born man, having mounted the life-long stage, falls away [from it]—
[Apparatus note]
1 "that Brahman is self-known" in manuscripts ga and ṅa; "that Brahman is easily known" in manuscripts ja and ṭa; "that Brahman is self-to-be-known" in manuscripts gha and ña

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ na paśyāmi yena śuddhyetsa ātmahā /
ye ca pravrajitāḥ patnyāṃ yā caiṣāṃ vījasantatiḥ //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं न पश्यामि येन शुद्ध्येत्स आत्महा /
ये च प्रव्रजिताः पत्न्यां या चैषां वीजसन्ततिः //
text_mt: I see no expiation by which that slayer of the self might be purified. / And those [ascetics] who have had intercourse with a wife, and whatever seed-lineage is theirs,

sanskrit_iast:
vidurā nāma caṇḍālā jāyante nātra saṃśayaḥ /
śatiko mriyate gṛdhraḥ śvāsau dvādaśikas tathā //
meaning:
विदुरा नाम चण्डाला जायन्ते नात्र संशयः /
शतिको म्रियते गृध्रः श्वासौ द्वादशिकस् तथा //
text_mt: are born as Caṇḍālas named viduras; there is no doubt about this. / He dies as a vulture of a hundred years, and likewise as a dog of twelve years;

sanskrit_iast:
bhāso viṃśativarṣāṇi sūkaro daśabhis tathā /
apuṣpo viphalo vṛkṣo jāyate kaṇṭakāvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
भासो विंशतिवर्षाणि सूकरो दशभिस् तथा /
अपुष्पो विफलो वृक्षो जायते कण्टकावृतः //
text_mt: a bird of prey for twenty years, and a pig for ten; / he is born as a flowerless, fruitless tree covered in thorns.

sanskrit_iast:
tato dāvāgnidagdhastu sthāṇurbhavati sānugaḥ /
tato varṣaśatānyaṣṭau dve tiṣṭhatyacetanaḥ //
meaning:
ततो दावाग्निदग्धस्तु स्थाणुर्भवति सानुगः /
ततो वर्षशतान्यष्टौ द्वे तिष्ठत्यचेतनः //
text_mt: Then, burnt by a forest fire, he becomes a stump along with his shoots; / then he remains senseless for two hundred and eight years.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu jāyate brahmarākṣasaḥ /
plavena labhate mokṣaṃ kulasyotsādanena vā //
meaning:
पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रे तु जायते ब्रह्मराक्षसः /
प्लवेन लभते मोक्षं कुलस्योत्सादनेन वा //
text_mt: When a thousand years are completed, he is born as a Brahmarākṣasa; / he obtains release by a raft, or by the destruction of his family.

sanskrit_iast:
yogameva niṣeveteta nānyaṃ mantramaghāpahaṃ //29//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe nānādhamā nāma
pañcaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaṭṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
varṇadharmādikathanaṃ
meaning:
योगमेव निषेवेतेत नान्यं मन्त्रमघापहं //29//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे नानाधमा नाम
पञ्चषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षट्षष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
वर्णधर्मादिकथनं
text_mt:
One should devote oneself only to yoga, and to no other mantra, for removing sin.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and sixty-fifth chapter, entitled "Various Dharmas."
Now, the one hundred and sixty-sixth chapter.
The statement on the duties of the castes and stages of life

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
vedasmārtaṃ pravakṣyāmi dharmaṃ vai pañcadhā smṛtaṃ(1) /
varṇatvamekamāśritya yo 'dhikāraḥ pravartate //
:n
1 dharmaṃ vai paramāmṛtamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 159
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच

meaning:
ब्रह्मणा सहितः शेषो दिक्पालाः पान्तु वः सदा /
कीर्तिर्लक्ष्मीर्धृतिर्मेधा पुष्टिः श्रद्धा क्रिया मतिः //
text_mt: together with Brahmā, Śeṣa, and the guardians of the directions protect you always! / May Kīrti, Lakṣmī, Dhṛti, Medhā, Puṣṭi, Śraddhā, Kriyā, Mati,

sanskrit_iast:
buddhir lajjā vapuḥ śāntistuṣṭiḥ kāntiś ca mātaraḥ /
etāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu dharmapatnyāḥ samāgatāḥ //
meaning:
बुद्धिर् लज्जा वपुः शान्तिस्तुष्टिः कान्तिश् च मातरः /
एतास्त्वामभिषिञ्चन्तु धर्मपत्न्याः समागताः //
text_mt: Buddhi, Lajjā, Vapuḥ, Śānti, Tuṣṭi, and Kānti—the divine Mothers— / may these wives of Dharma, assembled together, consecrate you with aspersion!

sanskrit_iast:
ādityaś candramā bhaumo budhajīvaśitārkajāḥ /
grahāstvāmabhiṣiñcantu rāhuḥ ketuś ca tarpitāḥ //
meaning:
आदित्यश् चन्द्रमा भौमो बुधजीवशितार्कजाः /
ग्रहास्त्वामभिषिञ्चन्तु राहुः केतुश् च तर्पिताः //
text_mt: May the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, and Saturn, / the planets, and Rāhu and Ketu, being propitiated, consecrate you with aspersion!

sanskrit_iast:
devadānavagandharvā yakṣarākṣasapannagāḥ /
ṛṣayo manavo gāvo devamātara eva ca //
meaning:
देवदानवगन्धर्वा यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः /
ऋषयो मनवो गावो देवमातर एव च //
text_mt: May the gods, Dānavas, Gandharvas, Yakṣas, Rākṣasas, and serpents, / the ṛṣis, Manus, cows, and the mothers of the gods,

sanskrit_iast:
devapatnyo drumā nāgā daityāścāpsarasāṅgaṇāḥ /
astrāṇi sarvaśāstrāṇi rājāno vāhanāni ca //
meaning:
देवपत्न्यो द्रुमा नागा दैत्याश्चाप्सरसाङ्गणाः /
अस्त्राणि सर्वशास्त्राणि राजानो वाहनानि च //
text_mt: the wives of the gods, trees, Nāgas, Daityas, and celestial nymphs, / missiles, all the scriptures, kings, mounts,

sanskrit_iast:
auṣadhāni ca ratnāni kālasyāvayavāś ca ye /
saritaḥ sāgarāḥ śailāstīrthāni jaladā nadāḥ //
:p 163
meaning:
औषधानि च रत्नानि कालस्यावयवाश् च ये /
सरितः सागराः शैलास्तीर्थानि जलदा नदाः //
:प् 163
text_mt:
medicinal herbs, jewels, the divisions of time, / rivers, oceans, mountains, sacred fords, clouds, and streams—
[Page 163]

sanskrit_iast:
ete tvāmabhiṣiñcantu sarvakāmārthasiddhaye(1) /
alaṅkṛtastato dadyāddhemagonnabhuvādikaṃ //
meaning:
एते त्वामभिषिञ्चन्तु सर्वकामार्थसिद्धये(1) /
अलङ्कृतस्ततो दद्याद्धेमगोन्नभुवादिकं //
text_mt: may these consecrate you with aspersion for the attainment of all desires and purposes!' / Adorned, he should then give gold, cows, food, land, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
kapile sarvadevānāṃ pūjanīyāsi rohiṇi /
tīrthadevamayī yasmādataḥśāntiṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
कपिले सर्वदेवानां पूजनीयासि रोहिणि /
तीर्थदेवमयी यस्मादतःशान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt: 'O tawny cow Rohiṇī, you are worthy of worship by all the gods; / since you consist of sacred fords and deities, therefore grant me peace!

sanskrit_iast:
puṇyastvaṃ śaṅkha puṇyānāṃ maṅgalānāñca maṅgalaṃ /
viṣṇunā vidhṛto nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
पुण्यस्त्वं शङ्ख पुण्यानां मङ्गलानाञ्च मङ्गलं /
विष्णुना विधृतो नित्यमतः शान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt: O conch, you are pure among pure things, the auspiciousness of auspicious things, / held perpetually by Viṣṇu; therefore grant me peace!

sanskrit_iast:
dharma tvaṃ vṛṣarūpeṇa jagadānandakārakaḥ /
aṣṭamūrteradhiṣṭānamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
धर्म त्वं वृषरूपेण जगदानन्दकारकः /
अष्टमूर्तेरधिष्टानमतः शान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt: O Dharma, in the form of a bull you bring bliss to the world; / you are the abode of the Eight-formed Lord; therefore grant me peace!

sanskrit_iast:
hiraṇyagarbhagarbhasthaṃ hemavījaṃ vibhāvasoḥ /
anantapuṇyaphaladamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
हिरण्यगर्भगर्भस्थं हेमवीजं विभावसोः /
अनन्तपुण्यफलदमतः शान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt: Gold, seated in the womb of Hiraṇyagarbha, the seed of Agni, / grants the fruit of endless religious merit; therefore grant me peace!

sanskrit_iast:
pītavastrayugaṃ yasmādvāsudevasya vallabhaṃ /
pradānāttasya vai viṣṇurataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
पीतवस्त्रयुगं यस्माद्वासुदेवस्य वल्लभं /
प्रदानात्तस्य वै विष्णुरतः शान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt: Since a pair of yellow garments is dear to Vāsudeva, / by its gift may Viṣṇu [be pleased]; therefore grant me peace!

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇustvaṃ matsyarūpeṇa yasmādamṛtasambhavaḥ /
candrārkavāhano nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
विष्णुस्त्वं मत्स्यरूपेण यस्मादमृतसम्भवः /
चन्द्रार्कवाहनो नित्यमतः शान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt: O Viṣṇu, since as the Fish incarnation you were born of nectar, / constantly bearing the Sun and Moon; therefore grant me peace!

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttvaṃ pṛthivī sarvā dhenuḥ keśavasannibhā /
sarvapāpaharā nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
यस्मात्त्वं पृथिवी सर्वा धेनुः केशवसन्निभा /
सर्वपापहरा नित्यमतः शान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt: Since you, the entire Earth, are a milch-cow resembling Keśava, / eternally removing all sins; therefore grant me peace!

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādāyasakarmāṇi tavādhīnāni sarvadā /
lāṅgalādyāyudhādīni ataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
यस्मादायसकर्माणि तवाधीनानि सर्वदा /
लाङ्गलाद्यायुधादीनि अतः शान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt: Since iron implements, plows, weapons, and the like, / are forever dependent on you; therefore grant me peace!

sanskrit_iast:
yasmāttvaṃ ssarvayajñānāmaṅgatvena vyavasthitaḥ /
yonirvibhāvasornityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me //
meaning:
यस्मात्त्वं स्सर्वयज्ञानामङ्गत्वेन व्यवस्थितः /
योनिर्विभावसोर्नित्यमतः शान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे //
text_mt: Since you stand as a limb of all sacrifices, / the perpetual source of Agni; therefore grant me peace!

sanskrit_iast:
gavāmaṅgeṣu tiṣṭhanti bhuvanāni caturdaśa /
yasmāttasmācchivaṃ me syādiha loke paratra ca //
:n
1 dharmakāmārthasiddhaye iti kha..
:p 164
meaning:
गवामङ्गेषु तिष्ठन्ति भुवनानि चतुर्दश /
यस्मात्तस्माच्छिवं मे स्यादिह लोके परत्र च //
:न्
1 धर्मकामार्थसिद्धये इति ख..
:प् 164
text_mt:
The fourteen worlds reside in the limbs of cows; / because of that, may there be auspiciousness for me in this world and the next!'
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: Or dharmakāmārthasiddhaye in ms. kha.] / [Page 164]

sanskrit_iast:
yasmādaśūnyaṃ śayanaṃ keśavasya śivasya ca /
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu dattā janmani janmani(1) //
meaning:
यस्मादशून्यं शयनं केशवस्य शिवस्य च /
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु दत्ता जन्मनि जन्मनि(1) //
text_mt: 'Since the couch of Keśava and Śiva is never empty, / may the bed given by me also never be empty in birth after birth!

sanskrit_iast:
yathā ratneṣu sarveṣu sarve devāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ /
tathā śāntiṃ prayacchantu ratnadānena me surāḥ //
meaning:
यथा रत्नेषु सर्वेषु सर्वे देवाः प्रतिष्ठिताः /
तथा शान्तिं प्रयच्छन्तु रत्नदानेन मे सुराः //
text_mt: Just as all the gods are situated in all jewels, / so may the gods grant me peace by this gift of jewels!

sanskrit_iast:
yathā bhūmipradānasya kalāṃ nārhanti ṣoḍaśīṃ /
dānānyanyāni me śāntirbhūmidānādbhavatviha //
meaning:
यथा भूमिप्रदानस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीं /
दानान्यन्यानि मे शान्तिर्भूमिदानाद्भवत्विह //
text_mt: Just as other gifts are not worth a sixteenth part / of the gift of land, may peace come to me here through the gift of land!'

sanskrit_iast:
grahayajño 'yutahomo dakṣiṇābhī raṇe jitiḥ /
vivāhotsavayajñeṣu pratiṣṭhādiṣu karmaṣu //
meaning:
ग्रहयज्ञो ऽयुतहोमो दक्षिणाभी रणे जितिः /
विवाहोत्सवयज्ञेषु प्रतिष्ठादिषु कर्मषु //
text_mt: The sacrifice to the planets with ten thousand fire oblations, with sacrificial fees, brings victory in battle, / in marriages, festivals, sacrifices, and rites such as consecration.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmāptaye lakṣakoṭihomadvayaṃ mataṃ /
gṛhadeśe maṇḍape 'tha(2) ayute hastamātrakaṃ //
meaning:
सर्वकामाप्तये लक्षकोटिहोमद्वयं मतं /
गृहदेशे मण्डपे ऽथ(2) अयुते हस्तमात्रकं //
text_mt: The two fire oblations—of one hundred thousand and ten million—are taught for the attainment of all desires. / In the house or in a pavilion, for the rite of ten thousand, [a fire-pit of] only one cubit,

sanskrit_iast:
mekhalāyonisaṃyuktaṃ kuṇḍañcatvāra ṛtvijaḥ /
svayameko 'pi vā lakṣe sarvaṃ daśaguṇaṃ hi tat //
meaning:
मेखलायोनिसंयुक्तं कुण्डञ्चत्वार ऋत्विजः /
स्वयमेको ऽपि वा लक्षे सर्वं दशगुणं हि तत् //
text_mt: furnished with stepped girdles and a spout, and four officiating priests [are required], / or even oneself alone; but for a hundred thousand, all that is tenfold.

sanskrit_iast:
caturhastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā tārkṣañcātrādhikaṃ yajet /
sāmadhvaniśīrastvaṃ vāhanaṃ pameṣṭhinaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्हस्तं द्विहस्तं वा तार्क्षञ्चात्राधिकं यजेत् /
सामध्वनिशीरस्त्वं वाहनं पमेष्ठिनः //
text_mt: One should worship [in a fire-pit of] four cubits or two cubits; and here one should additionally worship Garuḍa: / 'You whose head is the sound of the Sāmaveda, mount of the Supreme Lord,

sanskrit_iast:
viṣayāpaharo nityamataḥ śāntiṃ prayaccha me /
pūrvavat kuṇḍamāmantrya lakṣahomaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
विषयापहरो नित्यमतः शान्तिं प्रयच्छ मे /
पूर्ववत् कुण्डमामन्त्र्य लक्षहोमं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: who constantly destroys worldly attachments, therefore grant me peace!' / Having consecrated the fire-pit as before, one should perform the fire oblation of one hundred thousand.

sanskrit_iast:
vasordhārāṃ tato dadyācchayyābhūṣādikaṃ dadet /
tatrāpi daśa cāṣṭau ca lakṣahome tathartvijaḥ //
meaning:
वसोर्धारां ततो दद्याच्छय्याभूषादिकं ददेत् /
तत्रापि दश चाष्टौ च लक्षहोमे तथर्त्विजः //
text_mt: He should then pour the continuous stream of clarified butter and give beds, ornaments, and the like. / There also, in the oblation of one hundred thousand, there are ten or eight officiating priests.

sanskrit_iast:
putrānnarājyavijayabhuktimuktyādi(3) cāpnuyāt /
dakṣiṇābhiḥ phalenāsmācchatrughnaḥ koṭihomakaḥ //
:n
1 tathā janmani janmanīti ṅa..
2 gṛhādau maṇḍape vātheti kha.. / gṛhādau maṇḍape caivamiti
ña..
3 putrārtharājyavijayabhuktimuktyādīti kha.. , ṅa.. ca
:p 165
meaning:
पुत्रान्नराज्यविजयभुक्तिमुक्त्यादि(3) चाप्नुयात् /
दक्षिणाभिः फलेनास्माच्छत्रुघ्नः कोटिहोमकः //
:न्
1 तथा जन्मनि जन्मनीति ङ..
2 गृहादौ मण्डपे वाथेति ख.. / गृहादौ मण्डपे चैवमिति
ञ..
3 पुत्रार्थराज्यविजयभुक्तिमुक्त्यादीति ख.. , ङ.. च
:प् 165
text_mt:
He obtains sons, food, kingdom, victory, worldly enjoyment, liberation, and so on. / By its sacrificial fees and fruit, the rite of ten million fire oblations destroys enemies.
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: Or tathā janmani janmani in ms. ṅa.]
[Footnote 2: Or gṛhādau maṇḍape vātha in ms. kha; gṛhādau maṇḍape caivam in ms. ña.]
[Footnote 3: Or putrārtharājyavijayabhuktimuktyādi in mss. kha and ṅa.] / [Page 165]

sanskrit_iast:
caturhastaṃ cāṣṭahastaṃ kuṇḍandvādaśa ca dvijāḥ /
pañcaviṃśaṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ vā paṭe dvāre catuṣṭayaṃ //
meaning:
चतुर्हस्तं चाष्टहस्तं कुण्डन्द्वादश च द्विजाः /
पञ्चविंशं षोडशं वा पटे द्वारे चतुष्टयं //
text_mt: The fire-pit is of four cubits or eight cubits, and twelve brahmins [are employed], / or twenty-five or sixteen; on the cloth and at the four doors,

sanskrit_iast:
koṭihomī sarvakāmī viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati /
homastu grahamantrair vā gāyatryā vaiṣṇavair api //
meaning:
कोटिहोमी सर्वकामी विष्णुलोकं स गच्छति /
होमस्तु ग्रहमन्त्रैर् वा गायत्र्या वैष्णवैर् अपि //
text_mt: the performer of the ten million oblations attains all desires and goes to the realm of Viṣṇu. / The fire oblation may be performed with mantras of the planets, the Gāyatrī, Vaiṣṇava mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
jātavedomukhaiḥ śaivaiḥ(1) vaidikaiḥ prathitair api /
tilair yavair ghṛtair aśvamedhaphalādibhāk //
meaning:
जातवेदोमुखैः शैवैः(1) वैदिकैः प्रथितैर् अपि /
तिलैर् यवैर् घृतैर् अश्वमेधफलादिभाक् //
text_mt: with celebrated Vedic mantras beginning with Jātavedas, or Śaiva mantras, / using sesame, barley, and clarified butter; he attains the fruit of an horse sacrifice and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
vidveṣaṇābhicāreṣu trikoṇaṃ kuṇḍamiṣyate /
samidho vāmahastena śyenāsthyanalasaṃyutāḥ //
meaning:
विद्वेषणाभिचारेषु त्रिकोणं कुण्डमिष्यते /
समिधो वामहस्तेन श्येनास्थ्यनलसंयुताः //
text_mt: In rites of causing hatred and malevolent sorcery, a triangular fire-pit is prescribed. / Sacrificial sticks mixed with bones of hawks and fire [are offered] with the left hand,

sanskrit_iast:
raktabhūṣair muktakeśair dhyāyadbhiraśivaṃ ripoḥ /
durmitriyāstasmai santu yo dveṣṭi huṃ phaḍiti ca //
meaning:
रक्तभूषैर् मुक्तकेशैर् ध्यायद्भिरशिवं रिपोः /
दुर्मित्रियास्तस्मै सन्तु यो द्वेष्टि हुं फडिति च //
text_mt: wearing red ornaments, with disheveled hair, meditating on the misfortune of the enemy, / reciting: 'May those who hate [us] be without friends, huṃ phaṭ!'

sanskrit_iast:
chindyāt kṣureṇa pratimāṃ piṣṭarūpaṃ ripuṃ hanet(2) /
yajedekaṃ pīḍakaṃ vā yaḥ sa kṛtvā divaṃ vrajet //
:e ity āgneye mahapurāṇe 'yutalakṣakoṭihomā nāma
saptaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
mahāpātakādikathanam
meaning:
छिन्द्यात् क्षुरेण प्रतिमां पिष्टरूपं रिपुं हनेत्(2) /
यजेदेकं पीडकं वा यः स कृत्वा दिवं व्रजेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महपुराणे ऽयुतलक्षकोटिहोमा नाम
सप्तषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
महापातकादिकथनम्
text_mt:
He should cut the image with a razor and slay the enemy made of flour. / He who worships one planet or the tormentor [of planets], having done so, goes to heaven.
Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-seventh chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, entitled 'The Fire Oblations of Ten Thousand, One Hundred Thousand, and Ten Million'.
Now begins the one hundred and sixty-eighth chapter.
Account of the Great Sins and Related Matters

puṣkara uvāca
daṇḍaṃ kuryānnṛpo nṝṇāṃ prāyaścittamakurvatāṃ /
kāmato 'kāmato vāpi prāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ caret //
:n
1 jātavedomukhaiḥ saurair iti kha..
2 ripuṃ harediti ṅa.. , ña.. ca
:p 166
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
दण्डं कुर्यान्नृपो नॄणां प्रायश्चित्तमकुर्वतां /
कामतो ऽकामतो वापि प्रायश्चित्तं कृतं चरेत् //
:न्
1 जातवेदोमुखैः सौरैर् इति ख..
2 रिपुं हरेदिति ङ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 166
text_mt:
Puṣkara said: / The king should inflict punishment upon men who do not perform expiation. / Whether committed intentionally or unintentionally, one must perform the prescribed expiation.
[Footnote]
1. "jātavedomukhaiḥ saurair" in Kha.
2. "ripuṃ harediti" in Ṅa. and Ña. / p. 166

sanskrit_iast:
mattakruddhāturāṇāṃ ca na bhuñjīta kadācana /
mahāpātakināṃ spṛṣṭaṃ yacca spṛṣṭamudakyayā //
meaning:
मत्तक्रुद्धातुराणां च न भुञ्जीत कदाचन /
महापातकिनां स्पृष्टं यच्च स्पृष्टमुदक्यया //
text_mt: One should never eat the food of the intoxicated, the enraged, or the diseased, / nor what is touched by those guilty of great sins, nor what is touched by a menstruating woman;

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca(1) vārdhuṣergāyanasya ca /
abhiśaptasya ṣaṇḍasya yasyāścopapatirgṛhe //
meaning:
गणान्नं गणिकान्नं च(1) वार्धुषेर्गायनस्य च /
अभिशप्तस्य षण्डस्य यस्याश्चोपपतिर्गृहे //
text_mt: nor the food of a corporate guild, nor the food of a courtezan, nor of a usurer, nor of a singer, / nor of an accused person, nor of a eunuch, nor of a man in whose house a paramour dwells;

sanskrit_iast:
rajakasya nṛśaṃsasya vandinaḥ kitavasya ca /
mithyātapasvinaś caiva cauradaṇḍikayos tathā(2) //
meaning:
रजकस्य नृशंसस्य वन्दिनः कितवस्य च /
मिथ्यातपस्विनश् चैव चौरदण्डिकयोस् तथा(2) //
text_mt: nor of a washerman, nor of a cruel person, nor of a bard, nor of a gambler, / nor indeed of a false ascetic, nor of a thief, nor of a rod-bearer [policeman];

sanskrit_iast:
kuṇḍagolastrījitānāṃ vedavikrayiṇas tathā /
śailūṣatantravāyānnaṃ kṛtaghnasyānnameva ca //
meaning:
कुण्डगोलस्त्रीजितानां वेदविक्रयिणस् तथा /
शैलूषतन्त्रवायान्नं कृतघ्नस्यान्नमेव च //
text_mt: nor of sons of adulteresses, sons of widows, or henpecked men, nor of a seller of the Veda, / nor the food of an actor, nor of a weaver, nor the food of an ungrateful person;

sanskrit_iast:
karmārasya niṣādasya celanirṇejakasya ca /
mithyāpravrajitasyānnampuṃś calyāstailikasya ca //
meaning:
कर्मारस्य निषादस्य चेलनिर्णेजकस्य च /
मिथ्याप्रव्रजितस्यान्नम्पुंश् चल्यास्तैलिकस्य च //
text_mt: nor of a blacksmith, nor of a Niṣāda, nor of a clothes-washer, / nor the food of a false renunciant, nor of an unchaste woman, nor of an oilman;

sanskrit_iast:
ārūḍhapatitasyānnaṃ vidviṣṭānnaṃ ca varjayet /
tathaiva brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ brāhmaṇenānimantritaḥ //
meaning:
आरूढपतितस्यान्नं विद्विष्टान्नं च वर्जयेत् /
तथैव ब्राह्मणस्यान्नं ब्राह्मणेनानिमन्त्रितः //
text_mt: nor the food of an apostate ascetic; and one should avoid food offered with malice; / likewise, the food of a brāhmaṇa, if uninvited by that brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇānnañca śūdreṇa nādyāccaiva nimantritaḥ /
eṣāmanyatamasyānnamamatyā vā tryahaṃ kṣapet //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान्नञ्च शूद्रेण नाद्याच्चैव निमन्त्रितः /
एषामन्यतमस्यान्नममत्या वा त्र्यहं क्षपेत् //
text_mt: And the food of a brāhmaṇa should not be eaten by a śūdra, even when invited. / If one eats the food of any of these unwittingly, one should fast for three days;

sanskrit_iast:
matyā bhuktvā caret kṛcchraṃ retoviṇmūtrameva ca /
caṇḍālaśvapacānnantu bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret //
meaning:
मत्या भुक्त्वा चरेत् कृच्छ्रं रेतोविण्मूत्रमेव च /
चण्डालश्वपचान्नन्तु भुक्त्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत् //
text_mt: having eaten it wittingly, one should perform a kṛcchra penance; likewise for [consuming] semen, feces, or urine. / But having eaten the food of a Caṇḍāla or a Śvapāca, one should perform a cāndrāyaṇa penance.

sanskrit_iast:
anirdiśaṃ ca pretānnaṃ gavāghrātaṃ tathaiva ca /
śūdrocchiṣṭaṃ śunocchiṣṭaṃ patitānnaṃ tathaiva ca //
meaning:
अनिर्दिशं च प्रेतान्नं गवाघ्रातं तथैव च /
शूद्रोच्छिष्टं शुनोच्छिष्टं पतितान्नं तथैव च //
text_mt: And food during the ten days of mourning, food smelled by a cow, / the leavings of a śūdra, the leavings of a dog, and likewise the food of an outcaste:

sanskrit_iast:
taptakṛcchraṃ prakurvīta aśauce kṛcchramācaret /
aśauce yasya yo bhuṅkte sopyaśuddhas tathā bhavet //
meaning:
तप्तकृच्छ्रं प्रकुर्वीत अशौचे कृच्छ्रमाचरेत् /
अशौचे यस्य यो भुङ्क्ते सोप्यशुद्धस् तथा भवेत् //
text_mt: one should perform a taptakṛcchra penance, [and] during ritual impurity one should perform a kṛcchra penance. / Whoever eats [the food] of someone during ritual impurity, he too becomes impure in like manner.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛtapañcanakhāt kūpādamedhyena sakṛdyutāt /
:n
1 gaṇānāṃ gaṇikānāñceti ṅa.. , ña.. ca
2 cauradāmbhikayostatheti ña..
:p 167
apaḥ pītvā tryahaṃ tiṣṭhet sopavāso dvijottamaḥ //
meaning:
मृतपञ्चनखात् कूपादमेध्येन सकृद्युतात् /
:न्
1 गणानां गणिकानाञ्चेति ङ.. , ञ.. च
2 चौरदाम्भिकयोस्तथेति ञ..
:प् 167
अपः पीत्वा त्र्यहं तिष्ठेत् सोपवासो द्विजोत्तमः //
text_mt:
