From a well containing a dead five-nailed animal, or tainted with feces once,
[Footnote]
1. "gaṇānāṃ gaṇikānāñceti" in Ṅa. and Ña.
2. "cauradāmbhikayostatheti" in Ña. / p. 167
having drunk the water, the best of the twice-born should remain fasting for three days.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvatra śūdre pādaḥ syād dvitrayaṃ vaiśyabhūpayoḥ(1) /
viḍvarāhakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ gomāyoḥ kapikākayoḥ //
meaning:
सर्वत्र शूद्रे पादः स्याद् द्वित्रयं वैश्यभूपयोः(1) /
विड्वराहखरोष्ट्राणां गोमायोः कपिकाकयोः //
text_mt: Everywhere for a śūdra there should be a quarter [penance], two and three [quarters] for a vaiśya and a king [kṣatriya]. / Having consumed the urine and feces of a domesticated pig, a donkey, a camel,

sanskrit_iast:
prāśya mūtrapurīṣāṇi dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret /
śuṣkāṇi jagdhvā māṃsāni(2) pretānnaṃ karakāṇi ca //
meaning:
प्राश्य मूत्रपुरीषाणि द्विजश्चान्द्रायणं चरेत् /
शुष्काणि जग्ध्वा मांसानि(2) प्रेतान्नं करकाणि च //
text_mt: a jackal, a monkey, or a crow, a twice-born should perform a cāndrāyaṇa penance; / likewise having eaten dried meat, food during mourning, or hail-stones;

sanskrit_iast:
kravyādaśūkaroṣṭrāṇāṃ gomāyoḥ kapikākayoḥ /
gonarāśvakharoṣṭrāṇāṃ chatrākaṃ grāmakukkuṭaṃ //
meaning:
क्रव्यादशूकरोष्ट्राणां गोमायोः कपिकाकयोः /
गोनराश्वखरोष्ट्राणां छत्राकं ग्रामकुक्कुटं //
text_mt: or having eaten the meat of carnivores, boars, camels, jackals, monkeys, crows, / cows, humans, horses, donkeys, camels, or mushrooms, or a village rooster,

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsaṃ jagdhvā kuñjarasya taptakṛcchreṇa śuddhyati /
āmaśrāddhe tathā bhuktvā brahmacārī madhu tvadan //
meaning:
मांसं जग्ध्वा कुञ्जरस्य तप्तकृच्छ्रेण शुद्ध्यति /
आमश्राद्धे तथा भुक्त्वा ब्रह्मचारी मधु त्वदन् //
text_mt: or the meat of an elephant, one is purified by a taptakṛcchra penance. / Likewise, having eaten at an uncooked-grain ancestral rite, or a celibate student having consumed honey,

sanskrit_iast:
laśunaṃ guñjanaṃ cādyāt prājāpatyādinā śuciḥ(3) /
bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryān māṃsañcātmakṛtantathā //
meaning:
लशुनं गुञ्जनं चाद्यात् प्राजापत्यादिना शुचिः(3) /
भुक्त्वा चान्द्रायणं कुर्यान् मांसञ्चात्मकृतन्तथा //
text_mt: or if one should eat garlic or turnips, one becomes pure through a prājāpatya or other [penance]. / Having eaten meat prepared for oneself, one should perform a cāndrāyaṇa penance;

sanskrit_iast:
pelugavyañca peyūṣaṃ tathā śleṣmātakaṃ mṛdaṃ /
vṛthākṛśarasaṃyāvapāyasāpūpaśaṣkulīḥ //
meaning:
पेलुगव्यञ्च पेयूषं तथा श्लेष्मातकं मृदं /
वृथाकृशरसंयावपायसापूपशष्कुलीः //
text_mt: and [milk of a cow within ten days of calving], colostrum, the fruit of the śleṣmātaka, earth, / kṛśara, saṃyāva, rice-pudding, sweet cakes, and fried pastries made in vain [not offered to deities];

sanskrit_iast:
anupākṛṭamāṃsāni devānnāni havīṃṣi ca /
gavāñca mahiṣīṇāṃ ca varjayitvā tathāpyajāṃ //
meaning:
अनुपाकृटमांसानि देवान्नानि हवींषि च /
गवाञ्च महिषीणां च वर्जयित्वा तथाप्यजां //
text_mt: meat from an animal not consecrated for sacrifice, food offered to deities, and oblations. / Except for cows, buffaloes, and also she-goats,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakṣīrāṇi varjyāṇi tāsāñcaivāpyannirdaśaṃ /
śaśakaḥ śalyakī godhā khaḍgaḥ kūrmastathaiva ca //
meaning:
सर्वक्षीराणि वर्ज्याणि तासाञ्चैवाप्यन्निर्दशं /
शशकः शल्यकी गोधा खड्गः कूर्मस्तथैव च //
text_mt: all kinds of milk are to be avoided, and even their milk within ten days [of calving]. / The hare, porcupine, monitor lizard, rhinoceros, and tortoise:

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyāḥ pañcanakhāḥ proktāḥ pariśeṣāś ca varjitāḥ /
pāṭhīnarohitānmatsyān siṃhatuṇḍāṃś ca bhakṣayet //
meaning:
भक्ष्याः पञ्चनखाः प्रोक्ताः परिशेषाश् च वर्जिताः /
पाठीनरोहितान्मत्स्यान् सिंहतुण्डांश् च भक्षयेत् //
text_mt: these five-nailed animals are declared edible, and the remaining ones are forbidden. / One may eat the pāṭhīna and rohita fishes, and the siṃhatuṇḍa.

sanskrit_iast:
yavagodhūmajaṃ sarvaṃ payasaś caiva vikriyāḥ /
vāgaṣāḍgavacakrādīn sasnehamuṣitaṃ tathā //
:n
1 dvitīyaṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoreti ka.. , kha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca
2 śuṣkāṇi dagdhamaṃsāni iti ṅa..
3 prājāpatyāddvijaḥ śuciriti kha..
:p 168
meaning:
यवगोधूमजं सर्वं पयसश् चैव विक्रियाः /
वागषाड्गवचक्रादीन् सस्नेहमुषितं तथा //
:न्
1 द्वितीयं वैश्यशूद्रयोरेति क.. , ख.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च
2 शुष्काणि दग्धमंसानि इति ङ..
3 प्राजापत्याद्द्विजः शुचिरिति ख..
:प् 168
text_mt:
All products made of barley and wheat, modifications of milk, / [dishes like] vāgaṣāḍga, vacakra, and the like, even if kept overnight, provided they contain oil or ghee, [may be eaten].
[Footnote]
1. "dvitīyaṃ vaiśyaśūdrayoreti" in Ka., Kha., Ṅa., and Ña.
2. "śuṣkāṇi dagdhamaṃsāni iti" in Ṅa.
3. "prājāpatyāddvijaḥ śuciriti" in Kha. / p. 168

sanskrit_iast:
agnihotraparīddhāgnirbrāhmaṇaḥ kāmacārataḥ /
cāndrāyaṇaṃ carenmāsaṃ vīravadhvāsanaṃ hitaṃ //
meaning:
अग्निहोत्रपरीद्धाग्निर्ब्राह्मणः कामचारतः /
चान्द्रायणं चरेन्मासं वीरवध्वासनं हितं //
text_mt: A brāhmaṇa whose fire is kindled for the agnihotra, who acts willfully, / should perform a cāndrāyaṇa penance for a month; the posture of a hero's wife is beneficial.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṅganāgamaḥ /
mahānti pātakānyāhuḥ saṃyogaś caiva taiḥ saha //
meaning:
ब्रह्महत्या सुरापानं स्तेयं गुर्वङ्गनागमः /
महान्ति पातकान्याहुः संयोगश् चैव तैः सह //
text_mt: Killing a brāhmaṇa, drinking liquor, theft, and intercourse with the guru's wife: / they call these the great sins, as well as association with those [who commit them].

sanskrit_iast:
anṛte ca samutkarṣo rājagāmi ca paiśunaṃ /
guroścālīkanirbandhaḥ samānaṃ brahmahatyayā(1) //
meaning:
अनृते च समुत्कर्षो राजगामि च पैशुनं /
गुरोश्चालीकनिर्बन्धः समानं ब्रह्महत्यया(1) //
text_mt: Exalting oneself falsely, slander reaching the king, / and obstinate false accusation against a guru are equal to killing a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmojjhyavedanindā ca kauṭasākṣyaṃ suhṛdbadhaḥ /
garhitānnājyayorjagdhiḥ(2) surāpānasamāni ṣaṭ //
meaning:
ब्रह्मोज्झ्यवेदनिन्दा च कौटसाक्ष्यं सुहृद्बधः /
गर्हितान्नाज्ययोर्जग्धिः(2) सुरापानसमानि षट् //
text_mt: Abandoning the Veda, reviling the Veda, false testimony, slaying a friend, / eating condemned food or condemned clarified butter: these six are equal to drinking liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
nikṣepasyāpaharaṇaṃ narāśvarajatasya ca /
bhūmivajramaṇīnāñca rukmasteyasamaṃ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
निक्षेपस्यापहरणं नराश्वरजतस्य च /
भूमिवज्रमणीनाञ्च रुक्मस्तेयसमं स्मृतं //
text_mt: Misappropriation of a deposit, or of a man, a horse, silver, / land, diamonds, or gems is remembered as equal to the theft of gold.

sanskrit_iast:
retaḥsekaḥ svayonyāṣu kumārīṣvantyajāsu ca /
sakhyuḥ putrasya ca(3) strīṣu gurutalpasamaṃ viduḥ //
meaning:
रेतःसेकः स्वयोन्याषु कुमारीष्वन्त्यजासु च /
सख्युः पुत्रस्य च(3) स्त्रीषु गुरुतल्पसमं विदुः //
text_mt: Discharging semen into women of one's own family, maidens, low-caste women, / or the wives of a friend or a son, they know to be equal to violating the guru's bed.

sanskrit_iast:
gobadho 'yājya saṃyājyaṃ pāradāryātmavikriyaḥ /
gurumātṛpitṛtyāgaḥ svādhyayāgnyoḥ sutasya ca //
meaning:
गोबधो ऽयाज्य संयाज्यं पारदार्यात्मविक्रियः /
गुरुमातृपितृत्यागः स्वाध्ययाग्न्योः सुतस्य च //
text_mt: Killing a cow, sacrificing for those unfit to sacrifice, adultery, selling oneself, / abandoning one's guru, mother, or father, or one's Vedic study, sacred fires, or son;

sanskrit_iast:
parivittitānujena parivedanameva ca /
tayordānañca kanyāyāstayoreva ca yājanaṃ //
meaning:
परिवित्तितानुजेन परिवेदनमेव च /
तयोर्दानञ्च कन्यायास्तयोरेव च याजनं //
text_mt: letting a younger brother marry first, marrying before an elder brother, / giving a maiden to either of these two, or sacrificing for either of them;

sanskrit_iast:
kanyāyā dūṣaṇañcaiva vārdhuṣyaṃ vratalopanaṃ /
taḍāgārāmadārāṇāmapatyasya ca vikriyaḥ //
meaning:
कन्याया दूषणञ्चैव वार्धुष्यं व्रतलोपनं /
तडागारामदाराणामपत्यस्य च विक्रियः //
text_mt: defiling a maiden, usury, breaking a votive observance, / selling a tank, a grove, a wife, or offspring;

sanskrit_iast:
vrātyatā bāndhavatyāgo bhṛtādhyāpanameva ca /
bhṛtāccādhyayanādānamavikreyasya vikrayaḥ //
:n
1 samāni brahmahatyayeti kha.. , ṅa.. , ña.. ca
2 garhitānāmannajagdhiriti ṅa..
3 sakhyuḥ sutasya ceti ṅa..
:p 169
meaning:
व्रात्यता बान्धवत्यागो भृताध्यापनमेव च /
भृताच्चाध्ययनादानमविक्रेयस्य विक्रयः //
:न्
1 समानि ब्रह्महत्ययेति ख.. , ङ.. , ञ.. च
2 गर्हितानामन्नजग्धिरिति ङ..
3 सख्युः सुतस्य चेति ङ..
:प् 169
text_mt:
becoming an outcaste through neglect of rites, abandoning kinsmen, teaching for a salary, / studying from one who teaches for a salary, selling what is forbidden to sell;
[Footnote]
1. "samāni brahmahatyayeti" in Kha., Ṅa., and Ña.
2. "garhitānāmannajagdhiriti" in Ṅa.
3. "sakhyuḥ sutasya ceti" in Ṅa. / p. 169

sanskrit_iast:
sarvākāreṣvadhīkāro mahāyantrapravartanaṃ /
hiṃsauṣadhīnāṃ stryājīvaḥ kriyālaṅganameva ca //
meaning:
सर्वाकारेष्वधीकारो महायन्त्रप्रवर्तनं /
हिंसौषधीनां स्त्र्याजीवः क्रियालङ्गनमेव च //
text_mt: superintending mines and works of all kinds, operating large mechanical apparatuses, / destroying medicinal herbs, living off one's wife, omitting rites;

sanskrit_iast:
indhanārthamaśuṣkāṇāṃ dumāṇāñcaiva pātanaṃ /
yoṣitāṃ grahaṇañcaiva strīnindakasamāgamaḥ //
meaning:
इन्धनार्थमशुष्काणां दुमाणाञ्चैव पातनं /
योषितां ग्रहणञ्चैव स्त्रीनिन्दकसमागमः //
text_mt: felling unseasoned trees for firewood, / abducting women, associating with a reviler of women;

sanskrit_iast:
ātmārthañca kriyārambho ninditānnadanantathā /
anāhitāgnitāsteyamṛṇānāñcānapakriyā //
meaning:
आत्मार्थञ्च क्रियारम्भो निन्दितान्नदनन्तथा /
अनाहिताग्नितास्तेयमृणानाञ्चानपक्रिया //
text_mt: undertaking rituals solely for oneself, eating condemned food, / not maintaining the sacred fires, theft, non-payment of debts;

sanskrit_iast:
asacchāstrādhigamanaṃ dauḥśīlyaṃ vyasanakriyā /
dhānyakupyapaśusteyaṃ madyapastrīniṣevaṇaṃ //
meaning:
असच्छास्त्राधिगमनं दौःशील्यं व्यसनक्रिया /
धान्यकुप्यपशुस्तेयं मद्यपस्त्रीनिषेवणं //
text_mt: studying bad scriptures, vicious conduct, addiction to vices, / theft of grain, base metals, or cattle, consorting with women who drink liquor;

sanskrit_iast:
strīśūdraviṭkṣatrabadho nāstikyañcopapātakaṃ /
brāhmaṇasya rujaḥ kṛtyaṃ ghrātiraghreyamadyayoḥ //
meaning:
स्त्रीशूद्रविट्क्षत्रबधो नास्तिक्यञ्चोपपातकं /
ब्राह्मणस्य रुजः कृत्यं घ्रातिरघ्रेयमद्ययोः //
text_mt: killing a woman, a śūdra, a vaiśya, or a kṣatriya, and atheism are minor sins. / Causing bodily pain to a brāhmaṇa, smelling what ought not to be smelled or liquor,

sanskrit_iast:
jaiṃbhaṃ puṃsi ca maithunyaṃ jātibhraṃśakaraṃ smṛtaṃ /
śvakharoṣṭramṛgendrāṇāmajāvyoś caiva māraṇaṃ(1) //
meaning:
जैंभं पुंसि च मैथुन्यं जातिभ्रंशकरं स्मृतं /
श्वखरोष्ट्रमृगेन्द्राणामजाव्योश् चैव मारणं(1) //
text_mt: deceitfulness, and homosexual intercourse among men are remembered as causing loss of caste. / The slaughter of dogs, donkeys, camels, lions, goats, and sheep,

sanskrit_iast:
saṅkīrṇakaraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ mīnāhinakulasya ca /
ninditebhyo dhanādānaṃ bāṇijyaṃ śūdrasevanaṃ //
meaning:
सङ्कीर्णकरणं ज्ञेयं मीनाहिनकुलस्य च /
निन्दितेभ्यो धनादानं बाणिज्यं शूद्रसेवनं //
text_mt: and of fish, snakes, and mongooses is known as causing degraded status. / Receiving wealth from blameworthy persons, trade, serving śūdras,

sanskrit_iast:
apātrīkaraṇaṃ jñeyamasatyasya ca bhāṣaṇaṃ /
kṛmikīṭavayohatyā madyānugatabhojanaṃ //
meaning:
अपात्रीकरणं ज्ञेयमसत्यस्य च भाषणं /
कृमिकीटवयोहत्या मद्यानुगतभोजनं //
text_mt: and speaking falsehood are known as causing unfitness to receive gifts. / Killing worms, insects, and birds, eating food associated with liquor,

sanskrit_iast:
phalaidhaḥkusumasteyamadhair yañca malāvahaṃ //41//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe mahāpātakādikathanaṃ
nāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 mārjārasyaiva māraṇamiti ṅa..
:p 170
:ś athaikonasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāyaścittāni
meaning:
फलैधःकुसुमस्तेयमधैर् यञ्च मलावहं //41//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे महापातकादिकथनं
नामाष्टषष्ट्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 मार्जारस्यैव मारणमिति ङ..
:प् 170
:श् अथैकोनसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
प्रायश्चित्तानि
text_mt:
theft of fruits, firewood, and flowers, and lack of fortitude cause defilement. // 41
:e Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-eighth chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, entitled "Account of the Great Sins and Related Matters."
[Footnote]
[Variant: 1. "killing a cat indeed", thus ms. ṅa.]
[Page 170]
Now begins the one hundred and sixty-ninth chapter:
Expiations.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
etatprabhṛtipāpānāṃ prāyaścittaṃ vadāmi te /
brahmahā dvādaśābdāni kuṭīṅkṛtvā vane vaset //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
एतत्प्रभृतिपापानां प्रायश्चित्तं वदामि ते /
ब्रह्महा द्वादशाब्दानि कुटीङ्कृत्वा वने वसेत् //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / I shall declare to you the expiation for sins beginning with these. / A killer of a Brahmin should dwell in the forest for twelve years, having constructed a hut,

sanskrit_iast:
bhikṣetātmaviśuddhyarthaṃ kṛtvā śavaśirodhvajaṃ /
prāsyedātmānamagnau vā samiddhe triravākśirāḥ //
meaning:
भिक्षेतात्मविशुद्ध्यर्थं कृत्वा शवशिरोध्वजं /
प्रास्येदात्मानमग्नौ वा समिद्धे त्रिरवाक्शिराः //
text_mt: he should beg for alms to purify himself, bearing the skull of a corpse as his banner; / or he should cast himself thrice head downwards into a blazing fire,

sanskrit_iast:
yajeta vāśvamedhena svarjitā gosavena vā /
japanvānyatamaṃ vedaṃ yojanānāṃ śataṃ brajet //
meaning:
यजेत वाश्वमेधेन स्वर्जिता गोसवेन वा /
जपन्वान्यतमं वेदं योजनानां शतं ब्रजेत् //
text_mt: or he should sacrifice with an horse sacrifice, a Svarjit, or a Gosava; / or, reciting any one of the Vedas, he should walk a hundred yojanas,

sanskrit_iast:
sarvasvaṃ vā vedavide brāhmaṇāyopapādayet /
vratair etair vyapohanti mahāpātakino malaṃ //
meaning:
सर्वस्वं वा वेदविदे ब्राह्मणायोपपादयेत् /
व्रतैर् एतैर् व्यपोहन्ति महापातकिनो मलं //
text_mt: or he should bestow his entire property upon a Brahmin who knows the Veda. / By these votive observances, those guilty of major sins remove their stain.

sanskrit_iast:
upapātakasaṃyukto goghno māsaṃ yavān pivet /
kṛtavāpo vasedgoṣṭhe carmaṇā tena saṃvṛtaḥ //
meaning:
उपपातकसंयुक्तो गोघ्नो मासं यवान् पिवेत् /
कृतवापो वसेद्गोष्ठे चर्मणा तेन संवृतः //
text_mt: One guilty of a minor sin who has killed a cow should drink [gruel of] barley for a month; / having shaved his head, he should live in a cowpen, covered with that [cow’s] hide.

sanskrit_iast:
caturthakālamaśrīyādakṣāralavaṇaṃ mitaṃ /
gomūtreṇa caret snānaṃ dvau māsau niyatendriyaḥ //
meaning:
चतुर्थकालमश्रीयादक्षारलवणं मितं /
गोमूत्रेण चरेत् स्नानं द्वौ मासौ नियतेन्द्रियः //
text_mt: He should eat a measured amount at the fourth mealtime, free from pungent flavors and salt; / he should perform ablutions with cow urine for two months, restraining his senses.

sanskrit_iast:
divānugacchedgāś caiva tiṣṭhannūrdhvaṃ rajaḥ pivet /
vṛṣabhaikādaśā gāstu dadyādvicāritavrataḥ(1) //
meaning:
दिवानुगच्छेद्गाश् चैव तिष्ठन्नूर्ध्वं रजः पिवेत् /
वृषभैकादशा गास्तु दद्याद्विचारितव्रतः(1) //
text_mt: By day he should follow the cows, and standing upright, he should drink their dust; / having completed the votive observance, he should give away cows with a bull as the eleventh.

sanskrit_iast:
avidyamāne sarvasvaṃ vedavidbhyo nivedayet /
pādamekañcaredrodhe dvau pādau bandhane caret //
:n
1 dadyāt sucaritavrata iti ṅa..
:p 171
meaning:
अविद्यमाने सर्वस्वं वेदविद्भ्यो निवेदयेत् /
पादमेकञ्चरेद्रोधे द्वौ पादौ बन्धने चरेत् //
:न्
1 दद्यात् सुचरितव्रत इति ङ..
:प् 171
text_mt:
If [cattle are] not available, he should offer all his possessions to knowers of the Veda. / He should perform one quarter [of the penance] for confining [a cow], and two quarters for tying it up;
[Footnote]
[Variant: 1. "he should give, having well performed the votive observance", thus ms. ṅa.]
[Page 171]

sanskrit_iast:
yojane pādahīnaṃ syāccaret sarvaṃ nipātane /
kāntāreṣvatha durgeṣu viṣameṣu bhayeṣu ca //
meaning:
योजने पादहीनं स्याच्चरेत् सर्वं निपातने /
कान्तारेष्वथ दुर्गेषु विषमेषु भयेषु च //
text_mt: it should be less by a quarter [if death occurs] in yoking; he should perform the whole [expiation] in case of causing death. / In wildernesses, in difficult terrain, in rough places, and in perils,

sanskrit_iast:
yadi tatra vipattiḥ syādekapādo vidhīyate /
ghaṇṭābharaṇadoṣeṇa tathaivardhaṃ vinirdiśat //
meaning:
यदि तत्र विपत्तिः स्यादेकपादो विधीयते /
घण्टाभरणदोषेण तथैवर्धं विनिर्दिशत् //
text_mt: if death should occur there, one quarter is prescribed; / similarly, one should assign half for the fault of [decorating with] a bell-ornament.

sanskrit_iast:
damane damane rodhe śakaṭasya niyojane /
stambhaśṛṅkhalapāśeṣu mṛte pādonamācaret //
meaning:
दमने दमने रोधे शकटस्य नियोजने /
स्तम्भशृङ्खलपाशेषु मृते पादोनमाचरेत् //
text_mt: In training, in breaking in, in confining, in harnessing to a cart, / or if it dies in a post, chain, or noose, one should perform three-quarters.

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgabhaṅge 'sthibhaṅge ca lāṅgūlacchedane tathā /
yāvakantu pivettāvadyāvat susthā tu gaurbhavet //
meaning:
शृङ्गभङ्गे ऽस्थिभङ्गे च लाङ्गूलच्छेदने तथा /
यावकन्तु पिवेत्तावद्यावत् सुस्था तु गौर्भवेत् //
text_mt: If a horn is broken, or a bone is broken, or likewise if the tail is severed, / he should drink barley gruel until the cow becomes healthy again.

sanskrit_iast:
gomatīñca japedvidyāṃ gostutiṃ gomatīṃ smaret /
ekā cedbahubhirdaivād yatra vyāpāditā bhavet //
meaning:
गोमतीञ्च जपेद्विद्यां गोस्तुतिं गोमतीं स्मरेत् /
एका चेद्बहुभिर्दैवाद् यत्र व्यापादिता भवेत् //
text_mt: He should recite the Gomatī formula, and recollect the Gomatī hymn to the cow. / If by chance a single [cow] should be killed by many,

sanskrit_iast:
pādaṃ pādantu hatyāyāś careyuste pṛthak pṛthak /
upakāre kriyamāṇe vipattau nāsti pātakaṃ //
meaning:
पादं पादन्तु हत्यायाश् चरेयुस्ते पृथक् पृथक् /
उपकारे क्रियमाणे विपत्तौ नास्ति पातकं //
text_mt: they should each separately perform one quarter of [the penance for] the slaughter. / When doing an act of aid, there is no sin if death occurs.

sanskrit_iast:
etadeva vrataṃ kuryurupapātakinas tathā /
avakīrṇavarjaṃ śuddhyarthañcāndrāyaṇamathāpi vā //
meaning:
एतदेव व्रतं कुर्युरुपपातकिनस् तथा /
अवकीर्णवर्जं शुद्ध्यर्थञ्चान्द्रायणमथापि वा //
text_mt: Those guilty of minor sins should perform this same votive observance for purification, / with the exception of one who has broken his vow of chastity; or else a cāndrāyaṇa penance.

sanskrit_iast:
avakīrṇī tu kālena gardhabhena catuṣpathe /
pākayajñavidhānena yajeta nirṛtiṃ niśi //
meaning:
अवकीर्णी तु कालेन गर्धभेन चतुष्पथे /
पाकयज्ञविधानेन यजेत निरृतिं निशि //
text_mt: One who has broken his vow of chastity, however, should in due time sacrifice a donkey at a crossroads / to Nirṛti at night, in accordance with the rule of cooked sacrifices.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvāgniṃ vidhivaddhīmānantatastu samittṛcā /
candrendraguruvahnīnāṃ juhuyāt sarpiṣāhutiṃ(1) //
meaning:
कृत्वाग्निं विधिवद्धीमानन्ततस्तु समित्तृचा /
चन्द्रेन्द्रगुरुवह्नीनां जुहुयात् सर्पिषाहुतिं(1) //
text_mt: The wise man, having prepared the fire according to rule, and then with a triplet of kindling verses, / should offer an oblation of clarified butter to the Moon, Indra, Bṛhaspati, and Agni.

sanskrit_iast:
athavā gārdhabhañcarma vasitvābdañcarenmahīṃ /
hatvā garbhamavijñātaṃ brahmahatyāvrataṃ caret //
:n
1 juhuyātsarpiṣāhutīriti kha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. ca
:p 172
meaning:
अथवा गार्धभञ्चर्म वसित्वाब्दञ्चरेन्महीं /
हत्वा गर्भमविज्ञातं ब्रह्महत्याव्रतं चरेत् //
:न्
1 जुहुयात्सर्पिषाहुतीरिति ख.. , ङ.. , ज.. च
:प् 172
text_mt:
Or, clad in an ass’s hide, he should wander over the earth for a year. / Having killed an embryo of unknown sex, he should perform the votive observance for killing a Brahmin.
[Footnote]
[Variant: 1. "should offer oblations of clarified butter", thus mss. kha, ṅa, and ja.]
[Page 172]

sanskrit_iast:
sarāṃ pītvā dvijo mohādagnivarṇāṃ surāṃ pivet /
gomūtramagnivarṇaṃ vā pivedudakameva vā //
meaning:
सरां पीत्वा द्विजो मोहादग्निवर्णां सुरां पिवेत् /
गोमूत्रमग्निवर्णं वा पिवेदुदकमेव वा //
text_mt: Having drunk spirituous liquor out of delusion, a twice-born should drink fire-hot liquor, / or he should drink fire-hot cow urine, or simply water.

sanskrit_iast:
suvarṇasteyakṛdvipro rājānamabhigamya tu /
svakarma khyāpayan vrūyānmāṃ bhavānanuśāstviti //
meaning:
सुवर्णस्तेयकृद्विप्रो राजानमभिगम्य तु /
स्वकर्म ख्यापयन् व्रूयान्मां भवाननुशास्त्विति //
text_mt: A Brahmin who commits theft of gold, having approached the king, / declaring his own deed, should say: "May your majesty punish me!"

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītvā muśalaṃ rājā sakṛddhanyāt svayaṅgataṃ /
badhena śuddhyate steyo brāhmaṇastapasaiva vā //
meaning:
गृहीत्वा मुशलं राजा सकृद्धन्यात् स्वयङ्गतं /
बधेन शुद्ध्यते स्तेयो ब्राह्मणस्तपसैव वा //
text_mt: Taking a club, the king should strike once him who came on his own. / By death the thief is purified, or a Brahmin [is purified] through ascetic austerity alone.

sanskrit_iast:
gurutalpo nikṛtyaiva śiśnañca vṛṣaṇaṃ svayaṃ /
nidhāya cāñcalau gacchedānipātācca nairṛtiṃ //
meaning:
गुरुतल्पो निकृत्यैव शिश्नञ्च वृषणं स्वयं /
निधाय चाञ्चलौ गच्छेदानिपाताच्च नैरृतिं //
text_mt: One who violates his guru’s bed, having himself cut off his penis and testicles, / and placed them in his cupped hands, should walk toward the southwest until he drops down dead.

sanskrit_iast:
cāndrāyaṇān vā trīnmāsānabhyasenniyatendriyaḥ /
jātibhraṃśakaraṃ karma kṛtvānyatamamicchayā //
meaning:
चान्द्रायणान् वा त्रीन्मासानभ्यसेन्नियतेन्द्रियः /
जातिभ्रंशकरं कर्म कृत्वान्यतममिच्छया //
text_mt: Or, with restrained senses, he should practice cāndrāyaṇa penances for three months. / Having intentionally performed any action that causes loss of caste,

sanskrit_iast:
carecchāntapanaṃ kṛcchraṃ prājāpatyamanicchayā /
saṅkarīpātrakṛtyāsu māsaṃ śodhanamaindavaṃ //
meaning:
चरेच्छान्तपनं कृच्छ्रं प्राजापत्यमनिच्छया /
सङ्करीपात्रकृत्यासु मासं शोधनमैन्दवं //
text_mt: he should perform the śāntapana kṛcchra penance; if unintentionally, the prājāpatya penance. / For deeds causing degradation to a mixed class, a lunar penance of one month is the purifier.

sanskrit_iast:
malinīkaraṇīyeṣu taptaṃ syādyāvakaṃ tryahaṃ /
turīyo brahmahatyāyāḥ kṣatriyasya badhe smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
मलिनीकरणीयेषु तप्तं स्याद्यावकं त्र्यहं /
तुरीयो ब्रह्महत्यायाः क्षत्रियस्य बधे स्मृतः //
text_mt: For deeds causing defilement, there should be hot barley gruel for three days. / For killing a kṣatriya, one-fourth of [the penance for] killing a Brahmin is remembered;

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśye 'ṣṭamāṃśe vṛttasthe śūdre jñeyastu ṣoḍaśaḥ /
mārjaranakulau hatvā cāsaṃ maṇḍūkameva ca //
meaning:
वैश्ये ऽष्टमांशे वृत्तस्थे शूद्रे ज्ञेयस्तु षोडशः /
मार्जरनकुलौ हत्वा चासं मण्डूकमेव च //
text_mt: for a vaiśya who lives properly, an eighth part; and for a śūdra, a sixteenth part is to be known. / Having killed a cat, a mongoose, a blue jay, or a frog,

sanskrit_iast:
śvagodholūkakākāṃś ca śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret /
caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ nārīṃ hatvānavasthitāṃ //
meaning:
श्वगोधोलूककाकांश् च शूद्रहत्याव्रतं चरेत् /
चतुर्णामपि वर्णानां नारीं हत्वानवस्थितां //
text_mt: a dog, an iguana, an owl, or a crow, he should perform the votive observance for killing a śūdra. / Having killed a woman of any of the four castes who is unchaste,

sanskrit_iast:
amatyaiva pramāpya strīṃ śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret /
sarpādīnāṃ badhe naktamanasthnāṃ vāyusaṃyamaḥ //
meaning:
अमत्यैव प्रमाप्य स्त्रीं शूद्रहत्याव्रतं चरेत् /
सर्पादीनां बधे नक्तमनस्थ्नां वायुसंयमः //
text_mt: or having unintentionally slain a woman, he should perform the votive observance for killing a śūdra. / In killing snakes and the like, [there is fasting] at night; for boneless creatures, breath-control.

sanskrit_iast:
dravyāṇāmalpasārāṇāṃ steyaṃ kṛtvānyaveśmataḥ /
carecchāntapanaṃ kṛcchaṃ vrataṃ nirvāpya siddhyati //
:p 173
meaning:
द्रव्याणामल्पसाराणां स्तेयं कृत्वान्यवेश्मतः /
चरेच्छान्तपनं कृच्छं व्रतं निर्वाप्य सिद्ध्यति //
:प् 173
text_mt:
Having stolen items of little value from another's house, / he should perform the śāntapana kṛcchra; having discharged the votive observance, he is purified.
[Page 173]

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣabhojyāpaharaṇe yānaśayyāsanasya ca /
puṣpamūlaphalānāñca pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanaṃ //
meaning:
भक्षभोज्यापहरणे यानशय्यासनस्य च /
पुष्पमूलफलानाञ्च पञ्चगव्यं विशोधनं //
text_mt: In the case of stealing foods to be chewed or eaten, or a vehicle, bed, or seat, / or flowers, roots, and fruits, the five products of the cow are the purifier.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇakāṣṭhadrumāṇāntu śuṣkānnasya guḍasya ca /
celacarmāmiṣāṇāntu(1) trirātraṃ syādabhojanaṃ //
meaning:
तृणकाष्ठद्रुमाणान्तु शुष्कान्नस्य गुडस्य च /
चेलचर्मामिषाणान्तु(1) त्रिरात्रं स्यादभोजनं //
text_mt: For [the theft of] grass, wood, trees, dried grain, molasses, / clothes, skins, or meat, there should be a three-night fast.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ tāmrasya rajatasya ca /
ayaḥkāṃsyopalānāñca dvādaśāhaṃ kaṇānnabhuk //
meaning:
मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानां ताम्रस्य रजतस्य च /
अयःकांस्योपलानाञ्च द्वादशाहं कणान्नभुक् //
text_mt: For gems, pearls, corals, copper, silver, / iron, bell-metal, and stones, he should eat broken grain for twelve days.

sanskrit_iast:
kārpāsakīṭajīrṇānāṃ dviśaphaikaśaphasya ca /
pakṣigandhauṣadhīnāntu rajvā caiva tryahampayaḥ //
meaning:
कार्पासकीटजीर्णानां द्विशफैकशफस्य च /
पक्षिगन्धौषधीनान्तु रज्वा चैव त्र्यहम्पयः //
text_mt: For cotton, silk, worn-out garments, cloven-hoofed and single-hoofed animals, / birds, perfumes, medicinal herbs, and ropes, [he should drink only] milk for three days.

sanskrit_iast:
gurutalpavrataṃ kuryādretaḥ siktvā svayoniṣu /
sakhyuḥ putrasya ca strīṣu kumāroṣvantyajāsu ca //
meaning:
गुरुतल्पव्रतं कुर्याद्रेतः सिक्त्वा स्वयोनिषु /
सख्युः पुत्रस्य च स्त्रीषु कुमारोष्वन्त्यजासु च //
text_mt: He should perform the vow of a violator of the guru’s bed if he emits semen into women of his own lineage, / among the wives of a friend or a son, or among unmarried maidens and outcaste women.

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛsvasreyīṃ bhaginīṃ svasrīyāṃ mātureva ca /
mātuś ca bhrāturāptasya gatvā cāndrāyaṇañcaret //
meaning:
पितृस्वस्रेयीं भगिनीं स्वस्रीयां मातुरेव च /
मातुश् च भ्रातुराप्तस्य गत्वा चान्द्रायणञ्चरेत् //
text_mt: Having had sexual intercourse with a paternal aunt's daughter, a sister, a maternal aunt's daughter, / or the wife of a maternal uncle or of a trusted friend, he should perform the cāndrāyaṇa penance.

sanskrit_iast:
amānuṣīṣu puruṣa udakyāyāmayoniṣu /
retaḥ siktvā jale caiva kṛcchraṃ śāntapanañcaret //
meaning:
अमानुषीषु पुरुष उदक्यायामयोनिषु /
रेतः सिक्त्वा जले चैव कृच्छ्रं शान्तपनञ्चरेत् //
text_mt: If a man emits semen in non-human females, in a menstruating woman, in unnatural orifices, / or in water, he should perform the śāntapana kṛcchra penance.

sanskrit_iast:
maithunantu samāsevya puṃsi yoṣiti vā dvijaḥ /
goyāne 'psu divā caiva savāsāḥ snānamācaret //
meaning:
मैथुनन्तु समासेव्य पुंसि योषिति वा द्विजः /
गोयाने ऽप्सु दिवा चैव सवासाः स्नानमाचरेत् //
text_mt: Having practiced sexual intercourse in a male or in a woman, / in a bullock cart, in water, or by day, a twice-born should perform an ablution with his clothes on.

sanskrit_iast:
caṇḍālāntyastriyo gatvā bhuktvā ca pratigṛhya ca /
patatyajñānato vipro jñānāt sāmyantu gacchati //
meaning:
चण्डालान्त्यस्त्रियो गत्वा भुक्त्वा च प्रतिगृह्य च /
पतत्यज्ञानतो विप्रो ज्ञानात् साम्यन्तु गच्छति //
text_mt: Having had sexual intercourse with Caṇḍāla or outcaste women, having eaten their food, or accepted [gifts from them], / a Brahmin falls through ignorance; through intentional action, he becomes equal to them.

sanskrit_iast:
vipraduṣṭāṃ striyaṃ bhartā nirundhyādekaveśmani /
yat puṃsaḥ paradāreṣu tadenāñcārayedvrataṃ //
meaning:
विप्रदुष्टां स्त्रियं भर्ता निरुन्ध्यादेकवेश्मनि /
यत् पुंसः परदारेषु तदेनाञ्चारयेद्व्रतं //
text_mt: A husband should confine an unfaithful wife to a single dwelling; / that penance which applies to a man who commits adultery with another's wife, he should make her perform.

sanskrit_iast:
sācetpunaḥ praduṣyeta sadṛśenopamantritā /
kṛcchrañcādrāyaṇañcaiva tadasyāḥ pāvanaṃ smṛtaṃ //
:n
1 veṇucarmāmiṣāṇāñceti jha..
:p 174
meaning:
साचेत्पुनः प्रदुष्येत सदृशेनोपमन्त्रिता /
कृच्छ्रञ्चाद्रायणञ्चैव तदस्याः पावनं स्मृतं //
:न्
1 वेणुचर्मामिषाणाञ्चेति झ..
:प् 174
text_mt:
If she should again be corrupted when solicited by an equal, / the kṛcchra and cāndrāyaṇa penances are remembered as her purifier.
[Footnote]
[Variant: 1. "bamboo, skins, or meat", thus ms. jha.]
[Page 174]

sanskrit_iast:
yat karotyekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanaṃ dvijaḥ /
tadbhaikṣyabhuk japennityaṃ tribhirvaṣair vyapohati //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe prāyaścittāni nāma
ekonasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha saptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāyaścittāni
meaning:
यत् करोत्येकरात्रेण वृषलीसेवनं द्विजः /
तद्भैक्ष्यभुक् जपेन्नित्यं त्रिभिर्वषैर् व्यपोहति //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे प्रायश्चित्तानि नाम
एकोनसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ सप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
प्रायश्चित्तानि
text_mt:
[The guilt] that a twice-born incurs by spending a single night with a śūdra woman, / he removes in three years by living on alms and continually reciting sacred texts.
Thus ends the one hundred and sixty-ninth chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, named "Expiations."
Now begins the one hundred and seventieth chapter:
Expiations.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
mahāpāpānuyuktānāṃ(1) prāyaścittāni(2) vacmite /
saṃvatsareṇa patati patitena sahācaran //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
महापापानुयुक्तानां(1) प्रायश्चित्तानि(2) वच्मिते /
संवत्सरेण पतति पतितेन सहाचरन् //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / I shall declare to you the expiations for those associated with major sins. / By associating with a fallen person for a year, one becomes fallen,

sanskrit_iast:
yājanāddhyāpanādyaunānna tu yānāśanāsanāt /
yo yena patitenaiṣāṃ saṃsargaṃ yāti mānavaḥ //
meaning:
याजनाद्ध्यापनाद्यौनान्न तु यानाशनासनात् /
यो येन पतितेनैषां संसर्गं याति मानवः //
text_mt: through officiating at his sacrifice, teaching him, or entering marital alliance with him, but not through sharing a vehicle, food, or a seat. / Whichever person forms an association with any of these fallen people,

sanskrit_iast:
sa tasyaiva vrataṃ kuryāttatsaṃsargasya śuddhaye /
patitasyodakaṃ kāryaṃ sapiṇḍair bāndhavaiḥ saha //
meaning:
स तस्यैव व्रतं कुर्यात्तत्संसर्गस्य शुद्धये /
पतितस्योदकं कार्यं सपिण्डैर् बान्धवैः सह //
text_mt: He should perform the very votive observance [prescribed] for that [sinner] to purify himself of that association. / Water offerings for an outcaste must be made by his sapiṇḍas along with his kinsmen.

sanskrit_iast:
nindite 'hani sāyāhṇe jñātyṛtvig gurusannidhau /
dāso ghaṭamapāṃ pūrṇaṃ paryasyet pretavatpadā(3) //
meaning:
निन्दिते ऽहनि सायाह्णे ज्ञात्यृत्विग् गुरुसन्निधौ /
दासो घटमपां पूर्णं पर्यस्येत् प्रेतवत्पदा(3) //
text_mt: On an inauspicious day, at dusk, in the presence of relatives, officiating priests, and elders, / a servant should overturn a pot full of water with his foot, as for a dead man.

sanskrit_iast:
ahorātramupāsītannaśaucaṃ bāndhavaiḥ saha /
nivartayeraṃstasmāttu jyeṣṭhāṃśambhāṣaṇādike //
meaning:
अहोरात्रमुपासीतन्नशौचं बान्धवैः सह /
निवर्तयेरंस्तस्मात्तु ज्येष्ठांशम्भाषणादिके //
text_mt: They should observe ritual impurity for a day and a night along with their kinsmen. / Moreover, they should exclude him from the eldest son's share, conversation, and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
jyeṣṭhāṃśamprāpnuyāccāsya yavīyān guṇato 'dhikaḥ /
:n
1 mahāpāpopapannānāmiti ṅa..
2 prāyaścittaṃ vadāmi ta iti jha..
3 pretavat sadeti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
:p 175
prāyaścitte tu carite pūrṇaṃ kumbhamapāṃ navaṃ //
meaning:
ज्येष्ठांशम्प्राप्नुयाच्चास्य यवीयान् गुणतो ऽधिकः /
:न्
1 महापापोपपन्नानामिति ङ..
2 प्रायश्चित्तं वदामि त इति झ..
3 प्रेतवत् सदेति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
:प् 175
प्रायश्चित्ते तु चरिते पूर्णं कुम्भमपां नवं //
text_mt:
and a younger brother who is superior in virtue should obtain his eldest share.
[Footnote]
1. 'mahāpāpopapannānām' in manuscript ṅa.
2. 'prāyaścittaṃ vadāmi te' in manuscript jha.
3. 'pretavat sadā' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, and ṅa. / [p. 175]
When, however, the expiation has been performed, [they should take] a new pot full of water;

sanskrit_iast:
tenaiva sārdhaṃ prāśyeyuḥ snātvā puṇyajalāśaye /
evameva vidhiṃ kuryuryoṣitsu papitāsvapi //
meaning:
तेनैव सार्धं प्राश्येयुः स्नात्वा पुण्यजलाशये /
एवमेव विधिं कुर्युर्योषित्सु पपितास्वपि //
text_mt: having bathed in a sacred pool, they should drink [from it] together with him. / They should carry out this very rite even for women who have fallen [from caste].

sanskrit_iast:
vastrānnapānandeyantu vaseyuś ca gṛhāntike /
teṣāṃ dvijānāṃ sāvitrī nānūdyeta(1) yathāvidhi //
meaning:
वस्त्रान्नपानन्देयन्तु वसेयुश् च गृहान्तिके /
तेषां द्विजानां सावित्री नानूद्येत(1) यथाविधि //
text_mt: Clothing, food, and drink should be given [to them], and they should dwell near the house. / For those twice-born whose Sāvitrī [mantra] has not been recited according to rule,

sanskrit_iast:
tāṃścārayitvā trīn kṛchrān yathāvidhyupanāyayet /
vikarmasthāḥ parityaktāsteṣāṃ mapyetadādiśet //
meaning:
तांश्चारयित्वा त्रीन् कृछ्रान् यथाविध्युपनाययेत् /
विकर्मस्थाः परित्यक्तास्तेषां मप्येतदादिशेत् //
text_mt: having made them perform three kṛcchra penances, one should initiate them according to rule. / One should also prescribe this for those fallen into illicit deeds or abandoned.

sanskrit_iast:
japitvā trīṇi sāvitryāḥ sahastrāṇi samāhitaḥ /
māsaṅgoṣṭhe payaḥ pītvā mucyate 'satpratigrahāt //
meaning:
जपित्वा त्रीणि सावित्र्याः सहस्त्राणि समाहितः /
मासङ्गोष्ठे पयः पीत्वा मुच्यते ऽसत्प्रतिग्रहात् //
text_mt: Having recited three thousand [repetitions] of the Sāvitrī [mantra] with concentrated mind / and lived on milk in a cowpen for a month, one is freed from [the sin of accepting an] improper gift.

sanskrit_iast:
brātyānāṃ yājanaṃ kṛtvā pareṣāmantyakarma ca /
abhicāramahīnānāntribhiḥ kṛcchair vyapohati(2) //
meaning:
ब्रात्यानां याजनं कृत्वा परेषामन्त्यकर्म च /
अभिचारमहीनानान्त्रिभिः कृच्छैर् व्यपोहति(2) //
text_mt: Having officiated at sacrifices for the uninitiated (vrātyas), performed funeral rites for unrelated persons, / and [practiced] sorcery on unimpaired persons, one removes [the sin] by three kṛcchra penances.

sanskrit_iast:
śaraṇāgataṃ parityajya vedaṃ viplāvya ca dvijaḥ /
saṃvatsaṃ yatāhārastatpāpamapasedhati //
meaning:
शरणागतं परित्यज्य वेदं विप्लाव्य च द्विजः /
संवत्सं यताहारस्तत्पापमपसेधति //
text_mt: A twice-born man who abandons someone seeking refuge or misrepresents the Veda / wards off that sin [by being] restrained in diet for a year.

sanskrit_iast:
śvaśṛgālakharair daṣṭo grāmyaiḥ kravyādbhireva ca /
naroṣṭrāśvair varāhaiś ca(3) prāṇāyāmena śuddhyati //
meaning:
श्वशृगालखरैर् दष्टो ग्राम्यैः क्रव्याद्भिरेव च /
नरोष्ट्राश्वैर् वराहैश् च(3) प्राणायामेन शुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: A man bitten by dogs, jackals, or donkeys, or by domestic carnivorous animals, / camels, horses, or boars, becomes pure by breath-control (prāṇāyāma).

sanskrit_iast:
snātakavratalope ca karmatyāge hy abhojanaṃ /
huṅkāraṃ(4) brāhmaṇasyoktvā tvaṅkarañca garīyasaḥ //
meaning:
स्नातकव्रतलोपे च कर्मत्यागे ह्य् अभोजनं /
हुङ्कारं(4) ब्राह्मणस्योक्त्वा त्वङ्करञ्च गरीयसः //
text_mt: Upon the violation of a snātaka's vows or the abandonment of prescribed rites, fasting [is prescribed]. / Having uttered a grunt of contempt (huṅkāra) at a brāhmaṇa or addressed a superior disrespectfully ('thou'),

sanskrit_iast:
snātvānaśnannahaḥśeṣamabhivādya prasādayet /
avagūrya carekṣacchramatikṛcchrannipātane //
meaning:
स्नात्वानश्नन्नहःशेषमभिवाद्य प्रसादयेत् /
अवगूर्य चरेक्षच्छ्रमतिकृच्छ्रन्निपातने //
text_mt: bathing and fasting for the remainder of the day, having saluted [him], he should propitiate him. / Raising a hand [against a brāhmaṇa], he should perform a kṛcchra; upon striking him down, an atikṛcchra;

sanskrit_iast:
kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ kurvīta viprasyotpādya śoṇitaṃ /
:n
1 na yujyeteti kha..
2 kṛcchrair viśuddhyati iti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca
3 naroṣṭaviḍvarāhaiśceti ṅa..
4 krūṅkāramiti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. ca / oṅkāramiti ga.. , ṅa.. ca /
haṅkārañceti kha..
:p 176
cāṇḍālādiravijñāto yasya tiṣṭheta veśmani //
meaning:
कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रं कुर्वीत विप्रस्योत्पाद्य शोणितं /
:न्
1 न युज्येतेति ख..
2 कृच्छ्रैर् विशुद्ध्यति इति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. च
3 नरोष्टविड्वराहैश्चेति ङ..
4 क्रूङ्कारमिति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. च / ओङ्कारमिति ग.. , ङ.. च /
हङ्कारञ्चेति ख..
:प् 176
चाण्डालादिरविज्ञातो यस्य तिष्ठेत वेश्मनि //
text_mt:
causing the blood of a vipra to flow, he should perform a kṛcchrātikṛcchra.
[Footnote]
1. 'na yujyeta' in manuscript kha.
2. 'kṛcchrair viśuddhyati' in manuscripts ga, gha, and ṅa.
3. 'naroṣṭraviḍvarāhaiśca' in manuscript ṅa.
4. 'krūṅkāram' in manuscripts kha, gha, and cha; 'oṅkāram' in ga and ṅa; 'haṅkārañca' in kha. / [p. 176]
If an unrecognised cāṇḍāla or similar person should reside in someone's dwelling,

sanskrit_iast:
samyag jñātastu kālena tasya kurvīta śodhanaṃ /
cāndrāyaṇaṃ parākaṃ vā dvijānāntu viśodhanaṃ //
meaning:
सम्यग् ज्ञातस्तु कालेन तस्य कुर्वीत शोधनं /
चान्द्रायणं पराकं वा द्विजानान्तु विशोधनं //
text_mt: when fully recognised in time, one should perform a purification for it: / a cāndrāyaṇa or a parāka is the purification for twice-born men;

sanskrit_iast:
prājāpatyantu śūdrāṇāṃ śeṣantadanusārataḥ /
guṃḍaṅkusumbhaṃ lavaṇaṃ tathā dhānyāni yāni ca //
meaning:
प्राजापत्यन्तु शूद्राणां शेषन्तदनुसारतः /
गुंडङ्कुसुम्भं लवणं तथा धान्यानि यानि च //
text_mt: a prājāpatya for śūdras; the rest [should be done] accordingly. / Molasses, safflower, salt, and whatever grains [are there],

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā gṛhe tato dvāri teṣāndadyāddhutāśanaṃ /
mṛṇamayānāntu bhāṇḍānāṃ tyāga eva vidhīyate //
meaning:
कृत्वा गृहे ततो द्वारि तेषान्दद्याद्धुताशनं /
मृणमयानान्तु भाण्डानां त्याग एव विधीयते //
text_mt: having placed [them] at the doorway of that house, one should set fire to them. / The abandonment of earthen vessels is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
dravyāṇāṃ pariśeṣāṇāṃ dravyaśuddhirvidhīyate /
kūpaikapānasaktā ye sparśātsaṅkalpadūṣitāḥ(1) //
meaning:
द्रव्याणां परिशेषाणां द्रव्यशुद्धिर्विधीयते /
कूपैकपानसक्ता ये स्पर्शात्सङ्कल्पदूषिताः(1) //
text_mt: For the remaining materials, purification of objects is prescribed. / Those who are attached to drinking from a single well, corrupted in resolve through contact,

sanskrit_iast:
śuddhyeyurupavāsena pañcagavyena vāpyatha /
yastu saṃspṛśya caṇḍālamaśnīyācca svakāmataḥ //
meaning:
शुद्ध्येयुरुपवासेन पञ्चगव्येन वाप्यथ /
यस्तु संस्पृश्य चण्डालमश्नीयाच्च स्वकामतः //
text_mt: become pure by a fast or by the five products of the cow (pañcagavya). / One who intentionally touches a caṇḍāla and eats,

sanskrit_iast:
dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryāttaptakṛcchramathāpi vā /
bhāṇḍasaṅkalasaṅkīrṇaścāṇḍālādijugupsitaiḥ //
meaning:
द्विजश्चान्द्रायणं कुर्यात्तप्तकृच्छ्रमथापि वा /
भाण्डसङ्कलसङ्कीर्णश्चाण्डालादिजुगुप्सितैः //
text_mt: if twice-born, should perform a cāndrāyaṇa or a taptakṛcchra. / One who is contaminated through vessels [held in common] with despised persons such as cāṇḍālas,

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktvāpītvā tathā teṣāṃ ṣaḍrātreṇa viśuddhyati /
antyānāṃ bhuktaśeṣantu bhakṣayitvā dvijātayaḥ //
meaning:
भुक्त्वापीत्वा तथा तेषां षड्रात्रेण विशुद्ध्यति /
अन्त्यानां भुक्तशेषन्तु भक्षयित्वा द्विजातयः //
text_mt: having eaten or drunk their [food and drink], becomes purified after six nights. / Twice-born men having eaten the leftover food of outcasts

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ kuryustrirātraṃ śūdra eva tu /
caṇḍālakūpabhāṇḍeṣu ajñānātpivate jalaṃ //
meaning:
व्रतं चान्द्रायणं कुर्युस्त्रिरात्रं शूद्र एव तु /
चण्डालकूपभाण्डेषु अज्ञानात्पिवते जलं //
text_mt: should observe the cāndrāyaṇa votive observance, but a śūdra [fasts for] three nights. / If out of ignorance he drinks water from a caṇḍāla's well or vessels,

sanskrit_iast:
dvijaḥ śāntapanaṃ kuryācchūdraścopavaseddinaṃ /
caṇḍālena tu saṃspṛṣṭo(2) yastvapaḥ pivate dvijaḥ //
meaning:
द्विजः शान्तपनं कुर्याच्छूद्रश्चोपवसेद्दिनं /
चण्डालेन तु संस्पृष्टो(2) यस्त्वपः पिवते द्विजः //
text_mt: a twice-born man should perform the śāntapana penance, and a śūdra should fast for a day. / But a twice-born man who, touched by a caṇḍāla, drinks water,

sanskrit_iast:
trirātrantena kartavyaṃ śūdraścopavaseddinaṃ /
ucchiṣṭena yadi(3) spṛṣṭaḥ śunā śūdreṇa vā dvijaḥ //
:n
1 sparśasaṅkalpabhūṣitā iti jha..
2 saṃsṛṣṭa iti ka..
3 yadeti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
:p 177
meaning:
त्रिरात्रन्तेन कर्तव्यं शूद्रश्चोपवसेद्दिनं /
उच्छिष्टेन यदि(3) स्पृष्टः शुना शूद्रेण वा द्विजः //
:न्
1 स्पर्शसङ्कल्पभूषिता इति झ..
2 संसृष्ट इति क..
3 यदेति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
:प् 177
text_mt:
must observe [a penance of] three nights, and a śūdra should fast for a day. / If a twice-born man is touched by a dog or a śūdra while defiled by food,
[Footnote]
1. 'sparśasaṅkalpabhūṣitāḥ' in manuscript jha.
2. 'saṃsṛṣṭaḥ' in manuscript ka.
3. 'yadā' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, and cha. / [p. 177]

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ pañcagavyena śuddhyati /
vaiśyena kṣatriyeṇaiva snānaṃ naktaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
उपोष्य रजनीमेकां पञ्चगव्येन शुद्ध्यति /
वैश्येन क्षत्रियेणैव स्नानं नक्तं समाचरेत् //
text_mt: having fasted for one night, he is purified by the five products of the cow. / With a vaiśya or a kṣatriya [similarly defiled], he should take a bath and eat only at night.

sanskrit_iast:
adhvānaṃ prasthito vipraḥ kāntāre yadyanūdake /
pakvānnena gṛhītena mūtroccāraṅkaroti vai //
meaning:
अध्वानं प्रस्थितो विप्रः कान्तारे यद्यनूदके /
पक्वान्नेन गृहीतेन मूत्रोच्चारङ्करोति वै //
text_mt: If a vipra setting out on a journey in a waterless wilderness / discharges urine or feces while holding cooked food,

sanskrit_iast:
anidhāyaiva taddravyaṃ aṅge kṛtvā tu saṃsthitaṃ /
śaucaṃ kṛtvānnamabhyukṣya arkasyāgneyaś ca darśayet //
meaning:
अनिधायैव तद्द्रव्यं अङ्गे कृत्वा तु संस्थितं /
शौचं कृत्वान्नमभ्युक्ष्य अर्कस्याग्नेयश् च दर्शयेत् //
text_mt: without setting that item down but keeping it on his body, / having performed ritual purification and sprinkled the food with water, he should show it to the sun and fire.

sanskrit_iast:
mlecchair gatānāṃ caurair vā kāntāre vā pravāsināṃ /
bhakṣyābhakṣyaviśuddhyarthaṃ(1) teṣāṃ vakṣyāminiṣkṛtiṃ //
meaning:
म्लेच्छैर् गतानां चौरैर् वा कान्तारे वा प्रवासिनां /
भक्ष्याभक्ष्यविशुद्ध्यर्थं(1) तेषां वक्ष्यामिनिष्कृतिं //
text_mt: For those taken by barbarians (mlecchas) or thieves, or dwelling abroad in the wilderness, / I shall proclaim an expiation for the purification of edible and inedible things.

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ prāpya svadeśañca varṇānāmanupūrvaśaḥ /
kṛcchrasyānte brāhmaṇastu punaḥ saṃskāramarhati //
meaning:
पुनः प्राप्य स्वदेशञ्च वर्णानामनुपूर्वशः /
कृच्छ्रस्यान्ते ब्राह्मणस्तु पुनः संस्कारमर्हति //
text_mt: Having returned again to their own land, in the order of the social classes: / at the end of a kṛcchra, a brāhmaṇa is entitled to undergo sacraments again;

sanskrit_iast:
pādonānte kṣatriyaś ca ardhānte vaiśya eva ca /
pādaṃ kṛtvā tathā śūdro dānaṃ datvā viśuddhyati //
meaning:
पादोनान्ते क्षत्रियश् च अर्धान्ते वैश्य एव च /
पादं कृत्वा तथा शूद्रो दानं दत्वा विशुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: a kṣatriya at the end of three-quarters [of a kṛcchra]; a vaiśya at the end of half; / and having performed one quarter and given a gift, a śūdra becomes purified.

sanskrit_iast:
udakyā tu savarṇā yā spṛṣṭā cet syādudakyayā /
tasminnevāhani snātā śuddhimāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ //
meaning:
उदक्या तु सवर्णा या स्पृष्टा चेत् स्यादुदक्यया /
तस्मिन्नेवाहनि स्नाता शुद्धिमाप्नोत्यसंशयं //
text_mt: If a menstruating woman is touched by a menstruating woman of the same caste, / having bathed on that very day, she attains ritual purity without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
rajasvalā tu nāśnīyāt saṃspṛṣṭā hīnavarṇayā /
yāvanna śuddhimāpnoti śuddhasnānena śuddhyati //
meaning:
रजस्वला तु नाश्नीयात् संस्पृष्टा हीनवर्णया /
यावन्न शुद्धिमाप्नोति शुद्धस्नानेन शुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: A menstruating woman touched by a woman of lower caste should not eat / until she attains ritual purity; she is purified by a purifying bath.

sanskrit_iast:
mūtraṃ kṛtvā vrajanvartma smṛtibhraṃśājjalaṃ pivet /
ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śuddhyati //
meaning:
मूत्रं कृत्वा व्रजन्वर्त्म स्मृतिभ्रंशाज्जलं पिवेत् /
अहोरात्रोषितो भूत्वा पञ्चगव्येन शुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: If after urinating while walking on the road one drinks water through lapse of memory, / having fasted for a day and night, he is purified by the five products of the cow.

sanskrit_iast:
mūtroccāraṃ dvijaḥ kṛtvā akṛtvā śaucamātmanaḥ /
mohādbhuktvā(2) trirātrantu yavān pītvā viśuddhyati //
meaning:
मूत्रोच्चारं द्विजः कृत्वा अकृत्वा शौचमात्मनः /
मोहाद्भुक्त्वा(2) त्रिरात्रन्तु यवान् पीत्वा विशुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: If a twice-born man discharges urine or feces and, without performing his ritual purification, / eats out of delusion, he is purified by drinking barley-water for three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
ye pratyavasitā viprāḥ pravrajyādibalāttathā /
:n
1 bhakṣyabhojyaviśuddhyarthamiti jha..
2 lobhādbhuktveti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. ca
:p 178
anāśakanivṛtāś ca teṣāṃ śuddhiḥ pracakṣyate //
meaning:
ये प्रत्यवसिता विप्राः प्रव्रज्यादिबलात्तथा /
:न्
1 भक्ष्यभोज्यविशुद्ध्यर्थमिति झ..
2 लोभाद्भुक्त्वेति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. च
:प् 178
अनाशकनिवृताश् च तेषां शुद्धिः प्रचक्ष्यते //
text_mt:
For those vipras who have lapsed from religious mendicancy and the like by force
[Footnote]
1. 'bhakṣyabhojyaviśuddhyartham' in manuscript jha.
2. 'lobhādbhuktvā' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, and cha. / [p. 178]
and for those turned back from fasting to death, purification is proclaimed:

sanskrit_iast:
cārayettrīṇi kṛcchrāṇi cāndrāyaṇamathāpi vā /
jātakarmādisaṃskāraiḥ saṃskuryāttaṃ tathā punaḥ //
meaning:
चारयेत्त्रीणि कृच्छ्राणि चान्द्रायणमथापि वा /
जातकर्मादिसंस्कारैः संस्कुर्यात्तं तथा पुनः //
text_mt: one should make them perform three kṛcchras or a cāndrāyaṇa, / and should consecrate them again with the life-cycle sacraments beginning with the birth rite (jātakarman).

sanskrit_iast:
upānahamamedhyaṃ ca yasya saṃspṛśate mukhaṃ /
mṛttikāgomayau tatra pañcagavyañca śodhanaṃ //
meaning:
उपानहममेध्यं च यस्य संस्पृशते मुखं /
मृत्तिकागोमयौ तत्र पञ्चगव्यञ्च शोधनं //
text_mt: When a shoe or impure matter touches someone's face, / clay, cow dung, and the five products of the cow are the purification there.

sanskrit_iast:
vāpanaṃ vikrayañcaiva nīlavastrādidhāraṇaṃ /
tapanīyaṃ hi viprasya tribhiḥ kṛchrair viśuddhyati //
meaning:
वापनं विक्रयञ्चैव नीलवस्त्रादिधारणं /
तपनीयं हि विप्रस्य त्रिभिः कृछ्रैर् विशुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: Shaving [for money], selling, wearing blue garments, and the like, / are indeed a torment for a vipra; he is purified by three kṛcchras.

sanskrit_iast:
antyajātiśvapākena(1) saṃspṛṣṭā strī rajasvalā /
caturthe 'hani śuddhā sā trirātraṃ tatra ācaret(2) //
meaning:
अन्त्यजातिश्वपाकेन(1) संस्पृष्टा स्त्री रजस्वला /
चतुर्थे ऽहनि शुद्धा सा त्रिरात्रं तत्र आचरेत्(2) //
text_mt: A menstruating woman touched by an outcaste or dog-cooker / is purified on the fourth day; she should observe [a penance of] three nights therein.

sanskrit_iast:
cāṇḍālaśvapacau spṛṣṭvā tathā pūyañca sūtikāṃ /
śavaṃ tatsparśinaṃ spṛṣṭvā(3) sadyaḥ snānena śuddhyati //
meaning:
चाण्डालश्वपचौ स्पृष्ट्वा तथा पूयञ्च सूतिकां /
शवं तत्स्पर्शिनं स्पृष्ट्वा(3) सद्यः स्नानेन शुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: Having touched a caṇḍāla, a dog-cooker, or pus, or a woman in childbed, / or a corpse or one who touched it, one is instantly purified by a bath.

sanskrit_iast:
nāraṃ spṛṣṭvāsthi sasnehaṃ snātvā vipro viśuddhyati /
rathyārkaddamatoyena adhīnābhermṛdodakaiḥ //
meaning:
नारं स्पृष्ट्वास्थि सस्नेहं स्नात्वा विप्रो विशुद्ध्यति /
रथ्यार्कद्दमतोयेन अधीनाभेर्मृदोदकैः //
text_mt: Having touched a human bone with fat, a vipra is purified by bathing. / [Touched by] road dust, mud, or water below the navel, [one is purified] by earth and water.

sanskrit_iast:
vānto viviktaḥ snātvā tu ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśuddhyati /
snānāt kṣurakarmakartā kṛcchrakṛdgrahaṇe 'nnabhuk //
meaning:
वान्तो विविक्तः स्नात्वा तु घृतं प्राश्य विशुद्ध्यति /
स्नानात् क्षुरकर्मकर्ता कृच्छ्रकृद्ग्रहणे ऽन्नभुक् //
text_mt: One who has vomited or purged becomes pure after bathing and sipping clarified butter. / One who has shaved becomes pure through bathing; one who has eaten during an eclipse must perform a kṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
apāṅkteyāśī gavyāśī śunā daṣṭas tathā śuciḥ /
kṛmidaṣṭaścātmaghātī kṛcchrājjapyācca homataḥ //
meaning:
अपाङ्क्तेयाशी गव्याशी शुना दष्टस् तथा शुचिः /
कृमिदष्टश्चात्मघाती कृच्छ्राज्जप्याच्च होमतः //
text_mt: One who eats with outcasts, one who consumes cow products, or one bitten by a dog becomes pure in that way; / one bitten by worms and one who attempted suicide [become pure] through kṛcchra, recitation, and fire oblation.

sanskrit_iast:
homādyaiścānutāpena pūyante pāpino 'khilāḥ(4) //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe prāyaścittāni nāma saptatyadhikaśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 antyajaiś ca svapākeneti ṅa.
2 antyajātiśvapākenetyādiḥ, tatra ācaredityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha..
pustake nāsti
3 śavantatatsparśinaṃ śvānamiti kha.. / śavantatspṛṣṭinaṃ
śvānamiti gha.. , ja.. ca
4 mūtroccāraṃ dvijaḥ kṛtvetyādiḥ, pūyante pāpino 'khilā ity
antaḥ pāṭhaḥ ja.. , jha.. pustake nāsti
:p 179
:ś atha ekasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāyaścittāni
meaning:
होमाद्यैश्चानुतापेन पूयन्ते पापिनो ऽखिलाः(4) //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे प्रायश्चित्तानि नाम सप्तत्यधिकशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 अन्त्यजैश् च स्वपाकेनेति ङ.
2 अन्त्यजातिश्वपाकेनेत्यादिः, तत्र आचरेदित्यन्तः पाठः छ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
3 शवन्ततत्स्पर्शिनं श्वानमिति ख.. / शवन्तत्स्पृष्टिनं
श्वानमिति घ.. , ज.. च
4 मूत्रोच्चारं द्विजः कृत्वेत्यादिः, पूयन्ते पापिनो ऽखिला इत्य्
अन्तः पाठः ज.. , झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 179
:श् अथ एकसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
प्रायश्चित्तानि
text_mt:
And through fire oblations and the like, as well as through repentance, all sinners are purified.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventieth chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, named 'Expiations'.
1 'antyajaiś ca svapākeneti' in manuscript ṅa.
2 The passage beginning with 'antyajātiśvapākenetyādiḥ' and ending with 'tatra ācaredityantaḥ' is missing in manuscript cha.
3 'śavantatatsparśinaṃ śvānamiti' in kha; 'śavantatspṛṣṭinaṃ śvānamiti' in gha and ja.
4 The passage beginning with 'mūtroccāraṃ dvijaḥ kṛtvetyādiḥ' and ending with 'pūyante pāpino 'khilā ityantaḥ' is missing in manuscripts ja and jha.
Now begins the one hundred and seventy-first chapter.
Expiations.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
prāyaścittaṃ rahasyādi vakṣye śuddhikaraṃ para /
pauruṣeṇa tu sūktena māsaṃ japyādināghahā //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
प्रायश्चित्तं रहस्यादि वक्ष्ये शुद्धिकरं पर /
पौरुषेण तु सूक्तेन मासं जप्यादिनाघहा //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / I shall declare the supreme expiations—secret and otherwise—that effect purification. / One destroys sin by reciting the Pauruṣa hymn for a month or the like.

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvair japtvā triraghamarṣaṇaṃ /
vedajapyādvāyuyamād gāyatryā vratato 'dyahā(1) //
meaning:
मुच्यते पातकैः सर्वैर् जप्त्वा त्रिरघमर्षणं /
वेदजप्याद्वायुयमाद् गायत्र्या व्रततो ऽद्यहा(1) //
text_mt: One is freed from all mortal sins by reciting the Aghamarṣaṇa thrice, / [or] destroys sin today by reciting the Vedas, by breath-control, by the Gāyatrī, and by votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
muṇḍanaṃ sarvakṛcchreṣu snānaṃ homo hareryajiḥ /
utthitastu divā tiṣṭhedupaviṣṭas tathā niśi //
meaning:
मुण्डनं सर्वकृच्छ्रेषु स्नानं होमो हरेर्यजिः /
उत्थितस्तु दिवा तिष्ठेदुपविष्टस् तथा निशि //
text_mt: Tonsure, bathing, fire oblation, and sacrifice to Hari [are prescribed] in all kṛcchras. / One should stand upright during the day and sit at night;

sanskrit_iast:
etadvīrāsanaṃ proktaṃ kṛcchrakṛttena pāpahā /
aṣṭabhiḥ pratyahaṃ grāsair yaticāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
एतद्वीरासनं प्रोक्तं कृच्छ्रकृत्तेन पापहा /
अष्टभिः प्रत्यहं ग्रासैर् यतिचान्द्रायणं स्मृतं //
text_mt: this is declared to be the heroic posture (vīrāsana); by this, the performer of the kṛcchra destroys sin. / Eating eight mouthfuls each day is known as the ascetic's cāndrāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaś caturbhiḥ sāyañca śiśucāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtaṃ /
yathākathañcit piṇḍānām catvāriṃśacchatadvayaṃ //
meaning:
प्रातश् चतुर्भिः सायञ्च शिशुचान्द्रायणं स्मृतं /
यथाकथञ्चित् पिण्डानाम् चत्वारिंशच्छतद्वयं //
text_mt: Four mouthfuls in the morning and [four] in the evening is known as the child's cāndrāyaṇa. / Consuming in any manner two hundred and forty mouthfuls

sanskrit_iast:
māsena bhakṣayedetat suracāndrāyaṇaṃ caret /
tryahamuṣṇaṃ pivedāpastyahamuṣṇaṃ payaḥ pivet //
meaning:
मासेन भक्षयेदेतत् सुरचान्द्रायणं चरेत् /
त्र्यहमुष्णं पिवेदापस्त्यहमुष्णं पयः पिवेत् //
text_mt: over a month—one should perform this as the gods' cāndrāyaṇa. / For three days one should drink warm water; for three days one should drink warm milk;

sanskrit_iast:
tryāhamuṣṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ pītvā vāyubhakṣo bhavet tryahaṃ /
taptakṛcchramidaṃ proktaṃ śītaiḥ śītaṃ prakīrtitaṃ //
meaning:
त्र्याहमुष्णं घृतं पीत्वा वायुभक्षो भवेत् त्र्यहं /
तप्तकृच्छ्रमिदं प्रोक्तं शीतैः शीतं प्रकीर्तितं //
text_mt: having drunk warm clarified butter for three days, one should subsist on air for three days. / This is declared as the taptakṛcchra; with cold [liquids] it is proclaimed as the śītakṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛcchrātikṛcchraṃ payasā divasānekaviṃśatiṃ /
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakaṃ //
:n
1 japato 'vadhaheti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
:p 180
meaning:
कृच्छ्रातिकृच्छ्रं पयसा दिवसानेकविंशतिं /
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकं //
:न्
1 जपतो ऽवधहेति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
:प् 180
text_mt:
The kṛcchrātikṛcchra is performed with milk for twenty-one days. / Cow urine, cow dung, milk, curd, clarified butter, and kuśa grass water,
:n
1 'japato 'vadhaheti' in kha, gha, and ja.

sanskrit_iast:
ekarātropavāsaś cakṛcchraṃ śāntapanaṃ smṛtaṃ /
etacca pratyābhyastaṃ mahāśāntapanaṃ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
एकरात्रोपवासश् चकृच्छ्रं शान्तपनं स्मृतं /
एतच्च प्रत्याभ्यस्तं महाशान्तपनं स्मृतं //
text_mt: and fasting for one night, is known as the śāntapana kṛcchra. / And this, repeated day by day, is known as the mahāśāntapana.

sanskrit_iast:
tryahābhyastamathaikaikamatiśāntapanaṃ smṛtaṃ /
kṛcchraṃ parākasañjñaṃ syāddvādaśāhamabhojanaṃ //
meaning:
त्र्यहाभ्यस्तमथैकैकमतिशान्तपनं स्मृतं /
कृच्छ्रं पराकसञ्ज्ञं स्याद्द्वादशाहमभोजनं //
text_mt: Each of these repeated for three days is known as the atiśāntapana. / Complete abstinence from food for twelve days is the kṛcchra named parāka.

sanskrit_iast:
ekabhaktaṃ tryahābhyastaṃ kramānnaktamayācitaṃ /
prājāpatyamupoṣyānte pādaḥ syāt kṛcchrapādakaḥ //
meaning:
एकभक्तं त्र्यहाभ्यस्तं क्रमान्नक्तमयाचितं /
प्राजापत्यमुपोष्यान्ते पादः स्यात् कृच्छ्रपादकः //
text_mt: Eating a single meal [in the day] for three days, then similarly at night, then unasked-for food, / and fasting at the end, is the prājāpatya; one quarter [of it] is the kṛcchrapāda.

sanskrit_iast:
phalair māsaṃ phalaṃ kṛcchraṃ bilvaiḥ śrīkcchra īritaḥ /
padmākṣaiḥ syādāmalakaiḥ puṣpakṛcchraṃ tu puṣpakaiḥ //
meaning:
फलैर् मासं फलं कृच्छ्रं बिल्वैः श्रीक्च्छ्र ईरितः /
पद्माक्षैः स्यादामलकैः पुष्पकृच्छ्रं तु पुष्पकैः //
text_mt: Living on fruits for a month is the phalakṛcchra; on bilva fruits it is declared to be the śrīkṛcchra; / on lotus seeds or āmalakas, [or] on flowers, it is the puṣpakṛcchra;

sanskrit_iast:
patrakṛcchrantathā patraistoyakṛcchraṃ jalena tu /
mūlakṛcchrantathā mūlair dṛdhna kṣīreṇa takrataḥ //
meaning:
पत्रकृच्छ्रन्तथा पत्रैस्तोयकृच्छ्रं जलेन तु /
मूलकृच्छ्रन्तथा मूलैर् दृध्न क्षीरेण तक्रतः //
text_mt: likewise, with leaves it is the patrakṛcchra, and with water it is the toyakṛcchra; / likewise, with roots it is the mūlakṛcchra; [and similarly] with curd, milk, or buttermilk.

sanskrit_iast:
māsaṃ vāyavyakṛcchraṃ syātpāṇipūrānnabhojanāt /
tilair dvādaśarātreṇa kṛcchramāgneyamārtinut //
meaning:
मासं वायव्यकृच्छ्रं स्यात्पाणिपूरान्नभोजनात् /
तिलैर् द्वादशरात्रेण कृच्छ्रमाग्नेयमार्तिनुत् //
text_mt: For a month, eating only a handful of food is the vāyavyakṛcchra. / Living on sesame seeds for twelve nights is the āgneyakṛcchra, which dispels distress.

sanskrit_iast:
pākṣaṃ prasṛtyā lājānāṃ brahmakūrcaṃ tathā bhavet /
upoṣitaś caturdṛśyāṃ pañcadaśyāmanantaraṃ //
meaning:
पाक्षं प्रसृत्या लाजानां ब्रह्मकूर्चं तथा भवेत् /
उपोषितश् चतुर्दृश्यां पञ्चदश्यामनन्तरं //
text_mt: Consuming a handful of puffed grain for a fortnight is the brahmakūrca. / Having fasted on the fourteenth lunar day, then on the fifteenth

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyaṃ samaśnīyāddhaviṣyāśītyanantaraṃ /
māsena dvir naraḥ kṛtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
पञ्चगव्यं समश्नीयाद्धविष्याशीत्यनन्तरं /
मासेन द्विर् नरः कृत्वा सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: one should consume the five products of the cow, and thereafter eat sacrificial food. / Having performed this twice in a month, a person is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkāmaḥ puṣṭikāmaś ca svargakāmo 'ghanaṣṭaye /
devatārādhanaparaḥ kṛcchrakārī sa sarvabhāk //
:e ity āgneye mahāpureṇe rahasyādiprāyaśvittaṃ nāma
ekasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:p 181
:ś atha dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
sarvapāpaprāyaścittāni
meaning:
श्रीकामः पुष्टिकामश् च स्वर्गकामो ऽघनष्टये /
देवताराधनपरः कृच्छ्रकारी स सर्वभाक् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुरेणे रहस्यादिप्रायश्वित्तं नाम
एकसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:प् 181
:श् अथ द्विसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
सर्वपापप्रायश्चित्तानि
text_mt:
One who desires prosperity, nourishment, or heaven, or seeks the destruction of sins, / devoted to the worship of the deities and performing kṛcchras, obtains everything.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-first chapter in the great Agni Purāṇa, named 'Expiations: Secret and Otherwise'.
:p 181
Now begins the one hundred and seventy-second chapter.
Expiations for All Sins.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
paradāraparadravyajīvahiṃsādike yadā /
pravartate nṛṇāṃ cittaṃ prāyaścittaṃ stutistadā //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
परदारपरद्रव्यजीवहिंसादिके यदा /
प्रवर्तते नृणां चित्तं प्रायश्चित्तं स्तुतिस्तदा //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / When people's minds turn toward adultery, taking others' wealth, harming living beings, and the like, / then praise [of God] is the expiation:

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇave viṣṇave nityaṃ viṣṇave viṣṇave(1) namaḥ /
namāmi viṣṇuṃ cittasthamahaṅkāragatiṃ hariṃ //
meaning:
विष्णवे विष्णवे नित्यं विष्णवे विष्णवे(1) नमः /
नमामि विष्णुं चित्तस्थमहङ्कारगतिं हरिं //
text_mt: 'To Viṣṇu, to Viṣṇu, ever to Viṣṇu, to Viṣṇu, salutations! / I bow to Viṣṇu, who dwells in the heart, the destination of ego, Hari;

sanskrit_iast:
cittasthamīśamavyaktamanantamaparājitaṃ /
viṣṇumīḍyamaśeṣeṇa anādinidhanaṃ vibhuṃ //
meaning:
चित्तस्थमीशमव्यक्तमनन्तमपराजितं /
विष्णुमीड्यमशेषेण अनादिनिधनं विभुं //
text_mt: the Lord residing in the heart, unmanifest, infinite, unconquered, / Viṣṇu, praised by all without remainder, without beginning or end, the all-pervading.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣṇuścittagato yanme viṣṇurbuddhigataś ca yat /
yaccāhaṅkārago viṣṇuryadviṣṇurmayi saṃsthitaḥ //
meaning:
विष्णुश्चित्तगतो यन्मे विष्णुर्बुद्धिगतश् च यत् /
यच्चाहङ्कारगो विष्णुर्यद्विष्णुर्मयि संस्थितः //
text_mt: Because Viṣṇu is present in my heart, because Viṣṇu is present in my intellect, / because Viṣṇu is within my ego, and because Viṣṇu dwells within me,

sanskrit_iast:
karoti karmabhūto 'sau sthavarasya carasya ca /
tat pāpannāśamāyātu tasminneva hi cintite //
meaning:
करोति कर्मभूतो ऽसौ स्थवरस्य चरस्य च /
तत् पापन्नाशमायातु तस्मिन्नेव हि चिन्तिते //
text_mt: and manifests as the action of the immovable and the moving, / may that sin come to destruction when he is merely meditated upon!

sanskrit_iast:
dhyāto harati yat pāpaṃ svapne dṛṣṭastu bhāvanāt /
tamupendramahaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇatārtiharaṃ hariṃ //
meaning:
ध्यातो हरति यत् पापं स्वप्ने दृष्टस्तु भावनात् /
तमुपेन्द्रमहं विष्णुं प्रणतार्तिहरं हरिं //
text_mt: Meditation upon whom takes away sin, and who is seen in a dream through deep contemplation— / to that Upendra, Viṣṇu, the remover of the distress of those who bow, to Hari;

sanskrit_iast:
jagatyasminnirādhāre majjamāne tamasyadhaḥ /
hastāvalambanaṃ viṣṇuṃ praṇamāmi parāt paraṃ //
meaning:
जगत्यस्मिन्निराधारे मज्जमाने तमस्यधः /
हस्तावलम्बनं विष्णुं प्रणमामि परात् परं //
text_mt: in this unsupported world sinking down into darkness, / to Viṣṇu, the supporting hand, higher than the highest, I bow.

sanskrit_iast:
sarveśvareśvara vibho paramātmannadhokṣaja /
hṛṣīkeśa hṛṣīkeśa hṛṣīkeśa namo 'stu te //
meaning:
सर्वेश्वरेश्वर विभो परमात्मन्नधोक्षज /
हृषीकेश हृषीकेश हृषीकेश नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: O Sovereign of all lords, O omnipresent one, O Supreme Self, O Adhokṣaja, / O Hṛṣīkeśa, O Hṛṣīkeśa, O Hṛṣīkeśa, salutations to you!

sanskrit_iast:
nṛsiṃhānanta govinda bhūtabhavana keśava /
:n
1 viṣṇave viṣṇave iti ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 182
duruktaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ dhyātaṃ śamayāghannamo 'stu te //
meaning:
नृसिंहानन्त गोविन्द भूतभवन केशव /
:न्
1 विष्णवे विष्णवे इति ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 182
दुरुक्तं दुष्कृतं ध्यातं शमयाघन्नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt:
O Nṛsiṃha, O Infinite One, O Govinda, O source of all beings, O Keśava!
:n
1 'viṣṇave viṣṇave iti' in ja and ña.
pacify what was wrongly spoken, wrongly done, or thought, O destroyer of sin! Salutations to you!

sanskrit_iast:
yanmayā cintitaṃ duṣṭaṃ svacittavaśavartinā /
akāryamahadatyugrantacchamannaya keśava //
meaning:
यन्मया चिन्तितं दुष्टं स्वचित्तवशवर्तिना /
अकार्यमहदत्युग्रन्तच्छमन्नय केशव //
text_mt: Whatever evil was conceived by me, acting under the control of my own mind— / that terrible, great deed that should not be done—bring it to peace, O Keśava!

sanskrit_iast:
brahmaṇyadeva govinda paramārthaparāyaṇa /
jagannātha jagaddhātaḥ pāpaṃ praśamayācyuta //
meaning:
ब्रह्मण्यदेव गोविन्द परमार्थपरायण /
जगन्नाथ जगद्धातः पापं प्रशमयाच्युत //
text_mt: O Deity of the brāhmaṇas, O Govinda, devoted to the ultimate truth, / O Lord of the world, O sustainer of the world, pacify my sin, O Acyuta!

sanskrit_iast:
yathāparāhṇe sāyāhṇe madhyāhṇe ca tathā niśi /
kāyena manasā vācā kṛtaṃ pāpamajānatā //
meaning:
यथापराह्णे सायाह्णे मध्याह्णे च तथा निशि /
कायेन मनसा वाचा कृतं पापमजानता //
text_mt: Whatever sin has been committed unknowingly by body, mind, or speech / in the afternoon, in the evening, at midday, or at night,

sanskrit_iast:
jānatā ca hṛṣīkeśa puṇḍarīkākṣa mādhava /
nāmatrayoccāraṇataḥ svapne yātu mama kṣayaṃ //
meaning:
जानता च हृषीकेश पुण्डरीकाक्ष माधव /
नामत्रयोच्चारणतः स्वप्ने यातु मम क्षयं //
text_mt: or knowingly, O Hṛṣīkeśa, O lotus-eyed one, O Mādhava— / by the utterance of these three names, even in a dream, may it go to its destruction!

sanskrit_iast:
śārīraṃ me hṛṣīkeśa puṇḍarīkākṣa mādhava /
pāpaṃ praśamayādya tvaṃ(1) bākkṛtaṃ mama mādhava //
meaning:
शारीरं मे हृषीकेश पुण्डरीकाक्ष माधव /
पापं प्रशमयाद्य त्वं(1) बाक्कृतं मम माधव //
text_mt: O Hṛṣīkeśa, O lotus-eyed one, O Mādhava, / pacify today my bodily sin, and my sin committed by speech, O Mādhava!

sanskrit_iast:
yadbhuñjanyatsvapaṃstiṣṭhan gacchan jāgrad yadāsthitaḥ /
kṛtavān pāpamadyāhaṃ kāyena manasā girā //
meaning:
यद्भुञ्जन्यत्स्वपंस्तिष्ठन् गच्छन् जाग्रद् यदास्थितः /
कृतवान् पापमद्याहं कायेन मनसा गिरा //
text_mt: Whatever sin I have committed today through body, mind, or speech, / while eating, sleeping, standing, walking, awake, or sitting,

sanskrit_iast:
yat svalpamapi yat sthūlaṃ kuyoninarakābahaṃ /
tadyātu praśamaṃ sarvaṃ vāsudevānukīrtanāt //
meaning:
यत् स्वल्पमपि यत् स्थूलं कुयोनिनरकाबहं /
तद्यातु प्रशमं सर्वं वासुदेवानुकीर्तनात् //
text_mt: whether very minor or gross, leading to evil wombs or to hell— / may all that go to pacification through the recitation of Vāsudeva's names!

sanskrit_iast:
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramañca yat /
tasmin(2) prakīrtite viṣṇau yat pāpaṃ tat praṇaśyatu //
meaning:
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमञ्च यत् /
तस्मिन्(2) प्रकीर्तिते विष्णौ यत् पापं तत् प्रणश्यतु //
text_mt: The Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, that which is supremely pure— / when that Viṣṇu is proclaimed, may whatever sin there is perish!

sanskrit_iast:
yat prāpya na nivartante gandhasparśadivarjitaṃ /
sūrayastat padaṃ viṣṇostat sarvaṃ śamayatvaghaṃ(3) //
meaning:
यत् प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते गन्धस्पर्शदिवर्जितं /
सूरयस्तत् पदं विष्णोस्तत् सर्वं शमयत्वघं(3) //
text_mt: Having attained which the wise never return, devoid of smell, touch, and the rest— / may that state of Viṣṇu pacify all sin!'

sanskrit_iast:
pāpapraṇāśanaṃ stotraṃ yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādapi(4) /
:n
1 praśamātyarthamiti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
2 asminniti gha..
3 sarvaṃ gamayatvaghamiti jha..
4 yaḥ paṭecchraddhayā nara iti ja.. , jha.. ca / yaḥ
paṭhecchṛṇuyānnara iti ña..
:p 183
śārīrair mānasair vāgjaiḥ kṛtaiḥ papaiḥ pramucyate //
meaning:
पापप्रणाशनं स्तोत्रं यः पठेच्छृणुयादपि(4) /
:न्
1 प्रशमात्यर्थमिति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
2 अस्मिन्निति घ..
3 सर्वं गमयत्वघमिति झ..
4 यः पटेच्छ्रद्धया नर इति ज.. , झ.. च / यः
पठेच्छृणुयान्नर इति ञ..
:प् 183
शारीरैर् मानसैर् वाग्जैः कृतैः पपैः प्रमुच्यते //
text_mt:
Whoever recites or even listens to this hymn that destroys sin
:n
1 'praśamātyarthamiti' in kha, gha, and ja.
2 'asminniti' in gha.
[Variant reading:] 3 ‘sarvaṃ gamayatvagham’ in manuscript jha.
[Variant reading:] 4 ‘yaḥ paṭecchraddhayā naraḥ’ in manuscripts ja and jha; ‘yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyānnaraḥ’ in manuscript ña.
he is liberated from sins committed—bodily, mental, or produced by speech.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvapāpagrahādibhyo yāti viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padaṃ /
tasmāt pāpe kṛte japyaṃ stotraṃ sarvāghamardanaṃ //
meaning:
सर्वपापग्रहादिभ्यो याति विष्णोः परं पदं /
तस्मात् पापे कृते जप्यं स्तोत्रं सर्वाघमर्दनं //
text_mt: From all sins, planetary afflictions, and the like, he goes to the supreme abode of Viṣṇu. / Therefore, when a sin is committed, this praise, which destroys all sin, is to be recited.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittamaghaughānāṃ stotraṃ vratakṛte varaṃ /
prāyaścittaiḥ stotrajapair vratair naśyati pātakaṃ //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तमघौघानां स्तोत्रं व्रतकृते वरं /
प्रायश्चित्तैः स्तोत्रजपैर् व्रतैर् नश्यति पातकं //
text_mt: For hosts of sins, expiation by means of praise is best for one performing votive observances. / Through expiations, recitations of praise, and votive observances, a grave sin is destroyed.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ kāryāṇi(1) saṃsiddhyai tāni vai bhuktimuktaye //22//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe sarvapāpaprāyaścitte pāpanāśanastotraṃ
nāma dvisaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāyaścittaṃ
meaning:
ततः कार्याणि(1) संसिद्ध्यै तानि वै भुक्तिमुक्तये //22//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे सर्वपापप्रायश्चित्ते पापनाशनस्तोत्रं
नाम द्विसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ त्रिसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
प्रायश्चित्तं
text_mt:
Then those rites should be performed for complete success, indeed for worldly enjoyment and liberation. //22
Thus ends the hundred and seventy-second chapter, titled ‘The Praise That Destroys Sins’, in the context of expiation for all sins, in the Mahāpurāṇa spoken by Agni.
Now begins the hundred and seventy-third chapter.
[Topic:] Expiation.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
prāyaścittaṃ brahṇoktaṃ vakṣye pāpopaśāntidaṃ /
syāt prāṇaviyogaphalo vyāpāro hananaṃ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
प्रायश्चित्तं ब्रह्णोक्तं वक्ष्ये पापोपशान्तिदं /
स्यात् प्राणवियोगफलो व्यापारो हननं स्मृतं //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall state the expiation declared by Brahmā, which brings about the cessation of sins. / The activity whose consequence is the separation of life-breaths is remembered as killing.

sanskrit_iast:
rāgād dveṣāt pramādācca svataḥ parata eva vā /
brāhmaṇaṃ ghātayedyastu sa bhavedbrahmaghātakaḥ //
meaning:
रागाद् द्वेषात् प्रमादाच्च स्वतः परत एव वा /
ब्राह्मणं घातयेद्यस्तु स भवेद्ब्रह्मघातकः //
text_mt: Whether from passion, hatred, or negligence, directly by oneself or through another, / he who causes a brāhmaṇa to be slain is a slayer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
bahūnāmekakāryāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śastradhāriṇāṃ /
yadyeko ghātakastatra sarve te ghātakāḥ smṛtāḥ //
meaning:
बहूनामेककार्याणां सर्वेषां शस्त्रधारिणां /
यद्येको घातकस्तत्र सर्वे ते घातकाः स्मृताः //
text_mt: When many people have a single objective, all carrying weapons, / if one among them is the killer, all of them are remembered as killers.

sanskrit_iast:
ākrośitastāḍito vā dhanaivvā paripīḍitaḥ /
:n
1 tataḥ karmāṇīti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , cha.. ca
:p 184
yamuddiśya tyajet prāṇāṃstamāhurbrahmaghātakaṃ //
meaning:
आक्रोशितस्ताडितो वा धनैव्वा परिपीडितः /
:न्
1 ततः कर्माणीति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , छ.. च
:प् 184
यमुद्दिश्य त्यजेत् प्राणांस्तमाहुर्ब्रह्मघातकं //
text_mt:
Abused, beaten, or afflicted in terms of wealth,
[Footnote]
[Footnote:] 1 ‘tataḥ karmāṇi’ in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, and cha.
he on account of whom one gives up life-breaths is called the slayer of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
auṣadhādyupakāre tu na pāpaṃ syāt kṛte mṛte /
putraṃ śiṣyantathā bhāryāṃ śāsate na mṛte hy aghaṃ //
meaning:
औषधाद्युपकारे तु न पापं स्यात् कृते मृते /
पुत्रं शिष्यन्तथा भार्यां शासते न मृते ह्य् अघं //
text_mt: When assistance through medicine and the like has been rendered and death occurs, there is no sin. / In the case of disciplining a son, a pupil, or a wife, if death occurs, there is indeed no guilt.

sanskrit_iast:
deśaṃ kālañca yaḥ śaktiṃ pāpañcāvekṣya yatnataḥ /
prāyaścittaṃ prakalpyaṃ syādyatra coktā ba niṣkṛtiḥ(1) //
meaning:
देशं कालञ्च यः शक्तिं पापञ्चावेक्ष्य यत्नतः /
प्रायश्चित्तं प्रकल्प्यं स्याद्यत्र चोक्ता ब निष्कृतिः(1) //
text_mt: Having carefully examined the place, time, capability, and the sin, / an expiation should be assigned where no specific remedy has been stated.

sanskrit_iast:
gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe vā sadyaḥ prāṇān parityajet /
prāsyedātmānamagnau vā mucyate brahmahatyayā //
meaning:
गवार्थे ब्राह्मणार्थे वा सद्यः प्राणान् परित्यजेत् /
प्रास्येदात्मानमग्नौ वा मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया //
text_mt: For the sake of cows or for the sake of a brāhmaṇa, one should instantly surrender one's life, / or cast oneself into fire: one is freed from the killing of a brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
śiraḥkapālī dhvajavān bhaikṣāśī karma vedayan /
brahmahā dvādaśābdāni mitabhuk śuddhimāpnuyāt //
meaning:
शिरःकपाली ध्वजवान् भैक्षाशी कर्म वेदयन् /
ब्रह्महा द्वादशाब्दानि मितभुक् शुद्धिमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Carrying a human skull, bearing a staff, eating begged food, proclaiming his deed, / eating moderately, a brāhmaṇa-slayer attains purity after twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaḍbhirvarṣaiḥ śuddhacārī brahmahā pūyate naraḥ /
vihitaṃ yadakāmā māṃ kāmāttu dviguṇaṃ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
षड्भिर्वर्षैः शुद्धचारी ब्रह्महा पूयते नरः /
विहितं यदकामा मां कामात्तु द्विगुणं स्मृतं //
text_mt: Living purely for six years, a man who has slain a brāhmaṇa is purified. / That which is prescribed is for unintentional [killing]; but for intentional it is declared to be double.

sanskrit_iast:
prāyaścittaṃ pravṛttasya badhe syāttu(2) trivārṣikaṃ /
brahmaghni kṣatre dviguṇaṃ viṭcchūdre dviguṇaṃ tridhā //
meaning:
प्रायश्चित्तं प्रवृत्तस्य बधे स्यात्तु(2) त्रिवार्षिकं /
ब्रह्मघ्नि क्षत्रे द्विगुणं विट्च्छूद्रे द्विगुणं त्रिधा //
text_mt: The expiation for killing one who has undertaken [a sacrifice] is three years. / If a kṣatriya kills a brāhmaṇa, [the penance] is doubled; for a vaiśya or a śūdra, it is doubled threefold.

sanskrit_iast:
anyatra vipre sakalaṃ pādonaṃ kṣatriye mataṃ /
vaiśye 'rdhapādaṃ kṣatre syādvṛddhastrībālarogiṣu //
meaning:
अन्यत्र विप्रे सकलं पादोनं क्षत्रिये मतं /
वैश्ये ऽर्धपादं क्षत्रे स्याद्वृद्धस्त्रीबालरोगिषु //
text_mt: Elsewhere, in the case of a vipra, it is full; for a kṣatriya, it is considered one quarter less. / For a vaiśya, it is half a quarter; in the case of a kṣatriya [slaying] the aged, women, children, and the sick,

sanskrit_iast:
turīyo brahmahatyāyāḥ kṣatriyasya badhe smṛtaṃ /
vaiśye 'ṣṭamāṃśo vṛttasthe śūdre jñeyastu ṣoḍaśaḥ //
meaning:
तुरीयो ब्रह्महत्यायाः क्षत्रियस्य बधे स्मृतं /
वैश्ये ऽष्टमांशो वृत्तस्थे शूद्रे ज्ञेयस्तु षोडशः //
text_mt: one fourth of [the penance for] killing a brāhmaṇa is remembered for slaying a kṣatriya; / for [slaying] an upright vaiśya, an eighth part; but for a śūdra, a sixteenth is to be known.

sanskrit_iast:
apraduṣṭāṃ striyaṃ hatvā śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret /
pañcagavyaṃ pivedgoghno māsamāsīta saṃyataḥ //
meaning:
अप्रदुष्टां स्त्रियं हत्वा शूद्रहत्याव्रतं चरेत् /
पञ्चगव्यं पिवेद्गोघ्नो मासमासीत संयतः //
text_mt: Having slain an uncorrupted woman, one should perform the observance for slaying a śūdra. / A cow-killer should drink pañcagavya and dwell restrained for a month.

sanskrit_iast:
goṣṭhe śayo go 'nugāmī gopradānena śuddhyati /
kṛcchrañcaivātikṛcchraṃ vā pādahrāso nṛpādiṣu //
meaning:
गोष्ठे शयो गो ऽनुगामी गोप्रदानेन शुद्ध्यति /
कृच्छ्रञ्चैवातिकृच्छ्रं वा पादह्रासो नृपादिषु //
text_mt: Sleeping in a cowshed, following cows, he is purified by the gift of a cow. / [He performs] a kṛcchra or an atikṛcchra penance; there is a reduction of a quarter in the case of kings and others.

sanskrit_iast:
ativṛddhāmatikṛśāmatibālāñca rogiṇīṃ /
:n
1 na saṃskṛtiriti cha..
2 badhe 'sya tu iti cha..
:p 185
hatvā pūrvavidhānena caredardhavrataṃ dvijaḥ //
meaning:
अतिवृद्धामतिकृशामतिबालाञ्च रोगिणीं /
:न्
1 न संस्कृतिरिति छ..
2 बधे ऽस्य तु इति छ..
:प् 185
हत्वा पूर्वविधानेन चरेदर्धव्रतं द्विजः //
text_mt:
Having slain an extremely old, extremely emaciated, extremely young, or diseased [cow],
[Footnote]
[Footnote:] 1 ‘na saṃskṛtiḥ’ in manuscript cha.
[Footnote:] 2 ‘badhe 'sya tu’ in manuscript cha.
a twice-born should perform half the observance according to the earlier rule.

sanskrit_iast:
brāhmaṇān bhojayecchaktyā dadyāddhematiladikaṃ /
muṣṭicapeṭakīlena tathā śṛṅgādimoṭane //
meaning:
ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेच्छक्त्या दद्याद्धेमतिलदिकं /
मुष्टिचपेटकीलेन तथा शृङ्गादिमोटने //
text_mt: He should feed brāhmaṇas according to his ability and give gold, sesame seeds, and the like. / By a fist, a slap, or a peg, as well as breaking a horn or the like,

sanskrit_iast:
laguḍādiprahāreṇa gobadhaṃ tatra nirdiśet /
damena dāmane caiva śakaṭādau ca yojane //
meaning:
लगुडादिप्रहारेण गोबधं तत्र निर्दिशेत् /
दमेन दामने चैव शकटादौ च योजने //
text_mt: [or] by a blow with a staff or the like, cow-killing should be declared in that case; / or by subjugation, in taming, and in yoking to a cart or the like,

sanskrit_iast:
stambhaśṛṅkhalapāśair vā mṛte pādonamācaret /
kāṣṭhe śāntapanaṃ kuryāt prājāpatyantu loṣṭhake //
meaning:
स्तम्भशृङ्खलपाशैर् वा मृते पादोनमाचरेत् /
काष्ठे शान्तपनं कुर्यात् प्राजापत्यन्तु लोष्ठके //
text_mt: or if it dies by a post, an iron chain, or ropes, one should observe three-fourths [of the penance]. / For [striking with] wood, one should perform a śāntapana; for a clod of earth, a prājāpatya.

sanskrit_iast:
taptakṛcchrantu pāṣāṇe śastre cāpyatikṛcchrakaṃ /
mārjāragodhānakulamaṇḍūkaśvapatatriṇaḥ //
meaning:
तप्तकृच्छ्रन्तु पाषाणे शस्त्रे चाप्यतिकृच्छ्रकं /
मार्जारगोधानकुलमण्डूकश्वपतत्रिणः //
text_mt: For a stone, a taptakṛcchra; and for a weapon, an atikṛcchra. / Having killed a cat, an iguana, a mongoose, a frog, a dog, or a bird,

sanskrit_iast:
hatvā tryahaṃ pivet kṣīraṃ kṛcchraṃ cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret /
vrataṃ rahasye rahasi prakāśe 'pi prakāśakaṃ //
meaning:
हत्वा त्र्यहं पिवेत् क्षीरं कृच्छ्रं चान्द्रायणं चरेत् /
व्रतं रहस्ये रहसि प्रकाशे ऽपि प्रकाशकं //
text_mt: one should drink milk for three days, or perform a kṛcchra or a cāndrāyaṇa penance. / The observance for a secret [sin] is secret, and for a public [sin] it is public.

sanskrit_iast:
prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kāryaṃ sarvapāpāpanuttaye /
pānakaṃ drākṣamadhukaṃ khārjarantālamaikṣavaṃ //
meaning:
प्राणायामशतं कार्यं सर्वपापापनुत्तये /
पानकं द्राक्षमधुकं खार्जरन्तालमैक्षवं //
text_mt: A hundred breath-controls should be performed for the removal of all sins. / Sweet liquor made from grapes, madhūka, dates, palmyra, sugarcane,

sanskrit_iast:
madhvīkaṃ ṭaṅkamādhvīkaṃ maireyaṃ(?) nārikelajaṃ /
na madyānyapi madyāni paiṣṭī mukhyā surā smṛtā //
meaning:
मध्वीकं टङ्कमाध्वीकं मैरेयं(?) नारिकेलजं /
न मद्यान्यपि मद्यानि पैष्टी मुख्या सुरा स्मृता //
text_mt: honey, wood-apple, madhvīka, maireya, or coconut-juice: / these are not non-intoxicants, but intoxicants; liquor made from grain is remembered as the chief liquor.

sanskrit_iast:
traivarṇasya niṣiddhāni pītvā taptvāpyapaḥ śuciḥ /
kaṇān vā bhakṣayedabdaṃ piṇyākaṃ vā sakṛnniśi //
meaning:
त्रैवर्णस्य निषिद्धानि पीत्वा तप्त्वाप्यपः शुचिः /
कणान् वा भक्षयेदब्दं पिण्याकं वा सकृन्निशि //
text_mt: They are forbidden for the three classes; having drunk them, one becomes pure by burning [with hot water]. / Or he should eat grain-particles for a year, or oil-cake once at night.

sanskrit_iast:
surāpāṇāpanutyarthaṃ bālavāmā jaṭī dhvajī /
ajñānāt prāśya viṇmūtraṃ surāsaṃspṛṣṭameva ca //
meaning:
सुरापाणापनुत्यर्थं बालवामा जटी ध्वजी /
अज्ञानात् प्राश्य विण्मूत्रं सुरासंस्पृष्टमेव च //
text_mt: To remove the sin of drinking liquor, wearing hair-cloth, matted hair, and carrying a staff, / or having consumed feces or urine out of ignorance, or food touched by liquor,

sanskrit_iast:
punaḥ saṃskāramarhanti trayo varṇā dvijātayaḥ /
madyamāṇḍasthitā āpaḥ pītvā saptadinaṃ vratī //
meaning:
पुनः संस्कारमर्हन्ति त्रयो वर्णा द्विजातयः /
मद्यमाण्डस्थिता आपः पीत्वा सप्तदिनं व्रती //
text_mt: the three twice-born classes are fit for a fresh sacramental rite. / Having drunk water standing in an intoxicating liquor vessel, one should observe a vow for seven days.

sanskrit_iast:
cāṇḍālasya tu pānīyaṃ pītvā syāt ṣaḍdinaṃ vratī /
caṇḍālakūpabhāṇḍeṣu pītvā śāntapanaṃ caret //
:p 186
meaning:
चाण्डालस्य तु पानीयं पीत्वा स्यात् षड्दिनं व्रती /
चण्डालकूपभाण्डेषु पीत्वा शान्तपनं चरेत् //
:प् 186
text_mt:
Having drunk water belonging to an outcaste, one should observe a vow for six days. / Having drunk from wells or vessels of an outcaste, one should perform a śāntapana.
[Page 186]

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyaṃ trirānte pītvā cāntyajalaṃ dvijaḥ /
matsyakaṇṭakaśambūkaśaṅkhaśuktikapardakān //
meaning:
पञ्चगव्यं त्रिरान्ते पीत्वा चान्त्यजलं द्विजः /
मत्स्यकण्टकशम्बूकशङ्खशुक्तिकपर्दकान् //
text_mt: Having drunk water of the lowest outcaste, a twice-born, after drinking pañcagavya for three nights, / [and having drunk water with] fish-bones, snails, conches, mother-of-pearl, or cowrie-shells,

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā navodakaṃ caiva pañcagavyena śuddhyati /
śavakūpodakaṃ pītvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati //
meaning:
पीत्वा नवोदकं चैव पञ्चगव्येन शुद्ध्यति /
शवकूपोदकं पीत्वा त्रिरात्रेण विशुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: and also having drunk newly collected rainwater, is purified by pañcagavya. / Having drunk water from a well containing a corpse, he is purified in three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
antyāvasāyināmannaṃ bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret /
āpatkāle śūdragṛhe manastāpena śuddhyati //
meaning:
अन्त्यावसायिनामन्नं भुक्त्वा चान्द्रायणं चरेत् /
आपत्काले शूद्रगृहे मनस्तापेन शुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: Having eaten food of outcastes living at the edge of the settlement, one should perform a cāndrāyaṇa. / In a time of distress, in the house of a śūdra, one is purified by remorse.

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrabhājanabhuk vipraḥ pañcagavyādupoṣitaḥ /
kandupakvaṃ snehapakvaṃ snehaṃ ca dadhiśaktavaḥ //
meaning:
शूद्रभाजनभुक् विप्रः पञ्चगव्यादुपोषितः /
कन्दुपक्वं स्नेहपक्वं स्नेहं च दधिशक्तवः //
text_mt: A vipra who eats from a śūdra's vessel, having fasted, [is purified] by pañcagavya. / Food cooked in an iron pan, food cooked in oil, clarified butter, curd, and roasted barley meal:

sanskrit_iast:
śūdrādanindyānyetāni guḍakṣīrarasādikaṃ /
asnātabhuk copavāsī dinānte tu japācchuciḥ //
meaning:
शूद्रादनिन्द्यान्येतानि गुडक्षीररसादिकं /
अस्नातभुक् चोपवासी दिनान्ते तु जपाच्छुचिः //
text_mt: these are irreproachable from a śūdra, as well as jaggery, milk, juices, and the like. / One who eats without bathing should fast, and at the end of the day he is purified by recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
mūtroccāryaśucirbhuktvā trirātreṇa viśuddhyati /
keśakīṭāvapannaṃ ca pādaspṛṣṭañca kāmataḥ //
meaning:
मूत्रोच्चार्यशुचिर्भुक्त्वा त्रिरात्रेण विशुद्ध्यति /
केशकीटावपन्नं च पादस्पृष्टञ्च कामतः //
text_mt: Having eaten while impure with urine or feces, one is purified in three nights. / Food fallen into with hair or insects, intentionally touched by a foot,

sanskrit_iast:
bhrūṇaghnāvekṣittaṃ caiva saspṛṣṭaṃ vāpyudakyayā /
kākādyair avalīḍhaṃ ca śunāsaṃspṛṣṭameva ca //
meaning:
भ्रूणघ्नावेक्षित्तं चैव सस्पृष्टं वाप्युदक्यया /
काकाद्यैर् अवलीढं च शुनासंस्पृष्टमेव च //
text_mt: viewed by a slayer of an embryo, touched by a menstruating woman, / licked by crows and the like, or touched by a dog,

sanskrit_iast:
gavādyair annamāghrātaṃ bhuktvā tryahamupāvaset /
retoviṇmūtrabhakṣī tu prājāpatyaṃ samācaret //
meaning:
गवाद्यैर् अन्नमाघ्रातं भुक्त्वा त्र्यहमुपावसेत् /
रेतोविण्मूत्रभक्षी तु प्राजापत्यं समाचरेत् //
