text_mt: having eaten food smelled by cows and the like, one should fast for three days. / One who consumes semen, feces, or urine, however, should perform a prājāpatya.

sanskrit_iast:
cāndrāyaṇa navaśrāddhe parāko māsike mataḥ /
pakṣatraye 'tikṛcchraṃ syāt ṣaṇmāse kṛcchrameva ca //
meaning:
चान्द्रायण नवश्राद्धे पराको मासिके मतः /
पक्षत्रये ऽतिकृच्छ्रं स्यात् षण्मासे कृच्छ्रमेव च //
text_mt: A cāndrāyaṇa [is prescribed for eating] in a newly performed ancestral rite; a parāka is considered [prescribed] in a monthly rite. / In one of three fortnights, it should be an atikṛcchra; in one of six months, a kṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
ābdike pādakṛcchraṃ syādekāhaḥ punarāvdike /
pūrvedyurvārṣikaṃ śrāddhaṃ paredyuḥ punarāvdikaṃ //
meaning:
आब्दिके पादकृच्छ्रं स्यादेकाहः पुनराव्दिके /
पूर्वेद्युर्वार्षिकं श्राद्धं परेद्युः पुनराव्दिकं //
text_mt: In an annual rite, it should be a quarter-kṛcchra; a one-day fast in a second annual rite. / On the preceding day is the annual ancestral rite; on the following day is the second annual rite.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣiddhabhakṣaṇe bhukte prāyaścittamupoṣaṇaṃ /
bhūstṛṇaṃ laśunaṃ bhuktvā(1) śiśukaṃ kṛcchramācaret(2) //
:n
1 laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ bhuktveti ṅa..
2 śiśukṛcchraṃ samācarediti kha..
:p 187
meaning:
निषिद्धभक्षणे भुक्ते प्रायश्चित्तमुपोषणं /
भूस्तृणं लशुनं भुक्त्वा(1) शिशुकं कृच्छ्रमाचरेत्(2) //
:न्
1 लशुनं गृञ्जनं भुक्त्वेति ङ..
2 शिशुकृच्छ्रं समाचरेदिति ख..
:प् 187
text_mt:
When forbidden food is eaten, the expiation is fasting. / Having eaten bhūstṛṇa grass, garlic, or śiśuka, one should perform a kṛcchra.
[Footnote]
[Footnote:] 1 ‘laśunaṃ gṛñjanaṃ bhuktvā’ in manuscript ṅa.
[Footnote:] 2 ‘śiśukṛcchraṃ samācaret’ in manuscript kha.

sanskrit_iast:
abhojyānāntu bhuktvānnaṃ strīśūdrocchiṣṭameva ca /
jagdhvā māṃsamabhakṣyañca saptarātraṃ payaḥ pivet //
meaning:
अभोज्यानान्तु भुक्त्वान्नं स्त्रीशूद्रोच्छिष्टमेव च /
जग्ध्वा मांसमभक्ष्यञ्च सप्तरात्रं पयः पिवेत् //
text_mt: Having eaten the food of those whose food should not be eaten, or the remnants of women or śūdras, / and having eaten meat unfit to be eaten, one should drink milk for seven nights.

sanskrit_iast:
madhu māṃsañca yo 'śnīyācchāvaṃ sūtakameva vā /
prājāpatyaṃ caret kṛcchraṃ brahmacārī yatirvratī //
meaning:
मधु मांसञ्च यो ऽश्नीयाच्छावं सूतकमेव वा /
प्राजापत्यं चरेत् कृच्छ्रं ब्रह्मचारी यतिर्व्रती //
text_mt: A student of the Veda, an ascetic, or one observing a votive observance who consumes honey or meat, / or [food associated with] impurity from death or birth, should perform the prājāpatya kṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
anyayena parasvāpaharaṇaṃ steyamucyate /
musalena hato rājñā svarṇasteyī viśuddhyati //
meaning:
अन्ययेन परस्वापहरणं स्तेयमुच्यते /
मुसलेन हतो राज्ञा स्वर्णस्तेयी विशुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: Unlawful seizure of another's property is called theft. / A thief of gold is purified when struck dead by the king with a club.

sanskrit_iast:
adhaḥśāyī jaṭādhārī parṇamūlaphalāśanaḥ /
ekakālaṃ samaśnāno dvādaśābde viśuddhyati //
meaning:
अधःशायी जटाधारी पर्णमूलफलाशनः /
एककालं समश्नानो द्वादशाब्दे विशुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: Sleeping on the ground, wearing matted hair, subsisting on leaves, roots, and fruits, / eating only once a day, one is purified in twelve years.

sanskrit_iast:
rukmasteyī surāpaś ca brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ /
steyaṃ kṛtvā surāṃ pītvā kṛcchrañcābdaṃ carennaraḥ //
meaning:
रुक्मस्तेयी सुरापश् च ब्रह्महा गुरुतल्पगः /
स्तेयं कृत्वा सुरां पीत्वा कृच्छ्रञ्चाब्दं चरेन्नरः //
text_mt: A thief of gold, a drinker of liquor, a killer of a Brahmin, and one who violates a guru's bed— / a man who commits theft or drinks liquor should observe a kṛcchra for a year.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇimuktāpravālānāṃ tāmrasya rajatasya ca /
ayaskāṃsyopalānāñca dvādaśāhaṃ kaṇānnabhuk //
meaning:
मणिमुक्ताप्रवालानां ताम्रस्य रजतस्य च /
अयस्कांस्योपलानाञ्च द्वादशाहं कणान्नभुक् //
text_mt: [For the theft] of gems, pearls, coral, copper, or silver, / or iron, bronze, and stone, [one should fast] for twelve days, eating broken grains of rice.

sanskrit_iast:
manuṣyāṇāntu haraṇe strīṇāṃ kṣetragṛhasya ca /
vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ śuddhiścāndrāyaṇaṃ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
मनुष्याणान्तु हरणे स्त्रीणां क्षेत्रगृहस्य च /
वापीकूपतडागानां शुद्धिश्चान्द्रायणं स्मृतं //
text_mt: In the case of stealing humans, women, fields, houses, / or cisterns, wells, and reservoirs, the cāndrāyaṇa is remembered as the purification.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣyabhojyāpaharaṇe yānaśayyāsanasya ca /
puṣpamūlaphalānāñca pañcagavyaṃ viśodhanaṃ //
meaning:
भक्ष्यभोज्यापहरणे यानशय्यासनस्य च /
पुष्पमूलफलानाञ्च पञ्चगव्यं विशोधनं //
text_mt: In [the theft] of grass, wood, trees, dry food, and jaggery, / and of clothes, skins, or meat, there should be fasting for three nights.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛṇakāṣṭhadrumāṇāñca śuṣkānnasya guḍasya ca /
celacarmāmiṣāṇāñca trirātraṃ syādabhojanaṃ //
meaning:
तृणकाष्ठद्रुमाणाञ्च शुष्कान्नस्य गुडस्य च /
चेलचर्मामिषाणाञ्च त्रिरात्रं स्यादभोजनं //
text_mt: Going to the father's wife, a sister, likewise a teacher's daughter, / the teacher's wife, or one's own daughter, one violates the guru's bed.

sanskrit_iast:
pituḥ patnīñca bhaginīmācāryatanayāntathā /
ācāryāṇīṃ sutāṃ svāñca gacchaṃś ca gurutalpagaḥ //
meaning:
पितुः पत्नीञ्च भगिनीमाचार्यतनयान्तथा /
आचार्याणीं सुतां स्वाञ्च गच्छंश् च गुरुतल्पगः //
text_mt: Having confessed the sin committed regarding the guru's bed, [he should lie] on a heated iron bed / and embrace a blazing iron pillar; through death he is purified.

sanskrit_iast:
gurutalpe 'bhibhāṣyainastapte pacyādayomaye /
śūmīṃ jvalantīñcāśliṣya mṛtunā sa viśuddhyati //
meaning:
गुरुतल्पे ऽभिभाष्यैनस्तप्ते पच्यादयोमये /
शूमीं ज्वलन्तीञ्चाश्लिष्य मृतुना स विशुद्ध्यति //
text_mt: Or, having performed the cāndrāyaṇa for three months, the violator of the guru's bed [is purified].

sanskrit_iast:
cāndrāyaṇān vā trīnmāsānabhyasya gurutalpagaḥ /
:p 188
evameva vidhiṃ kuryād yoṣitsu patitāsvapi //
meaning:
चान्द्रायणान् वा त्रीन्मासानभ्यस्य गुरुतल्पगः /
:प् 188
एवमेव विधिं कुर्याद् योषित्सु पतितास्वपि //
text_mt:
[Page 188]
One should apply this very rule also in the case of fallen women.
Whatever votive observance is prescribed for a man regarding another's wife, one should make her perform that; / having emitted semen into maidens, Cāṇḍāla women, or daughters,

sanskrit_iast:
yat puṃsaḥ paradāreṣu taccaināṃ kārayedvrataṃ /
retaḥ siktvā kumārīṣu cāṇḍālīṣu sutāsu ca //
meaning:
यत् पुंसः परदारेषु तच्चैनां कारयेद्व्रतं /
रेतः सिक्त्वा कुमारीषु चाण्डालीषु सुतासु च //
text_mt: or into the wives of sapinda relatives or offspring, giving up one's life is prescribed. / If a twice-born man frequents a Śūdra woman for one night,

sanskrit_iast:
sapiṇḍāpatyadāreṣu prāṇatyāgo vidhīyate /
yat karotyekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanaṃ dvijaḥ //
meaning:
सपिण्डापत्यदारेषु प्राणत्यागो विधीयते /
यत् करोत्येकरात्रेण वृषलीसेवनं द्विजः //
text_mt: eating begged food [and] reciting daily, he removes that [sin] in three years. / In approaching the wife of a paternal uncle, or in approaching a brother's wife,

sanskrit_iast:
tadbhaikṣyabhug(1) japannityaṃ tribhirvarṣair vyapohati /
pitṛvyadāragamane bhrātṛbhāryāgame(2) tathā //
meaning:
तद्भैक्ष्यभुग्(1) जपन्नित्यं त्रिभिर्वर्षैर् व्यपोहति /
पितृव्यदारगमने भ्रातृभार्यागमे(2) तथा //
text_mt: or a Cāṇḍāla woman, a Pukkasa woman, a daughter-in-law, a sister, a female friend, / a maternal aunt, a paternal aunt, a woman entrusted [for safekeeping], a woman who has sought refuge,

sanskrit_iast:
cāṇḍālīṃ pukkasīṃ vāpi snuṣāñca bhaginīṃ sakhīṃ /
mātuḥ pituḥ svasārañca nikṣiptāṃ śaraṇāgatāṃ //
meaning:
चाण्डालीं पुक्कसीं वापि स्नुषाञ्च भगिनीं सखीं /
मातुः पितुः स्वसारञ्च निक्षिप्तां शरणागतां //
text_mt: a maternal uncle's wife, a sister, a woman of the same lineage, one longing for another, / the wife of a disciple, or the wife of a guru—having approached [her], he should perform the cāndrāyaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
mātulānīṃ svasārañca sagotrāmanyamicchatīṃ /
śiṣyabhāryāṃ gurorbhāryāṃ gatvā cāndrāyaṇañcaret //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe prāyaścittāni nāma trisaptatyadhikaśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 haviṣyabhugiti ga.. ,ṭa.. ca
2 mātṛjāyāgame iti ga.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 189
:ś atha catuḥsaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
prāyaścittāni
meaning:
मातुलानीं स्वसारञ्च सगोत्रामन्यमिच्छतीं /
शिष्यभार्यां गुरोर्भार्यां गत्वा चान्द्रायणञ्चरेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे प्रायश्चित्तानि नाम त्रिसप्तत्यधिकशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 हविष्यभुगिति ग.. ,ट.. च
2 मातृजायागमे इति ग.. , छ.. , ट.. च
:प् 189
:श् अथ चतुःसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
प्रायश्चित्तानि
text_mt:
Thus ends the one hundred seventy-third chapter, entitled 'Expiations', in the Mahāpurāṇa of Agni.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and seventy-third chapter, entitled 'Expiations'.
1 'Eating sacrificial food' in ga.. and ṭa..
2 'In approaching a mother's co-wife' in ga.., cha.., and ṭa..
[Page 189]
% Chapter
Expiations
Agni said: / The expiation for the omission of worship of the deity, the hermitage, and so forth [is now stated]: / when worship is omitted, one should recite [the mantra] one hundred and eight times, and perform twofold worship.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
devāśramārcanādīnāṃ prāyaścittantu lopataḥ /
pūjālope cāṣṭaśataṃ japeddviguṇapūjanaṃ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
देवाश्रमार्चनादीनां प्रायश्चित्तन्तु लोपतः /
पूजालोपे चाष्टशतं जपेद्द्विगुणपूजनं //
text_mt: Having offered fire oblations with the mantras of the five Upaniṣads, [there should be] feeding of Brahmins. / When the deity is touched by a woman in childbed, an outcaste, or a menstruating woman, one should recite [the mantra] a hundred times.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcopaniṣadair mantrair hutvā brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ /
sūtikāntyajakodakyāspṛṣṭe deve śataṃ japet(1) //
meaning:
पञ्चोपनिषदैर् मन्त्रैर् हुत्वा ब्राह्मणभोजनं /
सूतिकान्त्यजकोदक्यास्पृष्टे देवे शतं जपेत्(1) //
text_mt: Worship [should be performed] with the five Upaniṣads, and the bath twofold; / Brahmins are to be fed. When the fire oblation is omitted, [one should perform] the fire oblation, bath, and likewise worship.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcopaniṣadaiḥ pūjāṃ dviguṇaṃ snānameva ca /
viprabhojyaṃ homalope homasnānaṃ tathārcanaṃ //
meaning:
पञ्चोपनिषदैः पूजां द्विगुणं स्नानमेव च /
विप्रभोज्यं होमलोपे होमस्नानं तथार्चनं //
text_mt: When the sacrificial offering is eaten by mice and the like, or infested with insects, / abandoning that portion alone and sprinkling [with water], one should worship the deity and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
homadravye mūṣikādyair bhakṣite kīṭasaṃyute /
tāvanmātraṃ parityajya prokṣya devādi pūjayet //
meaning:
होमद्रव्ये मूषिकाद्यैर् भक्षिते कीटसंयुते /
तावन्मात्रं परित्यज्य प्रोक्ष्य देवादि पूजयेत् //
text_mt: Only the offering of sprouts that is cut or broken should be discarded; / when it has been touched by untouchables, its offering is to be in another vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
aṅkurārpaṇamātrantu chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ parityajet /
aspṛśyaiś caiva saṃspṛṣṭe anyapātre tadarpaṇaṃ //
meaning:
अङ्कुरार्पणमात्रन्तु छिन्नं भिन्नं परित्यजेत् /
अस्पृश्यैश् चैव संस्पृष्टे अन्यपात्रे तदर्पणं //
text_mt: [This] destroys divine and human obstacles at the time of worship likewise. / In the case of an inversion of mantras, ritual substances, and the like, having recited the root mantra, one should recite again.

sanskrit_iast:
devamānuṣavighnaghnaṃ pūjākāle tathaiva ca /
mantradravyādivyatyāse mūlaṃ japtvā punarjapet //
meaning:
देवमानुषविघ्नघ्नं पूजाकाले तथैव च /
मन्त्रद्रव्यादिव्यत्यासे मूलं जप्त्वा पुनर्जपेत् //
text_mt: There is recitation of a hundred and eight [mantras] with a pot when the deity has fallen from the hand; / when it is broken or lost, there is fasting, and through a hundred fire oblations good fortune shall come to be.

sanskrit_iast:
kumbhenāṣṭaśatajapo deve tu patite karāt /
bhinne naṣṭe copavāsaḥ śatahomācchubhaṃ bhavet(2) //
:n
1 śataṃ śahunediti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 śatahomācchucirbhavediti kha.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
:p 190
meaning:
कुम्भेनाष्टशतजपो देवे तु पतिते करात् /
भिन्ने नष्टे चोपवासः शतहोमाच्छुभं भवेत्(2) //
:न्
1 शतं शहुनेदिति ख.. , छ.. च
2 शतहोमाच्छुचिर्भवेदिति ख.. , घ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 190
text_mt:
If a deity drops from one's hand, one should recite one hundred and eight [mantras] with a jar; / if it is broken or lost, there should be a fast, and good fortune arises from a hundred fire oblations.
1 'He should recite a hundred times' in kha.. and cha..
2 'Through a hundred fire oblations one becomes pure' in kha.., gha.., and ña..
[Page 190]
When remorse arises in a man after a sin has been committed, / the single, supreme expiation for him is the remembrance of Hari.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛte pāpe 'nutāpo vai yasya puṃsaḥ prajāyate /
prāyaścittantu tasyaikaṃ harisaṃsmaraṇaṃ paraṃ //
meaning:

Definition of Votive Observance
Agni said: / At the conjunction of a lunar day, weekday, lunar mansion, day, month, season, year, or sun, / I shall proclaim the votive observances and so forth for men and women in their order; listen, O Vasiṣṭha.

text_mt:
Agni said: / According to the lunar day, weekday, asterism, solar day, month, season, year, and solar transit, / I shall proclaim the votive observances and the like for men and women, O Vasiṣṭha; listen to them in order.
1 'The Smṛtis, the Śrutis, and votive observance' in ka.., gha.., ṅa.., and ña.. / The text beginning with 'I am Brahman' and ending with 'ascetic austerity and votive observance' is not found in the ga.. manuscript
2 'The votive observances and so forth for men and women' in ṅa.. and ña..
[Page 192]
A restriction prescribed by scripture is indeed a votive observance, and that is considered ascetic austerity; / the restrictions are the specific [practices] of the votive observance itself, such as self-restraint.

sanskrit_iast:
śāstrodito hi niyamo vrataṃ tacca tapo mataṃ /
niyamāstu viśeṣāstu vratasyaiva damādayaḥ //

शास्त्रोदितो हि नियमो व्रतं तच्च तपो मतं /
नियमास्तु विशेषास्तु व्रतस्यैव दमादयः //
text_mt: A votive observance is called ascetic austerity on account of the torment of the performer; / and it is called a restriction on account of the restraint of the aggregate of the senses.

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ hi kartṛsantāpāttapa ity abhidhīyate /
indriyagrāmaniyamānniyamaścābhidhīyate //
meaning:
व्रतं हि कर्तृसन्तापात्तप इत्य् अभिधीयते /
इन्द्रियग्रामनियमान्नियमश्चाभिधीयते //
text_mt: A votive observance is called ascetic austerity because it burns away [sins] from the performer; / and it is called a restraint because of the restraint of the collection of senses.

व्रतोपवासनियमैर् नानादानैस् तथा द्विजः //

sanskrit_iast:
śyāmākāś caiva nīvārā godhūmādyā vrate hitāḥ /
kuṣmāṇḍālāvuvārtākūn pālaṅkīmpūtikāntyajet //
meaning:
श्यामाकाश् चैव नीवारा गोधूमाद्या व्रते हिताः /
कुष्माण्डालावुवार्ताकून् पालङ्कीम्पूतिकान्त्यजेत् //
text_mt: śyāmāka grain, wild rice, wheat, and the like are beneficial during a votive observance. / One should avoid pumpkin, bottle gourd, eggplant, spinach, and pūtikā.

sanskrit_iast:
carubhaikṣyaṃ śaktukaṇāḥ śākandadhi ghṛtaṃ payaḥ /
śyāmākaśālinīvārā yavakaṃ mūlataṇḍulaṃ //
meaning:
चरुभैक्ष्यं शक्तुकणाः शाकन्दधि घृतं पयः /
श्यामाकशालिनीवारा यवकं मूलतण्डुलं //
text_mt: Sacrificial porridge, alms-food, groats, broken grain, vegetables, curds, clarified butter, milk, / śyāmāka, winter rice, wild rice, barley porridge, and root-rice:

sanskrit_iast:
haviṣyaṃ vratanaktādāvagnikāryādike hitaṃ /
madhu māṃsaṃ vihāyānyad vrate vā hitamīritaṃ //
meaning:
हविष्यं व्रतनक्तादावग्निकार्यादिके हितं /
मधु मांसं विहायान्यद् व्रते वा हितमीरितं //
text_mt: this sacrificial food is beneficial in votive night-meals and the like, fire rites, and so forth; / anything other than honey and meat is stated to be beneficial in a votive observance.

sanskrit_iast:
tryahaṃ prātastryahaṃ sāyaṃ tryahamadyādayācitaṃ /
tryahamparañca nāśnīyāt prājāpatyañcaran dvijaḥ //
meaning:
त्र्यहं प्रातस्त्र्यहं सायं त्र्यहमद्यादयाचितं /
त्र्यहम्परञ्च नाश्नीयात् प्राजापत्यञ्चरन् द्विजः //
text_mt: For three days in the morning, for three days in the evening, for three days eating unasked-for food, / and for another three days one should not eat: [thus] a twice-born performs the prājāpatya.

sanskrit_iast:
ekaikaṃ grāsamaśnīyāt tryahāṇi trīṇi pūrvavat /
tryahañcopavasedantyamatikṛcchraṃ caran dvijaḥ //
meaning:
एकैकं ग्रासमश्नीयात् त्र्यहाणि त्रीणि पूर्ववत् /
त्र्यहञ्चोपवसेदन्त्यमतिकृच्छ्रं चरन् द्विजः //
text_mt: He should eat a single mouthful [each day] for three periods of three days as before, / and should fast for the final three days: [thus] a twice-born performs the atikṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakaṃ /
ekarātropavāsaś ca kṛcchraṃ śāntapanaṃ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकं /
एकरात्रोपवासश् च कृच्छ्रं शान्तपनं स्मृतं //
text_mt: Cow urine, cow dung, milk, curds, clarified butter, kuśa water, / and fasting for one night: this is remembered as the śāntapana kṛcchra.

sanskrit_iast:
pṛthak śāntapanadravyaiḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sopavāsakaḥ /
saptāhena tu kṛcchro 'yaṃ mahāśāntapano 'ghahā //
meaning:
पृथक् शान्तपनद्रव्यैः षडहः सोपवासकः /
सप्ताहेन तु कृच्छ्रो ऽयं महाशान्तपनो ऽघहा //
text_mt: When each of the ingredients of the śāntapana is taken on separate days for six days, followed by a fast [on the seventh], / this seven-day kṛcchra is the mahāśāntapana, destroying sins.

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśāhopavāsena parākaḥ sarvapāpahā /
:n
1 yatāhāra iti gha..
2 śamīdhānyaṃ tathaiva ceti ga.. ,jha.. ca
:p 194
mahāparākastriguṇastvayameva prakīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
द्वादशाहोपवासेन पराकः सर्वपापहा /
:न्
1 यताहार इति घ..
2 शमीधान्यं तथैव चेति ग.. ,झ.. च
:प् 194
महापराकस्त्रिगुणस्त्वयमेव प्रकीर्तितः //
text_mt:
The parāka, which destroys all sins, consists of a fast of twelve days.
[Footnote]
1. 'yatāhāraḥ' in manuscript gha.
2. 'śamīdhānyaṃ tathaiva ca' in manuscripts ga and jha.
The mahāparāka is proclaimed to be simply this [period] multiplied by three.

sanskrit_iast:
paurṇamāsyāṃ pañcadaśagrāsyamāvāsyabhojanaḥ /
ekāpāye tato vṛddhau cāndrāyaṇamato 'nyathā //
meaning:
पौर्णमास्यां पञ्चदशग्रास्यमावास्यभोजनः /
एकापाये ततो वृद्धौ चान्द्रायणमतो ऽन्यथा //
text_mt: One eats fifteen mouthfuls on the full moon day, and [nothing] on the new moon day, / decreasing by one [mouthful per day] and then increasing: this is the cāndrāyaṇa; otherwise [it is inverted].

sanskrit_iast:
kapilāgoḥ palaṃ mūtraṃ ardhāṅguṣṭhañca gomayaṃ /
kṣīraṃ saptapalandadyāt dadhnaś caiva paladvayaṃ(1) //
meaning:
कपिलागोः पलं मूत्रं अर्धाङ्गुष्ठञ्च गोमयं /
क्षीरं सप्तपलन्दद्यात् दध्नश् चैव पलद्वयं(1) //
text_mt: One should offer one pala of urine of a tawny cow, cow dung the size of half a thumb, / seven palas of milk, and two palas of curds,

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtamekapalandadyāt palamekaṃ kuśodakaṃ /
gayatryā gṛhya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayaṃ //
meaning:
घृतमेकपलन्दद्यात् पलमेकं कुशोदकं /
गयत्र्या गृह्य गोमूत्रं गन्धद्वारेति गोमयं //
text_mt: one pala of clarified butter, and one pala of kuśa water: / taking the cow urine with the Gāyatrī, the cow dung with 'gandhadvārā...',

sanskrit_iast:
āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi /
tejo 'sīti tathā cājyaṃ devasyeti kuśodakaṃ(2) //
meaning:
आप्यायस्वेति च क्षीरं दधिक्राव्णेति वै दधि /
तेजो ऽसीति तथा चाज्यं देवस्येति कुशोदकं(2) //
text_mt: the milk with 'āpyāyasva...', the curds with 'dadhikrāvṇo...', / the clarified butter with 'tejo 'si...', and the kuśa water with 'devasya...'.

sanskrit_iast:
brahmakūrco bhavatyevaṃ āpo hiṣṭhetyṛcaṃ japet /
aghamarṣaṇasūktena saṃyojya praṇavena vā //
meaning:
ब्रह्मकूर्चो भवत्येवं आपो हिष्ठेत्यृचं जपेत् /
अघमर्षणसूक्तेन संयोज्य प्रणवेन वा //
text_mt: Such is the brahmakūrca. One should recite the verse 'āpo hi ṣṭhā...', / combining it with the aghamarṣaṇa hymn or with the praṇava.

sanskrit_iast:
pītvā sarvāghanirmukto viṣṇulokī hy upoṣitaḥ /
upavāsī sāyambhojī yatiḥ ṣaṣṭhātmakālavān //
meaning:
पीत्वा सर्वाघनिर्मुक्तो विष्णुलोकी ह्य् उपोषितः /
उपवासी सायम्भोजी यतिः षष्ठात्मकालवान् //
text_mt: Having drunk it, freed from all sin, having fasted, one attains the realm of Viṣṇu. / One who fasts, one who eats in the evening, an ascetic, one who eats only at every sixth mealtime,

sanskrit_iast:
māṃsavarjī cāśvamedhī satyavādī divaṃ vrajet /
agnyādheyaṃ pratiṣṭhāñca yajñadānavratāni ca //
meaning:
मांसवर्जी चाश्वमेधी सत्यवादी दिवं व्रजेत् /
अग्न्याधेयं प्रतिष्ठाञ्च यज्ञदानव्रतानि च //
text_mt: one who abstains from meat, one who performs the horse sacrifice, and one who speaks the truth goes to heaven. / The installation of sacred fires, consecration, sacrifices, gifts, and votive observances,

sanskrit_iast:
devavratavṛṣotsargacūḍākaraṇamekhalāḥ /
māṅgalyamabhiṣekañca malamāse vivarjayet //
meaning:
देवव्रतवृषोत्सर्गचूडाकरणमेखलाः /
माङ्गल्यमभिषेकञ्च मलमासे विवर्जयेत् //
text_mt: votive observances for deities, release of a bull, tonsure ceremony, investiture with the sacred girdle, / auspicious ceremonies, and consecration by aspersion should be avoided in an intercalary month.

sanskrit_iast:
darśāddarśastu cāndraḥ syāt triṃśāhaś caiva bhāvanaḥ /
māsaḥ saurastu saṅkrānternākṣatro bhavivartanāt //
meaning:
दर्शाद्दर्शस्तु चान्द्रः स्यात् त्रिंशाहश् चैव भावनः /
मासः सौरस्तु सङ्क्रान्तेर्नाक्षत्रो भविवर्तनात् //
text_mt: The lunar month is from new moon to new moon; the civil month is thirty days; / the solar month is from solar transit [to transit]; the sidereal month is from the moon's revolution through the asterisms.

sanskrit_iast:
sauro māso vivāhādau yajñādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ(3) /
:n
1 dadhnaś caiva palatrayamiti gha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
2 gāyatryā ity ādiḥ, kuśodakamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha.. pustake
nāsti
3 sāvano mata iti cha..
:p 195
āvdhike pitṛkārye ca cāndro māsaḥ praśasyate //
meaning:
सौरो मासो विवाहादौ यज्ञादौ सावनः स्मृतः(3) /
:न्
1 दध्नश् चैव पलत्रयमिति घ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
2 गायत्र्या इत्य् आदिः, कुशोदकमित्यन्तः पाठः छ.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
3 सावनो मत इति छ..
:प् 195
आव्धिके पितृकार्ये च चान्द्रो मासः प्रशस्यते //
text_mt:
The solar month is prescribed for marriage and the like; the civil month for sacrifices and the like;
[Footnote]
1. 'dadhnaś caiva palatrayam' in manuscripts gha, ña, and ṭa.
2. The text from 'gāyatryā' up to 'kuśodakam' is absent in manuscript cha.
3. 'sāvano mataḥ' in manuscript cha.
and the lunar month is commended for annual ancestral rites.

sanskrit_iast:
āṣāḍhīmavadhiṃ kṛtvā yaḥ syātpakṣastu pañcamaḥ /
kuryācchrāddhantatra raviḥ kanyāṃ gacchatu vā na vā //
meaning:
आषाढीमवधिं कृत्वा यः स्यात्पक्षस्तु पञ्चमः /
कुर्याच्छ्राद्धन्तत्र रविः कन्यां गच्छतु वा न वा //
text_mt: Taking the full moon of Āṣāḍha as the limit, in whichever fortnight is the fifth, / one should perform ancestral rites there, whether the sun enters Virgo or not.

sanskrit_iast:
māsi saṃvatsare caiva tithidvaidhaṃ yadā bhavet /
tatrottarottamā jñeyā pūrvā tu syān malimlucā //
meaning:
मासि संवत्सरे चैव तिथिद्वैधं यदा भवेत् /
तत्रोत्तरोत्तमा ज्ञेया पूर्वा तु स्यान् मलिम्लुचा //
text_mt: In a month and in a year, whenever there is a conflict of lunar days, / the subsequent one is to be known as the best, while the earlier one is considered tainted.

sanskrit_iast:
upoṣitavyaṃ nakṣatraṃ yenāstaṃ yāti bhāskaraḥ /
divā puṇyāstu tithayo rātrau naktavrate śubhāḥ //
meaning:
उपोषितव्यं नक्षत्रं येनास्तं याति भास्करः /
दिवा पुण्यास्तु तिथयो रात्रौ नक्तव्रते शुभाः //
text_mt: The asterism during which the sun sets should be kept for fasting; / lunar days are auspicious by day, and in night-fasting observances they are auspicious at night.

sanskrit_iast:
yugmāgnikṛtabhūtāni(1) ṣaṇmunyorvasurandhrayoḥ /
rudreṇa dvādaśo yuktā caturdaśyātha(2) pūrṇimā //
meaning:
युग्माग्निकृतभूतानि(1) षण्मुन्योर्वसुरन्ध्रयोः /
रुद्रेण द्वादशो युक्ता चतुर्दश्याथ(2) पूर्णिमा //
text_mt: [The combinations of] two and three, four and five, six and seven, eight and nine, / twelve joined with eleven, and the full moon with the fourteenth,

sanskrit_iast:
pratipadā tvamāvāsyā tithyoryugmaṃ mahāphalaṃ /
etadvyastaṃ mahāghoraṃ hanti puṇyaṃ purākṛtaṃ //
meaning:
प्रतिपदा त्वमावास्या तिथ्योर्युग्मं महाफलं /
एतद्व्यस्तं महाघोरं हन्ति पुण्यं पुराकृतं //
text_mt: and the new moon with the first lunar day—such a pair of lunar days yields great fruit. / The reverse of this is exceedingly terrible and destroys merit earned in the past.

sanskrit_iast:
narendramantrivratināṃ(3) vivāhopadravādiṣu /
sadyaḥ śaucaṃ samākhyātaṃ kāntārāpadi saṃṣadi //
meaning:
नरेन्द्रमन्त्रिव्रतिनां(3) विवाहोपद्रवादिषु /
सद्यः शौचं समाख्यातं कान्तारापदि संषदि //
text_mt: For kings, ministers, and those engaged in a votive observance, in marriage, calamity, and similar crises, / in the perils of the forest, or in an assembly, immediate ritual purity is proclaimed.

sanskrit_iast:
ārabdhadīrghatapasāṃ na rājā vratahā striyāḥ /
garbhiṇī sūtikā naktaṃ kumārī ca rajasvalā //
meaning:
आरब्धदीर्घतपसां न राजा व्रतहा स्त्रियाः /
गर्भिणी सूतिका नक्तं कुमारी च रजस्वला //
text_mt: For those who have commenced long ascetic austerities, the king cannot terminate the votive observance. For women— / a pregnant woman, a woman in childbed, one observing a night fast, an unmarried girl, or a menstruating woman—

sanskrit_iast:
yadāśuddhā tadānyena kārayeta kriyāḥ sadā /
krodhāt pramādāllobhādvā vratabhaṅgo bhavedyadi //
meaning:
यदाशुद्धा तदान्येन कारयेत क्रियाः सदा /
क्रोधात् प्रमादाल्लोभाद्वा व्रतभङ्गो भवेद्यदि //
text_mt: whenever she is impure, she should always have the rites performed by another. / If a breach of the votive observance should occur through anger, negligence, or greed,

sanskrit_iast:
dinatrayaṃ na bhuññīta muṇḍanaṃ śiraso 'tha vā /
asāmarthye vratakṛtau patnīṃ vā kārayet sutaṃ //
meaning:
दिनत्रयं न भुञ्ञीत मुण्डनं शिरसो ऽथ वा /
असामर्थ्ये व्रतकृतौ पत्नीं वा कारयेत् सुतं //
text_mt: one should fast for three days, or else shave the head. / In case of incapacity to perform the votive observance, one may have one's wife or son perform it.

sanskrit_iast:
sūtake mṛtake kārtyaṃ prārabdhaṃ pūjanojjhitaṃ /
vratasthaṃ mūrchitaṃ dugdhapānādyair uddhared guruḥ //
:n
1 yugmāgniyugabhūtānīti ja.. , jha.. ca
2 caturdaśyā ceti ga..
3 narendrasatrivratināmiti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
:p 196
meaning:
सूतके मृतके कार्त्यं प्रारब्धं पूजनोज्झितं /
व्रतस्थं मूर्छितं दुग्धपानाद्यैर् उद्धरेद् गुरुः //
:न्
1 युग्माग्नियुगभूतानीति ज.. , झ.. च
2 चतुर्दश्या चेति ग..
3 नरेन्द्रसत्रिव्रतिनामिति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
:प् 196
text_mt:
During birth impurity or death impurity, an observance that has been begun should be carried out without worship. / If an observer of a vow faints, the guru should revive him by giving him milk to drink or the like.
[Footnote]
1. "yugmāgniyugabhūtāni" in ja and jha.
2. "caturdaśyā ca" in ga.
3. "narendrasatrivratinām" in kha, gha, ja, and ña. / Page 196.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣtau tānyavrataghnāni āpo mūlaṃ phalaṃ payaḥ /
havirbrāhmaṇakāmyā ca gurorvacanamauṣadhaṃ //
meaning:
अष्तौ तान्यव्रतघ्नानि आपो मूलं फलं पयः /
हविर्ब्राह्मणकाम्या च गुरोर्वचनमौषधं //
text_mt: These eight do not break a votive observance: water, roots, fruits, milk, / sacrificial butter, what is desired by a brāhmaṇa, the guru's word, and medicine.

sanskrit_iast:
kīrtisantatividyādisaubhāgyārogyavṛddhaye /
nairmalyabhuktimuktyarthaṃ kurve vratapate vrataṃ //
meaning:
कीर्तिसन्ततिविद्यादिसौभाग्यारोग्यवृद्धये /
नैर्मल्यभुक्तिमुक्त्यर्थं कुर्वे व्रतपते व्रतं //
text_mt: "For the increase of fame, lineage, learning and the like, good fortune, and health, / and for purity, worldly enjoyment, and liberation, I undertake this votive observance, O Lord of vows!

sanskrit_iast:
idaṃ vrataṃ mayā śreṣṭhaṃ gṛhītaṃ puratastava /
nirvighnāṃ siddhimāyātu tvatprasādāt jagatpate //
meaning:
इदं व्रतं मया श्रेष्ठं गृहीतं पुरतस्तव /
निर्विघ्नां सिद्धिमायातु त्वत्प्रसादात् जगत्पते //
text_mt: This excellent votive observance has been undertaken by me in your presence; / may it attain obstacle-free fulfillment by your grace, O Lord of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhīte 'smin vratavare(1) yadyapūrṇe mriye hy ahaṃ /
tatsarvaṃ pūrṇamevāstu prasanne tvayi satpatau //
meaning:
गृहीते ऽस्मिन् व्रतवरे(1) यद्यपूर्णे म्रिये ह्य् अहं /
तत्सर्वं पूर्णमेवास्तु प्रसन्ने त्वयि सत्पतौ //
text_mt: If, this excellent votive observance having been undertaken, I should die before it is completed, / let all of it be entirely complete when you, O true Lord, are pleased!"

sanskrit_iast:
vratamūrtiṃ jagadbhūtiṃ maṇḍale sarvasiddhaye /
āvahaye namastubhyaṃ sannidhībhava keśava //
meaning:
व्रतमूर्तिं जगद्भूतिं मण्डले सर्वसिद्धये /
आवहये नमस्तुभ्यं सन्निधीभव केशव //
text_mt: "The icon of the votive observance, the prosperity of the world, I invoke in the maṇḍala for the attainment of all success. / Reverence to you! Be present here, O Keśava!

sanskrit_iast:
manasā kalpitair bhaktyā pañcagavyair jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ /
pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpayāmi tvaṃ me ca bhava pāpahā //
meaning:
मनसा कल्पितैर् भक्त्या पञ्चगव्यैर् जलैः शुभैः /
पञ्चामृतैः स्नापयामि त्वं मे च भव पापहा //
text_mt: With pure waters, with the five products of the cow, and with the five nectars conceived mentally with devotion / I bathe you; and do you become the destroyer of my sins!

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpodakair yuktamarghyamarghyapate śubhaṃ /
gṛhāṇa pādyamācāmamarghyārhaṅkuru māṃ sadā //
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पोदकैर् युक्तमर्घ्यमर्घ्यपते शुभं /
गृहाण पाद्यमाचाममर्घ्यार्हङ्कुरु मां सदा //
text_mt: O Lord of the water offering, accept the auspicious water offering endowed with perfume, flowers, and water, / as well as foot-washing water and sipping water; always make me worthy of the water offering!

sanskrit_iast:
vastraṃ vastrapate puṇyaṃ gṛhāṇa kuru māṃ sadā /
bhūṣaṇādyaiḥ suvastrādyaiśchāditaṃ vratasatpate //
meaning:
वस्त्रं वस्त्रपते पुण्यं गृहाण कुरु मां सदा /
भूषणाद्यैः सुवस्त्राद्यैश्छादितं व्रतसत्पते //
text_mt: O Lord of garments, accept this holy garment! Always keep me, / covered with fine garments, ornaments, and the like, O true Lord of the votive observance!

sanskrit_iast:
sugandhigandhaṃ vimalaṃ gandhamūrte gṛhāṇa vai /
pāpagandhavihīnaṃ māṃ kuru tvaṃ hi sugandhikaṃ //
meaning:
सुगन्धिगन्धं विमलं गन्धमूर्ते गृहाण वै /
पापगन्धविहीनं मां कुरु त्वं हि सुगन्धिकं //
text_mt: O icon of fragrance, accept this pure, fragrant scent; / make me fragrant indeed, freed from the foul odor of sin!

sanskrit_iast:
puṣpaṃ gṛhāṇa puṣpādipūrṇa māṃ kuru sarvadā /
puṣpagandhaṃ suvimalaṃ āyurārogyavṛddhaye //
meaning:
पुष्पं गृहाण पुष्पादिपूर्ण मां कुरु सर्वदा /
पुष्पगन्धं सुविमलं आयुरारोग्यवृद्धये //
text_mt: Accept this flower, and ever make me filled with flowers and [blessings]! / [Accept] this immaculate floral fragrance for the increase of life and health!

sanskrit_iast:
daśāṅgaṃ guggulughṛtayuktaṃ dhūpaṃ gṛhāṇa vai /
sadhūpa dhūpita māṃ tvaṃ kuru dhūpitasatpate //
:n
1 vrate deva iti ga.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 197
meaning:
दशाङ्गं गुग्गुलुघृतयुक्तं धूपं गृहाण वै /
सधूप धूपित मां त्वं कुरु धूपितसत्पते //
:न्
1 व्रते देव इति ग.. , घ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
:प् 197
text_mt:
Accept this incense of ten ingredients, accompanied by bdellium and clarified butter! / O true Lord perfumed with incense, make me fragrant with incense!"
[Footnote]
1. "vrate deva" in ga, gha, ja, jha, ña, and ṭa. / Page 197.

sanskrit_iast:
dīpamūrdhaśikhaṃ dīptaṃ gṛhāṇākhilabhāsakaṃ /
dīpamūrte prakāśāḍhyaṃ sarvadordhvagatiṃ kuru //
meaning:
दीपमूर्धशिखं दीप्तं गृहाणाखिलभासकं /
दीपमूर्ते प्रकाशाढ्यं सर्वदोर्ध्वगतिं कुरु //
text_mt: "Accept this radiant lamp whose flame rises upward, the illuminator of all! / O icon of light, rich in radiance, grant me an ever-upward path!

sanskrit_iast:
annādikañca naivedyaṃ gṛhāṇānnādi satpate /
annādipūrṇaṃ kuru māmannadaṃ sarvadāyakaṃ //
meaning:
अन्नादिकञ्च नैवेद्यं गृहाणान्नादि सत्पते /
अन्नादिपूर्णं कुरु मामन्नदं सर्वदायकं //
text_mt: O true Lord of food and all else, accept the food offering consisting of cooked grain and other items; / make me full of food and goods, a giver of food, a bestower of all!

sanskrit_iast:
mantrahīnaṃ kriyāhīnaṃ bhaktihīnaṃ mayā prabho /
yat pūjitaṃ vratapate paripūrṇantadasu me //
meaning:
मन्त्रहीनं क्रियाहीनं भक्तिहीनं मया प्रभो /
यत् पूजितं व्रतपते परिपूर्णन्तदसु मे //
text_mt: Whatever has been worshipped by me, O Lord, deficient in mantra, deficient in ritual, / or deficient in devotion, O Lord of vows, may that be completely fulfilled for me!

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaṃ dehi dhanaṃ dehi saubhāgyaṃ guṇasantatiṃ /
kīrtiṃ vidyāṃ(1) dehi cāyuḥ svargaṃ mokṣañca dehi me ///
meaning:
धर्मं देहि धनं देहि सौभाग्यं गुणसन्ततिं /
कीर्तिं विद्यां(1) देहि चायुः स्वर्गं मोक्षञ्च देहि मे ///
text_mt: Grant me righteousness, grant me wealth, good fortune, an abundance of virtues, / fame, learning, long life, heaven, and liberation!"

sanskrit_iast:
imāṃ pūjāṃ vratapate gṛhītvā vraja sāmprataṃ /
punarāgamanāyaiva varadānāya vai prabho //
meaning:
इमां पूजां व्रतपते गृहीत्वा व्रज साम्प्रतं /
पुनरागमनायैव वरदानाय वै प्रभो //
text_mt: "Having accepted this worship, O Lord of vows, depart now, / only to return again, O Lord, to bestow boons!"

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā vratavatā sarvavrateṣu vratamūrtayaḥ /
pūjyāḥ suvarṇajāstā vai śaktyā vai bhūmiśāyinā //
meaning:
स्नात्वा व्रतवता सर्वव्रतेषु व्रतमूर्तयः /
पूज्याः सुवर्णजास्ता वै शक्त्या वै भूमिशायिना //
text_mt: Having bathed, the observer of vows must worship icons of the votive observance in all votive observances— / those made of gold according to one's capacity—while sleeping on the ground.

sanskrit_iast:
japo homaś ca sāmānyavratānte dānameva ca /
caturviṃśā dvādaśa vā pañca vā traya ekakaḥ //
meaning:
जपो होमश् च सामान्यव्रतान्ते दानमेव च /
चतुर्विंशा द्वादश वा पञ्च वा त्रय एककः //
text_mt: Recitation and fire oblation are common [to all], and gift-giving at the end of a votive observance. / Twenty-four, twelve, five, three, or one

sanskrit_iast:
viprāḥ prapūjyā guravo(2) bhojyāḥ śaktyā tu dakṣiṇā /
deyā gāvaḥ suvarṇādyāḥ pādukopānahau pṛthak //
meaning:
विप्राः प्रपूज्या गुरवो(2) भोज्याः शक्त्या तु दक्षिणा /
देया गावः सुवर्णाद्याः पादुकोपानहौ पृथक् //
text_mt: learned brāhmaṇas are to be worshipped, gurus are to be fed, and a sacrificial fee is to be given according to capacity: / cows, gold, and other gifts, as well as wooden sandals and leather shoes separately,

sanskrit_iast:
jalapātrañcānnapātramṛttikācchatramāsanaṃ(3) /
śayyā vastrayugaṃ kumbhāḥ paribhāṣeyamīritā //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe vrataparibhāṣānāma
pañcasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 kīrtiṃ vṛddhimiti kha.. , cha.. ca
2 viprāḥ pūjyāḥ sagarava iti gha.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca
3 mudrikāchatramāsanamiti gha..
:p 198
:ś atha ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
pratipadvratāni
meaning:
जलपात्रञ्चान्नपात्रमृत्तिकाच्छत्रमासनं(3) /
शय्या वस्त्रयुगं कुम्भाः परिभाषेयमीरिता //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे व्रतपरिभाषानाम
पञ्चसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 कीर्तिं वृद्धिमिति ख.. , छ.. च
2 विप्राः पूज्याः सगरव इति घ.. , ज.. , ट.. च
3 मुद्रिकाछत्रमासनमिति घ..
:प् 198
:श् अथ षट्सप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
प्रतिपद्व्रतानि
text_mt:
a water vessel, a food dish, an earthen pot, an umbrella, a seat, / a bed, a pair of cloths, and water jars—this general rule has been declared.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-fifth chapter, named "General Rules for Votive Observances," in the great Agni Purāṇa.
[Footnote]
1. "kīrtiṃ vṛddhim" in kha and cha. / 2. "viprāḥ pūjyāḥ sagarava" in gha, ja, and ṭa.
[…] [text missing or variant] / [Page 198]
Now, the one hundred and seventy-sixth chapter.
Votive observances of the first lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
vakṣye pratipadādīni vratānyakhiladāni te /
kārttikāśvayuje caitre pratipadbrahmaṇastithiḥ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
वक्ष्ये प्रतिपदादीनि व्रतान्यखिलदानि ते /
कार्त्तिकाश्वयुजे चैत्रे प्रतिपद्ब्रह्मणस्तिथिः //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall declare to you the votive observances of the first lunar day and others, which grant all desires. / In Kārttika, Āśvayuja, and Caitra, the first lunar day is the lunar day of Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadaśyānnirāhāraḥ pratipadyarcayedajaṃ /
oṃ tat sadbrahmaṇe namo gāyatryā vāvdamekakaṃ //
meaning:
पञ्चदश्यान्निराहारः प्रतिपद्यर्चयेदजं /
ओं तत् सद्ब्रह्मणे नमो गायत्र्या वाव्दमेककं //
text_mt: Fasting on the fifteenth day, one should worship the Unborn on the first lunar day / with "Om, tat sat, reverence to Brahmā," or with the Gāyatrī, for one year.

sanskrit_iast:
akṣamālāśruvandakṣe(1) vāme śrucakamaṇḍalu(2) /
lambakūrcañca jaṭilaṃ haimaṃ brahmāṇamarcayet //
meaning:
अक्षमालाश्रुवन्दक्षे(1) वामे श्रुचकमण्डलु(2) /
लम्बकूर्चञ्च जटिलं हैमं ब्रह्माणमर्चयेत् //
text_mt: With a rosary and a small offering ladle in his right hands, and a large offering ladle and a water pot in his left, / with a long beard and matted hair—one should worship golden Brahmā.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktyā kṣīraṃ pradadyāttu brahmā me prīyatāmiti /
nirmalo bhogabhk svarge bhūmau vipro dhanī bhavet //
meaning:
शक्त्या क्षीरं प्रदद्यात्तु ब्रह्मा मे प्रीयतामिति /
निर्मलो भोगभ्क् स्वर्गे भूमौ विप्रो धनी भवेत् //
text_mt: According to one's capacity one should offer milk, praying, "May Brahmā be pleased with me!" / Free from stain, he enjoys pleasures in heaven, and on earth he becomes a wealthy brāhmaṇa.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanyaṃ vrataṃ pravakṣyāmi adhanyo dhanyatāṃ vrajet /
mārgaśīrṣe pratipadi naktaṃ hutvā pyupoṣitaḥ(3) //
meaning:
धन्यं व्रतं प्रवक्ष्यामि अधन्यो धन्यतां व्रजेत् /
मार्गशीर्षे प्रतिपदि नक्तं हुत्वा प्युपोषितः(3) //
text_mt: I shall proclaim the Dhanya-vrata; by it the unfortunate becomes fortunate. / On the first lunar day of Mārgaśīrṣa, fasting and having offered oblations at night,

sanskrit_iast:
agnaye nama ity agniṃ prārcyāvdaṃ sarvabhāg bhavet /
pratipadyekabhaktāśī samāpte kapilāpradaḥ //
meaning:
अग्नये नम इत्य् अग्निं प्रार्च्याव्दं सर्वभाग् भवेत् /
प्रतिपद्येकभक्ताशी समाप्ते कपिलाप्रदः //
text_mt: having worshipped Agni for a year with "Reverence to Agni," one becomes an enjoyer of all things. / Eating only once a day on the first lunar day, upon its completion he gives a brown cow.

sanskrit_iast:
vaiśvānarapadaṃ yāti śikhivratamidaṃ smṛtaṃ /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe pratipadvratāni nāma
ṣaṭsaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 akṣamālāśrucaṃ dakṣe iti cha..
2 vāme daṇḍakamaṇḍalu iti cha.. , jha.. / vāme śruvakamaṇḍalu iti
cha..
3 naktaṃ kṛccābhyupoṣita iti ga..
:p 199
:ś atha saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dvitīyāvratāni
meaning:
वैश्वानरपदं याति शिखिव्रतमिदं स्मृतं /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे प्रतिपद्व्रतानि नाम
षट्सप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 अक्षमालाश्रुचं दक्षे इति छ..
2 वामे दण्डकमण्डलु इति छ.. , झ.. / वामे श्रुवकमण्डलु इति
छ..
3 नक्तं कृच्चाभ्युपोषित इति ग..
:प् 199
:श् अथ सप्तसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
द्वितीयाव्रतानि
text_mt:
He goes to the realm of Vaiśvānara; this is known as the Śikhi-vrata.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-sixth chapter, named "Votive Observances of the First Lunar Day," in the great Agni Purāṇa.
[Footnote]
1. "akṣamālāśrucaṃ dakṣe" in cha.
2. "vāme daṇḍakamaṇḍalu" in cha and jha; "vāme śruvakamaṇḍalu" in cha.
3. "naktaṃ kṛccābhyupoṣita" in ga. / Page 199.
Now, the one hundred and seventy-seventh chapter.
Votive observances of the second lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
dvitīyāvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktidāyakaṃ /
puṣpāhārī dvitīyāyāmaśvinau pūjayet surau //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
द्वितीयाव्रतकं वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिदायकं /
पुष्पाहारी द्वितीयायामश्विनौ पूजयेत् सुरौ //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observance of the second lunar day, which bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation. / Subsisting on flowers on the second lunar day, one should worship the two gods, the Aśvins,

sanskrit_iast:
abdaṃ svarūpasaubhāgyaṃ svargabhāg jāyate vratī /
kārttike śuktipakṣasya(1) ditīyāyāṃ yamaṃ yajet //
meaning:
अब्दं स्वरूपसौभाग्यं स्वर्गभाग् जायते व्रती /
कार्त्तिके शुक्तिपक्षस्य(1) दितीयायां यमं यजेत् //
text_mt: for a year; the observer of the vow obtains beauty and good fortune, and partakes of heaven. / On the second lunar day of the bright fortnight of Kārttika, one should worship Yama;

sanskrit_iast:
abdamupoṣitaḥ svargaṃ gacchenna narakaṃ vratī /
aśūnyaśayanaṃ vakṣye avaidhavyādidāyakaṃ //
meaning:
अब्दमुपोषितः स्वर्गं गच्छेन्न नरकं व्रती /
अशून्यशयनं वक्ष्ये अवैधव्यादिदायकं //
text_mt: having fasted [on this day] for a year, the observer of the vow goes to heaven and does not enter hell. / I shall declare the Aśūnyaśayana [vow], which averts widowhood and brings other benefits.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ śrāvaṇāsya caredidaṃ /
śrīvatsadhārin śrikānta śrīdhāman śrīpate 'vyaya //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे द्वितीयायां श्रावणास्य चरेदिदं /
श्रीवत्सधारिन् श्रिकान्त श्रीधामन् श्रीपते ऽव्यय //
text_mt: One should perform this on the second lunar day of the dark fortnight of Śrāvaṇa: / "O bearer of the Śrīvatsa, O beloved of Śrī, O abode of Śrī, O Lord of Śrī, O imperishable one!

sanskrit_iast:
gārhasthyaṃ mā praṇāśaṃ me yātu dharmārthakāmadaṃ /
agnayī mā praṇaśyantu mā praṇaśyantu devatāḥ //
meaning:
गार्हस्थ्यं मा प्रणाशं मे यातु धर्मार्थकामदं /
अग्नयी मा प्रणश्यन्तु मा प्रणश्यन्तु देवताः //
text_mt: May my householder life, which bestows righteousness, wealth, and desire, not perish! / May my fires not perish! May my deities not perish!"

sanskrit_iast:
pitaro mā praṇaśyantu matto dāmpatyabhedataḥ /
lakṣmyā viyujyate devo na kadāśidyathā bhavān //
meaning:
पितरो मा प्रणश्यन्तु मत्तो दाम्पत्यभेदतः /
लक्ष्म्या वियुज्यते देवो न कदाशिद्यथा भवान् //
text_mt: May the ancestors not perish away from me through marital discord. / Just as You, O God, are never separated from Lakṣmī,

sanskrit_iast:
tathā kalatrasambandho deva mā me vibhidyatāṃ /
lakṣmyā na śūnyaṃ varada yathā te śayanaṃ vibho //
meaning:
तथा कलत्रसम्बन्धो देव मा मे विभिद्यतां /
लक्ष्म्या न शून्यं वरद यथा ते शयनं विभो //
text_mt: so too, O God, may my marital union not be broken. / Just as Your bed is never devoid of Lakṣmī, O boon-giver, O All-pervading One,

sanskrit_iast:
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathaiva madhusūdana /
lakṣmīṃ viṣṇuṃ yajedavdaṃ dadyācchayyāṃ phalāni ca //
meaning:
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथैव मधुसूदन /
लक्ष्मीं विष्णुं यजेदव्दं दद्याच्छय्यां फलानि च //
text_mt: so also may my bed not be empty, O Madhusūdana! / One should worship Lakṣmī and Viṣṇu for a year, and give a bed and fruits,

sanskrit_iast:
pratimāsaṃ ca somāya dadyādarghyaṃ samantrakaṃ /
:n
1 śuktapakṣe tu iti ga..
:p 200
gaganāṅgaṇasandīpa dugdhābdhimathanodbhava //
meaning:
प्रतिमासं च सोमाय दद्यादर्घ्यं समन्त्रकं /
:न्
1 शुक्तपक्षे तु इति ग..
:प् 200
गगनाङ्गणसन्दीप दुग्धाब्धिमथनोद्भव //
text_mt:
and each month offer a water offering accompanied by mantras to Soma:
:n
1 'śuklapakṣe tu' thus in manuscript ga. / :p 200
‘O Illuminator of the courtyard of the sky! O One born from the churning of the milk ocean!

sanskrit_iast:
bhābhāsitādigābhoga rāmānuja namo 'stu te /
oṃ śrīṃ śrīdharāya namaḥ somātmānaṃ hariṃ yajet //
meaning:
भाभासितादिगाभोग रामानुज नमो ऽस्तु ते /
ओं श्रीं श्रीधराय नमः सोमात्मानं हरिं यजेत् //
text_mt: O You whose brilliance illumines the expanse of the directions! O younger brother of Rāma, salutation to You!’ / ‘Om Śrīm, salutation to Śrīdhara.’ One should worship Hari as the embodiment of Soma,

sanskrit_iast:
ghaṃ ḍhaṃ bhaṃ haṃ śriyai namo daśarūpamahātmane /
ghṛtena homo naktañca śayyāṃ dadyāddvijātaye(1) //
meaning:
घं ढं भं हं श्रियै नमो दशरूपमहात्मने /
घृतेन होमो नक्तञ्च शय्यां दद्याद्द्विजातये(1) //
text_mt: ‘Gham dham bham ham, salutation to Śrī, to the Great-souled One possessing ten forms.’ / A fire oblation should be made with ghee, [food taken] at night, and one should give a bed to a twice-born,

sanskrit_iast:
dīpānnabhājanair yuktaṃ chatropānahamāsanaṃ /
sodakumbhañca pratimāṃ viprāyātha ca pātrakaṃ(2) //
meaning:
दीपान्नभाजनैर् युक्तं छत्रोपानहमासनं /
सोदकुम्भञ्च प्रतिमां विप्रायाथ च पात्रकं(2) //
text_mt: equipped with lamps, vessels of food, an umbrella, shoes, and a seat, / along with a water-pot, an image, and a drinking vessel to the Brahmin.

sanskrit_iast:
patnyā ya evaṃ kurute bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
kāntivrataṃ pravakṣyāmi kārttikasya site caret //
meaning:
पत्न्या य एवं कुरुते भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् /
कान्तिव्रतं प्रवक्ष्यामि कार्त्तिकस्य सिते चरेत् //
text_mt: Whoever performs this along with his wife attains worldly enjoyment and liberation. / I shall now declare the Kāntivrata; one should observe it in the bright [fortnight] of Kārttika.

sanskrit_iast:
naktabhojī dvitīyāyāṃ pūjayed balakeśavau /
varṣaṃ prāpnoti vai kāntimāyurārogyakādikaṃ //
meaning:
नक्तभोजी द्वितीयायां पूजयेद् बलकेशवौ /
वर्षं प्राप्नोति वै कान्तिमायुरारोग्यकादिकं //
text_mt: Eating at night on the second lunar day, one should worship Balarāma and Keśava; / for a year [one does this and] obtains beauty, longevity, good health, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
atha śiṣṇuvrataṃ vakṣye manovāñchitadāyakaṃ /
pauṣaśukladvitīyādi kṛtvā dinacatuṣṭayaṃ //
meaning:
अथ शिष्णुव्रतं वक्ष्ये मनोवाञ्छितदायकं /
पौषशुक्लद्वितीयादि कृत्वा दिनचतुष्टयं //
text_mt: Now I will declare the Viṣṇuvrata, which grants the desires of the mind: / having observed it for four days beginning from the bright second lunar day of Pauṣa,

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvaṃ siddhārthakaiḥ snānaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇatilaiḥ(3)smṛtaṃ /
vacayā ca tṛtīye 'hni sarvauṣadhyā caturthake //
meaning:
पूर्वं सिद्धार्थकैः स्नानं ततः कृष्णतिलैः(3)स्मृतं /
वचया च तृतीये ऽह्नि सर्वौषध्या चतुर्थके //
text_mt: first a bath with white mustard seeds is prescribed, then with black sesame seeds, / with sweet flag on the third day, and with all-herbs on the fourth.

sanskrit_iast:
murāmāṃṣī vacā kuṣṭhaṃ śaileyaṃ rajanīdvarya(4) /
saṭī campakamustañca sarvauṣadhigaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
मुरामांषी वचा कुष्ठं शैलेयं रजनीद्वर्य(4) /
सटी चम्पकमुस्तञ्च सर्वौषधिगणः स्मृतः //
text_mt: Murā, jaṭāmāṃsī, sweet flag, kuṣṭha, lichen, the two turmerics, / saṭī, campaka, and mustā are known as the group of all-herbs.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmnā kṛṣṇācyutānanta hṛṣīkeśeti pūjayet /
pāde nābhyāṃ cakṣuṣi ca kramācchirasi puṣpakaiḥ //
meaning:
नाम्ना कृष्णाच्युतानन्त हृषीकेशेति पूजयेत् /
पादे नाभ्यां चक्षुषि च क्रमाच्छिरसि पुष्पकैः //
text_mt: One should worship Him with the names: ‘O Kṛṣṇa, Acyuta, Ananta, Hṛṣīkeśa!’ / on His feet, navel, eyes, and head, respectively, with flowers;

sanskrit_iast:
śaśicandraśaśāṅkendusañjñābhiścārghyaṃ indave /
naktaṃ bhuñjīta ca naro yāvattiṣṭhati candramāḥ //
:n
1 śayyāṃ dadyāddvitīyake iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. ,
ṭa.. ca
2 viprāyātha ca pānakamiti gha.. , ña.. ca
3 śuktatilair iti ga..
4 pūrvaṃ siddhārthakair ityādiḥ, rajanīdvayamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ
jha.. pustake nāsti
:p 201
meaning:
शशिचन्द्रशशाङ्केन्दुसञ्ज्ञाभिश्चार्घ्यं इन्दवे /
नक्तं भुञ्जीत च नरो यावत्तिष्ठति चन्द्रमाः //
:न्
1 शय्यां दद्याद्द्वितीयके इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ज.. , ञ.. ,
ट.. च
2 विप्रायाथ च पानकमिति घ.. , ञ.. च
3 शुक्ततिलैर् इति ग..
4 पूर्वं सिद्धार्थकैर् इत्यादिः, रजनीद्वयमित्यन्तः पाठः
झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 201
text_mt:
and [present] a water offering to the Moon with the names Śaśin, Candra, Śaśāṅka, and Indu. / A person should eat at night as long as the moon remains [in the sky].
:n
1 'śayyāṃ dadyāddvitīyake' thus in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, ja, ña, and ṭa.
2 'viprāyātha ca pānakam' thus in manuscripts gha and ña.
3 'śuklatilair' thus in manuscript ga.
4 The text from 'pūrvaṃ siddhārthakair' up to 'rajanīdvayam' is missing in manuscript jha. / :p 201

sanskrit_iast:
ṣaṇmāsaṃ pāvanaṃ cābdaṃ prāpnuyāt sakalaṃ vratī /
etad vrataṃ nṛpaiḥ strībhiḥ kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ surādibhiḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe dvitīyāvratāni nāma
saptasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭasaptatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
tṛtīyāvratāni
meaning:
षण्मासं पावनं चाब्दं प्राप्नुयात् सकलं व्रती /
एतद् व्रतं नृपैः स्त्रीभिः कृतं पूर्वं सुरादिभिः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे द्वितीयाव्रतानि नाम
सप्तसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टसप्तत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
तृतीयाव्रतानि
text_mt:
The observer of the votive observance attains purificatory [merit] for six months and a full year. / This votive observance was formerly performed by kings, women, and the gods.
:e Thus in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and seventy-seventh chapter, entitled 'The Votive Observances of the Second Lunar Day'.
:ś Now the one hundred and seventy-eighth chapter:
The Votive Observances of the Third Lunar Day

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
tṛtīyāvratānyākhyāsye bhuktimuktipradāni te /
lalitāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ mūlagaurīvrataṃ śṛṇu //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
तृतीयाव्रतान्याख्यास्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानि ते /
ललितायां तृतीयायां मूलगौरीव्रतं शृणु //
text_mt: Agni said: / I will declare to you the votive observances of the third lunar day, which grant worldly enjoyment and liberation. / Hear the Mūlagaurīvrata on the Lalitā third lunar day:

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyāyāṃ caitraśukle ūḍhā gaurī hareṇa hi /
tilasnāto 'rcayecchambhuṃ gauryā haimaphalādibhiḥ //
meaning:
तृतीयायां चैत्रशुक्ले ऊढा गौरी हरेण हि /
तिलस्नातो ऽर्चयेच्छम्भुं गौर्या हैमफलादिभिः //
text_mt: on the bright third lunar day of Caitra, Gaurī was indeed married by Hara. / Having bathed with sesame, one should worship Śambhu together with Gaurī with golden fruits and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'stu pāṭalāyaiva pādau devyāḥ śivasya ca /
śivāyeti ca saṅkīrtya jayāyai gulphayoryajet //
meaning:
नमो ऽस्तु पाटलायैव पादौ देव्याः शिवस्य च /
शिवायेति च सङ्कीर्त्य जयायै गुल्फयोर्यजेत् //
text_mt: ‘Salutation to the Rosy-red One,’ [worship] the feet of the Goddess and of Śiva; / and pronouncing ‘To Śivā,’ one should worship the ankles, [saying] ‘To Jayā’;

sanskrit_iast:
tripuraghnāya rudrāya bhānyai jaṅghayordvayaoḥ /
śivaṃ rudrāyeśvarāya(1) vijayāyaiva jānunī //
meaning:
त्रिपुरघ्नाय रुद्राय भान्यै जङ्घयोर्द्वयओः /
शिवं रुद्रायेश्वराय(1) विजयायैव जानुनी //
text_mt: ‘To Rudra, the Destroyer of Tripura,’ and ‘To the Resplendent One,’ [worship] the two shanks; / Śiva with ‘To Rudra, the Supreme Lord,’ and the two knees with ‘To Vijayā’;

sanskrit_iast:
īśāyeti kaṭiṃ devyāḥ(2) śaṅkarāyeti śaṅkaram /
:n
1 śivaṃ rudrāya viśvāyeti kha.. , cha.. ca / śivaṃ bhadrāyeśvarāyeti ja..
, jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
2 īśāya kaṭyāṃ devyāś ca iti ṅa.. / īśāyeti tāto devyā iti
gha..
:p 202
kukṣidvayañca koṭavyai śūlinam śūlapāṇaye //
meaning:
ईशायेति कटिं देव्याः(2) शङ्करायेति शङ्करम् /
:न्
1 शिवं रुद्राय विश्वायेति ख.. , छ.. च / शिवं भद्रायेश्वरायेति ज..
, झ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
2 ईशाय कट्यां देव्याश् च इति ङ.. / ईशायेति तातो देव्या इति
घ..
:प् 202
कुक्षिद्वयञ्च कोटव्यै शूलिनम् शूलपाणये //
text_mt:
with ‘To Īśa,’ [worship] the waist of the Goddess, and Śaṅkara with ‘To Śaṅkara’;
:n
1 'śivaṃ rudrāya viśvāyeti' thus in kha and cha; 'śivaṃ bhadrāyeśvarāyeti' in ja, jha, ña, and ṭa.
2 'īśāya kaṭyāṃ devyāś ca' thus in ṅa; 'īśāyeti tāto devyā' in gha. / :p 202
and the two flanks with ‘To Koṭavī’; and the Trident-bearer with ‘To the Trident-handed One’.

sanskrit_iast:
maṅgalāyai namastubhyamudarañcābhipūjayet /
sarvātmane namo rudramaiśānyai ca kucadvayaṃ //
meaning:
मङ्गलायै नमस्तुभ्यमुदरञ्चाभिपूजयेत् /
सर्वात्मने नमो रुद्रमैशान्यै च कुचद्वयं //
text_mt: ‘Salutation to You, to Maṅgalā,’ one should worship the belly; / ‘Salutation to Rudra, the Self of All,’ and the two breasts with ‘To Aiśānī’;

sanskrit_iast:
śivaṃ devātmane tadvat hrādinyai(1) kaṇṭhamarcayet /
mahādevāya ca śivamanantāyai karadvayaṃ //
meaning:
शिवं देवात्मने तद्वत् ह्रादिन्यै(1) कण्ठमर्चयेत् /
महादेवाय च शिवमनन्तायै करद्वयं //
text_mt: likewise, Śiva with ‘To the Divine Self,’ and the neck [of the Goddess] with ‘To the Delighting One’; / and Śiva with ‘To Mahādeva,’ and the two hands with ‘To Anantā’;

sanskrit_iast:
trilocanāyeti haraṃ bāhuṃ kālānalapriye(2) /
saubhāgyāyai maheśāya bhūṣaṇāni prapūjayet //
meaning:
त्रिलोचनायेति हरं बाहुं कालानलप्रिये(2) /
सौभाग्यायै महेशाय भूषणानि प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: Hara with ‘To the Three-eyed One,’ and the arm with ‘O Beloved of the Fire of Time!’; / one should worship the ornaments with ‘To Saubhāgyā’ and ‘To Maheśa’;

sanskrit_iast:
aśokamadhuvāsinyai īśvarāyeti cauṣṭhakau /
caturmukhapriyā cāsyaṃ harāya sthāṇave namaḥ //
meaning:
अशोकमधुवासिन्यै ईश्वरायेति चौष्ठकौ /
चतुर्मुखप्रिया चास्यं हराय स्थाणवे नमः //
text_mt: and the two lips with ‘To the One dwelling in the nectar of Aśoka’ and ‘To Īśvara’; / the face with ‘Beloved of the Four-faced One’; ‘Salutation to Hara, to Sthāṇu’;

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'rdhanārīśaharamamitāṅgyai ca nāsikāṃ /
nama ugrāya lokeśaṃ laliteti punarbhruvau //
meaning:
नमो ऽर्धनारीशहरममिताङ्ग्यै च नासिकां /
नम उग्राय लोकेशं ललितेति पुनर्भ्रुवौ //
text_mt: ‘Salutation to the Lord who is half-woman, to Hara,’ and the nose with ‘To the Immense-bodied One’; / the Lord of the world with ‘Salutation to the Fierce One,’ and again the eyebrows with ‘Lalitā’;

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāya purahantāraṃ(3) vāsantyai caiva tālukaṃ(4) /
namaḥ śrīkaṇṭhanāthāyai śitikaṇṭhāya keśakaṃ //
meaning:
सर्वाय पुरहन्तारं(3) वासन्त्यै चैव तालुकं(4) /
नमः श्रीकण्ठनाथायै शितिकण्ठाय केशकं //
text_mt: the Destroyer of the cities with ‘To Śarva,’ and the palate with ‘To Vāsantī’; / the hair with ‘Salutation to the Mistress of Śrīkaṇṭha’ and ‘To the Dark-throated One’;

sanskrit_iast:
bhīmogrāya supūpiṇyai śiraḥ sarvātmane namaḥ /
mallikāśokakamalakundantagaramālatī(5) //
meaning:
भीमोग्राय सुपूपिण्यै शिरः सर्वात्मने नमः /
मल्लिकाशोककमलकुन्दन्तगरमालती(5) //
text_mt: the head with ‘To the Terrifyingly Fierce One, the Well-formed One’ and ‘Salutation to the Self of All’. / Mallikā, aśoka, lotus, kunda, tagara, mālatī,

sanskrit_iast:
kadambakaravīrañca(6) vāṇamamlānakuṅkumaṃ /
sindhuvārañca māseṣu sarveṣu kramaśaḥ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
कदम्बकरवीरञ्च(6) वाणमम्लानकुङ्कुमं /
सिन्धुवारञ्च मासेषु सर्वेषु क्रमशः स्मृतं //
text_mt: kadamba, karavīra, vāṇa, unwithering [flower], saffron, / and sindhuvāra are prescribed respectively in all the months.

sanskrit_iast:
umāmaheśvarau pūjya saubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ(7) /
:n
1 śivaṃ vedātmane tadvadrūpiṇyai iti gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
2 harañcāntakālānalapriye iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
3 purahartāramiti gha..
4 vāsanyai ca tathālakamiti cha.. , ṭa.. ca
5 mallikāśokakamalacchadaṃ tagaramālatī iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
6 kundañca karavīrañceti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. ca
7 mallikāśoketyādiḥ, saubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ ity antaḥ cha..
pustake nāsti
:p 203
sthāpayed(1) ghṛtaniṣpāvakusumbhakṣīrajīvakaṃ //
meaning:
उमामहेश्वरौ पूज्य सौभाग्याष्टकमग्रतः(7) /
:न्
1 शिवं वेदात्मने तद्वद्रूपिण्यै इति घ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
2 हरञ्चान्तकालानलप्रिये इति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
3 पुरहर्तारमिति घ..
4 वासन्यै च तथालकमिति छ.. , ट.. च
5 मल्लिकाशोककमलच्छदं तगरमालती इति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
6 कुन्दञ्च करवीरञ्चेति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. च
7 मल्लिकाशोकेत्यादिः, सौभाग्याष्टकमग्रतः इत्य् अन्तः छ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 203
स्थापयेद्(1) घृतनिष्पावकुसुम्भक्षीरजीवकं //
text_mt:
Having worshipped Umā and Maheśvara, [one should place] the eight auspicious items before them:
:n
1 'śivaṃ vedātmane tadvadrūpiṇyai' thus in gha, ja, and ña.
2 'harañcāntakālānalapriye' thus in kha, gha, ja, and ña.
3 'purahartāram' thus in gha.
4 'vāsanyai ca tathālakam' thus in cha and ṭa.
5 'mallikāśokakamalacchadaṃ tagaramālatī' thus in kha, gha, and ja.
6 'kundañca karavīrañca' thus in kha, gha, ja.
7 The text from 'mallikāśoka-' up to 'saubhāgyāṣṭakamagrataḥ' is missing in manuscript cha. / :p 203
one should arrange: ghee, niṣpāva beans, safflower, milk, jīvaka,

sanskrit_iast:
tarurājekṣulavaṇaṃ(2) kustumburumathāṣṭamaṃ /
caitre śṛgodakaṃ prāśya devadevyagrataḥ svapet //
meaning:
तरुराजेक्षुलवणं(2) कुस्तुम्बुरुमथाष्टमं /
चैत्रे शृगोदकं प्राश्य देवदेव्यग्रतः स्वपेत् //
text_mt: sugarcane from the royal tree, salt, and eighth, coriander. / Having consumed water from a horn in Caitra, one should sleep before the God and Goddess.

sanskrit_iast:
prātaḥ snātvā samabhyarcya vipradāmpatyamarcayet(3) /
tadaṣṭakaṃ dvije dadyāllalitā prīyatāṃ mama(4) //
meaning:
प्रातः स्नात्वा समभ्यर्च्य विप्रदाम्पत्यमर्चयेत्(3) /
तदष्टकं द्विजे दद्याल्ललिता प्रीयतां मम(4) //
text_mt: Having bathed and worshipped in the morning, one should honor a Brahmin couple; / one should give that group of eight to a twice-born, saying: ‘May Lalitā be pleased with me!’

sanskrit_iast:
śṛṅgodakaṃ(5) gomayaṃ ca mandāraṃ bilvapatrakaṃ /
kuśodakaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ kārttike pṛṣadājyakam //
meaning:
शृङ्गोदकं(5) गोमयं च मन्दारं बिल्वपत्रकं /
कुशोदकं दधि क्षीरं कार्त्तिके पृषदाज्यकम् //
text_mt: Water from a horn, cow dung, mandāra, bilva leaves, / kuśa water, curds, milk, and in Kārttika ghee mixed with curds,

sanskrit_iast:
gomūtrājyaṃ kṛṣṇatilaṃ pañcagavyaṃ kramāśanaṃ /
lalitā vijayā bhadrā bhavānī kumudā śivā //
meaning:
गोमूत्राज्यं कृष्णतिलं पञ्चगव्यं क्रमाशनं /
ललिता विजया भद्रा भवानी कुमुदा शिवा //
text_mt: cow urine with ghee, black sesame, and the five products of the cow are the successive items to be consumed. / ‘Lalitā, Vijayā, Bhadrā, Bhavānī, Kumudā, Śivā,

sanskrit_iast:
vāsudevī tathā gaurī maṅgalā kamalā satī /
caitrādau dānakāle ca prīyatāmiti vācayet //
meaning:
वासुदेवी तथा गौरी मङ्गला कमला सती /
चैत्रादौ दानकाले च प्रीयतामिति वाचयेत् //
text_mt: Vāsudevī, and Gaurī, Maṅgalā, Kamalā, Satī’— / in Caitra and the other [months], at the time of giving gifts, one should recite: ‘May she be pleased!’

sanskrit_iast:
phalamekaṃ pavitrājyaṃ(6) vratānte śayānaṃ dadet /
umāmaheśvaraṃ haimaṃ vṛṣabhañca gavā saha //
meaning:
फलमेकं पवित्राज्यं(6) व्रतान्ते शयानं ददेत् /
उमामहेश्वरं हैमं वृषभञ्च गवा सह //
text_mt: At the conclusion of the votive observance, one should give a fruit, pure ghee, and a bed, / a golden [image of] Umā and Maheśvara, and a bull along with a cow.

sanskrit_iast:
guruñca mithunānyarcya(7) vastrādyair bhuktimuktibhāk(8) /
saubhāgyārogyarūpāyuḥ saubhāgyaśayanavratān //
meaning:
गुरुञ्च मिथुनान्यर्च्य(7) वस्त्राद्यैर् भुक्तिमुक्तिभाक्(8) /
सौभाग्यारोग्यरूपायुः सौभाग्यशयनव्रतान् //
text_mt: And after worshiping the teacher and married couples with clothes and other offerings, one enjoys worldly enjoyment and liberation, / [and obtains] good fortune, health, beauty, and long life from the votive observance of the couch of good fortune.

One should perform it in the month of Nabhasya (Bhādrapada), or in Vaiśākha, or in Mārgaśiras.

On the third lunar day of the bright fortnight, one should worship [saying]: “Homage to Lalitā!”

sanskrit_iast:
pratipakṣaṃ tataḥ prārcya vratānte(1) mityunāni ca /

प्रतिपक्षं ततः प्रार्च्य व्रतान्ते(1) मित्युनानि च /
चतुर्विंशतिमभ्यर्च्य वस्त्राद्यैर् भुक्तिमुक्तिभाक् //
text_mt: Then, having worshiped each fortnight, and at the conclusion of the votive observance having worshiped / twenty-four married couples with garments and the like, one enjoys worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ukto mārgo dvitīyo 'yaṃ saubhāgyavratamāvade /

उक्तो मार्गो द्वितीयो ऽयं सौभाग्यव्रतमावदे /
फाल्गुणादितृतीयायां लवणं यस्तु वर्जयेत् //
text_mt: This second method has been declared; I shall explain the votive observance of good fortune: / Whoever gives up salt on the third lunar day from Phālguna onwards,

sanskrit_iast:
samāpte śayanandadyādgṛhaścopaskarānvitaṃ /
sampūjya vipramithunaṃ bhavānī prīyatāmiti(2) //
meaning:
समाप्ते शयनन्दद्याद्गृहश्चोपस्करान्वितं /
सम्पूज्य विप्रमिथुनं भवानी प्रीयतामिति(2) //
text_mt: upon its completion, one should donate a bed together with a house and household utensils, / having worshiped a brahmin couple, [saying]: “May Bhavānī be pleased!”

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyārthaṃ tṛtīyoktā gaurīlokādidāyinī /

सौभाग्यार्थं तृतीयोक्ता गौरीलोकादिदायिनी /
माघे भाद्रे च वैशाखे तृतीयाव्रतकृत्तथा //
text_mt: The third lunar day is declared to grant good fortune and bestow the world of Gaurī and other realms. / Likewise, one who observes the votive observance of the third lunar day in Māgha, Bhādra, and Vaiśākha,

दमनकतृतीयाकृत् चैत्रे दमनकैर् यजेत् /
आत्मतृतीया मार्गस्य प्रार्च्येच्छाभोजनादिना //
text_mt: and performs the Damanakatṛtīyā, should worship in Caitra with damanaka blossoms. / The Ātmatṛtīyā of the month of Mārga[śīrṣa] is worshiped with food to one's liking and other offerings.

sanskrit_iast:
gaurī kālī umā bhadrā durgā kāntiḥ sarasvatī /

beginning from the third lunar day of Mārgaśīrṣa, one attains good fortune and heaven.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-eighth chapter, entitled “Votive Observances of the Third Lunar Day,” in the great Agni Purāṇa.

Now, the one hundred and seventy-ninth chapter.
Votive Observances of the Fourth Lunar Day

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
caturthī vratānyākhyāsye bhuktimuktipradāni te(1) /

अग्निर् उवाच
चतुर्थी व्रतान्याख्यास्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानि ते(1) /
माघे शुक्लचतुर्थ्यान्तु उपवासी यजेद् गुणं //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall explain the votive observances of the fourth lunar day, which bestow worldly enjoyment and liberation upon you. / On the fourth lunar day of the bright fortnight in Māgha, fasting, one should worship Gaṇa (Gaṇeśa).

sanskrit_iast:

गं स्वाहा(3) मूलमन्त्रो ऽयं गामाद्यं हृदयादिकं //
text_mt: And on the fifth lunar day, eating sesamum rice, happy, one is free from obstacles for a year. / ‘Gaṃ svāhā’ is this root mantra; ‘Gām’ and the rest are [used for] the heart and other limbs.

pracīdayāt

उल्कान्तैर् गादिगन्धाद्यैः पूजयेन्मोदकादिभिः //
ओं महोल्काय विद्महे वक्रतुण्डाय(4) धीमहि तन्नो दन्ती
प्रचीदयात्
text_mt:
With ‘Āgaccholkāya’ one invokes him, and with ‘Gaccholkāya’ one dismisses him. / One should worship with modakas and other offerings, along with fragrances and the rest beginning with ‘ga-’ and ending with ‘-ulkāya’.
“Oṃ. We know Maholka; we meditate upon Vakratuṇḍa; may that single-tusked one (Dantin) impel us.”

चतुर्थ्यां फाल्गुने नक्तमविघ्नाख्या व्रजेत् //

text_mt:
On the fourth lunar day in Phālguna, [eating] at night, that fourth lunar day is also called Avighnā. / On the fourth lunar day in Caitra, having worshiped Gaṇa with damana leaves and adored him, one becomes happy.
Thus ends the one hundred and seventy-ninth chapter, entitled “Votive Observances of the Fourth Lunar Day,” in the great Agni Purāṇa.
[Apparatus]

3 hāṃ svāhā iti in Kha
4 cakramuṇḍāya iti in Kha and Gha; vakramuṇḍāya iti in Ṅa;
raktatuṇḍāya iti in Ja and Jha / [Page 206]
Now, the one hundred and eightieth chapter.
Votive Observances of the Fifth Lunar Day

नभोनभस्याश्विने च कार्त्तिके शुक्लपक्षके //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observance of the fifth lunar day, which bestows health, heaven, and liberation. / In the bright fortnight of Nabhas (Śrāvaṇa), Nabhasya (Bhādrapada), Āśvina, and Kārttika,

vāsukistakṣakaḥ pūjyaḥ kālīyo maṇibhadrakaḥ /

वासुकिस्तक्षकः पूज्यः कालीयो मणिभद्रकः /
ऐरावतो धृतराष्ट्रः कर्कोटकधनञ्जयौ //

Votive Observances of the Sixth Lunar Day
