kṛṣṇaṣaṣṭhīvrataṃ vakṣye mārgaśīrṣe carecca tat(1) //
meaning:
षष्ट्यामथाक्षयं /
कृष्णषष्ठीव्रतं वक्ष्ये मार्गशीर्षे चरेच्च तत्(1) //
text_mt: On the sixth lunar day, then, [the fruit is] imperishable. / I shall declare the votive observance of the dark sixth lunar day; one should observe that in Mārgaśīrṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
anāhāro varṣamekaṃ bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe ṣaṣṭhīvratāni nāma
ekāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
saptamīvratāni
meaning:
अनाहारो वर्षमेकं भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे षष्ठीव्रतानि नाम
एकाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्व्यशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
सप्तमीव्रतानि
text_mt:
Without food for one year, one attains worldly enjoyment and liberation.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-first chapter, entitled “Votive Observances of the Sixth Lunar Day,” in the great Agni Purāṇa.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-second chapter.
Votive observances of the seventh lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
saptamīvratakaṃ vakṣye sarveṣāṃ bhuktimuktidaṃ(2) /
māghamāse 'bjake śukle sūryaṃ prārcya viśokabhāk //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
सप्तमीव्रतकं वक्ष्ये सर्वेषां भुक्तिमुक्तिदं(2) /
माघमासे ऽब्जके शुक्ले सूर्यं प्रार्च्य विशोकभाक् //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall explain the votive observance of the seventh lunar day, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation to all. / Having thoroughly worshipped the sun on the bright seventh lunar day in the month of Māgha, one becomes free of sorrow.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvāvāptistu saptabhyāṃ māsi bhādre 'rkapūjanāt /
pauṣe māsi site 'naśnan prārcyārkaṃ pāpanāśanaṃ //
meaning:
सर्वावाप्तिस्तु सप्तभ्यां मासि भाद्रे ऽर्कपूजनात् /
पौषे मासि सिते ऽनश्नन् प्रार्च्यार्कं पापनाशनं //
text_mt: Attainment of all things comes from worshipping the sun on the seventh lunar day in the month of Bhādrapada. / Fasting in the bright fortnight of the month of Pauṣa and worshipping the sun destroys sin.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe tu māghasya sarvāvāptistu saptamī /
phālgune tu site nandā saptamī cārkapūjanāt //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे तु माघस्य सर्वावाप्तिस्तु सप्तमी /
फाल्गुने तु सिते नन्दा सप्तमी चार्कपूजनात् //
text_mt: The seventh lunar day in the dark fortnight of Māgha brings the attainment of everything. / In Phālguna, in the bright fortnight, Nandā is the seventh lunar day by worshipping the sun.

sanskrit_iast:
mārgaśīrṣe site prārcya saptamī cāparājitā /
mārgaśīrṣe site cāvdaṃ putrīyā saptamī striyāḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe saptamīvratāni nāma
dvyaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 mārgaśīrṣe caredvratamiti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ṭa.. ca
2 sarvathā bhuktimuktidamiti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. ca
:p 208
:ś atha tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
aṣṭamīvratāni
meaning:
मार्गशीर्षे सिते प्रार्च्य सप्तमी चापराजिता /
मार्गशीर्षे सिते चाव्दं पुत्रीया सप्तमी स्त्रियाः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे सप्तमीव्रतानि नाम
द्व्यशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 मार्गशीर्षे चरेद्व्रतमिति घ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ट.. च
2 सर्वथा भुक्तिमुक्तिदमिति घ.. , ज.. , झ.. च
:प् 208
:श् अथ त्र्यशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
अष्टमीव्रतानि
text_mt:
Having worshipped on the bright seventh lunar day in Mārgaśīrṣa, it is Aparājitā. / And observed for a year starting on the bright seventh of Mārgaśīrṣa, it is the Putrīyā seventh for a woman.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and eighty-second chapter, entitled 'Votive Observances of the Seventh Lunar Day'.
[Apparatus]
1 'mārgaśīrṣe caredvratam' in manuscripts gha, ja, jha, and ṭa.
2 'sarvathā bhuktimuktidam' in manuscripts gha, ja, and jha.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-third chapter.
Votive observances of the eighth lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
vakṣye vratāni cāṣṭamyāṃ rohiṇyāṃ prathamaṃ vrataṃ /
māsi bhādrapade 'ṣṭabhyāṃ rohiṇyāmardharātrake //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
वक्ष्ये व्रतानि चाष्टम्यां रोहिण्यां प्रथमं व्रतं /
मासि भाद्रपदे ऽष्टभ्यां रोहिण्यामर्धरात्रके //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall explain the votive observances of the eighth lunar day. The first votive observance is on Rohiṇī: / in the month of Bhādrapada, on the eighth lunar day with Rohiṇī at midnight.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇo jāto yatastasyāṃ jayantī syāttato 'ṣṭamī /
saptajanmakṛtāt pāpāt mucyate copavāsataḥ //
meaning:
कृष्णो जातो यतस्तस्यां जयन्ती स्यात्ततो ऽष्टमी /
सप्तजन्मकृतात् पापात् मुच्यते चोपवासतः //
text_mt: Because Kṛṣṇa was born on it, that eighth lunar day is known as Jayantī. / Through fasting [on it], one is freed from sin committed over seven lifetimes.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇapakṣe bhādrapade aṣṭamyāṃ rohiṇīyute /
upāṣitorcayet kṛṣṇaṃ(1) bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ //
meaning:
कृष्णपक्षे भाद्रपदे अष्टम्यां रोहिणीयुते /
उपाषितोर्चयेत् कृष्णं(1) भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकं //
text_mt: In the dark fortnight of Bhādrapada, on the eighth lunar day conjoined with Rohiṇī, / one should fast and worship Kṛṣṇa, the bestower of worldly enjoyment and liberation:

sanskrit_iast:
āvāhayāmyahaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ balabhadrañca devakīṃ /
vasudevaṃ yaśodāṅgāḥ(2) pūjayāmi namo 'stu te //
meaning:
आवाहयाम्यहं कृष्णं बलभद्रञ्च देवकीं /
वसुदेवं यशोदाङ्गाः(2) पूजयामि नमो ऽस्तु ते //
text_mt: "I invoke Kṛṣṇa, Balabhadra, and Devakī, / Vasudeva, and Yaśodā with her attendants. I worship [them]; homage be to you!

sanskrit_iast:
yogāya yogapataye yogeśāya namo namaḥ /
yogādisambhāvayaiva govindāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
योगाय योगपतये योगेशाय नमो नमः /
योगादिसम्भावयैव गोविन्दाय नमो नमः //
text_mt: Homage, homage to yoga, to the lord of yoga, to the master of yoga! / Homage, homage to Govinda, the origin of yoga and the rest!

sanskrit_iast:
snānaṃ kṛṣṇāya dadyāttu arghyaṃ cānena dāpayet /
yajñāya yajñeśvarāya yajñānāṃ pataye namaḥ //
meaning:
स्नानं कृष्णाय दद्यात्तु अर्घ्यं चानेन दापयेत् /
यज्ञाय यज्ञेश्वराय यज्ञानां पतये नमः //
text_mt: One should offer a bath to Kṛṣṇa, and should present water offering with this [mantra]: / "Homage to the sacrifice, to the lord of sacrifice, to the master of sacrifices!

sanskrit_iast:
yajñādisaṃbhavāyaiva govindāya namo namaḥ /
gṛhāṇa deva puṣpāṇi sugandhīni priyāṇi te //
meaning:
यज्ञादिसंभवायैव गोविन्दाय नमो नमः /
गृहाण देव पुष्पाणि सुगन्धीनि प्रियाणि ते //
text_mt: Homage, homage to Govinda, the origin of sacrifice and the rest! / Receive, O God, fragrant flowers dear to you!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmaprado deva bhava me devavandita /
dhūpadhūpita dhūpaṃ tvaṃ dhūpitaistvaṃ gṛhāṇa me //
meaning:
सर्वकामप्रदो देव भव मे देववन्दित /
धूपधूपित धूपं त्वं धूपितैस्त्वं गृहाण मे //
text_mt: O God praised by the gods, become the fulfiller of all my desires! / O perfumed one, receive the incense offered by me!

sanskrit_iast:
sugandha dhūpagandhāḍhyaṃ kuru māṃ sarvadā hare /
:n
1 viṣṇumiti ṭa..
2 yaśodāñceti ṅa.. , ja.. ca
:p 209
dīpadīpta mahādīpaṃ dīpadīptada sarvadā(1) //
meaning:
सुगन्ध धूपगन्धाढ्यं कुरु मां सर्वदा हरे /
:न्
1 विष्णुमिति ट..
2 यशोदाञ्चेति ङ.. , ज.. च
:प् 209
दीपदीप्त महादीपं दीपदीप्तद सर्वदा(1) //
text_mt:
O Hari, always make me fragrant with the scent of incense!
[Footnote]
1 "viṣṇum" thus in manuscript ṭa.
2 "yaśodāñca" in manuscripts ṅa and ja. / [Page 209]
O blazing lamp, great lamp, bestower of light at all times!

sanskrit_iast:
mayā dattaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ kuru cordhvagatiṃ ca māṃ /
viśvāya viśvapataye viśveśāya namo namaḥ(2) //
meaning:
मया दत्तं गृहाण त्वं कुरु चोर्ध्वगतिं च मां /
विश्वाय विश्वपतये विश्वेशाय नमो नमः(2) //
text_mt: Receive [this lamp] offered by me, and grant me the upward path! / Homage, homage to the all, to the lord of the universe, to the master of the universe!

sanskrit_iast:
viśvādisambhavāyaiva govindāya niveditaṃ /
dharmāya dharmapataye darmeśāya namo namaḥ //
meaning:
विश्वादिसम्भवायैव गोविन्दाय निवेदितं /
धर्माय धर्मपतये दर्मेशाय नमो नमः //
text_mt: This offering is presented to Govinda, the origin of the universe and the rest! / Homage, homage to righteousness, to the lord of righteousness, to the master of righteousness!

sanskrit_iast:
dharmādisambhavāyaiva govindaśayanaṃ kuru /
sarvāya sarvapataye sarveśāya namao namaḥ //
meaning:
धर्मादिसम्भवायैव गोविन्दशयनं कुरु /
सर्वाय सर्वपतये सर्वेशाय नमओ नमः //
text_mt: To Govinda, the origin of righteousness and the rest: take your rest! / Homage, homage to the all, to the lord of all, to the master of all!

sanskrit_iast:
sarvādisambhavāyaiva govindāya ca pāvanaṃ(3) /
kṣīrodārṇavasambhūta atrinetrasamudbhava //
meaning:
सर्वादिसम्भवायैव गोविन्दाय च पावनं(3) /
क्षीरोदार्णवसम्भूत अत्रिनेत्रसमुद्भव //
text_mt: And the purifying [offering] to Govinda, the origin of all and the rest! / O you who arose from the Ocean of Milk, who originated from the eye of Atri,

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhāṇārghyaṃ śaśāṅkedaṃ rohiṇyā sahito mama /
sthaṇḍile sthāpayeddevaṃ sacandrāṃ rohiṇīṃ yajet //
meaning:
गृहाणार्घ्यं शशाङ्केदं रोहिण्या सहितो मम /
स्थण्डिले स्थापयेद्देवं सचन्द्रां रोहिणीं यजेत् //
text_mt: receive this water offering of mine, O Moon, together with Rohiṇī!" / One should place the god upon a cleared altar ground and worship Rohiṇī along with the Moon,

sanskrit_iast:
devakīṃ vasudevaṃ ca yaśodāṃ nandakaṃ balaṃ /
ardharātre parodhārāḥ pātayed guḍasarpiṣā //
meaning:
देवकीं वसुदेवं च यशोदां नन्दकं बलं /
अर्धरात्रे परोधाराः पातयेद् गुडसर्पिषा //
text_mt: Devakī, Vasudeva, Yaśodā, Nanda, and Balarāma. / At midnight one should pour out superior streams [of libation] with molasses and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
vastrahemādikaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇān bhojayedvratī /
janmāṣṭamīvratakaraḥ putravānviṣṇulokabhāk(4) //
meaning:
वस्त्रहेमादिकं दद्याद्ब्राह्मणान् भोजयेद्व्रती /
जन्माष्टमीव्रतकरः पुत्रवान्विष्णुलोकभाक्(4) //
text_mt: The observer of the vow should give garments, gold, and other gifts, and feed brāhmaṇas. / One who performs the Janmāṣṭamī votive observance obtains sons and participates in the world of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣe varṣe tu yaḥ kuryāt putrārthī vetti no bhayaṃ(5) /
putrān dehi dhanaṃ dehi āyurārogyasantatiṃ //
meaning:
वर्षे वर्षे तु यः कुर्यात् पुत्रार्थी वेत्ति नो भयं(5) /
पुत्रान् देहि धनं देहि आयुरारोग्यसन्ततिं //
text_mt: One who desires a son and performs it year after year knows no fear: / "Grant me sons, grant me wealth, long life, health, and progeny!

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaṃ kāmaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca dehi me /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe jayantyaṣṭamīvrataṃ nāma
tryaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 sarvadā iti gha.. , ṅa.. ca
2 viśveśāya namo 'stu te iti ja..
3 pāragamiti ga.. / sarvāyetyādiḥ. pāvanamityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ cha..
pustake nāsti
4 kṛṣṇalokabhāgiti cha..
5 putrārtho labhate sutamiti ja.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 210
:ś atha caturaśityadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
aṣṭamīvratāni
meaning:
धर्मं कामं च सौभाग्यं स्वर्गं मोक्षं च देहि मे /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे जयन्त्यष्टमीव्रतं नाम
त्र्यशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 सर्वदा इति घ.. , ङ.. च
2 विश्वेशाय नमो ऽस्तु ते इति ज..
3 पारगमिति ग.. / सर्वायेत्यादिः. पावनमित्यन्तः पाठः छ..
पुस्तके नास्ति
4 कृष्णलोकभागिति छ..
5 पुत्रार्थो लभते सुतमिति ज.. , ट.. च
:प् 210
:श् अथ चतुरशित्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
अष्टमीव्रतानि
text_mt:
Grant me righteousness, pleasure, good fortune, heaven, and liberation!"
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-third chapter, entitled "The Jayantyaṣṭamī Votive Observance," in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
[Footnote]
1 "sarvadā" thus in manuscripts gha and ṅa.
2 "viśveśāya namo 'stu te" thus in manuscript ja.
3 "pāragam" in manuscript ga. / The reading beginning with "sarvāya" and ending with "pāvanam" is missing in manuscript cha.
4 "kṛṣṇalokabhāk" in manuscript cha.
5 "putrārtho labhate sutam" in manuscripts ja and ṭa. / [Page 210]
Now, the one hundred and eighty-fourth chapter.
Votive observances of the eighth lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
brahmādimātṛyajanājjapen mātṛgaṇāṣṭamīṃ /
kṛṣṇāṣṭābhyāṃ caitramāse pūjyābdaṃkṛṣṇamarthabhāk //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
ब्रह्मादिमातृयजनाज्जपेन् मातृगणाष्टमीं /
कृष्णाष्टाभ्यां चैत्रमासे पूज्याब्दंकृष्णमर्थभाक् //
text_mt: Agni said: / From worshipping the Mothers headed by Brahmā, one should recite on the eighth day sacred to the host of Mothers. / Worshipping Kṛṣṇa on the dark eighth lunar day in the month of Caitra for a year, one gains prosperity.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamīvrataṃ vakṣye māse mārgaśire caret /
naktaṃ kṛtvā śucirbhūtvā gomūtraṃ prāśayenniśi //
meaning:
कृष्णाष्टमीव्रतं वक्ष्ये मासे मार्गशिरे चरेत् /
नक्तं कृत्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा गोमूत्रं प्राशयेन्निशि //
text_mt: I shall declare the votive observance of the dark eighth lunar day. One should perform it in the month of Mārgaśīrṣa: / having taken only an evening meal and having become pure, one should consume cow urine at night.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūmiśāyī niśāyāñca śaṅkaraṃ pujayed vratī /
pauṣe śambhuṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya māghe kṣīraṃmaheśvaram(1) //
meaning:
भूमिशायी निशायाञ्च शङ्करं पुजयेद् व्रती /
पौषे शम्भुं घृतं प्राश्य माघे क्षीरंमहेश्वरम्(1) //
text_mt: Sleeping on the ground at night, the observer of the vow should worship Śaṅkara. / In Pauṣa [one should worship] Śambhu after consuming clarified butter, in Māgha Maheśvara [after consuming] milk;

sanskrit_iast:
mahādevaṃ phālgune ca tilāśī(2) samupoṣitaḥ /
caitre sthāṇuṃ yavāśī ca vaiśākhe 'tha śivaṃ yajet //
meaning:
महादेवं फाल्गुने च तिलाशी(2) समुपोषितः /
चैत्रे स्थाणुं यवाशी च वैशाखे ऽथ शिवं यजेत् //
text_mt: in Phālguna Mahādeva, fasting and eating sesame seeds; / in Caitra Sthāṇu while eating barley; and in Vaiśākha one should worship Śiva

sanskrit_iast:
kuśodaśī paśupatiṃ jyaiṣṭhe śṛṅgodakāśanaḥ /
āṣāḍhe gomayāśyugraṃ śrāvaṇe sarvamarkabhuk //
meaning:
कुशोदशी पशुपतिं ज्यैष्ठे शृङ्गोदकाशनः /
आषाढे गोमयाश्युग्रं श्रावणे सर्वमर्कभुक् //
text_mt: drinking kuśa-grass water; in Jyaiṣṭha Paśupati while drinking water poured over a horn; / in Āṣāḍha Ugra while eating cow dung; in Śrāvaṇa Sarva while consuming calotropis;

sanskrit_iast:
tryambakaṃ ca bhādrapade bilvapatrāśano niśi /
taṇḍulāśī cāśvayuje īśaṃ rudantu kārttike //
meaning:
त्र्यम्बकं च भाद्रपदे बिल्वपत्राशनो निशि /
तण्डुलाशी चाश्वयुजे ईशं रुदन्तु कार्त्तिके //
text_mt: in Bhādrapada Tryambaka while eating bilva leaves at night; / in Āśvina [worship] Īśa while eating rice grains, and in Kārttika Rudra

sanskrit_iast:
dadhyāśī homakārī syādvarṣānte maṇḍale yajet(3) /
govastrahema gurave dadyādviprebhya īdṛśaṃ //
meaning:
दध्याशी होमकारी स्याद्वर्षान्ते मण्डले यजेत्(3) /
गोवस्त्रहेम गुरवे दद्याद्विप्रेभ्य ईदृशं //
text_mt: while eating curd, performing a fire oblation. At the end of the year, one should worship in a maṇḍala. / One should give a cow, garments, and gold to the guru, and similar gifts to the brāhmaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
prārthayitvā dvijān bhojya(4) bhuktimuktimavāpnuyāt /
:n
1 māghe kṣīrī maheśvaramiti gha.. , cha.. , ña.. ca
2 tilādīti ja..
3 varṣe varṣe tu maṇḍale iti ña..
4 dvijān toṣya iti ja..
:p 211
naktāśī tvaṣṭamīṣu syād vatsarānte ca dhenudaḥ //
meaning:
प्रार्थयित्वा द्विजान् भोज्य(4) भुक्तिमुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् /
:न्
1 माघे क्षीरी महेश्वरमिति घ.. , छ.. , ञ.. च
2 तिलादीति ज..
3 वर्षे वर्षे तु मण्डले इति ञ..
4 द्विजान् तोष्य इति ज..
:प् 211
नक्ताशी त्वष्टमीषु स्याद् वत्सरान्ते च धेनुदः //
text_mt:
Having prayed and fed the twice-born, one attains worldly enjoyment and liberation.
[Footnote]
1 "māghe kṣīrī maheśvaram" in manuscripts gha, cha, and ña.
2 "tilādī" in manuscript ja.
3 "varṣe varṣe tu maṇḍale" in manuscript ña.
4 "dvijān toṣya" in manuscript ja. / [Page 211]
One should eat only at night on the eighth lunar days, and give a milch cow at the end of the year.

sanskrit_iast:
paurandaraṃ padaṃ yāti svargativratamucyate(1) /
aṣṭamī budhavāreṇa pakṣayorubhayoryadā //
meaning:
पौरन्दरं पदं याति स्वर्गतिव्रतमुच्यते(1) /
अष्टमी बुधवारेण पक्षयोरुभयोर्यदा //
text_mt: One attains the abode of Indra; this is called the votive observance for reaching heaven. / When the eighth lunar day falls on a Wednesday in either fortnight,

sanskrit_iast:
tadā vrataṃ prakurvīta athavā saguḍāśitā /
tasyāṃ niyamakartāro na syuḥ khaṇḍitasampadaḥ //
meaning:
तदा व्रतं प्रकुर्वीत अथवा सगुडाशिता /
तस्यां नियमकर्तारो न स्युः खण्डितसम्पदः //
text_mt: then one should perform the votive observance, or eat food with molasses. / Those who observe rules on that day do not have their fortunes impaired.

sanskrit_iast:
taṇḍulasyāṣṭamuṣṭīnāṃ varjayitvāṅgulīdvayaṃ /
bhaktaṃ kṛtvā cāmrapuṭe sakuśe sakulāmbikāṃ //
meaning:
तण्डुलस्याष्टमुष्टीनां वर्जयित्वाङ्गुलीद्वयं /
भक्तं कृत्वा चाम्रपुटे सकुशे सकुलाम्बिकां //
text_mt: Taking eight handfuls of rice grains minus two fingerbreadths, / and making cooked food in an folded mango leaf with kuśa grass, / [one should worship] the Mother of the family.

sanskrit_iast:
sāttvikaṃ pūjayitvāṅgaṃ bhuñjīta ca kathāśravāt /
śaktito dakṣiṇāndadyāt karkaṭīntaṇḍulānvitāṃ(2) //
meaning:
सात्त्विकं पूजयित्वाङ्गं भुञ्जीत च कथाश्रवात् /
शक्तितो दक्षिणान्दद्यात् कर्कटीन्तण्डुलान्वितां(2) //
text_mt: Having worshipped the pure [goddess], one should eat after hearing the sacred story. / According to one's capacity, one should give a sacrificial fee, [along with] a cucumber accompanied by rice grains.

sanskrit_iast:
dhīro dvijo 'sya(3) bhāryāsti rambhā putrastu kaiśikaḥ /
duhitā vijayā tasya dhīrasya dhanado vṛṣaḥ(4) //
meaning:
धीरो द्विजो ऽस्य(3) भार्यास्ति रम्भा पुत्रस्तु कैशिकः /
दुहिता विजया तस्य धीरस्य धनदो वृषः(4) //
text_mt: There was a wise brāhmaṇa whose wife was Rambhā, and his son was Kauśika; / his daughter was Vijayā. That wise man had a bull that bestowed wealth.

sanskrit_iast:
kauśikastaṃ gṛhītvā tu gopālaiścārayan vṛṣaṃ /
gaṅgāyāṃ snānakṛtye 'tha(5) nītaś caurair vṛṣastadā //
meaning:
कौशिकस्तं गृहीत्वा तु गोपालैश्चारयन् वृषं /
गङ्गायां स्नानकृत्ये ऽथ(5) नीतश् चौरैर् वृषस्तदा //
text_mt: Kauśika took that bull and grazed it with the cowherds. / Then, during the bath in the Gaṅgā, the bull was carried off by thieves.

sanskrit_iast:
snātvā vṛṣamapaśyan sa vṛṣaṃ mārgitumāgataḥ /
vijayābhaginīyukto dadarśa sa sarovare //
meaning:
स्नात्वा वृषमपश्यन् स वृषं मार्गितुमागतः /
विजयाभगिनीयुक्तो ददर्श स सरोवरे //
text_mt: Having bathed and not seeing the bull, he went to search for the bull; / accompanied by his sister Vijayā, he saw at a lake

sanskrit_iast:
divyastrīyoṣitāṃ vṛndamavravīddehi bhojanaṃ /
strīvṛndamūce vratakṛd bhuṅkṣva tvamatithiryataḥ //
meaning:
दिव्यस्त्रीयोषितां वृन्दमव्रवीद्देहि भोजनं /
स्त्रीवृन्दमूचे व्रतकृद् भुङ्क्ष्व त्वमतिथिर्यतः //
text_mt: a company of celestial women. He said: "Give [us] food!" / The group of women said: "Perform the vow, and then eat, since you are a guest."

sanskrit_iast:
vrataṃ kṛtvā sa bubhuje prāptavān vanapālakaṃ /
:n
1 sugativratamucyate iti kha.. , gha.. , cha.. , ja.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
/suśāntivratamucyate iti ja..
2 karkarīntaṇḍulānvitāmiti kha.. , gha.. , ṅa.. ca /
gargarīntaṇḍulānvitāmiti jha..
3 vīro dvijo 'syeti ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
4 vīrasya dhanapo vṛṣa iti kha.. , cha.. , ṭa.. ca / vīrasya dhanado
vṛṣa iti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
5 snānakṛtyeṣu iti ṭa..
:p 212
gato dhīraḥ(1) savṛṣabho vijayāsahitastadā //
meaning:
व्रतं कृत्वा स बुभुजे प्राप्तवान् वनपालकं /
:न्
1 सुगतिव्रतमुच्यते इति ख.. , घ.. , छ.. , ज.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
/सुशान्तिव्रतमुच्यते इति ज..
2 कर्करीन्तण्डुलान्वितामिति ख.. , घ.. , ङ.. च /
गर्गरीन्तण्डुलान्वितामिति झ..
3 वीरो द्विजो ऽस्येति ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
4 वीरस्य धनपो वृष इति ख.. , छ.. , ट.. च / वीरस्य धनदो
वृष इति घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
5 स्नानकृत्येषु इति ट..
:प् 212
गतो धीरः(1) सवृषभो विजयासहितस्तदा //
text_mt:
Having performed the vow, he ate, and found the guardian of the forest.
[Footnote]
1 "sugativratamucyate" in manuscripts kha, gha, cha, ja, ña, and ṭa; / "suśāntivratamucyate" in manuscript ja.
2 "karkarīntaṇḍulānvitām" in manuscripts kha, gha, and ṅa;
"gargarīntaṇḍulānvitām" in manuscript jha.
3 'vīro dvijo 'sya' in manuscripts ga, gha, ṅa, ja, and ña.
4 'vīrasya dhanapo vṛṣaḥ' in manuscripts kha, cha, and ṭa; 'vīrasya dhanado vṛṣaḥ' in manuscripts gha, ṅa, ja, and ña.
5 'snānakṛtyeṣu' in manuscript ṭa.
Then Dhīra went, accompanied by the bull and along with Vijayā.

sanskrit_iast:
dhīreṇa(2) vijayā dattā yamāyāntaritaḥ pitā /
vratabhāvāt kauśiko 'pi hy ayodhyāyāṃ nṛpo 'bhavat //
meaning:
धीरेण(2) विजया दत्ता यमायान्तरितः पिता /
व्रतभावात् कौशिको ऽपि ह्य् अयोध्यायां नृपो ऽभवत् //
text_mt: Vijayā was given by Dhīra to Yama; his father was concealed [from torment]. / Due to the power of the votive observance, Kauśika also became king in Ayodhyā.

sanskrit_iast:
pitrostu narake dṛṣṭvā vijayārtiṃ yame gatā /
mṛgayāmāgataṃ proce mucyate narakāt kathaṃ //
meaning:
पित्रोस्तु नरके दृष्ट्वा विजयार्तिं यमे गता /
मृगयामागतं प्रोचे मुच्यते नरकात् कथं //
text_mt: Having seen the torment of her parents in hell, Vijayā went to Yama / and said to him as he arrived from hunting: 'How may [they] be freed from hell?'

sanskrit_iast:
vratadvayādyamaḥ proce prāpya tat kaiśiko dadau /
budhāṣṭamīdvayaphalaṃ svargatau pitarau tataḥ(3) //
meaning:
व्रतद्वयाद्यमः प्रोचे प्राप्य तत् कैशिको ददौ /
बुधाष्टमीद्वयफलं स्वर्गतौ पितरौ ततः(3) //
text_mt: Yama said, 'From the two votive observances.' Having obtained that, Kauśika gave / the fruit of two Budhāṣṭamī [observances]; thereupon the two parents went to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
vijayā harṣitā cakre vrataṃ bhuktyādisiddhaye /
aśokakalikāścāṣtau ye pivanti punarvasau //
meaning:
विजया हर्षिता चक्रे व्रतं भुक्त्यादिसिद्धये /
अशोककलिकाश्चाष्तौ ये पिवन्ति पुनर्वसौ //
text_mt: Delighted, Vijayā undertook the votive observance for the attainment of worldly enjoyment and other ends. / Those who drink eight buds of the aśoka tree on the Punarvasu asterism,

sanskrit_iast:
caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ na te śokamavāpnuyuḥ /
tvāmaśokaharābhīṣṭa madhumāsasamuḍgava //
meaning:
चैत्रे मासि सिताष्टम्यां न ते शोकमवाप्नुयुः /
त्वामशोकहराभीष्ट मधुमाससमुड्गव //
text_mt: on the bright eighth lunar day in the month of Caitra, shall not incur grief: / 'O aśoka, dear to Śiva, born in the spring month,

sanskrit_iast:
pivāmi śokasantapto māmaśokaṃ sadā kuru /
caitrādau mātṛpūjākṛdaṣṭamyāṃ jayate ripūn //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe aṣṭamīvratāni nāma
caturaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
navamīvratāni ||
meaning:
पिवामि शोकसन्तप्तो मामशोकं सदा कुरु /
चैत्रादौ मातृपूजाकृदष्टम्यां जयते रिपून् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे अष्टमीव्रतानि नाम
चतुरशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ पञ्चाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
नवमीव्रतानि ||
text_mt:
tormented by sorrow, I drink [you]; make me forever free of sorrow!' / One who worships the Mothers on the eighth lunar day in the beginning of Caitra overcomes enemies.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and eighty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Votive Observances of the Eighth Lunar Day'.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-fifth chapter.
Votive observances of the ninth lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
navamīvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktyādisiddhidaṃ /
devī pūjyāśvine śukle gauryākhyānavamīvrataṃ //
:n
1 gato vīra iti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
2 vīreṇeti ṭa..
3 pitarau tadeti kha..
:p 213
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
नवमीव्रतकं वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्त्यादिसिद्धिदं /
देवी पूज्याश्विने शुक्ले गौर्याख्यानवमीव्रतं //
:न्
1 गतो वीर इति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
2 वीरेणेति ट..
3 पितरौ तदेति ख..
:प् 213
text_mt:
Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observance of the ninth lunar day, which grants the attainment of worldly enjoyment, liberation, and other fruits. / The Goddess should be worshipped in the bright fortnight of Āśvina; it is the votive observance of the ninth lunar day named Gaurī.
[Apparatus]
1 'gato vīraḥ' in manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, ja, and ña.
2 'vīreṇa' in manuscript ṭa.
3 'pitarau tadā' in manuscript kha.

sanskrit_iast:
piṣṭakākhyā tu navamī piṣṭāśī devapūjanāt /
aṣṭamyāmāśvine śukte kanyārkamūlabhe yadā //
meaning:
पिष्टकाख्या तु नवमी पिष्टाशी देवपूजनात् /
अष्टम्यामाश्विने शुक्ते कन्यार्कमूलभे यदा //
text_mt: The ninth lunar day is named Piṣṭakā, where one eats ground meal after worshipping the deity. / When on the bright eighth lunar day in Āśvina, the sun is in Virgo and the asterism is Mūla,

sanskrit_iast:
aghārdanā sarvadā vai mahatī navamī smṛtā /
durgā tu navagehasthā ekāgārasthitāthavā //
meaning:
अघार्दना सर्वदा वै महती नवमी स्मृता /
दुर्गा तु नवगेहस्था एकागारस्थिताथवा //
text_mt: it destroys sins at all times; it is known as the Great Ninth Lunar Day. / Durgā, situated in nine chambers or standing in a single abode,

sanskrit_iast:
pūjitāṣṭādaśabhujā śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśamatkarāḥ(1) /
śeṣāḥ ṣoḍaśahastāḥ syurañjanaṃ ḍamaruntathā //
meaning:
पूजिताष्टादशभुजा शेषाः षोडशमत्कराः(1) /
शेषाः षोडशहस्ताः स्युरञ्जनं डमरुन्तथा //
text_mt: is worshipped with eighteen arms; the remaining [goddesses] have sixteen hands. / The remaining ones should have sixteen hands, holding collyrium and a drum,

sanskrit_iast:
rudracaṇḍā pracaṇḍā ca caṇḍogrā saṇḍanāyikā /
caṇḍā caṇḍavatī pūjyā caṇḍarūpāticaṇḍikā //
meaning:
रुद्रचण्डा प्रचण्डा च चण्डोग्रा सण्डनायिका /
चण्डा चण्डवती पूज्या चण्डरूपातिचण्डिका //
text_mt: Rudracaṇḍā, Pracaṇḍā, Caṇḍogrā, Caṇḍanāyikā, / Caṇḍā, Caṇḍavatī, Caṇḍarūpā, and Aticaṇḍikā should be worshipped,

sanskrit_iast:
kramānmadhye cogracaṇḍā durgā mahiṣamardinī(2) /
oṃ durge durge rakṣaṇi svāhā daśākṣāro mantraḥ //
meaning:
क्रमान्मध्ये चोग्रचण्डा दुर्गा महिषमर्दिनी(2) /
ओं दुर्गे दुर्गे रक्षणि स्वाहा दशाक्षारो मन्त्रः //
text_mt: and in order in their midst, Ugracaṇḍā, Durgā the slayer of Mahiṣa. / 'Oṃ durge durge rakṣaṇi svāhā' is the ten-syllable mantra.

sanskrit_iast:
dīrghākārādimantrādir navanetro namo 'ntikaḥ /
ṣaḍbhiḥ padair namaḥsvadhāvaṣaṭkārahṛdādikaṃ //
meaning:
दीर्घाकारादिमन्त्रादिर् नवनेत्रो नमो ऽन्तिकः /
षड्भिः पदैर् नमःस्वधावषट्कारहृदादिकं //
text_mt: The mantra begins with long vowels, has nine eyes, and ends with namaḥ. / With six words accompanied by namaḥ, svadhā, and vaṣaṭ, one performs [the nyāsa of] the heart and other limbs,

sanskrit_iast:
aṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntaṃ nyasyāṅgāni japecchivāṃ(3) /
etañjapati(4) yo guhyaṃ nāsau kenāpi bādhyate //
meaning:
अङ्गुष्ठादिकनिष्ठान्तं न्यस्याङ्गानि जपेच्छिवां(3) /
एतञ्जपति(4) यो गुह्यं नासौ केनापि बाध्यते //
text_mt: depositing the limbs from the thumb to the little finger, and should recite [the mantra of] the auspicious goddess. / Whoever recites this secret mantra is not afflicted by anyone.

sanskrit_iast:
kapālaṃ kheṭakaṃ ghaṇṭāṃ darpaṇantarjanīndhanuḥ /
dhvajaṇḍamarukaṃ pāśaṃ vāmahasteṣu vibhratīṃ //
meaning:
कपालं खेटकं घण्टां दर्पणन्तर्जनीन्धनुः /
ध्वजण्डमरुकं पाशं वामहस्तेषु विभ्रतीं //
text_mt: [She is visualised] bearing in her left hands a skull-cup, a shield, a bell, a mirror, a forefinger gesture, a bow, / a flag, a small drum, and a noose;

sanskrit_iast:
śaktimudgaraśūlāni vajraṃ khaḍgañca kuntakaṃ /
śaṅkhaṃ cakraṃ śalākāṃ ca āyudhāni ca pūjayet //
meaning:
शक्तिमुद्गरशूलानि वज्रं खड्गञ्च कुन्तकं /
शङ्खं चक्रं शलाकां च आयुधानि च पूजयेत् //
text_mt: and one should worship her weapons: a spear, a mallet, trident, thunderbolt, sword, lance, / conch, discus, and dart.

sanskrit_iast:
paśuñca kālī kālīti japtvā khaḍgena ghātayet /
kāli kāli vajreśvari lauhadaṇḍāyai namaḥ //
:n
1 ṣoḍaśahastakā iti ṅa..
2 kramāt madhye copacaṇḍāṃ kṭtvā mahiṣamardinīmiti ga..
3 dīrghākārādītyādiḥ, japecchivāmityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ gha.. , ja..
, jha.. , ña.. pustake nāsti
4 evaṃ japatīti ja.. , jha.. ca
:p 214
meaning:
पशुञ्च काली कालीति जप्त्वा खड्गेन घातयेत् /
कालि कालि वज्रेश्वरि लौहदण्डायै नमः //
:न्
1 षोडशहस्तका इति ङ..

, झ.. , ञ.. पुस्तके नास्ति

:प् 214
text_mt:
Having recited 'Kālī, Kālī', one should slay the sacrificial animal with a sword: / 'Kālī, Kālī, O Vajreśvarī, homage to the iron-staffed goddess!'
[Apparatus]
1 'ṣoḍaśahastakāḥ' in manuscript ṅa.
2 'kramāt madhye copacaṇḍāṃ kṛtvā mahiṣamardinīm' in manuscript ga.
3 The text from 'dīrghākārādi' up to 'japecchivām' is missing in manuscripts gha, ja, jha, and ña.
4 'evaṃ japati' in manuscripts ja and jha.

sanskrit_iast:
tadutthaṃ rudhiraṃ māṃsaṃ pūtanāyai ca nairṛte /
vāyavyāṃ pāparākṣasyai carakyai nama īśvare //
meaning:
तदुत्थं रुधिरं मांसं पूतनायै च नैरृते /
वायव्यां पापराक्षस्यै चरक्यै नम ईश्वरे //
text_mt: The blood and meat arising from it [should be offered] to Pūtanā in the southwest, / to the sinful demoness Carakī in the northwest, 'Homage to the sovereign goddess!';

sanskrit_iast:
vidārikāyai cāgneyyāṃ mahākauśikamagnaye(1) /
tasyāgrato nṛpaḥ snāyācchatruṃ piṣṭamayaṃ haret(2) //
meaning:
विदारिकायै चाग्नेय्यां महाकौशिकमग्नये(1) /
तस्याग्रतो नृपः स्नायाच्छत्रुं पिष्टमयं हरेत्(2) //
text_mt: and to Vidārikā in the southeast, [and] to Mahākauśika for Agni. / Before her, the king should bathe and destroy an enemy made of flour.

sanskrit_iast:
dadyāt skandaviśākhābhyāṃ brāhmādyā niśi tā yajet /
jayantī maṅgalā kālī bhadrakālī kapālinī //
meaning:
दद्यात् स्कन्दविशाखाभ्यां ब्राह्माद्या निशि ता यजेत् /
जयन्ती मङ्गला काली भद्रकाली कपालिनी //
text_mt: He should give [offerings] to Skanda and Viśākha; at night he should sacrifice to Brāhmī and the others: / Jayantī, Maṅgalā, Kālī, Bhadrakālī, Kapālinī,

sanskrit_iast:
durgā śivā kṣamā dhātrī svāhā svadhā namo 'stu te /
devīṃ pañcāmṛtaiḥ snāpya pūjayeccārhaṇādinā //
meaning:
दुर्गा शिवा क्षमा धात्री स्वाहा स्वधा नमो ऽस्तु ते /
देवीं पञ्चामृतैः स्नाप्य पूजयेच्चार्हणादिना //
text_mt: Durgā, Śivā, Kṣamā, Dhātrī, Svāhā, Svadhā, reverence to you! / Having bathed the Goddess with the five nectars, one should worship her with respectful offerings and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
dhvajādirathayātrādibalidānaṃ varādikṛt /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe navamīvratāni nāma
pañcāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
daśamīvrataṃ
meaning:
ध्वजादिरथयात्रादिबलिदानं वरादिकृत् /

पञ्चाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षडशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
दशमीव्रतं
text_mt:
The hoisting of flags, chariot processions, and animal sacrifices bestow boons and the like.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and eighty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Votive Observances of the Ninth Lunar Day'.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-sixth chapter.
Votive observance of the tenth lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
daśamīvratakaṃ vakṣye dharmakāmādidāyakaṃ /
daśamyāmekabhaktāśī samāpte daśadhenudaḥ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
दशमीव्रतकं वक्ष्ये धर्मकामादिदायकं /
दशम्यामेकभक्ताशी समाप्ते दशधेनुदः //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observance of the tenth lunar day, which grants virtue, desire, and other ends. / Eating only a single meal on the tenth lunar day, one should give ten cows at the conclusion.

sanskrit_iast:
diśaś ca kāñcanīrdadyādbrāhmaṇādhipatirbhavet /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe daśamīvratāni nāma
ṣaḍaśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 mahākauśikaṃ maṇḍape iti gha.. , ña.. ca
2 piṣṭamayaṃ hunoditi kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 215
:ś atha saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
ekādaśīvrataṃ
meaning:
दिशश् च काञ्चनीर्दद्याद्ब्राह्मणाधिपतिर्भवेत् /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे दशमीव्रतानि नाम
षडशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 महाकौशिकं मण्डपे इति घ.. , ञ.. च
2 पिष्टमयं हुनोदिति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 215
:श् अथ सप्ताशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
एकादशीव्रतं
text_mt:
He should give golden [images of] the directions, and he will become a ruler of brāhmaṇas.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and eighty-sixth chapter, entitled 'Votive Observances of the Tenth Lunar Day'.
[Apparatus]
[Variant reading:] 1. 'mahākauśikaṃ maṇḍape' in manuscripts gha and ña.
[Variant reading:] 2. 'piṣṭamayaṃ hunot' in manuscripts kha and cha.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-seventh chapter.
The votive observance of the eleventh lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
ekādaśīvrataṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyākaṃ /
daśamyānniyatāhāro māṃsamaithunavarjitaḥ(1) //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
एकादशीव्रतं वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायाकं /
दशम्यान्नियताहारो मांसमैथुनवर्जितः(1) //
text_mt: Agni said: / I will proclaim the votive observance of the eleventh lunar day, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation. / On the tenth lunar day, one should be restrained in diet, abstaining from meat and sexual intercourse.

sanskrit_iast:
ekadaśyāṃ na bhuñjīta pakṣayorubhayorapi /
dvādaśyekādaśī yatra tatra sannihito hariḥ //
meaning:
एकदश्यां न भुञ्जीत पक्षयोरुभयोरपि /
द्वादश्येकादशी यत्र तत्र सन्निहितो हरिः //
text_mt: One should not eat on the eleventh lunar day in either of the two fortnights. / Where the eleventh lunar day [coincides with] the twelfth lunar day, there Hari is present.

sanskrit_iast:
tatra(2) kratuśataṃ puṇyaṃ trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇe /
ekādaśī kalā yatra parato dvādaśo gatā(3) //
meaning:
तत्र(2) क्रतुशतं पुण्यं त्रयोदश्यां तु पारणे /
एकादशी कला यत्र परतो द्वादशो गता(3) //
text_mt: There is the religious merit of a hundred sacrifices there, while breaking the fast is done on the thirteenth lunar day. / Where a single minute division of the eleventh lunar day remains and the twelfth has passed beyond,

sanskrit_iast:
tatra kratuśataṃ puṇyantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇe /
daśamyekādaśīmiśrā nopoṣyā narakapradā //
meaning:
तत्र क्रतुशतं पुण्यन्त्रयोदश्यान्तु पारणे /
दशम्येकादशीमिश्रा नोपोष्या नरकप्रदा //
text_mt: there is the religious merit of a hundred sacrifices, while breaking the fast is done on the thirteenth lunar day. / An eleventh lunar day mixed with the tenth should not be observed as a fast, as it brings hell.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyānnirāhāro bhuktvā caivāpare 'hani /
bhokṣye 'haṃ puṇḍarīkākṣa śaraṇaṃ me bhavācyuta //
meaning:
एकादश्यान्निराहारो भुक्त्वा चैवापरे ऽहनि /
भोक्ष्ये ऽहं पुण्डरीकाक्ष शरणं मे भवाच्युत //
text_mt: "Fasting on the eleventh lunar day and having eaten on the next day, / I shall eat, O lotus-eyed one; be my refuge, O Acyuta."

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe puṣyarkṣantu yadā bhavet /
sopoṣpākṣayyaphaladā proktā sā pāpanāśinī //
meaning:
एकादश्यां सिते पक्षे पुष्यर्क्षन्तु यदा भवेत् /
सोपोष्पाक्षय्यफलदा प्रोक्ता सा पापनाशिनी //
text_mt: When the asterism Puṣya occurs on the eleventh lunar day in the bright fortnight, / that [day], fasted upon, is declared to bestow imperishable fruit and destroy sin.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśī dvādaśī yā śravaṇena ca saṃyutā /
vijayā sā tithiḥ proktā bhaktānāṃ vijayapradā //
meaning:
एकादशी द्वादशी या श्रवणेन च संयुता /
विजया सा तिथिः प्रोक्ता भक्तानां विजयप्रदा //
text_mt: The eleventh or twelfth lunar day that is conjoined with Śravaṇa / is called the Vijayā lunar day; it grants victory to devotees.

sanskrit_iast:
eṣaiva phālgune māsi puṣyarkṣeṇa ca saṃyutā /
:n
1 madhumāṃsair vivarjita iti ga..
2 atreti kha.. , cha.. , ja.. ca
3 dvādaśī mateti gha.. , ña.. ca / dvādaśī bhavediti ṅa.. , jha.. ca
:p 216
vijayā procyate sadbhiḥ koṭikoṭiguṇottarā(1) //
meaning:
एषैव फाल्गुने मासि पुष्यर्क्षेण च संयुता /
:न्
1 मधुमांसैर् विवर्जित इति ग..
2 अत्रेति ख.. , छ.. , ज.. च
3 द्वादशी मतेति घ.. , ञ.. च / द्वादशी भवेदिति ङ.. , झ.. च
:प् 216
विजया प्रोच्यते सद्भिः कोटिकोटिगुणोत्तरा(1) //
text_mt:
This very [lunar day], conjoined with the asterism Puṣya in the month of Phālguna,
[Footnote]
[Variant reading:] 1. 'madhumāṃsair vivarjitaḥ' in manuscript ga.
[Variant reading:] 2. 'atra' in manuscripts kha, cha, and ja.
[Variant reading:] 3. 'dvādaśī matā' in manuscripts gha and ña; 'dvādaśī bhavet' in manuscripts ṅa and jha.
is proclaimed by the virtuous to be Vijayā, yielding millions upon millions times greater [fruits].

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśyāṃ viṣṇupūjā(2) kāryā sarvopakāriṇī(3) /
dhanavān putravān loke viṣṇuloke mahīyate //
:e ity āgnyeye mahāpurāṇe ekādaśīvrataṃ nāma
saptāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś athāṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
dvādaśīvratāni
meaning:
एकादश्यां विष्णुपूजा(2) कार्या सर्वोपकारिणी(3) /
धनवान् पुत्रवान् लोके विष्णुलोके महीयते //
:ए इत्य् आग्न्येये महापुराणे एकादशीव्रतं नाम
सप्ताशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथाष्टाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
द्वादशीव्रतानि
text_mt:
On the eleventh lunar day, worship of Viṣṇu should be performed, which aids everyone; / one becomes wealthy and possesses sons in this world, and is honoured in the world of Viṣṇu.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-seventh chapter, named 'The Votive Observance of the Eleventh Lunar Day', in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-eighth chapter.
The votive observances of the twelfth lunar day.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
dvādaśīvratakaṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ /
ekabhaktena bhaktena tathaivāyācitena ca //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
द्वादशीव्रतकं वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकं /
एकभक्तेन भक्तेन तथैवायाचितेन च //
text_mt: Agni said: / I will proclaim the votive observance of the twelfth lunar day, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation, / by means of eating once a day, eating food, or similarly unasked food,

sanskrit_iast:
upavāsena bhaikṣyeṇa caivaṃ dvādaśikavratī /
caitre māsi site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ madanaṃ hariṃ //
meaning:
उपवासेन भैक्ष्येण चैवं द्वादशिकव्रती /
चैत्रे मासि सिते पक्षे द्वादश्यां मदनं हरिं //
text_mt: by fasting, or by begged food—thus one who observes the vow of the twelfth lunar day [observes it]. / In the month of Caitra, in the bright fortnight, on the twelfth lunar day, one worships Hari as Madana.

sanskrit_iast:
pūjayedbhuktimuktyarthī(4) madanadvādaśaīvratī /
māghaśukle tu dvādaśyāṃ bhīmadvādaśikavratī //
meaning:
पूजयेद्भुक्तिमुक्त्यर्थी(4) मदनद्वादशईव्रती /
माघशुक्ले तु द्वादश्यां भीमद्वादशिकव्रती //
text_mt: Seeking worldly enjoyment and liberation, one observes the vow of Madanadvādaśī. / On the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, observing the vow of Bhīmadvādaśī,

sanskrit_iast:
namo nārāyaṇāyeti yajedviṣṇuṃ sa sarvabhāk /
phālgune ca site pakṣe govindadvādaśīvratī //
meaning:
नमो नारायणायेति यजेद्विष्णुं स सर्वभाक् /
फाल्गुने च सिते पक्षे गोविन्दद्वादशीव्रती //
text_mt: one should worship Viṣṇu with the mantra, "Homage to Nārāyaṇa"; he obtains all. / In the month of Phālguna, in the bright fortnight, observing the vow of Govindadvādaśī,

sanskrit_iast:
viśokadvādaśīkārī yajedāśvayuje hariṃ /
lavaṇaṃ mārgaśīrṣe tu kṛṣṇamabhyarcya yo naraḥ //
meaning:
विशोकद्वादशीकारी यजेदाश्वयुजे हरिं /
लवणं मार्गशीर्षे तु कृष्णमभ्यर्च्य यो नरः //
text_mt: performing the Viśokadvādaśī, one should worship Hari in the month of Āśvina. / In the month of Mārgaśīrṣa, the person who, having worshipped Kṛṣṇa,

sanskrit_iast:
dadāti śukladvādaśyāṃ sa sarvarasadāyakaḥ /

1 kīṭikoṭiguṇottameti kha..
2 ekādaśyāmṛṣiṃ pūjyeti kha.. , cha.. ca / ekadaśyāmṛṣipūjeti
ṅa..
3 kāryā sarvāghahāriṇīti jha.. , ña.. ca
4 bhuktimuktyarthamiti cha.. , ña.. ca
:p 217
govatsaṃ pūjayed bhādre govatsadvādaśīvratī //
meaning:
ददाति शुक्लद्वादश्यां स सर्वरसदायकः /
:न्
1 कीटिकोटिगुणोत्तमेति ख..
2 एकादश्यामृषिं पूज्येति ख.. , छ.. च / एकदश्यामृषिपूजेति
ङ..
3 कार्या सर्वाघहारिणीति झ.. , ञ.. च
4 भुक्तिमुक्त्यर्थमिति छ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 217
गोवत्सं पूजयेद् भाद्रे गोवत्सद्वादशीव्रती //
text_mt:
gives salt on the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight, becomes a bestower of all essences.
[Footnote]
[Variant reading:] 1. 'koṭikoṭiguṇottamā' in manuscript kha.
[Variant reading:] 2. 'ekādaśyām ṛṣiṃ pūjya' in manuscripts kha and cha; 'ekadaśyām ṛṣipūjā' in manuscript ṅa.
[Variant reading:] 3. 'kāryā sarvāghahāriṇī' in manuscripts jha and ña.
[Variant reading:] 4. 'bhuktimuktyartham' in manuscripts cha and ña.
One observing the vow of Govatsadvādaśī should worship a cow and calf in the month of Bhādrapada.

sanskrit_iast:
mādhyāntu samatītāyāṃ śravaṇena tu saṃyutā /
dvādaśī yā bhavet kṛṣṇā proktā sā tiladvādaśī //
meaning:
माध्यान्तु समतीतायां श्रवणेन तु संयुता /
द्वादशी या भवेत् कृष्णा प्रोक्ता सा तिलद्वादशी //
text_mt: When noon has passed, the twelfth lunar day of the dark fortnight / that is conjoined with the asterism Śravaṇa is called Tiladvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
tilaiḥ snānantilair homo naivedyantilamodakaṃ /
dīpaś ca tilatailena tathā deyaṃ tilodakaṃ //
meaning:
तिलैः स्नानन्तिलैर् होमो नैवेद्यन्तिलमोदकं /
दीपश् च तिलतैलेन तथा देयं तिलोदकं //
text_mt: Bathing with sesame seeds, fire oblation with sesame seeds, food offering of sesame-sweetmeats, / a lamp with sesame oil, and likewise water with sesame seeds is to be offered,

sanskrit_iast:
tilāś ca deyā viprebhyaḥ phalaṃ homopavāsataḥ /
oṃ namo bhagavate 'tho vāsudevāya vai yajet //
meaning:
तिलाश् च देया विप्रेभ्यः फलं होमोपवासतः /
ओं नमो भगवते ऽथो वासुदेवाय वै यजेत् //
text_mt: and sesame seeds are to be given to brāhmaṇas, yielding the fruit of fire oblation and fasting. / Then one should worship with: "Om, homage to the Blessed Vāsudeva."

sanskrit_iast:
sukalaḥ svargamāpnoti ṣaṭtiladvādaśīvratī /
manorathadvādaśīkṛt phālgune tu site 'rcayet //
meaning:
सुकलः स्वर्गमाप्नोति षट्तिलद्वादशीव्रती /
मनोरथद्वादशीकृत् फाल्गुने तु सिते ऽर्चयेत् //
text_mt: One who observes the vow of Ṣaṭtiladvādaśī attains heaven with their family. / One who performs the Manorathadvādaśī should worship in the bright fortnight of Phālguna.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmadvādaśīvratakṛt keśavādyaiś ca nāmabhiḥ /
varṣaṃ yajeddhariṃ svargī na bhaven nārakī naraḥ //
meaning:
नामद्वादशीव्रतकृत् केशवाद्यैश् च नामभिः /
वर्षं यजेद्धरिं स्वर्गी न भवेन् नारकी नरः //
text_mt: One who performs the vow of Nāmadvādaśī should worship Hari with the names beginning with Keśava / for a year; he goes to heaven and does not become an inhabitant of hell.

sanskrit_iast:
phālgunasya site 'bhyarcya sumatidvādaśīvratī /
māsi bhādrapade śukte anantadvādaśīvratī(1) //
meaning:
फाल्गुनस्य सिते ऽभ्यर्च्य सुमतिद्वादशीव्रती /
मासि भाद्रपदे शुक्ते अनन्तद्वादशीव्रती(1) //
text_mt: Having worshipped in the bright fortnight of Phālguna, one observes the vow of Sumatidvādaśī. / In the bright fortnight of the month of Bhādrapada, one observes the vow of Anantadvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
aśleṣarkṣe tu mūle vā(2) māghe kṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ /
yajettilāṃś ca juhuyāttiladvādaśīkṛnnaraḥ //
meaning:
अश्लेषर्क्षे तु मूले वा(2) माघे कृष्णाय वै नमः /
यजेत्तिलांश् च जुहुयात्तिलद्वादशीकृन्नरः //
text_mt: Under the asterism Āśleṣā or Mūla, in Māgha, with "Homage to Kṛṣṇa", / a man observing Tiladvādaśī should worship and make fire oblation with sesame seeds.

sanskrit_iast:
sugatidvādaśīkārī phālgune tu site yajet /
jaya kṛṣṇa namastubhyaṃ varṣaṃ syād bhuktimuktigaḥ(3) //
meaning:
सुगतिद्वादशीकारी फाल्गुने तु सिते यजेत् /
जय कृष्ण नमस्तुभ्यं वर्षं स्याद् भुक्तिमुक्तिगः(3) //
text_mt: One performing Sugatidvādaśī should worship in the bright fortnight of Phālguna, / with "Victory, O Kṛṣṇa! Homage to you!" for a year; he attains worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣaśukle tu dvādaśyāṃ samprāptidvādaśīvratī /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe nānādvādaśīvratāni
nāmāṣṭāśītyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 manorathadvādaśītyādiḥ, anantadvādaśīvratītyantaḥ
pāṭhaḥ gha.. pustake nāsti
2 āṣāḍharkṣe tu mūle vā iti kha.. , ga.. , ja.. , ṭa.. ca
3 varṣe syād bhuktimuktida iti ga.. , gha.. ca
:p 218
:ś athaikonanavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śravaṇadvādaśīvratam
meaning:
पौषशुक्ले तु द्वादश्यां सम्प्राप्तिद्वादशीव्रती /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे नानाद्वादशीव्रतानि
नामाष्टाशीत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 मनोरथद्वादशीत्यादिः, अनन्तद्वादशीव्रतीत्यन्तः
पाठः घ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
2 आषाढर्क्षे तु मूले वा इति ख.. , ग.. , ज.. , ट.. च
3 वर्षे स्याद् भुक्तिमुक्तिद इति ग.. , घ.. च
:प् 218
:श् अथैकोननवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
श्रवणद्वादशीव्रतम्
text_mt:
On the twelfth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Pauṣa, one observes the vow of Samprāptidvādaśī.
Thus ends the one hundred and eighty-eighth chapter, named 'The Various Votive Observances of the Twelfth Lunar Day', in the Great Purāṇa of Agni.
[Footnote]
[Variant reading:] 1. The passage beginning with 'manorathadvādaśī' up to 'anantadvādaśīvratī' is missing in manuscript gha.
[Variant reading:] 2. 'āṣāḍharkṣe tu mūle vā' in manuscripts kha, ga, ja, and ṭa.
[Variant reading:] 3. 'varṣe syād bhuktimuktidaḥ' in manuscripts ga and gha.
Now, the one hundred and eighty-ninth chapter.
The votive observance of Śravaṇadvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
śravaṇādaśīṃ vakṣye māsi bhādrapade site /
śravaṇena yutā śreṣṭhā(1) mahatī sā hy upoṣitā //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
श्रवणादशीं वक्ष्ये मासि भाद्रपदे सिते /
श्रवणेन युता श्रेष्ठा(1) महती सा ह्य् उपोषिता //
text_mt: Agni said: / I will proclaim Śravaṇadvādaśī: in the bright fortnight of the month of Bhādrapada, / conjoined with the asterism Śravaṇa, it is supreme; when fasted upon, it is indeed great.

sanskrit_iast:
saṅgame saritāṃ snānācchravaṇadvādaśophalaṃ(2) /
budhaśravaṇasaṃyuktā dānādau sumahāphalā //
meaning:
सङ्गमे सरितां स्नानाच्छ्रवणद्वादशोफलं(2) /
बुधश्रवणसंयुक्ता दानादौ सुमहाफला //
text_mt: From bathing at the confluence of rivers comes the fruit of Śravaṇadvādaśī. / Conjoined with Wednesday and Śravaṇa, it yields exceedingly great fruit in giving gifts and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
niṣiddhamapi kartavyantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇaṃ /
dvādṛśyāñca nirāhāro vāmanaṃ pūjayāmyahaṃ //
meaning:
निषिद्धमपि कर्तव्यन्त्रयोदश्यान्तु पारणं /
द्वादृश्याञ्च निराहारो वामनं पूजयाम्यहं //
text_mt: Even if forbidden, the breaking of the fast must be done on the thirteenth lunar day. / [The vow:] "Fasting on the twelfth lunar day, I shall worship Vāmana

sanskrit_iast:
udakumbhe svarṇamayantrayodaśyāntu pāraṇaṃ /
āvāhayāmyahaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāmanaṃ śaṅkhacakriṇaṃ //
meaning:
उदकुम्भे स्वर्णमयन्त्रयोदश्यान्तु पारणं /
आवाहयाम्यहं विष्णुं वामनं शङ्खचक्रिणं //
text_mt: in a golden [image] placed on a water-jar, and break my fast on the thirteenth lunar day. / I invoke Viṣṇu as Vāmana, the bearer of the conch and discus,

sanskrit_iast:
sitavastrayugacchanne ghaṭe sacchatrapāduke /
snāpayāmi jalaiḥ śuddhair viṣṇuṃ(3) pañcāmṛtādibhiḥ //
meaning:
सितवस्त्रयुगच्छन्ने घटे सच्छत्रपादुके /
स्नापयामि जलैः शुद्धैर् विष्णुं(3) पञ्चामृतादिभिः //
text_mt: upon a jar covered with a pair of white garments, furnished with an umbrella and sandals. / I bathe Viṣṇu with pure waters and with the five nectars and other substances.

sanskrit_iast:
chatradaṇḍadharaṃ viṣṇuṃ vāmanāya namo namaḥ /
arghyaṃ dadāmi deveśa arghyārhādyaiḥ sadārcitaḥ(4) //
meaning:
छत्रदण्डधरं विष्णुं वामनाय नमो नमः /
अर्घ्यं ददामि देवेश अर्घ्यार्हाद्यैः सदार्चितः(4) //
text_mt: To Viṣṇu who holds an umbrella and a staff, to Vāmana, homage, homage! / I offer the water offering, O Lord of gods, who are ever worshipped by those worthy of water offerings and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktimuktiprajākīrtisarvaiśvaryayutaṃ kuru /
vāmanāya namo gandhaṃ homo 'nenāṣṭakaṃ śataṃ //
:n
1 śravaṇena samāyukteti gha..
2 dvādaśadvādaśīphalamiti kha.. , ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , cha.. , ña.. ca
3 śuddhair harimiti ga.. , ṭa.. ca
4 mudārcita iti ga..
:p 219
meaning:
भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रजाकीर्तिसर्वैश्वर्ययुतं कुरु /
वामनाय नमो गन्धं होमो ऽनेनाष्टकं शतं //
:न्
1 श्रवणेन समायुक्तेति घ..
2 द्वादशद्वादशीफलमिति ख.. , ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , छ.. , ञ.. च
3 शुद्धैर् हरिमिति ग.. , ट.. च
4 मुदार्चित इति ग..
:प् 219
text_mt:
Make me endowed with worldly enjoyment, liberation, offspring, fame, and all sovereign power! / Homage to Vāmana!" Perfume [is offered, and] fire oblation is made one hundred and eight times with this [mantra].
[Footnote]
1 In manuscript gha: "śravaṇena samāyuktā".
2 In manuscripts kha, ga, gha, ṅa, cha, and ña: "dvādaśadvādaśīphalam".
3 In manuscripts ga and ṭa: "śuddhair harim".
4 In manuscript ga: "mudārcitaḥ".

sanskrit_iast:
oṃ namo vāsudevāya śiraḥ sampūjayeddhareḥ /
śrīdharāya mukhaṃ tadvat kaṇṭhe kṛṣṇāya vai namaḥ //
meaning:
ओं नमो वासुदेवाय शिरः सम्पूजयेद्धरेः /
श्रीधराय मुखं तद्वत् कण्ठे कृष्णाय वै नमः //
text_mt: With "oṃ namo vāsudevāya", one should worship the head of Hari; / likewise the face with "to Śrīdhara"; [and] at the neck with "homage to Kṛṣṇa".

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ śrīpataye vakṣo bhujo sarvāstradhāriṇe /
vyāpakāya namo nābhiṃ vāmanāya namaḥ kaṭiṃ //
meaning:
नमः श्रीपतये वक्षो भुजो सर्वास्त्रधारिणे /
व्यापकाय नमो नाभिं वामनाय नमः कटिं //
text_mt: "Homage to Śrīpati" on the chest; the two arms with "to the wielder of all weapons"; / "homage to the all-pervading one" on the navel; "homage to Vāmana" on the hips;

sanskrit_iast:
trailokyajayakāyeti(1) meḍhraṃ jaṅghe yajeddhareḥ /
sarvādhipataye pādau viṣṇoḥ sarvātmane namaḥ //
meaning:
त्रैलोक्यजयकायेति(1) मेढ्रं जङ्घे यजेद्धरेः /
सर्वाधिपतये पादौ विष्णोः सर्वात्मने नमः //
text_mt: with "to the conqueror of the three worlds", one should worship the penis [and] the shanks of Hari; / with "to the sovereign lord of all", the two feet; homage to Viṣṇu, the universal Self.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtapakvañca naivedyandadyād dadhyodanair ghaṭān /
rātrau ca jāgaraṃ kṛtvā prātaḥ snātvā ca saṅgame //
meaning:
घृतपक्वञ्च नैवेद्यन्दद्याद् दध्योदनैर् घटान् /
रात्रौ च जागरं कृत्वा प्रातः स्नात्वा च सङ्गमे //
text_mt: And one should offer food cooked in clarified butter, and vessels with curd-rice; / and having kept a night-vigil, and having bathed at dawn at a confluence,

sanskrit_iast:
gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ pūjya vadet puṣpāñjalistvidaṃ /
namo namaste govinda budhaśravaṇasañjñita //
meaning:
गन्धपुष्पादिभिः पूज्य वदेत् पुष्पाञ्जलिस्त्विदं /
नमो नमस्ते गोविन्द बुधश्रवणसञ्ज्ञित //
text_mt: having worshipped with perfumes, flowers, and the rest, holding an offering of flowers in folded hands, he should say this: / "Homage, homage to you, Govinda, named Budha-Śravaṇa!

sanskrit_iast:
aghaughasaṅkṣayaṃ kṛtvā sarvasaukhyaprado bhava /
prīyatāndeva deveśa mama nityañjanārdana //
meaning:
अघौघसङ्क्षयं कृत्वा सर्वसौख्यप्रदो भव /
प्रीयतान्देव देवेश मम नित्यञ्जनार्दन //
text_mt: Having destroyed the heap of sins, be the bestower of all happiness! / May you be pleased, O God, Lord of Gods, Janārdana, always toward me!

sanskrit_iast:
vāmano buddhido dātā dravyastho vāmanaḥ svayaṃ /
vāmanaḥ pratigṛhṇāti vāmano me dadāti ca //
meaning:
वामनो बुद्धिदो दाता द्रव्यस्थो वामनः स्वयं /
वामनः प्रतिगृह्णाति वामनो मे ददाति च //
text_mt: Vāmana gives intellect; the giver is himself Vāmana residing within the wealth; / Vāmana accepts [it], and Vāmana gives to me.

sanskrit_iast:
dravyastho vāmano nityaṃ vāmanāya namo namaḥ /
pradattadakṣiṇo viprān sambhojyānnaṃ svayañcaret //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe śravaṇadvādaśīvrataṃ
nāmaikonanavatyadhikaśatatmo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 trailokyajananāyeti jha.. , ña.. ca / trailokyajanakāyeti ṅa.. , ṭa.. ca
:p 220
:ś atha navatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
akhaṇḍadvādaśīvrataṃ
meaning:
द्रव्यस्थो वामनो नित्यं वामनाय नमो नमः /
प्रदत्तदक्षिणो विप्रान् सम्भोज्यान्नं स्वयञ्चरेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे श्रवणद्वादशीव्रतं
नामैकोननवत्यधिकशतत्मो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 त्रैलोक्यजननायेति झ.. , ञ.. च / त्रैलोक्यजनकायेति ङ.. , ट.. च
:प् 220
:श् अथ नवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
अखण्डद्वादशीव्रतं
text_mt:
Vāmana resides constantly within the wealth; homage, homage to Vāmana!" / Having presented the sacrificial fee, having fed the brāhmaṇas, he may himself partake of the food.
Thus, in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the chapter entitled "The Votive Observance of Śravaṇa-dvādaśī", being the one hundred eighty-ninth chapter.
[Footnote]
1 In manuscripts jha and ña: "trailokyajananāya"; in manuscripts ṅa and ṭa: "trailokyajanakāya".
Now, the one hundred ninetieth chapter.
The Votive Observance of Akhaṇḍa-dvādaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ vakṣye vratasampūrṇatākṛtaṃ /
mārgaśīrṣe site viṣṇuṃ dvādaśyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
अखण्डद्वादशीं वक्ष्ये व्रतसम्पूर्णताकृतं /
मार्गशीर्षे सिते विष्णुं द्वादश्यां समुपोषितः //
text_mt: Agni said: / I will proclaim Akhaṇḍa-dvādaśī, which effects the completion of votive observances. / In Mārgaśīrṣa, during the bright [fortnight], fasting completely on the twelfth lunar day,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagavyajale snāto yajettatprāśano vratī /
yavavrīhiyutampātrandvādaśyāṃ hi dvije 'rpayet //
meaning:
पञ्चगव्यजले स्नातो यजेत्तत्प्राशनो व्रती /
यवव्रीहियुतम्पात्रन्द्वादश्यां हि द्विजे ऽर्पयेत् //
text_mt: having bathed in water mixed with the five products of the cow, having consumed them, the observer of the vow should worship Viṣṇu. / On the twelfth lunar day, he should indeed offer a vessel filled with barley and rice to a brāhmaṇa [with the prayer]:

sanskrit_iast:
saptajanmani yat kiñcinmayā khaṇḍaṃ vrataṃ kṛtaṃ /
bhagavaṃstvatprasādena tadakhaṇḍamihāstu me //
meaning:
सप्तजन्मनि यत् किञ्चिन्मया खण्डं व्रतं कृतं /
भगवंस्त्वत्प्रसादेन तदखण्डमिहास्तु मे //
text_mt: "Whatever vow has been broken by me in seven lifetimes, / O Lord, by your grace, may that become unbroken for me in this life.

sanskrit_iast:
yathākhaṇḍaṃ jagat sarvaṃ tvameva puruṣottama /
tathākhilānyakhaṇḍāni vratāni mama santu vai //
meaning:
यथाखण्डं जगत् सर्वं त्वमेव पुरुषोत्तम /
तथाखिलान्यखण्डानि व्रतानि मम सन्तु वै //
text_mt: Just as the entire universe is unbroken, [and] you alone are it, O Puruṣottama, / even so may all my votive observances be unbroken!"

sanskrit_iast:
evamevānumāsañca cāturmāsyo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ /
anyaccaitrādimāseṣu śaktupātrāṇi(1) cārpayet //
meaning:
एवमेवानुमासञ्च चातुर्मास्यो विधिः स्मृतः /
अन्यच्चैत्रादिमासेषु शक्तुपात्राणि(1) चार्पयेत् //
text_mt: In this very manner, month by month, the four-month rite is remembered. / Further, in the months beginning with Caitra, he should also offer vessels of roasted grain flour;

sanskrit_iast:
śrāvaṇādiṣu cārabhya kārttikānteṣu pāraṇaṃ /
saptajanmasu vaikalyaṃ vratānāṃ saphalaṃ kṛte //
meaning:
श्रावणादिषु चारभ्य कार्त्तिकान्तेषु पारणं /
सप्तजन्मसु वैकल्यं व्रतानां सफलं कृते //
text_mt: and the concluding fast-breaking begins in the months starting with Śrāvaṇa and ending with Kārttika. / When it is performed, deficiency of vows across seven lifetimes becomes fruitful;

sanskrit_iast:
āyurārogyasaubhāgyarājyabhogādimāpnuyāt(2) /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe akhaṇḍadvādaśīvrataṃ nāma
navatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 svarṇapātrāṇi iti kha.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
2 agnir uvāca / akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ vakṣye ity ādiḥ,
rājyabhogādimāpnuyādityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
:p 221
:ś athaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
trayodaśīvratāni
meaning:
आयुरारोग्यसौभाग्यराज्यभोगादिमाप्नुयात्(2) /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे अखण्डद्वादशीव्रतं नाम
नवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 स्वर्णपात्राणि इति ख.. , घ.. , ञ.. च
2 अग्निर् उवाच / अखण्डद्वादशीं वक्ष्ये इत्य् आदिः,
राज्यभोगादिमाप्नुयादित्यन्तः पाठः झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 221
:श् अथैकनवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
त्रयोदशीव्रतानि
text_mt:
he will obtain longevity, health, good fortune, the enjoyments of kingship, and the like.
Thus, in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the chapter entitled "The Votive Observance of Akhaṇḍa-dvādaśī", being the one hundred ninetieth chapter.
[Footnote]
1 In manuscripts kha, gha, and ña: "svarṇapātrāṇi".
2 The passage beginning with "agnir uvāca / akhaṇḍadvādaśīṃ vakṣye" and ending with "rājyabhogādimāpnuyāt" is missing in manuscript jha.
Now, the one hundred ninety-first chapter.
The Votive Observances of the Thirteenth Lunar Day.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
trayodaśīvratānīha sarvadāni vadāmi te /
anaṅgena kṛtāmādau vakṣye 'naṅgatrayodaśīṃ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
त्रयोदशीव्रतानीह सर्वदानि वदामि ते /
अनङ्गेन कृतामादौ वक्ष्ये ऽनङ्गत्रयोदशीं //
text_mt: Agni said: / I will proclaim to you the votive observances of the thirteenth lunar day, which bestow everything. / First I will proclaim Anaṅga-trayodaśī, instituted by Anaṅga.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśyāṃ mārgaśīrṣe śukle 'naṅgaṃ haraṃ yajet(1) /
madha samprāśayedrātrau ghṛtahomastilākṣataiḥ //
meaning:
त्रयोदश्यां मार्गशीर्षे शुक्ले ऽनङ्गं हरं यजेत्(1) /
मध सम्प्राशयेद्रात्रौ घृतहोमस्तिलाक्षतैः //
text_mt: On the thirteenth lunar day of the bright fortnight in Mārgaśīrṣa, one should worship Hara as Anaṅga. / At night, he should consume honey; there is a fire oblation of clarified butter with sesame and unbroken rice grains.

sanskrit_iast:
pauṣe yogeśvaraṃ prārcya candanāśī kṛtāhutiḥ /
maheśvaraṃ mauktikāśī māghe 'bhyarcya divaṃ vrajet //
meaning:
पौषे योगेश्वरं प्रार्च्य चन्दनाशी कृताहुतिः /
महेश्वरं मौक्तिकाशी माघे ऽभ्यर्च्य दिवं व्रजेत् //
text_mt: In Pauṣa, having worshipped Yogeśvara, eating sandalwood, having offered oblations; / in Māgha, eating pearl, having worshipped Maheśvara, he goes to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
kākolaṃ prāśya nīraṃ tu(2) phālgune pūjayedvratī /
karpūrāśī svarūpaṃ ca caitre saubhāgyavān bhavet //
meaning:
काकोलं प्राश्य नीरं तु(2) फाल्गुने पूजयेद्व्रती /
कर्पूराशी स्वरूपं च चैत्रे सौभाग्यवान् भवेत् //
text_mt: In Phālguna, consuming the fruit of *kākola* and water, the observer of the vow should worship. / In Caitra, eating camphor, [worshipping] Svarūpa, he will become endowed with good fortune.

sanskrit_iast:
mahārūpantu vaiśākhe yajejjātīphalāśyapi /
lavaṅgāśī jyaiṣṭhadine(3) pradyumnaṃ pūjayed vratī //
meaning:
महारूपन्तु वैशाखे यजेज्जातीफलाश्यपि /
लवङ्गाशी ज्यैष्ठदिने(3) प्रद्युम्नं पूजयेद् व्रती //
text_mt: In Vaiśākha, eating nutmeg, he should worship Mahārūpa. / On the day of Jyaiṣṭha, eating clove, the observer of the vow should worship Pradyumna.

sanskrit_iast:
tilodāśī tathāṣāḍhe umābhartāramarcayet /
śrāvaṇe gandhatoyāśī pūjayecchūlapāṇinaṃ //
meaning:
तिलोदाशी तथाषाढे उमाभर्तारमर्चयेत् /
श्रावणे गन्धतोयाशी पूजयेच्छूलपाणिनं //
text_mt: Likewise, in Āṣāḍha, consuming sesame water, he should worship the husband of Umā. / In Śrāvaṇa, consuming fragrant water, he should worship the Trident-bearer.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyojātaṃ bhādrapade prāśitā gurumarcayet /
suvarṇavāri saṃprāśya āśvine tridaśādhipam //
:n
1 hariṃ yajediti cha.. , ja.. , ña.. ca
2 kākolaṃ prāśya cīnañceti gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. ca
3 jyaiṣṭhamāse īt ga.. , gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. ca
:p 222
meaning:
सद्योजातं भाद्रपदे प्राशिता गुरुमर्चयेत् /
सुवर्णवारि संप्राश्य आश्विने त्रिदशाधिपम् //
:न्
1 हरिं यजेदिति छ.. , ज.. , ञ.. च
2 काकोलं प्राश्य चीनञ्चेति घ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ञ.. च
3 ज्यैष्ठमासे ईत् ग.. , घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 222
text_mt:
In Bhādrapada, eating [the food of the deity] Sadyojāta, he should worship the Guru. / In Āśvina, consuming water touched with gold, [he should worship] the Lord of the Gods.
[Footnote]
1 In manuscripts cha, ja, and ña: "hariṃ yajet".
2 In manuscripts gha, ja, jha, and ña: "kākolaṃ prāśya cīnañca".
3 In manuscripts ga, gha, ṅa, ja, jha, and ña: "jyaiṣṭhamāse".

sanskrit_iast:
viśveśvaraṃ kārttike tu madanāśī yajedvratī /
śivaṃ haimantu varṣānte sañcchādyāmradalena tu //
meaning:
विश्वेश्वरं कार्त्तिके तु मदनाशी यजेद्व्रती /
शिवं हैमन्तु वर्षान्ते सञ्च्छाद्याम्रदलेन तु //
text_mt: In Kārttika, consuming the fruit of the *dhattūra*, the observer of the vow should worship Viśveśvara. / At the end of the year, having covered golden Śiva with mango leaves

sanskrit_iast:
vastreṇa pūjayitvā tu dadyādviprāya gāntathā /
śayanañchatrakalaśān pādukārasabhājanam //
meaning:
वस्त्रेण पूजयित्वा तु दद्याद्विप्राय गान्तथा /
शयनञ्छत्रकलशान् पादुकारसभाजनम् //
text_mt: and having worshipped [him] with cloth, he should give to a brāhmaṇa a cow, / a bed, an umbrella, water pots, sandals, and a vessel of syrup.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśyāṃ site caitre ratiprītiyutaṃ smaran /
aśokākhyaṃ nagaṃ likhya sindūrarajanīmukhaiḥ //
meaning:
त्रयोदश्यां सिते चैत्रे रतिप्रीतियुतं स्मरन् /
अशोकाख्यं नगं लिख्य सिन्दूररजनीमुखैः //
text_mt: On the bright thirteenth lunar day of Caitra, remembering [the god of love] accompanied by Rati and Prīti, / having drawn the tree named Aśoka with red lead, turmeric, and the like,

sanskrit_iast:
avdhaṃ yajettu kāmārthī kāmatrayodaśīvratam /
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe trayodaśī vratāni
nāmaikanavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
caturdaśīvratāni
meaning:
अव्धं यजेत्तु कामार्थी कामत्रयोदशीव्रतम् /
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे त्रयोदशी व्रतानि
नामैकनवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ द्विनवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
चतुर्दशीव्रतानि
text_mt:
one who desires fulfillment of desires should worship for a year the vow of Kāma-trayodaśī.
Thus, in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the chapter entitled "The Votive Observances of the Thirteenth Lunar Day", being the one hundred ninety-first chapter.
Now, the one hundred ninety-second chapter.
The Votive Observances of the Fourteenth Lunar Day.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
vrataṃ vakṣye caturdaśyāṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ(1) /
kārttike tu caturdaśyāṃ nirāhāro yajecchivam //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
व्रतं वक्ष्ये चतुर्दश्यां भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकं(1) /
कार्त्तिके तु चतुर्दश्यां निराहारो यजेच्छिवम् //
text_mt: Agni said: / I will proclaim the votive observance on the fourteenth lunar day, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation. / On the fourteenth lunar day in Kārttika, fasting, one should worship Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
varṣabhogadhanāyuṣmān(2) kurvan śivacaturdaśīm /
mārgaśīrṣe site 'ṣṭābhyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ munivrataḥ //
:n
1 bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu iti kha.. , gha.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca /
bhuktimuktisukhapradamiti ṅa..
2 bhogabalāyuṣmāniti ṅa..
:p 223
meaning:
वर्षभोगधनायुष्मान्(2) कुर्वन् शिवचतुर्दशीम् /
मार्गशीर्षे सिते ऽष्टाभ्यां तृतीयायां मुनिव्रतः //
:न्
1 भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शृणु इति ख.. , घ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च /
भुक्तिमुक्तिसुखप्रदमिति ङ..
2 भोगबलायुष्मानिति ङ..
:प् 223
text_mt:
Performing the Śiva-caturdaśī, he becomes endowed with wealth, longevity, and enjoyment for a year. / In Mārgaśīrṣa, during the bright [fortnight], on the eighth [or] the third lunar day, keeping the vow of a sage,
[Footnote]
1 In manuscripts kha, gha, ja, jha, ña, and ṭa: "bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu".
In manuscript ṅa: "bhuktimuktisukhapradam".
2 In manuscript ṅa: "bhogabalāyuṣmān".

sanskrit_iast:
dvādaśyāṃ vā caturdaśyāṃ phalāhāro yajet suraṃ(1) /
tyaktvā phalāni dadyāttu kurvan phalacaturdaśīṃ //
meaning:
द्वादश्यां वा चतुर्दश्यां फलाहारो यजेत् सुरं(1) /
त्यक्त्वा फलानि दद्यात्तु कुर्वन् फलचतुर्दशीं //
text_mt: or on the twelfth or the fourteenth lunar day, subsisting on fruit, he should worship the god. / Having abstained from fruits, he should give them away, performing the Phala-caturdaśī.

sanskrit_iast:
caturdaśyāṃ mathāṣṭamyāṃ pakṣayoḥśuklakṛṣṇayoḥ /
anaśnan pūjayecchambhuṃ svargyubhayacaturdaśīṃ //
meaning:
चतुर्दश्यां मथाष्टम्यां पक्षयोःशुक्लकृष्णयोः /
अनश्नन् पूजयेच्छम्भुं स्वर्ग्युभयचतुर्दशीं //
text_mt: Moreover, on the fourteenth or on the eighth lunar day in both the bright and dark fortnights, / fasting, he should worship Śambhu, [and] one who observes Ubhaya-caturdaśī goes to heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāntu naktena tathā kṛṣṇacaturdaśīṃ /
iha bhogānavāpnoti paratra ca śubhāṅgatiṃ //
meaning:
कृष्णाष्टम्यान्तु नक्तेन तथा कृष्णचतुर्दशीं /
इह भोगानवाप्नोति परत्र च शुभाङ्गतिं //
text_mt: Taking only a single night-time meal on the eighth of the dark fortnight, and likewise on the fourteenth of the dark fortnight, / he obtains enjoyments in this world, and an auspicious state in the next.

sanskrit_iast:
kārtike ca caturdaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ snānakṛt sukhī /
ārādhite mahendre tu dhvajākārāsu yaṣṭiṣu(2) //
meaning:
कार्तिके च चतुर्दश्यां कृष्णायां स्नानकृत् सुखी /
आराधिते महेन्द्रे तु ध्वजाकारासु यष्टिषु(2) //
text_mt: And on the fourteenth [lunar day] of the dark fortnight in Kārttika, one who bathes becomes happy, / and when Mahendra is worshipped upon flag-shaped poles.

sanskrit_iast:
tataḥ śuklacaturdaśyāmanantaṃ pūjayeddhariṃ /
kṛtvādarbhamayaṃ caiva vāridhānī samanvitaṃ //
meaning:
ततः शुक्लचतुर्दश्यामनन्तं पूजयेद्धरिं /
कृत्वादर्भमयं चैव वारिधानी समन्वितं //
text_mt: Then, on the fourteenth [lunar day] of the bright fortnight, one should worship Hari as Ananta, / fashioning [an image] made of darbha grass, accompanied by a water-vessel.

sanskrit_iast:
śāliprasthasya piṣṭasya pūpanāmnaḥ kṛtasya ca /
ardhaṃ viprāya dātavyamardhamātmani yojayet(3) //
meaning:
शालिप्रस्थस्य पिष्टस्य पूपनाम्नः कृतस्य च /
अर्धं विप्राय दातव्यमर्धमात्मनि योजयेत्(3) //
text_mt: Half of the cake made from a prastha of śāli-rice flour / should be given to a Brahmin, and half one should take for oneself.

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyaṃ saritāṃ cānte kathāṃ kṛtvā(4) hareriti /
anantasaṃsāramahāsamudre magnān samabhyuddhara vāsudeva //
meaning:
कर्तव्यं सरितां चान्ते कथां कृत्वा(4) हरेरिति /
अनन्तसंसारमहासमुद्रे मग्नान् समभ्युद्धर वासुदेव //
text_mt: Having listened to the narrative of Hari at the edge of a river, [one should pray] thus: / 'O Vāsudeva, rescue those who are sunk in the great ocean of endless transmigration!

sanskrit_iast:
anantarūpe viniyojayasva anantarūpāya namo namaste /
anena pūjayitvātha sūtraṃ baddhā tu mantritaṃ //
meaning:
अनन्तरूपे विनियोजयस्व अनन्तरूपाय नमो नमस्ते /
अनेन पूजयित्वाथ सूत्रं बद्धा तु मन्त्रितं //
text_mt: Direct [us] into your endless form; adoration, adoration unto you whose form is infinite!' / Having worshipped with this [mantra], and tying a consecrated thread

sanskrit_iast:
svake kare vā kaṇṭhe vā tvanantavratakṛt sukhī //11//
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe nānācaturdaśīvratāni nāma
dvinavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 yajet svayamiti gha..
2 varṣaṃ bhogadhanāyuṣmānityādiḥ dhvajākārāsu yaṣṭiṣu
ity antaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake nāsti
3 bhojanamiti gha.. , ṅa.. , ja.. , jha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca
4 kathāṃ śrutveti jha..
:p 224
:ś atha trinavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
śivarātrivratam
meaning:
स्वके करे वा कण्ठे वा त्वनन्तव्रतकृत् सुखी //11//
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे नानाचतुर्दशीव्रतानि नाम
द्विनवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 यजेत् स्वयमिति घ..
2 वर्षं भोगधनायुष्मानित्यादिः ध्वजाकारासु यष्टिषु
इत्य् अन्तः पाठः झ.. पुस्तके नास्ति
3 भोजनमिति घ.. , ङ.. , ज.. , झ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
4 कथां श्रुत्वेति झ..
:प् 224
:श् अथ त्रिनवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
शिवरात्रिव्रतम्
text_mt:
upon one's own hand or upon the neck, one who performs the Anantavrata becomes happy. //11
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and ninety-second chapter, entitled 'The Votive Observances of Various Fourteenth Lunar Days'.
[Footnote]
1. 'one should sacrifice oneself' in manuscript gha.
2. The text beginning with 'a year, possessing enjoyment, wealth, and long life' up to 'upon flag-shaped poles' is not found in manuscript jha.
3. 'eating' in manuscripts gha, ṅa, ja, jha, ña, and ṭa.
4. 'having heard the narrative' in manuscript jha.
Now, the one hundred and ninety-third chapter.
The Votive Observance of Śivarātri.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
śivarātrivrataṃ vakṣye bhuktimuktipradaṃ śṛṇu(1) /
māghaphālgunayormadhye kṛṣṇā yā tu caturdaśī //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
शिवरात्रिव्रतं वक्ष्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदं शृणु(1) /
माघफाल्गुनयोर्मध्ये कृष्णा या तु चतुर्दशी //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observance of Śivarātri, which grants worldly enjoyment and liberation; hear! / That which is the fourteenth [lunar day] of the dark fortnight between Māgha and Phālguna,

sanskrit_iast:
kāmayuktā tu sopoṣyā kurvan jāgaraṇaṃ vratī /
śivarātrivrataṃ kurve caturdaśyāmabhojanaṃ //
meaning:
कामयुक्ता तु सोपोष्या कुर्वन् जागरणं व्रती /
शिवरात्रिव्रतं कुर्वे चतुर्दश्यामभोजनं //
text_mt: endowed with desire, that is to be fasted on, while the observer of the vow keeps vigil: / 'I shall perform the votive observance of Śivarātri, abstaining from food on the fourteenth [lunar day].

sanskrit_iast:
rātrijāgaraṇenaiva pūjayāmi śivaṃ vratī /
āvāhayāmyahaṃ śambhuṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakaṃ //
meaning:
रात्रिजागरणेनैव पूजयामि शिवं व्रती /
आवाहयाम्यहं शम्भुं भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकं //
text_mt: Through keeping vigil at night alone, as one observing the vow, I worship Śiva. / I invoke Sambhu, the bestower of worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
narakārṇavakottāranāvaṃ śiva namo 'stu te /
namaḥ śivāya śāntāya prajārājyādidāyine //
meaning:
नरकार्णवकोत्तारनावं शिव नमो ऽस्तु ते /
नमः शिवाय शान्ताय प्रजाराज्यादिदायिने //
text_mt: O Śiva, the boat for crossing over the ocean of hell, homage be to you! / Homage to Śiva, the tranquil one, the giver of offspring, sovereignty, and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
saubhāgyārogyavidyārthasvargamārgapradāyine(2) /
dharmandehi dhanandehi kāmabhogādi dehi me //
meaning:
सौभाग्यारोग्यविद्यार्थस्वर्गमार्गप्रदायिने(2) /
धर्मन्देहि धनन्देहि कामभोगादि देहि मे //
text_mt: to the bestower of good fortune, health, learning, wealth, and the path to heaven! / Grant me righteousness, grant me wealth, grant me desires, enjoyments, and so forth!

sanskrit_iast:
guṇakīrtisukhaṃ dehi svargaṃ mokṣaṃ ca dehi me /
lubdhakaḥ prāptavān puṇyaṃ pāpī sundarasenakaḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe śivarātrivrataṃ nāma trinavatyadhikaśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 bhuktimuktipradāyakamiti jha.. , ṭa.. ca
2 svargamokṣapradāyine iti ṅa..
:p 225
:ś atha caturnavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
aśokapūeṇimādivrataṃ
meaning:
गुणकीर्तिसुखं देहि स्वर्गं मोक्षं च देहि मे /
लुब्धकः प्राप्तवान् पुण्यं पापी सुन्दरसेनकः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे शिवरात्रिव्रतं नाम त्रिनवत्यधिकशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदायकमिति झ.. , ट.. च
2 स्वर्गमोक्षप्रदायिने इति ङ..
:प् 225
:श् अथ चतुर्नवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
अशोकपूएणिमादिव्रतं
text_mt:
Grant me virtues, renown, happiness; grant me heaven and liberation!' / Even the sinful hunter Sundarasenaka attained merit [by this].
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and ninety-third chapter, entitled 'The Votive Observance of Śivarātri'.
[Footnote]
1. 'the bestower of worldly enjoyment and liberation' in manuscripts jha and ṭa.
2. 'to the bestower of heaven and liberation' in manuscript ṅa.
Now, the one hundred and ninety-fourth chapter.
The Votive Observances of Aśokapūrṇimā and Others.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
aśokapūrṇimāṃ vakṣye bhūdharaṃ ca bhuvaṃ yajet /
phālgunyāṃ sitapakṣāyāṃ varṣaṃ syādbhuktimuktibhāk //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
अशोकपूर्णिमां वक्ष्ये भूधरं च भुवं यजेत् /
फाल्गुन्यां सितपक्षायां वर्षं स्याद्भुक्तिमुक्तिभाक् //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall declare [the rite of] Aśokapūrṇimā: one should worship the mountain and the earth / on the full-moon day in the bright fortnight of Phālguna for a year; one comes to share in worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
kārttikyāntu vṛṣotsargaṃ kṛtvā naktaṃ samācaret /
śaivaṃ padamavāpnoti vṛṣavratamidaṃ paraṃ //
meaning:
कार्त्तिक्यान्तु वृषोत्सर्गं कृत्वा नक्तं समाचरेत् /
शैवं पदमवाप्नोति वृषव्रतमिदं परं //
text_mt: On the full-moon day of Kārttika, having performed the setting-free of a bull, one should take food only at night; / one attains the realm of Śiva. This votive observance of the bull is supreme.

sanskrit_iast:
pitryā yāmāvasī tasyāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dattamakṣyaṃ /
upoṣyābdaṃ pitṝniṣṭvā niṣpāpaḥ svargamāpnuyāt //
meaning:
पित्र्या यामावसी तस्यां पितॄणां दत्तमक्ष्यं /
उपोष्याब्दं पितॄनिष्ट्वा निष्पापः स्वर्गमाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: On the new-moon day dedicated to the ancestors, what is given to the ancestors becomes imperishable; / having fasted [on it] for a year and worshipped the ancestors, freed from sin, one attains heaven.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadaśyāṃ ca māghasya pūjyājaṃ sarvamāpnuyāt /
vakṣye sāvitryamāvāsyāmbhuktimuktikarīṃ śubhāṃ //
meaning:
पञ्चदश्यां च माघस्य पूज्याजं सर्वमाप्नुयात् /
वक्ष्ये सावित्र्यमावास्याम्भुक्तिमुक्तिकरीं शुभां //
text_mt: And on the fifteenth [lunar day] of Māgha, by worshipping the Unborn, one attains everything. / I shall declare the auspicious Sāvitryamāvāsyā, which produces worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcadaśyāṃ vratī jyaiṣṭhe vaṭamūle mahāsatīṃ /
trirātropoṣitā nārī saptadhānyaiḥ prapūjayet //
meaning:
पञ्चदश्यां व्रती ज्यैष्ठे वटमूले महासतीं /
त्रिरात्रोपोषिता नारी सप्तधान्यैः प्रपूजयेत् //
text_mt: On the fifteenth [lunar day] in Jyaiṣṭha, at the root of a banyan tree, having fasted for three nights, / a woman observing the vow should worship the great chaste wife [Sāvitrī] with the seven grains,

sanskrit_iast:
prarūḍhaiḥ kaṇṭhasūtraiś ca rajanyāṃ kuṅkumādibhiḥ /
vaṭāvalambanaṃ kṛtvā nṛtyagītaiḥ prabhātake //
meaning:
प्ररूढैः कण्ठसूत्रैश् च रजन्यां कुङ्कुमादिभिः /
वटावलम्बनं कृत्वा नृत्यगीतैः प्रभातके //
text_mt: with sprouted [seeds], neck-cords, and at night with saffron and other [fragrances]. / Having embraced the banyan tree, with dances and songs at dawn,

sanskrit_iast:
namaḥ sāvitryai satyavate naivedyaṃ cārpayed dvije /
veśma gatvā dvijān bhojya svayaṃ bhuktvā visarjayet //
meaning:
नमः सावित्र्यै सत्यवते नैवेद्यं चार्पयेद् द्विजे /
वेश्म गत्वा द्विजान् भोज्य स्वयं भुक्त्वा विसर्जयेत् //
text_mt: one should offer food to a Brahmin with the mantra: 'Homage to Sāvitrī and Satyavat!' / Going home and feeding Brahmins, having eaten oneself, one should dismiss [the goddess]:

sanskrit_iast:
sāvitrī prīyatāṃ devī saubhāgyādikamāpnuyāt //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe tithivratāni nāma caturnavatyadhikataśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:p 226
:ś atha pañcanavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vāravratāni
meaning:
सावित्री प्रीयतां देवी सौभाग्यादिकमाप्नुयात् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे तिथिव्रतानि नाम चतुर्नवत्यधिकतशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:प् 226
:श् अथ पञ्चनवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
वारव्रतानि
text_mt:
'May the goddess Sāvitrī be pleased!' [Thus] she attains good fortune and the like.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and ninety-fourth chapter, entitled 'The Votive Observances of Lunar Days'.
[Page 226]
Now, the one hundred and ninety-fifth chapter.
Votive Observances of the Days of the Week.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
vāravratāni vakṣyāmi bhuktimuktipradāni hi /
karaṃ punarvasuḥ sūrye snāne sarvauṣadhī śubhā //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
वारव्रतानि वक्ष्यामि भुक्तिमुक्तिप्रदानि हि /
करं पुनर्वसुः सूर्ये स्नाने सर्वौषधी शुभा //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observances of the weekdays, which bestow worldly enjoyment and liberation: / When Punarvasu or Hasta falls on a Sunday, bathing with all medicinal herbs is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
śrādhhau cādityavāre tu saptajanmasvarogabhāk /
saṅkrāntau sūryavāro yaḥ so 'rkasya hṛdayaḥ śubhaḥ //
meaning:
श्राध्हौ चादित्यवारे तु सप्तजन्मस्वरोगभाक् /
सङ्क्रान्तौ सूर्यवारो यः सो ऽर्कस्य हृदयः शुभः //
text_mt: And in performing a śrāddha on a Sunday, one becomes free of disease for seven lifetimes. / A Sunday on a planetary transit is the heart of the sun, and is auspicious.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtvā haste sūryavāraṃ naktenābdaṃ sa sarvabhāk /
citrābhasomavārāṇi sapta kṛtvā sukhī bhavet //
meaning:
कृत्वा हस्ते सूर्यवारं नक्तेनाब्दं स सर्वभाक् /
चित्राभसोमवाराणि सप्त कृत्वा सुखी भवेत् //
text_mt: Having observed Sunday [under the asterism] Hasta with food only at night for a year, he enjoys everything; / having observed seven Mondays that coincide with Citrā, one becomes happy.

sanskrit_iast:
svātyāṃ gṛhītvā cāṅgāraṃ saptanaktyārtivarjitaḥ /
viśākhāyāṃ budhaṃ gṛhya saptanaktī grahārtinut //
meaning:
स्वात्यां गृहीत्वा चाङ्गारं सप्तनक्त्यार्तिवर्जितः /
विशाखायां बुधं गृह्य सप्तनक्ती ग्रहार्तिनुत् //
text_mt: Undertaking [the vow of] Tuesday under Svātī, one who eats only at night for seven [such days] is freed from affliction; / undertaking Wednesday under Viśākhā, eating only at night for seven [such days], he dispels afflictions from planets.

sanskrit_iast:
anurādhe devaguruṃ saptanaktī grahārtinut(1) /
śukraṃ jyeṣṭhāsu saṅgṛhya saptanaktī grahārtinut //
meaning:
अनुराधे देवगुरुं सप्तनक्ती ग्रहार्तिनुत्(1) /
शुक्रं ज्येष्ठासु सङ्गृह्य सप्तनक्ती ग्रहार्तिनुत् //
text_mt: Under Anurādhā, [undertaking] Thursday, eating only at night for seven [such days], he dispels afflictions from planets; / undertaking Friday under the Jyeṣṭhās, eating only at night for seven [such days], he dispels afflictions from planets.

sanskrit_iast:
mūle śanaiś caraṃ gṛhya saptanaktī grahārtinut //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe vāravratāni nāma pañcavanatyadhikaśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 anurādhetyādiḥ grahārtinudityantaḥ pāṭhaḥ jha.. pustake
nāsti
:p 227
:ś atha ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
nakṣatravratāni
meaning:
मूले शनैश् चरं गृह्य सप्तनक्ती ग्रहार्तिनुत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे वारव्रतानि नाम पञ्चवनत्यधिकशततमो
ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 अनुराधेत्यादिः ग्रहार्तिनुदित्यन्तः पाठः झ.. पुस्तके
नास्ति
:प् 227
:श् अथ षण्णवत्यधिकशततमो ऽध्यायः
नक्षत्रव्रतानि
text_mt:
Undertaking Saturday under Mūla, eating only at night for seven [such days], he dispels afflictions from planets.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the one hundred and ninety-fifth chapter, entitled 'Votive Observances of the Days of the Week'.
[Footnote]
1. The passage from 'under Anurādhā' up to 'dispels afflictions from planets' is not found in manuscript jha.
Now, the one hundred and ninety-sixth chapter.
Votive Observances of the Asterisms.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
nakṣatravratakaṃ vakṣye bhe hariḥ pūjito 'rthadaḥ(1) /
nakṣatrapuruṣaṃ cādau caitramāse hariṃ yajet //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
नक्षत्रव्रतकं वक्ष्ये भे हरिः पूजितो ऽर्थदः(1) /
नक्षत्रपुरुषं चादौ चैत्रमासे हरिं यजेत् //
text_mt: Agni said: / I shall declare the votive observance of the asterisms; Hari worshipped under an asterism grants desired objects. / First, in the month of Caitra, one should worship Hari as the Nakṣatrapuruṣa.

sanskrit_iast:
mūle pādau yajejjaṅghe rohiṇīsvarcayeddhariṃ /
jānunī cāśvinīyoge āṣāḍhāsūrusañjñake //
meaning:
मूले पादौ यजेज्जङ्घे रोहिणीस्वर्चयेद्धरिं /
जानुनी चाश्विनीयोगे आषाढासूरुसञ्ज्ञके //
text_mt: Under Mūla one should worship the feet; under Rohiṇī one should worship Hari's calves; / and the knees during conjunction with Aśvinī; and under Āṣāḍhā the parts designated as thighs.

sanskrit_iast:
meḍhraṃ pūrvottarāsveva kaṭiṃ vai kṛttikāsu ca /
pārśve bhādrapadābhyāntu kukṣiṃ vai revatīṣu ca //
meaning:
मेढ्रं पूर्वोत्तरास्वेव कटिं वै कृत्तिकासु च /
पार्श्वे भाद्रपदाभ्यान्तु कुक्षिं वै रेवतीषु च //
text_mt: Under Pūrvā- and Uttarā-[phālgunī] the penis, and the waist indeed under Kṛttikā; / the sides under both Bhādrapadās, and the belly indeed under Revatī;

sanskrit_iast:
stanau caivānurādhāsu dhaniṣṭhāsu ca pṛṣṭhakaṃ /
bhujau pūjyau viśākhāsu punarvasvaṅgulīryajet //
meaning:
स्तनौ चैवानुराधासु धनिष्ठासु च पृष्ठकं /
भुजौ पूज्यौ विशाखासु पुनर्वस्वङ्गुलीर्यजेत् //
text_mt: the breasts under Anurādhā, and the back under Dhaniṣṭhā; / the two arms are to be worshipped under Viśākhā, and one should worship the fingers under Punarvasu.

sanskrit_iast:
aśleṣāsu nakhān pūjya kaṇṭhaṃ jyeṣṭhāsu pūjayet /
śrotre viṣṇoś ca śravaṇe mukhaṃ puṣye hareryajet //
meaning:
अश्लेषासु नखान् पूज्य कण्ठं ज्येष्ठासु पूजयेत् /
श्रोत्रे विष्णोश् च श्रवणे मुखं पुष्ये हरेर्यजेत् //
text_mt: Having worshipped the nails under Āśleṣā, one should worship the neck under Jyeṣṭhā; / the two ears of Viṣṇu under Śravaṇa, and one should worship Hari's mouth under Puṣya.

sanskrit_iast:
yajet svātiṣu dantāgramāsyaṃ vāruṇato 'rcayet /
maghāsu nasāṃ nayane mṛgaśīrṣe lalāṭakaṃ //
meaning:
यजेत् स्वातिषु दन्ताग्रमास्यं वारुणतो ऽर्चयेत् /
मघासु नसां नयने मृगशीर्षे ललाटकं //
text_mt: One should worship the tip of the teeth under Svātī; one should worship the face under Śatabhiṣaj; / under Maghā the nose; the forehead in the eyes, under Mṛgaśīrṣa [the forehead];

sanskrit_iast:
citrāsu cārdrāsu kacānabdānte svarṇakaṃ hariṃ /
guḍapūrṇe ghaṭe 'bhyarcya śayyāgorthādi dakṣiṇā(2) //
meaning:
चित्रासु चार्द्रासु कचानब्दान्ते स्वर्णकं हरिं /
गुडपूर्णे घटे ऽभ्यर्च्य शय्यागोर्थादि दक्षिणा(2) //
text_mt: and the hair under Citrā and Ārdrā. At the end of the year, having worshipped a golden Hari / in a jar filled with raw sugar, a bed, a cow, wealth, and the like are the sacrificial fee.

sanskrit_iast:
nakṣatrapuruṣo viṣṇuḥ pūjanīyaḥ śivātmakaḥ /
:n
1 hariḥ sarvatra pūjita iti ga..
2 śayyāgoścādi dakṣiṇā iti kha.. , ṭa.. ca / śayyāgonnādi
dakṣiṇā iti gha.. , ña.. , ja.. ca / śayyādhenvādi sakṣikā iti ṅa..
:p 228
śāmbhavāyanīyavratakṛnmāsabhe pūjayeddhariṃ //
meaning:
नक्षत्रपुरुषो विष्णुः पूजनीयः शिवात्मकः /
:न्
1 हरिः सर्वत्र पूजित इति ग..
2 शय्यागोश्चादि दक्षिणा इति ख.. , ट.. च / शय्यागोन्नादि
दक्षिणा इति घ.. , ञ.. , ज.. च / शय्याधेन्वादि सक्षिका इति ङ..
:प् 228
शाम्भवायनीयव्रतकृन्मासभे पूजयेद्धरिं //
text_mt:
Viṣṇu, identical with Śiva, should be worshipped as the Nakṣatrapuruṣa.
[Footnote]
1. 'Hari is worshipped everywhere' in ga.
2. 'A bed, a cow, clothing, etc., as sacrificial fee' in kha and ṭa; 'a bed, a cow, food, etc., as sacrificial fee' in gha, ña, and ja; 'a bed, a milch cow, etc., with witnesses' in ṅa. / [Page 228]
One performing the Śāmbhavāyanīya votive observance should worship Hari on the day of the asterism corresponding to the month:

sanskrit_iast:
kārttike kṛttikāyāṃ ca mṛgaśīrṣe mṛgāsyake /
nāmabhiḥ keśavādyaistu acyutāya namo 'pi vā //
meaning:
कार्त्तिके कृत्तिकायां च मृगशीर्षे मृगास्यके /
नामभिः केशवाद्यैस्तु अच्युताय नमो ऽपि वा //
text_mt:
in Kārttika under Kṛttikā, and in Mārgaśīrṣa under Mṛgaśīrṣa,
with names beginning with Keśava, or with ‘Obeisance to Acyuta.’

sanskrit_iast:
kārttike kṛttikābhe 'hni māsanakṣatragaṃ hariṃ /
śāmbhavāyanīyavratakaṃ kariṣye bhuktimuktidaṃ //
meaning:
कार्त्तिके कृत्तिकाभे ऽह्नि मासनक्षत्रगं हरिं /
शाम्भवायनीयव्रतकं करिष्ये भुक्तिमुक्तिदं //
text_mt:
‘In Kārttika, on the day of the Kṛttikā asterism, Hari stationed in the asterism of the month
I shall worship; I shall perform the Śāmbhavāyanīya votive observance granting worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
keśavādi mahāmūrtimacyutaṃ sarvadāyakaṃ(1) /
āvāhayāmyahandevamāyurārogyavṛddhidaṃ //
meaning:
केशवादि महामूर्तिमच्युतं सर्वदायकं(1) /
