पितृभ्यां यस्य यद्दत्तं तत्तस्यैव धनं भवेत् /
पितुरूर्ध्वं विभजतां माताप्यंशं समं हरेत् //
text_mt: Whatever is given to someone by the parents shall belong to that person alone; / among those dividing after the father, the mother also should take an equal share.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃskṛtāstu saṃskāryā bhrātṛbhiḥ pūrvasaṃskṛtaiḥ /
bhāginyaś ca nijādaṃśāddatvāṃśantu turīyakaṃ //
meaning:
असंस्कृतास्तु संस्कार्या भ्रातृभिः पूर्वसंस्कृतैः /
भागिन्यश् च निजादंशाद्दत्वांशन्तु तुरीयकं //
text_mt: Uninitiated [brothers] are to be initiated by the brothers who have already been initiated, / and sisters [are provided for] by each giving a fourth share from their own share.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥstridvyekabhāgāḥ syurvarṇaśo brāhmaṇātmajāḥ /
kṣatrajāstridvyekabhāgā viḍjāstu dvyekabhāginaḥ //
meaning:
चतुःस्त्रिद्व्येकभागाः स्युर्वर्णशो ब्राह्मणात्मजाः /
क्षत्रजास्त्रिद्व्येकभागा विड्जास्तु द्व्येकभागिनः //
text_mt: Sons of a Brāhmaṇa according to caste shall have four, three, two, and one shares; / sons born of a Kṣatriyā shall have three, two, and one shares; while those born of a Vaiśyā shall have two and one shares.

sanskrit_iast:
anyonyāpahṛtaṃ dravyaṃ vibhakte yattu dṛśyate /
tat punaste samair aṃśair vibhajeranniti sthitiḥ //
meaning:
अन्योन्यापहृतं द्रव्यं विभक्ते यत्तु दृश्यते /
तत् पुनस्ते समैर् अंशैर् विभजेरन्निति स्थितिः //
text_mt: Property concealed from one another that is discovered after partition / they should divide again among themselves in equal shares; this is the established rule.

sanskrit_iast:
aputreṇa parakṣetre niyogotpāditaḥ sutaḥ /
ubhayorapyasāvṛkthī piṇḍadātā ca dharmataḥ //
meaning:
अपुत्रेण परक्षेत्रे नियोगोत्पादितः सुतः /
उभयोरप्यसावृक्थी पिण्डदाता च धर्मतः //
text_mt: A son begotten through appointment (niyoga) by a sonless man upon another's wife / is lawfully an heir and an offerer of the funeral cake (piṇḍa) to both men.

sanskrit_iast:
auraso dharmapatnījastatsamaḥ putrikāsutaḥ /
kṣetrajaḥ kṣetrajātastu sagotreṇetareṇa vā //
meaning:
औरसो धर्मपत्नीजस्तत्समः पुत्रिकासुतः /
क्षेत्रजः क्षेत्रजातस्तु सगोत्रेणेतरेण वा //
text_mt: The son born of a lawful wife is the aurasa (body-born), and equal to him is the son of an appointed daughter; / the kṣetraja (field-born) is one begotten on the wife by a man of the same family or by another.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhe pracchanna utpanno gūḍhajastu sutaḥ smṛtaḥ /
kānīnaḥ kanyakājāto mātāmahasuto mataḥ //
meaning:
गृहे प्रच्छन्न उत्पन्नो गूढजस्तु सुतः स्मृतः /
कानीनः कन्यकाजातो मातामहसुतो मतः //
text_mt: A son born secretly in the house is considered a gūḍhaja (secretly-born); / the kānīna (maiden-born) is born of an unmarried girl and is regarded as the son of the maternal grandfather.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣatāyāmakṣatāyāṃ vā jātaḥ paunarbhavaḥ sutaḥ /
dadyānmātā pitā vā yaṃ sa putrī dattako bhavet //
:p 422
meaning:
क्षतायामक्षतायां वा जातः पौनर्भवः सुतः /
दद्यान्माता पिता वा यं स पुत्री दत्तको भवेत् //
:प् 422
text_mt:
A son born of a woman whose marriage has or has not been consummated is a paunarbhava (son of a remarried woman); / he whom the mother or father gives becomes an adopted son (dattaka).
[Page 422]

sanskrit_iast:
krītaś ca tābhyāṃ vikrītaḥ kṛtrimaḥ syāt svyaṃ kṛtaḥ /
dattātmā tu svayaṃ datto garbhe vittaḥ sahoḍhajaḥ //
meaning:
क्रीतश् च ताभ्यां विक्रीतः कृत्रिमः स्यात् स्व्यं कृतः /
दत्तात्मा तु स्वयं दत्तो गर्भे वित्तः सहोढजः //
text_mt: A bought son (krīta) is one sold by both parents; an artificial son (kṛtrima) is one made by oneself; / a self-given son (dattātmā) is one who gives himself; one received while in the womb is a sahoḍhaja.

sanskrit_iast:
utsṛṣṭo gṛhyate yastu sopaviddho bhavet sutaḥ /
piṇḍado 'ṃśaharaś caiṣāṃ pūrvābhāve paraḥ paraḥ //
meaning:
उत्सृष्टो गृह्यते यस्तु सोपविद्धो भवेत् सुतः /
पिण्डदो ऽंशहरश् चैषां पूर्वाभावे परः परः //
text_mt: One who is abandoned and taken in becomes an apaviddha (cast-off) son; / each subsequent one among these offers the funeral cake and takes a share only in the absence of the preceding.

sanskrit_iast:
sajātīyeṣvayaṃ proktastanayeṣu mayā vidhiḥ /
jāto 'pi dāsyāṃ śūdrasya kāmato 'ṃśaharo bhavet //
meaning:
सजातीयेष्वयं प्रोक्तस्तनयेषु मया विधिः /
जातो ऽपि दास्यां शूद्रस्य कामतो ऽंशहरो भवेत् //
text_mt: This rule has been declared by me in respect of sons belonging to the same caste. / Even a son born to a Śūdra by a female slave may take a share at [the father's] pleasure.

sanskrit_iast:
mṛte pitari kuryustaṃ bhrātarastvardhabhāgikaṃ /
abhrātṛko haret sarvaṃ duhitṝṇāṃ sutādṛte //
meaning:
मृते पितरि कुर्युस्तं भ्रातरस्त्वर्धभागिकं /
अभ्रातृको हरेत् सर्वं दुहितॄणां सुतादृते //
text_mt: When the father is dead, the brothers should allot him half a share; / if he has no brothers, he may take the whole, except when there are sons of daughters.

sanskrit_iast:
patnī duhitaraś caiva pitaro bhrātaras tathā /
tatsuto gotrajo bandhuḥ śiṣyaḥ sabrahmacāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
पत्नी दुहितरश् चैव पितरो भ्रातरस् तथा /
तत्सुतो गोत्रजो बन्धुः शिष्यः सब्रह्मचारिणः //
text_mt: The wife, daughters, parents, brothers, / their sons, agnates (gotraja), cognates (bandhu), a pupil, and fellow students—

sanskrit_iast:
eṣāmabhāve pūvasya dhanabhāguttarottaraḥ /
svaryātsya hy aputrasya sarvavarṇeṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ //
meaning:
एषामभावे पूवस्य धनभागुत्तरोत्तरः /
स्वर्यात्स्य ह्य् अपुत्रस्य सर्ववर्णेष्वयं विधिः //
text_mt: in the absence of each preceding one, the next in order inherits the property / of a deceased man who has gone to heaven leaving no son; this is the rule for all castes.

sanskrit_iast:
vānaprasthayatibrahmacāriṇāmṛkthabhāginaḥ /
krameṇācāryasacchiṣyadharmabhrātrekatīrthinaḥ //
meaning:
वानप्रस्थयतिब्रह्मचारिणामृक्थभागिनः /
क्रमेणाचार्यसच्छिष्यधर्मभ्रात्रेकतीर्थिनः //
text_mt: The inheritors of the estate of a forest hermit (vānaprastha), an ascetic (yati), and a student (brahmacārin) / are, in order, the teacher, the virtuous pupil, and a spiritual brother belonging to the same hermitage.

sanskrit_iast:
saṃsṛṣṭinastu saṃsṛṣṭī sodarasya tu sodaraḥ /
dadyāccāpahereccāṃśaṃ jātasya ca mṛtasya ca //
meaning:
संसृष्टिनस्तु संसृष्टी सोदरस्य तु सोदरः /
दद्याच्चापहेरेच्चांशं जातस्य च मृतस्य च //
text_mt: A reunited coparcener belongs to a reunited coparcener, and a full brother to a full brother; / [a coparcener] should give a share to one born and take the share of one deceased.

sanskrit_iast:
anyodaryastu saṃsṛṣṭī nānyodaryadhanaṃ haret /
asaṃsṛṣtyapi cādadyātsodaryo nānyamānṛjaḥ //
meaning:
अन्योदर्यस्तु संसृष्टी नान्योदर्यधनं हरेत् /
असंसृष्त्यपि चादद्यात्सोदर्यो नान्यमानृजः //
text_mt: A half-brother who is reunited does not take the wealth of a half-brother; / even if unreunited, a full brother should take it, but not a son born of another mother.

sanskrit_iast:
patitastatsutaḥ klīvaḥ paṅgurunmattako jaḍaḥ /
andho 'cikitsyarogādyā bhartavyāstu niraṃśakāḥ //
meaning:
पतितस्तत्सुतः क्लीवः पङ्गुरुन्मत्तको जडः /
अन्धो ऽचिकित्स्यरोगाद्या भर्तव्यास्तु निरंशकाः //
text_mt: An outcaste and his son, a eunuch, a lame man, a madman, an idiot, / a blind man, and those afflicted with incurable diseases are shareless, but must be maintained.

sanskrit_iast:
aurasāḥ kṣetrajāstveṣāṃ nirdoṣā bhāgahāriṇaḥ /
sutāś caiṣāṃ prabhartavyā yāvadvai bhartṛsātkṛtāḥ //
meaning:
औरसाः क्षेत्रजास्त्वेषां निर्दोषा भागहारिणः /
सुताश् चैषां प्रभर्तव्या यावद्वै भर्तृसात्कृताः //
text_mt: However, their body-born (aurasa) and field-born (kṣetraja) sons who are free from defect are entitled to shares, / and their daughters must be maintained until they are given away to husbands.

sanskrit_iast:
aputrā yoṣitaś caiṣāṃ bhartavyāḥ sādhuvṛttayaḥ /
:p 423
nirvāsyā vyabhicāriṇyaḥ pratikūlāstathaiva ca //
meaning:
अपुत्रा योषितश् चैषां भर्तव्याः साधुवृत्तयः /
:प् 423
निर्वास्या व्यभिचारिण्यः प्रतिकूलास्तथैव च //

sanskrit_iast:
pitṛmātṛpatibhrātṛdattamadhyagnyupāgataṃ /
ādhivedanikuñcaiva strīdhanaṃ parikīrtitaṃ //
meaning:
पितृमातृपतिभ्रातृदत्तमध्यग्न्युपागतं /
आधिवेदनिकुञ्चैव स्त्रीधनं परिकीर्तितं //
text_mt: What is given by father, mother, husband, or brother, what is received before the nuptial fire, / and the gift on supersession (ādhivedanika)—this is declared to be woman's property (strīdhana).

sanskrit_iast:
bandhudattaṃ tathā śulkamanvādheyakameva ca /
aprajāyāmatītāyāṃ bāndhavāstadavāpnuyuḥ //
meaning:
बन्धुदत्तं तथा शुल्कमन्वाधेयकमेव च /
अप्रजायामतीतायां बान्धवास्तदवाप्नुयुः //
text_mt: Likewise, a gift from relatives, the bride-price (śulka), and the post-marital gift (anvādheyaka)— / if she dies without offspring, her relatives shall obtain it.

sanskrit_iast:
aprajāstrīdhanaṃ bhratturbrāhmyādiṣu caturṣvapi /
duhitṛṇāṃ prasūtā cecchreṣe tu pitṛgāmi tat //
meaning:
अप्रजास्त्रीधनं भ्रत्तुर्ब्राह्म्यादिषु चतुर्ष्वपि /
दुहितृणां प्रसूता चेच्छ्रेषे तु पितृगामि तत् //
text_mt: The property of a woman dying without offspring goes to the husband in the first four forms of marriage beginning with Brāhma; / if she has offspring, it belongs to the daughters; in the remaining forms, it goes to the father.

sanskrit_iast:
datvā kanyāṃ haran daṇḍyo vyayaṃ dadyācca sodayam /
mṛtāyāṃ dattamādadyāt pariśodhyobhayavyayam //
meaning:
दत्वा कन्यां हरन् दण्ड्यो व्ययं दद्याच्च सोदयम् /
मृतायां दत्तमादद्यात् परिशोध्योभयव्ययम् //
text_mt: One who takes back a girl after giving her away should be punished and must pay the expenses with interest; / if she dies, he may take back what was given after deducting the expenses incurred by both sides.

sanskrit_iast:
durbhikṣe dharmakārye ca vyādhau saṃpratirodhake /
gṛhītaṃ strīdhanaṃ bhartā na striye dātumarhati //
meaning:
दुर्भिक्षे धर्मकार्ये च व्याधौ संप्रतिरोधके /
गृहीतं स्त्रीधनं भर्ता न स्त्रिये दातुमर्हति //
text_mt: In famine, for religious acts, in sickness, or during confinement under arrest, / a husband who has taken woman's property is not obliged to return it to the woman.

sanskrit_iast:
adhivittastriyai dadyādadhivedanikaṃ samam /
na dattaṃ srīdhanaṃ yasyai datte tvardhaṃ prakīrtitam //
meaning:
अधिवित्तस्त्रियै दद्यादधिवेदनिकं समम् /
न दत्तं स्रीधनं यस्यै दत्ते त्वर्धं प्रकीर्तितम् //
text_mt: To a superseded wife, [the husband] should give an equal amount as the supersession compensation / if no woman's property was given to her; but if it was given, half of that amount is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
vibhāganihnave jñātibandhusākṣyabhilekhitaiḥ /
vibhāgabhāvanā jñeyā gṛhakṣetraiś ca yautikaiḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe dāyavibhāgo nāma
pañcapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:p 424
:ś atha ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
sīmāvivādādinirṇayaḥ
meaning:
विभागनिह्नवे ज्ञातिबन्धुसाक्ष्यभिलेखितैः /
विभागभावना ज्ञेया गृहक्षेत्रैश् च यौतिकैः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे दायविभागो नाम
पञ्चपञ्चाशदधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:प् 424
:श् अथ षट्पञ्चाशदधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः
सीमाविवादादिनिर्णयः
text_mt:
When partition is denied, knowledge of partition is to be ascertained through kinsmen, relatives, witnesses, documents, / and separately held houses and lands.
Thus ends the two hundred and fifty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Partition of Inheritance', in the great Agni Purāṇa.
[Page 424]
Now begins the two hundred and fifty-sixth chapter:
Settlement of Boundary Disputes and Related Matters.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
sīmno vivāde kṣetrasya sāmantāḥ sthavirā gaṇāḥ /
gopāḥ sīmākṛṣāṇā ye sarve ca vanagocarāḥ //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
सीम्नो विवादे क्षेत्रस्य सामन्ताः स्थविरा गणाः /
गोपाः सीमाकृषाणा ये सर्वे च वनगोचराः //
text_mt: Agni said: / In a dispute over the boundary of a field, neighboring landholders, elderly men, corporations, / cowherds, cultivators working on the boundary, and all forest dwellers

sanskrit_iast:
nayeyurete sīmānaṃ sthalāṅgāratuṣadrumaiḥ /
setuvalmīkanimnāsthicaityādyair upalakṣitām //
meaning:
नयेयुरेते सीमानं स्थलाङ्गारतुषद्रुमैः /
सेतुवल्मीकनिम्नास्थिचैत्याद्यैर् उपलक्षिताम् //
text_mt: should trace the boundary marked out by mounds, charcoal, chaff, trees, / dikes, anthills, depressions, bones, sacred trees, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
sāmantā vā samaṃgrāmāś catvāro 'ṣṭau daśāpi vā(1) /
raktasragvasanāḥ sīmānnayeyuḥ kṣitidhāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
सामन्ता वा समंग्रामाश् चत्वारो ऽष्टौ दशापि वा(1) /
रक्तस्रग्वसनाः सीमान्नयेयुः क्षितिधारिणः //
text_mt: Or the neighboring residents of the village—four, eight, or even ten— / wearing red garlands and garments, bearing earth, should determine the boundary.

sanskrit_iast:
anṛte tu pṛthagdaṇḍyā rājñā madhyamasāhasam /
abhāve jñātṛcihnānāṃ rājā sīmnaḥ pravattakaḥ //
meaning:
अनृते तु पृथग्दण्ड्या राज्ञा मध्यमसाहसम् /
अभावे ज्ञातृचिह्नानां राजा सीम्नः प्रवत्तकः //
text_mt: If they speak falsely, however, they are to be punished individually by the king with the middle fine for violence; / in the absence of witnesses and markers, the king shall establish the boundary.

sanskrit_iast:
ārāmāyatanagrāmanipānodyānaveśmasu /
eṣa eva vidhirjñeyo varṣāmvupravaheṣu ca //
meaning:
आरामायतनग्रामनिपानोद्यानवेश्मसु /
एष एव विधिर्ज्ञेयो वर्षाम्वुप्रवहेषु च //
text_mt: In disputes concerning groves, temples, villages, watering stations, pleasure gardens, houses, / and the courses of rainwater runoffs, this very same rule is to be observed.

sanskrit_iast:
maryādāyāḥ prabhedeṣu kṣetrasya haraṇe tathā /
maryādāyāś ca daṇḍyāḥ syuradhamottamamadhyamāḥ //
meaning:
मर्यादायाः प्रभेदेषु क्षेत्रस्य हरणे तथा /
मर्यादायाश् च दण्ड्याः स्युरधमोत्तममध्यमाः //
text_mt: In breaking boundary marks and likewise in seizing a field / or boundary, they should be fined the lowest, highest, and middle fines.

sanskrit_iast:
na niṣedhyo 'lpabādhastu setuḥ kalyāṇakārakaḥ /
parabhūmiṃ haran kūpaḥ svalpakṣetro bahūdakaḥ //
meaning:
न निषेध्यो ऽल्पबाधस्तु सेतुः कल्याणकारकः /
परभूमिं हरन् कूपः स्वल्पक्षेत्रो बहूदकः //
text_mt: A dam that causes little injury but brings welfare should not be prohibited, / nor a well encroaching on another's land that occupies little ground but yields abundant water.

sanskrit_iast:
svāmine yo 'nivedyaiva kṣetre setuṃ prakalpayet /
utpanne svāmino bhogastadabhāve mahīpateḥ //
meaning:
स्वामिने यो ऽनिवेद्यैव क्षेत्रे सेतुं प्रकल्पयेत् /
उत्पन्ने स्वामिनो भोगस्तदभावे महीपतेः //
text_mt: If someone builds a dam on a field without informing the owner, / when it yields produce, the enjoyment belongs to the owner; in his absence, to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
phālāhatamapi kṣetraṃ yo na kuryānna kārayet /
:n
1 catvāro 'tha daśāpi veti kha.. , ga.. , ña.. ca
:p 425
sa pradāpyo 'kṛṣṭaphalaṃ kṣetramanyena kārayet //
meaning:
फालाहतमपि क्षेत्रं यो न कुर्यान्न कारयेत् /
:न्
1 चत्वारो ऽथ दशापि वेति ख.. , ग.. , ञ.. च
:प् 425
स प्रदाप्यो ऽकृष्टफलं क्षेत्रमन्येन कारयेत् //
text_mt:
If a man neither cultivates nor causes to be cultivated a field that has even been touched by the plow,
[Note]
1. 'catvāro 'tha daśāpi vā' in manuscripts kha, ga, and ña. / [Page 425]
he should be made to pay the value of the unharvested produce, and the field should be caused to be tilled by another.

sanskrit_iast:
māsānaṣṭau tu mahiṣī satyaghātasya kāriṇī /
daṇḍanīyā tadardhantu gaustadardhamajāvikaṃ //
meaning:
मासानष्टौ तु महिषी सत्यघातस्य कारिणी /
दण्डनीया तदर्धन्तु गौस्तदर्धमजाविकं //
text_mt: A female buffalo destroying standing crops should be fined eight māṣas; / a cow half of that; and a goat or sheep half of that again.

sanskrit_iast:
bhakṣayitvopaviṣṭānāṃ yathoktād dviguṇo damaḥ /
samameṣāṃ vivītepi svarāṣṭraṃ mahiṣīsamam //
meaning:
भक्षयित्वोपविष्टानां यथोक्ताद् द्विगुणो दमः /
सममेषां विवीतेपि स्वराष्ट्रं महिषीसमम् //
text_mt: For animals that sit down after eating, the fine is twice what has been stated; / the fine is the same for them in an enclosed pasture; an ass or a camel is treated like a female buffalo.

sanskrit_iast:
yāvat satyaṃ vinaṣṭantu tāvat kṣetrī phalaṃ labhet /
pālastāḍyo 'tha gosvāmī pūrvoktaṃ daṇḍamarhati //
meaning:
यावत् सत्यं विनष्टन्तु तावत् क्षेत्री फलं लभेत् /
पालस्ताड्यो ऽथ गोस्वामी पूर्वोक्तं दण्डमर्हति //
text_mt: The field owner should receive produce equal to the crop that was destroyed; / the herdsman should be flogged, while the owner of the cattle deserves the aforementioned fine.

sanskrit_iast:
pathi grāmavivītānte kṣetre doṣo na vidyate /
akāmataḥ kāmacāre cauravaddaṇḍamarhati //
meaning:
पथि ग्रामविवीतान्ते क्षेत्रे दोषो न विद्यते /
अकामतः कामचारे चौरवद्दण्डमर्हति //
text_mt: No fault attaches to damage on a path, near a village, or at the edge of pastureland / done unintentionally; but if wandering at will, [the owner] deserves punishment like a thief.

sanskrit_iast:
mahotkṣotsṛṣṭapaśavaḥ sūtikāgantukā ca gauḥ /
pālo yeṣāntu mocyā daivarājapariplutāḥ //
meaning:
महोत्क्षोत्सृष्टपशवः सूतिकागन्तुका च गौः /
पालो येषान्तु मोच्या दैवराजपरिप्लुताः //
text_mt: A breeding bull, dedicated cattle, a cow recently calved, a stray animal, / and those afflicted by an act of God or the king are to be released, even if they have a keeper.

sanskrit_iast:
yathārpitān paśūn gopoḥ sāyaṃ pratyarpayettathā /
pramādamṛtanaṣṭāṃś ca pradāpyaḥ kṛtavetanaḥ //
meaning:
यथार्पितान् पशून् गोपोः सायं प्रत्यर्पयेत्तथा /
प्रमादमृतनष्टांश् च प्रदाप्यः कृतवेतनः //
text_mt: A cowherd must return the cattle in the evening just as they were entrusted to him; / if any die or are lost through his negligence, he who receives wages must be made to replace them.

sanskrit_iast:
pāladoṣavināśe tu pāle daṇḍo vidhīyate /
ardhatrayodaśapaṇaḥ svāmino dravyameva ca //
meaning:
पालदोषविनाशे तु पाले दण्डो विधीयते /
अर्धत्रयोदशपणः स्वामिनो द्रव्यमेव च //
text_mt: If loss occurs through the keeper's fault, a fine is prescribed for the keeper / amounting to twelve and a half paṇas, and he must restore the animal itself to the owner.

sanskrit_iast:
grāmecchayā gopracāro bhūmirājavaśena vā /
dvijastṛṇaidhaḥpuṣpāṇi sarvataḥ svavadāharet //
meaning:
ग्रामेच्छया गोप्रचारो भूमिराजवशेन वा /
द्विजस्तृणैधःपुष्पाणि सर्वतः स्ववदाहरेत् //
text_mt: Pastureland for cows depends on the wish of the village or the authority of the king. / A twice-born man may take grass, firewood, and flowers from anywhere as if they were his own.

sanskrit_iast:
dhanuḥśataṃ parīṇāho grāmakṣetrāntaraṃ bhavet /
dve śate kharvaṭasya syānnagarasya catuḥśatam //
meaning:
धनुःशतं परीणाहो ग्रामक्षेत्रान्तरं भवेत् /
द्वे शते खर्वटस्य स्यान्नगरस्य चतुःशतम् //
text_mt: The intervening space between a village and fields should be an extent of one hundred bows; / it should be two hundred bows for a market town (kharvaṭa), and four hundred for a city.

sanskrit_iast:
svaṃ labhetānyavikrītaṃ kreturdoṣo 'prakāśite /
hīnādraho hīnamūlye velāhīne ca taskaraḥ //
meaning:
स्वं लभेतान्यविक्रीतं क्रेतुर्दोषो ऽप्रकाशिते /
हीनाद्रहो हीनमूल्ये वेलाहीने च तस्करः //
text_mt: One may recover one's property sold by another; fault attaches to the buyer in a secret purchase: / from a disreputable person, in secret, at an inadequate price, or at an unseasonable time, he is deemed a thief.

sanskrit_iast:
naṣṭāpahṛtamāsādya hartāraṃ grāhayennaram /
deśakālātipattau vā gṛhītvā svayamarpayet //
:p 426
meaning:
नष्टापहृतमासाद्य हर्तारं ग्राहयेन्नरम् /
देशकालातिपत्तौ वा गृहीत्वा स्वयमर्पयेत् //
:प् 426
text_mt:
Having found lost or stolen property, a man should cause the thief to be arrested; / or, if prevented by considerations of place and time, he may seize him himself and deliver him.
[Page 426]

sanskrit_iast:
vikreturdarśanācchuddhiḥ svāmī dravyaṃ nṛpo damam /
kretā mūlyaṃ samāpnoti tasmādyastatra vikrayī //
meaning:
विक्रेतुर्दर्शनाच्छुद्धिः स्वामी द्रव्यं नृपो दमम् /
क्रेता मूल्यं समाप्नोति तस्माद्यस्तत्र विक्रयी //
text_mt: By producing the seller, the buyer's clearance is effected; the owner recovers his property, and the king [imposes] a fine. / The buyer receives back his purchase price from whoever was the seller there.

sanskrit_iast:
āgamenopabhogena naṣṭaṃ bhāvyamato 'nyathā /
pañcabandho damastasya rājñe tenāpyabhāvite //
meaning:
आगमेनोपभोगेन नष्टं भाव्यमतो ऽन्यथा /
पञ्चबन्धो दमस्तस्य राज्ञे तेनाप्यभाविते //
text_mt: Lost property must be established through legal acquisition and enjoyment; otherwise, / if it is not so established, he incurs a fine of one-fifth to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
hṛtaṃ pranaṣṭaṃ yo dravyaṃ parahastādavāpnuyāt /
anivedya nṛpe daṇḍyaḥ sa tu ṣannayatiṃ paṇān //
meaning:
हृतं प्रनष्टं यो द्रव्यं परहस्तादवाप्नुयात् /
अनिवेद्य नृपे दण्ड्यः स तु षन्नयतिं पणान् //
text_mt: One who recovers lost or stolen property from another's hand / without reporting it to the king, however, should be fined ninety-six paṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
śaulkikaiḥ sthānapālair vā naṣṭāpahṛtamāhṛtaṃ /
arvāk saṃvatsarāt svāmī labhate parato nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
शौल्किकैः स्थानपालैर् वा नष्टापहृतमाहृतं /
अर्वाक् संवत्सरात् स्वामी लभते परतो नृपः //
text_mt: Lost or stolen property brought in by toll-collectors or guards of the post, / the owner receives within a year; after that, it belongs to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
paṇānekaśaphe dadyāccaturaḥ pañca mānuṣe /
mahiṣoṣṭragavāṃ dvau dvau pādaṃ pādamajāvike //
meaning:
पणानेकशफे दद्याच्चतुरः पञ्च मानुषे /
महिषोष्ट्रगवां द्वौ द्वौ पादं पादमजाविके //
text_mt: He should give [as salvage fee] four paṇas for a single-hoofed animal, five for a human, / two each for buffaloes, camels, and cattle, and a quarter of a paṇa each for goats and sheep.

sanskrit_iast:
svakuṭumbāvirodhena deyaṃ dārasutādṛte /
nānvaye sati sarvasvaṃ deyaṃ yaccānyasaṃśrutam //
meaning:
स्वकुटुम्बाविरोधेन देयं दारसुतादृते /
नान्वये सति सर्वस्वं देयं यच्चान्यसंश्रुतम् //
text_mt: A gift may be made without detriment to one's family, excluding wife and son; / when lineage exists, one's entire property may not be given, nor what has been promised to another.

sanskrit_iast:
pratigrahaḥ prakāśaḥ syāt sthāvarasya viśeṣataḥ /
deyaṃ pratiśrutañcaiva datvā nāpaharet punaḥ //
meaning:
प्रतिग्रहः प्रकाशः स्यात् स्थावरस्य विशेषतः /
देयं प्रतिश्रुतञ्चैव दत्वा नापहरेत् पुनः //
text_mt: Acceptance should be public, especially of immovable property; / what has been promised must indeed be given, and once given, one may not take it back.

sanskrit_iast:
daśaikapañcasaptāhamāsatryahārdhamāsikaṃ /
vījāyovāhyaratnastrīdohyapuṃsāṃ pratīkṣaṇam //
meaning:
दशैकपञ्चसप्ताहमासत्र्यहार्धमासिकं /
वीजायोवाह्यरत्नस्त्रीदोह्यपुंसां प्रतीक्षणम् //
text_mt: The trial period for seeds, iron, beasts of burden, gems, female slaves, / milch cattle, and male slaves is ten days, one day, five, seven, a month, three days, and half a month respectively.

sanskrit_iast:
agnau suvarṇamakṣīṇaṃ dvipalaṃ rajate śate /
aṣṭau trapuṇi sīse ca tāmre pañcadaśāyasi //
meaning:
अग्नौ सुवर्णमक्षीणं द्विपलं रजते शते /
अष्टौ त्रपुणि सीसे च ताम्रे पञ्चदशायसि //
text_mt: Gold suffers no loss in fire; on a hundred [palas] of silver, [loss is] two palas; / on tin and lead, eight; on copper, five; and on iron, ten.

sanskrit_iast:
śate daśapalāvṛddhiraurṇe kārpāsike tathā /
madhye pañcapalā jñeyā sūkṣme tu tripalā matā //
meaning:
शते दशपलावृद्धिरौर्णे कार्पासिके तथा /
मध्ये पञ्चपला ज्ञेया सूक्ष्मे तु त्रिपला मता //
text_mt: An increase of ten palas per hundred is recognized for wool and cotton; / for medium cloth, it should be known as five palas; but for fine, it is considered three palas.

sanskrit_iast:
kārmike romabaddhe ca triṃśadbhāgaḥ kṣayo mataḥ /
na kṣayo na ca vṛddhistu kauśeye valkaleṣu ca //
meaning:
कार्मिके रोमबद्धे च त्रिंशद्भागः क्षयो मतः /
न क्षयो न च वृद्धिस्तु कौशेये वल्कलेषु च //
text_mt: For embroidered cloth and that interwoven with fur, a loss of a thirtieth part is recognized; / but for silk and bark garments there is neither loss nor increase.

sanskrit_iast:
deśaṃ kālañca bhogañca jñātvā naṣṭe balābalam /
:p 427
dravyāṇāṃ kuśalā brūyuryattaddāpyamasaṃśayam //
meaning:
देशं कालञ्च भोगञ्च ज्ञात्वा नष्टे बलाबलम् /
:प् 427
द्रव्याणां कुशला ब्रूयुर्यत्तद्दाप्यमसंशयम् //
text_mt:
Knowing the place, time, and wear, as well as the relative strength in case of destruction,
:p 427
experts in materials shall declare what compensation must be paid beyond doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
balāddāsīkṛtaś caurair vikrītaścāpi mucyate /
svāmiprāṇaprado bhaktatyāgāttanniṣkrayādapi //
meaning:
बलाद्दासीकृतश् चौरैर् विक्रीतश्चापि मुच्यते /
स्वामिप्राणप्रदो भक्तत्यागात्तन्निष्क्रयादपि //
text_mt: One enslaved by force or sold by thieves is released, / as also one who saves his master's life, by relinquishing his maintenance, or through ransom.

sanskrit_iast:
pravrajyāvasito rājño dāsa āmaraṇāntikaḥ /
varṇānāmānulomyena dāsyaṃ na pratilomataḥ //
meaning:
प्रव्रज्यावसितो राज्ञो दास आमरणान्तिकः /
वर्णानामानुलोम्येन दास्यं न प्रतिलोमतः //
text_mt: An apostate from asceticism becomes the king's slave until death; / slavery proceeds in the direct order of the castes, never in the reverse order.

sanskrit_iast:
kṛtaśilpopi nivaset kṛtakālaṃ gurorgṛhe /
antevāsī guruprāptabhojanastratphalaptadaḥ //
meaning:
कृतशिल्पोपि निवसेत् कृतकालं गुरोर्गृहे /
अन्तेवासी गुरुप्राप्तभोजनस्त्रत्फलप्तदः //
text_mt: An apprentice, even having acquired his craft, shall dwell in his teacher's house for the agreed time; / receiving his food from the teacher, he shall deliver the fruit [of his work] there.

sanskrit_iast:
rājā kṛtvā pure sthānaṃ brāhmaṇānnyasya tatra tu /
traividyaṃ vṛttimadbrūyāt svadharmaḥ pālyatāmiti //
meaning:
राजा कृत्वा पुरे स्थानं ब्राह्मणान्न्यस्य तत्र तु /
त्रैविद्यं वृत्तिमद्ब्रूयात् स्वधर्मः पाल्यतामिति //
text_mt: The king, having established a settlement in the city and settled brāhmaṇas there, / endowed with livelihoods and proficient in the three Vedas, should declare: "Let your own duty be maintained."

sanskrit_iast:
nijadharmāvirodhena yastu sāmayiko bhavet /
so 'pi yatnena saṃrakṣyo dharmo rājakṛtaś ca yaḥ //
meaning:
निजधर्माविरोधेन यस्तु सामयिको भवेत् /
सो ऽपि यत्नेन संरक्ष्यो धर्मो राजकृतश् च यः //
text_mt: Whatever conventional rule exists that does not conflict with one's own duty, / that too must be zealously guarded, as also any decree established by the king.

sanskrit_iast:
gaṇadravyaṃ haredyastu saṃvidaṃ laṅghayecca yaḥ /
sarvasvaharaṇaṃ kṛtvā taṃ rāṣṭrādvipravāsayet //
meaning:
गणद्रव्यं हरेद्यस्तु संविदं लङ्घयेच्च यः /
सर्वस्वहरणं कृत्वा तं राष्ट्राद्विप्रवासयेत् //
text_mt: He who steals the property of a corporation or violates an agreement / should be banished from the realm after confiscating all his property.

sanskrit_iast:
kartavyaṃ vacanaṃ sarvaiḥ samūhahitavādibhiḥ /
yastatra viparītaḥ syātsa dāpyaḥ prathamaṃ damam //
meaning:
कर्तव्यं वचनं सर्वैः समूहहितवादिभिः /
यस्तत्र विपरीतः स्यात्स दाप्यः प्रथमं दमम् //
text_mt: The word of those who speak for the welfare of the assembly must be obeyed by all; / he who acts contrary thereto should be made to pay the first fine.

sanskrit_iast:
samūhakāryaprahito yallabhettattadarpayet /
ekādaśaguṇaṃ dāpyo yadyasau nārpayet svayam //
meaning:
समूहकार्यप्रहितो यल्लभेत्तत्तदर्पयेत् /
एकादशगुणं दाप्यो यद्यसौ नार्पयेत् स्वयम् //
text_mt: One dispatched on the business of the assembly shall surrender whatever he acquires; / if he does not surrender it himself, he should be made to pay eleven times as much.

sanskrit_iast:
vedajñāḥ śucayo 'lubdhā bhaveyuḥ kāryacintakāḥ /
kartavyaṃ vacanaṃ teṣāṃ samūhahitavādināṃ //
meaning:
वेदज्ञाः शुचयो ऽलुब्धा भवेयुः कार्यचिन्तकाः /
कर्तव्यं वचनं तेषां समूहहितवादिनां //
text_mt: Those who manage affairs should be knowers of the Vedas, pure, and free from greed; / the word of these who speak for the welfare of the assembly must be obeyed.

sanskrit_iast:
śreṇinaigamapākhaṇḍigaṇānāmapyayaṃ vidhiḥ /
bhedañcaiṣāṃ nṛpo rakṣet pūrvavṛttiñca pālayet //
meaning:
श्रेणिनैगमपाखण्डिगणानामप्ययं विधिः /
भेदञ्चैषां नृपो रक्षेत् पूर्ववृत्तिञ्च पालयेत् //
text_mt: This rule also applies to guilds, mercantile associations, heterodox sects, and corporations; / the king should prevent dissension among them and protect their previous customs.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītavetanaḥ karma tyajan dviguṇamāvahet /
agṛhīte samaṃ dāpyo bhṛtyai rakṣya upaskaraḥ //
:p 428
meaning:
गृहीतवेतनः कर्म त्यजन् द्विगुणमावहेत् /
अगृहीते समं दाप्यो भृत्यै रक्ष्य उपस्करः //
:प् 428
text_mt:
A laborer who has received his wages and abandons the work shall pay twice as much; / if he has not received wages, he should be made to pay an equal amount; implements must be protected by the servants.
:p 428

sanskrit_iast:
dāpyastu daśamaṃ bhāgaṃ bāṇijyapaśusasyataḥ /
aniścitya bhṛtiṃ yastu kārayetsa mahīkṣitā //
meaning:
दाप्यस्तु दशमं भागं बाणिज्यपशुसस्यतः /
अनिश्चित्य भृतिं यस्तु कारयेत्स महीक्षिता //
text_mt: One who employs a worker without fixing the wages, however, / should be made by the king to pay a tenth part of the trade, cattle, or crops.

sanskrit_iast:
deśaṃ kālañca yo 'tīyāt karma kuryācca yo 'nyathā /
tatra tu svāminaśchando 'dhikaṃ deyaṃ kṛte 'dhike //
meaning:
देशं कालञ्च यो ऽतीयात् कर्म कुर्याच्च यो ऽन्यथा /
तत्र तु स्वामिनश्छन्दो ऽधिकं देयं कृते ऽधिके //
text_mt: If someone exceeds the place and time, or performs the work differently, / the master's choice prevails there; more must be given if more work has been done.

sanskrit_iast:
yo yāvat kurute karma tāvattasya tu vetanam /
ubhayorapyasādhyañcet sādhye kuryādyathāśrutam //
meaning:
यो यावत् कुरुते कर्म तावत्तस्य तु वेतनम् /
उभयोरप्यसाध्यञ्चेत् साध्ये कुर्याद्यथाश्रुतम् //
text_mt: Whoever performs work, his wage is commensurate with that much; / if it becomes impossible for both, he should perform what is possible as agreed.

sanskrit_iast:
arājadaivikannaṣṭaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ dāpyastu vāhakaḥ /
prasthānavighnakṛccaiva pradāpyo dviguṇāṃ bhṛtim //
meaning:
अराजदैविकन्नष्टं भाण्डं दाप्यस्तु वाहकः /
प्रस्थानविघ्नकृच्चैव प्रदाप्यो द्विगुणां भृतिम् //
text_mt: A carrier must make good any merchandise lost through causes other than the king or an act of god; / and one who creates an obstacle at the departure must be made to pay double wages.

sanskrit_iast:
prakrānte saptamaṃ bhāgaṃ caturthaṃ pathi saṃtyajan /
bhṛtimardhapathe sarvāṃ pradāpyastyājakoapi ca //
meaning:
प्रक्रान्ते सप्तमं भागं चतुर्थं पथि संत्यजन् /
भृतिमर्धपथे सर्वां प्रदाप्यस्त्याजकोअपि च //
text_mt: One who abandons [the load] at departure shall forfeit a seventh part; along the road, a fourth; / and at the midway point, the whole wage; one who dismisses the carrier must also be made to pay [similarly].

sanskrit_iast:
glahe śatikavṛddhestu sabhikaḥ pañcakaṃ gataṃ /
gṛhṇīyāddhūrtakitavāditarāddaśakaṃ śataṃ //
meaning:
ग्लहे शतिकवृद्धेस्तु सभिकः पञ्चकं गतं /
गृह्णीयाद्धूर्तकितवादितराद्दशकं शतं //
text_mt: On a stake with an increase of a hundred, the keeper of the gambling house may take / five percent from a cunning gambler, and ten percent from another.

sanskrit_iast:
sa samyakpālito dadyādrājñe bhāgaṃ yathākṛtaṃ /
jitamudgrāhayejjetre dadyātsatyaṃ vacaḥ kṣamī //
meaning:
स सम्यक्पालितो दद्याद्राज्ञे भागं यथाकृतं /
जितमुद्ग्राहयेज्जेत्रे दद्यात्सत्यं वचः क्षमी //
text_mt: Protected properly, he should give to the king the share as fixed; / being patient, he should collect the winnings for the winner and speak true words.

sanskrit_iast:
prāpte nṛpatinā bhāge prasiddhe dhūrtamaṇḍale /
jitaṃ saśabhike sthāne dāpayedanyathā na tu //
meaning:
प्राप्ते नृपतिना भागे प्रसिद्धे धूर्तमण्डले /
जितं सशभिके स्थाने दापयेदन्यथा न तु //
text_mt: When the king's share has been received in a recognized circle of gamblers, / he should cause payment of the winnings in a place provided with a gambling house keeper, not otherwise.

sanskrit_iast:
draṣṭāro vyavahārāṇāṃ sākṣiṇaś ca ta eva hi /
rājñā sacihnā nirvāsyāḥ kūṭākṣopadhidevinaḥ //
meaning:
द्रष्टारो व्यवहाराणां साक्षिणश् च त एव हि /
राज्ञा सचिह्ना निर्वास्याः कूटाक्षोपधिदेविनः //
text_mt: They alone are the judges of disputes and the witnesses; / those who gamble with false dice or trickery should be branded and banished by the king.

sanskrit_iast:
dyūtamekamukhaṃ kāryaṃ taskarajñānakāraṇāt /
eṣa eva vidhirjñeyaḥ prāṇidyūte samāhvaye //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe sīmāvivādādinirṇayo nāma
ṣaṭpañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:p 429
:ś atha saptapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vākpāruṣyādiprakaraṇam
meaning:
द्यूतमेकमुखं कार्यं तस्करज्ञानकारणात् /
एष एव विधिर्ज्ञेयः प्राणिद्यूते समाह्वये //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे सीमाविवादादिनिर्णयो नाम
षट्पञ्चाशदधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:प् 429
:श् अथ सप्तपञ्चाशदधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः
वाक्पारुष्यादिप्रकरणम्
text_mt:
Gambling should be centralized under one authority for the purpose of identifying thieves; / this very same rule is to be understood in the betting on living creatures.
Thus in the Great Purāṇa of Agni, the two hundred and fifty-sixth chapter, entitled "The Adjudication of Boundary Disputes and Other Matters."
:p 429
Now, the two hundred and fifty-seventh chapter:
The Section on Verbal Abuse and Related Matters.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
satyāsatyānyathā stotrair nyūnāṅgendriyarogiṇāṃ /
kṣepaṃ karoti ceddaṇḍyaḥ paṇānardhatrayodaśa //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
सत्यासत्यान्यथा स्तोत्रैर् न्यूनाङ्गेन्द्रियरोगिणां /
क्षेपं करोति चेद्दण्ड्यः पणानर्धत्रयोदश //
text_mt: Agni said: / If one insults those defective in limbs, senses, or suffering from diseases, / whether by true, false, or ironical statements, he is punishable with twelve and a half paṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
abhigantāsmi bhaginīmmātaraṃ vā taveti ca /
śapantaṃ dāpayedrājā pañcaviṃśatikaṃ damaṃ //
meaning:
अभिगन्तास्मि भगिनीम्मातरं वा तवेति च /
शपन्तं दापयेद्राजा पञ्चविंशतिकं दमं //
text_mt: And if one swears, "I will violate your sister or your mother," / the king should make him pay a fine of twenty-five [paṇas].

sanskrit_iast:
ardho 'dhameṣu dviguṇaḥ parastrīṣūttameṣu ca /
daṇḍapraṇayanaṃ kāryaṃ varṇajātyuttarādharaiḥ //
meaning:
अर्धो ऽधमेषु द्विगुणः परस्त्रीषूत्तमेषु च /
दण्डप्रणयनं कार्यं वर्णजात्युत्तराधरैः //
text_mt: Half [is the fine] against low persons, double against others' wives and superior persons; / the infliction of punishment should be carried out according to the higher and lower status of castes and classes.

sanskrit_iast:
prātilomyāpavādeṣu dviguṇatriguṇā damāḥ /
varṇānāmānulomyena tasmādevārdhahānitaḥ //
meaning:
प्रातिलोम्यापवादेषु द्विगुणत्रिगुणा दमाः /
वर्णानामानुलोम्येन तस्मादेवार्धहानितः //
text_mt: In defaming against the social order, fines are double and triple; / in the regular order of castes, [they decrease] by half reductions accordingly.

sanskrit_iast:
vāhugrīvānetrasakthivināśe vācike damaḥ /
śatyastato 'rdhikaḥ pādanāsākarṇikarādiṣu //
meaning:
वाहुग्रीवानेत्रसक्थिविनाशे वाचिके दमः /
शत्यस्ततो ऽर्धिकः पादनासाकर्णिकरादिषु //
text_mt: For verbal threat of destroying an arm, neck, eye, or thigh, the fine is / one hundred [paṇas]; half of that in the case of a foot, nose, ear, hand, and so forth.

sanskrit_iast:
aśaktastu vadannevandaṇḍanīyaḥ paṇān daśa /
tathā śaktaḥ pratibhuvaṃ dadyāt kṣemāya tasya tu(1) //
meaning:
अशक्तस्तु वदन्नेवन्दण्डनीयः पणान् दश /
तथा शक्तः प्रतिभुवं दद्यात् क्षेमाय तस्य तु(1) //
text_mt: If incapable [of doing so], one saying such should be fined ten paṇas; / but if capable, he should give a surety for the other's safety.

sanskrit_iast:
patanīyakṛte kṣepe daṇḍī madhyamasāhasaḥ /
upapātakayukte tu dāpyaḥ prathamasāhasaṃ //
meaning:
पतनीयकृते क्षेपे दण्डी मध्यमसाहसः /
उपपातकयुक्ते तु दाप्यः प्रथमसाहसं //
text_mt: For an insult charging a sin causing fall from caste, he incurs the middle fine for violence; / but for one involving a minor sin, he should be made to pay the first fine for violence.

sanskrit_iast:
traividyanṛpadevānāṃ kṣepa uttamasāhasaḥ /
:n
1 dadyādityatra dāpya iti pāṭho bhavituṃ yuktaḥ
:p 430
madhyamo jñātipūgānāṃ prathamo grāmadeśayoḥ //
meaning:
त्रैविद्यनृपदेवानां क्षेप उत्तमसाहसः /
:न्
1 दद्यादित्यत्र दाप्य इति पाठो भवितुं युक्तः
:प् 430
मध्यमो ज्ञातिपूगानां प्रथमो ग्रामदेशयोः //
text_mt:
Insulting those versed in the three Vedas, the king, or the gods warrants the highest fine for violence;
:n
1. In place of dadyāt ("should give"), dāpyaḥ ("should be made to give") seems to be the proper reading. / :p 430
[the fine is] the middle one against kinsmen and caste corporations, and the first against a village or a country.

sanskrit_iast:
asākṣikahate cihnair yuktibhinnāgamena ca /
draṣṭavyo vyavahārastu kūṭacihnakṛtādbhayāt //
meaning:
असाक्षिकहते चिह्नैर् युक्तिभिन्नागमेन च /
द्रष्टव्यो व्यवहारस्तु कूटचिह्नकृताद्भयात् //
text_mt: In a case of battery without witnesses, the suit must be investigated / through signs, circumstantial evidence, and legal title, out of fear of forged marks.

sanskrit_iast:
bhasmapaṅkarajaḥsparśe daṇḍo daśapaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ /
amedhyapārṣṇiniṣṭhyūtasparśane dviguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
भस्मपङ्करजःस्पर्शे दण्डो दशपणः स्मृतः /
अमेध्यपार्ष्णिनिष्ठ्यूतस्पर्शने द्विगुणः स्मृतः //
text_mt: For touching with ashes, mud, or dust, the fine is declared to be ten paṇas; / for touching with unholy substances, the heel, or spittle, it is declared to be double.

sanskrit_iast:
sameṣvevaṃ parastrīṣu dviguṇastūttameṣu ca /
hīneṣvardhaṃ damo mohamadādibhiradaṇḍanam //
meaning:
समेष्वेवं परस्त्रीषु द्विगुणस्तूत्तमेषु च /
हीनेष्वर्धं दमो मोहमदादिभिरदण्डनम् //
text_mt: Such is the rule among equals; it is double against another's wife and superiors, / and half the fine against inferiors; there is no punishment if done through delusion, intoxication, and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
viprapīḍākaraṃ cchedyamaṅgamabrāhmaṇasya tu /
udgūrṇe prathamo daṇḍaḥ saṃsparśe tu tadardhikaḥ //
meaning:
विप्रपीडाकरं च्छेद्यमङ्गमब्राह्मणस्य तु /
उद्गूर्णे प्रथमो दण्डः संस्पर्शे तु तदर्धिकः //
text_mt: The limb of a non-brāhmaṇa that causes injury to a brāhmaṇa should be cut off; / for raising a weapon, the first fine [is prescribed]; but for mere touch, half of that.

sanskrit_iast:
udgūrṇe hastapāde tu daśaviṃśatikau damau /
parasparantu sarveṣāṃ śāstre madhyamasāhasaḥ //
meaning:
उद्गूर्णे हस्तपादे तु दशविंशतिकौ दमौ /
परस्परन्तु सर्वेषां शास्त्रे मध्यमसाहसः //
text_mt: When a hand or a foot is raised [to strike], the fines are ten and twenty [paṇas] respectively; / but among all of them, the middle degree of violence [fine is imposed] for [raising] a weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
pādakeśāṃśukakarolluñcaneṣu paṇān daśa /
pīḍākarṣāṃ śukāveṣṭapādādhyāse śatandamaḥ //
meaning:
पादकेशांशुककरोल्लुञ्चनेषु पणान् दश /
पीडाकर्षां शुकावेष्टपादाध्यासे शतन्दमः //
text_mt: For pulling a foot, hair, clothing, or a hand, ten paṇas [is the fine]; / for inflicting pain by pulling, binding with cloth, or treading on [another’s] foot, the fine is one hundred.

sanskrit_iast:
śoṇitena vinā duḥsvaṅkurvan kāṣṭhādibhirnaraḥ /
dvātriṃśataṃ paṇān(1) dāpyo dviguṇaṃ darśane 'sṛjaḥ //
meaning:
शोणितेन विना दुःस्वङ्कुर्वन् काष्ठादिभिर्नरः /
द्वात्रिंशतं पणान्(1) दाप्यो द्विगुणं दर्शने ऽसृजः //
text_mt: A man causing pain without [shedding] blood by means of wood and the like / must be made to pay thirty-two paṇas, and double that if blood is seen.

sanskrit_iast:
karapādadato bhaṅge cchedane karṇanāsayoḥ /
madhyo daṇḍo vraṇodbhede mṛtakalpahate tathā //
meaning:
करपाददतो भङ्गे च्छेदने कर्णनासयोः /
मध्यो दण्डो व्रणोद्भेदे मृतकल्पहते तथा //
text_mt: In breaking a hand, a foot, or a tooth, in cutting off ears or the nose, / the fine is the middle one; likewise in opening an [healed] ulcer, and in beating [someone] almost to death.

sanskrit_iast:
ceṣṭābhojanavāgrodhe netrādipratibhedane /
kandharābāhusakthyāñca bhaṅge madhyamasāhasaḥ //
meaning:
चेष्टाभोजनवाग्रोधे नेत्रादिप्रतिभेदने /
कन्धराबाहुसक्थ्याञ्च भङ्गे मध्यमसाहसः //
text_mt: For obstructing movement, eating, or speech, for piercing an eye and the like, / and for breaking the neck, an arm, or a thigh, the middle degree of violence [fine is imposed].

sanskrit_iast:
ekaṃ ghnatāṃ bahūnāñca yathoktāddviguṇā damāḥ /
kalahāpahṛtaṃ deyaṃ daṇḍastu dviguṇaḥ smṛtaḥ //
meaning:
एकं घ्नतां बहूनाञ्च यथोक्ताद्द्विगुणा दमाः /
कलहापहृतं देयं दण्डस्तु द्विगुणः स्मृतः //
text_mt: For many [persons] beating a single [person], the fines are double those stated; / that which was snatched away in the brawl must be restored, and the fine is recorded as double [the value].

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhamutpādayedyastu sa samutthānajaṃ vyayam /
:n
1 dvāviṃśatipaṇāmiti kha..
:p 431
dāpyo daṇḍañca yo yasmin kalahe samudāhṛtaḥ //
meaning:
दुःखमुत्पादयेद्यस्तु स समुत्थानजं व्ययम् /
:न्
1 द्वाविंशतिपणामिति ख..
:प् 431
दाप्यो दण्डञ्च यो यस्मिन् कलहे समुदाहृतः //
text_mt:
Whoever causes injury must [pay] the expense arising from recovery,
[Footnote]
1. Manuscript Kha reads: “twenty-two paṇas”. / [Page 431]
and he must be made to pay the fine that is declared for that respective assault.

sanskrit_iast:
tarikaḥ sthalajaṃ śulkaṃ gṛhnan daṇḍyaḥ paṇāndaśa /
brāhmaṇaprātiveśyānāmetadevānimantraṇe //
meaning:
तरिकः स्थलजं शुल्कं गृह्नन् दण्ड्यः पणान्दश /
ब्राह्मणप्रातिवेश्यानामेतदेवानिमन्त्रणे //
text_mt: A ferryman who collects land-tax is to be fined ten paṇas; / this same [fine is prescribed] for not inviting brāhmaṇa neighbours.

sanskrit_iast:
abhighāte tathā bhede cchede buddhyāvapātane /
paṇāndāpyaḥ pañcadaśaviṃśatiṃ tattrayantathā //
meaning:
अभिघाते तथा भेदे च्छेदे बुद्ध्यावपातने /
पणान्दाप्यः पञ्चदशविंशतिं तत्त्रयन्तथा //
text_mt: For striking, piercing, cutting, and intentionally felling [trees], / he should be made to pay paṇas: fifteen, twenty, and then those two combined [i.e. thirty-five], respectively.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥsvotpādigṛhe dravyaṃ kṣipan prāṇaharaṃ tathā /
ṣāḍaśādyaṃ paṇāt dāpyo dvitīyo madhyamandamam //
meaning:
दुःस्वोत्पादिगृहे द्रव्यं क्षिपन् प्राणहरं तथा /
षाडशाद्यं पणात् दाप्यो द्वितीयो मध्यमन्दमम् //
text_mt: One who throws into [another’s] house a substance causing distress, or likewise one that takes life, / should be made to pay sixteen paṇas for the first; for the second, the middle fine.

sanskrit_iast:
duḥkhe ca śoṇitotpāde śākhāṅgacchedane tathā /
daṇḍaḥ kṣudrapaśūnāṃ syāddvipaṇaprabhṛtiḥ kramāt //
meaning:
दुःखे च शोणितोत्पादे शाखाङ्गच्छेदने तथा /
दण्डः क्षुद्रपशूनां स्याद्द्विपणप्रभृतिः क्रमात् //
text_mt: In inflicting pain, causing blood to flow, and cutting off limbs or branches / of small animals, the fine should begin with two paṇas in order.

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgasya cchedane mṛttau madhyamo mūlyameva ca /
mahāpaśūnāmeteṣu sthāneṣu dviguṇā damāḥ //
meaning:
लिङ्गस्य च्छेदने मृत्तौ मध्यमो मूल्यमेव च /
महापशूनामेतेषु स्थानेषु द्विगुणा दमाः //
text_mt: For cutting off the generative organ or causing death, the middle [fine] and the actual value [must be paid]; / in these same cases regarding large animals, the fines are double.

sanskrit_iast:
prarohiśākhināṃ śākhāskandhasarvavidāraṇe /
upajīvyadrumāṇāntu viṃśaterdviguṇā damāḥ(1) //
meaning:
प्ररोहिशाखिनां शाखास्कन्धसर्वविदारणे /
उपजीव्यद्रुमाणान्तु विंशतेर्द्विगुणा दमाः(1) //
text_mt: For breaking branches, the trunk, or the whole of spreading trees, / and [especially] for trees that provide a livelihood, the fines are double twenty [paṇas].

sanskrit_iast:
yaḥ sāhasaṅkārayati sa dāpyo dviguṇandamam /
yastvevamuktvāhaṃ dātā kārayet sa caturguṇam //
meaning:
यः साहसङ्कारयति स दाप्यो द्विगुणन्दमम् /
यस्त्वेवमुक्त्वाहं दाता कारयेत् स चतुर्गुणम् //
text_mt: He who incites an act of violence must be made to pay double the fine; / but he who incites it by saying, “I will pay [the fine],” [must be made to pay] fourfold.

sanskrit_iast:
āryākrośātikramakṛdbhrātṛjāyāprahāradaḥ /
sandiṣṭasyāpradātā ca samudragṛhabhedakaḥ //
meaning:
आर्याक्रोशातिक्रमकृद्भ्रातृजायाप्रहारदः /
सन्दिष्टस्याप्रदाता च समुद्रगृहभेदकः //
text_mt: One who reviles or insults noble persons, one who strikes a brother's wife, / one who does not deliver a entrusted message, one who breaks open a sealed house,

sanskrit_iast:
sāmantakulikādīnāmapakārasya kārakaḥ /
pañcāśatpaṇiko daṇḍa eṣāmiti viniś cayaḥ //
meaning:
सामन्तकुलिकादीनामपकारस्य कारकः /
पञ्चाशत्पणिको दण्ड एषामिति विनिश् चयः //
text_mt: and one who causes harm to neighbours, eminent family heads, and others— / the fine for these is fifty paṇas; this is the settled rule.

sanskrit_iast:
svacchandavidhavāgāmī vikruṣṭe nābhidhāvakaḥ /
akāraṇe ca vikroṣṭā caṇḍālaścottamān spṛśan //
meaning:
स्वच्छन्दविधवागामी विक्रुष्टे नाभिधावकः /
अकारणे च विक्रोष्टा चण्डालश्चोत्तमान् स्पृशन् //
text_mt: One who cohabits with an independent widow, one who does not run to help upon a cry for help, / one who cries out without cause, and a caṇḍāla who touches higher-caste persons,

sanskrit_iast:
śūdraḥ pravrajitānāñca daive paitrye ca bhojakaḥ /
:n
1 prarohiśākhināmityādirviṃśaterdviguṇā damā ity antaḥ
pāṭhaḥ kha.. pustake nāsti
:p 432
ayuktaṃ śapathaṃ kurvannayogyo yogyakarmakṛt //
meaning:
शूद्रः प्रव्रजितानाञ्च दैवे पैत्र्ये च भोजकः /
:न्
1 प्ररोहिशाखिनामित्यादिर्विंशतेर्द्विगुणा दमा इत्य् अन्तः
पाठः ख.. पुस्तके नास्ति
:प् 432
अयुक्तं शपथं कुर्वन्नयोग्यो योग्यकर्मकृत् //
text_mt:
a śūdra who feeds ascetics in rites to the gods or to the ancestors,
[Footnote]
1. The passage from “prarohiśākhinām” to “viṃśaterdviguṇā damāḥ” is absent in manuscript Kha. / [Page 432]
one who takes an improper oath, one who is unqualified but performs a qualified person's duty,

sanskrit_iast:
vṛṣakṣudrapaśūnāñca pūṃstvasya pratighātakṛt /
sādhāraṇasyāpalopī dāsīgarbhavināśakṛt //
meaning:
वृषक्षुद्रपशूनाञ्च पूंस्त्वस्य प्रतिघातकृत् /
साधारणस्यापलोपी दासीगर्भविनाशकृत् //
text_mt: one who destroys the virility of a bull or of small animals, / one who conceals common property, one who causes an abortion in a female slave,

sanskrit_iast:
pitāputrasvasṛbhrātṛdampatyācāryaśiṣyakāḥ /
eṣāmapatitānyonyatyāgī ca śatadaṇḍabhāk //
meaning:
पितापुत्रस्वसृभ्रातृदम्पत्याचार्यशिष्यकाः /
एषामपतितान्योन्यत्यागी च शतदण्डभाक् //
text_mt: and among father, son, sister, brother, husband and wife, or teacher and student, / whoever abandons the other when not fallen [from caste]—shall incur a fine of one hundred [paṇas].

sanskrit_iast:
vasānastrīn paṇān daṇḍyo nejakastu parāṃśukam /
vikrayāvakrayādhānayāciteṣu paṇān daśa //
meaning:
वसानस्त्रीन् पणान् दण्ड्यो नेजकस्तु परांशुकम् /
विक्रयावक्रयाधानयाचितेषु पणान् दश //
text_mt: A washerman who wears another's garment is to be fined three paṇas; / [and for] selling, renting, pawning, or lending it out, ten paṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
tulāśāsanamānānāṃ kūṭakṛnnāṇakasya ca /
ebhiś ca vyavahartā yaḥ sa dāpyo daṇḍamuttamam //
meaning:
तुलाशासनमानानां कूटकृन्नाणकस्य च /
एभिश् च व्यवहर्ता यः स दाप्यो दण्डमुत्तमम् //
text_mt: A maker of false balances, royal edicts, measures, or coins, / and whoever trades with these, must be made to pay the highest fine.

sanskrit_iast:
akūṭaṃ kūṭakaṃ brūte kūṭaṃ yaścāpyakūṭakam /
sa nāṇakaparīkṣī tu dāpyaḥ prathamasāhasam //
meaning:
अकूटं कूटकं ब्रूते कूटं यश्चाप्यकूटकम् /
स नाणकपरीक्षी तु दाप्यः प्रथमसाहसम् //
text_mt: An examiner of coins who declares what is genuine to be counterfeit, or what is counterfeit to be genuine, / must be made to pay the first degree of violence [fine].

sanskrit_iast:
bhiṣaṅmithyācaran dāpyastiryakṣu prathamaṃ damam /
mānuṣe madhyamaṃ rājamānuṣeṣūttamantathā //
meaning:
भिषङ्मिथ्याचरन् दाप्यस्तिर्यक्षु प्रथमं दमम् /
मानुषे मध्यमं राजमानुषेषूत्तमन्तथा //
text_mt: A physician acting improperly must be made to pay the first fine in the case of animals, / the middle one in the case of human beings, and the highest in the case of royal officials.

sanskrit_iast:
abadhyaṃ yaś ca badhnāti badhyaṃ yaś ca pramuñcati /
aprāptavyavahārañca sa dāpyo damamuttamam //
meaning:
अबध्यं यश् च बध्नाति बध्यं यश् च प्रमुञ्चति /
अप्राप्तव्यवहारञ्च स दाप्यो दममुत्तमम् //
text_mt: He who binds one who should not be bound, and he who releases one who should be bound, / or [he who prosecutes] one who has not reached legal maturity, must be made to pay the highest fine.

sanskrit_iast:
mānena tulayā vāpi yo 'ṃśamaṣṭamakaṃ haret /
dvāviṃśatipaṇān dāpyo vṛddhau hānau ca kalpitam //
meaning:
मानेन तुलया वापि यो ऽंशमष्टमकं हरेत् /
द्वाविंशतिपणान् दाप्यो वृद्धौ हानौ च कल्पितम् //
text_mt: Whoever takes away an eighth part by [false] measure or balance / must be made to pay twenty-two paṇas; [the fine] is determined in proportion to the increase or decrease.

sanskrit_iast:
bheṣajasnehalavaṇagandhānyaguḍādiṣu /
paṇyeṣu prakṣipan hīnaṃ paṇāndāpyastu ṣoḍaśa //
meaning:
भेषजस्नेहलवणगन्धान्यगुडादिषु /
पण्येषु प्रक्षिपन् हीनं पणान्दाप्यस्तु षोडश //
text_mt: In the case of commodities such as medicine, oil, salt, perfumes, corn, and molasses, / one who throws in inferior [substances] must be made to pay sixteen paṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
sambhūya kurvatāmarghaṃ sabādhaṃ kāruśilpināṃ /
arthasya hrāsaḥ vṛddhiṃ vā sahasro daṇḍa ucyate //
meaning:
सम्भूय कुर्वतामर्घं सबाधं कारुशिल्पिनां /
अर्थस्य ह्रासः वृद्धिं वा सहस्रो दण्ड उच्यते //
text_mt: For artisans and craftsmen who conspire together to fix a obstructing price / that causes the diminution or inflation of goods, a fine of one thousand is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
rājāni sthāpyate yo 'rthaḥ pratyahaṃ tena vikrayaḥ /
krayo vā nisravastasmādbaṇijāṃ lābhakṛt smṛtaḥ //
:p 433
meaning:
राजानि स्थाप्यते यो ऽर्थः प्रत्यहं तेन विक्रयः /
क्रयो वा निस्रवस्तस्माद्बणिजां लाभकृत् स्मृतः //
:प् 433
text_mt:
The value that is fixed daily by the king—by that the selling / or purchasing should proceed; the profit remaining from that is recorded as the merchant's gain.
[Page 433]

sanskrit_iast:
svadeśapaṇye tu śataṃ baṇij gṛhṇīta pañcakaṃ /
daśakaṃ pāradeśye tu yaḥ sadyaḥ krayavikrayau //
meaning:
स्वदेशपण्ये तु शतं बणिज् गृह्णीत पञ्चकं /
दशकं पारदेश्ये तु यः सद्यः क्रयविक्रयौ //
text_mt: On merchandise of one's own country, the merchant may take five percent, / but ten percent on foreign goods, when purchase and sale are immediate.

sanskrit_iast:
paṇyasyopari saṃsthāpya vyayaṃ paṇyasamudbhavaṃ /
artho 'nugrahakṛt kāryaḥ kreturvikretureva ca //
meaning:
पण्यस्योपरि संस्थाप्य व्ययं पण्यसमुद्भवं /
अर्थो ऽनुग्रहकृत् कार्यः क्रेतुर्विक्रेतुरेव च //
text_mt: Adding onto the commodity the expenses arising from the commodity, / a price beneficial to both buyer and seller should be fixed.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītamūlyaṃ yaḥ paṇyaṃ kreturnaiva prayacchati /
sodayantasya dāpyo 'sau diglābhaṃ vā digāgate //
meaning:
गृहीतमूल्यं यः पण्यं क्रेतुर्नैव प्रयच्छति /
सोदयन्तस्य दाप्यो ऽसौ दिग्लाभं वा दिगागते //
text_mt: He who does not deliver the merchandise to the buyer after receiving the payment / must be made to deliver it to him with interest, or with the foreign profit if it has arrived from another country.

sanskrit_iast:
vikrītamapi vikreyaṃ pūrve kretaryagṛhṇati /
hāniścet kretṛdoṣeṇa kretureva hi sā bhavet //
meaning:
विक्रीतमपि विक्रेयं पूर्वे क्रेतर्यगृह्णति /
हानिश्चेत् क्रेतृदोषेण क्रेतुरेव हि सा भवेत् //
text_mt: Even if sold, [the goods] may be resold if the first buyer does not accept [them]; / if loss occurs through the fault of the buyer, that loss indeed falls upon the buyer alone.

sanskrit_iast:
rājadaivopaghātena paṇye doṣamupāgate /
hānirvikreturevāsau yācitasyāprayacchataḥ //
meaning:
राजदैवोपघातेन पण्ये दोषमुपागते /
हानिर्विक्रेतुरेवासौ याचितस्याप्रयच्छतः //
text_mt: When a defect occurs in a commodity through royal or divine accident, / that loss belongs to the seller alone if he did not deliver it when demanded.

sanskrit_iast:
anyahaste ca vikrītaṃ duṣṭaṃ vā duṣṭavadyadi /
vikrīnīte damastatra tanmūlyādadviguṇo bhavet //
meaning:
अन्यहस्ते च विक्रीतं दुष्टं वा दुष्टवद्यदि /
विक्रीनीते दमस्तत्र तन्मूल्यादद्विगुणो भवेत् //
text_mt: If one sells into another's hand what has already been sold, or sells a defective item as non-defective, / the fine in that case should be double its value.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣayaṃ vṛddhiñca baṇijā paṇyānāmavijānatā /
krītvā nānuśayaḥ kāryaḥ kurvan ṣaḍ bhāgadaṇḍabhāk //
meaning:
क्षयं वृद्धिञ्च बणिजा पण्यानामविजानता /
क्रीत्वा नानुशयः कार्यः कुर्वन् षड् भागदण्डभाक् //
text_mt: A merchant who does not know the rise and fall [in value] of commodities / should not entertain regret after buying; if he does, he incurs a fine of the sixth share.

sanskrit_iast:
samavāyena baṇijāṃ lābhārthaṃ karma kurvatāṃ /
labhālābhau yathā dravyaṃ yathā vā saṃvidā kṛtau //
meaning:
समवायेन बणिजां लाभार्थं कर्म कुर्वतां /
लभालाभौ यथा द्रव्यं यथा वा संविदा कृतौ //
text_mt: For merchants carrying on business in partnership for the sake of profit, / the gain and loss are in proportion to the capital or as agreed by contract.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣiddhamanādiṣṭaṃ pramādādyacca nāśitaṃ /
sa taddayādvipravācca rakṣitāddaśamāṃśabhāk //
meaning:
प्रतिषिद्धमनादिष्टं प्रमादाद्यच्च नाशितं /
स तद्दयाद्विप्रवाच्च रक्षिताद्दशमांशभाक् //
text_mt: What is destroyed through negligence, forbidden, or unauthorised, / he must make good; and from what is preserved against danger he is entitled to a tenth share.

sanskrit_iast:
arthaprekṣapaṇādviṃśaṃ bhāgaṃ śulkaṃ nṛpā haret /
vyāsiddhaṃ rājayogyañca vikrītaṃ rājagāmi tat //
meaning:
अर्थप्रेक्षपणाद्विंशं भागं शुल्कं नृपा हरेत् /
व्यासिद्धं राजयोग्यञ्च विक्रीतं राजगामि तत् //
text_mt: The king should take a twentieth share as toll upon inspecting the value [of the goods]; / that which is prohibited and that which is fit for the king, if sold, shall go to the king.

sanskrit_iast:
mithyā vadan parīmāṇaṃ śulkasthānādapakraman /
dāpyastvaṣṭaguṇaṃ yaś ca savyājakrayavikrayau //
meaning:
मिथ्या वदन् परीमाणं शुल्कस्थानादपक्रमन् /
दाप्यस्त्वष्टगुणं यश् च सव्याजक्रयविक्रयौ //
text_mt: One who states a false measurement or evades the toll-house, / and whoever makes a fraudulent purchase or sale, must be made to pay eight times [the toll].

sanskrit_iast:
deśantaragate prete dravyaṃ dāyādabāndhavāḥ /
:p 434
jñātayo vā hareyustadāgatāstair vinā nṛpaḥ //
meaning:
देशन्तरगते प्रेते द्रव्यं दायादबान्धवाः /
:प् 434
ज्ञातयो वा हरेयुस्तदागतास्तैर् विना नृपः //
text_mt:
When [a person] has died while in another country, heirs, relatives,
[Page 434]
or kinsmen who have arrived may take that property; in their absence, the king [takes it].

sanskrit_iast:
jihmaṃ tyajeyurnirlobhamaśakto 'nyena kārayet /
anena vidhirākhyāta ṛtvikkarṣakarmiṇāṃ //
meaning:
जिह्मं त्यजेयुर्निर्लोभमशक्तो ऽन्येन कारयेत् /
अनेन विधिराख्यात ऋत्विक्कर्षकर्मिणां //
text_mt: [Partners] may abandon a dishonest member without giving him profit; one unable [to work] may have it done by another; / by this, the rule for officiating priests, cultivators, and artisans is declared.

sanskrit_iast:
grāhakair gṛhyate cauro loptreṇātha padena vā /
pūrvakarmāparādhī vā tathaivāśuddhavāsakaḥ //
meaning:
ग्राहकैर् गृह्यते चौरो लोप्त्रेणाथ पदेन वा /
पूर्वकर्मापराधी वा तथैवाशुद्धवासकः //
text_mt: A thief is caught by arresting officers either by the stolen goods or by footprints, / or by being an offender in past actions, or likewise by living in an impure manner.

sanskrit_iast:
anye 'pi śaṅkayā grāhyā jātināmādinihnavaiḥ /
dyūtastrīpānaśaktāś ca śuṣkabhinnamukhasvarāḥ //
meaning:
अन्ये ऽपि शङ्कया ग्राह्या जातिनामादिनिह्नवैः /
द्यूतस्त्रीपानशक्ताश् च शुष्कभिन्नमुखस्वराः //
text_mt: Others also may be seized on suspicion by their concealing their caste, name, and the like, / by their addiction to gambling, women, and drink, and by having a dry or broken face and voice,

sanskrit_iast:
paradravyagṛhāṇāñca pṛcchakā gūḍhacāriṇaḥ /
nirāyā vyayavantaś ca vinaṣṭa dravyavikrayāḥ //
meaning:
परद्रव्यगृहाणाञ्च पृच्छका गूढचारिणः /
निराया व्ययवन्तश् च विनष्ट द्रव्यविक्रयाः //
text_mt: by inquiring into the wealth and houses of others, moving about secretly, / spending without having income, and selling lost or stolen articles.

sanskrit_iast:
gṛhītaḥ śaṅkayā cauryenātmānañcedviśodhayet /
dāpayitvā hṛtaṃ dravyaṃ cauradaṇḍena daṇḍayet //
meaning:
गृहीतः शङ्कया चौर्येनात्मानञ्चेद्विशोधयेत् /
दापयित्वा हृतं द्रव्यं चौरदण्डेन दण्डयेत् //
text_mt: If one seized on suspicion of theft does not clear himself, / having made him restore the stolen property, [the king] should punish him with the punishment for a thief.

sanskrit_iast:
cauraṃ pradāpyāpahṛtaṃ ghātayedvividhair budhaiḥ /
sacihnaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kṛtvā svarāṣṭrādvipravāsayet //
meaning:
चौरं प्रदाप्यापहृतं घातयेद्विविधैर् बुधैः /
सचिह्नं ब्राह्मणं कृत्वा स्वराष्ट्राद्विप्रवासयेत् //
text_mt: Having made the thief restore what was stolen, [the king] should have him executed by various [means deemed fit by] the wise. / Having branded a brāhmaṇa with a mark, he should banish him from his kingdom.

sanskrit_iast:
ghātite 'pahṛte doṣo grāmabharturanirgate /
svasīmni dadyādgrāmastu padaṃ vā yatra gacchati //
meaning:
घातिते ऽपहृते दोषो ग्रामभर्तुरनिर्गते /
स्वसीम्नि दद्याद्ग्रामस्तु पदं वा यत्र गच्छति //
text_mt: If [someone] is killed or [property] stolen without having left [the village], the fault belongs to the village head. / But the village must make it good within its own boundary, or wherever the footprint leads.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcagrāmī vahiḥ krośāddaśagrāmya.atha vā punaḥ /
vandigrāhāṃs tathā vājikuñjarāṇāñca hāriṇaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चग्रामी वहिः क्रोशाद्दशग्राम्य.अथ वा पुनः /
वन्दिग्राहांस् तथा वाजिकुञ्जराणाञ्च हारिणः //
text_mt: Beyond a krośa, a group of five villages [is responsible], or again a group of ten villages. / So too, kidnappers of prisoners and those who steal horses and elephants,

sanskrit_iast:
prasahya ghātinaś caiva śūlamāropayennarān /
utkṣepakagranthibhedau karasandaṃśahīnakau //
meaning:
प्रसह्य घातिनश् चैव शूलमारोपयेन्नरान् /
उत्क्षेपकग्रन्थिभेदौ करसन्दंशहीनकौ //
text_mt: And men who kill by violence, he should impale on a stake. / A pickpocket and a cutpurse should have their thumb and index finger cut off;

sanskrit_iast:
kāryau dvitīyāparādhe karapādaikahīnakau /
bhaktāvakāśāgnyudakamantrāpakaraṇavyayān //
meaning:
कार्यौ द्वितीयापराधे करपादैकहीनकौ /
भक्तावकाशाग्न्युदकमन्त्रापकरणव्ययान् //
text_mt: For a second offence, they are to be deprived of one hand and one foot. / He who provides food, shelter, fire, water, counsel, implements, or expense money

sanskrit_iast:
dattvā caurasya hanturvā jānato dama uttamaḥ /
śastrāvapāte garbhasya pātane cottamo damaḥ //
:p 435
meaning:
दत्त्वा चौरस्य हन्तुर्वा जानतो दम उत्तमः /
शस्त्रावपाते गर्भस्य पातने चोत्तमो दमः //
:प् 435
text_mt:
To a thief or a murderer, knowing [who they are], incurs the highest fine. / For striking with a weapon, and for causing an abortion, the fine is also the highest.
[Page 435]

sanskrit_iast:
uttamo vādhamo vāpi puruṣastrīpramāpaṇe /
śilāṃ baddhvā kṣipedapsu naraghnīṃ viṣadāṃ striyaṃ //
meaning:
उत्तमो वाधमो वापि पुरुषस्त्रीप्रमापणे /
शिलां बद्ध्वा क्षिपेदप्सु नरघ्नीं विषदां स्त्रियं //
text_mt: Whether the highest or the lowest [fine applies] in the killing of a man or a woman. / Tying a stone [to her], one should cast into the water a woman who has murdered a man or administered poison.

sanskrit_iast:
viṣāgnidāṃ nijagurunijāpatyapramāpaṇīṃ /
vikarṇakaranāsauṣṭhīṃ kṛtvā gobhiḥ pramāpayet //
meaning:
विषाग्निदां निजगुरुनिजापत्यप्रमापणीं /
विकर्णकरनासौष्ठीं कृत्वा गोभिः प्रमापयेत् //
text_mt: A woman who administers poison or sets fire, or who murders her own elders or her own offspring, / he should deprive of ears, hands, nose, and lips, and cause to be killed by cattle.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣetraveśmavanagrāmavivītakhaladāhakāḥ /
rājapatny abhigāmī ca dagdhavyāstu kaṭāgninā //
meaning:
क्षेत्रवेश्मवनग्रामविवीतखलदाहकाः /
राजपत्न्य् अभिगामी च दग्धव्यास्तु कटाग्निना //
text_mt: Those who burn fields, houses, forests, villages, pastures, and threshing-floors, / and one who approaches the king's wife, are to be burned with a straw fire.

sanskrit_iast:
pumān saṃgrahaṇe grāhyaḥ keśākeśiparastriyāḥ /
svajātāvuttamo daṇḍa ānulomye tu madhyamaḥ //
meaning:
पुमान् संग्रहणे ग्राह्यः केशाकेशिपरस्त्रियाः /
स्वजातावुत्तमो दण्ड आनुलोम्ये तु मध्यमः //
text_mt: A man is caught in adultery by hair-pulling with another's wife. / In [the case of woman of] one's own caste, the punishment is the highest [fine]; but with a woman of a lower caste, it is the middle [fine].

sanskrit_iast:
prātilomye badhaḥ puṃsāṃ nāryāḥ karṇāvakartanam /
nīvīstanaprāvaraṇanābhikeśāvamardanam //
meaning:
प्रातिलोम्ये बधः पुंसां नार्याः कर्णावकर्तनम् /
नीवीस्तनप्रावरणनाभिकेशावमर्दनम् //
text_mt: In the inverse order of castes, there is death for men, and cutting off the ears for a woman. / Touching the waist-knot, breasts, upper garment, navel, or hair,

sanskrit_iast:
adeśakālasambhāṣaṃ sahāvasthānameva ca /
strī niṣedhe śataṃ dadyād dviśatantu damaṃ pumān //
meaning:
अदेशकालसम्भाषं सहावस्थानमेव च /
स्त्री निषेधे शतं दद्याद् द्विशतन्तु दमं पुमान् //
text_mt: Conversing at an unseasonable time or place, and staying together— / if forbidden [to do so], the woman should pay a fine of one hundred [paṇas], and the man two hundred.

sanskrit_iast:
pratiṣedhe tayordaṇḍo yathā saṃgrahaṇe tathā /
paśūn gacchaṃśchataṃ dāpyo hīnāṃ strīṃ gāś ca madhyamam //
meaning:
प्रतिषेधे तयोर्दण्डो यथा संग्रहणे तथा /
पशून् गच्छंश्छतं दाप्यो हीनां स्त्रीं गाश् च मध्यमम् //
text_mt: If forbidden by both, the punishment is the same as for adultery. / One who has intercourse with animals should be made to pay one hundred [paṇas]; with a low-caste woman or a cow, the middle [fine].

sanskrit_iast:
avaruddhāsu dāsīṣu bhujiṣyāsu tathaiva ca /
gamyāsvapi pumāndāpyaḥ pañcāśat paṇikandamam //
meaning:
अवरुद्धासु दासीषु भुजिष्यासु तथैव च /
गम्यास्वपि पुमान्दाप्यः पञ्चाशत् पणिकन्दमम् //
text_mt: With kept female slaves, and likewise with female servants, / even if accessible, a man should be made to pay a fine of fifty paṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
prasahya dāsyabhigame daṇḍo daśapaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ /
kubandhenāṅkya gamayedantyāpravrajitāgame //
meaning:
प्रसह्य दास्यभिगमे दण्डो दशपणः स्मृतः /
कुबन्धेनाङ्क्य गमयेदन्त्याप्रव्रजितागमे //
text_mt: For forcibly approaching a female slave, a fine of ten paṇas is prescribed. / If one approaches a woman of the lowest caste or a female ascetic, [the king] should banish him after branding him with an ignominious mark.

sanskrit_iast:
nyūnaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi likhedyo rājaśāsanam /
pāradārikacauraṃ vā muñcato daṇḍa uttamaḥ //
meaning:
न्यूनं वाप्यधिकं वापि लिखेद्यो राजशासनम् /
पारदारिकचौरं वा मुञ्चतो दण्ड उत्तमः //
text_mt: He who writes a royal edict with less or more [than ordered], / or releases an adulterer or a thief, incurs the highest fine.

sanskrit_iast:
abhakṣair dūṣayan vipraṃ daṇḍa uttamasāhasam /
kūṭasvarṇavyavahārī vimāṃsasya ca vikrayī //
meaning:
अभक्षैर् दूषयन् विप्रं दण्ड उत्तमसाहसम् /
कूटस्वर्णव्यवहारी विमांसस्य च विक्रयी //
text_mt: Defiling a brāhmaṇa with uneatables incurs the fine of the highest degree of violence. / A dealer in counterfeit gold and a seller of forbidden meat

sanskrit_iast:
aṅgahīnaś ca kartavyo dāpyaścottamasāhasaṃ /
:p 436
śakto hy amokṣayan svāmī daṃṣṭriṇaḥ śṛṅgiṇas tathā //
meaning:
अङ्गहीनश् च कर्तव्यो दाप्यश्चोत्तमसाहसं /
:प् 436
शक्तो ह्य् अमोक्षयन् स्वामी दंष्ट्रिणः शृङ्गिणस् तथा //
text_mt:
Should be mutilated of a limb and made to pay the highest fine.
[Page 436]
An owner, though capable, who does not restrain an animal with tusks or horns,

sanskrit_iast:
prathamaṃ sāhasaṃ dadyādvikruṣṭe dviguṇaṃ tathā /
acaurañcaure 'bhivadan dāpyaḥ pañcaśataṃ damaṃ //
meaning:
प्रथमं साहसं दद्याद्विक्रुष्टे द्विगुणं तथा /
अचौरञ्चौरे ऽभिवदन् दाप्यः पञ्चशतं दमं //
text_mt: Should pay the first degree of violence; and twice as much if a cry for help was raised. / Accusing a non-thief of being a thief, one should be made to pay a fine of five hundred [paṇas].

sanskrit_iast:
rājño 'niṣṭapravaktāraṃ tasyaivākrośakaṃ tathā /
mṛtāṅgalagnavikreturgurostāḍayitus tathā //
meaning:
राज्ञो ऽनिष्टप्रवक्तारं तस्यैवाक्रोशकं तथा /
मृताङ्गलग्नविक्रेतुर्गुरोस्ताडयितुस् तथा //
text_mt: One who speaks what is unwelcome to the king, one who reviles him, / a seller of what was attached to a dead body, and one who strikes a teacher,

sanskrit_iast:
tanmantrasya ca bhettāraṃ chittvā jihvāṃ pravāsayet /
rājayānāsanāroḍhurdaṇḍo madhyamasāhasaḥ //
meaning:
तन्मन्त्रस्य च भेत्तारं छित्त्वा जिह्वां प्रवासयेत् /
राजयानासनारोढुर्दण्डो मध्यमसाहसः //
text_mt: And one who betrays his secrets—having cut out [his] tongue, he should banish him. / For one who mounts the king's conveyance or seat, the punishment is the middle degree of violence.

sanskrit_iast:
dvinetrabhedino rājadviṣṭādeśakṛtas tathā /
vipratvena ca śūdrasya jīvato 'ṣṭaśato damaḥ //
meaning:
द्विनेत्रभेदिनो राजद्विष्टादेशकृतस् तथा /
विप्रत्वेन च शूद्रस्य जीवतो ऽष्टशतो दमः //
text_mt: For one who gouges out both eyes, one who carries out what the king hates, / and for a śūdra living by posing as a brāhmaṇa, the fine is eight hundred [paṇas].

sanskrit_iast:
yo manyetājito 'smīti nyāyenābhiparājitaḥ /
tamāyāntaṃ punarjitvā daṇḍayeddviguṇaṃ damaṃ //
meaning:
यो मन्येताजितो ऽस्मीति न्यायेनाभिपराजितः /
तमायान्तं पुनर्जित्वा दण्डयेद्द्विगुणं दमं //
text_mt: He who, having been legally defeated, thinks, 'I am not defeated'— / when he returns, having defeated him again, [the king] should fine him double the penalty.

sanskrit_iast:
rājñānyāyena yo daṇḍo gṛhīto varuṇāyataṃ /
vivedya dadyādviprebhyaḥ svayaṃ triṃśadguṇīkṛtaṃ //
meaning:
राज्ञान्यायेन यो दण्डो गृहीतो वरुणायतं /
विवेद्य दद्याद्विप्रेभ्यः स्वयं त्रिंशद्गुणीकृतं //
text_mt: A fine that has been unlawfully collected by the king, he should dedicate to Varuṇa / and give to brāhmaṇas himself, multiplied thirtyfold.

sanskrit_iast:
dharmaścārthaś ca kīrtiñca lokapaṅktirupagrahaḥ /
prajābhyo bahumānañca svargasthānañca śāśvatam //
meaning:
धर्मश्चार्थश् च कीर्तिञ्च लोकपङ्क्तिरुपग्रहः /
प्रजाभ्यो बहुमानञ्च स्वर्गस्थानञ्च शाश्वतम् //
text_mt: Righteousness, wealth, fame, the respect of the world, conciliation, / high esteem from his subjects, and an eternal place in heaven—

sanskrit_iast:
paśyato vyavahārāṃś ca guṇāḥ syuḥ sapta bhūpateḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe vākpāruṣyādiprakaraṇaṃ nāma
saptapañcāśadadhikadviśatatmo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:p 437
:ś athāṣṭapañcāśadadhikadviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
ṛgvidhānaṃ
meaning:
पश्यतो व्यवहारांश् च गुणाः स्युः सप्त भूपतेः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे वाक्पारुष्यादिप्रकरणं नाम
सप्तपञ्चाशदधिकद्विशतत्मो ऽध्यायः ||
:प् 437
:श् अथाष्टपञ्चाशदधिकद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः
ऋग्विधानं
text_mt:
These seven merits accrue to a king who properly investigates legal proceedings.
Thus in the great Purāṇa of Agni, the chapter titled 'Section on Verbal Abuse and Other Offences', the two hundred and fifty-seventh chapter.
[Page 437]
Now, the two hundred and fifty-eighth chapter:
The Application of the Ṛgveda.

sanskrit_iast:
agnir uvāca
ṛgyajuḥsāmātharvavidhānaṃ puṣkaroditam /
bhuktimuktikaraṃ japyāddhomādrāmāya tadvade //
meaning:
अग्निर् उवाच
ऋग्यजुःसामाथर्वविधानं पुष्करोदितम् /
भुक्तिमुक्तिकरं जप्याद्धोमाद्रामाय तद्वदे //
text_mt: Agni said: / The applications of the Ṛg-, Yajur-, Sāma-, and Atharva-[vedas] spoken by Puṣkara, / which bestow worldly enjoyment and liberation through recitation and fire oblation, I shall declare to you, O Rāma.

sanskrit_iast:
puṣkara uvāca
prativedantu karmāṇi kāryāṇi pravadāmi te /
prathamaṃ ṛgvidhānaṃ vai śṛṇu tvaṃ bhuktimuktidam //
meaning:
पुष्कर उवाच
प्रतिवेदन्तु कर्माणि कार्याणि प्रवदामि ते /
प्रथमं ऋग्विधानं वै शृणु त्वं भुक्तिमुक्तिदम् //
text_mt: Puṣkara said: / I shall declare to you the rites to be performed according to each Veda. / First, hear the application of the Ṛgveda, which bestows worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
antarjale tathā home japatī manasepsitam /
kāmaṃ karoti gāyatrī prāṇāyāmādviśeṣataḥ //
meaning:
अन्तर्जले तथा होमे जपती मनसेप्सितम् /
कामं करोति गायत्री प्राणायामाद्विशेषतः //
text_mt: Recited under water or in a fire oblation, the Gāyatrī fulfills any desire / cherished in the mind, especially through breath control.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatryā daśasāhasro japo naktāśano dvija /
bahusnātasya tatraiva sarvakalmaṣanāśanaḥ //
meaning:
गायत्र्या दशसाहस्रो जपो नक्ताशनो द्विज /
बहुस्नातस्य तत्रैव सर्वकल्मषनाशनः //
text_mt: A recitation of ten thousand times of the Gāyatrī, eating only at night, O twice-born, / destroys all sins for one who bathes frequently right there.

sanskrit_iast:
daśāyutāni japtvātha haviṣyāśī sa muktibhāk /
praṇavo hi paraṃ brahma tajjapaḥ sarvapāpahā //
meaning:
दशायुतानि जप्त्वाथ हविष्याशी स मुक्तिभाक् /
प्रणवो हि परं ब्रह्म तज्जपः सर्वपापहा //
text_mt: Having recited [it] one hundred thousand times while eating sacrificial food, one attains liberation. / The praṇava is indeed the supreme Brahman; its recitation destroys all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
oṃkāraśatajaptantu nābhimātrodake sthitaḥ /
jalaṃ pivet sa sarvaistu pāpair vai(1) vipramucyate //
meaning:
ओंकारशतजप्तन्तु नाभिमात्रोदके स्थितः /
जलं पिवेत् स सर्वैस्तु पापैर् वै(1) विप्रमुच्यते //
text_mt: Standing in water up to the navel, he who drinks water / over which the syllable Om has been recited one hundred times is freed from all sins.

sanskrit_iast:
mātrātrayaṃ trayo vedāstrayo devāstrayo 'gnayaḥ /
mahāvyāhṛtayaḥ sapta lokā homo 'khilāghahā //
meaning:
मात्रात्रयं त्रयो वेदास्त्रयो देवास्त्रयो ऽग्नयः /
महाव्याहृतयः सप्त लोका होमो ऽखिलाघहा //
text_mt: Its three morae are the three Vedas, the three gods, the three fires. / The seven great sacred utterances are the seven worlds; a fire oblation [with them] destroys all sin.

sanskrit_iast:
gāyatrī paramā jāpyā mahāvyāhṛtayas tathā /
antarjale tathā rāma proktaś caivāghamarṣaṇaḥ //
meaning:
गायत्री परमा जाप्या महाव्याहृतयस् तथा /
अन्तर्जले तथा राम प्रोक्तश् चैवाघमर्षणः //
text_mt: The supreme Gāyatrī is to be recited, as well as the great sacred utterances; / and likewise, O Rāma, the Aghamarṣaṇa hymn is declared [to be recited] under water.

sanskrit_iast:
agnimīle purohitaṃ sūtko 'yaṃ vahnidaivataḥ /
:n
1 pāpair hi vipramucyata iti ga.. , gha.. , ña.. ca
:p 438
śirasā dhārayan vahniṃ yo japetparivatsaram //
meaning:
अग्निमीले पुरोहितं सूत्को ऽयं वह्निदैवतः /
:न्
1 पापैर् हि विप्रमुच्यत इति ग.. , घ.. , ञ.. च
:प् 438
शिरसा धारयन् वह्निं यो जपेत्परिवत्सरम् //
text_mt:
This hymn, 'I praise Agni the priest,' has the fire-god as its deity.
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: ‘is freed indeed from sins’ according to manuscripts ga, gha, and ña.] / [Page 438]
He who, holding fire upon his head, should recite it for a full year,

sanskrit_iast:
homaṃ triṣavaṇaṃ bhaikṣyamanagnijvalanañcaret /
ataḥ paramṛcaḥ sapta vāyvādyā yāḥ prakīrtitāḥ //
meaning:
होमं त्रिषवणं भैक्ष्यमनग्निज्वलनञ्चरेत् /
अतः परमृचः सप्त वाय्वाद्या याः प्रकीर्तिताः //
text_mt: Performing fire oblation, [bathing at] the three divisions of the day, subsisting on alms, and abstaining from lighting [other] fires; / subsequent to this are the seven verses declared to have Vāyu and others [as deities];

sanskrit_iast:
tā japan prayato nityamiṣṭān kāmān samaśnute /
medhākāmo japennityaṃ sadasanyamiti tyacam //
meaning:
ता जपन् प्रयतो नित्यमिष्टान् कामान् समश्नुते /
मेधाकामो जपेन्नित्यं सदसन्यमिति त्यचम् //
text_mt: Reciting them constantly with restraint, one attains his desired wishes. / One desiring intellect should daily recite the triplet beginning with 'sadasaspatim'.

sanskrit_iast:
anvayo yannimāḥ proktāḥ navarco mṛtyunāśanāḥ /
śunaḥśephamṛṣiṃ baddhaḥ sanniruddho 'tha vā(1) japet //
meaning:
अन्वयो यन्निमाः प्रोक्ताः नवर्चो मृत्युनाशनाः /
शुनःशेफमृषिं बद्धः सन्निरुद्धो ऽथ वा(1) जपेत् //
text_mt: These nine verses are declared to be 'anvaya', destroying death. / One who is bound or imprisoned should recite [the hymn to] the sage Śunaḥśepha;

sanskrit_iast:
mucyate sarvapāpebhyo gadī vāpyagado bhavet /
ya icchecchāśvataṃ kāmaṃ mitraṃ prājñaṃ purandaraṃ //
meaning:
मुच्यते सर्वपापेभ्यो गदी वाप्यगदो भवेत् /
य इच्छेच्छाश्वतं कामं मित्रं प्राज्ञं पुरन्दरं //
text_mt: He is freed from all sins, or if diseased, he becomes free from disease. / He who desires enduring love, a wise friend, or Indra,

sanskrit_iast:
ṛgbhiḥ ṣoḍśabhiḥ kuryādindriyasyeti dine dine /
hiraṇyastūpamityetajjapan śatrūn prabādhate //
meaning:
ऋग्भिः षोड्शभिः कुर्यादिन्द्रियस्येति दिने दिने /
हिरण्यस्तूपमित्येतज्जपन् शत्रून् प्रबाधते //
text_mt: Should [recite] day after day with the sixteen verses beginning with 'indriyasya'. / Reciting this [hymn] beginning with 'hiraṇyastūpa', he overcomes enemies.

sanskrit_iast:
kṣemī bhavati cādhvāno ye te panthā japan naraḥ /
raudrībhiḥṣaḍbhirīśānaṃ stūyādyo vai dine dine //
meaning:
क्षेमी भवति चाध्वानो ये ते पन्था जपन् नरः /
रौद्रीभिःषड्भिरीशानं स्तूयाद्यो वै दिने दिने //
text_mt: A man reciting 'ye te panthāḥ' ('Those paths of yours') fares safely on journeys. / He who praises Īśāna daily with the six Rudra verses,

sanskrit_iast:
caruṃ vā kalpayedraudraṃ tasya śāntiḥ parā bhavet /
udityudantamādityamupatiṣṭhan dine dine //
meaning:
चरुं वा कल्पयेद्रौद्रं तस्य शान्तिः परा भवेत् /
उदित्युदन्तमादित्यमुपतिष्ठन् दिने दिने //
text_mt: Or prepares a Rudra sacrificial cooked offering, attains supreme peace. / Paying homage day after day to the sun rising in the sky,

sanskrit_iast:
kṣipejjalāñjalīn sapta manoduḥkhavināśanaṃ /
dviṣantamityathārdharcaṃ yadviprāntaṃ japan smaret //
meaning:
क्षिपेज्जलाञ्जलीन् सप्त मनोदुःखविनाशनं /
द्विषन्तमित्यथार्धर्चं यद्विप्रान्तं जपन् स्मरेत् //
text_mt: He should offer seven handfuls of water, which destroys mental sorrow. / Reciting the half-verse beginning with 'dviṣantam' ('He who hates') up to the word 'vipra', if he contemplates [an enemy],

sanskrit_iast:
āgaskṛt saptarātreṇa vidveṣamadhigacchati /
ārogyakāmī rogī vā praskannasyottamaṃ japet //
meaning:
आगस्कृत् सप्तरात्रेण विद्वेषमधिगच्छति /
आरोग्यकामी रोगी वा प्रस्कन्नस्योत्तमं जपेत् //
text_mt: That wrongdoer incurs hatred within seven nights. / One desiring health, or one who is sick, should recite the highest [verse] of Praskaṇva.

sanskrit_iast:
uttamastasya cārdharco japedvai vividhāsane /
udayatyāyurakṣyayyaṃ tejo madhyandine japet //
:n
1 sannibaddho 'theti ka.. , kha.. , ja.. ca
:p 439
meaning:
उत्तमस्तस्य चार्धर्चो जपेद्वै विविधासने /
उदयत्यायुरक्ष्यय्यं तेजो मध्यन्दिने जपेत् //
:न्
1 सन्निबद्धो ऽथेति क.. , ख.. , ज.. च
:प् 439
text_mt:
One should recite the highest half-verse of it while in various postures. / Reciting it at midday, imperishable vitality and radiance arise.
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: ‘sannibaddho 'tha’ according to manuscripts ka, kha, and ja.] / [Page 439]

sanskrit_iast:
astaṃ pratigate sūrye dviṣantaṃ pratibādhate /
na vayaśceti sūktāni japan śatrūnniyacchati //
meaning:
अस्तं प्रतिगते सूर्ये द्विषन्तं प्रतिबाधते /
न वयश्चेति सूक्तानि जपन् शत्रून्नियच्छति //
text_mt: When the sun has set, he repels the enemy; / reciting the hymns beginning with “na vayaḥ,” he restrains his foes.

sanskrit_iast:
ekādaśa suparṇasya sarvakāmānvinirdiśet /
ādhyātmikīḥ ka ity etā japanmokṣamavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
एकादश सुपर्णस्य सर्वकामान्विनिर्दिशेत् /
आध्यात्मिकीः क इत्य् एता जपन्मोक्षमवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: With the eleven [verses] of Suparṇa, he may appoint all desires. / Reciting these spiritual verses beginning with “kaḥ,” he attains liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ā no bhadrā ity anena dīrghamāyuravāpnuyāt /
tvaṃ someti ca sūktena navaṃ paśyenniśākaraṃ //
meaning:
आ नो भद्रा इत्य् अनेन दीर्घमायुरवाप्नुयात् /
त्वं सोमेति च सूक्तेन नवं पश्येन्निशाकरं //
text_mt: With the [verse] “ā no bhadrāḥ,” he attains long life. / And with the hymn “tvaṃ soma,” he should gaze upon the new moon.

sanskrit_iast:
upatiṣṭhet samitpāṇirvāsāṃsyāpnotyasaṃśayaṃ /
āyurīpsannimamiti kautsa sūktaṃ sadā japet //
meaning:
उपतिष्ठेत् समित्पाणिर्वासांस्याप्नोत्यसंशयं /
आयुरीप्सन्निममिति कौत्स सूक्तं सदा जपेत् //
text_mt: Holding sacrificial faggots in hand, he should worship; he obtains garments, without doubt. / Desiring life, he should constantly recite the hymn of Kutsa beginning with “imam.”

sanskrit_iast:
āpanaḥ śośucaditi stutvā madhye divākaraṃ /
yathā muñcati ceṣokāṃ tathā pāpaṃ pramuñcati //
meaning:
आपनः शोशुचदिति स्तुत्वा मध्ये दिवाकरं /
यथा मुञ्चति चेषोकां तथा पापं प्रमुञ्चति //
text_mt: Having praised the sun at midday with “apa naḥ śośucat,” / just as [the reed] sheds its stalk, so he sheds sin.

sanskrit_iast:
jātavedasa ity etajjapet svastyayanaṃ pathi /
bhayair vimucyate sarvaiḥ svastimānāpnuyāt gṛhān //
meaning:
जातवेदस इत्य् एतज्जपेत् स्वस्त्ययनं पथि /
भयैर् विमुच्यते सर्वैः स्वस्तिमानाप्नुयात् गृहान् //
text_mt: He should recite the auspicious [verse] “jātavedase” on a journey; / he is freed from all fears and reaches home safe and sound.

sanskrit_iast:
vyuṣṭāyāñca tathā rātryāmetadduḥsvapnanāśanaṃ /
pramandineti sūyantyā japedgarbhavimocanaṃ //
meaning:
व्युष्टायाञ्च तथा रात्र्यामेतद्दुःस्वप्ननाशनं /
प्रमन्दिनेति सूयन्त्या जपेद्गर्भविमोचनं //
text_mt: And at dawn of day, this destroys nightmares. / For a woman in labour, one should recite “pramandinaḥ” to release the fetus.

sanskrit_iast:
japannindramiti snāto vaiśyadevantu saptakaṃ /
muñcatyājyaṃ tathā juhvat sakalaṃ kilviṣaṃ naraḥ //
meaning:
जपन्निन्द्रमिति स्नातो वैश्यदेवन्तु सप्तकं /
मुञ्चत्याज्यं तथा जुह्वत् सकलं किल्विषं नरः //
text_mt: Bathed and reciting “indram,” the set of seven verses addressed to the Viśvedevas, / and likewise offering clarified butter into the fire, a man casts off all sin.

sanskrit_iast:
imāmiti japan śaśvat kāmānāpnotyabhīpsitān /
mānastoka iti dvābhyāṃ trirātropoṣitaḥ śuciḥ //
meaning:
इमामिति जपन् शश्वत् कामानाप्नोत्यभीप्सितान् /
मानस्तोक इति द्वाभ्यां त्रिरात्रोपोषितः शुचिः //
text_mt: Constantly reciting “imām,” he obtains desired wishes. / Pure, having fasted for three nights, with the two verses beginning with “mā nas toke,”

sanskrit_iast:
auḍumbarīś ca juhuyātsamidhaścājyasaṃskṛtāḥ /
chittvā sarvānmṛtyupāśān jīvedrogavivarjitaḥ //
meaning:
औडुम्बरीश् च जुहुयात्समिधश्चाज्यसंस्कृताः /
छित्त्वा सर्वान्मृत्युपाशान् जीवेद्रोगविवर्जितः //
text_mt: he should offer faggots of *udumbara* wood prepared with clarified butter; / having cut through all the nooses of death, he lives free from disease.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvabāhuranenaiva stutvā sambhuṃ tathaiva ca /
mānastoketi ca ṛcā śikhābandhe kṛte naraḥ //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वबाहुरनेनैव स्तुत्वा सम्भुं तथैव च /
मानस्तोकेति च ऋचा शिखाबन्धे कृते नरः //
text_mt: With raised arms, having praised Sambhu with this very [hymn], / and when the tying of the topknot is performed with the verse “mā nas toke,” a man

sanskrit_iast:
aghṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ jāyate saṃśayaṃ vinā /
:p 440
citramityupatiṣṭheta trisandhyaṃ bhāskaraṃ tathā //
meaning:
अघृष्यः सर्वभूतानां जायते संशयं विना /
:प् 440
चित्रमित्युपतिष्ठेत त्रिसन्ध्यं भास्करं तथा //
text_mt:
becomes unassailable by all beings, without a doubt.
[p. 440]
He should worship the sun at the three junctures of the day with the verse “citram.”

sanskrit_iast:
samitpāṇirnaro nityamīpsitaṃ dhanamāpnuyāt /
atha svapneti ca japan prātarmadhyandine dine //
meaning:
समित्पाणिर्नरो नित्यमीप्सितं धनमाप्नुयात् /
अथ स्वप्नेति च जपन् प्रातर्मध्यन्दिने दिने //
text_mt: With sacrificial faggots in hand, a man constantly obtains desired wealth. / And reciting “atha svapna,” in the morning and at midday every day,

sanskrit_iast:
duḥsvapnañcārhate kṛtsnaṃ bhojanañcāpnuyācchubham(1) /
ubhe pumāniti tathā rakṣoghnaḥ parikīrtitaḥ //
meaning:
दुःस्वप्नञ्चार्हते कृत्स्नं भोजनञ्चाप्नुयाच्छुभम्(1) /
उभे पुमानिति तथा रक्षोघ्नः परिकीर्तितः //
text_mt: he destroys every bad dream and obtains wholesome food. / Likewise, the verse “ubhe pumān” is declared to be a destroyer of demons.

sanskrit_iast:
ubhe vāsā iti ṛco japan kāmānavāpnuyāt /
na sāganniti ca japan mucyate cātatāyinaḥ //
meaning:
उभे वासा इति ऋचो जपन् कामानवाप्नुयात् /
न सागन्निति च जपन् मुच्यते चाततायिनः //
text_mt: Reciting the verses beginning with “ubhe vāsaḥ,” he obtains desires. / And reciting “na sā gāt,” he is released from an assailant.

sanskrit_iast:
kayā śubheti ca japan jātiśraiṣṭhamavāpnuyāt /
imannṛsomamityetat sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt //
meaning:
कया शुभेति च जपन् जातिश्रैष्ठमवाप्नुयात् /
इमन्नृसोममित्येतत् सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात् //
text_mt: Reciting “kayā śubhā,” he attains pre-eminence in his caste. / With this verse “iman nu somam,” he attains all desires.

sanskrit_iast:
pitarityupatiṣṭheta nityamarthamupasthitaṃ(2) /
agne nayeti sūktena ghṛtahomaś ca mārgagaḥ //
meaning:
पितरित्युपतिष्ठेत नित्यमर्थमुपस्थितं(2) /
अग्ने नयेति सूक्तेन घृतहोमश् च मार्गगः //
text_mt: With “pitaḥ,” he should constantly attend upon wealth that has arrived. / With the hymn “agne naya,” an oblation of clarified butter is made by one on a journey.

sanskrit_iast:
vīrānnayamavāpnoti suślokaṃ yo japet sadā /
kaṅkato neti sūktena viṣān sarvān vyapohati //
meaning:
वीरान्नयमवाप्नोति सुश्लोकं यो जपेत् सदा /
कङ्कतो नेति सूक्तेन विषान् सर्वान् व्यपोहति //
text_mt: He who constantly recites the well-known verse obtains the leading of heroes. / With the hymn “kaṅkato na,” he expels all poisons.

sanskrit_iast:
yo jāta iti sūktena sarvān kāmānavāpnuyāt /
gaṇānāmiti sūktena śnigdhamāpnotyanuttamaṃ //
meaning:
यो जात इति सूक्तेन सर्वान् कामानवाप्नुयात् /
गणानामिति सूक्तेन श्निग्धमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमं //
