khe strīṃ khe ca prayogo 'yaṃ vaśāya vijayāya ca /
aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ spheṃ kṣauṃ bhagavati ambike kubjike spheṃ oṃ
bhaṃ taṃ vaśanamo aghorāya sukhe vrāṃ vrīṃ kili kili viccā
sphrauṃ he sphraṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ śrīmiti kubjikāvidyā
sarvakarā smṛtā
bhūyaḥ skandāya yānāha mantrānīśaś ca tān vade //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe nānāmantrā nāma
pañcadaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha ṣoḍaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
sakalādimantroddhāraḥ
meaning:
खे स्त्रीं खे च प्रयोगो ऽयं वशाय विजयाय च /
ऐं ह्रीं श्रीं स्फें क्षौं भगवति अम्बिके कुब्जिके स्फें ओं
भं तं वशनमो अघोराय सुखे व्रां व्रीं किलि किलि विच्चा
स्फ्रौं हे स्फ्रं श्रीं ह्रीं ऐं श्रीमिति कुब्जिकाविद्या
सर्वकरा स्मृता
भूयः स्कन्दाय यानाह मन्त्रानीशश् च तान् वदे //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे नानामन्त्रा नाम
पञ्चदशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ षोडशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
सकलादिमन्त्रोद्धारः
text_mt:
"Khe strīṃ khe": this application is for subjugation and victory. / "Aiṃ hrīṃ śrīṃ spheṃ kṣauṃ bhagavati ambike kubjike spheṃ oṃ bhaṃ taṃ vaśanamo aghorāya sukhe vrāṃ vrīṃ kili kili viccā sphrauṃ he sphraṃ śrīṃ hrīṃ aiṃ śrīm": thus the Kubjikā lore / is remembered as accomplishing all tasks. / Again, I shall speak the mantras that the Lord taught to Skanda.
Thus ends the three hundred and fifteenth chapter, named "Various Mantras", in the Mahāpurāṇa called the Āgneya.
Now, the three hundred and sixteenth chapter:
Extraction of the Mantras of Sakala and Others.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ śūnyaṃ kalāḍhyaṃ svamalaṅkṛtam /
kṣapaṇaṃ kṣayamantasthaṃ kaṇṭhoṣṭhaṃ cāṣṭamaṃśivam //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
सकलं निष्कलं शून्यं कलाढ्यं स्वमलङ्कृतम् /
क्षपणं क्षयमन्तस्थं कण्ठोष्ठं चाष्टमंशिवम् //
text_mt: The Lord said: / Sakala, Niṣkala, Śūnya, Kalāḍhya, Svamalaṅkṛta, / Kṣapaṇa, Kṣayamantastha, and the eighth is Kaṇṭhoṣṭha-Śiva.

sanskrit_iast:
prāsādasya(2) parākhyasya smṛtaṃ rūpaṃ(3) guhāṣṭadhā /
:n
1 ripuduṣṭādi vārayediti ka.. , ṭa.. ca
2 prasādasyeti kha..
3 smṛtirūpamiti kha..
:p 155
sadāśivasya śabdasya rūpasyākhilasiddhaye //
meaning:
प्रासादस्य(2) पराख्यस्य स्मृतं रूपं(3) गुहाष्टधा /
:न्
1 रिपुदुष्टादि वारयेदिति क.. , ट.. च
2 प्रसादस्येति ख..
3 स्मृतिरूपमिति ख..
:प् 155
सदाशिवस्य शब्दस्य रूपस्याखिलसिद्धये //
text_mt:
The form of the Prāsāda called the Supreme, O Guha, is traditionally known to be eightfold,
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: "ripuduṣṭādi vārayed" in ka.. and ṭa..]
[Footnote 2: "prasādasya" in kha..]
[Footnote 3: "smṛtirūpam" in kha..]
for the attainment of all success of Sadāśiva's sound-form.

sanskrit_iast:
amṛtaścāṃśubhāṃścenduśceśvaraścogra ūhakaḥ /
ekapādena ojākhya auṣadhaścāṃśumān vaśī //
meaning:
अमृतश्चांशुभांश्चेन्दुश्चेश्वरश्चोग्र ऊहकः /
एकपादेन ओजाख्य औषधश्चांशुमान् वशी //
text_mt: Amṛta, Aṃśubhān, Indu, Īśvara, Ugra, Ūhaka, / Ekapāda, Ojas, Auṣadha, Aṃśumān, Vaśin—

sanskrit_iast:
akārādeḥ kṣakāraś ca kakārādeḥ kramādime /
kāmadevaḥ śikhaṇḍī ca gaṇeśaḥ kālaśaṅkarau //
meaning:
अकारादेः क्षकारश् च ककारादेः क्रमादिमे /
कामदेवः शिखण्डी च गणेशः कालशङ्करौ //
text_mt: these are in order from the letter "a" to "kṣa", and from the letter "ka" onwards: / Kāmadeva, Śikhaṇḍin, Gaṇeśa, Kāla, and Śaṅkara;

sanskrit_iast:
ekanetro dvinetraś ca triśikho dīrghabāhukaḥ(1) /
ekapādardhacandraś ca balapo yoginīpriyaḥ //
meaning:
एकनेत्रो द्विनेत्रश् च त्रिशिखो दीर्घबाहुकः(1) /
एकपादर्धचन्द्रश् च बलपो योगिनीप्रियः //
text_mt: Ekanetra, Dvinetra, Triśikha, Dīrghabāhu, / Ekapāda, Ardhacandra, Balapa, Yoginīpriya;

sanskrit_iast:
śaktīśvaro mahāgranthistarpakaḥ sthāṇudanturau /
nidhīśo nandī padmaś ca tathānyaḥ śākinīpriyaḥ //
meaning:
शक्तीश्वरो महाग्रन्थिस्तर्पकः स्थाणुदन्तुरौ /
निधीशो नन्दी पद्मश् च तथान्यः शाकिनीप्रियः //
text_mt: Śaktīśvara, Mahāgranthi, Tarpaka, Sthāṇu, Dantura, / Nidhīśa, Nandin, Padma, and then another, Śākinīpriya;

sanskrit_iast:
sukhavimbo bhīṣanaś ca kṛtāntaḥ prāṇasaṃjñakaḥ /
tejasvī śakra udadhiḥ śrīkaṇṭhaḥ siṃha eva ca //
meaning:
सुखविम्बो भीषनश् च कृतान्तः प्राणसंज्ञकः /
तेजस्वी शक्र उदधिः श्रीकण्ठः सिंह एव च //
text_mt: Sukhabimba, Bhīṣaṇa, Kṛtānta, the one named Prāṇa, / Tejasvin, Śakra, Udadhi, Śrīkaṇṭha, and Siṃha;

sanskrit_iast:
śaśāṅko viśvarūpaś ca kṣaś ca syānnarasiṃhakaḥ /
sūryamātrāsamākrāntaṃ viśvarūpantu kārayet //
meaning:
शशाङ्को विश्वरूपश् च क्षश् च स्यान्नरसिंहकः /
सूर्यमात्रासमाक्रान्तं विश्वरूपन्तु कारयेत् //
text_mt: Śaśāṅka, Viśvarūpa; and "kṣa" is Narasiṃha. / One should take Viśvarūpa mounted upon the solar measure,

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśumatsaṃyutaṃ kṛtvā śaśivījaṃ vināyutam /
īśānamojasākrāntaṃ prathamantu samuddharet //
meaning:
अंशुमत्संयुतं कृत्वा शशिवीजं विनायुतम् /
ईशानमोजसाक्रान्तं प्रथमन्तु समुद्धरेत् //
text_mt: combining it with Aṃśumat, without the seed of the moon. / First, one should extract Īśāna combined with Ojas.

sanskrit_iast:
tṛtīyaṃ puruṣaṃ viddhi dakṣiṇaṃ pañcamaṃ tathā /
saptamaṃ vāmadevantu sadyojātantataḥparaṃ //
meaning:
तृतीयं पुरुषं विद्धि दक्षिणं पञ्चमं तथा /
सप्तमं वामदेवन्तु सद्योजातन्ततःपरं //
text_mt: Know Puruṣa as the third, and Dakṣiṇa likewise as the fifth; / Vāmadeva as the seventh, and Sadyojāta next.

sanskrit_iast:
rasayuktantu navamaṃ brahmapañcapañcakamīritam /
oṃkārādyāś caturthyantā namontāḥ sarvamantrakāḥ //
meaning:
रसयुक्तन्तु नवमं ब्रह्मपञ्चपञ्चकमीरितम् /
ओंकाराद्याश् चतुर्थ्यन्ता नमोन्ताः सर्वमन्त्रकाः //
text_mt: And the ninth, joined with Rasa, is declared as the pentad of the five Brahmans. / Beginning with the syllable Oṃ, ending in the dative, and concluding with "namaḥ" are all the mantras.

sanskrit_iast:
sadyodevā dvitīyantu hṛdayañcāṅgasaṃyutam /
caturthantu śiro viddhi īśvarannāmanāmataḥ //
meaning:
सद्योदेवा द्वितीयन्तु हृदयञ्चाङ्गसंयुतम् /
चतुर्थन्तु शिरो विद्धि ईश्वरन्नामनामतः //
text_mt: From Sadyodeva, [extract] the second, the heart with its ancillary parts. / Know the head as the fourth, from the name Īśvara.

sanskrit_iast:
ūhakantu śikhā jñeyā viśvarūpasamanvitā /
:n
1 triśikhī cordhvavāhuka iti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 156
tanmantramaṣṭamaṃ khyātaṃ netrantu daśamaṃ matam //
meaning:
ऊहकन्तु शिखा ज्ञेया विश्वरूपसमन्विता /
:न्
1 त्रिशिखी चोर्ध्ववाहुक इति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 156
तन्मन्त्रमष्टमं ख्यातं नेत्रन्तु दशमं मतम् //
text_mt:
Ūhaka combined with Viśvarūpa is to be known as the crest;
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: "triśikhī cordhvavāhuka" in kha.. and cha..]
that mantra is declared as the eighth; the eye is held to be the tenth.

sanskrit_iast:
astraṃ śaśī samākhyātaṃ śivasaṃjñaṃ śikhidhyajaḥ /
namaḥ svāhā tathā vauṣat hūṃ ca phatkakrameṇa tu //
meaning:
अस्त्रं शशी समाख्यातं शिवसंज्ञं शिखिध्यजः /
नमः स्वाहा तथा वौषत् हूं च फत्कक्रमेण तु //
text_mt: Śaśin is declared as the weapon; Śikhidhvaja is named Śiva. / "Namaḥ", "svāhā", likewise "vauṣaṭ", "hūṃ", and "phaṭ", in order,

sanskrit_iast:
jātiphaṭkaṃ hṛdādīnāṃ prāsādaṃ mantramāvade(1) /
īśānādrudrasaṃkhyātaṃ proddhareccāṃśurañjitam //
meaning:
जातिफट्कं हृदादीनां प्रासादं मन्त्रमावदे(1) /
ईशानाद्रुद्रसंख्यातं प्रोद्धरेच्चांशुरञ्जितम् //
text_mt: are the six classes of endings for the heart and other limbs; I shall declare the Prāsāda mantra. / Counted from Īśāna by Rudra, one should extract it coloured by Aṃśu,

sanskrit_iast:
auṣadhākrāntaśirasamūhakasyoparisthitaṃ /
ardhacandrordhanādaś ca vindudvitayamadhyagaṃ //
meaning:
औषधाक्रान्तशिरसमूहकस्योपरिस्थितं /
अर्धचन्द्रोर्धनादश् च विन्दुद्वितयमध्यगं //
text_mt: having its head overlaid by Auṣadha, placed upon Ūhaka, / with half-moon and half-sound, situated between two drops;

sanskrit_iast:
tadante viśvarūpantu kuṭilantu tridhā tataḥ /
evaṃ prāsādamantraś ca sarvakarmakaro manuḥ //
meaning:
तदन्ते विश्वरूपन्तु कुटिलन्तु त्रिधा ततः /
एवं प्रासादमन्त्रश् च सर्वकर्मकरो मनुः //
text_mt: at the end thereof Viśvarūpa, and Kuṭila threefold. / Such is the Prāsāda mantra, a formula that performs all rites.

sanskrit_iast:
śikhāvījaṃ samuddhṛtya phaṭkārāntantu caiva phaṭ /
ardhacandrāsanaṃ jñeyaṃ kāmadevaṃ sasarpakam //
meaning:
शिखावीजं समुद्धृत्य फट्कारान्तन्तु चैव फट् /
अर्धचन्द्रासनं ज्ञेयं कामदेवं ससर्पकम् //
text_mt: Extracting the crest-seed, ending with the syllable "phaṭ", followed by "phaṭ", / know it as having the crescent moon as seat, Kāmadeva with the serpent.

sanskrit_iast:
mahāpāśupatāstrantu sarvaduṣṭapramardanam /
prāsādaḥ sakalaḥ prokto niṣkalaḥ procyate 'dhunā //
meaning:
महापाशुपतास्त्रन्तु सर्वदुष्टप्रमर्दनम् /
प्रासादः सकलः प्रोक्तो निष्कलः प्रोच्यते ऽधुना //
text_mt: The Mahāpāśupata weapon crushes all evil ones. / Sakala-Prāsāda has been spoken; Niṣkala is now declared.

sanskrit_iast:
auṣadhaṃ viśvarūpantu rudrākhyaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam /
candrārdhaṃ nādasaṃyogaṃ(2) visaṃjñaṃ kuṭilantataḥ //
meaning:
औषधं विश्वरूपन्तु रुद्राख्यं सूर्यमण्डलम् /
चन्द्रार्धं नादसंयोगं(2) विसंज्ञं कुटिलन्ततः //
text_mt: Auṣadha, Viśvarūpa, Rudra, the solar disc, / the crescent moon joined with nāda, devoid of vowel, and then Kuṭila:

sanskrit_iast:
niṣkalo bhuktimuktau syātpañcāṅgo 'yaṃ sadāśivaḥ /
aṃśumān viśvarūpañca āvṛtaṃ śūnyarañjitam //
meaning:
निष्कलो भुक्तिमुक्तौ स्यात्पञ्चाङ्गो ऽयं सदाशिवः /
अंशुमान् विश्वरूपञ्च आवृतं शून्यरञ्जितम् //
text_mt: the Niṣkala is for enjoyment and liberation; this Sadāśiva has five limbs. / Aṃśumān and Viśvarūpa, encircled, adorned with the void,

sanskrit_iast:
brahmāṅgarahitaḥ śūnyastasya mūrtirasastaruḥ /
vighnanāśāya bhavati pūjito bālabāliśaiḥ //
meaning:
ब्रह्माङ्गरहितः शून्यस्तस्य मूर्तिरसस्तरुः /
विघ्ननाशाय भवति पूजितो बालबालिशैः //
text_mt: devoid of Brahmans and limbs, empty—its icon is the tree of desire; / it leads to the destruction of obstacles when worshipped by children and simpletons.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśumān viśvarūpākhyamūhakasyopari sthitam /
kalāḍhyaṃ sakalasyaiva pūjāṅgādi ca sarvataḥ //
meaning:
अंशुमान् विश्वरूपाख्यमूहकस्योपरि स्थितम् /
कलाढ्यं सकलस्यैव पूजाङ्गादि च सर्वतः //
text_mt: Aṃśumān, Viśvarūpa, resting upon Ūhaka; / the Kalāḍhya of Sakala, and worship of limbs and all else from every side.

sanskrit_iast:
narasiṃhaṃ kṛtāntasthaṃ tejasviprāṇamūrdhagam /
:n
1 mantramādarediti ña..
2 candrārdhanādasaṃyuktamiti kha..
:p 157
aṃśumānūhakākrāntamadhordhaṃ svasalaṅghṛtam //
meaning:
नरसिंहं कृतान्तस्थं तेजस्विप्राणमूर्धगम् /
:न्
1 मन्त्रमादरेदिति ञ..
2 चन्द्रार्धनादसंयुक्तमिति ख..
:प् 157
अंशुमानूहकाक्रान्तमधोर्धं स्वसलङ्घृतम् //
text_mt:
Narasiṃha seated upon Kṛtānta, rising to the head of Tejasvin and Prāṇa,
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: "mantramādarediti" in ña..]
[Footnote 2: "candrārdhanādasaṃyuktam" in kha..]
Aṃśumān placed upon Ūhaka, above and below, well-adorned,

sanskrit_iast:
candrārdhanādanādāntaṃ brahmaviṣṇuvibhūśita /
udadhiṃ narasiṃhañca sūryamātrāvibheditam //
meaning:
चन्द्रार्धनादनादान्तं ब्रह्मविष्णुविभूशित /
उदधिं नरसिंहञ्च सूर्यमात्राविभेदितम् //
text_mt: ending in the crescent moon, sound, and nādānta, adorned by Brahmā and Viṣṇu, / Udadhi and Narasiṃha differentiated by the measure of the sun:

sanskrit_iast:
yadā kṛtaṃ tadā tasya brahmāṇyaṅgāni pūrvavat /
ojākhyamaṃśumadyuktaṃ prathamaṃ varṇamuddharet //
meaning:
यदा कृतं तदा तस्य ब्रह्माण्यङ्गानि पूर्ववत् /
ओजाख्यमंशुमद्युक्तं प्रथमं वर्णमुद्धरेत् //
text_mt: when made thus, its Brahmans and limbs are as before. / One should extract the first letter named Ojas, joined with Aṃśumat.

sanskrit_iast:
aśumaccāṃśunākrāntaṃ dvitīyaṃ varṇanāyakam /
aṃśumānīśvarantadvat tṛtīyaṃ muktidāyakam //
meaning:
अशुमच्चांशुनाक्रान्तं द्वितीयं वर्णनायकम् /
अंशुमानीश्वरन्तद्वत् तृतीयं मुक्तिदायकम् //
text_mt: The chief second letter is Aṃśumat overlaid by Aṃśu. / Likewise, Aṃśumān with Īśvara, the third, grants liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
ūhakañcāṃśunākrāntaṃ varuṇaprānataijasam /
pañcamantu samākhyātaṃ kṛtāntantu tataḥ param //
meaning:
ऊहकञ्चांशुनाक्रान्तं वरुणप्रानतैजसम् /
पञ्चमन्तु समाख्यातं कृतान्तन्तु ततः परम् //
text_mt: Ūhaka overlaid by Aṃśu, Varuṇa, Prāṇa, and Taijasa— / the fifth is proclaimed, and after that Kṛtānta.

sanskrit_iast:
aṃśumānudakaprāṇaḥ saptamaṃ varṇamuddhṛtam /
padmamindusamākrāntaṃ nandīśamekapādadhṛk //
meaning:
अंशुमानुदकप्राणः सप्तमं वर्णमुद्धृतम् /
पद्ममिन्दुसमाक्रान्तं नन्दीशमेकपादधृक् //
text_mt: Aṃśumān, Udaka, and Prāṇa are the seventh letter extracted. / Padma overlaid by Indu; Nandīśa holding Ekapāda;

sanskrit_iast:
prathamañcāntato yojyaṃ kṣapaṇaṃ daśavījakam /
asyārdhaṃ tṛtīyañcaiva pañcamaṃ saptamaṃ tathā //
meaning:
प्रथमञ्चान्ततो योज्यं क्षपणं दशवीजकम् /
अस्यार्धं तृतीयञ्चैव पञ्चमं सप्तमं तथा //
text_mt: the first is to be joined at the end: Kṣapaṇa has ten seed-syllables. / Half of it, and the third, fifth, and seventh,

sanskrit_iast:
sadyojātantu navamaṃ dvitīyāddhṛdayādikam /
daśārṇapraṇavaṃ yattu phaḍantañcāstramuddharet //
meaning:
सद्योजातन्तु नवमं द्वितीयाद्धृदयादिकम् /
दशार्णप्रणवं यत्तु फडन्तञ्चास्त्रमुद्धरेत् //
text_mt: Sadyojāta as the ninth; from the second, the heart and other limbs. / That which is the ten-syllabled Praṇava ending with "phaṭ" is extracted as the weapon.

sanskrit_iast:
namaskārayutānyatra brahmāṅgāni tu nānyathā /
dvitīyādaṣṭau yāvadaṣṭau vidyeśvarā matāḥ //
meaning:
नमस्कारयुतान्यत्र ब्रह्माङ्गानि तु नान्यथा /
द्वितीयादष्टौ यावदष्टौ विद्येश्वरा मताः //
text_mt: Here the Brahmans and limbs are accompanied by salutations, not otherwise. / From the second, up to eight, are considered the eight Lord of Lore:

sanskrit_iast:
ananteśaś ca sūkṣmaś ca tṛtīyaś ca śivoktamaḥ /
ekamūrcyekarūpastu trimūrtiraparas tathā //
meaning:
अनन्तेशश् च सूक्ष्मश् च तृतीयश् च शिवोक्तमः /
एकमूर्च्येकरूपस्तु त्रिमूर्तिरपरस् तथा //
text_mt: Ananteśa, Sūkṣma, and the third is Śivottama, / Ekamūrti, Ekarūpa, and another is Trimūrti,

sanskrit_iast:
śrīkaṇṭhaś ca śikhaṇḍī ca aṣṭauvidyeśvarāḥsmṛtāḥ /
śikhaṇḍino 'pyanantāntaṃ mantrāntaṃ mūrtirīritā //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe sakalādimantroddhāro nāma
ṣoḍaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:p 158
:ś atha saptadaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
gaṇapūjā
meaning:
श्रीकण्ठश् च शिखण्डी च अष्टौविद्येश्वराःस्मृताः /
शिखण्डिनो ऽप्यनन्तान्तं मन्त्रान्तं मूर्तिरीरिता //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे सकलादिमन्त्रोद्धारो नाम
षोडशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
:प् 158
:श् अथ सप्तदशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
गणपूजा
text_mt:
Śrīkaṇṭha, and Śikhaṇḍin—these eight are remembered as the Lords of Lore. / From Śikhaṇḍin up to Ananta, ending in mantras, the iconic form is declared.
Thus ends the three hundred and sixteenth chapter, named "Extraction of the Mantras of Sakala and Others", in the Mahāpurāṇa called the Āgneya.
Now, the three hundred and seventeenth chapter:
Worship of the Gaṇas.

sanskrit_iast:
iśvara uvāca
viśvarūpaṃ samuddhṛtya tejasyupari saṃsthitam /
narasiṃhaṃ tato 'dhastāt kṛtāntaṃ tadadho nyaset //
meaning:
इश्वर उवाच
विश्वरूपं समुद्धृत्य तेजस्युपरि संस्थितम् /
नरसिंहं ततो ऽधस्तात् कृतान्तं तदधो न्यसेत् //
text_mt: The Lord said: / Having extracted Viśvarūpa, situated above Tejas, / one should deposit Narasiṃha beneath it, and Kṛtānta below that.

sanskrit_iast:
praṇavaṃ tadadhaḥkṛtvā ūhakaṃ tadadhaḥ punaḥ /
aṃśumān viśvamūrtisthaṃ kaṇṭhoṣṭhapraṇavādikam //
meaning:
प्रणवं तदधःकृत्वा ऊहकं तदधः पुनः /
अंशुमान् विश्वमूर्तिस्थं कण्ठोष्ठप्रणवादिकम् //
text_mt: Placing the Praṇava below that, and again Ūhaka beneath that, / Aṃśumān resting on Viśvamūrti, Kaṇṭhoṣṭha, Praṇava, and so on.

sanskrit_iast:
namo 'ntaḥ syāccaturvarṇo viśvarūpañca kāraṇam /
sūryamātrāhataṃ brahmaṇyaṅgānīha tu pūrvavat(1) //
meaning:
नमो ऽन्तः स्याच्चतुर्वर्णो विश्वरूपञ्च कारणम् /
सूर्यमात्राहतं ब्रह्मण्यङ्गानीह तु पूर्ववत्(1) //
text_mt: It ends with namaḥ, consists of four syllables, and Viśvarūpa is the cause; / multiplied by the solar measure, on the Brahman [mantra], the ancillary limbs here are as before.

sanskrit_iast:
uddharet praṇavaṃ pūrvaṃ prasphuradvayamuccaret /
ghoraghorataraṃ paścāt tatra rūpamataḥ smaret //
meaning:
उद्धरेत् प्रणवं पूर्वं प्रस्फुरद्वयमुच्चरेत् /
घोरघोरतरं पश्चात् तत्र रूपमतः स्मरेत् //
text_mt: One should first extract the praṇava, utter 'prasphura' twice, / then 'ghoraghoratara', and thereupon meditate on the form there.

sanskrit_iast:
caṭaśabdaṃ dvidhā kṛtvā tataḥ pravaramuccaret /
daheti ca dvidhā kāryaṃ vameti ca dvidhā gatam(2) //
meaning:
चटशब्दं द्विधा कृत्वा ततः प्रवरमुच्चरेत् /
दहेति च द्विधा कार्यं वमेति च द्विधा गतम्(2) //
text_mt: Having uttered the word 'caṭa' twice, one should then utter 'pravara'; / 'daha' is to be uttered twice, and 'vama' twice.

sanskrit_iast:
ghātayeti dvidhākṛtya hūṃphaḍantaṃ samuccaret /
aghorāstrantu netraṃ syād gāyatrī cocyate 'dhunā //
tanmaheśāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi /
*1ab/
tatraḥ śivaḥ pracodayāt gāyatrī sarvasādhanī //
*1cd/
meaning:
घातयेति द्विधाकृत्य हूंफडन्तं समुच्चरेत् /
अघोरास्त्रन्तु नेत्रं स्याद् गायत्री चोच्यते ऽधुना //
तन्महेशाय विद्महे महादेवाय धीमहि /
*1अब्/
तत्रः शिवः प्रचोदयात् गायत्री सर्वसाधनी //
*1च्द्/
text_mt:
Having pronounced 'ghātaya' twice, one should utter [the mantra] ending in 'hūṃ phaṭ'. / The weapon is the Aghora-weapon, and the eye [is Aghora]; now the Gāyatrī is declared: / 'We know that Maheśa, we meditate upon Mahādeva;
*1ab
may Śiva impel us therein'—the Gāyatrī accomplishes everything.
*1cd

sanskrit_iast:
yātrāyāṃ vijayādau ca yajet pūrvaṅgaṇaṃ śriye /
turyāṃśe tu purā kṣetre samantādarkabhājite //
meaning:
यात्रायां विजयादौ च यजेत् पूर्वङ्गणं श्रिये /
तुर्यांशे तु पुरा क्षेत्रे समन्तादर्कभाजिते //
text_mt: On an expedition, for victory, and so forth, one should worship the retinue beforehand for prosperity. / In the fourth part of the field previously divided all around into twelve [squares],

sanskrit_iast:
catuṣpadaṃ trikoṇe tu tridalaṃ kamalaṃ likhet /
:n
1 sarvata iti kha..
2 dvidhākṛtamiti kha..
:p 159
tatpṛṣṭhe padikāvithībhāgi tridalamaśvayuk //
meaning:
चतुष्पदं त्रिकोणे तु त्रिदलं कमलं लिखेत् /
:न्
1 सर्वत इति ख..
2 द्विधाकृतमिति ख..
:प् 159
तत्पृष्ठे पदिकाविथीभागि त्रिदलमश्वयुक् //
text_mt:
one should draw a three-petalled lotus covering four squares in the triangle.
:n
1 kha reads 'sarvataḥ'
2 kha reads 'dvidhākṛtam'
:p 159
At its back is an alley of one square; having that share is a three-petalled [lotus] joined with horses;

sanskrit_iast:
vasudevasutaiḥ sābjaistidalaiḥ pādapaṭṭikā /
tadūrdhve vedikā deyā bhagamātrapramāṇataḥ //
meaning:
वसुदेवसुतैः साब्जैस्तिदलैः पादपट्टिका /
तदूर्ध्वे वेदिका देया भगमात्रप्रमाणतः //
text_mt: there is a base-border of three-petalled [divisions] with lotuses by the sons of Vasudeva; / above that an altar should be placed measuring merely one unit.

sanskrit_iast:
dvāraṃ padmamitaṃ koṣṭhādupadvāraṃ vivarṇitam /
dvāropadvāraracitaṃ maṇḍalaṃ vighnasūdanam //
meaning:
द्वारं पद्ममितं कोष्ठादुपद्वारं विवर्णितम् /
द्वारोपद्वाररचितं मण्डलं विघ्नसूदनम् //
text_mt: The doorway is of lotus measure; from the compartment the side-doorway is colorless; / the maṇḍala constructed with doors and side-doors destroys obstacles.

sanskrit_iast:
āraktaṃ kamalaṃ madhye vāhyapadmāni tadvahiḥ /
sitā tu vīthikā kāryā dvārāṇi tu yathecchayā //
meaning:
आरक्तं कमलं मध्ये वाह्यपद्मानि तद्वहिः /
सिता तु वीथिका कार्या द्वाराणि तु यथेच्छया //
text_mt: The lotus in the center is reddish; outside it are outer lotuses; / the pathway should be made white, and the doors as one wishes.

sanskrit_iast:
karṇikā pītavarṇā syāt keśarāṇi tathā punaḥ /
maṇḍalaṃ vighnamardākhyaṃ madhye gaṇapatiṃ yajet //
meaning:
कर्णिका पीतवर्णा स्यात् केशराणि तथा पुनः /
मण्डलं विघ्नमर्दाख्यं मध्ये गणपतिं यजेत् //
text_mt: The pericarp should be yellow, and likewise the filaments; / this is the maṇḍala named Vighnamarda, in the center of which one should worship Gaṇapati.

sanskrit_iast:
nāmādyaṃ savarākaṃ syāddevācchakrasamanvitam /
śiro hataṃ tatpuruṣeṇa omādyañca namo 'ntakam //
meaning:
नामाद्यं सवराकं स्याद्देवाच्छक्रसमन्वितम् /
शिरो हतं तत्पुरुषेण ओमाद्यञ्च नमो ऽन्तकम् //
text_mt: The first name should have the varāka, combined with Śakra from the deity; / the head is struck with Tatpuruṣa, beginning with oṃ and ending with namaḥ:

sanskrit_iast:
gajākhyaṃ gajaśīrṣañca gāṅgeyaṃ gaṇanāyakam /
trirāvartaṅgaganagaṅgopatiṃ pūrvapaṅktigam //
meaning:
गजाख्यं गजशीर्षञ्च गाङ्गेयं गणनायकम् /
त्रिरावर्तङ्गगनगङ्गोपतिं पूर्वपङ्क्तिगम् //
text_mt: Gajākhya, Gajaśīrṣa, Gāṅgeya, Gaṇanāyaka, / Trirāvarta, and Gaganagaṅgāpati in the eastern row;

sanskrit_iast:
vicitrāṃśaṃ mahākāyaṃ lamboṣṭhaṃ lambakarṇakam /
lambodaraṃ mahābhāgaṃ vikṛtaṃ pārvatīpriyam //
meaning:
विचित्रांशं महाकायं लम्बोष्ठं लम्बकर्णकम् /
लम्बोदरं महाभागं विकृतं पार्वतीप्रियम् //
text_mt: Vicitrāṃśa, Mahākāya, Lamboṣṭha, Lambakarṇaka, / Lambodara, Mahābhāga, Vikṛta, Pārvatīpriya,

sanskrit_iast:
bhayāvahañca bhadrañca bhagaṇaṃ bhayasūdanam /
dvādaśaite daśapaṅktau devatrāsañca paścime //
meaning:
भयावहञ्च भद्रञ्च भगणं भयसूदनम् /
द्वादशैते दशपङ्क्तौ देवत्रासञ्च पश्चिमे //
text_mt: Bhayāvaha, Bhadra, Bhagaṇa, and Bhayasūdana— / these twelve in the row of ten; and Devatrāsa in the west;

sanskrit_iast:
mahānādambhāsvarañca vighnarājaṃ gaṇādhipam /
udbhaṭasvānabhaś caṇḍau mahāśuṇḍañca bhīmakam //
meaning:
महानादम्भास्वरञ्च विघ्नराजं गणाधिपम् /
उद्भटस्वानभश् चण्डौ महाशुण्डञ्च भीमकम् //
text_mt: Mahānāda, Bhāsvara, Vighnarāja, Gaṇādhipa, / Udbhaṭa, Svānabha, Caṇḍa, Mahāśuṇḍa, Bhīmaka,

sanskrit_iast:
manmathaṃ madhusūdañca sundaraṃ bhāvapuṣṭakam /
saumye brahmeśvaraṃ brāhmaṃ manovṛttiñca saṃlayam //
meaning:
मन्मथं मधुसूदञ्च सुन्दरं भावपुष्टकम् /
सौम्ये ब्रह्मेश्वरं ब्राह्मं मनोवृत्तिञ्च संलयम् //
text_mt: Manmatha, Madhusūdana, Sundara, Bhāvapuṣṭaka; / in the north, Brahmeśvara, Brāhma, Manovṛtti, Saṃlaya,

sanskrit_iast:
layaṃ dūtyapriyaṃ laulyaṃ vikarṇaṃ vatsalaṃ tathā /
kṛtāntaṃ kāladaḍaṇca yajet kumbhañca pūrvavat //
:p 160
meaning:
लयं दूत्यप्रियं लौल्यं विकर्णं वत्सलं तथा /
कृतान्तं कालदडण्च यजेत् कुम्भञ्च पूर्ववत् //
:प् 160
text_mt:
Laya, Dūtyapriya, Laulya, Vikarṇa, and likewise Vatsala, / Kṛtānta, and Kāładaṇḍa; and one should worship the water jar as before.
:p 160

sanskrit_iast:
śrayutañca japenmantraṃ homayettu daśāṃśataḥ /
śeṣāṇāntu daśāhutyā japāddhomantu kārayet //
meaning:
श्रयुतञ्च जपेन्मन्त्रं होमयेत्तु दशांशतः /
शेषाणान्तु दशाहुत्या जपाद्धोमन्तु कारयेत् //
text_mt: One should recite the mantra ten thousand times and perform fire oblation with a tenth part of it; / but for the remaining [deities], one should make the fire oblation with ten oblations from the recitation.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrṇāṃ datvābhiṣekantu kuryātsarvantu sidhyati /
bhūgo 'śvagajavastrādyair gurupūjāñcarennaraḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe gaṇapūjā nāma saptadaśādhikatriśatatamo
'dhyāyaḥ
:ś athāṣṭādaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
vāgīśvarīpūjā
meaning:
पूर्णां दत्वाभिषेकन्तु कुर्यात्सर्वन्तु सिध्यति /
भूगो ऽश्वगजवस्त्राद्यैर् गुरुपूजाञ्चरेन्नरः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे गणपूजा नाम सप्तदशाधिकत्रिशततमो
ऽध्यायः
:श् अथाष्टादशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
वागीश्वरीपूजा
text_mt:
Having offered the full final oblation, one should perform the consecration by aspersion; everything succeeds. / A man should perform the worship of the guru with land, cows, horses, elephants, garments, and so on.
Thus ends the three hundred and seventeenth chapter, named the Worship of Gaṇas, in the great Agnipurāṇa.
Now the three hundred and eighteenth chapter.
Worship of Vāgīśvarī.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
vāgīśvarīpūjanañca pravadāmi samaṇḍalam /
ūhakaṃ kālasaṃyuktaṃ manuṃ varṇasamāyutam(1) //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
वागीश्वरीपूजनञ्च प्रवदामि समण्डलम् /
ऊहकं कालसंयुक्तं मनुं वर्णसमायुतम्(1) //
text_mt: Īśvara said: / I shall declare the worship of Vāgīśvarī along with the maṇḍala. / The ūhaka combined with Kāla, the mantra accompanied by syllables,

sanskrit_iast:
niṣāda īśvaraṃ kāryaṃ manunā candrasūryavat /
akṣaranna hi deyaṃ syāt dhyāyet kundendusannibhāṃ //
meaning:
निषाद ईश्वरं कार्यं मनुना चन्द्रसूर्यवत् /
अक्षरन्न हि देयं स्यात् ध्यायेत् कुन्देन्दुसन्निभां //
text_mt: the Niṣāda should be made Īśvara by the mantra, like the moon and sun; / no syllable should be given; one should meditate on her resembling the jasmine and moon,

sanskrit_iast:
pañcāśadvarṇamālāntu muktāsragdāmabhūṣitām /
varadābhayākṣasūtrapustakāḍhyāṃ trilocanāṃ //
meaning:
पञ्चाशद्वर्णमालान्तु मुक्तास्रग्दामभूषिताम् /
वरदाभयाक्षसूत्रपुस्तकाढ्यां त्रिलोचनां //
text_mt: adorned with a garland of fifty syllables and strings of pearl garlands, / endowed with the gestures of granting boons and fearlessness, a rosary, and a book, three-eyed.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ japenmastakāntaṃ skandhāntaṃ varṇamālikāṃ /
akārādikṣakārāntāṃ viśantīṃ mānavat smaret //
meaning:
लक्षं जपेन्मस्तकान्तं स्कन्धान्तं वर्णमालिकां /
अकारादिक्षकारान्तां विशन्तीं मानवत् स्मरेत् //
text_mt: One should recite [the mantra] one hundred thousand times up to the head; one should meditate on the garland of syllables reaching to the shoulders, / extending from the syllable 'a' to 'kṣa', entering like a human being.

sanskrit_iast:
kuryād guruś ca dīkṣārthaṃ mantragrāhe tu maṇḍalam /
sūryāgramindubhaktantu bhāgābhyāṃ kamalaṃ hitaṃ(2) //
:n
1 candramasāyutamiti ña..
2 kṛtamiti kha..
:p 161
meaning:
कुर्याद् गुरुश् च दीक्षार्थं मन्त्रग्राहे तु मण्डलम् /
सूर्याग्रमिन्दुभक्तन्तु भागाभ्यां कमलं हितं(2) //
:न्
1 चन्द्रमसायुतमिति ञ..
2 कृतमिति ख..
:प् 161
text_mt:
And the guru should construct a maṇḍala for initiation upon receiving the mantra; / divided by the sun and moon, a lotus with two shares is beneficial.
:n
1 ña reads 'candramasāyutam'
2 kha reads 'kṛtam'
:p 161

sanskrit_iast:
vīthikā padikā karyā padmānyaṣṭau catuṣpade /
vīthikā padikā vāhye dvārāṇi dvipadāni tu //
meaning:
वीथिका पदिका कर्या पद्मान्यष्टौ चतुष्पदे /
वीथिका पदिका वाह्ये द्वाराणि द्विपदानि तु //
text_mt: A pathway of one square is to be made, with eight lotuses in four squares; / an outer pathway of one square, and doors of two squares;

sanskrit_iast:
upadvārāṇita dvacca koṇabāndhaṃ dvipaṭṭikam(1) /
sidāni nava padmāni karṇikā kanakaprabhā //
meaning:
उपद्वाराणित द्वच्च कोणबान्धं द्विपट्टिकम्(1) /
सिदानि नव पद्मानि कर्णिका कनकप्रभा //
text_mt: side-doors likewise; the corner-band is of two strips; / nine white lotuses, and the pericarp has the luster of gold;

sanskrit_iast:
keśarāṇi vicitrāṇi koṇānraktena pūrayet /
vyomarekhāntaraṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dvārāṇīndrebhamānataḥ //
meaning:
केशराणि विचित्राणि कोणान्रक्तेन पूरयेत् /
व्योमरेखान्तरं कृष्णं द्वाराणीन्द्रेभमानतः //
text_mt: the filaments are multicolored; one should fill the corners with red; / the space between the sky-lines is black, and the doors measure an Indra-elephant.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye sarasvatīṃ padme vāgīśī pūrvapadmake /
hṛllekhā citravāgīśī gāyatrī viśvarūpayā //
meaning:
मध्ये सरस्वतीं पद्मे वागीशी पूर्वपद्मके /
हृल्लेखा चित्रवागीशी गायत्री विश्वरूपया //
text_mt: In the center lotus is Sarasvatī, Vāgīśī in the eastern lotus, / Hṛllekhā, Citravāgīśī, Gāyatrī with Viśvarūpā,

sanskrit_iast:
śāṅkarī matirdhṛtiś ca pūrvādyā hrīṃ svavījakāḥ /
dhyeyā sarasvatīvacca kapilājyena homakaḥ /
saṃskṛtaprākṛtakaviḥ kāvyaśāstrādividbhavet //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe vāgīśvarīpūjā
nāmāṣṭādaśādhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś athonaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
meaning:
शाङ्करी मतिर्धृतिश् च पूर्वाद्या ह्रीं स्ववीजकाः /
ध्येया सरस्वतीवच्च कपिलाज्येन होमकः /
संस्कृतप्राकृतकविः काव्यशास्त्रादिविद्भवेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे वागीश्वरीपूजा
नामाष्टादशाधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथोनविंशत्यधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
text_mt:
Śāṅkarī, Mati, and Dhṛti, in the east and other [directions], having 'hrīṃ' as their seed-syllables, / are to be meditated upon like Sarasvatī; the fire oblation is with ghee of a brown cow; / one becomes a poet in Sanskrit and Prakrit, and a knower of poetics, treatises, and so forth.
Thus ends the three hundred and eighteenth chapter, named the Worship of Vāgīśvarī, in the great Agnipurāṇa.
Now the three hundred and nineteenth chapter.

sanskrit_iast:
maṇḍalāni
īśvara uvāca
sarvato bhadrakānyaṣṭamaṇḍalāni vade guha /
śaktimāsādhayet prācīmiṣṭāyāṃ viṣuve sudhīḥ //
meaning:
मण्डलानि
ईश्वर उवाच
सर्वतो भद्रकान्यष्टमण्डलानि वदे गुह /
शक्तिमासाधयेत् प्राचीमिष्टायां विषुवे सुधीः //
text_mt: Maṇḍalas. / Īśvara said: / I shall declare eight Sarvatobhadra maṇḍalas, O Guha. / The wise man should establish the east by means of a gnomon at a desired equinox,

sanskrit_iast:
citrāsvātyantareṇātha dṛṣṭasūtreṇa vā punaḥ /
pūrvāparāyataṃ sūtramāsphālya madhyato 'ṅkayet //
:n
1 dviparṇakamiti kha..
:p 162
meaning:
चित्रास्वात्यन्तरेणाथ दृष्टसूत्रेण वा पुनः /
पूर्वापरायतं सूत्रमास्फाल्य मध्यतो ऽङ्कयेत् //
:न्
1 द्विपर्णकमिति ख..

text_mt:
or through the space between Citrā and Svātī, or again by an observed cord; / having stretched a cord extending east to west, he should mark it from the center.
:n

:p 162

sanskrit_iast:
koṭidvayantu tanmadhyādaṅkayeddakṣiṇottaram /
madhye dvayaṃ prakartavya sphālayeddakṣinottaram //
meaning:
कोटिद्वयन्तु तन्मध्यादङ्कयेद्दक्षिणोत्तरम् /
मध्ये द्वयं प्रकर्तव्य स्फालयेद्दक्षिनोत्तरम् //
text_mt: He should mark two endpoints north and south from its center; / two [points] are to be made in the center; he should stretch [the cord] north and south.

sanskrit_iast:
śatakṣetrārdhamānena koṇasampātamādiśet /
evaṃ sūtracatuṣkasya sphālanāccaturasrakam //
meaning:
शतक्षेत्रार्धमानेन कोणसम्पातमादिशेत् /
एवं सूत्रचतुष्कस्य स्फालनाच्चतुरस्रकम् //
text_mt: By the measure of half of the field of a hundred, he should indicate the intersection of the corners; / thus by stretching the four cords a square

sanskrit_iast:
jāyate tatra kartavyaṃ bhadrasvedakaraṃ śubham /
vasubhaktendu dvipade kṣetre vīthī ca bhāgikā //
meaning:
जायते तत्र कर्तव्यं भद्रस्वेदकरं शुभम् /
वसुभक्तेन्दु द्विपदे क्षेत्रे वीथी च भागिका //
text_mt: is produced; therein the auspicious [maṇḍala] that causes good fortune should be made. / In the field divided by eight into squares of one and two, there is a pathway of one share;

sanskrit_iast:
dvāraṃ dvipadikaṃ padmamānāddhai sakapolakam /
kīṇabandhavicitrantu dvipadaṃ tatra vartayet //
meaning:
द्वारं द्विपदिकं पद्ममानाद्धै सकपोलकम् /
कीणबन्धविचित्रन्तु द्विपदं तत्र वर्तयेत् //
text_mt: a door of two squares, half the size of the lotus, with cheeks; / he should delineate there a variegated corner-band of two squares.

sanskrit_iast:
śuklaṃ padmaṃ karṇikā tu pītā citrantu keśaram /
raktā vīthī tatra kalpyā dvāraṃ lokeśarūpakaṃ //
meaning:
शुक्लं पद्मं कर्णिका तु पीता चित्रन्तु केशरम् /
रक्ता वीथी तत्र कल्प्या द्वारं लोकेशरूपकं //
text_mt: The lotus is white, the pericarp is yellow, and the filament is multicolored; / a red pathway is to be designed there, and the door has the form of a world-guardian.

sanskrit_iast:
raktakoṇaṃ vidhau nitye naimittikābjakaṃ śṛṇu /
asaṃsaktantu saṃsaktaṃ dvidhābjaṃ bhuktimuktikṛt //
meaning:
रक्तकोणं विधौ नित्ये नैमित्तिकाब्जकं शृणु /
असंसक्तन्तु संसक्तं द्विधाब्जं भुक्तिमुक्तिकृत् //
text_mt: Hear of the lotus in the regular rite having red corners, and the occasional [lotus]: / the lotus is twofold, disconnected and connected, granting worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃsaktaṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ saṃsaktaṃ tattridhā pṛthak /
bālo yuvā ca vṛddhaś ca nāmataḥ phalasiddhidāḥ //
meaning:
असंसक्तं मुमुक्षूणां संसक्तं तत्त्रिधा पृथक् /
बालो युवा च वृद्धश् च नामतः फलसिद्धिदाः //
text_mt: The disconnected is for seekers of liberation; the connected is distinctly threefold: / young, mature, and aged by name, granting the achievement of fruits.

sanskrit_iast:
padmakṣetre tu sūtrāṇi digvidikṣu vinikṣipet /
vṛttāni pañcakalpāni padmakṣetrasamāni tu //
meaning:
पद्मक्षेत्रे तु सूत्राणि दिग्विदिक्षु विनिक्षिपेत् /
वृत्तानि पञ्चकल्पानि पद्मक्षेत्रसमानि तु //
text_mt: In the field of the lotus, one should cast cords in the cardinal and intermediate directions; / five concentric circles equal to the lotus-field [are drawn].

sanskrit_iast:
prathame karṇikā tatra puṣkarair navabhiryutā /
keśarāṇi caturviṃśadvitīye 'tha tṛtīyake //
meaning:
प्रथमे कर्णिका तत्र पुष्करैर् नवभिर्युता /
केशराणि चतुर्विंशद्वितीये ऽथ तृतीयके //
text_mt: In the first there is the pericarp accompanied by nine petals; / in the second are twenty-four filaments; then in the third,

sanskrit_iast:
dalasandhirgajakumbha nibhāntaryaddalāgrakam /
pañcame vyomarūpantu saṃsaktaṃ kamalaṃ smṛtaṃ //
meaning:
दलसन्धिर्गजकुम्भ निभान्तर्यद्दलाग्रकम् /
पञ्चमे व्योमरूपन्तु संसक्तं कमलं स्मृतं //
text_mt: The petal junction resembles an elephant's frontal lobe; the petal tip is within it. / In the fifth, which is shaped like the sky, the lotus is regarded as connected.

sanskrit_iast:
asaṃsakte dalāgre tu digbhāgair vistarādbhajet /
bhāgadvayaparityāgādvasvaṃśair vartayeddalam //
meaning:
असंसक्ते दलाग्रे तु दिग्भागैर् विस्तराद्भजेत् /
भागद्वयपरित्यागाद्वस्वंशैर् वर्तयेद्दलम् //
text_mt: If the petal tips are disconnected, one should divide the breadth into ten parts. / Discarding two parts, one should trace the petal with eight parts.

sanskrit_iast:
sandhivistarasūtreṇa tanmūlādañjayeddalam /
:p 163
savyāsavyakrameṇaiva vṛddhametadbhavettathā //
meaning:
सन्धिविस्तरसूत्रेण तन्मूलादञ्जयेद्दलम् /
:प् 163
सव्यासव्यक्रमेणैव वृद्धमेतद्भवेत्तथा //
text_mt:
One should draw the petal from its base with the cord of the junction's width
[Page 163]
clockwise and counter-clockwise in succession; thus it becomes expanded.

sanskrit_iast:
atha vā sandhimadhyāttu bhrāmayedardhacandravat /
sandhidvayāgrasūtraṃ vā bālapadmantathā bhavet //
meaning:
अथ वा सन्धिमध्यात्तु भ्रामयेदर्धचन्द्रवत् /
सन्धिद्वयाग्रसूत्रं वा बालपद्मन्तथा भवेत् //
text_mt: Or else, one should sweep from the center of the junction like a crescent moon, / or [use] the cord from the tips of the two junctions; thus it becomes a young lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
sandhisūtrārdhamānena pṛṣṭhataḥ parivartayet /
tīkṣṇāgrantu suvātena kamalaṃ bhuktimuktidam //
meaning:
सन्धिसूत्रार्धमानेन पृष्ठतः परिवर्तयेत् /
तीक्ष्णाग्रन्तु सुवातेन कमलं भुक्तिमुक्तिदम् //
text_mt: One should turn it backwards with the measure of half the junction cord. / With sharp tips and well-arranged winds, the lotus grants worldly enjoyment and liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
bhuktivṛddhau ca vaśyādau bālaṃ padmaṃ samānakaṃ /
navanābhaṃ navahastaṃ bhāgair mantrātmakaiś ca tat //
meaning:
भुक्तिवृद्धौ च वश्यादौ बालं पद्मं समानकं /
नवनाभं नवहस्तं भागैर् मन्त्रात्मकैश् च तत् //
text_mt: For the increase of worldly enjoyment and in subjugation and the like, the young lotus is equal [in effect]. / Having nine centers and nine cubits, divided into parts made of mantras,

sanskrit_iast:
madhye 'bjaṃ paṭṭikāvījaṃ dvāreṇābjasya mānataḥ /
kaṇṭhopakaṇṭhamuktāni tadvāhye vīthikā matā //
meaning:
मध्ये ऽब्जं पट्टिकावीजं द्वारेणाब्जस्य मानतः /
कण्ठोपकण्ठमुक्तानि तद्वाह्ये वीथिका मता //
text_mt: a lotus is in the center with a bordering band, measured by the door of the lotus. / When the neck and sub-neck are left open, outside it an aisle is prescribed.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcabhāgānvitā(1) sā tu samantāddaśabhāgikā /
digvidikṣvaṣṭa padmāni dvārapadmaṃ savīthikam //
meaning:
पञ्चभागान्विता(1) सा तु समन्ताद्दशभागिका /
दिग्विदिक्ष्वष्ट पद्मानि द्वारपद्मं सवीथिकम् //
text_mt: Endowed with five parts, it has ten parts all around. / In the cardinal and intermediate directions are eight lotuses; the door-lotus is with an aisle.

sanskrit_iast:
tadvāhye pañca padikā vīthikā yatra bhūṣitā /
padmavaddvārakaṇṭhantu padikañcauṣṭhakaṇṭhakaṃ //
meaning:
तद्वाह्ये पञ्च पदिका वीथिका यत्र भूषिता /
पद्मवद्द्वारकण्ठन्तु पदिकञ्चौष्ठकण्ठकं //
text_mt: Outside that is an aisle of five squares where it is adorned; / like the lotus, the neck of the door is of one square, and the lip-neck is [also] of one square.

sanskrit_iast:
kapolaṃ padikaṃ kāryaṃ dikṣu dvāratrayaṃ spuṭam /
koṇabandhaṃ tripattantu dvipaṭṭaṃ vajravadbhavet //
meaning:
कपोलं पदिकं कार्यं दिक्षु द्वारत्रयं स्पुटम् /
कोणबन्धं त्रिपत्तन्तु द्विपट्टं वज्रवद्भवेत् //
text_mt: The cheek is to be made of one square, and clearly three doors in the cardinal directions. / The corner-fastening is of three bands; having two bands, it resembles a vajra.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyantu kamalaṃ śuklaṃ pītaṃ raktañca nīlakam /
pītaśuklañca dhūmrañca raktaṃ pītañca muktidam //
meaning:
मध्यन्तु कमलं शुक्लं पीतं रक्तञ्च नीलकम् /
पीतशुक्लञ्च धूम्रञ्च रक्तं पीतञ्च मुक्तिदम् //
text_mt: The central lotus is white, yellow, red, and blue, / yellow, white, smoky, and red and yellow, granting liberation.

sanskrit_iast:
pūrvādau kamalānyaṣṭa śivaviṣṇvādikaṃ japet /
prāsādamadhyato 'bhyarcya śakrādīnabjakādiṣu //
meaning:
पूर्वादौ कमलान्यष्ट शिवविष्ण्वादिकं जपेत् /
प्रासादमध्यतो ऽभ्यर्च्य शक्रादीनब्जकादिषु //
text_mt: In the eight lotuses beginning in the east, one should recite [mantras of] Śiva, Viṣṇu, and others, / having worshipped Indra and the others in the small lotuses from the center of the temple.

sanskrit_iast:
astrāṇi vāhyavīthyāntu viṣṇvādīnaśvameghabhāk /
pavitrārohaṇādau ca mahāmaṇḍalamālikhet //
meaning:
अस्त्राणि वाह्यवीथ्यान्तु विष्ण्वादीनश्वमेघभाक् /
पवित्रारोहणादौ च महामण्डलमालिखेत् //
text_mt: In the outer aisle are the weapons; one who worships Viṣṇu and others shares the horse sacrifice. / At the investiture with sacred thread and the like, one should draw the great maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭahastaṃ purā kṣetraṃ rasapakṣair vivartayet /
:n
1 pañcabhāgamiteti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 164
dvipadaṃ kamalaṃ madhye vīthikā padikā tataḥ //
meaning:
अष्टहस्तं पुरा क्षेत्रं रसपक्षैर् विवर्तयेत् /
:न्
1 पञ्चभागमितेति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 164
द्विपदं कमलं मध्ये वीथिका पदिका ततः //
text_mt:
One should formerly divide the field of eight cubits into twenty-six [divisions].
[Note]
1. kha and cha read 'measured by five parts' (pañcabhāgamitā). / [Page 164]
The lotus is of two squares in the center; then there is an aisle of one square.

sanskrit_iast:
digvidikṣu tato 'ṣṭau ca nīlābjāni vivartayet /
madhyapadmapramāṇena triṃśatpadmāni tāni tu //
meaning:
दिग्विदिक्षु ततो ऽष्टौ च नीलाब्जानि विवर्तयेत् /
मध्यपद्मप्रमाणेन त्रिंशत्पद्मानि तानि तु //
text_mt: Then in the cardinal and intermediate directions one should draw eight blue lotuses. / According to the measure of the central lotus, these are thirty lotuses,

sanskrit_iast:
dalasandhivihīnāni nīlendīvarakāni ca /
tatpṛṣṭhe padikā vīthī svastikāni tadūrdhvataḥ //
meaning:
दलसन्धिविहीनानि नीलेन्दीवरकानि च /
तत्पृष्ठे पदिका वीथी स्वस्तिकानि तदूर्ध्वतः //
text_mt: devoid of petal junctions, being blue water-lilies. / At their back is an aisle of one square, and svastikas above them.

sanskrit_iast:
dvipadāni tathā cāṣṭau kṛtibhāgakṛtāni tu /
vartayet svastikāṃstatra vīthikā pūrvavadvahiḥ //
meaning:
द्विपदानि तथा चाष्टौ कृतिभागकृतानि तु /
वर्तयेत् स्वस्तिकांस्तत्र वीथिका पूर्ववद्वहिः //
text_mt: And eight [svastikas] of two squares each, made with four parts; / one should draw the svastikas there; the aisle outside is as before.

sanskrit_iast:
dvārāṇi kamalaṃ yadvadupakaṇṭhyutāni(1) tu /
raktaṃ koṇaṃ pītavīthī nīlaṃ padmañcamaṇḍale //
meaning:
द्वाराणि कमलं यद्वदुपकण्ठ्युतानि(1) तु /
रक्तं कोणं पीतवीथी नीलं पद्मञ्चमण्डले //
text_mt: The doors are like the lotus, but endowed with sub-necks. / The corner is red, the aisle yellow, and the lotus blue in the maṇḍala.

sanskrit_iast:
svastikādi vicitrañca sarvakāmapradaṃ guha /
pañcābjaṃ pañcahastaṃ syāt samantāddaśabhājitam //
meaning:
स्वस्तिकादि विचित्रञ्च सर्वकामप्रदं गुह /
पञ्चाब्जं पञ्चहस्तं स्यात् समन्ताद्दशभाजितम् //
text_mt: With variegated svastikas and the like, it grants all desires, O Guha. / The five-lotus [maṇḍala] should be five cubits, divided into ten all around.

sanskrit_iast:
dvipadaṃ kamalaṃ vīthī paṭṭikā dikṣu paṅkajam /
catuṣkaṃ pṛṣṭhato vīthī padikā dvipadānyathā //
meaning:
द्विपदं कमलं वीथी पट्टिका दिक्षु पङ्कजम् /
चतुष्कं पृष्ठतो वीथी पदिका द्विपदान्यथा //
text_mt: The lotus is of two squares, the aisle and band; in the cardinal directions is a group of four lotuses. / At the back is an aisle of one square, then [doors] of two squares

sanskrit_iast:
kaṇṭhopakaṇṭhayuktāni dvārānyabjantu madhyataḥ /
pañcābjamaṇḍale hy asmin sitaṃ pītañca pūrvakam //
meaning:
कण्ठोपकण्ठयुक्तानि द्वारान्यब्जन्तु मध्यतः /
पञ्चाब्जमण्डले ह्य् अस्मिन् सितं पीतञ्च पूर्वकम् //
text_mt: provided with neck and sub-neck; the doors and the lotus are in the center. / In this five-lotus maṇḍala, the eastern one is white and yellow;

sanskrit_iast:
vaidūryābhaṃ dakṣiṇābjaṃ kundābhaṃ vāruṇaṃ kajam /
uttarābjantu śaṅkhābhamanyat sarvaṃ vicitrakam //
meaning:
वैदूर्याभं दक्षिणाब्जं कुन्दाभं वारुणं कजम् /
उत्तराब्जन्तु शङ्खाभमन्यत् सर्वं विचित्रकम् //
text_mt: the southern lotus has the luster of cat's-eye; the western lotus has the luster of kunda jasmine; / the northern lotus has the luster of a conch shell; all the rest is variegated.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvakāmapradaṃ vakṣye daśahastantu maṇḍalam /
vikārabhaktanturyāśraṃ dvārantu dvipadaṃ bhavet //
meaning:
सर्वकामप्रदं वक्ष्ये दशहस्तन्तु मण्डलम् /
विकारभक्तन्तुर्याश्रं द्वारन्तु द्विपदं भवेत् //
text_mt: I shall speak of the ten-cubit maṇḍala which grants all desires: / it is square, divided into sixteen; the door should be of two squares.

sanskrit_iast:
madhye padmaṃ pūrvavacca vighnadhvaṃsaṃ vadāmyatha /
caturhastaṃ puraṃ kṛtvā vṛtrañcaiva karadvayam //
meaning:
मध्ये पद्मं पूर्ववच्च विघ्नध्वंसं वदाम्यथ /
चतुर्हस्तं पुरं कृत्वा वृत्रञ्चैव करद्वयम् //
text_mt: The lotus in the center is as before. Now I declare the destruction of obstacles: / having made a square of four cubits, and a circle of two cubits,

sanskrit_iast:
vīthīkā hastamātrantu svastikair vahubhirvṛtā /
:n
1 tadvadupakaṇṭhayutānīti kha.. , ña.. ca
:p 165
hastamātrāṇi dvārāṇi vikṣu vṛttaṃ sapadmakam //
meaning:
वीथीका हस्तमात्रन्तु स्वस्तिकैर् वहुभिर्वृता /
:न्
1 तद्वदुपकण्ठयुतानीति ख.. , ञ.. च
:प् 165
हस्तमात्राणि द्वाराणि विक्षु वृत्तं सपद्मकम् //
text_mt:
the aisle is of one cubit, surrounded by many svastikas.
[Note]
1. kha and ña read 'similarly endowed with sub-necks' (tadvadupakaṇṭhayutāni). / [Page 165]
The doors are of one cubit; in the intermediate directions is a circle with a lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
padmāni pañca śuklāni madhye pūjyaś ca niṣkalaḥ /
hṛdayādīni pūrvādau vidikṣvastrāṇi vai yajet //
meaning:
पद्मानि पञ्च शुक्लानि मध्ये पूज्यश् च निष्कलः /
हृदयादीनि पूर्वादौ विदिक्ष्वस्त्राणि वै यजेत् //
text_mt: There are five white lotuses; the Partless Lord is to be worshipped in the center. / One should worship the heart and other [limbs] beginning in the east, and the weapons in the intermediate directions.

sanskrit_iast:
prāgvacca pañca brahmāṇi buddhyādhāramato vade /
śatabhāge tithibhāge padmaṃ liṅgāṣṭakaṃ diśi //
meaning:
प्राग्वच्च पञ्च ब्रह्माणि बुद्ध्याधारमतो वदे /
शतभागे तिथिभागे पद्मं लिङ्गाष्टकं दिशि //
text_mt: The five Brahmās are as before. Next I declare the support of the intellect: / divided into a hundred parts or fifteen parts, a lotus and eight liṅgas in the cardinal direction.

sanskrit_iast:
mekhalābhāgasaṃyuktaṃ kaṇṭhaṃ dvipadikaṃ bhavet /
ācāryo buddhimāśritya kalpayecca latādikam //
meaning:
मेखलाभागसंयुक्तं कण्ठं द्विपदिकं भवेत् /
आचार्यो बुद्धिमाश्रित्य कल्पयेच्च लतादिकम् //
text_mt: The neck should be endowed with a girdle division, consisting of two squares. / Relying on his intellect, the preceptor should design the creepers and the like.

sanskrit_iast:
catuḥṣaṭpañcamāṣṭādi khāchikhādyādi maṇḍalam /
khākṣīndusūryagaṃ sarvaṃ khākṣi caivenduvarṇanāt //
meaning:
चतुःषट्पञ्चमाष्टादि खाछिखाद्यादि मण्डलम् /
खाक्षीन्दुसूर्यगं सर्वं खाक्षि चैवेन्दुवर्णनात् //
text_mt: Four, six, five, eight, and so forth, beginning with the sky, eyes, sky, and so forth, is the maṇḍala; / all are situated in sky, eyes, moon, and sun, and from the description of sky, eyes, and moon:

sanskrit_iast:
catvāriṃśadadhikāni caturdaśaśatāni hi /
maṇḍalāni hareḥ śambhordevyāḥ sūryasya santi ca //
meaning:
चत्वारिंशदधिकानि चतुर्दशशतानि हि /
मण्डलानि हरेः शम्भोर्देव्याः सूर्यस्य सन्ति च //
text_mt: there are indeed one thousand four hundred and forty / maṇḍalas of Hari, Śambhu, Devī, and Sūrya.

sanskrit_iast:
daśasaptavibhakte tu latāliṅgodbhavaṃ śṛṇu /
dikṣu pañcatrayañcaikaṃ trayaṃ pañca ca lomayet(1) //
meaning:
दशसप्तविभक्ते तु लतालिङ्गोद्भवं शृणु /
दिक्षु पञ्चत्रयञ्चैकं त्रयं पञ्च च लोमयेत्(1) //
text_mt: When divided into seventeen, hear the origin of creepers and liṅgas: / in the cardinal directions, five, three, and one, and three and five one should erase.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvage dvipade liṅgamandiraṃ pārśvakoṣṭhayoḥ /
madhyena dbipadaṃ padmamatha caikañca paṅkajaṃ //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वगे द्विपदे लिङ्गमन्दिरं पार्श्वकोष्ठयोः /
मध्येन द्बिपदं पद्ममथ चैकञ्च पङ्कजं //
text_mt: In the two squares going upward is the liṅga temple in the side chambers; / in the center is a lotus of two squares, and then a single lotus.

sanskrit_iast:
liṅgasya pārśvayorbhadre padadvāramalopanāt /
tatpārśvaśobhāḥ ṣaḍlopya latāḥ śeṣās tathā hareḥ //
meaning:
लिङ्गस्य पार्श्वयोर्भद्रे पदद्वारमलोपनात् /
तत्पार्श्वशोभाः षड्लोप्य लताः शेषास् तथा हरेः //
text_mt: On the flanks of the liṅga in the auspicious [division], because of the erasure of the door of two squares, / erasing the six side decorations, the remaining creepers are thus Hari's.

sanskrit_iast:
ūrdhvaṃ dvipadikaṃ lopya harerbhadrāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam /
raśmimānasamāyuktavedalopācca śobhikam //
meaning:
ऊर्ध्वं द्विपदिकं लोप्य हरेर्भद्राष्टकं स्मृतम् /
रश्मिमानसमायुक्तवेदलोपाच्च शोभिकम् //
text_mt: Erasing two squares above, eight auspicious [divisions] of Hari are remembered. / Joined with the measure of rays, and from erasing four, it is decorative.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcaviṃśatikaṃ padmaṃ tataḥ pīṭhamapīṭhakam /
dvayaṃ dvayaṃ rakṣayitvā upaśobhās tathāṣṭa ca //
meaning:
पञ्चविंशतिकं पद्मं ततः पीठमपीठकम् /
द्वयं द्वयं रक्षयित्वा उपशोभास् तथाष्ट च //
text_mt: The lotus is of twenty-five [squares]; then the pedestal or non-pedestal. / Keeping two and two, there are likewise eight sub-decorations.

sanskrit_iast:
devyādikhyāpakaṃ bhadraṃ vṛhanmadhye paraṃ laghu /
:n
1 lopayediti ña.. / lopayediti ṭa
:p 166
madhye navapadaṃ padmaṃ koṇe bhadracatuṣṭayam //
meaning:
देव्यादिख्यापकं भद्रं वृहन्मध्ये परं लघु /
:न्
1 लोपयेदिति ञ.. / लोपयेदिति ट
:प् 166
मध्ये नवपदं पद्मं कोणे भद्रचतुष्टयम् //
text_mt:
The auspicious design indicative of Devī and others is large in the center, and the other is small.
[Note]
1. ña reads 'lopayed'; ṭa reads 'lopayed'. / [Page 166]
In the center is a lotus of nine squares; in the corner is a group of four auspicious designs.

sanskrit_iast:
trayodaśapadaṃ śeṣaṃ buddhyādhārantu maṇḍalaṃ /
śatapatraṃ ṣaṣṭyadhikaṃ buddhyādhāraṃ harādiṣu //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe maṇḍalāni
nāmonaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:ś atha viṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
aghīrāstrādiśāntikalpaḥ
meaning:
त्रयोदशपदं शेषं बुद्ध्याधारन्तु मण्डलं /
शतपत्रं षष्ट्यधिकं बुद्ध्याधारं हरादिषु //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे मण्डलानि
नामोनविंशत्यधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
:श् अथ विंशत्यधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
अघीरास्त्रादिशान्तिकल्पः
text_mt:
The remainder is of thirteen squares; this is the buddhyādhāra maṇḍala. / With one hundred and sixty petals, the buddhyādhāra is for Hara and others.
Thus ends the three hundred and nineteenth chapter, entitled 'Maṇḍalas', in the Mahāpurāṇa composed by Agni.
Now the three hundred and twentieth chapter.
The rite of pacification using the Aghorāstra and other weapons.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
astrayāgaḥ purā kāryaḥ sarvakarmasu siddhidaḥ /
madhye pūjyaṃ śivādyastraṃ vajrādīn pūrvataḥ kramāt //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
अस्त्रयागः पुरा कार्यः सर्वकर्मसु सिद्धिदः /
मध्ये पूज्यं शिवाद्यस्त्रं वज्रादीन् पूर्वतः क्रमात् //
text_mt: The Lord said: / The sacrifice to weapons should be performed first; it grants success in all rites. / In the center, the weapon of Śiva or others is to be worshipped, and the vajra and others in the east in sequence.

sanskrit_iast:
pañcacakraṃ daśakaraṃ raṇādau pūjitaṃ jaye /
grahapūjā ravirmadhye pūrvādyāḥ somakādayaḥ //
meaning:
पञ्चचक्रं दशकरं रणादौ पूजितं जये /
ग्रहपूजा रविर्मध्ये पूर्वाद्याः सोमकादयः //
text_mt: Having five wheels and ten arms, worshipped in battle and the like, it brings victory. / In the worship of planets, the Sun is in the center, the Moon and others beginning in the east.

sanskrit_iast:
sarva ekādaśasthāstu grahāḥ syuḥ grahapūjanāt /
astraśāntiṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvotpātavināśinīṃ //
meaning:
सर्व एकादशस्थास्तु ग्रहाः स्युः ग्रहपूजनात् /
अस्त्रशान्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वोत्पातविनाशिनीं //
text_mt: All planets become placed in the eleventh house by worship of the planets. / I shall declare the pacification by the weapon, which destroys all portents,

sanskrit_iast:
graharogādiśamanīṃ mārīśatruvimardanīṃ /
vināyakopataptighnamaghorāstraṃ japennaraḥ //
meaning:
ग्रहरोगादिशमनीं मारीशत्रुविमर्दनीं /
विनायकोपतप्तिघ्नमघोरास्त्रं जपेन्नरः //
text_mt: calms planetary afflictions, illnesses, and the like, and crushes plagues and enemies. / A man should recite the Aghorāstra [mantra], which removes torment caused by Vināyakas.

sanskrit_iast:
lakṣaṃ grahādināśaḥ syādutpāte tilahomanam /
divye lakṣaṃ tadardhena vyomajotpātanāśanaṃ //
meaning:
लक्षं ग्रहादिनाशः स्यादुत्पाते तिलहोमनम् /
दिव्ये लक्षं तदर्धेन व्योमजोत्पातनाशनं //
text_mt: One hundred thousand [recitations] bring destruction of planetary evils; at a portent, there should be an oblation of sesame. / For a celestial [portent], one hundred thousand; by half of that, destruction of portents born of the sky.

sanskrit_iast:
ghṛtena lakṣapātena utpāte bhumije hitam /
ghṛtagugguluhome ca sarvotpātādimardanam //
:p 167
meaning:
घृतेन लक्षपातेन उत्पाते भुमिजे हितम् /
घृतगुग्गुलुहोमे च सर्वोत्पातादिमर्दनम् //
:प् 167
text_mt:
With one hundred thousand drops of clarified butter, it is beneficial in an earth-born portent. / And in an oblation of clarified butter and guggulu, there is destruction of all portents and the like.
[Page 167]

sanskrit_iast:
dūrvākṣatājyahomena vyādhayo 'tha ghṛtena ca /
sahasreṇa tu duḥkhasvapnā vinaśanti na saṃśayaḥ //
meaning:
दूर्वाक्षताज्यहोमेन व्याधयो ऽथ घृतेन च /
सहस्रेण तु दुःखस्वप्ना विनशन्ति न संशयः //
text_mt: By a fire oblation of dūrvā grass, unbroken grain, and clarified butter, diseases [are destroyed]; moreover, with clarified butter, / by a thousand [oblations], bad dreams are destroyed without doubt.

sanskrit_iast:
ayutād grahadoṣaghno javāghṛtavimiśritāt /
vināyakārtiśamanamayutena ghṛtasya ca //
meaning:
अयुताद् ग्रहदोषघ्नो जवाघृतविमिश्रितात् /
विनायकार्तिशमनमयुतेन घृतस्य च //
text_mt: From ten thousand [oblations] of clarified butter mixed with hibiscus, it destroys planetary afflictions; / and with ten thousand of clarified butter, it pacifies distress caused by Vināyaka.

sanskrit_iast:
bhūtavedālaśāntistu guggulorayutena ca /
mahāvṛkṣasya bhaṅgetu vyālakaṅke(1) gṛhe sthite //
meaning:
भूतवेदालशान्तिस्तु गुग्गुलोरयुतेन च /
महावृक्षस्य भङ्गेतु व्यालकङ्के(1) गृहे स्थिते //
text_mt: Pacification of spirits and vetālas occurs with ten thousand of bdellium; / and when a great tree breaks, or when a snake or crow is stationed in the house,

sanskrit_iast:
āraṇyānāṃ praveśe dūrvājyākṣatahāvanāt /
ulkāpāte bhūmikampe tilājyenāhutācchivam //
meaning:
आरण्यानां प्रवेशे दूर्वाज्याक्षतहावनात् /
उल्कापाते भूमिकम्पे तिलाज्येनाहुताच्छिवम् //
text_mt: or when wild animals enter, [auspiciousness arises] from offering dūrvā grass, clarified butter, and unbroken grain into the fire; / at the fall of a meteor or an earthquake, peace comes from oblations of sesame and clarified butter.

sanskrit_iast:
raktasrāve tu vṛkṣāṇāmayutād gugguloḥ śivaṃ /
akāle phalapuṣpāṇāṃ rāṣṭrabhaṅge ca māraṇe //
meaning:
रक्तस्रावे तु वृक्षाणामयुताद् गुग्गुलोः शिवं /
अकाले फलपुष्पाणां राष्ट्रभङ्गे च मारणे //
text_mt: When trees bleed sap, peace comes from ten thousand [oblations] of bdellium; / at the unseasonable [blooming of] fruits and flowers, the ruin of a realm, and pestilence,

sanskrit_iast:
dvipadāderyadā māri lakṣārdhācca tilājyataḥ /
hastimārīpraśāntyarthaṃ kariṇīdantavardhane //
meaning:
द्विपदादेर्यदा मारि लक्षार्धाच्च तिलाज्यतः /
हस्तिमारीप्रशान्त्यर्थं करिणीदन्तवर्धने //
text_mt: when there is a plague among bipeds and the like, [it is averted] by fifty thousand [oblations] of sesame and clarified butter; / for the pacification of an elephant epidemic, when a female elephant grows tusks,

sanskrit_iast:
hastinyāṃ madadṛṣṭau ca ayutācchāntiriṣyate /
akāle garbhapāte tu jātaṃ yatra vinaśyati //
meaning:
हस्तिन्यां मददृष्टौ च अयुताच्छान्तिरिष्यते /
अकाले गर्भपाते तु जातं यत्र विनश्यति //
text_mt: and when rut is seen in a cow elephant, pacification is sought from ten thousand [oblations]; / and in unseasonable miscarriage, or where the newborn dies,

sanskrit_iast:
vikṛtā yatra jāyante yātrākāle 'yutaṃ hunet /
tilājyalakṣahomantu uttamāsiddhisādhane //
meaning:
विकृता यत्र जायन्ते यात्राकाले ऽयुतं हुनेत् /
तिलाज्यलक्षहोमन्तु उत्तमासिद्धिसाधने //
text_mt: or where deformed offspring are born, or at the time of a military expedition, one should offer ten thousand [oblations]; / but a fire oblation of one hundred thousand with sesame and clarified butter is for the attainment of the highest success.

sanskrit_iast:
madhyamāyāṃ tadardhena tatpādādadhamāsu ca /
yathā japas tathā homaḥ saṃgrāme vijayo bhavet /
aghorāstraṃ japennyasya dhyātvā pañcāsyamūrjitam //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe aghorāstrādiśāntikalpe nāma
viṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:n
1 vyālakāke iti kha..
:p 168
:ś athaikaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
pāśupataśāntiḥ
meaning:
मध्यमायां तदर्धेन तत्पादादधमासु च /
यथा जपस् तथा होमः संग्रामे विजयो भवेत् /
अघोरास्त्रं जपेन्न्यस्य ध्यात्वा पञ्चास्यमूर्जितम् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे अघोरास्त्रादिशान्तिकल्पे नाम
विंशत्यधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:न्
1 व्यालकाके इति ख..
:प् 168
:श् अथैकविंशत्यधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
पाशुपतशान्तिः
text_mt:
In middling [success], [it is attained] by half of that; and in inferior [successes], by a quarter of that. / As the recitation is, so is the fire oblation; victory in battle will arise; / having performed the ritual deposition and meditated on the five-faced, powerful [Śiva], one should recite the Aghorāstra.
Thus in the glorious Agni Purāṇa, the three hundred twentieth chapter, called 'The Rite of Pacification through the Aghorāstra and Other Weapons'.
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: Or "vyālakāke" in manuscript kha.]
Now the three hundred twenty-first chapter.
The Pacification Rite of the Pāśupata [Weapon].

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
vakṣye pāśupatāstreṇa śāntijāpādi pūrvataḥ /
pādataḥpūrvanāśo hi phaḍantaṃ cāpadādinut //
oṃ namo bhagavate mahāpāśupatāya atulabalavīryaparākramāya
tripañcanayanāya nānārūpāya nānāpraharaṇodyatāya
sarvāṅgaraktāya bhinnāñjanacayaprakhyāya śmaśānavetālapriyāya
sarvavighnanikṛntaratāya sarvasiddhipradāya bhaktānukampine
asaṃkhyavaktrabhujapādāya tasminsiddhāya vetālavitrāsine
śākinīkṣobhajanakāya vyādhinigrahakāriṇe pāpabhañjanāya
sūryasomāgninetrāya viṣṇukavacāya khaḍgavajrahastāya
yamadaṇḍavaruṇapāśāya rudraśūlāya jvalajjihvāya
sarvarogavidrāvaṇāya grahanigrahakāriṇe duṣṭanāgakṣayakāriṇe
oṃ kṛṣṇapiṅgalāya phaṭ / hūṃkārāstrāya phaṭ /

text_mt:
The Lord said: / I shall declare the pacification recitation and other rites with the Pāśupata weapon, beginning from the front. / Destruction of earlier [afflictions comes] from the feet; and [the mantra] ending in "phaṭ" dispels misfortunes and the like:
Oṃ, homage to the Blessed One, the Great Pāśupata, of unequalled strength, valour, and prowess, having fifteen eyes, possessing manifold forms, brandishing various weapons, red over all his limbs, resembling a mass of split collyrium, fond of cremation grounds and vetālas, delighting in cutting down all obstacles, bestower of all siddhis, compassionate to devotees, having innumerable faces, arms, and legs, accomplished therein, terrifying vetālas, causing agitation to śākinīs, repressing disease, breaker of sins, having the sun, moon, and fire as eyes, whose armour is Viṣṇu, sword and thunderbolt in hand, having the staff of Yama, the noose of Varuṇa, the trident of Rudra, a blazing tongue, putter to flight of all diseases, curber of planetary afflictions, destroyer of wicked serpents!
Oṃ, to the dark and tawny one, phaṭ! To the hūṃkāra weapon, phaṭ!
To the thunderbolt-handed one, phaṭ! To the spear, phaṭ! To the staff, phaṭ! To Yama, phaṭ!

text_mt:
And from a fire oblation of clarified butter and bdellium, one accomplishes even the unachievable; / and from reading the Pāśupata weapon, universal pacification will occur.
Thus in the glorious Agni Purāṇa, the three hundred twenty-first chapter, called 'The Pacification Rite of the Pāśupata [Weapon]'.
[Footnote]
[Footnote 1: Or "asādhyamapi" in manuscript kha.]
Now the three hundred twenty-second chapter.
The Six Limbs of the Aghorāstra.

Salutation! O great armor, by the command of Śiva, bind the heart, bind! Shake, shake! Pulverize, pulverize! O bearer of the subtle vajra, whose body is the vajra noose, the vajra bow, and the vajra thunderbolt, enter my body and paralyze all wicked ones, paralyze! Hūṃ!” / The armor [mantra] consists of one hundred and five syllables.

burn, burn! cook, cook! churn, churn! turu 2 aru 2 suru 2(1) / remember the Rudra-pacification, O Kṛṣṇapiṅgala! / Homage to the lord of the universe, the sovereign of timeless Piśācas!’ In the śiva-tattva, on the pericarp, / Umā and Maheśvara are indeed to be worshipped: ‘Oṃ, to the sky-pervader, to the one whose form is space, to the all-pervader, / to Śiva, to Ananta, to Anātha, to Anāśrita, to Śiva.’ In the śiva-tattva, nine words: / ‘We shall declare the sky-pervading [mantra]: to the eternal one, seated on the yoga-throne, perpetually / to the yogin, whose food is meditation, homage! / Oṃ, homage to Śiva, the source of all, / to Śiva, with Īśāna as head, having five faces beginning with Tatpuruṣa—nine words / on the eastern petal in the sadākhya [tattva] one should worship, O Guha; / to the Aghora-heart, to the Vāmadeva-privy-parts, / to the Sadyojāta-form; oṃ, homage, homage! / To the most secret of the secret, to the protector, to the deathless one, / to the lord of all yoga, whose form is light.’ On the Agni petal, in the īśa-tattva and vidyā-tattva, two; / on the southern [petal], to the supreme lord, the conscious and unconscious, sky-pervader, first light of lights; / in the māyā-tattva, in the southwest; in the kāla-tattva;

‘Presence of all, higher than Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra, unworshipped, unpraised, witness 2, / turu 2, bird, Piṅga 2, knowledge 2, sound 2, subtle 2, Śiva 2, bestower of all 2, / oṃ, homage to Śiva, oṃ homage, homage to Śiva, oṃ homage, homage!’
In the northeast, in the prākṛta-tattva, one should worship, offer oblations, and recite.
This pacifies the distress caused by planets, diseases, and māyā, and yields all perfections.
Thus ends the three hundred and twenty-third chapter, entitled “Pacification by Rudra,” in the great Āgneya Purāṇa.

meaning:
सिद्धः साध्यः सुशिद्धो ऽरिः संज्ञातो गणयेत् क्रमात् /
मन्त्रस्यादौ तथा चान्ते सिद्धिदः स्याच्छतांशतः //
text_mt: One should count in order from the name: siddha, sādhya, susiddha, and ari; / at the beginning and at the end of the mantra, it bestows success by a hundredth portion.

sanskrit_iast:
siddhādiścāntasiddhaś ca tatkṣaṇādeva sidhyati /
susiddhādiḥ susiddhantaḥsiddhavat parikalpayet //
meaning:
सिद्धादिश्चान्तसिद्धश् च तत्क्षणादेव सिध्यति /
सुसिद्धादिः सुसिद्धन्तःसिद्धवत् परिकल्पयेत् //
text_mt: A mantra that is siddha at the beginning and siddha at the end succeeds in that very moment; / one with susiddha at the beginning and susiddha at the end should be considered like siddha.

sanskrit_iast:
arimādau tathānte ca dūrataḥ parivarjayet /
siddhaḥ susiddhaś caikārthe ariḥ sādhyastathaiva ca //
meaning:
अरिमादौ तथान्ते च दूरतः परिवर्जयेत् /
सिद्धः सुसिद्धश् चैकार्थे अरिः साध्यस्तथैव च //
text_mt: One must avoid an enemy from afar, both at the beginning and at the end; / siddha and susiddha have the same result, and similarly ari and sādhya.

sanskrit_iast:
ādau siddhaḥ sthito mantre tadante tadvadeva hi /
madhye ripusahasrāṇi na doṣāya bhavanti hi //
meaning:
आदौ सिद्धः स्थितो मन्त्रे तदन्ते तद्वदेव हि /
मध्ये रिपुसहस्राणि न दोषाय भवन्ति हि //
text_mt: If a siddha is stationed at the beginning of the mantra and likewise at its end, / thousands of enemies in the middle indeed cause no harm.

sanskrit_iast:
māyāprasādapraṇavenāṃśakaḥ khyātamantrake /
brahmāṃśako brahmavidyā viṣṇvaṅgo(1) vaiṣṇavaḥsmṛtaḥ //
:n
1 viṣṇvaṃśa iti ña..
:p 178
meaning:
मायाप्रसादप्रणवेनांशकः ख्यातमन्त्रके /
ब्रह्मांशको ब्रह्मविद्या विष्ण्वङ्गो(1) वैष्णवःस्मृतः //
:न्
1 विष्ण्वंश इति ञ..
:प् 178
text_mt:
In a well-known mantra, the division is determined by māyā, prasāda, and praṇava; / Brahmā's division is the lore of Brahmā; Viṣṇu's portion is remembered as Vaiṣṇava.
[Footnote]
1. "viṣṇvaṃśa" in manuscript ña.. / :p 178

sanskrit_iast:
rudrāṃśako bhavedvīra indrāṃśaśceśvarapriyaḥ /
nāgāṃśo nāgastabdhākṣo yakṣāṃśo bhūṣaṇapriyaḥ //
meaning:
रुद्रांशको भवेद्वीर इन्द्रांशश्चेश्वरप्रियः /
नागांशो नागस्तब्धाक्षो यक्षांशो भूषणप्रियः //
text_mt: Rudra's portion makes one a hero; Indra's portion makes one dear to the lord; / the Nāga-portion has rigid eyes like a serpent; the Yakṣa-portion is fond of ornaments;

sanskrit_iast:
gandharvāṃśo 'tigītādi bhīmāṃśo rākṣasāṃśakaḥ /
dairyāṃśaḥ syād yuddhakāryo mānī vidyādharāṃśakaḥ //
meaning:
गन्धर्वांशो ऽतिगीतादि भीमांशो राक्षसांशकः /
दैर्यांशः स्याद् युद्धकार्यो मानी विद्याधरांशकः //
text_mt: the Gandharva-portion is exceedingly fond of singing; the fierce portion belongs to the Rākṣasas; / the Daitya-portion is inclined to battle; the Vidyādhara-portion is proud;

sanskrit_iast:
piśācāṃśo malākrānto mantraṃ dadyānnirīkṣya ca /
mantra ekāt phaḍantaḥ syāt vidyāpañcāśatāvadhi //
meaning:
पिशाचांशो मलाक्रान्तो मन्त्रं दद्यान्निरीक्ष्य च /
मन्त्र एकात् फडन्तः स्यात् विद्यापञ्चाशतावधि //
text_mt: the Piśāca-portion is overcome by impurity; having examined [this], one should impart the mantra. / A mantra ending in phaṭ may consist of one [syllable]; a vidyā extends up to fifty [syllables].

sanskrit_iast:
bālā viṃśākṣarāntā ca rudrā dvāviṃśagāyudhā /
tata ūrdhvantu ye mantrā dṛddhā yāvacchatatrayaṃ //
meaning:
बाला विंशाक्षरान्ता च रुद्रा द्वाविंशगायुधा /
तत ऊर्ध्वन्तु ये मन्त्रा दृद्धा यावच्छतत्रयं //
text_mt: A bālā-mantra ends at twenty syllables; a rudra-mantra, having weapons, at twenty-two; / the mantras that are beyond that, up to three hundred, are mature.

sanskrit_iast:
akārādihakārantāḥ kramāt pakṣau sitāsitau /
anusvāravisargeṇa vinā caiva svarā daśa //
meaning:
अकारादिहकारन्ताः क्रमात् पक्षौ सितासितौ /
अनुस्वारविसर्गेण विना चैव स्वरा दश //
text_mt: From the letter "a" to the letter "ha" are in succession the two fortnights, light and dark; / and without the nasal mark and visarga, there are ten vowels.

sanskrit_iast:
hrasvāḥ śuklā dīrghāḥ śyāmāṃstithayaḥpratipammukhāḥ /
udite śāntikādīni bhramite vaśyakādikam //
meaning:
ह्रस्वाः शुक्ला दीर्घाः श्यामांस्तिथयःप्रतिपम्मुखाः /
उदिते शान्तिकादीनि भ्रमिते वश्यकादिकम् //
text_mt: Short [vowels] are white, long ones are dark; the lunar days begin with pratipad; / when [the breath is] ascending, rites of pacification and the like [should be done]; when circulating, rites of subjugation and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
bhrāmite sandhayo dveṣoccāṭane stambhane 'stakam /
ihāvāhe śāntikādyaṃ piṅgale karṣaṇādikam(1) //
meaning:
भ्रामिते सन्धयो द्वेषोच्चाटने स्तम्भने ऽस्तकम् /
इहावाहे शान्तिकाद्यं पिङ्गले कर्षणादिकम्(1) //
text_mt: when rotated, junctions, enmity, eradication, and immobilization are the eightfold rites; / during the left flow, rites of pacification and the like; during the right flow, rites of attraction and the like;

sanskrit_iast:
māraṇoccāṭanādīni viṣuve pañcadhā pṛthak /
adharasya gṛhe pṛthvī ūrdhve tejo 'ntarā dravaḥ //
meaning:
मारणोच्चाटनादीनि विषुवे पञ्चधा पृथक् /
अधरस्य गृहे पृथ्वी ऊर्ध्वे तेजो ऽन्तरा द्रवः //
text_mt: liquidation, eradication, and so forth [are done] separately in five ways at the equinox; / in the lower chamber is earth, above is fire, and in between is liquid;

sanskrit_iast:
randhrapārśve vahirvāyuḥ sarvaṃ vyāpya maheśvaraḥ /
stambhanaṃ pārthive śāntirjale vaśyādi tejase /
vāyau syād bhramaṇaṃ śūnye puṇyaṃ kālaṃ samabhyaset //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe aṃśakādirnāma
caturviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
:n
1 karṣakādikamiti kha.. , cha.. ca
:p 179
:ś atha pañcaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
gauryādipūjā
meaning:
रन्ध्रपार्श्वे वहिर्वायुः सर्वं व्याप्य महेश्वरः /
स्तम्भनं पार्थिवे शान्तिर्जले वश्यादि तेजसे /
वायौ स्याद् भ्रमणं शून्ये पुण्यं कालं समभ्यसेत् //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे अंशकादिर्नाम
चतुर्विंशत्यधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
:न्
1 कर्षकादिकमिति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 179
:श् अथ पञ्चविंशत्यधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
गौर्यादिपूजा
text_mt:
at the side of the aperture, wind is outside; Maheśvara pervades everything; / immobilization is in the earthly, pacification in water, subjugation and the like in fire; / roaming occurs in wind; in the void, one should practice at an auspicious time.
Thus ends the three hundred and twenty-fourth chapter, entitled “The Divisions and Related Topics,” in the great Āgneya Purāṇa.
[Footnote]
[Reading note:] 'karṣakādikam' in MSS kha and cha. Page 179.
Now, the three hundred and twenty-fifth chapter.
Worship of Gaurī and others.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara uvāca
saubhāgyāderumāpūjāṃ vakṣye 'haṃ bhuktimuktidāṃ /
mantradhyānaṃ maṇḍalañca mudrāṃ homādisādhanam //
meaning:
ईश्वर उवाच
सौभाग्यादेरुमापूजां वक्ष्ये ऽहं भुक्तिमुक्तिदां /
मन्त्रध्यानं मण्डलञ्च मुद्रां होमादिसाधनम् //
text_mt: The Lord said: / I will explain the worship of Umā that brings good fortune and other [blessings], bestowing worldly enjoyment and liberation, / along with the mantra, meditation, maṇḍala, ritual gesture, and the means [consisting of] fire oblation and the rest.

sanskrit_iast:
citrabhānuṃ śivaṃ kālaṃ mahāśaktisamanvitam /
iḍādyaṃ paratodvṛtya sadevaḥ savikāraṇam //
meaning:
चित्रभानुं शिवं कालं महाशक्तिसमन्वितम् /
इडाद्यं परतोद्वृत्य सदेवः सविकारणम् //
text_mt: Taking the Fire [‘r’], Śiva [‘h’], Time [‘m’], joined with the Great Power [‘ī’], / and having extracted [the seed-syllable] after Iḍā and the rest, together with the deity and the transformations,

sanskrit_iast:
dvitīyaṃ dvārakākrāntaṃ gaurīprītipadānvitaṃ /
caturthyantaṃ prakartavyaṃ gauyyā vai mūlavācakaṃ //
oṃ hrīṃ saḥ śauṃ gauryai namaḥ
meaning:
द्वितीयं द्वारकाक्रान्तं गौरीप्रीतिपदान्वितं /
चतुर्थ्यन्तं प्रकर्तव्यं गौय्या वै मूलवाचकं //
ओं ह्रीं सः शौं गौर्यै नमः
text_mt:
and the second [syllable] accompanied by the dvārakā, endowed with the phrase that pleases Gaurī, / which should be formed ending in the dative case, as the expression of the basic mantra of Gaurī:
“Oṃ hrīṃ saḥ śauṃ gauryai namaḥ” (Oṃ hrīṃ saḥ śauṃ, homage to Gaurī).

sanskrit_iast:
tatrārṇatritayenaiva jātiyuktaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulam /
āsanaṃ praṇaveṇaiva mūrtiṃ vai hṛdayena tu //
meaning:
तत्रार्णत्रितयेनैव जातियुक्तं षडङ्गुलम् /
आसनं प्रणवेणैव मूर्तिं वै हृदयेन तु //
text_mt: There, having six angulas, accompanied by the caste with the triad of letters; / the seat [is deposited] with the Praṇava, and the icon indeed with the heart[-mantra].

sanskrit_iast:
udakāñca tathā kālaṃ śivavījaṃ samuddharet /
prāṇaṃ dīrghasvarākrāntaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaṃ jātisaṃyutam //
meaning:
उदकाञ्च तथा कालं शिववीजं समुद्धरेत् /
प्राणं दीर्घस्वराक्रान्तं षडङ्गं जातिसंयुतम् //
text_mt: One should likewise extract the water [syllable], Time, and the seed-syllable of Śiva; / [then] the vital breath accompanied by a long vowel, as the six limbs together with the caste[-formulas].

sanskrit_iast:
āsanaṃ praṇavenātra mūrtinyāsaṃ hṛdācaret /
yāmalaṃ kathitaṃ vatsa ekavīraṃ vadāmy atha //
meaning:
आसनं प्रणवेनात्र मूर्तिन्यासं हृदाचरेत् /
यामलं कथितं वत्स एकवीरं वदाम्य् अथ //
text_mt: The seat [is deposited] here with the Praṇava, and one should perform the ritual deposition of the icon with the heart[-mantra]. / The paired [rite] has been taught, O child; now I will declare the solitary hero [rite].

sanskrit_iast:
vyāpakaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃyuktaṃ vahnimāyākṛśānubhiḥ /
śivaśaktimayaṃ vījaṃ vījaṃ hṛdayādivivarjitaṃ //
meaning:
व्यापकं सृष्टिसंयुक्तं वह्निमायाकृशानुभिः /
शिवशक्तिमयं वीजं वीजं हृदयादिविवर्जितं //
text_mt: The pervasive [syllable] conjoined with creation, through Fire, Māyā, and the flame, / the seed-syllable consisting of Śiva and Śakti, the seed-syllable devoid of the heart and other [limbs].

sanskrit_iast:
gaurīṃ yajeddhemarūpyāṃ kāṣṭhajāṃ śailajādikāṃ /
pañcapiṇḍāṃ tathāvyaktāṃ koṇe madhye tu pañcamaṃ(1) //
meaning:
गौरीं यजेद्धेमरूप्यां काष्ठजां शैलजादिकां /
पञ्चपिण्डां तथाव्यक्तां कोणे मध्ये तु पञ्चमं(1) //
text_mt: One should worship Gaurī [as an icon] made of gold, silver, wood, stone, and the like; / or as five lumps, or unmanifest, [worshipping them] in the corner and the fifth in the center:

sanskrit_iast:
lalitā subhagā gaurī kṣobhaṇī cāgnitaḥ kramāt /
:n
1 pañcamī iti ña..
:p 180
vāmā jyeṣṭhā kriyā jñānā vṛtte pūrvādito yajet //
meaning:
ललिता सुभगा गौरी क्षोभणी चाग्नितः क्रमात् /
:न्
1 पञ्चमी इति ञ..
:प् 180
वामा ज्येष्ठा क्रिया ज्ञाना वृत्ते पूर्वादितो यजेत् //
text_mt:
Lalitā, Subhagā, Gaurī, and Kṣobhaṇī, in order, starting from the southeast.
[Footnote]
[Reading note:] 'pañcamī' in MS ña. Page 180.
In the circular [area], starting from the east, one should worship Vāmā, Jyeṣṭhā, Kriyā, and Jñānā.

sanskrit_iast:
sapīṭhe vāmabhāge tu śivasyāvyaktarūpakam /
vyaktā dvinetrā tryakṣarā śuddhā vā śaṅkarānvitā //
meaning:
सपीठे वामभागे तु शिवस्याव्यक्तरूपकम् /
व्यक्ता द्विनेत्रा त्र्यक्षरा शुद्धा वा शङ्करान्विता //
text_mt: On the left side of the pedestal, [one should place] the unmanifest form of Śiva; / or the manifest one, two-eyed, of three syllables, pure, or accompanied by Śaṅkara,

sanskrit_iast:
pīṭhapadmadvayaṃ tārā dvibhujā vā caturbhajā /
siṃhasthā vā vṛkasthā(1) vā aṣṭāṣṭādaśasatkarā //
meaning:
पीठपद्मद्वयं तारा द्विभुजा वा चतुर्भजा /
सिंहस्था वा वृकस्था(1) वा अष्टाष्टादशसत्करा //
text_mt: having a pedestal and two lotuses, luminous, with two arms or four arms, / seated upon a lion or seated upon a wolf, with eight or eighteen auspicious hands,

sanskrit_iast:
sragakṣasūtrakalikā galakotpalapiṇḍikā /
śaraṃ dhanurvā savyena pāṇinānyatamaṃ vahat //
meaning:
स्रगक्षसूत्रकलिका गलकोत्पलपिण्डिका /
शरं धनुर्वा सव्येन पाणिनान्यतमं वहत् //
text_mt: holding a garland, a rosary, an unblown flower bud, a neck ornament, a blue lotus, a ball of food, / an arrow, or a bow, carrying any one with the right hand,

sanskrit_iast:
vāmena pustatāmbūladaṇḍābhayakamaṇḍalum /
gaṇeśadarpaṇeṣvāsāndadyādekaikaśaḥ kramāt //
meaning:
वामेन पुस्तताम्बूलदण्डाभयकमण्डलुम् /
गणेशदर्पणेष्वासान्दद्यादेकैकशः क्रमात् //
text_mt: and with the left hand a book, betel, a staff, the gesture of fearlessness, and a water-pot. / One should place Gaṇeśa, a mirror, and a bow one by one in succession.

sanskrit_iast:
vyaktāvyaktāthavā kāryā padmamudrā smṛtāsane /
tiṅgamudrā śivasyoktā mudā cāvāhanī dvayoḥ //
meaning:
व्यक्ताव्यक्ताथवा कार्या पद्ममुद्रा स्मृतासने /
तिङ्गमुद्रा शिवस्योक्ता मुदा चावाहनी द्वयोः //
text_mt: Or she should be made manifest-unmanifest; the lotus-mudrā is remembered for the seat. / The liṅga-mudrā is taught for Śiva, and the invocation mudrā for both of them.

sanskrit_iast:
śaktimudrā tu yonyākhyā caturasrantu maṇḍalaṃ /
caturasraṃ tripatrābjaṃ madhyakoṣṭhacatuṣṭaye //
meaning:
शक्तिमुद्रा तु योन्याख्या चतुरस्रन्तु मण्डलं /
चतुरस्रं त्रिपत्राब्जं मध्यकोष्ठचतुष्टये //
text_mt: The Śakti-mudrā is called the Yoni[-mudrā]. The maṇḍala is square; / a square three-petaled lotus is in the four central compartments.

sanskrit_iast:
tryaśrordhe cārdhacandrastu dvipadaṃ dviguṇaṃ kramāt /
dviguṇaṃ dvārakaṇṭhantu dviguṇādupakaṇṭhataḥ //
meaning:
त्र्यश्रोर्धे चार्धचन्द्रस्तु द्विपदं द्विगुणं क्रमात् /
द्विगुणं द्वारकण्ठन्तु द्विगुणादुपकण्ठतः //
text_mt: Above the triangle is a crescent moon, progressively two padas, doubled; / doubled at the neck of the doorway, doubled from the outer neck,

sanskrit_iast:
dvāratrayaṃ trayaṃ dikṣu atha vā bhadrake yajet /
sthaṇḍile vātha saṃsyāpya pañcagavyāmṛtādinā //
meaning:
द्वारत्रयं त्रयं दिक्षु अथ वा भद्रके यजेत् /
स्थण्डिले वाथ संस्याप्य पञ्चगव्यामृतादिना //
text_mt: with three doorways, three in the cardinal directions; or one should worship upon a bhadraka [maṇḍala], / or having established [the icon] on an altar with the five products of the cow, nectar, and the rest,

sanskrit_iast:
raktapuṣpāṇi deyāni pūjayitvā hy udaṅmukhaḥ /
śataṃ hutvāmṛtājyañca pūrṇādaḥ sarvasiddhibhāk //
meaning:
रक्तपुष्पाणि देयानि पूजयित्वा ह्य् उदङ्मुखः /
शतं हुत्वामृताज्यञ्च पूर्णादः सर्वसिद्धिभाक् //
text_mt: red flowers are to be offered. Having worshipped facing north, / and having offered a hundred oblations of nectar and clarified butter, one who offers the complete oblation enjoys all perfections.

sanskrit_iast:
balindatvā kumārīś ca tisro vā cāṣṭa bhojayet(2) /
naivedyaṃ śivabhakteṣu dadyānna svayamācaret //
:n
1 siṃhasthāvāhyasiṃhastheti kha.. , cha.. , ña.. , ṭa.. ca

:p 181
meaning:
बलिन्दत्वा कुमारीश् च तिस्रो वा चाष्ट भोजयेत्(2) /
नैवेद्यं शिवभक्तेषु दद्यान्न स्वयमाचरेत् //
:न्
1 सिंहस्थावाह्यसिंहस्थेति ख.. , छ.. , ञ.. , ट.. च
2 स्त्रियो वाष्ट च भोजयेदिति ख.. , छ.. च
:प् 181
text_mt:
Having offered an animal sacrifice, one should feed three or eight maiden girls. / One should distribute the food offering among the devotees of Śiva and not consume it oneself.
[Footnote]
[Reading note:] 'siṃhasthāvāhyasiṃhasthā' in MSS kha, cha, ña, and ṭa.
[Reading note:] 'striyo vāṣṭa ca bhojayet' in MSS kha and cha. Page 181.

sanskrit_iast:
kanyārthau labhate kanyāṃ aputraḥ putramāpnuyāt /
durbhagā caiva saubhāgyaṃ rājā rājyaṃ jayaṃ raṇe //
meaning:
कन्यार्थौ लभते कन्यां अपुत्रः पुत्रमाप्नुयात् /
दुर्भगा चैव सौभाग्यं राजा राज्यं जयं रणे //
text_mt: One who desires a maiden obtains a maiden; one without a son obtains a son; / an unfortunate woman [obtains] good fortune; a king obtains a kingdom and victory in battle.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭalakṣaiś ca vāksiddhirdevādyā vaśamāpnuyuḥ /
na nivedya na cāsnīyādvāmahastena cārcayet //
meaning:
अष्टलक्षैश् च वाक्सिद्धिर्देवाद्या वशमाप्नुयुः /
न निवेद्य न चास्नीयाद्वामहस्तेन चार्चयेत् //
text_mt: With eight hundred thousand [recitations], one achieves perfection of speech, and the gods and others come under control. / One should never eat without having first offered [the food], and one should worship with the left hand.

sanskrit_iast:
aṣṭamyāñca caturdaśyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ /
mṛtyuñcayārcanaṃ vakṣye pūjayet kalasodare //
meaning:
अष्टम्याञ्च चतुर्दश्यां तृतीयायां विशेषतः /
मृत्युञ्चयार्चनं वक्ष्ये पूजयेत् कलसोदरे //
text_mt: On the eighth, the fourteenth, and especially on the third lunar day, / I will declare the worship of the Conqueror of Death (Mṛtyuñjaya); one should worship inside a water jar.

sanskrit_iast:
hūyamānañca praṇavo mūrtirojasa īdṛśaṃ /
mūlañca vauṣaḍantena kumbhamudrāṃ pradarśayet //
meaning:
हूयमानञ्च प्रणवो मूर्तिरोजस ईदृशं /
मूलञ्च वौषडन्तेन कुम्भमुद्रां प्रदर्शयेत् //
text_mt: The oblation and the Praṇava; the icon of vigor is of such a nature; / and the root mantra ending in ‘vauṣaṭ’; one should display the water-pot mudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
homayet kṣīradurvājyamamṛtāñca punarnavām /
pāyasañca purāḍāśamayutantu japenmanuṃ //
meaning:
होमयेत् क्षीरदुर्वाज्यममृताञ्च पुनर्नवाम् /
पायसञ्च पुराडाशमयुतन्तु जपेन्मनुं //
text_mt: One should offer into the fire milk, dūrvā grass, clarified butter, amṛtā, and punarnavā, / as well as milk-rice and sacrificial cake, and recite the mantra ten thousand times.

sanskrit_iast:
caturmukhaṃ caturvāhuṃ dvābhyāñca kalasandadhat /
varadābhayakaṃ dvābhyāṃ snāyādvaikumbhamudrayā //
meaning:
चतुर्मुखं चतुर्वाहुं द्वाभ्याञ्च कलसन्दधत् /
वरदाभयकं द्वाभ्यां स्नायाद्वैकुम्भमुद्रया //
text_mt: Four-faced, four-armed, holding a water jar with two [hands], / and [bestowing] the boon and fearlessness with two, one should bathe with the water-pot mudrā.

sanskrit_iast:
ārogyaiś caryadīrghāyurauṣadhaṃ mantritaṃ śubham /
apamṛtyuharo dhyātaḥ pūjito 'dbhuta eva saḥ //
:e ity āgneye mahāpurāṇe gauryādipūjā nāma
pañcaviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||
:ś atha ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikatriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ
devālayamāhātmyam
meaning:
आरोग्यैश् चर्यदीर्घायुरौषधं मन्त्रितं शुभम् /
अपमृत्युहरो ध्यातः पूजितो ऽद्भुत एव सः //
:ए इत्य् आग्नेये महापुराणे गौर्यादिपूजा नाम
पञ्चविंशत्यधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः ||
:श् अथ षड्विंशत्यधिकत्रिशततमो ऽध्यायः
देवालयमाहात्म्यम्
text_mt:
Health, prosperity, long life, and blessed consecrated medicine [are attained]; / meditated upon and worshipped, he is indeed wondrous, dispelling untimely death.
Thus in the great Agni Purāṇa, the three hundred and twenty-fifth chapter, entitled 'The Worship of Gaurī and Others.'
Now, the three hundred and twenty-sixth chapter.
The Greatness of the Temple.

sanskrit_iast:
īśvara+uvāca
vrateśvarāṃś ca satyādīniṣṭvā vratasamarpaṇam /
ariṣṭaśamane śastamariṣṭaṃ sūtranāyakam //
:p 182
meaning:
ईश्वर+उवाच
व्रतेश्वरांश् च सत्यादीनिष्ट्वा व्रतसमर्पणम् /
अरिष्टशमने शस्तमरिष्टं सूत्रनायकम् //
:प् 182
text_mt:
The Lord said: / Having worshipped the lords of vows, Satya and the others, the dedication of the vow [is made]. / The soapberry bead as the central bead of a rosary is praised for the pacification of calamities;
Page 182.

sanskrit_iast:
hemaratramayaṃ bhūtyai mahāśaṅkhañca māraṇe /
āpyāyane śaṅkhasūtraṃ mauktikaṃ putravardhanam //
meaning:
हेमरत्रमयं भूत्यै महाशङ्खञ्च मारणे /
आप्यायने शङ्खसूत्रं मौक्तिकं पुत्रवर्धनम् //
text_mt: a [rosary] made of gold and gems brings prosperity, and a great conch shell [is used] in rites of killing; / a rosary of conch brings nourishment, and one of pearls increases sons;

sanskrit_iast:
sphāṭikaṃ bhūtidaṃ kauśaṃ muktidaṃ(1) rudranetrajaṃ /
dhādhīphalapramāṇena rudrākṣaṃ cottamantataḥ //
meaning:
स्फाटिकं भूतिदं कौशं मुक्तिदं(1) रुद्रनेत्रजं /
धाधीफलप्रमाणेन रुद्राक्षं चोत्तमन्ततः //
text_mt: one of crystal brings prosperity; one of kuśa grass brings liberation; one born of the eye of Rudra (rudrākṣa), / a rudrākṣa with the size of an āmalaka fruit, is the best among them.

sanskrit_iast:
sameruṃ meruhīnaṃ vā sūtraṃ japyantu mānasam /
anāmāṅguṣṭhamākramya japaṃ bhāṣyantu kārayet //
meaning:
समेरुं मेरुहीनं वा सूत्रं जप्यन्तु मानसम् /
अनामाङ्गुष्ठमाक्रम्य जपं भाष्यन्तु कारयेत् //
text_mt: With a meru bead or without a meru bead, the string [is used] for mental recitation. / Gripping with the ring finger and the thumb, one should perform spoken recitation;

sanskrit_iast:
tarjanyaṅguṣṭhamākramya na meruṃ laṅghyejjape /
pramādāt patite sūtre japtavyantu śatadvayam //
meaning:
तर्जन्यङ्गुष्ठमाक्रम्य न मेरुं लङ्घ्येज्जपे /
प्रमादात् पतिते सूत्रे जप्तव्यन्तु शतद्वयम् //
text_mt: gripping with the forefinger and the thumb, one must not cross over the meru in recitation. / If the rosary falls through carelessness, two hundred [recitations] must be performed.

sanskrit_iast:
sarvavādyamayī ghaṇṭā tasyā vādanamarthakṛt /
gośakṛnmūtravalmīkamṛttikābhasmavāribhiḥ //
meaning:
सर्ववाद्यमयी घण्टा तस्या वादनमर्थकृत् /
गोशकृन्मूत्रवल्मीकमृत्तिकाभस्मवारिभिः //
text_mt: The bell consists of all musical instruments; ringing it produces wealth. / With cow dung, cow urine, anthill earth, ashes, and water,

sanskrit_iast:
vesmāyatanaliṅgādeḥ kāryamevaṃ viśodhanam /
skando namaḥ śivāyeti mantraḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ //
meaning:
वेस्मायतनलिङ्गादेः कार्यमेवं विशोधनम् /
स्कन्दो नमः शिवायेति मन्त्रः सर्वार्थसाधकः //
text_mt: such purification of a temple, dwelling, liṅga, and the like must be performed. / O Skanda, the mantra ‘Homage to Śiva’ accomplishes all aims;

sanskrit_iast:
gītaḥ pañcākṣaro vede loke gītaḥṣaḍakṣaraḥ /
omityante sthitaḥ śambhurmudrārthaṃ vaṭavījavat //
meaning:
गीतः पञ्चाक्षरो वेदे लोके गीतःषडक्षरः /
ओमित्यन्ते स्थितः शम्भुर्मुद्रार्थं वटवीजवत् //
text_mt: it is sung as five-syllabled in the Veda, and sung as six-syllabled in the world. / At the end of ‘oṃ’ stands Śambhu, for the purpose of the seal, like the seed of a banyan tree.

sanskrit_iast:
kramānnamaḥ śivāyeti īśānādyāni vai viduḥ /
ṣaḍakṣarasya sūtrasya bhāṣyadvidyākadambakaṃ //
meaning:
क्रमान्नमः शिवायेति ईशानाद्यानि वै विदुः /
षडक्षरस्य सूत्रस्य भाष्यद्विद्याकदम्बकं //
text_mt: In order, ‘namaḥ śivāya’ is known [to represent] Īśāna and the other [faces]. / The collection of sciences is explained through the six-syllabled string [of letters].

sanskrit_iast:
yadoṃnamaḥ śivāyeti etāvat paramaṃ padam /
anena pūjayelliṅgaṃ liṅge yasmāt sthitaḥ śivaḥ //
meaning:
यदोंनमः शिवायेति एतावत् परमं पदम् /
अनेन पूजयेल्लिङ्गं लिङ्गे यस्मात् स्थितः शिवः //
text_mt: That which is ‘oṃ namaḥ śivāya’ is the supreme state to this extent. / With this one should worship the liṅga, because Śiva resides in the liṅga,

sanskrit_iast:
anugrahāya lokānāṃ dharmakāmārthamuktidaḥ /
yo na pūjayate liṅganna sa dharmādibhājanaṃ //
meaning:
